title_en: Finite space work order optimization method and system based on intelligent well lid
abstract_en: The invention provides a limited space work order optimization method and a limited space work order optimization system based on an intelligent well lid, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and are used for determining an abnormal well lid coordinate set in a target management and control area, carrying out busyness recognition on a single person, outputting busyness index set, identifying a person smaller than preset busyness, positioning a real-time position coordinate set, carrying out limited space area decomposition on the target management and control area by combining an area decomposition algorithm, carrying out regional management on an output area decomposition result, solving the technical problem that the management is wide in the prior art, which causes that the dispatch management in the area cannot be reasonably balanced, so that the operation and maintenance timeliness of the intelligent well lid is limited.
assignees: BEIJING TIANHENG ANKE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine risk early warning system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to a coal mine risk early warning system based on big data analysis, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data storage module, a data processing module, a risk assessment module and an early warning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring data in coal mine operation in real time, the data storage module is configured to store historical data records acquired by the data acquisition module, the data processing module is used for processing the stored data and identifying potential risk factors by adopting a big data analysis technology, the risk assessment module is used for assessing risk levels of the coal mine operation according to analysis results of the data processing module, the risk levels comprise low, medium and high levels, and the early warning module is used for sending early warning signals to related personnel when the risk levels reach a preset threshold value. The method can collect multidimensional data in the coal mine in real time, and realize safety risk early warning of the coal mine environment through data processing, analysis and evaluation models. The system has the advantages of high-efficiency data acquisition, accurate risk assessment, timely early warning and emergency response capability, and effectively improves the safety of coal mine operation.

title_en: Information gathering method and system based on network security threat
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network security, in particular to a method and a system for collecting information based on network security threat, comprising the following steps: based on the network security threat information, extracting network attacker and attack mode, identifying and classifying the attacker identification and the target type, and carrying out standardized processing on the data to obtain a standardized threat behavior data set. According to the invention, the security event log and the attack behavior information in the intrusion detection alarm are extracted, the main guest structure is analyzed, the data standardization is realized, the identification accuracy of the identity and the attack mode of an attacker is improved, the attack chain is integrated, the information consistency and the path identification accuracy are enhanced, the calculation of the target co-occurrence probability and the consistency weight is utilized, the event merging is optimized, the information redundancy is reduced, the time dependence relationship of the behavior nodes is analyzed, the similar attack path is induced, the identification capability of the attack mode is improved, the priority of the path is ordered according to the node weight value, the high-risk chain is screened, the emergency response is focused, and the security defense efficiency is improved.

title_en: Reservoir emergency management system
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir emergency management system, which belongs to the technical field of reservoir emergency management and comprises an emergency plan management module for managing an emergency plan of reservoir operation, a plan exercise management module for managing an exercise process of the emergency plan of reservoir operation, an emergency material management module for managing emergency materials of reservoir operation, a standby power supply management module for managing standby power supplies of reservoir operation, an on-duty management module for managing on-duty plans, attendance conditions and on-duty records of on-duty personnel of reservoir operation, and an emergency response module for acquiring the on-duty plans to inquire on-duty personnel when the reservoir operation meets the triggering condition of the emergency plan, inquiring and locking the standby power supplies and the emergency materials required to be used according to the content of the emergency plan and notifying the on-duty personnel. The invention not only improves the efficiency and effect of reservoir emergency management, but also enhances the executability of an emergency plan, provides powerful protection for the safe operation of the reservoir, and improves the emergency management level.
assignees: INSPUR SMART TECH INNOVATION SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Weapon escort route dynamic optimization and risk early warning platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of intelligent security and path planning and discloses a weapon escort route dynamic optimization and risk early warning platform which comprises a multi-mode data acquisition module, a dynamic risk assessment module, a quantum collaborative optimization module, a hypergraph emergency response module, a strategy collaborative updating module and a strategy collaborative updating module, wherein the multi-channel space-time characteristic tensor is constructed by integrating traffic flow, geographic elevation and threat public opinion data through space-time alignment and tensor filling, the dynamic risk assessment module generates a dynamic risk field based on balanced solution of an anti-game model and Nash, quantifies a risk gradient under an attacker strategy, the quantum collaborative optimization module generates quantum parameters through tensor hidden variable decomposition, solves a multi-target optimal route by combining a quantum annealing algorithm, the hypergraph emergency response module reconstructs a mutually exclusive redundant route and feeds back an updating strategy space when detecting a super-threshold risk, and the strategy collaborative updating module fuses the risk gradient and game utility to generate a combined rewarding signal so as to drive a reinforced learning model to dynamically optimize a decision strategy. The invention improves the safety, efficiency and reliability of escort tasks.
assignees: SHIJIAZHUANG SECURITY SERVICE GROUP GUOXIN NURSING GUARD CO LTD

title_en: Task profile automatic generation system oriented to simulation deduction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task profile automatic generation system for simulation deduction, which comprises a data structure construction module, a profile mathematical constraint model construction module and a profile visualization module, wherein the data structure construction module is used for analyzing relevant input data of a current task according to given task information in combination with simulation deduction requirements, the profile mathematical constraint model construction module is used for constructing a mathematical constraint model for task arrangement according to task type sequence and time constraint conditions, the task profile data generation module is used for calculating the take-off time, landing time and wave number of each task based on the constructed mathematical constraint model to generate structured task profile data, and the profile visualization module is used for constructing a profile visualization interface based on the structured task profile data. The method effectively solves the defects of the traditional method in the aspects of task arrangement efficiency, time precision control and dynamic adaptability, and can remarkably improve the success rate and timeliness of concurrent execution of multiple tasks in the scenes of deck flight task formulation, emergency command and the like.

title_en: Cctv led sensor lamp with emergency lighting
title_ko: 비상조명 겸용 cctv led 센서등
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency light and CCTV LED sensor light which has a structure in which an emergency power source unit having a battery unit and an explosion-proof case protecting a control means of a CCTV camera module are installed. The present invention supplies emergency power source from a battery unit in case of emergency such as power supply cut-off, fire, and the like to induce evacuation in a state of turning on a sensor light during a golden time, and verify an emergency situation after taking an accident by recording an image.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 비상조명 겸용 CCTV LED 센서등은, 배터리부를 구비한 비상 전원부와 CCTV 카메라 모듈의 제어수단을 보호하는 방폭 케이스가 설치되는 구조이기 때문에 전원공급 차단 및 화재 등의 비상 상황시 배터리부로부터 비상 전원을 공급하여 골든타임 동안 센서등이 점등된 상태로 피난을 유도할 수 있음과 동시에 영상을 녹화하여 사고 조치후 비상 상황을 검증할 수 있는 것임.

title_en: Method for evaluating road safety and apparatus for executing the method
title_ko: 도로 안전성 평가 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for evaluating road safety and an apparatus for performing the same. According to one embodiment, the method for evaluating road safety, which is performed in a computing device having one or more processors and memory storing one or more programs executed by the one or more processors, comprises the steps of: collecting traffic accident-related information including one or more among a traffic damage level, traffic volume information, and weather information in relation to a traffic accident having occurred on a predetermined road; collecting road-related information of a road; dividing the road into a plurality of sections based on the road-related information; and predicting the degree of risk for each section of the road by using the traffic accident-related information and the road-related information as input variables of a random forest model. Therefore, the present invention can more accurately predict the degree of risk of a corresponding road section.
abstract_ko: 도로 안전성 평가 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 컴퓨팅 장치가 개시된다. 개시되는 일 실시예에 따른 도로 안전성 평가 방법은, 하나 이상의 프로세서들, 및 하나 이상의 프로세서들에 의해 실행되는 하나 이상의 프로그램들을 저장하는 메모리를 구비한 컴퓨팅 장치에서 수행되는 방법으로서, 소정 도로에서 발생한 교통 사고와 관련하여 교통 피해 정도, 교통량 정보, 및 날씨 정보 중 하나 이상을 포함하는 교통 사고 관련 정보를 수집하는 단계, 도로의 도로 관련 정보를 수집하는 단계, 도로 관련 정보를 기반으로 도로를 복수 개의 구간으로 구분하는 단계, 및 교통 사고 관련 정보 및 도로 관련 정보를 랜덤 포레스트(Random Forest) 모델의 입력 변수로 하여 도로의 각 구간 별 위험도를 예측하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: GEON YEONG ENG & CONSULTANT CO LTD

title_en: An automated emergency response system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automated emergency response system (100) with direct police connectivity. The automated emergency response system (100) is a comprehensive solution for real-time transmission and storage of critical information during emergencies. Upon activation, the system (100) captures images, records audio, and video, and enables users to compose text messages via a graphical interface. Additionally, the system (100) tracks the user's location in real-time. The central processing unit (124) manages the activation of modules and transmission of data to emergency contacts, while a communication module (126) ensures seamless connectivity for transmitting data. The system (100) also includes an alert generating unit (128) for signaling emergencies and an interface for notifying designated contacts based on the user's geo-location and socket technology. The system (100) provides a comprehensive solution for enhancing user safety during emergencies.
assignees: Singh Niketa;SINGH RAJPUT ASHWANI KUMAR;SINGH UTTAM;SINGH SAVITA

title_en: Method and system for communicating information associated with an incident to a designated government public safety agency
abstract_en: A method and system for communicating information associated with an incident to a designated government public safety agency. Displaying a plurality of selectable icons each associated with a type of criminal offense on the display of the device for the user to select the type of criminal offense associated with the incident, displaying on the display of the device a text box and/or at least one other selectable option for allowing the user to optionally take or select a photo, a video, or an audio recording associated with the incident. Preparing and transmitting a message to a receiving system of the designated government public safety agency, the message including one or more of the user identification and/or contact information, the location-based information, the selected type of criminal offense, text information associated with the incident, photo information associated with the incident, video information associated with the incident.

title_en: Virtual Private Cloud Network Providing Emergency Data To Emergency Service Networks
abstract_en: A disclosed method of operating an emergency data management system includes: obtaining emergency data related to an emergency call to an emergency communication center (ECC) by a cloud server of the emergency data management system independent from the ECC; obtaining an address for the emergency call via a connectivity device located at the ECC, where the connectivity device is operatively coupled to the cloud server; matching the address to an ECC computer-aided-dispatch (CAD) system incident record address; and sending the emergency data to the ECC CAD system incident record corresponding to the matched CAD system incident record address.

title_en: Structural health monitoring of wind turbine blades using wireless acoustic sensing
abstract_en: Systems and methods for detecting damage or defects in wind turbine blades are described. In one embodiment, a sound receiver interior to the blade is used to listen for noise that is associated with the presence of damage or defects that interact with air flowing over the exterior of the blade. In another embodiment, a sound source located within the blade generates sound that is received by one or more sound receivers external to the blade. The received sounds are communicated wirelessly to a data processing system that analyzes the sound data. The results can be recorded, displayed, or transmitted for further processing. The systems have detected cracks and holes as small as one millimeter in diameter. One advantage of the system is that it makes possible preventive maintenance on an as needed or preplanned (scheduled) basis, rather than as an emergency response to turbine blade failure.

title_en: Power grid dispatcher training simulation method and system based on cloud technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a power grid dispatcher training simulation method and system based on a cloud technology, relates to the field of power grids, and aims to solve the technical problems of low resource utilization rate and high cost of the existing power grid dispatcher training simulation, improve the resource utilization rate and reduce the cost. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a teaching group establishing instruction of an instructor through an instructor client; the instruction for creating the teaching group carries group teaching information comprising a group information table and a group member information table; sending a first record request to a cloud server according to a teaching group creating instruction so that the cloud server adds a first record to a group table of a group teaching interaction database and adds a second record to a group member table of the group teaching interaction database; receiving a group entering request which carries a group name and is sent by a student through a student client; and sending a second record request to the cloud server according to the group entering request so that the cloud server adds a third record to a group member table of the group teaching interaction database.

title_en: Automatic safety protection system and method for wafer defect detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wafer defect detection, in particular to an automatic safety protection system and method for wafer defect detection equipment, which mainly comprise a hardware automatic protection system and a software monitoring and recording system, the hardware automatic protection system comprises a safety door state monitoring module, a safety door bypass module, an emergency response module, a vacuum state monitoring module, a compressed air state monitoring module, an automatic protection processing module, a motion control module and a light source control module. The system completely depends on hardware to realize an automatic safety protection function. The automatic protection process has no intervention of upper computer software or embedded software, and ensures real-time, rapid and reliable safety protection response. After the automatic protection is triggered, an operator confirms that the safety risk is relieved and the automatic protection system keeps the triggering state unchanged before the manual intervention operation is performed. Meanwhile, special application requirements of equipment maintenance personnel in equipment debugging and maintenance processes through professional training are met through control of the bypass switch.

title_en: .System for accepting of emergency rescue notice reporting criminal act using digital images with GPS or LBS information and method thereof
title_ko: 전자적 위치 측지 정보가 기록된 디지털 사진을 이용한긴급 구조, 범죄 신고 접수 자동화 방법 및 시스템.
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 이동통신단말기(일반적으로 휴대폰)에 부착된 카메라와 GPS 혹은 LBS와 같은 전자적 위치 측지 기능(일반적으로 GPS를 이용한 위치 측지 기능)을 이용하여 긴급 구조/범죄 신고와 접수를 자동화하는 방법 및 시스템의 설계이다. 
     본 고안의 목적은 긴급 구조/범죄 신고시 사건/사고의 현장을 사진을 통해 보다 직관적으로 알림과 동시에 긴급 구조/범죄 신고를 자동화하는 것이 첫째 목적이며, 112나 119와 같이 음성을 통해 긴급 구조/범죄 신고의 접수가 이루어지는 시스템의 사용자들이 겪을 수 있는, 음성을 통해 신고자의 상황과 구조/범죄의 내용을 전달 할 수 없는 상황에 대한 대처가 둘째 목적이다. 
     본 고안에서 구현하고자 하는 시스템은 디지털 사진 촬영 장치와 전자적 위치 측지 기능이 부착된 이동통신단말기에 디지털 사진 촬영과 위치 정보의 기록의 역할을 수행하는 긴급 구조/범죄 신고 응용프로그램을 설치하고, 촬영된 디지털 사진에 위치정보와 신고자의 전화번호를 기록하고 무선 인터넷 망을 통해 긴급 구조/범죄 신고 접수 자동화 시스템에 전송한다. 긴급 구조/범죄 신고 응용프로그램으로부터 사진을 전송받은 긴급 구조/범죄 신고 접수 자동화 시스템은 사진 속에 기록된 위치정보와 사용자 전화번호를 추출하고 이 정보를 이용하여 긴급 구조/범죄 신고 접수를 자동화하는 서버 측 시스템을 구성된다. 
       
     신고, 구조,  GPS, 사진, Exif, 휴대폰, 이동통신단말기, 무선 인터넷

title_en: Intelligent injector for intrusion fight and fire suppression having recording function
title_ko: 기록 기능을 구비한 침입퇴치 및 화재진압을 위한 지능형분사장치
abstract_ko:
같은 공간에서 침입과 화재가 언제든 발생할 수 있으나 대응은 침입에 대해 주로 수동적 대응방법(카메라, 녹화)을 적용했고 화재에 대해서는 법규에 정한 최소한의 시설만을 설치하였다. 또한, 능동적(적극적) 대응방법을 적용하고자 해도 장치의 동작상태와 동작여부(오동작 포함)에 대한 확인이 불가능한 경우가 있어 소비자가 도입 자체를 꺼리는 것이 현실이다. 
본 발명은 
능동적(적극적) 대응방법으로 전환할 수 있도록 연막분사장치, 그물망발사장치, 소방법규상 자진설비에 해당하는 소화장치에 
- 감지기술을 적용하여 동작할 수 있는 기본신호를 만들어 내고 
- 제어기술을 이용하여 이들 장치를 통제하고 결합할 수 있는 기술을 제공하고 
-동작상태와 동작여부를 확인할 수 있는 영상, 소리, 충격에 대한 기록이 가능(자체기록, 원격기록)하도록 기술을 제공하고 
-일정구역에 물품도난 방지 및 방범/방재가 가능하도록 ID인식기술과 상기 기술을 결합하여 
같은 공간에서 발생할 수 있는 침입사고와 화재사고에 능동적인 방법으로 저비용 
으로 초기에 대응할 수 있도록 하고자 한다.

title_en: Method for visualizing, device, server and the storage medium of fire-fighting event procedure
abstract_en: The present invention is suitable for technical field of fire safety, provides a kind of method for visualizing of fire-fighting event procedure, this method includes：Fire-fighting incident visualization instructs；When detecting the visible instructions, the process record data of the corresponding current fire-fighting event of the visible instructions are obtained；Analytic process records data, extracts the time range of each significant node in fire-fighting event procedure；It is the first display area and the second display area by displaying boundary division；The time shaft for being labelled with all significant node time ranges is generated, each significant node marks on a timeline successively in chronological order, and is shown in the first display area；The corresponding fire-fighting data of current point in time on time shaft are illustrated in the second display area.The present invention, by by boundary division region, being associated with the fire-fighting data of each significant node in fire-fighting event procedure in a manner of time shaft, information displaying is intuitive, convenient for understanding the overall development situation of a certain specific fire-fighting event.

title_en: Skid-mounted hazardous waste intelligent storage management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a skid-mounted hazardous waste intelligent storage management system, which comprises a storage warehouse and a cloud platform, wherein the storage warehouse is used for storing hazardous waste; a plurality of storage units for storing dangerous wastes are arranged in the storage warehouse; the hazardous waste is pasted with a first electronic tag, the first electronic tag comprises information parameters of the hazardous waste, and the information parameters comprise source information and characteristic information of the hazardous waste; the storage warehouse comprises a warehouse door, and the warehouse door is provided with an identification unit in communication connection with the cloud platform; when the dangerous waste is put in storage, the identification unit reads the first electronic tag and sends the read information parameters to the cloud platform for storage data recording; when the hazardous waste is discharged from the warehouse, the identification unit reads the first electronic tag and sends the read information parameters to the cloud platform for discharging data recording. Dangerous waste goes out warehouse entry, all carries out data record by the cloud platform, can effectively carry out intelligent management to the dangerous waste in the factory of the useless enterprise of producing from the useless source to before dispatching from the factory, and resources of using manpower sparingly reduce the error that manual operation easily appears, the wrong problem of judging etc..

title_en: Multi-network forest grassland fireproof emergency rescue command system and method based on cloud computing
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-network forest and grassland fireproof emergency rescue command system and method based on cloud computing, which relate to the technical field of forest and grassland fireproof emergency rescue, and are used for monitoring forest and grassland images through a video monitoring module to judge whether a fire occurs or not; positioning the position of the ignition point through a positioning module; monitoring meteorological data of a forest in real time through a sensing module, and determining meteorological grades of the forest; constructing a forest grassland model, and marking the position of a fire point on the forest grassland model; taking a forest grassland image at the position of the fire point as a background image, and superposing the forest grassland image on the corresponding position of the fire point of the forest grassland model; predicting the fire spreading direction and situation to obtain a fire spreading situation area; acquiring state data of a plurality of rescue team service nodes and a plurality of emergency material service nodes near a fire spreading situation area, uploading the state data to a cloud computing module, and generating an emergency command strategy. The timeliness and accuracy of the command system on the fire discovery and the rationality of the extinguishing decision are improved.
assignees: BEIJING BAICHUAN HUILIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Public health management system for processing trace source of cash microorganism data of financial system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a public health management system for processing trace sources of cash microorganism data of a financial system. The system comprises: recording the date and the geographic position of each banknote when the banknote flows back; acquiring a long-time circulation characteristic descriptor and a short-time circulation characteristic descriptor of each paper money; obtaining a geographical circulation range index, a reflux stability index and an activity rating index of each banknote; obtaining a microorganism characteristic descriptor of each paper currency; obtaining a public health event, obtaining a plurality of circulation modes by using clustering, obtaining general microorganism feature descriptors of each circulation mode, obtaining an adjusted public health event, obtaining a token Q corresponding to each record, obtaining an LOF value according to each cash situation feature, reducing the illusion phenomenon of LLM training based on the proportion of Dropout obtaining the token Q, and inputting the token Q and a plurality of guide sentences into the LLM to obtain an emergency response scheme.
assignees: YUNCHAO FINANCIAL SERVICES BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Method for capturing geological anomalies through video linkage automatic positioning of geological disaster monitoring equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring, and discloses a method for capturing geological anomalies by video linkage automatic positioning of geological disaster monitoring equipment, which comprises the following steps: installing automatic monitoring equipment and video monitoring equipment in a monitoring sub-target area; the intelligent AI edge computing equipment receives the abnormal signal and controls the video monitoring equipment to transmit back snapshot of field abnormal image data and video recording data; the geological abnormality is monitored by using the automatic monitoring equipment and signals are sent out, the included angle between the video monitoring equipment and the space geographic position of the automatic monitoring equipment is calculated by using the intelligent AI edge computing equipment, the quick linkage positioning of the video monitoring equipment and the automatic monitoring equipment is realized, the video monitoring equipment can accurately control the view angle range at the first time, the field image data and the video recording data of the sub-target area where the automatic monitoring equipment which sends out signals are collected and returned, and the research, judgment and scheduling accuracy under the emergency event of the command center is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent water and soil conservation monitoring and management system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent water and soil conservation monitoring and management system, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering and environmental monitoring. The data acquisition layer acquires data in real time by utilizing technologies such as an acoustic sensor network, machine vision monitoring equipment, internet of things monitoring equipment, satellite remote sensing monitoring, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection and the like. The data transmission layer adopts a wireless communication network to transmit the acquired data to the data processing and analyzing layer. The data processing and analyzing layer analyzes the multi-source data through data fusion and preprocessing, GIS technology application, big data analysis and machine learning. The decision support and application layer comprises a control measure generation and optimization unit, a real-time early warning and emergency response unit, a user interaction unit and a decision support unit, provides soil and water conservation and embankment reinforcement strategies for users, and has a feedback optimization mechanism. According to the invention, by comprehensively applying various monitoring technologies and data analysis methods, the accuracy and timeliness of water and soil loss monitoring are improved, and powerful guarantee is provided for the security of the embankment.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Management system of car for internet
title_ko: 인터넷을 이용한 자동차 관리 시스템
abstract_en: A car management system using the Internet is provided to manage the car history record of each member correspondingly to the visit check, reserved maintenance and repair history which are performed at the time and in the place desired by a client. A client terminal(20) applies for the car maintenance consultation, visit check, emergent dispatch or reserved repair. An operating server(40) notifies a designated service center terminal(10) of the contents requested by the client terminal, and then stores the processing result in a database(41) of car history records of each member. The operating server transmits the contents of a corresponding car history record to the client terminal. The designated service center terminal processes the visit check, emergent dispatch or reserved repair for the client.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Method for detecting vehicle accident using blackbox and sharing accident information automatically, apparatus computer program for performing the method
title_ko: 블랙박스를 이용한 차량 사고 감지 및 자동 사고 공유방법, 이를 수행하는 장치 및 프로그램
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an apparatus for detecting a vehicle accident using a black box and sharing accident information automatically comprises: an event receiving unit for receiving a vehicle accident event detected from a black box that detects an accident of at least one vehicle among the own vehicle and surrounding vehicles; an accident information generating unit for generating accident occurrence information including information on an accident occurrence place based on the received vehicle accident event; and a communication unit for transmitting the generated accident occurrence information to an emergency rescue center and surrounding vehicles within a predetermined distance from the own vehicle. The black box is equipped with an accident detection deep learning model suitable for a situation of a road on which the vehicle is driving.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 블랙박스를 이용한 차량 사고 감지 및 자동 사고 공유 장치는 자차 및 주변 차량 중 적어도 하나의 차량 사고를 감지하는 블랙박스로부터 감지된 차량 사고 이벤트를 수신하는 이벤트 수신부, 수신된 상기 차량 사고 이벤트에 기초하여 사고 발생 장소에 대한 정보를 포함하는 사고 발생 정보를 생성하는 사고 정보 생성부 및 생성된 상기 사고 발생 정보를 긴급 구조 센터 및 상기 자차로부터 일정 거리내 있는 주위 차량들에게 전송하는 통신부를 포함하고, 상기 블랙박스는 주행 중인 도로의 상황에 맞는 사고 감지 딥러닝 모델이 탑재된다.

title_en: Emergency Responder System For Portable Communication Device
abstract_en: An emergency communications system may transmit vital emergency data to a portable communications device of a first responder based on an identifier associated with a victim. In one example, the identifier is read by a first portable communications device (e.g., of a first responder) from a second portable communications device (e.g., of an accident victim). In another example, the portable communications device of an injured person may be transmit the identifier to a remote device to initiate the download of previously stored emergency data. The emergency data may be matched to the identifier at the remote device. A touch sequence on a display of the portable communications device may override passcode protections to automatically initiate an emergency response operation. For instance, video data may be automatically recorded and uploaded by portable communications device.

title_en: Training system for endoscope medium
abstract_en: This medical training system includes an operation unit, a display displaying an image data; a storage recording simulation data including biological data for forming a virtual manipulation space and device information about a first and second virtual medical devices, the simulation data using to generate image data for displaying the motion image on the display; and a controller configured to generate the image data based on the simulation data and an operation command input from the operation unit. The controller is configured to acquire the simulation data from the storage, calculate a first operation result of the first virtual medical device based on the simulation data and the operation command, calculate a second operation result of the second virtual medical device based on the first operation result, generate the image data based on the second operation result, and transmit the image data including the virtual manipulation space, and the first or the second virtual medical device to the display.

title_en: Emergency Communications Controller and Console
abstract_en: An emergency communications device contains dispatch consoles for use by user that contains multiple repeaters and multiple communication networks. The multiple repeaters and multiple communication networks are used for redundancy purposes, in case the repeater or communication network in use becomes disabled for any reason. The device also contains a recorder unit capable of provided instant playback to emergency dispatch personnel independently of whether the unit is recording. The device does not require an external computer to operate.

title_en: A kind of domestic safety monitoring warning system of anti-floods
abstract_en: A kind of domestic safety monitoring warning system of anti-floods, it is characterized in that, comprise domestic safety monitoring system server, Centroid, routing node, water sensor node, Set Top Box and report device, described water sensor node indirectly carries out wireless telecommunications with Centroid by routing node or directly communicates with Centroid, Centroid is uploaded to Set Top Box after receiving the immersion information of water sensor, and Set Top Box sends this immersion information to domestic safety monitoring system server by internet; After described domestic safety monitoring system server receives immersion information, send alarm command to report device, send alerting signal by report device, the personnel in notice man find the condition of a disaster early, and close water valve.Make user's Timeliness coverage the condition of a disaster, avoid causing large economy and the loss of people, avoid the water resource waste caused when there is floods the condition of a disaster, the scene allowing domestic safety monitoring monitor in family is more perfect, more meets the requirement of modern to monitoring home environments.

title_en: Natural gas fireproof explosion suppression valve device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valves and discloses a natural gas fireproof explosion suppression valve device which comprises a transmission pipeline, wherein a resettable explosion suppression cavity component and an emergency cut-off valve are sequentially communicated in the medium flow direction, a heat-sensitive sensor and a pressure sensor are both assembled at one air inlet end of the transmission pipeline, the heat-sensitive sensor and the pressure sensor are both connected with a controller in a signal manner, the controller is used for controlling on-off of the emergency cut-off valve, when a monitoring signal of the heat-sensitive sensor exceeds a preset threshold value, a valve core of the emergency cut-off valve is closed, and a fire blocking core is movably attached to a valve core sealing surface of the emergency cut-off valve. The invention can realize synchronous linkage protection, namely, when the overtemperature is abnormal, the emergency cut-off valve and the fire-retardant core synchronously act, thereby avoiding the hysteresis of single cut-off protection and improving the timeliness of emergency response. And (3) double sealing and blocking, namely, attaching the fire-retardant core to the closed valve core sealing surface to form a double medium blocking of a valve core of the stop valve and the fire-retardant core, and enhancing the reliability of the fireproof sealing.

title_en: Processing system using a traffic accident insurers linked black boxes

상기 영상정보는 상기 충격센서(1)의 충격 감지신호 발생시, 충격 감지신호 전,후의 설정시간의 사고영상정보를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 보험사 연계형 블랙박스를 이용한 교통사고 처리 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Server based disaster recovery by making use of dual write responses
abstract_en: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system for asynchronous replication. The mechanism creates a record in a write log in a host computing device for a write command and marking the record as uncommitted. The mechanism maintains a copy of data to be written by the write command at the host computing device. The mechanism issues the write command from the host computing device to a primary storage controller at the primary storage site. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been written to the primary storage site, the mechanism marks the record as unreplicated. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been replicated to a secondary storage site, the mechanism erases the record in the write log and deleting the copy of data.

title_en: Wisdom city SOS emergency call system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wisdom city SOS emergency call system, including setting up the call button on city place name guide system's stand, the stringent control center is connected to the call button, and the stringent control center is connected to 110 public security system, 120 emergency system, 119 fire extinguishing system, GPS vehicle security system respectively. The utility model discloses a LED display system and the monitored control system that makes a video recording not only can in time know the on -the -spot condition comprehensively, still can realize the two -way interdynamic of remote message, are favorable to keeping continuously comprehensively mastering information.

title_en: A kind of command centre receives a crime report platform system
abstract_en: It receives a crime report platform system the utility model relates to a kind of command centre, it further include being installed on the speech recognition system and face identification system received a crime report in computer including central database server, computer of receiving a crime report, queue scheduling machine and the display screen and warning device being connect with computer of receiving a crime report；The display screen includes for showing the first display screen of text information, the second display screen for showing track of vehicle and the third display screen for showing video image.The utility model is received a crime report platform using speech recognition, image recognition transformation public security command center, and in China, public security is the first.Public security phone can be improved to receive a crime report the speed of record, operated by artificial stamp and be changed to automatic operation.Foundation is received a crime report language library, and recognition accuracy is improved, and is for the first time in China's public security.Strong real-time can reduce the forgetting of the mistake and important plot of subsequent stamp record.

title_en: Method for positioning user fault through comprehensive analysis of repair request information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for positioning a user fault through comprehensive analysis of repair request information. The method for positioning the user fault through comprehensive analysis of the repair request information comprises the steps that the repair request information, such as the family number, the family name, the telephone number and the repair request address, of a repair request user is comprehensively analyzed, and intelligently matched with locally-stored user records, rapid and accurate positioning of the fault of the repair request user is achieved under the condition of low-pressure modeling, a dispatcher is guided to rapidly accomplish fault judgment. The method has important practical significance on improvement of the power line repair efficiency, shortening of the power outage time, reduction of the economic loss and improvement of the service quality.

title_en: Beidou timing type commanding machine
abstract_en: The invention relates to a Beidou timing type commanding machine. The Beidou timing type commanding machine is composed of an antenna module, a radio frequency module, a baseband processing plate, a time service plate, a display control unit and a power supply module. An output/input end of the antenna module is connected with the host radio frequency module. An output/input end of the radio frequency module is connected with an input/output end of the baseband processing plate. Display output ends of the baseband processing plate are connected with input ends of the display control unit and the time service plate. Output ends of the power supply module are connected with input ends of the baseband processing plate and the radio frequency module. Compared with the prior art, the Beidou timing type commanding machine has the advantages that the positioning precision is high, a plurality of receiving channels are provided, and the time service can be provided, etc; and the Beidou timing type commanding machine can be widely applied to the fields requiring group commanding, war exercises and unified time, such as command scheduling and time unification of a large-scale military exercise and disaster early warning, command scheduling of various vehicles and personnel in civil air defense and time unification of equipment rooms, and time synchronization among mobile base stations and power grids.

title_en: A kind of fireman fire scene tell-table
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of fireman fire scene tell-tables, including contactless card and logging machine, the contactless card is mounted in the fireproof garment of fireman, logging machine surface is provided with sensor, display screen and switch key, power supply, warning device, micro-chip processor, master control borad, SD card and display device are installed in logging machine, display device is connected with display screen, and micro-chip processor is connected with cloud server.This product is automatically recorded by micro-chip processor, solve the problems, such as manual record inefficiency, corresponding data is calculated automatically and is uploaded in real time simultaneously, more quickly in face of the feedback to commander of distinctness, enter the time in the scene of a fire in the display screen display soldier of logging machine, it can be alarmed with countdown, reach automatic alarm, the fireman outside the scene of a fire can call out and succour fireman in the scene of a fire；This product can be stored in the data of fire scene rescue in SD card, and SD card can store 2 years record data, can also copy out in computer, facilitate archive and access.

title_en: Seismic inversion method, system, device and medium based on wave equation
abstract_en: The invention provides a seismic inversion method, a system, a device and a medium based on a wave equation, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring and determining the calculation parameters of the single-frequency sensitivity kernel function according to the earthquake observation parameters and the initial velocity model parameters; generating a velocity model of the random boundary; performing wave equation forward modeling according to the calculation parameters and the velocity model to obtain a synthetic seismic record and a frequency domain incident wave field; determining a travel time accompanying seismic source according to the synthetic seismic record, and determining a single-frequency gradient of a travel time target functional according to the travel time accompanying seismic source; extracting a low wave number part from the single-frequency gradient, and performing seismic velocity inversion according to the low wave number; compared with the wave equation time-of-flight tomography technology based on the wave field reconstruction frame, the method has remarkable advantages in the aspects of calculation efficiency, memory occupation and algorithm complexity, and can be widely applied to the technical field of seismic velocity modeling.

title_en: Social fire control strength dispatching system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a social fire control strength dispatching system and a social fire control strength dispatching method, which belong to the technical field of fire control command dispatching, wherein the system comprises a management module and a plurality of strength terminals; the management module is used for receiving a scheduling instruction issued by the fire control center, generating at least one scheduling sub-instruction corresponding to the plurality of power terminals based on the scheduling instruction, sending the scheduling sub-instruction to the plurality of power terminals, and simultaneously initiating a video call request to the power terminals, wherein the power terminals respond to the video call request, establish video calls with the management module, generate emergency feedback information based on the video calls, and further are used for receiving the emergency feedback information and sending the emergency feedback information to the fire control center. The emergency feedback information is generated based on video call, so that the generation efficiency and the effectiveness of the emergency feedback information are improved, and the scheduling timeliness of social fire control force is improved.

title_en: Power plant safety management and control system and method based on intelligent work ticket
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power plant safety control system and method based on an intelligent work ticket, and belongs to the technical field of safety control. A power plant safety management and control system based on intelligent working tickets comprises an intelligent working ticket management module, a comprehensive data integration platform, a data analysis and processing module, an alarm and notification mechanism module, an emergency quick response module, a history record and report generation module and a self-learning and continuous improvement module. The invention solves the problems that the prior art ignores emergency and quick response of emergency, lacks multi-system linkage and fails to establish an effective early warning mechanism. According to the invention, through an automatic emergency response protocol and real-time command and dispatch, the quick response capability is improved, the information smooth transmission is realized through multi-system linkage, the cooperative operation efficiency is enhanced, the safety control flow is optimized through a self-adaptive learning mechanism and regular review, the accurate response measures are set according to different severity by a hierarchical early warning mechanism, and the safety and management efficiency of a power plant are improved.

title_en: Multi-source data management method and related device based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source data management method and a related device based on machine learning, which are characterized in that a multi-source data set under an emergency command and rescue scene is obtained, data preprocessing is carried out on the multi-source data set to obtain a standardized data set with a unified data form, a data meta-information set is extracted from the standardized data set, a pre-trained blood-edge relation modeling model is called to carry out association analysis processing on the data meta-information set, a blood-edge relation description set among all data items in the standardized data set is generated, a data blood-edge tracking result is generated based on the blood-edge description set, and the data blood-edge tracking result comprises a history record of a data full life cycle and cross-data-item dependency graph information. The invention can provide a treatment support with traceable data sources, traceable processing process and clear dependency relationship for emergency command rescue, so that rescue decisions can be developed based on reliable data blood-source information, and the support capability of data treatment on rescue decisions is effectively improved.

title_en: Apparaus for detecting vehicle accident and emergency level, and method therefore
title_ko: 차량의 사고감지 및 응급성 판단 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: As an apparatus for detecting vehicle accident and emergency level and a method therefore, the extent of the accident is precisely classified and the countermeasure management according to that the information having with aliquot is provided. An apparatus for detecting vehicle accident and emergency level and a method therefore comprises sensor units(100, 200) for perceiving the accident of the vehicles; the error correction member(300) for correcting the error of the sensor unit; the accident determination and the accident class processing unit(400) for judging the accident of the vehicles and producing the class of the accident; the GPS receiver(800) for sensing the location of the vehicles; the data management(700) for controlling data; the data buffer(500) which is the sensor in vehicle sense information for the predetermined time stored; the data storing means(600) which enduringly stores the accident information for the predetermined time stored in data buffer; and the information sending part(900) for sending the accident information and location information to outside.

title_en: fire-resistant
title_ko: 무독성 방화제와 내화제의 제조방법
abstract_en: Issue: to achieve our purpose, is a nontoxic flame resistant, which reduces toxic gas, is not burned by flames, and prevents a fire, able to be made? Solution: the followings are a manufacturing method and improving points of the issue. According to a fire retardant manufacturing method, (content omitted in the abstract) 1-borax, 2-magnesium chloride, 3-polyethylene oxide, 4-silica gel, 5-sodium bicarbonate, 6-germanium, 7-diatomite, 8-red clay, 9-stone flour, 10-sodium silicate, and 11-starch. 1 and 2 are plasticized for 5-10 hours at 1200-1400C. Then, 4 and 6 are mixed and ground at 500-700 meshes. Then, 1, 2, 4, and 6 are mixed to make specific powder, and then, the powder is cooled and decomposed in a cooling chamber at -20--50C. Then, 3 and 5 are quantitatively diluted and heated at high pressure to form fire retardant liquid with strong permeability. Then, the transparency and viscosity of the liquid are verified and confirmed while the liquid is steamed to make transparent liquid. The heat-resistance, fire-resistance, and insulation of the liquid are adjusted to make a transparent nontoxic fire retardant.

-.과학이 발달하며 프라스틱 문명이 가능한 기구들을 탈바꿈 시키다보니 이젠 건축자재도 약70-80%정도가 변형되었기에,,,

title_en: Detecting contacts during sporting activities etc
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus are described for determining parameters of a contact between bodies occurring within an activity, particularly within a sporting, game, recreational or entertainment activity, such as bounce of a tennis ball or contact of a cricket ball or baseball with the bat. A digital camera directed towards a target area during the course of the activity captures image frames including image data in the infra red region of the spectrum. Means for comparing image data for multiple temporally spaced frames with image data of a reference datum records any localised infra red emission appearing in at least one incident frame, such localised infra red emission being indicative of beat having been generated by a contact which has occurred in the target area and which has generated heat, such as by friction between the bodies or deformation of at least one of the bodies involved in the contact. The image data for at least one of the incident frames is analysed to determine at least one parameter of the contact, and the image data for the incident frame is recorded. Visual display means displays the incident frames including the image data in the IR spectrum by presenting IR data as a visible display of the scene captured for the incident frame so as to enable visual inspection of the activity in the target area at the time of the at least one incident frame and that gave rise to the contact producing the infra red emission.
assignees: BRENNAN BROADCAST GROUP PTY LT;BRENNAN WARREN

title_en: Large-range extreme drought emergency monitoring and influence evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out drought monitoring based on the medium-resolution data of the wind cloud satellite; establishing a comprehensive drought monitoring index by cooperating with the multiple remote sensing parameters and the ground historical drought record, and performing drought disaster monitoring and emergency response processing by using the established comprehensive drought monitoring index; and carrying out drought influence evaluation treatment based on multiple remote sensing parameters. In addition, the invention also discloses a large-range extreme drought emergency monitoring and influence evaluation system. By adopting the technical scheme of the invention, the drought situations can be well monitored to obtain accurate information, and the drought situation service is provided to prevent the drought situations in the future.

title_en: Method for managing traffic accident
title_ko: 교통사고 처리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for handling a traffic accident, capable of completely substituting an existing field investigation method in which a professional traffic accident investigator goes to a field and investigates a traffic accident, with an online method for handling a traffic accident. The present invention also provides a user-centered system for handling a traffic accident, capable of enabling even ordinary people to handle the traffic accident only by following instructions of an application after executing the application of a mobile terminal. The system for handling a traffic accident collects a field investigation result formed by a police/ insurance company investigator terminal (20) and traffic accident information on the accident field by a traffic accident witness (10′), a passenger terminal (10), or a driver terminal (10) in the accident field in which the traffic accident occurs. The system for handling a traffic accident also transmits the information collected to an integrated control center (70). After the system for handling a traffic accident forms significant event information by integrating vehicle driving information, the field investigation result, and information on a device attached to a vehicle, the event information is transmitted to a mobile terminal (60) by a communication module. The event information is reintegrated with the information collected by the terminal by an application of the mobile terminal (60). The application of the mobile terminal induces collection of a traffic accident record so that the information collected by the terminal by the application of the mobile terminal (60) includes detailed information capable of restructuring the traffic accident, such as the cause of the traffic accident, information about who is responsible, injury, and extent of damage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 기존의 교통사고 조사 전문가가 현장에 출동하여 조사하는 현장조사 방식을 완전 대체가능한, 사고처리를 온전히 온라인으로 대체할 수 있도록 하는 교통사고 처리 방법을 제공하며, 일반인들이라도, 모바일 단말기의 어플을 실행시키고 나서 어플에서 지시하는 대로만 따라하기만 하면 교통사고 처리가 가능한 유저 중심의 교통사고 처리 시스템을 제공하는 것으로, 교통사고가 발생한 사고 현장의 운전자나 탑승자 단말(10)이나 현장의 교통사고 목격자(10')의 사고 현장의 교통사고 정보 및 경찰/보험사 조사요원 단말(20)에 의한 현장조사 결과물이 차량에 부착된 장치의 정보와 함께 모바일 단말(60)을 통해 수집되어지고, 이러한 수집된 정보가 통합관제센터(70)로 전송되어지는 교통사고 처리 시스템으로서, 차량운행 정보, 현장조사 결과물 및 차량에 부착된 장치의 정보가 함께 통합됨으로써 의미있는 이벤트 정보를 형성된 후, 통신모듈을 통해 모바일 단말(60)로 전송되어지고, 모바일 단말(60)의 어플에 의해 단말 자체에 의해 수집된 정보와 재통합되며, 모바일 단말(60)의 어플에 의해 단말 자체에 의해 수집되는 정보는, 교통사고의 원인과 책임 소재, 그리고 부상의 정도와 피해 규모 등, 교통사고의 재구성이 가능할 정도의 상세한 정보를 포함하도록, 모바일 단말의 어플이 교통 사고 기록의 수집을 유도하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Health rating evaluation system and method for predicting the probability of health accident
title_ko: 건강사고의 발생확률을 예측하는 건강등급 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for evaluating health rating capable of presenting an objective measurement indicator for a health level of an individual as the paradigm for a health changes from disease treatment to disease prevention and health promotion. The system comprises: a user terminal transmitting approval information for consenting to use of personal medical information of a user, health rating application information requesting the calculation of health rating of the user, and accredited authentication information; a government office server equipped with a medical information database storing the personal medical information; and a health rating evaluation system connected to the user terminal and the government office server through a communication network, collecting the personal medical information matched with the official authentication information by providing the official authentication information to the government office server when approval information, health rating application information, and accredited authentication information are received through the communication network, and including an operation server for calculating health rating by analyzing a relative risk of a health related accident of the user within a predetermined period through a health rating program based on a health evaluation model for the personal medical information. According to the present invention, the system can predict a risk of occurrence of health related accidents in the near future by analyzing individual medical information so that incentives for lifestyle improvement and social health promotion awareness can be raised.
abstract_ko: 질병치료 중심에서 질병예방 및 건강증진 중심으로 건강에 대한 패러다임이 변화됨에 따라 개인의 건강수준에 대한 객관적인 측정지표를 제시할 수 있는 건강등급 평가 시스템이 개시된다.  이를 위하여 사용자의 개인의료정보 이용을 동의하는 승인정보와 사용자의 건강등급 산정을 요청하는 건강등급 신청정보 및 공인인증정보를 전송하는 사용자 단말기와, 개인의료정보가 저장된 의료정보 데이터베이스가 구비된 관공서서버, 및 상기 사용자 단말기 및 관공서서버에 통신 네트워크를 통해 연결되며, 상기 통신 네트워크를 통해 승인정보와 건강등급 신청정보 및 공인인증정보가 수신되면, 상기 공인인증정보를 상기 관공서서버로 제공하여 공인인증정보에 매칭된 개인의료정보를 수집하며, 상기 개인의료정보를 건강 평가모형에 기반한 건강등급 프로그램을 통해 미리 지정된 기간 내에 사용자의 건강사고가 발생할 상대적 위험도를 분석하여 건강등급을 산출하는 운영서버를 포함하는 건강등급 평가 시스템을 제공한다.  본 발명에 의하면, 개인의 의료정보를 분석하여 가까운 미래의 건강사고 발생위험을 예측할 수 있어 생활습관 개선에 대한 유인 및 사회적 건강증진 의식 제고가 가능하다.

title_en: Joystick for training to improve sensory-guided fine motor control of the hand
abstract_en: System and method for improving tactile sensitivity and precision/accuracy of motor control of the hand of a subject. A joystick is configured to provide commands to a computing device. The joystick includes a base, shaft, and a textured surface with a specified level of bumpiness. A computer-implemented exercise is executed, including presenting stimuli, including at least one target, to the subject via a computer display. The subject is required to respond to the stimuli via the joystick within a specified duration, including using the joystick to move a cursor to the target, and, upon reaching the target, disengage from the joystick. The subject's response to the stimuli is recorded, and a determination made regarding whether the subject responded correctly. The duration is modified based on whether the subject responded correctly to the stimuli. The presenting, requiring, recording, determining, and modifying are repeated a plurality of times in an iterative manner.
assignees: MERZENICH MICHAEL M;DELAHUNT PETER B;MAHNCKE HENRY W;TRUJILLO MICHAEL SCOTT;HARDY JOSEPH L;POSIT SCIENCE CORP

title_en: Wireless real-time tongue tracking for speech impairment diagnosis, speech therapy with audiovisual biofeedback, and silent speech interfaces
abstract_en: A real-time wireless system for recording natural tongue movements in the 3D oral space. By attaching a small magnetic tracer to the tongue, either temporarily or semi-permanently, and placing an array of magnetic sensors around the mouth, the tracer can be localized with sub-millimeter precision. The system can also combine the tracer localization with acoustic, video, and flow data via additional sensors to form a comprehensive audiovisual biofeedback mechanism for diagnosing speech impairments and improving speech therapy. Additionally, the system can record tongue trajectories and create an indexed library of such traces. The indexed library can be used as a tongue tracking silent speech interface. The library can synthesize words, phrases, or execute commands tied to the individual patterns of magnetic field variations or tongue trajectories.

title_en: Intelligent fire fighting system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting system, which comprises an intelligent miniature emergency rescue cabinet machine, a transparent transmission gateway, a fire-fighting host, an intelligent air switch with a gateway and an emergency call device with a base station and a gateway, wherein the intelligent air switch is connected with the base station through the gateway; the intelligent miniature emergency rescue cabinet machine is respectively in wireless connection with a transparent transmission gateway, an intelligent air switch with a gateway and an emergency call device with a base machine and a gateway, and the transparent transmission gateway is in wired connection with a fire control host; the intelligent miniature emergency rescue cabinet machine is respectively and wirelessly connected with a miniature fire station, an unmanned aerial vehicle, a fire command large screen and a mobile phone terminal; unmanned aerial vehicle is fire control unmanned aerial vehicle, takes a picture and makes a video recording to the conflagration place. According to the intelligent fire fighting system, when a fire disaster occurs, fire fighters can accurately and timely arrive at the positions of trapped persons to timely rescue the trapped persons, so that the time spent by the fire fighters in rescuing the trapped persons can be shortened, the efficiency is improved, and the casualty loss is reduced.

title_en: On-orbit emergency task instruction response time testing method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a system and a medium for testing on-orbit emergency task instruction response time, wherein the method comprises the following steps: compiling a test data packet which comprises an emergency task instruction response test target packet, an emergency task packet and a corresponding task interruption instruction; arranging an emergency task instruction response test target packet on the ground before an emergency response test arc section, wherein the emergency task instruction response test target packet is used by an interrupted task during emergency response test; after entering the measurement and control arc section, monitoring the execution condition of the emergency task instruction response test target packet; after the emergency task instruction responds to the test target packet to be executed, injecting a task interruption instruction on the ground, and recording the time T0 when the satellite receives the task interruption instruction in real-time remote measurement; after the load equipment is confirmed to be shut down, injecting an emergency task packet on the ground; recording the starting time T1 of the satellite load; and taking T1-T0 as the response time of the on-orbit emergency task instruction. The method can effectively and accurately test the response time of the on-orbit emergency task instruction of the microwave remote sensing satellite under the on-orbit emergency imaging environment.

title_en: Method and system for binding duty information
abstract_en: The invention provides a duty information binding method and a duty information binding system, which relate to the technical field of data processing, task information from a command platform can be bound with a recorder through an intelligent terminal, the recorder can upload audio and video to the command platform in real time through the intelligent terminal, and the command platform automatically picks up the audio and video uploaded by the recorder and the task information corresponding to the recorder to be bound automatically, so that an executive is not required to manually upload the processed audio and video to the command platform. The audio and video are bound with the task automatically, so that the accuracy and the efficiency of operation are improved, the audio and video are uploaded to the command platform in real time, the timeliness of the audio and video binding with the task is enhanced, the audio and video can be checked on the command platform in real time, the supervision strength is improved, and the fairness of the processing process is ensured.
assignees: HARBIN HAILINKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rail transit emergency working condition cooperative scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the field of traffic scheduling, and provides a method and a system for collaborative scheduling of emergency working conditions of rail transit, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring the running state and the position of the train in real time; simulating the running position of the train in the tunnel; the actual position of the train in the tunnel is estimated, the actual running condition of the train is analyzed, and recording is carried out when the abnormal train state is obtained; and sending the scheduling strategy to a track station adjacent to the train through an information interface, and increasing the real-time monitoring frequency of the track station. The position and the running state of the train can be obtained through simulation and the sound sensor under the condition of lacking accurate train information, so that more accurate dispatching basis is provided and the safe running of the train is ensured. The method can solve the technical problems of poor signals, incapability of obtaining train information and the like in the tunnel in the prior art, and improves the effect and accuracy of emergency dispatching.

title_en: Emergency management method and system based on hydropower station production
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency management method and system based on hydropower station production, and relates to the technical field of hydropower station emergency management, wherein the emergency management method comprises the steps of analyzing hydropower station emergency management requirements, acquiring hydropower station emergency resources and creating an immersive exercise environment of the hydropower station emergency resources; adjusting hydropower station emergency resources in an immersive drilling environment by using an intelligent scheduling algorithm; and establishing an emergency treatment management scheme based on the drilling result. The system and the method promote the efficiency and reliability of emergency management of the hydropower station, simulate various emergency scenes, adjust the emergency resource allocation in real time, optimize response time and effect, record and track all operations and decisions by using a blockchain technology, ensure the transparency and safety of data, realize the automatic processing of multi-source data and the emergency resource scheduling management by intelligent contracts, effectively cope with emergency situations such as geological disasters, equipment faults, extreme weather and the like, and improve the safety and emergency response capability of the hydropower station.
assignees: GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD GOUPITAN POWER PLANT

title_en: Emergency resource automatic allocation system based on generation type artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency resource automatic allocation system based on a generation type artificial intelligence, which is based on an emergency resource database which is established in advance and can be updated in real time, a query SQL statement generation system of the emergency resource database is used for receiving needed emergency resource information or emergency response tasks, analyzing to obtain resource attribute information, generating emergency materials, emergency equipment and emergency personnel database query SQL statements corresponding to the resource attribute information according to a preset query SQL statement output format of the emergency resource database, executing the generated statements by the database query system, querying conforming emergency materials, equipment and personnel from the emergency resource database, grouping and recording the conforming emergency materials, equipment and personnel according to emergency units, and generating an allocated emergency resource report. The invention realizes the rapid completion of emergency resource inquiry, ensures the comprehensiveness and rationality of resource allocation, enhances the centralized allocation capability of emergency command parts on emergency resources, and improves the synergy and efficiency of overall emergency response.
assignees: HEBEI SHENYI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Server and system for managing city facility
title_ko: 도시 조형물 관리 서버 및 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A city sculpture management server and a system thereof are provided to implement independent and integrated control of sculptures by independent operation even if a management server is out of control. CONSTITUTION: A schedule event queue(21) registers a schedule and an event which are read from a schedule database(30). A pre-scheduler(23) checks one or more schedules which are in the front of the schedule event queue. A schedule synchronization unit(43) synchronizes a schedule stored in the schedule database and a schedule stored in an agent. A control unit(60) transmits a control command to the agent at the operation time of each sculpture and sculpture composition equipment. [Reference numerals] (10) Schedule register; (20) Scheduler; (21) Schedule event queue; (23) Pre-scheduler; (30) Schedule database; (40) Synchronization unit; (41) Time synchronization unit; (43) Schedule synchronization unit; (50) Communication unit; (60) Control unit;
abstract_ko:
본 출원은 도시 조형물 관리 서버에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 통합적이면서도 독립적으로 조형물을 운영할 수 있고, 조형물을 시민도 제어할 수 있는 능동적 주체가 됨으로써, 교감형 조형물을 제공할 수 있으며, 에이전트 및 스크립트를 이용하여 독립적이면서도 각기 다른 조형물을 제어할 수 있는 표준을 제공할 수 있는 도시 조형물 관리 서버를 제공하기 위한 것이다. 
그 기술적 구성은 이벤트 처리 스크립트에 따라 적어도 하나의 도시 조형물을 각각 관리하는 복수의 에이전트들과 연결된 도시 조형물 관리 서버에 있어서, 적어도 하나의 특정 도시 조형물을 제어하는 특정 이벤트 처리 스크립트를 포함하는 스케줄을 저장하는 스케줄 데이터베이스; 상기 스케줄 데이터베이스에 상기 스케줄을 등록하는 스케줄 등록기; 상기 저장된 스케줄을 계속하여(Continually) 읽어서 스케줄 이벤트 큐에 등록하고, 상기 스케줄 이벤트 큐에서 현재시간에 따른 스케줄을 읽어서 적어도 하나의 해당 에이전트에 전송함으로써, 상기 적어도 하나의 해당 에이전트 각각이 해당 이벤트 처리 스크립트에 따라 해당 도시 조형물을 제어하도록 하는 스케줄러를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Sinkhole monitoring system with gps
title_ko: Gps를 활용한 지반침하 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a geomorphic change monitoring system enabling actions necessary for preventing disaster to be taken in advance by monitoring, sensing, and predicting geomorphic changes within a wide-area region. The geomorphic change monitoring system includes: multiple measuring devices distributed and installed at each point to monitor geomorphic changes due to an uplift and a subsidence at each point on a real time basis and measuring an angle change of a ground surface; a terminal collecting coordinates and an angle change degree of each measuring device; and a calculating device connected to the terminal and measuring a height change at each point with a calculation program installed therein based on coordinate data and angle change data of each measuring device collected in the terminal. Accordingly, land subsidence due to the geomorphic changes at each point can be monitored on a real time basis. In addition, the geomorphic change monitoring system provides better user convenience in comparison with leveling and the like.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 광역지구의 지형변화를 감시, 감지, 예측하여서 재해사고 예방에 필요한 조치를 사전에 취할 수 있도록 하는 지형변화 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
각 지점의 융기 및 침하에 따른 지형변화를 실시간으로 감시할 수 있도록, 각 지점에 분산 설치되어 지면의 각도변화를 측정하는 복수의 측정장치와, 각 측정장치의 좌표와 각도변화량을 수집하는 단말기와, 상기 단말기에 연결되며 연산프로그램이 탑재되어 단말기에 수집된 각 측정장치의 좌표데이터와 각도변화량데이터를 이용하여 각 지점의 높낮이 변화를 측정하는 연산장치 등을 포함한다. 
이에 따라, 각 지점의 지형변화에 따른 지반침하를 실시간으로 감시할 수 있으며, 수준측량 등에 비하여 사용이 편리하다.

title_en: Car accident history management method based on blockchain
title_ko: 블록체인 기반의 자동차 사고이력 관리방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a blockchain-based car accident history management method. The method includes the following steps of: (S100) logging into a vehicle accident history management system; (S200) when the logged-in user does not correspond to a manager, inputting a vehicle number or vehicle identification number into which the user wants to inquire; (S300) confirming a query by selecting an option including an item about the history to be checked; (S400) determining whether the corresponding vehicle number or vehicle identification number into which the user wants to inquire exists; (S500) calculating a mileage amount in accordance with the option selected by the user; (S600) requesting the mileage information of the user; (S700) executing a mileage charging module; (S800) deducting the mileage amount in accordance with the calculated option from the mileage of the user; and (S900) outputting an execution result of the corresponding query to provide the item about the accident history in a state that allows inquiry. Therefore, the present invention is capable of preventing forgery or falsification and transparently managing information about previous car accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 상기 자동차 사고이력 관리시스템에 로그인하는 단계(S100); 상기 로그인한 사용자가 관리자에 해당하지 아니한 경우, 상기 사용자가 조회하고자 하는 차량번호 또는 차대번호를 입력하는 단계(S200); 상기 확인하고자 하는 이력에 관한 사항이 포함된 옵션을 선택하여 쿼리문을 확정하는 단계(S300); 사용자가 조회하고자 하는 해당 차량번호 또는 차대번호가 존재하는 지를 판단하는 단계(S400); 사용자가 선택한 상기 옵션에 따른 마일리지 금액을 계산하는 단계(S500); 사용자의 마일리지 정보를 요청하는 단계(S600); 마일리지 충전모듈을 실행하는 단계(S700); 사용자의 마일리지에서 계산된 상기 옵션에 따른 마일리지 금액을 차감하는 단계(S800) 및 해당 쿼리문의 실행결과를 출력하여 사고이력에 관한 사항을 조회가능한 상태로 제공하는 단계(S900)로 구성되어, 위조 또는 변조할 수 없도록 하고 자동차의 사고이력에 관한 정보를 투명성 있게 관리할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Simulation system for hazardous work
title_ko: 위험작업 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a risky work simulation system, and in the present invention, systematically arranged/provided are: a computer module capable of supporting a selection procedure; a computer module capable of executing a simulation procedure related to risky work; and a computer module capable of forcibly stopping risky work. Accordingly, an effect of improving the ability to respond to an emergency situation can be provided.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위험작업 시뮬레이션 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에서는 운영체제를 구비한 정보처리기기의 통신 구조 항에, <작업자의 설비 종류 또는 장치 종류의 선택절차, 작업자의 설비 타입 또는 작업 타입의 선택절차, 작업자의 작업 세부종류의 선택절차 및 작업자의 시나리오의 선택절차를 지원할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <작업자가 선택한 설비 또는 장비, 작업 종류가 반영된 시나리오를 추출한 후, 해당 시나리오를 실사 사진 또는 2D 모션 그래픽을 통해 구현하면서, 위험작업과 관련된 시뮬레이션 절차를 실행할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <위험작업 시뮬레이션 절차의 진행 하에서, 위험작업이 제한 시간을 초과하면, 해당 위험작업을 강제 중단할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <위험작업 시뮬레이션 절차의 진행 하에서, 보호 가중치를 적용하여, 작업자의 건강 수치를 표시하고, 작업자의 건강 수치가 기준 % 이하이면, 위험작업을 강제 중단할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <위험작업 시뮬레이션 절차의 진행 하에서, 작업 측정 장비 가중치를 적용하여, 산소농도, 온도, 또는 가스농도를 포함하는 작업환경 값을 표시하고, 작업환경 값이 기 설정되어 있던 기준 값을 초과하면, 위험작업을 강제 중단할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <위험작업 시뮬레이션 절차의 진행 하에서, 작업자가 선택한 보호구 및 장비의 유효성을 체크하고, 해당 체크 결과에 따라, 작업자 측에서, 유효성이 인증된 보호구 및 장비만을 착용할 수 있도록 제어할 수 있는 전산모듈> 등을 체계적으로 배치/제공하고, 이를 통해, 시스템 측에서, 위험작업 운영주체/작업자(사용자) 측에게, '위험작업에 대한 인터랙티브한 시뮬레이션 교육으로 작업내용을 숙지할 수 있도록 지원하는 효과', '작업숙지에 따른 사고방지 및 돌발상황 대응 능력 향상 효과', '사용자 선택에 의한 유지보수 교육 진행으로. 피교육자의 적극적인 참여와 교육효과 향상 효과', '다양한 시나리오에 대한 실사사진 및 2D 모션(인포)그래픽으로 컨텐츠 구성하여 재미있게 교육을 진행할 수 있게 되는 효과', '사용자가 선택한 내용에 따라 확인사항 선택 여부를 기록하고 결과 리포트를 발행할 수 있게 되는 효과' 등을 폭 넓게 제공할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Multifunction Portable Electronic Device and Mobile Phone with Touch Screen, Internet Connectivity, and Intelligent Voice Recognition Assistant
abstract_en: A multifunction portable electronic device, mobile device, or smart phone may have a touch screen, cellular radio, microphone, speakers, video, camera, voicemail, website, and Internet connectivity. The device records spoken audio, processes the audio, transcribes the audio into text, and displays the text on the screen. The spoken audio may be used for composition of emails or documents. The mobile device may accept voice commands for actions including calling, dialing a number, or accessing an Internet site. The device may use local or server-based voice recognition software. Voice patterns may be stored in a database specific to an individual. Voice may be used to control functions on the device, a server, Internet site, or an intelligent television. The mobile device may communicate using an inside line path such as a Bluetooth, Ethernet, USB, WiFi or 802.11x or a cellular, GSM, CDMA, LTE, GPS, or other outside line path.

title_en: System and method for coordinated health monitoring, emergency response, and medical record delivery
abstract_en: A computer-based system for providing coordinated health monitoring, emergency response, and medical record delivery. The system can include computing devices configured to process emergency-related indicators and data. The system can also include monitoring devices communicatively linked to the computing devices. The monitoring devices can be configured to monitor a particular area for the emergency-related indicators and data, wherein the monitoring devices detect speech, sounds, images and other detectable emergency-related indicators. The monitoring devices can also be configured to transmit the emergency-related indicators and data to the computing devices. Furthermore, the system can include a module linked to the monitoring devices and configured to execute on the computing devices. The module can analyze the transmitted emergency-related indicators and data to determine whether there is an emergency, communicate with a monitoring service to validate that an emergency exists, and provide access to patient records to authorized personnel, when an emergency exists.

title_en: Video Content Analysis System and Method for Transportation System
abstract_en: A video content analysis system for mobile assets that includes track detection and infrastructure monitoring component. The track detection and infrastructure monitoring includes a reinforcement learning component, an object detection and location component, and an obstruction detection component to analyze video data, audio data, vehicle data, weather data, and route/manifest data to determine internal and/or external conditions relating to an the asset. A data acquisition and recording system uploads the data, internal and/or external condition information, object detection information, object location information, and obstruction detection information to a remote memory module and provides streaming video data in real-time to a remotely located user.
