Remotely located users can view the data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validates the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitors crew performance and safety.

title_en: Real-time wildfire incident monitoring system
abstract_en: A real-time incident monitoring system has a bi-spectrum infrared and visible-light camera and a wireless transmitter that transmits a video signal from the camera to a remote server. The camera is mounted in a location and position to monitor places at risk for wildfire breakout, for example, on mountaintops or near equipment such as power lines. The server monitors the infrared video signal for temperature anomalies and causes an alert to be sent to an end-user if a heat signature measured using the infrared image exceeds a predetermined level or falls outside a predetermined range, or if fire or smoke is detected. The server also provides access to live video stream and recorded video of the infrared and visible-light imaging for real-time human observation.

title_en: Full-chain digital command, dispatch, training and assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of full-chain management, in particular to a full-chain digital command and dispatch training assessment system, which comprises a monitoring module, a signal module, a receiving module and a learning module, wherein the monitoring module comprises a plurality of electronic fences which are arranged in groups and used for monitoring the advancing position of a target to be tested in real time, recording the time of passing through a single electronic fence when the target to be tested advances, transmitting communication frequency bands of a plurality of frequencies in real time, the receiving module is used for monitoring the corresponding communication frequency bands and receiving the time difference of any target to be tested arriving at or leaving any electronic fence, the learning module is used for preprocessing the time difference to generate corresponding preprocessed data and learn, a time difference monitoring graph is generated, the communication frequency bands are adjusted, the time difference of the target to be tested is visualized, and the operation efficiency of the system is improved while the accuracy of monitoring training track of the target to be tested is effectively improved, so that the training process can be monitored more accurately.

title_en: Apparatus for controlling lighting devices and heating/cooling equipment, and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 방범 시스템을 이용한 조명 및 냉난방 설비 제어장치 및 그방법
abstract_en: A light and heating and cooling equipment using a crime prevention system, and a method thereof, are provided to control a switch of the heating and cooling equipment by being linked to a state of a crime prevention controller. A card reader(210) recognize an access card to determine whether a visitor is allowed to enter or not. A crime prevention controller(220) outputs an alarm generation control signal, and confirms whether invasion or a disaster is generated. A management server(230) processes control commands of all system, and is communicated with the crime prevention controller. A light switch(240) and a switch of equipment(250) are connected electrically and operated depending on the crime prevention controller.
abstract_ko:
방범 시스템을 이용한 조명 및 냉난방 설비 제어장치 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 이 제어장치는 출입허용 카드를 인식하는 카드 리더와; 카드 리더로부터의 정보 및 각종 센서로부터의 신호를 분석하고 경보발생 제어신호를 출력하는 방범 컨트롤러와; 방범 컨트롤러로 입출력되는 정보를 검색하고 프로그램 세팅 및 제어, 영상 및 소리 출력, 제어데이터 입력에 관한 모든 시스템 제어 명령을 처리하는 방범/출입 관리 서버를 포함하는 방범 시스템을 이용한 조명 및 냉난방 설비 제어장치에 있어서, 상기 방범 컨트롤러에는 일반 건물에 설치되어 있는 조명 장치의 점등 및 소등에 관여하는 조명 스위치와, 냉난방 설비의 가동 및 정지에 관여하는 설비 스위치가 각각 전기적으로 접속되며, 상기 방범 컨트롤러의 세팅(경계)시에는 상기 조명 스위치와 냉난방 설비 스위치가 자동으로 연동하여 오프(OFF) 작동하고, 상기 방범 컨트롤러의 해제시에는 상기 조명 스위치와 냉난방 설비 스위치가 자동으로 연동하여 온(ON) 작동하도록 구성된다. 
     이와 같은 제어 장치 및 방법에 의하면, 고가의 BAS 시스템 대신에 기존의 방범 컨트롤러를 그대로 이용하여 시스템을 구성할 수 있어 설치비용을 절감할 수 있고, 사용자의 편리성을 제고할 수 있다.

title_en: Radiological emergency response and analysis system and method using meterological observation data on nuclear power plant sites
title_ko: 방사선비상대응 원전부지 기상관측자료 분석 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a meteorological observation data analysis system for a nuclear power plant site in response to a radiological emergency, capable of increasing accident countermeasure capability, and a method thereof. According to the present invention, the meteorological observation data analysis system for a nuclear power plant site comprises a data analysis module, a database, and a determination module. Moreover, the method comprises the following steps: collecting data observed in a meteorological tower installed in a nuclear power plant site and analyzing the collected data; storing rainfall and wind analysis data in the database for each season, month, and time; trying to secure real-time data from the meteorological tower upon a nuclear power plant accident; and using the rainfall and wind data stored in the database to select countermeasures when the real-time data cannot be acquired.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방사선비상대응 원전부지 기상관측자료 분석 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는, 원전 부지에 설치된 기상탑에서 관측된 데이터를 수집하고, 수집된 데이터를 분석하는 데이터 분석 모듈; 상기 데이터 분석 모듈의 분석 결과를, 개별 원전 부지에 대해 계절별, 월별 및 시간별로 강수 및 바람 분석 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스; 및 원전 사고 시 상기 원전 부지에 설치된 기상탑에서 실시간 데이터 확보가 불가능한 경우, 상기 데이터베이스에 저장된 원전 사고가 발생한 원전 부지에 대한 강수 및 바람 분석 데이터를 이용하여, 대응전략을 선택하는 판단 모듈을 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명은 방사선비상대응 원전부지 기상관측자료 분석 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는, (1) 원전 부지에 설치된 기상탑에서 관측된 데이터를 수집하고, 수집된 데이터를 분석하는 단계; (2) 상기 단계 (1)의 분석 결과를, 개별 원전 부지에 대해 계절별, 월별 및 시간별로 강수 및 바람 분석 데이터를 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계; (3) 원전 사고 시 상기 원전 부지에 설치된 기상탑에서 실시간 데이터 확보를 시도하는 단계; 및 (4) 상기 단계 (3)의 실시간 데이터 확보가 불가능한 경우, 상기 데이터베이스에 저장된 원전 사고가 발생한 원전 부지에 대한 강수 및 바람 분석 데이터를 이용하여, 대응전략을 선택하는 단계를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 방사선비상대응 원전부지 기상관측자료 분석 시스템 및 방법에 따르면, 원전 부지에 설치된 기상탑에서 관측된 데이터를 수집 및 분석하여 개별 원전 부지별로 저장 및 관리하고, 원전 사고 시 원전 부지에 설치된 기상탑에서 실시간 데이터 확보가 불가능한 경우, 상기 데이터베이스에 저장된 분석 데이터를 이용하여 대응전략을 선택함으로써, 기상탑 유실 등에 따른 실시간 기상 정보 단절 시에도 개별 원전 부지의 세부적인 기상 특성을 반영하여 사고 대응 능력을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: A WATER LEVEL MEASUREMENT SYSTEM USING CCTV-based ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
title_ko: cctv 기반의 인공지능을 적용한 수위계측 장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 농업용 저수지의 현장에서 실제 수위을 CCTV로 촬영하여 인공지능으로 수위를 계측하고 시설물의 안전사고을 예방하는 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 드론으로 저수지를 촬영하여 3D 실사화로 모델링 작업을 진행하고 리얼타임 3D 제작 프로그램으로 시뮬레이션을 진행하여 시뮬레이션 과정을 레코드형태로 저장하여 저장된 레코드들을 CNN 기반 알고리즘으로 학습한다. 학습이 완료되면 현장에 설치되어 본 발명 제품에 적용하고 본 발명 제품에서 CCTV로 저수지 실제 수위를 촬영하여 생성된 이미지를 CNN 기반 알고리즘에 대입하여 수위를 계측하고 결과를 지정된 서버로 전송하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
관리자가 자주 방문하지 못하는 저수지와 같은 시설물에 본 발명이 설치되어 상, 하, 좌, 우, 360도 주변 상황을 촬영하고 실시간으로 촬영된 영상에서 미리 정의된 사람, 동물, 구조물, 물에 빠진 사람, 산불, 제방붕괴, 여수로 붕괴 등과 같이 대상물을 특정하고, 대상물에 따라 이벤트를 달리하여 대응 조치를 차별화 할 수 있으며, 다른 관리주체에게 이벤트 정보를 전달하기 위해 Trap을 전송할수 있으며, 대상물이 탐지되는 동안 대상물을 따라다니면서 녹화하고 녹화영상을 서버로 전송하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
안정적인이고 예측 가능한 물관리을 위해서 예측 시뮬레이션을 진행하여 정상 단계인지, 관심 단계인지, 주의 단계인지, 심가 단계인지, 사전 방류해도 되는지 예측하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명이 설치되는 장소는 인터넷망이 설치되지 않는 지역으로써 Lora, Cat.M1, LTE와 같은 모뎀이 사용되는데 서버로 전송되는 데이터 패킷을 최소화하기 위해서 본 발명의 압축기법을 활용하여 서버로 데이터 패킷을 전송하는 시스템이다.

title_en: A possible computer reading recording medium saved search program for recycling of sealed radioisotope source
title_ko: 밀봉 방사성동위원소 선원의 재활용 검색 프로그램을 저장한 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a computer readable recording medium storing program for retrieval of sealed radioisotope sources. The purpose is to enable a user who wishes to recycle a sealed RI source to easily and quickly search for information on a sealed RI source corresponding to the search information requested on the website of a related public institution such as the Korea Radioactive Waste Agency, thereby activating the reuse of sealed RI sources. The program comprises: a search program execution step in which a search engine link program installed on a user terminal is executed; a search pop-up window display step in which a search pop-up window is displayed on a screen of the user terminal when the search program execution step is executed; a search target information input step in which search target information is input through a search information input field in the search pop-up window displayed on the screen of the user terminal in the search pop-up window display step; a search command step in which the search target information entered in the search target information input step is transmitted to a search engine; and a search result display step in which the user terminal receives the search results from the search engine and displays the search results through the search result display field in the search pop-up window.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 밀봉 방사성동위원소 선원의 재활용 검색 프로그램을 저장한 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것이며, 그 목적은 밀봉 RI 선원의 재활용을 원하는 사용자가 한국원자력환경공단 등과 같은 유관 공공기관의 홈페이지 상에서 요구되는 검색정보에 해당되는 밀봉 RI 선원의 정보를 간편하고 신속하게 검색할 수 있도록 하여 밀봉 RI 선원에 대한 재활용을 활성화시킬 수 있도록 하는 것이며, 그 구성은 사용자 단말기에 설치된 검색엔진 링크 프로그램이 실행되는 검색프로그램 실행단계와; 상기 검색프로그램 실행단계이 실행되면, 상기 사용자 단말기의 화면에 검색팝업창을 표시하는 검색팝업창 표시단계와; 상기 검색팝업창 표시단계에서 상기 사용자 단말기의 화면에 표시된 검색팝업창 내의 검색정보입력필드를 통해 검색대상정보를 입력하는 검색대상정보 입력단계와; 상기 검색대상정보 입력단계에서 입력된 검색대상정보를 검색엔진에 전달하는 검색명령단계와; 상기 사용자 단말기가 상기 검색엔진에 의해 검색된 결과를 전달받아 상기 검색팝업창 내의 검색결과표시필드를 통해 상기 검색된 결과를 표시하는 검색결과표시단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Wearable heads-up display (“HUD”) for a pharmacy workflow management system
abstract_en: A wearable heads-up display (“HUD”) for a pharmacy workflow management system is disclosed herein. An example HUD includes smart-glasses that are communicatively coupled to a client device. The smart-glasses include at least one camera and/or barcode scanner to record information needed for the verification of a medication dose during medication formulation preparation. The smart-glasses include at least one microphone to record voice commands. Further, the smart-glasses include at least one embedded display screen that shows sequential steps of a preparation protocol for guiding a pharmacy technician to prepare a medication dose. An application on the client device and/or the smart-glasses is configured to recognize and use voice commands to provide navigation for the embedded display screen. The voice commands may also be used to provide data entry for medication dose preparation verification. Gestures may be detected by the camera and translated by the application into navigation or data entry commands.

title_en: A kind of full landform multifunctional fuel disaster unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of full landform multifunctional fuel disaster units, its structure includes chassis, driver's cabin and compartment, it is characterized in that, the front end on chassis is provided with hydraulic capstan, warning lamp is provided at the top of driver's cabin, the front end of car body top is provided with PTZ camera, the rear end of car body top is provided with lifting illumination lamp, the top of the two sides in compartment has been respectively articulated with tilt-up door, fold-down door has been respectively articulated in the lower part of the two sides in compartment, the back door in compartment is made of the flap for being hinged on compartment upper rear end with the tailgate for being hinged on compartment lower part, the front end of driver's cabin is provided with bumper；Interior forward end in compartment is provided with generating set, is respectively arranged with shelf in interior two sides, and the bottom in compartment is provided with floor pull ring, is provided on the inside of tailgate and folds pull ladder.The utility model integrates the functions such as emergency first-aid repair, illumination, long-range control and command, ensure that timeliness, the reliability, safety of gas rush-repair rescue.

title_en: Gas environment emergency detection system
abstract_en: A gas environment emergency detection system comprises a gas detector, a data acquisition processor, a large and medium mobile emergency platform and an emergency command center system; the gas detector is in data connection with the data acquisition processor, and the data acquisition processor is in data connection with the emergency command center system and the large and medium mobile emergency platform respectively; and the emergency command center system is in data connection with the large and medium mobile emergency platform. The gas environment emergency detection system has the advantages of strong anti-interference capability, accurate inspection, difficult influences by impurity gases, small volume and simple operation, and can automatically distinguish and qualitatively and quantitatively measure all gases with the characteristic spectrums recorded in the database of an apparatus on the apparatus through an electrochemical and semiconductor sensor combination array.

title_en: A kind of vehicle accident immediate processing method based on drive recorder
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of vehicle accident immediate processing method based on drive recorder, specifically include following steps: S1: different automobile types is set up respectively three-dimensional feature storehouse, sets up information of vehicles storehouse, by three-dimensional feature storehouse and Access Control center, information of vehicles storehouse；S2: control centre receives vehicle accident alarm call, and control centre transfers scene of a traffic accident drive recorder video data according to the information provided in alarm call；The video data transferred is compared by S3: control centre with the vehicle in three-dimensional feature storehouse and information of vehicles storehouse, it is determined that incident classification；S4: choose corresponding preliminary treatment scheme according to incident classification and scheme and accident relevant information are fed back to accident treatment personnel.The present invention utilizes the video data of drive recorder record, auxiliary accident treatment personnel to make accident and process fast and effectively, reduce the time of accident treatment, alleviate the working strength of accident treatment personnel, add the work efficiency of accident treatment personnel.
assignees: HEFEI VLINE COMPUTER TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Emergency communication system based on mobile intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency communication system based on a mobile intelligent terminal, which comprises a management server, a GSM mobile phone cat cluster module, a telecom operator short message gateway module, a call center module, a mobile intelligent terminal APP and a monitoring system, wherein the management server is used for managing a mobile phone cat cluster; the management server is interconnected with the GSM mobile phone cat cluster module, the telecom operator short message gateway module and the call center module, so that the functions of converting GSM network mobile phone communication protocols of different operators, performing emergency dispatching between a user and the call center module, recording uplink and downlink information of emergency information and the like are realized. The mobile intelligent terminal APP and the management server are in web butt joint, information such as characters, voice, images, videos and positions can be conveniently uploaded to the management server through a user of the mobile intelligent terminal APP, and the information is sent to the call center module through the management server, so that rescue workers can be instructed to visually know disaster site conditions and take rescue measures in time.

title_en: Beidou-based comprehensive traffic scheduling and emergency commanding system and method
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of traffic systems, and provides a Beidou-based comprehensive traffic scheduling and emergency command system and method, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the operation perception layer is used for connecting multi-source data and storing and utilizing the data; the data resource layer is used for receiving the acquired information, establishing a data standard specification and an information resource sharing catalogue, and establishing a comprehensive database; the platform supporting layer is connected with the data resource layer and comprises a data sharing and exchanging system, a workflow management platform, a communication scheduling platform and a geographic information system; the service application layer is connected with the platform support layer and comprises three service application systems of a prior service application system, a middle service application system and a later service application system; and the display layer is connected with the service application layer and presents the data subjected to background access processing in a form of a graph. Therefore, the comprehensive traffic operation condition can be mastered in real time, efficient coordination command can be carried out according to specific conditions, the labor cost is saved, and the information resource utilization rate and the timeliness are improved.
assignees: BEIJING GAOCHENG SCIENCE & TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Safety early warning method for electric power emergency disposal of hazardous chemical substance accident
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a safety early warning method for electric power emergency disposal of dangerous chemical accidents, which comprises the following steps: acquiring basic attribute information and evaluation factor information of dangerous chemical accidents in real time; inputting the basic attribute information and the evaluation factor information into a typical model of the dangerous chemical accident, and determining the current dangerous chemical accident and a typical accident matched in the typical model of the dangerous chemical accident according to the basic attribute information; determining the similarity between the current dangerous chemical substance accident and the matched typical accident according to the evaluation factor information, and determining the early warning level corresponding to the current dangerous chemical substance accident; the system server determines early warning information according to the early warning level of the current dangerous chemical accident; and the terminal equipment receives the early warning information sent by the system server in real time. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device have the advantages that timeliness and accuracy of emergency safety early warning of the dangerous chemical accident are improved, and support is provided for timely starting electric power emergency and accurately carrying out electric power emergency response in the dangerous chemical accident.
assignees: LINYI POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;EMERGENCY MAN CENTER OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;CHINA NAT INST STANDARDIZATION

title_en: Dynamic monitoring system for carbon sink of artificial ecological environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic monitoring system for carbon sink in artificial ecological environment, which comprises: a gas concentration monitoring module for constructing confined artificial ecological environment, the inside of major structure is equipped with and is arranged in monitoring and adjusting artificial ecological environment carbon dioxide and oxygen concentration. The invention simulates the temperature and humidity, the carbon dioxide concentration, the oxygen concentration, the air pressure and the like of the external environment, so that the photosynthetic rate in the closed space is the same as that of the same kind of plants outside, the light receiving surface of the glass cover is wiped through the rubber strip, the insufficient illumination caused by fogging is prevented, water is stored through the long box in the wiping process, the accumulated water is automatically poured after returning, the incident light angle is adjusted, the injection amount and the release amount of carbon dioxide are respectively recorded, the carbon dioxide absorption amount is calculated, the carbon dioxide consumption amount in the closed environment is calculated, the carbon sequestration capacity of the closed environment in different time periods can be dynamically monitored, and the effective evaluation of the carbon sequestration capacity of the artificial ecological environment in different time periods is facilitated.
assignees: NANJING ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF MINISTRY OF ECOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT

title_en: Meteorological disaster early warning system based on child daemon
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of weather services, and discloses a weather disaster early warning system based on child daemon, which comprises a data collection module, a data analysis module and a data output module. This storm flood disaster early warning system based on children's safety guard sets up location information unit, weather information unit and voice information unit through data collection module, gather the safety guard dataset, data analysis module calculates safety command Aqzl and dangerous command Wxzl and transmits to data output module, through warning unit and alarm unit single or cyclic output safety warning dataset to children's communication wrist-watch and parent's mobile phone terminal, the timeliness of children's receipt message has been guaranteed, accurate early warning disaster information, data output module is according to children's voice data control cyclic alarm, guarantee children consciousness conscious man-machine interaction carries out the conversation, pacify emotion guiding escape, safety guard function is strong.
assignees: ZHUAO METEOROLOGICAL INNOVATION AND APPLICATION RES CENTER

title_en: Fire disaster early warning method and system for coal mine and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire disaster early warning method, a fire disaster early warning system and a storage medium for a coal mine, wherein a multi-mode sensor network is arranged in the coal mine; after the data are subjected to cleaning, time synchronization and fusion treatment, multi-mode characteristic data are extracted, and fire risk scores are calculated through a fire risk assessment model; uploading fire risk characteristic data to a blockchain network for encryption storage, monitoring in real time through intelligent contracts, automatically triggering early warning signals and starting an emergency response program; combining virtual reality and augmented reality technologies, constructing a virtual model of a mine, and dynamically displaying a fire risk area and a flame spreading path; the control center starts an emergency response program according to the early warning signal, and feeds back the emergency treatment condition in real time through the virtual reality and augmented reality equipment, so as to implement fire emergency exercise and capability improvement; the fire disaster early warning system effectively improves the accuracy of fire disaster early warning and the efficiency of emergency response, and reduces casualties and property loss caused by fire disasters.
assignees: CHONGQING MAS SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode-fused large model robot for finance escort
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of robots, and discloses a multi-mode-fused large model robot for financial escort, which comprises a multi-mode sensing layer module, a data warehouse module, a large model module for financial escort and a business support application module. The system realizes automation and informatization of escort registration and management, reduces the complexity and errors of manual operation and improves the working efficiency. Meanwhile, the data analysis and prediction functions provided by the large model of the finance escort can provide scientific basis for dispatching and management of escort tasks, and further optimize the management flow. The real-time monitoring and abnormal alarming functions can enable monitoring staff to find problems in time and take measures, and timeliness and effectiveness of emergency treatment are improved.
assignees: GOSUNCN XUNMEI CHONGQING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency resource management system for railway vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency resource management system for railway vehicles, which relates to the technical field of resource management and comprises an emergency command large screen, an electronic map, an emergency management module, a tool management module, an emergency resource module and an emergency regulation module, wherein the emergency command large screen visually displays system emergency points, accumulated emergency times and statistics of operation doors through a chart, the electronic map is used for displaying the distribution conditions of the emergency points, the operation doors, stations and line resources, the emergency management module comprises an emergency mechanism portal, an emergency cabinet portal, an emergency command portal and an emergency record portal, the tool management module comprises a tool account portal, a tool visualization portal and an access library record portal, the address list portal is used for inquiring and managing personnel information, and the modules are tightly matched and cooperatively work, so that comprehensive and efficient management of emergency resources can be realized, and the safety and stability of railway transportation can be effectively ensured.
assignees: INFORMATION TECH INSTITUTE OF CHINA RAILWAY ZHENGZHOU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method, Apparatus for Food Safety Data Analysis Based on Big Data, And a Computer-readableStorage Medium for executing the Method
title_ko: 빅데이터 기반 식품 안전 데이터 분석 장치, 그 방법 및 그 방법을 실행시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빅데이터 기반 식품 안전 데이터 분석 장치, 그 방법 및 그 방법을 실행시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 빅데이터 기반 식품 안전 데이터 분석 장치는, 식품 안전과 관련된 용어의 개체 유형과 관계의 의미를 기준으로 개체 인스턴스들을 그룹화 및 추상화하여 클래스를 정의하고, 이들 간의 관계를 정의하는 온톨로지 스키마를 구축하는 온톨로지 구축부; 식품 안전과 관련된 뉴스나 SNS 데이터를 실시간으로 수집하는 실시간 데이터 수집부; 상기 수집한 데이터에서 식품 안전과 관련된 개체명 및 개체명 간의 연관정보를 추출하고, 추출한 각 개체명에 개체정보를 태깅하여 출력하는 개체명 추출부; 상기 추출된 개체명을 상기 개체정보에 기초하여 상기 온톨로지 스키마에 따라 분석하여 스키마 매핑 및 인스턴스 매핑을 수행하여 추론하는 매핑추론부; 및 상기 데이터 수집부에서 수집한 데이터 리스트, 상기 개체명 추출부에서 추출한 상기 개체명 및 상기 개체정보, 및 상기 매핑추론부의 분석 및 매핑결과를 시각화하는 데이터 시각화부를 포함한다. 
이에 의해 직관적으로 식품 안전에 관한 데이터 및 관계 등을 쉽게 알 수 있도록 하며, 식중독 사고 등 식품 안전 사고가 발생한 경우, 관련 급식소 정보를 추출하여 신속한 사고 대응을 가능하게 해준다.
assignees: KOREA FOOD RES INST;KOREA INST SCI & TECH INF

title_en: Secure equipment and method of processing an emergency call in a telecommunication network
abstract_en:
The present invention relates to a method of processing an emergency call in a telecommunication network (10), a secure equipment (100) performing the method and a telecommunication network (10) comprising said secure equipment (100). The invention further relates to a network agent (120) in a telecommunication network (10) providing additional information relating to an individual (22) making an emergency call and relating to the location of an emergency call. 
More specifically present application relates to the case that when an emergency call is initiated a process is invoked to determine all personal information pertaining to the calling person (examples given name, date of birth) and the present location of the caller. This information can be provided to public authorities or a dispatch centre such that ambulances can be dispatched to the specified location. Also mentions recording of the distress call. Detecting abnormal call peaks from a location, for example in case of a terrorist attack, natural disaster and then listening in to conversations coming from the same location so as to determine the cause for the call peak, such that global security activities can be undertaken. Eavesdropping by public authorities depending on origination of call.

title_en: Scoring Server
abstract_en: A scoring server for assessing technical skills in a practical environment. A client application acts as a middle man between a terminal and an operating system to capture and forward all input from and output to students to the scoring server. The scoring server compares recorded student activity against a list of tasks deemed capable of accomplishing course objectives assigned to students. As objectives are met by a student, the students' grade is updated in real-time. Each student passes or fails an exam based on tasks performed and skills employed. The client application exists for two operating system types: windows and LINUX. A LINUX client employs a pseudoterminal to permit access to terminal input/output and communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr channels. A windows client (WC) comprises a WC command line activity logger and a WC monitor process to intercept all communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr communication channels.

title_en: Driving simulation test method for test bench of power system of electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a driving simulation test method in the field of a power system of an electric automobile. In the method, a speed curve part, a power calculating and matching part, a data processing part, a dynamometer, a vehicle road impedance realization part, an accelerator output part, a brake output part, a shift operation part and the power system are combined, and the corresponding functional modules are integrated; by setting target speed-time parameters, technical parameters of different vehicles and the like and calculating and matching the power of the whole vehicle, different commands such as rotating speed, torque, accelerator, brake, clutch, shift and the like at different speeds are obtained, and components on a test bench of the power system of the electric automobile perform corresponding actions so as to complete driving simulation tests under different predetermined road conditions and different vehicle models; and analysis can be performed according to the acquired and recorded related data after the tests are finished so as to obtain the related performance analysis report of the power system and complete the driver driving simulation test on the test bench of the power system of the electric automobile.
assignees: HUNAN CSR TIMES ELECTRIC AUTOMOBILE CO LTD

title_en: Emergency information service system and method based on satellite-borne unmanned aerial vehicle and high-flux satellite
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency information service system and method based on a satellite-borne unmanned plane and a high-flux satellite, which realize real-time sensing, information support and emergency command from the rear to the front based on the high-flux satellite, and comprise a multi-node sensing platform, the high-flux satellite, a satellite-ground integrated communication network and an emergency communication command center; the multi-node aware platform includes: satellite base nodes, space base nodes and ground nodes. The emergency information service method based on the manned satellite and the high-flux satellite comprises two working modes, namely: the remote automatic real-time sensing mode and the data and instruction bidirectional real-time feedback mode, the high-flux communication satellite link can improve the data transmission rate and timeliness, and the hundred percent success rate of unmanned aerial vehicle tasks is met. The system combines the flexibility of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the advantages of high-speed, real-time and wide-area coverage of the broadband communication satellite, can meet the industry with higher real-time requirements, and particularly aims at emergency information service under the scenes of serious disasters or military requirements.

title_en: Digital conversion sand table construction method and system based on aerial photography technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital conversion sand table construction method and a system based on an aerial photography technology, which relate to the technical field of three-dimensional sand table construction and comprise the steps of acquiring aerial photography images, and performing dynamic path planning and multi-mode data recording; and generating a three-dimensional digital sand table, and embedding dynamic updating and multi-platform display functions. The method improves the precision of image acquisition, reduces repeated coverage and blind areas, improves the overall efficiency of aerial photographing tasks, reduces splicing errors caused by complex terrain, illumination change and other factors in the traditional method, ensures that the output overall image parameters are more accurate and consistent, improves the detail expressive capacity of the model, lays a solid foundation for the subsequent three-dimensional digital sand table construction, meets the display requirements of multiple platforms, ensures that the sand table model has higher operability and sharing performance in actual scenes such as urban planning, emergency response and the like, and effectively optimizes the user interaction experience.

title_en: System and method for simulating realtime severe accident phenomena for training simulator of the nuclear power plant
title_ko: 원자력발전소 훈련용 시뮬레이터의 실시간 중대사고 모의 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원자력발전소 훈련용 시뮬레이터의 실시간 중대사고 모의 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 참조 원자력발전소의 모든 계통을 모의하도록 구동되어, 대상 원자력발전소에 모의를 위한 동적인 값을 제공하는 시뮬레이터 서버; 해석코드의 구성 원시파일들로부터, 전역 변수 또는 힙(Heap) 변수들로 정의된 변수들을 추출하여, _VAR 구조체 형태의 데이터로 변형하여 전역 데이터베이스부에 등록하고, 등록된 변수정보들을 바탕으로, 해석코드의 구성 원시 프로그램 소스파일들을 변경하여 모의 실행파일을 생성하는 실행파일 생성부; 상기 실행파일 생성부를 통해 추출된 변수정보들이 등록되어 있는 전역 데이터베이스부; 실시간 중대사고 모의를 수행하는 모의 실행부; 및 상기 전역 데이터베이스부에 등록된 모든 전역 변수들의 현재값을 저장하는 전역 메모리부; 를 포함하되, 상기 모의 실행부는, 상기 실행파일 생성부를 통해 생성된 모의 실행파일을 기동하고, 중대사고 현상을 모의하기 위한 발전소 정보들을 초기화 설정하는 설정모듈; 상기 시뮬레이터 서버로부터 실시간 단위시간(one-time step) 진행 또는 종료 여부에 관한 신호를 수신하여, 진행 신호 인지 여부를 판단하는 진행 판단모듈; 및 진행 신호일 경우, 타 계통 모델에서 계산되는 연계변수들의 현재값을 입력받아, 중대사고 현상을 계산하고, 타 계통 모델로의 송신을 위한 연계변수값을 출력하는 연계변수값 출력모듈; 을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Tunnel Autonomous operating system based Embedded using Multimedia and CPS Technology
title_ko: 멀티미디어 정보와 cps 기술을 활용한 임베디드 방식의 터널 자율운영시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an embedded autonomous tunnel operating system utilizing multimedia information and a cyber-physical system (CPS) technology. More specifically, the embedded autonomous tunnel operating system transmits sensing information and recorded image information from camera units to an autonomous tunnel operating and management office when obtaining sensing information related to any one of the temperature, light or brightness level, smoke, and fire hydrant opening information from automatic fire sensing facility installed and built in a tunnel, lets officers in the autonomous tunnel operating and management office obtain remote operation control signals related to a tunnel accident response facility, and enables the officers to respond immediately to an emergency accordingly. When obtaining sensing information related to two or more of the temperature, light or brightness level, smoke, and fire hydrant opening information from an automatic fire sensing facility, the embedded autonomous tunnel operating system transmits operation command signals to the tunnel accident response facility while set event determination conditions are not met as well as transmitting the sensing information, recorded image information from the camera units, and autonomous response operation information to the autonomous tunnel operating and management office. Accordingly, an initial response can be executed by requesting the following response automatically with a related institute on the tunnel management office server when the officers in the autonomous tunnel operating and management office do not request the same to the related institute within a first period set in advance, thereby preventing secondary and tertiary accidents and minimizing property damage and injuries by quickly executing damage control operations.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 멀티미디어 정보와 CPS 기술을 활용한 임베디드 방식의 터널 자율운영시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 터널 내부에 설치 구성된 자동화재탐지설비로부터 온도, 빛(조도), 연기, 소화전 개방 정보 중 어느 하나의 감지 정보를 획득할 경우에 카메라부로부터 촬영 영상 정보와 감지 정보를 터널자율운영관리사무소서버로 송출하여 터널자율운영관리사무소에 상주하고 있는 관리자로 하여금 터널사고조치설비에 대한 동작 원격 제어신호를 획득하여 이에 따라 즉각적으로 초동 대응할 수 있도록 하며, 자동화재탐지설비로부터 온도, 빛(조도), 연기, 소화전 개방 정보 중 적어도 두 개 이상의 감지 정보를 획득할 경우에 설정된 이벤트 판단 조건에 위배되는 경우, 터널사고조치설비에 동작 명령 신호를 송출하여 자율 조치를 수행하고, 카메라부로부터 촬영된 촬영 영상 정보와 두 개 이상의 감지 정보 및 자율 조치한 동작 정보를 터널자율운영관리사무소서버로 송출하여 터널자율운영관리사무소에 상주하고 있는 관리자로 하여금 설정된 제1시간 내에 유관기관으로 후속 조치를 요청하지 않을 경우에 터널관리사무소서버에서 유관기관으로 자동적으로 후속 조치를 요청하여 초기 진압을 수행할 수 있도록 함으로써, 2차 및 3차 사고를 미연에 방지하고, 사태 수습을 신속하게 하여 인명 피해와 재산 피해를 최소화하기 위한 멀티미디어 정보와 CPS 기술을 활용한 임베디드 방식의 터널 자율운영시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and program for providing a decision support service for hazardous chemical spill situation management
title_ko: 유해화학물질 유출사고 상황관리 의사결정 지원 서비스 제공 방법, 장치 및 프로그램
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유해화학물질의 유출사고가 발생 시 유출사고이력을 통해 유출 사고를 수습 및 복구하기 위한 의사결정을 지원해주는 유해화학물질 유출사고 상황관리 의사결정 지원 서비스 제공 방법, 장치 및 프로그램에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 유해화학물질 유출사고 상황관리 의사결정 지원 서비스 제공 방법은 재난 관련 정보를 수집하는 단계와, 수집된 데이터를 이용하여 의사결정 모델을 생성하는 단계와, 화학물질을 보유중인 기관을 점검한 결과를 분석하는 단계와, 유해화학물질 유출사고 신고 접수를 획득하는 단계와, 신고 내용에 따라, 유출사고 발생 지점의 특성 정보를 획득하는 단계와, 상기 특성 정보에 따른 의사결정 모델의 결과를 기초로 유출사고에 대응하기 위한 의사결정을 지원하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Crisis response function AI system for safety on predict accident or disaster with collecting big-data at restricted hazard local area
title_ko: 빅데이터 수집분석으로 제한된 지역 내 재난사고 다발영역 예측과 안전대응 신속처리 인공지능 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 거주인구 또는 유동인구가 많은 지역 중 각종 재난사고가 자주 발생하거나 발생할 수 있는 영역을 인공지능의 빅데이터 수집과 분석을 통하여 빠르게 예측하고 안전한 대응방법을 정확하게 안내하면서 신속한 후속조치가 빠르게 이루어지도록 하는 빅데이터 수집분석으로 제한된 지역 내 재난사고 다발영역 예측과 안전대응 신속처리 인공지능 시스템에 관한 것이며, 주거단지의 각 지역에서 발생되는 각종 재난사고 관련 데이터를 해당 위치정보와 시간정보에 연계시켜 수집 기록하고 재난정보포털서버로부터 재난사고 관련 빅데이터를 해당 위치정보와 시간정보에 연계시켜 주기적으로 수집 기록하고 분석하여 그 발생을 예측하는 인공지능통합처리서버; 인공지능통합처리서버에 접속하고 특정 지역에서 발생되는 재난사고 관련 데이터를 해당 위치정보와 연계시켜 수집 기록하며 패킷프레임으로 암호화하여 인공지능통합처리서버에 전송하는 지역운용관제센터부; 지역운용관제센터부에 접속하고 주거단지의 출입구 위치에 각각 설치되어 출입자의 인원수와 진행방향을 검출하고 출입구 주변의 영상신호와 소리신호를 확보하며 지역운용관제센터부로부터 인가되는 안내메시지를 소리신호와 영상신호로 각각 출력하며 터치에 의한 메시지를 입력받는 출입구영역센서부; 지역운용관제센터부에 접속하고 주거단지의 주차장, 어린이 놀이터, 계단참복도, 구내도로, 쉼터, 공공시설에 각각 설치되어 해당 주변의 영상신호를 가시광선과 적외선으로 확보하고 소리신호를 확보하며 지역운용관제센터부로부터 인가되는 안내메시지를 소리신호와 영상신호로 각각 출력하며 터치에 의한 신호를 입력받는 현장활동영역센서부를 포함하는 특징에 의하여 비교적 넓은 지역에서 다양하게 많이 발생되는 각종 재난사고의 빅데이터를 빠르게 수집하고 인공지능으로 정확하게 분석하여 재난사고가 발생할 수 있는 특정 다발영역과 발생을 예측하고 현장 및 지정된 관리자에게 통보하여 재난사고 예방과 대피 그리고 후속조치가 신속하고 빠르며 정확하게 이루어지도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Systems to infer identities of persons of interest rapidly and alert first responders
abstract_en: Systems, devices, and technical methods of the present disclosure leverage digital visitor logs from confinement facilities to identify people of interest that may be involved in incidents to which first responders are dispatched. When a phone call is received at phone public safety access point, a first query including a name associated with the call is transmitted to a digital visitor log for a confinement facility. A digital response to the first query identifies a visitee who was visited by a visitor by that name while the visitee was in confinement. The visitee's name is then transmitted in a second query to a digital repository containing release records; a digital response indicates the visitee was released before the call was received. An electronic notification that identifies the visitee is transmitted to a device associated with an agent who is responding to the call.

title_en: Fire rescue command equipment
abstract_en: The firefighting rescue command device comprises a command box and a plurality of interphones, wherein each interphone comprises a host machine and a plurality of sub-machines, each sub-machine can realize static detection, ambient temperature detection, ambient gas concentration detection, firefighter position detection and audible and visual alarm of a firefighter, the command box comprises a box body, a cover body, a display module, an information module, a map module and a wireless module, the display module, the information module, the map module and the wireless module are respectively and electrically connected with a command control module, a main containing groove and a plurality of sub-containing grooves are concavely formed in the top surface of the box body and are respectively used for containing the host machine and the sub-machines, the cover body is hinged to the top surface of the box body in an openable mode, the display module is a display screen arranged on the cover body, the information module is used for recording the ambient temperature and the ambient gas concentration detected by each sub-machine, and the map module is used for pre-storing map data. Therefore, the firefighting rescue command equipment can effectively improve the wearing efficiency of the equipment, remind firefighters to avoid danger in time, and effectively improve the firefighting rescue safety.

title_en: Learning tool set for self-growth of youth
title_ko: 청소년의 자기성장을 위한 학습교구세트
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 청소년이 사고의 확장 활동을 통해 자기에 대해 이해하고 스스로의 성장과 발전을 위해 수행 활동을 유지하고 지속하여 자기효능감을 향상시키기 위해, 학습 참여자 간에 친밀감을 형성하고 긴장감을 완화 또는 해소하기 위하여 별칭네임카드, 별칭이미지카드, 별칭캐릭터카드로 구성되는 친밀감형성교구(10); 자신이 과거의 생각 또는 현재 생각하고 있는 것에 대한 감정을 표현하고 감정에 따른 행동을 기록하면서 자신의 감정패턴을 볼 수 있도록 하는 신호등활동지와 감정스티커로 구성되는 감정인식교구(20); 자신의 이야기 또는 자신이 만든 이야기를 자유롭게 작성하면서 스스로 주도적으로 이야기를 만들어 갈 수 있도록 하는 스토리북과 스토리스티커로 구성되는 마이스토리교구(30); 자신의 생각과 이야기를 정리하여 그림 또는 글로 표현하고 발표하는 과정을 통해 자신감과 표현력을 향상시키기 위해 종이재 또는 합성수지재로 형성된 마음액자활동지로 구성되는 힐링프레임교구(40); 자신의 강점 또는 장점을 찾아보고 참여자들이 서로의 강점 또는 장점을 공유할 수 있도록 하여 사소한 것도 장점이 될 수 있음을 이해할 수 있도록 하기 위한 보물상자와, 보물지로 구성되는 자신감향상교구(50); 스스로 목표를 정하고 구체적으로 목표를 이루기 위해 챙겨야 할 물건, 마음가짐, 생각, 행동에 대한 것을 정리할 수 있도록 가방제작활동지, 준비카드로 구성되는 목표설계교구(60); 자신이 설정한 목표를 실천할 수 있도록 작은 변화부터 순차적으로 시작하기 위한 제1도미노, 제2도미노, 제3도미노, 제4도미노, 제5도미노, 제6도미노, 제7도미노, 제8도미노와 힐링도어로 구성되는 마음지도교구(70); 자신이 설정한 목표와 목표를 실천하기 위한 변화를 순서대로 진행하여 원하는 목표를 이룬 자신의 미래 모습을 상상하고 실제로 상상한 모습으로 성장할 의지를 갖도록 하기 위한 종이재, 펠트재, 합성수지재로 형성되는 명함포켓과 명함활동지로 구성되는 자기성장교구(80)를 포함하고, 상기 친밀감형성교구(10), 감정인식교구(20), 마이스토리교구(30), 힐링프레임교구(40), 자신감향상교구(50), 목표설계교구(60), 마음지도교구(70), 자기성장교구(80)를 순차적으로 활용하여 자신을 이해하고 상상하는 목표를 구체적으로 이룰 수 있도록 설정하며, 설정한 목표를 이루기 위하여 실천할 수 있도록 하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Improved application server disaster tolerance system of next generation network and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved application server disaster tolerance system of a next generation network and a method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: a service-call session control function records an incidence relation between address information of a current application server and a subscriber; the service-call session control function receives a service request of the subscriber which is associated with the current application server, and then the service request is triggered to the current application server for processing according to the incidence relation. The system comprises a main application server, one or more spare application server and the service-call session control function. By adopting the technical proposal of the invention, all incidents of one subscriber can be triggered to the current application server for processing, thus avoiding the problem of service loss caused by processing the related services of the subscriber on two or more application servers when the main application server is recovered to normal from the failure.

title_en: real-time data acquisition and recording system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a data acquisition and recording system DARS for mobile assets, comprising a data recorder. The data recorder includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queuing store. The DARS processes data from the at least one input sensor and stores compressed records of the data in a local memory module at least once per second. The DARS is designed to operate in near real-time mode, storing a complete record comprising five minutes of data to the remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once every second and up to once every tenth of a second. The remotely located user may: viewing video, audio and data acquired by the DARS through a web browser, which provides faster emergency response; verifying the effectiveness of the repair and rerouting; and monitor panelist performance and safety.

title_en: The task management system of airport emergency management and rescue
abstract_en: This disclosure relates to a kind of task management system of airport emergency management and rescue, comprising: server is communicated with first terminal and second terminal respectively；First terminal can be communicated with second terminal；Server receives the first task state that first terminal is sent, and first task state indicates that the state of the first primitive task, the first primitive task are the basic step of airport emergency management and rescue；If the state of the first primitive task of server judgement record is different from first task state, the state of the first primitive task of record is updated to first task state by server；Server sends first task state to second terminal, so that the task status of the first primitive task is updated to first task state by second terminal, the task disposition state for holding first terminal base emergency worker can be obtained in time by enabling to hold second terminal commanding, to effectively assist commander's efficiency of emergency management and rescue work of the airport decision-making level commanding's harpoon to emergency event.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY OF CIVIL AVIATION SCIENCE & TECH

title_en: Urban rail transit emergency command system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban rail transit emergency command system and method, wherein the system comprises a comprehensive gateway, a comprehensive server, an emergency dispatching command interaction subsystem and a plurality of terminal devices, the plurality of terminal devices are connected with the comprehensive server through the comprehensive gateway, the emergency dispatching command interaction subsystem is connected with the comprehensive server, alarm information which can be received by the emergency dispatching command interaction subsystem can be automatically and intelligently matched with an emergency plan and can be generated and sent by one key of an action guide, meanwhile, auxiliary decision-making, situation checking, resource query and dynamic feedback tools are provided, and a dispatcher is assisted to carry out emergency command, so that the intelligent matching, real-time adjustment and dynamic evaluation of the emergency plan are realized, a plurality of communication modes are integrated, process information is recorded and analyzed, and the high-efficiency information transmission is realized.

title_en: Emergency broadcasting method, device and equipment for city and county village linkage and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency information transmission and processing, in particular to a city and county village linkage emergency broadcasting method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps that a county level emergency broadcasting platform receives and analyzes emergency information from an upper level emergency broadcasting platform, a local level early warning issuing system and a transverse department, and the emergency information comprises an emergency level, an emergency type and an emergency geographic coordinate; generating a hierarchical classified dispatching scheme according to the level of the emergency information, the emergency type and the geographic coordinate area, wherein the dispatching scheme comprises a resource allocation instruction and a broadcasting priority rule, transmitting the emergency broadcasting information to an emergency broadcasting terminal of a target area through a main-standby dual-channel transmission network, combining a wired IP network with a wireless frequency modulation broadcasting network, monitoring the online state, the broadcasting success rate and coverage area thermodynamic diagram data of the emergency broadcasting terminal in real time, and generating a statistical report containing timeliness assessment indexes. The method and the device have the effect of improving the application scene requirement of emergency broadcasting.

title_en: System and method to monitoring a rail of train with an image
title_ko: 열차 선로 영상 모니터링 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A railroad image monitoring system and a method thereof are provided to monitor a railroad image in a situation room system, thereby precisely detecting railroad malfunction and dangerous articles on a railroad. CONSTITUTION: An image recording part(110) records a railroad(2) image. A railroad communication part(150) transmits a railroad image and railroad system information to a train system. A railroad controller(140) controls the operation of the railroad communication part and the image recording part. The railroad controller transmits the railroad image recorded through the image recording part to the train system. A railroad database part(170) stores the railroad image by being connected to the railroad controller.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 열차 선로 영상 모니터링 시스템 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 특히, 선로를 따라 순차적으로 설치되며, 열차시스템 및 상황실시스템과 통신을 수행하여, 열차 진행 방향 전방의 선로 영상을 열차 진행 상황에 따라 순차적으로 촬영하여 상기 열차시스템과 상황실시스템으로 전송하는 다수 개의 선로시스템; 열차 운전실에 설치되며, 상기 선로시스템과 통신을 수행하여, 상기 선로시스템에서 전송하는 선로 영상 등을 열차 진행 상황에 따라 순차적으로 수신하여 나타내는 열차시스템; 및, 종합 상황실에 설치되며, 상기 선로시스템과 통신을 수행하여, 하나 이상의 선로시스템에서 전송하는 선로 영상 등을 수신하여 나타내는 상황실시스템;을 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 열차 선로 영상 모니터링 시스템 및 그 제어방법이다. 
이러한 본 발명은, 특히, 선로를 따라 설치된 선로시스템을 통해 선로 영상을 촬영하여 열차 운행 상황에 따라 열차시스템에 순차적으로 나타내주고, 필요시 열차 운행을 자동 제어하며, 상황실시스템에서 선로 영상을 모니터링 할 수 있도록 함으로써, 첫째, 운전자가 근거리부터 원거리에 이르는 선로 영상을 보면서 운전할 수 있도록 하고, 둘째, 위험물 존재 여부 및 선로 이상 여부를 검출하여 나타내며, 셋째, 운전자 미 대응 시 열차 운행을 자동 제어함으로써 위험물 등으로 인한 사고를 방지하고, 넷째, 상황실 운영자가 전 노선에 걸친 선로 상황을 용이하게 모니터링 할 수 있는 효과 등이 있다.

title_en: Multi air container
title_ko: 멀티 항공화물 컨테이너
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A multi-purpose air cargo container capable of rapidly loading is provided to enable users to recognize a barcode tag of cargoes when loading the cargoes to the container. CONSTITUTION: A multi-purpose air cargo container includes the following: a controller attached to the container for loading cargoes into an aircraft; a power button(56) for lighting a power-display LED(52) after displaying 0000 on a screen display LED(51); a normality LED(53) notifying users to start a loading process after a tag-checking step for preventing the confusion of the cargoes; a barcode reader or an RFID reader for checking the tag on the cargoes, and wirelessly inputting into the controller; a main computer for searching weight information of each cargo in a database and inputting into the controller, and saving the code number of the container with the cargoes; an alarming LED(54) when the cargoes have the heavier weight than the permitted amount; a danger LED(55) lighted to stop the loading process; and a finishing button on the reader for users to turn off the power-display LED.
abstract_ko:
항공기에 화물을 적재시 사용하는 컨테이너에 컨트롤라(50)를 부착하여 전원 버튼을 길게 눌러 전원을 켜면 화면표시 LED (51)에 "0000"이 표시되고 전원 표시 LED(52)에 점등되며 잠시후 정상 LED(53)가 점등되면 적재작업을 시작한다. 적재작업시 화물의 혼입되는 것을 방지하기 위하여 태그 확인 작업을 하는데 이때에 바코드 리더기나 RFID 리더기로 읽어서 그 내용을 무선으로 컨트롤러에 입력시킨다  
리더기에서 읽은 데이터는 무게의 정보를 가지고 있지 않으므로 메인 컴퓨터에서 읽어들인 데이터를 검색하여 중량 정보를 얻어서 컨트롤러에 입력시킨다. 
컨트롤러는 읽어들인 중량의 정보를 메모리에 저장하고 저장이 완료되면 컨테이너의 고유번호를 다시 메인 컴퓨터에 전송하여 화물이 실린 컨테이너의 코드 번호를 기록하게 하여 화물을 추적하여 분실을 방지한다. 
계속해서 리더기로 읽어 저장하다가 중량이 허용 중량 오버시 주의LED(54)에 점등되고 간헐적인 부져음을 내어 경고를 준다  
또한 계속해서 적재시 위험 설정치 이상 적재시 위험 LED(55)가 점등되고 계속적인 부져 또는 멜로디나 음성을 내어 경고해주며 리더기의 읽어 들이는 데이터를 거부하여 계속 적재가 되지 않게 한다. 
화물컨테이너의 적재가 완료되면 리더기의 완료 버튼을 눌러 전원 LED(52)를 꺼준다.  
적재가 계속되는 동안 적재화물의 수량을 디지탈표시 LED(51)로 표시해주어 외부에서 확인할 수 있도록 한다. 
적재 후에는 표시는 나타지 않지만 콘트롤러 내부에서는 일정시간마다 현재의 온도와 GPS좌표값, 기압 등을 체크 하여 메모리에 기록한다. 
콘트롤러에는 항공기명, 목적 공항명 등을 태그 입력 할때에 리더기에서 일어서 기록한다.  
항공기 컨테이너의 위치는 메인 컴퓨터에서 비교하여 적재 위치와 순서를 정하고 항공기나 공항에서 확인할 수 있도록 한다.  
운항중 강한 충격이나 GPS좌표 계산 결과 급격한 고도 변화시 일정 시간 후에는 자동으로 발신 전파를 송출하여 비상시 위치를 확인할 수 있도록 한다. 
발신 전파는 HAM 사용자 누구라도 확인할 수 있는 주파수 대역에서 간헐적인 신호를 송출하여 위치를 확인할 수 있도록 한다. 
사고 후에 블랙박스의 수거가 어려우나 화물 컨테이너는 수량이 많아 그중에 한두개만 이라도 회수가 될 수 있으므로 회수된 콘트롤러는 저장되어있는 데이터는 일정시간 간격의 GPS좌표와 당시온도, 시간, 기압, 중력 이상 유무등을 기록하고 있으므로 사고 당시의 상황을 유추할 수 있다. 
또한 화물의 변질이나 상해시에도 기록된 데이터의 온도와 기압을 확인하여 운송중 문제점을 파악하여 대처할 수 있는 장점을 가지게 된다.  
 화물 컨테이너는 재질이 가벼우므로 바다에 추락시 물 위에 떠서 쉽게 확인할 수가 있다. 
따라서 콘트롤러는 방수가 되어야 하며 화재시에도 일정시간 견딜 수 있는 재질로 만들어져야 하며 전자파 차폐의 효과도 있어야 한다.

title_en: A multiplex disaster prevention system based on Internet of Things(lot) for radioactive disaster preparadness
title_ko: 방사능재난을 대비한 사물인터넷 기반 다중 방재시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a multi-disaster prevention system based on IoT for preparation of a radiological emergency. The multi-disaster prevention system based on IoT for preparation of a radiological emergency comprises: a radiological emergency prevention command and control center server; multiple disaster prevention agent radiological monitoring smart terminals; multiple first-aid station management and control servers; and a weather center server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사능재난을 대비한 사물인터넷 기반 다중 방재시스템에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 원자력시설 등의 사고로 인해 방사능재난이 발생하였을 때, 다양한 양방향 단말기를 사용하여 방사능 오염위험지역에 대한 방사능 오염 탐지, 오염된 지역에 대한 방사선량률 측정 및 기상상황에 따른 방사능 오염원의 이동경로를 종합적으로 분석하여 신속하고 정확하게 방사능재난에 대응할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 방사능재난 지역의 주민들을 신속하게 안전한 구호소로 소개하여 통제관리할 수 있음은 물론 방재요원들 상호간의 실시간 정보교환 및 방사능방재지휘통제본부과 각 방재요원과의 양방향 교신을 통해 실시간으로 재난상황정보를 공유할 수 있도록 하므로서 방재에 투입되는 방재요원들의 신체 및 심리적 안전을 확보하여 방재대응에 충실할 수 있도록 하는 것이며; 그 구성은 통신망을 통해 수신되는 각종 방재관련 데이터를 저장하고, 저장된 데이터를 분석하여 그 결과에 따라 방재관련 정보를 통신망을 통해 송신하여 방재대응 및 주민대피구호소를 통제관리하는 방사능방재지휘통제본부서버와; 방사능재난 발생 시, 방사능 오염위험지역으로 급파되고, 급파된 지역의 방사능 오염 여부를 탐지, 방사능 오염이 탐지된 구역의 선량률 측정 및 주변환경을 관찰하고, 그 위치, 선량률 주변환경정보를 통신망을 상기 방사능방재지휘통제본부서버로 송신하는 동시에 방사능방재지휘통제본부서버로 부터 방재관련 지휘 및 정보를 수신함은 물론 급파된 방재요원간의 양방향 정보교환을 실시간으로 실시하는 는 다수개의 방재요원 방사능측정스마트단말기와; 각 주민대피 구호소에 설치되고, 상기 방사능방재지휘통제본부서버와 통신망을 통해 연결되고, 각 해당 구소호로 소개된 주민들을 입소등록하고, 입출입통제관리 및 입소자 축적관리를 실시하는 동시에 관련 데이터를 실시간으로 송신하는 다수개의 구호소 관리통제서버와; 상기 방사능방재지휘통제본부서버와 통신망을 통해 연결되고, 상기 방사능방재지휘통제본부서버로 해당 지역의 기상정보를 송신하는 기상청서버로를 포함하며; 방사능방재지휘통제본부서버는 상기 방재요원 방사능측정스마트단말기 및 기상청서버로 부터 수신된 데이터를 기설정된 알고리즘에 따라 저장하고, 저장된 데이터를 기반으로 방사능 오염 위험지역, 방사능 오염 확산 가능지역, 방사능오염 가능한 위치의 구호소, 방사능 오염에 안전한 위치의 구호소 및 각 주민 소개지역에서 방사능 오염에 안전한 위치의 구호소까지 안전하게 이동할 수 있는 안전경로를 분석하고, 그 분석결과가 표시된 지도을 생성하고, 구호소 관리통제서버로 부터 수신된 데이터를 기설정된 알고리즘에 따라 저장하고, 저장된 데이터를 기반으로 각 구호소의 입소주민정보, 출입정보 및 구호소상황정보를 표시하는 필드를 생성하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Mobile Asset Data Recorder and Transmitter
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allows for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with impact detection, rough operating condition detection, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of a mobile asset. Users can use the normal operation of their mobile assets to locate and alert, in real-time, areas where their assets are encountering rough operating environments, to provide for quicker emergency response, and to validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting.
assignees: JORDAN JR LAWRENCE B;MATTA LISA A

title_en: Method for managing violation incident information and violation incident management system and computer-readable recording medium
abstract_en: Provided is a mechanism capable of assigning at least one index (ID) to violation abuse resources, violation association information, and violation information by taking into consideration organic relationships between the violation abuse resources, the violation association information, and the violation information when the generated violation abuse resources, the violation association information, and the violation information are collected through an external violation sharing channel or when they are collected or queried and of managing the generated violation abuse resources, the violation association information, and the violation information.

title_en: Server Based Disaster Recovery by Making Use of Dual Write Responses
abstract_en: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system for asynchronous replication. The mechanism creates a record in a write log in a host computing device for a write command and marking the record as uncommitted. The mechanism maintains a copy of data to be written by the write command at the host computing device. The mechanism issues the write command from the host computing device to a primary storage controller at the primary storage site. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been written to the primary storage site, the mechanism marks the record as unreplicated. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been replicated to a secondary storage site, the mechanism erases the record in the write log and deleting the copy of data.

title_en: Methods and systems for generating time-synchronized audio messages of different content in a talkgroup
abstract_en: Methods and systems for generating time-synchronized audio messages of different content in a talkgroup. One system includes an electronic computing device that includes an electronic processor configured to generate first public safety incident information as a function of context information of a first member of a talkgroup, and second public safety incident information as a function of context information of a second member of the talkgroup. The second public safety incident information is different than the first public safety incident information. The electronic processor is further configured to generate a first audio message including the first public safety incident information sized according to a time window and a second audio message including the second public safety incident information sized according to the time window such that a playback time of the first audio message is approximately the same as a playback time of the second audio message.

title_en: Field monitoring system using a mobile terminal
title_ko: 휴대단말을 이용한 현장 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The invention relates to a field monitoring system using a mobile terminal, the system comprising: a mobile terminal, which transmits context information and receives 3D image information corresponding to said context information, the context information consisting of audio-video information generated by photographing images of the field and by recording sounds in the field, and location information obtained by applying sensed signals from an accelerometer and from a Gyroscope sensor to a GPS signal including latitude, longitude and time; and a control server which receives the context information, matches location information of the context information with a pre-stored map or architectural drawing information to generate 3D image information for the current location of the mobile terminal, and transmits the generated information to the mobile terminal.  Therefore, by using a wireless terminal that utilizes a commercial communication module, GPS and INS,  the invention presents advantages in finding out the location of each personnel member who is sent to even a wide-area disaster, and photographing any unexpected accident or situation or blind spots.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대단말을 이용한 현장 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 현장의 영상촬영 및 음성녹음을 통해 생성한 영상·음성 정보와, 위도, 경도 및 시간을 포함하는 GPS 신호에 가속도 센서 및 자이로 센서의 감지신호가 적용된 위치정보로 이루어진 상황정보를 전송하고, 상기 상황정보에 대응하는 3D 영상정보를 수신하는 휴대단말; 및 상기 상황정보를 접수하고, 상기 상황정보의 위치정보를 기저장된 지도 또는 건축도면 정보에 매칭시켜 상기 휴대단말의 현재 위치에 대한 3D영상 정보를 생성하여 상기 휴대단말로 전송하는 관제서버를 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 상용화된 통신모듈과 GPS 및 INS를 이용하는 무선 단말을 이용하여, 사고의 범위가 넓은 지역에 있어서도 각 투입 인원의 위치파악이 가능하고, 돌발상황 또는 촬영 사각지대의 촬영이 가능한 효과가 있다.
assignees: ID FONE CO LTD;UHM HYUN DUK

title_en: Personnel gathering risk monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a personnel gathering risk monitoring and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring point location information and personnel information of a production device in a chemical production factory in real time; establishing an early warning grading rule according to the point location information of the production device of the chemical production factory area acquired in real time; judging the risk level of the personnel according to the personnel information and the early warning grading rule; and triggering personnel aggregation risk monitoring and early warning according to the risk level and the early warning grading rule. By using the personnel aggregation risk monitoring and early warning method provided by the invention, when different risk conditions are met, personnel can be reasonably dispersed according to the risk early warning, so that the personnel can move within a safety range, the safety of personnel operation and the timeliness of emergency response are improved, and the safety and the production efficiency in a chemical production factory are further improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on time sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on a time sequence, and relates to the technical field of information perception and recognition. The unmanned plane heading determining method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining ship navigation data in real time, recording comparison sequences of different moments and positions, predicting possible positions and headings of ships after AIS (automatic identification system) tracks of the ships disappear for a period of time based on a time sequence analysis model, and then calculating unmanned plane heading determining methods when the ship can search areas based on different navigational speeds based on searching meeting points. According to the invention, under the condition that the current ship position information cannot be acquired, the unmanned aerial vehicle is required to be dispatched to search and rescue the ship, the course of the unmanned aerial vehicle for searching and rescue is calculated and determined after a period of interruption based on a time sequence method, and engineering realization and application are easy.

title_en: System and Method for Transmitting Situation Information based on Multimedia Message Services Using Wireless Modem
title_ko: 무선모뎀을 이용한 메시징 기반의 상황전달 시스템 및 그방법
abstract_ko:
1. 청구범위에 기재된 발명이 속한 기술분야 
     본 발명은 무선모뎀을 이용한 메시징 기반의 상황전달 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것임. 
     2. 발명이 해결하려고 하는 기술적 과제 
     본 발명은 무선통신 단말기를 소지한 사용자들이 자신이 목격한 위험요소나 보안과 관련된 상황정보(즉, 다수의 사람이 모이는 공항, 소방서, 통계청, 경기장, 시내, 중요건물, 각종 관공서 등과 같은 국가의 중요시설에 대한 보안검색 및 위험요소에 대한 상황) 및 불법요소 등을 메시지 형태로 상황전달 시스템에 전달하면 상황전달 시스템이 메시지를 분석하여 관련자들(신고자나 목격자 등의 사용자, 관리자, 위험요소 제거기관 등)에게 대처사항 등의 분석결과를 제공하여 상황을 빠르고 정확하게 인지하게 함으로써, 사고를 사전에 예방하거나 이미 발생된 사고에 신속하게 대처할 수 있게 하는, 무선모뎀을 이용한 메시징 기반의 상황전달 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있음. 
     3. 발명의 해결방법의 요지 
     본 발명은, 상황전달 방법에 있어서, 외부의 무선통신 단말기로 하나 이상의 무선모뎀을 이용하여 상황전달 템플릿을 전송하는 상황전달 템플릿 전송 단계; 상 기 외부의 무선통신 단말기로부터 상기 하나 이상의 무선모뎀을 이용하여 상황전달 템플릿을 포함하는 메시지를 수신하는 메시지 수신 단계; 상기 수신한 상황전달 템플릿을 포함하는 메시지로부터 상황전달 템플릿을 추출하는 단계; 상기 추출한 상황전달 템플릿의 내용을 분석하여 각 미디어 데이터로 분류하는 단계; 상기 분석한 분석 데이터(상황전달 데이터)를 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계; 및 상기 상황전달 데이터에 대한 결과 데이터를 상기 하나 이상의 무선모뎀을 이용하여 해당하는 무선통신 단말기로 송신하는 단계를 포함함. 
     4. 발명의 중요한 용도 
     본 발명은 모든 형태의 무선모뎀을 이용한 메시징 기반의 상황전달 등에 이용됨. 
       
     MMS(Multimedia Message Service), 메시징 기반, 상황전달, 템플릿, 위험요소, 복수 개의 무선모뎀

title_en: Sinkhole monitoring system with gps
title_ko: Gps를 활용한 지반침하 감시 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 광역지구의 지형변화를 감시, 감지, 예측하여서 재해사고 예방에 필요한 조치를 사전에 취할 수 있도록 하는 지형변화 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
각 지점의 융기 및 침하에 따른 지형변화를 실시간으로 감시할 수 있도록, 각 지점에 분산 설치되어 지면의 각도변화를 측정하는 복수의 측정장치와, 각 측정장치의 좌표와 각도변화량을 수집하는 단말기와, 상기 단말기에 연결되며 연산프로그램이 탑재되어 단말기에 수집된 각 측정장치의 좌표데이터와 각도변화량데이터를 이용하여 각 지점의 높낮이 변화를 측정하는 연산장치 등을 포함한다. 
이에 따라, 각 지점의 지형변화에 따른 지반침하를 실시간으로 감시할 수 있으며, 수준측량 등에 비하여 사용이 편리하다.

title_en: System for managing transfer of personal image information
title_ko: 개인영상정보 반출 관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a personal image information export management system. The personal image information export management system according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a plurality of public image photographing devices (10); an image storing server (20) which stores a photographed image as public image information; an image reading management server (30) for a manager which manages the reading of the personal image information; an image reading management server (40) for a user which manages the reading of the personal image information; a manager terminal (50); and a user terminal (60) which performs the reading application of the personal image information and reads the permitted personal image information. Therefore, the present invention can protect the personal image information without an external leakage.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 개인영상정보 반출 관리시스템을 제공한다. 이와 같은 본 발명에 따른 개인영상정보 반출 관리시스템은 공공의 목적으로 CCTV 카메라 등의 공공용 영상촬영장치에 의해 촬영되는 공공 영상정보에 포함될 수 있는 개인영상정보를 각 개인들이 열람하거나 존재 여부를 확인할 수 있으며, 필요시 삭제 처리할 수 있도록 함으로써 공공 영상정보 내에 존재하는 본인의 개인영상정보에 대한 접근과 처리가 용이하게 이루어질 수 있어 개인정보보호법 상의 개인영상정보 열람권이 용이하고 안전하게 보장될 수 있으며, 개인영상정보의 열람 이력이나, 개인영상정보의 열람을 위한 서버에의 접속 로그 등이 누적적으로 저장되어 관리되도록 하는 한편 DRM 처리된 개인영상정보가 암호화/복호화의 과정을 거쳐 열람되도록 함으로써 개인영상정보가 열람되더라도 개인영상정보가 외부 누출없이 보호될 수 있고, 체계적인 개인영상정보 반출 관리를 통해 치매환자, 미아, 사고자, 범죄자 등에 대한 이동경로 추적/이동경로 조회가 원활하고 안정되게 수행되도록 함으로써 치매노인이나 미아을 찾거나, 범죄 관련 디지털 포렌식에 효과적으로 적용될 수 있는 기술적 특징을 갖는다. 
본 발명에 따른 개인영상정보 반출 관리시스템은 설정지점에 각각 설치되어 설정지점 주변 영상을 촬영하는 복수의 공공용 영상촬영장치(10)와; 각 공공용 영상촬영장치(10)와 유무선 통신으로 연결되어 촬영영상을 전달받게 되고, 전달받은 촬영영상을 공공 영상정보로 저장하게 되는 영상보관 서버(20)와; 영상정보 관리자가 접속하여 운용하게 되고, 영상보관 서버(20)와 연동되어 공공 영상정보에 대한 관리를 수행하게 되며, 공공 영상정보로 저장되는 공공용 영상촬영장치(10)의 촬영영상에 포함되어 있는 개인영상정보에 대한 열람 관리를 수행하게 되는 관리자용 영상열람 관리서버(30)와; 개인영상정보 사용자가 접속하게 되고, 영상보관 서버(20)와 관리자용 영상열람 관리서버(30)에 연동되어 개인영상정보에 대한 열람 관리를 수행하게 되는 사용자용 영상열람 관리서버(40)와; 영상정보 관리자에 의해 운용되고, 관리자용 영상열람 관리서버(30)에 접속하게 되는 관리자용 단말기(50) 및; 개인영상정보 사용자에 의해 운용되고, 사용자용 영상열람 관리서버(40)에 접속되어 개인영상정보에 대한 열람신청과 허가된 개인영상정보의 열람을 수행하게 되는 사용자용 단말기(60)를 포함한다.

title_en: AI and deep learning based smart flood control sluice automation control system
title_ko: Ai 및 딥러닝 기반의 스마트 홍수관리 수문제어 자동화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an AI and deep learning-based automated smart flood management and sluice control system which is configured to control a sluice installed in the river or stream by means of an AI and deep learning-based system and integrally manage an operation of the sluice, abnormality of the sluice and the like, thereby promptly responding to a disaster. The system comprises: a CCTV camera (100) provided between inside water and outside water to record an image between the inside water and the outside water; a central server (200) receiving and storing an image photographed by the CCTV camera (100); an image preprocessing module (300) data-preprocessing the image transmitted to the central server (200); an AI extraction engine module (400) creating a water level rise or water level fall prediction model based on an image in which data preprocessing is completed in the image preprocessing module (300); and a water level control module (500) determining whether to open or close the sluice based on the prediction model created by the AI extraction engine module (400).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 강이나 하천에 설치된 수문을 AI와 딥러닝을 기반한 시스템에 의해 제어하고, 수문의 구동과 이상 유무 등을 통합관리하여 재난사고에 신속히 대처할 수 있도록 한 AI 및 딥러닝 기반의 스마트 홍수관리 수문제어 자동화 시스템에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은 내수와 외수 사이에 구비되어 상기 내수와 외수 사이를 촬영하는 CCTV 카메라(100); 상기 CCTV 카메라(100)가 촬영한 이미지를 전송받아 저장하는 중앙서버(200); 상기 중앙서버(200)로 전송된 이미지를 데이터 프리프로세싱(data preprocessing)하는 이미지 전처리 모듈(300); 상기 이미지 전처리 모듈(300)에서 데이터 프리프로세싱이 완료된 이미지를 토대로 수위 상승 또는 수위 하강 예측 모델을 생성하는 AI 추출 엔진 모듈(400); 및 상기 AI 추출 엔진 모듈(400)에서 생성된 예측 모델을 바탕으로 수문의 개방 또는 폐쇄작동 여부를 결정하는 수문 조절 모듈(500);을 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Mirroring file data
abstract_en: High availability and disaster recovery can be achieved within a database management system by detecting which parts of a file have changed and sending the changed parts to secondary servers, without sending the entire file that has experienced the changes. A log cracker reads data from a transaction log that stores records from a database and a separately maintained file system. The log cracker sends mirror commands with some of the transaction log data to the file system to initiate mirroring of the data from the file system to secondary servers. The log data is then subsequently sent to the secondary servers as well, to enable identification of changed data without having to transfer the entire file that has been changed.

title_en: Soft-exchange emergency commanding and scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a soft-exchange emergency commanding and scheduling system, which comprises an integration communication host. The integration communication host comprises a user interface and a CPU (Central Processing Unit) processing system, a network switch is externally connected with the CPU processing system, is provided with an external relay E1 interface connected with an external gateway relay processing module, and is also externally connected with a network video monitoring device and an interface database of a GIS (Geographic Information System )/ GPS(Global Positioning System ). In the structure of the soft-exchange emergency commanding and scheduling system, the B/S (Browser/Server) network architecture and the browser login mode are adopted based on an IP (Internet protocol) broadband network; and voice scheduling and commanding (wired communication, digital trunking communication, mobile communication and digital recording), video scheduling and data scheduling are adopted as a core, the video monitoring, videos, scheduling, meetings, short message reception and transmission, data acquisition, GIS and the like are integrated seamlessly based on a software function module, and the use of resources is maximized.
assignees: ZHEJIANG UHOPE COMM TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of Campus Security emergency drilling management method
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of Campus Security emergency drilling management method, including：Rehearsal prepares：Administration school information, school's emergency response operational staff information and emergency drilling prediction scheme are stored in advance in emergency command administrative center, school emergency response operational staff receives emergency drilling prediction scheme information；Rehearsal starts：Emergency command administrative center starts emergency drilling prediction scheme to administration school；Rehearsal process：The personnel for participating in rehearsal evacuate or hide rapidly according to the alarm tone of school broadcasting's system plays and the commander of school emergency response operational staff；Rehearsal terminates：The personnel's number for participating in rehearsal is checked by school emergency response operational staff entire team；Emergency drilling data is uploaded to emergency command administrative center automatically；Rehearsal is summarized：Emergency drilling effect is evaluated, submits emergency drilling record；The present invention realizes that higher level responsible educational institution can start one or start multiple school safety emergency drilling tasks at the same time, and can learn the situation of one or more school safety emergency drillings in time.
assignees: NANJING XUE LI AN EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Linkage control system based on field environment data monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a linkage control system based on field environment data monitoring, which comprises: the mask control device is used for switching the mask on the seat from a hidden state to a use state when receiving a first control instruction, and switching the mask on the seat from the use state to the hidden state when receiving a second control instruction; the linkage control equipment is used for simultaneously sending first control instructions to the mask control equipment respectively corresponding to other seats in the same row when receiving the first control instructions; the network video recording device is arranged on the top of a seat of the entertainment device and is used for carrying out video recording operation on the front of the seat. The linkage control system based on the field environment data monitoring is intelligent in control and reliable in operation. Because the same-row linkage mechanism is established, the same-row emergency response can be simultaneously carried out on the abnormal conditions of the entertainment equipment during operation, thereby increasing the intelligent level of safety control.
assignees: TAIZHOU SAIDE ELECTROMECHANICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Visualization method and device based on passenger flow OD detail
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visualization method and a device based on passenger flow OD detail, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, receiving an OD query set request set by a user; step 2, acquiring bus record data and line track station data in the set time period according to the query set request; step 3, preprocessing the bus record data to obtain effective bus record data; step 4, processing the effective bus record data to obtain effective OD data; step 5, processing the effective OD data, and visually displaying the OD data of the passenger flow through the canvas assembly; the method can realize the effect of viewing OD data visualization with the finest granularity, and provides a precise and visual data basis for the optimization of bus dispatching strategies and line structures.
assignees: NANJING TRAVELER INTELLIGENT TRAFFIC SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Maritime search and rescue positioning method, system, equipment and storage medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a maritime search and rescue positioning method, a maritime search and rescue positioning system, maritime search and rescue positioning equipment and a storage medium based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: receiving distress information sent by distress persons of the marine accident; determining an incident airspace according to the approximate azimuth information and generating a corresponding search route; controlling an unmanned aerial vehicle to fly to the incident airspace to fly along the search air route, shooting corresponding image data and synchronously recording the flight data of the unmanned aerial vehicle; determining whether a suspected risk-involved target exists in the search route according to the image data shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle; controlling the unmanned aerial vehicle to lock and track the suspected dangerous object to be close to the suspected dangerous object, and confirming whether the suspected dangerous object is a dangerous person of a marine accident; the rescue ship can quickly and timely arrive by accurately positioning the risk-involved personnel of the marine accident through the unmanned aerial vehicle and sending the risk-involved personnel to the search and rescue ship, so that the search and rescue ship is improved in success rate.

title_en: Urban rail flood prevention early warning method and system based on multiple characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-feature-based urban rail flood prevention early warning method and system, which comprise the following steps: (1) frame extraction decoding and format conversion of a video stream; (2) preprocessing an image; (3) extracting a background image; (4) extracting rail characteristics; (5) detecting and positioning track abnormal invasion; (6) deep learning neural network ponding detection; (7) calculating the confidence coefficient of the accumulated water detection; (8) detecting the depth of accumulated water; and (9) intelligently early warning. The method effectively improves the timeliness and accuracy of the urban rail operation personnel for identifying the ponding disaster, is beneficial for decision personnel to quickly make emergency response, and practically ensures the urban rail operation safety in the flood season.
assignees: NANJING PANDA ELECTRONICS CO;NANJING PANDA INF IND CO LTD

title_en: Spherical device, system and method for realizing on-site investigation and early warning of emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides a spherical device, a system and a method for realizing the early warning of the on-site investigation of emergency rescue, which belong to the technical field of the on-site investigation of emergency rescue, wherein the device comprises a spherical shell; a millimeter wave radar module, a battery module and a digital signal module are arranged in the spherical shell; the millimeter wave radar module is connected with the battery module and the digital signal module; the cork material is filled among the millimeter wave radar module, the battery module, the digital signal module and the spherical shell; the spherical shell is provided with an external interface which is connected with the digital signal module and the battery module. The millimeter wave radar module has wide application range and strong anti-interference capability, all spherical devices are self-networked to form a local area network, the real-time performance is good, the timeliness is high, the assistance of the effective intelligent emergency plan is realized through the database module, and the on-site rescue is effectively commanded.
assignees: JUXIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method and system for power system based on big data
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an intelligent dispatching method and system for a power system based on big data, and belongs to the technical field of data processing. The method comprises the steps of obtaining initial operation data and initial power generation amount data corresponding to initial power equipment, carrying out operation anomaly analysis on the initial power equipment according to the initial operation data to obtain an initial operation state of the initial power equipment, obtaining target power utilization data of a target user when the initial operation state is a preset state, and determining an emergency dispatching strategy corresponding to the initial power equipment according to the target power utilization data and the initial power generation amount data.
