title_en: Black Box
title_ko: 교통사고 자동 기록장치
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 교통사고 자동 기록장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 고안은 교통사고 자동 기록장치에 있어서, 가해자와 피해자를 선별하기 위하여 도로, 교차로, 횡단보도 등의 현장 영상정보와 신호등의 영상 정보를 동시에 촬영하는 영상 카메라; 상기 영상 카메라에서 촬영한 영상정보를 유무선 통신수단을 통해 전송받아 실시간으로 저장되되 빠른 조회가 가능하게 날짜별, 시간대별로 저장되고, 저장된 영상정보는 상기 유무선 통신수단을 통해 경찰서 상황실이나 교통사고 처리조사반의 관리 서버로 실시간으로 전송하는 영상 저장장치; 교통사고 자동 기록장치의 오작동 및 임시 수동작동, 자동작동, 모순감지 등이 발생되는 경우, 안정적으로 전원을 공급하고, 전원 정상공급, 전원차단, 순간정전, 순간강하, 순간 승압, 배터리 충전상태 등의 이벤트들을 감지하여 통합 분석하고, 이 이벤트 정보를 영상 저장장치로 유무선 통신수단을 통해 전송하는 무정전 전원장치; 및 상기 영상 카메라 및 영상 저장장치로 유입되는 낙뢰를 예방하며, 상기 유무선 통신수단으로 유입될 수 있는 낙뢰를 예방하며, 낙뢰가 발생한 낙뢰 영상정보를 시시각각 실시간으로 영상 저장장치로 전송하는 낙뢰 보호장치를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 교통사고 자동 기록장치를 제공한다. 
     
      교통사고, 카메라, 영상, 신호등, 자동 기록, DVR, UPS

title_en: Command system convenient for dispatching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a command system convenient for dispatching. The command system comprises an emergency command and dispatching unit, a satellite phone, a fax and recording server, a dispatching station fax client, a vehicular station, a GSM module, a CDMA module, and a plurality of fax machines. The fax machines are connected in series. The emergency command and dispatching unit is provided with a VOIP interface. Through the structure, interconnection and interworking of the multiple command systems is realized; VOIP soft switch and traditional TDM hard switch are organically combined, the traditional advantages are retained, deployment is more facilitated, and extension and updating are better.
assignees: SICHUAN YOUMEI INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Personnel evacuation command system based on meteorological information monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personnel evacuation command system based on meteorological information monitoring, which relates to the technical field of disaster early warning, and comprises a meteorological data acquisition module, a geographic information acquisition module, a characteristic analysis module, a disaster influence prediction module, an evacuation scheme making module and an emergency response module, wherein the modules are connected by electric signals, and the meteorological data acquisition module is used for acquiring and recording meteorological observation data of a monitoring area in real time. According to the method, weather data are acquired and analyzed in real time, weather conditions which are likely to cause disasters are analyzed by combining with a disaster prediction model, an early warning mechanism is started immediately once disasters are predicted to be about to happen, early warning information is issued to people in affected areas through various channels, the types of disasters, the predicted influence range, the strength and evacuation measures are included, and the early warning not only provides valuable preparation time for the public, but also obviously reduces risks and losses when disasters occur.

title_en: Ship final assembly construction safety quality real-time monitoring method based on AI image recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship assembly construction safety quality real-time monitoring method and a storage medium based on AI image recognition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: A time-space aligned multi-modal dataset is created by collecting and preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data such as high definition visible light images, ultrasound scanning signals, infrared temperature data, and three-dimensional point cloud data. Based on the data set, a multi-modal deep learning model is constructed, texture, time sequence and temperature characteristics are automatically extracted, and the characteristics are fused through an attention mechanism. The model can identify quality hidden trouble in the ship construction process, monitor safety problems, predict collision risk and output a real-time monitoring report. The invention utilizes the comprehensive analysis of the multi-source data, enhances the accuracy and timeliness of monitoring, provides powerful support for management decision, and improves resource allocation and emergency response.
assignees: Shanghai waigaoqiao shipbuilding co ltd;SHANGHAI WAIGAOQIAO SHIPBUILDING & OFFSHORE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Emergency response method, device, electronic equipment, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency response method, an emergency response device, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data, carrying out time calibration on the multi-source data to obtain time synchronous data, carrying out coordinate conversion on the time synchronous data to obtain candidate data, carrying out data fusion on the candidate data to obtain data to be evaluated, analyzing the data to be evaluated, constructing fire-fighting situation indexes, dividing areas according to the fire-fighting situation indexes to determine monitoring areas, carrying out real-time monitoring on the monitoring areas, carrying out emergency response according to monitoring results, solving the problem that emergency is not timely, incomplete and inaccurate, solving the problem of time reference difference of heterogeneous data sources, eliminating projection deviation among different coordinate systems through coordinate conversion, enabling the time-space alignment accuracy of the multi-source data to be obviously improved, solving the problem that emergency is incomplete, converting the data into visual fire-fighting situation indexes, and improving emergency response efficiency and timeliness.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE GROUP SHANDONG CO;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Control device and control method of elevator, and modification method of existing elevator
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To prevent collision of a door engaging device caused by an aftershock without impeding the function of an opening/closing switch of an elevator landing door when an elevator is shifted to earthquake time emergency operation and an elevator car is traveling toward a closest floor.  <P>SOLUTION: This device is provided with a control part 26 controlling earthquake time emergency operation, a car location and speed computing part 27 computing the current location and speed of a car 18, and a location recording part 28 wherein a part of entire ascending and descending step of the car 18 is recorded as a door closing force increased section where door closing pushing force for a car door 1 is increased when required. Further, when the car 18 is determined to be traveling in the door closing force increased section during the earthquake time emergency operation, an operation command is output to increase the door closing pushing force of the car door 1 more than ordinary door closing force.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: An indolence management apparatus considering the body condition
title_ko: 산업재해예방 근태관리장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An assiduity management device for preventing industrial disaster for storing worker records to database is provided to separately determine whether the workers can be dispatched to the working place by checking a vitality symptom which presently shows the physical state. CONSTITUTION: An analysis program(24) compares a vitality symptom with a set value stored in a memory or a database(23). The analysis program determines weather the worker puts into a workplace through a comparison result. The analysis program stores the attendance time of the worker and defective information of the product in the memory. The analysis program decides whether the worker puts into the workplace.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 출근 입력부 및 음주측정프로브와 연결된 음주측정기를 동시에 구비하고, 근무자의 몸의 상태를 분석 체크하여 작업장에 투입하여 산업현장에서 발생하는 안전사고와 제품의 불량을 획기적으로 줄일 수 있는 산업재해예방 근태관리장치를 제공하는데 그 목적과 효과가 있다.  
     본 발명은 산업현장에서 발생하는 안전사고에 의한 산업재해와 작업불량을 획기적으로 줄이기 위하여 출근 시에 간단하게 근무자의 몸의 상태를 파악할 수 있는 음주, 체온 및 혈압 등을 측정하는 측정기를 구비하고, 이들 측정기들로부터 측정 입력된 데이터와 근무자들이 정상적으로 근무를 할 수 있는 몸 상태에 대한 설정치를 비교 분석하여 작업장에 투입할 수 있는지 여부를 판단하는 근무자 작업가능여부 판단부를 구비하며, 근무자 작업가능여부 판단부에서 판단한 결과를 근무자의 작업가능여부 판단에 반영하여 작업효율을 높이고, 생산 제품의 불량률을 감소시킬 수 있는 산업재해예방 근태관리장치를 제공하는데 있다.  
       
     산업재해예방, 근태관리장치, 활력증상, 음주측정기, 체온측정, 혈압

title_en: Sighting service system
title_ko: 제보 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for receiving information about a case, and provided is a system for receiving information about a case which is capable of matching an informant with an information requester in real time when a case or an accident occurs and matching an expert with the information requester in real time in case the information requester related to a case or an accident requires expertise like knowledge of law. For this, disclosed is a system for receiving information about a case comprising: a DB server for storing a case record by making a database with the case record including contact information of an informant, who reports about a case or an accident when the case or the accident occurs, a category of the case or the accident, and case or accident occurring area and time; a retrieval server, connected to the DB server through communications, for providing a retrieving function to retrieve a history corresponding to a specific keyword from content of the case record stored in the DB server; an information requester terminal, connected to the retrieval server and the DB server through communications, for retrieving the history corresponding to the specific keyword using the retrieving function of the retrieval server; an informant terminal, connected to the retrieval server and the DB server, for storing the case record in the DB server through the retrieval server; and an expert terminal, connected to the retrieval server through communications, for receiving connection information to connect to the information requester terminal in the retrieval server; wherein the retrieval server outputs the connection information to the expert terminal when the information requester terminal requests consultation with an expert. [Reference numerals] (10) DB server;(20) Searching server;(30) Information requester terminal;(40) Informant terminal;(50) Expert terminal;(AA) Record and search a case;(BB) Record and search payment
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 제보 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 기술적 과제는 사건 및 사고 발생시에 제보자와 제보요청자를 실시간으로 매칭시킬 수 있으며, 사건 및 사고와 관련된 제보요청자가 법률지식과 같은 전문지식을 필요로 하는 경우에 전문지식을 필요로 하는 전문가와 제보요청자를 실시간으로 매칭시킬 수 있는 제보 시스템을 제공하는 데 있다. 이를 위하여 사건 및 사고의 발생시, 상기 사건 및 사고를 제보하는 제보자의 연락처, 상기 사건 및 상기 사고에 관한 종류, 상기 사건 및 상기 사고가 발생한 지역과 시간을 포함하는 사건기록을 DB화하여 저장하는 DB서버; 상기 DB서버와 통신을 수행하여 연동되며, 상기 DB서버내에 기록된 사건기록의 내용 가운데 특정 키워드에 해당하는 내역이 검색되도록 검색기능을 제공하는 검색서버; 상기 검색서버 및 상기 DB서버와 통신을 수행하여 연동하며, 상기 검색서버의 검색기능으로 상기 특정 키워드에 해당하는 내역을 상기 DB서버에서 검색하는 제보요청자단말; 상기 검색서버 및 상기 DB서버와 통신을 수행하여 연동하며, 상기 검색서버를 통해 사건기록을 상기 DB서버에 저장하는 제보자단말; 및, 상기 검색서버와 통신을 수행하여 연동하며, 상기 검색서버에서 상기 제보요청자단말과 연결을 위한 연결정보를 입력받는 전문가단말; 를 포함하며, 상기 검색서버는 제보요청자단말에서 전문가의 상담을 요청시, 상기 전문가단말로 상기 연결정보를 출력하는 것을 특징으로 하는 제보 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: System of STEAM Educational Program based on Coding Technology and the Teaching Material for STEAM
title_ko: 코딩 기술을 기반으로 한 스팀융합교육 프로그램 시스템 및 스팀융합교육 교재
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a steam convergence education program system and steam fusion education textbooks based on coding technology that can simultaneously perform play and learning using a robot pet and improve science and technology-based convergence thinking ability. The system of the present invention comprises: a robot pet that distinguishes and recognizes different input marks for inputting a preset input value to the robot and outputs a preset output value according to the input value; a plurality of input cards provided with the different input marks; and a workbook containing coding learning contents using the robot pet. The workbook is composed of a plurality of learning units that provide a step-by-step and systematic curriculum according to the developmental stage of the child. Each study unit comprises steps of learning a function of learning a coding method using the robot pet and engaging in activities based on convergence talent education that apply this to real life problems.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 로봇 펫을 이용하여 놀이와 학습을 동시에 수행하며 과학기술 기반의 융합적 사고력을 향상시킬 수 있는 코딩 기술을 기반으로 한 스팀융합교육 프로그램 시스템 및 스팀융합교육 교재에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 코딩 기술을 기반으로 한 스팀융합교육 프로그램 시스템은, 로봇에 기설정된 입력값을 입력하기 위한 서로 다른 입력 표시를 각각 구분하여 인식하고 입력된 입력값에 따라 기설정된 출력값을 출력하는 로봇 펫과, 서로 다른 상기 입력 표시가 구비된 복수의 입력카드와, 상기 로봇 펫을 이용한 코딩 학습내용이 기재된 워크북을 포함하여 구성된 스팀융합교육 교재를 이용한 코딩 기술을 기반으로 한 스팀융합교육 프로그램 시스템으로서, 상기 워크북은 아동의 발달 단계에 따라 단계적이고 체계적인 커리큘럼을 제공하는 복수의 학습 단원으로 구성되고, 각 학습 단원은 상기 로봇 펫을 이용한 코딩 방법을 학습하는 기능 배우기 단계와 이를 실생활 문제에 적용하는 융합인재교육 기반의 활동하기 단계를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method, device and computer-readable recording medium for generating document content based on information aggregation for market matching of small business owners
title_ko: 소상공인의 판로 매칭을 위한 정보 취합 기반의 문서 컨텐츠를 생성하는 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터-판독 가능 기록 매체
abstract_en: A method for generating document content based on information collection for market matching of small business owners, which is implemented in a computing device including one or more processors and one or more memories storing commands executable by the processors, comprises: a business operator information extraction step; a structure information generation supplement step; and a document content generation step. According to the present invention, the method for generating document content based on information collection for market matching of small business owners can automatically generate document content including various forms based on business owner information and business information of small business owners for entering supermarkets and department stores. Accordingly, small business owners can increase the efficiency of work on document work without investing extra time and high costs in document work.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 하나 이상의 프로세서 및 상기 프로세서에서 수행 가능한 명령들을 저장하는 하나 이상의 메모리를 포함하는 컴퓨팅 장치에서 구현되는 소상공인의 판로 매칭을 위한 정보 취합 기반의 문서 컨텐츠를 생성하는 방법에 있어서, 복수 개의 소상공인 계정 중 제1 소상공인 계정으로부터 상기 문서 컨텐츠를 생성하기 위한 제1 입력을 수신하는 경우, 상기 수신된 제1 입력에 기반하여 공공 기관에서 관리하는 데이터베이스에 저장된 상기 제1 소상공인 계정의 사용자가 운영하는 운영 업체에 대한 사업자 정보를 추출하는 사업자 정보 추출 단계; 상기 사업자 정보 추출 단계의 기능 수행이 완료되면, 상기 사업자 정보를 통해 외부 플랫폼에 등록된 복수 개의 정보 중 상기 운영 업체에 대한 정보를 식별하여, 상기 식별된 정보를 크롤링 해 상기 운영 업체에 대한 업체 정보로 수집하는 업체 정보 수집 단계; 상기 사업자 정보 및 상기 업체 정보의 획득이 완료되면, 기 설정된 표준 DB 구조에 기반한 세부 구조에 상기 사업자 정보 및 상기 업체 정보를 반영해 DB 구조 정보를 생성한 경우, 상기 세부 구조 각각을 확인해 보완이 필요한 보완 세부 구조에 반영되는 정보를 보완 정보로 분류해 상기 제1 소상공인 계정에게 보완 정보를 요청하는 구조 정보 생성 보완 단계; 및 상기 제1 소상공인 계정으로부터 상기 보완 정보를 수신하는 경우, 상기 보완 세부 구조에 상기 수신된 보완 정보를 반영한 DB 구조 정보를 관리자 계정에게 제공하여, 상기 관리자 계정에 의해 상기 DB 구조 정보에 대한 승인이 완료되면, 상기 DB 구조 정보를 기 설정된 표준화 규칙에 따라 저장하며, 상기 제1 소상공인 계정으로부터 제2 입력을 수신 시, 상기 저장된 DB 구조 정보를 통해 문서 컨텐츠를 생성해 상기 제1 소상공인 계정에게 제공하는 문서 컨텐츠 생성 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이 외에도 본 문서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시예들이 가능하다.

title_en: Electric quantity and non-electric quantity internet of things monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric quantity and non-electric quantity internet of things monitoring device, which comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time operation data of each interface in the power distribution equipment, recording the real-time operation data to obtain full-power data, and receiving operation data of sensing equipment provided with a Bluetooth sub-module based on a Bluetooth technology; the processor and the communication module are used for carrying out safety evaluation on the acquired full-power data and the operation data of the sensing equipment, displaying an evaluation result on a local liquid crystal screen, and transmitting the data and the evaluation result to the background based on a broadband power carrier technology; and the execution module is used for positioning hidden danger points based on the background and carrying out emergency response on the power distribution equipment based on preset emergency measures when the evaluation result judges that the hidden danger of electricity consumption exists. The invention simplifies the data transmission mode, and is convenient for workers to check the electricity consumption and line safety condition through the preset liquid crystal display screen.

title_en: Forest and town boundary domain fire spread simulation method based on space-time semantic driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semantic modeling, and focuses on a forest and town boundary domain fire spread simulation method based on space-time semantic driving. Aiming at the complexity of fire spread in a forest and town boundary area (WUI), the method creatively introduces a space-time semantic driving mechanism on the basis of a traditional fire spread model, combines the characteristics of the WUI area, and solves the defects of the traditional simulation method in the aspects of accuracy, timeliness and adaptability to complex environments. The method comprises the steps of constructing a WUI fire spreading model based on cellular automaton, constructing a WUI fire scene simulation knowledge meta model and a knowledge map, and constructing a fire space-time semantic query and simulation framework. According to the invention, by fusing semantic information of time and space dimensions, the spreading path and speed of the fire disaster under different terrains, building distribution and meteorological conditions can be more accurately simulated, a more reliable decision basis is provided for fire disaster prevention, emergency response and resource allocation, and the fire disaster prevention and control capability of the border area of forests and towns is effectively improved.

title_en: Accident reporting system using iot safety tripod
title_ko: Iot기능을 포함하는 안전 삼각대를 이용한 스마트 사고 접수 시스템 및 사고 접수 방법
abstract_en: A smart accident report receiving system using a safety tripod including an IOT function according to the present invention includes: the safety tripod (100) which transmits an emergency signal to the outside as a Bluetooth module (110) when an emergency operation button (120) is driven; a portable mobile communication terminal (200) for a user which receives the emergency signal by driving of the emergency operation button (120) and includes a GPS receiver inside; an application program (AP) for transmitting personal information and insurance subscription information of a user and location information transmitted from the GPS receiver of the portable mobile communication terminal (200) for a user to the outside; and a control center (300) which receives an emergency situation. The present invention can instantly implement an accident reporting function by promptly receiving the personal information and the location information of the user in an accident processing control center.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 IOT기능을 포함하는 안전 삼각대를 이용한 스마트 사고 접수 시스템은, 블루투스 모듈(110)을 탑재하고, 비상작동버튼(120)을 구비하여 상기 비상작동버튼(120) 구동 시, 비상신호를 상기 블루투스 모듈(110)로써 외부로 송출하는 안전 삼각대(100); 상기 안전 삼각대(100)의 블루투스 모듈(110)과 페어링하여 상기 비상작동버튼(120) 구동에 의한 비상신호를 수신하며, 내부에 GPS수신기를 구비하는 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200); 상기 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)에 설치되고, 사용자의 개인정보 및 보험가입 정보를 입력하여, 상기 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)가 상기 안전 삼각대(100)의 블루투스 모듈(110)과 페어링하여 상기 비상작동버튼(120) 구동에 의한 비상신호를 수신할 시, 상기 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)의 GPS수신기부터 전달되는 위치정보 및 사용자의 개인정보 및 보험가입 정보를 외부로 송출하도록 하는 어플리케이션 프로그램(AP); 상기 어플리케이션 프로그램(AP)에 의하여, 상기 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)로부터 송출되는 위치정보 및 사용자의 개인정보 및 보험가입 정보를 수신하여 비상상황 접수를 수행하는 관제센터(300);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
	또한, IOT기능을 포함하는 안전 삼각대를 이용한 스마트 사고 접수 방법은, 사용자가 자신의 개인정보 및 보험가입 정보를 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)에 설치된, 어플리케이션 프로그램(AP)에 입력하는 개인정보 및 보험가입 정보 입력단계(S101); 사용자의 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)와 안전 삼각대(100)의 블루투스 모듈(110)을 페어링하여 인식 시키는 블루투스 페어링단계(S102);를 포함하는 사전 단계(S100)와, 사용자가 불의의 사고에 봉착하는 사고 발생단계(S201); 상기 사고 발생단계(S201) 후, 사용자가 안전 삼각대(100)의 비상작동버튼(120)을 작동시키는 비상작동버튼 작동단계(S202); 상기 비상작동버튼 작동단계(S202)에 의하여 비상작동버튼(120)이 작동 되면, 블루투스 모듈(110)에 의하여, 외부로 비상신호를 송출하는 비상신호 송출단계(S203); 상기 비상신호 송출단계(S203)에 의하여, 외부로 비상신호가 송출되면 상기 블루투스 페어링단계(S102)에 의하여 페어링된 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)가 이를 수신하는 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기 비상신호 수신단계(S204); 상기 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기 비상신호 수신단계(S204) 후, 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)에 설치된, 어플리케이션 프로그램(AP)에서 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)의 GPS기능을 이용하여, 현재의 위치정보를 획득하는 위치정보 획득단계(S205); 상기 위치정보 획득단계(S205) 후, 상기 사용자 휴대용 이동통신 단말기(200)의 통신방식에 따라 개인정보 및 보험가입 정보 입력단계(S101)에서 입력한 개인정보 및 보험가입 정보와, 상기 위치정보 획득단계(S205)에서 획득된 위치정보를 외부로 송출하는 정보 송출단계(S206);를 포함하는 사고 현장단계(S200)와, 상기 정보 송출단계(S206)에 의하여 송출되는 위치정보 및 사용자의 개인정보 및 보험가입 정보를 관제센터(300)에서 수신하는 관제센터 정보 수신단계(S301); 상기 관제센터 정보 수신단계(S301) 후, 수신된 위치정보를 이용하여 사고지점을 파악하는 사고지점 파악 단계(S302); 상기 사고지점 파악 단계(S302)에서 파악된 사고지점의 위치와 가장 근접한 기관 또는 순찰자를 탐색하는 최근접 기관 및 순찰자 검색단계(S303); 상기 최근접 기관 및 순찰자 검색단계(S303)에서 검색된 기관 및 순찰자에게 사고지점 위치정보 및 개인정보 및 보험가입 정보를 송출하고, 출동지시를 내리는 출동 지시단계(S304);를 포함하는 사고 대응단계(S300),로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Simulator system and simulation method for the public evacuation response system during a radiological emergency
title_ko: 방사능 재난 대응 시뮬레이터 시스템 및 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulator system and a simulation method for radiation emergency response and, more specifically, to a simulator system and a simulation method for radiation emergency response capable of predicting an evacuation process of residents during a radioactive disaster using a system dynamics concept. According to one embodiment of the present invention, provided is the simulator system comprising a modeling part for storing a numerical model related to the behaviors of the residents in a plurality of events related to the resident protection measure, a setting part for inputting data necessary for calculating the numerical model, and a simulation part for calculating the behaviors of the residents on the basis of the data in the numerical model, and transmitting the calculated result to an external device. The numerical model is a mathematical model which shows a rate of change of the number of residents located within a precautionary protection zone over time. The calculated result is a change in the number of residents located within the precautionary protection zone over time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사능 재난 대응 시뮬레이터 시스템 및 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 시스템 다이내믹스 개념을 활용하여, 방사능 재난 시, 주민 대피 과정을 예측할 수 있는 방사능 재난 대응 시뮬레이터 시스템 및 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 실시예는 주민 보호 조치에 대한 복수의 이벤트에서 주민의 거동에 관한 수치모델이 저장된 모델링부와, 수치모델의 연산에 필요한 데이터를 입력하는 설정부와, 수치모델에 데이터를 바탕으로 주민의 거동을 연산하고, 연산결과를 외부 장치로 송신하는 시뮬레이션부를 포함하고, 수치모델은 예방적 보호 조치 구역 내에 위치한 주민수의 시간에 대한 변화율을 나타내는 수학적 모델이고, 연산결과는 시간에 따른 예방적 보호 조치 구역 내에 위치한 주민수의 변화인 방사능 재난 대응 시뮬레이터 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Machine is commanded in emergency management and rescue based on Android ARM microcontroller
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of, and machine is commanded in the emergency management and rescue based on Android ARM microcontroller, belong to the technical field of fire-fighting equipment, master control mainboard includes CPU, ARM control module and wireless communication module, ARM control module is connected with pressure sensor, ARM control module can be managed intercommunication module and ZigBee module, and CPU, intercommunication module and ZigBee module pass through two-way communication link between ARM control module；ARM control module is connected with the orientation LED lamp group, flashlight, laser, buzzer, external key, EEPROM and serial ports and turns USB interface chip；The end of casing is equipped with intercommunication antenna, channel coding knob and ZigBee antenna；Wireless communication module communication link is connected to remote server, to reach multifunctional unit in one to realize intelligent control, monitors and transmit the various information of fire fighter in real time to promote the timeliness of floor manager and the purpose of validity.
assignees: CHENGDU DAQIN MINAN FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire control receives and processes police joint command system based on cloud
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire control, in particular to a fire control receiving and processing alarm combined command system based on cloud service; the method comprises the steps of receiving an alarm by an alarm receiving person, judging the alarm condition scale according to telephone content, and sending out early warning information through an alarm touching device; the alarm receiving module inputs alarm information, generates an action bill and uploads the action bill to the cloud service, and a firefighter acquires the action bill through the synchronous service; the alarm processing module is connected with the portable fire-fighting terminal through communication service, receives rescue information acquired by the portable fire-fighting terminal, and uploads the rescue information to the superior command mechanism through synchronous service for remote joint scheduling command; the invention obtains alarm information and rescue information through an analysis module, and constructs a five-dimensional analysis model according to a k-means cluster analysis method; the whole rescue process checking of the action list record is realized; and further, the reasons and rescue results of the police condition are analyzed, the loss and experience of corresponding emergency rescue are summarized, and the police-out efficiency of the fire-fighting emergency rescue under the subsequent similar police condition can be improved.

title_en: Prediction method for highest temperature and position of fire roof of underground inclined tunnel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a prediction method for the highest temperature and the position of a fire roof of an underground inclined tunnel, belongs to the technical field of tunnel fire safety, and solves the problem that the error of the determination method for the highest temperature and the position of the highest temperature of the fire roof of the inclined tunnel in the prior art is large. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the fire early warning capability is improved, the fire source position can be effectively identified by accurately predicting the highest temperature and the position of the ceiling when the fire occurs in the inclined tunnel, important references are provided for rescue workers, and the timeliness and the accuracy of fire emergency response are enhanced. The method reduces structural damage, predicts the highest temperature of the ceiling and the position of the ceiling, can take protective measures in time or in advance, reduces damage of fire to the tunnel structure, and prolongs the service life of the tunnel.

title_en: Checker dispatch system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable quick dispatch of a checker when such a disaster as earthquake occurs.  <P>SOLUTION: A checker dispatch system includes a management server 3 which transmits and receives information with a portable terminal 1 carried by a checker. The management server 3 is provided with: a transmission/reception means 25; an earthquake information recording means 21; a dam facility information recording means; a checker information recording means 23; a checking dam information preparation means 26; a mobilization checker selection means 27 for selecting a checker; a checking dispatch information preparation means 28 for preparing checking mobilization information in which the selected checker and the checking dam are described; and a control means 29 for transmitting the checking dam information and the checking mobilization information to the portable terminal 1. The mobilization checker selection means 27 selects mobilization checker in the order of earlier mobilizable dates under predetermined dispatch conditions based on reply information including a checking dam whose checking mobilization is possible and mobilizable dates from the portable terminal 1 which has received the checking dam information.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Apparatus and method for display language data with study function supported
title_ko: 학습기능을 지원하는 어학 데이터 표시 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A language study data display apparatus and a method using the same are provided to minimize escape phenomenon of concentration of studying of sentence by applying the automatic progress through an example sentence which is classified according to topic and level of difficulty. CONSTITUTION: A command menu part(100) receives a command signal which is selected by user. A storage part(300) stores a learning contents file of a short example sentence type saved as the contents DB structure in groups according to chapter. A display processor(200) indicates the learning data a short example sentence saved in the storage on a display part by spelling unit or by word unit. A control operator(400) designates the random rank of the learning data based on an index number of a learning data record. The control operator renders corresponding learning data based on the designated rank from the storage part to the display processor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다양한 어플리케이션을 구동할 수 있는 휴대용 단말기에서 사용자가 용이하고 효율높게 어학학습을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 학습기능을 지원하는 어학 데이터 표시 장치 및 방법을 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 사용자에 의해 선택되어 수신되는 명령 신호를 입력받는 명령 메뉴부와, 컨텐츠 DB 구조로 저장되는 단문예문 형태의 학습데이터인 학습 컨텐츠 파일을 챕터(chapter) 별로 그룹지어 저장하는 저장부와, 상기 저장부에 저장된 단문예문 형태의 학습데이터를 철자단위 또는 단어단위로 타이핑되듯이 표시부에 표시되도록 제어하는 표시 처리부를 포함하여 구성되는데 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for providing medical chatting service based on generative artificial intelligence
title_ko: 생성형 인공지능 기반의 의료 채팅 서비스를 제공하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, disclosed are an apparatus and method for providing a generative artificial intelligence-based medical chatting service. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the apparatus comprises: one or more processors; and a memory storing one or more programs executed by the one or more processors, wherein the one or more processors generate a prompt based on user input and a command, and input the prompt to a generative artificial intelligence model to output a corresponding response.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따른 생성형 인공지능 기반의 의료 채팅 서비스를 제공하는 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 일 실시예에 따른 생성형 인공지능 기반의 의료 채팅 서비스를 제공하는 장치는 하나 이상의 프로세서; 및 상기 하나 이상의 프로세서에 의해 실행되는 하나 이상의 프로그램을 저장한 메모리를 포함하는 생성형 인공지능 기반의 의료 채팅 서비스를 제공하는 장치로서, 상기 하나 이상의 프로세서는: 사용자 입력과 명령에 기초하여 프롬프트를 생성하고, 생성형 인공지능 모델에 상기 프롬프트를 입력하여 대응하는 응답을 출력한다.
assignees: SEOUL NAT UNIV HOSPITAL;RYU EUI SEOK

title_en: System for validating and appending incident-related data records in an inter-agency distributed electronic ledger
abstract_en: A computer apparatus, such as a validator node, for validating data records in a distributed electronic ledger may be configured to receive a proposed data record submitted by an originating agent of an originating agency to a distributed ledger. In response to the proposed incident-related data record, other agents within the originating agency may, based on validation criteria, submit one or more responsive data records that may provide information for use in determining a validity of the proposed incident-related data record. Validator nodes hosted by external agencies may submit validation responses relative to a validity of the proposed incident-related data record. The system may determine that the proposed data record is valid. Based a consensus algorithm, the system may responsively append the proposed data record or an indication of validity to the distributed ledger or to a different distributed ledger.

title_en: Urgent and emergency notification and communication system
abstract_en: A communication system for urgent and emergency notifications includes a commwunication device with sensors to obtain or determine user location information and/or status information following activation of the communication device. The communication device communicates over wireless and/or wired communication networks. In an urgent situation or an emergency, the communication device is activated and sends an alert to designated recipients, including the location and/or status information. The system also involves a repeated process of interrupting the recipients' communication devices to immediately notify the recipients of the urgency of the communication and to attempt to connect to the recipients. The system can also include the ability to record audio and/or video on the activating communication device and to transmit such recordings or files to designated recipients. The activated device can also send notification and connection attempts to emergency dispatchers.

title_en: Lost person rescue drone
abstract_en: A system and method for optimizing a rescue operation of an individual. The method comprises maintaining, by an individual engaged in an activity, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) associated with and in proximity to the individual. For storage at the UAV, the individual records at a recording device a message. A sensor device is configured to detect a situation requiring a need to rescue the individual at a current location, and generates a trigger signal in response to a detection. In response to the receipt of the trigger signal, a current GPS location of the individual is recorded and a launching of the UAV to traverse a flight-path to a destination location. At or before arriving at the destination location, the UAV contemporaneously provides the stored recorded message and current GPS location of the individual to an emergency response authority to inform of the individual's situation and location.

title_en: Systems and methods for assignment of equipment to an officer audio information
abstract_en: A system for tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment to security agency personnel (e.g., officers, administration, command, armorer). An armorer is assigned the task of tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment. Equipment may be assigned to a particular individual officer. The equipment provided to and used by officers may capture (e.g. gather, produce) information (e.g. audiovisual information, data logs, recordings). Equipment may provide information to the armorer via near field communication (NFC) circuits. The information captured may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system. The information captured by equipment assigned to a particular individual may be associated with that individual. An armorer may use information supplied by equipment, evidence management system, officers, or other sources to assist in the assignment process.

title_en: Tracking biometric data in response to device movement
abstract_en: This relates generally to systems and methods for tracking and recording pupil dilation and/or signs of unconsciousness in response to detecting specific movements of the electronic device. In some examples, the electronic device captures and tracks first biometric data including pupil dilation using one or more input devices. In some examples, in response to detecting a movement of the electronic device, such as a rapid acceleration or deceleration of the electronic device, the electronic device captures second biometric data. In some examples, the electronic device displays a virtual object while presenting an extended reality environment, such as a visual indication in response to detecting that the second biometric data meets one or more criteria based on a comparison of the second biometric data with the first biometric data. In some examples, the electronic device initiates an emergency response based on the second biometric data.

title_en: Field operation examination mechanism and field operation examination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a field operation examination mechanism and a field operation examination method. The field operation examination mechanism comprises a signal reflection board, a reflection board support, a signal projector and an upper computer. The signal projector is mounted on an examining vehicle. When an examination starts, the upper computer transmits number-fetching commands continuously in a wireless mode; distance between the vehicle and a roadside benchmark is measured, and measured distance value is transmitted to the upper computer; the upper computer performs data processing according to the measured distance value, performs measurement by utilizing of the signal projector, continuously measures the distance between the examining vehicle and the roadside benchmark and transmits a result to the upper computer for processing in the wireless mode to judge turning-around deviation and running parallel deviation of the examining vehicle. The field operation examination mechanism is high in degree of automation and high in measurement accuracy, so that timeliness for acquiring data can be guaranteed by adopting wireless transmission.

title_en: Portable disease surveillance recorder
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable disease surveillance recorder which comprises a shell and a central processing unit arranged in the shell and further comprises a display screen, a light sensitization module, a camera module, an infrared light supplementing module, a key module, a 3G communication module, a pickup module, a storage module, a power supply module, a GPS (Global Positioning System) module and a USB (Universal Serial Bus) module, wherein the central processing unit is respectively connected with the display screen, the light sensitization module, the camera module, the infrared light supplementing module, the key module, the 3G communication module, the pickup module, the storage module, the power supply module, the GPS module and the USB module; and the light sensitization module comprises a light sensitizer and an infrared lens, the input end of the light sensitizer is connected with the infrared lens and the output end of the light sensitizer is connected with the central processing unit. The portable disease surveillance recorder has multiple functions of photograph, camera shooting, recording pens and the like and integrates a GPS technology and a 3G technology, thereby greatly improving the accuracy and the timeliness of disease information collection works and rapid emergency response capability.
assignees: JINAN MUNICIPAL CT FOR DISEASE CONTROL & PREVENTION

title_en: Across-network written record management method, across-network written record management system and terminals
abstract_en: The invention relates to an across-network written record management method, an across-network written record management system and terminals. The across-network written record management method, which is applied to a case handling terminal in a case handling private network, comprises the following steps: S1, establishing communication with at least one internal reference terminal and a management terminal which is arranged in an office intranet, and establishing an inquiry unit or an interrogation unit for keeping a written record; S2, receiving and displaying entered question and answer information, receiving and displaying all annotation information when at least one internal reference terminal having communication relationship sends annotation information, and receiving and displaying command management information sent by the management terminal and forwarded by the internal reference terminals; and S3, entering the question and answer information, all the annotation information and all the command management information into the inquiry unit or the interrogation unit to generate a written record and storing the written record. The method, the system and the terminals ensure that the case handling chief can monitor the process of case handling without going to the site personally and ensure that the chief can have control of the whole process of case handling.

title_en: Control method and control system for reporting search and rescue state in real time
abstract_en: A control method and control system for real-time reporting search and rescue status is carried out by the control system, the control system has a plurality of sending units for search and rescue personnel to carry and record an identification data of the search and rescue personnel, a plurality of relay stations and a receiving platform, the receiving platform obtains an information including each identification data and corresponding positioning information from the sending unit, the receiving platform judges whether an emergency condition related to personal safety is met or not according to the content of the information, and the receiving platform judges whether a reply information generated by the sending unit is received or not, so that corresponding different measures are taken. Therefore, the monitoring system is used for monitoring the bodies of the search and rescue personnel and the search and rescue resources. Particularly, the commander can use the system to monitor the relative position of the search and rescue personnel on the front line, the operation safety and the search and rescue resources such as available water sources, water outlet pressure and water outlet flow.

title_en: Intelligent identification and alarm method and system for unscheduled power failure of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coal mine power, in particular to an intelligent recognition and alarm method for an unscheduled power failure of a coal mine, which comprises data acquisition and pretreatment; the method comprises the steps of planning power outage information comparison, constructing a PLC rule engine to judge power outage characteristics, combining machine learning model verification, starting local audible and visual alarm, pushing remote information through an industrial ring network, transmitting alarm based on risk level, linkage inspection and fault positioning, and recording and optimizing iteration. According to the method and the system for the intelligent recognition and alarm of the coal mine unplanned power failure, automatic linkage control is adopted, a closed-loop emergency response system is constructed through automatic switching-off of non-key equipment, switching of standby power supply of key equipment and path planning of a patrol robot, and a layered decision mechanism is constructed through planned power failure database filtering, rule engine primary screening and recognition classification model rechecking, so that recognition accuracy is effectively improved, dynamic optimization is realized through rule engine threshold self-adjustment and model iterative training, and model accuracy is effectively improved.
assignees: SHAANXI XINNENG COAL DRESSING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Accident result simulation calculation method based on mathematical physical model coupling solution
abstract_en: The invention provides an accident result simulation calculation method based on mathematical physical model coupling solution, which comprises the steps of constructing an accident chain knowledge map and a physical trigger map, establishing causal relation and physical constraint among equipment, states, events and results, converging and mapping historical records, expert rules and online observation data into map entities and relations to form a baseline accident scene and calculate a baseline index, generating candidate paths by utilizing map reasoning and coupling multi-physical field simulation, realizing closed loops of map reasoning and object understanding through consistency check, scoring and disturbance simulation analysis on the candidate paths, screening robust target paths, carrying out high-fidelity simulation on the target paths, combining sensitivity analysis and minimum cut-off set to identify key nodes, and generating treatment suggestions and action priorities. The invention realizes the high-reliability prediction of accident evolution and the closed-loop linkage of emergency response, and has high precision, high robustness and engineering feasibility.
assignees: SHANGHAI GELUE SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emotion state ecological instantaneous assessment and intervention system suitable for teenagers
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mental health and health, and particularly discloses an emotional state ecological instantaneous assessment and intervention system suitable for teenagers. The wearable equipment has the advantages of small size, portability, reminding function, capability of regularly collecting multi-mode data such as emotion, physiology, image, voice and the like, attention pre-verification, sleep and nightmare recording, instant intervention feedback and emergency response functions, and capability of supporting the customization of a question bank and a scheme bank, data management, intelligent analysis of emotion and behavioral risks, prize integration and remote control by a system software end. The invention can realize the instantaneous assessment, intelligent early warning and instant intervention of the emotion of the teenager of the child, and the linkage of parents, schools, students and doctors forms a management closed loop, and is suitable for daily learning life scenes with data accuracy and privacy protection.

title_en: Multiplication table game console
title_ko: 구구단 게임기
abstract_en: The preset invention relates to a multiplication table game console, which can be used as an auxiliary education tool for increasing education effects for a child, and can be used as an auxiliary treatment tool for suppressing a progress of Alzheimer′s diseases, and to a game method thereof. The game console comprises: a pair of logo display units (1010) for displaying a logo of a user; a pair of start buttons (1020) for operating the random number of the chance of winning; a pair of first displays (1030) for expressing the random number of the chance of winning; a key input unit (1040) for inputting the value of the chance of winning; a pair of second displays (1050) for expressing the calculation result; a voice processing unit (1060) for outputting the message; a micro-process unit (MPU) (1070) for integrally managing the game console; a memory (1080) for storing a program code and the processed data; a on/off volume switch (1090); a reset button (1100) for initializing the game; and a pair of logo selecting buttons (1110) for selecting the logo to be expressed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 1인 또는 2인이 숫자와 승산과정을 체험할 수 있고 시각적으로 볼 수 있도록 하여 어린이의 흥미를 유발하여 학습효과를 높일 수 있는 보조 교육 기구로 활용할 수 있으며, 치매 또는 알츠하이머 초기 증상을 보이는 노인들에게 두뇌 사고를 촉진하고 수와 승산에 대한 개념학습 능력을 유지시킴으로써, 뇌의 노화를 막아 치매 및 알츠하이머의 진행을 늦추기 위한 보조 치료기구로 활용할 수 있는 구구단 게임기 및 그 게임방법에 관한 것으로, 사용자의 로고를 각기 표시하기 위한 한 쌍의 로고 표시부(1010)와; 랜덤 방식으로 임의의 승산용 숫자를 각기 동작시키기 위한 한 쌍의 시작버튼(1020)과; 상기 한 쌍의 시작 버튼(1020)에 의해 작동되어 랜덤 방식으로 임의의 승산용 숫자를 표출하기 위한 한 쌍의 제1 디스플레이(1030)와; 상기 한 쌍의 제1 디스플레이(1030)에 의해 표출된 한 쌍의 승산용 숫자의 승산 값을 입력키를 통해 입력하기 위한 키 입력부(1040)와; 상기 키 입력부(1040)의 입력키에 대응하는 계산 결과를 표출하는 한 쌍의 제2 디스플레이(1050)와; 상기 입력된 내용 및 결과와 전체 진행을 이끌어 가는 메시지를 출력하는 음성처리부(1060)와; 게임기를 총괄 관리하는 MPU(Micro Process Unit, 1070)와; 프로그램 코드 및 처리된 자료를 보관하는 메모리(1080)와; 전원을 온, 오프시키고, 볼륨을 조절하기 위한 온, 오프 및 볼륨 스위치(1090)와; 게임을 초기화시키기 위한 리셋 버튼(1100); 및  한 쌍의 로고 표시부(1010)에 표출될 로고를 각기 선택하기 위한 한 쌍의 로고 선택버튼(1110);으로 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System for handling the state of emergency by using mobile phone
title_ko: 스마트폰을 이용한 비상 상황 대처용 경보 및 표시장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smartphone-based alarm and display device for emergency response. According to the present invention, button operation is performed in the event of an emergency related to a woman exposed to a crime from a third party. Then, voice content preset using a user′s smartphone is output and psychological self-control is induced on the third party′s part. As a result, the emergency can be avoided. In addition, it is possible to call for help by audio/video emergency recording and automatic transmission to an emergency contact network. As a result, the danger can be avoided and safety can be ensured. In addition, button operation is performed and an automatic emergency call to a rescue and relief agency such as a fire station and a police station is made in the event of an emergency on the part of a disabled person, a patient, a senior citizen, an ordinary person, and so on, examples of which include heart attack, cerebral hemorrhage, fall, house robbery, taxi robbery, female robbery, and kidnapping. The occurrence of the emergency is disseminated by means of voice output using a smartphone, audio/video recording, alarm, display through a display screen, and so on. As a result, an additional accident is prevented and safety is ensured by help from the outside. According to the present invention, user residential environment improvement can be achieved through visitor conversation and confirmation and doorplate and interior decoration, in-vehicle information such as boarding and unboarding can be disseminated by in-vehicle installation, promotion is possible, safe vehicle driving environment improvement can be achieved for a user through vehicle interior decoration, and profit creation is possible through promotion.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트폰을 이용한 비상 상황 대처용 경보 및 표시장치에 관한 것으로서, 좀더 상세하게는 제3자로 부터 범죄 위험이 있는 여성에게 긴급 상황 발생시 버튼 조작으로 사용자의 스마트폰을 이용해 미리 설정한 음성 내용을 출력하면서 제3자의 심리적 자제력을 유도하므로 비상 상황을 회피하게 함은 물론 비상 상황을 음성 및 영상으로 녹화하고 이를 비상 연락망으로 자동 전송하는 방식에 의해 도움을 요청하면서 위험에서 벗어나 안전을 도모할 수 있도록 하고, 또한, 장애인, 환자, 노인과 같이 거동이 불편한 사람들이나 일반인들에게 심장마비, 뇌출혈, 넘어짐 사고 등으로 발생되는 응급 상황, 주택에 침입한 강도, 택시강도, 부녀자 강도 및 납치사건 등 긴급 상황 발생시 버튼조작으로 119, 112 등의 구조 및 구호기관에 자동 긴급 호출되고, 스마트폰을 이용한 음성출력, 음성 및 영상 녹화, 경보 또는 디스플레이 화면을 통한 표시 작동 등에 의해 비상상황 발생을 전파해 추가 사고를 방지하고 외부의 도움을 받아 안전을 도모하도록 하고, 문패, 인테리어 장식, 방문객 대화 및 확인을 통한 사용자의 주거환경 개선, 차량에 설치되어 승하차 등의 차량내 현황 전파, 홍보, 차량 인테리어를 통한 사용자의 차량 안전운전환경 개선, 홍보기능을 통한 수익이 창출되는데 그 특징이 있다.
assignees: SONG CHEONG HEE;LEE HAE JEONG;JANG YU GYEONG;LEE YUN JI

title_en: Patient Emergency Response System
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.
assignees: CHIU ALEXANDER ROSS;FREDERICK NEIL ADAM;FREDERICK ERIC ALAN;CHUNG JIMMY YOUNG JAE;ROSS MEDICAL CORP

title_en: Scheduling method and device for sanitation vehicles in target city
abstract_en: The invention provides a dispatching method and a dispatching device for sanitation vehicles in a target city, which relate to the technical field of sanitation vehicle dispatching and comprise the following steps: and determining the dust accumulation amount and the dust accumulation area of each detection point on the road section through dust accumulation detection equipment, determining the dust accumulation grade of the road section, and determining the sanitation vehicle scheduling strategy according to the dust accumulation grade of the target road section, the road grade, the road section length and the position information of all idle sanitation vehicles if the dust accumulation grade of the target road section is higher than the preset grade so as to clean the target road section. The method can ensure the rationality and timeliness of the sanitation vehicle dispatching, and alleviate the technical problems of unreasonable dispatching strategy and low efficiency of the existing sanitation vehicle dispatching method.

title_en: The fire receive panel remote monitoring system
title_ko: 화재수신반 원격감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire receiver panel remote monitoring system in which a camera connected with a fire receiver panel by a signal line records a momentary stop image if the fire receiver panel is operated and a lamp of a fire layer is turned on and an alarm rings. A monitoring unit compares the momentary stop image with pre-inputted lamps and determines what lamp is turned on and reports it to a control center of a remote site and a manager as an image and texts. Therefore, the manager does not have to determine the image and understands a fire situation by moving to the level on fire immediately and handles the situation rapidly. Moreover, it is also possible to prevent a fire from spreading due to a misjudgment of the manager. The fire receiver panel remote monitoring system takes a photograph of the fire receiver panel using the camera and transmits it to the control center and the manager. The camera is connected to the fire receiver panel with the signal line and records the momentary stop image if the alarm rings, and the lamp is operated. The position of a lamp inside the fire receiver panel on each level is stored inside the camera. The monitoring unit compares the stored position of the lamp with the position of a lamp in which a light is sensed in the momentary stop image and reports the breakout of a fire to the control center and the manager using a text message.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재수신반이 작동되어 화재층의 램프가 켜지고 경종이 울리면 화재수신반과 신호선으로 연결된 카메라에서 순간 정지영상을 촬영하면 미리 입력된 램프들과 비교하여 어떤 램프가 켜졌는지를 감시수단에서 비교판단하여 원격지의 관제센터 및 관리자에게 영상과 문자로 통보함으로써, 관리자가 영상을 판단할 필요가 없으므로 즉시 화재층에 출동하여 화재상황을 파악할 수 있으며 신속한 대처가 가능하고, 또한 관리자의 오판으로 화재가 커지는 상황을 미연에 막을 수 있는 화재수신반 원격감시 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 화재수신반을 카메라로 촬영하여 관제센터 및 관리자에게 전송하는 화재수신반 원격감시 시스템에 있어서, 상기 카메라는 화재수신반과 신호선으로 연결되어 경종 및 램프가 작동될 때 상기 카메라에서 순간 정지영상을 촬영하고; 상기 카메라 내부에는 상기 화재수신반의 층별 램프 위치를 저장하고, 저장된 램프의 위치와 순간 정지영상에서 불빛이 감지된 램프의 위치를 비교하여 어느 층에 화재가 발생했는지 문자메시지로 관제센터 및 관리자에게 전송하는 감시수단이 구비된 특징이 있다.
assignees: LEADERS FIRE PROT ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: A control device of a agricultural tractor simulator
title_ko: 농업용 트랙터 시뮬레이터의 제어 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 농업용 트랙터 시뮬레이터의 제어 장치를 공개한다. 이 장치는 차체의 하부에 구비된 모션 플랫폼의 회전각도 데이터를 출력하는 메인 제어부; 상기 모션 플랫폼을 구동하는 서보 모터의 제어 각도가 제한 각도를 초과하는지 여부를 감지하는 센서부; 상기 제한 각도 및 상기 회전각도 데이터를 인가받아 감속기 축 회전 각도를 연산하는 프로그램 로직 제어기; 상기 연산된 감속기 축 회전 각도를 인가받아 상기 서보 모터의 제어 계수를 산출하여 상기 서보 모터를 구동하는 서보 모터 드라이버; 상기 프로그램 로직 제어기의 동작 모드를 선택하고, 상기 동작 모드에 따라 복수개의 스위칭 동작 및 디스플레이 동작을 수행하는 프로그램 로직 제어기 운전 조작부; 및 상기 서보 모터에 연결되어 상기 서보 모터 드라이버의 제어에 응답하여 상기 서보 모터를 소정의 감속비로 감속하는 감속기;를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의할 경우, 농업인에게 농업용 트랙터의 도로주행 안전교육이나 경사 작업 등의 안전교육시 고비용의 안전시설을 갖춘 교육 시스템의 필요 없이 운전자가 차량을 실제 운전하는 느낌을 갖도록 농업용 트랙터 차체의 하부에 장착된 모션 플랫폼의 움직임을 정밀하게 제어하고, 전복 사고 등 교육 과정 중에 위험한 상황을 예방할 수 있다.

title_en: IoT Smart Fire Detection Guide System Using Existing Fire Detector
title_ko: 기존 소방감지기를 활용한 IoT 스마트 화재감지 안내시스템
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제]   
본 발명은 IoT 스마트 화재감지 안내시스템에 관한 것으로, 화재가 발생할 경우 화재 발생 위치와 건물의 내부 구조를 잘 모르거나 화재 연기로 인해 비상구나 대피장소를 찾기 어려운 경우에 신속한 대피가 이루어지지 못해 인명사고가 발생하는 문제점을 해결하기 위한 것이다. 
 [해결수단]   
본 발명의 IoT 스마트 화재감지 안내시스템은, 화재를 감지하여 화재감지신호를 발생하는 소방감지기; 상기 소방감지기로부터 화재감지신호를 수신하는 소방수신기; 상기 소방수신기로부터 화재감지신호를 수신 받아 인터넷을 통해 시스템 서버로 전송하는 수신반 서버; 상기 수신반 서버로부터 화재감지신호를 수신 받아 시스템에 등록된 연락처로 상기 소방감지기 및 비상구의 위치, 대피방향이 포함된 상기 소방감지기에 해당하는 도면 경로(웹주소)를 SMS 문자, 이메일, 어플 푸쉬기능 중 적어도 하나 이상 전송하고, 안전수칙과 대응방법, 긴급전화번호를 안내하는 시스템 서버; 상기 시스템 서버에 로그인하여 상기 소방감지기의 위치별로 건물내부의 도면 또는 웹이미지를 등록하고, 상기 도면 또는 웹이미지에 경계구역명, 소방감지기 및 비상구의 위치, 대피방향을 등록하는 고객 PC; 및 상기 시스템 서버로부터 도면 경로가 포함된 SMS 문자, 이메일, 어플 푸쉬기능 중 하나 이상을 수신 받아 상기 도면 경로를 클릭하면 상기 고객 PC에서 등록한 상기 소방감지기에 해당하는 도면 또는 웹이미지가 화면에 출력되는 스마트폰;을 포함한다. 
 [기대효과]   
본 발명에 따르면, 별도의 센서 구입이나 재설치 없이 기존의 소방감지기를 활용하여 적은 비용으로 도입할 수 있고, 화재발생 시 신속하게 대처가 가능하다.

title_en: System for monitoring overheating and gas leak of energy storage system using thermal imaging camera
title_ko: 열화상 카메라를 이용한 에너지 저장 설비의 과열 및 가스 누출 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for monitoring overheating and gas leakage of an energy storage system (ESS), and specifically, to a system for monitoring overheating and gas leakage of an energy storage system using thermal imaging cameras, which can prevent fires in an energy storage system and major accidents caused thereby, by recording and monitoring in real time overheating and gas leakage in the energy storage system using thermal imaging cameras.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 에너지 저장 설비(ESS, Energy Storage System)의 과열 및 가스 누출을 감시하는 시스템에 관한 것으로, 상세하게는, 열화상 카메라를 이용하여 에너지 저장 설비 내에서 과열과 가스 누출을 실시간으로 촬영하여 감시함으로써 에너지 저장 설비의 화재발생과 그로 인한 대형사고를 사전에 예방할 수 있는 열화상 카메라를 이용한 에너지 저장 설비의 과열 및 가스 누출 감시 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Integrated Drone Measurement System linked with Surface Velocity Meter using doppler radar
title_ko: 전자파표면유속계를 연계한 통합 드론측정시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated drone measurement system linked with an electromagnetic wave surface flow velocity meter. More specifically, the integrated drone measurement system linked with an electromagnetic wave surface flow velocity meter comprises: a drone; a control computer for an electromagnetic wave surface flow velocity meter integrating and processing flow velocity data and flight data in the drone; a gimbal (9) consisting of a damper absorbing and alleviating vibration and a gimbal fixing bracket (19) attached to the damper; and a drone part including an electromagnetic wave surface flow velocity meter mounted on the gimbal fixing bracket of the gimbal. A ground part consisting of an integrated GCS connected to the drone part via wireless communication to simultaneously display the flight data and the flow velocity data is provided on the ground. The drone flies in the sky above a river to measure the flow of the river in a flood season to emit an electromagnetic wave in the upstream direction of the river. Then the Doppler effect of the electromagnetic wave reflected from the water surface is used to measure the surface flow velocity and then the flow velocity data and the flight data are integrated and processed by the control computer for an electromagnetic wave surface flow velocity meter to be stored in a flow velocity data storage part and a flight record storage part. The integrated GCS flight data and flow velocity data are simultaneously displayed and the flow is calculated to eliminate conventional measurement on a bridge and a bank by manpower to efficiently carry out measurement without accidents.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전자파표면유속계를 연계한 통합 드론측정시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히 설명하면 드론 및 드론 내부에 유속 데이터와 비행 데이터를 통합 처리하는 전자파표면유속계용 제어 컴퓨터와, 진동을 흡수ㆍ완충하는 댐퍼 및 상기 댐퍼에 부착된 짐벌 고정 브라켓(19)으로 구성된 짐벌(9)과, 상기 짐벌의 짐벌 고정 브라켓에 장착된 전자파표면유속계를 포함한 드론부로 구성한다. 
상기 지상에는 드론부와 무선 통신으로 연결되어 비행 데이터 및 유속 데이터를 동시에 표시하는 통합 GCS로 구성된 지상부로 이루어져, 홍수기에 하천의 유량을 측정하기 위해 드론을 하천의 상공으로 비행하여 전자파표면유속계에서 하천의 상류방향으로 전자파를 발사한 후 수표면에서 반사되는 전자파의 도플러 효과를 이용하여 표면유속을 측정한 다음 전자파표면유속계용 제어 컴퓨터에서 유속 데이터와 비행 데이터를 통합 처리하여 유속 데이터 저장부 및 비행기록 저장부로 저장한 다음 통합 GCS비행 데이터 및 유속 데이터를 동시에 표시하고 유량을 산정하는 방식으로 종래와 같이 교량, 제방에서 인력에 의해 측정을 하지 않아 안전사고 없이 효율적으로 측정하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Lost person rescue drone
abstract_en: A system and method for optimizing a rescue operation of an individual. The method comprises maintaining, by an individual engaged in an activity, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) associated with and in proximity to the individual. For storage at the UAV, the individual records at a recording device a message. A sensor device is configured to detect a situation requiring a need to rescue the individual at a current location, and generates a trigger signal in response to a detection. In response to the receipt of the trigger signal, a current GPS location of the individual is recorded and a launching of the UAV to traverse a flight-path to a destination location. At or before arriving at the destination location, the UAV contemporaneously provides the stored recorded message and current GPS location of the individual to an emergency response authority to inform of the individual's situation and location.

title_en: Computer implemented system and associated methods for management of workplace incident reporting
abstract_en: The computer implemented systems, devices, and methods are for documenting and tracking workplace injuries/incidents, generating safety analytics, providing fraud prevention features, and delivering wellness/training resources, for example. The Workplace Incident Reporting Platform (WIRP) is for industry project managers, associates, insurers, and medical providers. The WIRP is an innovative, user-friendly, secure digital platform that increases efficiency on the job site and brings enterprise leaders, designated employee representatives, associates, and their medical providers together as a team. The WIRP does this by providing a resourceful digital approach to document accurate, and comprehensive, First Report of Injury (FRI). The WIRP's streamline and digitized document record control benefits both the associates and enterprise with smart safety analytics, and updated status reports.

title_en: A Beidou command system for space-sky-ground multi-type unmanned planes
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a Beidou command system for space-sky-ground multi-type unmanned planes. The Beidou command system for space-sky-ground multi-type unmanned planes comprises at least two unmanned planes, an emergency command car, an array antenna, an antenna control device, and a Beidou command device. A Beidou satellite receiver acquires the positioning information of the unmanned planes with a Beidou satellite. The positioning information is transmitted to the Beidou command device by a Beidou satellite transmitter. The Beidou command device receives the positioning information with the array antenna. The Beidou command system for space-sky-ground multi-type unmanned planes is capable of controlling multiple unmanned planes with the Beidou satellite and has a strong anti-interference capability and good maneuverability so as to be capable of enhancing command accuracy and timeliness. In addition, the system also has advantages of simple structure, good realtimeness, high reliability, and strong practicality.
assignees: XI AN BOYU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Highway tunnel operation management and control system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a highway tunnel operation management and control system, which comprises an intelligent tunnel operation management and control platform, a comprehensive monitoring system, an emergency cooperative command system, a data analysis and auxiliary decision system, a communication system and a platform management system; the intelligent tunnel operation control platform is respectively connected with the comprehensive monitoring system, the emergency cooperative command system and the data analysis and auxiliary decision system through the communication system and is used for operation of management personnel; the comprehensive monitoring system is used for monitoring the running states of all facilities in the tunnel in real time; the emergency cooperative command system is used for linking various facilities in the tunnel to quickly process according to a preset plan when an accident occurs in the tunnel; the data analysis and auxiliary decision system is used for evaluating the running state of the tunnel, supporting a safety management decision, carrying out statistical analysis on operation data and supporting a special decision; the platform management system is used for managing basic information, electromechanical equipment, system logs, alarm records and telephone records in the system.

title_en: Wireless emergency bell control system and method, and computer-readable recording medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention relate to a wireless emergency bell and a method for controlling a wireless emergency bell installed in a school and a school zone, the method comprising the steps of: receiving an input signal generated by pressing a provided button by a reporter when an emergency situation occurs; generating an emergency bell signal, repeatedly transmitting the generated emergency bell signal to at least one pager and a receiver during a predetermined configuration time, and outputting a pre-stored alarm sound to the outside through a provided speaker; generating an emergency bell voice signal and transmitting the generated emergency bell voice signal to the at least one pager and the receiver; generating an emergency bell voice transmission completion signal indicating that the emergency bell voice signal has been completely transmitted, and transmitting the generated emergency bell voice transmission completion signal to the at least one pager and the receiver; converting an operation of the wireless emergency bell into a reception mode in which data can be automatically received from at least one pager after a configured time; receiving a pager voice signal from the at least one pager; determining whether the received pager voice signal exists, and outputting the received pager voice signal to the outside through the speaker when the received pager voice signal exists; and determining whether a mode conversion command signal is received from the at least one pager when the received pager voice signal does not exist, and converting the operation of the wireless emergency bell into a transmission mode in which data can be transmitted to the at least one pager and the receiver when there is the received mode conversion command signal.

title_en: Emergency comprehensive dispatching command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency comprehensive dispatching command system in the technical field of information dispatching communication, which comprises a management and control center, a village and town command center, a village command center, a satellite, a public network environment and an emergency command center, wherein the village and town command center is connected with the village command center through the public network environment; the emergency fusion command system is reasonable in structural design, a VPDN (virtual private network digital network) network is adopted in a management and control center, the VPDN network can fuse a communication server, a recording and video recording terminal and a touch screen dispatching desk to realize a basic audio/video dispatching function, an external telephone and a satellite telephone can be accessed to a fusion communication platform by configuring a telephone gateway, a conference seat system of the command center can be accessed to the fusion communication platform by configuring a seat gateway, and the communication platform is interconnected and communicated with other voice terminals of the system; the aircraft video access module is configured, the field aircraft video is accessed to the fusion communication platform, and the command center can quickly know the field situation through the aircraft video, so that the emergency can be quickly responded, and the command and the scheduling can be timely carried out.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HAOCHANG COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Public safety data management platform of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle public security data management platform. The method comprises the steps of extracting foreground high-frequency components from an area monitoring image acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle based on a deep learning image processing technology, extracting multi-level features and enhancing feature gradient masks from the extracted area foreground high-frequency object image to obtain shallow salient feature representation and deep salient feature representation of the area foreground high-frequency object, intelligently identifying whether the high-frequency object is a human object based on main component matching fusion features of the shallow salient feature representation and the deep salient feature representation, and generating corresponding personnel activity prompt signals. Therefore, the method can realize rapid and accurate identification of the human body target in the unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring image, thereby improving the efficiency of public safety management and the timeliness of emergency response.
assignees: ZHEJIANG PUBLIC SECURITY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Breeze climate monitoring method for transformation area of sand pressing land
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle breeze climate inspection, in particular to a breeze climate monitoring method for a sand pressing land transformation area, which comprises the steps that when a ground control station sends an inspection flight command, a ground observation network acquires point position data, calculates comprehensive deviation degree by comparing with a standard reference value, and screens an early warning point source data set; the method comprises the steps of generating first patrol area vector area data by superposing surface source grid data and early warning point source space, matching similar data from historical patrol data, determining patrol availability parameters through aerial photography and historical remote sensing data superposition analysis, dynamically adjusting the first patrol area to form a second vector area or amplifying the ground observation network according to the patrol availability parameters, and returning aerial photo data for breeze climate depth analysis after the unmanned aerial vehicle patrol the determined area. According to the invention, through multi-source data fusion and dynamic optimization, the accuracy and timeliness of microscale climate monitoring are improved, the influence of data delay is reduced, and an efficient scheme is provided for ecology monitoring and disaster control in a sand pressing land transformation area.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: High-yield cultivation method of japonica rice based on warm light resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-yield cultivation method of japonica rice based on warm light resources, which relates to the technical field of crop precise cultivation and comprises the steps of calculating TPU increment values based on field real-time warm light data, acquiring a historical TPU value dataset, carrying out TPU increment prediction by combining future weather forecast data, and generating a climatic period prediction instruction; the method comprises the steps of identifying a weather period time interval set based on a weather period prediction instruction, extracting weather data from future weather forecast data according to the weather period time interval set to generate a weather period weather risk data set, calculating risk probabilities of low-temperature cold injury and high-temperature heat injury according to the weather period weather risk data set to generate a weather risk probability set, and carrying out risk early warning judgment according to the weather risk probability set to generate a three-level risk early warning instruction signal. According to the invention, by generating the three-level risk early warning command signals, the initiative and grading response to the potential disasters are realized, and the disaster prevention and control accuracy and timeliness are enhanced.

title_en: Information management device, information management method and information management program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide background information of a past similar corresponding action helpful to examine a present state for an emergency response.SOLUTION: An information management device 10 comprises: an activity log management unit 122 which stores an activity log in an activity log storage unit 112 in association with a workflow and detects the activity log not corresponding to the workflow; an evaluation result storage unit 113 which stores an evaluation result of a past activity log; a similar activity log extraction unit 123 which extracts a past activities log similar to the activity log not corresponding to the workflow from the activity log storage unit 112; and an evaluation result management unit 124 which searches for external information around the date and time of occurrence of the extracted past activity log from the external information storage unit 114, and when the searched external information and the external information of the activity log not corresponding to the workflow are similar, displays the extracted past activity log, the external information around the date and time of occurrence, and the evaluation result of the past activity log searched from the evaluation result storage unit 113, on the screen of a client terminal.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Video content analysis system and method for transportation system
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a video content analysis system which provides for quicker emergency response, validates the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitors crew performance and safety. 
     SOLUTION: The track detection and infrastructure monitoring includes a reinforcement learning component, an object detection and position specifying component, and an obstruction detection component to analyze video data, vehicle data, weather data, and route/manifest data to determine internal and/or external conditions relating to an asset. A data acquisition and recording system uploads the data, internal and/or external condition information, object detection information, object position information, and obstruction detection information to a remote memory module and provides streaming video data in real-time to a remotely located user. Remotely located users can view the data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device.
