title_en: Bicycle mobile App service
title_ko: 자전거 사용에 대한 빅데이터 수집과 분석을 위한 모바일 앱 및 서버 솔루션 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile application and a server solution system for the collection and analysis of bigdata for the use of bicycles, capable of making a contribution to minimizing social losses such as environmental pollution and traffic congestion caused by the popularization of vehicles. More specifically, the system comprises: a main server interlinked with cooperative systems of local governments and civic groups related with bicycles; and an assisting server interlinked with the main server and collecting personal information of users and riding records of the users. Especially, the assisting server includes a member information module, a navigation module, an SOS requesting module, a neighboring environment module, and an open market module to be provided to bicycle users, and thus, the system is capable of inducing the vitalization of bicycles.
abstract_ko: 자전거관련 지자체 및 시민단체의 협력시스템과 상호 연동하면서 빅데이터를 수집 분석하는 모바일 앱을 자전거에 부착하여 운전하게 함으로써 이동 중인 자전거 도로의 정보, 자전거의 주요 이용 시간대, 안전사고 이력 등의 자전거 도로 상황 정보를 수집하여 분석한 정보를 지자체에 전송하여 자전거 도로의 문제점을 지속적으로 파악하여 신속한 개선을 유도하고, 자전거 이용자는 모바일 앱에서 내비게이션 기능, 사고발생 조치기능, 오픈마켓 플랫폼 등 편의 기능을 제공하여 편리하고 쾌적한 자전거 이용으로 자전거 활성화를 유도함에 따라 자동차 대중화로 인한 환경오염, 교통체증 등 사회적 소실의 최소화에 기여하는 자전거 사용에 대한 빅데이터 수집과 분석을 위한 모바일 앱 및 서버 솔루션 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 위 모바일 앱 및 서버 솔루션 시스템은 자전거관련 지자체 및 시민단체의 협력시스템과 상호 연동한 메인서버;와, 메인서버와 연동하고 사용자 인적사항 및 사용자의 자전거 운전 이력을 수집하는 보조서버;로 구성되고 특히, 보조서버는 사용자의 개인정보를 저장하는 회원정보모듈과, 위성항법장치(GPS)를 이용한 지도와 길 안내 수단이 저장된 내비게이션모듈과, GPS 및 행정관망시스템과 연동함에 따라 사고가 발생하면 행정기관에 상황정보를 전달하는 SOS 요청모듈과, 자전거 운전자의 현 위치를 인지하여 해당 도로의 자전거 유동량과 대기오염 정도를 수집하고 사용자에게 분석된 정보를 제공하는 주변환경모듈과, 자전거의 온라인 및 오프라인 매장 및 자전거 편의장비 매장을 추천하거나 연결 주도하는 오픈마켓모듈을 포함하여 자전거 사용자들에게 제공함으로써 자전거의 활성화를 유도하는 것에 특징이 있다.

title_en: Platform system for performing arbitration for medical disputes in medical institutions
title_ko: 의료기관의 의료 분쟁 중재기능을 수행하는 플랫폼
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a medical dispute mediation function platform including a function of providing real-time dispute information of a medical institution on an online platform when a medical accident occurs. The present invention relates to a platform system performing a function of mediating a medical dispute of a medical institution, which comprises the steps of: storing login information of a user; inquiring a medical institution visit record of the user; inquiring hospital information of the visited medical institution; receiving a medical accident report from the user; transmitting a relief request to a medical dispute relief institution system in an arbitration platform; storing a dispute situation in the arbitration platform; and providing real-time dispute information of the corresponding medical institution when a detailed inquiry is requested from the user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 의료사고 발생시 온라인 플랫폼에서 의료기관의 실시간 분쟁정보를 제공하는 기능을 포함하는 의료 분쟁 중재기능 플랫폼에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명은 사용자의 로그인 정보를 저장하는 단계; 사용자의 의료기관 방문 기록을 조회하는 단계; 방문했던 의료기관의 병원 정보를 조회하는 단계; 사용자로부터 의료사고 신고를 수신하는 단계; 중재 플랫폼에서 의료분쟁구제기관 시스템에 구제 요청을 송부하는 단계; 중재 플랫폼에서 분쟁 상황을 저장하는 단계; 사용자로부터 상세 조회 요청시 해당 의료기관의 실시간 분쟁 정보를 제공하는 단계를 포함하는 의료기관의 의료 분쟁을 중재하는 기능을 수행하는 플랫폼 시스템이다.

title_en: A System and Method of Providing Instruction Using Artificial Intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능을 이용하여 명령을 제공하는 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Described are a system and a method for providing commands using artificial intelligence. A memory is provided for storing at least one set of program commands. A processor is configured to execute at least one set of program commands stored in the memory. A machine learning trainer is configured to be executed by the processor, encode a set of parameters and training tasks based on machine learning, and provide a course to a user. The machine learning trainer determines an accurate response based on at least one past experience stored in the memory or a set of predetermined course parameters stored in the memory. The machine learning trainer evaluates the user based on at least one past experience stored in the memory or a set of predetermined course parameters stored in the memory.
abstract_ko: 인공지능을 이용하여 명령을 제공하는 시스템 및 방법이 설명된다. 프로그램 명령 중 적어도 하나의 세트를 저장하는 메모리가 제공된다. 프로세서는 메모리에 저장된 프로그램 명령 중 적어도 하나의 세트를 실행하도록 구성된다. 머신 러닝 트레이너는 프로세서에 의해 실행되며, 머신 러닝에 기초하는 파라미터 및 트레이닝 태스크의 세트를 인코딩하고, 사용자에게 코스를 제공하도록 구성된다. 머신 러닝 트레이너는 메모리에 저장된 적어도 하나의 과거 경험 또는 메모리에 저장된 미리 결정된 코스 파라미터의 세트에 기초하여 정확한 응답을 결정한다. 머신러닝 트레이너는 메모리에 저장된 적어도 하나의 과거 경험 또는 메모리에 저장된 미리 결정된 코스 파라미터의 세트에 기초하여 사용자를 평가한다.

title_en: Coding simulation device capable of checking coding
title_ko: 코딩 확인이 가능한 코딩 시뮬레이션 장치
abstract_en: A coding simulation device capable of checking coding, according to the present invention, comprises: a control module which, when a control command is input, generates a control signal by using a program coded by a user and outputs the control signal, the control signal corresponding to the control command and including control target information and control content information; and a coding simulation board which, when the control signal is input from the control module, outputs first coding checking information and second coding checking information, the first coding checking information indicating that the program has been coded so that the control signal for controlling a target to be controlled, which is indicated by the control target information of the input control signal, is generated in response to the control command, and the second coding checking information indicating that the program has been coded so that the control signal for carrying out control in response to control contents indicated by the control content information of the input control signal is generated in response to the control command.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 코딩 확인이 가능한 코딩 시뮬레이션 장치는 제어 명령이 입력되면 사용자로부터 코딩된 프로그램을 이용하여 상기 제어 명령에 대응되고 제어 대상 정보 및 제어 내용 정보를 포함하는 제어 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 제어 모듈; 및 상기 제어 모듈로부터 상기 제어 신호가 입력되면, 상기 입력된 제어 신호의 제어 대상 정보가 나타내는 제어 대상을 제어하는 상기 제어 신호가 상기 제어 명령에 대응하여 생성되도록 상기 프로그램이 코딩되었음을 나타내는 제1 코딩 확인 정보 및 상기 입력된 제어 신호의 제어 내용 정보가 나타내는 제어 내용에 대응하여 제어하는 상기 제어 신호가 상기 제어 명령에 대응하여 생성되도록 상기 프로그램이 코딩되었음을 나타내는 제2 코딩 확인 정보를 출력하는 코딩 시뮬레이션 보드;를 포함한다.

title_en: Headset Computer With Handsfree Emergency Response
abstract_en: Operating conditions for a headset computer are used to detect a situation where an emergency response mode should be activated. In emergency response mode, the headset computer may then broadcast location, live (real time) audio and video/data streams, and record other information concerning a possible theft and/or other situation of interest to law enforcement and/or security services.

title_en: Emergency vehicle dispatching management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency vehicle dispatching management system, which comprises a building, a main roller shutter door device arranged in the building, a secondary roller shutter door device arranged at the rear side of the main roller shutter door device and a management device arranged at the rear side of the secondary roller shutter door device, the management device comprises a control cavity arranged at the right rear part in the building, a control motor is fixedly arranged in the front wall of the control cavity, the rear end of the control motor is in power connection with a screw rod, a switching block which is in threaded connection with the screw rod is arranged in the control cavity in a front-back sliding manner, the device can be uniformly monitored through a dispatching management center, when receiving the emergency dispatching requirement, the garage door can be opened quickly as required, the driver can drive the vehicle away in time, meanwhile, the vehicle dispatching condition can be recorded, the management of the vehicle is facilitated, and the dispatching efficiency is improved.

title_en: Structured analytic driving method for reservoir flood scheduling scheme
abstract_en: The invention discloses a structured analytic driving method for a reservoir flood dispatching scheme. The method comprises the following steps: structural analysis of a reservoir flood scheduling scheme; step two: storing and managing structured clauses of the flood scheduling scheme; step three: establishing a driving engine of a structured clause of a flood scheduling scheme; step four: checking and correcting structured terms of the flood scheduling scheme; step five: and (4) real-time application of a reservoir flood scheduling clause library and a driving engine. The method overcomes the defects that the updating efficiency of the repair and adjustment model of the existing reservoir flood scheduling scheme is low, the supporting effect of the reservoir flood scheduling scheme in real-time scheduling is weakened, the timeliness requirement of reservoir flood scheduling under a real-time scheduling scene is difficult to adapt, and the simulation calculation and decision response efficiency of reservoir flood scheduling are seriously influenced; the method has the advantages of meeting the timeliness requirement of reservoir flood scheduling in a real-time scheduling scene and ensuring the supporting function of a reservoir flood scheduling scheme in real-time scheduling.

title_en: Construction system of criminal suspect knowledge network using public security information and Method thereof
title_ko: 치안정보를 활용한 범죄인물 지식망 구축 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention uses various big data analysis techniques and search techniques based on an integrated security information data bank to create a human node with criminals and their related people and build a criminal person knowledge network by reconstructing incident contents through past criminal record information and correlation information with similar cases to provide a user with three-dimensional information related to a suspect.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 통합 치안정보 데이터 뱅크를 기반으로 다양한 빅데이터 분석기법과 검색기법을 활용하여 범죄인물 및 그 연관인물들로 인명 노드를 생성하고, 과거 범죄기록 정보 및 유사사건과의 연관성 정보를 통해 사건 내용을 재구성하여 범죄인물 지식망을 구축하고 사용자에게 용의자와 관련된 입체적인 정보를 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Programming device and recording medium, and programming method
abstract_en: A programming device including a shape indication section which receives at least one first user operation for indicating a shape by specifying two or more portions among a plurality of tangible portions arranged at different positions with each other in a planar direction; and a control section which generates a command list for moving a control target section along the indicated shape.

title_en: Emergency response system with dynamic ALI database alphanumeric character hacking
abstract_en: An improved emergency response method and system are shown and described. A content-specified text field—such as a caller name field—an ALI database record for a communication device is updated to include information about a person experiencing an emergency and the emergency. A PSAP receiving an emergency services call from the communication device receives the caller name field on a terminal display and is thus informed about the emergency via a alphanumeric character communication rather than orally. A particular emergency may be assigned a code that is put in the caller name field. A PSAP operator receiving the emergency services call may then enter the code into an emergency services web interface to retrieve information about the emergency including service provider credentials, the person's medical condition, the person's medical records, real time physiologic data, treatment facility names, treatment facility types, a location of the emergency, a level of care, a videoconference web link, on-site personnel names, disaster information, and hazard information. The code can be transmitted to first responders and downstream medical professionals to enhance their ability to deliver emergency services. The system and method provide a means for legacy PSAPs to receive the benefits of Next Generation  911  systems without the infrastructure changes that would otherwise be required.

title_en: Systems and methods for event recorder logging
abstract_en: An incident recorder, worn by a user, maintains records in a log regarding operation of the incident recorder.
assignees: SMITH PATRICK W;SHEKARRI NACHE D;DHILLON JASJIT S;CEROVIC MILAN;WINN JR ROGER CLAY;TASER INT INC

title_en: Entrance guard, control, fire alarm multi-target intelligent control technology device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an entrance guard, control, fire alarm multi-target intelligent control technical device relates to building control technical field, including the equipment box, the outer wall edge of equipment box all fixes being provided with the water curtain pipe, and the outer wall of water curtain pipe all communicates and is provided with a plurality of shower nozzles. This entrance guard, the control, fire alarm multi-target intelligent control technical device, through the equipment box, the water curtain pipe, the shower nozzle, rotatory sprinkler bead and circulating pipe, can assist entrance guard control system output dry contact alarm signal to send to the digital video recorder, fire control system output dry contact alarm signal sends entrance guard control box and penetrates the entrance guard contact and realize that fire alarm opens the door, avoid because the conflagration, lead to equipment to take place to become invalid, through cooling fan, hang the pole, the mounting bracket, storage frame and receiver, can introduce entrance guard system and monitored control system through fire alarm signal, direct warning and opening entrance guard when the conflagration takes place, make the sampling personnel flee smoothly, prevent that the casualties incident from taking place.

title_en: A kind of Trunking Switching Center group exhales the method for being incorporated to and contention resolution
abstract_en: The method of being incorporated to and contention resolution are exhaled the invention discloses a kind of Trunking Switching Center group.The method of being incorporated to comprises the following steps：After the group that group exhales controller to be initiated according to user terminal calls for asking the session C1 for setting up group A, if the call request that the group that some other switching centre initiates according to user terminal is called for seeking the session C2 for setting up group A and sending to group A exhales controller to group, group exhales controller to be stored in session C2 information in group A conversation recording information table, resource is distributed to call request, session C1 and session C2 media are converged, is replied to the switching centre for sending call request and is incorporated to successful information.The present invention in one is conversed, can will ensure that emergency command communication is unimpeded to the merged session of multiple switching centres of identical group of calling.
assignees: HANGZHOU ACTEC COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent emergency rescue command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency rescue command system, which comprises: the emergency platform design basic unit is an accident risk description unit which is used for inputting and storing data such as basic conditions, danger sources, accident risks and the like in a target area, an emergency organization and responsibility control unit which realizes visualization of a corresponding emergency organization system, electronic input and check of emergency command organizations and responsibilities, an early warning and information statistics report unit which performs early warning, statistics and reporting to form summary records, an emergency response unit which selects emergency handling measures and response levels according to dynamic conditions of accident events, an emergency guarantee control unit and an emergency plan management unit, relevant personnel make decisions by combining actual conditions, call corresponding handling schemes in the emergency plan management unit, and the early warning and information statistics report unit automatically performs early warning and recording; and then the emergency response unit correspondingly executes corresponding emergency disposal measures and provides corresponding emergency resource guarantee by combining with the emergency guarantee control unit.

title_en: Forest fire prevention and extinguishing method based on unmanned aerial vehicle and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention and extinguishing method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, comprising the following steps: the first step, receive the position information of said fire and fire range information; secondly, dispatching the types and the number of the fire unmanned aerial vehicles according to the fire position information and the fire range information; thirdly, the fire unmanned aerial vehicles are formed into a formation to fly to a fire point, the fire is recorded through a camera, and the formation of the fire unmanned aerial vehicles is subjected to combined square matrix arrangement through a host; fourthly, fire prevention and extinguishment are carried out by using a combined square matrix; and fifthly, recording the fire in real time through a camera, and changing the square matrix arrangement according to the change of the fire by the host. The unmanned aerial vehicle adopts regional division and investigation of the system, the regions are independent and are mutually connected, the emergent fire can be better and faster dealt with, the spread of the fire is avoided, different fire changes and fire sizes are dealt with through different matrixes, and the adopted unmanned aerial vehicle has strong high-temperature resistance and improves the capability of reconnaissance of the unmanned aerial vehicle from the air to fire areas.
assignees: CCCC REMOTE SENSING LOAD JIANGSU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle control device, vehicle control method, and recording medium
abstract_en: A vehicle control device, a vehicle control method, and a recording medium are provided. In a vehicle control device for an autonomous vehicle that autonomously travels based on an operation command, a gesture image of a person located around the autonomous vehicle is acquired, and a stored reference gesture image is compared with the acquired gesture image. In this case, when it is determined that the gesture of the person located around the autonomous vehicle is the gesture requesting the stop of the autonomous vehicle, it is determined whether a disaster has occurred, and when it is determined that the disaster has occurred, the autonomous vehicle is stopped around the person requesting the stop of the autonomous vehicle.

title_en: Equipment emergency processing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an equipment emergency processing method, an equipment emergency processing device, computer equipment and a storage medium; the equipment emergency treatment method comprises the following steps: responding to a first operation aiming at a tool page, and acquiring equipment information; determining target equipment in each second network device according to the equipment information, updating the tool page, and displaying emergency measures corresponding to the target equipment on the updated tool page; the emergency measures are used for representing the incidence relation between the emergency scene where the target equipment is located and the emergency command; responding to a second operation aiming at the updated tool page, and outputting a corresponding emergency command; the emergency command is used for instructing the first network device to connect to the target device so as to execute corresponding emergency operation on the target device. The method and the device can improve emergency accuracy and timeliness.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Unexpected power-off remote transmission alarm system and alarm method thereof
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application relates to the technical field of communication, discloses an unexpected power-off remote transmission alarm system and an alarm method thereof, the remote transmission alarm system integrates the power supply module, the sensor module, the gateway component, the main control module, the cloud server, the user terminal and other functional modules, and realizes real-time monitoring of the power supply state of the mains supply and rapid remote transmission alarm of the power failure event. Once the mains supply is interrupted, the standby power supply unit is started immediately, so that timely power support is provided for the alarm system, and the response timeliness of the alarm system is ensured. The sensor module arranged in the system can continuously monitor the temperature of the standby power supply unit, so that the main control module can intelligently adjust the power supply time according to the power supply state and the temperature of the standby power supply unit, the standby power supply is ensured to operate efficiently in a safe temperature range, and the service life of the standby power supply is prolonged. Therefore, the remote user can acquire the power-off information in real time, and rapidly take countermeasures, so that the emergency response speed and the overall safety are improved.
assignees: CCCC TDC ENV ENGINEERING CO LTD;CCCC TIANJIN DREDGING CO LTD

title_en: Black box and preparing method of the same
title_ko: 블랙박스 및 그의 제조 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A black box and a manufacturing method thereof are provided to prevent damage of recorded data of a driving record device, an accident record device, and a video device embedded in a black box in spite of high temperature, sinking, or impact. CONSTITUTION: A black box comprises a housing, a driving record device, an accident record device, and a video storage device. The driving record device is formed inside the housing which is formed in a sealed type by bonding two or more frame members(110,120) using an inorganic sealing material(150) having a similar thermal expansion coefficient. The inorganic sealing material includes glass composition and ceramic filler. The kind and content of the ceramic filler are regulated according to the material of the frame members so that the thermal expansion coefficient is equal or similar to that of the frame members.
abstract_ko:
본원은 블랙박스 및 그의 제조 방법에 관한 것으로서, 블랙박스의 하우징을 형성하는 프레임 부재의 열팽창 계수와 동일 또는 유사한 열팽창 계수를 갖는 무기계 봉착 재료를 사용하여 두 개 이상의 프레임 부재들을 합착하여 상기 블랙박스의 하우징을 제조함으로써, 고온, 침수 또는 충격 시 블랙박스에 내장된 운행기록장치, 사고기록장치 또는 영상저장장치를 안전하게 보호할 수 있도록 하여 내열성, 내구성 및 내수성 등이 우수한 블랙박스를 제공할 수 있다. 
       
     블랙박스, 무기계 봉착 재료, 유리 조성물, 세라믹 필러, 열팽창 계수

title_en: Integrated safety management system for children school bus and method thereof
title_ko: 어린이 차량 통학을 위한 통합 안전 관리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated safety management system for transporting children to school by vehicle, and a method therefor. The integrated safety management system of the present invention uses a facial recognition thermal imaging camera installed in a school vehicle to recognize a face of a child when the child goes to and from school using a school vehicle, to check whether the child gets on and off the school vehicle and whether the child attends school, and to check the fever status of the child. The integrated safety management system uses a plurality of air quality sensors installed inside and outside the school vehicle to measure indoor and outdoor air quality information while the school vehicle is in operation, and monitors air pollution based on the information. In addition, the integrated safety management system uses a driving recorder of a driving recorder of a school vehicle to monitor the driving status of the school vehicle, and generates warnings and guidance to encourage safe driving when events such as speeding, sudden braking, and sudden acceleration occur. According to the present invention, accidents are prevented when children go to and from school, and safe operations of school vehicles are improved. Environmental conditions inside and outside a vehicle, and air pollution information while the vehicle is moving are measured, and various notification services according to the time of school transportation are provided to guardians and managers such that it is possible to promote safe transportation of children to and from school and health and safety of the children.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 어린이 차량 통학을 위한 통합 안전 관리 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 통합 안전 관리 시스템은 어린이의 통학 차량을 이용한 등하원 시, 통학 차량에 설치된 얼굴 인식 열화상 카메라를 이용하여 얼굴을 인식하여 승하차 및 등하원 여부 확인과, 발열 상태를 확인한다. 통합 안전 관리 시스템은 통학 차량 내외부에 설치된 복수 개의 공기질 센서를 이용하여 통학 차량의 운행 중에 실내 및 실외의 공기질 정보를 측정하고, 이를 통해 대기 오염 상태를 모니터링한다. 또 통합 안전 관리 시스템은 통학 차량의 운행 기록 장치를 이용하여 통학 차량의 운행 상태를 모니터링하고, 과속, 급제동, 급가속 등의 이벤트가 발생되면, 안전 운행을 유도하도록 경보 및 안내를 발생한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 어린이의 등하원 시에 안전 사고를 방지하고, 통학 차량의 안전 운행을 개도하며, 차량 내외부의 환경 상태와, 차량 이동 간에 대기 오염 정보를 측정하여, 등하원 시에 따른 다양한 알림 서비스를 보호자와 관리자에게 제공함으로써, 어린이의 안전 통학과 건강 안전을 도모할 수 있다.

title_en: Service providing apparatus for processing meteorological and climate data provided by IoT
title_ko: IoT가 제공한 기상기후 데이터의 자료 처리를 위한 서비스 제공 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a service providing apparatus for processing meteorological and climatic data provided by the IoT, and more specifically, to a service providing apparatus for processing meteorological and climatic data provided by the IoT, which may divide meteorological and climatic data received by the Internet of things (IoT) device constituting a smart city according to a data type before processing the same by means of a dispatcher or a worker, thereby increasing data processing efficiency with respect to meteorological and climatic data. In particular, the entire process for collecting meteorological and climatic data and generating a model by means of communication with at least one Internet of things device constituting the smart city may be divided for each step such that an application program calling method (a direct calling, and a loose calling) suitable to the characteristics of each step may be selected. A workflow-based scenario may be provided to link a product of a program executed in each calling method with the calling of the next step, thereby significantly increasing efficiency in resource distribution for data processing, and thus significantly increasing efficiency with respect to data processing by using meteorological and climatic data. To this end, the present invention comprises: a data collecting unit; a data exchange unit; a data processing unit; and a data distribution unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 IoT가 제공한 기상기후 데이터의 자료 처리를 위한 서비스 제공 장치에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히는 스마트 시티를 구성하는 사물인터넷 장치(IoT)로부터 수신된 기상기후 데이터를 자료 종류에 따라 구분하여 디스패처 또는 워커를 통해 처리함으로써 기상기후 데이터에 대한 자료 처리 효율성을 높이도록 한 IoT가 제공한 기상기후 데이터의 자료 처리를 위한 서비스 제공 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 스마트 시티를 구성하는 하나 이상의 사물 인터넷 장치와의 통신을 통한 기상기후 데이터 수집 및 모델 생산을 위한 전주기를 단계별로 세부화하여 각 단계의 특징에 맞은 응용프로그램 호출방식(직접호출, 느슨한호출)을 선택하고 각각의 호출방식에서 수행된 프로그램의 산출물을 다음 단계의 호출로 연동하는 워크플로우 기반의 시나리오를 제공하여 자료 처리를 위한 자원 분배 효율을 크게 높일 수 있으며, 이를 통해 기상기후 데이터를 이용한 자료 처리에 대한 효율을 크게 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Safety management device with NFC module
title_ko: 휴대폰 비상 안전장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile phone emergency safety device. Specifically, it relates to a safety management system in which an NFC module is embedded, which may be provided in a user terminal or its peripheral system, accessories, etc., and which enables the user to link the embedded NFC module with the terminal through a simple operation in an emergency situation, thereby transmitting emergency situation and location information and performing functions such as recording and filming the scene at the time of the accident. In a more specific configuration, it is provided by including a communication shielding part (140) which is provided between the NFC module (150) and the terminal and is provided to pass or shield electromagnetic waves between the terminal NFC part and the NFC module (150), and an NFC chip part (152) that receives induced power from the terminal NFC part of the terminal, thereby performing short-range wireless communication linked with the terminal (10).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 휴대폰 비상 안전장치에 대한 것이다. 즉, 사용자 단말기 또는 그 주변시스템, 액세서리 등에도 구비될 수도 있는 장치로서, 비상상황 시에 사용자가 간단한 동작으로 내장된 NFC모듈부와 단말기가 연동되도록 하여, 비상상황 및 위치정보를 전송하고 사고 당시 현장의 녹음, 녹화 등의 기능을 수행하는 NFC모듈부가 내장된 안전관리시스템에 관한 것이다.  
보다 구체적인 구성상에 있어서는, 전자기파를 차단하는 부재로 제공되며, NFC모듈부(150)와 단말기 사이에 구비되어, 단말기NFC부와 NFC모듈부(150) 사이에 전자기파를 통과 또는 차폐시키는 통신차폐부(140)를 포함하고, 단말기의 단말기NFC부로부터 유도 전력을 공급받는 NFC칩부재(152)로 이루어져 단말기(10)와 연동되는 단거리무선통신을 수행하는 NFC모듈부(150)를 포함하여 제공된다.

title_en: Accident data sending method for emergency management in car accident
title_ko: 차량 사고시 응급 대처를 위한 사고 데이터 전송 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량 사고시 응급 대처를 위한 사고 데이터 전송 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 의한 차량 사고시 응급 대처를 위한 사고 데이터 전송 방법은, 주, 정차에 따른 차량의 최소 진동값과 주행에 따른 차량의 최소 진동값을 감지하여 초기화시키는 제1 단계; 상기 차량의 현위치와 속도 및 현시간 중 적어도 하나에 대한 정보 데이터를 측정하여 수집하는 제2 단계; 상기 수집한 정보 데이터와 차량의 최소 진동값을 비교하여 상기 차량의 주, 정차 또는 주행 상태 여부를 분석하는 제3 단계; 상기 최소 진동값 범위 이상의 진동값이 감지되면 상기 차량의 정보 데이터가 차량의 저장매체에 기록되는 제4 단계; 및 상기 차량의 현위치 및 사고 시간 중 적어도 하나에 대한 기록 데이터가 무선 단말기로 전송되는 제5 단계;를 포함한다. 
     본 발명에 따르면, 차량의 사고 발생 후에 운전자가 의식이 없는 상황에서도 자동에 의해 사고자의 위치를 추적하고, 무선 통신을 통해 기관, 가족 등에게 사고 상황에 대한 데이터를 문자 메시지 등으로 전송하여 사고자에게 최대한 빨리 도움을 줄 수 있는 효과가 있다. 그리고 탑승자가 없는 주, 정차된 차량의 사고시 외부 충격에 의해서도 운전자에게 상황을 인지시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A emergency situation remote surveillance system using portable terminal
title_ko: 휴대용 단말기를 이용한 비상 상황 원격 관제 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed is a remote control system for an emergency situation using a portable terminal. The apparatus includes: a stationary photographing device that is fixed in an area where an emergency bell is installed, photographs and provides moving pictures, and outputs sound and motion signals by sensing a sound and a motion; the portable terminal for photographing an emergency situation moving pictures of an incident scene in real time, transmitting the moving pictures together with GPS data of a user, recognizing the occurrence of an emergency situation and firstly outputting an emergency bell operation signal; a digital image recording apparatus for receiving mapping and storing the GPS data and the stream data of the moving pictures and the emergency situation moving pictures, and secondly outputting a first control command for controlling the operation of the emergency bell by recognizing the occurrence of the emergency situation; and a government office control apparatus for receiving information about the occurrence of the emergency situation by interoperating with the digital image recording apparatus and outputting a second control command to control the operation of the emergency bell and the stationary photographing device. Accordingly, the present invention can early cope with the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대용 단말기를 이용한 비상 상황 원격 관제 시스템을 공개한다. 이 장치는 비상벨이 설치된 지역에 고정되어 동영상을 촬영하여 제공하면서 음향 및 움직임을 감지하여 음향 신호 및 동작 신호를 출력하는 고정형 촬영 기기; 사건 현장의 비상 상황 동영상을 실시간으로 촬영하여 사용자의 GPS 데이터와 함께 전송하고, 비상 상황 발생 사실을 인지하여 1차적으로 비상벨 작동 신호를 출력하는 휴대용 단말기; 상기 동영상 및 상기 비상 상황 동영상의 스트림 데이터 및 상기 GPS 데이터를 전송받아 매핑하여 저장하고, 2차적으로 상기 비상 상황 발생 사실을 인지하여 상기 비상벨의 동작을 제어하는 제1 제어 명령을 출력하는 디지털 영상 녹화 장비; 및 상기 디지털 영상 녹화 장비와 연동되어 상기 비상 상황 발생 사실에 대한 정보를 전달받아 상기 고정형 촬영 기기 및 상기 비상벨의 동작을 제어하는 제2제어 명령을 출력하는 관공서 관제 장비;를 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of sick and wounded identify locating device
abstract_en: A kind of sick and wounded identify locating device, and it comprises the making of identification ring module, identification module and identification ring; Described identification ring is made module by described identification rings different each patient's identity information difference typing, and described identification module is for identifying the information that described identification ring is recorded.The utility model has been realized the wounded's quick recognition and classification, has solved the treatment efficiency that the disaster assistance wounded in enormous quantities are unexpected, concentrate generation to bring, and defends the diligent unprecedented vigor that brings of commanding to medical aid.

title_en: PLC safety monitoring and dynamic measuring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a PLC safety real-time monitoring and measuring method and system. The technical scheme of the invention records and codes various input and output values and the state values of various soft elements in the PLC to form a code table under various running conditions of the normal running state of the PLC and at the running key point; and in the operation stage, collecting and coding each input and output and each soft element state value in the PLC at each operation key point to obtain a corresponding state code word, then quickly searching the state code word in a code table, and starting a PLC emergency response mechanism if the state code word cannot be found, so that the safety of the PLC application system is protected. The technical scheme of the invention can continuously and rapidly measure the safety of the PLC application system when the PLC runs, and timely find out the abnormal execution code and the abnormal input and output of the PLC.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU XINDA JIEAN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Stabilization method and system for hybrid power supply of shelter nucleic acid laboratory
abstract_en: The invention provides a stabilization method for hybrid power supply of a shelter nucleic acid laboratory, wherein the embodiment of the invention collects environmental parameters, power consumption and renewable energy power generation data in real time through sensors arranged inside and outside the shelter nucleic acid laboratory. And predicting the power demand peak value and the renewable energy potential by deep learning, and optimizing a charge-discharge plan by a genetic algorithm to form a dynamic energy management strategy. When the instability of the external power grid is detected, an emergency response mechanism is started, the energy storage system and the standby generator are switched to jointly supply power, and the power proportion is adjusted through reinforcement learning, so that an energy configuration scheme is generated. The fuzzy logic control system dynamically adjusts the state of the equipment to realize intelligent energy saving of non-key equipment. And (3) the implementation process of the block chain record control strategy generates an energy management log. And (5) machine learning an evaluation log and providing power supply strategy optimization suggestions. The scheme ensures the stability and reliability of power supply, optimizes the energy utilization efficiency and reduces the operation cost.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling management method and system based on ocean emergency plan
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of ocean safety, in particular to a scheduling management method and system based on an ocean emergency plan, comprising the following steps: based on the emergency processing request information, marine accident information is analyzed, text content is extracted, a plurality of keywords are detected, the types of accidents are identified by analyzing the combination and the context relation of the plurality of keywords, and accident type identification information is generated. According to the invention, through accident type identification and combination of offshore environment conditions and accident types, accurate matching of the emergency plan is realized, resources are ensured to be effectively utilized in the most needed places, the capability of handling sudden marine accidents is improved, the execution process of the emergency plan is recorded in real time, the execution efficiency is scored, the traceability of the emergency response process is optimized, a data basis is provided for subsequent optimization, the response speed and quality to the marine accidents are improved through analyzing and optimizing the emergency plan, and the damage to the marine safety accidents is effectively reduced.
assignees: NAT MARINE DATA AND INFORMATION SERVICE

title_en: Portable audio player and controlling method thereof
title_ko: 휴대용 오디오 플레이어 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: A portable audio player and a control method thereof are provided to select more functions than the number of keys by responding to key data of a key input part by a key mode management module according to set states of key modes and adding additional functions for learning. A portable audio player comprises a memory(10), a sound play part(20), a key input part(30), and a key mode management module(62). The key input part has keys used to assign basic functions related to the sound processing. The key mode management module sets key modes in which some of the keys are assigned to additional functions for learning when key data is inputted to a power-on-command from the key input part, responds to key data of the key input part according to set states of the key modes, and controls the memory and the sound playing part. The keys include high speed forward, reverse, and up and down keys.

title_en: System and method for transmitting situation information based on multimedia message services using wireless modem
title_ko: 무선모뎀을 이용한 메시징 기반의 상황전달 시스템 및 그방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for messaging-based situation transmission using a wireless modem are provided to allow a user to quickly and easily report a dangerous factor by filling in a previously stored report document format or downloading the format as necessary, thereby activating a reporting system. A situation transfer server(14) transmits and receives a message to and from an external mobile terminal(31) by using one or more wireless modems to transmit a situation transfer template to the mobile terminal(31), analyzes contents of the situation transfer template received in format of the message from the mobile terminal(31), transmits the analyzed data to an updating server(16), receives corresponding result data from the updating server(16), and transmits it to the mobile terminal(31). The updating server(16) stores and maintains the situation transfer data received from the situation transfer server(14) in a database, and transmits the result data to the situation transfer server(14).
abstract_ko:
1. 청구범위에 기재된 발명이 속한 기술분야 
     본 발명은 무선모뎀을 이용한 메시징 기반의 상황전달 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것임. 
     2. 발명이 해결하려고 하는 기술적 과제 
     본 발명은 무선통신 단말기를 소지한 사용자들이 자신이 목격한 위험요소나 보안과 관련된 상황정보(즉, 다수의 사람이 모이는 공항, 소방서, 통계청, 경기장, 시내, 중요건물, 각종 관공서 등과 같은 국가의 중요시설에 대한 보안검색 및 위험요소에 대한 상황) 및 불법요소 등을 메시지 형태로 상황전달 시스템에 전달하면 상황전달 시스템이 메시지를 분석하여 관련자들(신고자나 목격자 등의 사용자, 관리자, 위험요소 제거기관 등)에게 대처사항 등의 분석결과를 제공하여 상황을 빠르고 정확하게 인지하게 함으로써, 사고를 사전에 예방하거나 이미 발생된 사고에 신속하게 대처할 수 있게 하는, 무선모뎀을 이용한 메시징 기반의 상황전달 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있음. 
     3. 발명의 해결방법의 요지 
     본 발명은, 상황전달 방법에 있어서, 외부의 무선통신 단말기로 하나 이상의 무선모뎀을 이용하여 상황전달 템플릿을 전송하는 상황전달 템플릿 전송 단계; 상 기 외부의 무선통신 단말기로부터 상기 하나 이상의 무선모뎀을 이용하여 상황전달 템플릿을 포함하는 메시지를 수신하는 메시지 수신 단계; 상기 수신한 상황전달 템플릿을 포함하는 메시지로부터 상황전달 템플릿을 추출하는 단계; 상기 추출한 상황전달 템플릿의 내용을 분석하여 각 미디어 데이터로 분류하는 단계; 상기 분석한 분석 데이터(상황전달 데이터)를 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계; 및 상기 상황전달 데이터에 대한 결과 데이터를 상기 하나 이상의 무선모뎀을 이용하여 해당하는 무선통신 단말기로 송신하는 단계를 포함함. 
     4. 발명의 중요한 용도 
     본 발명은 모든 형태의 무선모뎀을 이용한 메시징 기반의 상황전달 등에 이용됨.

title_en: An integrated wireless command system on disaster site
title_ko: 재난 현장 무선 통합 지휘 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wireless integrated command system on a disaster site and, more particularly, to a system which is configured in a command control center for efficiently commanding and controlling rescue activities of disaster rescue workers which are deployed in a disaster site. The wireless integrated command system on a disaster site according to the embodiment of the present invention includes: a disaster information collecting and processing module, a multi-channel communication support module, a location tracking module which provides real-time location information of disaster rescue workers, an decision making support module, a communications module which supports wireless communications of an integrated control processor, and a database which stores various types of disaster information provided through the integrated control processor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 현장 무선 통합 지휘 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 재난 현장 전반을 지휘 통제하는 지휘통제본부에 구비되어 재난 현장에 투입되는 재난 구조요원들의 구조활동을 효과적으로 지휘 통제할 수 있도록 구성된 시스템으로서, 재난 현장 및 재난 구조대원의 상태 정보를 수집,처리하는 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈과, 재난 현장에서 통신 채널을 공유하여 다자간 통화가 가능하도록 하는 다채널 통신 지원 모듈과, 재난 구조요원의 실시간 위치 정보를 제공하는 위치 추적 모듈 및 재난 현장 통제에 대한 의사결정을 지원해주는 의사결정 지원모듈로 구성되는 통합 관제 프로세서를 구비하여, 상기 통합 관제 프로세서를 통해 재난 현장에서의 다자간 통화를 지원할 수 있고, 재난 현장의 상태와 재난 현장에 투입된 재난 구조대원의 상태 및 위치를 실시간으로 모니터링 할 수 있도록 하는 동시에, 재난 현장의 환경 상태나 재난 구조요원의 상태가 안전 기준범위를 초과하는 경우 경보를 발생시켜 재난 현장 통제에 대한 의사결정을 지원해줌으로써, 재난 현장 전반의 상황을 신속히 파악하여 재난 구조요원의 개인안전을 최대한 보호하고 재난 상황에 대해 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 하는 재난 현장 무선 통합 지휘 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은, 지휘통제본부에 구비되어 재난 현장 상황을 관제하기 위한 재난 현장 무선 통합 지휘 시스템에 있어서, 재난 현장에 투입되는 재난 구조요원이 구비한 센싱 장비로부터 전송되는 재난 현장의 상태 정보와 재난 구조요원의 상태 정보를 수집하여 모니터링할 수 있도록 처리하는 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈과; 상기 지휘통제본부와 재난 현장에 투입되는 재난 구조요원 및 유관기관의 현장 통제요원 간의 다자간 동시 통화가 가능하도록, 재난 현장에서 사용되는 서로 다른 통신채널의 통화 정보를 전송받아 채널 공유가 가능한 통신채널로 재전송하여 통신채널을 공유하도록 하는 다채널 통신 지원 모듈과; 재난 현장에 투입되는 재난 구조요원의 위치를 추적하여 실시간 위치 정보를 제공하는 위치 추적 모듈과; 상기 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈을 통해 제공되는 재난 현장의 및 재난 구조요원의 상태 정보와 상기 위치 추적 모듈을 통해 제공되는 재난 구조요원의 위치 정보를 기반으로, 재난 현장 통제에 대한 의사결정을 지원해주는 의사결정 지원모듈과; 상기 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈, 다채널 통신 지원 모듈 및 위치 추적 모듈의 무선 통신을 지원하는 통신 모듈; 및 상기 재난정보 수집/처리 모듈, 다채널 통신 지원 모듈, 위치 추적 모듈 및 의사결정 지원모듈을 통해 얻어지는 각종 재난 정보를 날짜 및 시간별로 저장하여 사건 내역을 기록하는 데이터베이스;를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: DAEJEON INST OF SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY LIAISON GROUP OF INDUSTRY EDUCATION PARTNERSHIP

title_en: Automation system, mtethod and computer program for issuance request of certificate of origin
title_ko: 원산지 증명서 발급 신청 자동화 시스템, 방법 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided are a system for automating an issuance application of a certificate of origin, which automates issuance of a certificate of origin required for import and export trade of an exporter of a first country and an importer of a second country with respect to an external server for issuing a certificate of origin, a method for automating an issuance application of a certificate of origin by using the same, and a computer program for automating an issuance application of a certificate of origin including commands for executing the method. The system for automating an issuance application of a certificate of origin comprises: a database for storing export and import trade information; a reception unit for receiving an issuance request of a certificate of origin; a control unit for extracting origin certification date required for issuing the certificate of origin from the database, writing an intention certificate of origin by using the origin certification data, and providing a preview screen to confirm the intention certificate of origin; and an application unit for applying issuance of a certificate of origin to a server for issuing a certificate of origin according to reception of the confirmation through the preview screen.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일례에 따르면, 외부의 원산지 증명서 발급 서버에 대한 제1국의 수출업자와 제2국의 수입업자의 수출입 거래에 필요한 원산지 증명서의 발급을 자동화하는 원산지 증명서 발급 신청 자동화 시스템과, 이를 이용한 원산지 증명서 발급 신청 자동화 방법과, 이 방법을 실행하는 명령어를 포함하는 원산지 증명서 발급 신청 자동화 컴퓨터 프로그램이 제공된다. 원산지 증명서 발급 신청 자동화 시스템은, 수출입 거래 정보를 저장하는 데이터베이스와, 원산지 증명서의 발급 요청을 수신하는 수신부와, 데이터베이스로부터 상기 원산지 증명서의 발급에 필요한 원산지 증명 데이터를 추출하고, 원산지 증명 데이터를 이용하여 의사 원산지 증명서를 작성하여, 의사 원산지 증명서를 확인할 수 있도록 미리보기 화면을 제공하는 제어부와, 미리보기 화면을 통한 확인 수신에 따라 원산지 증명서의 발급을 원산지 증명서 발급 서버에 신청하는 신청부를 포함한다.

title_en: A densely populated area calculation method
title_ko: 대중교통 이용량에 따른 인구 밀집 산출방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a method for calculating population density according to public transportation usage, capable of solving the problem that only real-time density is collected and calculated for a specific area and population to be introduced in the future cannot be calculated. The method comprises: a boarding tag checking step of tagging a transportation card to a boarding reader; a boarding position recording step of inputting a boarding place; a destination input step of inputting a destination after boarding; a route input step of inputting a route from the boarding place to the destination; an arrival time output step of outputting an arrival time according to a travel time; a current density output step of indicating density according to the inputted destination; an expected density output step of outputting the density of the destination in a similar time zone; and a final density output step of inputting an arrival signal to the destination and outputting a final density. The present invention has the effect of preventing human accidents due to overcrowded population by calculating population to be introduced in the future so that a preemptive response to extremely introduced population can be taken.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 대중교통 이용량에 따른 인구 밀집 산출방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 교통카드를 승차리더기에 테그하는 승차테그확인단계(100)와, 승차가 이루어진 장소가 입력되는 승차위치기록단계(200), 승차 후 목적지를 입력하는 목적지입력단계(300), 탑승 장소로부터 목적지까지의 경로를 입력하는 경로입력단계(400), 상기 경로입력단계(400)를 통해 이동시간에 따른 도착시간이 출력되는 도착시간출력단계(500), 상기 목적지입력단계(300)에서 입력된 목적지에 따른 현재까지의 밀집도를 나타내는 현재밀집도출력단계(600)와, 상기 목적지입력단계(300)에서 입력된 동일목적지에 대한 데이터를 취합하여 비슷한 시간대에 목적지의 밀집도를 출력하는 예상밀집도출력단계(700) 및 도착지에 도착신호를 입력하여 최종밀집도를 출력하는 최종밀집도출력단계(800)로 이루어져 수집된 유동인구에 따른 밀집도를 확인할 수 있도록 하여 특정지역의 인구 밀집에 따른 인사사고를 예방할 수 있는 효과를 갖는다.
assignees: LEE YOUNG WON;YUN SONG HO;CHOI GA IN;LEE DONG YOON

title_en: Interactive accident modeling methods and systems for accident reproduction.
title_ko: 사고재현을 위한 인터렉티브 사고 모델링 방법 및 시스템.
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for simulating an accident in a vehicle and, more specifically, to a method for modeling an interactive accident for accident reproduction, which operates each object based on a timeline to efficiently synchronize and control the operation and viewpoint of the objects in the simulation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자동차 사고 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것으로, 좀 더 구체적으로 설명하면 타임라인 기반의 각 오브젝트를 조작하여 시뮬레이션 내 객체들의 동작 및 시점을 효율적으로 동기화하고 제어할 수 있도록 한 사고재현을 위한 인터렉티브 사고 모델링 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Medical support system
abstract_en: In an initial emergency response step in which a patient is transported from a site of emergency to a hospital, when a paramedic starts treatment of the patient using a medical device such as a triage device or a vital sign measurement device, treatment start information is transmitted from the medical device to a medical support server of a medical support system. According to the treatment start information, the medical support server creates timeline information for managing medical care information of the patient along a time axis and starts management of the medical care information generated in the initial emergency response step.

title_en: Interactive Pitching Training Apparatus and System
abstract_en: A pitching interactive training system having of a mat against which a ball is thrown. The mat has an embedded electronic display of a strike zone broken down into subsidiary “zones” and an exterior perimeter of “zones” just outside the strike zone. The embedded sensors and electronics when hit with a pitch register a point value on a scoreboard. Assignment of values may be adjusted for each pitch by remote control for each batter depending upon the game situation. The electronic scoreboard registers whether a ball or a strike and values for each pitch and maintains a total score with a reset for each new batter. The embedded electronics and scoreboard are powered by battery and rechargeable via an attached electric cord plugged into a standard electrical outlet. An optional radar gun records the speed of each pitch. An optional high speed sports camera attached to the system allows measurement of pitch spin rotations, pitch release point, and captures the entire pitch delivery process for replay to aid coaching and visualizing pitch command.

title_en: System and method of aggregating and disseminating in-case-of-emergency medical and personal information
abstract_en: A system for aggregating and disseminating in-case-of-emergency (ICE) medical information to medical units. The system includes an ICE medical record server that stores medical records of respective subscribers, and automatically receive updates from health service entities visited by subscribers. When contacted by emergency dispatchers or first responders, the server sends subscribers medical information to first responders, emergency management agencies directly, via a dispatcher, or via a computer aided dispatch (CAD) system. The medical information may be arranged, emphasized, and/or filtered in a manner relevant to the on-going emergency. A communication device may wirelessly receive the medical information and pre-populate a pre-hospital care form with the information, which may be further orally annotated by the first responder. The completed PCR may then be sent to a PCR server for subsequent access by medical units that subsequently treat the subscriber. The medical server may further assist a public health agency to disseminate emergency information to selected subscribers, responders, and public health alerting systems. An ICE personal server for storing important personal documents is also disclosed. A PCR server is also disclosed that can disseminate aggregate PCR information in near real-time to an emergency management agency (EMA) system for developing incident response plans during a wide area emergency.

title_en: Safe weapon container for securely releasing a defense weapon
abstract_en: A weapons container for releasing a defense weapon includes a cabinet, a cabinet door, and an interior securing the defense weapon. Upon detection of a fingerprint input by a biometric sensor, a surveillance camera captures video and an audio intercom provides communication with a central command center. A recording system saves the video and audio to a storage database. A delay release lock secures the defense weapon for an amount of time and releases the defense weapon depending on a signal from the central command center. A communications system is connected over a network to the central command center, a local authority, and an emergency responder. The communications system notifies the local authority or the emergency responder upon detection of the fingerprint input and streams the video and audio to the central command center and at least one of the local authority and the emergency responder over the Internet.

title_en: Novel intelligent gun
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a novel intelligent gun, comprising a gun tube which is connected with the gun body into a whole, and a gun stock, wherein a cartridge holder, a gun handle and a bracket are arranged at the lower part of the gun body; a hairline pointer is arranged at the upper part; an intelligent control module is arranged at the rear part of the hairline pointer; the intelligent control module comprises a video and thermal power tracking system, and a module with the functions of data collecting, satellite positioning, accurately and automatically tracking, automatically emitting, alarming, GPS (global position system) search, video recording, identifying, emergency information processing, issuing, night viewing and command receiving; and a receiver is arranged on the intelligent control module. The novel intelligent gun overcomes the defects of the prior art, avoids the error rate of subjective factors; a plurality of functions are integrated on fire arms by a chip; the possibilities of accidentally injury, hitting leakage and deviation are reduced; the novel intelligent gun accords with the comprehensive requirements of modern world on the accuracy and functions of the fire arms, and is more scientific and humanized in design, high in efficiency, and free of artificial aiming and firing; and an accurate automatic tracking system of the fire arms is used for aiming and mechanically firing. Therefore, stable legal assurance is provided to a law-enforcement officer.

title_en: Quick response communication terminal
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a quick response communication terminal, which comprises a mobile law enforcement terminal, a wireless communicator, a VHF very high frequency communication system and a plurality of interphones, wherein the mobile law enforcement terminal is in communication connection with the VHF very high frequency communication system through the wireless communicator, and the output end of the mobile law enforcement terminal is in communication connection with the input ends of the plurality of interphones. According to the utility model, under a multi-sea patrol boat linkage scene, communication is carried out through the interphone, the command center can give internal instructions for on-site supervision and search and rescue, even if network signals fluctuate during intercom, the system can continuously push voice data until success, so that frequent dialing of on-site personnel telephone inquiry progress is avoided, the whole search and rescue command system is more efficient, voice recording can be carried out on the whole law enforcement activity process, the problem of the conventional VHF communication and mobile phone communication short board is solved, and real-time and convenient communication guarantee is provided for daily supervision of maritime and emergency search and rescue activities.
assignees: CHANGZHOU MARITIME SAFETY ADMINISTRATION OF PEOPLES REPUBLIC OF CHINA

title_en: Risk early warning cloud platform for safety production of hazardous chemical substance enterprises
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk early warning of dangerous chemicals, and discloses a risk early warning cloud platform for safety production of dangerous chemicals enterprises. The platform calculates the stability coefficient of the production environment, the stability coefficient of the equipment, the equipment failure rate, the risk index of the hazardous chemicals and the operation risk assessment value of staff through collecting the temperature, humidity, air pressure, operation state of production equipment, operation time, equipment failure information data, names of the hazardous chemicals, risk levels, storage positions and operation record data of the staff, and according to the calculated values, the risk assessment value is compared with an internal set threshold value, risk early warning is carried out through comprehensive analysis, a risk early warning report is generated, a risk information issuing module matches the corresponding safety production risk level according to the risk early warning report, and an emergency response module formulates a corresponding risk treatment strategy according to the risk early warning report and the safety production risk level and outputs the corresponding risk treatment strategy to a display terminal.
assignees: HENAN XINANLI OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time monitoring method and system for groundwater pollution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environment monitoring, in particular to a real-time monitoring method and a real-time monitoring system for groundwater pollution, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of analyzing groundwater flow direction and original pollution records in geographic information, combining geological structure and hydrologic characteristics of a monitoring area, and carrying out the matching of a pollution source position mark and a pollution range through water flow propagation characteristics to generate a pollution source and range matching result. According to the invention, through analyzing the groundwater flow direction, pollution record and geologic hydrologic characteristics, the position and range of a pollution source are accurately marked, the identification precision and monitoring pertinence are improved, monitoring points are deployed at key positions, diffusion information is extracted in real time, an early warning threshold value is dynamically generated, early warning is timely issued and emergency response is started, the pollution control efficiency is improved, the rapid development of isolation and water quality treatment is ensured, the closed loop adjustment and optimization of monitoring parameters is realized, the method is dynamically adapted to environmental changes, and the comprehensive control of groundwater pollution is realized.

title_en: Collaborative management system based on augmented reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a collaborative management system based on augmented reality, and belongs to the technical field of AR (augmented reality) glasses. The collaborative management system based on augmented reality comprises AR glasses, a rear platform and a cloud end, and is characterized in that the AR glasses, the rear platform and the cloud end are connected through a wireless network, the rear platform comprises a real-time information receiving and processing module, a remote assistance module, an SOS emergency response module and a log recording and backtracking module, and the cloud end comprises a data storage and management module, a data analysis and decision support module and a computing resource module. The invention solves the problems of outstanding transmission delay, low remote cooperation efficiency, lack of an emergency response mechanism and insufficient environment perception. According to the invention, through real-time information transmission and interaction among the AR glasses, the rear platform and the cloud, the system response speed and the cooperative efficiency are improved, the efficient interaction between the rear personnel and the on-site operation personnel is supported, and the environment perception capability and the safety are improved.
assignees: HUZHOU JIXIN SEMICONDUCTOR TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle photographing service method and system based on sharing economy
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle photographing service method and system based on sharing economy, which relate to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein unmanned aerial vehicle photographing service is reserved through a sharing platform, the unmanned aerial vehicles are intelligently matched and distributed by the platform according to user requirements and real-time states of the unmanned aerial vehicles, and meanwhile whether a user needs immersive control experience and an intelligent voice interaction function are recorded. After the user arrives at the appointed place, the unmanned aerial vehicle control system is connected through the mobile equipment, and the system starts the immersive control interface and the intelligent voice interaction module. The user can start unmanned aerial vehicle through immersive control interface or voice command and take off, unmanned aerial vehicle lift-off and low altitude disk revolve confirm environmental security, and system real-time supervision feeds back unmanned aerial vehicle state.
assignees: XIAMEN YUNQUE ZHILIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Hydropower station disaster protection method and system based on multi-target coupling and deep learning
abstract_en: The application relates to a hydropower station disaster protection method and system based on multi-target coupling and deep learning, belonging to the technical field of safety of hydraulic and hydroelectric engineering, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting monitoring data through a geological sensor network, a hydrologic monitoring terminal and an electromechanical equipment state sensor, performing space-time alignment and feature engineering processing, and generating a multi-disaster factor vector; the method comprises the steps of calculating interaction intensity among disaster factors based on vectors, constructing a dynamic coupling model, outputting a coupling form grade and a three-dimensional evolution map representing disaster chain space distribution, utilizing a parallel-processing space feature extraction channel and a parallel-processing time feature extraction channel, combining a deep learning model to predict disaster evolution paths and influence probabilities, optimizing by adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm to generate a disaster protection optimal decision combination, and transmitting the disaster protection optimal decision combination to an execution terminal through an industrial Internet of things. The application realizes the intelligent and dynamic optimization of disaster protection, and remarkably improves the prediction precision and the emergency response efficiency.
assignees: STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;AOSTAR INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Subway shielding door safety monitoring method and monitoring system based on multi-source data analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway shielding door safety monitoring method and a monitoring system based on multi-source data analysis, which are characterized in that a multi-source data set of a target subway platform is obtained, the multi-source data set is subjected to space-time alignment processing to generate a multi-mode monitoring data set fused with space-time characteristics, foreign matter identification processing is performed based on the multi-mode monitoring data set to generate a foreign matter monitoring result and foreign matter position distribution information of a shielding door area, and carrying out density prediction processing according to the foreign matter monitoring result and the passenger flowing data sequence in the multi-source data set, generating a passenger linear density prediction result and density change trend information, generating a safety early warning strategy based on the foreign matter position distribution information and the density change trend information, and transmitting the safety early warning strategy to a subway platform control system to trigger emergency response operation. The invention effectively improves the emergency treatment efficiency and the passenger dredging accuracy of the subway platform in the sudden foreign matter blocking scene.
assignees: CHENGDU VOCATIONAL & TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF IND

title_en: Intelligent dvr and emergency pager using a sensor
title_ko: 센서를 이용한 지능형 ｄｖｒ 및 응급호출장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An intelligent DVR(Digital Video Recorder) and an emergency calling device are provided to rapidly grasp the cause of an accident by storing sound and image information. CONSTITUTION: A DVR(40) receives an abnormal signal of a sensor from a transceiver and stores information photographed by a camera from a preset time. A wireless transmitter(32) transmits the abnormal signal of the transceiver to a designated place by wireless. A wired transmitter(34) transmits the abnormal signal of the transceiver to a preset administrative office or management office.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 센서를 이용한 지능형 DVR 및 응급호출장치에 관한 것으로, 특히 화재 발생 등의 응급 상황 발생시 응급사태 발생 신호를 출력하면서, 지정된 관리자 및 관공서 등에 동시에 통보하는 것과 함께 사고 전후의 일정 시간을 제어하여 현장을 녹화하고 이를 분석하는 데이터를 확보함으로써 사고의 신속한 대처 및 사고원인을 정확하고 신속하게 파악하여 불의의 사고를 방지하고자 하는 센서를 이용한 지능형 DVR 및 응급호출장치에 관한 것으로, 센서와; 센서로부터 이상 신호가 감지되면 이를 경보하는 알람장치와; 상기 센서에 연결되어 센서의 신호를 감지하고, 송수신처리하기 위한 송수신부와; 가정과 사무실 또는 공장 등의 장소에 설치되어 영상 및 음향을 녹화 또는 녹음하는 기능을 갖는 카메라와;상기 송수신부로부터 센서로부터 발생된 이상신호의 감지를 수신하면, 주변에 연결된 카메라로부터 촬영되는 정보를 일정시간 이내부터 저장하는 명령을 발행하고, 이상신호의 감지후 일정시간까지 음향 또는 영상을 녹화하는 디지털영상녹화장치(DVR)와; 송수신부로부터 발생된 이상신호를 무선으로 지정된 장소에 송출하는 무선송신장치와; 유선상으로 지정관청 또는 관리사무소등에 송출하는유선송신장치;를 구비하여 이루어진다.
