title_en: Working Record Device
title_ko: 공기호흡기의 작동 기억 장치
abstract_en: In an air respirator worn by a firefighter or worker performing duties in a polluted area or confined area other than a fire scene, various information of the air respirator, such as the air pressure and flow rate, the normal operation of a supply valve, and the normal operation of an HUD display, for a certain period of use is stored in a record device included in a PCB. The working record device of the air respirator is provided, wherein the operation information of the air respirator necessary for the investigation of causes of fatal accidents that occurred during the performance of duties and the operation information of the air respirator stored during work for special purposes can be confirmed through the record device.
abstract_ko:
화재 현장 외 오염지역, 밀폐지역 등에서 임무를 수행하는 소방대원 또는  
작업자가 착용한 공기호흡기에 있어서; 
일정한 사용시간동안의 공기호흡기의 각종 정보(공기 압력과 유량, 공급밸브의 정상 작동여부, HUD의 정상 작동여부 등) PCB에 포함된 기억장치에 저장하게 된다.  
임무수행 중 발생한 인명사고의 사고 발생 원인규명 필요한 공기호흡기의 작동 조사와 특수 목적에 따른 작업 간 저장된 공기호흡기의 작동 정보를 기억장치를 통해 확인 조사할 수 있는 공기호흡기 작동 기억장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Air Rights Trading and Financialization System
title_ko: 공중권 거래 및 금융상품화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for transaction of air rights, financial commercialization, and policy utilization. The system includes altitude limit tables (122, 312, 412) that expand the concept of altitude limit of existing applications to automatically adjust according to market conditions and policy judgment. This clarifies the ownership and right to use public rights, secures the reliability of transactions, and enables financial and policy use. In addition, it includes a function of adjusting the imbalance in public ticket prices and optimizing transaction conditions according to fluctuations in supply and demand in a specific region. This system safely records ownership changes using blockchain-based public rights verification and transaction technology, and supports automatic transactions through smart contracts. In particular, it is designed to utilize public rights that have not been traded for a long time for public purposes (city air mobility, disaster response, etc.), and to maximize liquidity by converting them into financial commodities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공중권(Air Rights)의 거래, 금융상품화 및 정책적 활용을 위한 시스템으로, 기존 출원의 고도제한 개념을 확장하여 시장 조건 및 정책적 판단에 따라 자동 조정할 수 있도록 한 고도제한 테이블(122, 312, 412)을 포함한다. 이를 통해 공중권의 소유권 및 사용권을 명확히 하며, 거래의 신뢰성을 확보하고 금융 및 정책적 활용을 가능하게 한다. 또한, 공중권 가격의 불균형을 조정하고, 특정 지역의 수요·공급 변동에 따라 거래 조건을 최적화하는 기능을 포함한다. 본 시스템은 블록체인 기반의 공중권 검증 및 거래 기술을 활용하여 소유권 변동을 안전하게 기록하며, 스마트 계약을 통해 자동 거래를 지원한다. 특히, 장기간 거래되지 않은 공중권을 공공 목적(도심 항공 모빌리티, 재난 대응 등)으로 활용할 수 있도록 하고, 금융상품화하여 유동성을 극대화할 수 있도록 설계되었다.

title_en: Air Rights Intrusion Alert and Autonomous Response System and Method
title_ko: 공중권 침해 경고 및 자동 대응 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for detecting a possibility that a space moving object infringes on public rights in advance and performing warning and automatic response in real time according to the possibility. The present invention has a function of blocking the infringement of the public right before the infringement of the public right occurs, and automatically transmits a control command together with the multi-level warning system to prevent the infringement. In addition, the infringement history and response details are safely recorded and stored based on the blockchain, so that they can be used as objective evidence in future legal disputes. This system plays an important role in preventing infringement of public rights, ensuring safe flight of moving objects, and providing reliable data in the event of a dispute.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공간 이동체가 공중권을 침해할 가능성을 사전에 탐지하고, 이 가능성에 따라 실시간으로 경고 및 자동 대응을 수행하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 공중권 침해가 발생하기 전에 이를 사전 차단하는 기능을 갖추고 있으며, 다단계 경고 시스템과 함께 자동으로 제어 명령을 전송하여 침해를 방지한다. 또한, 침해 이력과 대응 내역을 안전하게 기록하고, 이를 블록체인 기반으로 저장함으로써, 향후 발생할 수 있는 법적 분쟁에서 객관적인 증거 자료로 활용할 수 있도록 한다. 이 시스템은 공중권 침해를 예방하고, 이동체의 안전한 비행을 보장하며, 분쟁 발생 시 신뢰할 수 있는 자료를 제공하는 중요한 역할을 한다.

title_en: System and method for reporting and tracking incidents with a mobile device
abstract_en: A novel system and method for enhancing people's personal safety and incident reporting is presented, wherein mobile devices are used to report and/or record both “911” type situations and non-emergency situations. Users of the invention can record, transmit, stream, upload and/or send information from a threatening situation to a dispatcher at an emergency management office or facility and to the user's safety group. The dispatcher can assess the situation and, if the situation warrants action, then the information can be forwarded to the appropriate first responders. The system geo-locates the user and allows integration of camera feeds in the user's vicinity. The inventive system and method enables a user to contact a dispatcher and also to alert the user's safety group. Four pieces of software facilitate video, audio, images and/or text medium of communication between the user-in-distress and the dispatcher, first responders and the user's safety group.

title_en: Flight Data Tracker
abstract_en: When flights meet disaster in the mid-air, the cause of the mishap is unknown immediately. Teams are dispatched in difficult conditions to retrieve the flight data recorder (FDR) also known as black box. Until the black box is found, the exact cause of the crash cannot be determined. Sometimes it may take years to find the black box. For example, Air France flight 447 crashed into the Atlantic Ocean on Jun. 1, 2009. The cause of the accident remained unknown mainly because the black box was missing. It was found after almost two years in May 2011. The delay in finding the flight data creates risks for future flights if the crash occurred due to a manufacturing defect in the model of the plane. The ability to reach the data without the burden and need for a physical black box has obvious benefits. This idea has been discussed in the literature but no one has put forth a functional and effective method for the implementation of this concept, for example no one has determined an appropriate software scheme that would enable a universal system that doesn't need a black box or which can function in parallel with black box. In this project, a set of algorithms for reliable transmission of flight data in real-time to distributed ground servers is developed. The attached description presents an overall structure of the proposed scheme. We also describe the methods of communicating between at least one plane server, several data servers and at least one central server controlling various components of data transmission, and the algorithms that enable the communication of data. In addition, the proposed packet header formats, the packet type codes and fault tolerance features are described.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.

title_en: Wearable heads-up display ("hud") for a pharmacy workflow management system
abstract_en: A wearable heads-up display ("HUD") for a pharmacy workflow management system is disclosed herein. An example HUD includes smart-glasses that are communicatively coupled to a client device. The smart-glasses include at least one camera and/or barcode scanner to record information needed for the verification of a medication dose during medication formulation preparation. The smart-glasses include at least one microphone to record voice commands. Further, the smart-glasses include at least one embedded display screen that shows sequential steps of a preparation protocol for guiding a pharmacy technician to prepare a medication dose. An application on the client device and/or the smart-glasses is configured to recognize and use voice commands to provide navigation for the embedded display screen. The voice commands may also be used to provide data entry for medication dose preparation verification. Gestures may be detected by the camera and translated by the application into navigation or data entry commands.

title_en: Use method of wearable mobile police terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a use method of a wearable mobile police terminal, which comprises an information login module, a wireless transmission end, a main control platform and a wearable garment, wherein the information login module comprises a fingerprint detection end and can record information of a wearer, the information of the user is transmitted to the main control platform through the wireless transmission end, the command issuing is convenient while the physical condition of the user is monitored, and the wireless transmission end comprises a wireless transmitter arranged on the wearable garment.

title_en: System and method of managing resources for calamity confrontation
title_ko: 재난대응 자원 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for managing resources for a calamity are provided to manage several related institutes, manpower, and equipment for the calamity site systematically by obviously checking activities of the related institutes. A system(100) for managing resources for a calamity inputted to one individual zone of the calamity site is composed of a check pointer(10) for checking retention information of the resources by wireless; an input unit(12) for inputting input information including input tasks for the resources; and a processing unit(14) for making and outputting situation information for the resources input to the corresponding individual zone on the basis of information inputted from the check pointer and the input unit. The retention information is recorded in an RFID(Radio Frequency Identification) tag(1) applied to the corresponding resources. The check pointer has an RFID reader for reading the retention information recorded in the RFID tag.
abstract_ko: 현장 또는 원격지의 지휘자가 재난 현장에 투입된 자원의 운영을 합리적으로 할 수 있고 투입된 다수의 유관기관의 활동을 일목요연하게 파악할 수 있도록 한 재난대응 자원 관리 시스템 및 방법을 제시한다. 제시된 재난대응 자원 관리 시스템은 재난현장의 어느 한 개별 구역에 투입되는 자원을 관리하는 재난대응 자원 관리 시스템으로서, 투입되는 자원이 가지고 있는 보유 정보를 무선으로 체크하는 체크 포인트기; 투입되는 자원에 대하여 투입임무를 포함한 투입 정보를 입력하는 입력부; 및 체크 포인트기 및 입력부로부터의 정보에 근거하여 해당하는 개별 구역에 투입되는 자원에 대한 현황 정보를 만들어 출력하는 처리부를 포함한다. 이러한 본 발명에 의하면, 재난현장의 인적·물적 투입자원의 현황을 현장 및 원격지의 상황실의 수준별 지휘자가 전술적 및 전략적으로 판단할 수 있도록 데이터베이스화하고 단계적으로 연산 가공하여 제공해 줌으로써, 지휘자가 투입자원의 운영을 합리적으로 할 수 있고 투입자원의 희생을 보다 적극적으로 막을 수 있게 된다.

title_en: A hospital drug management system linked with doctor's terminal and management method using it
title_ko: 의사측 단말기와 연동되는 병원용 마약류 관리 시스템 및 이를 이용한 관리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a hospital drug management system linked to a doctor terminal which comprises: the doctor terminal transmitting, to a hospital drug management device, a prescription including hospital drugs from prescriptions written by a medical treatment of a doctor; and the hospital drug management device for receiving the prescription from the doctor terminal, and authenticating whether a person has an appropriate authority for the prescription so as to take in and out the hospital drugs. By taking in and out the hospital drugs only for a person who has an appropriate authority set in the doctor terminal, a risk in hospital drug supply due to an illegal use of the existing prescription can be prevented in advance.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 의사측 단말기와 연동되는 병원용 마약류 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 병원용 마약류 관리 시스템으로서, 의사의 진료에 의하여 작성된 처방전 중에서, 병원용 마약류를 포함하는 처방전을 병원용 마약류 관리 장치로 전송하는 의사측 단말기, 및 상기 의사측 단말기에서 처방전을 전송받고, 상기 처방전에 대하여 적법한 권한을 가진 자인지 여부를 인증하여, 상기 병원용 마약류를 인출입시키는 상기 병원용 마약류 관리 장치를 포함하되, 상기 의사측 단말기는, 상기 처방전에 대하여 적법한 권한을 가진 자를 설정하는 설정부를 포함하고, 상기 병원용 마약류 관리 장치는, 상기 설정부에서 설정된 적법한 권한을 가진 자로 인증된 자에게 상기 병원용 마약류를 인출입시키는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 본 발명은 의사측 단말기와 연동되는 병원용 마약류 관리 시스템을 이용한 관리 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 병원용 마약류 관리 시스템을 이용한 관리 방법으로서, (1) 의사측 단말기가, 의사의 진료에 의하여 작성된 처방전 중에서, 병원용 마약류를 포함하는 처방전을 병원용 마약류 관리 장치로 전송하는 단계, 및 (2) 상기 병원용 마약류 관리 장치가, 상기 단계 (1)의 의사측 단말기에서 처방전을 전송받고, 상기 처방전에 대하여 적법한 권한을 가진 자인지 여부를 인증하여, 상기 병원용 마약류를 인출입시키는 단계를 포함하되, 상기 의사측 단말기는, 상기 처방전에 대하여 적법한 권한을 가진 자를 설정하는 설정부를 포함하고, 상기 병원용 마약류 관리 장치는, 상기 설정부에서 설정된 적법한 권한을 가진 자로 인증된 자에게 상기 병원용 마약류를 인출입시키는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 의사측 단말기와 연동되는 병원용 마약류 관리 시스템에 따르면, 처방전 인증 과정만을 거쳐 처방전을 소유하고 있는 자에게 병원용 의약품을 인출입 가능하게 함으로써, 처방전 도용의 가능성이 있었던 기존의 시스템과는 달리, 의사의 진료에 의하여 작성된 처방전 중에서, 병원용 마약류를 포함하는 처방전을 병원용 마약류 관리 장치로 전송하는 의사측 단말기, 및 의사측 단말기에서 처방전을 전송받고 처방전에 대하여 적법한 권한을 가진 자인지 여부를 인증하여 병원용 마약류를 인출입시키는 병원용 마약류 관리 장치를 포함하되, 의사측 단말기는 처방전에 대하여 적법한 권한을 가진 자를 설정하는 설정부를 포함하고, 병원용 마약류 관리 장치는 설정부에서 설정된 적법한 권한을 가진 자로 인증된 자에게 병원용 마약류를 인출입시키도록 구성함으로써, 의사측 단말기에서 설정된 적법한 권한을 가진 자에게만 병원용 마약류를 인출입시킬 수 있도록 하여, 기존의 처방전의 도용으로 인한 병원용 마약류의 지급 위험을 사전에 방지할 수 있으며, 병원용 마약류를 약국이 아닌 병원 내부에 보관하게 됨으로써, 이송 과정에서 병원용 마약류의 분실 또는 소실의 위험을 줄일 수 있고, 이송을 위한 별도의 인력이 불필요하게 됨에 따라, 이에 지급되는 비용도 줄일 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 의사측 단말기의 설정부는 병원용 마약류의 인출입 가능 시간을 설정할 수 있으며, 병원용 마약류 관리 장치는 설정부에서 설정된 시간 내에만 병원용 마약류의 인출입이 가능하도록 함으로써, 즉, 1차적으로는 적법한 권한을 가진 자에게, 2차적으로는 정해진 시간 내에서만 병원용 마약류를 인출입 가능하도록 하여, 병원용 마약류를 더 안전하게, 효율적으로 보관, 관리할 수 있게 하며, 의사측 단말기에서 전송된 처방전에 따른 병원용 마약류의 종류 및 수량에 대한 정보를 판단하는 판단부를 더 포함하고, 판단부에서 판단된 병원용 마약류의 종류 및 수량에 따라 인출입되도록 구성함으로써, 처방된 병원용 마약류를 정확하게 지급하여 마약의 과다투여 문제를 해결할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명에 따르면, 인출입부의 내부에, 인출입되는 병원용 마약류의 이미지를 획득하는 촬영모듈을 포함하여 구성함으로써, 인출입부를 통하여 제공, 반환되는 병원용 마약류의 재고 관리를 철저하게 할 수 있고, 인출입되는 병원용 마약류의 종류 및 수량에 대한 데이터를 저장하는 저장부, 실시간으로 병원용 마약류의 사용 내역을 기록하는 기록부, 및 병원용 마약류의 재고상태, 사용 내역 등의 정보를 표시하는 표시부를 포함하여 구성함으로써, 병원용 마약류의 전체적인 사용량과 재고 및 상태를 실시간으로 관리할 수 있도록 하여 병원용 마약류 관련 사고를 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Attachable display pad module for fire extinguishers, control method and recording medium for performing the same
title_ko: 진압대원을 위한 어태처블 디스플레이 패드 모듈, 제어 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 기록매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 진압대원을 위한 어태처블 디스플레이 패드 모듈에 관한 것으로, 서버 및 착용 장치와 통신하는 통신부; 형상 변형이 가능하도록 마련되고, 상기 서버로부터 수신되는 화재 진압과 관련된 출동 정보 및 조치 정보가 출력되는 스트레처블 디스플레이(Stretchable display); 이송 수단 및 상기 진압대원의 의복 중 적어도 하나에 탈부착되도록 상기 스트레처블 디스플레이의 일부에 구비되는 탈부착부; 및 사전에 마련되는 이벤트 조건을 만족하면, 상기 스트레처블 디스플레이의 영역을 분할하고, 상기 진압대원을 위한 생체 정보, 그리고 상기 구조물 지도 상에 상기 착용 장치 중 적어도 하나인 열화상 카메라로부터 수신한 온도 정보를 표시한 구조물 온도 정보가 상기 분할한 영역 각각에 출력되도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이를 통해 화재 현장에서 화재를 진압하는 진압대원이 화재의 진압을 원활하게 수행할 수 있도록 하는 것은 물론 진압대원의 인명을 보호할 수 있다.

title_en: Analyzing 2D movement in comparison with 3D avatar
abstract_en: A processing device receive a two dimensional (2D) video recording of a subject user performing a physical activity and provides a three dimensional (3D) visualization comprising a virtual avatar performing the physical activity. The processing device causes display of the 3D visualization comprising the virtual avatar at a first key point in performing the physical activity, receives first user input to advance the 2D video recording to a first position corresponding the first key point, and receives second user input comprising a first synchronization command. In response, the processing device generates a first synchronization marker to indicate the first position in the 2D video recording corresponding to the first key point.

title_en: Environmental sanitation resource regulating method, device and system
abstract_en: This application involves a kind of environmental sanitation resource regulating methods, device and system.The described method includes: sending the work plan information pre-seted to environmental sanitation terminal and the first dispatch terminal；Obtain the work state information for the monitored object that environmental sanitation terminal is sent；The work state information of monitored object and work plan information are compared and analyzed；If the work state information of monitored object is not inconsistent with work plan information, warning message is sent to the first dispatch terminal；Obtain the dispatch command fed back after the first dispatch terminal response warning message；Dispatch command is sent to environmental sanitation terminal to be scheduled, to realize the Real-Time Scheduling to the monitored object of environmental sanitation terminal.Real-Time Scheduling can be carried out to sanitationman and environmental sanitation vehicles using method provided by the embodiments of the present application, it avoids daily manual record working condition and the complicated dispatching method of job placement is formulated and conveyed according to the working condition, so as to improve work quality and working efficiency, and reduce cost of labor.
assignees: CHENGDU XIAOBU CHUANGXIANG HUILIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command scheduling method and device for material reserve
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency command scheduling method and device for material reserve. The method comprises the following steps: the received material call letters of the emergency events are subjected to intelligent comparison of event templates, receiving information is determined, and an allocation scheme is determined according to the receiving information; according to the allocation scheme, allocating instructions are issued to the corresponding material reserves, and the materials in the reserves are determined; tracking the delivered materials, and determining the transportation track and the handover signing record of the delivered materials; after the emergency event is over, recycling the materials which are delivered out of the warehouse and recycling records; and generating a material dispatching emergency assessment report according to the picking scheme, the ex-warehouse materials, the transportation track, the handover signing record and the recovery record.

title_en: Self-adaptive multi-channel wireless anti-interference communication method and system based on competition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication applied to the fire-fighting industry, in particular to a competition-based self-adaptive multi-channel wireless anti-interference communication method and system. The scheme includes starting to monitor the base noise of the radio network to obtain the base noise of the network; judging whether the network background noise is larger than the network environment judgment margin, if so, sending a first command, and if not, sending a second command, judging whether the delay requirement is met, judging whether the channel replacement requirement is met, and sending communication data in the current channel; and after receiving the fifth command, transmitting communication data on the new channel, and after receiving the sixth command, updating the network channel. According to the scheme, the problem of communication instantaneity and anti-interference performance of the fire early warning and alarming network is solved by setting the multi-channel preemptive communication with the pre-sending interception function, and the problem of poor communication timeliness and poor anti-interference performance due to the fact that the fixed channels are distributed and the communication time slice network can be effectively avoided.
assignees: GERUITONG INTELLIGENT TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD;QINGDAO FIRE FIGHTING CO LTD

title_en: Cross-platform remote collaboration allocation method and system combined with unmanned aerial vehicle distribution
abstract_en: The application provides a cross-platform remote collaboration allocation method and system combined with unmanned aerial vehicle distribution. The method comprises the steps of receiving and processing emergency material demand signals from a help-seeking ship in real time through a cross-platform remote system to obtain an optimal logistics path evaluation result and a dynamic distribution task distribution instruction, optimizing a flight route of an unmanned aerial vehicle according to the dynamic distribution task distribution instruction by applying a reinforcement learning algorithm to generate an optimized safe flight confirmation report, processing an accurate docking process between the unmanned aerial vehicle and the help-seeking ship based on the safe flight confirmation report to obtain a material delivery record, updating an emergency response state according to the material delivery record and the help-seeking site condition, adjusting the emergency plan, feeding back successful experience and problems into a knowledge base, and generating a quick response plan. The technical scheme provided by the application obviously improves the speed, safety and reliability of the remote sea rescue material distribution.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fault automatic diagnosis and alarm processing method for dust management and control integrated platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and automatic control, in particular to a fault automatic diagnosis and alarm processing method of a dust management and control integrated platform, which comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring dust concentration time sequence data C (t) and current characteristics I (t) of associated equipment; step 2, when the C (t) exceeds a set threshold value, a fault decision tree containing equipment states and environmental parameters is established, step 3, the power of the dust removing equipment and the starting strategy of the emergency device are dynamically adjusted according to the fault grade, and step 4, a grading alarm signal is sent to a central control room according to the fault grade, and a maintenance work order is generated. The method has the advantages that the false alarm rate is obviously reduced through multi-sensor data fusion and equipment state linkage judgment, the classification alarm mechanism can accurately position fault types, energy consumption waste caused by blind equipment load lifting is avoided, and the voice alarm and forced spraying functions ensure emergency response timeliness and effectively inhibit dust diffusion.
assignees: HUANENG JILIN POWER GENERATION CO LTD JIUTAI ELECTRIC FACTORY;WODA CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Natural gas hydrogen-loading multi-scene leakage monitoring and early warning method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a natural gas hydrogen-adding multi-scene leakage monitoring and early warning method, a system and a computer readable storage medium, which realize accurate identification and high-precision monitoring of leakage signals through a sensor fusion technology and a self-learning mechanism, can remarkably improve the monitoring precision, improve the accuracy and timeliness of early warning by utilizing a deep learning early warning model and the application of a multi-stage early warning strategy, gain precious time for emergency response, enhance the intelligent early warning, solve the key problems of insufficient accuracy, low intelligent early warning degree and the like of hydrogen-adding natural gas leakage monitoring in the prior art, and improve the safety of hydrogen-adding natural gas transportation.

title_en: Automatic scheduling management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic scheduling management system, which relates to the technical field of hospital scheduling management systems, in particular to an automatic scheduling management system, comprising a medical data fusion module which is in butt joint with real-time data of HIS, electronic medical record and Internet of things equipment; the three-dimensional ability assessment system constructs a nurse portrait through professional skills, emergency response and working endurance dimensions. According to the invention, a new generation intelligent care scheduling system is constructed by deeply integrating medical service data, an innovative algorithm architecture and a closed-loop management mechanism, so that the systematic defect of traditional manual scheduling is effectively overcome.
assignees: NANTONG MENTAL HEALTH CENTER NANTONG FOURTH PEOPLES HOSPITAL NANTONG BRAIN HOSPITAL

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method and related device for emergency repair of gas pipe network
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent scheduling method and a related device for emergency repair of a gas pipe network. The method comprises the steps of generating a plurality of rush-repair schemes based on acquired emergency tasks and rush-repair teams, constructing a multi-objective optimization model for the rush-repair schemes, carrying out multi-objective solution for each rush-repair scheme, carrying out population initialization and genetic operation by adopting a heuristic rule and random generation combined mode, carrying out non-dominated sorting based on a pareto dominant relationship, calculating the crowding degree distance of the rush-repair schemes, carrying out local search and optimization until an optimal rush-repair scheme set is output, and carrying out intelligent scheduling by selecting a matched objective rush-repair scheme from the optimal rush-repair scheme set based on man-machine collaborative decision. The application can automatically generate a group of pareto optimal scheduling schemes, supports man-machine collaborative decision-making, realizes the transition from empirical scheduling to intelligent accurate scheduling, and remarkably improves the timeliness, the accuracy and the economy of emergency response.
assignees: BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem that since map data showing a building or a road or the like recorded in an emergency command system in a fire department headquarters are updated once a year, any building may not be registered in the address of a notification destination on the map data when receiving emergency notification, and that since the member of a fire station manually operates a maintenance device, and adds information such as a building at the notification destination to the map data while looking at the content of a letter of instruction, it is time-consuming.SOLUTION: Disclosed is an emergency command system configured to automatically determine whether or not a building is registered in the address of a notification destination on map data, and to, when determining that any building is not present, add the information of the notification destination to the map data.

title_en: Accident data recording device for vehicle
title_ko: 차량용 사고기록 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An accident record system for a vehicle is provided to supply the operation information of operator during an accident in order to be quick scrambled with an accident image analysis, and to supply a function to recognize proviso information in a photographic image. CONSTITUTION: An accident record system for a vehicle comprises: a vehicle accident recording device(100) which comprises a camera(150), an acceleration sensor(110), a GPS module(120), a electronic control unit(130), an interior gateway module(140), an accident record part(170), and an outside gateway module(180); a control server(200) which receives an image of an accident at the time, an accident spot, and vehicle operation information from the accident record system for a vehicle and analyzes the incident situation based on the received information; and an accident analyzer server(300) which analyzes the cause of the accident based on the accident information of the vehicle received from the accident recording device for a vehicle and stores the accident analyzed data in video data form.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량 사고 기록 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사고 당시의 차량 내부 또는 외부의 영상을 촬영하는 카메라, 차량의 충돌 여부를 감지하는 가속도 센서, 차량의 현재 위치를 검출하는 GPS 모듈, 차량의 작동정보를 산출하는 전자제어유닛, 상기 전자제어유닛으로부터 입력된 차량의 작동정보를 연산 및 변환처리하여 출력하는 내부 게이트웨이 모듈, 촬영된 영상 정보, 차량 충돌 감지정보, 사고 당시의 차량의 위치정보, 상기 내부 게이트웨이 모듈을 통해 수신된 차량의 작동정보를 연관시켜 기록하는 사고 기록부 및 상기 사고 기록부에 기록된 차량의 사고 정보를 통신망을 통해 외부로 송출하는 외부 게이트웨이 모듈을 포함하는 것으로서 차량 내부에 설치되는 차량 사고 기록장치, 상기 차량 사고 기록장치로부터 사고 당시의 컷영상, 사고위치 및 차량 작동정보를 수신하고, 이에 기초하여 사고 상황을 분석하고 긴급 상황 발생시 긴급처리를 수행하는 관제 서버 및 상기 차량 사고 기록장치로부터 수신된 차량의 사고 정보에 기초하여 사고 원인을 분석하고 사고 분석 결과를 영상 데이터 형태로 저장하는 사고 분석 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 사고 당시의 운전자 조작 정보 제공, 사고 영상 분석을 통한 신속한 긴급 출동, 촬영 영상에서의 단서 정보 인식 기능 제공, 사고의 정밀한 재구성을 통한 사고 사례의 데이터베이스화 및 이를 통한 사고 원인의 신속 정확한 분석이 가능한 효과가 있다.  
       
     차량, 자동차, 사고, 기록, 분석, 영상.

title_en: Simulator for training of cpr and defibrillator
title_ko: 심폐소생술 및 제세동기 훈련용 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A simulator for defibrillator training and cardiopulmonary resuscitation is provided to effectively check the performance of education by recording and evaluating training situations. CONSTITUTION: A simulator(100) for defibrillator training and cardiopulmonary resuscitation comprises a physical body model(110), a shock sensor(130), a free airway securing module, a pulse generating module, a pupil reflex module(150), an artificial breathing module(160), a chest pressing module(170), and a defibrillator training module. The shock sensor senses shocks added to the physical body model by a user in the process checking consciousness of the physical body model. The free airway securing module is installed on the neck of the physical body model and senses whether the physical body model secures a free airway or not. The pulse generating module is installed on the neck of the physical body model and generates carotid artery. The pupil reflex module senses the incident of external light and automatically performs a pupil react function. The artificial breathing module measures amount and speed of air entered in the physical body model. The chest pressing module senses location, depth, speed, and times of chest pressure performed by the user. The defibrillator training module protects electric circuits inside the physical body model from electric shocks generated in a defibrillator device. The defibrillator training module senses the number of electric shocks generated in the defibrillator device.
abstract_ko: 응급상황 환자 발생 시 효과적으로 응급처치를 시행할 수 있도록 심폐소생술과 제세동기의 사용 훈련 및 평가가 가능한 심폐소생술 및 제세동기 훈련용 시뮬레이터에 대한 것이다. 이러한 심폐소생술 및 제세동기 훈련용 시뮬레이터를 통하여 의사, 간호사, 응급구조사 등의 전문적 응급구조사들에 대한 심폐소생과 제세동기 사용을 체계적이고 반복적으로 훈련 할 수 있으며, 훈련을 지도하는 담당자는 훈련 상황을 기록하고 평가함으로써 효과적으로 교육이 수행 되는지 확인 할 수 있다. 또한 전문적 응급구조사들 뿐만 아니라 일반인들이 응급상황에서 효과적으로 응급처리를 시행할 수 있도록 심폐소생과 제세동기 사용법 교육이 가능하다.

title_en: Energy saving system, energy saving method and energy saving program
title_ko: 에너지 절약 시스템, 에너지 절약 방법, 에너지 절약 프로그램
abstract_ko:
이번의 동일본 대지진에 의한 원자력 발전소 사고에 발단하여 각지에서 원자력 발전의 가동이 정지한 가운데, 전력 회사는 이와 같은 곤란한 전력 공급 상황을 극복할 필요를 느끼고 있다. 이에 대하여, 전력 이용자가 현실의 전력 공급 체제에 일치한 에너지 절약 행동을 취해진다고는 반드시 말하기 어려웠다.  
복수의 전기 기기의 소비 전력량을 취득하는 소비 전력량 취득부와, 소비 전력량의 목표치인 목표 요구값을 저장하는 목표 요구값 저장부와, 일정한 범위의 지역내를 관할하는 전력 회사에 따른 전력 공급 여력을 나타내는 공급 여력 지표를 취득하는 공급 여력 지표 취득부와, 취득한 공급 여력 지표와, 취득한 소비 전력량과, 저장된 목표 요구값에 기초하여 상기 복수의 전기 기기의 제어를 실행하는 제어부를 포함하는 에너지 절약 장치 등을 제안한다.

title_en: Internet of things based coding robot apparatus including main frame fastenable to robot control board
title_ko: 로봇 제어 보드가 체결될 수 있는 메인 프레임을 포함하는 IoT 기반의 코딩 로봇 장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a coding robot apparatus performing an IoT function includes: a control module generating and outputting a control signal corresponding to a control command and including control target information and control detail information by using a program coded by a user when the control command is inputted; a robot control board allowing the control module to be attached thereto or detached therefrom, including a plurality of control targets, and outputting the control signal to a control target indicated by the control target information among the plurality of control targets when the control signal is inputted from the control module; a robot frame including a main frame and a plurality of sub frames corresponding to robot parts, respectively; and a robot skin attached to or detached from the robot frame to form a robot shape. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing an IoT service to a user and creating a design effect of the coding robot apparatus.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 IoT 기능을 수행하는 코딩 로봇 장치는 제어 명령이 입력되면 사용자로부터 코딩된 프로그램을 이용하여 상기 제어 명령에 대응되고 제어 대상 정보 및 제어 내용 정보를 포함하는 제어 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 제어 모듈; 상기 제어 모듈이 탈부착되고, 복수의 제어 대상을 포함하며, 상기 제어 모듈로부터 상기 제어 신호가 입력되면 상기 복수의 제어 대상 중에서 상기 제어 대상 정보가 나타내는 제어 대상으로 상기 제어 신호를 출력하는 로봇 제어 보드; 로봇 부위 각각에 대응되는 메인 프레임과 복수의 서브 프레임을 포함하는 로봇 프레임; 및 상기 로봇 프레임에 탈부착되어 로봇 형상을 구성하는 로봇 스킨;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Server Based Disaster Recovery by Making Use of Dual Write Responses
abstract_en: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system for asynchronous replication. The mechanism creates a record in a write log in a host computing device for a write command and marking the record as uncommitted. The mechanism maintains a copy of data to be written by the write command at the host computing device. The mechanism issues the write command from the host computing device to a primary storage controller at the primary storage site. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been written to the primary storage site, the mechanism marks the record as unreplicated. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been replicated to a secondary storage site, the mechanism erases the record in the write log and deleting the copy of data.

title_en: Post-vehicular incident reconstruction report
abstract_en: The disclosure herein describes systems and methods for generating a post-vehicular incident report. In some examples, the system includes receiving a notification from a user device indicating the user device has been involved in an incident, obtaining incident data from the user device that includes a timestamp and location data, retrieving third-party incident data corresponding to the timestamp and the location data received in the incident data, generating a timeline of the incident based on the obtained incident data from the user device and the retrieved third-party incident data, the generated timeline including events occurring prior to the incident and events occurring after the incident, generating a report of the incident based on the generated timeline, the obtained incident data, and the retrieved third-party incident data, the report including the timeline, and outputting the generated report to the user device and at least one of a plurality of approved devices.

title_en: Selective and protected release of private information to an incident response team
abstract_en: Selective and protected release of private information/data to an incident response team (for example, public safety personnel) is disclosed. The private data (which pertains to individuals recorded as being within a premises at the time of an incident with respect to which the incident response team is responding to) may take the form of a system-generated log, which may be transferred to a first level of the public safety personnel once authenticated. Based on at least one of role, incident type, and incident severity, the first level of authenticated public safety personnel may release at least a portion of the private data to a second level of authenticated public safety personnel.

title_en: Method and system for constructing and managing digital pipe network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing and managing a digital pipe network, wherein the method comprises the steps of 1, obtaining a pipeline distribution diagram of a drainage pipeline of a city, simultaneously, dynamically obtaining drainage data of the drainage pipeline, 2, constructing the digital pipe network corresponding to the drainage pipeline according to the pipeline distribution diagram and the drainage data based on a GIS technology, and 3, conducting anomaly detection and corresponding anomaly processing command on the drainage pipeline based on the digital pipe network, and simultaneously, outputting and displaying the digital pipe network. The method and the system for constructing and managing the digital pipe network do not need to set a patrol personnel to patrol and examine the pipeline condition of the drainage pipeline, greatly reduce the labor cost, improve the timeliness of the abnormal discovery of the pipeline, avoid missing the optimal solving time of the abnormal pipeline, improve the solving efficiency of the abnormal pipeline, and output and display the digital pipe network for visual examination of the staff.

title_en: Method for Playing Mathematical Game through User's Selection on Grid Input Screen, and Program Distribution Server Storing Program Executing the Method
title_ko: 격자형 입력 화면에서의 사용자의 선택을 통한 수학 게임 진행 방법 및 격자형 입력 화면에서의 사용자의 선택을 통한 수학 게임 진행 방법을 실행시키는 프로그램이 저장된 프로그램 배포용 서버
abstract_ko: 격자형 입력 화면에서의 사용자의 선택을 통한 수학 게임 진행 방법 및 격자형 입력 화면에서의 사용자의 선택을 통한 수학 게임 진행 방법을 실행시키는 프로그램이 저장된 프로그램 배포용 서버가 개시된다. 본 발명은 사용자 단말기가 사용자 단말기의 화면에 격자형 입력 화면과 사용자의 미션 수행을 위한 격자형 입력 화면에서의 입력 규칙을 출력하고, 입력 규칙에 따른 사용자의 입력 정보를 격자형 입력 화면을 통해 입력받으며, 사용자의 입력 정보에 기초하여 사용자의 미션 수행을 평가하는 과정을 통해 구현된다. 본 발명에 따르면, 사용자가 격자형 입력 화면을 통해 선택 정보를 입력하며 게임을 진행하는 과정에서 다양한 수학적 사고를 병행하게 됨으로써 게임을 통해 수학 실력을 함양하고 수학 학습의 흥미를 유발시킬 수 있게 될 뿐만 아니라, 수학 학습에서의 집중력을 향상시킬 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Portable recording device multimedia classification system
abstract_en: This disclosure describes an apparatus and system for classifying audio and video data captured by a portable recording device. The portable recording device may comprise a camera system enclosure that captures audio and video data that reflects a user's point-of-view perception of their surroundings. The video and/or audio data may be transmitted in real-time, or near real-time, to a Central Multimedia Management (CMM) System at a Network Operations Center, or one or more mobile computing devices, via one or more networks. Alternatively, or additionally, the video and/or audio data may be stored within memory of the portable recording device. This disclosure further describes a CMM system that may act as a central repository of multimedia data from one or more portable recording device(s). The CMM system may further generate and assign incident report forms for each individual instance of real-time data that is recorded by a portable recording device.
assignees: WHP WORKFLOW SOLUTIONS INC;GETAC TECHNOLOGY CORP

title_en: Wireless transmission duty recorder
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wireless transmission duty recorder, which relates to the technical field of recorders and comprises: the intelligent fire-fighting equipment comprises an instrument body, wherein a video camera is arranged on the front surface of the instrument body, a switch button is arranged on the front surface of the instrument body, a switch pattern is printed on the front surface of the switch button, an emergency button is arranged on the front surface of the instrument body, an SOS pattern is printed on the front surface of the emergency button, a hot camera is arranged on the front surface of the instrument body, the hot camera is started, a shot hot picture is transmitted to a command center, relatively useful information can be provided for the command center, a firefighter can hold the instrument body by hand, the environment in the current thick fog is observed through a hot screen, whether a person to be rescued exists at the position or not can be judged by heat Cheng Bing, the time for searching the person to be rescued is greatly shortened, the survival rate of the firefighter and the person to be rescued is improved, and the problem that the firefighter has no field of view in the thick fog is avoided.
assignees: WUHAN CHAOXIAN TONGRUI TECH CO LTD;XU JUNFENG;ZHAO CHUNSONG;FAN TAO

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image rapid positioning method for earthquake emergency response
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image rapid positioning method facing earthquake emergency response, which comprises the steps of inputting an unmanned aerial vehicle high-spatial resolution remote sensing image sequence and position attitude parameters to obtain exterior orientation elements of image positioning; the unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image data are quickly positioned by adopting the assistance of a world file, exterior orientation elements of the sequence image are converted into a position and corner definition form required by the world file, and the initial position of the image is determined; superposing the initially positioned remote sensing initial profile map of the unmanned aerial vehicle and reference image data; and according to the result of the matching and superposition of the profile map and the reference image data, correcting the position and angle parameters by adopting overall error improvement and rotation transformation compensation to obtain a positioned sequence image. The method improves the timeliness of the rapid positioning of the remote sensing image of the unmanned aerial vehicle, reduces the overall error of the rapid positioning of the sequence image, effectively avoids the problem of reduced image positioning precision caused by different rotation angle modes, and realizes high-efficiency and high-precision positioning.

title_en: Palm end command scheduling auxiliary method and system based on ChatOps technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to a palm end command scheduling auxiliary method and system based on ChatOps technology, comprising the following steps: mounting a specified command and dispatch knowledge base in an enterprise to enable ChatOps tools to interact with the enterprise command and dispatch knowledge base; by creating and configuring teams, maintaining the organization relation between command and dispatch combat teams and ChatOps robots; the beneficial effects are as follows: according to the palm end command scheduling auxiliary method and system based on ChatOps technology, through completing the mounting of the enterprise internal specified command scheduling knowledge base, a ChatOps tool is interacted with the enterprise command scheduling knowledge base; by creating and configuring teams, maintaining the organization relation between command and dispatch combat teams and ChatOps robots; setting a session node, and configuring ChatOps link processing paths; and through the palm end command scheduling system chat room, command scheduling knowledge base information interaction is carried out with ChatOps, the knowledge base query process is simplified, the timeliness of emergency communication guarantee knowledge base query is improved, and the user experience is improved.
assignees: INSPUR COMMUNICATION & INFORMATION SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: A recorded program media for providing a security surveillance service based on user involvement
title_ko: 사용자 참여형 보안 감시 관제 서비스 제공 프로그램 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a recording medium having a user-participatory security monitoring service program recorded thereon, which allows a control service server to process, according to event occurrence information collected from a security monitoring device, a control service including at least one of an accident occurrence report, a fire occurrence report, user notification, monitoring device control, dispatch notification, and real-time monitoring on the basis of occurrence of an event. According to one embodiment of the present invention, a control service method comprises the following steps: receiving, by a control service server, event occurrence information from a registered security monitoring device and sharing the event occurrence information with a plurality of registered service participant terminals; and allowing participants of one or more service participant terminals sharing the event occurrence information to participate in a security monitoring and control service to collect and manage processing result data input after a user-participatory security monitoring service is provided.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 기록매체는, 보안 감시 장치로부터 수집되는 이벤트 발생 정보에 따라 관제 서비스 서버가 상기 이벤트 발생에 기초한 사고 발생 신고, 화재 발생 신고, 사용자 알림, 감시 장치 제어, 출동 알림, 실시간 모니터링 중 적어도 어느 하나를 포함하는 관제 서비스 처리를 수행하는 보안 감시 관제 서비스 제공 프로그램 기록매체에 있어서, 상기 관제 서비스 서버가, 사전 등록된 보안 감시 장치로부터 이벤트 발생 정보를 수신받아 사전 등록된 다수의 서비스 참여자 단말들로 해당 이벤트 발생 정보를 공유하는 단계; 상기 이벤트 발생 정보를 공유한 하나 이상의 상기 서비스 참여자 단말들의 참여자들이 보안 감시 및 관제 서비스에 참여하여 사용자 참여형 보안 감시 서비스를 제공한 후 입력하는 처리 결과 데이터를 수집 관리하는 단계; 를 포함하는 관제 서비스 방법을 실행시키기 위한 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터에서 판독 가능한 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: Generating an incident dossier
abstract_en: Methods, devices, and systems for generating an incident dossier are described herein. One device includes a memory, and a processor configured to execute executable instructions stored in the memory to import data associated with an incident associated with a site, wherein the data is in a number of different forms, receive a number of user inputs associated with the incident, and generate an incident dossier based on the data associated with the incident and the number of user inputs, wherein the incident dossier includes a timeline of the incident, a report of the incident, and a damage assessment of the incident.

title_en: System And Method For Analysis And Visualization Of Incident Data
abstract_en: An apparatus for analyzing grouped incidents belongs to a group having the group (grouped incidents, grouped sources, a grouped incident tag) and group interface (grouped incidents panel, a group visualization panel). The group visualization panel has an incident visualization panel. The incident visualization panel has an incidents area displaying an incident graphic visually representative of the incident information of the grouped incidents during an incident display period, an incident display period user control allowing the user to change the incident display period, an incident tag user control enabling the user to select the group incident tag to be a visible incident tag or to be a hidden incident tag, and a group timeline panel having a timeline sequence graphic representing a sequence of the grouped incidents and a display period graphic highlighting a portion of the timeline sequence graphic corresponding to the incident display period.

title_en: Communication device, communication system, communication method, and recording medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a communication device, a communication system, a communication method, and a recording medium. The 1 st communication device includes a control unit and a storage unit storing a command, and controls the control unit to perform the following processing when the command is executed by the control unit. The control unit transmits 1 st connection request information including information on a network address of the 1 st communication device, information indicating a code for communication with a 2 nd communication device, and information on a port number used for communication, to 1 or more arbitrary devices connected to a network to which the 1 st communication device is connected, receives 2 nd connection request information, which is information transmitted by the 2 nd communication device to which the network address is addressed, and establishes connection with the 2 nd communication device, in response to receiving the 1 st connection request information.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image rapid positioning method for earthquake emergency response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quick positioning method of an unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image for earthquake emergency response, which comprises the steps of inputting a high-spatial-resolution remote sensing image sequence and position posture parameters of an unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain external azimuth elements of image positioning; the method comprises the steps of carrying out rapid positioning on remote sensing image data of an unmanned aerial vehicle by using a world file, converting external azimuth elements of a sequence image into a position and rotation angle definition form required by the world file, and determining an initial position of the image; superposing the initial outline image of the initial positioning unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing with reference image data; and correcting the position and angle parameters by adopting integral error improvement and rotation transformation compensation according to the overlapping result of the outline image and the reference image data to obtain a positioned sequence image. According to the invention, the timeliness of the rapid positioning of the remote sensing images of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved, the overall error of the rapid positioning of the sequence images is reduced, the problem of image positioning precision reduction caused by different rotation angle modes is effectively avoided, and high-efficiency and high-precision positioning is realized.

title_en: Air environment pollution degree detection system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air pollution detection, and particularly relates to an air environment pollution degree detection system and method based on big data. The invention realizes detection and early warning of the pollution degree of the air environment by mining and analyzing the multi-source environment data, adopts a dynamic weight distribution strategy when determining the pollution comprehensive index in a monitoring area, thereby effectively improving the calculation precision of the pollution comprehensive index, improving the accuracy and timeliness of air quality monitoring, and in addition, by constructing a space-time correlation matrix and calculating a correlation strength coefficient, the invention can automatically identify the correlation between abnormal types, provides scientific basis for emergency response, and meanwhile, the bimodal early warning mechanism provided by the invention can distinguish instant abnormality from normalized abnormality, avoids the problems of resource waste caused by false report or missing report and untimely emergency response, and ensures the continuity and stability of air quality monitoring.

title_en: Method for optimizing sizing hardware of energy management system
title_ko: 에너지 제어 시스템의 규격산정 최적화방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 에너지제어시스템(Energy Management System, EMS)의 하드웨어 규격 산정 최적화방법에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 EMS의 하드웨어 규격 산정 최적화방법에 있어서, 시스템의 규모와 응용 프로그램에 따라 호스트노드/RTU데이터취득노드/RCC데이터취득노드/히스토리데이터노드 등에 대응하는 각각의 변수값을 입력받고 그 결과값을 계산하여 출력하는 에너지 관리 시스템을 구성하는 하드웨어 규격 산정 방법을 제공하여, 전력계통 운영의 특징이 반영되도록 접근 가능하고, 안정적인 계통상태 뿐만 아니라 고장(또는 사고)발생시에도 요구 성능을 충분히 발휘할 수 있도록 한다. 
       
     에너지 제어 시스템(EMS), 하드 웨어, 규격 산정,최적화

title_en: Situational awareness/triage tool for use in a chemical, biological, radiological nuclear explosive (CBRNE) environment
abstract_en: A method of managing patient care and emergency response following a Chemical, Biological, Radiological, or Nuclear Explosive (CBRNE) attack and maintaining compliance with the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA). The method including identifying each patient with a unique patient identifier, the identifier based upon the geospatial location of the patient, the geospatial location including at least the latitude and longitude of the patient when first treated, the unique patient identifier being part of patient data. Providing a collection point of patient data to form a patient data database where in the patient location data may be used to map the location, and severity of patient injuries. The method may include using the patient database is used to assist determining the type of attack and/or assist directing the distribution of medical resources. The patient data may be updated as treatment is administered. The treatment may include medication, decontamination, vaccination or a combination thereof. The patient data may be maintained on a hardware data card with the patient. The hardware data card patient data may be integrated with HIPPA patient data at a medical facility.
assignees: SCARLETT JOHN N;GALLUP HEATHER L;SMITH DAVID A;US AIR FORCE

title_en: A wide range of extreme drought emergency monitoring and impact evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of methods, comprising: the intermediate-resolution data based on wind and cloud satellite carry out draught monitor；It cooperates with more Remote sensing parameters and ground historical drought to record and constructs comprehensive draught monitor index, carry out the monitoring of Droughts using the synthesis draught monitor index of building and emergency response is handled；Drought impact assessment processing is carried out based on more Remote sensing parameters.In addition, the invention also discloses a kind of a wide range of extreme drought emergency monitorings and impact evaluation system.It uses technical solution of the present invention that can carry out Drought Disasters monitoring well Drought Disasters service is provided, is prevented trouble before it happens to obtain accurate information.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Big data analysis-based sand-mud interbed reservoir development zone earthquake prediction method
abstract_en: A sand-mud interbed reservoir development zone earthquake prediction method based on big data analysis comprises the following steps: firstly, the method comprises the following steps: constructing a mass sand-mud interbedded geological model based on the sedimentary characteristics of the drilled reservoir to obtain a transition probability matrix; II, secondly: constructing a 0-degree incident PP wave reflection seismic record of the model in a forward algorithm and a 90-degree phase Rake wavelet simulation model; thirdly, the method comprises the following steps: screening a model trace data set highly matched with the seismic record waveform of the actual stratum through a big data analysis technology, and carrying out normalization processing; matching records in the big data model which are most similar to the actual seismic waveform according to a formula; fourthly, the method comprises the following steps: and obtaining the quantitative prediction and characterization of the earthquake in the dominant development zone of the reservoir. The invention not only realizes the earthquake forward modeling; moreover, the probability density distribution of the sand-ground ratio and the maximum single-layer sand body thickness corresponding to the corresponding geological model is statistically solved, the development degree of the reservoir is indicated, and meanwhile, the uncertainty of the interpretation is quantified.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CNOOC TIANJIN BRANCH

title_en: Earthquake forward modeling method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a seismic forward modeling method, a seismic forward modeling device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of determining target depth domain logging data of target logging, determining frequency-slowness domain reflection coefficients based on the target depth domain logging data, determining frequency domain wavelets in target seismic records related to the target depth domain logging data, obtaining time slowness domain seismic records based on the frequency slowness domain reflection coefficients and the frequency domain wavelets, and finally obtaining corresponding relations between horizontal slowness and incidence angles of propagation waveforms in the target logging, and obtaining time angle domain seismic records based on the corresponding relations and the time slowness domain seismic records. According to the technical scheme, the time angle domain seismic record is accurately obtained through the frequency slowness domain reflection coefficient, the frequency domain wavelet and the corresponding relation between the horizontal slowness and the incident angle, so that the seismic record is accurately obtained, and the problem that the seismic record obtained through simulation under the influence of vertical transverse isotropy is inaccurate is solved.

title_en: Rule base-based method for matching and consignment of underwriting units and automatic dispatching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rule base-based matching support unit and automatic dispatch method, which is used for sorting submitted resort work orders and acquiring information; analyzing the essential elements of the resort worksheet, the decision-making worksheet element and the resort worksheet flow, and establishing an internal logic rule model based on the essential elements of the resort content and the underwriting units; the rule model appeal content basic elements and the appeal content basic elements information, the association relation between the appeal content basic elements and the appeal content basic elements is analyzed through a deep learning algorithm, the outline matching rule is generated and stored in a pre-release rule base, the pre-release rule base is manually checked by a hotline management unit, and the check is incorporated after passing; and when the operator records the work order, carrying out the matching of the sponsoring units by using the production rule base, recommending the sponsoring units finally, submitting the sponsoring units to the sponsoring units for processing after manual auditing, and filing after processing is finished. The accuracy of the selection of the sponsor department is improved, the work orders are automatically delivered to the terminal disposal units, and the timeliness of work order handling is improved.
assignees: CHINA COMSERVICE NETWORK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant emergency command center personnel evacuation dose rate threshold calculation and decision method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear emergency, and particularly relates to a method for calculating and deciding a personnel evacuation dose rate threshold of an emergency command center of a nuclear power plant. Calculating a conservation threshold: all data in the typical accident scene dose rate threshold value set are ordered, and the minimum value is taken, wherein the minimum value is a conservative threshold value applicable to any scene; judging the current accident scene: when the accident scene is unknown, selecting a conservative threshold suitable for any scene as a final threshold; when the accident scene is clear, selecting corresponding data from a typical accident scene dose rate threshold set as a final threshold according to meteorological data and the accident type; and acquiring the reading of the radiation monitoring instrument in the emergency command center, and if the reading is greater than or equal to a final threshold value, giving out a decision suggestion of evacuation of personnel in the emergency command center. The method and the system effectively improve the rationality and timeliness of corresponding response action decisions taken by emergency command center personnel under the condition of nuclear power plant accidents.
assignees: JIANGSU NUCLEAR POWER CORP;SUZHOU NUCLEAR POWER RES INST

title_en: Method and system for monitoring, early warning and emergency response of manual hole digging pile construction
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data analysis, and discloses a method and a system for monitoring, early warning and emergency response of manual hole digging pile construction. The method comprises the steps of collecting pile position parameters and environment data to establish a database, arranging sensors to obtain monitoring data, identifying risks through a convolutional neural network to generate a prediction matrix, forming a four-level early warning signal diagram in a quantitative grading mode, formulating a targeted emergency treatment flow, executing response and recording treatment effects to form a data record table. According to the application, the risk mode is timely identified from the monitoring data through the intelligent analysis processing technology, and a targeted emergency treatment scheme is automatically generated based on the early warning result, so that a complete closed-loop management system of monitoring, early warning, response and assessment is formed, and the accuracy and the effectiveness of the construction safety management of the manual hole digging pile are improved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY GUIZHOU ENGINEERING COMPANY LTD

title_en: Hierarchical intelligent emergency response method and system for high-risk operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical intelligent emergency response method and system for high-risk operation. The method comprises the steps of collecting at least one environmental parameter and at least one physiological parameter of an operator on a high-risk operation site, determining a current response level in a plurality of preset risk levels according to the abnormal severity of any parameter when the preset response rule is triggered, and automatically executing corresponding early warning notification and equipment linkage actions according to the current response level. According to the invention, real-time analysis is performed by fusing environment and personnel data, and grading and automatic response are performed according to the risk severity, so that the problems of delayed emergency response, single alarm mode and easiness in causing 'alarm fatigue' or resource waste in the prior art are solved, the timeliness, the accuracy and the intelligent level of emergency treatment in a high-risk operation scene are remarkably improved, and more reliable safety guarantee is provided for operators.
assignees: BEIJING DATANG SITUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake observation system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an inexpensive earthquake observation system excellent in versatility, which is easily installed in any place when there is a network circuit such as the Internet, synchronizes many vibration observation devices with a simple mechanism, and facilitates analysis.  <P>SOLUTION: When the vibration by the earthquake detected by a trigger sensor is determined to exceed a specific level, a control computer commands data recording. This command is not individually transmitted to many vibration observation devices interconnected via the network circuit, but is performed by blocking the transmission of the signal in the network circuit. Each vibration observation device, when the circuit is blocked, independently starts the recording of data. Then, each vibration observation device independently completes the data recording, and resets the network circuit. Then, each vibration observation device is accessed from the control computer, and the recorded data is accumulated and analyzed.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Battle system of naval vessel capable of operating mutiple operating mode simultaneously, method thereof, and computer readable medium recording program for performing the method
title_ko: 다중 운용 모드를 동시 운용할 수 있는 함정 전투 시스템 및 그 방법, 그리고 이를 행하는 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A battle system of a naval vessel capable of operating a multiple operating mode simultaneously, a method thereof, and a computer readable medium recording a program for performing the method are provided to individually set up an operating mode of unit devices arranged at each node and operate the unit device in a multiple operating mode in order to reduce the time taken according to a restart operation of the entire unit devices. CONSTITUTION: An integrated operation control device(310) is prepared in a control device to set up and change an operating modes of plural unit devices. A unit operation control device(320) is prepared in each unit device, and sets up and changes the operating mode of the unit device by controlling the integrated operation control device. The unit device is a sensor-linked device linked with a sensor which senses a target object.
abstract_ko:
다중 운용 모드를 동시 운용할 수 있는 함정 전투 시스템 및 그 방법, 그리고 이를 행하는 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 매체가 개시된다.  복수의 단위 장비를 구비하는 함정 전투 시스템에 있어서, 소정의 지휘 통제 장비에 구비되어 상기 복수의 단위 장비의 운용 모드를 각 단위 장비별로 설정 또는 변경하도록 제어하는 통합 운용 통제 장치와, 상기 복수의 단위 장비 중에서 각 단위 장비마다 구비되고, 구비된 단위 장비의 운용 모드를 상기 통합 운용 통제 장치의 제어에 의해 설정 또는 변경하는 단위 운용 통제 장치를 포함하는 다중 운용 모드를 동시 운용할 수 있는 함정 전투 시스템을 구성한다.  상기와 같은 함정 전투 시스템에 따르면, 하나의 함정 전투 시스템에서 각 노드에 배치되는 단위 장비들의 운용 모드를 개별적으로 설정하여 동시에 다중 운용 모드를 운용할 수 있으므로, 운용 모드 변경을 위한 전체 단위 장비들의 재가동이나 그에 따라 소비되는 시간을 줄일 수 있는 유리한 효과를 가진다.  한편, 모든 단위 장비들이 물리적으로 분리되지 않고 논리적으로 구분된 운용 모드에서 동작되므로, 지휘 통제 장비가 센서 연동 장비나 무장 연동 장비에 대한 통합 운용을 유지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and method for emergency service of motor-vehicle insurance using qr code
title_ko: Ｑｒ 코드를 이용한 자동차 보험 긴급 출동 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automobile insurance emergency mobilizing system which uses a QR code and a method thereof are provided to easily use a emergency mobilizing service which an automobile insurance company supplies by recognizing the QR code through a mobile terminal. CONSTITUTION: A QR code(70) includes access information including a URL(Uniform Resource Locator). The mobile terminal(30) recognizes the QR code. A emergency mobilizing managing server(10) supplies a emergency mobilizing site using the URL recorded in the QR code. The mobile terminal decodes the URL from the QR code and connects to the emergency mobilizing site through the URL and transmits emergency mobilizing request information to the emergency mobilizing managing server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 QR 코드를 이용한 자동차 보험 긴급 출동 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 따른 QR 코드를 이용한 자동차 보험 긴급 출동 시스템은 URL을 포함하는 접속 정보가 기록된 QR 코드와, 상기 QR 코드의 인식이 가능한 모바일 단말기와, 상기 QR 코드에 기록된 상기 URL을 사이트 주소로 하는 긴급 출동 사이트를 제공하는 긴급 출동 관리 서버를 포함하며; 상기 모바일 단말기는 상기 QR 코드로부터 상기 URL을 판독하여 상기 URL을 통해 상기 긴급 출동 사이트에 접속하고, 상기 긴급 출동 사이트를 통해 긴급 출동 요청 정보를 상기 긴급 출동 관리 서버로 전송하고; 상기 긴급 출동 관리 서버는 상기 모바일 단말기로부터 전송되는 상기 긴급 출동 요청 정보에 기초하여 기 등록된 출동 요원에게 출동 요원 호출 정보를 전송하고, 상기 출동 요원으로부터 출동 수락 정보가 수신되는 경우 상기 모바일 단말기로 긴급 출동 접수 정보를 전송하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  이에 따라, 자동차 보험 회사에서 제공하는 긴급 출동 서비스를 스마트 폰과 같은 모바일 단말기를 이용한 QR 코드의 인식을 통해 보다 쉽게 제공받을 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Information integrated control system and information processing program, social infra management system, management method, local device, server device, and program
title_ko: 정보 통합 제어 시스템과 정보 처리 프로그램, 사회 인프라 운용 시스템, 운용 방법, 로컬 장치, 서버 장치 및 프로그램
abstract_ko:
사회 인프라(12A, 12B, …), 행정용 서버(13)로부터 전력 수요 예측 정보, 교통 지체 정보, 사고 발생 정보, 기상 정보 등을 수집하고, 주민용 서버(14)로부터 가옥내 각종 센서(전기 계량기, 가스 계량기, 보안 센서) 등의 주민 정보를 수집하여 데이터베이스(115)에 KVS 형식으로 저장하고, 정기적으로 갱신한다. 
 산출부(114)에서는, 데이터베이스(115)에 저장된 정보로부터, 미리 부여된 지표 또는 행정측으로부터 새롭게 부여된 지표에 기초하여 KPI를 산출하고, 산출된 KPI에 기초하여 각 사회 인프라에 관한 운전 계획의 책정을 행한다.

title_en: Electronic device, system and method for determining suitable workout by considering context
title_ko: 상황 정보를 고려하여 적합한 운동을 결정하는 전자 장치, 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic device, a system and a method for determining a suitable workout by considering situation information. According to various embodiments of the present invention, the electronic device comprises: a communication module to communicate with at least one different electronic device; a display to provide a user interface; a memory to store instructions; and a processor electrically connected to the communication module, the display, and the memory. The memory may store instructions to determine whether it is suitable for the processor to receive a command to execute a workout program, collect context data for a user, and perform workout content planned by the user based on the collected context data when executed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 상황 정보를 고려하여 적합한 운동을 결정하기 위한 전자 장치, 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 다양한 실시예들에 따른 전자 장치는 적어도 하나의 다른 전자 장치와 통신하는 통신 모듈; 유저 인터페이스를 제공하는 디스플레이; 인스트럭션들을 저장하는 메모리; 상기 통신 모듈, 디스플레이 및 메모리와 전기적으로 연결된 프로세서를 포함하고, 상기 메모리는, 실행 시에, 상기 프로세서가 운동 프로그램을 실행하는 명령을 수신하고, 사용자에 대한 컨텍스트 데이터를 수집하고, 상기 수집된 컨텍스트 데이터에 기반하여 사용자가 계획된 운동 컨텐츠를 수행하는 것이 적합한지 여부를 판단하도록 하는 인스트럭션들을 저장할 수 있다.

title_en: Potential competence development method, system and recording media for computer program
title_ko: 잠재능력개발 방법, 시스템 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for developing latent abilities, and to a recording medium with a recorded computer program. The method for developing latent abilities comprises: an advance complete enumeration step where a teacher or a parent implements the multiple intelligence (MI) test, the Myers-Briggs Type Indicator (MBTI) test, and a test for rearing and propensity of parents; a creativity test step where a test person implements a creativity test, a linguistic skill test by thinking area, and a creative thinking availability test while recording an observation log on reactions of an infant through a face-to-face test, and inputs the results in a program in order to prepare a test opinion; a potential ability test step where the teacher makes a check list through performance observation during a class by using the program, and implements the MI test, the creative problem solving (CPS) test, and the self-esteem profile (SEP) test; an overall analysis step of analyzing a learning type and a career direction by implementing a brain education program, an imagination experiential program, a museum connection program, a reading camp program, and a family camp program; and a preparation step of preparing a latent ability spectrum and a personal portfolio. Therefore, the method for developing latent abilities can comprehensively identify talented person creativity abilities by field according to latent abilities, can accurately evaluate latent abilities of an infant to be tested by implementing education such as reading activities and experiential activities after a fixed period of time from a first test, and then implementing a second test, and comprehensively analyzing the first and second test results and relationship tendency test results between a parent or a teacher and the infant to be tested, and can suggest a learning method and a career direction appropriate for a personal latent ability spectrum of the infant.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 잠재능력개발 방법, 시스템 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 교사 및 학부모로부터 다중지능검사(MI), 성격유형검사(MBTI), 학부모 양육 및 성향검사를 실시하는 사전 전수 조사 단계; 검사요원이 대면 검사로 유아의 반응을 관찰일지로 기록하면서 척도별 창의성 검사, 사고영역별 언어능력 검사, 창조적 사고 활용도 검사를 실시하고 프로그램에 결과를 입력하여 검사소견서를 작성하는 창의성 검사 단계; 교사가 프로그램을 이용하여 수업시 수행관찰로 체크리스트를 작성하고 다중지능검사(MI), 창의적문제해결력검사(CPS), 자존감검사(SEP)를 실시하는 잠재능력 검사 단계; 뇌교육 프로그램, 상상력 체험학습 프로그램, 미술관 연계프로그램, 독서캠프 및 가족캠프 프로그램을 실시하여 학습유형을 분석하고 진로 방향성을 탐색하여 종합 분석하는 단계; 및 잠재능력스펙트럼 및 개인별 포트폴리오를 작성하는 단계를 포함한다. 
상기한 바와 같이 구성된 본 발명에 의하면 잠재능력에 따른 분야별 영재창의성 능력을 종합적으로 판별하고, 1차 검사 후 일정한 시간을 경과하면서 독서활동 및 체험활동 등의 교육을 수행 후 2차 검사를 수행하고, 상기 1차 및 2차 검사결과 및 부모나 교사와 대상자간 관계성향 검사 결과등을 종합적으로 분석함으로써, 대상자의 잠재능력을 정확하게 평가할 수 있고, 이러한 개인별 잠재능력 스펙트럼에 적합한 학습법 및 진로 방향성을 제시할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Coding robot apparatus selectively attachable to control module corresponding to code
title_ko: 코딩 기반의 제어 모듈이 탈부착될 수 있는 코딩 로봇 장치
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, a coding robot apparatus performing an IoT function includes: a control module generating and outputting a control signal corresponding to the control command and including control target information and control content information by using a program coded by a user when a control command is inputted; a robot control board which has the control module attachable thereto or detachable therefrom, includes a plurality of control targets, and outputs the control signal to a control target indicated by the control target information among the plurality of control targets when the control signal is inputted from the control module; a robot frame including a mainframe and a plurality of sub frames corresponding to robot parts, respectively; and a robot skin attached to or detached from the robot frame to constitute a robot shape. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing an IoT service to a user and creating a design effect for the coding robot apparatus.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 IoT 기능을 수행하는 코딩 로봇 장치는 제어 명령이 입력되면 사용자로부터 코딩된 프로그램을 이용하여 상기 제어 명령에 대응되고 제어 대상 정보 및 제어 내용 정보를 포함하는 제어 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 제어 모듈; 상기 제어 모듈이 탈부착되고, 복수의 제어 대상을 포함하며, 상기 제어 모듈로부터 상기 제어 신호가 입력되면 상기 복수의 제어 대상 중에서 상기 제어 대상 정보가 나타내는 제어 대상으로 상기 제어 신호를 출력하는 로봇 제어 보드; 로봇 부위 각각에 대응되는 메인 프레임과 복수의 서브 프레임을 포함하는 로봇 프레임; 및 상기 로봇 프레임에 탈부착되어 로봇 형상을 구성하는 로봇 스킨;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for electronically obtaining and displaying contextual information for unknown or unfamiliar callers during incoming call transmissions
abstract_en: An incoming call from a source device having a source identifier is received at a receiving device and an indication of and request to accept the incoming call is provided at an output interface of the receiving device. A determination is made of whether this is a first time that the source device has called this receiving device or ifthe local address book is devoid of the source identifier or any associated contextual information associated with a user of the source device having the source identifier. If so, one or more databases of public safety incident information, call information, registration information, dispatch records, mobile application information, and location information is accessed and contextual information identified from the databases associating the source device with the receiving device. The contextual information is then provided at the receiving device while providing the indication of and request to accept the incoming call.

title_en: System and method for driving condition detection and notification
abstract_en: A system for accident detection or detecting an unsafe driving condition in a vehicle including a device that measures and transmits at least one output signal; at least one remote device configured to receive, record, and/or display the at least one output signal from the device; a computing device configured to receive the at least one output signal from the device and display the at least one output signal in real-time; and a graphical user interface on the computing device that allows an emergency response professional to view and customize options for monitoring the at least one output signal, wherein the device, the at least one remote device, and the computing device are communicatively connected to each other via a communications network.

title_en: Providing a gui to enable analysis of time-synchronized data sets pertaining to a road segment
abstract_en: Techniques for collecting, synchronizing, and displaying various types of data relating to a road segment enable, via one or more local or remote processors, servers, transceivers, and/or sensors, (i) enhanced and contextualized analysis of vehicle events by way of synchronizing different data types, relating to a monitored road segment, collected via various different types of data sources; (ii) enhanced and contextualized analysis of filed insurance claims pertaining to a vehicle incident at a road segment; (iii) advantageous machine learning techniques for predicting a level of risk assumed for a given vehicle event or a given road segment; (iv) techniques for accounting for region-specific driver profiles when controlling autonomous vehicles; and/or (v) improved techniques for providing a GUI to display collected data in a meaningful and contextualized manner.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO
