title_en: Cargo vessel operator emergency response system, with operator directives, incident data recording and reporting
Emergency management method and system based on multi-mode intermodal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency management method and system based on multi-mode intermodal, and relates to the technical field of emergency management, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, acquiring dynamic geographic information of a disaster area in real time through a satellite remote sensing technology; according to the invention, a dynamic cross-mode cooperative scheduling mechanism is constructed by fusing satellite remote sensing data, so that real-time grasp of geographical information of a disaster area is realized, the problem of lack of real-time geographical information support in scheduling is solved, the joint nodes and the transfer flow of different transportation modes are automatically adjusted according to real-time road conditions through a model, the situation that the adjustment of the transportation modes is delayed and the transfer waiting time is overlong is avoided, the timeliness of emergency material transportation is improved, the information sharing and cooperative cooperation among the transportation modes are promoted by establishing cross-mode cooperative scheduling, an efficient transportation chain is formed, the emergency requirement of emergency management on material transportation is met, the dynamic adaptation and efficient scheduling of multi-mode transportation of the emergency material are realized, and the timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response are ensured.

title_en: A method of appraising weather condition using a road surface temperature restoring model
title_ko: 노면 온도 복원 모델을 이용한 기상 감정 보조 방법
abstract_en: An embodiment provides an operating method of a server included in a black ice risk diagnosis program, which comprises the steps of: receiving information on an accident according to a user input, wherein the information on the accident includes an accident point and an accident time point; selecting a first road section including the accident point and a first time section including the accident point; outputting a first index by inputting weather forecast information for the first road section and the first time section and weather forecast information for a second time section including a current time point to a first algorithm, wherein the forecast information includes at least one of a precipitation forecast, a fog forecast, and a humidity forecast; outputting a second index by inputting weather characteristic information for the first road section to a second algorithm designed in parallel with the first algorithm, wherein the weather characteristic information includes at least one of a wire, a pressure belt, an inversion layer and an altitude in the first road section; and calculating a third index indicating the degree of risk of accidents caused by black ice based on the first index indicating the degree of risk of light ice in the first road section and the second index indicating the possibility of freezing rain occurring in the first road section. Therefore, the present invention can calculate the degree of accident risk due to the black ice at the time of occurrence of the accident.
abstract_ko: 일 실시예에 따르면, 블랙아이스 위험 진단 프로그램에 포함되는 서버의 동작 방법으로서, 사용자 입력에 따라, 사고에 대한 정보 - 이때, 상기 사고에 대한 정보는 사고 지점 및 사고 시점을 포함함 - 를 수신하는 단계; 상기 사고 지점을 포함하는 제1 도로 구간 및 상기 사고 시점을 포함하는 제1 시간 구간을 선택하는 단계; 상기 제1 도로 구간 및 상기 제1 시간 구간 동안의 기상 예보 정보 및 현재 시점을 포함하는 제2 시간 구간 동안의 기상 예보 정보를 제1 알고리즘에 입력하여 제1 인덱스를 출력하는 단계 - 이때, 상기 기상 예보 정보는 강수 예보, 안개 예보 및 습도 예보 중 적어도 하나를 포함함 -; 상기 제1 도로 구간에 대한 기상 특성 정보를 상기 제1 알고리즘과 병렬적으로 설계되는 제2 알고리즘에 입력하여 제2 인덱스를 출력하는 단계 - 이때, 상기 기상 특성 정보는 상기 제1 도로 구간 에서의 전선, 기압대, 역전층 및 고도 중 적어도 하나를 포함함 -; 및 상기 제1 도로 구간의 살얼음 위험 정도를 나타내는 상기 제1 인덱스 및 상기 제1 도로 구간에 어는비 발생 가능성을 나타내는 상기 제2 인덱스를 기초로 블랙아이스에 의한 사고 위험 정도를 나타내는 제3 인덱스를 산출하는 단계;를 포함하는 서버의 동작 방법이 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Computerized method and system for global health, personal safety and emergency response
abstract_en: A computerized system and method for intuitively detecting a user's need for emergency help, preventive care and medical interventions and also for coordinating care for user's loved ones and pets when user experiences an emergency or has passed away. Detection is done via labs and life signs equipment and sensors, self-initiated request for monitoring or the system's periodically polling user through an alert, a telephone call, a notification, a text message or other appropriate means to find out if they are in danger. Polling and automated monitoring may also be triggered by real-time medical data electronically or wirelessly transmitted to the system. If user fails to respond, the system automatedly calls either user's contacts (by listed priority) to notify them of a potential emergency, or emergency responders directly depending on severity of the emergency and communicates to them critical information as well as a code to access user's medical record(s).

title_en: Emergency command management platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency command management platform. The emergency command management platform comprises a basic information management system used for managing system users and units and managing operation authorities of the users to the system; a daily business management system used for processing related business in daily work of the system users; an emergency resource management system used for uniformly managing various kinds of resources which may be used for dealing with an emergent event; an emergency strategy support system used for managing strategy data related to emergency processing in a non-emergency event period, carrying out collection, statistics and analysis on related recordings, and assisting for early-warning; a command scheduling system used for integrally using various communication command means to realize unified command of whole city emergency guarantee and emergency command action, wherein the emergency command comprises situation analysis, plan making, task execution tracing, remote resource scheduling and action control.
assignees: CHINA CHANGFENG SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY IND GROUP CORP

title_en: Remote power distribution monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote power distribution monitoring device comprising the function modules as follows: a current sampling module, a voltage sampling module, a temperature and humidity monitoring module, an IC card reading module, a real-time monitoring unit module, and a protection and alarm module. The output ends of the function modules are connected to an information processing unit. The information processing unit is connected with a signal sending and receiving device. The signal sending and receiving device is connected with a remote control unit through a wireless network. The signal sending and receiving device is connected with a power distribution terminal through a terminal control device. When the power distribution terminal is abnormal, the information processing unit makes the terminal control device make a corresponding emergency response according to received monitoring data in order to protect the safety of the circuit and the power distribution terminal. The temperature and humidity in a distribution box and the situation around the distribution box can be monitored in real time. The maintenance history of the power distribution terminal is recorded by the IC card reading device. When the distribution box is damaged by external force, the protection and alarm device alarms and transmits the field state to a person in charge. Thus, remote monitoring is realized.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG GAOMI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: A kind of scheduling system and its application method for building waste transfer transport operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of scheduling system and its application method for building waste transfer transport operation, the scheduling system of the building waste transfer transport operation includes basic data management module, vehicle management module, management map module and path optimization's module；The basic data management module includes building waste point collecting unit, prediction allocation unit, temporary line are sent a car unit and dispatch command unit, the building waste point collecting unit are used to collecting and recording the construction site for needing to transport building waste；The construction site for needing to transport building waste that the prediction allocation unit is used to collect building waste point collecting unit carries out allocating garbage transporting vehicle in advance.The present invention is calculated and analyzed to the possibility road of transport by management map module and path optimization's module, so that it is determined that going out optimal transportation route, is substantially increased conevying efficiency, is saved the cost of transport.
assignees: FOSHAN JIEZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of underground communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of underground communication systems, including mobile communications device, signal receiver, radio communication base station, video monitoring system and main control base station, it is provided in the main control base station for dispatching the recording system used, ups system, multi-media dispatcher and administration telephone, the signal receiver is set in main control base station, radio communication base station spaced set is in underground, on the one hand radio communication base station realizes wireless signal transmission with the signal receiver in main control base station, on the other hand it realizes wireless signal transmission with the mobile communications device and video monitoring system of underground, in addition this system further includes having an emergency communication device, the communication of underground can be realized by underground real-time monitoring and active communication, in addition this system is provided with emergency communication device, emergency communication after achievable calamity.

title_en: Pump station intelligent decision system and method based on voice recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a pump station intelligent decision system and a method based on voice recognition, wherein a monitoring system is used for collecting the running state and equipment information of a pump station; the operation control layer is utilized to realize the voice scheduling control, the operation record, the safety emergency management and the equipment fault processing of the pump station; setting a knowledge base in an information management layer and carrying out data interaction and management with an operation control layer through an Ethernet; the mobile terminal is accessed to the information management layer through the Ethernet, and the polling personnel inquire or record the pump station information in a voice recognition mode according to the authority of the polling personnel; and the dispatching center carries out dispatching control on the real-time monitoring of the pump stations in the area through voice, and automatically calls a decision scheme in the knowledge base to send to the mobile terminal. By applying the voice recognition technology, the intelligent monitoring, control, diagnosis and management of the pump station are realized, and the operation efficiency, the fault processing rate and the management efficiency of the pump station are improved.
assignees: CHINA WATER SANLI DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Client using method for high-speed mobile vehicle dispatching based on 5G technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a client using method for dispatching high-speed mobile vehicles based on a 5G technology, which comprises the following steps: 1) the system dispatcher inputs travel information of a specified train number at a client of a system dispatching center, determines the time point of the first transmission and records the time point on a case, and keeps a fixed call of each station with train number contact personnel and performs proofreading; 2) simulating and producing a route map of a specified train number at a client of a dispatching center, determining two station nodes with larger distance and marking red by using software; 3) when the train is first sent, the train is communicated with train contact personnel and the final departure time is determined. The invention avoids the unnecessary occurrence of the traffic control, simultaneously leads the staff to take the duties of the staff through the complete emergency plan, accelerates the getting-on of the staff through the mode of maintaining the order, avoids the defect of train delay as soon as possible, thereby improving the dispatching effect and leading the train to advance more accurately and efficiently.
assignees: SHANGHAI CHARMHOPE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bit-frame operator and note
title_ko: '비트프레임' 연산자와 노트
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A bit-frame operator and a note are provided to help a user to understand semantic structure and English style thinking by applying a bit frame to an English sentence. CONSTITUTION: An input unit selectively inputs: an English sentence or text outputted from an English text input unit and an English text storing unit; and a bit frame operators outputted a bit frame storage unit. A storage unit(11) includes a bit frame storing unit, a text storing unit, and a bit frame node storing unit. A controller unit controls of the output of a meaning unit, a symbol, a bit frame note1, a bit frame note2, a bit frame note3 which are visually outputted from an output unit.
abstract_ko:
본원은 영어 문장의 의미구조를 도식화하여 하나의 틀을 형성한 것으로서, 영어식 사고를 훈련하기 위한 장치 및 수단에 관한 것이다. 
     본원 발명의 '비트프레임'은 영어의 사고방식을 '대상'과 '서술'의 이원 체계로 보고, 그 표현인 영어 문장의 의미구조를 '{(Q) f(N)|0 [(f)(N)(＃)] 1 /(d)|(0)(1) /(d) ||{(C)(R)(=)}'과 같이 도식화한 것이다. 영어의 문장성분을 의미요소의 단위로 나누어, 각각 '대상(0), 서술(1), 정동사(f), 상술(d), 접속사(C), 관계사(R), 의문사(Q), 부정(N), 함축(＃), 생략(=)'으로 기호화한 연산자로서 영어의 문법체계를 새롭게 기술하고 있다. 
     이러한 '비트프레임' 연산자를 적용한 본원 발명의 노트나 컴퓨터 프로그램 등은 효과적인 영어학습의 도구가 될 수 있다. 노트나 컴퓨터 프로그램 등에 장치된 '비트프레임' 연산자를 이용하여 영어 원문의 의미요소를 분석해보는 것만으로도 영어의 '생각'과 '문법'을 이해하게 되고, 그 연습을 거치는 동안 자연히 영어식 사고가 학습자의 뇌리에 자리를 잡는다. 영어 학습자가 겪게 마련인 모국어의 간섭을 해소함으로써, 영어를 '영어의 생각'으로 학습할 수 있게 한다. 영어의 생각으로 보고 듣고 직해하고, 말하고, 쓸 수 있는 능력을 배양할 수 있는 토대를 제공하는 것이다. 
       
     영어교육, 영문법, 의미단위, 연산자, 노트, 컴퓨터프로그램

title_en: Making Device for Electric Log Book AutomaticallyUsing Shipping Service Information
title_ko: 선박의 운항 정보를 이용하여 자동 생성되는 전자로그북 생성 장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides an electronic log book generating apparatus automatically generated by using sailing information of a vessel. According to the present invention, an electronic log book generating apparatus automatically generated by using sailing information of a vessel has the following technical characteristics to: reduce workload for an operation crew and a person in charge, which is over spent for writing a log book by reducing report writing time everyday to significantly reduce working time; generate big data for real-time sailing history of various sailing vessels to predict various disasters at sea and establish prevention base by using the big data; collect written data for various situations occurring during working as well as data related to sailing generated during sailing the vessel, data generated from various apparatuses in an engine room, data generated from communication equipment, data related to loading, and data related to communication, classify the data by field and save the same to be classified so that a log book having a form consistent with an IMO standard is automatically generated for people in charge in a shipping company to efficiently perform work about building berth management through the automatically generated log book; bring data corresponding to a required item to the log book by field, collect data from apparatuses of the vessel such as sailing equipment, engine equipment and communication equipment so that the data should be automatically written and stored in the corresponding item; and receive required data from a manager to store the same by field, and bring required data to automatically generate the log book. The present invention includes a collection module, a storage module, a data load module, a log book writing module, and a user terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박의 운항 정보를 이용하여 자동 생성되는 전자로그북 생성 장치를 제공한다. 이와 같은 본 발명에 따른 선박의 운항 정보를 이용하여 자동 생성되는 전자로그북 생성 장치는 매일 보고서 작성시간을 줄일 수 있어 업무시간이 획기적으로 적게 절감되어 로그북 작성을 위해 과중하게 소요되었던 운영 승무원 및 당무자에 대한 작업 부하를 감소 할 수 있고, 각종 운항선박의 실시간 운항내역에 대한 빅데이터를 생성할 수 있어, 빅데이터를 활용하여 각종 해난사고 미연에 예측 및 예방기반을 구축할 수 있으며, 해운사에서도 자동 생성된 로그북을 통해 당무자들의 선대관리에 관한 업무 효율화할 수 있도록 선박을 항해하면서 발생하는 항해와 관련되는 데이터, 기관실에서 다양한 장치들로부터 발생하는 데이터, 통신설비에서 발생하는 데이터, 선적관련 데이터, 통신관련 데이터뿐만 아니라 업무 중에 발생하는 각종 상황에 대하여 기입한 데이터를 수집하여 분야별로 분류하여 저장한 후, IMO 기준에 부합하는 형태의 로그북을 자동적으로 생성할 수 있도록 분류가 이루어지고, 분야별로 해당 로그북에 필요한 항목에 해당하는 데이터를 가져와서 해당 항목에 자동적으로 기입되어 저장될 수 있도록 항해장비, 기관장비, 통신장비 등 선박의 장치들로부터 데이터를 수집하거나 관리자로부터 필요한 데이터를 입력받아 이를 분야별로 저장하고 필요한 데이터를 가져와 로그북을 자동으로 생성하도록 하는 기술적 특징을 갖는다.

title_en: Conveyor jamming smart device
title_ko: 컨베이어 끼임 사고 방지 스마트 디바이스
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart device for preventing a conveyor jamming accident, which can minimize machine damage and loss of life, comprising: a smart conveyor belt; a vibration sensor; a pressure sensor; a device; a vibration data graph converting application; and a digital display panel.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 컨베이어 끼임 사고 방지 스마트 디바이스에 관한 것으로서 진동센서(300)과 압력센서(400)을 활용하여 자동식 비상정지 장치를 구현하여 빠른 사고에 대한 대처가 가능하며 진동 데이터를 그래프로 변환시켜 끼임사고의 발생이 잦은 공장 구역을 집중 관리 하여 궁극적으로는 기계의 파손, 인명손실을 최소화 시킬 수 있다하도록 함으로써 기존의 수동식 비상정지 장치의 끼임 사고 발생 시 빠른 상황 대처가 어려운 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 컨베이어 벨트 정지 장치에 있어서 진동과 압력을 감지하여 끼임사고 발생 시 자동 정지할 수 있게 각종 센서와 그에 연동할 수 있는 시스템을 형성한 스마트 컨베이어 벨트, 본 시스템을 실현 하기 위해 끼임사고 발생 시 진동을 감지할 수 있게 끼임사고가 발생하는 곳(회전부, 고정부)에 구성한 진동센서, 끼임사고 발생 시 높아진 압력을 감지할 수 있게 진동센서와 같은 위치에 구성한 압력센서, 진동센서(200),압력센서(300)의 데이터를 받아 일정 진동 값, 압력 갑 이상 감지 될 경우 컨베이어 벨트를 자동 정지할 수 있게 파이썬으로 코딩하여 프로그램을 만들어 디바이스에 전송한 디바이스, 진동센서(200)의 데이터를 그래프로 변환할 수 있게 어플을 만들어  그래프 형성한 진동 데이터 그래프 변환 어플, 관리자가 사고 발생이 잦은 구역을 집중 관리할 수 있게 진동 데이터 그래프 변환 어플(500)을 이용하여 화면에 표시하도록 구성한 디지털 표시 패널으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 진동센서(300)과 압력센서(400)을 활용하여 자동식 비상정지 장치를 구현하여 빠른 사고에 대한 대처가 가능하며 진동 데이터를 그래프로 변환시켜 끼임사고의 발생이 잦은 공장 구역을 집중 관리 하여 궁극적으로는 기계의 파손, 인명손실을 최소화 시킬 수 있다하도록 함으로써 기존의 수동식 비상정지 장치의 끼임 사고 발생 시 빠른 상황 대처가 어려운 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Camera device for vehicle safety
title_ko: 차량안전용 카메라장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a camera device for vehicle safety, the camera device being directly/indirectly connected to hardware and software systems installed in a vehicle. The camera device is connected to an electronic control unit (ECU) and an electric power control unit (EPCU) including a vehicle control unit (VCU), thus enabling an autonomous driving system including an advanced driver assistance system (ADAS) through a video algorithm of the camera device and enabling real-time wired/wireless transmission and storage of video through a display device in the vehicle cabin and an antenna module of the camera device. In addition, an emergency rescue following a traffic accident during vehicle operation and the on-site situation before and after the traffic accident can be recorded and used as video material, and the camera device can be activated to record a video of on-site vehicle damage when a physical/chemical change is sensed by a sensor installed in the parked/stationary vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량안전용 카메라장치에 관한 것으로, 카메라장치는 차량에 장치된 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어시스템에 직·간접적으로 연결돼 차량에 구비함으로써, 차량제어장치(VCU)를 포함한 전력제어장치(EPCU) 및 전자제어장치(ECU)에 연결해서 카메라장치의 영상알고리즘으로 첨단운전자지원시스템(ADAS)을 포함한 자율주행시스템이 가능하고, 차량 실내의 디스플레이장치 및 카메라장치의 안테나모듈을 통해서 실시간으로 유·무선의 영상전송 및 저장이 가능하다. 그리고 운행 중 교통사고로 인한 긴급구조 및 사고 전·후의 현장상황을 녹화해서 영상자료로 사용할 수 있으며, 주·정차 중 차량에 장치된 센서에 물리·화학적 변화가 감지되면 카메라장치를 작동해서 차량파손 현장의 영상녹화가 가능한 차량안전용 카메라장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Apparatus and method for assessing and tracking user competency in augmented/virtual reality-based training in industrial automation systems and other systems
abstract_en: A method includes receiving one or more records containing commands, an association of the commands with visual objects in an augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) space, and an AR/VR environment setup. The commands correspond to user actions taken in the AR/VR space. The method also includes analyzing the user actions based on the one or more records and assessing the user actions based on the analysis. The one or more records could have a portable file format. The commands could correspond to one or more gestures made by a user, one or more voice commands or voice annotations spoken by the user, one or more textual messages provided by the user, and/or one or more pointing actions taken by the user using at least one pointing device.

title_en: System and method for speech-enabled adaptive training for human pilot verbal data capture and reporting for flight operations quality assurance
abstract_en: A system and method for implementing one or more real-time flight operations quality assurance (RTS-FOQA) systems and protocols is disclosed. RTS-FOQA systems assist pilots and other personnel in managing hazards and risks to protect the safety of passengers, pilots, flight attendants, crew, as well as people on the ground. The system is configured to capture voice data from the cockpit, recognize words spoken by the pilots, air traffic controllers (ATC), and other personnel; convert the recognized words into text; compare the text derived from the words spoken by the pilots, ATC, and other personnel to a standard operational procedure (SOP) sequence, wherein the sequence comprises a plurality of SOP operational steps; identify at least one of a plurality of flight operations executed by the pilots; compare the plurality of flight operations executed by the pilots with the required SOP operational procedures; identify at least one of the plurality of SOP operational steps not executed or incorrectly executed by the pilots; and alert the pilots if and when the pilots fails to execute or incorrectly execute any of the plurality of SOP operational steps. In addition to alerting the pilots of the deviation(s) from the SOP sequence(s), the system may automatically generate a SOP exceedance report for recording the SOP operational step(s) not executed or incorrectly executed by the pilot(s), as well as automatically execute an emergency response, automatically execute an evasive maneuver, and/or automatically implement an autopilot—E.G., initiate execution of remotely-piloted, semi-autonomous, or autonomous, arrival approach, and landing procedures.

title_en: Vehicle driver advisory application
abstract_en: The present disclosure recites a method and a system for providing a user involved in a traffic stop or accident with immediate access to information about their rights and step-by-step instructions on appropriate actions. A Stopsafe (SS) utility module may enable the user to access traffic stop and accident-related features via a mobile application. The SS utility module may provide interactive prompts that enable the user to receive situation specific advice from a virtual assistant through natural language processing and understanding. It may also allow the user to record the incident, automatically notify emergency contacts of the incident, and complete state specific accident forms. The application aims to protect civil rights and enhance safety by delivering clear, concise guidance tailored to real-time events. The application features an intuitive interface, educational content on rights, and practical advice on managing car accident situations.

title_en: Systems and methods for classifying recorded information
abstract_en: An incident recorder records original and supplemental incident information and categorizes information using a simplified user interface.

title_en: Apparatus and method for initiating and recording incident information in a communication system
abstract_en: A communication system (100) comprises a first two-way portable handheld or vehicular radio unit (102) having a camera (506; 606; 706). The first unit, responsive to receiving an incident event trigger, transmits a unique emergency alert to a central control station, activates the camera (506; 606; 706), automatically records first video of an incident scene, and wirelessly provides the first video to the central control station. At least one more portable handheld or vehicular radio unit is in a talk group (104, 106, 108) established by the central control station with the first two-way portable handheld or vehicular radio unit, and responds to activation of the first unit by recording, and wirelessly providing to the central control station, second video of the incident scene. The central control station records and stores the first and second video for subsequent accessing for evidentiary purposes.

title_en: Garbage delivery monitoring method based on robbery mode and related products
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a garbage delivery monitoring method based on a robbery mode and a related product, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of acquiring a junk delivery image shot for a delivery user in a designated area in real time, analyzing the junk delivery image, generating delivery events, sending the delivery events to electronic equipment of a supervision user in the designated area, determining target supervision users with successful delivery according to a preset delivery algorithm, acquiring junk delivery sites reporting the delivery events to a server, pushing the junk delivery sites to the electronic equipment of the target supervision users, generating supervision records according to uploading states of supervision data of the target supervision users, determining scores of each target supervision user in the target supervision users according to the supervision data and the supervision records of the target supervision users, and accordingly, dispatching the supervision users based on the delivery modes and monitoring delivery behaviors of the delivery users.

title_en: LBS-based flood control emergency danger avoiding method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood control emergency risk avoiding method based on LBS, which is characterized in that large data are positioned by introducing Internet and mobile phone communication, and comprehensive analysis is carried out by combining water conservancy, space topography, internet crowd large data and the like, so that the existing household registration-based personnel transfer mode and technical bottleneck are broken through, the precise arrival of risk avoiding transfer is realized, the precision and timeliness of recognition, early warning, guiding, tracking and feedback of risk avoiding crowd are greatly improved, and the emergency risk avoiding transfer efficiency and effect of crowd in a flood inundation influence area are practically improved. The problems that the traditional emergency risk avoidance technology is limited in real-time dynamic crowd information acquisition means, slow in notification response, low in early warning efficiency, difficult in risk avoidance crowd transfer condition tracking, difficult in transfer effect control and the like are solved; the crowd emergency response action guide technology solves the problem of other emergency events such as earthquake, typhoon, tsunami and other natural disasters.

title_en: Automatic generation method and system for scheduling instruction ticket
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for automatically generating a scheduling instruction ticket, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, the client side obtains power outage detail table data and opens the data through word processing software; s2, triggering a scheduling instruction ticket automatic generation function interface for a single or a plurality of records in the power outage and transmission detail table data by a user; s3, generating confirmation information by the automatic generation function interface of the dispatching instruction ticket, and acquiring a confirmation instruction or a modification instruction of a user for the confirmation information, wherein the confirmation information comprises switch ledger information and equipment state required to be operated; and S4, the automatic generation functional interface of the scheduling instruction ticket generates a corresponding scheduling instruction ticket according to the confirmation instruction or the modification instruction. The invention can automatically generate the corresponding dispatching instruction ticket through the automatic generation function interface of the dispatching instruction ticket, has higher input efficiency compared with manual typing, and can effectively avoid human factor errors.

title_en: River and lake burst pollutant leakage cross-boundary pollution real-time monitoring and disposing system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river and lake burst pollutant leakage cross-boundary pollution real-time monitoring and disposing system and a method, wherein a dynamic monitoring system of the system is provided with more than one monitoring point in a burst pollution system and a conventional pollution system, pollution information is obtained through real-time monitoring and is transmitted to an intelligent control system, and the intelligent control system is connected with a water quality purifying system and a hydrodynamic force regulating and controlling system; the burst pollution system, the conventional pollution system and the water quality purifying system are arranged on two sides of the river channel along the river channel, control gates are arranged at the upstream and downstream of the river channel and at the junction between each system and the river channel, and the water quality purifying system comprises ecological purifying ponds arranged at the upstream and downstream of the river channel. The emission condition of new pollutants of each pollution source is monitored in real time through the flow and concentration monitor, meanwhile, the hydrologic condition of a river channel is clarified through the water level and flow velocity monitor, and the monitored data are sent to the intelligent control system through the signal transceiver to realize real-time monitoring, command execution and data feedback, so that the intelligent control system has the advantages of timeliness, science, accuracy, flexibility and the like.

title_en: Disaster emergency scheme recommendation method for underground coal mine trackless rubber-tyred vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster emergency scheme recommendation method for a coal mine underground trackless rubber-tyred vehicle, which is characterized in that a digital twin platform is used for acquiring data acquired by a data acquisition module to construct a virtual environment of an operation roadway of the coal mine underground trackless rubber-tyred vehicle, an expert recommendation module is used for manually processing an emergency scheme before the emergency is acquired by an information recording module, recommending the disaster emergency scheme after analysis, inputting the scheme into the digital twin platform for simulation verification, a voice recognition module is used for converting manual voice recognition into a control command which can be recognized by a dynamic command module, and the dynamic command module is used for dynamically controlling the trackless rubber-tyred vehicle according to the control command and the disaster emergency scheme. Through the mutual cooperation of the modules, the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle can be rapidly and effectively processed when an emergency occurs in the operation process of the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle, the operation safety of the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle is ensured, and the working efficiency of the underground trolley rubber-tyred vehicle of a coal mine is finally improved.

title_en: Cloud platform-based intelligent scheduling method and system for emergency of water tank fire truck
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud platform-based intelligent scheduling method and system for emergency of a water tank fire truck, and relates to the technical field of intelligent scheduling management. The method comprises the steps of acquiring priority data in the dynamic acquisition and classification storage processes of multi-disaster data and vehicle data to be scheduled based on a multi-dimensional real-time database constructed by a cloud platform, synchronously completing preliminary scheduling distribution of the vehicles to be scheduled so as to shorten the initial scheduling response period, generating a candidate scheduling scheme after the preliminary scheduling distribution, simultaneously screening out an optimal scheduling scheme so as to accurately match emergency demands of all target areas, dynamically adjusting a driving route and task distribution based on received scheduling instructions after the optimal scheduling scheme is acquired, and synchronously pushing scheduling information to a command center and all task scheduling sites so as to avoid rescue delay caused by information lag. The full-flow optimization of data processing, scheme screening and collaborative scheduling under the multi-disaster concurrent scene is realized, and the timeliness of the emergency scheduling of the water tank fire truck is further effectively improved.

title_en: Method for providing check service by using mobile device and computer readable recording medium applying the same
title_ko: 모바일 기기를 이용한 점검 서비스 제공방법 및 이를 적용한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체
abstract_en: A method for providing a check service using a mobile device and a computer-readable recording medium applying the same are provided. According to the method for providing a check service, the accident can be prevented in advance by easily recording/storing/managing various important buildings, facilities, equipment, situation on site and et cetera by displaying check item information which correspond to information of tag arranged in a predetermined location, inputting and storing an check result. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S210) Tagging a tag which is arranged in a predetermined region; (S220) Extracting location information corresponding to the tag; (S230) Detecting the location information of a mobile device; (S240) Displaying the check item information on a screen; (S250) Inputting the check result information; (S260) Location information of the mobile device is within the predetermined range of the tag location information?; (S265) Displaying an error; (S270) Storing the check result information; (S280) Transmitting the check result information to an external server
abstract_ko: 모바일 기기를 이용한 점검 서비스 제공방법 및 이를 적용한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체가 제공된다. 본 점검 서비스 제공방법에 따르면, 특정 위치에 배치된 태그의 정보에 대응되는 점검 항목 정보를 화면에 표시하고 점검 결과를 입력 및 저장할 수 있게 되어, 각종 중요 시설물, 설비, 장비, 현장상황등을 손쉽게 기록/저장/관리할 수 있게 되어, 사전에 발생할 수 있는 사고 등을 미연에 방지할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: System for maintaining and managing valves and pipe lines and establishing social security network in complex using radio frequency tag connector
title_ko: 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 이용한 단지 내 밸브 및 관로 유지 관리 및 사회 안전망 구축 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for maintaining and managing various valves and pipe lines and constructing a social safety network by transmitting location information (GIS information) to a disaster-related agency and families in a complex using a wireless communication tag connector. More specifically, the present invention provides a system wherein a wireless communication tag connector in which location information (GIS information) is stored is installed on valves and pipe lines which supply various necessary public goods and services to an apartment complex, an industrial complex, etc., and which records and stores a variety of information about maintaining and managing the valves and the pipe lines in a database via a server using the wireless communication tag connector, allows a manager to receive the stored information on a terminal to view, modify, input, and store information about the valves and the pipe lines, and transmits the location information stored in the database to the disaster-related agency and families via a wireless user terminal in real time using the wireless communication tag connector. According to the present invention, a variety of information about valves and pipe lines in a complex can be managed electronically, not by a hand-written register to improve accuracy, reliability and convenience. When an unfortunate accident or incident occurs, GIS-based current location information can be immediately transmitted to a location information display of a disaster-related agency without having to call the disaster-related agency to explain local information to allow the disaster-related agency to take relief actions immediately and construct a national-level social safety network.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 이용하여 단지 내 각종 밸브 및 관로를 유지 관리하는 동시에 위치 정보(GIS 정보)를 재난 관련 기관 및 가족에게 전송하여 사회 안전망을 구축하는 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로는 아파트 단지 또는 산업 단지 등에 각종 생활 필수 공공재 등을 공급하는 밸브 및 관로에 위치 정보(GIS 정보)가 저장된 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 설치해 두어 상기 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 이용하여 밸브 및 관로의 각종 유지 관리 정보를 서버를 통해 데이터베이스에 수록, 저장하며, 이렇게 저장된 정보를 관리자가 단말기를 통해 전송받아 밸브 및 관로의 정보를 조회, 수정, 입력, 저장 등을 할 수 있는 동시에, 상기 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 통해 데이터베이스에 저장된 위치 정보를 사용자의 무선 단말기를 통해 재난 관련 기관이나 가족에게 실시간으로 전송할 수 있도록 하는 시스템을 제공하고자 한다.  
본 발명에 의해 단지 내 밸브 및 관로의 각종 정보를 수기 대장에 의해 관리하지 않고 전자적으로 관리할 수 있게 되어 정확성, 신뢰성 및 편의성을 증대시킬 수 있고, 불의의 사고나 사건 발생시 재난 관련 기관에 전화하여 일일이 주변 정보를 설명할 필요 없이 즉각적으로 GIS에 기반한 현재의 위치 정보가 재난 관련 기관의 위치 정보 디스플레이에 전송되도록 함으로써 재난 관련 기관의 즉각적 구호 활동을 가능하게 하여 국가적인 사회 안전망을 구축할 수 있다.

title_en: Hospital disaster computer system
title_ko: 병원 재난 전산 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 병원 내외 재난, 사고 등이 초래될 경우를 대비한 훈련과 실제 재난, 사고 등의 발생에 있어 의료서비스의 중지 및 혼선이 없이 상시적으로 병원 내외 재난훈련을 가능토록 하여 병원 관계자들에게 명확한 역할 부여 및 이에 따른 상황 대응, 지휘체계, 협업, 평가 및 미비점 보완 등이 이루어짐에 따라 실제 재난, 사고 발생시 즉각적인 대응 및 의료서비스의 지속성을 유지하는 병원 재난 전산 시스템에 관한 것으로, 교육자로 하여금 재난상황 설정 및 피교육자로 하여금 설정된 재난상황에 대한 대응을 입력 가능하게 하여 실시간 재난상황 훈련과 소통을 가능하게 하는 입력부(100); 입력부(100)에 입력된 교육자의 재난상황 설정 데이터 및 피교육자의 대응 데이터를 저장 및 관리하여 성과 평가와 개선을 가능하게 하는 서버부(200); 서버부(200)에 저장된 데이터를 적어도 한 구역 이상 분할된 화면으로 출력하여 교육자 및 피교육자로 하여금 가시적으로 재난상황 및 재난상황에 대한 대응내역을 확인 가능하게 하는 출력부(300);로 구성되며, 상기 입력부(100);는, 재난상황 설정과 피교육자에 대한 임무를 할당 가능한 교육자입력부(110); 교육자입력부(110)에 의해 설정된 재난상황에 대한 대응을 입력 가능한 피교육자입력부(120);로 구성되어 교육자가 설정한 재난상황에 대하여 피교육자의 대응능력 및 피교육자들간 소통 협업을 이루어지도록 하고, 상기 교육자입력부(110);는, 재난상황의 명칭, 장소, 시간, 목표, 교육자 정보가 포함된 기본정보를 입력 가능하게 하는 기본정보입력부(111); 재난상황 교육내용, 시간, 진행 교육자 정보가 포함된 교육프로그램 정보를 입력 가능하게 하는 교육프로그램입력부(112); 재난상황 발생 및 각 재난상황에 대한 안내 메시지를 순차적으로 발송하고 발송되는 메시지의 저장 및 수정, 발송 순서를 입력 가능하게 하는 메시지입력부(113); 재난상황 교육이 실시되는 병원 정보를 입력 가능하게 하는 병원정보입력부(114); 재난상황의 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책을 포함하는 피교육자정보를 입력 가능토록 하고 입력된 피교육자정보를 수정 입력이 가능한 피교육자정보입력부(115); 재난상황에 대한 요약정보를 입력 가능하게 하여 피교육자로 하여금 재난상황을 문자로 확인할 수 있도록 하는 재난정보입력부(116); 재난상황 하에 피교육자의 활동 팀과 임무를 입력 가능하게 하는 팀및임무할당부(117); 재난상황 하에 활용 가능한 물품의 종류와 수량을 입력 가능하게 하는 물품입력부(118); 피교육자들의 재난상황 대응 결과 및 시기를 설정, 삭제 가능하게 구성하는 사고조치입력부(119);를 포함하며, 상기 피교육자입력부(120);는, 재난상황의 대응 내용을 작성 및 전송 가능하게 하는 피교육자메시지입력부(121); 피교육자에게 할당된 임무와 설정된 팀의 변경, 자구 수정 입력을 가능하게 하는 정보변경부(122);를 포함하고, 상기 피교육자메시지입력부(121);는, 재난상황 발생시 메시지 전송으로 피교육자간 소통을 위한 문구를 설정 및 추가 입력을 가능하게 하는 입력설정부(121a);를 더 포함하고, 상기 출력부(300);는, 입력부(100)에 교육자가 입력하는 정보를 토대로 적어도 한 구역 이상 구분된 화면으로 출력하여 교육자의 재난상황 설정과 피교육자의 대응내역을 확인 가능하게 하는 교육자출력부(310); 입력부(100)에 피교육자가 입력하는 정보를 토대로 적어도 한 구역 이상 구분된 화면으로 출력하여 피교육자간 대응과 임무의 완수하도록 하는 피교육자출력부(320);로 구성되어 피교육자간 협업과 재난상황 훈련이후 피교육자의 훈련성과 평가 및 개선점을 파악할 수 있도록 하며, 한편, 상기 교육자입력부(110) 상에는 피교육자입력부(120)와 달리 피교육자입력부(120)에 비해 추가로 재난상황에 능숙한 전문가를 구별할 수 있는 사용자 인증이 추가로 이루어지고, 또한, 상기 교육자입력부(110)의 각 기본정보입력부(111); 교육프로그램입력부(112); 메시지입력부(113); 병원정보입력부(114); 피교육자정보입력부(115); 재난정보입력부(116); 팀및임무할당부(117); 물품입력부(118); 사고조치입력부(119);에는 데이터를 입력하기 위해 각각 분할된 화면이 제공되고, 공란에 데이터를 입력하는 방법으로 각각의 기본정보, 교육프로로그램 정보, 피교육자정보, 병원정보가 입력됨과 아울러 출력부(300) 상에도 입력이 필요한 정보를 공란으로 설정하고 이에 대한 데이터 입력이 가능한 화면을 제공하며, 그리고, 피교육자정보입력부(115) 상에는 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책을 작성 가능한 문서를 제공하는 문서제공부(115a); 문서제공부(115a)의 제공 문서에서 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책에 대한 기재내용을 문자판독하는 문자판독부(115b); 문자판독부(115b);에 의해 판독된 문자를 피교육자의 연락처, 근무부서, 직종, 직책별로 구분하여 입력되도록 하는 판독문자자동입력부(115c);를 더 포함하고, 또한, 상기 교육자출력부(310) 상에는 기본정보입력부(111)에 입력되는 기본정보를 토대로 교육목록을 출력하는 교육목록출력부(311); 기본정보입력부(111)의 기본정보에 포함된 교육자 정보를 토대로 교육자목록을 출력하는 교육자목록출력부(312); 메시지입력부(113)에 저장된 메시지를 출력하는 교육메시지출력부(313); 피교육자정보입력부(115) 및 팀및임무할당부(117)에 입력된 피교육자별 팀과 임무를 구분하여 표 형식으로 출력하는 피교육자및부서출력부(314); 피교육자의 접속 여부를 확인 가능하게 출력하는 접속출력부(315); 피교육자별 대응내역을 확인 가능하게 구성하고 대응내역을 일지로 구성하여 출력하는 일지출력부(316); 사고조치입력부(119)의 재난상황 대응 결과 및 시기를 설정, 삭제 가능하도록 출력하는 사고조치출력부(317);를 더 포함하여 이루어진다.
assignees: KNL CO LTD;KIM YOUNG JIN;CHOI DAI HAI

title_en: A kind of fire communication command car with log management function
abstract_en: A kind of fire communication command car with log management function, including operation terminal, intelligent control device, bus power source control device and multiple working equipments, working equipment is connected on bus power source control device by power bus, working equipment is connected on intelligent control device by controlling bus, and bus power source control device is connected by controlling bus with intelligent control device control；Intelligent control device is connected by IP buses with operation terminal, or intelligent control device with operation terminal by being wirelessly connected.The utility model is linked together working equipment with controller by controlling bus, and be connected controller with operation terminal by wireless or IP buses, so as to not only realize the overall management to daily record of work in each working equipment on fire-fighting communication command vehicle, but also operation is convenient for people to, it is very simple and practical.
assignees: HNEGYANG TELLHOW COMMUNICATION VEHICLES CO LTD

title_en: Power system transformer substation integration simulating training system and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system transformer substation integration simulating training system and an implementation method thereof. The implementation method of the simulating training system includes the following steps: firstly, a student workstation sends orders to a simulating server; secondly, an information regulating and controlling service module receives order information and sends the order information to a simulation integration simulating module of a power system transformer substation; thirdly, the simulation integration simulating module of the power system transformer substation processes the order information and conducts simulating calculation, updates entire network current data, generates a deflection state, primary and secondary equipment signals and recorded information of sequence of events, and sends back the information of the sequence of the events to the information regulating and controlling service module; fourthly, the information regulating and controlling service module stores the simulating data, marks the order information, and distributes the order information to a power system dispatching central simulating module and a power system monitoring center to be displayed. According to the power system transformer substation integration simulating training system, a training environment with real simulating results and comprehensive training functions is established for regulating and controlling integration production and operation personnel, and new requirements for the production and operation personnel by 'mass operation' production system are met.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;NINGXIA ELECTRIC POWER CORP EDUCATION TRAINING CT;BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Indoor emergency response and context awareness navigation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an indoor emergency response and context awareness navigation system and method. The navigation system at least comprises a location sensor network, a server and an early warning sensor, wherein the location sensor network comprises a location base station, a mobile terminal and/or a location label and an LED (Light Emitting Diode) screen; the location base station is in wired or wireless connection with the server; the mobile terminal and/or the location label is in wireless connection with the location base station; the LED screen is in wired connection with the location base station; the early warning sensor is in wireless connection with the server. The navigation method is capable of combining a plurality of context calculation navigation paths of indoor environment, self-adaptively presenting the navigation paths to users according to the scenes of the users in many ways and providing real-time, accurate and individual navigation service. The navigation system and the navigation method are applicable to personnel location, emergency evacuation, rescue after disaster and safety management of large complex indoor venues such as hospitals, markets, office buildings and stations; meanwhile, the navigation system and the navigation method are capable of improving scientificity, timeliness, effectiveness of emergency response of public places.

title_en: Scheduling control scheme generation method of emergency broadcast system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling control scheme generation method of an emergency broadcast system. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring a resource list and task record from a database; S2, calculating a biggest publishing region according to information fields related to the region in the resource list and the task record; S3, calculating a time matching result according to information fields related to the time in the resource list and the task record; S4, obtaining a resource matching result according to information fields related to the resource in the resource list and the task record; S5, obtaining an original broadcast language matching result according to information fields related to the language in the resource list and the task record; S6, carrying out permutation and combination on the four results to obtain a plurality of schemes; S7, screening out four schemes satisfying the actual needs from the plurality of schemes obtained in the step S6 for the decision-making of a decision maker. After the method is adopted, the decision maker can be helped to rapidly and accurately formulate an emergency command scheme in real time, so that the method plays a great helping role in the establishment of emergency broadcast.
assignees: CHENGDU JIUZHOU ELECTRIC INFORMATION SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Fire rescue management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire rescue management method and system, and relates to the field of fire safety. Firstly, after receiving warning information, a background server of a team sends out a warning; after receiving the warning information, the middle team determines the number of fire stations for implementing rescue, auxiliary small stations, police-giving personnel, fire trucks and the like by combining a fire-fighting force distribution map in the area, generates an alarm-giving instruction and sends the alarm-giving instruction. Then, according to the feedback information reported by the small-sized station after the small-sized station arrives at the site, the alarm condition is updated to generate an operation action time line, and the operation process is recorded, so that unified command is facilitated. And finally, the rescue fire brigade arrives at the site and carries out rescue actions according to the instructions until the task is finished. According to the method, the field situation is known in real time through communication between the background server and the client, the disaster information is integrally controlled, and the operation information and the communication command can be accurately and timely transmitted, so that the fire fighting strength in the district can be efficiently and conveniently scheduled and commanded.
assignees: LANZHOU BOYANG SOFTWARE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Anti-terrorism monitoring emergency command system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to an anti-terrorism monitoring emergency command system, which comprises: monitoring equipment groups, dispatch centers and emergency response equipment groups. The monitoring equipment group is used for collecting monitoring data of the inside of the hydropower plant and the boundary of the plant area and returning the monitoring data to the dispatching center; the dispatching center is used for analyzing anti-terrorism emergency events according to the monitoring data returned by the monitoring equipment group and commanding and dispatching emergency response equipment group and personnel to defend in time according to the analysis result. The system can improve the recognition range, recognition capability and recognition timeliness of the ground global emergency event of the hydropower plant, can improve the emergency response capability and emergency response timeliness of the ground global emergency event of the hydropower plant, and can further strengthen the recognition and emergency response processing capability of the airspace emergency event of the hydropower plant.

title_en: 5G interconnection transfer system and method applied to medical emergency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a 5G interconnection transfer system and method applied to medical emergency, wherein the system comprises an intelligent critical illness transfer platform, an emergency command cabin, a 5G pre-hospital emergency command system and a 5G ambulance, and the 5G ambulance comprises a network communication module, an intelligent task terminal, an ambulance position real-time return module, a patient vital parameter module and an in-vehicle panoramic high-definition video module. The method is realized by the system. According to the invention, the timeliness of pre-hospital emergency is improved through a 5G technology, the emergency efficiency is improved, the integration of pre-hospital emergency treatment and treatment is realized, and the pre-hospital emergency and off-hospital transportation medical service mode is innovated.
assignees: THE FIRST HOSPITAL OF HEBEI MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Mountain landslide space-space cooperative sensing early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain landslide space-space collaborative sensing early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of early warning and comprises the following steps: setting targets, acquiring images for identifying a plurality of targets at fixed time through a satellite remote sensing technology, and connecting each target with a plurality of adjacent targets according to the distance from small to large to form a monitoring and early warning network; step 3, triggering early warning: measuring the length of each line segment and/or the angle of each line segment included angle in the monitoring and early warning network through an image recognition technology; and comparing the measured value with the initial value each time, and triggering a first early warning command when the change rate of the length of the line segment exceeding A% is greater than B% and/or the change rate of the included angle exceeding C% is greater than D%. The satellite remote sensing technology provides large-scale and high-precision monitoring data, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection provides real-time on-site information, foundation monitoring focuses on key factors such as rainfall, and the three work cooperatively, so that the accuracy and timeliness of early warning are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG NUCLEAR GEOLOGY SURVEY INST;GUANGDONG POLYTECHNIC IND & COMMERCE;GUANGDONG GUANGYU GEOLOGICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting linkage control method and system for avoiding fire-fighting risks
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting coordinated control method and system for avoiding fire-fighting risks, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting coordinated control, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a fire dynamic simulator in a simulation manner; the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time monitoring parameters, obtaining the distribution of the covering combustible, carrying out harmful gas diffusion prediction in a preset future time zone to generate harmful gas prediction distribution, carrying out smoke discharging linkage control scheme optimization in combination with the layout of a smoke discharging device, outputting an optimal smoke discharging linkage control scheme, and carrying out smoke discharging control of a target building in the preset future time zone. The technical problems that fire protection alarms in the prior art are difficult to adjust aiming at different building structures and fire scenes, and the diffusion paths of fire and harmful gases cannot be predicted in real time, so that an emergency linkage control scheme is lack of pertinence, and fire protection emergency response is not timely and accurate are solved, and the technical effects of improving the timeliness and the accuracy of the fire protection emergency response, reducing the harmful gas risk of an evacuation channel and the overall fire protection safety risk are achieved.
assignees: HANGZHOU JIANTAI ZHICHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Object abnormal behavior prompting method and device, wearable device and medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an object abnormal behavior prompting method, device, wearable equipment and medium, which comprise the steps of acquiring and acquiring equipment motion change data of the wearable equipment based on a first frequency, acquiring environment sensing data when the equipment motion change data is detected to meet a risk action detection condition, acquiring the equipment motion change data and object physiological change data of an object worn by the equipment based on a second frequency, determining that an abnormal behavior state exists in the object worn by the equipment if any abnormal behavior detection condition is met, carrying out cooperative detection on multi-mode sensor data, determining abnormal grade information corresponding to the abnormal behavior state, prompting a corresponding target user based on a target prompting mode corresponding to the abnormal grade information, effectively solving the problem that the traditional wearable equipment depends on response hysteresis caused by manual triggering alarm information and single detection dimension abnormal detection, and improving the accuracy of object risk behavior judgment and the timeliness of emergency response.
assignees: ZHENSHI INFORMATION TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Power grid emergency material intelligent supply chain dynamic allocation and priority ordering method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of power grid emergency management and intelligent supply chains, in particular to a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, comprising the steps of constructing a digital twin environment model integrating geographic information, real-time traffic, inventory status and fault prediction; defining a reinforcement learning framework, wherein a state space covers stock, in-transit materials, demand urgency and traffic states, an action space comprises material allocation instructions and task priority ordering, a reward function synthesizes shortage relief, delivery timeliness and cost, and a strategy network capable of outputting optimal dynamic allocation strategies is obtained through training an intelligent agent. The invention realizes intelligent dynamic allocation and priority optimization of emergency materials, and effectively improves the emergency response efficiency and resource utilization rate of the power grid.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: System for evaluating safety of radioactive waste-transportation
title_ko: 방사성폐기물 운반 안전성 평가 시스템
abstract_en: A radioactive waste carrying safety assessment system evaluating safety in the radioactive waste by analyzing risk evaluation from an evaluation program through statistical data is provided to evaluate risk by using feedback data. A carrying condition for evaluating risk is inputted to a data input module(111). A risk evaluation module(112) evaluates the degree of danger according to the transporting course based on the inputted data. A comparative valuation module(113) compares risk and safety about an available path by using the calculated risk data. The result output module actually produces the safe carrying condition from the compared each carrying condition. A result value at the respective module is controlled and stored in database.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방사성폐기물 운반 안전성 평가 시스템에 관한 것이고, 구체적으로는 방사능 누출율 및 사고 통계 데이터를 통한 위험성 평가 및 산출하는 프로그램으로부터 위험성을 평가 및 분석하여 방사성폐기물 운반시 안전성을 평가하는 안전성 평가 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 방사성폐기물 운반 안전성 평가 시스템은 운반 조건 데이터를 입력받아 처리하는 데이터 입력 모듈; 상기 입력된 데이터로부터 위험성을 평가하는 위험성 평가 모듈; 상기 평가된 위험성으로부터 여러 조건별 운반을 비교하는 비교 평가 모듈; 및 최적의 운반 조건을 산출하는 결과 출력 모듈을 포함한다.
