title_en: Realtime video regulations system of waste handling
title_ko: 폐기물 및 쓰레기 처리의 실시간 영상 관제시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A real time video monitoring system of wastes and waste handling is provided to record an image photographed by an image photographing device using wire/wireless communication networks between an installation region and a remote monitoring room, thereby monitoring the image at a remote place in real time. CONSTITUTION: A waste process monitoring system(300) transmits an emergency bell generation signal and warning voice to a corresponding installation region managing system at crime and fire. An emergency bell processing system(400) receives the emergency bell generation signal. The emergency bell processing system requests emergency departure to a corresponding fire station and a corresponding police station. A local government data collecting system(600) transmits collected amount information transmitted from an RF communication collection amount measurement system to a local government RF reader device by an RF antenna. The local government data collecting system stores a processing situation per a region and one day processing situation per an intrinsic number to manage.

title_en: Processing system using a traffic accident insurers linked black boxes
title_ko: 보험사 연계형 블랙박스를 이용한 교통사고 처리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a traffic accident processing system using an insurance company related black box, and more specifically, to a traffic accident processing system using an insurance company related black box, which includes: an impact sensor (1) for sensing impact; a black box (20) which is connected to the impact sensor (1) and is embedded with a communication module (21) to transmit image information; and a vehicle management server (30) for receiving the image information and recording the image information and then transmitting the image information to an insurance company server (40). The image information includes accident image information for a setting time before and after an impact sensing signal, when the impact sensing signal of the impact sensor is generated. The present invention like the above is effective in unscheduled vehicle condition checking, driving behavior correction, rapid accident processing, emergency rescue, etc.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 보험사 연계형 블랙박스를 이용한 교통사고 처리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 충격 감지용 충격센서(1)와; 상기 충격센서(1)와 연결되며 영상정보를 전송하기 위한 통신모듈(21)이 내장된 블랙박스(20); 및 상기 영상정보를 수신하여 기록 및 보험사 서버(40)에 전송하는 차량관리 서버(30)를 포함하되, 
상기 영상정보는 상기 충격센서(1)의 충격 감지신호 발생시, 충격 감지신호 전,후의 설정시간의 사고영상정보를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 보험사 연계형 블랙박스를 이용한 교통사고 처리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이와 같은 본 발명은 차량 상태 수시 점검, 운전 습관 교정, 신속한 사고처리, 긴급구조 등에 효과적이다.

title_en: Method and program for emergency reporting by wearable glass device
title_ko: 글라스형 웨어러블 디바이스를 이용한 긴급시 비상연락방법 및 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a program for performing an emergency contact in case of an emergency using a wearable glass-type device. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a method for performing an emergency contact in case of an emergency using a wearable glass-type device comprises the steps of: obtaining a user′s voice input or motion input (S100); recognizing the voice input or the motion input to determine an emergency situation (S200); and transmitting emergency situation notification information to the other party corresponding to an emergency contact through wireless communications (S300). According to the present invention, a user in an emergency situation may perform an emergency contact without an additional operation. Accordingly, the number of crimes or accidents may be reduced by dealing with an emergency situation at an early stage. In addition, a user may wear the wearable glass-type device all the time according to the characteristics thereof, thereby preparing for the user′s emergency situation at all times. Further, voice inputs and motion inputs may be classified by emergency situations, the other parties and contact numbers for emergency contact may be specified, thereby enabling a user to perform an emergency contact with the other party who can properly deal with the user′s emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 글라스형 웨어러블 디바이스를 이용한 긴급시 비상연락방법 및 프로그램에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 글라스형 웨어러블 디바이스를 이용한 긴급시 비상연락 방법은, 사용자의 음성입력 또는 동작입력을 획득하는 단계(S100); 음성입력 또는 동작입력을 인식하여 긴급상황을 판단하는 단계(S200); 및 무선통신으로 비상연락 상대방에게 긴급상황 알림정보를 전송하는 단계(S300);를 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 긴급상황에 처한 사용자가 별도의 조작없이 비상연락을 수행할 수 있다. 이에 따라 조기에 긴급상황에 대처하여 범죄 또는 사고를 줄일 수 있다. 또한, 상기 글라스형 웨어러블 디바이스의 특성상 사용자가 항상 입고 있으므로, 항상 사용자의 긴급상황에 대비할 수 있다. 또한,  긴급상황 별로 음성입력과 동작입력을 분류하고 비상연락을 할 상대방 및 연락처를 지정해두므로, 사용자가 처한 긴급상황에 적절하게 대응할 수 있는 상대방에게 비상연락이 수행될 수 있다.

title_en: system for reliability of operator's manual action and method for reliability of operator's manual action
title_ko: 운전원 수동조치의 신뢰성 확보 시스템 및 운전원 수동조치의 신뢰성 확보 방법
abstract_en: A system for securing the reliability of an operator's manual action according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a database in which scenario data is recorded for an accident requiring an operator's manual action on a specific device among a plurality of devices in a power plant in which a plurality of devices are installed; an accident state implementation unit modeling a virtual power plant corresponding to the power plant and a plurality of virtual devices corresponding to the plurality of devices, implementing a state in which the accident occurs at the virtual power plant based on the scenario data and simulating a process in which the operator takes a manual action on a specific virtual device corresponding to the specific device among the plurality of virtual devices; an available time setting unit setting available time which is the time required for the operator to complete the manual action on the specific virtual device in response to the implemented accident; a diagnosis time measurement unit measuring a diagnosis time, which is the time consumed in a diagnosis step in which the operator recognizes the accident and specifies the specific virtual device among the plurality of virtual devices; a movement time measuring unit measuring movement time, which is the time consumed in a movement step in which the operator moves from an initial position within the virtual power plant to the operating position where the specific virtual device is installed; and an operation time measuring unit measuring operation time, which is the time consumed in an operation step in which the operator operates the specific virtual device at the operating position. When an accident occurs, the initial countermeasure capability of the operator can be enhanced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 운전원 수동조치의 신뢰성 확보 시스템은 복수의 기기가 설치된 발전소에서 상기 복수의 기기 중에 특정기기에 운전원의 수동조치가 요구되는 사고가 발생한 상황에 대한 시나리오데이터가 기록된 데이터베이스, 상기 발전소에 대응되는 가상발전소와 상기 복수의 기기에 대응되는 복수의 가상기기를 모델링하고, 상기 시나리오데이터를 기반으로 상기 가상발전소에서 상기 사고가 발생한 상황을 구현하여, 상기 운전원이 상기 복수의 가상기기 중에 상기 특정기기에 대응되는 특정가상기기를 수동조치하는 과정을 시뮬레이션하는 사고 상황 구현부, 구현된 상기 사고에 대응하여 상기 운전원이 상기 특정가상기기에 대한 수동조치를 완료하기까지 요구되는 시간인 가용시간을 설정하는 가용시간설정부; 상기 운전원이 상기 사고를 인지하고 상기 복수의 가상기기 중에 상기 특정가상기기를 특정하는 진단단계에서 소모된 시간인 진단시간을 측정하는 진단시간 측정부, 상기 운전원이 상기 가상발전소 내의 초기 위치에서 상기 특정가상기기가 설치된 조작 위치까지 이동하는 이동단계에서 소모된 시간인 이동시간을 측정하는 이동시간 측정부 및 상기 운전원이 상기 조작 위치에서 상기 특정가상기기를 조작하는 조작단계에서 소모된 시간인 조작시간을 측정하는 조작시간 측정부를 포함한다.

title_en: Systems and methods for three-dimensional interaction monitoring in an ems environment
abstract_en: A method for tracking interactions in an emergency response environment according to embodiments of the present invention includes receiving color images and depth information from within a field of view of a sensor array; maintaining an emergency encounter record; monitoring one or both of a position of an object and movement of the object in the emergency response environment based on the color images and depth information received by the sensor array; and recording an occurrence of a condition in the emergency encounter record, wherein the condition is based on the one or both of the position of the object and the movement of the object.

title_en: Device for dispatching police officers
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for dispatching a police officer, and aims to improve the intelligent level of dispatching the police officer. The method for dispatching the police officers comprises the following steps: under the condition of receiving an alarm, the server receives a case place and a case type recorded by an alarm, and determines a distance weight and a professional weight according to an alarm telephone voice corresponding to the alarm; the server determines the professional score of each police officer in the administration area of the case according to the preset professional label of the police officer and the case type, and determines the distance score of the police officer according to the position information of the police officer and the case type; the server determines the police output score of each police officer according to the professional score and the distance score of the police officer, the distance weight and the professional weight; the server determines the police officer from the plurality of officers according to the respective police output scores of the police officers, and sends an alarm output instruction to a law enforcement terminal of the police officer.

title_en: System and Method for Remote Real-Time Intergrated Management of Bus Platform, and Recording Medium having Computer Readable Program for Executing the Method
title_ko: 버스 승강장의 원격 실시간 통합관리 시스템 및 방법과 그 기록매체
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a remote real-time integrated management system for a bus stop connects a plurality of bus stop terminals, glass repairers and a bus stop management center through a network. The bus stop management center performs a real time integrated management program. The real time integrated management program includes the following operations of: receiving glass damage sensing information from a glass damage sensor attached on the glass of each of a plurality of bus stops; delivering a command to take a damage condition image of the corresponding glass through a CCTV camera of a corresponding bus stop terminal when receiving the glass damage sensing information; delivering an immediate glass repair command by transmitting bus stop location information and damage condition image information to a glass repairer on a positioning basis when receiving the damage condition image, while reporting a glass damage case to the competent authorities; receiving repair completion information from the glass repairer; delivering a command to take a repair condition image of the corresponding glass through the CCTV camera of the corresponding bus stop terminal when receiving the repair completion information; and transmitting the repair condition image and the repair completion information to the competent authorities and requesting payment for the glass repair of the corresponding glass repairer when receiving the repair condition image.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 버스 승강장의 원격 실시간 통합관리 시스템은 다수의 버스 승강장 단말장치들 및 유리 수리업자들과 버스 승강장 관리센터 사이를 네트워크로 연결한다. 버스 승강장 관리센터는 실시간 통합관리 프로그램을 수행한다. 실시간 통합관리 프로그램은 다수의 버스 승강장들 각각의 유리에 부착된 유리파손센서로부터 유리파손 센싱정보를 수신하는 동작과, 유리파손 센싱정보가 수신되면 해당 버스 승강장 단말장치의 CCTV카메라를 통하여 해당 유리의 파손상태영상을 촬영하도록 명령을 하달하는 동작과, 파손상태 영상이 수신되면 위치기반에 의해 유리수리업자에게 버스 승강장 위치정보 및 파손상태 영상정보를 전송하여 즉시 유리 수리명령을 하달함과 동시에 관할 관공서에 유리파손사건을 접수하는 동작과, 유리수리업자로부터 수리완료정보를 수신하는 동작과, 수리완료정보가 수신되면, 해당 버스 승강장 단말장치의 CCTV카메라를 통하여 해당 유리의 수리상태 영상을 촬영하도록 명령을 하달하는 동작과, 수리상태 영상이 수신되면, 수리상태 영상 및 수리완료정보를 관할 관공서에 전송하고 해당 수리업자의 유리 수리비용결재를 요청하는 동작을 구비한다.
assignees: PITCHCABLE CO LTD;UNION CT CO LTD

title_en: Traffic accident recognition method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
title_ko: 교통 사고 인식 방법, 장치, 기기 및 컴퓨터 기록 매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교통 사고 인식 방법, 장치, 장치 및 컴퓨터 기록 매체를 개시하였는 바, 지능형 교통 및 빅 데이터 기술 분야에 관한 것이다. 구체적으로 실현 방안은, 도로 특징, 환경 특징 및 도로 상의 교통 흐름 특징을 취득하는 것; 및 상기 도로 특징, 환경 특징 및 도로 상의 교통 흐름 특징을 사전에 트레이닝하여 얻은 교통 사고 인식 모델에 입력하여, 사고가 발생하였는지 여부의 인식 결과를 적어도 포함하는 상기 도로 상의 사고 정보 인식 결과를 얻는 것을 포함한다. 본 발명은 도로 특징, 환경 특징 및 도로 상의 교통 흐름 특징에 기반하여, 도로 상에 사고가 발생하였는지 여부를 자동적으로 인식할 수 있다. 기존의 수동으로 신고하는 방식과 비교하면, 시간적 효과성이 더 강하고, 커버율이 더 높다.

title_en: System and method for redaction of data that is incidentally recorded
abstract_en: Techniques for redaction of data that is incidentally recorded. A request for information is received from a user. The requested information includes confidential information. The request is received via a first device. The requested information is sent to the first device for output to the user by the first device. A second device within proximity to the first device is determined. The second device causes the output from the first device to be recorded based on the proximity of the second device to the first device. The recording from the second device is marked as redactable. A portion of the recording from the second device that includes the confidential information is redacted when the recording from the second device is output.

title_en: A kind of fireman fire scene tell-table
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fireman fire scene tell-tables, including contactless card and logging machine, the contactless card is mounted in the fireproof garment of fireman, logging machine surface is provided with sensor, display screen and switch key, power supply, warning device, micro-chip processor, master control borad, SD card and display device are installed in logging machine, display device is connected with display screen, and micro-chip processor is connected with cloud server.This product is automatically recorded by micro-chip processor, solve the problems, such as manual record inefficiency, corresponding data is calculated automatically and is uploaded in real time simultaneously, more quickly in face of the feedback to commander of distinctness, enter the time in the scene of a fire in the display screen display soldier of logging machine, it can be alarmed with countdown, reach automatic alarm, the fireman outside the scene of a fire can call out and succour fireman in the scene of a fire；This product can be stored in the data of fire scene rescue in SD card, and SD card can store 2 years record data, can also copy out in computer, facilitate archive and access.
assignees: GUANGZHOU SHANQIU ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-extinguishing rescue tactic sleeve board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire-extinguishing rescue tactical board, which comprises three tactical boards, namely a team station fire-extinguishing rescue tactical board, a large team-level fire-extinguishing rescue tactical board and a fire-extinguishing rescue tactical panel, wherein each tactical board comprises a tactical board cover, an identification area and a hand-painted area, the tactical board cover, the identification area and the hand-painted area are sequentially connected, a plurality of identification pieces are adsorbed on the identification area, the identification pieces comprise a grade personnel label, a equipment label, a fire-fighting vehicle label and a combat team label, the identification pieces adsorbed on the identification area can be removed and adsorbed on the hand-painted area so as to draw a more accurate tactical map on site, the three tactical boards hand-painted area comprises an electronic map function, command information recording, transmission and sharing can be carried out in a traditional mode, and in an effective network state, the team, the command information (comprising words, audios and videos) can be cooperatively recorded, transmitted through a network, and the command information of various levels are convenient for the command staff to communicate and communicate with each other.

title_en: 3 A computer game education tool digital 3D for traffic safety education
title_ko: 교통안전교육 및 생활안전교육을 위한 안전교육용 3차원 디지털 게임 학습기
abstract_ko:
본 고안 물인  <교통안전 및 기타 안전교육을 위한 3D디지털 게임 학습기> 는 본인이 제출하여 실용신안 등록 후 소멸 되었던 교통안전 가상체험 가상 시물레이터(소멸:20-0418851)와 교통안전교육용 입체영상 삼차원 시뮬레이터(소멸:20-0418843)처럼 동영상이 아닌 3D 그래픽 데이터를 게임프로그래밍으로 실시간 동영상 제어방식의 게임 학습기로서 한시적으로 고정된 장소(전시관 등)에 설치하여 특정  장소에서만 3D디지털 체험 학습교육이 가능하게 만들어진 것으로 제한되지 않고 일반 컴퓨터에 소프트웨어와 하드웨어를 연결 하여, 가정, 학교컴퓨터실, 유치원에서도 손 쉽게 컴퓨터 또는 모니터가 부착된 기기에 안전교육 게임 소프트웨어와 하드웨어를 설치하여 학습할 수 있도록 새롭게 고안된 안전교육 전용 게임 학습기이다.내용 면에서는 실제로 3D 가상현실에서 학습 사용자가 3D게임화면에서 선정한  대리캐릭터, 또는 대리운전자를 조종하여 각종 사고 현장(10대 보행자    교통사고 상   황, 조기 운전교육 등) 각종 사고 상황을 안전하게 캐릭터를   조종하면서 학습하고 안전교육게임을 진행하면서 얻은 점수를 토대로, 지금까지 수치화하기 힘들었던 개인의 안전학습 정도를 측정할 수 있고 평가 이수시킬 수 있는 기능이 추가되어 있다.    
     본 고안 물인 3D디지털 게임 학습기는 주로 교통안전교육의 내용으로 구성되며  3D 가상 현실 그래픽과 게임프로그래밍이 결합 된 소프트웨어와 이 그래픽 게임 영상을 조작하기 위한 컴퓨터와 연동 되는 핸들, 그리고 멈춤 ,전진, 등을 구현할  수 있는 기능과 각종 사고상황 학습구성요소를 자유롭게 선택할 수 있는 버튼이 포함된 자동차 기어 형 조작기로 구성된 일반 보급형 최첨단 3D디지털 안전학습 게임기이다.   
     또한 소방 및, 방재 체험 3D게임컨텐츠를 첨가하여  교통안전교육은 물론 다양한 생활안전교육을 게임을 즐기며, 체험하듯이  안전교육을 즐길 수 있도록 고안되었다. 
     
     도로, 건물, 교통신호등, 횡단 보도 등이 포함된 안전교육 3D 가상현실 그래 픽데이터, 게임프로그래밍, 하드웨어프로그래밍, 자동차 형 핸들, 자동차 기어형 게임 조작기, 안전교육 점수부여(게임점수) 후 해당점수 획득하면 안전교육 이수 자격증 부여.

title_en: Multi-core CPU-based high-performance network cruise ship shipping terminal regulating and controlling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-core CPU-based high-performance network cruise ship shipping terminal regulating and controlling system, which is front-end equipment of a cruise ship monitoring and management system. Generally, the system is secretly mounted in various cruise ships; cruise ship-mounted terminal equipment mainly comprises a cruise ship-mounted video server, an LCD touch screen, an external camera, a communication handle and a steam cruise ship anti-theft device. The multi-core CPU-based high-performance network cruise ship shipping terminal regulating and controlling system disclosed by the invention integrates a plurality of functions of positioning and communicating, a steam cruise ship driving recording instrument and the like, has a powerful service scheduling function and high data processing capacity and supports telephone book calling; the cruise ship-mounted video server of a cruise ship scheduling monitoring terminal (TCU terminal) acquires an audio signal and compresses the audio signal into a digital stream; the digital stream is transmitted to a user monitoring center through wireless networks, such as cdma 20001x. Therefore, the purposes of remote monitoring and emergency commanding are achieved.
assignees: SHANGHAI MUFENG DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent landfill management system based on three-dimensional storage capacity analysis and prediction technique
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent management system and particularly relates to an intelligent landfill management system based on the three-dimensional storage capacity analysis and prediction technique. The system comprises a service management module, a daily operation management module and an emergency module. The system is characterized in that the service management module comprises a landfill operation management system, an operating vehicle monitoring system, a video monitoring system, a pollute discharge monitoring system and a landfill stability monitoring system. The daily operation management module comprises a daily office management system, and a public service system. The emergency module comprises a daily scheduling system, an emergency command system and a master control room construction system. According to the technical scheme of the invention, by means of the system, the functions of vehicle access automatic control, data automatic recording and weighing status remote viewing are realized. Meanwhile, the position trajectory of an operating vehicle in a landfill can be monitored in real time, and the operation amount, the operation status and other information of the vehicle are acquired. The oil consumption of the vehicle is managed, and the abnormal condition of the vehicle is monitored.
assignees: SUZHOU VORTEX INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Automatic testing method and system for flight simulator cabin display equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic test method for a flight simulator cabin display device, which comprises the steps of designing a test case and a test flow by using a test case editor of test software, and storing the test case and the test flow into a database system; the test software selects the type of the equipment to be tested, the host window displays all test cases of the equipment, the equipment to be tested is accessed into the test tool, and the equipment is powered on to be tested; the software inputs the serial number of the equipment to be tested, the test is started, the test software executes all test cases according to the test flow, gradually sends the test command of each case, delays, processes the test feedback data and records the test result, the test host displays the test report, and the test result is stored in the database. The automatic test system for the cockpit display equipment provided by the invention can completely avoid the defects of the traditional test method, saves labor, improves the test efficiency and accuracy, and can avoid the generation of measurement errors due to the unified test case and test process.
assignees: QINGDAO SHANJING VIRTUAL REALITY RES INSTITUTE;QINGDAO SHANJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evacuation roll-call system, safe evacuation method, readable storage medium and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides an evacuation roll call system, a safe evacuation method, a readable storage medium and electronic equipment. The evacuation roll call system records evacuation events through the event storage module and classifies the evacuation events according to categories so as to determine evacuation areas, commanders and evacuation assembly sites. And acquiring an evacuation list according to the real-time database, wherein the evacuation list not only comprises a staff list in an evacuation area, but also comprises a visitor and carrier list so as to avoid evacuation or rescue carelessness. In addition, all commanders or all employees can perform roll calling operation so as to improve roll calling efficiency. And after the attendance is finished, the commander can perform quick rescue according to the list information of the people who do not arrive at the safe evacuation gathering place, so that the rescue efficiency is ensured. Therefore, the invention not only can timely acquire the accurate evacuation list and the commander list in emergency, ensure the stability and high efficiency of evacuation management, but also can realize high-efficiency emergency rescue through the acquired feedback information.
assignees: HONGSHENG CRYSTALLIZATION INTEGRATED CIRCUIT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency scene quick response access control authority dynamic management and control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of access control, and discloses an emergency scene quick response access control authority dynamic management and control system which comprises an emergency sensing module, an emergency decision module, an authority adjustment module, a central control module, an execution and feedback module, an information notification module and a plan management module, wherein the emergency sensing module is used for monitoring environmental changes or receiving external alarm signals in real time, the emergency decision module is used for matching an emergency plan according to data provided by the sensing module or generating an access control authority adjustment strategy through an intelligent algorithm, and the authority adjustment module dynamically modifies the access control authority based on the adjustment strategy. The rapid identification and dynamic authority regulation of emergency events are realized through a cooperation mechanism of multi-source perception and intelligent decision, and the system can automatically adjust the passing rules in different emergency stages based on a time attenuation mechanism and space partition mapping of a four-dimensional authority matrix, so that the timeliness of emergency response and the order of personnel evacuation are remarkably improved.
assignees: WUHAN CHUGUAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Crime-vechicles crackdown system
title_ko: 범죄차량 단속시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A control system for vehicles used in a crime is provided to transmit the information of a vehicle used in a crime to a user terminal in real-time and to dispatch competent officers possessing the user terminal to the field rapidly, thereby preventing another crime within a short period of time and arresting the criminal. CONSTITUTION: A local server (110) photographs vehicles to collect and store information about each vehicle. A main server (160) is connected to the local server and an all-points bulletin (APB) server. The main server stores the information of a vehicle received from the local server. The main server compares the received information of the vehicle with the information of the vehicle used in a crime which is obtained through the APB server. If the compared information matches, the main server transmits notification information to the registered user terminals (200). [Reference numerals] (10) Communication network; (110) Local server; (140) Wanted server; (160) Main server; (200) User terminal
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 범죄차량 단속시스템에 관한 것으로서, 차로를 통행하는 차량들을 촬영하여 얻어진 각각의 차량정보 통신망을 통해 실시간으로 송신하는 로컬서버와, 범죄차량의 차량정보가 기록된 수배서버와, 로컬서버로부터 수신된 차량정보를 각각 저장하고, 로컬서버로부터 수신된 차량정보를 수배서버를 통해 얻은 범죄차량 정보를 서로 비교하여 일치하면 통신망을 통해 등록된 사용자 단말기로 알림정보를 송출하도록 된 메인서버를 구비하고, 메인서버는 로컬서버로부터 송신되는 차량정보와 수배서버로부터 송신되는 차량정보를 각각 수신처리하는 네트워크수신부와, 네트워크수신부로부터 수신된 차량정보들을 저장처리하는 저장부와, 네트워크수신부를 통해 수신되어 저장부에 저장처리된 로컬서버와 수배서버의 차량정보를 서로 비교하여 일치하면 일치한 차량정보를 출력하는 메인 제어부와, 메인 제어부에 의해 출력된 차량정보에 대응되는 알림정보를 등록된 사용자단말기들로 송출하는 알림부를 구비하며, 알림부는 차량번호를 포함한 차량 정보를 음성으로 변환하여 등록된 사용자단말기로 전송한다. 이러한 범죄차량 단속시스템에 의하면, 범죄차량의 차량정보가 실시간으로 사용자단말기들로 전송되며 사용자단말기를 소지한 관할경찰관들이 신속하게 현장에 출동하여 빠른 시간내에 추가범죄발생을 예방하고 검거가 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Wearable LED Traffic Safety Belt
title_ko: Wearable 교통방향지시 안전벨트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wearable traffic direction indicating seat belt, which protects a driver and other people from the risk of a traffic accident, comprising: a low- and high-brightness conversion LED headlight; a traffic direction indicating LED; a motion sensor; a human body sensor; a brightness control sensor; a pest control ultrasonic device; a battery and a charging device; and a ring type remote controller traffic direction indicating device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은  동력, 무동력 자전거 와 그 종류들의 이용자를 위한 Wearable 교통방향지시 안전벨트에 관한 것이다. 전 세계적인 탄소중립 추세와 코로나 감염 사태로 인해  개인 모빌리티 의 이용 인구는 폭발적인 증가세를 나타내고 있다. 그러나 그 증가세 만큼 안전사고 또한 가파른 상승세를 나타내 사회 문제화 되고 있는 실정이나 마땅한 대책이 없는 상황이다.  
따라서 본 발명은  개인 모빌리티 의 이용자들이 안심하고 그것을 이용하고 즐길 수 있는 방법을 고안하였다.  본 발명은  자전거 혹은 그 종류 를 이용하는 모든 사람들에게 그것들을 안전한 교통수단 혹은 레저수단으로 그 활용범위를 더 넓게 활용할 수 있게 하는 역할을 하게 할 것이다. 또한 본 발명은 이  동력 무동력 장치들에  의해 유발된 많은 교통안전 사고와 이로 인해 야기된 사회문제와 그와 관련된 레저 모빌리티 산업의 경제적 손실 문제를 어느 정도 해결할 수 있는 기회를 제공하게 될 것이다.  
이 장치는 착용자의 교통사고로부터의 안전과 범죄자 맹견 등으로부터 보호해 주는 기능으로서의 헤드라이트, 주간 야간을 막론하고 확고하게 상대 차량에게 좌회전 우회전 주행 정지를 확실하게 알려 주는 방향지시 신호기능, 그리고 그것을 리모콘 및 음성으로 작동케하는 장치, 전방 보행자등을 보호하는 인체감지센서, 유해동물 퇴치기능 및 해충퇴치기능을 탑제하여 또 다른 안전사고에서 인명의 안전을 지켜주는 장치이다.  
이 안전벨트는 허리의 크기 혹은 그 착용여건에 상관없이 모든 사람이 쉽고 간편하게 착용 가능하도록 벨트를 고안하였다. 또 이 벨트는 각 장치를 최소한의 크기와 무게로 벨트 내에 장착하기 위하여 각 장치들의 작동회로들은 IC칩으로 집약하고 연결 전선은 Flat Cable를 사용하여 벨트의 두께와 무게를 경량화 한다. 또 핸드폰에 집약된 애플리케이션을 프로그램하여 Wifi나 Bluetooth로 벨트의 각 기능들과 연결하여 벨트에 부가적인 장치들이 더하여지지 않도록 하여 자전거등 착용자들이 가볍고 간편하게 자신의 안전을 위해 사용할 수 있게  Wearable 교통방향지시 안전벨트 장치에  관한 것이다.

title_en: Demand controller with built-in arc, heat and gas sensor for danger-monitering in electric panel
title_ko: 수배전반 내부 위험감시용 아크, 열, 가스 감지센서를내장한 최대수요전력 관리장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 복합기능형 수배전반에 설치되어 전력 수용가의 최대수요전력을 제어하는 최대수요전력 관리장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세히는 최대수요전력 관리장치 내부에 아크, 열, 가스 감지센서를 구비하여 최대수요전력 관리기능에 부가하여 수배전반 내에 설치, 운전 중인 기기들의 고장 및 화재 예방기능을 효과적으로 수행하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
     상기 목적 달성을 위해서 본 발명은, 최대수요전력 관리장치 내부에; 수배전반 내부에 설치, 운전 중인 기기들의 경년 열화 및 사고로 인한 아크발생시 감지해내는 아크 감지센서; 변압기 부품의 경년 열화로 인한 급격한 권선온도 상승시 감지해내는 열 감지센서; 수배전반 내부화재시 발생하는 일산화탄소(CO) 및 이산화탄소(CO2)를 감지해 내는 가스 감지센서; 입력받은 미세신호를 사용가능한 신호로 증폭시키는 증폭부; 증폭된 아날로그 신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하는 A/D 변환부; 수배전반 내부의 위험판단을 수행하는 CPU 프로세서; 사고발생시 현장근무자에게 위험을 경고하는 경보 릴레이; 사고발생시 원방근무자에게 위험을 경고하는 위험신호 전송; 을 구비하는 것을 포함한다. 
       
     복합기능형 수배전반, 최대수요전력 관리장치, 아크 감지센서, 열 감지센서,  가스 감지센서, 증폭부, A/D 변환부, CPU 프로세서

title_en: System and method for emergency situation message system using road facility
title_ko: 도로 시설물을 이용한 긴급상황 알림 시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 시설물을 이용한 긴급상황 알림 시스템 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로서,  신고버튼, 무선AP 및 상기 신고버튼이 선택된 경우 고유정보와 함께 위급상황 발생 메시지를 송신하는 도로 시설물; 및 상기 위급상황 발생 메시지를 수신하여 상기 도로 시설물의 위치를 판단하고, 상기 무선AP의 서비스 지역 내에 위치한 이동 단말기에 긴급 안내 메시지가 송신되도록 제어하는 중앙관제서버를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 즉각 적인 조치를 취해야 하는 위급한 상황이거나, 사고 상황을 기록, 혹은, 관찰해야 하는 경우, 사고 수습을 위한 전문가가 도착하기 이전에 근접한 위치의 사용자에게 도움을 요청할 수 있다.

title_en: A mobile tritium radioactive field measurement and monitoring system
title_ko: 이동형 삼중수소 방사능 현장 측정 및 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a mobile on-site tritium radioactivity measurement and monitoring system comprising a water quality sample picking/storage tank (20), a liquid scintillator storage tank (30), a water quality sample mixing and tritium radioactivity detection unit (40), a radioactivity analysis means (50), a controller (60), a storage means (70), and a radioactivity analysis data monitoring terminal (80). According to the present invention, the mobile on-site tritium radioactivity measurement and monitoring system is small in volume and light in weight so that a worker can easily carry the mobile system. Therefore, the mobile system enables a worker to be rapidly dispatched to marine sites for accurate collection of seawater samples, detection and analysis of tritium radioactivity in the collected samples, and to perform long-term, periodic, and continuous tritium radioactivity monitoring according to the on-site conditions.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이동형 삼중수소 방사능 현장 측정 및 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 부피가 작고 가벼워 작업자가 휴대하고 이동하는데 매우 용이하여 방사능 모니터링이 요구되는 현장에 신속하게 출동하여 현장 바다로 부터 수질시료를 채취하고, 삼중수소 방사능 검출을 정확하고 신속하게 실시할 수 있으면서도 제작단가 및 유지비용이 매우 저렴하게 해수에 대한 삼중수소 방사능 모니터링을 실시할 수 있도록 하는 것이며, 그 구성은 상면에 개폐구를 갖는 저장탱크로써, 해수 내의 이물질을 필터링하는 필터장치를 갖고, 바다와 연결되어 해수를 채취하는 해수채취구와, 상기 해수채취구 상에 장착되어 바다로 부터 해수를 펌핑하는 펌프수단과, 바다와 연결되고, 저장된 해수를 방류하는 배수구와, 저장된 수질 시료를 공급하는 공급구와, 상기 배수구 상에 장착되고 배수구를 개폐하는 제1 전자변과, 상기 공급구 상에 장착되고 공급구를 개폐하는 제2 전자변을 구비하고, 바다로 부터 수질 시료를 채취하고, 채취된 수질 시료를 저장하는 수질시료 채취/저장탱크와; 상면에 개폐구를 갖는 저장탱크로써, 저장된 액체 신틸레이터를 공급하는 공급구와, 상기 공급구 상에 장착되고 공급구를 개패하는 제3 전자변을 구비하고, 수질시료와 혼합되는 액체 신틸레이터를 저장하는 액체 신틸레이터 저장탱크와; 바이알 이송수단, 삼중수소 검출수단 및 바이알트레이를 구비하고, 바이알트레이 상에 배치된 빈 바이알을 픽업하여 상기 수질시료 채취/저장탱크 내에 저장된 수질시료 및 액체 신틸레이터 저장탱크 내에 저장된 액체 신틸레이터를 바이알에 기설정된 양 만큼 각각 주입하고, 바이알에 주입된 수질시료 및 액체 신틸레이터를 혼합한 후, 바이알 내의 수질시료에 대한 삼중수소 방사능 검출을 실시하고, 삼중수소 방사능 검출이 완료된 바이알을 바이알트레이 상에 배치하는 수질시료 혼합 및 삼중수소 방사능 검출부와; 상기 수질시료 혼합 및 삼중수소 방사능 검출부의 삼중수소 방사능 검출수단으로 부터 수신되는 검출신호를 분석하는 다중채널분석기와, 상기 삼중수소 방사능 검출수단의 작동을 제어하는 컨트롤러로 구성되고, 상기 수질시료 혼합 및 삼중수소 방사능 검출부의 삼중수소 방사능 검출수단으로 부터 수신되는 검출신호를 분석하는 방사능분석수단과; 상기 수질시료 채취/저장탱크의 펌프수단와, 제1 및 제2 전자변와, 액체 신틸레이터 저장탱크의 제3 전자변와, 수질시료 혼합 및 삼중수소 방사능 검출부의 바이알 이송수단 및 삼중수소 방사능 검출수단와, 방사능분석수단과 각각 연결되고, 연결된 각 구성요소들의 작동을 제어하는 제어부와; 상기 방사능분석수단과 착탈가능하게 연결되고, 상기 방사능분석수단에서 분석된 로우데이터를 저장하는 저장수단과; 전용프로그램이 탑재된 컴퓨터로서, 상기 저장수단 내에 저장된 로우데이터를 전용프로그램 상에서 데이터베이스화하여 저장하고, 모니터로 출력하여 수질 시료에 대한 방사성 분석 데이터를 모니터링하는 방사성 분석 데이터 모니터링 단말기로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for three-dimensional interaction monitoring in an EMS environment
abstract_en: A method for tracking interactions in an emergency response environment according to embodiments of the present invention includes receiving color images and depth information from within a field of view of a sensor array; maintaining an emergency treatment receiving record; monitoring one or both of a location of the object and a motion of the object in the emergency response environment based on the color image and the depth information received by the sensor array; and recording the occurrence of the condition in an emergency encounter record, wherein the condition is based on one or both of the location of the subject and the motion of the subject.

title_en: Method and system for quickly associating police resources with cases
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for fast associating police resources with cases, wherein the fast associating method comprises the following steps: the police dispatching platform displays an electronic map of a district and displays case places of cases on the electronic map; the police dispatching platform acquires the geographic position and the on-duty state of the police resource in the district, and displays the police resource and the on-duty state at the corresponding position on an electronic map, wherein the on-duty state comprises patrol, alarm receiving and non-alarm receiving; and judging whether the touch input operation or the mouse input operation of selecting the police officer and dragging the police officer to the case place is detected, if so, establishing association between the selected police officer and the case, and selecting the selected police officer as the responsible officer of the case. The method and the system for quickly associating the police resources with the cases greatly improve the reasonability and timeliness of police resource allocation.
assignees: CHANGWEI INFORMATION TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Smart-city intelligent monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart-city intelligent monitoring system. The system is formed by a monitoring information acquisition terminal, a monitoring information processing terminal and a monitoring information response terminal. The monitoring information processing terminal comprises a central processing module, a data gathering system, a biological information database and a common safety database. The monitoring information acquisition terminal comprises a face information acquisition module, a biological infrared information acquisition module, a global eye monitoring system, a sound acquisition system, a vehicle access system, a GIS service system and a video access module. The monitoring information response terminal comprises a police alarm system, a fire-fighting alarm system, a first aid calling system and a municipal service system. In the invention, through lattice layout, full coverage to a city plane space is realized, an on-site condition can be timely and comprehensively known and bidirectional interaction of remote information can be realized. Once the system is triggered, the monitoring information acquisition terminal is directly connected to a monitoring information processing terminal and commands the monitoring information response terminal to carry out corresponding responses so that timeliness of an emergency response is guaranteed maximumly.
assignees: SUZHOU SPACEFLIGHT SYSTEM ENG CO LTD

title_en: The method of testing and system of dispatcher's inferential capability
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of method of testing and system of dispatcher's inferential capability, wherein, the method for testing of dispatcher's inferential capability includes：After the instruction for starting test is received, control shows the operation simulation picture in switchyard；EEG signals of the collection scheduling person when being scheduled test according to the operation simulation picture；And the EEG signals are subjected to frequency domain conversion, and extract corresponding frequency domain character；Record duration and the scheduling times to vehicle that the dispatcher completes scheduling tests；The frequency domain character, the dispatcher are completed into the duration of scheduling tests and input feature vector is used as to the scheduling times of vehicle, input to probability characteristics selection sort vector machine obtains probabilistic forecasting result, the inferential capability of dispatcher according to the probabilistic forecasting evaluation of result.The method of testing and system of the present invention can improve the test accuracy of dispatcher's inferential capability.

title_en: Power distribution network based on load transfer Information Matrix turns for training evaluation method
abstract_en: Turn to include for training evaluation method, this method the invention discloses a kind of power distribution network based on load transfer Information Matrix：All switches and disconnecting link information that load transfer critical field collection LTSR and load transfer actual range collection LTPR are established to be included in the range of single turn of confession after record standard operation and practical operation.Establish load transfer standard information battle array LTSI and load transfer actual information battle array LTPI with the action number of devices of all load transfers, load transfer removal of load number, responsible consumer after record standard operation and practical operation restore electricity number, turn load transfer range set associated by supplying.Turn to give based on the dispatcher's load transfer training evaluation method turned for Information Matrix for actual information battle array LTPI comparison by load transfer standard information battle array LTSI and load transfer.The evaluation method can preferably reflect the operating process of dispatcher's load transfer, have preferable practical training evaluative meaning.
assignees: INTEGRATED ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS LAB CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent shared bicycle cloud platform scheduling method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention provides a big data-based intelligent scheduling method and system for a shared bicycle cloud platform, wherein the intelligent scheduling method for the shared bicycle cloud platform comprises the following steps: step S1, drawing the divided station area; step S2, acquiring the data of the buried point of the user and recording the data into a database; step S3, counting the borrowing rate and returning rate of each hour of all stations through the buried point data; step S4, collecting weather data of each day and each hour, dividing the collected weather data into three dimensions, assigning coefficients, and storing the three dimensions into a database, wherein the three dimensions comprise wind power, air temperature and rain amount; step S5, collecting date data of each day, and carrying out dimension division on the collected date data according to date categories; step S6, calculating the cycle borrowing rate of each station; step S7, calculate the estimated demand number of periodic scheduling of the current day. The invention can timely and effectively realize the advance preparation and dispatching of the shared bicycle.

title_en: Intelligent flood automatic monitoring system for urban rail transit underground complex
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent flood automatic monitoring system for an urban rail transit underground complex, which comprises a field sensing device, a data processing device, a calculation and analysis device and a visual display device, wherein the field sensing device is connected with the data processing device; the field sensing equipment comprises a full-automatic water level flowmeter, a fiber bragg grating liquid level meter and an infrared video camera which are arranged in the comprehensive body; the field sensing equipment is arranged at an entrance and an exit at the lower part of the terrain of the complex, and the positions of an inner rail area, a water pump room, a water collecting well, a drainage ditch and/or a water collecting port of the complex; the data processing equipment comprises a water level flowmeter switch, a fiber bragg grating demodulator, a camera switch, a flood core switch and an NVR (network video recorder); the calculation and analysis equipment comprises a monitoring data analysis and calculation server and a linkage alarm, and the monitoring data analysis and calculation server and the linkage alarm are linked to early warn flood disaster information; the intelligent flood monitoring and early warning system can carry out intelligent flood monitoring and early warning in all directions and all weather, effectively carry out on-site dispatching and commanding before the flood occurs, and reduce the loss of equipment and personnel to the minimum.

title_en: Multi-college student offline combined training culture platform based on visual cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a visual cloud platform-based offline combined training and training platform for students in various colleges, which relates to the technical field of student training management and comprises a student distribution and information recording module, a training recording module, a safety management module, an exchange module and a credit evaluation module, wherein the platform randomly distributes students in training of colleges to different colleges, records the condition of the students in training, carries out roll call recording before the students start and end of training, plans the free activity range of the students, records the position of the students in real time, logs in the platform for the trainees to exchange with the students in the colleges, solves the problems, scores the completion condition of work and examination according to the training performance of the students, judges the training result as good, qualified and unqualified, and realizes the online monitoring of the condition of the students without the following of a guide when the students in the colleges are dispatched to other colleges, the resource sharing among the colleges is realized, and the training effect of the trainees is improved.

title_en: Intelligent real-time monitoring system for digital perception of whole process of dangerous waste
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital intelligent real-time sensing and intelligent real-time supervision application system for the whole process of dangerous waste, which is developed based on digital intelligent real-time sensing and data exchange of dangerous waste source head end, transfer end and treatment application end equipment; the intelligent real-time digital sensing and original record permanent tracing of the whole process of the use state, the production operation and the production amount, the intelligent generation of the collection and transportation requirements, the intelligent optimization of the transportation line, the monitoring of the transportation process, the temporary storage and the treatment application of the dangerous waste special container are realized; the whole process closed-loop supervision of the real-time digital sensing, abnormal state early warning, operation standard specification, real-time accurate recording and process source tracing of the states of all nodes such as generation, collection, handover, transfer, temporary storage, treatment application and the like is realized; the head end of the hazardous waste generating source is directly communicated with the hazardous waste disposal application end, so that the requirement of temporary storage of hazardous waste in different places is eliminated, and the efficiency of the hazardous waste disposal application end is improved; the method realizes the goals of intelligent process, manpower saving, closed-loop tracking, emergency response and management optimization.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring method for mine geological environment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent monitoring of mine environments, and discloses an intelligent monitoring method of mine geological environments, which comprises the following steps: step one, building a mine virtual model: constructing a mine virtual three-dimensional model by taking G IS system basic data as a main body, taking mine site on-site geological scanning data as auxiliary body deficiency, and taking mine geological data based on the G IS system basic data and the auxiliary body deficiency as a model basic framework; step two, monitoring network construction: dividing an actual mine area, synchronizing data of the divided area to a mine virtual three-dimensional model, and arranging vibration amplitude sensors according to the area of the divided area. The mine is monitored in a classified mode by constructing and actually monitoring a network through the mine virtual model, and the artificial intelligent neural network is used as a brain of the mine virtual model to perform earthquake focus simulation training, earthquake point linkage response training and sudden geological emergency response training, so that an intelligent monitoring mode of the mine geological environment is perfected, and the timeliness and the intelligent level of data are higher.
assignees: MINGCHUANG HUIYUAN GUIZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Elevator emergency voice video guidance method based on large model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevator safety, and discloses an elevator emergency voice video guidance method based on a large model, which comprises the following steps: emergency trigger mechanism: and an emergency trigger mechanism is established, and when an emergency occurs, the emergency trigger mechanism is activated, and an emergency voice video guidance flow is started. According to the elevator emergency voice video guidance method based on the large model, an intelligent system capable of monitoring the elevator state in real time, identifying the fault type and providing emergency voice video guidance is constructed through technologies such as artificial intelligence, large data and cloud computing, the efficiency and safety of elevator emergency response can be improved, casualties and property loss are reduced, real-time monitoring, fault identification and emergency guidance of the elevator running state are realized, and the accuracy of the large model can be continuously optimized through continuously collecting and utilizing fault records and feedback contents.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR CHAOGAOQING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD;SHANDONG INSPUR INNOVATION AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Security system
title_ko: 보안 감시 시스템
abstract_en: A security system is provided to improve an emergency state and to monitor easily an image of an emergency region by detecting easily the emergency region in case of emergency. A map information access unit accesses map information including installation regions of emergency buttons(100-1 to 100-n) from a DB(DataBase). An emergency state propagation unit(110) outputs an emergency signal including region information related to the installation regions of the emergency buttons in an operating state of the emergency buttons. An emergency region display unit detects the region information included in the emergency signal and displays the map information including the region information. A recording control unit propagates a recording control command including the detected region information to image recording devices(500-1,500-2,500-3). A monitoring image display unit outputs a monitoring image to the display unit.
