title_en: Coding training devices and systems
title_ko: 코딩 교육 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a system for training coding, in which a block corresponding to unit program command output to a display unit of the device for training the coding is dragged and dropped in a row to enable a user to easily understand the concept of the coding, a robot is controlled by executing a series of the coded command and a sense of accomplishment and motivation for the coding depending on the execution of the coding is given. One problem to be solved by proposed invention is that the block corresponding to the unit program command output to the display unit of the device for training the coding is dragged and dropped in a row to enable the user to easily understand the concept of the coding.
abstract_ko:
코딩 교육 장치의 표시부에 출력된 단위 프로그램 명령어에 대응되는 블록을 드래그 앤 드랍으로 일렬로 배치하여 쉽게 코딩의 개념을 이해할 수 있도록 하고, 코딩된 일련의 명령어를 실행하여 로봇을 제어하고 코딩 수행에 따른 성취감과 코딩에 대한 동기를 부여해주는 코딩 교육 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
제안된 발명이 해결하고자 하는 하나의 과제는 코딩 교육 장치의 표시부에 출력된 단위 프로그램 명령어에 대응되는 블록을 드래그 앤 드랍으로 일렬로 배치하여 쉽게 코딩의 개념을 이해할 수 있도록 하는 것이다.

title_en: SAFETY SYSTEM OF SUBWAY WORKERS USING LOW-POWER LONG RANGE COMMUNICATION LoRa
title_ko: 저전력 장거리 통신 LoRa를 이용한 지하철 근로자 안전 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety system for subway workers and, more specifically, to a safety system configured to safely evacuate subway workers using a low-power long range communication network (LoRa). In a system capable of preventing any accident from occurring in a subway through a LoRa (10), there is a step of recognizing an RF tag (20) using a smartphone (40) and primarily transmitting the recognized RF tag (20) to an RFID device (30). The smartphone is configured to primarily recognize the RF tag. A situation is transmitted to a central management center (50) and a subway that is in service at the same time when the situation is recognized. When the RF tag is recognized, a screen door is opened. Adversely, when a user is in an inner side of the screen door before the subway starts, the screen door is automatically opened through a system programed in the central management center, and thus, the user can safely evacuate. When the subway arrives at the previous station, the situation is transmitted to the smartphone (40) through the LoRa (10) so that it is possible to propagate the situation to the user. However, in order to prepare a case when a user does not know a notification, the central management center (50) is caused to recognize the situation so that the screen door can be automatically controlled. Therefore, it is possible to prevent any possible accident from occurring in the inner side of the screen door.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하철 근로자 안전 시스템에 관한 것이다. 더욱 상세하게는 저전력 장거리 통신망 LoRa를 이용하여 지하철 근로자를 안전하게 대피시키는 것에 관한 것이다.LoRa(10)를 통한 지하철 안전 사고 예방이 가능한 시스템에 있어서, 스마트폰(40)으로 RF태그(20)를 인식하여 RFID 장치(30)로 1차 상황 전송이 가능한 단계이다. 스마트폰은 RF태그를 먼저 인식시킨다. 인식과 동시에 중앙관리실(50)에 상황을 전달하며 운행중인 지하철에도 동시에 상황을 전달한다. 이때 RF태그에 인식을 할 경우 스크린도어가 열리나 반대로 지하철이 출발하기 전에 사용자가 스크린도어 안쪽에 있을 경우 중앙관리실에서 프로그램된 시스템을 통해 자동으로 스크린도어가 열림으로써 사용자가 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 하는 것이다. 상기 LoRa(10)을 통해 지하철이 전역에 도착할 경우 상기 스마트폰(40)으로 상황을 전송하여 사용자에게 상황을 전파가 가능하다. 하지만 사용자가 알림을 모를 경우를 대비하여 동시에 중앙관리실(50)에도 상황을 인지하도록 하여 스크린도어가 자동으로 제어 가능하게 할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 한다 이로 인해 스크린도어 안쪽에서 일어나는 사고를 사전에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: IoT Smart Fire Detection Guide System Using Existing Fire Detector
title_ko: 기존 소방감지기를 활용한 IoT 스마트 화재감지 안내시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an Internet of Things (IoT) smart fire detection guide system using an existing fire detector, to enable a customer to quickly take countermeasures when a fire occurs. According to the present invention, the IoT smart fire detection guide system using an existing fire detector comprises: a firefighting detector; a firefighting receiver; a reception panel server; a system server; a customer PC registering a drawing or web image of the inside of a building by a position of each fire detector, and registering a watching zone name, a position of the fire detector and an emergency exit, and an evacuation direction in the drawing or the web image; and a smartphone outputting, on a screen, the drawing or web image corresponding to the firefighting detector registered by the customer PC.
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제]   
본 발명은 IoT 스마트 화재감지 안내시스템에 관한 것으로, 화재가 발생할 경우 화재 발생 위치와 건물의 내부 구조를 잘 모르거나 화재 연기로 인해 비상구나 대피장소를 찾기 어려운 경우에 신속한 대피가 이루어지지 못해 인명사고가 발생하는 문제점을 해결하기 위한 것이다. 
 [해결수단]   
본 발명의 IoT 스마트 화재감지 안내시스템은, 화재를 감지하여 화재감지신호를 발생하는 소방감지기; 상기 소방감지기로부터 화재감지신호를 수신하는 소방수신기; 상기 소방수신기로부터 화재감지신호를 수신 받아 인터넷을 통해 시스템 서버로 전송하는 수신반 서버; 상기 수신반 서버로부터 화재감지신호를 수신 받아 시스템에 등록된 연락처로 상기 소방감지기 및 비상구의 위치, 대피방향이 포함된 상기 소방감지기에 해당하는 도면 경로(웹주소)를 SMS 문자, 이메일, 어플 푸쉬기능 중 적어도 하나 이상 전송하고, 안전수칙과 대응방법, 긴급전화번호를 안내하는 시스템 서버; 상기 시스템 서버에 로그인하여 상기 소방감지기의 위치별로 건물내부의 도면 또는 웹이미지를 등록하고, 상기 도면 또는 웹이미지에 경계구역명, 소방감지기 및 비상구의 위치, 대피방향을 등록하는 고객 PC; 및 상기 시스템 서버로부터 도면 경로가 포함된 SMS 문자, 이메일, 어플 푸쉬기능 중 하나 이상을 수신 받아 상기 도면 경로를 클릭하면 상기 고객 PC에서 등록한 상기 소방감지기에 해당하는 도면 또는 웹이미지가 화면에 출력되는 스마트폰;을 포함한다. 
 [기대효과]   
본 발명에 따르면, 별도의 센서 구입이나 재설치 없이 기존의 소방감지기를 활용하여 적은 비용으로 도입할 수 있고, 화재발생 시 신속하게 대처가 가능하다.

title_en: system for opening/closing common entrance door
title_ko: 공동현관 출입문 개폐 지원시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a common entrance door opening and closing support system and comprises: a deliverer terminal used by a deliverer to accept a delivery service and perform delivery; a delivery support server for providing delivery application list information to the deliverer terminal connected through a communication network, processing a delivery acceptance application received from the deliverer terminal, and transmitting temporary visitor information to the deliverer terminal; and a common entrance switch for opening and closing a common entrance, receiving a temporary password included in the temporary visitor information received through Bluetooth communication from the deliverer terminal in accordance with a transmission rule, opening a common entrance if a temporary password input through an input unit matches the received temporary password, and recording the temporary visitor information in a memory unit. According to the common entrance door opening and closing support system, it is possible to easily support the entry and exit of a deliverer and record the history of a visitor, thereby checking and utilizing visitor information in the event of a fire or other accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동현관 출입문 개폐 지원시스템에 관한 것으로서, 배달 서비스를 수락 및 배달을 수행하는 배달원이 이용하는 배달원 단말기와, 통신망을 통해 접속된 배달원 단말기로 배달 신청된 리스트 정보를 제공하고, 배달원 단말기로부터 수신된 배달수락 신청을 처리하며, 배달원 단말기로 임시 출입자 정보를 전송하는 배달지원서버와, 공동현관문의 개폐를 수행하고, 배달원 단말기로부터 블루투스 통신을 통해 수신된 임시 출입자정보에 포함된 임시비밀번호가 전달규칙에 맞게 수신되고, 입력부를 통해 입력된 임시비밀번호가 수신된 임시 비밀번호와 일치하면  공동현관문이 개방되게 처리하고, 임시 출입자 정보를 기억부에 기록처리하는 공동현관 개폐기를 구비한다. 이러한 공동현관 출입문 개폐 지원시스템에 의하면, 배달원의 출입을 용이하게 지원하면서 출입자 이력을 기록해놓을 수 있어 화재 또는 그 밖의 사고 발생시 출입자 정보를 확인하여 활용할 수 있는 장점을 제공한다.

title_en: Scoring server
abstract_en: A scoring server for assessing technical skills in a practical environment. A client application acts as a middle man between a terminal and an operating system to capture and forward all input from and output to students to the scoring server. The scoring server compares recorded student activity against a list of tasks deemed capable of accomplishing course objectives assigned to students. As objectives are met by a student, the students' grade is updated in real-time. Each student passes or fails an exam based on tasks performed and skills employed. The client application exists for two operating system types: windows and LINUX. A LINUX client employs a pseudoterminal to permit access to terminal input/output and communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr channels. A windows client (WC) comprises a WC command line activity logger and a WC monitor process to intercept all communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr communication channels.

title_en: Big data-based energy management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy management, and particularly discloses an energy management method and system based on big data. The invention divides a plurality of management sub-road sections; determining a plurality of networking street lamps and a plurality of local street lamps, and constructing local communication connection; based on a big data technology, navigation record data are acquired, and vehicle passing data of a plurality of management sub-road sections are periodically predicted; matching an energy gear instruction; and according to the multiple energy gear commands, adjusting the illumination gear. The navigation record data can be acquired based on a big data technology, the vehicle passing data is periodically predicted, the energy gear instruction is generated, the illumination gear adjustment is carried out on a plurality of management sub-road sections, a large number of sensing devices are not needed to be additionally arranged, the energy management cost of street lamp illumination is effectively reduced, good illumination environment can be provided for the farther front of the vehicle due to the adjustment of the plurality of management sub-road sections, and illumination energy management adjustment of different gears can be carried out according to different vehicle passing data.

title_en: Apparatus for presenting scene of marine accident area using unmanned aerial vehicle, method thereof and computer recordable medium storing program to perform the method
title_ko: 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장의 영상을 제공하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장의 영상을 제공하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 이러한 본 발명은 무인항공기와 통신하기 위한 통신부와, 소정 지역을 상기 무인항공기의 통신 범위에 따라 규격이 결정되는 정각기둥 형상의 복수의 셀로 구분하며, 복수의 셀 중 탐색 지역으로 지정된 셀과 상기 관제장치가 위치한 셀을 셀 단위로 연결했을 때, 최단 경로에 속하는 적어도 하나의 셀을 도출하고, 상기 도출된 셀을 네트워크를 구성할 셀로 설정하며, 상기 도출된 셀 각각에 대해 무인항공기를 배정하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 관제장치와, 이에 따른 방법과, 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: System and method for analysis and visualization of incident data
abstract_en: An apparatus for analyzing grouped incidents belongs to a group having the group (grouped incidents, grouped sources, a grouped incident tag) and group interface (grouped incidents panel, a group visualization panel). The group visualization panel has an incident visualization panel. The incident visualization panel has an incidents area displaying an incident graphic visually representative of the incident information of the grouped incidents during an incident display period, an incident display period user control allowing the user to change the incident display period, an incident tag user control enabling the user to select the group incident tag to be a visible incident tag or to be a hidden incident tag, and a group timeline panel having a timeline sequence graphic representing a sequence of the grouped incidents and a display period graphic highlighting a portion of the timeline sequence graphic corresponding to the incident display period.

title_en: One kind simulation mixing tank experimental provision
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of simulation mixing tank experimental provision, including aluminium frame and control board, and simulating drawing board is embedded in aluminium frame, provided with charactron, dispaly state LED, LED light post, LED annulus, binding post etc. on simulating drawing board；Control board includes 1# singlechip control panels, 2# singlechip control panels, LED light post control panel, LED charactron control panels；Experimental provision receives PLC or industrial control computer（Hereinafter referred to as industrial computer）The control command of output, simulates the phenomenons such as the change of mixing tank liquid level, temperature change, mixing speed change, the switch of electrically operated valve, then feeds back to PLC or industrial computer by the output of switching value and analog quantity, realizes closed loop feedback control effect.The present apparatus truly reflects the actual process process of mixing tank, timeliness, interesting strong, can mobilizing students learning interest, it is easy to use, occupy little space, be adapted to the real one teaching of reason while make simple.
assignees: JILIN TEACHERS' INSTITUTE OF ENGINEERING & TECH

title_en: A kind of vehicle-mounted hard disk videocorder
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of vehicle-mounted hard disk videocorder, including central control unit, input-output unit and power subsystem.Central control unit includes central processing unit, DDR3, SPI NOR/NAND Flash and network PHY; input-output unit includes audio frequency and video A/D modular converters, audio Codec, display, SATA hard disc, USB HUB and CAN module, and power subsystem includes power transfer module, lifting die block and power source protective module.The utility model can support multi-channel sound video input, the transport condition and various emergency situations of monitoring in real time and record road vehicle, realize user and the information mutual communication of scheduling, advantageously ensured the ability of quick processing accident and emergency command.

title_en: Alarm short massage service system for space environment disaster incidents
abstract_en: The invention provides an alarm short massage service system for space environment disaster incidents. The system is an alarm short massage implementation service system for the space environment disaster incidents based on space environment monitoring data. The system comprises a mode computing subsystem, a short message preparation subsystem, a short massage management subsystem, a short message sending subsystem and a data storage system, wherein the mode computing subsystem is used for generating warning information of the space environment disaster incidents on the basis of the space environment monitoring data and disturbance of space environment factors; the short message preparation subsystem is used for monitoring a warning information storage table of the space environment disaster incidents in real time and generating alarm messages; the short massage management subsystem is used for mobile phone user management and short massage sending record management; the short message sending subsystem is used for monitoring a space environment disaster incident short massage information storage table of a data storage subsystem in real time and sending information in the storage table to users in a short massage mode; and the data storage system is used for storing and managing required data of normal operation of the short massage service system for the space environment disaster incidents. The invention further provides a mid-value based filtering method.
assignees: CT SPACE SCI & APPLIED RES CAS

title_en: Emergency rescue system and using method thereof, emergency data compressing method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication, and specifically provides an emergency rescue system comprising a transmitter used by the user, and a receiving station erected at a fixed position, wherein the system may comprise one or more receiving stations which are determined according to the range required to be covered, and the transmitter is carried along with the user and used for contacting with the group and performing rescue in emergency circumstances. When the user is in emergency circumstance, the transmitter sends out own position information, and the receiving station receives a distress signal, determines the position of the distress signal, instruct a command center to perform rescue, and thereby achieving the emergency rescue; and meanwhile, via the position of the receiving station, the transmitted position information can be converted into a polar coordinate from a GPS coordinate, thus the transmission data size is reduced, the transmission reliability and timeliness are ensured, and the user safety is ensured.
assignees: XI'AN TUOQI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting monitoring and early-warning platform and method combined with Internet of things
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent fire-fighting monitoring and early-warning platform and method combined with the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting early-warning, wherein the intelligent fire-fighting monitoring and early-warning platform comprises the steps of determining a location type and excavating related combustible matters and related explosive matters through intelligent building space and a dangerous source, and establishing a fire-fighting risk mapping table; the method comprises the steps of determining a first edge computing node set according to the influence range of a fire scene based on a distributed computing core, determining a second edge computing node set according to the spreading path of the fire scene, configuring an edge computing network, and establishing a fire emergency response mechanism based on the edge computing network. According to the application, the technical problems of low crowd evacuation efficiency and confusion caused by incapability of accurately setting an adaptive crowd evacuation strategy due to incapability of rapidly analyzing and processing fire monitoring data in the traditional fire monitoring and early warning method can be solved, and the crowd evacuation efficiency and safety can be remarkably improved, so that the timeliness and accuracy of fire emergency response are improved.
assignees: JIANGSU NIT SMART SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest and town boundary domain fire spread simulation method based on space-time semantic driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of semantic modeling, and focuses on a forest and town boundary domain fire spread simulation method based on space-time semantic driving. Aiming at the complexity of fire spread in a forest and town boundary area (WUI), the method creatively introduces a space-time semantic driving mechanism on the basis of a traditional fire spread model, combines the characteristics of the WUI area, and solves the defects of the traditional simulation method in the aspects of accuracy, timeliness and adaptability to complex environments. The method comprises the steps of constructing a WUI fire spreading model based on cellular automaton, constructing a WUI fire scene simulation knowledge meta model and a knowledge map, and constructing a fire space-time semantic query and simulation framework. According to the invention, by fusing semantic information of time and space dimensions, the spreading path and speed of the fire disaster under different terrains, building distribution and meteorological conditions can be more accurately simulated, a more reliable decision basis is provided for fire disaster prevention, emergency response and resource allocation, and the fire disaster prevention and control capability of the border area of forests and towns is effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING ACADEMY OF SCIENCE AND TECH

title_en: Local disaster prevention digital radio broadcast system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the problem that in a conventional local disaster prevention digital radio broadcast system, there is no other free slot available so that only single broadcast is allowed at a time because five of six slots including a control channel are used for public-address.  <P>SOLUTION: Public-address receivers 3 and 5 include memory devices 31 and 51 for recoding voice. Home receivers 4 and 6 include memory devices 41 and 61 for recording voice. Voice information with different contents are respectively recorded in the memory devices 31, 41, 51 and 61. A control signal transmitted from master station radio equipment 2 reproduces the voice recorded in the memory devices 31, 41, 51 and 61 according to a command from a console panel 1. Then, the local disaster prevention digital radio broadcast system can simultaneously perform voice broadcast with different contents to each home receiver without causing line shortage.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: A system of preventing a human-accident with a pressure sensor for a vehicle
title_ko: 압력 센서를 구비한 자동차용 인명 사고 방지 시스템
abstract_en: A system for preventing accidents in a vehicle, which is equipped with a pressure sensor, is provided to ensure the safety of a passenger when the passenger is detected from the vehicle in an ignition off state of the vehicle. A system for preventing human accidents in a vehicle comprises as follows. A headrest pressure sensor(11a) for measuring the pressure applied from a passenger to a headrest(11). A seatback pressure sensor(13a) measures the pressure applied from the passenger to a seatback(13). A seat pressure sensor(15a) measures the pressure applied from the passenger to a seat(15). An analog process module converts pressure data, which are detected by the headrest pressure sensor, the seatback pressure sensor and the seat pressure sensor, into digital data. A body control module controls the operation of a warning alarm and a window(51).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 압력센서를 구비한 자동차용 인명 사고 방지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 주행중의 탑승자를 보호하는 전장 시스템과 더불어 미주행시에도 발생하는 탑승자의 안전을 위하여 미주행시 시스템이 동작함으로써, 탑승자의 탑승을 감지하며, 위험 사항을 판단하여 운전자에게 알람 경고 및 위험 상황을 알려 인명 사고를 방지하고, 미주행 상태에서의 탑승자의 잔류가 감지될 시, 자동적으로 차량 내부 상태 감시 모드가 구동됨으로써, 위험 임계치에 도달할 시, 바디 컨트롤 모듈에서 내부 경고음 발생 및 위험 상태 회피를 위한 도어 모터 액츄에이터를 구동시켜 도어의 윈도우 다운을 제어하고, 좌석에 압력센서를 구비 및 소프트 웨어의 추가로 안전 사고를 방지할 수 있는 저비용 고효율의 압력센서를 구비한 자동차용 인명 사고 방지 시스템을 제공하기 위한 것으로서, 그 기술적 구성은 자동차의 실내 온도를 측정하는 내기 온도 센서를 포함하는 자동차용 인명 사고 방지 시스템에 있어서, 좌석의 머리받이에 구비되어 승객으로부터 압박되는 머리받이의 압력을 측정하는 머리받이 압력센서; 좌석의 등받이에 구비되어 승객으로부터 압박되는 등받이의 압력을 측정하는 등받이 압력센서; 좌석의 시트에 구비되어 승객으로부터 압박되는 시트의 압력을 측정하는 시트 압력 센서; 상기 머리받이 압력센서, 등받이 압력센서 및 시트 압력 센서로부터 감지된 압력 데이터를 디지털 데이터로 변경시키는 아날로그 프로세스 모듈; 그리고 상기 아날로그 프로세스 모듈로부터 상기 내기 온도 센서의 센서값 및 머리받이 압력 센서, 등받이 압력센서, 및 시트 압력센서의 센서 값으로 알람 및 도어의 도어의 윈도우의 구동을 제어하는 바디 컨트롤 모듈;을 바람직하게 포함하여 이루어짐으로써, 상기 내기 온도 센서 및 상기 각 압력센서로부터 감지된 데이터로 승객의 탑승 여부를 감지하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     인명 사고 방지 시스템, 압력센서, 아날로그 프로세스 모듈(Analog Process Module), 바디 컨트롤 모듈(Body Control Module,BCM), 공조 시스템

title_en: Apparatus and method for controling power quality with a blackbox, and apparatus for analyzing consumption of electric power by load
title_ko: 블랙박스 기능을 갖춘 전력 품질 관리 장치 및 방법, 그리고 부하별 전력 사용량 분석 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An electricity quality control device, a method thereof, and a power usage analysis device thereof are provided to handle power quality by informing a manager of the sensed information in real time. CONSTITUTION: A sensor(100,102,104,106,108) senses the state of a power line. A sensing part(110,112,114,116,118) generates sensing information by collecting information from the sensor. An inner temperature sensor senses self inner temperature compared to the sensing information. A data recorder(180) stores the sensing information. A controller(150) disconnects power inputted to a load according to the sensing information. The controller protects saved information by supplying a disconnection command which disconnects the sensing information and power. A switch part disconnects at least one connection between the data recorder and the load according to the disconnection command.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 블랙박스 기능을 갖춘 전력 품질 관리 장치 및 방법, 그리고 부하별 전력 사용량 분석 장치를 제공한다. 
     이를 위해, 전력 품질 관리 장치에는, 센서로부터 감지한 정보를 취합하여 자체 내 저장된 알람 한계치와 비교하여 알람 한계치 이상이면 감지 정보를 생성하는 감지부와, 감지 정보와 비교되는 자체 내부 온도를 감지하는 내부 온도 센서부와, 감지 정보를 저장하는 기록 저장부와, 감지 정보의 발생에 따라 부하쪽으로 입력되는 전력을 차단하도록 명령하고, 내부 온도 센서부로부터 감지된 자체 내부 온도를 전송받아 미리 설정된 기준 온도와 비교하여 더 높으면 기록 저장부쪽으로 입력되는 감지 정보 및 전력을 차단하도록 차단 명령을 하여 저장된 정보를 보호하는 제어부와, 차단 명령에 따라 차단 명령에 따라 기록 저장부 및 부하쪽과의 중 적어도 하나의 연결을 차단하는 스위치 수단 등이 포함된다.  
     본 발명에 의하면, 기록 저장부에 화재의 원인에 대한 효과적인 감지 및 그에 따른 감지 정보를 안정적으로 기록함으로써, 화재 발생 후 원인 분석을 수행하는데 효과적이다. 
     
     화재, 전력, 과전류, 누설, 알람, 전원

title_en: Apparatus, method and computer-readable storage medium for electronic voting based on homomorphic encryption technology through blockchain network
title_ko: 블록체인 네트워크를 통한 동형 암호 기술 기반의 전자 투표 서비스 서버, 방법, 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention provides a service server capable of providing quick and accurate statistical analysis results. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the service server for providing an electronic voting service executes: an operation of acquiring a voting generation request including information on a voting issue; an operation of invoking a smart contract including a digital command of a rule for generating a block or a transaction consisting of first information including homomorphically encrypted personal information of a voter participating in the voting issue and second information including the voting content of the voter in an identifiable form; and an operation of controlling the smart contract to generate a transaction or a block consisting of the first information and the second information based on voting information including personal information and voting content when the voter generates voting information or performing a node role of a right for generating the block.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 전자 투표 서비스를 제공하는 서비스 서버는 투표 사안에 관한 정보를 포함하는 투표 생성 요청을 획득하는 동작, 상기 투표 사안에 참여하는 유권자의 개인 정보가 동형 암호화되어 포함되는 제1 정보 및 상기 유권자의 투표 내용이 식별 가능한 형태로 포함되는 제2 정보로 구성된 트랜잭션 또는 블록을 생성하는 규약의 디지털 명령어를 포함하는 스마트 컨트랙트를 상기 블록체인 네트워크에 발동시키는 동작 및 상기 유권자가 개인 정보 및 투표 내용을 포함하는 투표 정보를 생성하면, 상기 투표 정보를 기초로 상기 제1 정보 및 상기 제2 정보로 구성된 트랜잭션 또는 블록이 생성되도록 상기 스마트 컨트랙트를 제어하거나, 또는 상기 블록을 생성하는 권한의 노드 역할을 수행하는 동작을 실행한다.

title_en: Reversing object manipulations in association with a walkthrough for an application or online service
abstract_en: Disclosed are examples of systems, apparatus, methods and computer program products for reversing object manipulations in association with a walkthrough for an application or online service. A first state of resources associated with the walkthrough can be recorded in a database of a database system. Input can be received to perform an interaction command with one or more demonstration objects associated with the walkthrough. The one or more demonstration objects can be caused to be manipulated in response to the input. The object manipulation can change the resources from the first state to a second state. The second state can be recorded in the database of the database system. Actions can be determined to reverse the object manipulation to return the resources to the first state. The determined actions can be caused to be performed.

title_en: Method and apparatus for handling citizen callback of a public-safety officer
abstract_en: In order to address the above-mentioned need, a method for routing civilian calls to an associated public-safety officer is provided herein. During operation, a call processor receives a civilian call having a source identifier number identifying a source of the call and a target identifier number identifying a target of the call. A current status priority of the associated public-safety officer is determined as a function of the current assignment status, and when the current status priority is less than the incident record priority, the civilian call is routed directly to a mobile device associated with the associated public-safety officer. When the current status priority is greater than the incident record priority, the civilian call is routed directly to one of a public-safety answering point or an automated voice mail system.

title_en: Systems and methods for patient-managed medical records and information
abstract_en: A system and methods for managing a patient's medical records and information that use a portable memory device that securely stores the patient's medical records and information. The portable memory device is formatted for designated access by the patient and third parties, wherein access requires authentication and verification by designated persons in non-emergencies, or by security override in emergency situations. The system and methods for managing a patient's medical records and information can be used at a patient's home, at the patient's physician's office, hospital, or pharmacy, and by emergency response team personnel. The system and methods can use home software designed for use on the patient's home computer or a computer designated by the patient for managing the patient's medical records and information. The patient's physician's office, hospital, or pharmacy, and emergency response team personnel use devices designed to interface with the portable storage device to view, print, and update the patient's medical records and information.

title_en: Virus spread prevention game device
title_ko: 바이러스 확산 방지 게임 장치
abstract_en: Provided is a virus spread prevention game method implemented by using a virus spread prevention game device. The method comprises: a first step of providing at least one user with a game board, at least one virus prevention robot located on an edge area of the game board, a virus robot located inside the game board, and a game method image; a second step of providing the user with a learning model building program so that an action command model is built, wherein the action command model is trained to set at least one of a direction change and a movement distance of the virus prevention robot based on a command image generated by a camera; and a third step of allowing the user to play the virus spread prevention game using the built-up action command model, wherein the virus spread prevention game includes operation of the virus prevention robot through the built-up action command model so as to prevent the virus robot located in the game board from moving to the outside of the game board for a certain time period and the user operates the virus prevention robot by causing the camera to recognize a written command text. The game device is capable of improving the effect and quality of coding education.
abstract_ko: 바이러스 확산 방지 게임 장치를 이용한 바이러스 확산 방지 게임 방법이 제공된다. 상기 방법은 상기 게임판, 상기 게임판의 모서리 영역에 위치한 적어도 하나의 바이러스 방역 로봇, 상기 게임판의 내부에 위치한 바이러스 로봇 및 상기 게임 방법 영상을 적어도 하나의 사용자에게 제공하는 제1 단계; 상기 학습 모델 구축 프로그램을 상기 사용자에 제공하여 동작 명령 모델을 구축하는 제2 단계로서, 상기 동작 명령 모델은 상기 카메라에서 생성된 명령 이미지에 기초하여 상기 바이러스 방역 로봇의 방향 전환 및 이동 거리 중 적어도 하나를 설정하도록 학습되는, 제2 단계; 및 상기 사용자가 상기 구축된 동작 명령 모델을 바이러스 확산 방지 게임을 수행하는 제3 단계로서, 상기 바이러스 확산 방지 게임은 일정 시간 동안 상기 게임판의 내부에 위치한 바이러스 로봇이 상기 게임판의 외부로 이동되지 못하도록 상기 바이러스 방역 로봇을 상기 구축된 동작 명령 모델을 통해 조작하는 것을 포함하며, 상기 사용자는 작성한 명령 문자를 카메라에 인식시켜 상기 바이러스 방역 로봇을 조작하는, 제3 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Multiple robot control device, method for controlling movement paths of multiple robots according to emergency commands, system and program
title_ko: 다수의 로봇 제어 장치, 비상 명령에 따라 다수의 로봇의 이동 경로를 제어하는 방법, 시스템 및 프로그램
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 유동적인 이동경로 정보를 이용한 다수 무인이동체 제어장치는 메모리, 상기 메모리와 통신을 수행하는 적어도 하나의 프로세서 및 다수 무인이동체 및 사용자 단말과 통신을 수행하는 통신모듈을 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 사용자 단말로부터 작업 명령을 수신하면, 상기 다수 무인이동체 각각의 목적지 정보 및 상기 목적지에 도달하기 위한 복수의 경유지 정보를 기초로 목적지까지 최단 이동경로를 판단하여 이동경로 정보를 생성하고, 상기 다수 무인이동체의 이동공간에 대한 탑뷰 이미지 데이터, 상기 작업에 대응되는 미션 정보 및 생성된 상기 이동경로 정보를 미리 결정된 주기로 상기 다수 무인이동체 각각에 전송하고, 상기 다수 무인이동체 각각과 상기 통신모듈의 통신이 단절되면, 상기 무인이동체는 통신 단절 이전 시점에 수신한 복수의 상기 이동경로 정보를 기초로 상기 목적지까지 이동하도록 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Operation and maintenance automatic system suitable for disaster recovery center
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation and maintenance automation system suitable for a disaster recovery center, which comprises a data storage, a system function, a front-end interface and an external interface, wherein the data storage is used for storing data; the data storage comprises the following steps: the operation data, the performance data and the alarm data information collected in the third-party operation and maintenance automation system are collected and recorded into six resource libraries in an interface mode, and the information which is not provided by the existing system, including log data and information system performance data, is collected through a collection technology, so that a bottom layer data support is provided for an alarm center, a configuration management module, a deployment management module and a diagnosis analysis module. In the invention, the system can effectively promote the optimization of a future 'dispatching, transporting and detecting' system of the disaster recovery center by researching and developing a set of automatic alarming, deploying, configuring and operating diagnosis tools which are suitable for the information operation and maintenance reality of the disaster recovery center and developing the performance monitoring, reliability monitoring, automatic deploying and automatic configuring of business application through the tools.
assignees: GREAT POWER SCIENCE AND TECH STOCK CO LTD STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CORPORATION;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Super heuristic ant colony optimization method for green distribution process of chain bakeries
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ultra-heuristic ant colony optimization method for a green distribution process of a chain bakery, which comprises the following steps: determining a low-carbon scheduling model of a chain bakery distribution process; and (3) designing an optimal scheduling method based on a hyper-heuristic ant colony algorithm to optimize an objective function with the lowest carbon emission in a scheduling model. According to the invention, the dispatching model of the green distribution process of the chain bakeries is determined, so that the process expression of dispatching two-stage vehicles is clear and definite; in a high-level strategy domain stage of the algorithm, a pheromone matrix and a heuristic function matrix are provided, and block sequences and block position information of high-quality individuals are recorded at the same time, so that global search is effectively guided; in the low-level problem domain stage of the algorithm, 9 local operators conforming to the problem features are designed to search the problem solution space deeply to enhance the algorithm performance, and meanwhile, the nearest neighbor rule and the random rule are adopted for population initialization to generate individuals so as to effectively ensure the quality of the population and avoid the individuals from being too concentrated.

title_en: Pre-hospital medical first-aid information system based on 5G
abstract_en: The application provides a 5G-based pre-hospital medical first-aid information system, which comprises: the vehicle-mounted terminal system comprises a vehicle-mounted terminal, a vehicle event data recorder, 5G individual equipment, a camera, a gateway and medical equipment which are arranged in a 5G ambulance, and is used for realizing information acquisition of video images, audio data, geographic position positioning and medical data, and the acquired information is sent to a command center by the 5G gateway; and the command center is used for performing resource supervision, monitoring and early warning, analysis decision making, command scheduling, remote consultation and emergency assessment. The application realizes the seamless connection and data communication fusion of the flow of pre-hospital first aid, intra-hospital first aid and inter-hospital cooperation, and achieves the purposes of system connection, service digitization and first aid intellectualization. The application support coverage range is expanded transversely to the edge, the application support professionality and intellectualization are deepened longitudinally to the bottom, and the informatization application support for three business fields of intelligent emergency medical treatment, intelligent emergency service and intelligent emergency management is realized.

title_en: All-weather motor-driven emergency command and dispatch system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an all-weather mobile emergency command and dispatch system which is connected through a plurality of preset communication modes, so that stable and reliable communication can be ensured when disasters occur, and the problem of unsmooth communication caused by the damage of a traditional communication network is avoided. Various dispatching terminal equipment can support the acquisition of field data and the transmission of information, and the collection of information and the capability of commanding and dispatching can be enhanced by combining the commanding and dispatching functions of the cloud platform, so that the efficiency and the accuracy of emergency treatment are improved. The arrangement of the maneuvering emergency system enables resources to be rapidly deployed to disaster areas, and meanwhile, through command and dispatch of the cloud platform, collaborative cooperation and efficient utilization of the resources can be achieved, and the problem that traditional resource allocation is difficult is solved. The application of the dispatching terminal equipment enables field personnel to better receive command dispatching instructions and record field conditions, and improves the efficiency and safety of field command.
assignees: BEIJING QISHAN CHUANGZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency direct-reporting quick response system, method and program product
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer application, in particular to a system, a method and a program product for directly reporting and quick response to an emergency. The system comprises a business processing subsystem and a cockpit subsystem; the service processing subsystem comprises an information end, a management end and a command end; the information terminal is used for reporting, continuing to report and editing and viewing event/risk information; the management end is used for approving and associating the events/risks, carrying out state management, carrying out statistical analysis on the approved events/risks, and sending out early warning, requesting collaboration and triggering wholesale aiming at the events/risks; the command end is used for checking the details of the triggered event/risk and carrying out wholesale; the system is used for checking and editing the wholesale information and analyzing and displaying all reported events/risks; the cockpit subsystem is used for continuously monitoring events/risks and recording important nodes; the method is used for visually displaying various information and accessing other platform data. The technical scheme can improve the quality effects of information reporting and response treatment of the emergency.
assignees: CHONGQING DANGZHENG SPECIAL COMMUNICATION SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Intelligent collision detection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of radar detection, in particular to an intelligent collision detection method and system, comprising the following steps: setting an initial emission angle of the radar, monitoring a reflected signal in the movement of an object, recording the return time, calculating the reflection distance according to the speed of light and the time, adjusting the emission angle to optimize the coverage range, and obtaining angle correction data. According to the invention, the position of an object can be more accurately determined by recording the return time of the reflected signal in real time and calculating the reflection distance by utilizing the light speed and the time difference, the adaptability to a dynamic environment is enhanced by iteratively optimizing a scanning path, the potential collision risk can be more accurately predicted and identified by updating the target track information, the intelligent judgment of the risk level and the adjustment of emergency response measures are carried out, the response efficiency and the accuracy of an early warning system are improved, the function of the collision detection system is enhanced, the traffic safety is obviously improved, and the potential accident risk is reduced.

title_en: Rail transit junction emergency regulation and control method and system based on real-time simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rail transit junction emergency control method and system based on real-time simulation, which relate to the technical field of intelligent transportation and rail transit emergency management and comprise the steps of performing time synchronization processing on real-time passenger flow data and train running state data to generate a junction state data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-level simulation model, simulating a passenger flow distribution evolution process by presetting passenger flow evacuation behaviors and train operation constraint conditions, positioning capacity limiting nodes in each evacuation path based on an output result of the multi-level simulation model by adopting a bottleneck recognition algorithm, calculating passenger flow bearing capacity, generating optimal path regulation parameters aiming at shortest evacuation time, converting the optimal path regulation parameters into a train automatic control system instruction and a passenger flow guiding display instruction, and transmitting the train automatic control system instruction and the passenger flow guiding display instruction to each line control unit by a hub centralized dispatching system to regulate train operation frequency and passenger flow evacuation direction. The invention realizes the intellectualization and the coordination of the emergency control of the rail transit junction.
assignees: JIANGSU TIANKUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency broadcast scheduling command platform
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency broadcast scheduling command platform which comprises an audio and video acquisition module, an emergency exercise management module, a broadcast scheduling command module and a broadcast execution module, wherein the audio and video acquisition module is used for acquiring on-site audio and video data in real time, analyzing the audio and video data based on an integrated AI model, identifying existing abnormal events, the emergency exercise management module is used for issuing exercise tasks, receiving exercise result data corresponding to the exercise tasks and on-line review results, constructing unit emergency capability portraits, the broadcast scheduling command module is used for determining basic abnormal parameters of the abnormal events and determining an emergency broadcast scheduling strategy for the abnormal events in combination with the unit emergency capability portraits, and the broadcast execution module is used for controlling broadcast equipment to play corresponding emergency broadcast contents to the abnormal events on site based on the emergency broadcast scheduling strategy. The timeliness, accuracy and overall coordination of emergency response are improved, human intervention errors are reduced, and the processing efficiency of emergency events is enhanced.

title_en: Environmental radiation monitoring system that is capable of measuring dose rate of natural and artificial radioisotope
title_ko: 방사성 핵종별 선량률 측정이 가능한 환경방사능감시시스템
abstract_en: An environmental radiation monitoring system is provided to compare and analyze dose rate of artificial radioisotope as well as that of natural radioisotope. An environmental radiation monitoring system comprises a scintillator detector(11), a photomultiplier tube(12), a high voltage device(13), an amplifier(14), a multi-channel analyzer(15), and a monitor(16). The scintillator detector is configured to measure energy of gamma rays, and emits beams proportional to the measured energy of the gamma rays. The photomultiplier tube is physically connected to the scintillator detector to convert the beam emitted by the scintillator detector into an electric signal. The high voltage is electrically connected to the scintillator detector to feed high voltage to the scintillator detector. The amplifier is electrically connected to the photomultiplier tube to rectify and amplify the electric signal come from the scintillator detector. The multi-channel analyzer is electrically connected to the amplifier to record and compare information on radiation projected into the scintillator detector so that the energy of the radiation corresponds to the size of the electric signal received by the amplifier. The monitor is electrically connected to the multi-channel analyzer to display data received from the multi-channel analyzer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방사성 핵종별 선량률 측정이 가능한 환경방사능 감시시스템에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 환경중의 방사선 준위와 핵종별 선량률 기여분을 측정하여 원자력 발전소의 사고나 환경 중의 방사선 이상 유무를 감시하고 판단하기 위한 방사성 핵종별 선량률 측정이 가능한 환경방사능 감시시스템을 제공하는 것이고, 다른 목적은 방사성핵종의 에너지스펙트럼을 측정한 후 스펙트럼의 피크(peak)로부터 방사성핵종의 선량률 기여분을 평가하고 인공방사선 및 자연방사선의 선량률을 비교하고 분석할 수 있는 방사성 핵종별 선량률 측정이 가능한 환경방사능 감시시스템을 제공하는 것이며, 그 구성은 감마선의 에너지를 측정하고, 그 측정된 에너지에 비례하는 광을 방출하는 섬광체검출기와; 상기 섬광체검출기와 물리적으로 연결되어 상기 섬광체검출기로부터 발생한 광을 전기신호로 변환하는 광전자증배관과; 상기 광전자증배관과 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 광전자증배관으로 고전압을 공급하는 고전압장치와; 상기 광전자증배관과 전기적으로 연결되어, 상기 광전자증배관으로부터 수신되는 전기신호를 정형 및 증폭하는 증폭기와; 상기 증폭기와 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 증폭기로부터 수신되는 전기신호의 크기를 방사선의 에너지와 대응하도록 섬광체검출기 내로 입사한 방사선 정보를 기록 및 비교분석하는 다중채널파고분석기와; 상기 다중채널파고분석기와 전기적으로 연결되어 상기 다중채널파고분석기로부터 수신되는 데이터를 디스플레이하는 모니터로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Real-time video surveillance system
title_ko: 실시간 영상보안 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A real-time video security system is provided to minimize the damage of the property or the human life in an emergency by the implementation of the real-time video security. CONSTITUTION: A real-time video security system includes sensors, a CCTV(Closed Circuit Television)(20), a DVR(Digital Video Recorder)(30), an IDC(Internet Data Center)(40), a control PC(50), a subscriber mobile phone(60) and an internet(70). The system transmits the sensed abnormal signal of the DVR motion sensor to the control PC through the internet. The system transmits the sensed video of the DVR to the control PC thorugh the IDC.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 종래의 영상보안 시스템이 관제실이나 가입자가 DVR(Digital Video Recorder 이하 DVR)을 이용하여 녹화된 영상을 추후에 보거나 증거자료로 이용하거나 아니면 DVR 서버에 접속하여 현장의 화면을 확인 하였으나, 무인경보기가 탑재된 DVR(30)를 이용하여 실시간으로 무인경보기가 탑재된 DVR(30)가 관제실 PC(50)와 가입자의 모바일 폰(60)에 직접 동영상을 전송해 외부침입이나 화재경보 가스 누출 등을 통보하는 방법이다. 
     더욱 상세히는 실내나 건물에 외부에서 무단으로 침입할 경우나 화재발생 및 가스누출을 각종 감지센서(10)를 통하여, 무단침입, 화재, 가스누출 여부를 감지하여 이상발생시, 인터넷망(20)을 이용하여 IDC(Internet Data Center 이하 IDC)(40)로 동영상을 전송하고 , IDC의 서버는 DVR(30)로부터 받은 동영상을 관제실 PC(50)와 가입자의 모바일 폰(60)으로 전송하며, DVR에 함께 장착된 무인경보기(30)는 역시 인터넷망(70)을 이용하여 관제실의 PC(50)로 텍스트 신호를 보내 무인경비 회사의 직원을 현장으로 출동하게 하는 방법이다. 기존의 영상보안 시스템은 단지 움직임을 감지하여 녹화를 하고, 녹화된 화면을 나중에 증거로 이용하였으나, DVR에 함께 장착된 무인경보기(30)를 이용하여 실시간으로 감지된 이상신호와 함께 동영상을 전송하는 방법이다. 
     
     감지센서   폐쇄회로 카메라   무인경보기가 탑재된 DVR   IDC(Internet Data Center)   관제 PC   가입자 모바일 폰   인터넷 망

title_en: A recording apparatus for vehicle capable of keeping emergency situation during driving
title_ko: 주행 중 긴급 상황을 기록하는 차량용 영상녹화장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides an image recording apparatus for a vehicle. The image recording apparatus comprises: a speed detection part; a plurality of sensor parts; a plurality of photographing parts; a control part; and a communication part. The speed detection part detects the speed of a vehicle. The sensor parts are installed on a plurality of exterior positions of the vehicle to detect the quantity of motion when the speed of the vehicle is detected and detect the quantity of impact to the vehicle based on a changed quantity of the detected quantity of motion. The photographing parts are in connection with the sensor parts to receive an input of information regarding an image of the surroundings of the corresponding sensor part when the speed of the vehicle is detected. In a case where a total quantity of impact applied to each of the sensor parts exceeds a predetermined range compared to the quantity of impact in a normal state, the control part recognizes an abnormal state of the vehicle, determines the damaged part of the vehicle in accordance with quantities of impacts detected by each of the sensor parts and a ratio between the quantities of impacts, and collects information regarding an accident. The communication part transmits information regarding the accident to a user terminal which is set to communicate with the image recording apparatus of the vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 차량용 영상녹화장치가 개시된다.  상기 차량용 영상녹화장치는, 차량의 속도를 검출하는 속도검출부; 상기 차량의 속도가 검출되면, 운동량을 감지하고 상기 감지된 운동량의 변화량에 기반하여 상기 차량에 가해지는 충격량을 검출하며, 차량 외부의 다수 위치에 설치되는 다수의 센서부; 상기 차량의 속도가 검출되면, 상기 센서부와 각각 연동되어 해당 센서부 인근의 영상정보를 입력받는 다수의 촬영부; 상기 다수의 센서부 각각에 인가된 충격량의 총합에 기반하여, 정상 상태의 충격량과 비교하여 미리 결정된 범위를 초과하는 경우, 상기 차량에 대해 비정상 상태로 인식하고, 상기 다수의 센서부 각각에서 검출된 충격량 및 상호 간의 비율에 따라 차량의 파손지점을 결정하고, 사고에 관한 정보를 수집하는 제어부; 차량용 영상녹화장치와 통신가능하도록 설정된 사용자 단말에 상기 사고에 관한 정보를 송신하는 통신부를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for recognizing police emergency similarity, and device
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus for recognizing police emergency similarity, and a device. Said method comprises: analyzing current police emergency information and extracting current police emergency features (101); acquiring, according to the current police emergency features, all historical police emergency records satisfying a preset matching condition (102); performing similarity calculation on the current police emergency information and the historical police emergency records, and selecting, according to the calculation result, a target historical police emergency record similar to the current police emergency information (103). Thus, automatic determination of similar emergencies is implemented by acquiring the historical police emergency record similar to the current police emergency information during a police emergency dispatching process, improving the working efficiency of a dispatcher, and improving the determination accuracy.

title_en: Triggering of Incident Report Record Generation in a Controlled Facility
abstract_en: Embodiments of systems and methods for triggering of incident report record generating in a controlled facility are described. The incidents may involve acts of sexual misconduct. An embodiment of a system includes one or more communication devices in electronic communication with a crime reporting server. The system may also include a crime reporting server coupled to the one or more communication devices. The crime reporting server may be configured to receive information concerning an inmate in a controlled facility over a facility communications system that is related to an act of sexual misconduct, automatically trigger an event in response to receiving the information, and generate a record comprising at least a portion of the information related to the act of sexual misconduct in a data storage device.

title_en: Remote Based System and Method For Collecting Eye Movement Data
abstract_en: A remote diagnostic system and method for collecting eye-movement data includes a mobile visual recording device which is mounted on a set of goggles. In this combination, the recording device will necessarily include both a camera and a computer. With the combined visual recording device and goggles stabilized on the head of a patient/user, a blackout vision chamber is established in front of an eye of the patient/user. An illuminator on the goggles can then be activated to illuminate the eye, and the camera in the visual recording device can record eye-movement data from the patient's eye while it is illuminated. A programmed protocol from the computer directs the patient using voice commands through a predetermined sequence of head orientations in space and collects eye-movement data that is used to generate a record of nystagmographs and gyroscopic head positions/stabilization data. The record of eye movements can then be automatically uploaded and viewed remotely by physicians via the web-based browser for diagnostic purposes.

title_en: Authentication method, recording medium, server, and vehicle deployment system
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to an authentication method, a recording medium, a server, and a vehicle deployment system. In an authentication method in a vehicle allocation system, a user ID for identifying the user and a target vehicle ID for identifying a target vehicle for which the user tries to authenticate are received from a terminal device of the user, it is determined whether the target vehicle ID matches a reserved vehicle ID for identifying a reserved vehicle for which the user allocates the reserved vehicle, an unlock command for unlocking a door of the target vehicle is transmitted to the target vehicle when the target vehicle ID matches the reserved vehicle ID, and a message indicating that the user can ride the target vehicle is presented to the terminal device, and when the target vehicle ID does not match the reserved vehicle ID, a message indicating that the target vehicle is not the reserved vehicle of the user is presented to the terminal device.

title_en: Recording medium, terminal device, communication system, and riding determination method
abstract_en: The present disclosure relates to a computer-readable recording medium, a terminal device, a communication system, and a riding determination method. The terminal device includes a communication unit configured to communicate with a communication device used in a vehicle, and a control unit configured to determine whether a user is in the vehicle according to at least one of whether the user has set a destination and whether a vehicle scheduling application is started, when a signal transmitted from the communication device is received via the communication unit. The vehicle dispatch application is a program for receiving a vehicle dispatch service.

title_en: Display board for information notification and method of manufacturing for the same
title_ko: 정보 알림 표지판 및 그 제조방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An information notifying board and a manufacturing method thereof are provided to improve discrimination in day and night, thereby providing various kinds of information to citizens. CONSTITUTION: A base plate(101) with a circle or polygon shape is comprised of metal, non-metal, or synthetic resin. A reflective fabric(102) is applied or printed on the upper surface of the base plate. A character, picture, figure, number, or arrow is printed using an intaglio or embossment process. A film layer(103) is printed or applied on the upper surface of the reflective fabric and comprised of a glass powder film, a hologram film, an embossing effect film, a metallic film, or a light reflecting film. A coating layer(104) is applied on the surface of the film layer. The coating layer is made of silicon or fluoride type materials for water repellency or watertight properties. A heating coating layer(106) is applied on the upper surface of the coating layer and generates heat in order to eliminate water or snow remaining on the surface of the coating layer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전시 상황, 화재, 재난사고 시 안전한 곳으로 대피할 수 있도록 정보를 제공하거나, 도로 또는 인도에서 차량이나 보행자의 안전확보를 위해 정보를 제공하는 정보 알림 표지판 및 그 제조방법에 관한 것으로, 금속, 비금속 또는 합성수지 중 어느 하나로 이루어지며, 원형 또는 다각형의 베이스 플레이트, 베이스 플레이트 상면에 도포 또는 인쇄되며, 문자, 그림, 도형, 숫자 또는 화살표 중 어느 하나 이상이 프린팅(Printing)된 반사원단, 반사원단의 상면에 도포 또는 인쇄되며, 유리가루 필름, 홀로그램 필름, 엠보 효과 필름, 금속 필름 또는 빛 반사 필름 중 어느 하나 이상으로 이루어진 필름층, 필름층 표면에 도포 또는 인쇄되며, 발수성 또는 방수성을 위해 실리콘계 또는 불소계를 사용한 코팅층, 베이스 플레이트 후면에 구비된 결합장치을 포함한다. 
나아가, 정보 알림 표지판 제조방법은 금속, 비금속 또는 합성수지 중 어느 하나로 이루어지며, 원형 또는 다각형의 베이스 플레이트를 준비하는 단계, 베이스 플레이트 상면에 합성수지 또는 합성섬유로 이루어진 반사원단을 도포 또는 인쇄하는 단계, 반사원단 상면에 액체 또는 분말의 축광안료를 이용해 문자, 그림, 도형, 숫자 또는 화살표 중 어느 하나 이상을 프린팅하는 단계, 반사원단 상면에 유리가루 필름, 홀로그램 필름, 엠보 효과 필름, 금속 필름 또는 빛 반사 필름 중 어느 하나 이상으로 이루어진 필름층을 도포 또는 인쇄하는 단계 및 필름층 상면에 발수성 또는 방수성을 위한 실리콘계 또는 불소계를 사용한 코팅층을 형성하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Method for providing information service between black box for vehicle and server using lte modem
title_ko: Lte모뎀을 이용한 차량용 블랙박스와 중계서버 간의 서비스 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a service between vehicle blackbox and relay server using an LTE modem, and the method for providing a service between vehicle blackbox and relay server using an LTE modem according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a step of transmitting vehicle information having image information and driving information from vehicle blackbox and vehicle tachograph formed in a vehicle to a relay server through the LTE modem; and a step that the relay server transmits the vehicle information to mobile communication terminal and insurance company management server which are authenticated and connected through wired and wireless communication networks. According to the present invention, a user who is authenticated and connected through the wired and wireless communication networks can monitor a vehicle status in real time, the insurance company can rapidly and accurately process accidents and can actively utilize the present invention to insurance products such as mileage and fixed-day driving. Furthermore, the present invention can be used for providing traffic information contents by collecting and reproducing real-time traffic information of major cities across the country and can be used for new businesses such as development of the navigation which is interoperated with a blackbox, establishment of the central control solution and et cetera. abstract_ko: 본 발명은 LTE모뎀을 이용한 차량용 블랙박스와 중계서버 간의 서비스 제공방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 LTE모뎀을 이용한 차량용 블랙박스와 중계서버 간의 서비스 제공방법은 (a) 차량 내에 구비된 차량용 블랙박스 및 차량운행기록장치로부터 영상정보 및 운행정보를 포함하는 차량정보를 LTE모뎀을 통해 중계서버로 전송하는 단계;와 (b) 상기 중계서버는 유무선통신망을 통해 인증접속된 이동통신단말기와 보험사관리서버로 상기 차량정보를 전송하는 단계;를 포함한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 유무선통신망을 통해 인증접속된 사용자가 차량상태를 실시간으로 모니터링할 수 있고, 보험사로서는 신속 정확한 사고처리가 가능하게 되고 마일리지나 요일제 등의 보험상품에도 적극 활용할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 전국 주요도시의 실시간 교통정보를 수집 및 가공하여 교통정보 컨텐츠를 제공하거나 블랙박스와 연동된 내비게이션 등의 개발 및 관제솔루션 구축 등의 신규사업에도 활용될 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: The internet of things field control and guidance system using private communication network
title_ko: 자가통신망을 활용한 사물인터넷 현장제어 및 안내시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an Internet-of-things (IoT) field control and guidance system using a private communication network and, more specifically, to a smart system capable of sensing in advance fire, flooding, gas, heavy snowfall, ground subsidence, landslides and complex disasters in mountain areas, earthquakes, and coastal erosion occurring in a work site through an advanced IoT, and simultaneously using a private communication network to share pieces of information sensed in advance with a worker terminal, a manager terminal, and a head office terminal through a real-time management center server in order to cope with a predetermined program type suitable for an accident type, and transmitting and informing an optimal evacuation path through the management center server, considering an area where workers are located in the work site, a location of an emergency exit, and a congestion level, to the worker terminal, the manager terminal, and the head office terminal, thereby allowing workers to safely evacuate in case of emergency. According to the present invention, various sensor signals of a sensor group unit and images captured by various cameras of an image capturing unit which are provided at the work site are collected and analyzed in real time by using the private communication network, and an alarm is transmitted in real time to the worker terminal, the manager terminal, and the head office terminal with text messages and images when an abnormality occurs at the work site, thereby enabling safe evacuation in accordance with the type and characteristics of an accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자가통신망을 활용한 사물인터넷 현장제어 및 안내시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 첨단 사물인터넷(IOT)을 통하여 작업 현장에서 발생하는 화재, 침수, 가스, 폭설, 지반침하, 산사태 및 산지대형 복합재난, 지진, 해안침식을 사전에 감지함과 동시에 자가통신망을 활용하여 사전 감지된 정보들을 실시간 관리센터서버를 통해 작업자단말기, 관리자단말기, 본사단말기와 공유함으로써, 사고유형에 적합하게 사전에 설정된 프로그램 유형에 맞게 대처가 가능하고, 작업 현장에서 작업자들이 위치한 영역, 비상구의 위치, 혼잡도의 분석 내용을 관리센터서버를 통한 최적의 대피 경로를 작업자단말기, 관리자단말기, 본사단말기로 전송하여 알려줌으로써, 유사시 작업자들이 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있는 스마트시스템이며, 작업 현장에 설치된 센서그룹부의 각종 센서 신호와 영상촬영부의 각종 카메라로 촬영한 영상을 자가통신망을 이용하여 실시간으로 수집하여 분석하고 작업 현장에서의 이상 징후 또는 이상 발생시 문자와 영상으로 작업자단말기, 관리자단말기, 본사단말기로 실시간으로 알람과 전송하여 줌으로써, 사고 유형 및 특성에 맞게 안전하게 대피할 수 있게 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Generating an incident dossier
abstract_en: Methods, devices, and systems for generating an incident dossier are described herein. One device includes a memory, and a processor configured to execute executable instructions stored in the memory to import data associated with an incident associated with a site, wherein the data is in a number of different forms, receive a number of user inputs associated with the incident, and generate an incident dossier based on the data associated with the incident and the number of user inputs, wherein the incident dossier includes a timeline of the incident, a report of the incident, and a damage assessment of the incident.

title_en: Site-disposal rescue command system
abstract_en: The invention provides a site-disposal rescue command system. The site-disposal rescue command system comprises positioning helmets, a Beidou command receiving device, an on-site command vehicle, an on-site handheld command terminal and an emergency command center, wherein each positioning helmet comprises a helmet body, as well as a positioning device, a mobile communication module, an audio/video acquiring module and an SOS alarming module which are mounted on the helmet body; the Beidou command receiving device is in communication with the positioning helmets, and transmits the received information to the on-site command vehicle, the on-site handheld command terminal and the emergency command center; the on-site command vehicle and the on-site handheld command terminal can carry out corresponding command treatment according to the received information; and the emergency command center carries out user identity authentication, authority identification, user operation recording and the like on the on-site command vehicle and the on-site handheld command terminal. The site-disposal rescue command system provided by the invention is comprehensive in function and signal cover, and meanwhile, the operation cost can be reduced, and the positioning is accurate.

title_en: Identification and positioning system for war field sick and wounded
abstract_en: An intelligent identification and positioning system for sick and wounded comprises an identification ring manufacturing module, an identification module and an identification ring; the identification ring manufacturing module is used for respectively inputting the identification information of each patient into different identification rings, and the identification module is used for identifying the information recorded in the identification rings. The invention realizes the rapid identification and classification of the wounded, solves the problem of treatment efficiency caused by sudden and centralized generation of a large number of wounded in disaster rescue, and brings unprecedented vitality to medical service command of medical care facilities.

title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for converting earthquake information
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for converting earthquake information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first earthquake motion information to be converted; inputting the first earthquake motion information into a pre-established earthquake motion information conversion model to obtain first emergency disposal information corresponding to the first earthquake motion information; the seismic oscillation information conversion model is a mathematical model established by utilizing a Petri net time sequence modeling mode; outputting the first emergency treatment information. Therefore, the embodiment of the invention can realize the quick conversion from the earthquake motion information to the emergency disposal information, save the earthquake emergency response time, improve the earthquake early warning precision and improve the accuracy and timeliness of the earthquake early warning system.
assignees: CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD SIGNAL & COMM RES INST;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Method for measuring resistivity of underground tensor
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring underground tensor resistivity, and belongs to the field of geological exploration. The method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps that firstly, n sub-station nodes are arranged on an underground rock layer at intervals along the roadway construction direction, and each sub-station node is respectively provided with three transmitting electrodes and three collecting electrodes along X, Y and Z directions; secondly, the master station equipment sends an acquisition command to the substation equipment, the transmitting electrode of the substation node transmits a signal, the acquisition electrode receives the signal and records the potential difference between the transmitting electrode and the acquisition electrode, and then the substation equipment uploads the acquired potential difference to the master station equipment; and thirdly, the main station equipment collects the acquired data and uploads the collected data to the background equipment, and the background equipment calculates the resistivity according to the acquired potential difference data among all the nodes. The method can comprehensively measure the resistivity along the trend, the inclination and the vertical direction of the rock stratum, and improve the accuracy of the final measurement result, thereby accurately predicting the geological disaster.
assignees: ANHUI INDUSTRIAL UNIV SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY PARK LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Data security emergency management analysis method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data safety emergency management analysis method and system based on big data, which are technically characterized by comprising the following steps of S1, collecting data from a plurality of heterogeneous data sources, S2, preprocessing the collected data, S3, carrying out multi-mode data fusion on the processed data, S4, carrying out real-time analysis on the fused data by using a big data analysis algorithm to generate an emergency response suggestion, S5, generating an emergency decision support based on an analysis result, and protecting data privacy by data encryption and desensitization, and carrying out real-time analysis based on a big data technology to generate an emergency response suggestion, optimizing emergency resource allocation by a genetic algorithm or a particle swarm optimization algorithm, wherein in the aspect of data safety, encryption and desensitization technology is adopted to protect sensitive information, cross-department information sharing is realized by a data opening platform, the cooperativity and timeliness of emergency response are improved, the emergency management efficiency is improved, and the safety and privacy protection of the data are ensured.

title_en: Underwater welding training method, system and equipment based on welding handle posture record
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of intelligent control and discloses an underwater welding training method, an underwater welding system and underwater welding equipment based on welding handle posture record, wherein the training method comprises the following steps of S1, collecting the space posture and the moving speed of a welding handle during welding operation of standard welding personnel and trained personnel, uploading welding handle parameters of the trained personnel to a teaching personnel, S2, analyzing and sorting the collected welding handle parameters of the standard welding personnel to establish a standard welding skill library, comparing the welding handle parameters reflecting the trained personnel with the standard welding skill library, calculating an adjustment instruction according to a fuzzy control algorithm or providing a guiding instruction according to experience by the teaching personnel, wherein when the welding handle parameters of the trained personnel are collected, the welding handle parameters reflecting the trained personnel are analyzed and sorted to establish a standard welding skill library When not outputting the adjustment instruction Outputting fine-tuning adjustment command when And S3, adjusting the welding handle parameters of the welding machine according to the adjusting instruction or the guiding instruction to finish welding training. The trained personnel can correct the welding operation in time under the real-time instruction.

title_en: Disaster recovery method for futures transaction
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster recovery method for futures transaction, which comprises the following steps of carrying out handshake on two ends of a main end and a standby end and checking whether a communication link is effective or not. And negotiating the file header sizes of the master and the slave sides aiming at the file which is created and read. The method comprises the steps that a host end sends a file clearing command to a standby machine before file backup, and the standby machine end executes clearing operation. The host synchronizes the MD5 value of each file to be backed up to the standby machine, and the host decides whether to perform initial backup or not according to the value. And starting file update monitoring logic at the host end, and recording the changed files in a file queue Qu to be backed up. The host traverses the Qu and reads the file to be updated from the Qu, packages the file to be updated, sends the package to the standby terminal, and after receiving the package, the standby terminal executes unpacking logic to release the file into a relevant path. The invention can realize the dynamic real-time backup of the data file generated by the future transaction counter, and when the future transaction counter is down, the future company can rapidly complete the main-standby switching, thereby greatly reducing the loss caused by the down.
assignees: NANJING ACCELECOM INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent big data analysis and prediction method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent big data analysis and prediction method and system based on deep learning, comprising a physical field sensing layer, an edge computing layer, a cloud intelligent analysis layer and an emergency response layer, wherein the synchronous acquisition of multidimensional parameters such as dam deformation, seepage and stress is realized through a three-dimensional monitoring network constructed by a plurality of high-precision sensors, the edge layer carries out real-time data preprocessing and a dynamic risk assessment model, so that the relevant characteristics of a cross physical field can be identified, a risk conduction path is predicted, and the transition from passive monitoring to active early warning is realized. The emergency response efficiency is greatly improved through multi-channel early warning information pushing and automatic control instruction issuing. Meanwhile, the three-dimensional visualization platform visually presents the professional analysis result, so that the decision support capability is remarkably improved, the system has remarkable advantages in the aspects of early warning timeliness, analysis accuracy, management efficiency and the like, and an intelligent solution is provided for hydraulic engineering safety management.
