title_en: Fidget spinner type arduino learning kit
title_ko: 피젯 스피너 타입 아두이노 학습 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fidget spinner type arduino learning kit comprising: a rotational body provided to rotate around a support unit and having a mounting space formed therein; a master Arduino installed inside the mounting space, receiving power necessary for operations from a computer through a connector, and having firmware uploaded from block coding software installed in the computer to control input/output according to commands of a block coding; a slave arduino installed inside the mounting space, receiving power necessary for operations from the master arduino, having firmware for control of a device uploaded to receive command signals from the master arduino, and outputting control signals of the device corresponding to the command signals; a neo pixel LED installed inside the mounting space to receive control signals from the salve arduino and power necessary for operations, and operating according to control signals; a power supply unit installed inside the mounting space to supply power; and a switching unit, when power supply stops from the computer, switching to supply power for operations to the master arduino, the slave arduino and the neo pixel LED from the power supply unit. According to the present invention, the upload of firmware prevents existing programs from being deleted and accordingly, the present invention releases the limit of functions basically provided by the block coding software and enables control of relatively complex devices.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지지부를 중심으로 회전하도록 마련되고, 장착공간이 형성되는 회전몸체; 장착공간 내에 설치되고, 커넥터를 통해서 컴퓨터로부터 동작에 필요한 전원을 커넥터를 통해서 공급받음과 아울러, 컴퓨터에 설치되는 블록코딩소프트웨어로부터 펌웨어를 업로드받아 블록코딩의 명령에 따라 입출력을 제어하는 마스터아두이노; 장착공간 내에 설치되고, 마스터아두이노로부터 동작에 필요한 전원을 공급받으며, 디바이스의 제어를 위한 펌웨어를 업로드받아 마스터아두이노로부터 명령신호를 수신받고, 명령신호에 상응하는 디바이스의 제어신호를 출력하는 슬레이브아두이노; 슬레이브아두이노로부터 제어신호 및 동작에 필요한 전원을 제공받도록 장착공간 내에 설치되고, 제어신호에 따라 동작하는 네오픽셀 LED; 전원을 공급하도록 장착공간 내에 설치되는 전원공급부; 및 컴퓨터로부터 전원 공급이 중단되면, 전원공급부로부터 마스터아두이노, 슬레이브아두이노 및 네오픽셀 LED에 동작을 위한 전원을 공급하도록 스위칭하는 스위칭부;를 포함하도록 한 피젯 스피너 타입 아두이노 학습 키트에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 펌웨어의 업로드로 인해 기존에 기록된 프로그램의 삭제를 방지할 수 있고, 이로 인해 블록코딩소프트웨어가 기본으로 제공하는 기능의 제한을 해소할 수 있으며, 비교적 복잡한 디바이스의 제어를 가능하도록 한다.

title_en: Method and system for providing convergence security control service based on Internet of Things
title_ko: IoT 기반 융합보안 관제 서비스 제공 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Provided are an IoT-based convergence security control service providing method capable of integrally controlling an information security area, a physical security area, an industrial security area and an IoT security area, and a system thereof. In accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, the IoT-based convergence security control service providing method includes: a collection step in which a collection part collects log information and raw event information through a physical security device, an information security server and an IoT platform connected through a network; a normalization step in which an analysis part generates base event information having an analyzable format based on the collected information; and an analysis step in which the analysis part generates analyzed event information by analyzing the normalized base event information. Thus, through analysis on a correlation between an event occurring in the physical security area and an event occurring in the information security area, the present invention can predict multilateral risks, can detect an accurate accident sign, can prevent a security gap from being formed between areas, and can lower the ratio of false alarms.
abstract_ko: 정보 보안 영역, 물리 보안 영역, 산업보안 영역 및 IoT 보안 영역을 통합관제할 수 있는 IoT 기반의 융합보안 관제 서비스를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른, IoT 기반 융합보안 관제 서비스 제공 방법은, 수집부가, 네트워크로 연결된 물리 보안 디바이스, 정보 보안 서버 및 IoT 플랫폼을 통해 로그 정보 및 로우 이벤트(Raw Event) 정보를 수집하는 수집 단계; 분석부가, 수집된 정보들을 기반으로 분석 가능한 형태인 기본 이벤트(Base Event) 정보를 생성하는 정규화 단계; 및 분석부가, 정규화된 기본 이벤트 정보를 분석하여, 분석 이벤트(Analyzed Event) 정보를 생성하는 분석 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 물리 보안 영역에서의 발생되는 이벤트와 정보 보안 영역에서의 발생되는 이벤트 간의 상관관계를 분석하여, 다각적 위험에 대한 예측이 가능하고, 정확한 사고 징후를 탐지하며, 영역 간의 보안 공백이 발생하는 것을 방지하고, 알람의 오탐 발생률을 낮출 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for communicating information associated with an incident and/or emergency situation
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method and system for communicating real-time multi-media information associated with an emergency situation. The method may include providing a device having a dedicated button and/or at least one displayed selectable icon on a display of the device. The button and/or the icon may be associated with indicating an emergency situation. After pushing of the button or selection of the at least one selectable icon by the user in the emergency situation, the method may include automatically preparing, by the device, a message to send, the message including one or more of user identification information, user contact information, and/or location-based information; automatically sending, by the device, the message to a receiving system of a government public safety agency; automatically activating video and/or audio recording features of the device; and automatically transmitting, by the device, real-time video, audio, and/or location-based information to the government public safety agency.

title_en: Method and apparatus for communication with emergency dispatch services
abstract_en: Emergency reporting is described in which user input is received in an emergency call that is used to classify the call. Based on the classification process, emergency calls are processed to give priority to certain calls. The calls that are given the highest priority may be transmitted by a voice network and other calls may be transmitted by a data network. The reporting includes receiving user input identifying an emergency perspective of the user and selecting a data call based on the emergency perspective indicating the user is a bystander. It also includes recording an audio message from the user and transmitting the audio message to a public service answering point (PSAP) over a data network.

title_en: Ground disaster automatic monitoring equipment linkage early warning technology based on intelligent internet of things cradle head
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring and early warning, and discloses a ground disaster automatic monitoring equipment linkage early warning technology based on an intelligent internet of things holder, which comprises that each monitoring point in a monitoring area is provided with a data acquisition device, the data acquisition device is uniformly connected to the intelligent internet of things holder through a plurality of communication protocols, and the intelligent internet of things holder generates an installation distribution diagram of each data acquisition device; triggering early warning by the data acquisition equipment, and synchronously sending out early warning signals to form early warning equipment; according to the installation distribution diagram, the intelligent internet of things cloud deck marks data acquisition equipment in a set range around the early warning equipment as adjacent equipment, the intelligent internet of things cloud deck sets encryption acquisition frequency of each adjacent equipment and sends an instruction to the adjacent equipment, and the adjacent equipment receives the instruction and then carries out encryption acquisition; and issuing a forecast notice and an emergency response instruction through a research result of linkage early warning research, and finally completing monitoring data analysis and recording.

title_en: Atmospheric flux estimation method based on multi-scale dynamic association
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of atmospheric flux calculation, in particular to an atmospheric flux estimation method based on multi-scale dynamic association. In the existing multi-scale atmospheric flux calculation technology, multi-scale data integration depends on manual interpolation or step calculation, space-time correlation of different-scale atmospheric processes cannot be effectively captured, obvious scale engagement errors are easy to generate, and the traditional iterative calculation needs repeated parameter verification, so that the aging requirement is difficult to meet in the scenes of atmospheric pollution emergency monitoring, real-time carbon flux evaluation and the like. The invention firstly performs space-time alignment and noise suppression on multisource multiscale observation data, and then adopts an AI model to construct a trans-scale dynamic association mechanism to replace the traditional artificial empirical formula. The method can effectively reduce the scale engagement error, solves the problem that the precision and the speed of the traditional technology are difficult to consider, and is suitable for the scenes such as emergency response of air pollution, dynamic monitoring of regional carbon circulation and the like.

title_en: Flooded manhole theft anti apparatus and method
title_ko: 맨홀 침수 도난 방지 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 맨홀 침수 도난 방지 장치및 방법 가 개시된다. 다수의 센서로 수위 측정하는 수위 센서; 측정된 수위가 일정 수위를 초과하면 침수 위험을 알리는 침수부; 측정된 수위에 맨홀 위치를 더하여 침수 관리를 체계화하는 위치부; 위치 정보와 수위 정보를 기록하여 침수 이력을 관리하고, 맨홀 유무를 감지하여 맨홀 도난시 중앙 서버로 도난 사실을 알리는 제어부; 및 도난 사실을 수신하면 스마트 센서에서 감지하고, 게이트웨이를 통해 침수 및 도난 정보를 제공하는 중앙 서버를 구성한다. 따라서 맨홀 침수 또는 맨홀 도난에 대처하고 사고 위치로 현장 관리자가 즉시 출동하여 사고에 대처할 수 있고, 스마트 센서의 수위 온도 센서는 다수의 연결하는 선을 50cm폭의 4개의 마디를 가지고 있는 수위온도센서를 통해 발생할 수 있는 상황에서도 수위를 정확히 측정해서 침수 위험을 판단하는 장점이 있고, 맨홀 도난이 발생할 때 현장관리자가 맨홀을 상황을 조치를 취한다.

title_en: Method for Playing Math Game Using User's Grouping Selection for Multiple Items, and Program Distribution Server Storing Program Executing the Method
title_ko: 복수의 아이템에 대한 사용자의 그룹핑 선택을 통한 수학 게임 진행 방법, 및 복수의 아이템에 대한 사용자의 그룹핑 선택을 통한 수학 게임 진행 방법을 실행시키는 프로그램이 저장된 프로그램 배포용 서버
abstract_ko: 복수의 아이템에 대한 사용자의 그룹핑 선택을 통한 수학 게임 진행 방법, 및 복수의 아이템에 대한 사용자의 그룹핑 선택을 통한 수학 게임 진행 방법을 실행시키는 프로그램이 저장된 프로그램 배포용 서버가 개시된다. 본 발명은, 사용자 단말기가, 사용자의 미션 수행에 필요한 복수의 아이템을 출력하고, 복수의 아이템 중 그룹핑 처리되는 아이템에 대한 사용자의 선택 정보를 입력받으며, 그룹핑 처리된 아이템의 개수와 복수의 아이템의 개수의 관계를 정의하는 수학식을 생성하는 과정을 통해 구현된다. 본 발명에 따르면, 사용자가 화면에 출력된 복수의 아이템을 그룹핑하는 직관적인 방식을 통해 약수 또는 소인수를 산출하는 수학적 사고를 표현하고 평가받게 됨에 따라 수학 학습의 흥미를 유발시킬 수 있게 될 뿐만 아니라, 수학 학습에서의 집중력을 향상시킬 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Providing a GUI to enable analysis of time-synchronized data sets pertaining to a road segment
abstract_en: Techniques for collecting, synchronizing, and displaying various types of data relating to a road segment enable, via one or more local or remote processors, servers, transceivers, and/or sensors, (i) enhanced and contextualized analysis of vehicle events by way of synchronizing different data types, relating to a monitored road segment, collected via various different types of data sources; (ii) enhanced and contextualized analysis of filed insurance claims pertaining to a vehicle incident at a road segment; (iii) advantageous machine learning techniques for predicting a level of risk assumed for a given vehicle event or a given road segment; (iv) techniques for accounting for region-specific driver profiles when controlling autonomous vehicles; and/or (v) improved techniques for providing a GUI to display collected data in a meaningful and contextualized manner.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Empty space multi-model unmanned aerial vehicle remote-control remote-sensing system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an empty space multi-model unmanned aerial vehicle remote-control remote-sensing system which comprises at least two unmanned aerial vehicles, an emergency command vehicle, a vehicle-mounted transceiver, a remote-control remote-sensing device and a display device. Audio and video signals shot by a camera are sent to the vehicle-mounted transceiver through a wireless transmission device after going through multi-carrier modulation. The vehicle-mounted transceiver conducts multi-carrier modulation on the received audio and video signals and then sends the audio and the video signals to the remote-control remote-sensing device. The remote-control remote-sensing device stores the received audio and video signals into a storer or displays the received audio and video signals to users. The empty space multi-model unmanned aerial vehicle remote-control remote-sensing system can control multiple unmanned aerial vehicles at the same time, is strong in interference resisting ability, and has good maneuverability so as to be capable of improving the accuracy and timeliness of command. Further, the system has the advantages of being simple in structure, good in timeliness, high in reliability and strong in practicality.

title_en: Children programming result feedback system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a child programming result feedback system and a child programming result feedback method, wherein the child programming result feedback system comprises a carrier, a force calculation unit, an optical identification unit, an execution unit and terminal equipment; the carrier is provided with a specific pattern, and the specific pattern is used for representing an execution command; the optical identification unit comprises an image acquisition module, the image acquisition module is used for acquiring a carrier image and recording an image sequence, and the image sequence is formed by combining a plurality of specific patterns; the force calculation unit is used for preprocessing the carrier image, identifying an executive program or an executive command of the image sequence and sending the executive program or the executive command to the execution unit; the execution program is formed by combining a plurality of execution commands according to the sequence contained in the image sequence; the execution unit completes the designated action according to the execution program or the execution command and feeds back the execution result to the terminal equipment. The invention realizes the interaction between the execution unit and the environment and the user, and avoids the lack of interaction sense and accuracy in the programming process of children; the interactivity of the children programming product is improved, and the immersive interactive experience of programming learning is provided.
assignees: XIAMEN YINGFUN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Database data security anti-leakage system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a database data security anti-leakage system and method, and relates to the technical field of data management. The test simulation comprises the following steps: the data in the database is identified and classified, the data object to be protected is determined, the data leakage condition of the database is simulated, the condition that an attacker illegally accesses the database and leaks the data is simulated, and the related test result is recorded. The invention can discover possible security holes and risks in the database through the test simulation module, is beneficial to early discovering and repairing the holes, improves the security of the database, can test the effectiveness of the deployed security protection measures in the database, is beneficial to discovering and repairing the possible holes and the possible weaknesses, improves the security of the database, can help to evaluate the influence degree of data leakage on the database and related systems, and is beneficial to formulating corresponding emergency response plans and security strategies so as to reduce potential loss.

title_en: Elevator operation noise diagnosis and maintenance method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of noise suppression, in particular to a method and a system for diagnosing and maintaining elevator operation noise, comprising the following steps: and acquiring audio data in the elevator operation period based on the acoustic monitoring device, performing amplitude correction, and converting the time domain signal into a frequency domain signal to obtain an equalization frequency domain signal set. According to the invention, audio samples in an elevator shaft, a machine room and a car are synchronously collected, amplitude correction is carried out, consistency and comparability of data are ensured, entropy analysis based on a time scale is introduced, noise data are analyzed from a plurality of layers from microcosmic to macroscopic, signal characteristics which are inconsistent with normal operation of the elevator are more accurately identified through energy spectrum density analysis on abnormal frequency bands, potential faults are identified in advance, accuracy and timeliness of fault prediction are remarkably improved, and a data driving basis of fault diagnosis is enhanced through comparison analysis and historical fault data, so that maintenance planning and emergency response measures are more accurate and efficient.

title_en: Full-chain digital command, dispatch, training and assessment system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of full-chain management, in particular to a full-chain digital command, dispatch, training and assessment system, which comprises the following components: the monitoring module comprises a plurality of electronic fences which are arranged in groups and used for monitoring the advancing position of a target to be tested in real time, recording the time of passing through a single electronic fence when the target to be tested advances, a signal module and used for transmitting communication frequency bands of a plurality of frequencies in real time, a receiving module and used for monitoring the corresponding communication frequency bands and receiving the time difference that any target to be tested arrives at or leaves any electronic fence, and a learning module and used for preprocessing the time difference and generating corresponding preprocessing data and learning, so as to generate a time difference monitoring graph, adjust the communication frequency bands and visualize the time difference of the electronic fence, and the operation efficiency of the system is improved while the accuracy of the training track of the monitoring training target is effectively improved, thereby being capable of monitoring the training process more accurately.

title_en: Environment risk monitoring system for dangerous waste storage warehouse
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environmental risk monitoring system for a hazardous waste storage warehouse, which relates to the technical field of hazardous waste storage, and comprises a sensor module, a data transmission module, a data processing and storage module, a risk assessment model module and an early warning notification and emergency response module, wherein the potential environmental risk can be timely found by monitoring the temperature, the humidity and the key parameters of gas concentration of the hazardous waste storage warehouse in real time, so as to prevent possible environmental pollution and safety accidents, the method has the advantages that the big data and cloud computing technology are utilized for data processing and storage, abnormal and repeated data are removed, statistical indexes such as mean values and variances are calculated, the quality and timeliness of the data are guaranteed, a reliable basis is provided for accurate risk assessment, a risk assessment model is established by utilizing machine learning algorithms such as decision trees or neural networks, comprehensive and accurate risk assessment can be performed by combining multiple factors, different risk grades are divided, and the risk condition is clearer and clearer.
assignees: NANJING INST OF ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE

title_en: An experience type system of a safety education for children and method at the same
title_ko: 체험형 영유아 안전교육 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides an infant safety experiential education system comprising: an experience chamber which is a space for accommodating one or more educators; screens formed on three side surface walls excluding an entrance side for forming the experience chamber; a projector capable of projecting educational audiovisual contents on the screen; a motion sensor for recognizing motions of the educators accommodated in the experience chamber; and a game server for generating a game program by receiving measured and transmitted position and behavior data of the educators from the motion sensor. According to the present invention, realization of a situation which may occur in actual life and a coping method corresponding thereto can be experienced by a motion sensor and playing-type contents. Thus, preparing and coping abilities with respect to life safety accidents can be improved, and more realistic safety education can be performed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 한 명 이상의 교육자를 수용하는 공간으로서 체험방과, 상기 체험방에 형성하는 입구측을 제외한 나머지 3측면벽에 형성되는 스크린과, 상기 스크린에 교육용 시청각 콘텐츠를 투영할 수 있는 프로젝터와, 상기 체험방에 수용된 교육자의 모션을 인식하는 모션 센서와, 상기 모션 센서를 통해 측정된 상기 교육자의 위치 및 행동의 데이터를 전송받아 게임 프로그램을 생성하는 게임 서버를 포함하는 체험형 영유아 안전교육 시스템을 제공한다. 
이를 통해, 실제 생활 속에서 발생할 수 상황의 재현과 그에 맞는 대처방법을 모션 센서와 놀이형 콘텐츠를 통해 체험함으로써 생활안전사고에 대한 대비 및 대처능력을 향상시켜 보다 현실적인 안전교육이 가능하다.

title_en: Fire Double Check System Using Drone and Method of The Same
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 화재 더블체크 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire double check system using a drone and a method thereof. The present invention is provided to solve the problem of erroneous dispatch by fire trucks and firefighters because it is impossible to immediately check whether or not a fire has occurred in a place where CCTV is not installed when a malfunction occurs or a fire alarm occurs due to malfunction among numerous sensors or fire detectors. According to the present invention, a fire double check method using the drone includes the steps of: (a) registering and storing factory interior drawings of industrial facilities, location information of fire detectors, and moving routes of drones in a system server; (b) transmitting a fire detection signal by operating the fire detector, and transmitting the fire detection signal from an IoT repeater to the system server through LoRa or Wi-Fi communication; (c) transmitting the coordinates of the moving routes and a target point from the system server to the drone to autonomously fly the drone to an area where the fire detection signal is transmitted, when the fire detection signal is received from the system server; (d) photographing surrounding images, and transmitting the captured images in real time while automatically rotating in the air by a program; and (e) outputting an image of the drone in real time through an application of the system server and a smartphone to provide an image of a fire point.
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제] 
본 발명은 드론을 이용한 화재 더블체크 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 수많은 센서 또는 화재감지기 중에서 하나라도 고장이 발생되거나 오작동으로 화재 경보가 발생되면 CCTV가 설치되지 않은 장소에는 화재 발생 유무를 즉시 확인할 수 없기 때문에 소방차와 소방인력이 오인 출동하는 문제점을 해결하기 위한 것이다. 
[해결수단] 
본 발명의 드론을 이용한 화재 더블체크 방법은, (a) 산업시설의 공장 내부 도면과 화재감지기의 위치 정보 및 드론의 이동 경로를 시스템서버에 등록하여 저장하는 단계; (b) 상기 화재감지기가 작동하여 화재 감지 신호를 송신하고, IoT 중계기에서 화재 감지 신호를 로라(LoRa) 또는 와이파이(Wi-Fi) 통신을 통해 상기 시스템서버로 전송하는 단계; (c) 상기 시스템서버에서 화재 감지 신호가 수신되면 상기 시스템서버에서 드론으로 이동 경로 및 목표 지점의 좌표를 전송하여 상기 화재 감지 신호가 송신된 구역으로 상기 드론을 자율 비행으로 출동시키는 단계; (d) 상기 드론이 목표 지점에 도달하면 프로그램에 의해 자동으로 공중에서 회전하면서 주변 영상을 촬영하고 촬영한 영상을 실시간으로 송신하는 단계; (e) 상기 드론의 영상을 상기 시스템서버와 스마트폰의 어플리케이션을 통해 실시간으로 출력하여 화재 발생 지점의 영상을 제공하는 단계; 및 (f) 상기 스마트폰의 어플리케이션 영상을 영상공유서버에 스마트뷰 어플로 연결하여 공유하고, 상기 영상공유서버에서 상기 영상을 팀뷰 어플을 통해 하나 이상의 기기로 전송하여 공유하는 단계;를 포함하고 있다. 
[기대효과] 
본 발명에 따르면, 화재감지기에서 화재가 감지되면 드론이 화재감지구역으로 자율 비행하여 영상을 전송함으로써 화재 여부와 화재 상황을 바로 확인할 수 있기 때문에 소방차 및 소방인력이 오인 출동할 우려가 없다.

title_en: A method of constructing a work-based map library to respond to disasters
title_ko: 재난대응 업무기반 맵 라이브러리 구축방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for constructing a task-based map library to respond to disasters. The method for constructing a task-based map library, according to the present invention, comprises the processes of: 1) classifying pieces of natural disaster-related information according to disaster type; 2) classifying the pieces of information into two or more among information about areas with risk factors, information about areas with damage history, and information about areas where vulnerable people live; 3) constructing the pieces of information into map ports, respectively, together with location information; and 4) constructing a map library by combining the constructed map ports. According to the present invention, practicality and utilization of map information in the field are greatly improved.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상황관리 매핑콘텐츠 정보를 하나의 시스템에서 조회가 가능하도록 제공하기 위한 재난상황 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 
풍수해를 포함한 자연재난 관련정보들과, 상기 정보들에 의해 풍수해를 예측하기 위한 프로그램(GIS 기반 통합상황 관리시스템)이 내장된 운영컴퓨터와, 상기 프로그램에 의한 결과물을 화면에 표시하기 위한 모니터로 구성되어진 시스템에서, 상기 프로그램에 의해 다음과 같은 과정으로 수행되는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난대응 업무기반 맵 라이브러리 구축방법. 
1) 상기 자연재난 관련정보들이 운영컴퓨터의 프로그램에 입력되면 상기 프로그램에 의해  재난유형(예를 들어, 태풍, 가축전염병 등)에 따라 분류되는 과정, 
2) 상기 1)과정에서 재난유형별 분류된 정보들이 상기 프로그램에 의해 위험요인 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 피해이력 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 취약자 거주지역에 대한 정보 중에서 2개 이상으로 분류되는데, 
상기 위험요인 보유지역 및 피해이력 보유지역에 대한 정보는 사전 점검 및 예찰을 위해 시간에 따라 누적된 정보이고, 
상기 취약자 거주지역에 대한 정보는 사전 대피를 위한 정보로서 분류되는 과정, 
3) 상기 2)과정에서 위험요인 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 피해이력 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 취약자 거주지역에 대한 정보로 분류된 정보들이  각각 상기 프로그램에 의해 위치정보와 함께 지도정보 기반의 맵포트(재난대비 업무활용지도)로 구축되는 과정, 
4) 상기 3)과정에서 위험요인 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 피해이력 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 취약자 거주지역에 대한 정보로 나뉘어 구축된 맵포트(재난대비 업무활용지도)들이 합쳐져서 맵 라이브러리(지도 정보 묶음집)로 구축되는 과정.

title_en: System and method for reporting and tracking incidents with a mobile device
abstract_en: A novel system and method for enhancing people's personal safety and incident reporting is presented, wherein mobile devices are used to report and/or record both "911" type situations and non-emergency situations. Users of the invention can record, transmit, stream, upload and/or send information from a threatening situation to a dispatcher at an emergency management office or facility and to the user's safety group. The dispatcher can assess the situation and, if the situation warrants action, then the information can be forwarded to the appropriate first responders. The system geo-locates the user and allows integration of camera feeds in the user's vicinity. The inventive system and method enables a user to contact a dispatcher and also to alert the user's safety group. Four pieces of software facilitate video, audio, images and/or text medium of communication between the user-in-distress and the dispatcher, first responders and the user's safety group.

title_en: Method and system for communicating information associated with an incident and/or emergency situation
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method and system for communicating real-time multi-media information associated with an emergency situation. The method may include providing a device having a dedicated button and/or at least one displayed selectable icon on a display of the device. The button and/or the icon may be associated with indicating an emergency situation. After pushing of the button or selection of the at least one selectable icon by the user in the emergency situation, the method may include automatically preparing, by the device, a message to send, the message including one or more of user identification information, user contact information, and/or location-based information; automatically sending, by the device, the message to a receiving system of a government public safety agency; automatically activating video and/or audio recording features of the device; and automatically transmitting, by the device, real-time video, audio, and/or location-based information to the government public safety agency.

title_en: Analyzing 2d movement in comparison with 3d avatar
abstract_en: A processing device receive a two dimensional (2D) video recording of a subject user performing a physical activity and provides a three dimensional (3D) visualization comprising a virtual avatar performing the physical activity. The processing device causes display of the 3D visualization comprising the virtual avatar at a first key point in performing the physical activity, receives first user input to advance the 2D video recording to a first position corresponding the first key point, and receives second user input comprising a first synchronization command. In response, the processing device generates a first synchronization marker to indicate the first position in the 2D video recording corresponding to the first key point.

title_en: Methods and Systems for Facilitating Safety and Security of Users
abstract_en: A safety method and system for users in a vehicle is provided. The method includes operations that are executed by a circuitry of the system to facilitate safety features to the users. The operations include detecting an emergency input for activating a camera device to record real-time in-vehicle activities. A preferred contact of a user in the vehicle is determined and audiovisual information of the in-vehicle activities is communicated in real-time with each preferred contact. The recorded in-vehicle activities are further processed in real-time for detecting an emergency incident. An alert signal is generated based on the emergency incident, and one or more entities who can provide help are identified based on a location of the vehicle. The alert signal is communicated to the one or more entities along with the recorded in-vehicle activities.

title_ko: 차량용 사고기록 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량 사고 기록 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사고 당시의 차량 내부 또는 외부의 영상을 촬영하는 카메라, 차량의 충돌 여부를 감지하는 가속도 센서, 차량의 현재 위치를 검출하는 GPS 모듈, 차량의 작동정보를 산출하는 전자제어유닛, 상기 전자제어유닛으로부터 입력된 차량의 작동정보를 연산 및 변환처리하여 출력하는 내부 게이트웨이 모듈, 촬영된 영상 정보, 차량 충돌 감지정보, 사고 당시의 차량의 위치정보, 상기 내부 게이트웨이 모듈을 통해 수신된 차량의 작동정보를 연관시켜 기록하는 사고 기록부 및 상기 사고 기록부에 기록된 차량의 사고 정보를 통신망을 통해 외부로 송출하는 외부 게이트웨이 모듈을 포함하는 것으로서 차량 내부에 설치되는 차량 사고 기록장치, 상기 차량 사고 기록장치로부터 사고 당시의 컷영상, 사고위치 및 차량 작동정보를 수신하고, 이에 기초하여 사고 상황을 분석하고 긴급 상황 발생시 긴급처리를 수행하는 관제 서버 및 상기 차량 사고 기록장치로부터 수신된 차량의 사고 정보에 기초하여 사고 원인을 분석하고 사고 분석 결과를 영상 데이터 형태로 저장하는 사고 분석 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 사고 당시의 운전자 조작 정보 제공, 사고 영상 분석을 통한 신속한 긴급 출동, 촬영 영상에서의 단서 정보 인식 기능 제공, 사고의 정밀한 재구성을 통한 사고 사례의 데이터베이스화 및 이를 통한 사고 원인의 신속 정확한 분석이 가능한 효과가 있다.  
       
     차량, 자동차, 사고, 기록, 분석, 영상.

title_en: Method, server and computer-readable recording media for providing maritime safety service by using information on danger area
title_ko: 위험 지역에 대한 정보를 이용하여 해양 안전 서비스를 제공하는 방법, 서버 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method, a server and a computer-readable recording medium for providing a maritime safety service using information on a danger area. According to an aspect of the present invention, the method for providing a maritime safety service using information on a danger area comprises: (a) a step where a server acquires information on a plurality of danger areas where loss of lives can occur; and (b) a step where the server determines a specific danger area among the danger areas to which an unmanned aerial apparatus having a plurality of lifesaving units detachably installed thereon is to be dispatched to control the unmanned aerial apparatus to move to the specific danger area, and supports in separating at least one lifesaving unit among the lifesaving units from the unmanned aerial apparatus after the unmanned aerial apparatus reaches the specific danger area.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위험 지역에 대한 정보를 이용하여 해양 안전 서비스를 제공하는 방법, 서버 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 태양에 따르면, 위험 지역에 대한 정보를 이용하여 해양 안전 서비스를 제공하는 방법에 있어서, (a) 서버가, 인명 피해가 발생할 수 있는 복수의 위험 지역에 대한 정보를 획득하는 단계 및 (b) 상기 서버가, 상기 복수의 위험 지역 중, 복수의 인명구조 유닛이 착탈 가능하게 설치되어 있는 무인 항공 장치가 파견될 특정 위험 지역을 판단하여 상기 무인 항공 장치가 상기 특정 위험 지역으로 이동하도록 제어하고, 상기 무인 항공 장치가 상기 특정 위험 지역에 도달한 후 상기 인명구조 유닛 중 적어도 하나를 상기 무인 항공 장치로부터 분리하도록 지원하는 단계를 포함하는 방법이 제공된다.
assignees: KOREA OCEANIC AND ATMOSPHERIC SYSTEM TECHNOLOGY KOAST

title_en: Apparatus, method and recording medium storing command for determining proximity to specific person
title_ko: 특정인에 대한 근접성을 결정하기 위한 장치, 방법 및 명령을 기록한 기록 매체
abstract_en: Disclosed is an apparatus for determining proximity to a specific person, which determines a person who was close to an infection-confirmed person without disclosing movement of the infection-confirmed person to the public. According to the present invention, the apparatus comprises one or more processors and one or more memories. The one or more processors acquires homomorphically encrypted first moving line information from a server which homogeneously encrypts first moving line information indicating a moving line of a specific person on the basis of a homomorphic encryption algorithm; acquires second movement information indicating a user's movement from one or more memories; determines homomorphically encrypted proximity information indicating whether the user was close to the specific person on the basis of the homomorphically encrypted first moving line information and the second moving line information; transfers the homomorphically encrypted proximity information to the serve; and acquires an alarm delivered from the server on the basis of decreased proximity information.
abstract_ko: 본 개시는 특정인에 대한 근접성을 결정하기 위한 장치를 제안한다.  본 개시에 따른 장치는 하나 이상의 프로세서 및 하나 이상의 메모리를 포함할 수 있다.  하나 이상의 프로세서는, 특정인의 동선을 지시하는 제1 동선 정보를 동형 암호 알고리즘에 기초하여 동형 암호화하는 서버로부터 동형 암호화된 제1 동선 정보를 획득하고, 하나 이상의 메모리로부터 사용자의 동선을 지시하는 제2 동선 정보를 획득하고, 동형 암호화된 제1 동선 정보 및 제2 동선 정보에 기초하여, 사용자가 특정인에 대해 근접했었는지 여부를 지시하는 동형 암호화된 근접성 정보를 결정하고, 동형 암호화된 근접성 정보를 서버로 전달하고, 복호화된 근접성 정보에 기초해 서버로부터 전달된 알람을 획득할 수 있다.

title_en: Attachable display pad module for rescuers, control method and recording medium for performing the same
title_ko: 구조대원을 위한 어태처블 디스플레이 패드 모듈, 제어 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 기록매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구조대원을 위한 어태처블 디스플레이 패드 모듈에 관한 것으로, 서버, 착용 장치 및 아이디-태그(ID Tag)와 통신하는 통신부; 형상 변형이 가능하도록 마련되고, 상기 서버로부터 수신되는 화재와 관련된 출동 정보 및 상기 구조대상자에 대한 구조 정보가 출력되는 스트레처블 디스플레이(Stretchable display); 스트레처블 디스플레이의 일부에 구비되는 탈부착부; 및 상기 착용 장치 및 아이디-태그로부터 수신되는 정보 중 적어도 하나가 사전에 마련되는 이벤트 조건을 만족하면, 상기 구조대원의 시야를 기준으로 상기 스트레처블 디스플레이의 영역을 분할하고, 상기 구조대원을 위한 알림 정보 및 타인을 위한 경고 정보가 분할된 영역 중 서로 다른 영역에 출력되도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이에 의해 화재 현장에서 구조대상자를 구조하는 구조대원이 인명구조를 원활하고 신속하게 수행할 수 있도록 하는 것은 물론, 구조대원의 인명을 보호할 수 있다.

title_en: Electronic control apparatus of automobile driving simulation cabin group
abstract_en: The invention provides an electronic control apparatus of an automobile driving simulation cabin group. The electronic control apparatus is connected to a plurality of driving simulation cabins. The electronic control apparatus comprises an upper computer, a command parser and collection and control circuit boards. The upper computer sends a command packet to the command parser through a data uplink unit. The command parser parses the command packet into an individual cabin command and then sends to each collection and control circuit board through a data downlink unit. The collection and control circuit board receives the individual cabin command and executes, and then returns driving simulation cabin operation data to the command parser through the data downlink unit. The parser receives all the driving simulation cabin operation data, and then packs the data and sends to the upper computer through the data uplink unit. The apparatus can realize functions of independently collecting and transmitting individual cabin operation data of a traditional electronic control apparatus, and can collect real-time operation data of all the cabins of the cabin group in real time and record so as to carry out later-period analysis and research.
assignees: BEIJING SUNHEART SIMULATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mobile sharing intelligent garbage can scheduling control software system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of garbage classification, and discloses a mobile sharing intelligent garbage can scheduling control software system, which comprises a user order management unit, a task scheduling unit, a monitoring management unit and a sorting supervision unit; the user order management unit is used for realizing address doorplate management, payment management, order placing and calling intelligent garbage cans, order record inquiry and point system management; the task scheduling unit is used for scheduling and commanding a plurality of intelligent garbage cans in a distributed mode through a task scheduling program; the monitoring management unit is used for uploading the faults of all the intelligent garbage cans and the sensors and the system running state to server-side software through a network; the sorting supervision unit is used for realizing electronic supervision of resident garbage classification through intelligent garbage can cover opening control. The invention can effectively implement garbage classification, can still facilitate all building owners to classify and throw garbage under various weather conditions in all regions of the country, can be popularized and realizes the intelligent management of garbage classification.
assignees: GUANGZHOU HECHUANG FUTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shared vehicle scheduling method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling method, a scheduling device, computer equipment and a storage medium of shared vehicles, wherein the method comprises the following steps: predicting the total number of predicted vehicles of each time node of a target station in a preset time period after the current time by using a prediction model obtained by pre-training; acquiring the maximum capacity of a target station; determining a time node with the minimum total number of the predicted vehicles, acquiring the minimum total number of the predicted vehicles, determining a time node with the maximum total number of the predicted vehicles, and acquiring the maximum total number of the predicted vehicles; and determining the vehicle dispatching quantity and generating a dispatching task based on the numerical value size relationship among the minimum predicted vehicle total number, the maximum predicted vehicle total number and the maximum capacity so as to allow the staff to carry out vehicle dispatching. The vehicle dispatching quantity determined based on the prediction result can be used for early warning and dispatching tasks in advance, dispatching tasks and dispatching staff are prevented from being redistributed and dispatched for dispatching after accumulation, and the working efficiency and the dispatching timeliness of the staff are improved.
assignees: SHANGHAI JUNZHENG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for measuring combustion ash content of forest vegetation
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for measuring the combustion ash content of forest vegetation, belongs to the technical field of fire prevention, and is used for solving the problem that the combustion ash content of the vegetation after forest fire happens cannot be accurately, timely and effectively analyzed at present. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting branches and leaves of typical forest vegetation, then putting ash after the branches and leaves are fully combusted into a device system penetrated by a laser-induced spectrum, then recording the spectral intensity of main elements of the ash corresponding to a specific spectral line position, establishing a model by adopting a partial least square method and carrying out quantitative analysis on the ash burnt by the forest. The method firstly analyzes the content of each element in the typical vegetation combustion ash after the forest fire, then researches the combustion characteristics of different vegetation in the forest from the combustion ash level and determines the fire prevention index, and carries out timely fire scene positioning and monitoring on the forest fire through a forest management information system, thereby providing information technical support for a forest fire suppression command department and having important significance for preventing and controlling the forest fire.

title_en: Accident trend identification method based on time sequence analysis
abstract_en: The application provides an accident trend identification method based on time sequence analysis, which comprises the following steps: denoising historical safety accident data on a production line, extracting a time point, and eliminating interference of sporadic interference factors on accident analysis; according to the periodicity law obtained by the frequency domain analysis, carrying out seasonal trend analysis on the historical security accident record through a seasonal autoregressive integral moving average model; characteristic learning is carried out by utilizing a random forest algorithm according to seasonal trends, and accident evolution characteristics are identified and extracted from nonlinear and non-stationary time sequences; identifying and quantifying the sensitivity and vulnerability difference of dual links on the production line in the event of an accident, and predicting the reactions of different production line links in the event of the accident; and predicting the reactions of different production line links in the event of an accident, simulating an emergency response strategy, and adjusting the emergency response strategy of the production line.

title_en: Emergency response coordination system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coordination response, in particular to an emergency response coordination system based on the Internet of things, the system comprises an abnormal event identification module, an event influence analysis module, a resource dynamic matching module, an emergency scheme making module, a scene simulation previewing module, a priority adjustment module, a real-time monitoring module and an intelligent scheduling command module. According to the invention, discrete event simulation is adopted in the resource dynamic matching module, emergency resources can be dynamically collected and distributed according to the regional influence rating in the event influence analysis record, the accuracy of resource allocation is remarkably improved, the resource utilization rate is optimized, key resources and personnel can be rapidly scheduled to the most needed place, the scene simulation previewing module adopts an individual as the model, the practicability and the reliability of an emergency scheme are improved by simulating different response strategies, the emergency response speed and accuracy are ensured, and casualties and property loss are effectively reduced.
assignees: ANYUE NETWORK TECH NANTONG CO LTD

title_en: Social treatment work order dispatching method, medium and equipment based on emergency degree assessment
abstract_en: The invention provides a social treatment work order dispatching method, medium and equipment based on emergency degree assessment, and belongs to the technical field of social treatment information. The method comprises the steps of collecting text data and image data in a social management work order, calling a text encoder and an image encoder, converting the text data and the image data into text feature vectors and image feature vectors respectively, detecting consistency of the text feature vectors and the image feature vectors of the same work order, calculating emotion intensity based on the text feature vectors, combining dangerous degree and time codes of corresponding work order events, splicing the generated vectors into a trained neural network model, generating a work order emergency index, dividing the emergency degree of the work order by comparing the work order emergency index with a preset threshold, and dispatching the work order according to the emergency degree of the work order. The invention obviously improves the disposal timeliness of the social treatment worksheet by introducing the cross characteristic, residual connection and Swish-activated multi-layer perceptron network.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM HONGXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and early warning management and control system for high-speed on-duty linkage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent monitoring early warning management and control system for high-speed on-duty linkage, and relates to the technical field of AI (advanced technology) research. The system comprises a data processing and early warning module and an information acquisition and interaction module, wherein the data processing and early warning module and the information acquisition and interaction module acquire image, position and equipment motion state information in real time through mobile terminal equipment, bidirectional information interaction with background management equipment is realized, timeliness and comprehensiveness of information transmission are guaranteed, the data processing and early warning module can accurately identify abnormal conditions of high-speed road conditions, duty force distribution and equipment operation through multi-dimensional data fusion and abnormality degree analysis of the position, the image and the equipment state, and can adjust weight coefficients according to actual requirements to realize grading early warning, the overall system comprehensively improves management efficiency and emergency response capability of high-speed joint service linkage, can timely find and treat various problems, effectively guarantees smoothness and trip safety of a highway network, and promotes intelligent and refined development of high-speed management.
assignees: SHANDONG HI SPEED JINING DEV CO LTD

title_en: Infotainment system for notifying emergency rescue request and method thereof
title_ko: 긴급 구조 요청 알림 인포테인먼트 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for notifying an emergency rescue request using an infotainment system. An emergency rescue request notification method in a vehicle according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises the steps of: detecting an accident of the vehicle; collecting information corresponding to the detected accident; generating an emergency rescue request message based on the collected information; searching for an FM radio channel with the highest reception sensitivity; changing the program type of the searched FM radio channel to a specific value using an FM radio data system message and transmitting the same; and transmitting the emergency rescue request message through the discovered FM radio channel. Accordingly, the present invention has the advantage of being able to provide a vehicle emergency rescue service more safely and inexpensively.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인포테인먼트 시스템을 이용한 긴급 구조 요청 알림 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 실시 예에 따른 차량에서의 긴급 구조 요청 알림 방법은 상기 차량의 사고를 감지하는 단계와 상기 감지된 사고에 상응하는 정보를 수집하는 단계와 상기 수집된 정보에 기초하여 긴급 구조 요청 메시지를 생성하는 단계와 수신 감도가 최상위인 FM 라디오 채널을 탐색하는 단계와 상기 탐색된 FM 라디오 채널의 프로그램 타입을 FM 무선 데이터 시스템 메시지를 이용하여 특정 값으로 변경하여 전송하는 단계와 상기 탐색된 FM 라디오 채널을 통해 상기 긴급 구조 요청 메시지를 전송하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 따라서, 본 발명은 보다 안전하고 저렴하게 차량 긴급 구조 서비스를 제공할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Augmented reality-based educational programming language authoring system using block smart toys
title_ko: 블록형 스마트토이를 활용한 증강현실 기반 교육용 프로그래밍언어 저작 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an augmented reality (AR)-based educational programming language authoring system using block smart toys, which implements various commands by using one block-type smart toy. According to the present invention, the AR-based educational programming language authoring system comprises: a plurality of block-type smart toys including identification units corresponding to one or a plurality of commands for each side of a rectangular parallelepiped; an array plate having a plurality of grooves into which the plurality of block-type smart toys can be inserted and supported; a photographing unit including a first photographing unit photographing the block-type smart toy and a second photographing unit photographing an AR marker paper; a display unit displaying an AR image corresponding to the AR marker paper; a block processing unit photographing the block-type smart toy from the image of the first photographing unit, recognizing the command corresponding to the identification unit of the block-type smart toy, receiving the command related to a selection of an object displayed in the AR image or a coding mission, combining the command corresponding to the identification unit with the command corresponding to the object or the received command, and completing the combined commands into corresponding execution statements when the combined command corresponds to a predetermined action, logic, or control; and an image processing unit processing results of the combined commands from the block processing unit to be displayed on the AR image.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 블록형 스마트토이를 활용한 증강현실 기반 교육용 프로그래밍언어 저작 시스템은 직육면체의 각 면마다 하나 또는 복수의 명령어에 대응되는 식별부가 구비된 복수의 블록형 스마트토이; 상기 복수의 블록형 스마트토이가 삽입되어 지지될 수 있는 다수의 홈을 갖는 배열판; 상기 블록형 스마트토이를 촬영하는 제1촬영부와 증강현실 마커지를 촬영하는 제2촬영부를 포함하는 촬영부; 상기 증강현실 마커지에 대응한 증강현실영상을 표시하는 디스플레이부; 상기 제1촬영부의 영상으로부터 상기 블록형 스마트 토이를 촬영하며 상기 블록형 스마트 토이의 상기 식별부에 대응한 명령어를 인식하고 상기 증강현실영상에 표시된 오브젝트의 선택 또는 코딩 미션에 관련된 명령어를 수신하며, 상기 식별부에 대응한 명령어와 상기 오브젝트에 대응된 명령어 또는 상기 수신된 명령어를 조합하고, 상기 조합된 명령어가 미리 정해진 행위, 논리, 또는 제어에 대응한다면, 상기 조합된 명령어들을 해당 실행 문장으로 완성하는 블록처리부; 및 상기 블록처리부로부터 상기 조합된 명령어들의 처리 결과를 상기 증강현실영상 상에 표시하도록 처리하는 영상처리부;를 포함한다.

title_en: A customized automatic guidance system for terminal situation characteristics through automatic analysis by risk type
title_ko: 위험유형별 자동분석을 통한 단말기 상황특성 맞춤형 자동안내 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic guide system customized for terminal situation characteristics through automatic analysis for each risk type to solve problems caused by the operation of a situation room in a person-centered call center method, that is, accuracy of determining whether there is a false fact through a phone call with a reporter, the time required accordingly, switching to ars standby when on the phone, securing 24-hour situation room operation manpower, and costs. The system comprises: a report terminal (100a) providing event information for report; an operating company server (200) generating event information for guide by automatically analyzing the fact of the event information for report, sharing a link server (300), and transmitting a message to a receiving terminal (100b); the receiving terminal (100b) automatically guiding the received event information for guide, the generated event information for comparison, and automatic comparison and analysis only when the received event information for guide and the generated event information for comparison are matched with an automatic guide condition customized for terminal situation characteristics, and automatically blocking the guide when the received event information for guide and the generated event information for comparison and analysis are not matched; and the link server (300) of the government, a local government, an emergency joint management center, a police station, a fire station, a meteorological administration, a Korea expressway corporation, a navigation company, an insurance company, etc. sharing fixed and movable risk information with the operating company server (200) and operating a call center. According to the present invention, when a corresponding icon is selected among risk types provided through a menu method or voice recognition on a reporting terminal screen or a command is commanded by voice, event information for reporting, which is classified into a fixed type or a movable type according to the risk type, is automatically transmitted to an operator server without a voice and a video call with a call center counselor to report a dangerous situation, thereby quickly and accurately reporting the dangerous situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위험유형별 자동분석을 통한 단말기 상황특성 맞춤형 자동안내 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 
메뉴 형식으로 제공되는 위험 유형 선택 또는 음성명령을 통해 위험 유형을 선택하면 선택한 위험 유형에 따라 유형이 구분된 신고용 이벤트 정보를 생성, 운영사 서버로 제공하는 모바일 단말기와 자동차 단말기로 구성한 신고 단말기와 상기 신고 단말기로부터 접수된 신고용 이벤트 정보 및 연계 서버와 공유한 위험정보를 자동분석 프로그램을 통해 사실 여부에 관해 확인하고, 사실이면 유형 구분을 ‘모바일 고정형’, ‘모바일 이동형’, ‘자동차 이동형’ ‘연계 서버 고정형’, ‘연계 서버 이동형’으로 자동 구분하고 유형 구분에 따라 안내용 이벤트 정보를 생성, 연계 서버 공유 및 수신 단말기로 전송하는 운영사 서버, 상기 운영사 서버와 위험 데이터를 공유하는 연계 서버, 상기 운영사 서버로부터 안내용 이벤트 정보를 수신하면 비교형 이벤트 정보를 생성하여 안내용 이벤트 정보와 비교용 이벤트 정보의 비교 분석을 통해, 단말기 상황특성 맞춤형 자동안내 조건 일치 시 자동안내하고, 일치하지 않으면 안내를 자동 차단하는 모바일 단말기와 자동차 단말기로 구성한 수신 단말기로 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 위험유형별 자동분석을 통한 단말기 상황특성 맞춤형 자동안내 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Flood water level monitoring method and system for power equipment and facilities
abstract_en: A flood water level monitoring method and system for power equipment and facilities. The method comprises: upon receiving a flood disaster emergency response notification and a heavy rainfall defense alarm, starting a flood water level monitoring process for power equipment and facilities; and, according to the separate areas of power equipment and facilities affected by the flood disaster, the total area of the power equipment and facilities and water level sensing monitoring information of the power equipment and facility bodies, constructing a neural network for measuring a disaster damage range of a power equipment and facility area, and outputting a monitoring result of the submerged surface height of the area where the power equipment and facilities are located. The present invention realizes the function of performing around-the-clock real-time monitoring of flood disaster-affected power equipment and facility areas on the basis of hydrological release data and water level monitoring data, overcoming the problem about measuring the submerged surface height of the areas where power equipment and facilities are located, and ensuring excellent timeliness and accuracy of monitoring results of the submerging height, degree and time of disaster-affected power equipment and facility areas.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE OF GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Advanced smart pandemic and infectious disease response engine
abstract_en: A method of predicting a spread of an infectious disease and evaluating pandemic response resources is disclosed. The method includes generating a predictive model, obtaining a set of patient data and a set of resource data from a plurality of data sources, geocoding the patient and resource data, loading the data into a geospatial data analytic application (or spatial data infrastructure) and applying the predictive model to the patient data and the resource data. The method further includes determining resource levels based on an output of the predictive model, outputting the resource levels formatted for integration into a data processing system such as an electronic health records system , other clinical application, emergency response management system, supply chain management system, or any other suitable data processing system, to trigger a resource allocation and/or procurement, and adjusting the set of resource data based on the resource allocation and/or procurement.

title_en: Method and system for servicing enhanced 911 calls
abstract_en: The present invention is a method and system for servicing enhanced 911 emergency calls. The present invention is utilized in a network providing Voice over Internet Protocol (VOIP) by a service provider to a user using a VoIP phone. When a user originates an emergency 911 call from the VoIP phone, a gateway communicating with a digital class 5 switch within the network, analyzes the signaling packets received from the VoIP phone and determines if a VoIP call originated by the user is an emergency 911 call. If the call is an emergency 911 call, the gateway will also determine if the VoIP call originates from the user's listed location provided to the service provider. If the call is not originated from the listed home location, the call is handled in a manner to prevent sending emergency response teams to the wrong location. The call may be processed and transferred to a specialized emergency call center which is informed that the call is not originating from the user's listed location. Alternatively, or in combination, a recording may be played informing the user and/or the call center that the call is not originating from the user's listed address.

title_en: Rapid emergency dispatching system
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid emergency dispatching system, aiming at solving the problem of low efficiency of the traditional manual dispatching mode. The system is mainly developed in specific to the integral dispatching flow and the management of emergency events and provides a series of intelligent treatments including incoming call positioning, HER/HIS (Electronic Health Record/Hospital Information System) access, commanding and dispatching, vehicle monitoring, information service, query and statistics and the like in the entire process starting from call incoming by dialing 120 to emergency vehicle dispatching to a field. The rapid emergency dispatching system not only improves the dispatching and vehicle dispatching efficiency, but also ensures that vehicles and hospitals are sufficiently prepared in advance for receiving patients, so that precious rescue time is saved, the data of an overall emergency process can be completely preserved, reliable guarantee is provided to patient treatment and the acquisition of complete patient information by the doctors, and flow reformation and resource integration are realized to improve rescue efficiency.
assignees: SHANGHAI HUAMEILUO INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Shock level rapid estimation method, system and terminal based on strong shock PGV
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information technology service, discloses a method, a system and a terminal for rapidly estimating the magnitude based on a strong vibration PGV, which solves the problem that the magnitude obtained by the traditional method for estimating the magnitude by using strong vibration displacement is affected by saturation effect to cause underestimation of the magnitude of large vibration, the method is technically characterized in that a strong vibration acceleration data set of the earthquake event with 23 times of earthquake magnitude between M  w  6.0 and M  w .0 in the global scope is constructed, the time course direction, the record dimension and the file format of the acceleration record are processed uniformly, the acceleration record is preprocessed by a high-pass filtering method, the three-dimensional PGV is extracted after the speed is obtained through integration, and then a strong vibration PGV earthquake magnitude model is constructed. The method realizes real-time and rapid estimation of the large earthquake magnitude based on the strong earthquake observation means, and provides technical support for rapid earthquake early warning and post-earthquake emergency response.

title_en: Comprehensive system and method for extinguishing explosion accident and guaranteeing life in airtight space
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive system and a method for extinguishing explosion accident and guaranteeing life in a closed space, wherein the system comprises a fire monitoring and alarming subsystem, an extinguishing and life guaranteeing subsystem, a data recording and analyzing subsystem and a remote monitoring and controlling subsystem; the method comprises the steps of monitoring whether a fire disaster occurs in a closed space or not and the occurrence situation of the fire disaster, sending an alarm and sending fire disaster position information to a fire extinguishing and life protecting subsystem if the fire disaster is detected, selecting a program according to the nature and the degree of the fire disaster to extinguish the fire, monitoring the oxygen concentration in the closed space and providing life protecting equipment, recording and analyzing the data of the fire disaster, improving the performance and emergency response strategy of the system through data analysis, realizing remote monitoring and control of the system through network connection, and monitoring the running state of the system through terminal equipment to perform remote operation and control. The invention can improve the emergency response capability and the personnel safety guarantee level of the explosion accident in the closed space.

title_en: Single big dipper car record appearance that traveles of integrated safe auxiliary driving function
abstract_en: The invention provides a single Beidou automobile travel recorder integrated with a safety auxiliary driving function, which comprises a travel recording module, a single Beidou positioning module, a safety auxiliary driving module and a target influence factor, wherein the travel recording module is used for recording the travel of an automobile, the single Beidou positioning module is used for positioning the automobile in a single Beidou mode, the safety auxiliary driving module is used for predicting the travel risk of the automobile and scheduling the automobile to carry out emergency response on the travel risk, and the target influence factor is used for predicting target influence factors which can cause the driver of the automobile to cause driving distraction in the future and carrying out the auxiliary for avoiding the driving distraction on the driver in advance aiming at the target influence factors. According to the automobile traveling recorder, the accurate positioning and the effective integration of the safe auxiliary driving are realized through the single Beidou positioning module and the safe auxiliary driving module, and the automobile traveling recorder is convenient and fast to install on a vehicle and avoids increasing the management cost of an automobile owner on the premise of realizing accurate positioning, traveling risk prediction and response of the automobile and driving distraction avoidance assistance of a driver.

title_en: Wireless emergency bell control system and method, and computer-readable recording medium
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention relate to a wireless emergency bell and a method for controlling a wireless emergency bell installed in a school and a school zone, the method comprising the steps of: receiving an input signal generated by pressing a provided button by a reporter when an emergency situation occurs; generating an emergency bell signal, repeatedly transmitting the generated emergency bell signal to at least one pager and a receiver during a predetermined configuration time, and outputting a prestored alarm sound to the outside through a provided speaker; generating an emergency bell voice signal and transmitting the generated emergency bell voice signal to the at least one pager and the receiver; generating an emergency bell voice transmission completion signal indicating that the emergency bell voice signal has been completely transmitted, and transmitting the generated emergency bell voice transmission completion signal to the at least one pager and the receiver; converting an operation of the wireless emergency bell into a reception mode in which data can be automatically received from at least one pager after a configured time; receiving a pager voice signal from the at least one pager; determining whether the received pager voice signal exists, and outputting the received pager voice signal to the outside through the speaker when the received pager voice signal exists; and determining whether a mode conversion command signal is received from the at least one pager when the received pager voice signal does not exist, and converting the operation of the wireless emergency bell into a transmission mode in which data can b e transmitted to the at least one pager and the receiver when there is the received mode conversion command signal.

title_en: Rapid emergency dispatching system
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid emergency dispatching system, aiming at solving the problem of low efficiency of the traditional manual dispatching mode. The system is mainly developed in specific to the integral dispatching flow and the management of emergency events and provides a series of intelligent treatments including incoming call positioning, HER/HIS (Electronic Health Record/Hospital Information System) access, commanding and dispatching, vehicle monitoring, information service, query and statistics and the like in the entire process starting from call incoming by dialing 120 to emergency vehicle dispatching to a field. title_en: Fire-fighting and rescuing command computer simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire-fighting and rescuing command computer simulation training system. The fire-fighting and rescuing command computer simulation training system comprises a guide and scheduling controlling room, a simulation training controlling room, an observation and discussing controlling room and a database server; the guide and scheduling controlling room and the observation and discussing controlling room are connected with the simulation training controlling room and the database server respectively through a computer network. According to the fire-fighting and rescuing command computer simulation training system, the vision, hearing and touch integrated scene dynamic virtual environment of fire hazards or other hazards can be generated, the virtual environment fidelity is high, the immersion feeling is high, and interaction is good; users in different geographical areas and at different physical locations can share one virtual hazard scene in a real-time synchronization mode, and the users can be in interaction with various objects in the virtual environment through an input device.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLES ARMED POLICE FORCE ACADEMY

title_en: Mobile property data recorder and transmitter
abstract_en: An acceleration-based athletic data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel quantity sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor circuit board. The inertial navigation sensor circuit board includes: a three-axis gyroscope, a three-axis accelerometer, a three-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allow for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with collision detection, detection of rough operating conditions, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of moving objects. Users are able to locate areas of their property that encounter harsh operating environments and alert in real time using the normal operation of their mobile property, provide faster emergency response, and make repairs and new routing effective.

title_en: Intelligent networking method for fire-fighting system and fire-fighting controller thereof
abstract_en: The intelligent networking method for the fire fighting system is characterized in that the running states of all fire fighting controllers in a fire fighting network are obtained by acquiring authentication information, detecting conflicts, forming configuration data and forming a sending rule table, so that all the fire fighting controllers can recognize each other and make corresponding records according to recognition results, and all the fire fighting controllers make corresponding control commands according to the records of the fire fighting controllers. The utility model provides a fire control controller, including bottom communication interface, intelligence network deployment device and upper control unit, wherein, the authentication information in the fire control network is acquireed and configuration data is formed to intelligence network deployment device on the one hand, on the other hand receives upper control unit's service command and produces external control command according to sending the rule table, thereby make whole fire control system possess intelligent information processing process, can independently realize the network deployment problem, also make the staff needn't debug the network deployment controller frequently, the maintenance cost of fire control system has also been reduced simultaneously.
assignees: SHENZHEN FANHAI SANJIANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Subway and ground police force linkage service management method based on structured data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a subway and ground police force linkage service management method based on structured data, which comprises the steps of establishing a corresponding relation between a subway station and a ground jurisdiction, and storing structured data through a database according to a hierarchical relation; the subway and the ground respectively carry out the service management of the unit, and the information of the service scheduling is input, so that the management of service elements such as posts, personnel, equipment and the like is realized; and carrying out service association query display by combining the association relationship between the subway and the ground and the service information recorded by each unit to realize bidirectional association butt joint, and carrying out visual display by combining a map and a chart. The invention can improve the efficiency of public security service management, break the message barrier between the subway and the ground and provide powerful support for commanding and dispatching and emergency handling.
assignees: CHINA CHANGFENG SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY IND GROUP CORP

title_en: Video detection system based on police affair command platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to a video detection system based on a police service command platform, which comprises: the command scheduling module is used for butting the video detection data subjected to video data cleaning and situation perception analysis, displaying detection information and manually analyzing and judging the detection information by a commander; the mobile police service module is used for realizing that the mobile police service terminal receives video detection alarm information, handles feedback and cooperatively commands combat; the statistical analysis module is used for statistically analyzing the video detection result according to dimensions such as event types, region positions, time scales and the like; and the work recording module is associated with the command platform work recording module, so that the video detection and disposal of the work record are realized, and data storage is provided. The video detection system of the invention efficiently commands and dispatches, realizes the event coping strategy, realizes that the mobile police terminal receives video detection alarm information, handles the feedback and cooperatively commands the battle.
assignees: SUZHOU GUANGLI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sit-up detection system and method based on human body and skeleton key point identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sit-up detection system and a sit-up detection method based on human body and bone key point identification, wherein the sit-up detection system comprises: the image acquisition module acquires a video image of the testee by adopting a high-definition camera; the image identification module is used for extracting human skeleton key points of the testee in the continuous frames; the action detection module is used for detecting the change condition of an included angle formed by a straight line formed by the waist key point and the shoulder key point and a relative horizontal position of the human skeleton key point of the tested person in the continuous frames to judge whether the tested person lies down or sits up or lies down to sit up; the judging and counting module is used for judging and recording the times of the sit-up of the testee in the testing time; and the data display module is used for displaying the times of the sit-up completed by the testee within the test time. The invention has the advantages of high detection speed and low cost, is suitable for single-person or multi-person detection, and can be applied to sports home operation, exercise detection in an emergency response state and other scenes.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG;SICHUAN LEJIAN DREAMER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Agricultural disaster early warning and emergency response method integrating weather big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural disaster treatment, and discloses an agricultural disaster early warning and emergency response method integrating weather big data. The method comprises the steps of receiving heterogeneous meteorological data flow of a target area, performing space-time alignment and feature fusion through a disaster feature decoupling model, and generating a disaster potential energy field distribution map and a disaster category probability matrix. And constructing a self-adaptive early warning threshold model, and generating a multi-mode emergency response instruction set. Simulating a disaster secondary event cascade effect by using a disaster chain propagation model, optimizing collaborative decision parameters, and outputting a disaster response action sequence to an agricultural emergency command platform through iterative optimization of a distributed reinforcement learning framework. According to the method, meteorological big data are comprehensively utilized, the early warning accuracy of agricultural disasters is improved, high-efficiency emergency response is achieved, resources are reasonably allocated, cross-department coordination is promoted, and the agricultural disaster loss is effectively reduced.

title_en: Drowning prevention monitoring method and system based on multi-source positioning data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of drowning prevention monitoring, in particular to a drowning prevention monitoring method and system based on multi-source positioning data, comprising the steps of multi-source data acquisition, positioning fusion and state marking of a wading environment, dynamic modeling of a virtual safety zone, dynamic positioning safety assessment and multistage linkage rescue response; the method comprises the steps of integrating satellite positioning, indoor positioning, wearing equipment and environment scanning equipment, collecting position, physiological state and environment data of wading personnel in real time, adopting dynamic reliability weight calculation and space-time alignment compensation technology, generating fusion positioning coordinates, constructing an elastic virtual safety zone boundary, evaluating risks through a safety scoring algorithm, and triggering multistage linkage rescue response, wherein the multistage linkage rescue response comprises wearing equipment alarming, audible and visual alarming, unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling and first-aid system linkage. The method remarkably improves timeliness and accuracy of drowning risk discovery, and optimizes rescue resource scheduling efficiency and rapidness of emergency response.

title_en: System for determining the authenticity of resident registration and method performing the same
title_ko: 보안 기능이 구비된 인감증명서 용지를 통해 출력된 인감증명서 진위 여부 판단 시스템 및 이의 실행 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for determining the authenticity of a seal certificate outputted through a seal certificate paper having a security function. The system for determining the authenticity of a seal certificate outputted through a seal certificate paper having a security function comprises: a first user terminal which selects a printing grade of a smart code and a service connected to the smart code when printing the seal certificate through a printing program, and commands a point cloud pattern to be inserted into a background screen of the seal certificate according to a code value generated according to the service connected to the smart code and then printed through a printing device; a printing device which prints the seal certificate with the printing grade of the smart code according to a request of the first user terminal; and a seal certificate paper distribution brokerage server which generates a code value using the service connected to the smart code and provides the code value to the first user terminal when the service connected to the smart code is received from the first user terminal when the first user terminal receives the seal certificate and prints the seal certificate through the printing program.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 보안 기능이 구비된 인감증명서 용지를 통해 출력된 인감증명서 진위 여부 판단 시스템은 인쇄 프로그램을 통해 인감증명서를 인쇄할 때 스마트 코드의 인쇄 등급 및 스마트 코드와 연결되는 서비스를 선택하며, 상기 스마트 코드와 연결되는 서비스에 따라 생성된 코드 값에 따라 인감증명서의 배경 화면에 점군 패턴을 삽입된 후 인쇄 장치를 통해 인쇄되도록 명령하는 제1 사용자 단말, 상기 제1 사용자 단말의 요청에 따라 스마트 코드의 인쇄 등급으로 인감증명서를 인쇄하는 인쇄 장치 및 상기 제1 사용자 단말이 인감증명서를 발급받아 인쇄 프로그램을 통해 인감증명서를 인쇄할 때 상기 제1 사용자 단말로부터 스마트 코드와 연결되는 서비스를 수신하면, 스마트 코드와 연결되는 서비스를 이용하여 코드 값을 생성하여 상기 제1 사용자 단말에 제공하는 인감증명서 용지 유통 중개 서버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for communication with emergency dispatch services
abstract_en: Emergency reporting is described in which user input is received in an emergency call that is used to classify the call. Based on the classification process, emergency calls are processed to give priority to certain calls. The calls that are given the highest priority may be transmitted by a voice network and other calls may be transmitted by a data network. The reporting includes receiving user input identifying an emergency perspective of the user and selecting a data call based on the emergency perspective indicating the user is a bystander. It also includes recording an audio message from the user and transmitting the audio message to a public service answering point (PSAP) over a data network.

title_en: Danger detection system using smart insole, processing method therefor, and storage medium for recording computer program for same
title_ko: 스마트 깔창을 이용한 위험 감지 시스템 및 그 처리 방법, 그리고 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램을 기록한 저장 매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a danger detection system using a smart insole, a processing method therefor, and a storage medium for recording a computer program for the same. The danger detection system of the present invention uses a danger recognition application so as to recognize whether a user of a smartphone is in a dangerous situation by using various pieces of sensor information of the smartphone and pressure information of the smart insole, and processes a message regarding location information of the user and the dangerous situation such that the message is transmitted to a set emergency contact point. According to the present invention, when the user of the smartphone and the smart insole does not move because of fainting, various kinds of falling accidents, and the like, which can occur during an outdoor activity, the smartphone can recognize the dangerous situation of the user and request an emergency rescue.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 깔창을 이용한 위험 감지 시스템 및 그 처리 방법, 그리고 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램을 기록한 저장 매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 위험 감지 시스템은 위험 인지 어플리케이션을 이용하여 스마트 폰의 다양한 센서 정보와 스마트 깔창의 압력 정보를 활용해서 스마트 폰의 사용자가 위험 상황에 있는지를 인지하고, 설정된 긴급 연락처로 사용자의 위치 정보와 위험 상황에 대한 메시지를 전송하도록 처리한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 스마트 폰과 스마트 깔창의 사용자가 야외 활동 중 발생할 수 있는 갑작스런 실신 및 각종 낙상 사고 등으로 인해 사용자가 움직이지 않을 경우, 스마트 폰이 사용자의 위험 상황을 인지하여 긴급 구호를 요청할 수 있다.
