title_en: Secure database systems and methods for delivering health care treatment
abstract_en: Databases comprising autonomous or semi-autonomous platforms for the diagnosis and treatment of patient conditions are disclosed. A CarePod is configured to be a system for affecting an authenticatable, HIPAA-compliant communications and monitoring platform to facilitate patient's on-going diagnosis and treatment of a given condition. In the area of psychotherapy, CarePod/IA may affect methods for allowing new members into the treatment group by directing a set of diagnostic tools and tests, ingesting response data, re-evaluating such response data to fine tune diagnosis as to patient's condition. Facilitated communications by and between members may be monitored by and between members by a CarePod/IA and, depending upon threshold conditions, may either update a patient's care dashboard/record or take a plurality of actions (e.g., emergency responses) as the situation dictates.
assignees: CERRONE KIMBERLIE;AGAHI FARID;ALTOBELLO DAN;NORMAN SETH;ACKERMAN TODD;TIATROS INC

title_en: A kind of method of setting up the emergent intelligent command system of flood control
abstract_en: The invention discloses the method for setting up the emergent intelligent command system of flood control, the prediction scheme of formulation is carried out to digitlization abstract, build one and comprise the prediction scheme storehouse of all flood control emergency preplan relevant informations, and corresponding emergency preplan entry condition, approving person, prompting personnel and corresponding execution flow process are set; According to the digitlization prediction scheme having generated, in the time that various measuring point information meets emergency preplan entry condition, automatic alarm immediately, and automatically start corresponding emergency preplan; Adopt workflow technology, each emergency preplan set handling is become to a series of mutual linkings, possesses the flow process of the condition of automatically performing, when starting after some emergency preplans, just examine and tasks carrying flow process according to the flow process setting in advance. The emergent intelligence commander of the flood control system queries that the present invention sets up facilitates, is swift in response, operating efficiency is high, command process is directly perceived, be conducive to emergency preplan rehearsal and perfect, flood control emergency command process record is complete.

title_en: Information display method, device, terminal equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an information display method, an information display device, terminal equipment and a computer readable storage medium, wherein the information display method comprises the following steps: and when the order is detected to be sent, receiving and displaying supply and demand prompt information corresponding to the historical order record. According to the technical scheme, the passenger is triggered to adopt a dynamic dispatching scheme or other service interfaces by displaying the supply and demand prompt information to the passenger, so that the traffic volume of the network car booking operation is increased, and the use experience of a user is improved.

title_en: A kind of Emergency Command Vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of Emergency Command Vehicle, comprise car body, in described car body, comprise driver's compartment and compartment district, described compartment district is divided into again front portion, middle part and 3rd district, rear portion, described front portion is operating space, middle part is rest area, and rear portion, for generating cabin, is provided with partition wall between described middle part and rear portion; Described operating space comprises rack, on described rack, be provided with operating desk, in described rack, be placed with ups power, server, electrical apparatus control system, power amplifier, printer, video/audio matrix switch, video encoder and 3G router, on described operating desk, be provided with display, described ups power provides the energy for other electrical equipment. and the beneficial effects of the utility model are: this Emergency Command Vehicle has been realized incident scene information collection, emergency vehicles are located in real time, daily tour record, emergency communication, the several functions such as emergency event floor manager.

title_en: Car dispatch service device, method, and computer-readable medium having program recorded thereon
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle dispatching service device for going to an evacuation facility, a vehicle dispatching service method for going to an evacuation facility and a computer readable medium recorded with a program, wherein the vehicle can be dispatched to the evacuation facility when large-scale power failure occurs for a long time, and the vehicle can be supplied with power. The vehicle dispatching service device 100 for traveling to an evacuation center includes: a calculation unit 130 that calculates an optimal mode of dispatching the electric vehicle 200 based on a vehicle request received from the user's terminal device 300 by the communication unit 110, vehicle notification information 164, and host information on each evacuation stored in advance in the storage unit 160, the vehicle notification information 164 being received by the communication unit 110, including identification information of the electric vehicle 200, position information of the electric vehicle 200, and information showing a state of charge of the electric vehicle 200, and being stored in the storage unit 160; and a management unit 140 that outputs information that instructs the electric vehicle 200 to dispatch the vehicle using the dispatch mode.

title_en: Landslide displacement monitoring method, system and device based on binocular stereo vision
abstract_en: The monitoring method comprises the steps of processing images, periodically acquiring a first image and a second image of a slope body to be measured after an acquisition command is triggered, recording shooting time, and calibrating a binocular image acquisition device to obtain a calibration result of the binocular image acquisition device; obtaining a three-dimensional image of the slope to be measured; generating a hot spot diagram related to unit displacement, and obtaining a displacement track and a first displacement value; and reporting the data, namely reporting the hot spot diagram, the displacement track and the first displacement value to a remote monitoring center. Compared with the related art, the method and the device have the effect of improving the problem of low monitoring efficiency.
assignees: SHENZHEN NORTHDOO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;SHENZHEN GAOGUANGPU NEW TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transfer station traceable berth management system based on RFID technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic berth management, in particular to a transfer station traceable berth management system based on an RFID technology. Comprising the following steps: the acquisition module comprises a wagon balance system, an RFID card and RFID card reading equipment; the control module is used for carrying out dispatching operation according to the state information of the incoming vehicle, or is used for firstly weighing and measuring through a wagon balance system when the transfer container of the transfer station leaves the transfer station and goes to a disposal garden area, automatically reading the RFID card of the container to record the number information of the transfer container of the transfer station when the container is out of the station, and recording the state information of the outgoing vehicle by combining the wagon balance measurement information. Based on RFID technology, the whole process and traceable monitoring of the garbage entering the transfer station are realized by combining the vehicle-mounted terminal, the GPS, the wagon balance system and other Internet of things equipment.
assignees: QINGDAO WATER GROUP CO LTD;QINGDAO SOLID WASTE DISPOSAL CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based pasture flock detection tracking method and safety early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pasture flock detection tracking method and a safety early warning system based on an unmanned plane, which belong to the technical field of automatic management of animal husbandry and comprise the following steps of S1, data acquisition and pretreatment, S2, detection model construction and training, and S3, flock tracking. The invention greatly expands the monitoring visual field range through the aerial working capability of the unmanned plane platform, reduces the labor cost, improves the monitoring timeliness and accuracy, is beneficial to animal husbandry managers to timely master the flock dynamics and make scientific decisions, can still keep higher recognition rate and tracking stability under complex environments through the proposed target detection model and multi-target tracking algorithm, effectively solves the problems of target shielding and the like, realizes the accurate detection and tracking of flock targets, and can timely find and report missing livestock conditions through the safety early warning system so as to provide powerful emergency response support for animal husbandry managers.

title_en: Rapid sick and wounded information registration method and system for emergency rescue
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for rapidly registering sick and wounded information for emergency rescue. The method comprises the steps of receiving information of a sick and wounded input by an on-site emergency personnel through mobile data acquisition application, generating a preliminary information record, presetting and processing relevance among emergency degree classification standards based on the preliminary information record by using a two-way long-short-term memory network algorithm, carrying out semantic analysis by using a natural language understanding technology, evaluating the emergency degree of the sick and wounded, generating an emergency degree grade of the sick and wounded, weighting and evaluating an information acquisition template by using a multi-layer perceptron-attention mechanism algorithm based on the emergency degree grade of the sick and wounded, adjusting the information acquisition template by using an automatic encoder method, generating an optimized information acquisition template, guiding the completion of detailed information collection based on the optimized information acquisition template, and generating an electronic file of the sick and wounded information. The technical scheme provided by the application obviously improves the emergency response efficiency and improves the information registration efficiency and accuracy of the sick and wounded.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire detection alarm device and system suitable for rail engineering vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire detection alarm device and a fire detection alarm system suitable for a track engineering vehicle, wherein the device comprises a main controller, a monitoring acousto-optic alarm, a twisted pair shielding cable, a compound sensor, a terminal resistor, a shielding network cable, a multi-core cable and a secondary controller; the system comprises a monitoring alarm module, a control output module, a fault alarm module, a self-checking module and an alarm recording module. The intelligent fire extinguishing system based on the RS485 bus integrates a plurality of groups of composite sensors, achieves multi-dimensional fusion analysis of smoke, temperature and flame signals, combines adjustable alarm threshold setting to reduce false alarm rate, and is characterized in that a main controller processes data in a centralized mode and is linked with 8 groups of fire extinguishing devices, and is matched with a double-cab main and auxiliary controller design to achieve real-time visual monitoring of the whole vehicle state and cross-region synchronous audible and visual alarm, shorten emergency response time, ensure full coverage of fire information, and enable the emergency starting of the fire extinguishing devices after power failure of a vehicle by means of a built-in standby power supply and redundant control logic.

title_en: Flood prevention road information real-time monitoring and display system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood control road information real-time monitoring and displaying system, which relates to the technical field of smart cities and flood control disaster reduction, and comprises the following components: the intelligent flood control system comprises a multi-source sensing acquisition module, an edge computing node module, a cloud data analysis module, a dynamic information board module and a mobile terminal early warning pushing module, wherein the efficiency and accuracy of flood control work can be remarkably improved, the multi-source sensing acquisition module of the system comprehensively acquires water depth, flow velocity, road surface bearing and video data through various sensors, a rich and accurate information basis is provided for flood control decision, the edge computing node module carries out preprocessing on original data, data transmission quantity and cloud processing pressure are reduced, timeliness and reliability of the data are guaranteed, the cloud data analysis module fuses historical hydrologic data and real-time sensing data, the ponding risk level is accurately predicted, and dynamic scheduling instructions are generated, so that flood control command personnel can timely know the actual conditions of roads.
assignees: CHUZHOU TRAFFIC ENG TEST AND TESTING CO LTD

title_en: Bus barrier-free travel service evaluation method for full-element cooperation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public transportation, in particular to a public transportation barrier-free travel service evaluation method oriented to full-element cooperation, which comprises the steps of constructing policy regulations by using a supervision and assessment mechanism, constructing space planning by using a transfer node ratio, constructing station equipment facilities by using infrastructure completeness and blind road paving safety, constructing vehicle carriers by using seat comfort, constructing vehicle operation scheduling, constructing dynamic supervision by using facility maintenance timeliness, constructing training and emergency management by using service training and spare vehicle dispatching efficiency, constructing an information service layer evaluation model, constructing satisfaction, constructing social public opinion by using front news report proportion, travel dependence and feedback problem distribution characteristics, and calculating comprehensive scores by using an evaluation method integrating AHP layering and fuzzy analysis. The invention solves the problems that the existing urban public transport barrier-free travel service evaluation system is imperfect, the evaluation method is single, the traffic passing efficiency cannot be effectively improved, and the traffic jam is solved.
assignees: JIANGSU URBAN AND RURAL CONSTRUCTION COLLEGE

title_en: Touch panel vending machine
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a vending machine having an electronic advertisement signboard function to dispatch information, a function to change a product display position with consideration given to a child or a handicapped person on a wheelchair, and a function to display disaster warning in occurrence of a disaster by equipping the vending machine with a large-scale liquid crystal display panel and a touch panel.  <P>SOLUTION: The touch panel vending machine having a communication means to connect with a network via a CATV or a telephone line includes: a display means displaying product information on a screen; a touch panel mounted on the screen of the displaying means; an input means for inputting information; and a recording means for recording and reproducing the product information. In a product sales standby state, the displaying means displays an advertisement based on images and voices distributed via the network. In selling products, when the touch panel is operated, the touch panel operation is linked with the product information displayed in the displaying means.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2011,JPO&INPIT

title_en: A virtual simulation system and a hardware control program embodiment method using the same
title_ko: 가상 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 하드웨어 제어 프로그램 구현방법
abstract_en: A virtual simulation system and a hardware control program implementation method for accomplishing the quality improvement of a teaching practice are provided to give a subject preparing the same program as the program controlling a hardware platform. Each command included in an embedded system control program is decoded and patched(130). Information controlling a specific hardware module comprising the embedded system in the decoded instruction is included is determined(140). According to a decision result, the information controlling the specific hardware module is transformed to the information controlling the specific software module(150). According to the transformed information, the specific software module is performed. The output data of the specific software module is indicated through the graphic user interface.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가상 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 하드웨어 제어 프로그램 구현 방법에 관한 것으로서, 특히 실습교육용으로 사용되는 임베디드 시스템을 구성하는 하드웨어 모듈들과 대응하는 소프트웨어 모듈들을 포함하고, 실행 프로그램 코드에 따른 실행결과를 그래픽 사용자 인터페이스를 통해 표시하는 가상 시뮬레이션 시스템 및 하드웨어 제어 프로그램 구현 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따른 하드웨어 제어 프로그램 구현 방법은, 사용자에 의해 작성된 임베디드 시스템 제어 프로그램에 포함된 각각의 명령어를 패치 및 디코딩하는 단계, 상기 디코딩된 명령어에 상기 임베디드 시스템을 구성하는 특정 하드웨어 모듈을 제어하는 정보가 포함되어있는지를 판단하는 단계, 상기 판단결과에 따라 상기 특정 하드웨어 모듈을 제어하는 정보를 그에 대응하는 특정 소프트웨어 모듈을 제어하는 정보로 변환하는 단계, 상기 변환된 정보에 따라 상기 특정 소프트웨어 모듈을 실행하는 단계, 및 상기 특정 소프트웨어 모듈의 출력 데이터를 그래픽 사용자 인터페이스를 통해 표시하는 단계를 포함한다. 
       
     임베디드 시스템, 시뮬레이션, 하드웨어 모듈, 소프트웨어 모듈, 실습교육

title_en: Apparatus and method for dealing with fine dust
title_ko: 미세먼지 대응 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an anti-fine dust apparatus and a method thereof. According to the present embodiment, the anti-fine dust apparatus includes a processor and a memory connected to the processor. The memory calculates an impact index at a measured fine dust concentration in view of a relationship between a pre-input age and the fine dust concentration measured at a current position by means of at least one sensor. The memory stores programs commands that can be executed by the processor such that anti-fine dust information is generated by means of the measured fine dust concentration and fine dust-related information received from a service server connected via a network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 미세먼지 대응 장치 및 방법을 개시한다. 본 실시예에 따르면, 프로세서 및 상기 프로세서에 연결된 메모리를 포함하며, 상기 메모리는, 하나 이상의 센서를 이용하여 현재 위치에서 측정된 미세먼지 농도와 미리 입력된 나이와의 관계를 고려하여 상기 측정된 미세먼지 농도에서의 영향지수를 계산하고, 네트워크를 통해 연결된 서비스 서버로부터 수신된 미세먼지 관련 정보와 상기 측정된 미세먼지 농도를 이용하여 미세먼지 대응 정보를 생성하도록, 상기 프로세서에 의해 실행 가능한 프로그램 명령어들을 저장하는 미세먼지 대응 장치가 제공된다.

title_en: System and method for controlling warining lights
title_ko: 비상 경고등 제어 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for controlling an emergency lamp of a vehicle and a method thereof. The system for controlling an emergency lamp according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an input unit which receives driving situation information; a memory in which a program is stored to determine whether it is necessary to automatically turn on the emergency lamp by using the driving situation information; and a process which executes the program. The processor is configured to: check whether it is necessary to turn on an emergency lamp by using driving situation information including at least one among front image information, vehicle in-between information, vehicle speed information, and brake control information; and transmit, when the emergency lamp is not turned on in a situation in which the emergency lamp needs to be turned on, an automatic emergency lamp turning command signal. According to the present invention, safety can be improved by notifying surrounding vehicles of an emergency situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량의 비상 경고등을 제어하는 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 실시예에 따른 비상 경고등 제어 시스템은 주행상황 정보를 수신하는 입력부와, 주행상황 정보를 이용하여 자동 비상 경고등 점등 필요 여부를 판단하는 프로그램이 저장된 메모리 및 프로그램을 실행시키는 프로세서를 포함하고, 프로세서는 전방 영상 정보, 차간 거리 정보, 차속 정보, 브레이크 제어 정보 중 적어도 어느 하나를 포함하는 주행상황 정보를 이용하여, 비상 경고등 점등이 필요한 상황인지 여부를 확인하고, 비상 경고등 점등이 필요한 상황에서 비상 경고등이 점등되어 있지 않은 경우, 자동 비상 경고등 점등 명령 신호를 전송하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Automated Emergency Response Systems for a Vehicle
abstract_en: A method of automated emergency response for a vehicle includes identifying a condition with respect to the vehicle that indicates a potential collision, and recording imagery in response to the identifying.
assignees: TOYOTA ENG & MFG NORTH AMERICA;TOYOTA MOTOR SALES USA INC

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and viewer for mobile assets that includes a data encoder, onboard data manager, and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Beidou autonomous navigation method based on Beidou short message and 4G communication mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Beidou autonomous navigation method based on a Beidou short message and a 4G communication mode, namely Beidou type airborne equipment acquires information such as the current position, speed, time and the like of an airplane in real time and sends the information in the form of ADS-C messages according to the requirements of a ground system; meanwhile, the ground low-altitude flight operation monitoring system receives the airspace situation information from other systems, codes and processes the situations of other airplanes around the target airplane, and transmits the coded information to the Beidou type airborne equipment in a short message mode through the Beidou command type user machine or the 4G communication equipment; the invention has the advantages that the positioning information sent by the Beidou type onboard equipment can be received; the system can monitor in real time at low altitude; the flight data such as the position, the height, the speed and the like of the navigation aircraft in the flight process can be recorded in real time through the airborne data recording module; the Beidou short message channel can be used for carrying out emergency command communication with the aircraft loaded with the Beidou type onboard equipment; and the seamless coverage of low-altitude navigation can be realized.

title_en: Double law enforcement work system and method based on real-time video
abstract_en: The system comprises a Web service module, a GIS service module, a streaming media service module, a central storage service module, a recorder, acquisition equipment, storage equipment and the like, realizes the double law enforcement service function between the recorder and a command console based on real-time video, stores video recorded on site at the recorder end as cooperative work evidence in the cooperative work process, facilitates subsequent backtracking evidence taking, can effectively meet the service requirement of requiring real-time participation of multiple persons, and particularly can solve the problem that the field law enforcement of police is difficult to be equipped with enough when the police strength is insufficient in some services. The system and the method are suitable for running in public networks and private networks, have strong applicability and labor cost saving, are suitable for security industries such as public security, traffic police and the like, are also suitable for other industries with similar requirements, and can be widely applied to systems with similar application scenes such as government, public security, institutions, companies and the like.

title_en: Meteorological disaster plan intelligent configuration method and system based on disaster census result
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent configuration method and an intelligent configuration system for a weather disaster plan based on a disaster general investigation result, and relates to the field of the intellectualization of weather disaster plans. The disaster data processing method has the advantages that disaster basic parameters and disaster state requirements are rapidly extracted by receiving disaster data from a sensor network, a weather monitoring station and a manual report, analyzing disaster situation data, grasping specific positions, damage types, damage degrees, needed rescue materials, personnel, medical equipment and the like of disaster points in detail, and providing accurate data support for subsequent material allocation, rescue path planning and rescue task allocation, so that timeliness and pertinence of emergency response are improved.

title_en: Oil quantity detection method in a wreck using acoustic wave
title_ko: 음파를 이용한 사고 선박 내 기름 잔류량 감지 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting the residual amount of oil inside a damaged ship using acoustic waves, and, more specifically, to a method for measuring the residual amount of oil inside an oil storage tank in real time when the oil is spilled from a ship having marine accidents such as collision or stranding. In particular, the method for detecting the residual amount of the oil inside the damaged ship according to the present invention is to quickly and properly prevent disasters by checking the diffusion process of the oil from accident occurrence time based on the residual amount and the spilling amount of the oil and ocean current information in real time. In addition, the method and a system for detecting the residual amount of the oil according to the present invention can be built in not only a ship, which is being ordered and developed now, but also a ship, which has been used already, through the installation of an acoustic sensor and the installation of a simple program, thereby easily applying the method and the system to the various ships. Therefore, competitiveness and reliability in fields to which the method for detecting the residual amount of the oil according to the present invention is applied can be improved, wherein the fields are such as a shipbuilding field, a marine transportation field, a marine pollution and disaster prevention field, and a field relating thereto or similar thereto.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 음파를 이용한 사고 선박 내 기름 잔류량 감지 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 선박의 충돌이나 좌초 등의 해상사고로 인하여 기름이 유출되는 경우, 기름저장탱크 내부의 기름 잔류량을 실시간으로 측정할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 특히, 본 발명은 기름의 잔류량, 유출량 및 해류정보 등을 토대로, 사고발생 시점부터 기름이 확산되는 과정을 실시간으로 확인함으로써, 신속하고 적절한 방재작업이 이루어질 수 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 현재 수주하여 개발되는 선박뿐만 아니라, 이미 이용중인 선박에 대해서도 음파센서의 설치 및 간단한 프로그램의 설치를 통해, 본 발명에 의한 기름 잔류량 감지 방법 및 시스템을 구축할 수 있으므로, 다양한 선박들에 용이하게 적용할 수 있다. 따라서, 본 발명은 선박분야, 해양운송분야 및 해양오염방재분야는 물론, 이와 연관 내지 유사한 분야에서 경쟁력 및 신뢰성을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: A.I. based CBR Event Source Tracking System and controlling method for the same
title_ko: 인공지능 기반 화생방 오염원점 추적 시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an artificial intelligence-based chemical, biological, and radiological pollution source tracking system and a control method thereof. Rather than using actual sensor data measured in various environmental conditions in a given area in the event of a chemical, biological, and radiological situation, it is possible to more quickly and reliably track a chemical and biological pollution source by using artificial intelligence technology for pollution diffusion information data for each time period calculated from a chemical, biological, and radiological pollution diffusion prediction modeling tool in a protection area. In addition, it is possible to predict the initial accident occurrence origin by learning the pollution diffusion (contaminant concentration and deposition amount) information distributed for each time period on a given space (map) in an image format and using artificial intelligence-based video prediction or next frame prediction.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능 기반 화생방 오염원점 추적 시스템 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로, 화생방 상황 발생 시 주어진 구역에서 다양한 환경조건에서 측정된 실 센서 데이터를 사용하기 보다는, 방호지역 내 화생방 오염확산예측 모델링 툴(Tool)로부터 산출 된 시간대 별 오염확산 정보 데이터를 인공지능 기술을 활용하여 보다 신속하고 신뢰성 있는 화생방 오염원점을 추적할 수 있고, 또한 인공지능 기반 비디오 예측 기술(Video prediction 혹은 Next frame prediction)을 활용하여 주어진 공간(지도) 상 시간대 별 분포된 오염확산(오염물질 농도 및 침적량) 정보를 이미지 형식으로 학습하여 최초 사고발생 원점을 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: Patient emergency response system
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.

title_en: Towing cable data interface board
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a towing cable data interface board, which overcomes the defect that the reception and processing of long towing cable high-density earthquake data in a conventional geophysical exploration is relatively poor in real-time performance. The towing cable data interface board comprises a towing cable interface used for finishing the serial/parallel conversion of towing cable data and towing cable control commands; a data processor used for analyzing towing cable state data and earthquake data from parallel towing cable data, carrying out conversion from time sequence to path sequence to the earthquake data, which are cached into a first memory and a second memory, receiving the towing cable control commands sent by a controller, and sending the towing cable control commands to the towing cable interface; an external interconnection bus standard interface used for sending the towing cable state data to the controller; the controller used for generating the towing cable control commands according to the towing cable state data and external control system instructions, and sending the towing cable control commands to the data processor; and a compact external interconnection bus standard interface used for transmitting the path data cached in the first memory and the second memory to an external work station record system. The towing cable data interface board can be used as the interface unit of an indoor record device and an underwater towing cable part.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CHINA OILFIELD SERVICES LTD

title_en: Cross-platform-based emergency command video conference method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-platform-based method and system for an emergency command video conference, and belongs to the field of emergency command video conferences. The method comprises the following steps of (1) a video conference terminal database which is a MySQL database or a NoSQL database, (2) a service layer which comprises a data compiling layer, a data storage layer and a data interaction layer, wherein the data storage layer comprises a unit information database, the service layer is used for providing an interface for unit inquiry and addition, receiving a user request and processing, and (3) a front display layer which comprises a rapid inquiry, screening and positioning terminal and is used for providing a user interface, and (4) outputting a result. The invention can quickly respond to the inquiry request of the user and return accurate unit information in a short time. The unit information can be updated in real time, and timeliness of the data is ensured.
assignees: Beijing Emergency Command and support center

title_en: Coast protection dyke settlement monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coast protection dyke settlement monitoring method, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering safety monitoring. The method comprises the steps of setting a longitudinal monitoring section on a slope surface on the back sea side of a dam, arranging a three-line fiber grating sensor array, periodically collecting vertical displacement and horizontal inclination angle data through a synchronous triggering unit, establishing a vertical displacement-horizontal inclination angle joint analysis model through a multi-source data fusion module, eliminating tide level interference through a Kalman filtering algorithm to generate a settlement distribution curve, triggering three-level to one-level early warning signals based on a grading early warning rule, and transmitting the three-level to terminal equipment. The method solves the problems that the traditional monitoring method cannot effectively separate tidal interference, has poor real-time performance and insufficient multi-dimensional data collaborative analysis, realizes high-precision settlement monitoring, complex environment anti-interference and quick emergency response through multi-line sensor deployment, dynamic filtering optimization and hierarchical early warning mechanisms, and remarkably improves the reliability and timeliness of dam safety monitoring.

title_en: Driving robot for coding education equipped with voice recognition artificial intelligence
title_ko: 음성인식 인공지능 탑재 코딩교육용 주행로봇
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to solve the problems of complex program usage and high configuration costs (such as a space and a computer). A voice recognition artificial intelligence-mounted driving robot for coding education is provided, which comprises: a Raspberry Pi (RPI) attached in board form inside the robot body to enable a user to command voice recognition data processing, input/output, and motor control; a motor which is attached to the lower side of the robot body in order to transfer the driving power to wheels; a voice recognition module attached to the RPI inside the body for outputting voice recognition and response; a wheel attached to an outer motor of the main body to drive the robot; and a battery case combined in the top of the robot to supply power for robot operation and configured to replaceable with rechargeable batteries. The present invention can provide an effect of solving the problems such as complex program usage, high configuration costs (including a space and a computer), and the presence of distracting elements (such as games and internet browsing) which hinder use by lower-grade elementary school students.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 음성인식 인공지능 탑재 코딩교육용 주행로봇에 관한 것으로, RPI(라즈베리파이)에 의하여 음성인식 데이터 처리 및 입출력, 모터 구동을 명령 할 수 있게  함으로써 코딩 교육에 있어 부가 기능이 너무 많고 문제 발생 시 문제 해결점을 찾기 어렵다. 그리고 프로그램 사용법이 복잡하고 구성 비용(장소, 컴퓨터)이 많이 발생한다. 또한 초등학교 저학년이 사용하기에 방해되는 요소(게임, 인터넷 검색)들이 있는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 것이다. 
즉, 본 발명은, 컴퓨터 교육에 있어서 음성인식 데이터 처리 및 입출력, 모터 구동을 명령 할 수 있게 보드 형태로 로봇 본체 안에 부착한 RPI(라즈베리파이), 바퀴를 움직일 수 있는 동력을 전달 할 수 있게 로봇 본체 옆 아래에 부착한 모터, 음성인식 및 답변을 출력 할 수 있게 본체 안 라즈베리파이에 부착한 음성 인식 모듈, 모터에 부착되어 로봇을 구동 할 수 있게 본체 외부 모터에 부착한 바퀴, 로봇 작동을 위한 전원을 제공 할 수 있게 로봇 상단부에 결합되어 충전지 교환 가능한 베터리 케이스를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 RPI(라즈베리파이)에 의하여 음성인식 데이터 처리 및 입출력, 모터 구동을 명령 할 수 있게 하여, 코딩 교육에 있어 부가 기능이 너무 많고 문제 발생 시 문제 해결점을 찾기 어렵다. 그리고 프로그램 사용법이 복잡하고 구성 비용(장소, 컴퓨터)이 많이 발생한다. 또한 초등학교 저학년이 사용하기에 방해되는 요소(게임, 인터넷 검색)들이 있는 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써, 기존의 코딩 교육에 있어 부가 기능이 너무 많고 문제 발생 시 문제 해결점을 찾기 어렵다. 그리고 프로그램 사용법이 복잡하고 구성 비용(장소, 컴퓨터)이 많이 발생한다. 또한 초등학교 저학년이 사용하기에 방해되는 요소(게임, 인터넷 검색)들이 있는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: A device and system for sending emergency alerts on roads using CCTV, sound and VMS
title_ko: Cctv, 음향 및 전광판을 활용한 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a system for transmitting a road unexpected situation alarm, capable of suppressing a secondary accident caused by a following vehicle by detecting an unexpected situation on a road by using a cctv, a sound, and an electric sign installed on the road. According to the present invention, the apparatus for transmitting an emergency signal of an emergency signal of a road comprises: an image acquisition unit; an emergency signal detection unit; and an emergency signal output unit. The cctv image recording from cctv installed at the image acquisition part is on the road is gotten. The outbreak situation sensor senses the outbreak situation whether or not to the outbreak situation sensing model about the cctv image gotten. The alarm signal output unit outputs an alarm signal when an unexpected situation is detected. At this time, the unexpected situation detection model is modeled by machine learning the cctv image, but machine learning is performed by dividing the time, season, and weather at the time of capturing the cctv image into variables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 위에 설치되는 CCTV, 음향 및 전광판을 활용하여 도로 위 돌발상황을 감지하여 후속차량에 의한 2차 사고를 억제할 수 있는 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치는 영상 획득부, 돌발상황 감지부 및 경보 신호 출력부를 포함한다. 영상 획득부는 도로 상에 설치된 CCTV로부터 촬영된 CCTV 영상을 획득한다. 돌발상황 감지부는 획득한 CCTV 영상에 대한 돌발상황 감지 모델로 돌발상황 여부를 감지한다. 그리고 경보 신호 출력부는 돌발상황이 감지되면 경보 신호를 출력한다. 이때 돌발상황 감지 모델은 CCTV 영상을 기계학습 하여 모델링 하되, CCTV 영상을 촬영하는 시점의 시간, 계절 및 기상을 변수로 구분하여 기계학습 한다.

title_en: System and method for checking well-being of member of one-person household based on meter reading information and sensing information, computer-readable recording medium, and computer program stored in recording medium
title_ko: 검침 정보 및 감지 정보에 기반한 1인 가구 가구원의 안부 확인 시스템 및 방법, 컴퓨터 판독가능 기록 매체 및 기록 매체에 저장된 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method, based on meter reading information and sensing information, for checking the well-being of a member of a one-person household, the system comprising: a collection server for collecting electricity meter reading information, water meter reading information, visual information, and auditory information from a primary sensor unit, which provides the electricity meter reading information and water meter reading information so that the electricity and water usage of the one-person household can be numerically obtained, and a secondary sensor unit, which provides the visual information and auditory information so that the electricity and water usage of the single-person household can be detected visually and audibly; an analysis server for analyzing the presence or absence of life reactions of the member of the one-person household on the basis of the collected electricity meter reading information, water meter reading information, visual information, and auditory information; and a first application configured to notify a manager so that the manager can take predetermined measures when the analysis shows there to be an absence of life reactions of the member of the one-person household. Accordingly, life reactions can be more accurately detected, and thus the manager can be notified to take measures and thereby respond to an unexpected disaster or accident without delay.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 검침 정보 및 감지 정보에 기반한 1인 가구 가구원의 안부 확인 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 1인 가구의 전기 및 수도 사용 여부를 수치적으로 획득할 수 있도록 전기 검침 정보 및 수도 검침 정보를 제공하는 1차 센서부, 및 1인 가구의 전기 및 수도 사용 여부를 시청각적으로 감지할 수 있도록 시각적 정보 및 청각적 정보를 제공하는 2차 센서부로부터, 전기 검침 정보, 수도 검침 정보, 시각적 정보 및 청각적 정보를 수집하는 수집 서버; 수집된 전기 검침 정보, 수도 검침 정보, 시각적 정보 및 청각적 정보에 기초하여 해당 1인 가구의 가구원의 생활 반응 존부를 분석하는 분석 서버; 및 해당 1인 가구의 가구원의 생활 반응이 없는 것으로 분석된 경우, 관리자에게 통지하여 소정의 조치를 취할 수 있도록 구성되는 제1 어플리케이션을 포함한다. 이로써, 보다 정확하게 생활 반응을 감지할 수 있어 예기치 못하는 재난이나 사고 발생에 지체없이 대응할 수 있도록 관리자에게 통지하여 조치를 취할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: Learning toy, mobile body for learning toy, and panel for learning toy
abstract_en: A learning toy which enables learning of high-level programming in a stepwise manner. A movement path is constituted by a plurality of command panels in which command information which can be read with an optical reading module is recorded being arranged. A mobile robot sequentially reads command information included in the command panels through which the mobile robot passes while moving along the movement path and stores a plurality of pieces of command information in a command information memory. The mobile robot takes out a plurality of pieces of command information from arbitrary positions in the command information memory to execute operation. If a plurality of pieces of command information necessary for operation of the mobile robot are stored in the command information memory, a control unit of the mobile robot automatically extracts and takes out the command information and causes the mobile robot to operate.

title_en: Field monitoring system using a mobile terminal
title_ko: 휴대단말을 이용한 현장 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The invention relates to a field monitoring system using a mobile terminal, the system comprising: a mobile terminal, which transmits context information and receives 3D image information corresponding to said context information, the context information consisting of audio-video information generated by photographing images of the field and by recording sounds in the field, and location information obtained by applying sensed signals from an accelerometer and from a Gyroscope sensor to a GPS signal including latitude, longitude and time; and a control server which receives the context information, matches location information of the context information with a pre-stored map or architectural drawing information to generate 3D image information for the current location of the mobile terminal, and transmits the generated information to the mobile terminal.  Therefore, by using a wireless terminal that utilizes a commercial communication module, GPS and INS,  the invention presents advantages in finding out the location of each personnel member who is sent to even a wide-area disaster, and photographing any unexpected accident or situation or blind spots.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대단말을 이용한 현장 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 현장의 영상촬영 및 음성녹음을 통해 생성한 영상·음성 정보와, 위도, 경도 및 시간을 포함하는 GPS 신호에 가속도 센서 및 자이로 센서의 감지신호가 적용된 위치정보로 이루어진 상황정보를 전송하고, 상기 상황정보에 대응하는 3D 영상정보를 수신하는 휴대단말; 및 상기 상황정보를 접수하고, 상기 상황정보의 위치정보를 기저장된 지도 또는 건축도면 정보에 매칭시켜 상기 휴대단말의 현재 위치에 대한 3D영상 정보를 생성하여 상기 휴대단말로 전송하는 관제서버를 포함한다. 따라서, 본 발명은 상용화된 통신모듈과 GPS 및 INS를 이용하는 무선 단말을 이용하여, 사고의 범위가 넓은 지역에 있어서도 각 투입 인원의 위치파악이 가능하고, 돌발상황 또는 촬영 사각지대의 촬영이 가능한 효과가 있다.
assignees: ID FONE CO LTD;UHM HYUN DUK

title_en: Scalable SPOR algorithm for flash memory
abstract_en: The method of sudden power outage restoration may include: reading a dirty metapage from a storage block on the dirty block list, recording mapping information in an open metapage, supplying host commands by looking up logical block addresses, LBAs, in the dirty and open metapages, and when LBAs are not found in the dirty and open metapages, reading new mapping information from the dirty table and saving the new mapping information in the host write metapage.

title_en: Danger detection system using smart insole and method for processing, and storage medium for recoding computer program therefor
title_ko: 스마트 깔창을 이용한 위험 감지 시스템 및 그 처리 방법, 그리고 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램을 기록한 저장 매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a danger detection system using a smart insole, a processing method thereof, and a storage medium recording a computer program for the same. According to the present invention, the danger detection system recognizes whether a user of a smartphone is in a dangerous situation by utilizing various sensor information of the smartphone and pressure information of the smart insole through using a danger recognition application. The danger detection system also processes the location information of the user and a message regarding the dangerous situation to transmit the information and the message to a predetermined emergency contact. The present invention enables the smartphone to recognize the dangerous situation the user of the smartphone and the smart insole is in and requests emergency rescue when the user does not move due to sudden blackouts and various fall accidents which can occur while the user engages in an outdoor activity.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 깔창을 이용한 위험 감지 시스템 및 그 처리 방법, 그리고 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램을 기록한 저장 매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 위험 감지 시스템은 위험 인지 어플리케이션을 이용하여 스마트 폰의 다양한 센서 정보와 스마트 깔창의 압력 정보를 활용해서 스마트 폰의 사용자가 위험 상황에 있는지를 인지하고, 설정된 긴급 연락처로 사용자의 위치 정보와 위험 상황에 대한 메시지를 전송하도록 처리한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 스마트 폰과 스마트 깔창의 사용자가 야외 활동 중 발생할 수 있는 갑작스런 실신 및 각종 낙상 사고 등으로 인해 사용자가 움직이지 않을 경우, 스마트 폰이 사용자의 위험 상황을 인지하여 긴급 구호를 요청할 수 있다.

title_en: Management System for Accuracy Inspection of Vehicle Measurement
title_ko: 자동차용 측정기의 정도검사 관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a management system for accuracy inspection of a measuring instrument for a vehicle, which enables to manage accuracy and performance maintenance of a machine/instrument used for check, maintenance, or inspection of a vehicle and an environment measuring device by using a computing system so as to secure safety of the vehicle for preventing car accidents, and to prevent atmospheric pollution and reduce noise due to vehicles, thereby contributing to development of national health and comfort living environment. The management system for accuracy inspection of a measuring instrument for a vehicle comprises: an inspection management server in which calibration equipment for each user and standard material information are divided and stored, which enables legislation related to inspection, to which the stored calibration equipment or standard material is applied, is applied to each user based on login so as to allow determination with respect to accuracy inspection to be performed, and which allows a result with respect to the accuracy inspection to be output in a report form; and a user terminal which allows a user to access the inspection management server, and allows a user login process to be proceeded. According to the management system for accuracy inspection of a measuring instrument for a vehicle, by using login information of an inspector (employee of a public corporation) who performs accuracy inspection for maintaining accuracy and performance of a machine/instrument used for check, maintenance, or inspection of a vehicle and an environment measuring device, legislation related to inspection can be managed by using a computing system and applied on the basis of individual data for each user. Therefore, confusion that can be generated during the accuracy inspection can be prevented, thereby securing reliability of the accuracy inspection.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자동차의 점검, 정비 또는 검사에 사용하는 기계·기구 및 환경 측정기기의 정확도와 성능 유지를 전산 시스템으로 관리하여, 자동차의 안전성을 확보하여 교통사고를 예방하고, 자동차로 인한 대기오염 방지 및 생활소음 저하로 국민건강과 쾌적한 생활환경 조성에 기여하기 위한 자동차용 측정기의 정도검사 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 사용자별 교정장비 및 표준물질 정보가 구분 저장되며, 로그인을 기반으로 한 사용자마다 상기 저장된 교정장비 또는 표준물질이 적용된 검사관련 법령이 적용되어 정도검사의 결과에 대한 판정이 이루어지도록 한 후, 정도검사에 대한 결과를 리포트 형태로 출력되도록 하는 검사관리서버 및 상기 검사관리서버에 접속하여 사용자 로그인 과정이 진행되도록 하는 사용자단말기를 포함하여 구성된다. 
본 발명의 자동차용 측정기의 정도검사 관리시스템에 따르면, 자동차 점검, 정비 또는 검사에 사용하는 기계·기구 및 환경 측정기기의 정확도와 성능 유지를 위한 정도검사를 실시하는 검사자(공단직원)의 로그인 정보를 활용하여 사용자별 개별 데이터를 기반으로 검사관련 법령을 전산 시스템으로 관리하여 적용함으로써 정도검사 시 발생할 수 있는 혼선을 방지하여 정도검사의 신뢰성이 확보되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.

title_en: Reservoir flood control early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a reservoir flood control early warning system, including monitoring early warning case and level sensor, be provided with rainfall sensor, searchlight video collector, alarm and light level sensor on the monitoring early warning case, be provided with microcontroller and all be connected with microcontroller on the monitoring early warning case time-recorder, memory, be used for saving staff's telephone number and automatic dial-up staff's telephone number automatic dialing module and be used for with dispatch terminal wireless communication's wireless communication module. The utility model discloses utilize level sensor to gather reservoir water level in real time, utilize the time-recorder to observe reservoir water level rising speed, set up multistage early warning rank, for reservoir flood control provides automatic early warning suggestion, set up illumination sensor simultaneously and distinguish daytime or night to close or open the searchlight, the flood water level is surveyed at night to the video collection ware of being convenient for, utilizes automatic dialing module and wireless communication module in time to indicate the staff to make flood control work, reduces potential safety hazard and risk as far as possible.

title_en: Portable mine intrinsic safety seismograph
abstract_en: The invention is a portable multifunctional earthquake recorder used in the mine which can resist the burst, water, corrosion and be carried. The device is made up of the hardware and the software. The hardware includes the self-make controlling circuit board, the dot matrix figure LCD, the silvery conducting film, the rechargeable battery, the safety shell with the IP54 safety grade and the connector; the software includes the monitoring module, the recording module, the communicating module and the data processing module; the self-make controlling circuit board is used the double CPU which goes on the data switch by the double ports memorizer. The main function is to collect and command the digital cymoscope, human-machine alternation, store the data and treat the data at time. So the device can be used in the earthquake exploration and the surface wave exploration of the mine.

title_en: Method for grid steady simulating way recorded on the basis of real-time event sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for a grid steady simulating way recorded on the basis of an event sequence and relates to the technical field of grid simulation. The invention aims to solve the technical problem of incomplete simulation of a simulating system. The method comprises the following steps of: (1) establishing a storage data table; (2) establishing a grid simulation index table; (3) dividing real-time data and event data; (4) mapping the event type and the SOE type; (5) judging the received uplink data of a transformer station; (6) judging data at a normal time interval; (7) executing an event data calling command; (8) recoding data in an event data set; (9) storing events in a teaching plan simulation index table; and (10) recording the data in a real-time data set. The method for the grid steady simulating way can ensure the non-redundancy of the data of a database, ensure the millisecond grade data storage at an abnormal time interval and ensure the authenticity and the integrality of the formed teaching plan.

title_en: A kind of Vehicle Dispatch Administration terminal, system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Vehicle Dispatch Administration terminal, system and methods, belong to technical field of vehicle management, including cabinet, multiple boxes for keys are opened up in cabinet, setting electric control lock is with switch board door open-close on the inside of boxes for keys, further include driver management system, which includes human-computer interaction module, task management module, record storage module, car key authorization module, authority recognition module and control module.Bus management and running terminal is used to receive driver task's information realization driver scheduling management of cloud server transmission, and driver directly can take car key according to mission bit stream in the bus management and running terminal.The present invention effectively realizes bus key and the intelligent supervision of driver, the Portable Batch System of driver and taking for car key more intelligently facilitate, improve the working efficiency of driver, and can effectively specification bus management, the problem of preventing bus private, abuse.
assignees: ANHUI ZHONGKE MEILUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for starting sign-in of emergency organization of nuclear power plant
abstract_en: The utility model provides a method and a device for starting sign-in of nuclear power plant emergency organization, which relates to the field of nuclear emergency and is mainly suitable for sign-in of similar nuclear power plant operation units and nuclear power groups when the emergency organization is started. The method comprises the following specific steps: shooting a face image of the current person, recording the face image to the post time, and matching according to the face image to determine the target identity of the current person; determining a target authority according to the target identity, and acquiring a target emergency post corresponding to the target authority according to a current emergency duty list; and generating an emergency response check-in table according to the target identity, the target emergency post and the post arrival time. According to the method and the system, the target identity is determined by identifying according to the face image of the current person, and the corresponding target authority and the target emergency post are obtained, so that the emergency response sign-in is quicker and more accurate, the recorded information is more complete, and various complex conditions of the emergency response are better met.
assignees: HUANENG NUCLEAR ENERGY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: High-efficiency intelligent fire-fighting emergency dispatching system based on distance and resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distance and resource-based high-efficiency intelligent fire-fighting emergency dispatching system, which relates to the technical field of fire-fighting emergency management and comprises a command dispatching platform, a fire-fighting station dispatching platform, a fire-fighting truck terminal system and a firefighter personal terminal system, wherein the command dispatching platform comprises a display module, a control command center, a fire-fighting station material recording module, a firefighter dispatching module, a disaster information processing system, a map searching module, a command information transmission module and a disaster information storage module, and the fire-fighting station dispatching platform is used for dispatching fire-fighting trucks and firefighters in the coverage area of the system. The invention can flexibly allocate according to the disaster place and the distance between the fire stations in the system coverage area, and can also flexibly adjust the material reserve of the fire stations and the on-duty condition of fire fighters in real time, quickly reach the disaster site and carry out timely treatment.
assignees: YANGZHOU NAIPUDUN SECURITY ENG CO LTD

title_en: Recording media for english study
title_ko: 영어학습용 기록매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A recording medium for English learning is provided to naturally improve English command capability of a learner by continuously inducing learning motivation through a training method in regard to principles of specific sound, speed, rhythm, and word order. CONSTITUTION: Reading speed of rapid reading document is measured and the level of skillfulness is evaluated based on the measurement result(S1). Speaking and writing trainings are enforced according to principles of specific sound, speed, rhythm, and word order(S2). A repetition training and speed reading for improving direct reading and direct interpreting and direct listening and direct interpreting are enforced(S3). The reading speed of total learners is measured(S4). Time required for reading the whole sentence is measured(S5).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 영어학습을 위한 교수법에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 영어학습자로 하여금 특정의 소리, 스피드, 리듬 및 어순의 교습법을 통해 영어 어순의 법칙이 자연스럽게 습득되도록 한 영어학습용 기록매체에 관한 것이다.  
이러한 본 발명은 (a) 이전에 과제로 내준 ‘빨리 읽기’자료의 읽기 속도를 측정하여 그 측정 결과를 근거로 숙달 정도를 평가하는 단계; (b) 특정의 소리, 스피드, 리듬 및 어순의 법칙에 따라 말하기와 쓰기 훈련을 실시하는 단계; (c) 학습자들의 전반적인 숙달 완성도를 높이기 위해 직독직해, 직청직해 능력 향상을 위한 반복 훈련 및 스피드 리딩을 실시하는 단계; (d) 특정 속도에 해당하는 분당 200~220단어 속도가 나오도록 전체 학습자들의 읽기 속도를 측정하는 단계; (e) 학습자들로 하여금 각 문항 별로 기본적으로 기 설정된 횟수만큼 읽은 후 전체 문항을 읽는데 소요되는 시간을 측정해 오도록 하고, 가장 빠른 속도와 그 때까지 읽은 횟수를 해당 페이지에 적어오도록 하는 단계;가 기록된 영어학습용 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: System and method for educating reading
title_ko: 문장의 구조화를 이용한 사고력독해 학습장치 및 학습방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus and a method for learning thinking power and reading ability by structuralizing a sentence are provided to improve the reading ability by extracting the core contents of the sentence. CONSTITUTION: A reading structuralizing learning system includes an input unit (100), a storage unit (200), a control unit (300), and an output unit (400). In the input unit, various commands and contents necessary for a learning process are input. The control unit receives the command of a control program, and controls a voice and a class selected by a learner. The output unit outputs the learning contents. An application text for learning includes texts for grasping the core of a sentence, texts for easily memorable word substitution training, texts for the schematization training of sentence contents, texts for prediction comprehension training, and texts for associated vocabulary learning. [Reference numerals] (100) Storage unit; (200) Input unit; (300) Control unit; (400) Output unit
abstract_ko: 위와 같은 과제를 해결하기 위하여, 본 발명은 각종 명령 및 학습과정상 필요한 내용을 입력하기 위한 입력장치와, 학습에 필요한 각 단계별 학습용 응용 지문 및 교육음성, 그리고 학습을 제어하는 제어프로그램을 저장하는 저장장치와, 상기 제어프로그램의 명령을 받아 학습자가 선택한 학습 및 음성을 제어하는 제어장치와, 학습내용을 출력하는 출력장치를 포함하여 이루어지는 독해구조화 학습 시스템에 있어서, 상기 학습용 응용지문은 문장의 핵심을 파악하는 학습을 통하여 핵심문장과 핵심어를 찾는 훈련에 필요한 지문들과, 문장 속의 단어를 기억하기 좋은 단어로 치환하는 훈련에 필요한 지문들과, 문장의 내용을 도식화하여 그림으로 정리해내는 훈련에 필요한 지문들과, 한 문단을 읽을 때 다음 문단의 내용을 예측해내는 예측독해 훈련에 필요한 지문들과, 연관어휘 습득 훈련을 통하여 문장 속의 어휘 뜻을 모르더라도 연관어휘 습득을 통하여 유추해 내는 연관어휘 습득 훈련에 필요한 지문들을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 독해구조화 학습 시스템을 제공한다..

title_en: Information processing system for calculationg safety index of vehicle and operation method thereof
title_ko: 차량의 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 정보 처리 시스템 및 그것의 동작 방법
abstract_ko: 차량들 각각의 사고 기록 데이터를 기반으로 정적 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 정적 안전 지수 산출부, 차량들 각각의 차량 정보 데이터를 기반으로, 차량들 각각의 속도 지수, 가속도 지수, 감속도 지수 및 운행 시간을 산출하기 위한 주행 정보 산출부, 사고 기록 데이터를 기반으로 하나 이상의 가중치들을 산출하고, 하나 이상의 가중치들 및 속도 지수, 가속도 지수, 및 감속도 지수를 기반으로 동적 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 동적 안전 지수 산출부, 운행 시간을 기반으로 차량들 각각의 사고율에 따른 작업부하 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 작업부하 안전 지수 산출부, 및 정적 안전 지수, 동적 안전 지수, 및 작업부하 안전 지수를 기반으로, 종합 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 종합 안전 지수 산출부를 포함하되, 하나 이상의 가중치들은 속도 지수, 가속도 지수 및 감속도 지수의 일부 또는 전부와 대응하여 산술된다.

title_en: Program input device through sequential arrangement of picture cards printed with command code
title_ko: 명령 코드가 인쇄된 그림 카드의 순차 배치를 통한 프로그램 입력 장치
abstract_en: The present invention is a technology developed for allowing children under the age of 10 who are difficult to learn coding with a computer-based programming language to understand the concept of coding, providing a means to directly conduct coding with picture cards that can be understood by a coding bot as actual computer-based coding, and generating the movement of the coding bot based on the coded result.
abstract_ko: 컴퓨터를 이용한 프로그램언어로 코딩을 익히기 어려운10살 이하의 어린이를 대상으로 코딩의 개념을 이해하고 , 실제로 컴퓨터 코딩을 하는 것 처럼 코딩 봇을 이용하 여코딩봇이 이해할수있는 그림카드 로코딩을 직접하 게하는 수단을 제공하고, 코딩된 결과 로코딩봇의 움직임을 발생하게 하는 목적으로 개발하는 기술이다.

title_en: Image-based face recognition, health check and position tracking system
title_ko: 영상기반 얼굴 인식, 건강 체크 및 위치 추적 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an image-based face recognition, health check, and position tracking system. According to the present invention, the system comprises: a CCTV camera installed at a predetermined location throughout the country, having corresponding location coordinates set thereto to capture an image of any predetermined person or transportation means and people therearound and record the image together with the location coordinates; a computer system recognizing the predetermined person's face, posture, and clothes on the basis of the images captured by the CCTV camera, detecting fever characteristics, classifying the images according to predetermined classification criteria, and digitizing each classified image information; a database storing and managing image information (data) classified and digitized by the computer system and various information related to system operation; and a central server receiving context information from the computer system in real-time, transmitting corresponding commands or information, and sharing the image information (data) stored in the database in real-time. Accordingly, the coordinates of the location of CCTV cameras installed throughout the country and a person's face, posture and clothes, transportation means, and surrounding people information included in an image are linked and stored in a standard database and are linked through a network, and thus a predetermined person can be identified by only face shape or image information without recording or leaking personal information, health status (fever, etc.) can be checked, and the location of a person or moving object can be tracked in real-time.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 영상기반 얼굴 인식, 건강 체크 및 위치 추적 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 영상기반 얼굴 인식, 건강 체크 및 위치 추적 시스템은, 전국 곳곳의 특정 위치에 설치되고 해당 위치좌표가 설정되어, 임의의 특정 사람이나 이동수단, 그 주변 사람을 촬영하고 위치좌표와 함께 영상을 기록하는 CCTV 카메라와; CCTV 카메라에 의해 촬영된 영상을 바탕으로 특정인의 얼굴, 자세 및 복장을 인식하고, 발열 특징을 감지하며, 미리 설정된 분류 기준에 따라 영상을 각각 분류하고, 분류된 각 영상 정보를 디지털화하는 컴퓨터 시스템과; 컴퓨터 시스템에 의해 분류 및 디지털화된 영상 정보(데이터) 및 시스템 운영과 관련된 각종 정보를 저장 및 관리하는 데이터베이스(DB); 및 컴퓨터 시스템으로부터 실시간으로 상황 정보를 수신하여 상응하는 명령이나 정보를 전송하고, 데이터베이스(DB)에 저장된 영상 정보(데이터)를 실시간으로 공유하는 중앙 서버를 포함한다. 
이와 같은 본 발명에 의하면, 전국 곳곳에 설치된 CCTV 카메라의 위치좌표와 영상에 포함된 사람 얼굴, 자세 및 복장, 이동수단, 주변 사람 정보를 연계해서 표준 데이터베이스화 하고, 네트워크로 연동함으로써, 개인정보의 기록 및 유출 없이 얼굴 모양이나 영상 정보만으로 특정인을 인식하고, 건강 상태(발열 등)를 체크하며, 사람이나 이동체의 위치를 실시간으로 추적할 수 있다.

title_en: Headset computer with handsfree emergency response
abstract_en: Operating conditions for a headset computer are used to detect a situation where an emergency response mode should be activated. In emergency response mode, the headset computer may then broadcast location, live (real time) audio and video/data streams, and record other information concerning a possible theft and/or other situation of interest to law enforcement and/or security services.

title_en: Interactive smart toilet training device
abstract_en: An interactive smart toilet training device is provided in the form of a potty¬ training chair that resembles/mocks the traditional toilet in miniature form and has special/smart features to assist with potty training. The smart features enable the device to maintain the functionality of a standard toilet while attracting and engaging with the child and identifying, recording, and tracking metrics/history associated with the child's use of the device. Multiple interactive features include smart software applications, songs, and phrases to gain the toddler's attention, and a transparent lighted seat that lights on command, when in use, and/or when there was a successful sit/use. Tracking metrics/history to identify the frequency and conditions of successful sits/uses enable a more timely, accurate, and efficient means for successful completion of toilet training.

title_en: Board game assembly providing learning function
title_ko: 학습기능을 제공하는 보드게임교구
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Board game teaching tools are provided to enable students to easily learn contents of difficult curriculums using cards. CONSTITUTION: Board game teaching tools (10) comprise a game board (100), game pieces (200), a question card tool (500), an item card (300), and a social development card (400). The game board includes an image display unit (110) in which drawings showing the characteristics of contents are painted and a track unit (120) consisting of compartments in which characteristic colors corresponding to the image display unit are painted on an edge part thereof. The multiple game pieces display the location of a gamer on the track unit according to the shape of Yut rods (600). The question card tool comprises questions and answers. The item card comprises items which can be bought. The social development card comprises commands for commanding designated behaviors.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교과 내용을 문제화한 카드(예를 들어, 사회과목의 경우 각 시대별 상황에 맞는 사건 등을 기록한 각종 카드) 및 게임판과, 각 교과내용의 상황에 맞는 여러 가지 문제와 답 등을 표시한 문제카드 등을 이용하여 초등학생이나 중고등학생들을 대상으로 어렵고 딱딱한 교과 내용을 학년별, 과목별로 구성한 재미있는 보드게임을 통해 자연스럽게 배울 수 있는 학습기능을 제공하는 보드게임교구에 관한 것이다.  본 발명에 의하면, 중앙부에 각 팀이 맡게 될 내용의 특징을 나타내는 그림이 그려져 있는 이미지 표시부와, 테두리부에 상기 이미지 표시부에 해당하는 고유한 색깔이 교대로 칠해져 있는 다수의 구획칸으로 이루어진 트랙부를 포함하는 게임판; 윷가락을 던져 나타나는 윷가락의 모양에 따라 상기 트랙부 위로 이동하여 게임자의 위치를 상기 트랙부에 나타내는 복수의 게임말; 상기 게임말이 상기 트랙부의 해당 구획칸에 도착할 경우, 상기 해당 구획칸의 시대별 특징을 나타내는 그림을 포함하는 각 팀이 맡게 될 내용의 특징을 나타내는 그림에 해당하는 색깔에 대한 문제를 내고, 상기 문제에 대한 정답을 맞힐 수 있는 문제와 정답이 적혀 있는 문제카드교구; 상기 트랙부 중 게임자가 선택한 색깔의 구획칸에 도착한 경우, 해당 아이템을 살 수 있는 아이템이 적혀 있는 아이템카드; 및 상기 트랙부에는 사회발전카드가 적힌 구획칸이 하나 이상 존재하며, 상기 사회발전카드가 적힌 구획칸에 도착할 경우, 일정한 지령대로 행해야 하는 일정한 지령이 적혀 있는 사회발전카드;를 포함하되, 상기 문제카드교구는 상면 및 일측면이 개방되고 내부에는 수납공간이 형성되어 문제카드가 상기 수납공간에 수납될 수 있는 케이스본체와, 상기 케이스본체의 일측면에 구비되어 상하방향으로 이동 가능한 슬라이드부재를 포함하는 교구케이스와, 상기 케이스본체 내부에 복수 개가 수납되어 사용자에 의해 하나씩 선택되는 문제카드;를 포함하며, 상기 문제카드는 문제 및 정답으로 구성되어 있는 세트가 적어도 둘 이상으로 이루어지며, 상기 슬라이드부재의 상하방향으로의 이동에 의해 상기 문제카드의 문제 및 정답이 사용자에게 공개되는 것을 특징으로 하는 학습기능을 제공하는 보드게임교구를 제공한다.

title_en: The vr drones realistic experience formation device
title_ko: Vr드론실기실감체험 형성장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for forming a realistic experience of a VR drone practical test, which can improve an adaptation rate of a drone practical test field, and can reduce a fault of a machine and an occurrence rate of an accident. The apparatus of the present invention comprises: a main body (100) for forming a VR drone practical test experience space; a VR drone practical test experience certification marker (200); a control server (300) for a VR drone practical test realistic experience, a display module (400) for forming a VR drone practical test field; and a wearable VR drone control module (500).
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래 PC와 연결된 프로그램상에서 가상시뮬레이션을 통해 드론실기시험을 연습하고 있으나, 실제 비행과는 차이가 있고, 단순 키입력방식으로는 조종감이 둔하고, 비용이 비싼 문제점과, 드론실기시험 코스별로 1:1맞춤형 드론실기시험장분위기를 조성시키기 위한 장치와 프로그램이 없어, 연습량이 부족하고, 드론실기시험장분위기와 많이 달라서 적응을 못하여, 드론실기시험장에서 불합격 수가 점점 높아지는 문제점을 개선하고자,  VR드론실기체험 공간형성용 본체(100), VR드론실기체험인증마커(200), VR드론실기실감체험용 제어서버(300), VR드론실기시험장형성용 디스플레이모듈(400), 웨어러블형 VR드론제어모듈(500)로 구성됨으로서, 연두색 또는 초록색 배경의 실제 드론시험장 코스 분위기와, 비, 바람, 눈의 기상환경분위기와 함께, 실제 비, 바람, 눈의 느낌을 느낄 수 있도록 구성됨으로서, 실제 드론실기시험장에 있는 것처럼 느끼게 하여, 사용자로 하여금 드론실기시험장 적응률을 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 기체 고장과 안전사고 발생율을 70% 이하로 낮출 수 있으며,  VR드론실기실감체험용 제어서버의 제어하에 드론실기시험 코스별로 매긴 만족(S : Satisfactory) 체크 또는 불만족(U : Unsatisfactory) 체크를 통해 합격 또는 불합격 여부를 판정하여 표출제어할 수 있고, 드론실기시험 코스별로 연습량을 기존에 비해 2배~4배로 늘릴 수 있어, 드론실기시험 합격률을 80% 이상으로 향상시킬 수 있으며, VR 환경속에서 10채널 립모션센서모듈의 정밀한 손 모션제어를 통해 VR 드론을 정밀제어시킬 수 있어, 손 모션제어감각과 함께 VR 드론제어를 머리속에 연상되도록 습득할 수 있고, 이로 인해, 드론제어습득율을 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 건물의 특정 공간내에 밀폐된 독립공간만 있으면, VR드론실기실감체험 형성장치를 형성시킬 수 있어, 기존에 비해 60% 저렴한 가격으로 제공할 수 있고, 손쉽게 드론조종기술을 습득함으로써 드론의 대중화에 기여하고, 기존에 비해 활용도를 80% 높일 수 있는 VR드론실기실감체험 형성장치를 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Disaster site reconstruction and cause analysis method and system using drones
title_ko: 드론을 활용한 재난현장 재구성 및 원인분석 방법과 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for disaster site reconstruction and cause analysis using a drone, which reconstruct a target site through 3D spatial information analysis on the basis of an accident site image acquired from a drone device flying over a disaster accident site, store a site situation as a recordable and manageable tangible data if necessary, and can analyze an accident cause on the basis of the recordable and manageable tangible data. The system of the present invention comprises: a drone device for acquiring disaster accident site information by flying over a disaster accident site to photograph the same, and transmitting the same to a control device; a control device for controlling the flight of the drone device and transmitting the disaster accident site information received from the drone device to an analysis device; and an analysis device for reconstructing a disaster site by analyzing the disaster accident site information received from the control device, and analyzing an accident cause on the basis of the reconstructed disaster site.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 사고 현장을 비행하는 드론 장치로부터 취득한 사고 현장 영상을 기반으로 3차원 공간정보 분석을 통하여 대상 현장을 재구성하고, 필요에 따라 현장 상황을 기록 및 관리가 가능한 유형의 자료로 보관하며, 이에 근거하여 사고 원인을 분석할 수 있도록 하는, 드론을 활용한 재난현장 재구성 및 원인분석 방법과 시스템이 개시된다. 
개시된 드론을 활용한 재난현장 재구성 및 원인분석 방법과 시스템은, 재난사고 현장을 비행하면서 촬영하여 재난사고 현장 정보를 취득하고 통제 장치로 전송하는 드론 장치; 상기 드론 장치의 비행을 조정하고, 상기 드론 장치로부터 수신되는 재난사고 현장 정보를 분석 장치로 전달하는 통제 장치; 및 상기 통제 장치로부터 전달받은 상기 재난사고 현장 정보를 분석하여 재난 현장을 재구성하고, 재구성된 재난 현장에 근거하여 사고 원인을 분석하는 분석 장치를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for synchronizing incident response profiles across distinct computing platforms
abstract_en: A synchronized incident response system is distributed across one or more user devices and a host server. Each device has a stored version of an incident response profile for a defined location, the profile having version numbers corresponding to a set of data values for one or more attributes specific to the defined area. Each device is linked to the server and can transmit data records with changes to profile attributes, wherein the server determines whether the user changes are valid updates with respect to what is already stored in server memory. If so, the server synchronizes the profile attributes to generate a current profile and generates incremented version numbers. Each device can provide an incident response request for the defined area to the server, wherein the server generates an incident response report populated with data corresponding to a latest version number for each of one or more predetermined attributes.

title_en: Implementing enhanced EPO protection for indirection data
abstract_en: A method and a storage system are provided for implementing indirection tables for persistent media or disk drives with enhanced emergency power outage (EPO) protection for the indirection data, such as shingled perpendicular magnetic recording (SMR) indirection tables. Chaining of indirection data is provided with one block pointing to another block of the indirection data stored to disk or flash memory. An EPO-safe buffer is used to store a metadata entry responsive to completing each host write command. Each metadata entry is added to a metadata block, a pointer is stored in the EPO-safe buffer to a current metadata block and a previous metadata block. For a next EPO-safe buffer update entries are removed for the previous metadata block, keeping the last two metadata pointers and last metadata block.

title_en: A kind of hazardous materials transportation vehicle danger based on Big Dipper location gathers and warning system
abstract_en: This utility model provides a kind of hazardous materials transportation vehicle danger based on Big Dipper location to gather and warning system, including car-mounted terminal, Beidou satellite navigation positioning and communicating device and control end；Described car-mounted terminal passes through Beidou satellite navigation positioning and communicating device wireless connections with controlling end；Car-mounted terminal includes that vehicle runs device detector, video detector, luminous organ, optical communication equipment, black box, warning system, integrated manipulator；Described vehicle operation device detector, video detector, optical communication equipment, warning system all connect integrated manipulator by wire.This utility model can understand the position of vehicle in real time, the instantaneous velocity of display vehicle, the information such as the hypervelocity record of each driver, in violation of rules and regulations route can be stored in black box simultaneously, it is easy to understand traffic violation, to occurring on road and the hazardous material incident in other places can be reported to the police in time, effectively, quickly process, the loss that minimizing accident is brought.

title_en: Comprehensive data fusion system based on unmanned aerial vehicle road inspection
abstract_en: The utility model provides a comprehensive data fusion system based on unmanned aerial vehicle road inspection, which is characterized in that a road network sheet area can be distributed with a plurality of fusion type comprehensive data bins, a platform is connected with the plurality of data bins through a convergence switch, a dispatching control instruction is operated through the platform, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can realize take-off and landing among the plurality of data bins, a distributed take-off and landing network of the unmanned aerial vehicle is deployed, the problem that the existing unmanned aerial vehicle cannot complete autonomous inspection, a flight hand and law enforcement personnel are required to complete on-site inspection is solved, the system is built, the data can be transmitted back to the platform in real time, the emergency command can be issued in time, the timeliness and the response speed are improved, the system realizes the linkage of the point positions of a plurality of data bins, the comprehensive management of the road section data of the whole sheet area, the control and communication capacity of the unmanned aerial vehicle are enhanced, the fusion and intelligent network linkage are realized, the intelligent management are reduced, and the manual operation is applicable to the diversified application scene of urban traffic intersections.
assignees: SHENZHEN URBAN TRANSP PLANNING CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Multimedia commanding dispatching system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multimedia commanding dispatching systems, comprising: multi-media dispatcher is communicated to connect for establishing with dispatch terminal, uses adaptable scheduling mode to realize monitoring and allotment to dispatch terminal according to dispatch terminal type；Dispatch terminal receives and executes the dispatch command of multi-media dispatcher for communicating to connect with multi-media dispatcher；Video Monitoring Terminal feeds back monitor video data to multi-media dispatcher based on dispatch command for communicating to connect with multi-media dispatcher.It is that front command centre and commanding in the rear center carry out monitoring remote video, video conference service that the system can be communicated using 4G.Can in the case that can not general communication, command centre and the urgent communication channel in rear in front of fast construction provide satellite positioning, real-time communication service between commanding in the rear center, operation center, rescue team member.Rapid command information and field rescue information are provided for the disaster relief, gives full play to its timeliness and accuracy.

title_en: Dynamic data acquisition intelligent equipment adopted in fire rescue scene
abstract_en: The invention provides dynamic data acquisition intelligent equipment used in a fire rescue site, which relates to the technical field of fire rescue equipment and comprises a fire rescue command center and intelligent hardware, wherein the intelligent hardware comprises a dial plate, a date disc, a vital sign acquisition disc and a motion recording disc are arranged in the dial plate, the date disc, the vital sign acquisition disc and the motion recording disc are fixedly arranged in the dial plate, a first acquisition camera is arranged at the edge of the dial plate, and the first acquisition camera is fixedly connected with the edge of the dial plate. Adopt intelligent hardware as the on-spot dynamic data collection equipment of fire rescue, intelligent hardware includes 4G 5G communication module, timing module, big dipper and motion detection module, and vital sign collection module can be used to training, the life sign condition of rescue in-process detection first-aid staff, according to the big data of training collection at ordinary times, early warning judgement basis when as emergency rescue also can regard as the punctual accurate equipment of checking the card when the rescue of giving an police.
assignees: SHENZHEN AUREA WISDOM SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Public affair car management system
