title_en: Automatic reporting device through impact detection
title_ko: 충격 감지를 통한 자동신고 장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides an automatic reporting device through impact detection, which automatically reports an accident occurrence when an accident occurs to a personal mobility driver. The automatic reporting device through impact detection comprises: a helmet worn by a personal mobility driver; an impact sensor module provided in the helmet, and measuring the amount of impact applied to the personal mobility driver wearing the helmet; a hardware board including an input connection unit, an output connection unit, and a calculation unit for performing logic by a mounted application program; a GPS module provided in the hardware board, and receiving position information on the driver; a LoRa module for wirelessly transmitting the position information received from the GPS module; and a control unit for controlling the hardware board and the LoRa module.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 충격 감지를 통한 자동신고 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 퍼스널 모빌리티 운전자에게 사고가 발생하면 가까운 경찰서, 소방서 및 응급의료센터 중 어느 하나 이상에 신고하는 충격 감지를 통한 자동신고 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시 예에 따르면, 퍼스널 모빌리티 운전자에게 사고가 발생하면 자동으로 사고 발생 신고를 하는 헬멧(1)에 있어서, 상기 퍼스널 모빌리티 운전자가 착용하는 헬멧(1); 상기 헬멧(1)에 구비되고, 상기 헬멧(1)을 착용한 퍼스널 모빌리티 운전자에게 가해지는 충격량을 측정하는 충격센서모듈; 입력접속부, 출력접속부 및 탑재된 응용프로그램에 의해 로직을 수행하는 연산부를 포함하여 구성되는 하드웨어보드(2); 상기 하드웨어보드(2)에 구비되어 운전자의 위치 정보를 수신하는 GPS모듈(3); 상기 GPS모듈(3)에서 수신된 위치 정보를 무선으로 전송하는 로라(LoRa)모듈(4); 및 상기 하드웨어보드(2) 및 로라(LoRa)모듈(4)을 제어하는 제어부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는, 충격 감지를 통한 자동신고 장치를 제공한다.
assignees: UNIV DONG A RES FOUND FOR IND ACAD COOP

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digital video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event, and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted server to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time, the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: Shelter emergency power supply processing method and system suitable for extreme environment
abstract_en: The application provides a shelter emergency power supply processing method and system suitable for an extreme environment. The method comprises the steps of detecting and recording extreme condition parameters of the environment where the shelter is located, generating an environment risk assessment report, dynamically adjusting the load distribution ratio between a main power supply and a standby power supply according to the environment risk assessment report, carrying out thermal management analysis on an internal circuit of a power supply system, generating an optimized power supply distribution scheme, immediately starting an emergency response mechanism when the system detects that an emergency situation occurs in the shelter, generating an electric power distribution adjustment record under the emergency situation, and executing comprehensive power supply system health inspection by using the electric power distribution adjustment record under the emergency situation after the extreme environment condition is relieved, and generating a detailed maintenance report. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the reliability and stability of the power supply system, improves the emergency response capability, ensures the power supply of key equipment, reduces the maintenance cost and improves the energy utilization efficiency.

title_en: Centerless ad hoc network emergency communication command method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a centerless ad hoc network emergency communication command method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of distributing communication frequency, channel resources, power control parameters and routing strategies for all nodes in a network; the method comprises the steps of generating an initial connection relation table among nodes and an initial topological structure of a network according to communication frequency and channel resources, distributing route paths leading to other nodes for each node and recording, collecting real-time communication load data of links on the route paths, calculating link communication congestion degree, updating the node connection relation and the route paths according to the congestion degree, generating an emergency communication task model, determining task priority and distributing tasks to nodes meeting the conditions, synchronously updating the communication frequency, the channel resources and the route paths of the nodes, starting the nodes in an ad hoc network to execute the emergency communication tasks, and improving network performance and task scheduling reliability.

title_en: Hydraulic generation sprinkler for refuge leading
title_ko: 피난유도기능을 갖는 수압발전식 스프링클러
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 피난유도기능을 갖는 수압발전식 스프링클러에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은 배관에 접속되어 내부로 물이 유입될 수 있는 공간부를 형성하고 그 하단부에 분사용 노즐캡을 일체로 구비하여서 된 케이싱과, 그 내부에 설치된 고정자와, 상기 케이싱 내에서 유입수의 흐름을 제어하는 토출유도부와 상기 토출유도부를 통해 공급되는 물의 수압에 의해 회전력을 발생시키는 임펠러 및 상기 임펠러와 함께 회전하면서 상기 고정자와의 사이에서 유도기전력을 발생시키는 회전자를 구비하여서 된 회전구동부와, 상기 고정자와 유기적 회로를 구성하여 상기 회전자의 회전시 발광효과와 함께 경고음발생, 위치정보용 무선신호송출 또는 영상·음성기록 등의 선택된 표출효과를 구현하는 표시/기록장치부를 포함하여 이루어짐을 특징으로 하는 것으로서, 본 발명에 의하면, 화재 발생시 스프링클러 고유의 물 분사작동과 동시에 자가 발전에 의한 비상전원으로 자체 광원이 점멸됨으로써 정전시 별도의 비상조명등 없이도 시인성을 확보할 수 있고, 화재를 알리는 경고음이나 무선신호를 송출하여 사고에 대한 신속 대처가 가능하며, 화재현장의 녹화 및 녹음 자료를 확보할 수 있어 사후 원인분석을 통한 생활환경 개선 효과를 발휘할 수 있다. 
       
      스프링클러, 조명등, 경고음, 무선주파수송신모듈, 영상·음성기록모듈

title_en: System and method for managing record of vehicles
title_ko: 차량의 기록 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A method and a system for managing vehicle records are provided to easily and quickly detect a hit-and-run vehicle by storing parking and stopping records of the hit-and-run vehicle so as to reduce the number of vehicles to be inspected in car accidents. A system for managing vehicle records includes an apparatus unit(11), which is installed on a vehicle and generates parking/stopping data of the vehicle, and a main system. The apparatus unit includes an information collecting unit(12), a controller(13), and a data transmitter(14). The controller determines whether the vehicle stops or parks and generates the parking/stopping data. The data transmitter communicates with the main system. The main system includes a system transceiver(22) and a system managing unit(23). The system transceiver receives and transmits the parking/stopping data from or to the apparatus unit. The system managing unit manages the parking/stopping data of the vehicle and outputs the parking/stopping data to be recognizable.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사고 발생 차량의 기록 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로 차량에 장착되어 차량의 주/정차 데이터를 생성하고 전송하는 장치부와, 상기 장치부로부터 차량의 주/정차 데이터를 전송받아 분류, 축적하여 관리하는 메인 시스템을 포함하며, 
     상기 장치부는, 차량의 위치정보를 포함하는 차량 정보를 수집하는 정보수집부와, 상기 수집된 차량 정보를 통해 차량의 주/정차 여부를 판단하여 주/정차 데이터를 생성하는 판정제어부와, 상기 판정제어부에서 생성된 주/정차 데이터를 전송하거나 상기 메인 시스템으로부터 전송받는 데이터 송수신부를 포함하며, 
     상기 메인 시스템은, 상기 장치부에서 송신한 차량의 주/정차 데이터를 전송받거나 전송하는 시스템 송수신부와, 상기 차량의 주/정차 데이터를 관리하고 인지 가능한 형태로 출력하는 시스템 관리부를 포함한다.  
       
     위성, 위치정보, 뺑소니, 주/정차 기록

title_en: Local distributed type intgrated control system based on high resolution cctv camera
title_ko: 고해상도 카메라 기반의 지역분산형 통합관제시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A local distribution type integrated control system of high-resolution CCTV cameras is provided to enable a central control system to selectively transmit image data including an incident to the central control system, thereby highly reducing data traffic. CONSTITUTION: A central control system (100) includes a server (200) and a monitor (300). A local control system (400) includes a closed circuit television (CCTV) camera which is connected a sever (420) via wire or wirelessly and take pictures of a surveillance zone. The server of the local control system selects an event image by analyzing the taken image data through an image analysis module. The server of the local control system transmits the event image to the central control system through a communication module. The server of the local control system transmits images based on a recording time label each corresponding to a call request of the central control system. [Reference numerals] (AA) Storage/analysis
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 중앙에서 CCTV를 관리하는 통합관제시스템에 관한 것으로, 종래, CCTV 영상을 지역관제시스템에서 중앙관제시스템으로 모두 보내고 중앙관제시스템 상황실에서 관리요원이 모니터를 지켜보며 모든 영상을 감시하여 돌발상황을 찾아내는 방식의 비효율을 개선한 새로운 관제시스템을 제공한다.  
본 발명은 지역관제시스템에 모든 CCTV 영상 정보를 저장하고, 영상분석 시스템을 설치하여 돌발 상황이 감지된 영상에 대해서만 중앙관제시스템으로 전송하게 하여, 전송량을 대폭 줄이고, 전송량이 줄어듦에 따라 각 지역에 설치되는 CCTV의 화소수를 100만 화소 이상의 고해상도로 구성하여, 네트워크 대역폭에 구애받지 않고 유용성이 큰 고해상도 영상정보를 제공함과 동시에 중앙관제실 모니터에도 유의미한 영상을 제공하여 업무 효율을 높이게 된다.

title_en: Apparatus for connecting ad board
title_ko: 지진기록계용 ａｄ 보드 접속 장치
abstract_en: An AD board connecting apparatus for an earthquake recorder is disclosed. The AD board connecting apparatus for an earthquake recorder according to the present invention comprises a board selection part for selecting an AD board; a function selection part for selecting the function of the AD board; a logic part for combining the AD board selected by the board selection part and the function selected by the function selection part; and a buffer part for transferring the data output from the AD board selected by the board selection part to a main board according to the output of the logic part or for transferring a function selection command transmitted from the main board to the board selected by the board selection part. It is possible to connect a plurality of AD boards and select the AD boards and their functions.
abstract_ko: 지진기록계용 AD 보드 접속 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 지진기록계용 AD 보드 접속 장치는 AD 보드를 선택하는 보드 선택부; AD 보드의 기능을 선택하는 기능 선택부; 보드 선택부에 의해 선택된 AD 보드와 기능 선택부에 의해 선택된 기능을 조합하는 논리부; 및 논리부의 출력에 따라, 보드 선택부에 의해 선택된 AD 보드로부터 출력된 데이터를 메인 보드에 전달하거나 또는 메인 보드로부터 전달된 기능 선택 명령을 보드 선택부에 의해 선택된 보드에 전달하는 버퍼부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Swichgear and controlgear minimizing damage from electric accident
title_ko: 정전 사고에 의한 피해를 최소화한 배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchboard for minimizing damage from power outages. The switchboard comprises: a cover (110); a weight (120); a substrate (130); and a case (140). According to the present invention, when vibration suddenly occurs due to an earthquake, the vibration can be detected early by a pendulum movement of the weight.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서는 하면에 고리형태로 하방으로 돌출된 좌고리(111) 및 우고리(112)가 형성되고 통기홀(113)이 하나 이상 형성되어 있는 커버(110); 직육면체이고 하면에는 반사판(122)이 형성되며, 상면에는 상방으로 연장되다가 바깥쪽으로 90도로 꺽인 좌암(123)과 우암(124)이 구비되어 상기 좌고리(111) 및 우고리(112)에 걸리는 무게추(120); 상기 반사판(122)으로부터 소정간격 이격되고, 상면의 중심부에 발광부(131)와 직수광부(132)가 돌출되어 매립되며, 상기 좌암(123)과 우암(124)을 잇는 선의 방향과 평행하게 중심부로부터 양측으로 이격되어 복수개의 측수광부(133)가 매립되고, 유무선통신이 가능한 통신부(134)와 아날로그 신호를 디지털신호로 변환하는 A/D 컨버터(135)와 발광부(131), 직수광부(132), 측수광부(133), 통신부(134) 및 A/D컨버터(135)에 전원을 공급하는 전원부(136)를 구비하는 기판(130); 및, 상기 기판(130)이 저면에 삽치되고 커버(110)에 의해 개방된 상부가 밀폐되며, 외측벽 양쪽에는 걸림홈(141)이 형성되어 있고, 배전반의 캐비닛(500)의 저면에 설치되는 케이스(140);를 포함하되, 지진이 발생하여 배전반의 캐비닛(500)이 진동함에 따라 무게추(120)가 진자운동을 하는 경우, 발광부(131)에서 조사된 빛이 반사판(122)에 의해 반사되어 측수광부(133)에서 수신하면 진동이 있음을 감지하고, 상기 통기홀(113)을 통해 연기가 발생하면 직수광부(132)나 측수광부(133)가 빛을 감지하지 못하여 화재가 있음을 감지하는 것을 특징으로 하는 정전 사고에 의한 피해를 최소화한 배전반이 제공된다. 
본 발명은 지진에 의하여 진동이 갑자기 발생한 경우에는 무게추의 진자운동에 의하여 진동을 조기에 감지할 수 있는 유리한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digital video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event, and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted server to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time, the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: Manned centrifuge medical science monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model provides a pair of manned centrifuge medical science monitoring system, include: the system comprises an operation desk and a control cabinet, wherein physiological monitoring, a database and audio and video monitoring equipment are installed in the control cabinet, and the operation desk controls the equipment in the control cabinet through a PLC (programmable logic controller); the operation panel includes: the control display module displays signals monitored in the control cabinet through the control operation module, and enables a subject to communicate with a commander in real time through real-time monitoring, recording and replaying of analysis and monitoring data, so that the training and testing safety is guaranteed, and the work completion quality is improved.
assignees: PLA AIR FORCE CHARACTERISTICS MEDICAL CENTER

title_en: Whole load equalizing method and system and dispatch server based on dual-active framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of Whole load equalizing method based on dual-active framework and system and dispatch server, the system includes：The first data center and the second data center of dual-active framework, and dispatch server；Wherein, the WEB layer switch of first and second data center is connected by internet with the dispatch server；The dispatch server is used for the resource situation that the WEB server of first and second data center is periodically obtained from the WEB layer switch of first and second data center；And determine domain name after the domain name mapping request of user's transmission is received；The IP address and resource situation of the server of domain name mapping are searched from DNS resource record tables, the IP address for therefrom filtering out server returns；When one of data center breaks down, the WEB server of the data center is labeled as failure.The present invention can be directed to the cluster service node with dual-active disaster tolerance framework and provide GSLB service.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of weather based reminding method, device, equipment and computer-readable recording medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a kind of weather based reminding method, device, equipment and computer-readable recording medium, wherein, this method includes：Obtain the target ownership place prestored；The target ownership place is associated with corresponding identity information；Whether abnormal detect the target ownership place weather；If abnormal, information command is sent.The embodiment of the present invention solves the weather condition that existing weather based reminding method can only get mobile terminal location, it can not obtain in mobile terminal corresponding to different phone numbers the problem of the weather condition of ownership place, experience to user is brought conveniently, while adds the exchange between different user.

title_en: Personnel gathering risk monitoring and early warning method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a personnel gathering risk monitoring and early warning method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring point location information and personnel information of a production device in a chemical production factory in real time; establishing an early warning grading rule according to the point location information of the production device of the chemical production factory area acquired in real time; judging the risk level of the personnel according to the personnel information and the early warning grading rule; and triggering personnel aggregation risk monitoring and early warning according to the risk level and the early warning grading rule. By using the personnel aggregation risk monitoring and early warning method provided by the invention, when different risk conditions are met, personnel can be reasonably dispersed according to the risk early warning, so that the personnel can move within a safety range, the safety of personnel operation and the timeliness of emergency response are improved, and the safety and the production efficiency in a chemical production factory are further improved.
assignees: NANJING BEILU IOT INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Colliery belt conveyor slip protection system based on driving roller abnormal temperature monitoring and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of coal mine safety monitoring and control, and discloses a slip protection system of a coal mine belt conveyor, which forms an efficient monitoring and emergency response system by using an infrared temperature sensor temperature acquisition module, a wireless communication protocol conversion module, an edge computing gateway, a driving roller motor power-off protection module and a database server; the temperature acquisition module detects the surface temperature of the driving roller in real time and transmits the surface temperature to the edge computing gateway through the wireless sensor network; the neural network processing unit built in the gateway utilizes a one-dimensional convolutional neural network algorithm to analyze the roller surface temperature data in real time, identify abnormal temperature changes and further infer the slip state of the driving roller; when the system detects the severe slipping symptom, the gateway can timely send a command to the motor power-off protection module, rapidly cut off the motor power supply and inform the control center to prevent accidents; the database server is used as a data storage and management center to record all monitoring data and event logs in real time.

title_en: Intelligent medical terminal for health management of old people
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of health management of the elderly, and provides an intelligent medical terminal for health management of the elderly, which comprises an information management module, a control module and a control module, wherein the information management module is used for recording and managing basic information and health information of the elderly; the basic information comprises one or more of names, ages, sexes and contact modes of the old and the relatives; the health information comprises one or more of past medical history, operation history, medication records, physical examination results and daily health monitoring data of the old people; the intelligent medical terminal for the health management of the elderly not only improves the efficiency and the accuracy of the health management, but also greatly enhances the independent living capacity and the safety coefficient of the elderly, simultaneously lightens the care burden of families and medical institutions, effectively prevents diseases, improves the life quality of the elderly, and solves the problems of information dispersion, health abnormality early warning lag, slow emergency response and the like of the prior art in the health management of the elderly.
assignees: VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL COLLEGE OF ANSHUN

title_en: Scenic spot inspection and travel pat integration method of AI collaborative double-machine unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicles, and discloses a scenic spot inspection and travel pat integration method of an AI collaborative double-machine unmanned aerial vehicle system, which comprises the following steps of: the unmanned aerial vehicle AI system comprises an energy module, a communication module, a flight control module, an edge calculation module, an environment sensing module, an inspection unmanned aerial vehicle, a travel shooting unmanned aerial vehicle, an edge calculation module, a scenic spot management platform and a user APP. The invention integrates scenic spot inspection and travel pat service innovation through the collaborative operation of the inspection unmanned aerial vehicle and the travel pat unmanned aerial vehicle. The tour unmanned aerial vehicle can monitor scenic spot environment, facility state, people flow condition and the like in real time, provide data support for scenic spot security, environment management, emergency response and the like, provide personalized image service for tourists, meet the requirement of the tourists for recording the traveling moment, promote the tourist experience, expand the service dimension of the scenic spot, promote diversified development of the scenic spot, realize efficient integration of management and service, promote the overall operation efficiency of the scenic spot, and facilitate practical application and operation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SHUIKE CULTURE GROUP CO LTD

title_en: System, method and computer readable recording medium for providing an escort service
title_ko: 에스코트 서비스 제공 시스템, 방법 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for providing an escort service, and a computer readable recording medium therefor which can efficiently manage an escort service by tracking paths for multiple sections set by a customer. The escort service providing method comprises the following steps of: receiving escort service reservation information inputted by a customer asking for an escort service, and storing the information in a database; allocating a unique code to each escort agent, and storing the allocation information in the database; mapping escort agent selection information by the customer requesting an escort service or requested escort service selection by the escort agent or particular agent selected by automatic mapping by a service server to the reserved escort service, and storing the mapped information in the database; executing an exclusive application installed on an escort agent terminal, and logging in the application by inputting the unique code and the password of the agent through the executed exclusive application; receiving selection information on at least one command designated by the exclusive application; and transmitting a text message corresponding to the designated command to the escort service server and/or a terminal of the customer requesting an escort service according to the designated command selection. [Reference numerals] (310) Reservation setting unit; (320) Path setting unit; (330) Agent mapping unit; (340) Service monitoring unit; (350) Section searching unit; (360) Path tracking unit; (370) Message transmission unit; (381) Customer information database; (382) Reservation information database; (383) Map information database; (384) Path information database; (385) Agent information database; (386) Performance information database
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고객이 설정한 복수의 구간에 대한 경로를 추적함으로써 효과적인 에스코트 서비스의 관리가 가능한 에스코트 서비스 제공 시스템, 방법 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체에 관한 것으로, 특히 에스코트 서비스 신청자로부터 입력된 에스코트 서비스 예약 정보를 입력받아 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계; 복수의 에스코트 요원들에 고유한 코드를 할당하여 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계; 상기 에스코트 서비스 신청자의 에스코트 요원 선택 정보 또는 상기 에스코트 요원의 신청된 에스코트 서비스 선택 또는 서비스 서버의 자동 매핑에 의해 특정 에스코트 요원과 상기 예약한 에스코트 서비스를 매핑하여 데이터베이스에 저장하는 단계; 상기 에스코트 요원의 단말에 설치된 전용 애플리케이션이 실행되고, 상기 실행된 전용 애플리케이션을 통해 입력된 요원의 고유한 코드 및 비밀 번호를 입력받아 로그인하는 단계; 상기 전용 애플리케이션에서 지정된 적어도 하나의 명령에 대한 선택 정보를 입력받는 단계; 및 상기 지정된 명령의 선택에 따라 에스코트 서비스 서버 및/또는 상기 에스코트 서비스 신청자의 단말로 상기 지정된 명령에 대응하는 문자 메시지가 전송되는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Schedule data auto generating system for soil remediation project
title_ko: 토양정화 공정정보 자동생성 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for automatically generating soil remediation process information, which includes a database unit (100) for storing a business soil drawing, a temporary facility drawing, and a ground facility drawing of a construction field of a target of soil remediation; an input unit (200) allowing a user to input data or a command; a three-dimensional cell model generation module (300) having a program generating a three-dimensional cell model using the drawings stored in the database unit (100) according to input of the input unit (200); a process calculating module (400) having a program generating an underground excavation order and process information using the input of the input unit (200) and the three-dimensional cell model generated from the three-dimensional cell model generation module (300); a report generation module (500) having a program generating an analysis report using the input of the input unit (200) and the underground excavation order and the process information generated by the process calculating module; and a monitoring unit (600) which displays a screen receiving the input of the data or the command from a user and displays data generated by the three-dimensional cell model generation module (300), the process calculating module (400), and the report generation module (500).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 토양정화의 대상이 되는 공사현장의 사업부지 도면, 가시설 도면 및 지상시설물 도면이 저장된 데이터베이스부(100); 사용자가 데이터나 명령어를 입력하는 입력부(200); 상기 입력부(200)의 입력에 따라 상기 데이터베이스부(100)에 저장된 도면을 이용하여 3차원셀모델을 생성하는 프로그램이 내장된 3차원셀모델생성모듈(300); 상기 입력부(200)의 입력과 상기 3차원셀모델생성모듈(300)에서 생성한 3차원셀모델을 이용하여 토공굴착 순서 및 공정정보를 생성하는 프로그램이 내장된 공정산출모듈(400); 상기 입력부(200)의 입력과 상기 공정산출모듈에서 생성된 토공굴착 순서 및 공정정보를 이용하여 분석보고서를 생성하는 프로그램이 내장된 보고서생성모듈(500); 사용자가 상기 입력부(200)를 통하여 데이터나 명령어를 입력하는 화면을 제시하고, 상기 3차원셀모델생성모듈(300), 상기 공정산출모듈(400) 및 상기 보고서생성모듈(500)에서 생성된 자료들을 화면으로 제시하는 모니터부(600);를 포함하여 구성되는 토양정화 공정정보 자동생성 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Wastewater discharge monitoring system using solar cell module combined with ZigBee communication
title_ko: 지그비통신이 결합된 태양전지모듈을 이용한 폐수배출자동기록 모니터링시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic wastewater discharge monitoring system using a solar cell module combined with Zigbee communication, automatically measuring and monitoring a water usage, a wastewater discharge amount, a chemical usage, and a power usage in real-time through Zigbee communication without a burden to fix and dispatch a separate personnel in a small scale business site, such as a wastewater processing plant, and the like, so as to reduce personnel costs and duty time. In particular, through a notification unit to inform a manager of a small scale business site, such as a wastewater processing plant, and the like, of whether a measurement unit to measure the water usage, the wastewater discharge amount, the chemical usage, and the power usage is failed, the failed measurement unit is able to be quickly replaced and repaired. Moreover, provided are effects of lowering an environmental violation rate of a nationwide business site discharge facility, allowing a joined researcher to acquire technologies, training a graduate student, and a researcher who accumulates technologies related to a business of a wastewater discharge and prevention facility field, and accumulating the technologies related to the business of the wastewater discharge and prevention facility field, and training and technical human power and creating employment of an information and communication technology (ICT) related industry, which is the basis of new/regeneration energy and creative economy.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지그비통신이 결합된 태양전지모듈을 이용한 폐수배출자동기록 모니터링시스템에 관한 것으로서, 폐수처리장 등의 소규모 사업장에서 별도의 인력을 고정 배치해야하는 부담감 없이 지그비통신을 이용하여 용수사용량, 폐수배출량, 약품사용량과 더불어 전력사용량 또한 자동으로 측정하면서 실시간으로 모니터링 할 수 있기 때문에 인건비 및 근무시간을 절감할 수 있고, 특히, 용수사용량, 폐수배출량, 약품사용량 및 전력사용량을 측정하는 측정부의 이상여부를 폐수처리장 등의 소규모 사업장의 관리자에게 알리는 알림부를 통해 이상이 발생된 측정부를 신속하게 교체보수할 수 있으며, 나아가, 전국 사업장 배출시설의 환경기준 위반율을 낮출 수 있음은 물론 참여 연구원의 기술 습득 및 대학원생 양성과 폐수 배출 및 방지시설 분야 사업에 관련된 기술 축적 연구인을 양성할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 폐수 배출 및 방지시설분야에 관련된 기술축적효과가 발생될 수 있고, 아울러, 신재생에너지 및 창조경제의 기반인 ICT 관련 산업의 기술 인력 양성 및 고용창출 효과 기대할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: NAT UNIV CHONBUK IND COOP FOUND

title_en: Systems and Methods for Forming and Operating an Ecosystem for a Conducted Electrical Weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment (e.g., ecosystem) for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: Prioritizing and resolving inconsistencies in digital evidence
abstract_en: A system for prioritizing and resolving inconsistencies in digital evidence. The system includes a database containing a first type of data and a second type of data related to an incident record and an electronic computing device including an electronic processor. The electronic processor is configured to receive the first and second types of data from the database, determine an inconsistency between the first and second types of data, and determine an incident type from the incident record. The electronic processor is also configured to determine whether a priority of the determined inconsistency meets a threshold case impact level. When the priority of the inconsistency meets the threshold case impact level, the electronic processor is configured to take a first notification action and when the priority of the inconsistency does not meet the threshold case impact level, the electronic processor is configured to take a second notification action.

title_en: Determining priority discrepancies between audio data and records data
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for determining priority discrepancies between audio data and records data. In one example, the system includes an electronic computing device. The electronic computing device compares audio data associated with a public safety incident to records data associated with the public safety incident, determines discrepancies between the audio data and the records data, and determines an organization and a type associated with the public safety incident. The electronic computing device also determines, based on the organization and the type, priority discrepancies included in the discrepancies and generates a geographical map that includes the priority discrepancies and that is configured for display on a display device.

title_en: Simulation method and system for demand response type dispatching applied to intelligent public transport system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent transportation, and discloses a simulation method and a system for demand response scheduling applied to an intelligent public transportation system: the bus dispatching simulation system comprises a dispatching management platform and a dispatching simulation platform, wherein the dispatching management platform records real-time passenger flow data, historical passenger flow data and vehicle operation data, runs an intelligent bus demand response dispatching algorithm and outputs a bus plan, the dispatching simulation platform is a simulation environment of the intelligent bus demand response dispatching algorithm, the bus station system counts station passenger flow data and passenger waiting time of a bus station, the bus station system counts bus departure interval data and bus departure times, and the bus mobile terminal service system collects a car pooling order and a package order of passengers. The invention solves the problem of lack of simulation schemes aiming at intelligent bus demand responsive dispatching functions.

title_en: System of STEAM Educational Program based on Coding Technology and the Teaching Material for STEAM
title_ko: 코딩 기술을 기반으로 한 스팀융합교육 프로그램 시스템 및 스팀융합교육 교재
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 로봇 펫을 이용하여 놀이와 학습을 동시에 수행하며 과학기술 기반의 융합적 사고력을 향상시킬 수 있는 코딩 기술을 기반으로 한 스팀융합교육 프로그램 시스템 및 스팀융합교육 교재에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 의한 코딩 기술을 기반으로 한 스팀융합교육 프로그램 시스템은, 로봇에 기설정된 입력값을 입력하기 위한 서로 다른 입력 표시를 각각 구분하여 인식하고 입력된 입력값에 따라 기설정된 출력값을 출력하는 로봇 펫과, 서로 다른 상기 입력 표시가 구비된 복수의 입력카드와, 상기 로봇 펫을 이용한 코딩 학습내용이 기재된 워크북을 포함하여 구성된 스팀융합교육 교재를 이용한 코딩 기술을 기반으로 한 스팀융합교육 프로그램 시스템으로서, 상기 워크북은 아동의 발달 단계에 따라 단계적이고 체계적인 커리큘럼을 제공하는 복수의 학습 단원으로 구성되고, 각 학습 단원은 상기 로봇 펫을 이용한 코딩 방법을 학습하는 기능 배우기 단계와 이를 실생활 문제에 적용하는 융합인재교육 기반의 활동하기 단계를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for determining disastrous based on image and accident record analysis
title_ko: 사고기록정보와 이미지에 기반한 재난 상황 판단 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster situation determination method based on an image and accident record information. The method is performed by a server including a server collection unit, a server processing unit, a server transmission unit, and a web server. The method includes: a step in which the server collection unit receives an accident image and location information from a user device; a step in which the server collection unit transmits pre-stored accident record information, the accident image, and the location information to the server processing unit and transmits the accident image to the web server; a step in which the web server calculates an accident type result value included in the accident image by inputting the accident image to an accident recognition model machine-learned in advance; a step in which the web server transmits the accident type result value to the server processing unit; and a step in which the server processing unit calculates monthly disaster situation information corresponding to the point of time of receiving the accident image by using the pre-stored accident record information, the location information, and the accident type result value. The accident record information includes traffic accident information of the same month for the past 10 years from the current month and fire accident information of the same month for the past 10 years. The monthly disaster situation information includes the estimated accident count of the month, the estimated accident death toll of the month, and the estimated accident injured count of the month.
abstract_ko: 사고기록정보와 이미지에 기반한 재난 상황 판단 방법이 제공된다. 서버 수집부, 서버 처리부, 서버 전송부 및 웹 서버를 포함하는 서버에 의해 수행되는 사고기록정보와 이미지에 기반한 재난 상황 판단 방법은, 상기 서버 수집부가 사용자 장치로부터 사고 이미지 및 위치 정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 서버 수집부가 미리 저장된 사고기록정보, 상기 사고 이미지 및 상기 위치 정보를 상기 서버 처리부로 전송하고, 상기 웹 서버로 상기 사고 이미지를 전송하는 단계; 상기 웹 서버가 미리 기계학습된 사고 인식 모델에 상기 사고 이미지를 입력하여 상기 사고 이미지에 포함된 사고 유형 결과 값을 산출하는 단계; 상기 웹 서버가 사고 유형 결과 값을 상기 서버 처리부에 전송하는 단계; 및 상기 서버 처리부가 상기 미리 저장된 사고기록정보, 상기 위치 정보 및 상기 사고 유형 결과 값을 이용하여 상기 사고 이미지를 수신한 시점에 대응하는 이달의 재난 상황 정보를 산출하는 단계;를 포함하고, 상기 사고기록정보는 상기 이달 기준으로 최근 10년간 동월(同月)의 교통사고 정보 및 최근 10년간 동월의 화재사고 정보를 포함하고, 상기 이달의 재난 상황 정보는 이달의 예상 사고 발생건수, 이달의 예상 사고 사망자수 및 이달의 예상 사고 부상자수를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for post-vehicle crash intelligence
abstract_en: A system and method to capture and aggregate occupant and incident information from within a vehicle following an accident, and to transmit such aggregated incident and patient data, in an automated and event triggered fashion, to an emergency responder. The data transmitted to the emergency responder can trigger creating a new patient record for the occupant of the vehicle.

title_en: A kind of fire scene rescue personnel managing and control system and its application method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of fire scene rescue personnel managing and control system and its application method, including the inductor with rescue personnel, in addition to inductor sensing apparatus that rescue personnel passes in and out recorded by being used for of using cooperatively of wireless communication mode, be connected with sensing apparatus to obtain the control display system of sensing apparatus data.The present invention realizes the real-time monitoring to fire scene rescue, facilitates commanding to the real-time commander of rescue site, the effect for greatly improve search and rescue, suing and labouring, while also the life to rescue personnel has safely provided guarantee.
assignees: WUHU PUWEITE INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Fire control supervisory systems based on thing networking
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire fighting, in particular to a fire fighting supervisory system based on the Internet of things, which solves the problems that in the prior art, the urban fire fighting construction is relatively lagged, and the accurate information of a fire disaster can not be automatically reported to a fire fighting command center at the first time when the fire disaster happens, so that the misestimation of the disaster situation is caused, a proper emergency measure can not be timely made, and the timeliness is poor. The utility model provides a fire control supervisory systems based on thing networking, includes server, mobile terminal equipment and sets up the two-dimensional code on fire-fighting equipment, fire engine, and every two-dimensional code has independent identification number, and mobile terminal equipment passes through to the server after scanning the two-dimensional code and editing corresponding information on mobile terminal equipment, and the server is provided with control center and the administrative center who is connected with control center respectively. The invention can timely send accurate disaster information to the Internet of things fire management center, is convenient for emergency response and simultaneously makes a proper response scheme, and has high emergency efficiency.
assignees: JIANGSU LANDUN FIRE FIGHTING TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Mining disaster relief linkage control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of rescue control of floods under mines, in particular to a method and a system for controlling rescue linkage of floods under mines, which are used for acquiring environmental monitoring data in real time, generating alarm information based on the environmental monitoring data, pushing a corresponding early warning strategy aiming at the generated alarm information, and executing the rescue strategy by one key after confirmation of a dispatcher, thereby realizing a novel mode of rescue linkage control of floods combining automatic fire judgment, automatic dispatching and manual decision participation, being beneficial to reducing the omission and errors caused by manual judgment, manual making of rescue strategies and manual command, facilitating timely evacuation and disaster avoidance of personnel when floods occur, and simultaneously being beneficial to improving timeliness and timeliness of rescue.

title_en: Analysis monitoring method and system based on intelligent park operation state
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent park management, in particular to an analysis monitoring method and system based on the operation state of an intelligent park, comprising the following steps: acquiring operational data parameters and associated environmental parameters of the intelligent park, analyzing operational differences of the intelligent park, identifying operational states of the intelligent park, predicting state change trend, calculating propagation paths and rates of abnormal events, determining response priority and constructing early warning information, and acquiring intelligent park monitoring records. According to the method, the accuracy of the identification of the park equipment state is improved by combining the fluctuation analysis of the equipment operation data and the environmental parameters, the early warning of the abnormal state is realized by combining the time sequence correlation analysis and the equipment state prediction, the influence of equipment faults on the park operation is reduced, the prediction of the abnormal event propagation path is realized by calculating the topological structure and the propagation probability, the accuracy and timeliness of emergency response are enhanced, the real-time monitoring and fault prediction capability is improved, and the efficient operation and the safety of the park are ensured.
assignees: CHENGDU KAOLA LIWEI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Neurosurgery ward quick response method based on double-paradigm layered brain-computer interface system
abstract_en: The invention provides a neurosurgery ward quick response method based on a double-paradigm layering brain-computer interface system, and relates to the technical field of medical information. The system consists of a motor imagery subsystem, a steady-state vision induction potential subsystem, a protocol management module, an event response module and a state machine management module, and is interconnected with a ward terminal. The method realizes emergency triggering through motor imagery normally open monitoring, and switches to steady-state visual evoked potential high-precision interaction when the illness state is stable or medical care is confirmed, and can be interrupted by preemption to return to an emergency state, and a state machine module switches between three states and records operation indexes to realize log audit and parameter setting. The method gives consideration to quick start, low false triggering and accurate transmission, and improves ward emergency response efficiency and communication safety.
assignees: UNION HOSPITAL TONGJI MEDICAL COLLEGE HUAZHONG UNIV SCI & TECH

title_en: Artificial intelligence auxiliary ship safety management system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an artificial intelligence auxiliary ship safety management system and an application method thereof, and relates to the technical field of ship safety management and artificial intelligence technology intersection. According to the artificial intelligent auxiliary ship safety management system and the application method thereof, when an AIS device signal is interrupted, a shipborne offline regulation library and a navigation database are called for localized analysis, management blind areas are eliminated, an AIS data packet and a device operation parameter packet are synchronized, and the regulation library is combined for cross analysis, so that single data misjudgment is avoided, risk identification precision is improved, classified instructions are generated and pushed through automatic verification of data compliance, manual dependence is reduced, compliance records are truly and timely ensured, an AI analysis layer updates the database according to instruction feedback, an AI model is optimized regularly to reduce misinformation rate, active early warning is realized, shore bases view data in real time and issue instructions, a crew terminal feedback result is broadcasted in a grading manner, sudden accident handling time is shortened, and emergency response speed is effectively improved.
assignees: WUHU ANHANG E COMMERCE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent inspection and safety interlocking control system for radioactive source library
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent inspection and safety interlocking control system for a radioactive source library, and particularly relates to the field of safety control of the radioactive source library, wherein a central control unit comprises five core modules, namely an intelligent inspection path planning module is responsible for loading an environment map and planning an inspection path, and the central control unit supports real-time adjustment of a line; the dynamic radiation monitoring module dynamically monitors the motion trail of personnel and the carrying state of a radioactive source through a high-sensitivity radiation detector and a mobile sensor carried by the robot; the factory area state diagnosis module reads fixed sensor data in real time, diagnoses environment abnormality and issues instructions, the abnormality response and mobile check module enables the robot to interrupt inspection after receiving early warning, autonomously plans a path to the field for checking and preliminary treatment, and the intelligent decision and emergency response module automatically records abnormality or starts an emergency flow according to a check result, so that the safety control capacity and emergency response efficiency of the radioactive source library are remarkably improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR ENVIRONMENTAL PROT INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent wearable device emergency call system with voiceprint recognition assistance
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent wearable device emergency call system assisted by voiceprint recognition, which relates to the technical field of intelligent devices, wherein a multimode data acquisition module is used for acquiring voice information, physiological signals and environment data of a user, a voiceprint recognition and identity verification module is used for extracting voiceprint characteristics of the user, a voiceprint model is built, an emotion state analysis module is used for analyzing the emotion state of the user, and a physiological risk assessment module and an environment risk assessment module are used for respectively assessing the physiological state and the environment of the user in real time. The risk assessment module adopts a multisource data fusion algorithm, comprehensively considers the identity verification result, the emotion state, the physiological state and the environmental factors of the user, and calculates a more accurate comprehensive risk score. The emergency response strategy execution module triggers the emergency response strategy of the corresponding level according to the comparison result of the comprehensive risk score and the preset threshold value, and improves the accuracy of emergency situation identification and the timeliness of response.

title_ko: 연약지반에서 홍수범람 예방을 위한 친환경적인 안전장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 경사지나 소하천용 제방에서 홍수범람 예방을 위한 친환경적인 안전장치에 관한 것으로서, 상세하게는 기후변화로 발생하는 급격한 폭우에 대하여 영농지역의 연약구간이나 소하천용 제방에서 홍수의 범람에 의한 수압으로 스며든 빗물에 의한 붕괴발생을 예방토록 생활폐기물로 발생하는 폐비닐체를 활용하는 친환경적인 안전장치에 관한 것이다. 
   일반적으로 산업의 도시화로 발생하는 폐비닐체는 소각이나 매립하고 있으나, 과인생산으로 환경오염의 요인이 되고 있으며, 또한 기후변화로 발생하는 급격한 홍수의 발생은 대부분 영농지역에 조성된 주거지역이나 비닐하우스단지에서 발생하는 피해는 실로 기록적이라 할 것이다.  
 따라서 본 발명을 첨부된 도면에 의거 상세히 설명하면, 
비탈면의 기울어진 경사지(150)나 영농지역을 흐르는 소하천(152)에서 홍수피해를 방지하도록 조성토로 구축된 제방용 안전장치에 있어서, 
상기 제방용 기소에서 길이방향으로 연속반복적으로 볼록부(207)와 요홈부(208)로 구비된 제1보강벽(250)와, 상기 제1보강벽(250)를 기소(168)에서 길이방향으로 다수개로 결속보강되도록  기둥체(330)와, 상기 기둥체(330)에서 외측면을 교호상이면서 만곡상태로 결속으로 조립되는 제1보강벽(250)과,  
상기 기둥체(330)에서 길이방향으로 외측면에 구비되면서 볼록하게 연속적인 양측구간의 양측볼록부(a)(a`)에 각각 경사지면서 대칭적으로 고정되는 경사고정빔(245)(245`)으로 결합되는 제1보강벽체블럭(450)과,  
상기 제1보강벽체블럭(450)를  둔치의 지중(160)에 매설된 기소(168)에 고정되는 기둥체(330)로 매설시켜서 주되, 상기 제1보강벽체블럭(450)를 제방(300)의 조성토에 내장으로 감싸줌으로서, 홍수로 인한 빗물의 수압에 의한 내구력을 제공하는 발명이다.

title_en: Computer-implemented method and system for the triggering of an alarm in an emergency communication system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a computer-implemented method of triggering an alarm in an emergency communication system, wherein the emergency system comprises a pre-recording system (1) that is connected to at least one PSAP (8) and a plurality of peripheral devcies (6) that respectively are equipped with a microphone via an emergency communication network, the method comprising the steps of receiving, at the pre-recording system (1), audio data input from at least one peripheral device (6), the audio data comprising speech and/or sound, determining, if the speech and/or sound exceeds a noise level threshold for a predetermined period of time, and if the noice level threshold is exceeded for a predetermined period of time, identifying a possible emergency incident; recording the audio data comprising the speech and/or sound related to the possible emergency incident, and initiating an emergency call to at least one PSAP (8). Further, the present invention relates to an emergency communication system comprising a pre-recording system (1) adapted for carrying out the computer-implemented method of triggering an alarm.

title_en: Address validation for personal emergency response systems
abstract_en: A server verifies that an address of record for a personal emergency response (PERS) device is in agreement with a current address of the PERS device. The PERS device has a docking station and a wearable unit. At start-up, the docking station places a call to the server and the server receives coordinates of the wearable unit. The coordinates are reverse-mapped into the current address and compared with the address of record. If the address and the address of record differ, the address of record is updated to reflect the current address.

title_en: Broadcasting system equipped with touch-switch for school
title_ko: 터치스위치로 구성된 입력부를 갖는 교내 방송 시스템
abstract_en: A school broadcast system having an input unit which consists of touch switches is provided to improve the convenience in use by inputting a command signal through the touch switches, and automatically broadcast according to a preset program at a desired time and through a desired TV or speaker. A central broadcasting unit(100) transmits the broadcasting data of a video and sound source through an internal communication network(10). A power management unit(400) monitors states of power supply units and remotely controls their power ON/OFF states. An input unit for enabling a user to input a command signal is respectively installed in the central broadcasting unit, a broadcasting unit(200) for a staff room, a broadcasting unit(300) for a classroom and the power management unit. The input unit consists of a plurality of touch switches.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 터치스위치로 구성된 입력부를 갖는 교내 방송 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 다수의 터치스위치로 이루어진 입력부를 통해 사용자가 편리하게 명령신호를 입력할 수 있고,  각 교실에 방송될 방송을 방송실에 설치된 중앙방송부뿐만 아니라 각 교무실에 설치된 교무실방송부와 각 교실에 설치된 교실방송부를 통해서 제어할 수 있고,  관리실에 설치된 전원관리부에서 교실, 교무실 등에 설치되어 있는 전원장비의 전원상태를 감시하고, 전원장비의 ON/OFF를 원격 제어할 수 있고,  여러 외부기기로부터 음원의 방송데이터를 입력받아 믹싱하는 중앙방송부의 믹서에는 입력되는 여러 방송데이터의 우선순의 방송을 선택 제어하는 우선순위제어부와 방송을 송출할 교실을 선택 제어하는 매트릭스제어부가 내장되어 있는 터치스위치로 구성된 입력부를 갖는 교내 방송 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     	본 발명의 터치스위치로 구성된 입력부를 갖는 교내 방송 시스템은 방송실에 설치되고, 영상 및 음원의 방송데이터를 내부통신망을 통해 송출하는 중앙방송부;  각각의 교무실에 설치되고, 영상 및 음원의 방송데이터를 내부통신망을 통해 송출하는 다수의 교무실방송부;  각각의 교실에 설치되고, 상기 교무실방송부 및 중앙방송부에서 송출한 방송데이터를 수신하고, 수신된 방송데이터를 TV 및 스피커를 통해 방송하는 다수의 교실방송부;  관리실에 설치되고, 상기 방송실과 교무실과 교실 각각에 설치되어 있는 전원장비들(예; 형광등, TV, 선풍기)의 전원상태(입력전원에 연결되어 있는지 여부, 전원이 ON상태인지 OFF상태인지 여부)를 감시하고,  상기 전원장비들의 전원 ON/OFF를 원격 제어하는 전원관리부;를 포함하는 교내 방송 시스템에 있어서,  상기 중앙방송부, 교무실방송부, 교실방송부 및 전원관리부 각각에는 사용자의 명령신호를 입력받는 입력부를 구비하되, 상기 입력부는 다수의 터치스위치로 이루어지고,  상기 중앙방송부는 상기 내부통신망에 연결된 제1송수신기와, 외부기기로부터 방송데이터를 입력받는 제1방송데이터수신수단과, 상기 제1송수신기, 상기 제1방송데이터수신수단 및 상기 입력부가 연결되고 상기 교무실방송부 및 교실방송부로 출력되는 방송을 제어하는 중앙제어부와, 상기 중앙제어부에 연결되고 교내 소방설비들을 전체적으로 제어하는 화재수신기로부터 화재발생신호를 전송받는 화재수신부를 포함하여 이루어지되, 상기 제1방송데이터수신수단은 여러 외부기기로부터 입력받는 음원들의 방송데이터를 믹싱하는 믹서와, 상기 믹서에 내장되어 있으며 기설정된 프로그램 따라 상기 믹서가 우선 출력할 방송데이터를 선택 제어하는 우선순위제어부와, 상기 믹서에 내장되어 있으며 상기 믹서가 방송데이터를 송출할 교실을 선택 제어하는 매트릭스제어부를 포함하여 이루어지고,  상기 교실방송부는 상기 내부통신망에 연결된 제2송수신기와, 외부기기로부터 방송데이터를 입력받는 제2방송데이터수신수단과, 상기 제2송수신기, 상기 제2방송데이터수신수단 및 상기 입력부가 연결되고 교실에 설치된 상기 TV 및 스피커로 출력되는 방송을 제어하는 교실제어부와, 상기 교실제어부에 연결되고 교실에 설치되어 있는 단독경보형 화재감지기로부터 화재발생신호를 전송받고 이를 상기 중앙방송부로 전송하는 교실 화재송신부를 포함하여 이루어지되, 상기 각 교실방송부의 제2송수신기는 내부통신망을 통해 상호 연결됨으로서 상호간에 방송데이터의 송수신이  가능하고, 어느 한 교실방송부에서 다른 교실방송부가 출력할 방송데이터의 제어가 가능한 것을 특징으로 하고, 상기 교무실방송부는 상기 내부통신망에 연결된 제3송수신기와, 외부기기로부터 방송데이터를 입력받는 제3방송데이터수신수단과, 상기 제3송수신기, 상기 제3방송데이터수신수단 및 상기 입력부가 연결되고 상기 교실방송부로 출력되는 방송을 제어하는 교무실제어부와, 상기 교무실제어부에 연결되고 교무실에 설치되어 있는 단독경보형 화재감지기로부터 화재발생신호를 전송받고 이를 상기 중앙방송수부으로 전송하는 교무실 화재송신부를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하고,  상기 전원관리부는 상기 내부통신망에 연결된 제4송수신기와, 상기 제4송수신기를 통해 상기 전원장비들 각각에 설치되어 있는 전원상태감지기로부터 전원상태에 대한 신호를 전송받아 이를 표시하는 표시부와, 상기 제4송수신기, 표시부 및 입력부가 연결되고, 상기 제4송수신기를 통해 상기 전원장비들 각각에 설치되어 있는 ON/OFF구동부에 ON/OFF신호를 전송하여 전원장비들의 전원 ON/OFF를 제어하는 전원제어부를 포함하여 이루어진 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     
     교내, 방송, 시스템, 터치스위치, 오디오믹서, 우선순위제어부, 매트릭스제어부, 화재감지기

title_en: RFID-based management system of fire hydrants
title_ko: Rfid 기반의 소화전 관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides an RFID-based management system of a fire hydrant capable of rapidly providing checked condition and location information of the fire hydrant to a fire brigade at a disaster site. The RFID-based management system of a fire hydrant comprises: one or more fire hydrants in which RFID tags having unique identification numbers recorded therein are respectively embedded; a mobile terminal which reads the RFID tags of the fire hydrants to identify the fire hydrants, and stores checked condition of the identified fire hydrants; a fire hydrant monitoring terminal for receiving and displaying the checked condition of the fire hydrants stored in the mobile terminal; a fire hydrant management server for receiving the checked condition of the fire hydrants from the fire hydrant monitoring terminal and storing the checked condition in a database; an automatic location identification server which exchanges data with the fire hydrant management server, and provides a service that provides information about an operation state of a dispatch vehicle by tracking a location of the dispatch vehicle and displaying the location on an electronic map in real time; and an automatic location identification terminal for providing information about an available fire hydrant by connecting to the automatic location identification server so as to receive data, and displaying the checked condition of the fire hydrants on an electronic map.
abstract_ko: RFID 기반의 소화전 관리시스템은, 고유한 식별번호가 기록된 RFID 태그가 각각 내장되는 적어도 하나 이상의 소화전; 상기 소화전의 RFID 태그를 읽어 상기 소화전을 식별하며, 식별된 상기 소화전의 점검상태를 저장하는 휴대용 단말기; 상기 휴대용 단말기에 저장된 상기 소화전의 점검상태를 전송받아 표시하는 소화전 모니터링 단말기; 상기 소화전 모니터링 단말기로부터 상기 소화전의 점검상태를 전송받아 데이터베이스화 하여 저장하는 소화전 관리서버; 상기 소화전 관리서버와 데이터를 상호 교환하며, 출동차량의 위치를 추적하여 실시간으로 전자지도에 표시함으로써 상기 출동차량의 운행상황을 파악할 수 있는 서비스를 제공하는 자동위치확인 서버; 및 상기 자동위치확인 서버에 접속하여 데이터를 전송받으며, 전자지도상에 상기 소화전의 점검상태를 표시함으로써 사용가능한 소화전의 정보를 제공하는 자동위치확인 단말기;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Apparatus for performing IoT function of cording robot
title_ko: IoT 기능을 수행하는 코딩 로봇 장치
abstract_en: A coding robot apparatus performing an IoT function according to the present invention may include: a control module which generates and outputs a control signal corresponding to a control command and including control target information and control content information, by using a program coded by a user when the control command is input; a robot control board which has the control module detachably attached, includes a plurality of control targets, and when the control signal is input from the control module, outputs the control signal to a control target indicated by the control target information among the plurality of control targets; a robot frame which includes a main frame and a plurality of sub-frames corresponding to each part of a robot; and a robot skin which is detachably attached to the robot frame to form a robot shape.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 IoT 기능을 수행하는 코딩 로봇 장치는 제어 명령이 입력되면 사용자로부터 코딩된 프로그램을 이용하여 상기 제어 명령에 대응되고 제어 대상 정보 및 제어 내용 정보를 포함하는 제어 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 제어 모듈; 상기 제어 모듈이 탈부착되고, 복수의 제어 대상을 포함하며, 상기 제어 모듈로부터 상기 제어 신호가 입력되면 상기 복수의 제어 대상 중에서 상기 제어 대상 정보가 나타내는 제어 대상으로 상기 제어 신호를 출력하는 로봇 제어 보드; 로봇 부위 각각에 대응되는 메인 프레임과 복수의 서브 프레임을 포함하는 로봇 프레임; 및 상기 로봇 프레임에 탈부착되어 로봇 형상을 구성하는 로봇 스킨;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for on-demand drone surveillance and emergency response
abstract_en: In a system and method for on-demand drone surveillance and emergency response, a software application receives a service request from a user device. A server processes the request and determines available drone pilots based on geographical proximity to the user. A selected drone pilot operates a drone equipped with video recording capabilities to the service location. The drone records a video feed at the service location, which is transmitted via a communication interface and displayed through the software application on the user device. The system provides real-time, on-demand surveillance and emergency response, potentially enhancing safety and security in various situations.

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digital video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event, and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted server to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time, the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: Systems and methods for forming and operating an ecosystem for a conducted electrical weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment (e.g., ecosystem) for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: Wireless neighborhood wildfire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in a neighborhood through GPS-tracking and mapping of environmentally-clean anti-fire (AF) chemical liquid spray applied to the property before wild fires reach the neighborhood
abstract_en: A wireless wild fire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in GPS-specified neighborhoods using GPS-managed delivery of environmentally-clean anti-fire (AF) chemical liquid spray to property before wild fire reaches the neighborhoods. The wireless system network includes a GPS system for providing GPS-location services to each system components in the wireless system network. A wireless communication network supports one or more network databases accessible by systems and devices deployed on the wireless communication network. A fleet of mobile GPS-tracked anti-fire liquid spraying systems are assigned to GPS-specified neighborhoods for spraying anti-fire chemical liquid on combustible property, buildings, and ground cover to inhibit fire ignition and flame spread wherever the anti-fire chemical liquid is sprayed. When allowed to dry, the anti-fire chemical liquid provides fire-protection status to sprayed property that is GPS-tracked and mapped within a network database maintained on the wireless communication network, recording wherever the environmentally-safe anti-fire chemical liquid has been spray applied. The system network includes mobile computing systems, each running a mobile application and deployed to a property owner, spray contractor or other stakeholder, such as firefighters and property insurance inspectors, for remotely monitoring the fire-protection status of property in any GPS-specified neighborhood, at any time on any specified date, along with the status of active wild fires surrounding the neighborhood. A command center deployed on the wireless system network transmits wild fire alerts and notifications and property spray orders, and supports microservices configured for monitoring and managing GPS-tracked spraying operations within GPS-specified neighborhoods. Through GPS-managed delivery of anti-fire chemical liquid spray on property surfaces before arrival of wild fire, fire ignition and flame spread are inhibited, and human and animal life and property are protected.

title_en: Device for vehicle-mounted wireless train dispatching emergency communication
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a device for vehicle-mounted wireless train dispatching emergency communication, which comprises a GSM-R voice module, a GSM-R data module, a satellite positioning module, a control module, a recording module, a display, an interface module, a 450MHz locomotive radio module, an LBJ module and an antenna; the control module is respectively and electrically connected with the GSM-R voice module, the GSM-R data module, the satellite positioning module, the recording module, the display and the interface module, the interface module is respectively and electrically connected with the 450MHz locomotive radio module and the LBJ module, and the antenna is respectively and electrically connected with the GSM-R voice module, the GSM-R data module, the 450MHz locomotive radio module and the LBJ module. The utility model has the characteristics of improve the reliability, reduced the fault rate.

title_en: Processing and displaying alarm system for high-speed rail disaster prevention information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing and displaying alarm system for high-speed rail disaster prevention information, which belongs to the technical field of rail disaster prevention safety monitoring. The system comprises a display interface module, a data input module, a data processing module, a database recording module and a data output module; the data input module inputs the disaster information collected by a data collecting system into the data processing module for processing; the data processing module outputs the well processed data to the display interface module, the data output module and the database recording module; the data output module outputs the data well processed by the data processing module to a CTC system and an operation dispatching system; the database recording module is connected with a disaster data storage tank and the data well processed by the data processing module is recorded into the disaster data storage tank. The processing and displaying alarm system for the high-speed rail disaster prevention information can be used for comprehensively monitoring various factors generating danger for the safe driving of a high-speed rail. Once a disaster occurs, the system automatically sends an alarm to limit or stop a train from running and ensures the running safety.

title_en: Power distribution network dispatching management statistical analysis system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power distribution network dispatching management statistical analysis system. The system includes a first second server, a second server and a switch, wherein the first server and the second server are respectively connected with the switch; the switch is connected with a business module which performs examination, approval and implementation of applications, work ticket, instruction ticket and fault processing, new equipment commissioning and operation, power supply guarantee, examination, approval and release of wiring diagram change, and mode change, and inquires, prompts and processes businesses required to be processed on duty, a recording module which enables an on-duty dispatching to record business processing records in the form of sequential events and performs power outage and electrification operation, fault processing, new equipment commissioning and operation, operation mode change, operation ticket and instruction ticket information. With the power distribution network dispatching management statistical analysis system of the invention adopted, informationized, automated and networked management and monitoring on the operation of power distribution network dispatching can be realized. The power distribution network dispatching management statistical analysis system can perform computerization management on data such as dispatching, automation, communication, operation and relay protection.
assignees: XINING POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA;STATE GRID QINGHAI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Comprehensive security inspection management system
abstract_en: The application provides a comprehensive security inspection management system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the inspection requirement acquisition subsystem is used for acquiring the inspection requirement input by the inspector into the comprehensive management platform; the checking key point list generating subsystem is used for generating a checking key point list according to checking requirements; the comprehensive safety inspection subsystem is used for dispatching inspection personnel to conduct comprehensive safety inspection on the target inspection enterprises according to the inspection gist list; the checking result generating subsystem is used for acquiring the editing record of the checking key point list by the checking personnel and generating a checking result according to the editing record; and the comprehensive management subsystem is used for carrying out comprehensive safety inspection management according to different inspection results. According to the comprehensive security inspection management system and method, the inspection key point list is generated according to the inspection requirements, the inspection results generated by editing records of the inspection key point list are comprehensively managed according to the inspection personnel, the generation of inspection contents is more flexible, and the management efficiency is further improved.
assignees: UNIV YANCHENG TEACHERS;QINGKONG JIANGSU SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Disaster emergency scheme recommendation method for underground coal mine trackless rubber-tyred vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster emergency scheme recommendation method for a coal mine underground trackless rubber-tyred vehicle, which is characterized in that a digital twin platform is used for acquiring data acquired by a data acquisition module to construct a virtual environment of an operation roadway of the coal mine underground trackless rubber-tyred vehicle, an expert recommendation module is used for manually processing an emergency scheme before the emergency is acquired by an information recording module, recommending the disaster emergency scheme after analysis, inputting the scheme into the digital twin platform for simulation verification, a voice recognition module is used for converting manual voice recognition into a control command which can be recognized by a dynamic command module, and the dynamic command module is used for dynamically controlling the trackless rubber-tyred vehicle according to the control command and the disaster emergency scheme. Through the mutual cooperation of the modules, the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle can be rapidly and effectively processed when an emergency occurs in the operation process of the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle, the operation safety of the trolley rubber-tyred vehicle is ensured, and the working efficiency of the underground trolley rubber-tyred vehicle of a coal mine is finally improved.
