title_en: Speakerphone and extension speakerphone for use in personal emergency response system
title_ko: 개인 비상 응답 시스템에서 사용하기 위한 스피커폰 및 확장 스피커폰
abstract_ko: 개인 비상 응답 시스템(PERS)은 베이스 유닛(16) 및 하나 이상의 확장 유닛들(20)을 포함한다. 베이스 유닛은 스피커(64), 마이크로폰(72), 전화 인터페이스 회로(40), 마이크로 제어기(46), 및 오디오다이얼러(48)를 포함한다. 각각의 확장 유닛은 스피커(164), 마이크로폰(172), 스피커, 전화 인터페이스 회로(140), 및 오디오 다이얼러가 없는 제어기(146)를 포함한다. 베이스 유닛 제어기(46) 및 확장 유닛 제어기(146)는 도움 모드에서 베이스 유닛 제어기 및 확장 유닛 제어기가 마스터/슬레이브 관계를 취하도록 프로그래밍된다.

title_en: Nonvolatile memory device capable of performing asynchronous operations, nonvolatile memory system including the same, and operation performing method of the same
title_ko: 비동기적 동작 수행이 가능한 비휘발성 메모리 장치와 이를 포함하는 메모리 시스템, 그리고 이의 동작 수행 방법
abstract_en: Provided is a nonvolatile memory device which includes a nonvolatile memory cell array, an input/output pad unit, and a peripheral circuit unit. The nonvolatile memory cell array stores data in a nonvolatile manner. The input/output pad unit receives commands and data related to operations requested by an external controller, and provides a path to output results of performing the requested operations to a controller. The peripheral circuit unit stores a plurality of commands provided by the controller, while temporarily storing program data provided by the controller and data read from the nonvolatile memory cell array, and performs operations by adjusting the order asynchronously with the controller.
abstract_ko: 비휘발성 메모리 장치는 비휘발성 메모리 셀 어레이, 입출력 패드부, 그리고 주변 회로부를 포함한다. 비휘발성 메모리 셀 어레이는 데이터를 비휘발적으로 저장한다. 입출력 패드부는 외부의 콘트롤러가 요청하는 동작들에 관련된 명령어들 및 데이터가 입력되고, 요청된 동작들의 수행 결과들을 콘트롤러로 출력하는 통로를 제공한다. 주변 회로부는 콘트롤러가 제공하는 복수 개의 명령어들을 적재해두고, 콘트롤러가 제공한 프로그램 데이터와 비휘발성 메모리 셀 어레이로부터 독출한 데이터를 임시로 저장하면서, 복수 개의 명령어들을 비휘발성 메모리 장치 내부의 동작 상태에 기초하여 상기 콘트롤러와 비동기적으로 순서를 조정하여 수행한다.

title_en: Recording Medium
title_ko: 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a recording medium and, more specifically, to a recording medium having recorded thereon an integrated residence management program using environmental information capable of preventing accidents based on collected environmental information. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the recording medium having recorded thereon the integrated residence management program using environmental information comprises: a smart plug; and an integrated home appliance and a user terminal capable of communicating with the smart plug.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 더욱 자세하게, 본 발명은 환경정보를 수집하고 이를 기반으로 재난에 대비하거나 사고를 방지할 수 있는 환경정보를 이용한 거주지 종합 관리 프로그램을 기록한 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 환경정보를 이용한 거주지 종합 관리 프로그램을 기록한 기록매체는, 스마트 플러그 및 상기 스마트 플러그와 통신이 가능한 종합 가전기기 및 사용자 단말기를 포함하되, 일산화탄소 센서, 이산화탄소 센서, 온도 센서, 습도 센서, 화재 센서, 인체감지 센서 및 미세먼지 센서를 포함하여 거주지의 환경정보를 측정하는 기능; 종합 가전기기 및 사용자 단말기와 인증을 수행하고, 인증된 가전기기 및 단말기만의 접속을 허용하는 기능; 스마트 플러그 및 사용자 단말기 간의 데이터 송수신을 매개하는 기능; 종합 가전기기의 전원을 제어하여 종합 가전기기의 전원을 공급 및 차단하는 기능; 거주지 내의 환경정보와 재난상황 정보 및 가전상태 정보를 사용자에게 전송하는 기능; 거주지 내에 설치된 설정등, 스피커, 가전기기의 동작을 제어하는 기능을 포함하되, 상기 거주지 내에 설치된 설정등, 스피커, 가전기기의 동작을 제어하는 기능은, 거주지 내에 설치된 전등과 연동되어 전송된 제어값에 따라 전등의 ON/OFF를 제어하는 기능; 재난상황을 알릴 수 있는 사이렌 소리, 음성 소리를 출력하는 기능; 스마트 플러그로부터 전송된 제어값에 따라 가전의 동작 상태가 제어되는 기능을 포함하는 환경정보를 이용한 거주지 종합 관리를 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 판독 가능한 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: Flight scheduling, dispatch and check-in
abstract_en: Systems and methods are described for scheduling, dispatching and checking-in a flight event. A method may include receiving a request from a user to schedule a block of time for a first flight event, whereupon the block of time and an associated flight resource can be reserved for the block of time. The first flight event can be dispatched and a master flight record can be created for the first flight event. When the first flight event is checked-in, the master flight record can be updated with check-in data for the first flight event. When checking-in a first flight event, a second flight event can be checked-in and a master flight record can be created for the second flight event. Check-in data can be received for the second flight event and the master flight record associated with the second flight event can be updated with the check-in data.

title_en: Earthquake data acquisition platform used for geophysical exploration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake data acquisition platform for geophysical prospecting, which transmits earthquake data to a data recording system under the action of a record control system. The platform comprises a power supply, a command synchronization module, a power supply and a synchronization control module, a cable interface module, an auxiliary channel module and a CPU system module, wherein the command synchronization module generates a synchronous instruction; the power supply and the synchronization control module read information of towing hawser power supply state; the cable interface module analyzes towing hawser state data and earthquake data in submarine towing hawser data, and transmits the towing hawser data to the record control system; the auxiliary channel module receives auxiliary channel data; and the CPU system module transmits the earthquake data and the auxiliary channel data to the data record system after the earthquake data and the auxiliary channel data are collected. The earthquake data acquisition platform for geophysical prospecting solves the bottleneck of data interchange, improves capability of transmission and processing, can meet the requirement on data acquisition of a high-density long cable, and has excellent stability and reliability.
assignees: CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP;CHINA OILFIELD SERVICES LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle image fast matching method combining SIFT and ORB
abstract_en: According to the unmanned aerial vehicle image fast matching method combining SIFT and ORB, the timeliness and reliability of unmanned aerial vehicle image fast matching are comprehensively considered, a two-layer pyramid matching strategy is adopted, SIFT matching is carried out on pyramid images, the result of pyramid matching is used for constraining original images to carry out ORB matching, the unmanned aerial vehicle image matching speed is greatly accelerated, the matching efficiency is greatly improved, and unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing is better applied to the fields of disaster emergency response and the like. A full-automatic flight band arrangement method based on sequence images is disclosed, which greatly reduces the matching time and improves the accuracy of flight band arrangement. The original unmanned aerial vehicle images are preprocessed after the automatic flight band arrangement is completed, so that the precision of relative orientation and adjustment of an area network is improved, and the problems of cracks and distortion at the image splicing position are solved. The condition of inconsistent colors is effectively improved, the processing efficiency is high, and the efficiency and the accuracy of automatic area measurement recovery are improved.

title_en: PLC safety monitoring and dynamic measuring method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a PLC safety real-time monitoring and measuring method and system. The technical scheme of the invention records and codes various input and output values and the state values of various soft elements in the PLC to form a code table under various running conditions of the normal running state of the PLC and at the running key point; and in the operation stage, collecting and coding each input and output and each soft element state value in the PLC at each operation key point to obtain a corresponding state code word, then quickly searching the state code word in a code table, and starting a PLC emergency response mechanism if the state code word cannot be found, so that the safety of the PLC application system is protected. The technical scheme of the invention can continuously and rapidly measure the safety of the PLC application system when the PLC runs, and timely find out the abnormal execution code and the abnormal input and output of the PLC.

title_en: CARE : Computerized Technical Advisory System for a Radiological Emergency
title_ko: 방사능방재대책 기술지원 전산 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방사성 물질의 사고 시에 실시간으로 상황판단을 위한 원전안전정보망(SIDS), 방재대응기상정보망(REMDAS), 환경방사선감시망(IERNet)을 설치하여 운영하고 있으며, 이의 정보를 자동으로 해석하고 판단하여 이상 시에 자동정보인지시스템(AINS)이 가동되며, 사고를 범위 및 방사성물질의 외부 방출량을 평가하는 방사선원항평가시스템(STES), 방사성물질 이동경로 및 피해영역과 피해정도를 계산하는 방사선영향평가시스템(FADAS)등의 주요모듈로 구성되어 있다. 
     이렇게 평가된 결과물을 전자지도 및 방재속성정보 데이터베이스, 즉 지리정보시스템(GIS)에 연결하여 방사성물질의 피해지역과 주민보호조치 대책 등을 시각적 표현으로 결과를 도출하도록 구성되어 있다. 
     또한 중앙정부 및 지방자치단체, 그리고 모든 방재대응 유관기관에 처리된 정보를 제공하고 상호 비상대응 활동 등을 교환하는 비상대응정보교환시스템(ERIX)이용하여 범국가적인 차원에서의 대응·대책을 수립하는 방사능방재대책 기술지원 전산 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
       
     방사능방재대책, 방사선원항평가시스템(STES), 방사선영향평가시스템(FADAS), 지리정보시스템(GIS), 자동정보인지시스템(AINS), 원전안전정보망(SIDS), 방재대응기상정보망(REMDAS), 환경방사선감시망(IERNet), 비상대응정보교환시스템(ERIX)

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting abnormal respiration
title_ko: 이상호흡 감지 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 사용자 신체로부터 반사되어 수신되는 광신호로부터 광용적맥파를 센싱하는 센서, 상기 센서로부터 수신된 광용적맥파로부터 필요 대역의 신호를 추출하는 대역통과 필터, 상기 필터링된 신호에 대해 디지털 변환을 수행하는 아날로그-디지털 변환기, 및 디지털 변환된 광용적맥파 신호로부터 호흡률 신호를 추출하고, 추출된 호흡률 신호에 대해 시간 축 분석을 통해 복수의 호흡률 특징 값을 도출하고, 도출된 복수의 호흡률 특징 값을 이용해 이상 호흡을 감지하는 이상호흡 인지부를 포함하는 이상호흡 감지 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 이상호흡 감지 장치는 독거노인 및 군사 작전시 고립된 병사들, 재난/사고 현장에 고립된 사람들의 생존 여부 모니터링, 수면 질 진단 및 모니터링 등에 활용될 수 있다.

title_en: System for health and safety and management of worker in construction site
title_ko: 건설현장 근로자의 보건 안전 및 관리 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건설현장 근로자의 보건 안전 및 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 건설현장 근로자의 보건 안전 및 관리 시스템은, 다양하고 확장된 무선 측위와 스캐너를 기반으로 근로자와 사물의 위치를 추적하고, 출입을 감지하는 전자장비가 구비된 게이트웨이 기반으로 근로자의 출입을 관리하는 근로자 위치 파악 및 출입 관리부와; 환경센서를 이용한 작업환경을 모니터링하고, 근로자 피로도 관리 및 치유 솔루션에 기반하여 근로자의 신체적, 정신적 건강 상태를 체크하며, 중장비의 근로자에의 접근 상황을 알리는 안전 사고 예방부와; 와이파이(WiFi) 인터넷을 기반으로 시스템의 구성요소간 및 현장과 외부 시스템 간의 통신을 가능하게 하는 웹/앱 모니터링부와; CCTV 영상 모니터링 시스템을 기반으로 하여 작업 현장에서의 근로자의 안전모 미착용 여부와, 화재 발생 여부를 분석하는 인공지능 기반 지능형 안전모 미착용/화재감지 분석부; 및 상기 웹/앱 모니터링부와 연동하며, 클라우드 서버를 기반으로 작업 현장에서 기록 및 관리하는 각종 정보와 데이터를 공유하도록 하는 데이터 연동부를 포함한다.

title_en: Device and method for cracking down on crosswalk violations
title_ko: 횡단보도 통행 위반 단속 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 횡단보도 통행 위반 단속 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로,  횡단보도 통행 위반 단속 장치는 크게, 횡단보도와 우회전으로 해당 횡단보도로 진입하는 차량을 촬영하도록 적어도 하나 이상 구비된 카메라모듈; 상기 카메라모듈에서 측정된 신호를 분석하여 불법 우회전여부 및 차량 번호를 인식하는 영상분석모듈; 상기영상분석모듈에 의한 불법 우회전 발생 검출시 해당 차량의 차주에게 불법을 통지하고 해당 데이터를 기록 및 관리하는 관제센터모듈;을 포함하여 구성되어, 보행자의 안전을 확보하고 우회전 차량의 통행 위반을 효과적으로 단속할 수 있도록 하여, 교통사고를 예방하는 횡단보도 통행 위반 단속 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Automatic forest fire identification and alarm system
abstract_en: An automatic forest fire identification and alarm system belongs to the technical field of fire protection inspection. The system comprises a plurality of monitoring base stations and a command and control center, and the monitoring base stations are arranged on monitoring towers in key fire hazard areas, and are connected with the command and control center through a wireless communication network. The forest fire detection work of the system is sequentially carried out according to five steps, i.e. on-site data acquisition, data processing, fire identification, identification result transmission and automotive fire alarm. The system is integrated with the video compression and decompression technology, the thermal infrared image identification and analysis technology, the visible light image identification and analysis technology and the embedded technology, and can automatically identify forest fires and give the alarm. The system is characterized by high forest fire identification accuracy, low false alarm rate, high timeliness, high reliability, advanced technical means, broad market prospect and the like.

title_en: A kind of novel emergency command car
abstract_en: This utility model provides a kind of novel emergency command car, including car body, include driver's compartment and compartment area in the car body, the compartment area is divided into front portion, 3rd area of middle part and rear portion again, described anterior for operating space, middle part is rest area, and rear portion is generating cabin, is provided with partition wall between the middle part and rear portion；The roof front portion of the car body is provided with video camera A and lifting illumination system, the video camera A is arranged on lifting illumination system head, the roof rear portion is provided with vehicle roof platform, the vehicle roof platform is connected with the cat ladder in tailstock portion, air-conditioning and video camera B is provided with the vehicle roof platform, in vehicle body, the video camera A and video camera B are connected the air outlet of the air-conditioning with server.The beneficial effects of the utility model are：This Emergency Command Vehicle achieves the several functions such as incident scene information collection, emergency vehicles real-time positioning, daily tour record, emergency communication, emergency event floor manager.

title_en: Earthquake disaster affected people detecting devices based on STM32 microprocessors
abstract_en: A kind of earthquake disaster affected people detecting devices based on STM32 microprocessors, including quadrotor body, portable equipment and being used on quadrotor body handle and analyzed sensing data and the STM32 microprocessor modules of control command, Audio Input Modules for collecting voice messaging, the four road avoiding obstacles by supersonic wave modules for recognizing and avoiding four direction barrier, for the wireless communication module with portable equipment radio communication, the data memory module of disaster affected people geographical location information is collected into for storing, the six road PWM output modules for providing control signal for quadrotor body, Big Dipper locating module for providing positional information, OLED display module, for recognizing disaster affected people voice messaging and synthesizing speech recognition and synthesis module and the power supply module of prompt message.The utility model provides a kind of disaster affected people and detects automatically and record the earthquake disaster affected people detecting devices based on STM32 microprocessors of its geographical location information.

title_en: 3 85 LPG LNG CO LPG LNG CO Gas alarm detector of sound-pressur level of at least 85 decibels at 10 feet3.0M and set which uses the Semi-condector sensor
title_ko: 3메터 이상의 거리에서 최소한의 85데시벨 이상의 사운드 압력 경보와 반도체식 가스센서를 이용한 lpg, lng, co 가스경보기
abstract_ko:
본 경보기는 반도체식 가스센서를 사용하여 가스 누출 사고 시, 가스농도를 감지하고, 칼리브레이션을 통하여 입력된 적정 가스 농도의 기준 값과 비교하여, 마이콤 내부에서 프로그램으로 연산 처리된 이상상태에 해당하는 경보 신호를 발생시킨다. 발생된 경보 신호는 부저를 구동하여 85데시벨 이상의 경보 소리를 발생시키며 경보 적색 신호를 나타낸다. 
     이로써 가스누출사고 시에 최저폭발한계점 값 범위 내에서 가스농도를 감지하며, 경보를 울려서 인명피해와 재난으로부터 보호(예방)기능을 수행하는 장치이다. 
     국내에 사용하고 있는 전기화학식 가스센서는 가스 농도에 비례하여 출력전압이 직선적으로 증가하여 불연성가스인 잡가스에 영향을 받지 않는 잇점이 있지만 습도의 영향을 받고 또 너무 고농도인 가스는 검출이 어렵다. 그리고 유해가스가 센서의 촉매를 열화시키기 때문에 감도가 둔해져 점차적으로 기능을 발휘하지 못함으로 수명이 짧은 단점을 가지고 있으며, 즉시경보 방식으로 가스렌지의 점화미스 일때 불필요한 경보음을 발산한다. 
     이에 미국 UL(Underwriters Laboratories) 규정에 따른 방식을 통한 시험 테스트를 진행함으로서 안전성과 견고성 그리고 사용에 있어 긴 수명과 안정성을 유지한다. 
     
     반도체식 가스센서, 전기화학식 가스센서, 데시벨, 최저폭발한계점, UL

title_en: A kind of Utilities Electric Co.'s emergency command and on-site examination system and checking method
abstract_en: A kind of Utilities Electric Co.'s emergency command and on-site examination system and checking method, described system mainly includes the wisdom helmet worn by electric field construction, the workman that speedily carries out rescue work, the mobile terminal that at least one hand-held mobile phone or panel computer are constituted, one is provided with and mobile terminal wireless connections proceed to electric power wireless private network TD LTE230d communicating terminal；It is provided with Centimeter Level high accuracy Big Dipper positioner and audio, video data collection and voice call device on the described wisdom helmet and carries out power construction, the location at the scene of speedily carrying out rescue work and audio frequency and video field data with this and collect and record, the information data collected and recorded is by the APP intelligent mobile terminal installed promising Utilities Electric Co. data acquisition and O&M, implement customized development, and the WIFI installed through site operation vehicle turns the communicating terminal of LTE230 electric power wireless private network and is sent to be deployed in cloud service center and the electric power command centre of electric power Intranet.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;JIAXING POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG HAIYAN POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Supervision emergency management system based on mobile internet technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computer application, and discloses a supervision emergency management system based on a mobile internet technology; the system comprises an emergency response issuing module, an emergency sign-in module, a task delegation module and an emergency information reporting module; the emergency response issuing module is used for filling and sending an emergency response sheet; the emergency sign-in module is used for logging in on-site hidden danger investigation information while signing in on site, generating an emergency sign-in record and a hidden danger investigation order, and sending the emergency sign-in record and the hidden danger investigation order to corresponding departments or personnel; and the task delegation module is used for performing task delegation according to the received emergency sign-in record and the hidden danger investigation order and generating a corresponding task delegation order. The invention realizes the reduction of the time of emergency response and improves the working efficiency of emergency management.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER ENG SUPERVISION CO LTD

title_en: Emergency event plan recommendation method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an emergency incident plan recommendation method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. The emergency incident plan recommendation method comprises the steps of obtaining emergency incident information; inputting the emergency event information into a preset plan library for matching to obtain a plan to be recommended, which is similar to the emergency event information; performing task configuration on the to-be-recommended plan based on a preset condition, and generating a disposal scheme corresponding to the to-be-recommended plan; pre-operating the disposal scheme to obtain pre-operating data of the scheme; and grading the plan operation data, and determining whether to recommend the treatment plan as a final plan according to a grading result. According to the scheme, the emergency plan can be automatically generated according to the event information, and the timeliness of processing the emergency event is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN BIOCOME SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Legion fusion degree measurement and evaluation method based on Feder-ram model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for measuring and evaluating the fusion degree of army and civilian based on a Feder-ram model, which is characterized by comprising the following units of a data center, a national defense department, a non-national defense department, a database, a command system and a regulation quantity statistics, wherein the data center is used for receiving and processing a data model and other data, and coupling each group of data with the model to obtain the fusion data of the army and civilian. Through the setting of command system and regulation quantity statistics, when a manager observes the process of the military and civil fusion, the manager can judge the speed of the military and civil fusion to be increased or decreased according to the flow direction of people and the conditions of personnel record, regulation and the like in the same year, so that the evaluation is better, and through two major blocks of national defense departments and non-national defense departments, the Feder-ram model can perform different data models through two major types when model data are established, so that the data comparison peer-to-peer work is better performed.

title_en: Relay protection method and system for transformer substation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of relay protection, in particular to a relay protection method and a relay protection system for a transformer substation, comprising the following steps: and collecting electromagnetic field data of the substation relay, and drawing an electromagnetic field distribution diagram by integrating node connection data of a substation power grid to generate an electromagnetic field data matrix. According to the invention, through numerical solution of an electromagnetic field data matrix and accurate spatial positioning of nodes, an electromagnetic field distribution diagram can be drawn in detail, an in-depth view of interaction between power grid nodes is provided, not only is the accuracy of fault positioning improved, but also the accuracy of fault analysis and simulation is improved through accurate correction of the node positions, the continuity and safety of transformer substation operation are ensured, timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response are further enhanced through on-site testing and sending of early warning signals, a stronger guarantee is provided for preventing large-scale power interruption and equipment damage, and potential service interruption is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent endowment management system based on AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of customer personalized service, in particular to an AI-based intelligent endowment management system, which comprises an AI customer service acquisition module, a customer service management module and a customer service management module, wherein customer information is acquired through guiding voice interaction, customer basic information is recorded and stored, a home environment image is acquired, customer portrait is drawn after analysis, customer portrait data is generated, and different labels are marked according to the customer portrait data to generate customer behavior labels. According to the invention, physiological data of the old is collected and monitored, a long-period memory network is adopted to conduct time sequence analysis, the trend of the physiological data is accurately predicted, accurate health condition prediction is provided, a support vector machine is adopted to detect abnormal physiological data, health risks can be rapidly identified and automatically alarmed through learning of the normal mode of the physiological data, and when abnormal conditions are detected, alarm notification can be immediately sent out and the medical institution and family members are contacted, so that health advice and emergency response are timely provided.

title_en: Method and device for scheduling buses based on battery health status
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for dispatching buses based on battery health states, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring battery health state parameters, battery residual capacity, real-time position information and line information of each bus in real time, evaluating loss coefficients of each bus line based on the line information, matching the evaluated loss coefficients with the battery health state parameters of each bus to determine a plurality of dispatchable vehicles on each bus line, classifying the plurality of dispatchable vehicles according to the battery residual capacity of each dispatchable vehicle, the battery health state parameters and the line information of the corresponding bus line, determining operation vehicles and alternative vehicles on each bus line, and dispatching the alternative vehicles based on the real-time position information of the operation vehicles under the condition that the battery residual capacity of the operation vehicles is smaller than a preset electric quantity threshold value. The matching precision of each bus line and the schedulable vehicles is improved, and the rationality and timeliness of vehicle scheduling are fully ensured.
assignees: GUANGZHOU TONGDA AUTO ELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Power breaking apparatus and method with fire protection
title_ko: 화재예방기능을 가지는 전원차단기 및 전원차단방법
abstract_en: An apparatus and a method for breaking the power are provided to break a load power or give an alarm by predicting fire possibility when the contact of an electric wire or outlet is trouble. A switch(20) is installed in a power circuit breaker(10) to switch the load power supply. A detection circuit(C1) detects and amplifies a spark waveform and a leakage waveform. A converting circuit(C2) converts the signal received from the detection circuit into a digital signal. A central processing unit(C3) outputs the signal from the converting circuit to a determining circuit. A comparator(C4) compares the signal inputted to the central processing unit with the prediction program. The determining circuit(C5) generates the alarm according to the comparison result of the comparator. An alarm circuit(C6) generates the alarm through a speaker and turns on an LED(Light Emitting Diode) lamp. A circuit breaker(C7) cuts off the load power according to a risk signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 입력전원으로부터 필요전원을 공급받고 부하전원 라인으로부터 스파크파형 및 누전파형을 검출하고, 이를 이용하여 초기에 누전 또는 전기스파크를 감지 분석하여 전기스파크로 인한 발화 또는 위험이 극도에 달하기 전에 경고 또는 전원을 완전히 차단함으로써, 화재 및 감전사고로부터 재산과 인명피해를 줄일 수 있도록 한 화재예방기능을 가지는 전원차단기 및 전원차단방법으로, 전원차단기 본체(10)에 설치되어 부하전원공급을 개폐하는 스위치(20); 및 상기 입력전원(도시하지 않음)으로부터 전원을 공급받아 스파크파형과 누전파형을 검출하고, 이 검출된 파형을 증폭 출력하는  검출회로(C1)와, 상기 검출회로 로부터 입력된 신호를 변별하여 안정된 디지털신호로 변환하여 출력하기 위한 변환회로(C2)와, 상기 변환회로에 입력된 신호를 선별하여 판별회로(C5)로 출력 및 모니터링 할 수 있는 마이콤(MC)을 구성한 중앙처리부(C3)와, 상기 중앙처리부에 입력된 신호를 사전에 입력된 예측프로그램과 비교 분석하는 비교회로(C4)와, 그 결과에 따라 단계별 경보발생 및 해제할 수 있으며 각각의 경보원인제거 시 초기화기능을 할 수 있도록 한 판별회로(C5)와, 상기 판별회로에서 경보원인 미제거시 스피커(11)를 통해 경고음 발생하고, 동시에 LED램프(12)를 점멸하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Safety management device with NFC module
title_ko: Nfc를 활용한 안전관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety management means linked to a smartphone mobile phone terminal and a method thereof and, more specifically, to a safety management means in which an nfc module unit is embedded. More specifically, the present invention relates to a safety management system, which is a device provided in a smartphone system, an accessory thereof, and the like, and allows a user to interwork with an nfc module unit and a terminal embedded with a simple operation in an emergency situation, thereby transmitting an emergency situation and location information and performing functions such as recording and recording of a site at the time of an accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트폰 휴대폰 단말기에 연동되는 안전관리 수단 및 방법과 관련되며 특히 NFC모듈부가 내장된 것이다. 더욱 상세히는, 스마트폰 시스템, 그 액세서리 등에 구비되는 장치로서, 비상상황 시에 사용자가 간단한 동작으로 내장된 NFC모듈부와 단말기가 연동되도록 하여, 비상상황 및 위치정보를 전송하고 사고 당시 현장의 녹음, 녹화 등의 기능을 수행하는 안전관리시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Learning toy, and learning toy mobile body and learning toy panel used in learning toy
abstract_en: [Problem] To provide a learning toy with which it is possible to learn high-level programming in stages, so as to be suitable not only for young children but also children in higher age groups. [Solution] A plurality of command panels 121 are disposed in which is recorded command information that is readable by an optical reading module 240, whereby a movement path 120 is constituted. A mobile robot 110 sequentially reads the command information included in the command panels 121 passed while moving along the movement path 120, and a plurality of command information items are stored in a command information memory 508. The mobile robot 110 takes out the plurality of command information items from arbitrary positions of the command information memory 508 and executes operations. If the plurality of command information items required for operation of the mobile robot 110 is stored in the command information memory 508, a control unit 501 of the mobile robot 110 automatically extracts and takes out the command information and operates the mobile robot 110.

title_en: Ocean monitoring drone
title_ko: 해양 모니터링용 드론
abstract_en: The present invention provides an ocean monitoring drone. The ocean monitoring drone according to the present invention can monitor the occurrence of various kinds of coastal accidents/disasters such as oil-spills/appearance of red tides/appearance of cold pools/appearance of low sodium/ship accidents and conveniently and smoothly diagnose defects of ships/sea structures even by an unmanned aerial small drone, and to this end, provides a motor tilting-based horizontal thrust generation structure so as to extend an activity region for checking various kinds of sea environments and promote the improvement of sea environment flight adaptability since horizontal movement at sea level after landing on the sea is possible, and presents actuator forms of various structures for vertical movement control of a water sampler and a CTD recorder so as to enable seawater collection/seawater state information measurement to be smoothly and easily performed while stably maintaining the flight operation (flight, take-off/landing, posture control) of the drone. The ocean monitoring drone according to the present invention comprises: a body frame (10) for performing unmanned aerial flight over the sea, take-off/landing, and horizontal movement after landing on the sea; a plurality of driving motors (20), which are arranged to be spaced apart from each other at set intervals along the circumferential part of an edge of the body frame (10) and perform tilting operations within a set angle range; a plurality of rotors (30) connected to the respective driving motors (20) and rotating; a battery (40), which is fixed to the body frame (10) so as to be connected to the plurality of driving motors (20), and supplies power to each driving motor (20); a floating body (50) provided on a lower side of the body frame (10) such that the body frame (10) is positioned on the water without sinking into the water; a sea environment detection module (60) provided to the body frame (10) so as to detect sea environment state information; and a controller (70) for controlling aerial flight, take-off/landing, and horizontal movement of the body frame (10) after landing on the sea through rotational operation control and tilting operation control of the driving motors (20).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 해양 모니터링용 드론을 제공한다. 이와 같은 본 발명에 따른 해 양 모니터링용 드론은 기름 유출/적조 출현/냉수대 출현/저염분 출현/선박 사고 등의 각종 해상 사고/재난 발생에 대한 모니터링과 선박/해상 구조물의 결함 진단이 무인비행하는 소형 드론을 통해서도 간편하고 원활하게 수행될 수 있도록 하고, 이를 위하여 모터 틸팅 기반의 수평추력 발생구조를 제공함 으로써 해상 착륙 후 해수면에서의 수평이동이 가능해져 각종 해상환경 점검 을 위한 활동영역의 확장과 해상환경 운항적응력 향상이 도모되도록 하며, 채수기와 CTD 측정기의 상하이동 제어를 위한 다양한 구조의 액추에이터 구 성을 제안함으로써 드론의 운항(비행, 이착륙, 자세제어)이 안정적으로 유지 되면서도 해수 채취/해수 상태정보 측정이 원활하고 용이하게 수행될 수 있 도록 한다. 본 발명에 따른 해양 모니터링용 드론은 해상에서의 무인 공중비행과 이착륙 이나 해상 착륙 후의 수평이동을 수행하게 되는 몸체프레임(10)과; 몸체프레 임(10) 가장자리 둘레 부위를 따라 설정간격으로 이격 배치되고, 설정각도 범위에서 틸팅 동작하게 되는 복수의 구동모터(20)와; 각 구동모터(20)에 연결되어 회 전하게 되는 복수의 로터 회전체(30)와; 몸체프레임(10)에 고정되어 복수의 구동모터(20)와 연결되고, 각 구동모터(20)로 전원을 공급하게 되는 배터리(40)와; 몸체프레임(10) 하측에 설치되어 몸체프레임(10)이 수중으로 잠기지 않고 수면 상에 위치되 도록 하는 부유체(50)와; 몸체프레임(10)에 설치되어 해상환경 상태정보를 검출하게 되는 해상환경 검출모듈(60) 및; 구동모터(20)의 회전동작 제어 및 틸팅동작 제어를 통해 몸체프레임(10)의 공중비행과 이착륙이나 해상 착륙 후의 수평이동을 제어하게 되는 컨트롤러(70)를 포함하는 구성으로 이루어진 다.

title_en: Integrating data from multiple devices
abstract_en: A recording system for an emergency response unit includes a first data collection device configured to record a first video, audio or data segment with an incident identifier and transmit a message including the incident identifier. A second data collection device may receive the message and, as appropriate, record at least a second video, audio or data segment with the incident identifier, allowing the first segment and the second segment to be associated using the incident identifier. In other embodiments, a first recording device may begin recording video, audio or legal evidence data with an incident identifier, and a control system may receive a message including the incident identifier from the first recording device, identify one or more additional recording devices located within a certain distance of the first recording device, and obtain recordings from the one or more additional recording devices.

title_en: Systems and methods for assignment of equipment to an officer
abstract_en: A system for tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment to security agency personnel (e.g., officers, administration, command, armorer). An armorer is assigned the task of tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment. Equipment may be assigned to a particular individual officer. The equipment provided to and used by officers may capture (e.g. gather, produce) information (e.g. audiovisual information, data logs, recordings). Equipment may provide information to the armorer via near field communication (NFC) circuits. The information captured may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system. The information captured by equipment assigned to a particular individual may be associated with that individual. An armorer may use information supplied by equipment, evidence management system, officers, or other sources to assist in the assignment process.

title_en: Systems and methods for generating graphical user interfaces relating to determined parametric events
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing a graphic user interface. The systems and methods may (1) receive an indication of a parametric event involving a vehicle; (2) provide a series of component graphic user interfaces, wherein the component graphic user interfaces may be configured to (i) initiate a claim filing, (ii) communicate with an insurer entity, (iii) communicate with an emergency response entity, (iv) communicate with a towing service entity, (v) communicate with a taxi or ride-share service entity, (vi) communicating with a vehicle repair service entity, (vii) communicating with a vehicle salvage entity, and/or (viii) communicating with a vehicle rental service entity; (3) detect one or more user interactions that may include one or more selections of the one or more actions; (4) perform the one or more actions; and/or (5) record a transaction indicating that the one or more actions has been performed to the blockchain.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Construction system of power failure pool
abstract_en: The present application illustrates a blackout pool construction system, the system comprising: the intelligent analysis platform firstly acquires upstream and downstream equipment information through the corresponding relation between the fault information after record processing and the equipment set, secondly records the corresponding relation between the equipment information and the user set, selects the summoning user in the user set, traverses an automatic metering database, calls the fault user and the meter data of the summoning user, substitutes the fault user and the meter data of the summoning user into a fault type, judges whether the fault exists or not, and stores power failure information into a shutdown battery if the fault exists. Through the construction of stopping the battery, the problems that a large number of manual communication links exist in the process of emergency repair and dispatching of the power failure, so that the failure information cannot be judged quickly and accurately and the dispatching cannot be carried out reasonably are solved.

title_en: Railway emergency communication method and system based on communication conference
abstract_en: The invention relates to a railway emergency communication method and a system based on a communication conference, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, a user initiates help seeking through terminal equipment in a railway system, and the terminal equipment collects user audio and video information in real time and broadcasts the information through a signaling server; s2, the response center receives the help-seeking information, pushes the help-seeking information in a page help-seeking queue, a worker selects to put through the help-seeking conversation and then sends put-through information to the signaling server, and the double terminals establish P2P point-to-point connection through respective networks; s3, the response center can record the content information of the help after answering or completing answering, select a plan and directionally dispatch information to workers; and S4, when the staff of the response center finishes the task dispatching, the emergency help seeking is defined as ending. The invention has high safety and good usability, and can be widely applied to railway systems.

title_en: Time synchronization method for minimizing power consumption of hetero-species sensor nodes and network adopting same
title_ko: 이기종 센서노드의 전력소모 최소화를 위한 시간동기화방법 및 이를 적용한 네트워크
abstract_en: A time synchronization method for minimizing power consumption in heterogeneous sensor nodes and a network applied with the method are provided to minimize power consumption of the sensor nodes by easily performing time synchronization of an overall sensor network, and to operate all sensor nodes with a battery except a sink node, thus efficient resource management is available. Homogeneous sensor nodes connected below a sink node(50) are set to masters(60), and plural heterogeneous sensor nodes connected below the masters are set to time synchronization slaves(70). Time synchronization is conducted by using time synchronization algorithm among the time synchronization masters. The time synchronization slaves receive time synchronization commands by the masters, and power on/off by receiving active time and slave time control included in the time synchronization commands.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 싱크노드 아래에 이기종 센서노드들이 혼재해 있는 센서네트워크에 있어서, 싱크노드 아래에 연결되어 있는 동종 센서노드를 시간동기 마스터로 설정하며, 마스터 아래에 연결되어 있는 다수의 이기종 센서노드를 시간동기 슬레이브로 설정하는 단계를 포함하는, 센서네트워크에서의 센서노드의 시간동기화 방법 및 이를 적용한 네트워크에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면 향후에 전개될 이기종 센서노드 기반의 센서네트워크 시스템에서도 전체 센서네트워크의 시간동기화를 용이하게 수행하여 센서노드의 전력소모를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Health and usage monitoring system for wind turbine
title_ko: 풍력발전설비 상태감시시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A wind-driven electric plant state monitoring system is provided to manage data in a remote monitoring station by executing a data collection process and analyzing process in a remote place. CONSTITUTION: A wind-driven electric plant state monitoring system all kinds of sensors, a data analyzing and processing unit(100), and an analyzer device(200). All kinds of the sensors are installed in the main part of the wind-driven electric plant. The data analyzing and processing unit process analyzes and processes data transmitted from the sensor. Data received from the data analyzing and processing unit is constructed to a database in the remote monitoring station. The data analyzing and processing unit comprise an analog processing unit(103), a vibration acquisition unit(104), and a digital processing uint(102). The ground analytical device includes a communications module(201), a database(203), a fault diagnosing and predicting program(204), and a monitor(202).

title_en: Automated digital forensic system to identify the command history of the file
title_ko: 파일의 명령이력을 판별하는 자동화된 디지털 포렌식 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a digital forensic system that determines a command history by utilizing a log file recorded according to a file command in a Windows file system, and includes a collection module that extracts a timestamp before performance of a file command and information of the timestamp after the performance of the file command by loading a log file; a conversion module that compares the extracted timestamp information, calculates the change history into a timestamp change pattern, and outputs a binary code; and a forensic determination module that calculates the binary code to convert the binary code to a decimal code and decodes the decimal code into an allocated letter code. Accordingly, the present invention may reduce an analysis time of a target file in an automated manner without depending on manual work by an experience and an intuition of an analyst.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 윈도우즈 파일시스템에서 파일명령에 따라 기록되는 로그파일을 활용하여 명령이력을 판별하는 디지털 포렌식 시스템에 관한 것으로 그 구성의 특징으로서, 상기 로그파일을 로딩 하여 파일명령수행 이전의 타임스탬프와, 파일명령수행 이후의 타임스탬프의 정보를 각각 추출하는 수집모듈; 상기 추출된 타임스탬프의 정보를 서로 비교하여 변경내역을 타임스탬프 변화패턴으로 연산하여 이진코드를 출력하는 변환모듈; 및 상기 이진코드를 연산하여 십진코드로 변환하고, 상기 십진코드를 할당된 문자코드로 디코딩하는 포렌식 판별모듈;을 포함하여 이루어지진다. 이에 따라 본 발명은, 분석가의 경험과 직관에 의한 수작업에 의존하지 않고, 자동화된 방식으로 대상파일의 분석시간을 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOP FOUND OF DONGYANG UNIV

title_en: Vehicle operation record analysis system and method connected to server of insurance company by using the OBD and smart phone
title_ko: Ｏｂｄ와 스마트폰을 사용한 보험사 서버와 연동된 자동차 운행기록 분석 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention comprises: a vehicle onboard diagnostics (OBD) apparatus providing OBD data comprising driving and state information of a vehicle; a smart device having a GPS receiver with an OBD data application installed thereon which receives the OBD data from the apparatus and transmits emergency information in real-time to the vehicle driving operation record server and the insurance company server in the case of that abnormal driving and accident information is detected and normally transmits GPS location information and the OBD data to a vehicle driving record server in real-time; and the vehicle driving record server collecting GPS location information and the OBD data of the vehicle in real-time from the smart device, analyzing the collected information and data to identify a traveling route of the vehicle, using information of the vehicle extracted from the OBD data to inspect operation of vehicle components, record a driving record and a driving pattern, and diagnose breakdown of the vehicle, and transmitting analysis results of the vehicle driving record generated during an abnormal driving and a car accident to the insurance company server. The purpose of the present invention is to provide a system and a method for analyzing a vehicle driving record linked with an insurance company server using OBD and a smartphone which provide a vehicle wireless internet service of a novel concept of telecommunication added with informatics in which the vehicle linked with the server is combined with the wireless communication.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 OBD와 스마트폰을 사용한 보험사 서버와 연동된 자동차 운행기록 분석 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 자동차의 운행기록 자기진단장치(OBD, On-Board Diagnostics)와 근거리 통신(Wi-Fi 또는 블루투스)을 통해 스마트폰(OBD 데이터 App)으로 OBD 데이터를 전송하고, 스마트폰으로부터 시시각각 자동차의 실시간 GPS 위치정보와 OBD 데이터를 SaaS 클라우드 서비스를 제공하는 자동차 운행기록 서버가 차량 상태와 운전 행태의 텔레매틱스 정보가 포함된 OBD 데이터를 수집하며 빅 데이터를 분석하여 고장/이상 운행/사고시에 그 자동차 운행기록 분석 결과를 보험사 서버로 전송하며, 자동차 운행기록 서버로부터 개인화 서비스로 상기 스마트 기기의 OBD데이터 앱(app)으로 자동차 운행기록 분석 결과를 전송하여 표시되도록 하며 사고 예방과 정비 이력을 관리하고, 자동차의 운행 정보, 이상 운행 정보(급발진/급회전), 고장 정보 및 사고 정보 기반 자동차 보험 처리를 제공하는 보험사 서버와 연계된 자동차와 무선 통신을 결합한 신개념의 Telecommunication + Informatics가 결합된 차량 무선 인터넷 서비스를 제공한다. 상기 시스템은 자동차 운행기록 자기진단장치(OBD, On-Board Diagnostics), OBD 데이터 App이 설치된 GPS 수신기가 탑재된 스마트 기기, 자동차 운행기록 서버, 및 보험사 서버로 구성된다.  
자동차 운행기록 자기진단장치(OBD), 스마트폰과 SaaS 클라우드 서비스를 제공하는 자동차 운행기록 서버와 보험사 서버가 연동되며, 자동차 운행기록 서버가 스마트폰으로부터 차량 상태와 운전 행태에 포함된 텔레매틱스 정보가 포함된 OBD 데이터와 시간대별 실시간 GPS 위치 정보를 수집하며, 시간대별 자동차의 GPS 위치에 따라 자동차의 이동경로와 주행거리를 파악하고, 차량 정보, 자동차의 속도(rpm), 엑셀레이터/브레이크의 조작, 바퀴의 회전 속도, 엔진과 연료 계통의 정보, 자동차의 배기 상태, 자동차의 위치와 자세를 바탕으로 분석된 안전 운행 정보, 급발진/급회전/급정지 등의 이상 운행 정보, 고장 정보, 에어백 충돌 감지 여부, 사고 발생 기록을 저장하고 그 자동차의 운행기록의 빅 데이터에 대한 시간과 위치에 따라 차량의 속도/방향/자세를 분석하여 자동차의 운행 정보와 운행 패턴을 파악하고, 고장 정보 자가 경고, 이상 운행 정보, 사고 정황 정보만을 추려 그 분석 결과를 보험사 서버에 제공하며, 교통사고시에 보험사의 사고 유무 확인과 보험 처리에 능동적으로 대처할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Appropriate location selection method of solar photovoltaic power station using aerial laser scanning data processing and space analysis technique
title_ko: 항공레이저측량 자료처리와 공간분석 기법을 사용한 태양광 발전소 적정 위치 선정 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for selecting an appropriate position of a solar photovoltaic power station using aerial laser scanning data processing and a space analysis technique. The method for selecting an appropriate position of a solar photovoltaic power station includes: a step of removing noise of a point of a minimum true height and the point of a maximum true height based on a predetermined height value from noise data in which distance becomes increased as the noise is reflected to a building or woods multiple times or is reflected to a cloud or dust in the air, about a source document obtained by aerial laser scanning on a solar photovoltaic power station land examination area to analyze the solar photovoltaic power station land based on aerial laser scanning materials by GIS software; a step of building a DEM in which subjects such as a building or woods from a geographic feature by an aerial laser scanning geographic material (Terrascan) program; a step of analyzing the solar radiation quantity for a year based on the DEM material which is built; and a step of analyzing changes in solar radiation quantities in accordance with the inclined direction by comparing the average solar radiation quantities of eight inclined directions. The method for selecting an appropriate position of a solar photovoltaic power station selects a land having a gradient of 30 degrees or less and the inclined direction of southeast (SE), south (S), and southwest (SW) as the solar photovoltaic power station land by considering the inclined direction and an appropriate gradient to prevent an accident happening in a construction step when the solar photovoltaic power station land is examined. The method for selecting an appropriate position of a solar photovoltaic power station also determines an installation size of the solar photovoltaic power station considering the available area.
abstract_ko: 항공레이저측량 자료처리와 공간분석 기법을 이용한 태양광 발전소 적정 위치 선정 방법이 개시된다. 상기 방법은, 항공레이저측량 자료 기반의 태양광 발전소 입지를 분석하기 위해 태양광발전소 부지 검토 지역에 대하여 항공레이저측량을 통해 취득한 원시자료에 대해 GIS 소프트웨어가 대기중의 구름이나 먼지에 반사되거나 건물이나 수목에 여러번 반사되어 거리가 길어지는 노이즈 데이터를 일정한 높이값 기준으로 최고표고 이상인 점과 최저 표고 이하의 점의 노이즈를 제거하고, 항공레이더측량 지형자료(TerraScan) 프로그램에 의해 지형지물에서 건물이나 수목과 같은 객체들을 제거한 DEM을 구축하며, 구축한 DEM 자료를 기반으로 1년 동안의 태양광 일사량을 분석하며, 8개 사면방향에 대한 평균 일사량을 상호 비교하여 사면방향에 따른 일사량 변화를 분석하였다. 태양광 발전소 부지 검토시 시공 단계에서 발생하는 안전사고를 예방하도록 사면방향과 적정 경사도를 고려하여, 사면방향이 남동(SE), 남(S), 남서(SW) 이면서, 30°이하의 경사도를 갖는 부지를 태양광 발전소 적정 부지로 선정하며, 해당 면적을 고려한 태양광 발전소 설치 규모를 결정한다.
assignees: IND ACADAMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION;KUMKANG ENG CORP

title_en: Headset computer with handsfree emergency response
abstract_en: Operating conditions for a headset computer are used to detect a situation where an emergency response mode should be activated. In emergency response mode, the headset computer may then broadcast location, live (real time) audio and video/data streams, and record other information concerning a possible theft and/or other situation of interest to law enforcement and/or security services.

title_en: Management of medical equipment and responders
abstract_en: A system for managing responders acquiring medical equipment and responding to an emergency medical event includes mobile devices associated with responders; a computer aided dispatch (CAD), and an equipment/responder management system communicatively coupled to the mobile devices and CAD and configured to receive an event location from the CAD, retrieve medical equipment locations from a database, receive responder locations from the mobile devices, send the event and equipment locations to a first mobile device, generate an activity log for the event including first responder status information based on the responder location, the event and medical equipment locations, send the activity log to the first mobile device, send the event location and the medical equipment locations to a second mobile device, update the activity log with second responder status information based on the responder, event and medical equipment locations, and send the activity log to the mobile devices.

title_en: EMUs remote visible patrol instrument
abstract_en: It the utility model is related to visual inspection equipment, more particularly to EMUs remote visible patrol instrument.It includes handle, remote visible device and camera lighting device, the remote visible device is fixedly mounted on the handle front end, the camera lighting device is fixedly mounted on the remote visible device front end, the handle is provided with light switch, visual speech button, video recording record button and intercom push key, touch display screen, microphone and loudspeaker are installed on the remote visible device, corresponding information interchange pattern can be automatically selected by operating visual speech button, video recording record button and intercom push key.The utility model has the advantage of by commonly installing remote visible device on video recording torch, remote visualization operation is realized, the emergency command personnel of technique center is commanded maintenance process as being in the action.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY JINAN BUREAU GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Decision-making method and system for whole-journey continuous electrocardio treatment during advancing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a decision-making method and system for whole-journey continuous electrocardio treatment during advancing. The decision-making method for whole-journey continuous electrocardio treatment during advancing comprises the steps that (a) an emergency command center receives a first-aid message of a patient and dispatches an ambulance to leave for the position where the patient is located; (b) electronic medical record information of the patient is searched for and read by the emergency command center to be analyzed preliminarily; (c) the emergency command center receives monitoring information, achieved by monitoring equipment, of the patient on the ambulance, checks the road condition GIS information of the ambulance and sends the monitoring information of the patient to a hospital, and the hospital gives a report of the state of the illness of the patient according to the monitoring information and the electronic medical record information and feeds the report of the state of the illness back to the emergency command center; (d) the emergency command center transmits the information of a hospital assigned according to a decision to the ambulance; (e) the emergency command center sends the electronic medical record of the patient, the report of the state of the illness of the patient and the GIS information of the ambulance to the hospital assigned according to the decision. The decision-making method and system for whole-journey continuous electrocardio treatment during advancing have the advantages that the intelligentization degree is high, efficiency and reliability of decision-making treatment are improved, the application range is wide, and safety and reliability are guaranteed.
assignees: WUXI ASCEND MEDICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of hydrological data Automation Reorganization system and method based on service dispatch
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of data Automation Reorganization system and methods, belong to hydrographic data processing technology field, are specifically related to a kind of hydrological data Automation Reorganization system and method based on service dispatch.The present invention realizes the reorganization method of multi-user concurrent processing, constructs data/address bus and transmission link, realize that online data is shared and reorganization scheme is shared online, and ensure the consistency of data by establishing the reorganization system architecture of multitasking mode.On-line mode provided by the invention can not only modification by policy control user to data, moreover it is possible to reflect the modification situation of data in real time, realize the backtracking of modification process, greatly improve timeliness and benefit；The present invention is by hydrological data compilation track identification and adaptive remodeling, and according to object property, adjust automatically reorganizes track, improves reorganization the degree of automation.
assignees: BUREAU OF HYDROLOGY CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION;WUHAN JIJIA SHIKONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban operation comprehensive linkage command system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an urban operation command system, in particular to an urban operation comprehensive linkage command system. The system comprises a waste management unit, an integrated management unit and an integrated display unit, and the applicable analysis display module comprises a record numbering module, a data processing module, a three-dimensional modeling module, a memory and an interval transmission module. According to the invention, when the regional garbage can positioning module is used for processing the wastes in each region, the garbage can storage space acquisition module is used for recording the waste storage content of each can point, and the information acquired by the garbage can storage space acquisition module is processed by the application analysis display module, so that the waste carrying capacity and the waste production capacity of the can point are calculated, and therefore, a regional commander can conveniently adjust the garbage can capacity of the can point according to the carrying capacity and the waste production capacity of each can point, the garbage cans in each region can reasonably contain the garbage, and the satisfaction degree of residents is improved.

title_en: Information system for air transportation and later delivery of wounded person and working method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information system and a working method for air transportation and post-delivery of a wounded person, the invention is provided with a portable data terminal, a wounded person information acquisition system, a storage module, a display interaction module, a wounded person information identification module and a medical record rapid construction module, after the data of vital sign monitoring, on-way medical treatment and on-way medical nursing of the wounded person are acquired, electronic wound ticket information is generated, the uploaded medical record information simultaneously corresponds to the wound ticket information and the wounded person information, the rapid search of the information can be realized, the invention can provide information support for the overall treatment efficiency and the command decision of a disaster site, and makes an improved design aiming at the condition of delivering the wounded person after air strength. The information safety factor under the service support environment is considered, and the portability and the universality are enhanced. The present invention has the general functionality of a medical telematics system and can be further improved with respect to privacy, portability, and air traffic applications.

title_en: Mine emergency rescue command system
abstract_en: The application discloses a mine emergency rescue command system, which comprises: the system comprises an emergency rescue command platform, a ground control terminal and a mobile terminal, wherein the ground control terminal monitors and records the environment of each tunnel in a mine, obtains videos and pictures of the environment of each tunnel, obtains the position of an accident point, marks the accident point in a pre-recorded mine model and confirms the position of the accident point; matching rescue schemes of corresponding accidents based on pre-entered accident data to obtain rescue routes; the ground control terminal updates the accident point position and the field environment of the roadway. The mine emergency rescue command system disclosed by the application can update the rescue scheme in real time according to the field environment, clear the command right in rescue work, avoid the situation that the notification of an emergency event is unreasonable and not in place due to the undefined command right, enable rescue staff to rapidly solve the sudden problem, reduce the waste of rescue time and improve the rescue efficiency.
assignees: JIANGSU DASHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for rapidly estimating earthquake middle position based on strong vibration acceleration record
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly estimating the position of a seism based on strong vibration acceleration record, which belongs to the technical field of geophysics and is used for estimating the position of the seism, and comprises the steps of extracting the arrival time of P waves of the seism, constructing a station P wave arrival time observation equation, and (3) primarily selecting quasi-observation and primarily calculating true error estimation, fitting a feature vector by using a random sample consensus algorithm RANSAC, identifying inner points and outer points, checking the inner points as quasi-observation and secondarily calculating the true error estimation, and outputting seismic elements. The method introduces a more efficient and rapid quasi-observation selection scheme so as to optimize the accuracy of the coarse-difference quasi-verification method, realizes real-time and rapid estimation of the position of the middle of the large earthquake based on a strong-earthquake observation means, realizes more accurate and reliable determination of the position of the middle of the earthquake, and can provide technical support for rapid early warning of the earthquake and post-earthquake emergency response.

title_en: Luminaires for emergency exit sings control system
title_ko: 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어시스템
abstract_en: A fire emergency light control system with a guiding direction display function is provided to protect precious lives of people by effectively guiding residents of a building to an exit path of the building. A fire emergency light control system with a guiding direction display function includes a fire emergency light(30) and an automatic fire detection receiver(70). The fire emergency light includes a CPU(Central Processing Unit,80), a voice output circuit, and a direction indication lamp(40), which are embedded therein. The fire emergency light is electrically(10) coupled with the receiver by a signal(20). The automatic fire detection receiver is electrically coupled with conventional sensors(50) and signal generators(60). When fire breaks out in a building, the sensor detects fire, the receiver receives a fire signal from the sensor and locates a fire site, and then the receiver generates alarm and delivers commands to the fire emergency light.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건축물 화재시 비상 피난을 유도하는 시스템 으로써, 기존에 사용되고 있는 통로 유도등, 피난구 유도등 및 객석 유도등에 소방용 자동화재탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반 및 로컬 수신반 등)으로부터 피난 경로 유도 신호를 전달 받아 실행할 수 있는 내부연산장치(CPU)를 형성 시킴으로써, 화재 발생시 소방용 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반 및 로컬 수신반 등)에 내장되어 있는 컴퓨터 시스템의 자동 연산장치(CPU)에 의해 명령을 전달받아 건물내에 있는 다수의 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있는 것을 특징으로 하는 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어 시스템을 제공함에 있다. 현재의 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)은 고도의 산업이 발전함과 더블어 다양한 기능 및 첨단 감시 시스템을 내장하고 있으며 대부분이 컴퓨터(CPU) 시스템에 의해 제어되고 있다. 또한 보다 세밀하고 안정적으로 건물의 화재 등을 감시하기 위하여 다양한 방법들을 사용하고 있으며 특히 실시간 감시를 위하여 디지털 방식은 물론 시분할 감시 등 아날로그 방식을 통하여 건물의 보안 감시 및 화재를 감시하고 있다. 본 시스템은 이들의 기존 시스템을 활용하여 현재 제어되고 있지않는 소방용 유도등(통로유도등, 피난구유도등, 객석유도등)을 제어함으로써 위험상황 발생시 이들을 유용하게 통제하여 건물내의 사람들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있는 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어 시스템을 제공하고자 한다. 본 시스템은 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반 및 로컬 수신반 등)의 주컴퓨터(CPU)에  연결되어 있는 각 구역의 감지기들의 상황을 수시로 파악하여 화재 발생시 화재 발생 지역의 감지기 위치를 인지하여 내부연산 프로그램에 의해 최적의 피난 통로를 기존의 소방용 통로유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등)을 통하여 유도하게 되는 특징을 갖게 된다. 현재의 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)들은 상기의 감지기 위치를 어드레스(ADDRESS) 별로 관리 및 감시를 하고 있으며 화재시 화재신호 발령 및 초기 소화 장치들을 제어하고 있다. 본 시스템은 이에 추가적 으로 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신기(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)가 소방용 통로 유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등)을 제어할 수 있도록 통로유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등 )에 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)으로 부터의 명령 및 제어를 수행할 수 있도록 내부연산장치(CPU)를 형성 시킴으로써 전체적인 피난 유도 방향 표시 기능을 구비한 소방용 유도등 제어 시스템이 완성되게 된다. 상기의 통로 유도등(피난구유도등, 객석유도등)의 내부연산장치(CPU)는 간단한 논리적 회로인 OR 게이트의 단순한 구현으로 그 실행이 가능하다. 즉 기존의 소방용 유도등(통로유도등, 피난구유도등, 객석유도등)은 기존의 유도등 기능을 유지 하면서 유사시에 방향 표시 기능을 추가할 수 있는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 또한 상기 소방용 유도등은 화재로 인하여 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)과의 신호선이 단선될 경우에는 자동백업(back up) 기능에 의하여 피난 유도 방향 표시를 하지 않고 기존의 소방용 유도등의 기능만을 수행하게 된다. 또한 시각 장애인을 위하여 소방용 자동화재 탐지설비 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반 등)으로 부터 전달된 연산 신호를 소방용 유도등에 형성되어 있는 내부 연산 장치(CPU)에 의하여 실행되는 방향 표시는 물론 해당 방향으로 유도할 수 있는 음성 신호를 출력할 수 있는 기능도 내장하게 된다. 이는 해당 방향으로의 신호 접점을 유지 시켜줌 으로써 내부 연산장치(CPU)에 내장되어 있는 해당 음성 신호를 일측에 형성된 스피커를 통하여 출력할 수 있게 된다. 
       
     통로 유도등(피난구유도등,객석유도등), 연상장치(CPU), 어드레스(ADDRESS), 자동화재 탐지설비, 주수신반(보조수신반, 로컬수신반), R형 수신반, 접점, 피난계획, 규정중심, 성능위주, 피난경로, 피난동선, 페닉(PANIC), 추종본능, 회귀본능

title_en: Automobile for total system
title_ko: 통합시스템 이동형 관제차량
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An integrated system moving type control vehicle is provided to monitor a slope after disaster including falling rocks and landslide by going to a field in real time. CONSTITUTION: A monitoring unit(20) installs a program for slope investigation and monitors a slope at the field in real time. A monitor and an input/output unit of the monitoring unit are installed at a space between a front seat and a back seat of a control vehicle. A communications unit transmits slope field information monitored by the monitoring unit to a slope control center(2). The communications unit communicates with the slope control center. A GPS(30) transmits field location information to the slope control center in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 낙석, 산사태 등의 재해를 예방, 사고 후 피해를 저감시키기 위해 사면을 모니터하기 위한 통합시스템 이동형 관제차량에 관한 것이다. 특히 본 발명은 출동한 현장의 사면상황을 모니터하기 위한 현장 모니터링 시스템이 구축된 통합시스템 이동형 관제차량(10)으로서, 상기 현장 모니터링 시스템은 실시간으로 사면을 현장에서 모니터할 수 있도록 사면조사용 프로그램이 설치된 모니터부(20); 및, 상기 모니터부(20)에 의해 모니터 된 사면현장정보를 사면통제센터(2)로 전송하며, 상기 사면통제센터(2)와 통신하기 위한 통신부; 실시간으로 현장 위치 정보를 상기 사면통제센터(2)에 전송하는 GPS(30);를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 통합시스템 이동형 관제차량(10)를 제시한다.

title_en: Apparatus for producing algorithm
title_ko: 알고리즘 생성 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an algorithm generating device, which checks a source code of algorithm created by a user by generating the algorithm created by a command block inserted in an operation body with the source code of programming language and trains various kinds of programming languages by the user by creating the source code through the algorithm created by the command block inserted into the operation body using the programming languages selected by the user among various programming languages.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 알고리즘 생성 장치에 관한 것으로 동작 본체에 삽입된 명령 블록에 의해 작성된 알고리즘을 프로그래밍 언어의 소스 코드로 생성하여 사용자는 본인이 작성한 알고리즘의 소스 코드를 확인할 수 있으며, 동작 본체에 삽입된 명령 블록에 의해 작성된 알고리즘을 다양한 프로그래밍 언어 중 사용자가 선택한 프로그래밍 언어로 소스 코드를 작성하여 사용자는 다양한 종류의 프로그래밍 언어를 교육받을 수 있는 알고리즘 생성 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Voice self-practice method for voice disorders and user device for voice therapy
title_ko: 음성 장애 환자를 위한 음성 자가 훈련 방법 및 사용자 단말 장치
abstract_en: A user terminal device for voice self-training comprises: an input device receiving a user's command to select a training program; a storage device storing voice training candidate programs for user voice training; an arithmetic device generating first guide content according to a first voice training program selected by a user among the voice training candidate programs; an output device outputting the first guide content; and a microphone receiving the voice output by the user according to the first guide content output to the output device. The arithmetic device selects a second voice training program among the voice training candidate programs according to the evaluation result of the user's voice, and generates second guide content according to the second voice training program, and the output device outputs the second guide content. According to the present invention, an elderly patient can easily grasp his or her vocalization state (voice strength, change in vocalization, and the like) by using a visual object.
abstract_ko: 음성 자가 훈련을 위한 사용자 단말 장치는 사용자의 훈련 프로그램 선택 명령을 입력받는 입력장치, 사용자 음성 훈련을 위한 음성 훈련 후보 프로그램들을 저장하는 저장장치, 상기 음성 훈련 후보 프로그램들 중 상기 사용자가 선택한 제1 음성 훈련 프로그램에 따른 제1 가이드 콘텐츠를 생성하는 연산장치, 상기 제1 가이드 콘텐츠를 출력하는 출력장치 및 상기 출력장치에 출력되는 제1 가이드 콘텐츠에 따라 사용자가 출력하는 음성을 입력받는 마이크를 포함한다. 상기 연산장치는 상기 사용자의 음성에 대한 평가 결과에 따라 상기 음성 훈련 후보 프로그램들 중 제2 음성 훈련 프로그램을 선택하고, 상기 제2 음성 훈련 프로그램에 따른 제2 가이드 콘텐츠를 생성하고, 상기 출력장치는 상기 제2 가이드 콘텐츠를 출력한다.

title_en: Method to provide relevant persons the event video in an emergency situation and Image transmission system for the same
title_ko: 비상상황에서 이벤트 현장 영상의 관련자 제공방법 및 그에 따른 영상 송출 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method for providing a person involved in an event site image in an emergency situation and an image transmission system according to the same, wherein the method comprises the steps of: checking whether an event occurs; detecting a biometric signal of a passenger to determine whether the situation is an emergency situation; and transmitting a recorded image of the interior and exterior of a vehicle at the time of occurrence of the event to a management server when it is determined that the situation is the emergency situation. In a dangerous environment in which a driver loses consciousness due to a big accident or a secondary accident occurs while the vehicle is stopped after the accident, the recorded image of the accident occurrence time and the interior and exterior of the vehicle are provided in a real-time streaming format in an emergency vehicle, a racker vehicle, a police vehicle, or the like dispatched to recover the person related to the driver or the accident in a dangerous environment in which the driver loses consciousness due to a big accident or a secondary accident occurs after the accident. Therefore, it is expected that it is possible to efficiently and quickly recover and respond to the accident site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이벤트 발생 여부를 확인하는 단계와; 탑승자의 생체 신호를 감지하여 비상상황인가를 판단하는 단계; 및 상기 비상상황이라 판단되는 경우 상기 이벤트 발생 시점의 차량 실내외 녹화영상을 관리서버로 전송하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 비상상황에서 이벤트 현장 영상의 관련자 제공방법 및 그에 따른 영상 송출 시스템을 제공하여  큰 사고가 발생되어 운전자가 의식을 잃거나, 사고 후 차량 정차 상태에서 2차 사고가 발생하는 위험한 환경 속에서 운전자와 관련된 인원 또는 사고 수습을 위해 출동하는 응급 차량/렉카 차량/경찰 차량 등에 사고 발생시점의 녹화영상과 차량 실내외 상황을 실시간 스트리밍(Streaming) 형식으로 제공함으로써 보다 효율적이고 신속하게 사고 현장 수습 및 대응이 가능해 질 수 있을 것으로 기대한다.

title_en: Learning toy, and learning toy mobile body and learning toy panel used in learning toy
abstract_en: [Problem to be Solved] A learning toy which enables learning of high-level programming in a stepwise manner so that older children as well as younger infants are targeted at is provided.[Solution] A movement path 120 is constituted by a plurality of command panels 121 in which command information which can be read with an optical reading module 240 is recorded being arranged. A mobile robot 110 sequentially reads command information included in the command panels 121 through which the mobile robot 110 passes while moving along the movement path 120 and stores a plurality of pieces of command information in a command information memory 508. The mobile robot 110 takes out a plurality of pieces of command information from arbitrary positions in the command information memory 508 to execute operation. If a plurality of pieces of command information necessary for operation of the mobile robot 110 are stored in the command information memory 508, a control unit 501 of the mobile robot 110 automatically extracts and takes out the command information and causes the mobile robot 110 to operate.

title_en: Algorithm generation method and device
title_ko: 알고리즘 생성 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an algorithm generation method and a device therefor and, more specifically, to an algorithm generation method and a device therefor, the method: generating, as a source code in a programming language, an algorithm created by a command block inserted into an operation body such that a user can check a source code of an algorithm created by the user; and creating a source code in a programming language, selected by the user, among various programming languages for the algorithm created by the command block inserted into the operation body, such that the user can be learn various kinds of programming languages.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 알고리즘 생성 방법 및 그 장치에 관한 것으로, 보다 구체적으로 동작 본체에 삽입된 명령 블록에 의해 작성된 알고리즘을 프로그래밍 언어의 소스 코드로 생성하여 사용자는 본인이 작성한 알고리즘의 소스 코드를 확인할 수 있으며, 동작 본체에 삽입된 명령 블록에 의해 작성된 알고리즘을 다양한 프로그래밍 언어 중 사용자가 선택한 프로그래밍 언어로 소스 코드를 작성하여 사용자는 다양한 종류의 프로그래밍 언어를 교육받을 수 있는 알고리즘 생성 방법 및 그 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: A kind of anomaly detection method based on extensive WiFi activity trajectory
abstract_en: The invention proposes a kind of anomaly detection methods based on extensive WiFi activity trajectory, on the basis of the MAC of acquisition record, the normal MAC of individual behavior is found out using frequent track mining algorithm, extract the active characteristics attribute of the normal MAC of these individual behaviors, input as SVDD algorithm, establish the MAC that multiple abnormality detection model filters fall largely to meet group behavior rule, both the time for substantially reducing processing large-scale data needs in turn ensures the stability of method for detecting abnormality, and positive negative sample seriously unbalanced feature can be overcome in this application environment very well, and then the MAC progress time consistency and Space Consistency individually different from group behavior rule are detected, the MAC of abnormal movement can more accurately be locked.The present invention can effectively apply the motion track for monitoring mobile object in real time in public safety field, accurately identify abnormal behaviour in real time, and the security incident to have occurred and that provides auxiliary and studies and judges, and early warning is made in the security incident for that may occur.

title_en: Bus dynamic scheduling system and method based on WiFi detection and GPS positioning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus dynamic scheduling system and a scheduling method based on WiFi detection and GPS positioning.A WiFi probe is arranged on a bus and a platform, a device for opening a WiFi function in a detection range on the bus and near the platform is detected in real time, and MAC address data is recorded; recording real-time GPS data of the bus by utilizing vehicle-mounted GPS equipment; carrying out noise reduction and matching on the MAC address data through a core algorithm, and estimating the real-time passenger carrying number of the bus and the number of the passengers waiting at the platform; setting a waiting satisfaction function by taking the waiting time of passengers as a parameter, setting a satisfaction function of a bus company by taking the dispatching frequency as a parameter, and determining weights of the waiting time and the dispatching frequency according to actual conditions to obtain a comprehensive satisfaction function; and solving the optimal value of the satisfaction function based on real-time data such as the number of passengers in real time of the issued vehicle, the number of waiting passengers in real time of each platform and the like, and dynamically obtaining the departure frequency adaptive to the current line passenger flow condition.

title_en: Firefighting radio order system by using cable for ultrahigh frequency send and receive
title_ko: 극초단파 송수신용 케이블을 이용한 소방 무선 지령 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wireless fire incident command system which smoothly broadcasts a wireless call between a radio device underground and another radio device on the ground. The wireless fire incident command system according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a first low-frequency converter (510); a first analog-digital converter (520); a first feedback signal remover (530); first digital-analog converter (550); A first high-frequency converter (560); a broadcast transmitter (500); a descending line amplifier (750); an ascending line amplifier (900); a second low-frequency converter (610); a second analog-digital converter (520); a second feedback signal remover (630); a second automatic gain adjuster (640); a second digital-analog converter (650); and a second high-frequency converter (660). title_en: Method for evaluating road safety and apparatus for executing the method
title_ko: 도로 안전성 평가 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 장치
abstract_ko: 도로 안전성 평가 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 컴퓨팅 장치가 개시된다. 개시되는 일 실시예에 따른 도로 안전성 평가 방법은, 하나 이상의 프로세서들, 및 하나 이상의 프로세서들에 의해 실행되는 하나 이상의 프로그램들을 저장하는 메모리를 구비한 컴퓨팅 장치에서 수행되는 방법으로서, 소정 도로에서 발생한 교통 사고와 관련하여 교통 피해 정도, 교통량 정보, 및 날씨 정보 중 하나 이상을 포함하는 교통 사고 관련 정보를 수집하는 단계, 도로의 도로 관련 정보를 수집하는 단계, 도로 관련 정보를 기반으로 도로를 복수 개의 구간으로 구분하는 단계, 및 교통 사고 관련 정보 및 도로 관련 정보를 랜덤 포레스트(Random Forest) 모델의 입력 변수로 하여 도로의 각 구간 별 위험도를 예측하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Safety compliance, identification, and security monitoring system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety compliance, identification, and security monitoring system that includes a monitoring device operable to capture images/videos of a predefined area and persons and events within the area. The monitoring device is further operable to determine whether persons within the area are wearing required personal protective equipment. In one embodiment, the monitoring device initiates an alert a safety equipment infraction. In one embodiment, the system is operable to further record an incident report identifying the nature, date, and location of the infraction, as well as the identity of the person committing the infraction. In one embodiment, the system is operable to monitor various external conditions, such as heat, humidity, smoke, and initiate an alert of the external condition detected. In one embodiment, the system detects quality assurance/quality control issues, including situations involving inspecting equipment, tools, and/or materials for non-conformance.

title_en: System and method for speech-enabled adaptive training for human pilot verbal data capture and reporting for flight operations quality assurance
abstract_en: A system and method for implementing one or more real-time flight operations quality assurance (RTS-FOQA) systems and protocols is disclosed. RTS-FOQA systems assist pilots and other personnel in managing hazards and risks to protect the safety of passengers, pilots, flight attendants, crew, as well as people on the ground. The system is configured to capture voice data from the cockpit, recognize words spoken by the pilots, air traffic controllers (ATC), and other personnel; convert the recognized words into text; compare the text derived from the words spoken by the pilots, ATC, and other personnel to a standard operational procedure (SOP) sequence, wherein the sequence comprises a plurality of SOP operational steps; identify at least one of a plurality of flight operations executed by the pilots; compare the plurality of flight operations executed by the pilots with the required SOP operational procedures; identify at least one of the plurality of SOP operational steps not executed or incorrectly executed by the pilots; and alert the pilots if and when the pilots fails to execute or incorrectly execute any of the plurality of SOP operational steps. In addition to alerting the pilots of the deviation(s) from the SOP sequence(s), the system may automatically generate a SOP exceedance report for recording the SOP operational step(s) not executed or incorrectly executed by the pilot(s), as well as automatically execute an emergency response, automatically execute an evasive maneuver, and/or automatically implement an autopilot—E.G., initiate execution of remotely-piloted, semi-autonomous, or autonomous, arrival approach, and landing procedures.

title_en: Dispatching monitoring system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a dispatching monitoring system comprising a dispatching platform, a dispatching host machine, a base station controller, an intrinsically safe type base station and an intrinsically safe wireless terminal. The dispatching host machine is connected with a ground telephone and an underground intrinsically safe type telephone. The dispatching monitoring system also comprises an explosion-proof camera, a multi-channel optical receiver, a hard disk recorder, a video matrix and a large screen display system. The explosion-proof camera is connected with the ground multi-channel optical receiver through a mine fire retardant communication cable. The multi-channel optical receiver, the hard disk recorder, the video matrix and the large screen display system are orderly connected through a BNC video line. At the same time, the video matrix is in communication connection with the dispatching host machine through an RS232 serial port. According to the dispatching monitoring system, the real-time exchange of audio and video can be realized through the connection of the dispatching platform with the voice and monitoring of a communication site, and the on-site command scheduling and the implementation of emergency rescue are facilitated.
assignees: HENAN HENGAN COMM EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Alarm receiving and processing digitization management system for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm receiving and processing digitization management system for fire fighting, comprising a central processing module, a digital speech recording playback module and a relay unit, wherein the output end of the central processing module is respectively connected with the input ends of the relay unit and the digital speed recording playback module; the input end of the central processing module is respectively connected with a mode selection switch, a bugle command button and a volume control button; the relay unit is composed of a fire bell controller, a lighting controller and a garage door controller, and the output end of the fire bell controller, the lighting controller and the garage door controller are respectively connected with a fire bell, a lamp and a garage door; the output end of the digital speech recording playback module is connected with a power amplifier and a voice box in sequence; and the central processing module communicates with an upper computer via an extended interface. The invention utilizes the mature and an open TCP/IP protocol to integrate all fire fighting functions at present with good working reliability, rapid response speed, simple operation and relatively low cost.

title_en: Government financial tracking method, equipment and medium based on block chain
