abstract_en: The application discloses a block chain-based government financial tracking method, which comprises the following steps: building a block chain platform, and respectively generating a trusted timestamp and a trusted random number according to the receiving and dispatching behaviors; binding the trusted timestamp and the trusted random number to the income and expenditure behaviors respectively, collecting income and expenditure information in an income and expenditure process, and generating a financial income and expenditure record; uploading the financial income and expense record to the blockchain platform through an intelligent contract, and encrypting the financial income and expense record to generate an encrypted file; decrypting the encrypted file to obtain a decrypted file, and auditing the balance record in the decrypted file; and disclosing the auditing result. The public can be made to have a clearer understanding of the government financial income and expenditure situation, and the trust of the government is further increased.
assignees: SHANDONG ICITY NETWORK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Protective mask communication device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of protective masks, in particular to a protective mask communication device which comprises a face mask, wherein a connecting ring is fixedly arranged on the face mask, a sealing ring is arranged on the connecting ring, an inner shell is fixedly arranged at the bottom of the face mask, a shielding cover is fixedly arranged on the inner shell, a gap is formed between the shielding cover and the face mask, a sealing gasket is fixedly arranged on the shielding cover, a communication mechanism is arranged on the sealing ring and comprises a first communication component and a second communication component, the first communication component is arranged in the gap, the second communication component is arranged on the sealing ring, the first communication component is electrically connected with the second communication component, a breathing component is arranged on the inner shell, and the breathing component penetrates out of the face mask, so that the problem that the existing protective mask cannot communicate and transmit information with other workers, external personnel and commanders on site due to structural design defects is solved, therefore, the rescue timeliness is limited to a certain extent, the rescue time is delayed, and the emergency situation treatment is not facilitated.
assignees: CHINESE PEOPLE LIBERATION ARMY ROCKET ARMY CHARACTERISTIC MEDICAL CENTER

title_en: Gas explosion accident emergency resource scheduling optimization method, system, equipment and medium for improving particle swarm optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a gas explosion accident emergency resource scheduling optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium for improving a particle swarm algorithm, which comprise the following steps of constructing a gas explosion area emergency resource scheduling model, establishing an objective function with minimum rescue time as a target, and setting constraint conditions; and solving a gas explosion area emergency resource scheduling model by applying a greedy heuristic algorithm and combining an improved particle swarm algorithm, wherein the greedy heuristic algorithm obtains a local optimal solution of an objective function through iterative search, and the improved particle swarm algorithm finds global optimal particles through algorithm iteration to finally obtain the optimal rescue scheme and a corresponding target value. The algorithm optimizes the emergency resource scheduling of the gas explosion accident, and can remarkably improve the timeliness and rescue efficiency of emergency response.
assignees: CHINA TELECOM HONGXIN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Smart city environment supervision system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart city environment supervision system, which particularly relates to the technical field of environment supervision, wherein a conversion delay response module, an information loss response module, a noise interference response module and an accuracy loss response module are used for respectively acquiring a calculated data conversion delay coefficient, a data conversion loss coefficient, a data noise interference coefficient and a data accuracy loss coefficient, finding out the problems of conversion delay, information loss, noise interference and accuracy loss in data format conversion in time, constructing a data conversion hidden danger assessment model, generating a data conversion hidden danger assessment index, assessing the hidden danger of format conversion in the data format conversion process, ensuring that the system can always maintain the accuracy and timeliness of data in the environment crisis emergency response process, avoiding decision errors and response delays caused by inaccurate or delayed data, automatically sending early warning and making corresponding decisions based on hidden danger assessment results, and indicating whether the system needs to adjust a data processing flow or carry out emergency repair.
assignees: JIANGSU GANGCHENG ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency response method, system, device and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a first-aid response method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of first-aid response, and are characterized in that a plurality of sub-action interaction items are determined according to the identification of action interaction events, collision positions and corresponding collision grades of first-aid personnel are determined according to the identification of each sub-action interaction item, the preliminary first-aid state of the first-aid personnel is predicted according to the positions of each collision position of the first-aid personnel, the corresponding collision grade and the past medical record information of the first-aid personnel, and the accuracy of the preliminary first-aid state of the first-aid personnel is improved. The emergency response procedure corresponding to the first-aid condition information, the preliminary emergency state of the first-aid waiting personnel and the position of the first-aid waiting personnel is determined, the plurality of sub-emergency items are determined based on the identification of the first-aid waiting personnel, the emergency response event is determined according to the plurality of sub-emergency items, the corresponding medical team and the current state of the first-aid waiting personnel, and the accuracy of the emergency response event is further improved.

title_en: Computer storage media and methods for automated emergency response systems for vehicle
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide computer storage media and methods for automated emergency response systems for a vehicle.SOLUTION: A method of automated emergency response for a vehicle includes identifying a condition with respect to a vehicle that indicates a potential collision, and recording imagery in response to the identification. The method also includes identifying a condition of a driver of a vehicle indicative of an emergency medical condition; and communicating an alert to an emergency responder through a communication system in response to identifying the emergency medical condition.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4
assignees: TOYOTA ENG & MFG NORTH AMERICA;TOYOTA MOTOR SALES USA INC

title_en: Vehicle Loading type Blackbox System and Information Providing Method by using Surrounding Image produced from the System
title_ko: 차량 탑재형 블랙박스 시스템 및 그 시스템에서 생성된 주변 영상을 이용한 정보제공방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A black box device for an automobile and information offering method using a peripheral video produced by the device are provided to use the recorded video including the entire periphery of an automobile as evidence of a car accident and transmit the recorded video and the location of an automobile to an establishment offering accident handling services. CONSTITUTION: An information offering method using a peripheral video produced by a black box device for an automobile is as follows. A plurality of cameras is used for recording the entire periphery of an automobile. The recorded entire periphery of an automobile is changed to one or more types such as a raw video, a top view video, and a 3D video. An impact of an automobile is detected. If a collision is detected, the video recorded during the determined time period including the collision time is extracted as a collision video.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 차량 탑재형 블랙박스 시스템 및 그 시스템에서 생성된 주변 영상을 이용한 정보제공방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 방법은 복수 개의 카메라를 이용하여 차량 주변의 영상을 촬영하는 단계, 상기 복수 개의 카메라에서 촬영된 차량 주변을 원본 영상, 탑뷰 영상 및 3D 영상 중 적어도 하나의 형태로 처리하여 차량 주변 영상을 생성하는 단계 및 상기 차량 주변 영상을 저장하는 단계를 포함한다.  상기 방법은 차량의 충돌 여부를 감지하는 단계 및 상기 차량의 충돌이 감지되면, 상기 충돌이 감지된 시간을 포함하는 소정 시간 구간 동안에 생성된 주변 영상을 충돌영상으로 추출하는 단계를 더 포함할 수 있다.   이에 의해, 차량의 충돌시 주변 영상 중 충돌시점을 포함하는 소정 시간의 충돌영상을 추출하여 운전자 및 탑승자에게 서비스를 제공할 수 있는 기관에 차량 위치정보와 함께 제공함으로써, 교통사고의 증거를 확보하여 가해자와 피해자를 정확히 가릴 수 있다.  뿐만 아니라, 차량 충돌시 신속하고 정확하게 운전자와 탑승자에게 서비스를 제공하여 인명 피해를 최소화할 수 있다.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based automobile insurance information management computer, automobile insurance information management system, automobile insurance information management method, and recording medium
title_ko: 인공지능(ai) 기반 자동차 보험정보 관리 컴퓨터, 자동차 보험정보 관리 시스템, 자동차 보험정보 관리 방법 및 기록매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 인공지능(AI) 기반 자동차 보험정보 관리 컴퓨터, 자동차 보험정보 관리 시스템, 자동차 보험정보 관리 방법 및 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에서는 사용자의 관리 대상 자동차의 자동차식별정보를 기초로 해당 자동차의 보험정보를 수집하여 가입 자동차보험의 제반 정보를 확인 가능하게 처리하고, 수집된 가입 보험사의 보험정보를 기초로 교통사고처리정보 및 긴급출동요청을 원터치로 수행할 수 있도록 관련 수단을 자동 생성하고, 수신된 자동차사고의 발생 정보를 수신하여 인공지능(AI) 기반으로 보험처리 정황 정보를 생성하여 제공하고, 자동차 보험의 갱신 가능 스케줄과 운행이력 정보 및 보험사들의 보험상품정보를 기초로 인공지능(AI) 기반으로 보험정보를 추천하는 인공지능(AI) 기반 자동차 보험정보 관리에 관한 발명이 제시된다.

title_en: Data processing method, data processing device, and computer program
abstract_en:
[Problem] To achieve high reliability in managing a certificate related to suppression of greenhouse gas. 
     [Solution] A data processing method includes, by a computer 1 connected to a recorder terminal 30 and a distributed database 50 through a network NW, executing: certification data receiving processing S101 of receiving certification data related to a reduction amount of greenhouse gas from the recorder terminal; deposit receiving processing S103 of receiving a deposit from the recorder terminal, the deposit being transmitted in association with the certification data; communication processing S104 of transmitting a storage request of the certification data and deposit processing necessary for the storage request to the distributed database; recording processing S106 of receiving information of a purchaser of the certification data and recording the information of the purchaser in association with the certification data; amortization processing S205 of storing, in the distributed database, amortization information indicating amortization of the certification data in association with the certification data when receiving an amortization command of the certification data; and deposit reimbursement processing S207 of reimbursing the deposit associated with the certification data to the recorder terminal when the amortization information is stored.

title_en: Golf lesson apparatus and server by using intrinsic location and user authentication
abstract_en: This invention relates to a golf lesson apparatus and server by using intrinsic location and user authentication which is installed at each tee box of golf courses or driving ranges. This invention aims simple and easy correction of user's swing posture, and is comprised of: the Wireless Communication Part which authenticates users with the user's RFID ID card; the Motion Detection Part which records user's swing posture; the Data Storage Part which stores the video of the user's swing posture; the Key Input Interface Part which receives user's command; the Display Part which shows the video of the user's swing posture on real time basis and the video of analysis and lesson on user's swing posture transmitted from the golf lesson server; the Network Interface Part which connects the golf lesson server via wired/wireless networks; and the Control Part which provides the services linked with the Golf Lesson Server.

title_en: Vehicle impact sensor and notification system
abstract_en: The present disclosure involves systems, software, sensors, and applied solutions for detecting incidents associated with a vehicle, where sensors associated with the vehicle identify impacts or proximity alerts to other vehicles and objects and record information related to those detected incidents. The recorded information can be immediately communicated to interested parties of the person or entity (e.g., emergency responders, business contacts) associated with the vehicle, or alternatively, stored for inspection at the vehicle and reviewed at a destination along the vehicle's route. In one example method, operations include detecting an incident associated with a monitored vehicle, where detecting the incident comprises receiving an alert from at least one sensor associated with the vehicle, identifying a location of the vehicle in response to the detection, and storing a record of the detected incident, where the record includes the identified location of the vehicle and a time associated with the detected incident.

title_en: Apparatus and method for assessing and tracking user competency in augmented/virtual reality-based training in industrial automation systems and other systems
abstract_en: A method includes receiving (402) one or more records (120) containing commands, an association of the commands with visual objects in an augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) space, and an AR/VR environment setup. The commands correspond to user actions taken in the AR/VR space. The method also includes analyzing (406) the user actions based on the one or more records and assessing (408) the user actions based on the analysis. The one or more records could have a portable file format. The commands could correspond to one or more gestures made by a user, one or more voice commands or voice annotations spoken by the user, one or more textual messages provided by the user, and/or one or more pointing actions taken by the user using at least one pointing device.

title_en: Patient emergency response system
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digital video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event. and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted serv r to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time. the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: Wireless neighborhood wildfire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in a neighborhood through gps-tracking and mapping of environmentally-clean anti-fire (af) chemical liquid spray applied to the property before wild fires reach the neighborhood
abstract_en: A wireless wild fire defense system network supporting proactive protection of life and property in GPS-specified neighborhoods using GPS-managed delivery of environmentally-clean anti-fire (AF) chemical liquid spray to property before wild fire reaches the neighborhoods. The wireless system network includes a GPS system for providing GPS-location services to each system components in the wireless system network. A wireless communication network supports one or more network databases accessible by systems and devices deployed on the wireless communication network. A fleet of mobile GPS-tracked anti-fire liquid spraying systems are assigned to GPS-specified neighborhoods for spraying anti-fire chemical liquid on combustible property, buildings, and ground cover to inhibit fire ignition and flame spread wherever the anti-fire chemical liquid is sprayed. When allowed to dry, the anti-fire chemical liquid provides fire-protection status to sprayed property that is GPS-tracked and mapped within a network database maintained on the wireless communication network, recording wherever the environmentally-safe anti-fire chemical liquid has been spray applied. The system network includes mobile computing systems, each running a mobile application and deployed to a property owner, spray contractor or other stakeholder, such as firefighters and property insurance inspectors, for remotely monitoring the fire-protection status of property in any GPS-specified neighborhood, at any time on any specified date, along with the status of active wild fires surrounding the neighborhood. A command center deployed on the wireless system network transmits wild fire alerts and notifications and property spray orders, and supports microservices configured for monitoring and managing GPS-tracked spraying operations within GPS-specified neighborhoods. Through GPS-managed delivery of anti-fire chemical liquid spray on property surfaces before arrival of wild fire, fire ignition and flame spread are inhibited, and human and animal life and property are protected.

title_en: Centralized management type backup disaster recovery system
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized management type backup disaster recovery system, which comprises: a console (104) which performs centralized control on the data container (105), the backup process module (103), the storage medium (101) and the standby machine (102) through control operations; a production server (108) for controlling and managing data flow between the production server and the storage medium in units of data blocks; a backup process module (103) for backing up data to a storage space allocated to the production server (180) by the storage medium (101) by means of mirroring and synchronous or asynchronous techniques or any other backup method; a storage medium (101) storing data and assigning a logical unit (200) for data storage to the production server (108); the standby machine (102) stores the system data of the production server (108), and completes the automatic operation and setting of the standby machine (102) through the console (104); and the data container (105) records the operation state, the data information and the command request of the console, the production server, the backup process module, the storage medium and the standby machine through data state updating.

title_en: Hazardous chemical substance disaster situation material scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a dangerous chemical disaster situation material scheduling method and system, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the dispatching center server comprises a database and is used for storing hazardous chemical substance information; the display screen is connected with the dispatching center server and used for displaying the disaster data of the hazardous chemical substances; the dispatching system field platform is used for sending hazardous chemical substance disaster information to the dispatching center server by a manager; and the sensor is used for sending the acquired disaster situation field parameters to the dispatching center server. The method comprises the following steps: the province power grid is divided into regional ranges, a dispatching center is arranged in each regional range, position distribution and quantity information of dangerous chemicals are recorded in advance, after the dangerous chemicals are in a disaster, disaster types and related parameters are sent to a dispatching center server through a dispatching system field platform, the dispatching center server predicts the diffusion range of the dangerous chemicals after the time of arrival at a rescue site through calculation, rescue goods and personnel are dispatched according to the diffusion range, and if the goods and materials of a local dispatching center are insufficient, the dispatching center with the nearest distance asks for assistance.

title_en: Risk prediction method based on identification of human actions in video key frame flood
abstract_en: The application discloses a risk prediction method based on identification of human actions in video key frame flood, which comprises the following steps of extracting key frames of flood monitoring video; and constructing a key frame image rapid motion recognition model, and quantifying the risk level based on disaster condition feature recognition. The method combines single-wide flow information and multi-class behavior characteristics, remarkably improves the accuracy and reliability of risk prediction, ensures the timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response, adopts an optimized deep learning model and an efficient data processing flow, ensures the timeliness and high performance when processing large-scale video data, and greatly improves the monitoring efficiency and resource utilization rate in disaster management.

title_en: On-site intelligent emergency broadcasting multi-program exchange control device consisting of 1:1 customized live emergency broadcasting output signal and digital program conversion signal
title_ko: 1:1 맞춤형 라이브 비상방송출력신호·디지털 프로그램 전환신호로 이루어진 현장지능형 비상방송다중프로그램교환제어장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for exchanging and controlling an emergency broadcasting multi-program of an on-site intelligent type including a one-to-one-customized live emergency broadcasting output signal and digital program conversion signal, which can minimize loss of lives. The device of the present invention comprises: an on-site intelligent type emergency broadcasting multi-program exchange control module (100); and a digital network program (DNP) exchange module (200) connected to the on-site intelligent type emergency broadcasting multi-program exchange control module (100) through a network.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 종래 프로그램 교환기의 경우에 획일적인 비상방송만을 송출하기 때문에 재난발생위치와 대피경로, 그리고 다양한 재난발생(지진, 연기, 불꽃, 가스, 미세먼지)에 따른 맞춤형 비상방송이 없어, 비상방송 시스템의 대피 안내 신뢰도, 실효성이 떨어져 긴급피난 및 신속대처가 어렵고, 선로 포설에 대한 물적, 인적 부담이 큰 문제점과, 지진, 화재로 인한 재난발생시, 전원장치가 단락되거나 단선되어 비상구 위치 또는 출입구 위치에 대한 대피경로 안내방송까지 멈추게 되는 경우에, 어둡고 깜깜한 실내에서 비상구 위치 또는 출입구 위치를 찾지 못해 우왕좌왕하거나, 긴급대피를 못해 질식사하는 등 인명피해가 많이 발생되는 문제점을 개선하고자, 현장지능형 비상방송다중프로그램교환제어모듈(100), DNP(Digital Network Program) 익스체인저모듈(200)로 구성됨으로서, 특정된 공간의 구조에 정확하게 부합하는 특정대피경로 + 재난발생위치정보 + 재난발생에 맞는 비상안내방송멘트로 이루어진 1:1 맞춤형 라이브 비상방송을 제공할 수 있어, 비상방송 시스템의 대피 안내 신뢰도, 실효성을 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 이로 인해 재난사고로 인한 인명피해를 최소화할 수 있고, 인터넷 프로토콜을 활용하여 동일한 네트워크망 내에서 고유한 장치식별번호를 통해 연결 및 구성이 가능하여 선로 포설에 대한 물적, 인적 부담을 기존에 비해 60% 이상으로 줄일 수가 있으며, 사용자가 별도의 인터넷 프로토콜에 대한 설정을 하지 않아도 동일한 네트워크망에 위치한다면 자동으로 고유한 장치식별번호를 통해 연결이 되는 시스템의 특성상 설치기간을 기존에 비해 1.5배~2배 더 빠르게 할 수 있는 1:1 맞춤형 라이브 비상방송출력신호·디지털 프로그램 전환신호로 이루어진 현장지능형 비상방송다중프로그램교환제어장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Device for establishing communications interoperability at an incident site including means for recording crisis incidents
abstract_en: What is provided is recording capability for each of the modules utilized by the first responders and other personnel within the area of the incident, with the stored information at each of the first responders' modules being read out through the ad hoc network, where it can be uploaded to storage. The stored information can be displayed at an incident commander work station in real time to give the incident commander a realistic view of the timeline and the severity of the incident, as well as the response. The use of the ad hoc network permits offloading stored information from each of the first responders' modules so as to free up storage within the modules. By providing storage at every node of the ad hoc network, one has access to a timeline of the actions at the incident as well as redundancy, which enhances the memories and observational skills of the first responders. Incident reporting is made complete due to the fact of all recordings being made available at one node on the temporary ad hoc network from which information reports and analysis can proceed, as well as subsequent training.
assignees: BAE SYS INF & ELECT SYS INTEG

title_en: Mobile communication rescue command vehicle
abstract_en: The mobile communication rescue command vehicle of the utility model, it include car body, and it is set to the compartment above car body, the utility model is equipped with power supply and distribution, communications exchange, warning lamp alarm, monitoring camera-shooting, the equipment such as air conditioning and telecommunication, make the utility model that there is powered lighting, disaster field video acquisition, transmission, processing, display, the functions such as radio data communication, the communication on remote mobile communication rescue command vehicle periphery can be achieved, a set of complete live emergency command communication network is formed by core of mobile communication rescue command vehicle, and energy Support, Command center is to the control and command of disaster field, it is advanced to form equipment, it is powerful, the mobile communication command system of flexible operation, it realizes any time, it quickly networks with command centre in any place, voice is carried out with command centres at different levels in real time, data, image it is more Media realizes the multi-functional dispatch controls such as control, exchange, decision, inquiry, record.
assignees: BEIJING BEIDA JADE BIRD SAFETY SYSTEM ENGINEERING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Building blocks module recognition device based on it is infrared
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a building block module identification device based on infrared, which comprises a bottom shell, a face shell, a programming instruction block, an infrared geminate transistor sensor, an infrared identification circuit board, a mainboard, a limit switch and a battery; the face shell is provided with a counter bore for placing a programming command block, one side of the bottom shell is provided with a sliding chute, and the bottom shell is internally provided with a sliding rail, a battery, a main board and two limit switches; the infrared identification circuit board is arranged on the guide rail through a sliding groove on the side part of the bottom shell, the bottom of the programming instruction block is provided with an instruction code, and the programming instruction block is placed on a counter bore of the face shell; during operation, the infrared identification circuit board is pushed to reciprocate left and right on the guide rail, and the command codes of the programming command blocks placed on the panel shell can be sequentially identified and recorded through the counter bores during movement; the push rod touches a limit switch trigger circuit on any side to complete one round of infrared identification and start to execute programming action. The utility model discloses the dependable performance reduces programming instruction block cost when, reduces recognition device's cost.
assignees: SHENZHEN MATA CHUANGXIANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for processing emergency dispatching command data for urban rail transit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for processing emergency dispatching command data for an urban rail transit. The method comprises the steps of before an accident fault happens, reducing probability of a major accident fault through a reliable pre-warning technology; after the accident fault happens, directly guiding and dispatching an administrator to publish an emergency disposal and rescue dispatching command to a travelling watchman terminal and a driver terminal; and publishing accident fault information to a passenger, wherein the device comprises a driver terminal, a travelling dispatcher terminal, a passenger terminal, a server terminal and a secondary server. In comparison with the prior art, the method and the device have the advantages of capability of effectively improving timeliness of emergency dispatching of the urban rail transit under emergency, ensuring operation safety of accident duration, and improving emergency service quality of the rail transit to the passenger.

title_en: A kind of public bicycles intelligent dispatching system region partitioning method based on k-means algorithms
abstract_en: The invention belongs to public transport scheduling fields, propose a kind of public bicycles intelligent dispatching system region partitioning method based on k means algorithms, applied to the region division of city public bicycle intelligent dispatching system, the area division scheme of demand absolute value summation minimum is obtained.This method specific steps include：Step 1. carries out region division using k means algorithms to public bicycles website；Step 2. counts the dispatching requirement amount of each website；Step 3. carries out second zone division to the marginality website in region of the scheduling demand absolute value more than 20；Step 4. generates final area division scheme.The present invention takes full advantage of the geographical location of website and the dispatching requirement amount of website, consider the auto-flowability of bicycle system, to public bicycles dispatcher-controlled territory classifying rationally, ensure that more regions just can not meet scheduling in region, the generation of trans-regional scheduler task is reduced, the timeliness of scheduling can be improved.

title_en: Oil-immersed transformer oil-draining foam-injecting simulation test device and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an oil-immersed transformer oil-draining foam-injecting simulation test device and a method, wherein the device comprises a simulation transformer, a control system, an oil-injecting system and a simulation oil-draining foam-injecting system, the simulation transformer is respectively connected with the oil-injecting system and the simulation oil-draining foam-injecting system through pipelines, the control system is respectively electrically connected with the oil-injecting system and the simulation oil-draining foam-injecting system, the control system sends out a corresponding control instruction and records related data in the test process, and the oil-injecting system receives the oil-injecting instruction of the control system and executes the instruction and performs oil-injecting operation; the simulation oil drainage and foam injection system receives an oil drainage and foam injection command of the control system and executes the command to drain oil and inject foam; the invention has the advantages that: through simulating the oil discharge and foam injection condition of the oil discharge and foam injection system, the actual fire condition of the transformer is reduced, the development rule of the fire in the transformer is accurately known, and the development of a fire-fighting system which can quickly suppress internal fire by using low fire-fighting media is facilitated.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENCE RES INST OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ANHUI XINLI ELEC TECH CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for identifying vulnerability of urban public transport network, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent transportation, and discloses a method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium for identifying the vulnerability of an urban public transportation network, namely, automatically calculating index values of the urban public transportation network on various static vulnerability indexes and various dynamic vulnerability indexes based on public transportation topology network data of the urban public transportation network and vehicle operation data and passenger flow collection data of all bus lines recorded when an urban public safety incident occurs, then judging whether the urban public transportation network, each bus stop, each inter-bus line and each bus line are the vulnerability of the urban public transportation network according to the comparison result of the index values and a preset index threshold value, forming a quantifiable vulnerability identification scheme capable of matching the development and evolution characteristics of the urban public safety incident, ensuring the accuracy of the final identification result, and further providing scientific decision basis for determining the guarantee point of an urban public transportation emergency plan, is convenient for practical application and popularization.

title_en: Production emergency command management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a production emergency command management system and a method, comprising the following steps: the monitoring platform is connected with an intelligent individual soldier and is connected with a monitoring module; the monitoring platform comprises a data module, the data module is connected with a decision module, and the data module is connected with a task module; the monitoring platform is used for monitoring the state of the equipment in the production process, and the monitoring platform can be used for carrying out centralized processing on monitoring information of all the equipment, so that all the equipment can be monitored in real time through the monitoring platform, and the convenience of production emergency command management is improved; the intelligent individual soldier is a portable device of operation and maintenance personnel, can record the state of the device in the operation and maintenance process, and sends field information to a designated receiving end, so that the maintenance efficiency management efficiency is improved; the decision module is used for carrying out early warning according to the monitoring information and determining a strategy for issuing an emergency task by the task adjusting module; the production management process can be displayed in a centralized manner, and centralized scheduling is facilitated.
assignees: GUONENG BEILUN NO 1 POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Offshore emergency mobilization command platform system and processing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore emergency mobilization command platform system and a processing method, and relates to the technical field of offshore command platform systems; comprising the following steps: a data collection unit: the method comprises the steps of collecting marine environment data and ship dynamic information in real time by utilizing satellite remote sensing, a ship automatic identification system and a meteorological station multisource information collecting means; and the data processing and analyzing module is used for: the machine learning algorithm is applied to process a large amount of data, including marine environment change trend analysis and abnormal behavior detection, and a visual report is generated for reference of a decision maker. The system of the invention realizes the omnibearing real-time monitoring of marine environment and ship dynamics by integrating satellite remote sensing, AIS and meteorological station multi-metadata sources; the accuracy and timeliness of the information are ensured by data preprocessing and real-time monitoring; by using the isolated forest and HNNPM model, the system can quickly and accurately identify potential risks and abnormal behaviors, and conduct deep analysis and prediction, so that scientific basis is provided for decision making.

title_en: Armored car driving training system based on man-machine interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an armored car driving training system based on man-machine interaction, which relates to the technical field of armored car training, wherein in the training process, collaborative operation data among commanders, drivers and blasters are monitored in real time, meanwhile, motion state data and shooting performance data of the blasters are monitored and recorded, and each key step in the training process is further ensured to be recorded and analyzed through real-time acquisition of the data; the collaborative operation analysis module constructs a coordination coefficient Xtxs according to the collaborative state set, and analyzes the response conditions of the driver and the blaster under the command of the commander in a quantized expression form; the shooting analysis module analyzes the shooting precision under different motion states, comprehensively obtains a shooting hit coefficient Smxs, can accurately evaluate the shooting level by analyzing the shooting performance of a gun, provides targeted improvement suggestions, and improves the overall shooting hit rate.

title_en: Method of preventing to escape car from a certain accident
title_ko: 도주차량사고를 방지하는 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method for preventing a getaway vehicle accident is provided to recognize accident generation according to collision size by transmitting collision quantity of constant size. CONSTITUTION: External impact is measured. Impact strength is converted into current impact. If the detected impact value is greater than a first threshold, the detected impact value is stored in an internal record apparatus of a vehicle. If the sensed impact value is greater than a second threshold, the sensed impact value is recorded in the internal record apparatus and transmitted to a central system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차체에 내재한 충격 감지 장치를 이용하여 임계 이상의 충격크기를 중앙시스템에 전송함으로써 오늘날 늘어나고 있는 도주차량사고를 방지하는 방법이다.  뺑소니 교통사고는 교통사고 피해자에 대하여 교통사고 현장에서 필요한 조치를 취하지 않고 도주함으로 인하여 생명, 신체에 위험을 가중할 뿐만 아니라 민사법적인 피해보상을 어렵게 함으로써 피해 당사자뿐만 아니라 피해자의 가족들에게조차 정신적, 물질적 피해를 가중한다. 상기 발명은 차체에 내재한 충격 감지 장치(1)를 이용하여 임계 이상의 충격크기를 중앙시스템(5)에 전송하는 방법으로서, (a) 외부충격을 측정하는 단계와, (b) 충격 세기를 전류 세기로 전환하는 단계와, (c) 상기 충격 감지 장치를 통하여 감지된 충격 값이 미리 지정된 임계값 1 이상인지 판단하는 단계와, (d) 상기 감지된 충격 값이 상기 임계값 1 이상이면 내부기록장치(4)에 기록하는 단계와, (e) 상기 감지된 충격 값이 상기 임계값 2 이상이면 기록 및 중앙 시스템(5)에 전송하는 단계를 포함한 외부 충격 기록 및 전송을 이용한 교통사고에 대한 정보를 파악하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면, 작은 충격량에 대해서는 차량 내부기록장치(4)에 단순히 저장만 하고 일정 크기 이상의 충격량에 대해서는 기록과정을 포함하여 중앙시스템(5)에 충격정보를 전송시키게 된다. 충격정보에는 충격발생시기와 발생장소, 충격의 크기, 충격감지장치를 내재한 차량의 번호, 소유주 등이 포함되어 있다. 충격정보에 포함된 발생장소에 관한 정보는 GPS가 탑재된 차량에 대해서만 전제되며 GPS를 포함하지 않은 차량에 대해서는 발생장소를 제외한 정보만이 중앙시스템으로 발신된다. 이렇게 발신된 충격정보로부터 외부 충격 기록 및 전송장치를 구비한 자동차에 대하여 충격크기에 따른 사건발생 여부를 파악할 수 있게 된다. 이는 뺑소니와 같은 차량범죄 발생 시 유력한 증거물로 채택될 수 있으며 소방서와 병원 등의 기관에 걸려오는 신고전화의 진위나 긴급 정도를 파악할 수 있는 정보로써도 사용될 수 있다. 또한, 충격정보가 중앙시스템(5)에 전송된다는 사실을 차량운전자가 인식함으로써 뺑소니를 줄일 수 있고 충돌에 대한 기록을 통해 보험금이나 중고차매매가격을 설정함으로써 운전자에게 경각심을 불러일으켜 차량사고를 줄일 수 있는 계기가 될 수 있다.

title_en: Canine emergency alert system
abstract_en: An emergency alert system and method of operation are provided. The system includes an emergency alert pad configured to detect a pad activation by a service animal and communicate a pad alert in response. An emergency alert vest is worn by the service animal and is configured to detect a vest activation by a person in proximity and communicate a vest alert in response. A user mobile device is in communication with the emergency alert pad and vest and is configured to record a pre-recorded message. At least one affiliated mobile device is configured to receive the pre-recorded message during the pad activation and the vest activation. An emergency response center is in communication with the emergency alert pad and the emergency alert vest and is configured to receive at least one of the pad alert and the vest alert and provide emergency services accordingly.

title_en: Portable recording device multimedia classification system
abstract_en: This disclosure describes an apparatus and system for classifying audio and video data captured by a portable recording device. The portable recording device may comprise of a camera system enclosure that captures audio and video data that reflects a user's point-of-view perception of their surroundings. The video and/or audio data may be transmitted in real-time, or near real-time, to a Central Multimedia Management (CMM) System at a Network Operations Center, or one or more mobiles computing devices, via one or more networks. Alternatively, or additionally, the video and/or audio data may be stored within memory of the portable recording device. This disclosure further describes a CMM system that may act as a central repository of multimedia data from one or more portable recording device(s). The CMM system may further generate and assign incident report forms for each individual instance of real-time data that is recorded by a portable recording device.
assignees: WHP WORKFLOW SOLUTIONS INC;GETAC TECHNOLOGY CORP

title_en: Recording device for historical events
abstract_en: The utility model aims at solving the problem of historical incident record study, disclose a recorder for historical incident, the mounting panel comprises a mounting plate, the bracing piece is installed to the mounting panel bilateral symmetry, bracing piece lower extreme fixed mounting has the base, second motor and first motor are installed respectively to the mounting panel surface left and right sides, the second pivot is equipped with to second motor upside, the even cover in second pivot surface is equipped with the second carousel, first pivot is equipped with to first motor upside, the even cover in first pivot surface is equipped with first carousel, be connected with the conveyer belt between first carousel and the second carousel, the inside even cover of conveyer belt is equipped with the balloon. The utility model discloses a mode to the inflation and deflation of balloon can realize depositing the record of historical incident to can reduce the occupation space of data, can not observe historical incident under the state of shrivelled moreover, also further can train the memory to historical incident.

title_en: A kind of emergency communication command car and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency communication command car, the vehicle body top is equipped with mounting platform, which is provided with exceedingly high line, PTZ camera, night light and stroboscopic lamp in quiet；The vehicle body tail portion is equipped with Pneumatic lifting arm, and top is equipped with lightning rod；Carriage body is equipped with driver's cabin and communication and command room in the vehicle, and the driver's cabin is equipped with main driving seat, passenger seat and driver behavior device, display device and navigator；The communication and command room includes communication and command platform and communication and command seat, the communication and command platform is equipped with microphone, liquid crystal display and supervisory keyboard display, shock absorption case is installed under the communication and command platform, main controller, vehicle-mounted hard disk videocorder, vehicle radio station, printing device, stereo set and electrical apparatus control equipment are installed in the shock absorption case.Compact-sized, system function integrated level is high, and unitize management and operation, has flexible performance, can obtain field data in time, improve the accuracy and timeliness of decision.
assignees: ZHONGKE XINGDI OPTOELECTRONIC TECH QIDONG CO LTD

title_en: Medical first-aid system and first-aid method thereof
abstract_en: The medical first-aid system comprises a vehicle-mounted end, a workstation, a medical care end and a big data visualization platform; the vehicle-mounted end can be used for establishing or acquiring pre-hospital emergency event information acquired from a 120 emergency command center in a networking manner, recording departure time node information, patient basic information, patient symptom types and patient evaluation information, and selecting a proper early warning hospital according to the evaluation result of the patient, the position information of the patient, the treatment capacity of a nearby hospital and the bed condition; in conclusion, the invention carries out relevant diagnosis and treatment on the emergency patients arriving at the pre-hospital routes, ensures that the patients can be timely and stably treated, shortens the waiting time for treatment of the pre-hospital patients, improves the prognosis level of the pre-hospital patients and improves the treatment rate of the patients.
assignees: WUXI ZIYUN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent investigation robot for emergency
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent robot for carrying out early warning and research after accident (fire), which comprises four main parts, namely a fire sensor module, an intelligent alarm module, a voice investigation module and a data analysis module. The fire sensor can detect physical phenomena such as flame, smoke, heat and the like, so as to realize fire alarm; the intelligent alarm module can not only give an early warning to surrounding people when a fire disaster occurs, but also directly tap 119 at the first time of the fire disaster; the voice investigation module carries out voice investigation on the masses in the fire scene, and the investigation is carried out on the problems of fire occurrence time, alarm time hearing, fire occurrence reason knowing and the like; after the voice survey content is converted into text analysis, a fire incident analysis report can be directly obtained. The intelligent robot also has the functions of shooting and recording, and can completely monitor the scene of fire.
assignees: SHANGHAI VOICECOMM INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en: The invention relates to a real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer for mobile assets, comprising a data encoder, an onboard data manager and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores compressed records of the data in the local memory module at least once per second. DARS is designed to operate in near real-time mode, storing a complete record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once every second and up to once every tenth of a second. The remotely located user may: viewing video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides faster emergency responses; verifying the effectiveness of the repair and rerouting; and monitor panelist performance and safety.

title_en: Power system dispatching instruction safety evaluation system and evaluation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power system dispatching instruction safety evaluation system and an evaluation method thereof, wherein the evaluation system comprises a dispatching instruction acquisition module, a power grid parameter acquisition module, a dispatching simulation model and a model updating module; the evaluation method comprises the following steps: A. the dispatching instruction acquisition module acquires dispatching instructions, and the power grid parameter acquisition module acquires real-time parameters of a power grid; B. the scheduling simulation model carries out system simulation operation on the collected scheduling instructions and outputs a judging result; C. and the model updating module updates the model parameters according to the scheduling instruction and the real-time parameters of the power grid. The invention can improve the defects of the prior art and improve the accuracy and timeliness of model simulation judgment.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multimedia man-machine interaction platform based on mixed reality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimedia man-machine interaction platform based on mixed reality, which relates to the technical field of scene security simulation, and the invention acquires and processes multi-mode sensor data in real time through a context awareness system, dynamically generates and adjusts a virtual scene, so that the virtual scene is consistent with a real environment, and the context awareness and response capability is improved; the virtual information is overlapped in a real environment through a virtual and reality fusion system, so that augmented reality AR guidance and immersive virtual exercise are provided, and the sense of reality and actual combat effect of the exercise are improved; analyzing user operation data, environmental changes and historical cases in real time, providing real-time decision support and optimization suggestions, and remarkably improving; the accuracy and timeliness of the emergency response; the method solves the problem that the traditional static training mode for fire disaster in the prior art cannot simulate dynamic change and emergency, so that users cannot deal with the deficiency in the actual scene.
assignees: BEIJING ANJIU QIUSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ocean emergency scheduling method and system based on interaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, in particular to an interactive marine emergency scheduling method and system, which comprise the following steps: receiving the dispatching information of the offshore platform, screening the favorable information, unifying information formats, reprogramming the information structure according to a public protocol, verifying the emergency level and the integrity of the information, and generating a standardized dispatching instruction. In the invention, through carrying out detail level analysis and task classification on the standardized dispatching instruction content, proper priority codes are allocated for each task, the sequential management of task execution is promoted, the priority mapping table is used for sorting the task sequence, the task urgency change is responded, the required resources are accurately identified, the resource allocation is carried out according to the task target requirement, the resource utilization efficiency is improved, the starting and finishing time of the task is recorded in real time, the task state is updated in time, the management flow is made transparent, the low-efficiency factors are identified through analyzing the task execution record, and the future task dispatching and resource allocation are optimized.
assignees: NAT MARINE DATA AND INFORMATION SERVICE

title_en: Intelligent power management module of ship computer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power management, in particular to an intelligent power management module of a ship computer. The system comprises a data acquisition processing unit: for collecting power consumption data of the vessel; the central storage unit is used for storing the data of the data acquisition processing unit and the fault event information of the fault detection unit; the fault detection unit is used for immediately responding and recording fault event information when an abnormal condition is detected; the intelligent distribution control unit is used for generating the power requirement of the current subsystem and the priority of the subsystem according to the historical data and the real-time data, and dynamically adjusting the distribution of the power supply to the system; control instruction execution unit: for converting the calculated power distribution scheme into specific control instructions. The intelligent power management module of the ship computer can meet the operation requirements under different conditions, effectively save energy sources, and enhance the emergency response and self-protection capability of the ship under special conditions.
assignees: HENAN SHENLAN JINGXING PHOTOELECTRIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Model construction-based data security risk assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data security, and discloses a data security risk assessment method based on model construction, the method comprises the steps of firstly collecting multi-dimensional data such as historical data security events, related system configuration, network architecture and the like, and preprocessing to form a normalized data set. Then, a data security risk prediction model is constructed, and future possible data security events and potential influences thereof are predicted by combining multidimensional factors. And acquiring data such as system state, network flow and the like in real time, inputting a prediction model, and acquiring a risk prediction result. Meanwhile, a risk influence assessment framework is established, the severity, occurrence frequency and business influence of risks are comprehensively considered, and a risk comprehensive score is calculated. Finally, the risks are sorted according to the scores, and corresponding risk mitigation measures and emergency response plans are formulated and implemented for the high risk and medium risk data assets. The invention improves the accuracy and timeliness of data security risk assessment.
assignees: BEIJING GUOXIN CHENGYAN SCIENCE AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: Dangerous source investigation and early warning method and device for safety management of chemical dangerous chemicals
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, in particular to a dangerous source investigation and early warning method and device for safety management of chemical industry dangerous chemicals, which comprises the steps of collecting field sensor data, safety inspection records and accident report data from chemical enterprises; and inputting the expanded chemical production data into a pre-constructed dangerous source investigation and early warning model, and carrying out dangerous level classification prediction on the chemical production data through the dangerous source investigation and early warning model to determine a dangerous classification result. The method has the advantages of realizing rapid and accurate identification of potential hazard sources in the environment of the chemical plant, improving the efficiency and accuracy of emergency response, ensuring the continuity and safety of chemical production by the real-time data processing capability, reducing the risk of artificial judgment errors and enhancing the timeliness of preventive and control measures.
assignees: SHANDONG TRANS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for editing (a) saving image of (an) image display device
title_ko: 영상표시기기의 저장영상 편집장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus for editing a stored image of an image display device are provided to implement an edit play mode for collecting and playing only an edited video separately, thereby satisfying conditions that a user wants as freely moving between record play and edit play only through a simply key input process. A storage medium(126) stores a video which a user is desired to see. A user inputs a desired command through a user interface(106). A controller(102) enable an input video to be stored in the storage medium by the user request command inputted through the user interface, plays of the video stored in the storage medium, edit, and play of the edited section. A video signal processor(128) enables the video signal to be displayed by a control signal of the controller. A display unit(136b) displays the video, stored video and edited video processed by the video signal processor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재기록이 가능한 저장매체를 갖는 영상표시기기에서 녹화된 영상의 편집 및 편집된 구간만의 재생이 가능하도록 한 것이다. 
     즉, 본 발명은 녹화된 프로그램을 재생하여 편집하고자 할 경우 녹화재생을 위한 모드와는 별개로 편집된 영상만을 취합하여 재생할 수 있도록 한 편집재생모드를 별도로 구현할 수 있도록 함으로써 간단한 키 입력만으로 녹화재생과 편집재생을 자유로이 이동하며 사용자가 원하는 조건을 만족시킬 수 있다. 
     따라서 본 발명에 따른 영상표시기기의 저장영상 편집장치 및 방법은 녹화된 프로그램에서 편집하고자 하는 부분을 편집한 후 편집된 부분만을 따로 확인할 수 있으며, 간단한 키 입력만으로 녹화재생 및 편집재생을 이동할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 편집된 구간에서 편집구간의 수정이 용이하므로 사용자가 원하는 최적의 상태로 편집이 가능하므로 사용자 편의성을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
       
     녹화/재생

title_en: System and method for open door-lock automatically in case of accident
title_ko: 재난 상황 발생시 도어락의 잠금 모드를 자동으로 해제하는시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for automatically releasing a lock mode of a door lock in case of a disaster are provided to let residents get out of a building by detecting a disaster through various sensors by a home server and then keeping the digital door lock opened. A method for automatically releasing a lock mode of a door lock in case of a disaster by detecting a disaster generated in the house through a home server remotely controlling the digital door lock comprises steps for receiving disaster sensing data from a connected sensor(S410); generating a manual mode change signal for changing setting/releasing of the lock mode of the digital door lock into a manual mode and transmitting the manual mode change signal to the digital door lock(S440); generating and transmitting a lock mode release command for releasing the lock mode of the digital door lock, to the digital door lock(S450); judging whether a release finishing signal is transmitted from the digital door lock or not, and repeatedly executing the third step if the release finishing signal is not transmitted(S460,S462); and keeping the lock mode of the digital door lock in a release state until a disaster cancellation signal is input, and changing the lock mode setting/releasing mode of the digital door lock into an auto mode if the disaster cancellation signal is input(S470,S480,S490).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난 상황 발생시 도어락의 잠금 모드를 자동으로 해제하는 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 센서로부터 재난 감지 데이터를 수신되면, 수동 모드 변경 신호 및 잠금 모드 해제 명령을 생성하고 디지털 도어락으로 전송하여 잠금 모드를 해제시키며, 재난 발생 해지 신호가 입력되면 디지털 도어락을 자동 모드로 변경하는 디지털 도어락의 잠금 모드 해제 방법을 제공한다. 또한, 본 발명은 디지털 도어락과의 무선 통신을 수행하는 무선 송수신부, 디지털 도어락의 모드 변경 및 잠금 모드 설정/해제 명령을 생성하는 도어락 처리부, 이동통신망으로 재난 발생 메시지의 전송을 요청하는 통신 모듈, 센서를 통해 재난 상황 발생을 감지하고, 홈 서버를 전반적으로 제어하는 제어부 및 디지털 도어락 제어 및 홈 서버의 운영 프로그램을 저장하는 메모리를 포함하는 홈 서버를 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 의하면, 거주자 댁내의 재난 상황 발생시 디지털 도어락을 열림 상태로 유지함으로써 인명 피해 및 재산 피해를 줄일 수 있고, 외부에서도 이동통신망을 통하여 재난 상황 발생을 확인할 수 있어, 빠른 조치를 취할 수 있다. 
       
     디지털 도어락, 재난 상황, 화재, 잠금 모드, 홈 서버, 홈 네트워크

title_en: Image generating apparatus and method therefor, and recording medium
title_ko: 화상 생성 장치 및 방법, 및 기록 매체
abstract_en: An image generating apparatus, a method thereof, and a recording medium are provided to be capable of smoothly moving the position of a viewing point of a virtual camera with existence of an obstacle between the position of the viewing position of the virtual camera and the position of a subject avoided. A sound processing unit(109) of a main body(101) is connected to a sound output device(125) that is a speaker, and a graphic process unit(111) is connected to a display device(121) having a display screen(122). Into a DVD/CD-ROM drive(113), a recording medium(131) can be loaded. A communication interface(115) is connected to a network(151). To an interface unit(117), an input unit(161) and a memory card(162) are connected. A control unit(103) includes a CPU(Central Processing Unit), a ROM(Read Only Memory), and the like. The control unit executes a program stored in an HDD(Hard Disk Drive)(107) or the recording medium and controls the main body. The graphic process unit expands image data into a frame memory(112) in accordance with a drawing command output from the control unit and outputs a video signal for displaying an image on a display screen(122) of the display device. The graphic process unit generates image data of a two-dimensional image acquired from performing a perspective transformation process for objects existing in a virtual three-dimensional space by using a virtual camera and records the image data in the frame memories. The direction of the viewing axis of the virtual camera is configured to be aligned forward the player character all the time. The DVD/CD-ROM drive reads out a program and data from the recording medium. The communication interface is connected to the network, and communicates with other computers. The input unit includes arrow keys and a plurality of operation buttons. The position of the player character in the virtual three-dimensional space is moved in accordance with a direction input by using the arrow keys of the input unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가상 카메라의 시점의 위치와 피사체의 위치 사이에 장해물이 존재해 버리는 것을 피하면서, 가상 카메라의 시점의 위치를 순조롭게 이동시키는 것을 과제로 한다. 
     가상 카메라의 시점(201)을 중심으로 하는 반경 R의 카메라 주변 영역(301)과, 가상 카메라의 시축(視軸; 203)이 향하는 피사체(202)를 중심으로 하는 반경 r의 피사체 주변 영역(302)과, 그 사이의 원뿔대의 영역으로 이루어지는 카메라 피사체 간 영역(303)을, 장해물이 존재할 수 없는 카메라 콜리젼(camera collision; 300)으로서 설정한다. 가상 카메라의 시점(201)의 위치는, 피사체(202)의 이동에 추종하여 이동하고, 카메라 콜리젼(300)에 장해물이 존재하면 거리 D가 기준 거리 D s 보다도 짧아지는 위치로 이동되지만, 카메라 주변 영역(301)의 반경 R과 피사체 주변 영역(302)의 반경 r은, 가상 카메라의 시점(201)의 위치와 피사체(202) 사이의 거리 D가 기준 거리 D s 보다도 짧아지면, 기준 거리 D s 에 있어서의 반경 R, r의 표준치 R s , r s 보다도 작아진다.

title_en: Advertisement-system in the mobile messenger screen
title_ko: 모바일 문자 화면에서 제공되는 지도 제공 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention includes: a terminal having a display and an input unit; and a server providing a service for transmitting and receiving text through the terminal, wherein the server and the terminal are connected via the internet; a program of the service which transmits and receives text is executed through the terminal; the terminal may be divided into a first terminal and a second terminal, wherein when a selection command receiving a map providing system is inputted through the input unit of the first terminal and command designating information of a second terminal which is the target terminal is inputted, the input information is transmitted to the server, and the information is stored in a database of the server; the server transmits service information of the map providing system to the second terminal, and in the case of wanting to be served with the map providing system, destination information can be inputted through the input unit of the first or second terminal, wherein an authorized disclosure and an unauthorized disclosure exist in a method of which the locations of the first and second terminals are displayed, generally reducing the screen size of the display. In the small-sized screen, while using a mobile messenger, the system provides location information and destination information effectively and efficiently between users.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 디스플레이 및 입력장치가 구비된 단말기 및 상기 단말기를 통하여 문자를 송수신하는 서비스를 제공하는 서버가 구비되고, 상기 서버와 상기 단말기는 인터넷을 통하여 연결되며, 상기 휴대 단말기를 통하여 문자를 송수신 하는 서비스의 프로그램이 실행되고, 상기 단말기는 제 1 단말기와 제 2 단말기로 구분될 수 있고, 상기 제 1 단말기의 입력장치를 통하여 지도 제공 시스템을 서비스 받는 선택 명령이 입력되고, 상대가 되는 제 2 단말기 정보를 지정하는 명령도 입력되면, 상기 입력 정보는 서버에 전송되고, 서버의 데이터 베이스에는 상기 정보가 저장되고, 상기 서버는 제 2 단말기에 지도 제공 시스템 서비스 정보를 전송하고, 지도 제공 시스템을 서비스 받고자 할 경우 목적지 정보도 제 1 혹은 제 2 단말기 입력장치를 통하여 입력될 수 있고, 제 1 단말기와 제 2 단말기의 위치가 표시되는 방식으로, 승인 공개와 비 승인 공개가 존재하므로서, 일반적으로 모바일 디스플레이는 화면 크기가 작게 된다, 이러한 작은 화면 크기 내에서, 모바일 메신저를 사용하는 동안에도 사용자 상호간에 위치 정보와 목적지 정보를 효과적면서도 효율적으로 제공하기 위한 시스템을 개발하기 위한 것이다.

title_en: Emergency Response Center
abstract_en: The present invention is an Emergency Response Center (ERC) which provides a variety of emergency and information functions in public environments. The ERC operates in a number of modes, including Information Mode, Emergency Response Mode, Security Mode, and Surveillance Mode. The Emergency Response Center functions are software selectable on a large video touch screen. A video screen displays emergency information to users and allows videoconferencing with various authorities as well as any individuals that own the account and apparatus. News, maps, weather, store directories, and other non-emergency information are also displayed by the ERC. The ERC can conduct surveillance of passersby using video cameras configured to stream and record the area in the vicinity of the ERC. The ERC can also scan employee IDs, capture employee facial images, and register employee data in the ERC database. An ERC server allows remote administration of the ERC.

title_en: System and method for driving condition detection and notification
abstract_en: A system for accident detection or detecting an unsafe driving condition in a vehicle including a device that measures and transmits at least one output signal; at least one remote device configured to receive, record, and/or display the at least one output signal from the device; a computing device configured to receive the at least one output signal from the device and display the at least one output signal in real-time; and a graphical user interface on the computing device that allows an emergency response professional to view and customize options for monitoring the at least one output signal, wherein the device, the at least one remote device, and the computing device are communicatively connected to each other via a communications network.

title_en: Network emergency response method, system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a network emergency response method, a system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target strategy set of a scene; the strategy controller executes the strategy in the target strategy set to obtain a first execution result, and a first tool mark set in the strategy is obtained according to data in the first execution result; the first tool mark set is sent to a tool library, so that the tool library calls a security script to obtain a second execution result, and the second execution result is returned to a recorder; the recorder analyzes the second execution result to obtain a first analysis result; the policy controller switches the scene and returns to the step of obtaining the target policy set for the scene. In the embodiment of the invention, the strategy is executed by the strategy controller, the execution result of the strategy is analyzed by the recorder, so that the problem that the decision needs to be made manually is solved, and the scene is switched according to the analysis result, so that the problem that the scene needs to be switched manually is solved.

title_en: Information gathering method and system based on network security threat
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network security, in particular to a method and a system for collecting information based on network security threat, comprising the following steps: based on the network security threat information, extracting network attacker and attack mode, identifying and classifying the attacker identification and the target type, and carrying out standardized processing on the data to obtain a standardized threat behavior data set. According to the invention, the security event log and the attack behavior information in the intrusion detection alarm are extracted, the main guest structure is analyzed, the data standardization is realized, the identification accuracy of the identity and the attack mode of an attacker is improved, the attack chain is integrated, the information consistency and the path identification accuracy are enhanced, the calculation of the target co-occurrence probability and the consistency weight is utilized, the event merging is optimized, the information redundancy is reduced, the time dependence relationship of the behavior nodes is analyzed, the similar attack path is induced, the identification capability of the attack mode is improved, the priority of the path is ordered according to the node weight value, the high-risk chain is screened, the emergency response is focused, and the security defense efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multi-watershed water environment pollution emergency protection system and method based on three-dimensional GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional GIS-based multi-river basin water environment pollution emergency protection system and method, and belongs to the technical field of water environment pollution emergency protection. The method comprises the steps of constructing a drainage basin database by using a three-dimensional GIS technology, obtaining turbidity data and average pollution concentration data of the drainage basin, unifying data acquisition periods, recording the turbidity data as period turbidity data and the average pollution concentration data as average pollution concentration period data respectively, calculating the change degree and the diffusion degree, designing a pollution index, calculating the comprehensive pollution index, a difference value and a correlation degree, presetting a threshold value, analyzing and outputting emergency protection early warning, rapidly identifying potential pollution events by calculating the change degree and the diffusion degree of different monitoring areas, providing scientific basis for timely emergency, improving multi-basin emergency response capability by a comprehensive pollution index calculation and early warning mechanism, helping related departments to rapidly react, avoiding pollution event diffusion, and effectively protecting water resources and ecological environment.

title_en: Urban area tunnel network dynamic cooperative scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic collaborative scheduling method and a dynamic collaborative scheduling system for a tunnel network in an urban area, which belong to the technical field of intelligent management of tunnel networks. The method adopts a space-time diagram multidimensional prediction method to carry out multidimensional prediction evaluation, performs unified modeling and short-time prediction on traffic operation, air environment, equipment state and emergency channel conditions in the tunnel network, can identify potential congestion points, pollution hot spots and high risk areas in advance, improves risk identification efficiency and accuracy, adopts a multi-objective optimization tunnel network intelligent scheduling method to carry out dynamic collaborative scheduling, realizes comprehensive balance of traffic smoothness, air quality and energy consumption, and improves the performability and emergency response timeliness of a scheduling strategy through layered optimization and emergency priority strategies on the premise of meeting safety constraint.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
Dc power supply device of earthquake recorder
title_ko: 지진관측 기록계의 직류전원 공급장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a DC power supply for a seismological observation data recorder. More specifically, the present invention is to prevent failures in recognizing desired signals due to neighboring electrical noise induced from an input terminal or around a device by supplying flawless DC power to a seismological observation data recorder which needs to filter and record signals from a sensor sensing fine natural or artificial signals. Furthermore, the recorder is protected from strong external impact currents such as a thunderbolt. In the present invention, the power to the recorder is supplied only from a battery so that AC noise, which is induced from the output terminal of a charger connected to AC power, is prevented from flowing into a line. By doing so, flawless DC power is supplied to the recorder, thereby resolving the problem of signal recognition failures due to neighboring electrical noise induced from the input terminal or around the device. As a result, quality observation data is achieved, and accidents due to analysis errors can be prevented. [Reference numerals] (100,200) Battery;(110,210) Relay unit;(120,220) Photo coupler;(130,230) Flip-flop circuit unit;(300) Seismometry recording meter;(400) Charger;(500) Power supply unit for controlling;(600) Clock pulse generating unit
abstract_ko:
