본 발명을 통해 지진관측 기록계를 작동시키는 전원은 오직 배터리만을 이용하게 함으로서 AC 전원으로부터 연결되어진 충전기의 출력단자로부터 유기되는 AC 잡음이 선로를 통하여 유입되는 것을 차단하여 지진관측 기록계에 완전한 DC전원을 공급하여 주변의 전기 잡음이 입력단자 혹은 기기 주변으로부터 유기되어 원하는 신호를 식별하는데 장애를 일으키는 문제를 해결하여 양질의 자료를 획득하여 오분석에 의한 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 효과를 제공하게 된다.

title_en: Address validation for personal emergency response systems
abstract_en: A server verifies that an address of record for a personal emergency response (PERS) device is in agreement with a current address of the PERS device. The PERS device has a docking station and a wearable unit. At start-up, the docking station places a call to the server and the server receives coordinates of the wearable unit. The coordinates are reverse-mapped into the current address and compared with the address of record. If the current address and the address of record differ, the address of record is updated to reflect the current address.
assignees: CHITRE MONICA ANILKUMAR;BATES PETER CHARLES;CELLCO PARTNERSHIP DBA VERIZON

title_en: Concrete cut-off wall detecting system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a concrete impervious wall detection system, which comprises an excitation generating mechanism for generating shallow earthquake on the wall top of a impervious wall, a wave detector for detecting excitation waves and a handheld electric control device, wherein the handheld electric control device is provided with a display screen and is connected with the wave detector through a circuit and used for displaying a detection result; the detector is arranged on the wall top of the impervious wall and is adjacent to the vibration excitation generating mechanism. The utility model can simply and conveniently generate and detect the shock wave at the impervious wall and observe the wave impedance at each part of the impervious wall; if a defect exists in the wall body of the impervious wall, the wave impedance value detected at the defect is changed necessarily, and the incident wave generates irregular reflection records at the defect. And the staff judges whether defects exist at each position of the impervious wall or not by observing the detected data characteristics.
assignees: HENAN WATER CONSERVANCY FIRST ENG BUREAU

title_en: Emergency command communication vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a special equipment vehicle, in particular to an emergency command communication vehicle. The emergency command communication vehicle comprises a vehicle body and vehicle-mounted systems, wherein the vehicle body is divided into a driving zone, an operating zone and an equipment zone from head to tail in sequence, and each functional block is isolated by an isolating door; and the vehicle-mounted systems are distributed inside or outside the three functional blocks. Quick networking with a command center at any time and at any place can be realized through various communication modes of satellite communication, wireless communication, wired communication, computer communication and the like and the configuration of a broadcasting sound amplifying platform, an audio video acquisition and processing platform, an image real-time transmission platform, a communication dispatching management platform and the like, the real-time multimedia communication interaction of voice, data and images with command centers at all levels is realized, the multifunction dispatching command of controlling, exchanging, decision making, querying, recording and the like is realized, and the requirements of real time performance and effectiveness of emergency rescue site communication command are satisfied.
assignees: WUXI BINDA IND ORIGINALITY DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: It is a kind of intelligently to inquest control system, console and its control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligence hearing control system, console and its control methods, including display terminal, information acquisition module, the display module connecting with display terminal, the communication module connecting with information acquisition module, the command centre connecting with communication module；Display module includes the notes confirmation screen for recording the notes display screen of hearing record, putting down for people being asked's real-time confirmation, and notes display screen, notes confirm that screen is connect with display terminal；Put down display screen and notes confirmation screen communication connection.Plurality of devices control is integrated on intelligence hearing console by the present invention, both guarantee the program and equipment requirement that meet public security hearing, in turn simplify operation when public security hearing, put down display screen and notes confirmation screen real-time synchronization, the problem of capable of finding policeman's interrogation record in time convenient for people being asked, the equity for having ensured people being asked also improves the efficiency that policeman handles a case.
assignees: HANGZHOU HENGBAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Event emergency method and device and emergency command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an event emergency method, an event emergency device and an emergency command system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining target emergency data corresponding to a target event in a source database corresponding to an emergency command system; synchronously acquiring target emergency data to a data analysis platform of an emergency command system; analyzing the target emergency data based on an analysis unit of the data analysis platform to obtain index data corresponding to the target event; and generating a visual page corresponding to the index data according to the index data and the predetermined geographic map corresponding to the target event. Therefore, the method and the device can improve the efficiency of collecting and processing the emergency data, and further improve the timeliness, the accuracy and the integrity of the emergency data, so that emergency personnel can intuitively and accurately obtain the change rule and the change trend of the index data and the relevance between the index data and other data in a short time, the reliability and the timeliness of determining an emergency plan according to the emergency data are improved, and property loss and casualties caused by an emergency are reduced.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL PLATFORM TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Cascade hydropower station long-term optimization scheduling model considering incoming water nonuniformity
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of hydropower dispatching operation, in particular to a cascade hydropower station long-term optimization dispatching model for considering water inflow nonuniformity. The invention aims at the hydropower stations with weak regulating capacity and low water heads in the cascade hydropower stations and the characteristic that the generating capacity of the low water head hydropower station is limited by the warehousing flow, fits the relationship between the warehousing flow and the generating output of each hydropower station and each month, and optimizes the load distribution among the cascade hydropower stations by taking the cascade generating capacity as the maximum target. Compared with the conventional method for carrying out long-term scheduling on the cascade hydropower station only by means of output coefficient calculation, the method can quickly give out a reasonable hydropower scheduling result and meet the requirements of timeliness and practicability of actual operation of the power grid.
assignees: GUANGXI GUIGUAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HONGSHUIHE JIKONG CENTER;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Solar energy pipeline construction safety management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a solar pipeline construction safety management system, which relates to the technical field of safety management, and is characterized in that a geological monitoring module is used for monitoring and predicting geological disaster risks in real time, so that the monitoring capability of the system to geological environments is improved, the occurrence of the geological disasters is effectively treated, a construction path is planned more scientifically by using a path planning algorithm and unmanned aerial vehicle inspection data, the occupation of construction space is reduced, the safety condition of a construction site is guaranteed, the real-time positioning and information transmission of constructors are realized in the aspect of emergency management, the timeliness and the effectiveness of emergency response are improved, meanwhile, a machine learning algorithm is used for accurately predicting faults, the accuracy and the reliability of fault prediction are improved, and potential safety hazards are conveniently found and solved in time.
assignees: BEIJING JIZHENG YUANDA GAS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mobile terminal remote control monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of remote monitoring, in particular to a mobile terminal remote control monitoring system and a mobile terminal remote control monitoring method. According to the invention, the change of network bandwidth can be responded in real time by dynamically adjusting video coding parameters, the stability and adaptability in data transmission are obviously enhanced, dynamic content and color change are accurately captured by analyzing video frames, and key events are immediately positioned and extracted, so that the speed and precision of emergency response are greatly improved, cognitive resources are dynamically allocated by utilizing video stream complexity evaluation, resource allocation is adjusted according to actual requirements, the monitoring quality is ensured, the resource utilization efficiency is optimized, the optimization of audio processing and real-time alarm strategy adjustment are ensured, the clear transmission and alarm timeliness of sound information are ensured, and the overall response capability and effect are improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN XIAOYING VISION INTELLIGENT CO LTD

title_en: Industrial firewall isolation method of DCS system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial firewall isolation method of a DCS system. Aims to solve the problem that the existing industrial network safety protection aims at the DCS system to be insufficient. The method comprises the steps of analyzing a DCS system architecture and evaluating risks, accurately determining protection key points and data flow directions, customizing firewall strategies which are attached to the characteristics of all areas (such as a core control unit, an operation station and an external network interface), and covering multiple data encryption mechanisms. And then performing firewall deployment and configuration optimization to ensure protection continuity and rule timeliness. The system recovery under the security event is ensured by a real-time monitoring and dynamic adjusting mechanism to timely cope with the abnormality and an emergency response and backup recovery mechanism. And a periodic safety exercise and evaluation mechanism is provided for continuously enhancing the protection capability. The invention comprehensively improves the network security level of the DCS system, ensures the stable and safe operation of industrial production, and has remarkable practical value.
assignees: YUHENG POWER STATION OF SHAANXI HUADIAN YUHENG COAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Multisource data fusion supervision system for geological disaster management engineering
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster engineering supervision, and particularly discloses a multi-source data fusion supervision system for geological disaster management engineering, which is characterized in that the real-time acquisition, multi-protocol analysis, high-precision time synchronization, advanced denoising, missing value interpolation, outlier filtering and preliminary feature extraction of data are realized at a data source end, so that the data quality and the real-time performance are remarkably improved, and the processing load of a central platform is reduced; the real-time state mapping of the physical world and the virtual space and the recognition and correction scheme matching of the abnormal result of the disaster management project realize the matching of the multistage early warning linkage and the automatic emergency plan, provide visual and comprehensive visual display and decision support, greatly improve the supervision efficiency, early warning accuracy and emergency response speed, provide reliable technical guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the geological disaster management project, and effectively reduce the disaster risk and economic loss.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR DADI ECOLOGICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Learning board
title_ko: 학습 보드
abstract_en: A learning board activating a brain is provided to stimulate a brain more through activity of a brain connected to the sense of sight of user by enable a user to hit the number of flickering frequency with a ball. A board is composed a numerical portion in which more than one number is written. A flickering unit(120) is equipped at the upper part of the board, and a sensor(130) is equipped in the flickering unit while having a vibration sensor detecting the vibration of the board. A flickering lighting unit(121) is turned on or not by setting of the sensor, and a sound occurrence sensor(132) generates sound according to the operation of the flickering unit.
abstract_ko:
본원 발명은 학습 보드에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 적어도 하나 이상의 숫자가 적혀있는 숫자부가 구비되어 있는 보드; 상기 보드의 상단면에 구비되어 있는 점멸부; 및 상기 점멸부에 구비되어 사용자가 던진 볼이 숫자부에 맞는 순간을 감지하는 진동감지센서가 구비되어 있는 감지부;를 포함하여 구성되는 것이다.

title_en: Ubiquitous guard system and service for infant
title_ko: 영ㆍ유아용 유비쿼터스 안전관리 시스템 및 서비스
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A ubiquitous safety management system and a service for an infant are provided to recognize the safety state of the infant continuously and transmit an instant alarm to the monitor in a dangerous situation. CONSTITUTION: A crib bottom supporting equipment(250) measures safety and health information. The emergency information is transmitted to a monitor through communication network. The weight signal of the objector is measured by the crib bottom supporting equipment. The crib bottom supporting equipment recognizes the paroxysm or spasm of the objector. The crib bottom supporting equipment measures an emergency situation or a safety state of the objector.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 영ㆍ유아를 위한 안전관리 시스템으로서 영ㆍ유아용 요람 및 모빌 형태의 기구에 장착되는 안전관리 시스템을 이용해 영ㆍ유아의 안전 상태를 측정하고 그 결과 또는(그리고) 그에 대한 해석(예를 들어 사고 발생 유무, 엎어져 자는 상황 검출)을 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크(USN)를 이용하여 감시자(부모 또는 의료진)의 감시용 단말기 혹은 중앙 감시시스템 서버에 전달하여, 영ㆍ유아의 안전관리를 위한 시스템과 그 서비스에 관한 것이다. 
      발명에 해당하는 시스템은 온도, 습도, 먼지농도, 무게, 소리 계측이 가능한 센서들의 조합과 지능형 알고리즘을 내장한 계측 장비이며, 그 형태는 영ㆍ유아용 침대에 장착 가능한 막대 형태 혹은 영ㆍ유아용 모빌 기구에 장착되는 형태와 영ㆍ유아 잠자리를 위한 잠자리 밑 받힘 형태이다.  
      안전감시 프로그램을 이용한 이벤트 분석(사고 발생 시 경고 신호 발생, 평상시 주기적인 측정)결과를 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크 기술을 이용하여 전송하며, 사용 환경(가정용, 병원용, 산후조리원용 등)에 따라 감시자(부모, 의료진, 보모 등)에게 휴대폰을 이용한 문자 메시지나 혹은 전용 단말기를 통한 경고 메세지를 송출하여, 영ㆍ유아의 상태에 따른 빠른 조치가 가능하도록 하여 그 결과 사망 가능성을 줄이거나 소생률을 향상시킨다. 
       
       영ㆍ유아 안전관리, 영ㆍ유아 돌연사 증후군(Sudden Infant Death Syndrome), 유비쿼터스 센서네트워크(USN), 영ㆍ유아 감시

title_en: System for forecasting power management
title_ko: 전력관리 예측 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A power management estimating system is provided to estimate connection and usage points of an uninterruptible power supply device for preventing power source accidents using existing database in which a power source used amount of corresponding electric power facilities is recorded. CONSTITUTION: A data collecting part(100) collects data for estimating load of corresponding electric power facilities. A data calculating part(200) calculates seasonal load used amount data according to climate and load used amount data which is used at the same period of the previous year based on climate data and load used amount data which is recently used. A load estimating part(300) estimates the load using the climate data, the seasonal load used amount data, and the load used amount data. A connection point estimating part(400) estimates connection and usage points with an uninterruptible power supply device using existing database. [Reference numerals] (100) Data collecting part; (200) Data calculating part; (300) Load estimating part; (400) Connection point estimating part
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전력관리 예측 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 전력설비의 기후정보를 포함하는 환경정보 및 부하 사용량을 바탕으로, 신경회로망을 이용하여 부하예측을 수행하며, 해당 전력설비의 전원 사용량이 기록된 기존의 데이터베이스를 이용하여 전원사고 방지를 위한 무정전 전원공급장치 등의 연결사용 시점을 예측하는 전력관리 예측 시스템을 제공함에 그 목적이 있다.  
이러한 목적을 달성하기 위한 본 발명은, 해당 전력설비의 부하 예측을 위한 데이터들을 수집하는 데이터 수집부; 상기 데이터 수집부를 통해 수집된 기후 데이터와 최근 사용한 부하 사용량 데이터를 바탕으로, 기후에 따른 계절적 부하 사용량 데이터 및 전년도 동일시기에 사용에 부하 사용량 데이터를 산출하는 데이터 산출부; 상기 데이터 수집부를 통해 수집한 기후 데이터, 상기 데이터 산출부를 통해 산출된 계절적 부하 사용량 데이터 및 전년도 동일시기에 사용된 부하 사용량 데이터를 이용하여, 부하를 예측하는 부하 예측부; 및 해당 전력설비의 전원 사용량이 기록된 기존의 데이터베이스를 이용하여, 전원사고 방지를 위한 무정전 전원공급 장치와의 연결사용 시점을 예측하는 연결시점 예측부; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Cargo vessel operator emergency response system, with operator directives, incident data recording and reporting
abstract_en: A method, computer program product, mobile communication device, and a shipment tracking system provide automated incident recording, reporting, and response protocols, including operator directives. The method includes receiving an input identifying an occurrence of an incident associated with a shipment entity, the shipment entity being one or more of a vessel, an operator, and a cargo being transported via the vessel. The method includes, in response to the input, presenting on a user interface (UI) of an operator mobile communication device (MCD) one or more selectable incident reporting options to activate incident response, data recording, and reporting (IRDRR) protocols. The method further includes generating and presenting an incident response UI that instructs the operator of specific sequence of steps to take in response to the incident and to complete an incident information gathering process. The method further includes automatically transmitting/uploading a notification of the incident to an incident management server.

title_en: Space-earth integrated search and rescue system airborne command solution based on intelligent handheld equipment
abstract_en: The space-earth integrated search and rescue system airborne command solution based on the intelligent handheld device is characterized in that the real-time altitude value is obtained every 0.5 seconds through the conversion relation between air pressure and altitude; then calculating the average parachute landing speed within 0.5 seconds according to the landing height difference before and after 0.5 seconds; then according to the time requirement of reporting or recording the instantaneous speed, the instantaneous speed of the current parachute information is equal to the sum of the average speeds of n past 0.5 s/0.5 n; according to the method, a signal is sent to the transfer device through the Lora technology arranged in the wristwatch worn by the parachuting personnel, information is transmitted to the command platform through the transfer device, so that the command platform can monitor the parachuting speed, position situation information, abnormal alarm, help seeking information and other conditions of the parachuting personnel in real time when in an empty drop under a public network-free environment, the command platform receives the obtained information to send a gathering instruction or a rescue instruction to the transfer device, and finally the transfer device transmits the instruction to the wristwatch worn by the parachuting personnel.

title_ko: 매연저감장치 사후관리 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 매연저감장치 사후관리 방법 및 시스템과 이를 위한 프로그램 기록매체에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 매연저감장치 사후관리 방법은, 매연저감장치 장착 차량에 구비된 단말장치에서 상기 매연저감장치를 회수해야 하는 원인 발생시, 상기 매연저감장치 회수 원인 정보-사고발생 정보 또는 장치 탈거 정보 등-를 기지국을 통해 중앙관제서버로 전송하는 제1단계와, 상기 중앙관제서버에서 상기 매연저감장치 회수 원인 정보(또는 상기 매연저감장치 회수 원인 정보에 대응하는 정보)와 상기 차량 정보를 매연저감장치 회수 기관 서버(또는 단말)와 매연저감장치 관리 기관 서버로 전송하는 제2단계와, 상기 매연저감장치 회수 기관을 통해 상기 차량의 매연저감장치가 회수되면, 상기 매연저감장치 회수 기관 서버(또는 단말)에서 상기 차량의 매연저감장치 회수 결과를 상기 매연저감장치 관리 기관 서버로 전송하는 제3단계와, 상기 매연저감장치 관리 기관 서버에서 상기 중앙관제서버에서 기 전송한 정보와 상기 매연저감장치 회수 기관 서버(또는 단말)에서 전송한 회수 결과를 비교하여, 상기 차량의 매연저감장치 회수 내역을 확인하는 제4단계 및 상기 확인결과, 상기 차량의 매연저감장치 회수가 정상적으로 이루어진 경우, 상기 매연저감장치 관리 기관 서버에서 상기 차량의 매연저감장치 회수 내역을 소정의 저장매체에 저장, 관리하는 제5단계를 포함한다.  
       
     매연, 저감, 회수, 관리

title_en: Mobile robot comprising input module for programming
title_ko: 프로그래밍 가능한 입력모듈을 포함하는 이동 로봇
abstract_en: A mobile robot according to an embodiment of the present invention is a mobile robot comprising a programmable input module, comprising: a processor controlling the mobile robot; an input module which is an input module receiving a command for programming of the mobile robot from a user, wherein the command for programming includes an action command related to operation for the mobile robot, a conditional command related to a condition to execute the action command, and a control command controlling the command inputted in the mobile robot; a sensor module which is a sensor module sensing changes in the periphery of the mobile robot, wherein the processor determines whether the condition to execute the action command is satisfied based on the sensing result of a sensor module; and an operational module operated corresponding to the action command inputted from the input module when the processor executes a command sequence including the command inputted from the input module. Here, the control command includes a repetitive command. The processor repeats execution of the action command inputted from the input module before the repetitive command is inputted.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 이동 로봇은, 프로그래밍이 가능한 입력모듈을 포함하는 이동 로봇으로서, 상기 이동 로봇을 제어하는 프로세서; 사용자로부터 상기 이동 로봇의 프로그래밍을 위한 명령어를 입력 받는 입력모듈로서, 프로그래밍을 위한 명령어는 상기 이동 로봇의 작동과 관련된 액션명령어, 상기 액션명령어를 실행하기 위한 조건과 관련된 조건명령어 및 상기 이동 로봇에 입력된 명령어를 제어하는 제어명령어를 포함하는 것인, 입력모듈; 상기 이동 로봇의 주변 변화를 감지하는 센서모듈로서, 상기 프로세서는 상기 센서모듈의 감지 결과에 기초하여 상기 액션명령어를 실행하기 위한 조건의 만족여부를 판단하는 것인, 센서모듈; 및 상기 프로세서가 상기 입력모듈로부터 입력된 명령어를 포함하는 명령어 시퀀스를 실행하는 경우, 상기 입력모듈로부터 입력된 상기 액션명령어에 따라 작동하는 작동모듈을 포함하고, 상기 제어명령어는 반복명령어를 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는 상기 반복명령어가 입력되기 전 상기 입력모듈로부터 입력된 상기 액션명령어의 실시를 반복한다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer-readable medium for predicting accident and tracing the flowing into foreign material path through monitoring of water treatment system
title_ko: 수처리 시스템의 모니터링을 통한 사고 예측 및 이상 물질 유입 경로 추적 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터 판독-가능 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for predicting an accident and tracking an abnormal material inflow path through monitoring a water treatment system. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for predicting an accident by monitoring a water treatment system comprises: a danger level setting step of collecting state information including material information, installation information, repair information, and accident history information of facility components making up a water treatment system to quantitatively analyze states of the facility components and set danger levels classified into preset classes for each facility component based on analysis results; an accident information providing step of supplying information of a facility component determined to have a high accident probability from the danger levels set to the facility components to a manager terminal; and a response strategy providing step of determining an accident point and an accident type when an accident occurs, and establishing an accident response strategy in accordance with determination results to supply the accident response strategy to the manager terminal. According to another embodiment of the present invention, the method for tracking an abnormal material inflow path by monitoring of a water treatment system comprises: a sensing step of sensing whether an abnormal material flows into a fluid from a sensor installed on one or more flow passages making up a water treatment system; and a tracking step of acquiring a position of a flow passage where an abnormal material is sensed when a flow of an abnormal material into the fluid is sensed in the sensing step, and selecting a flow passage with a high probability of an inflow of an abnormal material based on damage history information of flow passages adjacent to the acquired position of the flow passage to track the inflow path of abnormal material.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 수처리 시스템의 모니터링을 통한 사고 예측 및 이상 물질 유입 추적 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 수처리 시스템의 모니터링을 통한 사고 예측 방법은, 수처리 시스템을 구성하는 설비 부품의 자재 정보, 설치 정보, 보수 정보 및 사고 이력 정보를 포함하는 상태 정보를 수집하여 설비 부품의 상태를 정량적으로 분석하고, 분석 결과를 기초로 설비 부품마다 기 설정된 등급으로 분류된 위험 레벨을 설정하는 위험 레벨 설정 단계; 설비 부품에 설정된 위험 레벨로부터 사고 발생 가능성이 높은 것으로 판단되는 설비 부품의 정보를 관리자 단말로 제공하는 사고 예측 정보 제공 단계; 및 사고 발생 시, 사고 발생 지점 및 사고 유형을 판단하고, 관리자 단말에 판단 결과에 따른 사고 대응 전략을 수립하여 제공하는 대응 전략 제공 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.한편 본 발명의 다른 실시 예에 따른 수처리 시스템의 모니터링을 통한 이상 물질 유입 경로 추적 방법은, 수처리 시스템을 구성하는 하나 이상의 유로에 설치된 센서로부터 유체에 이상 물질이 유입되었는지 여부를 감지하는 감지 단계; 및 감지 단계에서 유체에 이상 물질이 유입된 것으로 감지될 시, 이상 물질이 감지된 유로의 위치를 파악하고, 파악된 유로의 위치에 인접한 유로들의 손상 이력 정보를 기초로 이상 물질의 유입 가능성이 높은 유로를 선별하여 이상 물질의 유입 경로를 추적하는 추적 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method, recording medium and system for calculating resional safety index using adjusted maximum value standardization
title_ko: 조정 최대값 표준화를 이용한 지역안전지수 산출 방법, 기록매체 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 조정 최대값 표준화를 이용한 지역안전지수 산출 방법에 관한 것으로, 재난 및 안전사고에 대한 지역의 안전지수 산출 방법에 있어서, (a) 해당년도 및 해당 지역의 지역안전지수 산출에 필요한 통계 데이터를 수집하고 구축하는 단계; (b) 상기 수집한 통계 데이터를 지역간 비교가 가능한 위해지표, 취약지표, 경감지표 및 의식지표를 포함하는 지표 데이터로 제1차 표준화하는 단계; (c) 상기 제1차 표준화된 지표 데이터 간 비교가 가능하도록 조정된 최대값을 이용하여 가중치 범위 내에서 영향력이 작용 가능하도록 제2차 표준화하는 단계; (d) 상기 제2차 표준화된 지표 데이터가 미리 설정된 범위를 벗어나는 이상치(outlier)를 약화 또는 제거하는 단계; (e) 상기 이상치가 약화 또는 제거된 제2 표준화된 지표 데이터 간 위해지표 증감에 미치는 영향력에 따른 가중치를 적용하는 단계; 및 (f) 상기 가중치가 적용된 지표 데이터를 바탕으로 안전지수 산출식을 이용하여 지역안전지수를 산출하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency response center
abstract_en: The present invention is an Emergency Response Center (ERC) which provides a variety of emergency and information functions in public environments. The ERC operates in a number of modes, including Information Mode, Emergency Response Mode, Security Mode, and Surveillance Mode. The Emergency Response Center functions are software selectable on a large video touch screen. A video screen displays emergency information to users and allows videoconferencing with various authorities as well as any individuals that own the account and apparatus. News, maps, weather, store directories, and other non-emergency information are also displayed by the ERC. The ERC can conduct surveillance of passersby using video cameras configured to stream and record the area in the vicinity of the ERC. The ERC can also scan employee IDs, capture employee facial images, and register employee data in the ERC database. An ERC server allows remote administration of the ERC.

title_en: System and method for coordinated health monitoring, emergency response, and medical record delivery
abstract_en: A computer-based system for providing coordinated health monitoring, emergency response, and medical record delivery. The system can include computing devices configured to process emergency-related indicators and data. The system can also include monitoring devices communicatively linked to the computing devices. The monitoring devices can be configured to monitor a particular area for the emergency-related indicators and data, wherein the monitoring devices detect speech, sounds, images and other detectable emergency-related indicators. The monitoring devices can also be configured to transmit the emergency-related indicators and data to the computing devices. Furthermore, the system can include a module linked to the monitoring devices and configured to execute on the computing devices. The module can analyze the transmitted emergency-related indicators and data to determine whether there is an emergency, communicate with a monitoring service to validate that an emergency exists, and provide access to patient records to authorized personnel, when an emergency exists.
assignees: HEATH CHESTER;GUILLAMA NOEL J;QUANTUM GROUP INC;SYNABEE INC

title_en: ECG-enabled personal emergency response systems
abstract_en: The invention provides personal emergency response systems (PERS) with expanded life-saving capabilities. One embodiment of the invention provides a wearable PERS pendant that incorporates a cell phone transmitter or transceiver, a GPS location system, an accelerometer-based fall detector that automatically triggers an alert, and an electrocardiogram (ECG) recorder permitting a remote service center or medical personnel to receive and respond to transmitted alerts and electrocardiographic data.

title_en: Systems and methods for incident recording
abstract_en: An incident recorder records original and supplemental incident information using a simplified user interface. A lead incident recorder may request any of several support tasks be accepted by other subsystems configured to Follow. Tactical support tasks may be requested. Communication support tasks may be requested. Collection support tasks may be requested. Collection support tasks may include directives for operation of an incident recorder.

title_en: Providing a GUI to enable analysis of time-synchronized data sets pertaining to a road segment
abstract_en: Techniques for collecting, synchronizing, and displaying various types of data relating to a road segment enable, via one or more local or remote processors, servers, transceivers, and/or sensors, (i) enhanced and contextualized analysis of vehicle events by way of synchronizing different data types, relating to a monitored road segment, collected via various different types of data sources; (ii) enhanced and contextualized analysis of filed insurance claims pertaining to a vehicle incident at a road segment; (iii) advantageous machine learning techniques for predicting a level of risk assumed for a given vehicle event or a given road segment; (iv) techniques for accounting for region-specific driver profiles when controlling autonomous vehicles; and/or (v) improved techniques for providing a GUI to display collected data in a meaningful and contextualized manner.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Forest fire suppression video monitoring command system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a forest fire suppression video monitoring command system which comprises a video monitoring device, a first wireless transmitting and receiving device, a second wireless transmitting and receiving device, a command and control video-recording system and control terminals, wherein the video monitoring device is connected with the command and control video-recording system through the first and second wireless transmitting and receiving devices, and the command and control video-recording system is connected with the control terminals through a wireless network. The forest fire suppression video monitoring command system further comprises a flying device on which the video monitoring device and the first wireless transmitting and receiving device are installed. The system is capable of comprehensively monitoring a fire scene in real time.

title_en: Digital Public Address Broadcating with Patrol Management System
title_ko: 방범 순찰 기능이 내장된 디지털 전관 방송 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 건물 및 아파트 등, 기본적인 방송설비와 화재방송, 정기적인 순찰을 필요로 하는 다수 산업현장에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 단순 전관방송만이 아닌, 순찰자로 하여금 정기적으로 순찰 구역을 점검하도록 유도하고 체계적으로 관리하여 안전사고, 도난방지 등을 사전에 예방하도록 하는 순찰관리와 전관방송을 통합 관리하는 것에 특징이 있다. 
     현재 건물 및 아파트 등에는 화재나 도난 등의 재난에 신속히 대처하기 위하여 CCTV 보안 시스템, 가스검출센서, 화재검출센서, 과전압보호장치, 비상전관방송 등 여러가지의 기계적인 안전 장치가 시스템 화 되어 있지만, 그 시스템들은 안전사고의 예방차원보다, 안전사고 발생시점으로부터 즉각 대응하기 위한 기능밖에 발휘하지 못하고 있는 것이 현실이다. 위의 사항에 있어 더욱이 정확한 안전사고 예방에 있어서는 직접 순찰자가 정기적으로 순찰 구역을 Patrol(순찰점검)하는 것이 최선의 방법이라 생각한다. 
     하지만, 순찰 근무자의 업무를 체계적으로 관리하지 않는다면, 순찰자의 업무 기록은, 그저 문서상의 종이쪽에 불과하게 되는 것이 사실이다. 그렇기에 본 고안은 PC기반으로, 소프트웨어를 통한 건물 및 아파트에 모든 관리시스템을 통합하여, 보디 체계적으로 예방, 관리 하도록 고안된 시스템이라 하겠다. 
       
     순찰관리시스템, 전관방송, 통합방송시스템, Patrol

title_en: Intelligent subtitle recording system in emergency command system
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent subtitle recording system in an emergency command system. The system comprises a satellite communication vehicle and a subtitle machine. The satellite communication vehicle is provided with a camera and a computer, the computer has a GPS navigation function and a WiFi function and is provided with GIS mobile navigation software and intelligent recording software, and subtitle software is embedded into the subtitle machine to form an intelligent subtitle information processor and achieves automatic superimposing of subtitles and videos. Subtitle information is extracted by means of the reverse geocoding technique, the subtitle software is embedded into the subtitle machine, the videos and the subtitle information are superimposed, the problem that manual recording is needed is successfully solved, and instantaneity of the videos and the subtitle information is guaranteed. The intelligent subtitle recording system fully uses and represents multi-service, perfect background management, wirelessness, clients based on Andriod operations systems and the like, and development of road real-time monitoring service is greatly promoted.

title_en: Power emergency three-dimensional plotting method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of power emergency command, and provides a power emergency three-dimensional plotting method and system in order to solve the problem that the timeliness and the interactivity of an existing power emergency system are insufficient. The power emergency three-dimensional plotting system comprises a power emergency information collecting module, a power emergency command module, a satellite signal receiving device, a satellite message receiving and sending device, a plan information server, a central processing server and data display equipment. According to the power emergency three-dimensional plotting method and system, the three-dimensional visual plotting function of power emergency information is achieved, the position information of emergency on-site personnel and vehicles is displayed in a three-dimensional map system in real time, and therefore the timeliness and the interactivity of the power emergency system are enhanced.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;POWER EMERGENCY CT OF STATE GRID SICHUAN ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Data center system for centralized management and displaying underground monitoring and control data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data center system for centralized management and display of underground monitoring and monitoring data, and relates to the technical field of centralized management and display of underground monitoring and monitoring. The data center system for centrally managing and displaying underground monitoring and monitoring data comprises a parameter acquisition and analysis module, an early warning parameter analysis module, a three-dimensional image acquisition and analysis module, an intelligent ventilation module, an early warning module and a data cloud platform, wherein monitoring and analysis are carried out on the aspect of environment and natural disasters caused by mining factors of mines, so that timeliness of timely processing potential safety hazards of the mines is improved, safety monitoring and analysis results of the mines are more comprehensive and rich, data of a monitoring and monitoring system are centrally managed in the data center and are used as important data supports of a digital mine management system, and more convenient and efficient measures are provided for emergency command, safety production management and production scheduling.
assignees: HUNAN HONGSEN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic switching system and switching method for automatic switching pressure plate of equipment based on double-active framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spare automatic switching press plate switching system and a switching method based on a dual-active architecture, which comprise dual-active systems, wherein the dual-active systems have the capability of performing real-time calculation, an active system and a standby system are mutually switched seamlessly, a perfect fault detection mechanism is designed, the communication state and the running state of the system are monitored through heartbeat test, the data synchronization of the dual-active systems is the key for ensuring the data consistency among the systems, measures are taken to ensure the timeliness and the safety of the data synchronization, the data error caused by inconsistent service data is avoided, and various autonomous judging and self-rescue functions are integrated, so that the fault switching, recovery and early warning can be automatically completed under abnormal conditions. The stability and the safety of the system are improved, the switching efficiency of the disaster recovery system is improved, and the system can be quickly switched to the standby system under the condition that the master system of the OCS system is unavailable, so that the influence of the dispatching production work of the power grid is reduced to the minimum.
assignees: GUANGZHOU POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;DONGFANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Learing Kit for Programming Motion Pattern of Toy
title_ko: 완구의 동작 프로그래밍 학습 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kit for learning programming for a motion of a toy wherein toddlers or children in lower grades of an elementary school are able to easily manipulate without deep knowledge of motion components and able to easily acquire an understanding of and experiences involving programming for realizing a motion pattern of a toy. The kit for learning programming for a motion of a toy according to the present invention comprises: a drive module having at least one toy and capable of operation by means of power applied internally or externally; a program palette having a plurality of connection grooves having a connection terminal arranged, and embedded with a control module having a microprocessor electrically connected to the connection terminal and capable of controlling a motion of the toy; a connecting member for electrically connecting the program palette and the drive module; and a polyhedral icon block composed of a polyhedron detachably attached to the connection groove of the program palette and having a terminal connected to a terminal of the connection groove and embedded with an electric component for giving a command for a specific motion of the toy.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 유아나 초등학교 저학년의 어린이와 같이 동작 부품에 대한 깊은 이해가 없이도 쉽게 조작이 가능하며, 완구의 동작 패턴 구현을 위한 프로그래밍의 이해와 경험을 쉽게 체득할 수 있는 완구의 동작 프로그래밍 학습 키트에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 완구의 동작 프로그래밍 학습 키트는, 내부 또는 외부로부터 인가되는 전원에 의해 동작하는 적어도 1개의 완구를 구비한 구동모듈과; 접속단자를 구비한 복수개의 접속홈이 배열되어 있고, 상기 접속단자와 전기적으로 연결되며 상기 완구의 동작을 제어하는 마이크로프로세서를 구비한 제어모듈이 내장되어 있는 프로그램팔레트와; 상기 프로그램팔레트와 구동모듈을 전기적으로 연결하는 컨넥팅부재와; 상기 프로그램팔레트의 접속홈에 착탈되는 다각면체로 이루어지며, 상기 접속홈의 단자와 접속되는 단자를 구비하고, 상기 완구의 특정 동작 명령을 위한 전기부품이 내장되어 있는 다각면체의 아이콘블록을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Apparatus for locking electric watt hour meter and control method thereof
title_ko: 전력량계 봉인 장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are a watt-hour meter sealing device and a control method thereof. The watt-hour meter sealing device comprises: a sealing module for locking or unlocking a sealing cover covering and sealing a sealing object of a watt-hour meter; a sealing sensor for detecting a locked state and an unlocked state of the sealing cover; a communication module for connecting to a meter reading server; a memory having an execution program embedded therein; and a processor operatively coupled to the sealing module, the sealing sensor, the communication module, and the memory. The processor drives the execution program to be connected to the meter reading server through the communication module, operates the sealing module according to a sealing command to lock or unlock the sealing cover when the sealing command is received from the meter reading server, and transmits an operation result to the meter reading server according to a detection result of the sealing sensor.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전력량계 봉인 장치 및 그 제어방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 전력량계 봉인 장치는, 전력량계의 봉인 대상체를 덮어 봉인하는 봉인커버를 잠그거나 해제시키는 봉인모듈; 봉인커버의 잠금상태와 해제상태를 감지하는 봉인센서; 검침서버와 접속하기 위한 통신모듈; 실행 프로그램이 내장된 메모리; 및 봉인모듈, 봉인센서, 통신모듈 및 메모리와 작동적으로 연결(operatively coupled to)된 프로세서;를 포함하되, 프로세서는, 실행 프로그램을 구동하여 통신모듈을 통해 검침서버에 접속되어, 검침서버로부터 봉인명령이 수신된 경우 봉인명령에 따라 봉인모듈을 작동시켜 봉인커버를 잠그거나 해제시키고, 봉인센서의 감지결과에 따라 작동결과를 검침서버로 전송하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: AI-based integrated flight simulation platform to open the future of the drone industry
title_ko: 드론 산업의 미래를 여는 ai 기반 통합 비행 시뮬레이션 플랫폼
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 산업의 미래를 여는 AI 기반 통합 비행 시뮬레이션 플랫폼에 관한 것으로, 교육생, 교관 및 적어도 하나의 드론 정보를 관리하고, 기상청 API와 연계하여 교육원의 위치를 기반으로 기상 정보를 안내하며, 상기 기상 정보를 기반으로 지정된 교관, 교육생 및 드론의 비행로그를 모의 계산하여 비행계획을 수립 및 관리하는 드론 비행 교육 관리 서버; 적어도 하나의 교관 또는 관리자의 제어에 의해 상기 드론 비행 교육 관리 서버와, 연계하여 관리 기능을 수행하는 교육장 단말; 및 조종 단말을 통한 원격 제어에 의해 비행이 가능한 적어도 하나의 드론;을 포함함으로써 교육생, 교관, 드론 등의 다양한 관리대상을 통합적으로 관리하고, 인공지능 기반 비행 분석을 제공하여 교육생과 교관의 교육 성과 및 합격율을 높일 수 있으며, 드론의 비행기록, 정비, 사고기록을 기반으로 체계화된 관리 시스템을 통해 드론의 장비 수명을 늘릴 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Electronic block system for programming education
title_ko: 프로그래밍 교육을 위한 전자블록 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electronic block system for programming education, wherein command blocks of scratch programming for program coding education are configured as hardware-type electronic blocks, and, when multiple electronic blocks are connected according to a program flowchart, a program that controls a sprite according to the corresponding flowchart is executed, the electronic block system comprising: a master electronic block connected to a smart terminal so as to form a data communication line and to receive power; and multiple slave electronic blocks, wherein each of the slave electronic blocks may be assembled with the master electronic block or with another slave electronic block; the master electronic block is assembled in the uppermost stage; multiple slave electronic blocks are successively assembled in stages below the master electronic block; and each slave electronic block is configured to form a data communication line and receive power from a slave electronic block assembled in the upper stage or from the master electronic block. The electronic block system, configured as above, makes it possible to connect tangible electronic blocks to each other and to compose scratch programming such that, even without a computer, for example, programming that controls a sprite can be composed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 프로그램 코딩 교육을 위한 스크래치 프로그래밍의 명령 블록들을 하드웨어 형태의 전자블록으로 구성하고, 다수의 전자블록들을 프로그램 흐름도에 따라 연결하면 해당 흐름도에 따라 스프라이트를 제어하는 프로그램을 수행시켜주는, 프로그래밍 교육을 위한 전자블록 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상기 스마트 단말과 연결되어, 데이터 통신 라인을 형성하고 전원을 공급받는 마스터 전자블록; 및, 다수의 슬레이브 전자블록들을 포함하고, 상기 슬레이브 전자블록은 상기 마스터 전자블록 또는 다른 슬레이브 전자블록과 조립될 수 있고, 상기 마스터 전자블록이 최상단에 조립되고, 상기 마스터 전자블록의 하단에 다수의 슬레이브 전자블록들이 순차적으로 조립되고, 상기 슬레이브 전자블록은 상단에 조립된 슬레이브 전자블록 또는 마스터 전자블록으로부터 데이터 통신 라인을 형성하고 전원을 공급받는 구성을 마련한다. 상기와 같은 전자블록 시스템에 의하여, 손으로 만질 수 있는 전자블록들을 서로 연결하여 스크래치 프로그래밍을 작성할 수 있고, 이로 인해, 컴퓨터 등이 없더라도 스프라이트를 제어하는 프로그래밍을 작성할 수 있다.

title_en: Improved patient emergency response system
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.
assignees: ROSS MEDICAL CORP;CHIU ALEXANDER ROSS;FREDERICK NEIL ADAM;FREDERICK ERIC ALAN;JAE CHUNG JIMMY YOUNG

title_en: Method and system for communicating information associated with an incident to a designated government public safety agency
abstract_en: A method and system for communicating information associated with an incident to a designated government public safety agency. Displaying a plurality of selectable icons each associated with a type of criminal offense on the display of the device for the user to select the type of criminal offense associated with the incident, displaying on the display of the device a text box and/or at least one other selectable option for allowing the user to optionally take or select a photo, a video, or an audio recording associated with the incident. Preparing and transmitting a message to a receiving system of the designated government public safety agency, the message including one or more of the user identification and/or contact information, the location-based information, the selected type of criminal offense, text information associated with the incident, photo information associated with the incident, video information associated with the incident.

title_en: Integrating data from multiple devices
abstract_en: A recording system for an emergency response unit includes a first data collection device configured to record a first video, audio or data segment with an incident identifier and transmit a message including the incident identifier. A second data collection device may receive the message and, as appropriate, record at least a second video, audio or data segment with the incident identifier, allowing the first segment and the second segment to be associated using the incident identifier. In other embodiments, a first recording device may begin recording video, audio or legal evidence data with an incident identifier, and a control system may receive a message including the incident identifier from the first recording device, identify one or more additional recording devices located within a certain distance of the first recording device, and obtain recordings from the one or more additional recording devices.

title_en: Methods and systems for updating information in a timeline of a public safety incident
abstract_en: Methods and systems for updating information in a timeline of a public safety incident. One method includes receiving, at an electronic computing device, a user query and identifying a time window in the past associated with the user query. The method further includes determining that the user query relates to a public safety incident. The method further includes generating a response to the user query. The response is generated as a function of the time window and information relating to the public safety incident. The method further includes storing the response such that information included in the response is added to one of (i) timeline information associated with a user of a communication device at a time commensurate with the time window and (ii) timeline information associated with the public safety incident at a time commensurate with the time window.

title_en: Systems and methods for assignment of equipment to an officer
abstract_en: A system for tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment to security agency personnel (e.g., officers, administration, command, armorer). An armorer is assigned the task of tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment. Equipment may be assigned to a particular individual officer. The equipment provided to and used by officers may capture (e.g. gather, produce) information (e.g. audiovisual information, data logs, recordings). Equipment may provide information to the armorer via near field communication (NFC) circuits. The information captured may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system. The information captured by equipment assigned to a particular individual may be associated with that individual. An armorer may use information supplied by equipment, evidence management system, officers, or other sources to assist in the assignment process.

title_en: Post-vehicular incident reconstruction report
abstract_en: The disclosure herein describes systems and methods for generating a post-vehicular incident report. In some examples, the system includes receiving a notification from a user device indicating the user device has been involved in an incident, obtaining incident data from the user device that includes a timestamp and location data, retrieving third-party incident data corresponding to the timestamp and the location data received in the incident data, generating a timeline of the incident based on the obtained incident data from the user device and the retrieved third-party incident data, the generated timeline including events occurring prior to the incident and events occurring after the incident, generating a report of the incident based on the generated timeline, the obtained incident data, and the retrieved third-party incident data, the report including the timeline, and outputting the generated report to the user device and at least one of a plurality of approved devices.

title_en: Urban intelligent traffic emergency monitoring, regulation and control management system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban intelligent traffic emergency monitoring, regulating and controlling management system based on the Internet of things, which analyzes the predicted fault maintaining time of each fault sub-line by acquiring the corresponding fault parameter of each fault sub-line in a target urban traffic electric power line, analyzes the required electric quantity of each fault sub-line according to the unit time electric quantity of each traffic signal lamp in each fault sub-line, acquires the predicted vehicle flow of the traffic road corresponding to each fault sub-line in the predicted fault maintaining time interval, analyzes the emergency response index of each fault sub-line and performs corresponding emergency regulation and control management according to the comparison result, thereby being capable of accurately analyzing the emergency response grade of the fault electric power line in many aspects, further realizing the pertinence, the intelligence and the timeliness of the urban traffic electric power line emergency regulation and control management and improving the urban traffic electric power line emergency regulation and control information level to the greatest extent.

title_en: Method and system for generating remote centralized control plan of step hydropower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydropower system control, in particular to a method and a system for generating a remote centralized control plan of a step hydropower station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous dynamic data of a target step hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of carrying out statistics reconstruction on multi-source heterogeneous dynamic data to generate dynamic characteristic tensors, carrying out risk identification on a target cascade hydropower station according to the dynamic characteristic tensors to obtain a risk index sequence of the target cascade hydropower station, carrying out dynamic weighted superposition on a preset plan template set based on the risk index sequence to generate a self-adaptive plan set, carrying out dynamic matching in the self-adaptive plan set based on the real-time running state of a cascade hydropower remote centralized control system, and determining an optimal plan so as to control the cascade hydropower remote centralized control system based on the optimal plan. According to the invention, through dynamic data fusion and risk quantitative analysis, real-time self-adaptive matching of the step hydropower station risk early warning and the emergency plan is realized, and the emergency response accuracy and timeliness are obviously improved.

title_en: Communication network-based hazardous chemical accident detection and response system
title_ko: 통신망 기반 유해화학사고 감지 및 대응 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for detecting and responding to hazardous chemical accidents based on a communication network. Through a disaster safety communication network, the concentration of hazardous substances is displayed in real time, and the concentration is displayed in color on a map according to the location of a sensor so that a user can recognize the level of risk at a glance. The system includes: sensor information collected from disaster detection sensors; a disaster management server that executes a disaster management program when the sensor information is input, detects symptoms of a disaster, and sequentially executes an initial response and an emergency response; and a monitor that is connected to the disaster management server so that signs of disaster, initial response, and emergency response are displayed on the screen. The disaster management server provides real-time numerical values of sensor information collected from various sensors by a built-in disaster management program, diagrams, converts the same into graphs, or displays the same along with a map of the corresponding area. In addition to the variety of sensor information, one or more of CCTV information, base station information, populated area information, and weather information are added to the input information for the disaster management server. Various sensor information, CCTV information, base station information, populated area information, and weather information input to the disaster management server are displayed on the monitor as the disaster management program is executed. In the disaster response process, a symptom detection step, an initial response step, and an emergency response step are configured to be executed sequentially.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난안전통신망을 통해 유해물질 농도를 실시간으로 표출하고, 센서 위치에 따라 지도위에 농도를 색상으로 표출하여 사용자가 위험도를 한눈에 알아볼 수 있도록 한 통신망 기반 유해화학사고 감지 및 대응 시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난 감지용 센서들로부터 수집된 센서정보들과; 상기 센서정보들이 입력되면 재난관리프로그램이 실행되어 재난의 징후를 감지하고, 초기대응 및 비상대응이 순차적으로 실행되도록 하는 재난관리 서버와; 상기 재난관리 서버와 연결되어 재난의 징후, 초기대응 및 비상대응의 과정이 화면에 디스플레이되도록 하는 모니터로 구성된 통신망 기반 유해화학사고 감지 및 대응 시스템에 있어서, 상기 재난관리서버는 내장된 재난관리프로그램에 의해, 각종 센서들로부터 수집된 센서정보들을 실시간 수치로 제공하거나, 도표로 도식화하거나, 그래프로 변환하여 나타내거나, 해당 지역의 지도와 함께 표시하며, 상기 재난관리서버에 대한 입력 정보들은, 상기 '각종 센서정보' 외에도, 'CCTV 정보'와, '기지국 정보'와, '인구 밀집지역 정보'와, '기상정보' 들 중에서 한개 이상이 추가되며, 상기 재난관리서버에 입력된 '각종 센서정보', 'CCTV 정보', '기지국 정보', '인구 밀집지역 정보', '기상정보' 들은 재난관리 프로그램이 실행됨에 따라 상기  모니터에 디스플레이되는데, 재난 대응과정에서 징후감지 단계와, 초기대응 단계와, 비상대응 단계가 순차적으로 실행되도록 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System for validating and appending incident-related data records in a distributed electronic ledger
abstract_en: A computer apparatus, such as a validator node, for validating incident-related data records in a distributed electronic ledger is configured to receive a request from an agent to add a proposed incident-related data record associated with an incident to the distributed electronic ledger. In response to the proposed incident-related data record, the computer apparatus determines, from the distributed electronic ledger, one or more attributes of the agent or incident. The computer apparatus determines whether the proposed incident-related data record satisfies validation criteria based at least partially on the one or more attributes of the agent or incident. Once validated, the computer apparatus may then append the proposed incident-related data record to the distributed electronic ledger. Alternatively, the proposed incident-related data record may be appended regardless of validity, but an indication of validity may be appended if the proposed incident-related data record is validated.

title_en: A kind of record live streaming switching system and its method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of record live streaming switching system and its methods.The system, it include: that recorded broadcast equipment is connect with electronic whiteboard and the first camera respectively, for obtaining the first information and the second information, the first information includes the information of the first camera acquisition, and the second information includes the writing on the blackboard write on electronic whiteboard and the information by electronic whiteboard displaying；Control equipment is connect with recorded broadcast equipment, and for obtaining record live streaming handover information, handover information is broadcast live according to record, record live streaming switching command is sent to recorded broadcast equipment, record live streaming handover information includes: the instruction recorded broadcast equipment recorded broadcast first information, alternatively, instruction the second information of recorded broadcast equipment recorded broadcast.By the way that handover information is broadcast live according to record, record live streaming switching command is sent to recorded broadcast equipment, to realize the information for obtaining the writing on the blackboard write on electronic whiteboard and showing by electronic whiteboard, so as to avoid blocking due to the preceding teacher of electronic whiteboard, cause student that can not watch the content of display of electronic whiteboard.

title_en: A kind of classroom manually intellectual education system based on movement interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of classroom manually intellectual education systems based on movement interaction,Including obtaining module,Analysis module,Action module,Adjust module,Projection module,Playing module and memory module,Module is obtained to be used to obtain the action message in classroom,Analysis module record and comparison obtain the information that module is sent,Action module command instruction for identification,And command instruction is sent to adjustment module and projection module,Adjusting module includes temperature control modules,Luminance adjustment module,Gas permeability module and shock module,Projection module includes mapping block and receiving module,Projection module is used to control the sequence and form of indoor article projection,Receiving module is for receiving and recognizing action command,Playing module includes task module,Alarm modules and adjustment module,Task module is for broadcasting order,Alarm modules are used to carry out the casting of emergency management,Adjustment module is for adjusting different voice systems,Memory module is used to store the information of analysis module.
