title_en: Shock level rapid estimation method, system and terminal based on strong shock PGV
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information technology service, and discloses a method, a system and a terminal for quickly estimating the vibration level based on a strong vibration PGV, which solve the problem that the vibration level obtained by the traditional method for estimating the vibration level by using strong vibration displacement is underestimated due to the influence of saturation effect, and the technical key point is that 23 vibration levels in the global range are constructed to be M  w  6.0 to M  w  9.0, uniformly processing the time course direction, the record dimension and the file format of the acceleration record, preprocessing the acceleration record by using a high-pass filtering method, integrating the obtained speed, and extracting three dimensionsPGV, and then a strong vibration PGV magnitude model is constructed. The method realizes real-time and rapid estimation of the large earthquake magnitude based on the strong earthquake observation means, and provides technical support for rapid earthquake early warning and post-earthquake emergency response.

title_en: Fire early warning system for paper machine and working method thereof
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire early warning, in particular to a fire early warning system for a paper machine and a working method thereof, wherein the fire early warning system for the paper machine comprises an information collecting module, an information processing module and an emergency execution module; the working method of the fire early warning system comprises the steps of S1, collecting temperature, smoke concentration and heat radiation intensity information through a sensor S2, transmitting data to a processing unit, preprocessing S3, extracting relevant characteristic information such as temperature mutation, smoke diffusion speed and flame image characteristic S4, comprehensively evaluating according to the characteristic information and combining a fire early warning model, repeating the steps when the risk is not found, transmitting a signal to the next step S5 when the risk is found, receiving a signal, sending an early warning signal S6, and starting an emergency plan after the early warning signal is issued. The invention improves the accuracy and timeliness of fire early warning, reduces the false alarm rate and the missing report rate, enhances the emergency response capability and improves the overall safety performance of the paper machine.

title_en: Intelligent hospital medical guide system based on AI visual recognition and man-machine conversation functions
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent medical guidance system for a hospital, which integrates a plurality of advanced artificial intelligence technologies and modules and aims at improving the intelligent level of navigation, illness state communication and medical services of the hospital. The system core comprises a portable intelligent medical guiding robot, has functions of deformation, intelligent mechanical arm operation, multi-mode interaction, emergency response and the like, and realizes accurate positioning and intelligent path planning by integrating a multi-mode sensor and an edge calculation module. In addition, the system also covers intelligent medical robotic chaperones. And the knowledge processing and reasoning module builds a knowledge map, so that the system interpretability and the federal learning capability are improved. The data management and communication module ensures data security, synchronization and anomaly detection, and supports multi-channel communication. The medical history and illness state communication module realizes remote booking, voice recognition and medical record management. Overall, the system significantly improves hospital service efficiency and patient experience through a highly integrated and intelligent design.

title_en: Three-proofing handheld device structure suitable for outdoor environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-proofing handheld device structure suitable for an outdoor environment, which comprises a machine body and a falling detection device. The machine body is provided with a screen and a first accommodating cavity, the first accommodating cavity is provided with a through hole and an active protection device, the through hole is communicated with the first accommodating cavity and the external environment, the active protection device comprises a first elastic piece, a supporting piece and a locking and releasing mechanism, the fixed end of the first elastic piece is arranged on the side wall of the first accommodating cavity, the movable end of the first elastic piece is connected with the supporting piece, and the falling detection device is in signal connection with the locking and releasing mechanism. Through setting up initiative protection device, can respond rapidly when the whereabouts, form physical buffering through support piece, effectively absorb and disperse impact energy. Through the synergistic effect of the locking release mechanism and the first elastic piece, the supporting piece can be quickly and controllably ejected, and the timeliness of emergency response is ensured. The falling detection device is used for rapidly responding when recognizing the falling state and monitoring the motion state of the equipment in real time.
assignees: HUBEI ZHONGQING HUACHUANG ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Early thermal runaway early warning management system of lithium battery based on temperature detection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lithium battery early thermal runaway early warning management system based on temperature detection, which relates to the technical field of lithium battery thermal runaway management, and comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring fire related data in real time through a sensor array; the system comprises a data processing module, a disaster situation prediction module, a classification early warning module, a task generation module, a fire extinguishing execution module, a liquid nitrogen fire extinguishing unit and a disaster situation tracing module, wherein the data processing module is used for analyzing acquired data flow in real time, the disaster situation prediction module is used for inputting processed data into a model for prediction, the classification early warning module is used for carrying out self-adaptive classification on disaster situations according to predicted data trend and combining comprehensive disaster situation indexes, the task generation module is used for generating a corresponding task chain according to classification results, the fire extinguishing execution module is used for starting the liquid nitrogen fire extinguishing unit according to execution commands, and the disaster situation tracing module is used for recording operation logs of the whole system module. The invention can solve the technical problems that the prior thermal runaway management system of the lithium battery cabin can not early warn early thermal runaway and can not timely block fire spreading when thermal runaway occurs.
assignees: FENSHI HIGH END EQUIPMENT MFG JIANGSU CO LTD

title_en: Train plan adjustment evaluation method based on high-speed railway line network operation simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a train plan adjustment evaluation method based on high-speed railway line network operation simulation, which relates to the technical field of railway dispatching simulation training and comprises the following steps of setting the score proportion of each evaluation index; the simulation is started, a CTC simulation system loads a fault scene and a train operation plan, a simulation stage, a trainee adjusts the train operation plan, the CTC simulation system simulates train operation according to the adjusted train operation plan and records train operation conditions and trainee operation events, the simulation is ended, the score of each evaluation index is calculated according to the recorded train operation conditions and trainee operation events, and the final evaluation total score is calculated through a weighted average algorithm by utilizing the score and the score proportion of each evaluation index. The invention provides a set of automatic evaluation index system comprising a plurality of dimensions, and a specific and quantifiable scoring formula is designed for each evaluation index, so that comprehensive, quantified and objective evaluation of the train plan adjustment behavior of a dispatcher is realized.

title_en: Loans reviewing device reflecting the risk of natural disasters and the method thereof
title_ko: 자연재해 위험을 반영한 대출 심사 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method thereof to evaluate a loan by reflecting the risk of natural disasters, capable of minimizing the risk of natural disasters on loan finance by adjusting loan conditions by reflecting the risk of natural disasters in an area, in which a loan setting object exists, when a financial institution evaluates the loan. The load evaluating device includes: a control part reading and executing a program code in which a series of processing sequences are written; an input part inputting data or an operating command; a display part displaying an operating state; and a storage part storing a loan evaluation part, a loan evaluation standard information DB, a natural disaster risk evaluation part, and a natural disaster risk DB as coded data including the code, indicating the processing sequences, and the data applied to the processing sequences. Therefore, the present invention is capable of minimizing a loss of the financial institution, caused by natural disasters, when the financial institution loans money by correcting loan evaluation information by applying the risk of natural disasters to the information after the generation of the evaluation information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 금융기관의 대출 심사 시 대출 설정 목적물이 위치하는 지역에 대한 자연 재해의 위험성을 반영하여 대출의 조건을 조정하는 것에 의해 자연재해로 인한 대출 금융에 미치는 위험을 최소화시키는 자연재해 위험을 반영한 대출 심사 장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 
상기 대출 심사 장치는, 일련의 처리과정을 기재한 프로그램 코드를 읽어 들여 실행하는 제어부; 데이터 또는 구동 명령을 입력하는 입력부; 구동 상태를 표시하는 표시부; 상기 제어부에 의한 연산처리 순서를 나타내는 코드 및 연산 처리에 적용될 데이터를 포함하는 코드화된 데이터로서의 대출평가부와 대출평가기준정보DB와 자연재해위험평가부와 자연재해위험도DB를 저장하는 저장부;를 포함하여, 대출 평가 정보를 생성한 후, 생성된 대출 평가 정보를 상기 자연재해위험을 적용하여 보정하도록 구성되어, 
금융 기관의 대출 시 자연재해로 인한 금융 기관의 손실을 최소화시키는 효과를 제공한다.
assignees: LEE HO CHEOL;NAT UNIV CHUNGBUK IND ACAD

title_en: Disaster situation propagation system
title_ko: 재난 상황 전파 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster situation spreading system. A dedicated program or a disaster report spreading application is installed in a government disaster management server and a mobile communication terminal to rapidly and efficiently report and spread a surrounding disaster situation such as a traffic accident or a forest fire, and to automatically block unnecessary disaster information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 상황 전파 시스템에 관한 것으로, 정부 재난관리 서버와 이동통신 단말기에 전용 프로그램이나 재난신고전파용앱을 설치하여, 교통 사고, 산불 등 주변의 재난 상황을 인지할 경우 신속하고 효율적으로 신고 및 전파할 수 있게 하며, 아울러 불필요한 재난 정보를 자동으로 차단할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method of electronic voting, decoder for implementing this method and network comprising a voting server for implementing the method
abstract_en: Method of electronic voting in a questionnaire, comprising: - a step of broadcasting an offer of electronic voting service to a plurality of communications terminals; - a step of dispatching from a communication terminal of a voter, a request to a remote server, this request containing information for authenticating a voter; - a step of authenticating the voter by comparing the authentication information received with recorded information associated with the voter; - when the voter has been authenticated, a step of dispatching to the communication terminal of the voter a ticket to participate in the vote; a step of dispatching the vote to the server, the former containing a response to the questionnaire and the ticket to participate in the vote, this method being characterized in that it comprises two steps of anonymization, a first step ensuring anonymization to the ticket to participate addressed to the voter by the server, a second step ensuring anonymization of the communication terminal addressing the response to the vote to the server, the participation ticket containing at least one item of data associated with the profile of the voter.

title_en: Managing a patient injured in an emergency incident
abstract_en: A method and system employed by emergency responders to an emergency incident in the management of individuals injured in emergency incidents. An injured patient is tagged with a triage tag that has a bar code and an RFID inlay that identify the patient. At least one of the bar code and RHD inlay are scanned by a portable optical/electronic unit. As the patient is moved through various zones in which the condition of the patient is evaluated and, if necessary, the condition of the patient is treated, patient evaluation data is recorded in the in the portable optical/electronic unit and a command computer in association with patient identification data.

title_en: Call management system for incoming video calls at a command center
abstract_en: A process and system for managing incoming video emergency calls (VECs) at a command center relative to an incident includes receiving first and second VECs from respective first and second recording and transmitting devices reflecting a first incident. Identifying the second VEC as a preferred one of the first and second VECs based on one or both of a quality and a field-of-view between the first and second VECs, and responsively causing the identified second VEC to be forwarded to a first live call taker and the first VEC to a VEC monitoring bot configured to continue to monitor video content of the first VEC and refrain from forwarding the first VEC to the first live call taker. The first VEC may be forwarded to the first live call taker at a lower relative resolution.

title_en: Digital evidence transcription and incident report generation system
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method, system, and apparatus of a body-worn camera system with integrated artificial intelligence for real-time field assistance and automated incident reporting. In one embodiment, a cloud-based data management system includes an artificial intelligence module to generate a transcript of an incident using data captured from a body-worn safety device (e.g., audio or video data) that captures an incident surrounding a first responder. The transcription is highly accurate, even in noisy environments, and discerns different speakers, making it valuable for documenting interactions and statements. The transcribed text is analyzed with a private Large Language Model (LLM), to interpret at least one of the audio and video data, and to provide insights, summaries, and/or flag potential areas of concern based on the context and content of a conversation during the incident. An incident report based on the recorded and analyzed data.

title_en: Device for practising simulation of electric and electronic components using 3-dimensional virtual space
title_ko: 3d 가상 공간을 이용한 전기, 전자, 자동화 부품의 시뮬레이션 실습 장비
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a practical device for simulating electrical, electronic and automatic parts using three-dimensional virtual space and, more specifically, a practical device for simulating electrical, electronic and automatic parts using three-dimensional virtual space, including a customized processor with a serial port to be connected to a PCB built-in board and a PC main body; a PC main body which is connected to the customized processor and the serial port to transmit and receive data and has an operation software to treat transmitted and received data from the customized processor; a display device which outputs data treated in the operation software of the PC main body; and a hard ware consisting of electrical, electronic automatic parts which is controlled by manipulating the operation software of the PC main body.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 3D 가상 공간을 이용한 전기, 전자, 자동화 부품의 시뮬레이션 실습 장비에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로는 PCB 내장 보드 및 PC본체와 연결하기 위한 시리얼 포트를 포함하는 전용프로세서; 상기 전용프로세서와 시리얼 포트에 의해 연결되어 데이터를 송수신하며, 상기 전용프로세서에서 송수신되는 데이터를 처리하기 위한 운영 소프트웨어를 구비한 PC본체; 상기 PC본체의 운영 소프트웨어에서 처리되는 데이터를 출력하는 디스플레이 장치; 및 상기 PC본체의 운영 소프트웨어의 조작을 통해 제어되는 실제 전기, 전자, 자동화 부품의 하드웨어 모듈을 포함하여 구성되며, 상기 PC본체의 운영 소프트웨어는 윈도우 폼에 유니티 프로그램을 탑재하여 시퀀스와 메커니즘 시뮬레이션을 수행하고, 상기 윈도우폼에 탑재된 유니티뷰어에 인보크스크립트(InvokeScript)와 OCX(Object Linking and Embedding)를 사용하여 데이터를 공유하고 유니티 프로그램 내에 구현되어 있는 함수를 호출하여 이벤트를 발생시킨 후 윈도우 폼으로 결과값을 리턴시키도록 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 3D 가상 공간을 이용한 전기, 전자, 자동화 부품의 시뮬레이션 실습 장비를 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따르면 PC 기반의 3D 가상 공간을 이용하여 실제 전기, 전자, 자동화 부품을 배치하여 프로세서 입출력 보드를 이용해 실제 장비를 이용하지 않아도 실제와 동일한 전기, 전자, 자동화 부품의 움직임을 제어하는 것을 직접 실습 할 수 있도록 할 수 있으므로 전기, 전자, 자동화 부품의 실습과정에서의 오류에 따른 안전사고와 전기, 전자, 자동화 부품의 오프라인 실습에 대한 거부감을 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System for retrieving past scenarios for responding to social disasters and method for operating the Same
title_ko: 사회재난 대응을 위한 과거 시나리오 검색 시스템 및 그 운용 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난관리 및 재난대응 기술 분야에 관한 것으로서,  
재난 대응을 위한 시나리오 기반의 의사결정 지원 시스템에 있어서, 
과거 재난 사례, 가상훈련 시나리오 및 사용자 정의 시나리오 데이터를 포함하는 재난 관련 정보를 저장하는 데이터 저장부와; 상기 저장된 데이터를 분류, 검색 및 시각화 가능하도록 처리하는 데이터 처리부와; 입력된 재난 유형, 발생 지역, 재난 경보 단계 등을 기반으로 상기 저장된 데이터 중에서 대응 시나리오를 검색하여 추출하는 시나리오 추천부와; 상기 추천된 시나리오를 인과관계형, 타임라인형 또는 서술형 중 적어도 하나의 형태로 시각화하여 출력하는 시나리오 시각화부와; 시각화된 시나리오를 다수의 사용자에게 실시간으로 공유할 수 있도록 재난안전상황실 내 전광판 또는 협업형 사용자 단말로 출력하는 협업 공유부와; 신규로 수집되거나 사용자에 의해 작성된 시나리오를 학습하여 유사한 재난 유형 또는 새로운 조합의 시나리오를 자동 생성하는 인공지능 기반 시나리오 생성부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: System and method for emergency communications
abstract_en: The provision of emergency response services to a user can be based on transitioning a communications device associated with a user to a listening mode, setting a first timer, recording user actions with the communications device, ascertaining, based on a status of the first timer and the user actions, whether a criteria with respect to at least user interaction is met, and, if the criteria is met, transitioning the communications device to an emergency communications mode, else resetting the timer and repeating the recording and the ascertaining until the criteria is met. The emergency communication mode consists of forwarding user and live location information to a remote server and receiving emergency contact information, selected based on the user and live location information, for establishing a communication with emergency response personnel.

title_en: Systems and methods for three-dimensional interaction monitoring in an EMS environment
abstract_en: A method for tracking interactions in an emergency response environment according to embodiments of the present invention includes receiving color images and depth information from within a field of view of a sensor array; maintaining an emergency encounter record; monitoring one or both of a position of an object and movement of the object in the emergency response environment based on the color images and depth information received by the sensor array; and recording an occurrence of a condition in the emergency encounter record, wherein the condition is based on the one or both of the position of the object and the movement of the object.

title_en: Fire alarm text response system
abstract_en: A computer software and hardware system for fire stations is described which provides communications utilizing SMS (Short Message Service) cellular phone text messaging automatically notifying firemen or other personnel of an emergency page when their dispatch pages them via radio dispatch or by other means. Responses from this SMS text message are replied to via SMS text messaging with a code letter and their response is displayed on a screen at their station so other responding firemen know if, who, and where other firemen are responding. Users can also opt to automatically receive on their cell phones an MMS (Multimedia Message Service) message containing a multimedia sound recording of the actual emergency dispatch voice page.

title_en: Gas environment emergency detection system
abstract_en: A gas environment emergency detection system comprises a gas detection device, a data acquisition processing device, a large and medium size mobile emergency platform and an emergency command center system. The gas detection device is in data connection with the data acquisition processing device, the data acquisition processing device is in data connection with the emergency command center system and the large and medium size mobile emergency platform respectively, and the emergency command center system is in data connection with the large and medium size mobile emergency platform. The gas environment emergency detection system is strong in anti-interference capacity, accurate in detection, free of mixed gas influence, small in volume and simple to operate. Electrochemical and semiconductor sensor combination arrays are arranged on one instrument, and the gas environment emergency detection system can automatically distinguish and measure various gases with characteristic maps recorded in a data base of the gas environment emergency detection system and can perform qualitative and quantitative measurement.
assignees: ZHONGKE YUTU WORLD TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting inside fire attack secure registration board
abstract_en: Fire-fighting inside fire attack secure registration board, is provided with CPU processor and GPRS signal receiver in its folding-type box inside; CPU processor outside is provided with alarm, alarm X button, timer initiation button and multiple timer; Timer side is provided with Information, has assigned individual soldier's release in Information; Information side is provided with aerial respiration force value display field, and aerial respiration force value display field side is also provided with entry time record hurdle and task location record hurdle, and task location record is provided with electronic clock above hurdle; Toolbar is provided with on the right side of casing.Advantage of the present utility model: the mode combined with manual monitoring by automatic alarm, remind inside fire attack personnel can withdraw in time before danger occurs, the safe precaution measure in the further reinforcement scene of a fire, promote commander's level of fire fighting and rescue, also compensate for current safety resignation system implements deficiency not in place simultaneously, for vast grass-roots unit alleviates secure registration burden and pressure.

title_en: automatic notification system of occurred emergency signal in PLC and the method thereof
title_ko: Ｐｌｃ기반의 전력선 이상발생시 원격 자동통보장치 및 그방법
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 농업용 관정 등 저압선(전선) 도난에 의하여 전력을 적기 공급하지 못하는 문제점과, 전선방치로 인한 인간 및 가축의 감전사고를 예방하기 위한 PLC 기반의 전력선 이상발생시 원격 자동통보장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 
     	PLC 기반의 전력선 이상발생시 원격 자동통보장치는, 전력선에 투입되는 전원의 공급 여부를 감지하는 정전검출부와, 상기 정전검출부에서 공급전력의 차단시 구동되는 경보상태부와, 내부에 보조 전원을 구비하고 정전시 공급 전원을 공급하는 전원부의 전원에 의하여 구동되는 중앙제어부와, 상기 중앙제어부에 연결되어 시스템의 이상 여부 및 현재의 구동상태를 표시하는 자가진단부와, 상기 중앙제어부의 일측에 연결되어 퍼스널 컴퓨터와 통신이 가능 하도록 구성된 PC 연결부로 구성된 제어회로에 있어서, 
     	상기 중앙제어부의 타측에 연결되어 제어용 프로그램이나 전원복구시 관리자의 전화번호 및 통보를 위한 데이터가 내장되는 메모리부와, 상기 중앙제어부에 연결되어 비상상태 발생시 관리자 등과 통신을 위하여 설치되는 통신용 포트와, 상기 중앙제어부에 연결되고, 재해방지를 위하여 온도, 습도, 방재, 방범을 위한 각종 센서의 온/오프 접점을 통하여 감지하는 다목적용 검출부와, 	상기 중앙제어부에 연결되고, 전력선을 통하여 농가시설물의 원격장치와 데이터 통신을 수행하는 PLC 모듈로 구성되며,

title_en: Wearable recorder for recording construction site conditions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wearable recorder for recording construction site conditions. The wearable recorder comprises a wearable mobile terminal and a service terminal, wherein the service terminal is connected with the wearable mobile terminal; the wearable mobile terminal comprises a power supply, a communication device, a GPS module, an RFID (radio frequency identification) module, a camera and a wireless transmission module, and is connected to the service terminal through the wireless transmission module. Due to wireless transmission, wiring and the size of the wearable recorder are reduced, and the wearable recorder serving as a monitoring device can move along with a working personnel, so that the monitoring effect of the wearable recorder is better than that of the conventional monitoring device arranged on a construction site; moreover, by means of distributed servers, real-time and dynamic recording of the personnel on the construction site can be realized, the data reading speed is greatly accelerated, and fragmented information can be displayed in a concentrated manner, so that the emergency command capability is enhanced, and the management efficiency is improved. The recorder can be widely applied to the field of engineering monitoring.
assignees: GUANGZHOU CONSTRUCTION QUALITY & SAFETY TESTING CT;BEIJING LRK SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent standardization law enforcement central management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent standardization law enforcement central management systems, including carry out the associated back-stage management subsystem of data interaction, user management subsystem, file management subsystem, area's management subsystem of handling a case by interchanger and command centre between each other.The present invention is used based on intelligence hearing control, intelligent folder control and its is managed in the Technical Architecture of one, by the way that service logic is complete and linking innovation, the complete process process of case is fully considered, from by putting on record, personnel positioning and tracking, controlled to form streamlined system control system to the intelligence hearing of suspect, intelligent folder, it realizes public security organs users at different levels to jointly control program of handling a case by command centre, substantially increases the efficiency and intelligence handled a case；System design is rigorous, and running efficiency of system is high, and intelligence degree is higher, security performance with higher, is suitble to promote and apply.
assignees: HANGZHOU HENGBAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground-air defense product antagonism simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground air defense product antagonism simulation training system which comprises a guiding and adjusting system, a training monitoring system, a training control system, a blue army simulation system, a weapon control system and a simulation cartridge. The system can simulate a vivid threat environment, covers various typical targets, simulates common attack fighting styles such as maneuvering, formation and anti-radiation attack, and has the electromagnetic scattering characteristic consistent with the typical fighting targets; the electromagnetic environment can be simulated vividly, and the mutual interference environment of the own party and common interference patterns such as the suppression, the deception and the like of the enemy are constructed; the training management functions of guiding, planning, evaluating and the like of the commander at the upper level can be assisted; the main fire platform display control information, the local deployment and the main platform activity real scene can be recorded in real time; can be connected with a real device to launch the simulated rocket bomb, thereby increasing the real operation feeling of the operator.
assignees: SHANGHAI SPACE PRECISION MACHINERY RES INST

title_en: Comprehensive test simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of accident rescue, and discloses a comprehensive test simulation training system which comprises a receiving system, a processing system and a notification system, wherein the receiving system comprises a rescue call answering system for answering the rescue calls of people and an accident information recording system for recording main accident information; the processing system comprises an accident analysis system and a suggestion prompt system which are used for judging the accident category; the notification system comprises a broadcasting system for notifying all rescue workers and a wireless communication system for commanding the battle on site. The invention can simulate and drill various situations in accident rescue, thereby leading commanders and rescue workers for on-site rescue to be familiar with and know the flow of the accident rescue, and being convenient for carrying out the accident rescue quickly and efficiently when the accident really occurs.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE CHUANGXIN SCIENCE AND TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent micro-patch protection method and system based on native micro-service design
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent micro-patch protection method and system based on a native micro-service design, and relates to the technical field of information security. The method provides a reliable data basis for subsequent vulnerability detection and micro-patch protection, reduces the possibility of attack of the system, improves the efficiency of emergency response, realizes comprehensive recording and timely updating of vulnerability information, ensures the accuracy of vulnerability detection, improves the efficiency and safety of vulnerability repair, and can provide customized security reinforcement for specific environments or demands by supporting uploading of custom micro-patch information, thereby further improving the safety of the system.

title_en: Intelligent safety control system for transformer substation construction site
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent safety control and provides an intelligent safety control system for a construction site of a transformer substation, which comprises a data acquisition module, a control module and a control module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting data of the construction site; the intelligent analysis system comprises a data acquisition module, a central processing platform, an intelligent analysis module, a real-time monitoring module, an access control management module, an emergency response module and an emergency response mechanism, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring data from a central processing platform, the data acquisition module is used for transmitting the data to the central processing platform through a wireless network, the intelligent analysis module is used for analyzing the data transmitted to the central processing platform, identifying potential safety hazards and abnormal behaviors and giving out early warning, the real-time monitoring module is used for displaying real-time conditions of a construction site in a chart form, the access control management module is used for carrying out identity verification, access record and regional authority management on constructors and limiting personnel access to a key region, the emergency response module is used for presetting an emergency plan template, and the emergency response mechanism is started when abnormal conditions occur according to an analysis result of the intelligent analysis module.
assignees: STATE GRID SHAANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD CONSTRUCTION BRANCH;UNIV XIDIAN

title_en: Combined fleet safety risk assessment method and system based on data processing
abstract_en: The invention provides a combined fleet safety risk assessment method and system based on data processing, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps of 1, acquiring four types of data including ship state data, connecting device working condition data, sailing environment data and cargo safety parameters through sensors on a main propulsion ship, a barge and an auxiliary functional ship; and 2, transmitting the four types of data through a data interaction channel of the ship connecting device, discretizing the data into space distribution data of a ship key area after space-time alignment, and generating six groups of position data sets with three-dimensional space coordinate labels. According to the invention, through establishing the space mapping, quantifying the risk coefficient and fusing the navigation data, the accurate assessment and targeted early warning of the combined fleet all-navigation-segment dynamic risk are realized, and the transportation safety and the emergency response efficiency are improved.
assignees: TIMES TIANHAI XIAMEN INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based traffic emergency command method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a traffic emergency command method and system based on digital twinning, which belong to the technical field of intelligent traffic, and the method comprises the following steps of S1, reporting traffic abnormal events; step S2, event feature extraction and grade calculation, step S3, intelligent match and dynamic deduction of a plan, step S4, visual command and resource automatic scheduling, and step S5, event handling effect evaluation and knowledge base iterative optimization. According to the invention, by fusing physical equipment data, real-time sensor feedback and historical operation records, a dynamically updatable digital mirror image is constructed in a virtual space, the whole process from construction to scrapping of traffic facilities is completely mapped, corresponding disposal schemes are quickly matched according to event severity, and information such as a rescue personnel list and real-time position and contact information thereof in a pre-scheme are synchronously called, so that a visual command link from event discovery to resource scheduling is formed.
assignees: CHENGDU TONGGUANG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent park emergency command method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent park emergency command method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring temperature data of an accident area in a park, wind direction, and congestion degree and length of each road section in a park road network; and when the accident area is judged to be the inoperable area, generating an optimal evacuation path based on the wind direction, the congestion degree and the length of each road section and a graph theory model constructed according to the distribution condition of the park road network, wherein each evacuation point and each exit in the park road network are used as nodes in the graph theory model, the safety coefficient of the road section between the nodes is used as an edge weight value, and pushing and displaying the optimal evacuation path to provide emergency command for emergency command staff. By the method, timeliness and safety of park emergency command can be improved.
assignees: BEIJING YONGSHENG JIETAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electronic device and method of providing workout service thereof
title_ko: 전자 장치 및 전자 장치의 운동 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: According to various embodiments of the present invention, an electronic device may comprise: an input module receiving a user command to select a workout program and a day of the week or a date for workout; and a control module configured to set a schedule for the workout program, based on the entire day that the workout program is conducted, the day of the week or the date for the workout. Other embodiments are also possible. According to the present invention, a user can effectively perform a planned workout schedule by receiving the workout schedule in consideration of a user schedule.

title_en: Iot chemical waste solution separation system and its method by scanning chemical label
title_ko: 화학물질 라벨 스캔을 통한 IoT 화학 폐용액 분리 시스템과 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an IoT chemical waste solution separation system chemical label scanning and a method thereof. The IoT chemical waste solution separation method, according to the present invention, comprises the steps of: (a) inputting a waste solution to be discarded to a program screen of a waste solution search engine and then transmitting the waste solution to a DB server; (b) displaying, on the program screen, information about a substance that should not be mixed with the waste solution and a solution currently collected in a waste solution collection box; (c) collecting the inputted waste solution into a DB of the corresponding waste solution collection box through an algorithm; (d) distinguishing the waste solution collection box of the waste solution from other waste solution collection boxes, indicating the waste solution collection box with an indicator lamp, and locking and unlocking the waste solution collection box with a locking device; and (e) displaying the current state of the waste solution collection box on a web page in real time and allowing access to a user terminal or a collection company terminal. According to the present invention, assets as well as the safety of an experimenter can be protected from an explosion, fire accident, or secondary accident.
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제]   
본 발명은 화학물질 라벨 스캔을 통한 IoT 화학 폐용액 분리 시스템과 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 디스플레이를 통해 버리고자 하는 폐용액을 검색 또는 스캔하면 해당 용액과 혼합되어선 안되는 용액들의 종류를 표기해주고, 현재 여러개의 폐용액 수거함에 들어있는 용액들을 파악하여 버리고자 하는 폐용액을 알맞은 폐용액 수거함에 배출할 수 있도록 하여 실험간에 각종 사고들을 예방할 수 있다. 
 [해결수단]   
본 발명에 의한 IoT 화학 폐용액 분리 방법은, (a) 폐용액 분리 단말기(110)에 폐액검색엔진(120)을 설치 및 구동하고, 상기 폐액검색엔진(120)의 프로그램 화면에서 버리고자 하는 폐용액을 입력 후 검색 버튼을 누르면 통신부(112)를 통해 DB 서버(140)로 전달하는 단계; (b) 상기 DB 서버(140)에서 저장된 정보를 바탕으로 상기 폐용액을 검색하여 상기 폐용액과 섞이면 안되는 물질과 현재 폐용액 수거함(130)에 수거된 용액 정보를 송신하여 상기 폐액검색엔진(120)의 프로그램 화면에 표시해주는 단계; (c) 상기 폐액검색엔진(120)에서 입력 받은 폐용액을 상기 DB 서버(140)로 전송하여 알고리즘(190)을 통해 해당 폐용액 수거함(130)의 DB에 취합하는 단계; (d) 상기 폐용액 분리 단말기(110)에서 상기 DB 서버(140)로부터 수신받은 취합된 데이터를 바탕으로, 상기 폐용액의 폐용액 수거함(130)과 그렇지 않은 다른 폐용액 수거함(130)을 구분하여 표시램프(131)로 표시하고 잠금장치(132)로 잠금 및 해제하는 단계; 및 (e) 상기 웹 서버(150)에서 상기 DB 서버(140)로부터 상기 폐용액 수거함(130)의 현황을 수신받아 웹 페이지(151)에 실시간으로 표시하며, 사용자 단말기(160) 또는 수거업체 단말기(180)에게 접근을 허용하는 단계;를 포함한다. 
 [기대효과]   
본 발명에 따르면, 화학 실험 간 사고는 폐용액의 잘못된 혼합으로 발생하는 경우가 매우 잦은데 이러한 사고로부터 실험자를 안전하게 하고, 폭발이나 화재사고, 2차사고로부터 실험자의 안전 뿐만 아니라, 재산을 보호해줄 수 있다.

title_en: Extracting shared state information from message traffic
abstract_en: An approach to having a shared state from one system to another is to represent data in one system according to service traffic of the other system For example, by intercepting service traffic associated with a first entity, identifying a data object representing at least a portion of the state of the first entity in the service traffic, and updating a corresponding portion of a shared state data structure in accordance with a value of the data object, the shared state can be maintained outside of the first entity This process can be extended to maintaining shared state of more than one entity The service traffic might be e-mail service traffic, database service traffic, or the like Synchronization commands can be used to initiate at least a portion of the service traffic The shared state can be used for backups, record-keeping, service migration, disaster recovery, fail-over and/or fault tolerance improvements

title_en: Chemicals production device actual time safety method for early warning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of chemicals production device actual time safety method for early warning, mainly solve the problems, such as that the dispersion of the subsystems fail messages such as existing chemicals process units technological parameter, equipment, interlocking, pressure relief device, torch, fire-fighting, major accident danger million cannot be by timely identification, discovery and processing.The present invention is by using a kind of chemicals production device actual time safety method for early warning, pass through data mining technology, concentrate mapping techniques, Early-warning Model, early warning classification rule, warning information treatment principle etc., cell arrangement systematic failure information is subjected to real-time monitoring, grading forewarning system, and it is sent to responsible person concerned in time, realize failure discovery in time, problem is handled in time, cutting in time feeds or stops in emergency before major accident danger million, and event handler procedure is recorded, it statisticallys analyze and the technical solution for providing reference as knowledge base for similar incidents next time preferably solves the above problem, it can be used in chemicals production device actual time safety early warning.

title_en: Server, method and computer for classfing and providing structural information of an accident vehicle by vehicle type
title_ko: 서버 장치, 사고 차량의 구조 정보를 차종 별로 분류하여 제공하는 방법, 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a method for classifying and providing structural information of an accident vehicle by vehicle type of a server device connected to a user terminal via a communication network comprises: a step where the server device receives an image or a video of an accident vehicle from the user terminal; a step of receiving vehicle type information of the accident vehicle from the user terminal; a step of searching for a standard image set corresponding to the vehicle based on the vehicle type information; a step of extracting one or more contamination areas included in the image or the video of the accident vehicle; a step of acquiring corresponding position values of contaminants from the standard image set; a step of converting the corresponding position values of the one or more contaminants into structure names; and a step of storing the converted structure names of the vehicle type with an identification code and an image generated in accordance with the accident vehicle, and providing accident data including the structure names of the vehicle type by an information request of the accident vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 명세서는 통신망을 통해 사용자 단말기와 연결되어 서버 장치의 사고 차량의 구조 정보를 차종 별로 분류하여 제공하는 방법에 있어서, 상기 서버 장치가 사용자 단말기로부터 사고 차량의 이미지 또는 영상을 수신하는 단계; 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 상기 사고 차량의 차종 정보를 수신하는 단계; 상기 차종 정보를 기초로 상기 차량과 대응되는 표준 이미지 셋트를 검색하는 단계; 상기 사고 차량의 이미지 또는 영상에 포함된 하나 이상의 오염 영역을 추출하는 단계; 상기 표준 이미지 셋트에서 각 오염물의 대응 위치값을 획득하는 단계; 상기 하나 이상의 오염물의 대응 위치 값을 차종의 구조 명칭으로 변환하는 단계; 및 변환된 상기 차종의 구조 명칭을 상기 사고 차량에 따라서 생성되는 식별 코드 및 이미지와 함께 저장하고, 상기 사고 차량의 정보 요청에 의해 상기 차종의 구조 명칭을 포함하는 사고 데이터를 제공하는 단계;를 포함하는, 사고 차량의 구조 정보를 차종 별로 분류하여 제공하는 방법을 개시한다.
