title_en: Fire-fighting robot water hose joint and automatic butt joint method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting robot hose joint which comprises a joint body, a clamping seat mounting plate and a joint clamping seat, wherein the joint body comprises a water pipe connecting part and a fire hydrant butt joint part which are communicated with each other; the clamp seat mounting plate is fixedly provided with a joint clamp seat; the joint clamping seat comprises a fixing part and a clamping part which are fixedly connected, and the fixing part is fixed with the clamping seat mounting plate. The clamping part is a slot arranged on the peripheral side surface of the clamping part. A fire-fighting robot comprises an image acquisition device, a mechanical arm, a joint gripper and the fire-fighting robot water hose joint; one end of the joint gripper is fixed with the joint clamping seat, and the other end of the joint gripper is hinged with the mechanical arm. The invention realizes rapid and convenient butt joint, guarantees the personal safety of firemen, and improves the intellectualization of the fire-fighting robot and the timeliness of fire-fighting emergency response.
assignees: CHANGZHOU SCHOOL DISTRICT OF RIVER AND SEA UNIV

title_en: Visual monitoring method and system for power transmission line iron tower erection construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual monitoring method and a system for the erection construction of a power transmission line iron tower, wherein the method comprises the following steps: recording face information data registered by constructors; deploying a UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) system to a construction operation site of the iron tower assemblage; designing and writing a UAV flight path planning algorithm for avoiding impacting a bending point of an iron tower; the method comprises the steps that image acquisition equipment carried by the UAV acquires face information and an operation video of an operation site in real time; judging whether the imposition condition of constructors exists or not; and the UAV system transmits a real-time operation video of the construction site to the power grid emergency command center. According to the embodiment of the invention, the UAV automatic shooting process waypoint operation is carried out by setting the UAV fixed navigation process waypoint, the construction operation condition of the iron tower assembly of the overhead transmission line is efficiently monitored, whether the phenomenon of impersonation displacement exists or not is identified, and the personal risk of field maintainers is effectively controlled.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent task dispatching system based on vehicle annual inspection app
abstract_en: Compared with a common expense recording system, the system can intelligently screen out nearby designated driving companies and drivers, so that the drivers can complete the tasks of vehicle annual inspection, a large amount of time is saved, meanwhile, the operation cost is greatly saved by adopting artificial intelligent taxi selection, and meanwhile, the efficiency can be improved.
assignees: HAINAN YILE IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bedrock incident-downlink wave number value separation method based on array observation
abstract_en: The invention provides a matrix incident-downlink wave number value separation method based on array observation, which comprises the steps of establishing a two-dimensional stratified field finite element model according to wave speed structure information of a field where an array is located, inputting array matrix observation waves into grid nodes at the bottom, extracting a counter force time course RF (t) from middle grid nodes at the bottom after submitting operation, dividing the counter force time course by the grid node width L to obtain a node counter force time course F (t) with unit length, and converting the station matrix observation waves a (t) into an equivalent node force time course F (t) 1 And (t) calculating an equivalent node force time course f (t) of the bedrock incident wave, substituting the equivalent node force time course of the bedrock incident wave into an equivalent node force calculation formula, and performing inverse solution calculation to obtain a bedrock incident wave u (t). The method can separate the incident wave and the down-going wave reflected by the earth surface in the observation record of the vertical array bedrock, obtain the accurate input data for the earthquake-resistant analysis of the underground structure, and realize the accurate analysis of the earthquake field reaction.

title_en: Optimal path selection method for fire water intake and intelligent monitoring system for fire hydrant
abstract_en: The application relates to a fire-fighting water intake optimal path selection method and a fire hydrant intelligent monitoring system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: constructing a fire hydrant optimal selection mathematical model based on timeliness and reliability; s2: calculating a road section passing time matrix; s3: calculating the shortest time and the path passing through any two intersections; s4: and calculating the shortest time for a single fire truck to travel to the target fire hydrant and the path of the single fire truck, and dispatching the fire truck according to the calculation result. The optimal path selection method for fire-fighting water intake can quickly and accurately help firefighters to select optimal water intake points from a plurality of water intake points, and plan the optimal water intake path of the fire-fighting truck, so that water intake time is effectively reduced, and more favorable time is striven for fire-fighting rescue.

title_en: Satellite super-melt intercommunication digital communication emergency command scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication command, in particular to a satellite super-melt intercommunication digital communication emergency command scheduling method, which comprises the steps of constructing a coverage range of a request signal by taking an emergency place to be used as a circle center, determining the position of emergency equipment in the range, primarily judging whether the emergency equipment meets the emergency treatment requirement of the emergency place to be used according to the number of the emergency repair terminals, increasing the number of the emergency repair terminals by expanding the transmission radius of the request signal when the number of the emergency repair terminals is small, screening emergency repair terminals with higher emergency efficiency according to the distance between each emergency repair terminal and the emergency place to be used when the number of the emergency repair terminals is large, determining the emergency repair time limit of the emergency treatment according to the type of an emergency event of the emergency place to be used, determining the scheduling time of the emergency repair terminal to reach the emergency place to be used and the emergency repair time length of the emergency treatment by the emergency terminal according to the factors such as the current road condition, and analyzing the timeliness of the emergency treatment according to the emergency repair time limit, the scheduling time length and the emergency repair time length, thereby guaranteeing the emergency treatment efficiency.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA EHV POWER SUPPLY BRANCH INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting on-line monitoring alarm system, method and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of fire control supervision, and particularly relates to an intelligent fire control on-line monitoring alarm system, an intelligent fire control on-line monitoring alarm method and a storage medium, wherein the intelligent fire control on-line monitoring alarm system comprises a fire control monitoring module, a fire control analysis prediction module, an emergency response alarm module, a regional threat analysis module and a fire control management end; according to the invention, the fire risk prediction model analyzes fire data to identify fire hazards through the fire monitoring module to carry out environmental monitoring on the fire monitoring area, when the fire hazards are identified, accurate alarm information is sent to the fire management end to inform personnel evacuation, the accuracy and timeliness of fire early warning are obviously improved, the fire threat of the fire monitoring area in the supervision period is analyzed through the area threat analysis module, the fire supervision of the fire monitoring area is enhanced when a fire high threat signal is generated, the timely and reasonable formulation of the fire management scheme of the fire monitoring area is facilitated, and the scientificity of the fire management scheme and the area safety of the fire monitoring area are ensured.
assignees: JIANGSU JIELAER INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Government hot line work order intelligent allocation method based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention provides a large language model-based government affair hot line work order intelligent allocation method, which comprises fine adjustment of a large language model and government affair case allocation of the fine adjustment model, wherein the fine adjustment of the large language model comprises the following steps of arranging case allocation record information and constructing a case allocation knowledge base; the method comprises the steps of constructing a fine tuning data set in batches, cleaning the fine tuning data set, and fine tuning a large language model by using the fine tuning data set. The invention utilizes the logic reasoning capability of the large language model to simulate the logic of manual dispatch, sorts out the work order dispatch rules followed by the dispatch staff in the actual dispatch process on business, completes intelligent dispatch, has higher flexibility, can complete the update of the intelligent dispatch module without retraining the model and updating the work order dispatch rule document under the condition of slight change of the work order dispatch rules, has interpretability, can provide the original wavelet model, and is easier to understand and optimize the effect of the whole module.
assignees: GEO SPACE TIME INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for simulating response plans against nbc hazards and recording medium thereof
title_ko: 화생방 재난 대응 시뮬레이션 방법, 장치 및 기록 매체
abstract_en: One embodiment relates to a simulation method and a simulation device for a CBR emergency response and a recording medium thereof. According to one embodiment, the simulation method for a CBR emergency response comprises the steps of: receiving an input of a scenario including a CBR emergency; executing a simulation based on the input scenario; calculating, when the CBR emergency occurs during the execution of the simulation, a contamination area and contamination concentration distribution caused by the CBR emergency using a governing equation; determining whether an object is contaminated using the calculated contamination area and contamination concentration distribution; and determining, when it is determined that the object is contaminated, whether the contaminated object is neutralized. Accordingly, the present invention has the effect of providing an analysis tool for establishment of effective countermeasures.
abstract_ko: 실시예는 화생방 재난 대응 시뮬레이션 방법, 장치 및 기록 매체에 관한 것으로서, 실시예에 따른 화생방 재난 대응 시뮬레이션 방법은, 화생방 재난을 포함한 시나리오가 입력되는 단계, 상기 입력된 시나리오를 기초로 하여 시뮬레이션을 실행하는 단계, 상기 시뮬레이션의 실행 중에 상기 화생방 재난이 발생한 경우, 상기 화생방 재난에 의한, 오염 영역 및 오염 농도 분포를 지배방정식을 이용하여 산출하는 단계, 상기 산출된, 오염 영역 및 오염 농도 분포를 이용하여, 개체가 오염되었는지 판정하는 단계, 그리고 상기 개체가 오염된 것으로 판정된 경우, 상기 오염된 개체가 무력화되었는지 판단하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: KOREA Defense certification management system
title_ko: K(korea)방역 인증관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a K (KOREA)-quarantine authentication managing system, which can more actively and safely maintain quarantine, comprising: an access control device (100) for wirelessly transmitting identity check data and camera photographing data to an integrated control server; a plurality of distancing alarm devices (200, 201, 202) assigned to each visitor during an event; and an integrated control server (300) for allowing access management.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 코로나의 장기화에 따른 집단의 모임을 집단 스스로 방역 관리하도록 집단의 모임 행사를 기록 및 모니터링 할 수 있도록 시스템화하여 관리토록 하되, 모임에 입장하는 사람들의 방역관련 정보를 수집 기록관리하고, 모임 행사의 진행을 지속적으로 모니터링 하여 모임을 갖는 사람들 스스로는 물론 행사주최측에서도 보다 적극적으로 안전하게 방역을 유지할 수 있는 K방역 인증관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 출입자가 행사장 출입조건에 맞는지 발열 및 마스크착용을 확인하여 감염자의 차단 및 전파를 막고, 향후 감염사고 발생시 출입 기록을 확인하여 신속한 역학조사를 함으로써 감염의 확산을 방지하기 위하여 사용되는 장치로, 체온측정, 카메라 촬영, 출입 주적합자에 대한 경보음 출력 및 출입 게이트에 대한 오픈/클로즈 신호 발생, 출입자에 대한 화면 안내, 출입자 및 출입 거부자에 대한 신원 확인 데이터 및 카메라 촬영 데이터를 통합관제 서버로 무선전송 등을 수행하는 출입관리장치(100); 행사중 출입자 각각에게 교부되는 것으로, 사람간의 거리가 일정거리 접근하면 알람을 발생하여 스스로 서로간의 거리를 확보할 수 있도록하여 감염을 예방하고, 알람이 반복되면 해당 알람이 반복되는 출입자 정보를 통합관제 서버로 전송하여 거리두기의 위반을 기록함으로써 불이익을 준다는 것을 인식토록하여, 행사 개최자 스스로 조심토록하기 위한 복수의 거리두기 알람장치(200, 201, 202); 및 상기 출입관리장치(100)와 거리두기 알람장치(200, 201, 202)로부터 수신되는 정보를 데이터베이스(DataBase)로 기록 관리하여 논리적인 통계 분석이 가능토록하며, 빅데이터(BigData)화로 가공할 수 있도록 한다.  또한 보건복지부 서버(도시되지 않음) 등으로부터 감염자 또는 격리자 데이터를 받아 출입관리장치(100)로 전송하여 출입관리를 할 수 있도록 하는 통합관제 서버(300);를 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 K(KOREA)방역 인증관리 시스템을 제공한다.
assignees: PARK YOUNG SUNG;HUR YOO JUNG;TRATEC INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Incident report generation from multimedia data capture
abstract_en: This disclosure describes an apparatus and system for classifying audio and video data captured by a portable recording device. The portable recording device may comprise a camera system enclosure that captures audio and video data that reflects a user’s point-of-view perception of their surroundings. The video and/or audio data may be transmitted in real-time, or near real-time, to a Central Multimedia Management (CMM) System at a Network Operations Center, or one or more mobile computing devices, via one or more networks. Alternatively, or additionally, the video and/or audio data may be stored within memory of the portable recording device. This disclosure further describes a CMM system that may act as a central repository of multimedia data from one or more portable recording device(s). The CMM system may further generate and assign incident report forms for each individual instance of real-time data that is recorded by a portable recording device.
assignees: GETAC TECHNOLOGY CORP;WHP WORKFLOW SOLUTIONS INC

title_en: Improved application server disaster tolerance system of next generation network and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an improved application server disaster tolerance system of a next generation network and a method thereof. The method comprises the following steps: a service-call session control function records an incidence relation between address information of a current application server and a subscriber; the service-call session control function receives a service request of the subscriber which is associated with the current application server, and then the service request is triggered to the current application server for processing according to the incidence relation. The system comprises a main application server, one or more spare application server and the service-call session control function. By adopting the technical proposal of the invention, all incidents of one subscriber can be triggered to the current application server for processing, thus avoiding the problem of service loss caused by processing the related services of the subscriber on two or more application servers when the main application server is recovered to normal from the failure.

title_en: Trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster warning analysis, and particularly relates to a trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data. According to the invention, the accuracy and timeliness of disaster prediction are obviously improved through optimizing the matching rules and the threshold values in real time, the deep fusion and the efficient utilization of multi-source data are realized, scientific basis and technical support are provided for disaster early warning and emergency response, meanwhile, the system has self-adaptive learning capability, a model can be continuously optimized in continuously updated data, the dynamic accuracy of a prediction result is ensured, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability is effectively improved.

title_en: Monitoring system for maintaining common duct
title_ko: 공동구 유지관리 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A utility-pipe conduit maintenance monitoring system is provided to perform maintenance of more systematical and safe utility-pipe. CONSTITUTION: A utility-pipe conduit information provider includes as follows. An electric field sensing module senses an electric field which is exposed to an external side from a wire pipe which is arranged in the utility-pipe. A gas leakage sensing module senses gas which exposed form the pie for gas transmission. A pH measuring module is buried in a concrete of a utility-pipe and measures a pH of the concrete.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동구 유지관리 모니터링 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 이는 공동구 내에서 전기, 물, 가스 흐름의 정상 및 비정상 상태를 실시간으로 점검하여 유지보수 시기 예측과 안전사고 방지에 기여하기 위한 것이다. 이를 위해 본 발명은, 콘크리트를 타설하여 형성된 공동구 내 배치되는 전선용배관으로부터 외측으로 누출되는 전기장을 감지하기 위한 전기장감지모듈과, 상기 공동구 내 배치되는 가스이송용배관 외주면을 따라 일정간격으로 설치되어 그 가스이송용배관으로부터 누출되는 가스를 감지하기 위한 가스누출감지모듈과, 상기 공동구 내 배치되는 상하수이송용배관 외주면을 따라 일정간격으로 설치되어 습도를 측정하기 위한 습도측정모듈과, 상기 공동구의 콘크리트에 매설되어 그 콘크리트의 pH를 측정하기 위한 pH측정모듈과, 상기 전기장감지모듈, 가스누출감지모듈, 습도측정모듈 및 pH측정모듈 중 어느 하나로부터 전송된 아날로그 신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하여 출력하는 A/D 변환모듈과, 상기 A/D 변환모듈의 디지털 신호를 유무선으로 인터넷 네트워크에 전송하는 제1 통신모듈로 이루어진 공동구정보제공부와; 상기 제1 통신모듈과 통신하기 위한 제2 통신모듈과, 상기 제2 통신모듈로부터 수신된 공동구정보제공부의 과거 및 현재 이력정보를 저장하는 이력 DB(DataBase)와, 상기 이력 DB의 과거 및 현재 정보를 비교하여 출력하는 분석모듈과, 상기 분석모듈의 비교정보를 기초로 하여 과거 및 현재 정보의 편차가 미리 설정된 데이터값을 초과하는 경우 경고신호를 생성하기 위한 경고모듈과, 상기 분석모듈의 비교정보를 시각적으로 표시하고 경고모듈의 경고신호를 시청각적으로 통보하는 모니터링모듈로 이루어진 서브관리부와; 복수개의 상기 서브관리부와 인터넷 통신하여 각각의 서브관리부로 전송된 공동구정보제공부의 정보를 모니터링할 수 있는 메인관리부;로 구성되는 것을 특징되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Programing Training Device
title_ko: 미로 코딩을 이용한 프로그래밍 학습 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device of learning programing using maze coding. The device of learning programing using maze coding comprises: a maze table (10) having a maze (13, or a path) formed by a plurality of block walls on the table (11); a small traveling body (20) located at one point on the maze (13, or path) of the maze table (10) and including a traveling means (21, a first motor) and a steering means (23, a second motor); a sub control unit (30) including a sub control circuit (31) configured to control the traveling means (21, a first motor) and the steering means (23, a second motor) by receiving a command from a coding command unit (40) via a first receiving and transmitting unit (35); and the coding command unit (40) including coding buttons (41) inscribed with a flowchart or a phrase of coding concept, a processing device (43) generating a command (program, control signal) to be transmitted to a controller (30) in the order in which the selected coding buttons (41) are selected (pressed), and a second transmitting and receiving unit (45) transmitting the command (program, control signal) generated in the processing device (43) to the sub control unit (30). According to the present invention, a learner who is learning coding for the first time can feel interests in learning coding while using an IoT coding kit including Arduino and Scratch.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 미로 코딩을 이용한 프로그래밍 학습 장치에 관한 것으로, 테이블(11) 상에 복수개 블록 형태의 차단벽으로  미로(13, 또는 경로)를 형성한 미로 테이블(10)과; 상기 미로 테이블(10)의 미로(또는 경로) 상의 일지점에 위치되고, 주행 수단(21, 제1 모터)과 조향 수단(23, 제2 모터)을 구비한 소형 주행체(20)와; 제1 송수신부(35)를 통하여 코딩 지령부(40)의 지령을 받아서 상기 주행 수단(21, 예를들어 제1 모터)과 조향 수단(23, 예를들어 제2 모터)을 제어하는 서브 제어회로(31)를 구비한 서브 제어부(30)와; 순서도 또는 코딩 개념의 문구가 새겨진 코딩 버튼(41)과, 선택된 코딩 버튼(41)이 선택된(눌려진) 순서대로 제어기기(30)에 전달될 지령(프로그램, 제어신호)을 생성하는 처리장치(43)와, 상기 처리장치(43)에서 생성된 지령(프로그램, 제어신호)을 서브제어부(30)에 전달하는 제2 송수신부(45)로 구성된 코딩 지령부(40);를 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 미로 코딩을 이용한 프로그래밍 학습 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Industrial site safety management method and system using application
title_ko: 애플리케이션을 이용한 산업현장 안전 관리 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Provided are an industrial site safety management method and system using an application. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the industrial site safety management method using an application comprises: a first step of performing, by a user terminal, executing the application provided by a server to perform a login procedure; a second step of selecting, by the user terminal in which the login procedure is normally performed, a work item to receive information from among selectable work items; and a third step of receiving, by the user terminal, information on the selected work item from the server to output the same on a screen. The information on the selected work item may include work content related to the selected work item, safety regulations, and emergency response strategies in case of potential hazards during work. Accordingly, the present invention can prevent accidents by informing the work content, safety regulations, and emergency response strategies in case of potential hazards during work through the application.
abstract_ko: 애플리케이션을 이용한 산업현장 안전 관리 방법 및 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 애플리케이션을 이용한 산업현장 안전 관리 방법은, 사용자 단말이 서버가 제공하는 애플리케이션을 실행하여 로그인 절차를 수행하는 제1 단계; 로그인 절차가 정상적으로 수행된 사용자 단말이 선택 가능한 작업 항목 중 정보를 제공받고자 하는 작업 항목을 선택하는 제2 단계; 및 사용자 단말이 서버로부터 선택된 작업 항목에 대한 정보를 수신하여 화면에 출력하는 제3 단계;를 포함하고, 선택된 작업 항목에 대한 정보는, 선택된 작업 항목에 연관된 작업 내용, 안전 수칙, 작업 중 위험요소 및 위험 발생 시 대처 방안에 대한 정보를 포함할 수 있다. 이에 의해, 애플리케이션을 통해 작업 내용, 안전 수칙, 작업 중 위험요소 및 위험 발생 시 대처 방안에 대한 내용을 숙지하도록 함으로써, 안전 사고를 예방할 수 있다.
assignees: KOREA PLANT SERV & ENG CO LTD

title_en: Online street safety map system displaying crime density and traffic accident data
abstract_en: An interactive street safety map system for internet, GPS, and mobile users is disclosed. The system is designed to identify crime and traffic accidents information at street level. Each street segment on the map indicates low to high density of crime and traffic accidents in different colors in order to improve public perception of safety on each of the streets displayed. The system includes crime and traffic accident data, and the system users can query the data for their interest locations, crime types, crime date and time of occurrence, and the number of crime incidents and traffic accidents. Ultimately, the online street safety map allows users to choose relatively low risk of crime and traffic accident streets for their own safety. The system harvests crime and traffic information data from police departments through Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD), Recorded Management Systems (RMS), and other crime and traffic information sharing services.

title_en: A kind of firearms management system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of firearms management system, including gun, also include chip, client, management service platform and work station, chip is arranged on gun, chip includes single-chip microcomputer, bluetooth module and power module, power module is connected with single-chip microcomputer and bluetooth module respectively, described single-chip microcomputer is connected with described bluetooth module, described chip is communicated with client by bluetooth module, client includes mobile phone or transmitter receiver, mobile phone or transmitter receiver are provided with client, client is communicated with management service platform by wireless network, management service platform includes external network server and database server, work station includes command centre's work station, firearm management work station and department head's work station.The beneficial effects of the present invention is, it is provided that a kind of firearms management system, this system can effectively, accurately, intelligently gun to turnover storehouse carry out information binding, gather, record, position, and the maintenance information of gun is quickly inquired about and is added up.
assignees: BEIJING RICHES & SAGACIOUS TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of test method based on helicopter analog device synchronism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of test methods based on helicopter analog device synchronism, belong to computer distribution type Simulation Application technical field.Include the following steps：Platform is adjusted to issue synchronism test command to 1 steerable system of simulator Step 1: leading；It is settled accounts Step 2: the simulation management software in simulator 1 receives steering command and is sent to flight Simulation System, obtained helicopter position and attitude information is sent to visual system to render, the what comes into a driver's software that the data after rendering are simultaneously sent to simulator 2 is rendered；Step 3: the data after the completion of simulator 1 and simulator 2 render are respectively sent to synchronism test macro in the form of UDP, and record receiving time t 1 Grade t 2 ；Step 4: synchronism test macro, which draws comparison diagram according to the sine wave and time that obtain twice, obtains error T synchronization time；Step 5: repeating above step, synchronism test statistics table is obtained, and judge synchronization time, whether error T met the requirements.

title_en: Self-response disposal method for security product and related equipment
abstract_en: According to the self-response disposal method and the related equipment for the safety product, fault reporting information sent by a user side can be obtained, wherein the fault reporting information comprises an IP address and system access information of the user side; determining a safety product of the forbidden IP address by using the IP forbidden record; calling an interface of a safety product to obtain the sealing information corresponding to the fault reporting information through the IP address and the system access information, wherein the sealing information comprises a sealing strategy applied by the sealing IP address; obtaining historical forbidden record information associated with a forbidden strategy in a strategy judgment historical database; and determining whether to decapsulate the IP address by using the historical decapsulation record information. This openly can integrate multiple safety product, and history through the policy of banning seals the linkage analysis that record information realized data, realizes the emergency response to user's report failure between each safety product, is favorable to improving user's use and experiences.

title_en: Information security emergency response system based on quantum characteristics
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information security, and discloses an information security emergency response system based on quantum characteristics, which comprises: the quantum dot module is used for responding nodes of information communication and recording physical index information and health index information of the nodes; the quantum communication module is used for constructing a quantum channel of quantum communication, and is used for constructing a quantum tensor network by cross-connecting a plurality of quantum base point modules; the safety processing module is used for integrating and processing node information of the quantum base point modules, extracting safety identity marks and constructing safety identity information; an area storage module; the safety identity mark is used for storing the quantum tensor network and comprises a safety early warning protection instruction for storing preset information; information transmission is carried out through the quantum base point module and the quantum communication module, data transmission is carried out by utilizing a quantum entanglement principle, the data transmission speed is effectively increased, the response speed of safety processing is effectively increased when dangerous data are aimed at, and the safety of data safety protection is improved.

title_en: Comprehensive system and method for extinguishing explosion accident and guaranteeing life in airtight space
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive system and a method for extinguishing explosion accident and guaranteeing life in a closed space, wherein the system comprises: a fire monitoring and alarming subsystem, a fire extinguishing and life protecting subsystem, a data recording and analyzing subsystem and a remote monitoring and controlling subsystem; the method comprises the following steps: monitoring whether fire and fire occurrence occur in the closed space, and if the fire is detected, sending an alarm and sending fire position information to the fire extinguishing and life protecting subsystem; the fire is extinguished by selecting a program according to the nature and the degree of the fire, and the oxygen concentration in the closed space is monitored and life support equipment is provided; recording and analyzing the data of fire accidents, and improving the performance and emergency response strategy of the system through data analysis; the remote monitoring and control of the system are realized through network connection, and the running state of the system is monitored through terminal equipment to perform remote operation and control. The invention can improve the emergency response capability and the personnel safety guarantee level of the explosion accident in the closed space.
assignees: SHENZHEN TAICHANG TONGXIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Operation system and method based on front-end receiving, transporting and processing of renewable resources
abstract_en: The invention discloses an operation system based on front-end collection, transportation and treatment of renewable resources and a method thereof, and relates to the technical field of renewable resource treatment, wherein the operation system comprises a front-end recovery management module, a vehicle dispatching management and control module, an early warning module, an administrator authority working module and a management application platform; in order to solve the problems of unbalanced allocation, low timeliness and low economical efficiency of the renewable resources caused by various types of renewable resource materials, serious bundling conditions and unreasonable allocation at the present stage, the operation system of the front-end receiving, transporting and positioning of the renewable resources of the invention obtains the optimal solution of the front-end receiving, transporting and positioning of the materials by constructing the benefit function of the front-end receiving, transporting and positioning of the renewable resources and generates the treatment scheme of the front-end by restraining and solving, thereby improving the efficiency of the front-end treatment of the renewable resources, reducing the cost and having good balance and timeliness.

title_en: Real-time alert data processing method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time warning condition data processing method and a system based on edge calculation, which relate to the technical field of traffic management and are transmitted to a nearby edge server in real time by collecting traffic warning condition original data, and constructing a lightweight deep learning model at the edge side to generate a traffic situation prediction result, and simultaneously, constructing a police dispatch optimization matrix by combining police information, uploading the matrix to a cloud platform to generate a traffic optimization strategy and issuing the traffic optimization strategy to edge computing nodes of an accident area. The integrity and timeliness of accident information perception can be improved, police resource allocation and traffic guiding decision are optimized, and the intelligent and cooperative capacity of traffic accident emergency management is remarkably enhanced.
assignees: SHANDONG SIWO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for constructing of respose on disaster based on scenario
title_ko: 시나리오 기반 재난 대응 구축 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system to construct a disaster response based on a scenario. The system to construct a disaster response based on a scenario comprises: a scenario planning unit that a user logs in and configures a simulation environment to simulate a scenario by disaster type; a disaster type-based scenario generation unit to generate a scenario in accordance with the user conditions and the simulation environment configured by the scenario planning unit, wherein the scenario is generated by combining a standard operation procedure (SOP) corresponding to a disaster management step by disaster type, emergency support function and geographic information; a simulation unit to execute a simulation to realize a scenario with respect to the disaster type-based scenario generated by the scenario generation unit, generate an emergency warning along the scenario, distribute response resources in accordance with a crisis situation, manage a command system and recover the disaster situation; a post-event analysis unit to generate user assessment data in accordance with the simulated results, generate and store a report; and a disaster variable introduction unit to search not only analyzed disaster variables but also disaster type-based disaster variables from a variety of internet webpages using a web robot module and provide the searched disaster variables to the scenario generation unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 시나리오 기반 재난 대응 구축 시스템에 대한 것으로, 재난 유형별로 시나리오를 시뮬레이션하기 위해서 사용자가 로그인하고 시뮬레이션 환경을 설정하기 위한 시나리오 플래닝부; 상기 시나리오 플래닝부에 의하여 설정된 사용자 조건과 시뮬레이션 환경에 따라 시나리오를 생성하되, 재난 유형에 따라 재난 처리 단계에 해당하는 표준 운영 절차(SOP)와, 긴급 지원 기능 자원과, 지리 정보를 조합하여 시나리오를 생성하는 재난 유형별 시나리오 생성부; 상기 시나리오 생성부에서 생성된 재난 유형별 시나리오에 대하여 시나리오를 구현하고 상기 시나리오 진행에 따라 위기 발생 경보를 발생하며, 위기 상황에 따른 우선 순위에 따라서 대응 자원을 배분하고 지휘체계를 관리하여 재난 상황을 복구 처리하도록 시뮬레이션을 실행하는 시뮬레이션부; 상기 시뮬레이션 진행결과에 따라서 사용자 평가 자료를 생성하고 결과 보고서를 생성하여 저장하는 사후분석부; 및 조사분석된 재난 변수 뿐만 아니라 웹 로봇모듈에 의하여 다양한 인터넷 사이트로부터 재난 유형별로 재난 변수를 검색하고 상기 검색된 재난 변수를 상기 시나리오 생성부로 제공하는 재난변수 도입부를 포함한다.

title_en: Safety management device with NFC module
title_ko: Nfc모듈이 내장된 안전관리 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety management apparatus having a near field communication (NFC) module embedded therein, which comprises: a body disposed on the rear surface of a user terminal; the NFC module received in the body and performing short-range wireless communications with the user terminal; and a communication blocking means disposed between the NFC module and the user terminal to block the short-range wireless communications. According to the present invention, upon an emergency situation, the communication blocking means is simply removed by physical force such that the user terminal is interlocked with the NFC module to automatically activate an exclusive application installed in the user terminal. Accordingly, without an input for unlocking security, such as fingerprint recognition, a lock pattern, and the like, and executing phone and safety applications, the emergency situation is quickly and simply transferred to a set terminal or a control center including surrounding investigation institutions or embassies and legations abroad, and audio and video upon an accident are recorded to collect and store recorded audio and video data, thereby managing safety of a user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 NFC모듈이 내장된 안전관리 장치에 관한 것으로, 사용자 단말기의 배면에 구비되는 몸체와 상기 몸체의 내부에 수용되며, 상기 사용자단말기와 단거리무선통신을 수행하는 NFC모듈 및 상기 NFC모듈과 상기 사용자단말기 사이에 구비되어, 상기 단거리무선통신을 차폐시키는 통신차폐수단을 포함하며, 비상 상황 시에 상기 통신차폐수단을 물리력을 사용하여 간편하게 제거함으로써, 상기 사용자단말기와 상기 NFC모듈이 연동되어 상기 사용자단말기에 설치된 전용 어플리케이션이 자동으로 활성화됨으로써, 지문인식 및 잠금 패턴 등의 보안을 풀고 전화 및 안전 어플리케이션을 실행하는 입력이 필요치 않아 더욱 신속하고 간편하게 지정단말기 또는 주변의 수사기관 또는 재외공관을 포함하는 상기 관제센터에 비상상황을 전파하고, 사고 당시의 녹음 및 녹화를 수행하여 상기 녹음 및 녹화 데이터를 수집 및 저장하여 사용자의 안전을 관리할 수 있는 NFC모듈이 내장된 안전관리 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Quality alerting for computer-aided dispatch systems
abstract_en: Examples provide a public safety answering point server including a processor configured to determines that a call taker of the PSAP has received a call from a caller regarding an incident and generate a transcript of the call. Based on the transcript, the processor determines a set of call attributes associated with the call, and determines whether a computer automated dispatch (“CAD”) record associated with the call is created within a threshold time period from the start time of the call. When the CAD record associated with the call is not created within the threshold time period, the processor infers, using a first artificial intelligence model, whether a CAD record should be created. In response to inferring that a CAD record should be created based on the set of call attributes, the processor generates and transmits a quality alert to an electronic device associated with a user of the PSAP.

title_en: Fire emergency response method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire emergency response, in particular to a fire emergency response method and a fire emergency response system. The fire emergency response method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: acquiring accident information and on-duty ERT personnel information; determining fire equipment information and accident handling people information according to the accident level; acquiring a fire-fighting equipment ID and a storage position through the fire-fighting equipment information, matching the current ERT personnel ID with the fire-fighting equipment ID, and generating an emergency plan according to a matching result; informing the emergency planning to the corresponding person with the current value ERT and acquiring feedback information of the person with the current value ERT; updating the emergency plan by combining the feedback information and the accident handling people number information; recording the accident handling process of the person with the value ERT and broadcasting the handling result. According to the fire emergency response method provided by the invention, a reasonable and high-efficiency executable emergency plan is generated by comprehensively analyzing the emergency situation, and the coping capacity and efficiency of an ERT team under the emergency situation are improved, so that the life and property safety is ensured.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency evacuation intelligent command system and method based on three-dimensional modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency evacuation intelligent command system and a method based on three-dimensional modeling, which relate to the technical field of fire-fighting emergency evacuation, wherein the system comprises: the emergency evacuation system comprises a management and control building site scanning modeling module, a management and control building site fire sensing module, an emergency evacuation route pre-planning module, an emergency evacuation route dynamic correction module, an emergency intelligent command module and a data cloud, wherein after a fire is sensed, the emergency evacuation route of a site evacuation object can be planned in time, and the emergency evacuation route of the site evacuation object can be obtained through correction processing, so that the limitation of the lack of dynamic correction and adjustment of the current emergency evacuation route is effectively overcome, the planned evacuation route can be adapted to specific situations of the site in time after a fire disaster occurs, the capability and efficiency of coping with emergency situations in the command evacuation process are improved, the timeliness of emergency evacuation is guaranteed, and the reliable command evacuation guarantee is provided for evacuees.

title_en: Early warning method and information release platform suitable for emergency
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application aims to construct an early warning and response mechanism capable of automatically learning and self-optimizing by deeply mining key elements in monitoring information of past emergencies and combining historical emergency response behavior data. The establishment of the mechanism not only can remarkably improve the timeliness and accuracy of disaster early warning, but also can ensure that early warning information directional sending plans and data disaster recovery backup processing plans aiming at specific areas can be rapidly generated and executed when disasters occur, thereby reducing casualties and property loss caused by the disasters to the greatest extent.

title_en: Alram system of emergency vehicle movement
title_ko: 긴급차량 출동 알림 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency vehicle dispatch notification system capable of effectively preventing an accident from occurring on a sidewalk by enabling a pedestrian to easily recognize an emergency vehicle dispatched from a garage such as a fire station. The emergency vehicle dispatch notification system includes: a falcon sensor (20) sensing the movement of at least one emergency vehicle parked in a garage (A) for the emergency vehicle; a control unit (100) opening a door shutter (10) which is closing the garage (A) when the movement of the emergency vehicle is sensed; at least hologram display unit (30) installed by being attached to a wall in front of the garage (A) or installed as a post between a sidewalk and a road, and displaying a hologram image through the control unit (100) when the door shutter (10) is opened; and a voice signal output unit (40) installed in front of the garage (A) and outputting corresponding voice information when the hologram image is displayed. Therefore, since a pedestrian can be provided with a hologram image and a voice signal at the same time, the pedestrian can easily recognize the dispatch of an emergency vehicle, so the probability of accidents on a sidewalk can be lowered.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방서와 같은 차고지에서 출동하는 긴급차량을 보행자가 쉽게 인지하여 인도에서의 사고발생을 효과적으로 방지할 수 있도록 하는 긴급차량의 출동 알림 시스템을 제안한다. 이러한 출동 알림 시스템은 긴급차량의 차고지(A)에 주차된 적어도 한 대 이상의 긴급차량의 움직임을 감지하는 팔콘 센서(20)와, 상기 긴급차량의 움직임이 감지되면, 차고지(A)를 폐쇄하고 있는 도어 셔터(10)를 개방하도록 제어하는 제어유닛(100), 상기 차고지(A)의 전방에 벽면부착형으로 설치되거나 인도와 차도의 경계에 지주형으로 설치되고, 상기 도어 셔터(10)가 개방되는 시점에 상기 제어유닛(100)에 의해 홀로그램 영상을 표시하는 적어도 하나 이상의 홀로그램 표시유닛(30), 그리고 상기 차고지(A)의 전방에 설치되고 상기 홀로그램 영상이 표시될 때 대응하는 음성정보를 출력하는 음성신호 출력유닛(40)을 포함하여 구성된다. 따라서 보행자는 홀로그램 영상과 음성신호를 동시에 제공받을 수 있어 긴급차량의 출동사실을 쉽게 인지할 수 있게 되고, 그만큼 인도에서의 사고 발생 가능성이 감소하는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Input output hot-swappable wiring interface providing method and apparatus and system therefor
title_ko: 입출력 핫스와퍼블 배선 인터페이스 제공 방법 및 그를 위한 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing an input/output hot-swappable wiring interface for a simulation control panel for nuclear power plant education, and a device and system therefor. The simulation control panel system for power plant training according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a main control room control panel including a plurality of operation equipment panels for controlling operation equipment for each system; a nuclear power plant training simulator equipped with an education training control program to perform modeling of a power plant component and generate a command value calculated through the education training control program; an input/output control card having a plurality of channels for receiving the command value and transmitting it to the main control room control panel; and a wiring change device for monitoring the channel and performing a wiring change when a failure is detected. Accordingly, the present invention can solve the problem more safely and quickly by changing the input/output wiring in a non-stop state when a channel failure is detected during the operation of a simulation control panel for nuclear power plant education.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원전교육용 모의제어반을 위한 입출력 핫스와퍼블 배선 인터페이스 제공 방법 및 그를 위한 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 원전훈련용 모의제어반 시스템은 각 계통 별 운전 설비를 제어하기 위한 다수의 운전 설비 패널을 포함하는 주제어실 제어 패널과 교육 훈련용 제어 프로그램이 탑재되어 발전소 구성 요소의 모델링을 수행하고 상기 교육 훈련용 제어 프로그램을 통해 계산된 명령 값을 생성하는 원전훈련용 시뮬레이터와 상기 명령 값을 수신하여 상기 주제어실 제어 패널로 전달하기 위한 다수의 채널을 구비하는 입출력 제어 카드와 상기 채널을 모니터링하여 고장 감지 시 배선 변경을 수행하는 배선 변경 장치를 포함할 수 있다. 따라서, 본 발명은 원전교육용 모의제어반 동작 중 채널 고장 감지 시 무정지 상태에서 입출력 배선을 변경하여 보다 안전하고 빠르게 문제를 해결할 수 있는 장점이 있다.
assignees: KOREA PLANT SERV & ENG CO LTD

title_en: Gonu game device based on AI learning and gonu game method using the same
title_ko: Ai 학습 기반의 고누 놀이 장치를 이용한 고누 놀이 방법
abstract_en: Provided is an artificial intelligence (AI) learning-based dice game device to provide programming education easily and efficiently, and a dice game method using the same. According to the present invention, the method comprises: a first step of providing a dice game board and a game method image to a first user group and a second user group, wherein the first user group and the second user group include at least one user and a plurality of dice game-bots include a first dice game-bot corresponding to the first user group and a second dice game-bot corresponding to the second user group; a second step of providing a learning model building program to the first user group and the second user group to build a first command model and a second command model, respectively, wherein the first command model is trained to determine at least one of a direction change and a movement of the first dice game-bot on the basis of a voice command of the first user group and a second command model is trained to determine at least one of a direction change and a movement of the second dice game-bot on the basis of a voice command of the second user group; and a third step of performing a dice game between the first user group and the second user group through the learned first command model and the learned second command model, wherein steps of allowing the first user group to select one of the plurality of first dice game-bots and change the location of the selected first dice game-bots through the learned first command model and allowing the second user group to select one of the plurality of second dice game-bots and change the location of the selected second dice game-bots through the learned second command model are repeated until a game completion condition is fulfilled.
abstract_ko: AI 학습 기반의 고누 놀이 장치를 이용한 고누 놀이 방법이 제공된다. 상기 방법은: 상기 고누 놀이판과 상기 게임 방법 영상을 제1 사용자 그룹과 제2 사용자 그룹에게 제공하는 제1 단계로서, 상기 제1 사용자 그룹과 상기 제2 사용자 그룹은 적어도 한명의 사용자를 포함하고, 상기 복수의 고누 놀이봇는 상기 제1 사용자 그룹에 대응하는 제1 고누 놀이봇과 상기 제2 사용자 그룹에 대응하는 제2 고누 놀이봇을 포함하는, 제1 단계; 상기 학습 모델 구축 프로그램을 상기 제1 사용자 그룹과 상기 제2 사용자 그룹에 제공하여 제1 명령 모델과 제2 명령 모델을 각각 구축하는 제2 단계로서, 상기 제1 명령 모델은 상기 제1 사용자 그룹의 음성 명령에 기초하여 상기 제1 고누 놀이봇의 방향 전환 및 이동 중 적어도 하나를 결정하도록 학습되고, 상기 제2 명령 모델은 상기 제2 사용자 그룹의 음성 명령에 기초하여 상기 제2 고누 놀이봇의 방향 전환 및 이동 중 적어도 하나를 결정하도록 학습되는, 제2 단계;및 상기 학습된 제1 명령 모델과 상기 학습된 제2 명령 모델을 통해 상기 제1 사용자 그룹과 상기 제2 사용자 그룹 사이의 고누 놀이를 진행하는 제3 단계로서, 상기 제1 사용자 그룹이 상기 복수의 제1 고누 놀이봇 중 하나를 선택하고 상기 학습된 제1 명령 모델을 통해 선택된 제1 고누 놀이봇의 위치를 변경하고, 상기 제2 사용자 그룹이 상기 복수의 제2 고누 놀이봇 중 하나를 선택하고 상기 학습된 제2 명령 모델을 통해 선택된 제2 고누 놀이봇의 위치를 변경하는 과정을 게임 완료 조건이 수행될 때까지 반복 수행하는, 제3 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of mine emergency command management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mine emergency command management system, connected by optical fiber and set command scheduling central station on the ground to command substation with the underground being distributed in mine, before accident generation or safe manoeuvre, command scheduling central station can be according to the accident case and corresponding safe escape emergency preplan worked out and be stored in emergency preplan storehouse before, secure path is indicated by underground broadcast and LED information screens, commander underground work personnel efficiently withdraw scene in time, and disaster can record emergency preplan according to system after occurring and provide reliable decision-making foundation for rescue and relief work.
assignees: ANHUI DINGXIN TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: A kind of pipe gallery fire-fighting system extinguishing property test device and operating method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of pipe gallery fire-fighting system extinguishing property test device and operating methods, simulated fire gallery cabin including long and narrow cabin spaces, ventilation controller, automatic ignition device, extinguishing device, data acquisition device, video recording system are installed, analog fire occurs, can start extinguishing device fire extinguishing, and whole observation fire extinguishing video and data acquire, for judging extinguishing device performance.Beneficial effect is, the scene of fire incident occurs for the pipe gallery that can simulate a variety of section structures, total flooding and topical application fire-extinguishing test can be carried out for various fire-fighting systems, the situation of change of flue-gas temperature and fire source temperature in real-time monitoring combustion process is conducive to the system revision of pipe gallery technical norm for fire fighting.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Ship emergency navigation position-indicating search and rescue and environment monitoring anti-pollution integrated intelligent platform
abstract_en: The application discloses boats and ships emergency navigation shows a search and rescue and anti-pollution integration wisdom platform of environmental monitoring, it is including floating in the body of the surface of water, be provided with on the body: the VDR-EPIRB equipment is used for sending distress signals to a ground station, reporting the real-time position information of an emergency radio position indicator and a sunken ship, and recording navigation information, navigation equipment information, state information, a driving platform recording and very high frequency wireless communication information of the ship; the AIS equipment is used for sending out the name, position and dynamic information of the ship, marking the accurate position of the ship for search and rescue commands, marking the accurate position and real-time dynamic information of a sunken ship for navigation aid of the passing ship and providing navigation warning; and the power supply is used for supplying power to each electric device.

title_en: Loading and unloading accident emergency disposal test method for container self-ship
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for testing emergency handling of loading and unloading accidents of a container from a ship; the method comprises the following steps: animation scenes of container allocation and transportation, collapse and dangerous cargo leakage are manufactured; the operator stops the loading and unloading operation and checks whether a leakage accident occurs; if leakage occurs, an operator carries out emergency operation; the operator makes personal protection on site; an operator uses communication equipment to report accident conditions to safety management personnel or superior management personnel at the first time; judging the accident influence range according to the collapse leakage scene by an operator; an operator checks an accident scene and records information; the operator places the persons in distress according to the recorded information; and the operators can carry out investigation and treatment on the periphery of the accident site in an interactive mode and report the emergency command leader group of the unit. The testing method provided by the invention can improve the safety awareness and the operation level of the staff in the first-line operation, and meanwhile, the emergency handling capacity of accidents of related staff is enhanced.
assignees: TIANJIN RESEARCH INST WATER TRANSP ENGINEERING MOT

title_en: Emergency rescue system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency rescue system and an emergency rescue method. The emergency rescue system comprises: the command device comprises a first communication terminal; the aircraft comprises an aircraft body, an image acquisition terminal and a second communication terminal, wherein the image acquisition terminal and the second communication terminal are arranged on the aircraft body, and the second communication terminal sends image information acquired by the image acquisition terminal; the ground rescue equipment comprises a third communication terminal, and communication can be carried out among the first communication terminal, the second communication terminal and the third communication terminal. The emergency rescue system and the emergency rescue method improve the timeliness of rescue and the real-time situation awareness capability of disaster areas.
assignees: CETC WUHU GENERAL AVIATION INDUSTRY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CETC WUHU DIAMOND AIRCRAFT MFT CO LTD

title_en: Tunnel fire risk assessment method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a tunnel fire risk assessment method, a tunnel fire risk assessment device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first video stream; the first video stream is a video stream shot by a tunnel entrance; determining the category and track of each vehicle in the tunnel based on the first video stream; obtaining tunnel vehicle distribution at different moments according to each track; determining a vehicle set corresponding to each position in the tunnel according to the distribution of the tunnel vehicles, and determining a tunnel risk index corresponding to each position in the tunnel at a corresponding moment according to the category of each vehicle in the vehicle set and the first corresponding relation; the first corresponding relation is the corresponding relation between the category and the vehicle risk index; and obtaining fire risk distribution according to the risk indexes of each tunnel. The method realizes real-time and dynamic assessment of the tunnel fire risk with lower deployment and implementation cost, greatly improves the timeliness and accuracy of risk management, and provides precious decision support for timely preventive measures and emergency response.

title_en: Factory personnel gathers alarm system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of factory safety production, in particular to a factory personnel gathering alarm system which comprises a personnel positioning module, a dynamic area dividing module, a gathering judging module and an alarm processing module. The system divides the virtual grid area by collecting positioning data in real time, judges personnel gathering events by combining preset parameterization indexes, and generates an emergency response path or a daily monitoring path. The data center records environment information and updates a database, and the risk assessment model is utilized to predict the potential safety hazard development condition so as to generate a scheduling strategy. According to the application, the fine warning is realized by quantifying the aggregation index, the accuracy and timeliness of potential safety hazard warning in a complex production environment are improved, and the safety production requirement of a factory is met.
assignees: HANGZHOU XINKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent comprehensive monitoring and management platform for forest ecosystem
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent comprehensive monitoring and management platform for a forest ecosystem, and belongs to the technical field of ecological system monitoring and management. The intelligent forest ecological system comprehensive management system comprises a multi-source data acquisition subsystem, a data processing and fusion subsystem, an intelligent analysis and prediction subsystem, a decision support subsystem, a comprehensive management subsystem and a comprehensive management subsystem, wherein the multi-source data acquisition subsystem is used for realizing all-round real-time data acquisition of each element of a forest ecological system through an air-space-ground integrated perception network, the data processing and fusion subsystem is used for cleaning, standardizing and evaluating quality of multi-source heterogeneous data, and extracting through space-time alignment and characteristics, the intelligent analysis and prediction subsystem is used for evaluating the health of the ecological system based on a deep learning model and carrying out early warning and prediction on plant diseases and insect pests, fire risks and ecological degradation trends through an intelligent algorithm, the decision support subsystem is used for providing intelligent decision suggestions for resource scheduling optimization, management measure formulation and emergency response, and the comprehensive management subsystem is used for realizing visual display and collaborative management of the forest ecological system through a 3D digital twin and visual display platform and supporting multi-azimuth task scheduling and resource management.
assignees: HENAN ZHONGWEI JIANYE CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for monitoring operation of fans of construction tunnel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of tunnel construction, and particularly discloses a method and a system for monitoring the operation of a fan for constructing a tunnel. The method comprises the steps of constructing a fan efficiency model by collecting tunnel parameter data, collecting multi-source data of fan operation, evaluating and analyzing multi-source standard data based on the fan efficiency model, performing intelligent regulation and control and/or emergency response when the fan operation is abnormal and/or environment risk is abnormal, recording abnormal process data, and performing data archiving treatment. The intelligent monitoring system can construct a fan efficiency model, perform multi-source data acquisition on fan operation, perform evaluation analysis based on the fan efficiency model, and perform corresponding intelligent regulation and control and/or emergency response when abnormal conditions exist, so that flexible monitoring and analysis can be performed according to actual dynamic factors, different abnormal problems can be processed, manual inspection is not needed, and accuracy and timeliness of fan operation monitoring and processing are improved.
assignees: CHINA ANNENG GROUP SECOND ENG BUREAU CO LTD

title_en: Call control system and call control method
abstract_en: To perform connection to an appropriate emergency response agency when an emergency message is transmitted from a mobile terminal device in a communication network that cannot directly specify the current position of the mobile terminal device.SOLUTION: A call control system includes a location management unit 10 for registering the location of a mobile terminal device 30 in an area A, a call control unit 12 for setting a communication route of the mobile terminal device 30 in an area B, and a statistical information DB40 of the position at which the frequency at which the mobile terminal device 30 has registered the location in the location management unit 10 within the area A, the frequency at which the mobile terminal device 30 has registered in the call control unit 12 within the area A or the area B, the frequency at which calling has occurred within area A or area B are recorded as statistical information, and when the mobile terminal device 30 moves to the area B and makes an emergency call, the call control unit 12 specifies the characteristic of the position of the mobile terminal device 30 from the statistical information, and connects the mobile terminal device 30 to an appropriate emergency response agency in accordance with the characteristics of the specified position.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Apparatus and method of car diagnosis service using telematics
title_ko: 텔레매틱스를 이용한 차량 진단 서비스 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An apparatus and a method of car diagnosis service using telematics are provided to take car maintenance service at the time reserved by a driver through a wireless communication. An apparatus of car diagnosis service comprises a telematics terminal device(20), a GPS satellite(30), a mobile communication network(50), a car management service center(60) and a car service part(70). The telematics terminal device having a car management database receives car information from a CAN(Controller Area Network) communicating unit, and compares the car information with reference data to determine a state of a car, and creates a car diagnosis message so as to require service. The car management service center is connected with the telematics terminal device through mobile communication, receives the car diagnosis message, connects the service required by the car, and offers the position data of the car to a terminal device of a mobilization car. The car service part receives the car diagnosis message, finds out causes of malfunction, and offers maintenance service reservation, emergency traction and mobilization service.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 텔레매틱스에 관한 것으로, 특히 차량의 다양한 상태 정보를 텔레매틱스 단말기에 수신 저장하고 기록된 차량상태 정보를 차량의 기준 데이터와 비교 판단하여 이상이 발생시에는 텔레매틱스 단말기의 화면으로 제공하고, 필요시에는 긴급정비 혹은 긴급출동 서비스를 요청 처리하는 텔레매틱스를 이용한 차량 진단 서비스 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 장치는 차량관리 데이터베이스를 설치하고 차량 정보를 CAN 통신부에서 수신하여 상기 차량 관리 데이터 베이스에 기록하여 기준데이터와 비교 판단하여 차량의 이상 여부를 판단하고 차량 진단 메시지를 생성하여 필요시 서비스를 요청하는 텔레매틱스 단말기와, 텔레매틱스 단말기와 이동통신으로 연결되어 상기 차량 진단 메시지를 수신하고 상기 차량에서 요청한 서비스를 연결하고 출동차량의 단말기로 상기 차량의 위치정보를 제공하는 차량관리 서비스센터와, 차량관리 서비스센터에서 상기 차량 진단 메시지를 수신하여 상기 차량의 고장 원인을 파악하고 운전자가 요청한 정비 예약, 긴급 견인, 출동서비스를 제공하도록 제어하는 차량 서비스부를 포함함을 특징으로 한다.
