title_en: Automatic fire extinguishing system and method
title_ko: 자동 소화 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic fire extinguishing system and method which allow a fire-extinguishing range to be minimized through early detection of occurrence of fire and accurate identification of the range of occurrence of fire by using intelligent sensors which wirelessly transmit fire sensing signals. For this purpose, the present invention comprises a storage unit for storing fire-extinguishing liquid; multiple vents connected to the storage unit of fire-extinguishing liquid through a moving passage for discharging the fire-extinguishing liquid; opening and closing units installed at each vent of fire-extinguishing liquid for opening and closing a nozzle passage for each vent of fire-extinguishing liquid; multiple intelligent sensor nodes which sense fire occurrence status and transmit fire sensing signals by a near-field wireless communication method; multiple control units installed at each vent of fire-extinguishing liquid for recording receiving times and controlling opening and closing units when fire-sensing signals are received from the intelligent sensor nodes; and a main control unit for determining which opening and closing unit to be opened based on the receiving times received from each control unit, and imposing control commands to the control unit for controlling the operation of the control unit. Accordingly, the present invention can prevent secondary damages due to excessive fire-extinguishing liquid by detecting occurrence of fire early and minimizing the fire-extinguishing range from accurate identification of the range of occurrence of fire, and can facilitate installation and expansion by employing intelligent sensors which wirelessly transmit fire-sensing signals.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재 감지 신호를 무선으로 송신하는 지능형 센서를 이용하여 조기에 화재 발생을 검출하고, 화재 발생 범위를 정확하게 파악하여 소화 범위를 최소화할 수 있도록 하는 자동 소화 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해, 본 발명은 소화액을 보관하는 소화액 보관부; 소화액 이동 통로를 통해 상기 소화액 보관부에 연결되어 소화액을 분출하는 복수의 소화액 분출구; 각각의 소화액 분출구에 설치되어 각 소화액 분출구의 노즐 통로를 개폐하는 개폐부; 화재 발생 여부를 감지하고, 화재 감지 신호를 근거리 무선 통신 방식으로 송출하는 복수의 지능형 센서 노드; 각각의 소화액 분출구에 설치되어, 상기 지능형 센서 노드로부터 화재 감지 신호를 수신하면, 화재 감지 신호를 수신한 시간을 기록하고, 상기 개폐부의 동작을 제어하는 복수의 수신 시간 기록 및 개폐 제어부; 및 각각의 수신 시간 기록 및 개폐 제어부로부터 수신한 상기 수신 시간에 의거하여 오픈할 개폐부를 결정하고, 결정된 개폐부의 동작을 제어하는 수신 시간 기록 및 개폐 제어부로 제어 명령을 인가하는 주 제어부를 포함하여 이루어지는 것이 바람직하다. 
이에 따라, 본 발명은 화재 발생의 조기 검출이 가능하고, 화재 발생 범위를 정확하게 파악하여 소화 범위를 최소화할 수 있게 됨에 따라 과도한 소화액으로 인한 2차 피해를 방지할 수 있으며, 화재 감지 신호를 무선으로 송신하는 지능형 센서의 채용으로 설치 및 확장이 용이하게 된다.

title_en: Multi-Level Scenario Authoring Method for Threat in Cyber Training Environment
title_ko: 사이버 훈련 환경에서 위협 발생을 위한 멀티레벨 기반의 시나리오 저작 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, provided is a multi-level based scenario authoring method for threat generation in a cyber training environment. The method comprises: an installation step which is performed by a threat generation simulation device corresponding to a cyber attacker and installs a malicious program on a target system; a command and control step which performs a command and control for remotely operating the target system; and an attack purpose achievement step which is to achieve an attack purpose in accordance with tactics for each attack step for the target system. The scenario authoring method can be varied for each level to assist in constructing a cyber training environment more efficiently.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 사이버 훈련 환경에서 위협 발생을 위한 멀티레벨 기반의 시나리오 저작 방법이 제공된다. 상기 방법은 사이버 공격자에 해당하는 위협 발생 시뮬레이션 장치에 의해 수행되고, 목표 시스템에 악성 프로그램을 설치하는 설치 단계; 상기 목표 시스템을 원격 조작하기 위한 명령 및 제어를 수행하는 명령 및 제어 단계; 및 상기 목표 시스템에 대한 각 공격단계 별 전술에 따라 공격 목적을 이루기 위한 공격 목적 달성 단계를 포함하고, 시나리오 저작방법을 레벨 별로 달리하여, 보다 효율적으로 사이버 훈련 환경을 구성하도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for worker safety at construction sites and worker rescue in the event of an accident
title_ko: 건설현장 내 근로자 안전 및 재해사고 발생시 근로자 구조방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a system for rescuing workers in the event of a worker safety and disaster accident in a construction site. According to an aspect of the present invention, there is provided a worker safety and disaster rescue method in a construction site, the worker safety and disaster rescue method including: determining, by a control system, a position of a worker by communicating with a worker communication device carried by the worker at the construction site; checking, by the control system, a communication record of each of a plurality of beacons installed at the construction site, wherein each of the beacons is capable of performing short-range communication with the worker communication device when the control system is unable to communicate with the worker communication device due to a disaster at the construction site; and specifying, by the control system, the position of the worker based on the communication record.
abstract_ko:
건설현장 내 근로자 안전 및 재해사고 발생시 근로자 구조방법 및 그 시스템이 개시된다.  
상기 건설현장 내 근로자 안전 및 재해사고 발생시 근로자 구조방법은 상기 기술적 과제를 달성하기 위한 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 건설현장 내 근로자 안전 및 재해사고 발생시 근로자 구조방법은 관제 시스템이 건축현장의 근로자가 소지한 근로자 통신장치와 통신을 수행하여 근로자의 위치를 판단하는 단계, 상기 관제 시스템이 상기 건축현장의 재해발생으로 인해 상기 근로자 통신장치와 통신이 불가능한 경우, 상기 건축현장에 설치된 복수의 비콘들-상기 비콘들 각각은 상기 근로자 통신장치와 근거리 통신을 수행할 수 있음-각각의 통신기록을 확인하는 단계, 및 상기 관제 시스템이 상기 통신기록에 기초하여 상기 근로자의 위치를 특정하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Online street safety map system displaying crime density and traffic accident data
abstract_en: An interactive street safety map system for internet, GPS, and mobile users is disclosed. The system is designed to identify crime and traffic accidents information at street level. Each street segment on the map indicates low to high density of crime and traffic accidents in different colors in order to improve public perception of safety on each of the streets displayed. The system includes crime and traffic accident data, and the system users can query the data for their interest locations, crime types, crime date and time of occurrence, and the number of crime incidents and traffic accidents. Ultimately, the online street safety map allows users to choose relatively low risk of crime and traffic accident streets for their own safety. The system harvests crime and traffic information data from police departments through Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD), Recorded Management Systems (RMS), and other crime and traffic information sharing services.

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting linkage control method and system for avoiding fire-fighting risks
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting coordinated control method and system for avoiding fire-fighting risks, and relates to the technical field of fire-fighting coordinated control, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a fire dynamic simulator in a simulation manner; the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time monitoring parameters, obtaining the distribution of the covering combustible, carrying out harmful gas diffusion prediction in a preset future time zone to generate harmful gas prediction distribution, carrying out smoke discharging linkage control scheme optimization in combination with the layout of a smoke discharging device, outputting an optimal smoke discharging linkage control scheme, and carrying out smoke discharging control of a target building in the preset future time zone. The technical problems that fire protection alarms in the prior art are difficult to adjust aiming at different building structures and fire scenes, and the diffusion paths of fire and harmful gases cannot be predicted in real time, so that an emergency linkage control scheme is lack of pertinence, and fire protection emergency response is not timely and accurate are solved, and the technical effects of improving the timeliness and the accuracy of the fire protection emergency response, reducing the harmful gas risk of an evacuation channel and the overall fire protection safety risk are achieved.

title_en: Emergency plan making method based on industrial park
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency plan making method based on an industrial park, which is characterized in that data acquisition and preprocessing are realized through a distributed sensing network and edge calculation, a park dynamic model is constructed by utilizing multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and a digital twin technology, a risk propagation path is analyzed by combining a graph neural network, and a preliminary emergency suggestion is generated based on a knowledge graph matching historical case. The invention further adopts a resource scheduling optimization and path planning algorithm to formulate a dynamic response scheme, evaluates the effects of different schemes through a situation evolution prediction model, finally generates an optimal emergency treatment scheme and issues a structural instruction. The method realizes the intelligent formulation of the emergency plan of the industrial park, improves the accuracy of risk identification and the timeliness of emergency response, and provides powerful support for park safety management.

title_en: Method, Apparatus for Food Safety Data Analysis Based on Big Data, And a Computer-readableStorage Medium for executing the Method
title_ko: 빅데이터 기반 식품 안전 데이터 분석 장치, 그 방법 및 그 방법을 실행시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 빅데이터 기반 식품 안전 데이터 분석 장치, 그 방법 및 그 방법을 실행시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 빅데이터 기반 식품 안전 데이터 분석 장치는, 식품 안전과 관련된 용어의 개체 유형과 관계의 의미를 기준으로 개체 인스턴스들을 그룹화 및 추상화하여 클래스를 정의하고, 이들 간의 관계를 정의하는 온톨로지 스키마를 구축하는 온톨로지 구축부; 식품 안전과 관련된 뉴스나 SNS 데이터를 실시간으로 수집하는 실시간 데이터 수집부; 상기 수집한 데이터에서 식품 안전과 관련된 개체명 및 개체명 간의 연관정보를 추출하고, 추출한 각 개체명에 개체정보를 태깅하여 출력하는 개체명 추출부; 상기 추출된 개체명을 상기 개체정보에 기초하여 상기 온톨로지 스키마에 따라 분석하여 스키마 매핑 및 인스턴스 매핑을 수행하여 추론하는 매핑추론부; 및 상기 데이터 수집부에서 수집한 데이터 리스트, 상기 개체명 추출부에서 추출한 상기 개체명 및 상기 개체정보, 및 상기 매핑추론부의 분석 및 매핑결과를 시각화하는 데이터 시각화부를 포함한다. 
이에 의해 직관적으로 식품 안전에 관한 데이터 및 관계 등을 쉽게 알 수 있도록 하며, 식중독 사고 등 식품 안전 사고가 발생한 경우, 관련 급식소 정보를 추출하여 신속한 사고 대응을 가능하게 해준다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer-readable medium for inspection of fire fighting facility based on augmented reality
title_ko: 증강현실 기반의 소방시설 점검 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터-판독가능 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an augmented reality-based firefighting facility inspection method including: a firefighting facility installation information providing step of receiving a firefighting facility drawing regarding an inspection target building from a database of firefighting facility drawings regarding one or more buildings and providing installation information on a firefighting facility installed in the inspection target building by displaying the received firefighting facility drawing on a user terminal; an inspection guidance information providing step of providing the user terminal with guidance information by inspection item of the firefighting facility in the form of augmented reality content by causing object recognition to be performed with respect to the selected firefighting facility when a selection command is received from the user terminal with respect to at least one firefighting facility included in the firefighting facility drawing; and a defective firefighting facility information collection step of collecting defective firefighting facility information by providing the user terminal with an interface enabling state information input regarding a defective firefighting facility when it is determined that the firefighting facility is defective as a result of firefighting inspection regarding the firefighting facility based on the guidance information by inspection item.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 증강현실 기반의 소방시설 점검 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따르면, 하나 이상의 건축물에 대한 소방시설 도면이 저장된 데이터베이스로부터 점검 대상 건축물에 대한 소방시설 도면을 수신하고, 유저 단말에, 수신된 소방시설 도면을 디스플레이함으로써, 점검 대상 건축물에 설치된 소방시설물의 설치 정보를 제공하는 소방시설물 설치 정보 제공 단계; 유저 단말로부터 소방시설 도면에 포함되는 적어도 어느 하나의 소방시설물에 대한 선택 명령이 수신될 시, 선택된 소방시설물에 대한 객체 인식이 수행되도록 하여, 유저 단말에 소방시설물의 점검 항목별 안내 정보를 증강현실 콘텐츠의 형태로 제공하는 점검 안내 정보 제공 단계; 및 점검 항목별 안내 정보에 기초하여 소방시설물에 대한 소방 점검 수행 결과, 소방시설물의 상태가 불량한 것으로 판단될 시, 유저 단말에, 불량 소방시설물에 대한 상태 정보의 입력이 가능한 인터페이스를 제공함으로써, 불량 소방시설물 정보를 수집하는 불량 소방시설물 정보 수집 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Management server, method and computer program for event safety based on ai model
title_ko: Ai 모델 기반의 행사 안전을 위한 관리 서버, 방법 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a risk management technique which calculates the risk of overcrowding at an event site using an AI model and provides a site agent with an instructional message for reducing the accident risk based on the calculated risk. An objective of the present invention is to provide a risk management technique which is capable of determining the actual risk by considering risk information collected by event managers on a site and effectively implementing measures to alleviate the risk. According to the present invention, a server, a method, and a computer program can calculate an overcrowding accident risk index based on participant location information and overcrowding accident risk information through an AI risk management model, and, based on the calculated overcrowding accident risk index, can provide an overcrowding accident risk warning message to event participant terminals and the overcrowding accident risk warning message to event manager terminals. Accordingly, the risk of accidents in project events due to a high density of participants can be effectively managed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 AI 모델을 이용하여 이벤트 현장에서 과밀 사고가 발생할 리스크를 산출하고 이를 기반으로 사고 리스크 경감을 위한 지시 메시지를 현장 관리자에게 제공하는 리스크 관리 기법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 목적은 이벤트 관리자들이 현장에서 수집하는 리스크 정보를 고려하여 실질적인 위험성을 판단하고 이를 경감하기 위한 방안을 실효성 있게 수행할 수 있는 리스크 관리 기법을 제공하는 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 서버, 방법 및 컴퓨터 프로그램에 의하면, AI 리스크 관리 모델을 통해 참여자 위치 정보 및 과밀 사고 리스크 정보에 기초하여 과밀 사고 리스크 지수가 산출될 수 있으며, 이에 기초하여 이벤트 참여자 단말들에 과밀 사고 리스크 경고 메시지가 제공될 수 있고, 이벤트 관리자 단말들에 과밀 사고 리스크 경감 지시 메시지가 제공될 수 있으므로, 참여자들의 밀집으로 인한 프로젝트성 이벤트의 사고 위험이 효과적으로 관리될 수 있다.

title_en: Selective and protected release of private information to an incident response team
abstract_en: Selective and protected release of private information/data to an incident response team (for example, public safety personnel) is disclosed. The private data (which pertains to individuals recorded as being within a premises at the time of an incident with respect to which the incident response team is responding to) may take the form of a system-generated log, which may be transferred to a first level of the public safety personnel once authenticated. Based on at least one of role, incident type, and incident severity, the first level of authenticated public safety personnel may release at least a portion of the private data to a second level of authenticated public safety personnel.

title_en: Quality alerting for computer-aided dispatch systems
abstract_en: Examples provide a public safety answering point server including a processor configured to determines that a call taker of the PSAP has received a call from a caller regarding an incident and generate a transcript of the call. Based on the transcript, the processor determines a set of call attributes associated with the call, and determines whether a computer automated dispatch (“CAD”) record associated with the call is created within a threshold time period from the start time of the call. When the CAD record associated with the call is not created within the threshold time period, the processor infers, using a first artificial intelligence model, whether a CAD record should be created. In response to inferring that a CAD record should be created based on the set of call attributes, the processor generates and transmits a quality alert to an electronic device associated with a user of the PSAP.

title_en: Hot standby-level on-site duplex computer system command work box
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hot standby-level on-site duplex computer system command work box which comprises two independent embedded computer systems, two display systems, a computer control equipment, a power supply control system, a computer power supply system and a display power supply system, wherein the two independent embedded computer systems are connected with the two display systems respectively; the computer control equipment is connected with two embedded hardware computer systems respectively; the computer power supply system is connected with the two independent embedded computer systems respectively; the display power supply system is connected to the two display systems respectively; and the power supply control system is connected with and is used for controlling the computer power supply system and the display power supply system. In the utility model, the two independent computer systems are operated by using the same computer control equipment, and the two independent display systems can be seen simultaneously, so that a commander can watch the on-site images of a disaster in real time, and make data records and play various rescue plans at the same time.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGYUN RENAN FIRE FIGHTING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Power transformation video master station system capable of automatically starting video storage
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a power transformation video master station system with self-starting video storage, which comprises a power transformation video master station, a station end video substation, a data server, a main server and an SCADA master station of a power grid; the SCADA master station is used for acquiring the starting information of the tripping of the station end master equipment; the video substation at the station end communicates with a data server through a protocol, and the SCADA master station communicates with a main server through the protocol; and a signal output port of the data server is connected with an input interface of the main server, and the main server is also communicated with the power transformation video master station through a protocol. The utility model discloses utilize main website, the existing SCADA signal of emergency command center, after receiving the tripping operation information of equipment such as relevant main change, circuit breaker, according to the primary equipment that has been correlated with camera relation table, the video recording storage of relevant camera is started in the main website side in the initiative, can provide more video recording data for follow-up fault analysis of developing, improves accident handling efficiency.
assignees: EXAMING & EXPERIMENTAL CT ULTRAHIGH VOLTAGE POWER TRANS CO CHINA SOUTHEN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Safety management system for intelligent frontier defense barrack
abstract_en: The invention provides a safety management system for an intelligent frontier defense camp area, which comprises: the camp security monitoring module automatically analyzes the monitoring picture and marks abnormal behaviors in the monitoring picture by utilizing the video monitoring device and the perimeter intrusion alarm device; the vehicle management module is used for dispatching management, maintenance management and private car management of police vehicles; the ordnance management module is used for dynamically transmitting personnel and firearms to the control management background through the face recognition system and the active tags on the firearms and recording the personnel and firearms; the equipment library management module controls the equipment cabinet through face recognition access control and linkage equipment cabinet; the fixed asset management module is used for realizing dynamic management of the fixed assets by registering, allocating and scrapping the assets; the police equipment management module is used for carrying out standardized management on the classified assets of the police equipment and carrying out real-time dynamic supervision on the police equipment; the intelligent camp management module integrates the functions of home housing and office. By implementing the method and the system, the safety management level and the management and control strength of the frontier defense barracks are improved.
assignees: BEIJING E HUALU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Data recovery method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a data recovery method, a data recovery device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. Relates to big data technology, and can be used in the field of financial science and technology or other related fields. The method comprises the following steps: responding to the data recovery request, and acquiring data recovery information carried in the data recovery request, wherein the data recovery information at least comprises: the occurrence period of false deletion of the object to be restored, the object name of the object to be restored and the IP address of the database; determining whether a current recovery record corresponding to the data recovery information already exists; if the data is existed, displaying the data recovery operation state corresponding to the current recovery record; if the data recovery task does not exist, determining the recovery type of the object to be recovered according to the data recovery information, and carrying out recovery processing on the object to be recovered by newly creating a data recovery task corresponding to the recovery type. The problem that in the prior art, the emergency response time of the data recovery process is too long to meet the emergency timeliness requirement is solved.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Power grid flood investigation method and system for analyzing topography surface morphology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid flood investigation method and system for analyzing topography surface morphology, comprising the following steps: collecting geographical information data of a disaster area; judging a disaster-stricken power equipment area, inputting disaster-stricken position monitoring data, and constructing a neural network; measuring and calculating disaster-related positions and inundation degrees of the power equipment areas and damage ranges of the power equipment areas due to disaster; and outputting a survey result of the topography surface morphology, and making a disaster-stricken area restoration power supply strategy. The method for surveying the flood disaster of the power grid for analyzing the topography surface morphology creatively realizes the functions of surveying flood disasters in real time all weather based on meteorological release, hydrologic release, water level monitoring and water level observation data, has excellent timeliness and accuracy in the measuring and calculating result of disaster receiving conditions, and is beneficial to an emergency command center to guide the development of emergency response, load transfer, flood control reinforcement, rush repair electricity, material allocation, customer service, grid planning and the like.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based intelligent monitoring method for multi-model fusion well lid
abstract_en: The invention relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle-based intelligent monitoring method for a multi-model fusion well lid. According to the method, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection technology and artificial intelligent technology are fully utilized, unmanned intelligent monitoring and maintenance of the well lid are achieved, well lid metadata are recorded, full life cycle tracking is conducted on well lid monitoring, well lid dispatching maintenance and well lid maintenance confirmation, well lid intelligent operation and maintenance closed loops are formed, well lid maintenance efficiency and real-time performance are greatly improved, and compared with a pipe network well lid operation and maintenance method based on manual inspection and based on the Internet of things sensor technology, the method has efficiency and economical efficiency and good practical application value. The self-iterative data algorithm closed-loop design can continuously improve the performance of the well lid detection model in the operation of the well lid operation and maintenance management system, realize the data algorithm double-wheel drive under the condition of big data addition, continuously enhance the well lid maintenance efficiency, and gradually reduce the manual confirmation intervention links.

title_en: Intelligent protection method for photovoltaic inverter
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent protection method of a photovoltaic inverter, which comprises the following steps: step one: data acquisition and monitoring are carried out, and the acquisition and monitoring of relevant data of the photovoltaic inverter are carried out; step two: data encryption and transmission, wherein the data encryption is carried out on the collected information related to the photovoltaic inverter and then the data encryption is carried out on the collected information related to the photovoltaic inverter; step three: data storage and management, namely processing and managing the related data of the photovoltaic inverter; step four: access control and management, and establishing a control mechanism and hierarchical protection of data; step five: performing security audit and log recording, and performing security audit on data access and operation of the photovoltaic inverter; step six: and carrying out physical safety protection on the inverter, establishing an emergency response mechanism, and making an emergency plan. The invention can better realize the data safety protection of the photovoltaic inverter and further ensure the stable operation of the photovoltaic inverter.
assignees: SHANGHAI YISHI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Elevator safety management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent building and elevator dispatching control, and particularly discloses an elevator safety management method and system. The method comprises the steps of collecting elevator structure, electrical configuration, environmental parameters, using record and maintenance historical data, constructing an elevator twin map in a unified format, executing fault evolution modeling and simulation based on the map to generate a trigger factor set, constructing a multi-elevator dispatching task map, completing path optimization and task cooperation, generating an intelligent rescue path table, identifying abnormality, generating a fault response trigger chain, issuing an edge control instruction, constructing an emergency response rule base and a strategy template set, and performing virtual exercise based on the strategy template and outputting feedback data. Compared with the prior art, the intelligent scheduling method and the intelligent scheduling system based on the multi-source data and the path scoring mechanism under the condition that the elevator is trapped, and response timeliness and system coordination capability are improved.
assignees: ZHONGYUAN CARBON INVESTMENT ANHUI ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cross-department travel resource cooperative processing method, platform, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a cross-department text and travel resource cooperative processing method, a platform, equipment and a medium, belonging to the technical field of travel data processing; the method comprises the steps of realizing resource change synchronization through a real-time synchronization channel, meeting high concurrency demands, dynamically calculating available inventory based on real-time data, checking reservation and evaluating overstock risks, defining cross-department cooperation subtasks and completion conditions, controlling emergency response time, improving automation efficiency, quantifying emergency event influence range, triggering cross-department linkage treatment through multi-system data synchronization, configuring distributed guarantee measures, and guaranteeing operation atomicity, service stability and data consistency. Platform coordination is achieved, resource synchronization efficiency and system stability are improved, cross-department emergency response speed is optimized, and user service experience is improved.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR SMART CULTURAL TOURISM IND DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Digital twin monitoring and fault early warning system for hydraulic junction engineering
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin monitoring and fault early warning system for hydraulic hub engineering, and relates to the technical field of intelligent water conservancy. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing and storage module, a hydraulic semantic dictionary and a data storage module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring hydraulic data, the data processing and storage module is used for carrying out standardized cleaning on the hydraulic data to obtain standard hydraulic data, the hydraulic semantic dictionary is established, the standard hydraulic data are unified into a hydraulic event label, and the standard hydraulic data are stored according to space-time and service attributes in a separated mode, and full life cycle metadata are recorded. According to the invention, by constructing a virtual complex scene laboratory, an extreme disaster scene which rarely occurs in the history is generated and previewed, the defect of insufficient historical data of the digital twin is fundamentally overcome, the emergency response capability of the hydraulic junction engineering to the extreme disaster scene is enhanced, and the accuracy of the digital twin prediction is improved.

title_en: Transmit picture and text datas via cdma hsdpa wibro etc in a pda at the same time and make disater report
title_ko: ＣＤＭＡ，ＨＳＤＰＡ，ＷｉＢｒｏ의 무선통신망을이용하여 ＰＤＡ를 이용한 사진 그리고 문자데이터 실시간전송 및 재해대장 자동 작성
abstract_en: A method for transmitting photograph and character data and editing disaster report automatically in real time through a PDA(Personal Digital Assistant) by using a wireless communication network such as CDMA, HDSPA and WiBro are provided to overcome the limitation of a CCTV and to perform the preparation against the disaster speedily, thereby minimizing the damage of property/life. A program(125) converts the analog image received from a camera(110) into a digital image, compresses the converted digital image in JPG or GIF. The present date and time are extracted from a timer(115) of a PDA. The PDA with the IP(Internet Protocol) address or host name, position, title and contents and the like received from the program is connected to a wireless network(515) by telephone connection networking of a CDMA modem(120) so that the photograph and character data are transmitted concurrently to plural briefing room computers(525) via an Internet network(520). The photograph and character data are extracted and divided through a program of a computer and then displayed on a screen of the computer.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 PDA(Personal Digital Assistants)의 카메라를 이용하여 재난/재해 또는 주요 사고가 발생한 지점의 현장 사진을 입력하고 PDA 프로그램을 이용하여 사고 위치, 사고 시간 및 날짜, 제목, 내용 등의 문자 데이터를 입력하여 CDMA, HSDPA, WiBro 등 무선통신망 또는 무선랜 망을 이용하여 실시간으로 지정된 한대 이상의 컴퓨터에 동시에 전송한다. 
     이때 지정된 컴퓨터에서는 수신된 사진과 문자 데이터를 화면에 저장, 표시한다. 또한 레포트 기능을 포함하여 수작업으로 수행하던 복구대장을 자동화한다.

title_en: Intelligent system and method for saving a life when auto accidents
title_ko: 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An intelligent car accident lifesaving system and a method thereof are provided to transfer the car accident data to a control center and rescue by direct communication with a driver of the accident vehicle. CONSTITUTION: An intelligent lifesaving system(16) comprises a communication server for receiving the accident information from the intelligent terminal, transferring the accident information to a control server, and communicating with the intelligent terminal. Also, it comprises a DB server for storing the accident information transferred from the communication server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템을 구축함에 있어, 차량 사고 시 신속한 대응을 위하여 차량에 장착된 단말기에서 차량사고 데이터를 관제 센터에 전송하고 관제 센터에서 사고차량의 운전자와 직접 교신을 통해 응급구조를 할 수 있는 시스템을 구축하여 사용자들에게 안정적이고 신뢰성 있는 시스템을 제공하고 관제 센터를 무인으로 운영하여 운영비용을 최소화할 수 있는, 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체를 제공하고자 한다. 
이를 위하여, 본 발명은 지능형 인명구조 시스템에 있어서, 사고 발생 장치의 지능형 단말기로부터 사고 정보를 수신하여 관제 서버로 전달하고, 상기 지능형 단말기와 통화 연결을 하여 무인으로 사고를 접수하기 위한 통신 서버; 회원 정보를 저장하고 있으며, 상기 통신 서버로부터 사고 관련 정보를 전달받아 저장하기 위한 DB 서버; 사고 발생 위치에 상응하는 지도 화면 데이터와 지번 데이터를 생성하여 상기 관제 서버로 전달하기 위한 맵(MAP) 서버; 및 상기 통신 서버로부터의 사고 정보를 상기 맵(MAP) 서버로부터의 지도 화면 데이터와 지번 데이터에 따라 표시하고, 사고 접수를 처리하기 위한 상기 관제 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: User device, computer program stored in computer-readable medium and system for processing civil complaint
title_ko: 민원 신청을 처리하기 위한 컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체에 저장된 프로그램 및 사용자 디바이스
abstract_en: According to embodiments of the present disclosure, disclosed is a computer program stored in a computer-readable storage medium including encoded instructions. The computer program, when executed by one or more processors of a computer system, allows the one or more processors to perform the following operations: acquiring image information for a civil complaint application from a photographing means for photographing an image around a vehicle of a user when it is determined that an image information acquisition command is received from the user; generating a civil complaint application including at least a part of the image information at least partially on the basis of the acquired image information; and transmitting the generated civil complaint application to a server related to a civil complaint application institution. In the operation of acquiring image information, when it is determined that the user has entered a tunnel, image information for a civil complaint application can be acquired from the photographing means for photographing an image around the vehicle of the user regardless of whether the image information acquisition command is received or not.
abstract_ko: 본 개시의 실시예들에 따라서 인코딩된 명령들을 포함하는 컴퓨터 판독가능 저장 매체에 저장된 컴퓨터 프로그램이 개시된다. 상기 컴퓨터 프로그램은 컴퓨터 시스템의 하나 이상의 프로세서들에 의해 실행되는 경우, 상기 하나 이상의 프로세서들로 하여금 이하의 동작들을 수행하도록 하며, 상기 동작들은: 사용자로부터 영상 정보 획득 명령이 수신되었다고 판단되는 경우, 상기 사용자의 차량 주변의 영상을 촬영하는 촬영 수단으로부터 민원 신청을 위한 영상 정보를 획득하는 동작; 획득된 상기 영상 정보에 적어도 부분적으로 기초하여 상기 영상 정보의 적어도 일부를 포함하는 민원 신청서를 생성하는 동작;및 생성된 상기 민원 신청서를 민원 신청 기관과 관련된 서버로 송신하는 동작;을 포함하고, 그리고  상기 영상 정보를 획득하는 동작은 상기 사용자가 터널에 진입하였다고 판단되는 경우, 상기 영상 정보 획득 명령 수신 여부와 상관없이 상기 사용자의 차량 주변의 영상을 촬영하는 촬영 수단으로부터 민원 신청을 위한 영상 정보를 획득할 수 있다.

title_en: Block programming system and method for block programming using the same
title_ko: 카드 리더기를 이용한 블록 프로그래밍 시스템 및 이를 이용한 블록 프로그래밍 방법
abstract_en: In a block programming system using a card reader and a block programming method using the same, the block programming system comprises a card part, a card reader, and an operation system. The card part comprises a motion card comprising motion contents, and a calculation card comprising a parameter. The card reader recognizes the card part to transmit a corresponding command, and comprises a button part which receives an input of a user with respect to whether to perform the corresponding command. The operation system forms a motion logic by receiving the contents of the recognized card part and verifies whether to perform the formed motion logic based on the input of the button part. According to the present invention, unnecessary and impossible motions of a robot can be prevented.
abstract_ko: 카드 리더기를 이용한 블록 프로그래밍 시스템 및 이를 이용한 블록 프로그래밍 방법에서, 상기 블록 프로그래밍 시스템은 카드부, 카드 리더기 및 운영 시스템을 포함한다.  상기 카드부는 동작 내용을 포함하는 동작 카드, 및 매개 변수를 포함하는 연산 카드를 포함한다.  상기 카드 리더기는 상기 카드부를 인식하여 해당 명령을 전송하고, 해당 명령의 수행 여부에 대한 사용자의 입력을 제공받는 버튼부를 포함한다.  상기 운영 시스템은 상기 인식된 카드부의 내용을 전송받아 동작 로직을 형성하고, 상기 버튼부의 입력을 바탕으로 상기 형성된 동작 로직의 수행 여부를 판단한다.

title_en: Method And Apparatus for Providing Guidance Service for Cardio Pulmonary Resuscitation
title_ko: 심폐소생술 안내서비스 제공 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: In a method for providing a cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR) guide service using a guide service providing device, provided, according to one aspect of the present embodiment, is the method for providing the CPR guide service comprising: a process of receiving a guide service start command provided through a touch of a user or a manipulation of a case mounted on the guide service providing device; a process of providing at least one or more of a preset service among a rescue request information transmission, a user legal protection measure guide, a patient condition confirmation guide, and a CPR guide according to the guide service start command; and a process of collecting a CPR record of the user according to the service provision. Therefore, the present invention is capable of increasing an execution rate of CPR.
abstract_ko: 본 실시예의 일 측면에 의하면, 안내서비스 제공장치를 이용하여 심폐소생술 안내서비스를 제공하는 방법에 있어서, 사용자의 터치 또는 상기 안내서비스 제공장치에 장착된 케이스의 조작을 통해 제공되는 안내서비스 개시명령을 입력 받는 과정; 상기 안내서비스 개시명령에 따라 구조 요청정보 전송, 사용자 법적 보호조치 안내, 환자 상태 확인 안내, 및 심폐소생술 안내 중 적어도 하나 이상의 기 설정된 서비스를 제공하는 과정; 및 상기 서비스 제공에 따른 사용자의 심폐소생술 기록을 수집하는 과정을 포함하는 심폐소생술 안내서비스 제공 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Untact based computer maintenance device
title_ko: 비대면 기반의 컴퓨터 유지보수장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-face-to-face computer maintenance device, which installs a server program on a computer running Windows, sets the same as a management computer, installs a client program for diagnosis and emergency management on a sub-computer operating as Windows, runs as an agent program, is connected to the management computer through a network, and performs self-maintenance or executes system backup recovery according to commands of the management computer. The non-face-to-face computer maintenance device comprises: a client computer installing a client program for self-diagnosis and emergency handling, and when the client program is executed, operating as an agent, connecting to the management computer through a network, and automatically transmitting diagnosis information to the management computer after self-diagnosis, and executing an emergency recovery function according to a diagnosis result for self-maintenance or executing system backup recovery according to a command of the management computer; and a management computer installing a server program for managing the client computer, handling backup recovery of the client computer according to a predetermined procedure when the server program is executed, and automatically performing emergency measures according to the diagnosis result.
abstract_ko: 윈도우(Windows)로 동작하는 컴퓨터에 서버 프로그램을 설치하여 관리 컴퓨터로 설정하고, 윈도로 동작하는 하위 컴퓨터에 진단 및 응급 관리를 위한 클라이언트 프로그램을 설치하고 에이전트(Agent) 프로그램으로 동작하면서 관리 컴퓨터와 네트워크로 연결되어 자체 유지보수를 실행하거나 관리 컴퓨터의 명령에 따라 시스템 백업 복구를 실행하는 비대면 기반의 컴퓨터 유지보수장치에 관한 것으로서, 자가 진단 및 응급 처리를 위한 클라이언트 프로그램을 설치하고, 클라이언트 프로그램이 실행되면 에이전트로 동작하여 관리 컴퓨터와 네트워크로 연결하고, 자가 진단 후 진단 정보를 자동으로 관리 컴퓨터에 전송하며, 진단 결과에 따라 응급 복구 기능을 실행하여 자체 유지보수를 하거나 관리 컴퓨터의 명령에 따라 시스템 백업 복구를 실행하는 클라이언트 컴퓨터, 클라이언트 컴퓨터를 관리하기 위한 서버 프로그램을 설치하고, 서버 프로그램이 실행되면 정해진 절차에 따라 클라이언트 컴퓨터의 백업 복구를 처리하고, 진단 결과에 따라 응급조치를 자동으로 수행하는 관리 컴퓨터를 포함하여, 비대면 기반의 컴퓨터 유지보수장치를 구현한다.

title_en: Greenhouse risk monitoring system
title_ko: 하우스 시설 위해성 예방 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for preventing risks that may occur during work in a greenhouse facility. The system comprises: a sensor unit which collects environmental information of a management target workplace in real time and transmits the collected environmental information; a gateway which preprocesses the environmental information received from the sensor unit, transmits the same to a deep learning server, receives a prediction model from the deep learning server, and based thereon, determines whether there is a risk; a database which receives and records pre-processed data from the gateway; and a server unit which includes the deep learning server, extracts the data recorded in the database, and constructs a prediction model through deep learning. Accordingly, surrounding environmental information such as temperature, humidity, carbon dioxide, and fine dust inside or outside an agricultural workplace is collected, so that deep learning analysis is done on whether the environment is suitable or harmful for current agricultural workers to carry out works, the analysis result is provided to a user as forecast/warning information, and at the same time, the ventilation inside the workplace is automatically performed to prevent personal accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 하우스 시설에서 작업시 발생할 수 있는 위해성을 예방하는 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 관리대상 작업장의 환경정보를 실시간 수집하고 수집한 환경정보를 송신하는 센서부; 상기 센서부로부터 환경정보를 수신받은 데이터를 전처리하여 딥 러닝 서버로 송신하며 상기 딥 러닝 서버로부터 예측 모델을 수신받고 이를 기반으로 위해성 여부를 판단하는 게이트웨이; 상기 게이트웨이로부터 전처리 과정을 거친 데이터를 수신받아 기록하는 데이터베이스; 및 상기 딥 러닝 서버를 포함하며 상기 데이터베이스에서 기록된 데이터를 추출하여 이를 딥 러닝 학습을 통한 예측 모델을 구축하는 서버부; 를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이로 인한 효과로서 농작업장 내부나 외부의 온도, 습도, 이산화탄소, 미세먼지 등의 주변 환경정보를 수집하여 현재 농작업자가 작업을 실시함에 있어 적합한 환경인지 또는 유해한 환경인지를 딥 러닝 분석하고, 이를 사용자에게 예·경보 정보로 제공함과 동시에 작업장 내부 환기가 자동으로 수행되어 인명사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Improved patient emergency response system
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.

title_en: Systems and methods for automated personal emergency responses
abstract_en: A personal emergency response system implemented as a conference bridge on a remote computing network. Upon receiving an alert from an individual in need of aid, a conference including audio and/or video connection is established. A predetermined list of parties is coupled to the conference, including friends, caregivers, medical professionals, emergency responders and others as stored in a configuration database specific to the individual via a web interface. The database record may also contain vital information about the individual, in additional to demographic data, location information, history and other factual information. Medical telemetry may be obtained in real-time and disseminated among the conference participants. Other parties may be dynamically joined to the conference as needed upon a conference participant utilizing DTMF codes or other means to request the others to join.
assignees: WILL TRAVIS E;VANDEVANTER RUSSELL E;MYHRE STEVEN M;MYHRE MICHAEL J

title_en: Safe weapon container for securely releasing a defense weapon
abstract_en: A weapons container for releasing a defense weapon includes a cabinet, a cabinet door, and an interior securing the defense weapon. Upon detection of a fingerprint input by a biometric sensor, a surveillance camera captures video and an audio intercom provides communication with a central command center. A recording system saves the video and audio to a storage database. A delay release lock secures the defense weapon for an amount of time and releases the defense weapon depending on a signal from the central command center. A communications system is connected over a network to the central command center, a local authority, and an emergency responder. The communications system notifies the local authority or the emergency responder upon detection of the fingerprint input and streams the video and audio to the central command center and at least one of the local authority and the emergency responder over the Internet.

title_en: Wearable heads-up display ("hud") for a pharmacy workflow management system
abstract_en: A wearable heads-up display (“HUD”) for a pharmacy workflow management system is disclosed herein. An example HUD includes smart-glasses that are communicatively coupled to a client device. The smart-glasses include at least one camera and/or barcode scanner to record information needed for the verification of a medication dose during medication formulation preparation. The smart-glasses include at least one microphone to record voice commands. Further, the smart-glasses include at least one embedded display screen that shows sequential steps of a preparation protocol for guiding a pharmacy technician to prepare a medication dose. An application on the client device and/or the smart-glasses is configured to recognize and use voice commands to provide navigation for the embedded display screen. The voice commands may also be used to provide data entry for medication dose preparation verification. Gestures may be detected by the camera and translated by the application into navigation or data entry commands.

title_en: A kind of harbour rescue dispatch method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of harbour rescue dispatch method, steps are as follows: 1, each harbour is carried out label and the location information at harbour to be uploaded to database；2, the information for the rescue ship stopped in harbour is recorded and is uploaded to database；3, for needing the position of emergency place to position, and location information is sent to each harbour；4, position of each harbour apart from emergency place is calculated, and arrives far arranged from now on；5, selection harbour carries out the scheduling of rescue ship.It 6, is rescue ship setting rescue route；7, rescue terminates.The present invention can preferably share the information at each harbour, and can preferably dispatch arrival rescue site after the condition of a disaster or dangerous situation occur.

title_en: Management system, method, equipment and the readable storage medium storing program for executing of shopping cart
abstract_en: The present invention relates to wisdom retail domains, and disclose a kind of management system of shopping cart, including shopping cart ontology, intelligent electronic lock and background server；Intelligent electronic lock is set on shopping cart ontology, and intelligent electronic lock and background server are wirelessly connected；Smart electronics are locked equipped with electromagnetic induction region, are received electromagnetic induction region in intelligent electronic lock and are incuded after the electromagnetic induction switch triggering command of generation by magnet apparatus, intelligent electronic lock is based on triggering command and generates mark information, is sent to background server；After background server is based on mark information generation prompt information, it is sent to corresponding unlocking terminal.The invention also discloses a kind of management method of shopping cart, equipment and readable storage medium storing program for executing.The management system of shopping cart of the invention is simple and reliable, dramatically saves the operation cost of shopping cart, and sales field staff discovery marks, the shopping cart that do not give back in place will not be omitted, also, automatic reminding informs that customer does not give back record, effectively saves manpower and links up cost.

title_en: Cascade reservoir group dam break emergency scheduling method and system based on dynamic discharge method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of reservoir emergency scheduling, and relates to a cascade reservoir group dam break emergency scheduling method and system based on a dynamic discharge method. The method comprises the following steps: inputting the flood process into a cascade reservoir group emergency scheduling model, considering the water rising and water falling stages of the flood process, controlling reservoir capacity pre-discharge and reservoir flood discharge based on a dynamic discharge method, and combining to generate a reservoir emergency scheduling scheme set; when the dam is broken, calling a dam-breaking flood simulation model to calculate the dam-breaking flood process and perform river course evolution; calculating a benefit objective function of emergency dispatching of the cascade reservoir group; and carrying out optimization and recommendation of the emergency scheduling scheme according to the benefit objective function value. The invention considers the timeliness and feasibility of the step reservoir dispatching under the dam break flood dangerous situation and the difference and method universality of the dispatching processes of the reservoirs in different watersheds and different steps, can rapidly and universally carry out emergency dispatching scheme making when the step reservoir group encounters the dam break flood dangerous situation, and can be applied to the dam break emergency dispatching of the step reservoir groups in different watersheds.
assignees: UNIV HUAZHONG SCIENCE TECH;POWERCHINA HUADONG ENGINEERING CORP LTD

title_en: HAZOP knowledge graph construction method and system based on text mining
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for constructing a HAZOP knowledge graph based on text mining. Comprising the following steps: training to obtain an equipment information extraction model for extracting equipment entity information according to the text data in the HSE field; extracting corresponding equipment information from the HAZOP report according to the equipment information extraction model; and constructing a unified HAZOP knowledge graph structure based on the equipment information and the HAZOP analysis record table. The method can reduce data redundancy, improve the effectiveness and uniqueness of each piece of data, improve the utilization rate of data storage resources, form a HAZOP analysis knowledge graph with comprehensive content, realize shared multiplexing, be favorable for improving analysis efficiency and analysis report quality, assist safety risk management and control personnel of enterprises, rapidly make emergency response to process deviation through the HAZOP knowledge graph, prevent and solve major risks, timely eliminate potential safety hazards, and realize accident prevention and risk early warning.
assignees: CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP;RES INST SAFETY & ENV TECH CO LTD CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Intelligent communication management terminal
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent communication management terminal, and relates to the technical field of communication. The intelligent communication management terminal comprises an emergency management module, a communication scheduling module, a fault management module, a network monitoring module and a safety management module. The detection component is responsible for monitoring fault conditions in a communication network, and can periodically or in real time detect indexes such as network connection, equipment state, transmission quality and the like so as to ensure that faults are found in time, when a data packet is prevented from being interrupted, fault sources cannot be found, the type and the fault occurrence points are judged sequentially through the diagnosis component and the positioning component, the processing component and the recording component are combined for maintaining the fault and recording detailed information of the fault, the phenomenon that the fault cannot be repaired quickly after the next fault occurs is prevented, and a commander or a dispatcher cannot receive important information or instructions and the subsequent emergency effect is influenced.

title_en: Bodily sensation education method using motion detection in robot and thereof system
title_ko: 로봇에서 움직임 검출을 이용한 체감형 교육방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: An experience-based education method and an experience-based education system are provided to improve an education effect by enabling a student to actually move his/her body and analyzing the movement of the student. An experience-based education system includes an image camera(100), a moving picture processor(200), a content database(300), a robot platform(400), and an output unit(500). The image camera pictures a motion of a user and displays the motion on a screen. The moving picture processor analyzes the motion of the user and generates input information based on the motion. The content database stores educational contents related to experience-based education. The robot platform controls a motion of the robot and executes the educational contents. The output unit outputs the motion of the user according to a command from the robot platform using a voice or graphic signal.
abstract_ko:
본원 발명은 교육을 진행하는 사용자가 전신을 이용하여 교육을 진행하는 것이 효과적인 교육방식이라는 전신반응교습법을 기반으로 한 체감형 교육으로 화상 카메라가 장착된 Robot에서 실행되는 교육 프로그램이 프로그램 흐름에 대한 사용자의 행동에 대한 동영상을 입력 받아 움직임 검출 기능을 적용하여 동영상을 처리하고 사용자의 행동을 분석하여 프로그램 진행에 반영함으로써 사용자가 적극적으로 교육 프로그램에 집중하게 되는 교육 방법에 관한 발명이다. 
     본 발명에 의하면, 로봇에서 움직임 검출기능을 이용한 체감형 교육방법에 있어서, 지정된 교육 시간에 로봇이 사용자에게 교육 시작을 통지하는 단계와, 상기 로봇에 장착된 화상 카메라로 사용자의 동영상을 입력받는 단계와, 상기 사용자가 화상 카메라의 중심에 있는지를 판단하는 단계와, 상기 사용자가 화상 카메라의 중심에 있지 않으면 사용자 tracking 기능을 사용하여 사용자를 화상카메라의 중심에 위치하도록 조정하는 단계와, 상기 화상 카메라로 촬영한 사용자의 동영상에서 사용자의 행동이 변화되는 차영상 정보를 생성하는 단계와, 상기 차영상 정보를 얻기 위해 각 프레임의 동영상을 8*8의 작은 사각형으로 블록화하는 단계와, 상기 블록화된 동영상 프레임을 이전 동영상 프레임과 비교하여 변화된 색상을 기준으로 차영상 정보를 정의하는 단계와, 상기 차영상 정보를 사용자가 한 행위에 대하여 정의된 데이터베이스를 기반으로 분석하여 사용자 행위를 정의하는 단계와, 상기 입력된 사용자 동영상과 기 제작된 그래픽 애니메이션을 합성하여 화면에 출력하는  단계와, 상기 분석된 사용자 행위가 체감형 프로그램에서 결과로 보여주어야 하는 입력인지를 판단하는 단계를 포함하는 로봇에서 움직임 검출을 이용한 체감형 교육방법에 관한 발명을 제시한다.

title_en: Method for providing learning language service by using paraphrase, system, server and computer-readable recording medium with program therefor
title_ko: 패러프레이즈를 이용하여 언어 학습 서비스를 제공하는방법과 그를 위한 시스템, 서버 및 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는기록매체
abstract_en: A method for providing a language studying service by using paraphrasing, a system and a server therefor, and a computer-readable recording medium are provided to improve learning ability for translation in the process of translating an English sentence into the Korean alphabet and develop the learning ability in order to writing a natural sentence, thereby improving vocabulary power, thinking power, esthetic ability, and language development ability. In case a user level a junior course level, a control module(350) controls to produce a sentence for the junior course level and output the produced sentence to an output module(330). In case an extracted user level is an advanced level, the control module controls to produce a sentence for the advanced level and output the produced sentence to the output module, and controls paraphrasing requested data for the sentence for the advanced level is controlled to be outputted to the output module. In case paraphrasing response data for the advanced level by the manipulation of a user is received, the control module confirms whether a wrong expression or an awkward expression is in the paraphrasing response data for the advanced level. In case there is no wrong or awkward expression, the control module produces the received number of the paraphrasing response data for the advanced level to update the user level.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 패러프레이즈를 이용하여 언어 학습 서비스를 제공하는 방법과 그를 위한 시스템, 서버 및 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 유무선 통신망을 이용하여 언어 학습 서비스를 제공하는 시스템에 있어서, 상기 언어 학습 서비스와 관련된 컨텐츠를 수신하여 출력하는 사용자 단말기; 및 상기 사용자 단말기의 사용자 계정에 대한 사용자 레벨을 추출하고, 상기 사용자 레벨에 따른 제시 문장을 생성하여 상기 사용자 단말기로 전송하며, 상기 사용자 단말기로 상기 제시 문장에 대한 패러프레이징(Paraphrasing) 요청 데이터를 전송한 후 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 패러프레이징 응답 데이터를 수신하는 경우 상기 패러프레이징 응답 데이터에 잘못된 표현 또는 어색한 표현이 있는지의 여부를 확인하고, 확인 결과, 상기 패러프레이징 응답 데이터에 잘못된 표현 또는 어색한 표현이 없는 경우, 상기 패러프레이징 응답 데이터의 수신 횟수를 산출하여 상기 사용자 레벨을 갱신하는 패러프레이징 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 패러프레이즈를 이용하여 언어 학습 서비스를 제공하는 시스템을 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 의하면, 패러프레이징을 이용한 언어 학습 서비스를 제공받음으로써, 영문을 한글로 번역하는 과정에서, 번역에 대한 학습 능력이 증대되는 효과가 있을 뿐만 아니라, 보다 자연스러운 문장을 구현할 수 있는 학습 능력의 개발로 인해 어휘력, 사고력, 심미적인 능력 및 언어 발달 능력이 증대되는 효과가 있다. 
       
     패러프레이징, 패러프레이즈, 언어, 학습, 번역, 교육

title_en: Method for emergency action service using earphine and terminal therefor
title_ko: 이어폰을 이용한 위급 상황 대응 서비스 방법 및 이를 위한 단말기
abstract_en: A method for an emergency response service using earphones comprises the following steps of: running an application programmed to perform an emergency response service; maintaining a standby mode after running the application, and switching the standby mode to an emergency execution mode when separation of earphones from a terminal is detected; and performing a predetermined function for the emergency response service when the standby mode is switched to the emergency execution mode.
abstract_ko: 위급 상황 대응 서비스를 수행하도록 프로그래밍된 어플리케이션을 실행하는 단계; 상기 어플리케이션의 실행에 따라 대기 모드를 유지하다가 이어폰이 단말기로부터 분리되는 것이 감지되면 상기 대기 모드를 위급 상황 실행 모드로 전환하는 단계; 및 상기 위급 상황 실행 모드로 전환되면 위급 상황 대응 서비스를 위해 미리 설정된 기능을 실행하는 단계를 포함하는 이어폰을 이용한 위급 상황 대응 서비스 방법이 제공된다.

title_en: Programmable-assembly educational tools
title_ko: 프로그래밍 가능한 조립 교구
abstract_en: A programmable assembly-type educational tool is generally disclosed. The examplery educational tool includes a body housing, a sensing unit, a control unit, a driving unit, and a power supply unit. The sensing unit includes an insertion unit configured to receive a color-coded assembly element and a sensing circuit configured to acquire color data from the element. The control unit is configured to determine a predetermined command based on the acquired color data, input and store the determined command in a cumulative input manner, and generate and execute a program comprising one or more cumulatively input commands. The driving unit is configured to execute one or more operation components according to the execution of the program.
abstract_ko: 조립형 교구 장치가 일반적으로 설명된다.  예시적인 조립형 교구 장치는 본체 하우징, 센싱부, 제어부, 구동부 및 전원부를 포함할 수 있다.  센싱부는 색상형 조립형 교구를 삽입하기 위한 삽입부 및 색상 데이터를 획득하는 센싱회로를 포함할 수 있다.  제어부는 색상 데이터에 기초하여 미리 정해진 명령을 결정하고 결정된 명령을 누적 입력하는 방식으로 입력하여 저장하고, 누적 입력된 하나 이상의 명령을 포함하는 프로그램을 생성하고 실행할 수 있다.  구동부는 프로그램의 실행에 따라, 하나 이상의 동작 컴포넌트를 실행할 수 있다.

title_en: Decision support system for air missioncommander dynamic mission re-planning
abstract_en: A dynamic human machine interface system includes a mission commander application (MCA) unit including a control processor, the MCA active on one vehicle of a plurality of mission member vehicles, the MCA unit in communication with a datastore, the control processor accessing executable instructions that cause the control processor to direct operations of components of the MCA unit, an alternate scenario evaluation unit accessing at least one of mission parameter records and flight member data records in the data store to recalculate mission parameters, a dynamic video interface unit to render the recalculated mission parameters on a mission control dashboard (MCD), the MCD presented to the mission commander on a display unit of the one vehicle, the MCD including a plurality of display pane areas selectable by a user interaction with an interactive interface, and each display area configurable by the user interaction to change content of the display pane.

title_en: System and method for driving condition detection and notification
abstract_en: A system for accident detection or detecting an unsafe driving condition in a vehicle including a device that measures and transmits at least one output signal; at least one remote device configured to receive, record, and/or display the at least one output signal from the device; a computing device configured to receive the at least one output signal from the device and display the at least one output signal in real-time; and a graphical user interface on the computing device that allows an emergency response professional to view and customize options for monitoring the at least one output signal, wherein the device, the at least one remote device, and the computing device are communicatively connected to each other via a communications network.

title_en: Real-Time Data Acquisition and Recording System
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) for mobile assets that includes a data recorder. The data recorder includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queueing repository. DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data acquired by DARS through a web browser, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Systems and Methods for Incident Recording
abstract_en: An incident recorder records original and supplemental incident information using a simplified user interface. A lead incident recorder may request any of several support tasks be accepted by other subsystems configured to Follow. Tactical support tasks may be requested. Communication support tasks may be requested. Collection support tasks may be requested. Collection support tasks may include directives for operation of an incident recorder.

title_en: Alarm short massage service system for space environment disaster incidents
abstract_en: The invention provides an alarm short massage service system for space environment disaster incidents. The system is an alarm short massage implementation service system for the space environment disaster incidents based on space environment monitoring data. The system comprises a mode computing subsystem, a short message preparation subsystem, a short massage management subsystem, a short message sending subsystem and a data storage system, wherein the mode computing subsystem is used for generating warning information of the space environment disaster incidents on the basis of the space environment monitoring data and disturbance of space environment factors; the short message preparation subsystem is used for monitoring a warning information storage table of the space environment disaster incidents in real time and generating alarm messages; the short massage management subsystem is used for mobile phone user management and short massage sending record management; the short message sending subsystem is used for monitoring a space environment disaster incident short massage information storage table of a data storage subsystem in real time and sending information in the storage table to users in a short massage mode; and the data storage system is used for storing and managing required data of normal operation of the short massage service system for the space environment disaster incidents. The invention further provides a mid-value based filtering method.

title_en: Edutech educational content support system for using virtual reality (VR) and Lego and Drive method of the Same
title_ko: 가상현실(vr)과 레고를 이용한 에듀테크 교육컨텐츠 지원 시스템 및 그 구동방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, disclosed is a technology related to virtual reality (VR) and online platform information provision. That is, an edutech educational content support system using VR and Lego and a driving method thereof according to an embodiment of the present invention present a variety of VR Lego assembly diagrams describing a method of assembling various VR Lego products shown on a 3D VR screen window, and program examples that also support graphic user interface (GUI) therefor. Thus, users who want to learn VR Lego assembly and program coding with this as an issue in an interesting way can make their own action programs that operate VR Legos. The users are allowed to experience through simulation whether the VR Legos applied therewith is working. Accordingly, it is possible to provide an opportunity to deepen engineering thinking centered on a structural design and a sense of achievement on the subject of improving software learning ability for program design and assembling VR Legos that enable to feel 3D senses.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실 및 온라인 플랫폼 정보제공 관련 기술을 개시한다. 즉, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 가상현실(VR)과 레고를 이용한 에듀테크 교육컨텐츠 지원 시스템 및 그 구동방법은 3D 가상현실 화면창에서 보여지는 여러가지 각양각색의 VR 레고 제품에 관한 조립방법을 설명하는 VR 레고 조립도와 이를 GUI(Graphic User interface)도 지원하는 프로그램 예제를 다양하게 제시해 줌으로써, VR 레고 조립과 이를 이슈로 프로그램 코딩을 흥미롭게 배우고자 하는 사용자들에게 VR 레고를 동작시키는 동작 프로그램으로 직접 짜게 하고 이를 적용시킨 VR 레고가 작동되는지 시뮬레이션으로 경험케 해주고, 이를 통해 프로그램 설계에 대한 소프트웨어 학습능력 향상 및 3D 입체감을 느낄 수 있을만한 VR 레고 조립을 주제로 한 성취감 및 구조설계학 중심의 공학적 사고를 심층시켜 나아가는 계기를 마련한다.
assignees: SOPOONG&COMPANY CO LTD;YOON JEONG KWAN;YOON TAE KYUNG

title_en: Intelligent recorder used for police service
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a 3G terminal device, and especially relates to an intelligent recorder used for the police service. The intelligent recorder includes a machine body, a display screen, buttons, and a host machine chip and a power supply arranged in the body. The inside of the body is provided with a video module, a short message function module, a voice module, a GPS positioning module, a 3G built-in antenna, an alarm module which is wirelessly connected with a remote emergency command system, and a communication module. The above modules are connected with the host machine chip respectively. The intelligent recorder used for the police service is simple in structure, various in function, and is easy to use, and can track and record the law enforcement process of a responding police officer during the whole course, and transmit the environment and the actual condition of a law enforcement site to a command center in an audio and video mode, so the command center can work out the effective and correct command to the responding police officer, and consequently the law enforcement efficiency of the responding police officer is improved.
assignees: WUHAN HUAAN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A site environment monitoring system for emergency command vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a site environment monitoring system for emergency command vehicle, this system includes on -the -spot headend equipment, on -vehicle COFDM equipment, computer, digital video recorder, display screen no. 1, video switch, the video distributor, display screen no. 2, fuel quantity sensor, hall sensor and wind speed sensor, on -the -spot headend equipment design has smoke transducer, the oxygen concentration sensor, temperature humidity transducer, aspect sensor and big dipper location chip, wherein on -the -spot headend equipment is connected with on -vehicle COFDM equipment, on -vehicle COFDM equipment and video switch, display screen no. 1 is connected respectively, computer and video distributor, display screen no. 2 connects gradually, video distributor and video switch, display screen no. 1 connects gradually, on -vehicle COFDM equipment, fuel quantity sensor, hall sensor, the wind speed sensor is connected with computer respectively, make the staff know site environment more, the efficiency of the rescue is greatly improved.
