title_en: Wearable job site situation record appearance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a wearable job site situation record appearance, communication, GPS module, RFID radio frequency module, the camera connected respectively including power and power and be used for with the wireless transmission module of service terminals communication, communication, GPS module, RFID radio frequency module and camera are connected with wireless transmission module respectively. The utility model discloses a set up the wiring that wireless transmission module reduces monitoring device to reduced the volume, and monitoring device can remove along with the staff, its monitoring effect is superior to the technical scheme who realizes setting up monitoring device among the prior art at the construction field (site), secondarily, the utility model discloses real -time, the dynamic record to the job site personnel can have been realized to cooperation distributed service ware, guarantees data processing rate to show in can the message set with above -mentioned pieceization, reinforcing emergency command ability promotes management efficiency. The utility model relates to a but the field is monitored in the engineering to a wearable job site situation record appearance wide application.
assignees: GUANGZHOU CONSTRUCTION QUALITY & SAFETY TESTING CENTER;BEIJING LIANRUIKE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for interacting information between command platform and on-site rescue equipment in earthquake
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of the earthquake rescue communication and in particular relates to a method for interacting information between a command platform and on-site rescue equipment in an earthquake. The method comprises the following steps: the command platform is used for sending communication information to a server; the server is used for sending confirmation information to the on-site rescue equipment indicated in the communication information; the on-site rescue device is used for photographing, recording and returning information and generating an IP address; the on-site rescue equipment is connected with a wireless network; finally the information is interacted between the on-site rescue equipment and the command platform. By virtue of the method, the defects that most of network resources are occupied, the information of the on-site rescue equipment cannot be acquired in time, and the information cannot be effectively interacted under the condition of lack of network communication resources in the earthquake regions can be solved; the real-time follow-up of the rescue of the regions with the lack of the network communication resources is ensured; the network connection time is reduced; the rescuing efficiency is greatly increased.
assignees: JIANGSU GUOYAO INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire commander and fighter identity identification and management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire commander and fighter identity identification and management system. The fire commander and fighter identity identification and management system is composed of a fire commander and fighter identity identification watch, a portable identity identification device, a fixed identity identification device and an identity management data center. The fire commander and fighter identity identification watch is composed of a smart watch and an identity identification tag; and the fire commander and fighter identity identification and management system provided by the invention reads the identity identification RFID electronic tag information on the fire commander and fighter identity identification watch, and a data communication module interacts the read information with the identity management data center to record and process related data. The system identifies the identities of fire commanders and fighters in fire stations and during fire emergency rescues by means of the fixed identity identification device to achieve digital and dynamic management of the number of the fire commanders and fighter, personnel mobilization and the number of personnel asking for leave and on holiday in daily life; and the system achieves digital and dynamic management of attendance, fire ground entry time, fire ground entry countdown, fire ground exit conditions and the like of emergency rescue sites during wartime by means of the portable identity identification device, so that the personnel inventory efficiency of the rescue sites is improved, and then effective technical measures are provided for guaranteeing the life safety of firemen entering the fire grounds.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RES INST;SHANGHAI BEIAN INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command playback system based on event
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency command playback system based on events, which consists of an emergency command dispatching center, a video recording terminal and a playback request terminal, wherein the video recording terminal and the playback request terminal are configured to execute the following operations: the playback request terminal sends a playback transmission resource request message to the emergency command dispatching center; the playback request terminal receives a playback transmission resource response message sent by the emergency command dispatching center; the playback request terminal determines a period for transmitting playback transmission control information and a period for transmitting playback transmission data information based on the indication of the resource for playback transmission after receiving the playback transmission resource response message. The emergency command playback system based on the event can flexibly adjust the transmission mode, the transmission content and the transmission complexity, thereby being suitable for various emergency environments.

title_en: Nuclear power plant intelligent fire alarm response method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent fire alarm response method, a system, a storage medium and electronic equipment of a nuclear power plant, which comprise the steps of receiving a fire alarm detection signal, correlating on-site fire protection information and starting fire protection isolation measures; the method comprises the steps of determining fire information based on a fire detection signal, displaying and outputting a fire prompt on a large screen in a fire control center of a nuclear power plant, acquiring flow guide data of a fire control action card, reporting on-site fire information according to the flow guide data, verifying and confirming and converting the on-site fire information based on the on-site fire information, executing fire response work according to the on-site fire information, and tracking and recording all fire response data. The invention can realize the structuring and digitalization of the fire-fighting action card, realize the automatic recognition flow and dispatch of the automatic fire-fighting action card file, and the operators can carry out visual interactive operation through the mobile terminal or the PC terminal, thereby providing high-efficiency fire-fighting action support for the operators and ensuring that corresponding fire-fighting response tasks can be rapidly and accurately executed in emergency.
assignees: Yangjiang nuclear power co ltd;CGN SHANGHAI SIMULATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Boarding personnel information management method and ship access control management system
abstract_en: The application provides a boarding personnel information management method and a ship access control management system, and relates to the technical field of ships. The access controller can receive the ship operation task sheet from the dispatch server. The ship operation task list at least carries at least one identity information of the boarding personnel, controls the interception mechanism to release under the condition that the identity information of the actual boarding personnel is consistent with the identity information of the boarding personnel, and records the release time of the interception mechanism, the identity information of the actual boarding personnel and the number of the actual boarding personnel for operation on the ship for one time. When an accident occurs on the subsequent ship, rescue personnel can determine a rescue scheme according to the number of actual boarding personnel for the operation on the ship, the identity information of each actual boarding personnel and the boarding time of each actual boarding personnel.
assignees: WUCHANG SHIPBUILDING IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Reservoir artificial flood peak ecological scheduling effect evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a reservoir artificial flood peak ecological dispatching effect evaluation method, which relates to the technical field of reservoir regulation and control and comprises the steps of setting a fish egg sampling section, collecting a fish egg sample and recording data. Culturing and identifying the sample, and obtaining daily roe type composition, number and density data, thereby determining the roe resource amount. The number of species and amount of resources of the floating eggs are analyzed and the highest level of history is determined with reference to historical survey data. And selecting the species number and the resource quantity of the floating eggs as evaluation indexes to give weight, and calculating the comprehensive indexes of spawning response of the fishes. And finally, grading the ecological dispatching effect by using a percentile grading method. The method takes the number of species of the fish spawns with the drift production property and the fish spawn resource quantity as evaluation indexes, and compared with the highest historical level, a simple and practical evaluation system is constructed, the comparability and the accuracy of ecological dispatching effects of different years are enhanced, and scientific basis is provided for ecological dispatching management of reservoirs.
assignees: CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;INST OF HYDROECOLOGY MWR & CAS

title_en: High-speed rescue material scheduling method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-speed rescue material scheduling method and system based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of emergency management, wherein the method comprises the steps of dispatching an unmanned aerial vehicle provided with a multi-mode sensing unit to fly against a target area for dynamic inspection, receiving an aid seeking signal sent by the target area through an Internet of things terminal and an inspection signal returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and generating an estimated value of the number of trapped people; and generating a dynamic material scheduling scheme based on the estimated value of the trapped people, the real-time disaster prediction information and a preset material demand model, and sending the dynamic material scheduling scheme to a rescue execution unit through an Internet of things scheduling platform. Therefore, the response speed and timeliness of material scheduling are improved.

title_en: Information management device, information management method and information management program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To facilitate grasping of a time-series relationship between activity logs and an organizational relationship related to the activity logs, and to quickly grasp the situation.SOLUTION: An information management device 10 calculates the degree of similarity of each activity log in emergency response, and based on the degree of similarity, classifies activity logs with the high degree of similarity as a group. The information management device 10 time-sequentially displays the content of an activity log included in a group selected from a plurality of classified groups, and also displays an organization name related to each activity log. title_en: Method of managing traffic accicident information using electronic recording device of vehicle and apparatus for the same
title_ko: 차량 블랙박스와 연동한 교통사고 정보 관리 방법 및 이를 위한 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and a device for managing traffic accident information using a black box. The method for managing traffic accident information using a black box according to the present invention comprises the steps of: recognizing an accident situation by detecting an image or a sound of a predetermined pattern from a neighboring vehicle in the event of a traffic accident; generating transmission information by selecting information related to the accident situation from the information collected by a black box of the neighboring vehicle and sending the transmission information to an integrated management server along with time information and position information; integrating and reconfiguring the received transmission information per accident by classifying the received transmission information according to time and position by the integrated management server; and performing accident determination using the integrated and reconfigured information and informing an accident handling service server of the accident determination to perform an accident handling service.
abstract_ko: 블랙박스와 연동한 교통사고 정보 관리 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  본 발명에 따른 블랙박스와 연동한 교통사고 정보 관리 방법은, 교통사고 발생시 주변 차량에서 기설정된 패턴의 영상이나 음향을 감지하여 사고 상황을 인식하는 단계; 상기 주변 차량이 블랙박스에 수집된 정보 중 상기 사고 상황과 관련된 정보를 선별하여 송신 정보를 생성하고, 상기 송신 정보를 시간 정보 및 위치 정보와 함께 통합 관리 서버로 전송하는 단계; 상기 통합 관리 서버가 수신된 송신 정보를 시간과 위치를 기준으로 분류하여 사고별로 통합 및 재구성하는 단계; 및 상기 통합 및 재구성된 정보를 이용하여 사고 판정을 수행하고, 상기 사고 판정을 받은 경우 사고 처리 서비스 서버로 통보하여 사고 처리 서비스가 수행되도록 하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and incident management system, and computer-readable recording medium
title_ko: 침해 사고 정보를 관리하기 위한 방법과 침해 사고 관리 시스템, 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 매체
abstract_ko:
본 실시예는 외부의 침해 공유 채널로부터 수집되거나 생성된 침해 악용 자원, 침해 연관 정보 및 침해 정보를 수집 또는 조회시 이들의 유기적인 연관 관계를 고려하여 적어도 하나의 인덱스(ID)를 부여하여 관리할 수 있는 메카니즘이 제공된다. 
이에, 본 실시예는 침해사고 정보 관리를 통해, 그에 따른 침해 연관 성을 파악하고, 이를 분류 및 체계적으로 관리함으로써, 차후에 발생하는 침해 사고에 대해 지능적인 분석의 방향성을 제시할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for assignment of equipment to an officer
abstract_en:
A system for tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment to security agency personnel (e.g., officers, administration, command, armorer). An armorer is assigned the task of tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment. Equipment may be assigned to a particular individual officer. 
     The equipment provided to and used by officers may capture (e.g. gather, produce) information (e.g. audiovisual information, data logs, recordings). Equipment may provide information to the armorer via near field communication (NFC) circuits. The information captured may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system. The information captured by equipment assigned to a particular individual may be associated with that individual. An armorer may use information supplied by equipment, evidence management system, officers, or other sources to assist in the assignment process.

title_en: Wearable Safety and Emergency Response Device
abstract_en: A wearable safety device is disclosed. The device includes a waterproof housing with a touch-based display screen. The device includes dual alarm buttons utilizing, for example, simultaneous actuation to trigger an emergency alert, which initiates an alert message to be transmitted to law enforcement, employer, emergency contact, et. al. (i.e., selected destination) of the wearer of the device along with activation of vibration feedback and automatic audio recording. The device features a GPS receiver/transceiver for location tracking and a wireless module for real-time communication with law enforcement, employer, emergency contact, et. al. (i.e., selected destination). The device connects to a mobile application and cloud database for storing audio/video and receiving predictive safety alerts based on historical data analysis, thereby enhancing user safety through both reactive and preventive measures.

title_en: Incident alert and information gathering method and system
abstract_en: An apparatus, a system and a method of collecting vehicle data for use in incident investigations, including: a vehicle data recorder for recording vehicle parameters such as geographic location, speed, azimuth of motion, acceleration, brake pedal pressure and similar parameters: a means for detecting incidents such as an accident, and sending an incident message to a incident monitoring station, which then transmits a broadcast message. Other vehicles within communication range of the incident monitoring station each respond to the broadcast message with a report message including a unique identifier. When an incident occurs, a portion of the data stored prior to, and at the time of, the incident is saved for future retrieval. The incident message may be reported to a central site or other authority so that emergency response can be provided.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted terminal for public safety field monitoring
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted terminal for public safety field monitoring. The invention realizes the monitoring and recording of the vehicle driving process by storing the high-definition video data obtained by the image acquisition equipment into the high-speed storage unit through the mSATA interface after decoding and compressing. The invention can also connect the vehicle-mounted terminal to a background data processing center in cooperation with a 4G communication module, and the background data processing center processes the acquired flammable and combustible detection data, vehicle-mounted electronic information, command commands, positioning data, navigation data and video monitoring signals in real time to generate corresponding command data, wherein the command data comprises video monitoring signals, emergency stop signals, one-key window breaking signals or contact vehicle interception signals and the like to the vehicle-mounted terminal, so that the remote monitoring of the vehicle running state is realized.

title_en: Child programming result feedback system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a child programming result feedback system and a method, comprising a carrier, a power calculation unit, an optical identification unit, an execution unit and terminal equipment; the carrier is provided with a specific graph which is used for representing the execution command; the optical identification unit comprises an image acquisition module, wherein the image acquisition module is used for acquiring carrier images and recording image sequences, and the image sequences are formed by combining a plurality of specific patterns; the power calculating unit is used for preprocessing the carrier image, identifying an execution program or an execution command of the image sequence and issuing the execution program or the execution command to the execution unit; the execution program is formed by combining a plurality of execution commands according to the sequence contained in the image sequence; the execution unit completes the appointed action according to the execution program or the execution command and feeds back the execution result to the terminal equipment. The invention realizes the interaction of the execution unit with the environment and the user, and avoids the lack of interaction feeling and accuracy in the process of programming children; the interactivity of the child programming product is improved, and an immersive interactive experience for programming learning is provided.

title_en: Intelligent system and method for saving a life when auto accidents
title_ko: 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템을 구축함에 있어, 차량 사고 시 신속한 대응을 위하여 차량에 장착된 단말기에서 차량사고 데이터를 관제 센터에 전송하고 관제 센터에서 사고차량의 운전자와 직접 교신을 통해 응급구조를 할 수 있는 시스템을 구축하여 사용자들에게 안정적이고 신뢰성 있는 시스템을 제공하고 관제 센터를 무인으로 운영하여 운영비용을 최소화할 수 있는, 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체를 제공하고자 한다. 
이를 위하여, 본 발명은 지능형 인명구조 시스템에 있어서, 사고 발생 장치의 지능형 단말기로부터 사고 정보를 수신하여 관제 서버로 전달하고, 상기 지능형 단말기와 통화 연결을 하여 무인으로 사고를 접수하기 위한 통신 서버; 회원 정보를 저장하고 있으며, 상기 통신 서버로부터 사고 관련 정보를 전달받아 저장하기 위한 DB 서버; 사고 발생 위치에 상응하는 지도 화면 데이터와 지번 데이터를 생성하여 상기 관제 서버로 전달하기 위한 맵(MAP) 서버; 및 상기 통신 서버로부터의 사고 정보를 상기 맵(MAP) 서버로부터의 지도 화면 데이터와 지번 데이터에 따라 표시하고, 사고 접수를 처리하기 위한 상기 관제 서버를 포함한다.

title_en: System and method for beach risk assessment based on situation awareness and fuzzy logic and computer program for the same
title_ko: 상황인식 및 퍼지이론 기반의 해수욕장 위험도 평가 시스템 및 방법과, 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: A beach risk assessment system includes: a receiving part configured to receive basic data including public data related with a target beach; a context-awareness-based analysis part configured to determine at least one piece of feature data related with a dangerous situation among the basic data based on a context-awareness algorithm, and calculate a risky situation prediction value corresponding to the basic data based on the feature data; a fuzzy theory-based analysis part configured to store a fuzzy function based on at least one piece of the basic data, and determine a risk grade corresponding to the basic data by using the fuzzy function; and a risk assessment part configured to calculate a risk degree of the target beach by using the risky situation prediction value calculated by the context-awareness-based analysis part and the risk grade determined by the fuzzy theory-based analysis part. According to the beach risk assessment system, the feature data is extracted from data related with a natural environment of the target beach based on context-awareness and the fuzzy theory, and, through multi-linear regression analysis based thereon, a risky situation which can cause an accident in the beach can be predicted with a relation between features and likelihood according to the same.
abstract_ko: 해수욕장 위험도 평가 시스템은, 대상 해수욕장에 관련된 공공 데이터를 포함하는 기본 데이터를 수신하도록 구성된 데이터 수신부; 상황인식 알고리즘에 기반하여 상기 기본 데이터 중 위험 상황에 관련된 하나 이상의 특징 데이터를 결정하며, 상기 특징 데이터를 기반으로 상기 기본 데이터에 상응하는 위험 상황 예측값을 산출하도록 구성된 상황인식 기반 분석부; 상기 기본 데이터 중 하나 이상의 데이터를 기반으로 하는 퍼지 함수를 저장하며, 상기 퍼지 함수를 이용하여, 상기 기본 데이터에 상응하는 위험 등급을 결정하도록 구성된 퍼지이론 기반 분석부; 및 상기 상황인식 기반 분석부에 의해 산출된 위험 상황 예측값 및 상기 퍼지이론 기반 분석부에 의해 결정된 위험 등급을 이용하여 상기 대상 해수욕장의 위험도를 산출하도록 구성된 위험 평가부를 포함한다. 상기 해수욕장 위험도 평가 시스템에 의하면, 대상 해수욕장의 자연 환경에 관련된 데이터로부터 상황인식 및 퍼지이론에 기반하여 특징 데이터를 추출하고, 이를 기반으로 한 다중 선형 회귀 분석을 통하여, 해수욕장의 안전 사고를 발생시키는 위험 상황을 시간에 따른 특징간의 관계 및 이에 따른 확률로 예측할 수 있다.
assignees: UNIV GACHON IND ACAD COOP FOUND;MOKPO NATIONAL MARITIME UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Emergency communications controller and console
abstract_en: An emergency communications device contains dispatch consoles for use by user that contains multiple repeaters and multiple communication networks. The multiple repeaters and multiple communication networks are used for redundancy purposes, in case the repeater or communication network in use becomes disabled for any reason. The device also contains a recorder unit capable of provided instant playback to emergency dispatch personnel independently of whether the unit is recording. The device does not require an external computer to operate.

title_en: System for handling messages and distributing information
abstract_en: System for handling messages and distributing information between subscribers and their customers and contact. Each system subscriber can generate customized landing and flyer web pages called flyer pages for each of the subscriber's products, services, and/or listings. Landing and flyer pages can contain multiple links to other flyer pages. When a subscriber's customer or contact views a landing or flyer page and clicks on a link presented on that page, the system provides subscriber's information to a customer or contact immediately after the information is requested. The system can also make a lead, including a record of that event, and present the record to the subscriber who owns the landing or flyer page, allowing a subscriber to view a report with a history of who has viewed which page for all leads generated for their pages. Leads are tracked through a process that includes steps of lead generation and lead propagation. Embodiments of the system include a system for tracking sales leads, an internet-based wagering system, and an emergency response system.

title_en: Systems and methods for AI-based real-time incident response intelligence
abstract_en: An emergency response data system (ERDS) provides AI-based real-time intelligence during a response to an incident. The system includes a monitoring module configured to receive and process incident metadata from an emergency system, such as a Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD) system, wherein the incident metadata includes location, type of emergency, units dispatched, and comments. An analysis module analyzes the incident metadata and identifies changes in incident circumstances, including comparing current comments with historical comments corresponding to the location. A data retrieval module accesses and retrieves public record information corresponding to the location, including property data, tax records, real estate records, historical records, and permits. An insight generation module generates real-time insights and updates regarding the incident, including reclassifying the type of emergency based on the analyzed metadata and retrieved public records. An alert module transmits the real-time insights to emergency personnel, including field responders and Emergency Communication Centers (ECC).

title_en: A kind of accident pre-alarming system based on main fan
abstract_en: The utility model proposes a kind of accident pre-alarming systems based on main fan, with on the cable between main fan and the first power supply be equipped with the first on-off transducer, cable between spare main fan and the second power supply is equipped with the second on-off transducer, with on main fan be equipped with the first air velocity transducer and the first B/P EGR Back Pressure Transducer EGR, spare main fan is equipped with the second air velocity transducer and the second B/P EGR Back Pressure Transducer EGR, first on-off transducer, second on-off transducer, first air velocity transducer, first B/P EGR Back Pressure Transducer EGR, second air velocity transducer and the second B/P EGR Back Pressure Transducer EGR are connected with control device, control device is connected by network with intelligent control platform, intelligent control platform is connected with gsm module.The utility model improves the timeliness of accident discovery, substantially reduces response time of accident, improves main logical machine accident emergency response and the efficiency of decision-making, has good safety benefit and very strong popularizing value.

title_en: Railway emergency CIR radio station

abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of quick Big Dipper transmission methods of earthquake disaster information, it is characterised in that：Column content is reported in table to input corresponding content with by earthquake disaster data input according to the condition of a disaster on Big Dipper terminal device；Input content is extracted and input content is carried out by recombination according to earthquake agreement and forms Big Dipper short message；Emit Big Dipper short message；Prison receives the reception receipt that earthquake command system is sent later；Earthquake command system receives and extracts parsing Big Dipper short message, transmits and receives receipt；Big Dipper short message by section is extracted according to earthquake agreement, and is entered into corresponding position in the condition of a disaster record form, recombinates out earthquake disaster information, and record the card number for reporting Big Dipper terminal device.This method can make user rapidly input the necessary information that earthquake disaster reports, and shorten Big Dipper short message length, it can be achieved that earthquake disaster is quick, effectively reports, ensured the safe and reliable transmission of earthquake information.

title_en: Dispute troubleshooting system and method for dispute contradiction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dispute investigation system and a method thereof for dispatching contradictory dispute, which comprises a processor, wherein the processor is connected with a login module in series through a circuit, the processor is connected with an account module in series through a circuit, the account module is connected with a management module in series through a circuit, the management module is connected with a storage module in parallel through a circuit, the storage module is connected with the processor in series through a circuit, the management module is connected with an input module, a marking module, a classifying module, a searching module and a deleting module in parallel through a circuit, and after logging in by combining various accounts, the dispute event is input and recorded through a multi-interface system structure, so that the dispute investigation system is beneficial to timely distributing responsible persons, effectively improving the police force utilization efficiency, avoiding waste, classifying and marking states of different events, ensuring the timeliness of checking and playback, being convenient for managing to realize cloud information sharing and multi-person information maintenance, the previous file management work is eliminated, and a large amount of manpower work is saved.

title_en: Method for forecasting mountain torrent disasters by means of cooperation of heaves and earth
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for forecasting mountain torrents in a coordinated manner, which comprises the following steps of comprehensively processing multi-source data, obtaining mountain torrents situation data in a monitored area based on three-dimensional spatial interpolation, second-order grid refinement and strong variation spatial perception technology, fusing the mountain torrents situation data with unmanned aerial vehicle remote sensing image data, comprehensively analyzing water level changes and terrain changes, constructing a multi-mode mountain torrents early warning large model, finely adjusting the multi-mode mountain torrents early warning large model by adopting a technology combining P-Tuning V2 and low-rank self-adaption LoRA, and adopting non-autoregressive decoding to accelerate the reasoning speed of the large model. The mountain torrent early warning large model improves early warning accuracy and timeliness, optimizes emergency response and provides technical support for flood control and disaster relief. And moreover, the mountain torrent early warning large model after fine adjustment can be used for predicting the mountain torrent risk more accurately, in real time and efficiently, processing multi-mode data and providing powerful technical support for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Intelligent allocation optimization method and system for first-aid equipment resources
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent allocation optimization method and system for emergency equipment resources, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining historical use records, real-time inventory states, hospital orders, environment parameters, geographic positions and vital sign data of patients of cross-regional emergency equipment, fusing the real-time inventory, orders and the vital sign data, carrying out association analysis through a federal learning frame and the historical records, predicting future emergency equipment demand fluctuation, simultaneously constructing a dynamically updated emergency equipment distribution map by combining real-time traffic network based on the environment parameters and the geographic position information, generating a multi-objective path plan considering timeliness and resource utilization rate according to the distribution map and the real-time traffic data by utilizing a reinforcement learning model, and finally carrying out joint optimization on demand prediction and path scheme to generate an optimal cross-regional equipment allocation instruction set. The application improves the emergency response speed and the resource utilization rate.
assignees: THE FIRST MEDICAL CENTER OF CHINESE PLA GENERAL HOSPITAL

title_en: Intelligent command method and system for fire extinguishment of coal mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting intelligent command method for a coal mine, a fire-fighting intelligent command system for the coal mine, fire-fighting intelligent command equipment for the coal mine and a computer readable storage medium. The method comprises the steps of collecting underground multi-source heterogeneous data, carrying out space-time alignment and fusion processing to construct a data base reflecting a fire scene state in real time, mapping the fusion data to a digital twin model constructed in advance to generate three-dimensional visual expression of the fire scene, carrying out dynamic prediction on a fire spreading trend by utilizing a cellular automaton model, combining the current fire condition and a resource distribution state, taking response time and resource utilization rate as optimization targets, generating an optimal fire extinguishing resource allocation scheme by a scheduling optimization algorithm, and finally carrying out visual presentation on the scheduling scheme in the digital twin scene and issuing scheduling instructions to related execution units. The invention realizes the prediction of fire and the resource scheduling, and provides systematic technical support for the emergency disposal of underground coal mine fire.

title_en: Method for Predicting Vehicle Collision Using Data Collected from Video Games
title_ko: 비디오 게임을 활용한 차량 사고 예측 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fast and effective method for predicting a car accident which collects accident data of a virtual world by utilizing a video game using high-level graphic resolution, applies the accident data to a design of a deep learning car accident prediction algorithm and can increase performance for real world data of the corresponding algorithm by using a domain adaptation technique. According to the present invention, the method for predicting a car accident using a video game comprises the following steps of: collecting the virtual accident data including collision images and non-collision images with a game player car by changing an execution state of a video program; and performing determination for a collision accident of the car based on trained learning data by applying the virtual accident data to a learning algorithm.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비디오 게임을 활용한 차량 사고 예측 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 차량 사고 예측 시스템의 차량 사고 예측 방법은, 비디오 프로그램의 실행 상태를 변경하여 게임 플레이어 차량과의 충돌 이미지들 및 비충돌 이미지들을 포함하는 가상의 사고 데이터를 수집하는 단계, 및 상기 가상의 사고 데이터를 학습 알고리즘에 적용하여 훈련된 학습 데이터를 기반으로 차량의 충돌 사고 여부에 대한 판단을 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: E-call system with digital tachograph
title_ko: 디지털운행기록 기능을 구비한 차량 긴급 구난 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a vehicle emergency rescue device having a digital driving record function. According to the present invention, a vehicle emergency rescue device having a digital driving record function comprises: an input interface device collecting driving data; a memory performing a digital driving record using the driving data and storing a program generating an eCall; and a processor executing the program. The processor generates the driving data using the driving data, analyzes the driving data to determine whether a dangerous driving behavior pattern has occurred, and generates the eCall when it is determined that an accident has occurred.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털운행기록 기능을 구비한 차량 긴급 구난 장치에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명에 따른 디지털운행기록 기능을 구비한 차량 긴급 구난 장치는 주행 데이터를 수집하는 입력 인터페이스 장치와, 주행 데이터를 이용하여 디지털 운행 기록을 수행하고, eCall을 발생시키는 프로그램이 저장된 메모리 및 프로그램을 실행시키는 프로세서를 포함하고, 프로세서는 주행 데이터를 이용하여 운행 데이터를 생성하고, 운행 데이터를 분석하여 위험운전 행동패턴 발생 여부를 판단하며, 사고 발생 상황으로 판단한 경우에는 eCall을 발생시킨다.

title_en: Mobile asset data recording for fuel compensation
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allows for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with impact detection, rough operating condition detection, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of a mobile asset. Users can use the normal operation of their mobile assets to locate and alert, in real-time, areas where their assets are encountering rough operating environments, to provide for quicker emergency response, and to validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting.

title_en: Mobile asset data recording for engine running detection
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. title_en: Method and application for emergency incident reporting and communication
abstract_en: A wireless, mobile device application for a first-responder to create incident reports for events such as an automobile accident or natural disaster, including digital photographs, audio recordings, notes, ordinance numbers, number of individuals affected, type of incident, real time global positioning satellite coordinates (GPS), and any other relevant information that a first-responder deems necessary. Such a report may then be transmitted to a server for access by emergency personnel, E-911 dispatchers, or any others with access to a secure server hosted on the World Wide Web.

title_en: Online street safety map system displaying crime density and traffic accident data
abstract_en: An interactive street safety map system for internet, GPS, and mobile users is disclosed. The system is designed to identify crime and traffic accidents information at street level. Each street segment on the map indicates low to high density of crime and traffic accidents in different colors in order to improve public perception of safety on each of the streets displayed. The system includes crime and traffic accident data, and the system users can query the data for their interest locations, crime types, crime date and time of occurrence, and the number of crime incidents and traffic accidents. Ultimately, the online street safety map allows users to choose relatively low risk of crime and traffic accident streets for their own safety. The system harvests crime and traffic information data from police departments through Computer-Aided Dispatch (CAD), Recorded Management Systems (RMS), and other crime and traffic information sharing services.

title_en: Secure database systems and methods for delivering health care treatment
abstract_en: Databases comprising autonomous or semi-autonomous platforms for the diagnosis and treatment of patient conditions are disclosed. A CarePod is configured to be a system for affecting an authenticatable, HIPAA-compliant communications and monitoring platform to facilitate patient's on-going diagnosis and treatment of a given condition. In the area of psychotherapy, CarePod/IA may affect methods for allowing new members into the treatment group by directing a set of diagnostic tools and tests, ingesting response data, re-evaluating such response data to fine tune diagnosis as to patient's condition. Facilitated communications by and between members may be monitored by and between members by a CarePod/IA and, depending upon threshold conditions, may either update a patient's care dashboard/record or take a plurality of actions (e.g., emergency responses) as the situation dictates.

title_en: System for validating and appending incident-related data records in an inter-agency distributed electronic ledger
abstract_en: A computer apparatus, such as a validator node, for validating data records in a distributed electronic ledger may be configured to receive a proposed data record submitted by an originating agent of an originating agency to a distributed ledger. In response to the proposed incident-related data record, other agents within the originating agency may, based on validation criteria, submit one or more responsive data records that may provide information for use in determining a validity of the proposed incident-related data record. Validator nodes hosted by external agencies may submit validation responses relative to a validity of the proposed incident-related data record. The system may determine that the proposed data record is valid. Based a consensus algorithm, the system may responsively append the proposed data record or an indication of validity to the distributed ledger or to a different distributed ledger.

title_en: Systems and Methods for Emergency Contact and Response
abstract_en: The system and method for communicating with emergency services includes a front end system and a back end system. The front end system has a user interface that allows a front end user to initiate contact with emergency services through text, video, or voice, auto-populate the front end user's 3D Geolocation, and to initiate a livestream of the surroundings. The back end system is adapted to allow an emergency response officer to view live stream videos remotely, communicate with a front end user via text, video, or voice, submit links and other information to the front end user, and log the location of the front end user. The back end system utilizes automated identification capabilities, being able to perform an automatic identification of sounds, objects, or entities in a recording. The system further produces a police report to summarize the event and store all relevant information for future reference.

title_en: A real time processing system and method of a traffic accident using an unmanned recording device
title_ko: 무인교통사고기록장치를 이용한 실시간 교통사고처리시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for processing a traffic accident in real-time by using an unmanned traffic accident recorder are provided to precisely detect/analyze correct 3D(Dimensional) moving picture and license plate image, and prevent the traffic accidents and traffic violation by installing a plurality of cameras in an area frequently causing the traffic accident, and constructing a real-time two-way voice communication system between the area and a control center. A system includes an unmanned traffic accident recorder(100), a multi-codec CMS(Center Management System) server(20), a monitoring monitor(300), a moving picture analyzing system(400), and a service guide device(500). The unmanned traffic accident recorder includes crossway monitoring cameras(10a,10b) capturing a moving picture of a real situation of a crossway in real-time, license plate monitoring cameras(11a,11b) capturing a photo of a license plate of a vehicle, a microphone(12a), a speaker(13a), a mixer(14), a memory(15), a camera driver(17), an interphone(18), and a controller(16) linked with the multi-codec CMS server of a central control center and controlling each component. The multi-codec CMS server transmits moving picture and image data received from the recorder to the central control center, and transmits command data to the recorder.

title_en: Firefighting radio order system by using fire and work for the radio
title_ko: 소방 및 업무용 무전기를 이용한 소방 무선 지령 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting radio command system using a firefighting and business radio. The firefighting radio command system using a firefighting and business radio according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: an FM receiving unit (10); a DMB receiving unit (30); a relay transmitter (500); a downward line amplifier (750); an upward line amplifier (900); and a relay receiver (600). The relay transmitter (500), the relay receiver (600), the FM receiving unit (10), and the DMB receiving unit (30) are installed on the ground. The downward line amplifier (750) and the upward line amplifier (900) are installed underground. Therefore, the present invention enables a user to listen to FM/terrestrial DMB broadcasting in a radio shadow area, and can smoothly perform a firefighting radio command.

title_en: Air-ground voice communication management and dispatching system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an air-ground voice communication management and dispatching system. The system comprises a server and a plurality of clients, wherein a plurality of voice cards are arranged in a server motherboard expansion slot of the server, and the plurality of voice cards form a plurality of mutually independent voice channels; and each client is composed of a traffic box, and the traffic box comprises a casing and a traffic box circuit. The system has the characteristics of high-fidelity comprehensive dispatching of simulated air-ground calls and blank-pipe through calls and continuous and clear voice signals; the system has a voice recording and playback function; and the system is strong in practical applicability, and applicable to the management and dispatching of voice communication between a controller seat and a pilot seat in an air traffic control simulation system.

abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for monitoring a scene using a mobile terminal and a method therefor are provided to quickly find a dangerous situation by real time photographing of the portable terminal. The portable terminal transmits situation information to a control server(200). The situation information is made of location information. The control server maps map information or blueprint information corresponding to the situation information from a preset database based on the situation information of the portable terminal. The control server displays the mapped situation information of the portable terminal.

title_en: Learning aids for software programming education
title_ko: 소프트웨어 프로그래밍 교육을 위한 학습 교구
abstract_en: Provided is a learning tool for software programming education. The learning tool comprises: a board; a plurality of contact terminals disposed on the board; and a circuit structure disposed on the board, and electrically connected to the contact terminals. Each of the contact terminals comprises: at least one first contact terminal disposed on the outer edge of the board; and at least one second contact terminal disposed in the board. The first contact terminal comprises: one penetration hole penetrating the board; and an electrode pattern formed on an inner side wall of the penetration hole. The second contact terminal comprises: a plurality of penetration holes penetrating the board; and an electrode pattern formed on an inner side wall of the penetration holes. The contact terminals can be respectively electrically connected to a conductive object through a clip cable. The circuit structure comprises: a communications unit connected to the computer system; and a control unit for detecting a change in a capacitance from the contact terminals. The contact terminals are respectively mapped with commands for performing a predetermined function or a predetermined operation of the computer system. The control unit transmits a command mapped with at least one contact terminal having a changed capacitance from the contact terminals to the computer system. The computer system performs software programming by a command received from the learning tool.
abstract_ko: 소프트웨어 프로그래밍 교육을 위한 학습 교구가 제공된다. 상기 학습 교구는 보드, 상기 보드에 배치되는 복수의 접속 단자, 및 상기 보드에 배치되고 상기 복수의 접속 단자와 전기적으로 연결되는 회로 구성을 포함하고, 상기 복수의 접속 단자는, 상기 보드의 외곽 테두리에 배치되는 적어도 하나의 제1 접속 단자와, 상기 보드의 내측으로 배치되는 적어도 하나의 제2 접속 단자를 포함하고, 상기 제1 접속 단자는, 상기 보드를 관통하는 하나의 관통 홀과, 상기 하나의 관통 홀의 내부 측벽에 형성된 전극 패턴을 포함하고, 상기 제2 접속 단자는, 상기 보드를 관통하는 복수의 관통 홀과, 상기 복수의 관통 홀의 내부 측벽에 형성된 전극 패턴을 포함하고, 상기 복수의 접속 단자는, 각각 클립 케이블을 통해서 전도성 물체와 전기적으로 연결가능하고, 상기 회로 구성은, 컴퓨터 시스템과 연결되는 통신부와, 상기 복수의 접속 단자에서 정전용량의 변화를 검출하는 제어부를 포함하고, 상기 복수의 접속 단자는, 각각 상기 컴퓨터 시스템의 소정의 기능 또는 소정의 동작의 수행을 위한 명령과 매핑되고, 상기 제어부는, 상기 복수의 접속 단자 중 정전용량이 변화된 적어도 하나의 접속 단자에 매핑된 명령을 상기 컴퓨터 시스템에 전송하고, 상기 컴퓨터 시스템은, 상기 학습 교구로부터 수신된 명령에 의해서 소프트웨어 프로그래밍을 수행한다.

title_en: Smart rescue helmet, especially for firefighters
abstract_en: A smart rescue helmet, especially a firefighter helmet formed from a shell in the shape similar to a hemisphere, equipped inside with a shock absorbing canopy and a retention system and also in the front part with a rotating visor, characterised by the fact that it is equipped with a control module (1) in the form of a microcomputer (8), a near-field display (2), a visible band camera (3) and a thermal imaging camera (4), a sensor module monitoring physiological parameters (5) and the position of the firefighter (6) and communication system (7) with the command centre where the data readings are properly processed and stored in a dedicated database. The near-field display (2) is built on a mini LCD screen with a bright backlight and an optical prism allowing a wide-angle field of vision, a visible band camera (3) records images from the scene of action and the compressed video stream is transmitted via CPU to the command centre, an integrated thermal imaging camera has a radiometry function. In addition, the image from the thermal imaging camera (4) is fed directly to the mini near-field display (2) of the firefighter, the sensor module (5) of the rescuer's physiological parameters and accelerometer sensors are mounted in the helmet housing at the point of contact with the skin and the information from the sensors is transmitted to the CPU of the networked Smart helmet.

title_en: Detecting contacts during sporting activities etc.
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus are described for determining parameters of a contact between bodies occurring within an activity. A digital camera directed towards a target area during the activity captures image frames including infra red image data. Structure for comparing image data for multiple temporally spaced frames with image data of a reference datum records any localised infra red emission appearing in at least one incident frame. The image data for at least one of the incident frames is analysed to determine at least one parameter of the contact, and the image data for the incident frame is recorded. Visual display means displays the incident frames including the image data in the IR spectrum to enable visual inspection of the activity in the target area at the time of the incident frame and that gave rise to the contact producing the infra red emission.

title_en: Fire department garage door device
title_ko: 소방서 차고용 도어 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방서 차고용 도어 장치에 관한 것으로, 소방서 차고의 출입구에 설치되고 충격 이탈 복구형 도어로 이루어지는 도어부; 정전 시 상기 도어부의 도어 개방을 위한 전원을 공급하는 UPS부; 및 상기 도어부가 도어를 개방할 때마다 해당 시간 및 횟수를 기록하고 해당 기록을 소방차의 출동과 연계시켜 상기 소방차의 출동이력으로 데이터베이스에 저장하는 로그기록부를 포함한다.

title_en: Intelligent flood automatic monitoring system for urban rail transit underground complex
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent flood automatic monitoring system for an urban rail transit underground complex, which comprises a field sensing device, a data processing device, a calculation and analysis device and a visual display device; the field sensing equipment comprises a full-automatic water level flowmeter, a fiber bragg grating liquid level meter and an infrared video camera which are arranged in the comprehensive body; the field sensing equipment is arranged at an entrance and an exit at the lower part of the terrain of the complex, and the positions of an inner rail area, a water pump room, a water collecting well, a drainage ditch and/or a water collecting port of the complex; the data processing equipment comprises a water level flowmeter switch, a fiber bragg grating demodulator, a camera switch, a flood core switch and an NVR (network video recorder); the calculation and analysis equipment comprises a monitoring data analysis and calculation server and a linkage alarm, and the monitoring data analysis and calculation server and the linkage alarm are linked to early warn flood disaster information; the intelligent flood monitoring and early warning system can carry out intelligent flood monitoring and early warning in all directions and all weather, effectively carry out on-site dispatching and commanding before the flood occurs, and reduce the loss of equipment and personnel to the minimum.

title_en: Device for positioning fire source centre and fire-fighting method of device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device for positioning a fire source centre and a fire-fighting method of the device, wherein a smog sensor is used as a unique address code signal source; a sensor directly controls fire fighting equipment and video equipment in the space; an address code chip and a fire-fighting device control circuit are connected at two ends of the smog sensor in parallel, and a video collector is controlled; the video collector synchronously emits and transmits video images and video information to a command centre and a piece of communication terminal equipment, the video collector synchronously transmits the video images and the video information to guarantee the accuracy, timeliness, high efficiency and security of fire fighting; and the device can be applied to industrial, standardized, serial and universal production and installation, and the device and the method belong to the field of communication and fire-fighting control.
assignees: TIANJIN PUBLIC SECURITY & FIRE BUREAU;HAO LI;TIANJIN BINHAI INSTITUTE MANAGEMENT SCIENCE

title_en: Alert rapid disposal method based on LBS technologies
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of alert rapid disposal method based on LBS technologies, existing GIS-Geographic Information System and 110 are connect to deal with emergencies and dangerous situations combine to form new local police station and connect terminal of dealing with emergencies and dangerous situations, go on patrol people's police's hand-held mobile terminal in the street and dock upload location information with police LBS platforms；110 polices are single according to according to corresponding disposal authority and positional information, and 110 command centres receive a crime report 110 and single are sent to local police station's night shift room, police car of dealing with emergencies and dangerous situations in real time, in people's police's police service terminal；After terminal receives 110 alerts, prompted with sound and flash of light；People's police are clicked on by active realizes that alert receives, and enters alert disposal process, record in real time responding, show up, on-the-spot record, picture concerned of winding up the case, video and track record.
assignees: CHINA CHANGFENG SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY IND GROUP CORP

title_en: A kind of multi-channel transient surface wave exploration method under MODEL OVER COMPLEX TOPOGRAPHY
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multi-channel transient surface wave exploration method under MODEL OVER COMPLEX TOPOGRAPHY, the vertical component wave detector of 4.5Hz is respectively from many dominant frequency first, tail cone uses pointed cone formula；Then wave detector is arranged centered on the measuring point of design requirement, Combining with terrain condition is observed system arrangement；On-site data gathering is carried out after arrangement wave detector, is respectively excited twice at the two ends of geophone arrangement respectively, collect corresponding earthquake record, then fixed pickup arrangement, mobile shot point position, forms centered on test point, the measuring point of 4 times, i.e., one is excited to gather four groups of data altogether；According to the data for measuring, excited by both sides difference offset distance, and comprehensive analysis is carried out by being composed to frequency dispersion, can be with chain of command wave number according to this and inversion result quality；Opposite ripple record carries out frequency dispersion calculating, dispersion curve extraction, genetic inverse, determines the surface wave speed structure on stratum.

title_en: A kind of management system of environmental sanitation control centre
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of management system of environmental sanitation control centre, including service platform, console, the first locating module, the second locating module, the 3rd locating module, wireless network module, video surveillance module, environment protection digital module, warning module；Service platform, is located at control centre, is responsible for receiving the information that each console sends in dispatcher-controlled territory；Console, sets up separately in dispatcher-controlled territory, is responsible for the environmental sanitation information in real-time reception monitoring range；First locating module is responsible for being sent to console in real time the positional information of environmental sanitation personnel；Second locating module is responsible for being sent to console in real time the positional information of each dustbin；3rd locating module is responsible for being sent to console in real time the transporting position information of each sanitation cart；Video surveillance module, is responsible for the video record of environmental sanitation work in each console；Environment protection digital module, is responsible for the storage of the information that console is received；Warning module, is responsible for the early warning of dustbin and environmental sanitation vehicles in each console region.
assignees: HEFEI RUISADE ENV TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic signal coincidence monitoring and warning system
abstract_en: A Data Acquisition and Recording System (DARS) for mobile assets includes a data recorder and an automatic signal monitoring and alarm system. The data recorder includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queuing store. The DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores compressed records of the data in a local memory module at least once per second. DARS is designed to operate in near real-time mode, storing a complete record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once every second and up to once every tenth of a second. The remotely located user may: viewing video, audio and data acquired by the DARS through a web browser, which provides faster emergency response; verifying the effectiveness of repair and re-routing and monitoring crew performance and safety; and receiving signal coincidence and signal violation in real time.

title_en: Nuclear emergency response method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: According to the nuclear emergency response method, the nuclear emergency response system and the storage medium, the emergency state is received, a plurality of emergency tasks corresponding to the emergency state are obtained from the database based on the emergency state, each emergency task comprises a corresponding emergency post, the emergency tasks are issued to the corresponding emergency posts according to the emergency posts in each emergency task, task results corresponding to each emergency task are obtained, and an emergency response report corresponding to the emergency state is generated according to each task result. After receiving the emergency state, the emergency response system can automatically issue all emergency tasks corresponding to the emergency state, and can record all information related to the emergency tasks, so that support data can be provided for task investigation and analysis in the following process, and the execution effect of emergency response actions is improved.
assignees: HUANENG NUCLEAR ENERGY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Overhead cable multi-agent cooperative anti-icing coating control method and robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric robots. The invention provides an overhead cable multi-agent cooperative anti-icing coating control method and a robot, wherein a lower coating component cannot be separated from an overhead cable or cannot be moved to a set off-line position although separated from the overhead cable, and is judged to be in an emergency off-line state. The invention solves the problem that the anti-icing coating device lacks emergency off-line structural support, improves the pertinence and timeliness of emergency response, and avoids the risk that the device is detained in cables due to delay of off-line operation caused by incapability of judging an emergency state.
assignees: STATE GRID INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power analysis recorder for electric safety check
title_ko: 전기안점점검용 전력분석기록계
abstract_en: An electric power analysis recorder is provided to enable a user to remotely monitor a voltage, current, leakage current, and power factor of a power distribution box by using a wireless device, which communicates with a main device. An electric power analysis recorder includes a current transformer, a main device(10), and an auxiliary device(30). The current transformer is installed on a main circuit breaker(2) of a power distribution box(1). The main device is connected to an electrical line at an output terminal of a ZCT(Zero Phase Sequence Current Transformer). The electrical line(3) is arranged to pass through a line passing hole. The auxiliary device is installed on a wall outlet, such that the auxiliary device wirelessly communicates with the main device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재예방, 전기사고예방, 전기사고분석을 위한 전기안전점검용 전력분석기록계에 관한 것으로서, 분전반의 메인차단기에 설치된 변류기와 영상변류기의 출력단측  전선을 메인장치에 접속하거나 메인장치의 전선통과구멍으로 통과하도록 배선하고, 상기 메인장치와 무선으로 교신할 수 있는 보조 장치를 사용자가 위치한 곳의 벽 콘센트에 꽂으면 일일이 메인장치까지 가지 않고도 어디서나 쉽게 분전반의 전압, 전류, 누설전류, 접촉불량, 역률 등을 표시장치에 의해 용이하게 파악할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 사용자가 분전반(1)까지 일부러 가서 상태를 파악하지 않아도 현재 일하고 있는 장소의 벽 콘센트에 간단히 보조 장치(30)만 꽂으면 분전반의 전압 및 전류 등의 측정이 가능한 것인바, 분전반(1)으로부터의 전선이 메인장치(10)의 전선통과구멍(11)을 통과하도록 배선한 상태에서 이러한 메인장치(10)와 무선으로 통할 수 있는 보조 장치(30)를 임의의 장소에 설치하고, 메인장치(10)로부터 무선으로 송출되는 신호를 보조 장치(30)의 RF수신부(35)에서 수신하며, 메인장치(10)의 각종 입력장치(29)를 통하여 입력되는 전압, 전류, 누설전류, 역률, 역상 등의 상태를 보조 장치(30)의 표시부(32)를 통해 용이하게 파악할 수 있음은 물론 알람부저(34) 등을 통해 경고해 줄 수 있는 것이다. 
       
     전력, 기록, 무선, 표시, 엘이디, 통신포트, 조작버튼, 누설

title_en: Construction site safety diaster predicting method and system based on artificial intelligence
title_ko: 인공지능을 기반으로 한 건설 현장 안전 재해 예측 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a construction site safety disaster predicting system can train an artificial intelligence model by using data including site information, permits to work, non-conformance reports, safety inspection comment information, record process rates, accident investigation reposts, and near-miss reports to predict disaster breakout probabilities for each construction site, date, and disaster type by using the artificial intelligence to have the advantage of quickly and accurately predicting disaster outbreak probabilities to prevent disasters. The construction site safety disaster predicting system can also select risk elements which can affect disaster outbreaks and provide pre-inspection checklists for the risk elements to effectively prevent disaster outbreaks. The construction site safety disaster predicting system can also provide past similar disaster information on the risk elements to improve recognition rates of disaster outbreaks.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 건설 현장 안전 재해 예측 시스템은, 현장 정보, 작업 허가서, 부적합 보고서, 안전점검 지적 정보, 실적 공정률, 사고 조사 보고서 및 아차사고 보고서를 포함하는 데이터를 이용하여 인공지능 모델을 학습시켜, 상기 인공지능 모델을 이용하여 건설 현장별, 일자별, 재해 유형별 재해 발생 확률을 미리 예측할 수 있으므로, 보다 신속하고 정확하게 재해 발생 확률을 예측하여, 재해 발생을 예방할 수 있는 이점이 있다. 또한, 재해 발생에 영향을 줄 수 있는 위험 요소를 미리 선정하고, 상기 위험 요소에 대한 사전 점검 체크 리스트를 제공함으로써, 재해 발생을 보다 효과적으로 방지할 수 있다. 또한, 상기 위험 요소에 대한 과거 유사 재해 정보를 제공함으로써, 재해 발생에 대한 인식율을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Automated signal compliance monitoring and alerting system
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) for mobile assets that includes a data recorder and an automated signal monitoring and alerting system. The data recorder includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queueing repository. DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data acquired by DARS through a web browser, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety, and receive signal compliance and signal violations in real-time.

title_en: Intelligent accident lifesaving system and method thereof
title_ko: 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an intelligent accident lifesaving system, a method thereof, and a computer-readable recording medium for recording a program for realizing the same method thereof. In the establishment of the intelligent accident lifesaving system, the intelligent accident lifesaving system, the method thereof, and the computer-readable recording medium for recording the program for realizing the same method thereof can provide a stable and reliable system to users by establishing a system capable of transmitting vehicle accident data from a terminal installed in a vehicle to a control center to rapidly process a vehicle accident and administering first aid through the direct communication between the control center and the driver of the accident vehicle, and can minimize an operating cost by operating the control center in an unmanned manner. The intelligent accident lifesaving system of the present invention comprises: a communication server which receives accident information from an intelligent terminal of an accident transmission unit and receives a report of an accident through communication with the intelligent terminal; a DB for storing membership information and receiving and storing information related to the accident from the communication server; a map server for generating map data and address data corresponding to a location of the accident and transferring the map data and the address data; and a control server for displaying the accident information of the communication server according to the map data, the address data and processing the report of the accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템을 구축함에 있어, 차량 사고 시 신속한 대응을 위하여 차량에 장착된 단말기에서 차량사고 데이터를 관제 센터에 전송하고 관제 센터에서 사고차량의 운전자와 직접 교신을 통해 응급구조를 할 수 있는 시스템을 구축하여 사용자들에게 안정적이고 신뢰성 있는 시스템을 제공하고 관제 센터를 무인으로 운영하여 운영비용을 최소화할 수 있는, 지능형 차량사고 인명구조 시스템 및 그 방법과 상기 방법을 실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체를 제공하고자 한다. 이를 위하여, 본 발명은 지능형 인명구조 시스템에 있어서, 사고 발생 장치의 지능형 단말기로부터 사고 정보를 수신하여 관제 서버로 전달하고, 상기 지능형 단말기와 통화 연결을 하여 무인으로 사고를 접수하기 위한 통신 서버; 회원 정보를 저장하고 있으며, 상기 통신 서버로부터 사고 관련 정보를 전달받아 저장하기 위한 DB 서버; 사고 발생 위치에 상응하는 지도 화면 데이터와 지번 데이터를 생성하여 상기 관제 서버로 전달하기 위한 맵(MAP) 서버; 및 상기 통신 서버로부터의 사고 정보를 상기 맵(MAP) 서버로부터의 지도 화면 데이터와 지번 데이터에 따라 표시하고, 사고 접수를 처리하기 위한 상기 관제 서버를 포함한다.
assignees: UDTECH CO LTD;LEE WOO YOEL;IN YU JIN;JUNG JONG HA

title_en: Distribution network failure training evaluation method based on Fault Isolation Information Matrix
abstract_en: The distribution network failure training evaluation method based on Fault Isolation Information Matrix that the invention discloses a kind of, this method comprises: establishing Fault Isolation critical field collection FISR and Fault Isolation actual range collection FIPR to describe all switches for including in standard operation and practical operation isolation range after single failure, disconnecting link information.Fault Isolation standard information battle array FISI and Fault Isolation actual information battle array FIPI are established with Fault Isolation range set associated by xegregating unit number contained by responsible consumer number contained by the movement number of devices of all Fault Isolations after record standard operation and practical operation, area of isolation, area of isolation, failure.A kind of Fault Isolation evaluation method based on fault message battle array is given by the comparison operation of standard failure Information Matrix FISI and physical fault Information Matrix FIPI.The evaluation method can preferably reflect the operating process of dispatcher's Fault Isolation, have preferable practical training evaluative meaning.

title_en: Accident trend identification method based on time sequence analysis
abstract_en: The application provides an accident trend identification method based on time sequence analysis, which comprises the following steps: denoising historical safety accident data on a production line, extracting a time point, and eliminating interference of sporadic interference factors on accident analysis; according to the periodicity law obtained by the frequency domain analysis, carrying out seasonal trend analysis on the historical security accident record through a seasonal autoregressive integral moving average model; characteristic learning is carried out by utilizing a random forest algorithm according to seasonal trends, and accident evolution characteristics are identified and extracted from nonlinear and non-stationary time sequences; identifying and quantifying the sensitivity and vulnerability difference of dual links on the production line in the event of an accident, and predicting the reactions of different production line links in the event of the accident; and predicting the reactions of different production line links in the event of an accident, simulating an emergency response strategy, and adjusting the emergency response strategy of the production line.

title_en: System for Tracing Super-Proximity Accident Vehicle, Location Tracing Server and Program Recording Medium
title_ko: 초근접 사고차량 위치추적 시스템과 위치추적 서버 및 이를위한 기록매체
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 초근접 사고차량 위치추적 시스템과 위치추적 서버 및 이를 위한 기록매체에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 위치추적 서버는, 소정의 통신망을 통해 상기 적어도 3개 이상의 기지국으로부터 소정의 차량에 구비된 위치추적 단말로부터 송출되는 소정의 RCM 데이터(또는 ECM 데이터)를 수신하는 정보 수신부와, 상기 RCM 데이터(또는 ECM 데이터)를 통해 상기 차량의 위치를 산출하는 위치 산출부와, 상기 RCM 데이터(또는 ECM 데이터)를 판독하여 상기 차량에 사고가 발생했는지 확인하는 사고발생 확인부와, 소정의 보험사에 구비된 보험사 서버, 또는 경찰서(또는 소방서)에 구비된 긴급구조 서버로부터 상기 사고차량으로 접근하는 위치추적 단말을 구비한 긴급구조 차량 정보를 수신하는 긴급구조 정보 수신부와, 상기 사고차량의 위치정보와 소정의 위치추적 단말을 구비한 긴급구조 차량의 위치정보를 확인하여 상기 긴급구조 차량이 상기 사고차량의 호밍신호 도달범위에 도달하는지 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 긴급구조 차량이 상기 호밍신호 도달범위에 도달시, 상기 기지국으로 상기 사고차량에 구비된 위치추적 단말로 소정의 호밍신호 송출 명령을 전송하는 정보 전송부를 포함한다.
