title_en: 3G remote emergency command system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of 3G communication, and provides a 3G remote emergency command system, which comprises a 3G intelligent recorder, an IDC machine room unit, a headquarter monitoring center unit, a mobile monitoring center unit and a WEB monitoring center unit. The 3G remote emergency command system can make whole-course tracking and record of the law enforcement process of front-end policemen, and transmits the environment and practical situation of a law enforcement site to an emergency command center in time via a video-audio mode, so that the command center can give correct and effective commands to the policemen, and law enforcement efficiency is improved.
assignees: WUHAN HUAAN SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting and accident emergency rescue system of separation explosion-proof skid-mounted filling station
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire control of explosion-proof sled dress formula filling station of separation, emergent rescue system of accident, including information processing module and with information processing module signal connection's man-machine interaction device, fire incident monitoring module, be provided with information collection module at information processing module's input port, information collection module signal connection fire incident monitoring module. The utility model discloses a filling station monitored control system has realized going into and out the vehicle condition, the equipment operation condition and the filling station working condition to the filling station and has carried out real-time supervision and record, fast, conveniently masters the real-time situation of each site, has improved management quality and benefit, has ensured each filling station safe operation; the system integrates video monitoring, oil tank liquid level and temperature, oil leakage of the oil tank and an oiling machine, combustible gas concentration monitoring and early warning and network communication, realizes accident early warning and multimedia linkage warning, prevents serious and serious accidents of the oiling station, and better guarantees life and property safety of people.
assignees: YUNNAN XINNENG OIL PRODUCTS DEV CO LTD

title_en: Headset computer with handsfree emergency response
abstract_en: Operating conditions for a headset computer are used to detect a situation where an emergency response mode should be activated. In emergency response mode, the headset computer may then broadcast location, live (real time) audio and video/data streams, and record other information concerning a possible theft and/or other situation of interest to law enforcement and/or security services.

title_en: Simulation method and system for demand response type dispatching applied to intelligent public transport system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent transportation, and discloses a simulation method and a system for demand response scheduling applied to an intelligent public transportation system: the bus dispatching simulation system comprises a dispatching management platform and a dispatching simulation platform, wherein the dispatching management platform records real-time passenger flow data, historical passenger flow data and vehicle operation data, runs an intelligent bus demand response dispatching algorithm and outputs a bus plan, the dispatching simulation platform is a simulation environment of the intelligent bus demand response dispatching algorithm, the bus station system counts station passenger flow data and passenger waiting time of a bus station, the bus station system counts bus departure interval data and bus departure times, and the bus mobile terminal service system collects a car pooling order and a package order of passengers. The invention solves the problem of lack of simulation schemes aiming at intelligent bus demand responsive dispatching functions.

title_en: Unmanned system for autonomous navigation and positioning in complex mining area environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses an autonomous navigation and positioning unmanned system in a complex mining area environment, which comprises an environment sensing system, a sensing processing system, a local map system, a known map system, an operating state sensing system, a path planning system, a real-time control system and a data command recording system, wherein the environment sensing system is used for sensing the real-time environment state of the periphery of a running vehicle of the mining area; the perception processing system is used for processing and recording the perceived real-time environment. The unmanned system for autonomous navigation and positioning in the complex environment of the mining area can not only solve the production connection problem caused by artificial factors in production, but also realize uninterrupted mining for twenty-four hours, so that the production efficiency of the mine can be obviously improved, meanwhile, the casualties caused by safety production accidents can be greatly reduced, the safety production of enterprises is ensured, the occupational hazard of miners is reduced, and the safety of mine production is greatly improved.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA ZHISHENGDA ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent evaluation method and system for fire risk of power distribution network equipment based on RBI technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire risk intelligent evaluation method and a fire risk intelligent evaluation system for power distribution network equipment based on RBI technology, which belong to the technical field of power equipment evaluation and comprise the steps of arranging sensors in the power distribution network equipment and an operation environment thereof to acquire original data; the method comprises the steps of collecting original data, carrying out digital preprocessing on the collected original data, eliminating noise and abnormal values, outputting processed data, extracting temperature rise values, load change values and voltage fluctuation values from the processed data, combining equipment types and historical fault records to generate three-dimensional health state vectors reflecting equipment running states, ageing degrees and potential fault trends, and generating emergency response strategies including load adjustment, load isolation and temperature monitoring according to an input risk assessment model by the health state vectors. The risk assessment model can reflect the current running state and potential risk of the equipment more accurately by considering the change rate of the equipment state and the deviation condition of the phase space position.

title_en: Satellite communication-based companion guarantee management coordination method and system for all-network public network base station
abstract_en: The invention discloses a satellite communication-based accompanying security management coordination method and system for a full-network public network base station, which are applied to the field of emergency communication security and realize acquisition, processing, storage and interaction of relevant data of a satellite station, a base station and user service. The full life cycle management of the accompanying security tasks, effective transmission and execution tracking of the instructions, statistical analysis of security effect data and coordination of the ground station position scheduling and security tasks are respectively realized through the accompanying security task management module, the instruction processing module, the feedback statistics module and the ground station position scheduling management module. The invention solves the problems of low efficiency, insufficient timeliness and accuracy of data statistics of emergency communication guarantee command scheduling in the prior art through online operation, can efficiently conduct command scheduling with accompanying guarantee, automatically count guarantee effect data of the accompanying guarantee points in real time, optimize management collaborative flow and promote emergency communication guarantee capability and efficiency.

title_en: Data acquisition method, system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data acquisition method, a system and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of data acquisition and processing, and the technical scheme is that multi-source data are acquired in real time by integrating various sensor devices and data interfaces, format standardization processing, time synchronization correction and space information alignment are performed by utilizing a multi-mode fusion module, and a data consistency factor Tyhz is calculated and acquired and evaluated; when the data consistency factor Tyhz does not reach the standard, the data optimization module performs noise filtering and outlier rejection on the multi-source data set, the intelligent analysis module calculates risk prediction parameters Fcyz by using a convolutional neural network, the early warning evaluation module compares Fcyz with a risk evaluation threshold Fth, calculates a risk early warning index Gyzs, and dynamically generates an early warning execution scheme by comparing with a risk early warning threshold E, so that information pushing and emergency resource scheduling are realized, the problems of low multi-source data fusion efficiency and insufficient early warning precision are solved, and the risk identification and emergency response capability of the urban emergency management system is effectively improved.
assignees: DAZONG ONLINE SERVICE NANTONG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode knowledge graph-based park multistage intelligent reasoning early warning system
abstract_en: Aiming at the problems of data island, high false alarm rate, response lag and the like of the traditional park early warning system, the invention provides an intelligent early warning system integrating the perceived data of the Internet of things and the domain knowledge graph, which is suitable for park safety prevention and control in the industries of chemical industry, logistics, manufacturing and the like. The knowledge graph is an ideal tool for modeling the connection between objective objects in the real world, and the problem of data island can be effectively solved by constructing the knowledge graph and the fusion intelligent reasoning algorithm for the intelligent park safety management field, and the accuracy and timeliness of park risk early warning are obviously improved. Specifically, the invention designs a whole set of early warning system from bottom to top in three aspects of multi-mode knowledge graph modeling, three-level early warning reasoning engine and self-adaptive optimization mechanism, and establishes the park early warning requirement which meets the current intelligentization and saves the labor cost. The multi-modal knowledge graph relates to six types of ontology concepts, and comprises different data types, including equipment topological relation, environment parameter association, emergency plan, risk analysis, attack behavior simulation and asset attribute model. The three-level early warning reasoning comprises rule reasoning, sub-graph matching reasoning and link prediction reasoning. The self-adaptive optimization technology aims at constructing a feedback learning mechanism, taking the treatment result of each early warning into a knowledge graph, and continuously optimizing the object relation weight. In early warning simulation experiments, the scheme of the invention realizes the effect that the false alarm rate is reduced by 42% and the emergency response speed is improved by 60%, thereby proving the feasibility and effectiveness of the scheme.
assignees: INNOVATION DRIVE SHAANXI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Recycling system, recycling method and control program
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a recycling system that can promote resource recycling.  <P>SOLUTION: The recycling system connects a terminal 30 that instructs printing, an image forming apparatus 40 for printing on a printing medium 50, a disposal apparatus 60 for disposing of the printing medium 50, and a recycling information management server 20. The recycling information management server 20 stores recycling definition information, generates recycling information according to the recycling definition information, and issues an ID associated with the recycling information. The terminal 30 generates a print command with the ID added thereto. The image forming apparatus 40 acquires the recycling information with the ID, generates a recycling tag 51 to read the recycling information and records it on the printing medium 50. The disposal apparatus 60 reads the recycling information from the recycling tag 51, disposes of the printing medium 50 according to the recycling information, and sends the result to the recycling information management server 20.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Accident data recording device for vehicle
title_ko: 차량용 사고기록 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An accident data recording system for a vehicle is provided to rapidly and accurately analyze the cause of an accident by storing risk factor information. CONSTITUTION: An accident data recording system for a vehicle comprises an accident recording device(100), a control server(200), and an accident analysis server(300). The accident recording device is installed inside a vehicle. The control server receives images, an accident position, and vehicle information from the accident recording device and analyzes the accident. The accident analysis server analyses the cause of the accident based on the received accident information and stores the analyzed result.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량 사고 기록 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사고 당시의 차량 내부 또는 외부의 영상을 촬영하는 카메라, 차량의 충돌 여부를 감지하는 가속도 센서, 차량의 현재 위치를 검출하는 GPS 모듈, 차량의 작동정보를 산출하는 전자제어유닛, 상기 전자제어유닛으로부터 입력된 차량의 작동정보를 연산 및 변환처리하여 출력하는 내부 게이트웨이 모듈, 촬영된 영상 정보, 차량 충돌 감지정보, 사고 당시의 차량의 위치정보, 상기 내부 게이트웨이 모듈을 통해 수신된 차량의 작동정보를 연관시켜 기록하는 사고 기록부 및 상기 사고 기록부에 기록된 차량의 사고 정보를 통신망을 통해 외부로 송출하는 외부 게이트웨이 모듈을 포함하는 것으로서 차량 내부에 설치되는 차량 사고 기록장치, 상기 차량 사고 기록장치로부터 사고 당시의 컷영상, 사고위치 및 차량 작동정보를 수신하고, 이에 기초하여 사고 상황을 분석하고 긴급 상황 발생시 긴급처리를 수행하는 관제 서버 및 상기 차량 사고 기록장치로부터 수신된 차량의 사고 정보에 기초하여 사고 원인을 분석하고 사고 분석 결과를 영상 데이터 형태로 저장하는 사고 분석 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 사고 당시의 운전자 조작 정보 제공, 사고 영상 분석을 통한 신속한 긴급 출동, 촬영 영상에서의 단서 정보 인식 기능 제공, 사고의 정밀한 재구성을 통한 사고 사례의 데이터베이스화 및 이를 통한 사고 원인의 신속 정확한 분석이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Coding robot apparatus for operating based on code recognition according to control target information and control content information
title_ko: 제어 대상 정보 및 제어 내용 정보에 따른 코드 인식을 기반으로 동작하는 코딩 로봇 장치
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, a coding robot apparatus performing an IoT function includes: a control module generating and outputting a control signal corresponding to a control command and including control target information and control content information by using a program coded by a user when the control command is inputted; a robot control board allowing the control module to be attached thereto or detached therefrom, including a plurality of control targets, and outputting the control signal to a control target indicated by the control target information among the plurality of control targets when the control signal is inputted from the control module; a robot frame including a mainframe and a plurality of sub frames corresponding to robot parts, respectively; and a robot skin attached to or detached from the robot frame to constitute a robot shape. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing an IoT service to a user and creating a design effect for a coding robot apparatus.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 IoT 기능을 수행하는 코딩 로봇 장치는 제어 명령이 입력되면 사용자로부터 코딩된 프로그램을 이용하여 상기 제어 명령에 대응되고 제어 대상 정보 및 제어 내용 정보를 포함하는 제어 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 제어 모듈; 상기 제어 모듈이 탈부착되고, 복수의 제어 대상을 포함하며, 상기 제어 모듈로부터 상기 제어 신호가 입력되면 상기 복수의 제어 대상 중에서 상기 제어 대상 정보가 나타내는 제어 대상으로 상기 제어 신호를 출력하는 로봇 제어 보드; 로봇 부위 각각에 대응되는 메인 프레임과 복수의 서브 프레임을 포함하는 로봇 프레임; 및 상기 로봇 프레임에 탈부착되어 로봇 형상을 구성하는 로봇 스킨;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Mobile device and method for assisting driving training, electronic device, storage medium and computer program
title_ko: 운전 트레이닝을 보조하기 위한 모바일기기, 방법, 전자기기 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present application provides a mobile device, method, electronic device, storage medium, and computer program for assisting driving training and relates to the technical field of a computer, in particular, to the technical field of mobility control. The mobile device comprises: a communication module for acquiring training situations of a plurality of teaching vehicles from a server; a display module for displaying the training situations of the teaching vehicles; and a control module for generating a control command for driving training on the basis of an instruction of a training instructor in a training site. The communication module is also used for sending the control command to a vehicle terminal of the corresponding teaching vehicle. The technical proposal of the present application can be applied to the training site and realize mobile driving training to improve the driving training effect by controlling the vehicle terminal based on a mobile device.
abstract_ko: 본 출원은 운전 트레이닝을 보조하기 위한 모바일기기, 방법, 전자기기, 저장매체 및 컴퓨터 프로그램을 제공하고, 컴퓨터 기술분야에 관한 것이며, 특히는 모바일 제어 기술분야에 관한 것이다. 해당 모바일기기는 서버로부터 복수의 수업차량의 훈련상황을 취득하기 위한 통신모듈; 상기 복수의 수업차량의 훈련상황을 디스플레이하기 위한 디스플레이모듈; 훈련현장내의 코치의 지시에 따라 운전 트레이닝을 위한 제어명령을 생성하기 위한 제어모듈;을 포함하되, 상기 통신모듈은 상기 제어명령을 대응되는 수업차량의 차량용 단말에 발송하기 위한 것으로도 사용된다. 본 출원의 기술안은 훈련현장에 적용될 수 있고, 모바일기기에 기반하여 차량용 단말을 제어함으로써, 이동식 운전 트레이닝을 실현하였고, 운전 트레이닝의 효과를 향상시켰다.
assignees: APOLLO INTELLIGENT DRIVING TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Service providing apparatus and method for preventing safety accident at construction site, service providing system including the same and non-transitory computer readable medium having computer program recorded thereon
title_ko: 건설 현장의 안전 사고 방지를 위한 서비스 제공 장치 및 방법, 그리고 이를 포함하는 서비스 제공 시스템 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 비휘발성 기록매체
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to more accurately determine whether there is an abnormality in a tower crane by comprehensively considering detection information received from a plurality of sensors and abnormality judgment based on the experience of an operator operating the tower crane by installing a plurality of sensors on the tower crane. The present invention includes: a tower crane management unit; a concrete structure management unit; and an alarm providing unit that generates alarm information based on the first judgment result information or the second judgment result information when an abnormality occurs and transmits it to one or more preset notification board devices, respectively. The present invention has the effect of more accurately determining whether there is an abnormality in a tower crane by comprehensively considering detection information received from the plurality of sensors and abnormality judgment based on the experience of an operator operating the tower crane by installing a plurality of sensors on the tower crane.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건설 현장의 안전 사고 방지를 위한 서비스 제공 장치 및 방법, 그리고 이를 포함하는 서비스 제공 시스템 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 비휘발성 기록매체에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히는 건설 현장에 배치된 타워 크레인의 이상 여부 감지를 위한 복수의 센서별 감지 정보와 상기 타워 크레인에 탑승한 운전자의 이상 감지에 따른 이벤트 정보를 학습하여 학습 기반으로 타워 크레인의 이상 발생 여부를 판단함과 아울러 콘크리트 구조물에 온도 센서부 및 압전 센서부를 매립하고, 해당 온도 센서부 및 압전 센서부로부터 수신된 센싱 정보를 기초로 양생 중인 콘크리트 구조물의 이상 여부를 검출할 수 있도록 하여 이상이 발생한 타워 크레인이나 비정상적인 양생 상황이 발생한 콘크리트 구조물에 의한 안전 사고를 방지하는 건설 현장의 안전 사고 방지를 위한 서비스 제공 장치 및 방법, 그리고 이를 포함하는 서비스 제공 시스템 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 비휘발성 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 타워 크레인이나 콘크리트 구조물에서 이상 발생시 사고 발생 이전에 이상 발생을 정확하게 검출한 후 건설 현장에 배치된 하나 이상의 알림판 장치를 통해 이상 발생에 대한 알람을 제공하여 건설 현장에서 근무하는 근무자들을 안전하게 대피시킬 수 있어, 타워 크레인과 콘크리트 구조물의 이상 발생에 의한 안전 사고를 사전에 방지하여 건설 현장의 안전을 지원하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Emergency response system with dynamic ali database alphanumeric character hacking
abstract_en: An improved emergency response method and system are shown and described. A content-specified text field-such as a caller name field-- an ALI database record for a communication device is updated to include information about a person experiencing an emergency and the emergency. A PSAP receiving an emergency services call from the communication device receives the caller name field on a terminal display and is thus informed about the emergency via a alphanumeric character communication rather than orally. A particular emergency may be assigned a code that is put in the caller name field. A PSAP operator receiving the emergency services call may then enter the code into an emergency services web interface to retrieve information about the emergency including service provider credentials, the person’s medical condition, the person’s medical records, real time physiologic data, treatment facility names, treatment facility types, a location of the emergency, a level of care, a videoconference web link, on-site personnel names, disaster information, and hazard information. The code can be transmitted to first responders and downstream medical professionals to enhance their ability to deliver emergency services. The system and method provide a means for legacy PSAPs to receive the benefits of Next Generation 911 systems without the infrastructure changes that would otherwise be required.

title_en: Emergency broadcast intelligent triggering system based on multi-source seismic data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency broadcast intelligent triggering system based on multi-source seismic data fusion, which relates to the technical field of seismic monitoring and early warning, and comprises a data receiving module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data receiving module is used for receiving multi-source seismic early warning information in real time, including seismic source parameter data, strong vibration observation data and real-time early warning parameters, and outputting standardized multi-source seismic data through a built-in communication protocol; the localization calculation module is used for analyzing the standardized multi-source seismic data in real time, extracting the P-wave initial parameters, the earthquake motion acceleration predicted value and the earthquake source rupture characteristics, dynamically calibrating the analysis result by combining the actual measurement data of the built-in intensity meter, and outputting the multi-dimensional seismic data stream verified by the intensity meter. According to the method, through multi-source seismic data fusion, real-time analysis and calibration, dynamic risk modeling and intelligent broadcast scheduling, generation and efficient propagation of seismic early warning information are realized, timeliness and pertinence of emergency response are improved, and the risk of earthquake disasters is reduced.

title_en: Danger signal semantic auto- transmission system and transmission method
title_ko: 위험신호 시멘틱 자동송신시스템 및 송신방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A semantic/automatic danger signal transmission system and a transmission method thereof are provided to use a keyword for detecting a dangerous situation, thereby automatically transmitting a danger signal to a family or a national organization. CONSTITUTION: A smart phone(20) stores voice information of a caller in a deactivated state by collecting caller location information through an application program. The smart phone includes a voice modulation function which modulates the voice information into text information through the application program. The smart phone immediately modulates the voice information into the text information while receiving the voice information. The text information is compared with crime information stored in a crime information database(21). The smart phone transmits the voice information, smart phone information, caller location information, and an emergency rescue request signal to a management server when the text information is related to a criminal act. The management server(10) receives the emergency rescue request signal and analyzes the voice information. The management server transmits the emergency rescue request signal to a national organization which is located near the caller when the criminal act is confirmed.

title_en: Mobilization command system using mobile devices mobile
title_ko: 휴대기기를 이용한 모바일출동 지령 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobilization command system using a portable device and, more particularly, to a mobilization command system which includes a sensor (110) which continuously senses a fire, a gas leakage, and the trespass of an outsider, an obtaining unit (100) which is composed of a main device (120) which receives a signal from the sensor (110), a decoder (210) which receives the signal of the obtaining unit and grasps the signal, and a control unit (200) which includes a control program to analyze the signal grasped by the decoder (210). [Reference numerals] (110) Detecting sensor; (120) Main device; (210) Decoder; (220) Control program; (300) Android; (AA,DD) Wired/wireless internet; (BB,CC) C2DM, GCM, TCP communication
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 휴대기기를 이용한 모바일 출동지령 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 외부인이 무단 침입하는 경우 및 가스유출, 화재가 발생되는 문제를 지속적으로 감지 할 수 있는 감지센서(110)와 상기 감지센서(110) 신호를 수신 받는 주장치(120)로 구성되는 획득부(100)와, 상기 획득부(100)의 신호를 수신 받아 파악하는 데코더(210)와 상기 데코더(210)에 의해 파악된 신호를 분석하는 관제프로그램(220)으로 구성되는 관제부(200)로 구성되어 상기 관제부(200)에서 전화 또는 무전을 이용하여 출동요원으로 정보를 전달하도록 구성되는 출동지령 시스템에 있어서, 상기 출동지령시스템은 상기 관제부(200)와 유선 또는 무선 인터넷 망을 통해 연결 구성되는 휴대기기(300)가 구성되되, 상기 휴대기기(300)에는 상기 관제부(200)의 관제프로그램(220)의 신호를 수신 받아 수신하는 지령프로그램(310)이 구성되고, 상기 관제부(200)의 관제프로그램(220)은 상기 휴대기기(300)에 설치된 안드로이드 O/S 또는 IOS O/S에 따라 자동적으로 신호를 실시간으로 전송하되, 상기 안드로이드 O/S일 경우 C2DM, GCM 방식으로 전송되며 상기 관제부(200)의 설정에 따라 TCP/IP 기반 소켓통신 방식으로 상기 획득부(100)에서 발생된 신호를 전송하고, 상기 IOS O/S일 경우 Local Notification, TCP/IP 기반 소켓통신 방식으로 전송하도록 구성되어, 휴대기기(300)를 통해 발생되는 상황을 실시간으로 전송되기 때문에 현장에서 대처가 즉각적으로 이뤄질 수 있으며 현재 사용되고 있는 휴대기기만 구비하고 있으면 쉽게 운영이 가능할 수 있는 유용한 발명인 것이다.

title_en: Method and system for controlling program for domestic vessel international safety management
title_ko: 내항 선박 안전 관리를 위한 프로그램 제어 방법 및 프로그램 제어 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a program control method and a program control system for international safety management (ISM). According to an embodiment of the present invention, the program control method includes: a step of analyzing a command within fixed rules regarding a cloud-based program, which is operated by a crewman terminal of a vessel or a company terminal of a vessel company on land when receiving a document generation request from the program; a step of determining a main item provided to the crewman terminal or the company terminal in accordance with the analysis results; and a step of transforming a standard document into a customized document in accordance with the first and second options in the main item, which are set by the crewman terminal or the company terminal.
abstract_ko: 내항 선박 안전 관리(ISM: International Safety Management)를 위한 프로그램 제어 방법 및 프로그램 제어 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 내항 선박 안전 관리를 위한 프로그램 제어 방법은, 선박과 연관되는 선원 단말 또는 지상의 선박회사의 회사 단말에서 클라우드 기반으로 구동하는 프로그램으로부터, 문서 생성 요청이 발생하면, 상기 프로그램에 대한, 정해진 규칙 내에서의 명령을 분석하는 단계와, 상기 분석 결과에 따라, 선원 단말 또는 회사 단말에 제공하는 주항목을 결정하는 단계, 및 상기 주항목 중, 선원 단말 또는 회사 단말에 의해 설정된 제1 옵션 및 제2 옵션에 따라, 표준 문서를 변형하여 맞춤 문서로 생성하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for communication with emergency dispatch services
abstract_en: Emergency reporting is described in which user input is received in an emergency call that is used to classify the call. Based on the classification process, emergency calls are processed to give priority to certain calls. The calls that are given the highest priority may be transmitted by a voice network and other calls may be transmitted by a data network. The reporting includes receiving user input identifying an emergency perspective of the user and selecting a data call based on the emergency perspective indicating the user is a bystander. It also includes recording an audio message from the user and transmitting the audio message to a public service answering point (PSAP) over a data network.

title_en: Intelligent command system for emergency security protection of tunnel
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent command system for emergency security of a tunnel of a pit, which comprises a server, a display screen, an intelligent safety helmet, a camera, a broadcasting equipment terminal and an intelligent individual soldier; the server is arranged in the remote control room; the display screen is connected with the server; the intelligent safety helmet is provided with an audio-video recording module, a first positioning module and a first communication module, wherein the audio-video recording module and the first positioning module are respectively and electrically connected with the first communication module, and the first communication module is in communication connection with the server; the camera is arranged on the construction site, is used for collecting monitoring pictures of the construction site and sends the monitoring pictures to the server; the broadcasting equipment terminal is connected with the server and comprises a microphone and a sound column, wherein the microphone is arranged in the remote control room, and the sound column is arranged on a construction site; the intelligent command system for the emergency security protection of the tunnel of the pit can effectively improve the safety and the protection of construction operation, and avoid the delay of the processing of emergencies, so that the construction errors and even the personal casualties caused by the delay are avoided.

title_en: Railway emergency commanding system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway emergency commanding system, which comprises an emergency system, a recording and playing system and a visual central control system, wherein the emergency system comprises a monitoring early-warming module, an emergency commanding module, a rehabilitation module, a daily emergency management module, an information submission module, a plan management module, a case management module, a training and drilling module and the like; the visual central control system shows the monitoring of a system through a large screen; and a recording and playing system records the content shown by the large screen. In the invention, all emergency resources are organically combined together, and with related surrounding supporting equipment, the railway emergency commanding system which is complete and high-efficient, has complete functions and is simple to operate is formed.

title_en: System and method for conducting infrared monitoring on low-altitude flight targets in sensitive area
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and method for conducting infrared monitoring on low-altitude flight targets in a sensitive area. The system comprises a central station and a far-end station which are connected through an external network. The central station comprises an integrated data display terminal and an integrated monitoring terminal, wherein the integrated data display terminal and the integrated monitoring terminal are connected through an internal network. The far-end station comprises an infrared optoelectronic device, a hard disk video recorder, a data fusion terminal and a display control terminal, wherein the infrared optoelectronic device, the data fusion terminal and the display control terminal are connected through the internal network; the infrared optoelectronic device is also connected with the hard disk video recorder. The system and method have the advantages that remote command control can be achieved, and video data of the flight targets within the range of a whole flight service station can be observed in real time; the method is low in transmission delay and high in real-time performance; the clear and visualized video data of the flight targets can be provided; the far-end station and the central station are directly connected for data communication through the passthrough technology, and the video data are low in delay; visualized information of false targets and the search and rescue process in the sensitive area can be provided.

assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Management system for optimizing physical and chemical experiment operation examination
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of examination management systems, in particular to a management system for optimizing physical and chemical life experiment operation examination, which comprises a basic management module, an intelligent examination discharging module, an examination real-time video preview module and an on-site examination paper management module, wherein the basic management module, the intelligent examination discharging module, the examination real-time video preview module and the on-site examination paper management module are all connected based on examination point terminals. The management system for optimizing the physical and chemical experiment operation examination has the advantages of intelligent examination, high-definition recording and safe storage in the experimental process, supports multiple scoring modes such as centralized scoring, on-site scoring and AI scoring, realizes the whole-area unified command of the physical and chemical experiment examination, carries out whole-process hierarchical management and whole-domain real-time monitoring, ensures quick preparation before examination, whole-process management in examination and intelligent examination after examination, and improves the informationized management level of the physical and chemical experiment operation examination.
assignees: GUANGZHOU YIHUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent power grid online safety operation and maintenance management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent power grid online safety operation and maintenance management method and system, which relate to the technical field of computer platform load balancing. The intelligent power grid online safety operation and maintenance management method provided by the invention can be used for rapidly processing by a containerized threat isolation method, ensuring the safety and reliability of data by distributed storage, effectively preventing threat diffusion and realizing the protection of safety data. And the operation and maintenance management platform is used for carrying out event tracking and generating a safety evaluation report, so that autonomous and efficient emergency response and safety optimization are realized, and the safety protection capability of the power grid is comprehensively improved. The invention has better effects in the aspects of reliability, timeliness and safety.

title_en: Intelligent park service management system and method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent park service management system and method based on the Internet of things, and belongs to the technical field of service management. The system comprises a data acquisition module, a service management module, a job scheduling module and a data storage module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring a facility plan of a park and historical logs and state information of objects, the service management module divides the job areas on the facility plan, screens sample records for each job area according to the historical logs, maps job tracks in the sample records to the job areas, divides a converging area and calculates weight coefficients, the job scheduling module screens service records for each object, maps the job tracks of the service records into each job area again, analyzes intersection conditions of the job tracks and the converging area and calculates matching coefficients, selects matching objects for each job area according to the matching coefficients and generates job tasks for dispatch, and the data storage module is used for generating service records for each object and uploading the service records to the historical logs.

title_en: Flight control task hierarchical planning method and system based on software implementation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of flight control task planning, and particularly discloses a flight control task hierarchical planning method and system based on software implementation, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a month event set based on flight control task requirements proposed by multiple parties for a target flight control task, and dividing each month event in the month event set into at least one initial flight control event according to flight control task behavior logic; based on instruction constraint conditions among the flight control instructions, determining an initial flight control event of the flight control instruction to be adjusted, adjusting, and determining the flight control instruction corresponding to the adjusted initial flight control event and the flight control instruction corresponding to the initial flight control event without adjustment as a planning result of a target flight control task according to the flight control event level. According to the invention, through a layering planning mode of 'month event-flight control event-instruction', flight control implementation high-efficiency preparation, high reliability and high timeliness accurate planning and quick emergency response can be realized, and powerful support is provided for long-term reliable and safe operation of the spacecraft.

title_en: Scheduling automation operation and maintenance fault simulation training method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dispatching automation operation and maintenance fault simulation training method and system, which are applied to the technical field of dispatching automation operation and maintenance and comprise the steps of constructing a dispatching automation operation and maintenance fault feature library, combining fault simulation requirements, and designing and storing fault case data according to the triggering conditions of all faults in the fault feature library; and respectively analyzing, positioning and removing faults by a learner according to the corresponding parts of the fault case data, uploading the operation data of the learner, integrating the step matching score, the parameter configuration score and the file modification score, and finishing the final evaluation of the simulation training. The invention realizes the automatic reproduction of the fault scene of the automatic system and the intelligent scoring of the training records of the trainees, enriches the means of dispatching the automatic operation and maintenance fault simulation training and improves the training effect.
assignees: TECH COLLEGE BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORPORATION;Shandong electric power college;BEIJING KEDONG ELECTRIC POWER CONTROL SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Fire safety management supervision platform system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire safety management and discloses a fire safety management supervision platform system. The system comprises a building information acquisition module, a risk area division module, a historical data indexing module, a dynamic risk analysis module, a fire resource scheduling module and an emergency response decision module, wherein the building information acquisition module acquires building structure data and environment monitoring data of a target building in real time, the risk area division module divides a plurality of independent fire risk areas according to the building structure data and distributes area identifications, the historical data indexing module indexes a historical fire accident data set and a fire facility maintenance record set of each area according to the area identifications, the dynamic risk analysis module fuses the environment monitoring data and the historical fire accident data set to generate a real-time fire risk coefficient sequence, the fire resource scheduling module generates a fire resource allocation scheme based on the real-time fire risk coefficient sequence and the facility maintenance record set, and the emergency response decision module generates a multi-stage fire emergency response strategy according to the resource allocation scheme. The system improves timeliness and pertinence of fire safety management.
assignees: LIAONING DAYI ZHUHE SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle arrangement method determination system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To determine an arrangement method for arranging vehicles for lifeline associated operation or emergency dispatch operation to base stations by using arithmetic processing of a computer.SOLUTION: When a temporary arrangement pattern is determined, an optimal arrangement pattern determining section 10 selects a selective dispatch case from a plurality of arithmetic target dispatch cases registered in a dispatch record DB 12, determines a base station where an available vehicle exists in a dispatch request date and time and which is closest to a dispatch site as a dispatch base station, and derives a dispatch time based on registration information of a map DB 13 and a traffic information DB 14. Then, the dispatch base station and the dispatch time are determined for all arithmetic target dispatch cases while a selective dispatch case is changed, and an index value determined based on the dispatch time for each arithmetic target dispatch case is calculated. While the temporal arrangement pattern is changed, the index value is calculated for each vehicle arrangement pattern, and a vehicle arrangement pattern having the best index value is determined as an optimal arrangement pattern.

title_en: Vehicle with automatic notification function and server device
abstract_en: To provide a vehicle with automatic notification function and a server device that enable dispatched group to arrive at an accident site generated by the vehicle without excessive delay even if the current position of the accident site may be inaccurate.SOLUTION: In an automatic emergency notification system 1, a vehicle 10 includes: a transmission unit that transmits emergency information of the vehicle 10 to a server device 2 for requesting emergency dispatch when a collision is detected or estimated; a GNSS receiving unit; a recording unit that records a past position generated by the GNSS receiving unit; and a control unit that collects information from the vehicle 10 to transmit it as emergency information from the transmission unit, when a collision of the vehicle 10 is detected or estimated. If the current position cannot be acquired from the GNSS receiving unit when a collision of the vehicle 10 is detected or estimated, the control unit collects the past position recorded in the recording unit to transmit it to the server device 2 from the transmission unit.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Coding learning system
title_ko: 텐저블 블록 기반 증강현실 코딩 학습 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a play-type augmented reality (AR) coding learning system which grafts AR and tangible blocks including object blocks and command blocks to enable a low-age user, who has difficulty in learning program coding, to easily learn the program coding and be continuously concentrated from a programming subject of low difficulty to a programming subject of high difficulty. According to the present invention, the play-type AR coding learning system comprises: the tangible blocks including object blocks and command blocks; and a coding-learning terminal including a display, a recognition module recognizing the shape and arrangement of the tangible blocks, and a learning module using the shape and arrangement of the tangible blocks recognized through the recognition module to output a subject through the display to provide coding learning to a user. The subject enables the object block to perform an event by the command block, the event is determined in accordance with the shape of the command block, and output order of the events is determined in accordance with the arrangement of the command block.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 대상 블록과 명령 블록을 포함하는 텐저블 블록에 증강현실을 접목하여, 프로그램 코딩을 학습하기에 어려운 저 연령대의 사용자도 쉽게 코딩을 배울 수 있도록 하고, 나아가 낮은 난이도의 프로그래밍 과제로부터 높은 난이도의 프로그래밍 과제까지 지속적으로 집중 할 수 있도록 하는 놀이형 증강현실 코딩 학습 시스템에 관한 것으로,  
대상 블록과 명령 블록을 포함하는 텐저블 블록, 그리고 디스플레이, 상기 텐저블 블록의 형상 및 배치를 인식하는 인식모듈 및, 상기 인식모듈을 통해 인식된 상기 텐저블 블록의 형상 및 배치를 이용한 과제를 상기 디스플레이를 통해 출력하여 사용자에게 코딩 학습을 제공하는 학습모듈을 포함하는 코딩 교육용 단말기를 포함하되, 상기 과제는 상기 대상 블록이 상기 명령 블록에 의해 이벤트를 수행하는 것이고, 상기 이벤트는 상기 명령 블록의 형상에 따라 결정되고, 상기 이벤트의 출력 순서는 상기 명령 블록의 배치에 따라 결정되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.
assignees: TASER INT INC;SMITH PATRICK W;HANCHETT MARK A;KLOC AARON J;CONANT TYLER J

title_en: Marine accident monitoring system and method for preventing marine passenger accident, and computer program therefor
title_ko: 해상 여객 사고 방지를 위한 해양사고 모니터링 시스템과 방법 및 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: This marine accident monitoring system may comprise: a reception module configured to receive image information of a space including a ship; an evaluation module configured to store a machine learning-based detection model and apply the image information to the detection model, so as to calculate a risk level related to one or more areas partitioning the space corresponding to the image information or passengers in the space; and an output module configured to generate dashboard content by matching the risk level calculated by the evaluation module to the space, and display the dashboard content through a user interface on the marine accident monitoring system or a terminal device communicatively connected to the marine accident monitoring system.
abstract_ko: 해양사고 모니터링 시스템으로서, 선박을 포함하는 공간의 영상 정보를 수신하도록 구성된 수신 모듈; 머신러닝(machine learning) 기반의 탐지 모델을 저장하며, 상기 영상 정보를 상기 탐지 모델에 적용함으로써 상기 영상 정보에 상응하는 상기 공간을 구획하는 하나 이상의 영역 또는 상기 공간 내의 여객에 관련된 위험도를 산출하도록 구성된 평가 모듈; 및 상기 평가 모듈에 의해 산출된 상기 위험도를 상기 공간에 매칭하여 대시보드(dashboard) 콘텐츠를 생성하며, 상기 대시보드 콘텐츠를 상기 해양사고 모니터링 시스템 또는 상기 해양사고 모니터링 시스템과 통신 가능하게 연결된 단말 장치 상의 사용자 인터페이스를 통해 표시하도록 구성된 출력 모듈을 포함할 수 있다.
assignees: MOKPO NATIONAL MARITIME UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION;SSL CO LTD

title_en: Vulnerability automatic protection method and system based on early warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vulnerability automatic protection method and system based on early warning information, which take call analysis and real-time call interception of Web application normal behavior as breakthrough for solving problems, take vulnerability early warning announcement as a starting point: the influence range of the loophole is determined through normal behavior calling analysis, and the influence on the operation of other services is avoided; carrying out parameter check on function call possibly having attack behaviors through real-time call interception, and judging abnormal behaviors through parameter recording; by crawling vulnerability early warning announcements of a security website, key defect information is extracted from the vulnerability early warning announcements, vulnerability influence files and functions are accurately positioned, and vulnerability response and automatic protection are automatically carried out. According to the invention, emergency response measures can be automatically implemented on the Web application vulnerability according to vulnerability early warning information, vulnerability attack can be prevented in time with low performance loss, the problems of low vulnerability response speed and false missing and report of manual vulnerability are solved, unknown attack can be responded, and certain usability is achieved.

title_en: Cross-organization workflow operation method and system based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based cross-organization workflow operation method and a block chain-based cross-organization workflow operation system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a plurality of organization modules acquire certificates issued by CA nodes; the plurality of organization modules register webService services respectively provided to the outside with a service registration center; the first organization module establishes a business process model and sends a deployment command to the workflow engine; the workflow engine analyzes the business process model and stores analysis contents to a data object; the first organization module sends a flow instance execution command to the workflow engine; the workflow engine creates a business process instance and executes the business process instance, and the first organization module records the process of executing the business process instance and the service request process on the blockchain. The invention can reduce the data coupling degree of the cross-organization business system, reduce the data integration cost and solve the multi-party trust problem of the cross-organization business process.

title_en: Forest fire prevention and extinguishing method based on unmanned aerial vehicle and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention and extinguishing method based on an unmanned aerial vehicle and the unmanned aerial vehicle, comprising the following steps: a first step of receiving the fire position information and the fire range information; a second step of dispatching the type and the number of the fire unmanned aerial vehicles according to the fire position information and the fire range information; thirdly, the fire unmanned aerial vehicles are formed into a formation to fly to a fire point, the fire is recorded through a camera, and the fire unmanned aerial vehicles are formed into a combined square matrix through a host; fourthly, fire prevention and extinguishment are carried out by a combined square matrix; and fifthly, recording the fire in real time through a camera, and changing the square matrix arrangement according to the change of the fire by the host. The unmanned aerial vehicle adopts regional division and investigation of the system, the regions are independent and are mutually connected, the emergent fire can be better and faster dealt with, the spread of the fire is avoided, different fire changes and fire sizes are dealt with through different matrixes, and the adopted unmanned aerial vehicle has strong high-temperature resistance and improves the capability of reconnaissance of the unmanned aerial vehicle from the air to fire areas.

title_en: Emergency command playback system based on event
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency command playback system based on events, which consists of an emergency command dispatching center, a video recording terminal and a playback request terminal, wherein the video recording terminal and the playback request terminal are configured to execute the following operations: the playback request terminal sends a playback transmission resource request message to the emergency command dispatching center; the playback request terminal receives a playback transmission resource response message sent by the emergency command dispatching center; the playback request terminal determines a period for transmitting playback transmission control information and a period for transmitting playback transmission data information based on the indication of the resource for playback transmission after receiving the playback transmission resource response message. The emergency command playback system based on the event can flexibly adjust the transmission mode, the transmission content and the transmission complexity, thereby being suitable for various emergency environments.

title_en: Video real-time monitoring system and method for emergency disposal of barrier lake
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency disposal of barrier lakes, in particular to a video real-time monitoring system and method for emergency disposal of barrier lakes. According to the invention, accurate monitoring and analysis of the environment and the safety condition of the barrier lake are realized through an integrated advanced technology, and technical means such as a convolutional neural network, a machine vision algorithm, dynamic planning, a structural mechanics model, a computational fluid dynamics model and the like are applied, so that the capturing capacity of dynamic events and the prediction accuracy of potential risks are improved, the real-time performance and the accuracy of monitoring are improved, the efficiency and the effectiveness of emergency response are also improved, the comprehensiveness of barrier lake monitoring, the timeliness of early warning and the scientificity of emergency treatment are obviously improved, and a powerful support is provided for disaster prevention and reduction.

title_en: Control method for facility by using a/v record device
title_ko: 무인 에이브이 기록 장치를 이용한 시설물 관리방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A facility management method using an unmanned AV recording apparatus by bidirectional communication is provided to secure stability and security for various facilities and devices through real-time monitoring. CONSTITUTION: An unmanned AV recording apparatus monitors various facilities, devices and intruders within a facility management place in real time(S110). A moving picture, an image and audio data obtained by the AV recording apparatus are transmitted to a server(S120). When an accident occurs, the AV recording apparatus automatically monitors an intruder or accident in an electronic map(S130). Analyzed information obtained through precise analysis of monitoring information is provided to a field worker(S140~S160).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 AV기록 장치를 이용한 시설물 관리방법에 관한 것이다. 저수지, 담수호, 상ㆍ하수도 처리장, 하천 보, 사방댐, 다목적댐 등의 물 관리 시설물 관리장내에 하나 이상의 무인 A/V기록 장치를 설치하여 각종 설비 및 장치들을 관리할 수 있도록 한 시설물 관리시스템에 있어서, 상기 시설물 관리장내의 각종 설비 및 장치들에 대해 감시용 카메라를 통해 기준영상과 현재영상을 비교하여 움직임이 포착되거나 상기 설비 및 장치들에 부착된 센서로부터 이상 음성이 감지되면  CCTV 혹은 Web-Camera를 통해 동영상을 촬영하며, 상기 동영상과 연동하고 원격명령이나 사전에 설정된 프로그램에 따라 침입자나 사고발생시 사고 부위를 추적하여 다양한 각도로 이미지 사진으로 정밀 촬영하고, 상기 센서로부터 감지된 기계 진동음과 같은 이상 음성을 PC기반의 데이터수집(DAQ: Data Acquisition) 유니트를 통해 수집기록하되, 시설물 관리장내의 각종 설비(전기설비) 및 장치들의 전압, 전류, 온도, 압력 또는 사운드와 같은 전기 또는 물리적인 현상에 대한 사고발생 원인을 추정하고 분석하기 위한 그래픽(Graph), 챠트(Chart) 및 보고서(Report) 등의 감시용 모니터링에 필요한 각종 이벤트 데이터들이 사전에 설정 저장되는 사용자 입력용 응용프로그램(Man Machine Interface: MMI)에 의해 수집ㆍ기록하여 디지털 신호로 변환한 후 합성하여 압축 파일로 저장하고, 또한 상기 시설물 관리장내의 사고신고나 사고분석영상 및 자막데이터를 수신 저장하고 침입자에 대한 경고나 위험 상황의 알림과 수리를 안내하도록 제어하여 하나 이상의 영상/음성 데이터를 수집ㆍ기록하도록 하는 제1 단계를 포함하여 구성하되, 상기 수집ㆍ기록된 하나 이상의 영상/음성 데이터를 다양하고 편리한 사용자 지원 모니터링과 양방향 통신을 지원하는 지역 관제센터의 서버로 유ㆍ무선 통신망을 통해 전송하는 제2 단계와; 상기 서버로부터 실시간 제공되는 동영상과 이미지 및 음성 데이터를 멀티분할화면을 통해 표시하고 시설물 관리장내의 침입자나 사고발생시 자동적으로 아이콘 형태의 알람 및 램프 점등 표시가 동시에 표시되는 전자지도(E-map) 방식에 의해 모니터링 하는 제3 단계와; 상기 제3 단계에서 사고 발생 여부에 따라 동영상과 이미지 및 음성 데이터를 분석하고 계속 모니터링 하는 제4 단계와; 상기 제4 단계에서 상기 동영상과 이미지 및 음성 데이터를 분석하되, 현장 근무자와 수시로 정보 교환하고, 각종 시설물 및 장비들에 대한 사고발생 이미지는 사전에 준비된 실제 사진과 3D 설계도면의 관측지점으로 매핑(Mapping)하여 사고발생 부위를 정밀 분석하도록 하는 제5 단계와; 상기 분석된 데이터는 데이터베이스화하되, 지역 관제센터 상황실로 전송하여 현장 근무자 전용 송수신기나 관리책임자에게 정보제공 및 중앙 관리센터에 보고하도록 하는 제6 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 무인 A/V기록 장치를 이용한 시설물 관리방법을 제공한다.

title_en: System of realtime remote wirwless diagnostic underground power distribution line
title_ko: 지중 배전선로 실시간 무선 원격 진단시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of this invention is to provide a real-time wireless remote diagnostic system for underground distribution lines which prevents major accidents by blocking or suppressing accidents at the early stage. The system comprises: an underground relay wireless communication unit (1000) which is installed at regular intervals on a portion of an inner wall of an underground power conduit (200), which is buried underground and has an underground distribution line (100) installed, and conducts a wireless relay communication between the ground and an inside of the underground power conduit (200); an underground driving diagnostic robot (2000) which sprays a cooling extinguishing agent or an insulator coating agent through each spray nozzles (2550) based on the corresponding remote control signal, converts the captured image information, analyzed temperature information, and measured leakage current information into a distribution line diagnostic control signal packet (4000), and transmits the same in real-time to the underground relay wireless communication unit (1000); and a ground central control server (3000) which notifies a designated management terminal device to dispatch to the site, converts the remote control signal input by the manager into the distribution line diagnostic control signal packet (4000) and transmits the same to the underground driving diagnostic robot (2000).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하의 전력선 관로에 설치된 지중 배전선로의 상태를 자율주행 로봇으로 감시와 진단하고 지중 배전선로의 특정 부위에서 허용 온도보다 높은 온도 또는 허용레벨 이상의 누설전류가 검출되면 해당 위치의 지중 배전선로에 절연피막을 도포하는 동시에 해당 부위의 이미지를 촬영하고 검출된 위치정보와 함께 서버에 통보하며 연기와 화재가 검출되면 해당 위치에 소화액을 분사하여 초기에 진압하므로 대형사고를 방지하는 지중 배전선로 실시간 무선 원격 진단시스템에 관한 것이며, 지하에 매설되고 지중배전선로가 설치된 지중전력선관로의 내부 벽면 일부분에 균일한 간격으로 고정 설치되며 지표면으로 관통 설치된 지상안테나를 통하여 지상과 실시간 중계무선통신하고 지중안테나를 통하여 지중전력선관로의 내부와 무선통신하는 지중중계무선통신부; 지중전력선관로의 내부에 배치되고 자율주행 방식과 제어신호에 의하여 이동하며 상기 지중중계무선통신부)와 무선 접속하고 지중배전선로의 외관의 이미지를 실시간 촬영하며 촬영된 이미지를 분석하여 온도를 검출하고 지중배전선로로부터 검출되는 전류크기를 측정하여 전류가 누설되는지 판단하며 해당 제어신호에 의하여 냉각소화액 또는 절연체도포액을 분사하고 촬영된 이미지 정보와 분석된 온도 정보와 측정된 누설전류 정보를 상기 지중중계무선통신부에 실시간 전송하는 지중주행진단로봇; 지중중계무선통신부와 무선 접속하고 지중주행진단로봇이 전송한 정보를 기록 저장하고 실시간 분석하여 장애가 발생된 것으로 판단되면 지정된 관리자 단말장치에 통보하여 현장으로 출동하도록 제어하는 지상중앙관제서버를 포함하는 특징에 의하여 지하에 매설된 전력선 관로에 설치된 지중 배전선로의 주변을 자율주행 로봇이 주행하여 감시 진단하고 발열이 심한 위치와 화재 또는 연기가 검출되는 위치와 전류가 급격하게 변화하는 위치가 검출되면 현장의 이미지 정보와 위치정보를 확보하여 원격지에 전송하는 동시에 해당 위치에 접근하여 냉각소화액, 절연제를 분사하므로 초기에 진압하여 대형사고를 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Rail transit operation control method, device, electronic equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic, and provides a rail transit operation control method, a rail transit operation control device, electronic equipment and a rail transit operation control system. The method is applied to a cloud brain platform which is in communication connection with a station level operation information and safety guarantee subsystem, a line level multi-station and multi-professional monitoring control subsystem and a line network level comprehensive operation monitoring and emergency command subsystem, and comprises the following steps: acquiring monitoring information; determining a traffic running state; and sending a control instruction to each subsystem to realize the cooperative linkage of each subsystem and adjust the traffic running state. Acquiring feedback information after adjusting the traffic running state; and adjusting the traffic running state based on the feedback information. Therefore, the subsystems are uniformly managed through the cloud brain platform, the cooperative linkage of the subsystems is realized, the traffic running state is adjusted, the information element circulation and multi-system linkage of three layers of stations, lines and nets are realized, and the timeliness of operation information release and the comprehensive emergency command capability of safety guarantee are improved.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd

title_en: Infectious disease flow regulation detection system and method based on AI video flow
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infectious disease flow dispatching detection system and method based on AI video flow, which comprises a network video recorder management platform and an intelligent infectious disease flow dispatching screening platform based on video analysis, wherein the network video recorder management platform is in communication butt joint with the infectious disease flow dispatching screening platform, the network video recorder management platform is accessed with a multi-channel video monitoring camera, and the multi-channel video monitoring camera acquires historical video/short video/long video of a target site and uploads the historical video/short video/long video to the intelligent infectious disease flow dispatching screening platform in real time; the infectious disease flow regulation screening platform analyzes the acquired flow regulation screening video, analyzes the result of the infectious disease flow regulation screening platform and the short video of the contact event, and determines the danger level of the abnormal event according to the rule configuration of the flow regulation system. The detection system and the detection method have the advantages of wider search coverage and better search data integrity, and are suitable for scene application of flow modulation screening.
assignees: SHUGUANG HOSPITAL AFFILIATED WITH SHANGHAI UNIV TCM

title_en: Fire emergency response method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire emergency response, in particular to a fire emergency response method and a fire emergency response system. The fire emergency response method provided by the invention comprises the following steps: acquiring accident information and on-duty ERT personnel information; determining fire equipment information and accident handling people information according to the accident level; acquiring a fire-fighting equipment ID and a storage position through the fire-fighting equipment information, matching the current ERT personnel ID with the fire-fighting equipment ID, and generating an emergency plan according to a matching result; informing the emergency planning to the corresponding person with the current value ERT and acquiring feedback information of the person with the current value ERT; updating the emergency plan by combining the feedback information and the accident handling people number information; recording the accident handling process of the person with the value ERT and broadcasting the handling result. According to the fire emergency response method provided by the invention, a reasonable and high-efficiency executable emergency plan is generated by comprehensively analyzing the emergency situation, and the coping capacity and efficiency of an ERT team under the emergency situation are improved, so that the life and property safety is ensured.
assignees: SHENZHEN FUSHENGTAI FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine emergency command communication information system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency communication, in particular to a mine emergency command communication information system and a method, wherein the system comprises a risk identification module based on mining area environment data, and constructing a model through a graph data structure, identifying potential connection among the data nodes, marking a risk area, collecting risk data associated with landslide and collapse of the mining area, and generating a potential risk map. According to the invention, the risk nodes are identified and evaluated by applying the graph neural network model, complex node relations in mining area environment data are analyzed, so that a system can perform rapid and accurate risk response, the accuracy and response speed of risk evaluation are improved, emergency information can be ensured to be rapidly and accurately conveyed, a genetic algorithm dynamically adjusts rescue actions through a genetic mechanism, resource allocation and rescue strategies are optimized, the resource utilization efficiency and rescue success rate under emergency conditions are improved, and the timeliness and accuracy of rescue operation are ensured, so that casualties and property loss are reduced.

title_en: Forest fire intelligent prediction early warning system integrating machine learning and ecological behavior recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent forest fire prediction and early warning system, which integrates technologies such as satellite remote sensing, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, ground monitoring and the like, and utilizes a deep learning algorithm to intelligently identify ecological behaviors. The system comprises four core modules, namely multi-source data acquisition, ecological behavior identification, machine learning prediction model and intelligent early warning and emergency response. By comprehensively monitoring forest environment, analyzing ecological data, accurately predicting fire risk, automatically generating early warning information, and tightly linking with an emergency system. The system effectively solves the problems of single traditional early warning means, poor timeliness and insufficient precision, remarkably improves the accuracy and response speed of forest fire early warning, and provides powerful technical support for forest resource protection and ecological environment safety.

title_en: Reservoir landslide evolution state sensing method integrating distributed inclinometry and GNSS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a reservoir landslide evolution state sensing method integrating distributed inclinometry and GNSS, which relates to the technical field of landslide monitoring and comprises the steps of arranging a distributed inclinometer and installing a global navigation satellite system; monitoring data acquisition is carried out through an inclinometer and a global navigation satellite system, noise processing is carried out, data fusion is carried out, and landslide dynamics are output in real time. The method disclosed by the invention realizes the organic combination of macroscopic deformation information and local deformation data, can more accurately capture the overall motion trend and local deformation characteristics of the landslide, improves the timeliness and practicability of data acquisition, effectively removes noise and abnormal values in the data, improves the signal-to-noise ratio of the data, provides a more accurate basis for subsequent data analysis, improves the precision and reliability of dynamic landslide estimation, ensures more accurate monitoring results, provides timely information support for landslide early warning and emergency response, and ensures the continuity and stability of a monitoring system.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA RIVER YUNCHUAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD;CHINA THREE GORGES CORP;CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Load fluctuation dynamic attribution and multiscale prediction method, system, equipment and medium based on multi-mode-RMT combination
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power grid load prediction, and discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for load abnormal dynamic attribution and multiscale prediction based on multi-mode-RMT combination, which are used for solving the problems of insufficient multi-mode data fusion, difficult multi-scale space-time coupling modeling and delayed emergency response in the traditional power load prediction. The method comprises the steps of multi-mode data fusion and feature extraction, template feature construction, random matrix feature mining and space-time combined prediction model construction. The method combines the techniques of multi-mode space-time alignment, random matrix feature screening and the like, evaluates the self-correction prediction error by means of a dynamic sliding window, combines the random matrix theory with deep learning, improves the load mutation response force by covariance mutation detection and the like, is suitable for regional power grid load prediction, and can greatly improve the prediction precision and the system stability under multiple scenes.
assignees: MARKETING SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Gate control method, system and storage medium for self-adaptive cooperative regulation and control
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of hydraulic engineering automation control, and discloses a gate control method, a gate control system and a storage medium for self-adaptive cooperative regulation and control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining gate node real-time instruction data, performing time synchronization calibration to generate an initial instruction sequence, extracting instruction features based on the sequence, classifying the instruction features to obtain an instruction sequencing list, separating emergency instructions and distributing dedicated channels when the emergency instruction duty ratio exceeds a threshold value, generating an acceleration transmission path, determining an optimized transmission path through path delay evaluation, selecting a path with the lowest delay from the optimized path to carry out emergency instruction distribution, obtaining a feedback signal, checking the feedback signal, recording response speed indexes, determining adjusted transmission configuration based on the indexes, and synchronizing and integrating conventional instructions to a main transmission sequence by utilizing the configuration to generate a complete regulation instruction set. The method improves the sequence consistency and emergency response capability of the multi-node instruction, reduces transmission conflict and improves the collaborative regulation and control efficiency.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER XIAOLANGDI IND OPERATION SERVICE HENAN CO LTD

title_en: A career proof system of collecting career data directly by users
title_ko: 사용자 직접 수집에 의한 경력증명 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a career providing system by direct collection by user, capable of suggesting and authenticating career data of a user to a third person by recording read career data when the user reads careers of the user by accessing an institution server and then generating reading proof data to authenticate institution server access and reading processes. The present invention comprises: a web connection part relaying packet data transceived to enable the user terminal to read a webpage by accessing the institution server; a read recording part extracting and recording reading proof data including a reading time, an address of the webpage, and a screen of the webpage, read by the user terminal, when receiving a capture command from the user terminal; a career input part generating career data of the user by receiving career information of the user from the user terminal, and connecting the generated career data with the extracted reading proof data; and a career management part setting an opening range for the reading proof data and the career data in accordance with a request of the user terminal. The career proving system is capable of collecting all careers, provided from the institution server, as the user collects the careers of the user directly from the institution server by fundamentally combining matrix completion with a clustering method.
abstract_ko:
사용자가 기관서버에 접속하여 직접 자신의 경력을 열람하면, 열람된 경력 데이터를 기록하고, 기관서버 접속 및 열람 과정을 인증할 수 있는 열람증명 데이터를 생성하여, 제3자에게 사용자의 경력 데이터를 제시하고 인증해주는, 사용자 직접 수집에 의한 경력증명 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상기 사용자 단말이 상기 기관서버에 접속하여 웹페이지를 열람하기 위하여 송수신되는 패킷 데이터를 중계하는 웹연결부; 상기 사용자 단말로부터 캡쳐 명령을 수신하면, 상기 사용자 단말에서 열람하는 웹페이지의 화면, 열람 웹페이지의 주소, 열람 시간을 포함하는 열람증명 데이터를 추출하여 기록하는 열람기록부; 상기 사용자 단말로부터 사용자의 경력 정보를 입력받아 사용자의 경력 데이터를 생성하고, 생성된 경력 데이터에 추출한 열람증명 데이터를 연결하여 함께 생성하는 경력입력부; 및, 상기 사용자 단말의 요청에 따라, 상기 경력 데이터 및 열람증명 데이터의 공개범위를 설정하는 경력관리부를 포함하는 구성을 마련한다. 
상기와 같은 경력증명 시스템에 의하여, 행렬 완성과 클러스터링 방법을 근본적으로 결합시킴으로써, 사용자가 직접 기관 서버에서 자신의 경력을 수집하기 때문에, 기관 서버에서 제공하는 경력을 모두 수집할 수 있다.

title_en: Coding training method and apparatus using coding puzzle
title_ko: 코딩퍼즐을 이용한 코딩교육 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a coding training method and apparatus using a coding puzzle, which can improve motivation, concentration, and logical thinking while users are solving various coding puzzles with fun, makes it possible to solve problems by intuitive operation using blocks of commands (advance, rotation, repetition, attack, defense) that are iconized by approaching a game format differently from conventional coding training using a combination of complex commands, and enables children to students and adults, without programming experience, to learn basic functions of computer programming.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다양한 코딩 퍼즐을 재미있게 풀어가면서 동기부여와 집중력, 논리적 사고방식을 향상시킬 수 있고, 복잡한 명령어의 조합을 이용한 기존 코딩교육과 다르게 게임형식으로 접근하여 아이콘화한 명령어(전진, 회전, 반복, 공격, 방어) 블록을 활용한 직관적인 조작으로 문제 해결이 가능하면서 프로그래밍 경험이 없는 어린이부터 학생, 성인까지 컴퓨터 프로그래밍의 기본 기능을 학습할 수 있도록 한 코딩퍼즐을 이용한 코딩교육 방법 및 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Real-time security guard patrol system
abstract_en: A real-time security guard patrol system, further comprising at least one set of application programs, the application programs being stored within a patrol security guard communication device, the application programs being executed so that a patrol security guard logs in to the system, selects a predefined patrol route, touches an initial checkpoint to show the start of a patrol route patrol, touches subsequent checkpoints on the patrol route and a destination checkpoint, transmits the positions of the initial checkpoint, the subsequent checkpoints and the destination checkpoint to a cloud server, responds to one or more security check queries received by a central monitoring station, reports one or more incidents to the central monitoring station, the reporting process comprising capturing at least one incident image or recording an incident video, classifying the incident and loading at least one recorded audio message or video message into the report, and touches the initial checkpoint on the patrol route again to show the end of the patrol route patrol.
assignees: SHENZHEN CHAO WEIDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for initiating and recording incident information in a communication system
abstract_en: A communication system (100) comprises a first two-way portable handheld or vehicular radio unit (102) having a camera (506; 606; 706). The first unit, responsive to receiving an incident event trigger, transmits a unique emergency alert to a central control station, activates the camera (506; 606; 706), automatically records first video of an incident scene, and wirelessly provides the first video to the central control station. At least one more portable handheld or vehicular radio unit is in a talk group (104, 106, 108) established by the central control station with the first two-way portable handheld or vehicular radio unit, and responds to activation of the first unit by recording, and wirelessly providing to the central control station, second video of the incident scene. The central control station records and stores the first and second video for subsequent accessing for evidentiary purposes.

title_en: Digital kit system
title_ko: 디지털 키트 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a digital kit system, comprising: a toy assembly configured to be able to move back and forth, left and right; and a programming learning device that receives a coding command for controlling the operation of the toy assembly and transmits the coding command to the toy assembly. The present invention implements the toy assembly that operates according to a learner′s manipulation commands, thereby inducing the learner′s interest in programming.
abstract_ko: 전후좌우 이동이 가능하도록 구성되는 완구 조립체; 및 상기 완구 조립체의 동작을 제어하기 위한 코딩 명령을 입력 받아 상기 완구 조립체로 전송하는 프로그래밍 학습 장치;를 포함하는 디지털 키트 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Prioritizing and resolving inconsistencies in digital evidence
abstract_en: A system for prioritizing and resolving inconsistencies in digital evidence. The system includes a database containing a first type of data and a second type of data related to an incident record and an electronic computing device including an electronic processor. The electronic processor is configured to receive the first and second types of data from the database, determine an inconsistency between the first and second types of data, and determine an incident type from the incident record. The electronic processor is also configured to determine whether a priority of the determined inconsistency meets a threshold case impact level. When the priority of the inconsistency meets the threshold case impact level, the electronic processor is configured to take a first notification action and when the priority of the inconsistency does not meet the threshold case impact level, the electronic processor is configured to take a second notification action.

title_en: A kind of emergency evacuation automated intelligent generates system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to exit signs technical field, it is related to emergency evacuation automated intelligent to generate system.Including alarm detector, indicating lamp for emergency, virtual crossing node, by initializing all through paths, form routing database, calculate and generate the reference data instrument of most short best-effort path in this, as principle is evacuated according to keeping fire away, exporting nearby, direct construction, the basic routing database of generation, path node is set to by alarm detector and indicating lamp for emergency；All through paths are initialized, routing database is formed；Principle is evacuated according to keeping fire away, exporting nearby to calculate and generate most short best-effort path；The dispersal plan write into Databasce of generation is called for system and drives that indicating lamp for emergency is oriented to be lighted or close in real time, while the alert event and dispersal plan are preserved as daily record and supply ex-post analysis.The present invention can reduce Evacuation Design commander's difficulty of complicated scene of fire, it is ensured that the correctness in exit signs direction, intelligent evacuation is more stablized safety.

title_en: A method of video monitoring system is accessed into video conferencing system
