abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of methods by video monitoring system access video conferencing system, for can be by the design method in the accessing conferences systems such as video camera/video record in video monitoring system, so that the video side of attending a meeting in video conferencing system can watch the video image of video camera.This technology can be widely applied in the products such as emergency command scheduling, can be widely applied in the section industries such as public security/traffic/municipal administration/fire-fighting, so that the judgement field condition that can be more clear in the video of emergency command is linked up, makes more accurate decision.

title_en: Highway patrol is alert with unmanned aerial vehicle system
abstract_en: A highway patrol police unmanned aerial vehicle system is disclosed, wherein the sky end comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle provided with a three-axis nacelle; the relay terminal comprises a graph transmission data relay station and a graph transmission antenna; the ground end comprises a takeoff field, a ground control station and a 4G direct broadcast module; the remote end comprises a mobile command center, a remote command center and a remote intelligent terminal; the unmanned aerial vehicle wirelessly transmits with a graph transmission data relay station provided with a graph transmission antenna, and wirelessly transmits without relay with a ground control station; and the image transmission data relay station performs wireless transmission with the ground control station and the 4G live broadcast module. The system improves the high-efficiency law enforcement monitoring and evidence obtaining capability of the traffic police in the complex environment, can realize portable and quick maneuvering deployment, integrates the aerial monitoring visual angle and the ground monitoring system into a heaven-earth-human integrated layout, records various road traffic conditions in all directions, provides the most powerful evidence information for decision making of field and central commanders, and simultaneously reduces the possibility that the traffic police on-duty personnel suffer from safety hazards and accidental injuries.

title_en: Multi-terminal collaborative water administration law enforcement inspection system and method
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of water administration law enforcement inspection management, in particular to a multi-terminal collaborative water administration law enforcement inspection system and a multi-terminal collaborative water administration law enforcement inspection method, wherein the system comprises a single law enforcement inspection application program module arranged in a mobile terminal, a water administration law enforcement officer carries the water administration law enforcement officer for regular and non-regular on-site inspection, and real-time data acquired in real time and information required to be reported are reported to a law enforcement inspection background operation module in real time; the system comprises a sub-server, a law enforcement and patrol background operation module, a central server and a law enforcement and patrol comprehensive service module, wherein the law enforcement and patrol background operation module is arranged in the sub-server and is responsible for recording, analyzing, annotating and storing data and information uploaded by each single law enforcement and patrol application program module, uploading the well-arranged data and information to the law enforcement and patrol comprehensive service module, and the law enforcement and patrol comprehensive service module is arranged in the central server and is responsible for summarizing and integrating the data and information uploaded by each law enforcement and patrol background operation module and analyzing big data. The system provides good technical support for emergency response of sudden water events.
assignees: INFORMATION CENTER YELLOW RIVER WATER CONSERVANCY COMMISSION;UNIV NORTHWESTERN POLYTECHNICAL

title_en: Multi-source data processing method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-source data processing method and device, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source data, classifying the multi-source data according to the data source type of the multi-source data, carrying out data coding on the classified data to obtain coded data of each type, enabling the coded data and codes to form a unique corresponding relation, and carrying out quality inspection on the coded data to obtain final data. The application can realize the automation of the data acquisition process, and realize the real-time acquisition and the real-time processing of the data so as to support real-time decision and emergency response. By optimizing the data processing flow and adopting a high-performance computing platform, the delay of data acquisition and processing is greatly reduced, and the efficiency and timeliness of information transmission are improved.

title_en: River domain disaster monitoring pre-alarming method and system based on multisource monitoring data analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a river domain disaster monitoring pre-alarming method and system based on multisource monitoring data analysis, which are characterized in that multisource monitoring data are obtained, the multisource monitoring data are subjected to data preprocessing, noise interference in real-time position data is eliminated, channel image data and environment parameter data are subjected to time synchronization alignment to generate a standardized monitoring data set, water flow dynamic characteristics, meteorological abnormal characteristics and channel obstacle distribution characteristics of Jiang Heyu are extracted, the method comprises the steps of generating a multidimensional disaster association feature set, inputting the multidimensional disaster association feature set into a preset disaster early warning model for dynamic analysis, generating a disaster early warning signal, determining a disaster type and an influence range, triggering an autonomous detachment mechanism of a drag airship and a quick starting instruction of an unmanned aerial vehicle, broadcasting early warning information to a ship in a channel through the unmanned aerial vehicle, and synchronously transmitting the disaster type and the influence range to a command center. The invention can improve the timeliness of disaster early warning and the space adaptation precision of disposal measures.
assignees: SHENZHEN XIYUE WISDOM DATA CO LTD

title_en: Information management system for automobile security
title_ko: 자동차 보안을 위한 정보관리 시스템
abstract_en: An information management system for vehicle security is provided to process collision and fire information generated in the rear-end collision and fire accident generation of a parked vehicle. An information management system(50) for vehicle security comprises a fire detection sensor(20), an impact detection sensor(30), and a microprocessor(40). The fire detection sensor is installed on the vehicle body beyond front and rear wheel and senses the smoke in a fire and transmits the sensed information to the microprocessor. The impact detection sensor forms a contact module using a touch switch mode on + and - lines and is installed inside lateral molding of front and rear bumpers and senses a impact and transmits the information to the microprocessor when a certain pressure is applied.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 주차된 차량의 추돌 및 화재사고 발생 시 나타나는 충돌, 화재정보를 동시에 처리함과 아울러 카메라 모듈 유닛(CMU)을 이용하여 가해 차량의 번호판을 추적하여 기록함으로써, 사고에 대한 초기 알림과 가해차량 추적을 통한 차량의 이상 유무를 관리하는 자동차 보안을 위한 정보관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위해 본 발명은, 화재발생 시 연기를 감지하여 이 감지정보를 마이크로프로세서로 전송하는 화재감지센서와; 접촉 스위치 방식을 이용한 접점식 모듈을 +, - 선로 위에 구성하여 형성되는 것으로서, 차량의 앞, 뒤범퍼 측면 몰딩 내부에 설치되어 일정 이상의 압력이 가해질 경우 충격을 감지하여 이 정보를 마이크로프로세서로 전송하는 충돌감지센서와; 미리 설정된 프로그램에 의해 상기 화재감지센서 및 충돌감지센서에서 감지한 화재정보나 충격정보를 블루투스 송수신모듈을 통해 중앙관리 시스템 송ㆍ수신부로 전송하는 마이크로프로세서와; 이벤트 상황발생 알림부를 통해 이동통신 단말기 조작 신호 발생부를 통제하여 상기 중앙관리 시스템 송ㆍ수신부로부터 받은 화재정보나 충격정보를 사용자 이동통신 단말기에 문자서비스 형태로 제공하는 정보관리 시스템을; 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     자동차, 접점 스위치, 화재 감지, CMU, 무선통신, 문자메시지, 번호판 추출
assignees: BAEK DEOK SOO;KIM JONG GEUN;BAEK YOUNG HYUN

title_en: First-aid training simulation unit
title_ko: 응급처치 훈련용 시뮬레이션 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a first-aid training simulation device for enabling emergency medical technicians or ordinary people to actively correspond in real situations which require emergency measures by training the emergency medical technician or ordinary people to give various types of emergency measures in virtual situations and feeding the results back. The first-aid training simulation device of the present invention comprises a monitor which performs status of a virtual patient on a virtual reality image which can be expressed in 2D or 3D according to the selection of a user and displays individual training menu in order to facilitate first-aid training according to each incident situation of the virtual patient by recognizing screen touch by the user; a joystick for front, back, left and right direction for controlling the emergency medical technicians who perform emergency measures on the virtual patient on the monitor; a trackball mouse which changes view point of the emergency medical technicians in the virtual reality who perform emergency measures on the virtual patient on the monitor; a touch screen in which first-aid equipment needed for first-aid training on virtual patients or a device for monitoring status change of the virtual patient is displayed; speakers which produce sound effects according to situations in the virtual reality; and a computer main body which loads programs for simulating first-aid training in the virtual reality situation and runs a program or a device for recognizing input signals for first-aid training and performs output corresponing to the relevant input.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가상현실에서 응급구조 요원 또는 일반인 등이 다양한 형태의 응급처치 훈련을 수행하고 그 결과가 피드백되도록 함으로써 응급처치가 필요한 실제 상황하에서도 능동적인 대응이 가능하도록 하기 위한 응급처치 훈련용 시뮬레이션 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 응급처치 훈련용 시뮬레이션장치는, 사용자의 선택에 따라 2D, 3D 또는 3D 입체로 표현가능한 가상현실 영상에 가상환자의 상태 구현이 가능하며, 사용자의 화면터치를 인식하여 상기 가상환자의 발생상황별 응급조치 훈련이 가능하도록 개별 훈련메뉴가 디스플레이되는 모니터, 상기 모니터상의 가상환자에 대한 응급처치를 수행하는 가상현실 내의 응급구조요원의 전·후·좌·우 방향제어를 위한 조이스틱, 상기 모니터상의 가상환자에 대한 응급처치를 수행하는 가상현실 내의 응급구조요원의 시점을 변화시키는 트랙볼마우스, 가상환자에 대한 응급조치 훈련을 위해 필요한 응급구조장치 또는 상기 가상환자의 상태변화를 모니터링할 수 있는 장치가 표시되는 터치스크린, 가상현실상의 상황에 따른 효과음이 발생되도록 하는 스피커 및 가상현실 상황에서의 응급처치 훈련을 시뮬레이션하기 위한 프로그램을 탑재하고, 응급처치 훈련을 위한 입력신호를 인식하고 해당 입력에 대응하는 출력을 수행하도록 장치 또는 프로그램을 구동하는 컴퓨터 본체로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Systems and Methods for Forming and Operating an Ecosystem for a Conducted Electrical Weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment (e.g., ecosystem) for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: Emergency broadcase system scheduling controlling scheme generation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of emergency broadcase system scheduling controlling scheme generation methods, include the following steps：S1, the Resources list and task record are obtained from database；S2, according in the Resources list and task record maximum issue region is calculated with the relevant information field in region；S3, according in the Resources list and task record time match result is calculated with the information field of time correlation；S4, according in the Resources list and task record resource matched result is obtained with the relevant information field of resource；S5, language matching result is broadcast according to obtaining original with the relevant information field of language in the Resources list and task record；S6, several schemes are obtained to four kinds of results progress permutation and combination；Scheme that four kinds meet actual demand is filtered out in S7, several schemes obtained from step S6 for policymaker's decision.The present invention can aid decision person real-time, quickly and accurately formulate emergency command scheme, for emergent broadcast construction have great booster action.

title_en: Power distribution network fault simulation training evaluation method based on feasibility
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault simulation training evaluation method based on feasibility, which comprises the following steps: recording the fault processing operation sequence and operation information of a dispatcher by establishing a fault processing track array model, and generating an active isolation range set model and a real-time passive isolation range set model by the matrix; establishing a fault processing result feasibility index to comprehensively evaluate the feasibility of the fault processing result of the dispatcher; establishing an anti-misoperation correctness evaluation index to perform anti-misoperation evaluation on the dispatcher fault handling operation; establishing a simplicity evaluation index of an operation process to comprehensively evaluate the simplicity of fault processing of a dispatcher; and establishing a fault treatment comprehensive feasibility index to comprehensively evaluate the dispatcher power distribution network fault simulation training. The method can comprehensively reflect the whole process of the fault handling of the dispatcher in the aspects of result, error prevention and process, and has good practical value.

title_en: Individual soldier companion help calling method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a help calling method for individual soldier companions, which comprises the following steps: receiving track data sent by a plurality of terminals, recording the track data and displaying the relative positions of the terminals; receiving a distress signal sent by a first terminal in the plurality of terminals; and sending rescue signals and the track data of the first terminal to other terminals in the plurality of terminals, and comparing the track data of the other terminals with the track data of the first terminal to confirm the position of the first terminal. The invention also provides a single soldier companion distress device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The invention can provide commands when rescuers rescue the fellows in danger, thereby avoiding the rescuers from blindly rescuing and causing more loss.

title_en: Control system for facility by using a/v record device
title_ko: 무인 에이브이 기록 장치를 이용한 시설물 관리시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for managing facilities using an unmanned AV recording device is provided to execute a real-time monitoring process and exchange information between a field worker and a control center, thereby stably maintaining various facilities and devices. CONSTITUTION: Sensors(101) detect abnormal machine vibration or adjacent abnormal peripheral voice. A monitoring camera(102) compares a reference image with a present image. If motion is captured or the abnormal voice is detected, the monitoring camera photographs a video. A still camera(103) tracks a defective part according to a remote command or a preset program.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인 AV기록 장치를 이용한 시설물 관리시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위해 본 발명은 저수지, 담수호, 상ㆍ하수도 처리장, 하천 보, 사방댐, 다목적댐 등의 물 관리 시설물 관리장내에 하나 이상의 무인 A/V기록 장치를 설치하여 각종 설비 및 장치들을 관리할 수 있도록 한 시설물 관리시스템에 있어서, 상기 시스템은 시설물 관리장내의 각종 설비 및 장치들에 대해 기준영상과 현재영상을 비교하여 움직임이 포착되거나 각종 설비 및 장치들에 부착된 센서로부터 이상 음성이 감지되면 동영상을 촬영하는 CCTV와, 상기 CCTV와 연동하며, 원격명령이나 사전에 설정된 프로그램에 따라 침입자나 사고발생시 사고 부위를 추적하여 다양한 각도로 카메라를 구동시켜 이미지 사진으로 정밀 촬영하는 스틸 카메라와, 상기 각종 설비 및 장치에 부착된 센서로부터 감지된 기계 진동음과 같은 이상 음성을 수집하되, 시설물 관리장내의 각종 설비 및 장치들의 사고발생 원인을 추정하고 분석하기 위한 그래픽(Graph), 챠트(Chart) 및 보고서(Report) 등의 모니터링에 필요한 각종 이벤트 데이터들이 사전에 설정 저장되는 사용자 입력용 응용프로그램(Man Machine Interface: MMI)에 의해 분석 가능하도록 하는 PC기반의 데이터수집장치(DAQ Unit) 및, 상기 동영상과 이미지 및 음성 신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하고 합성하여 압축 파일로 변환ㆍ저장하는 하드디스크를 구비하는 저장수단과, 상기 시설물 관리장내의 사고신고나 사고분석영상 및 자막데이터를 수신 저장하는 송ㆍ수신기 및 시설물 관리장내의 침입자 경고나 위험 상황 알림과 수리를 안내하는 스피커와, 상기 수단들 전체를 구동 제어하며, 지역 관제센터 서버와 연동하는 제어부를 구비하는 하나 이상의 무인 A/V기록 장치를 포함하며; 또한, 상기 하나 이상의 무인 A/V기록 장치와 지역 관제센터 간의 유ㆍ무선 통신망을 통해 양방향 통신을 지원하고, 다양하고 편리한 사용자 지원 모니터링을 제공하는 지역 관제센터 서버와; 상기 지역 관제센터 서버로부터 실시간 제공되는 동영상과 이미지 및 DAQ 데이터를 1화면 표시 내지 64화면으로 분할 표시 가능한 제1 감시용 모니터와 시설물 관리장내의 침입자나 사고발생시 전자지도(E-map)상에 자동적으로 아이콘 형태로 표시해주는 제2 감시용 모니터를 구비하는 감시용 모니터와; 상기 감시용 모니터를 통해 상기 동영상과 이미지 및 DAQ 데이터를 분석하되, 각종 설비 및 장치에 대한 사고발생 이미지는 사전에 준비된 실제 사진과 3D 설계도면의 관측지점으로 매핑(Mapping)하여 사고발생 부위를 정밀 분석하도록 하는 분석시스템과; 상기 분석시스템으로부터 분석된 데이터는 데이터베이스화하되, 지역 관제센터 상황실로 전송하여 현장 근무자의 전용 송ㆍ수신기나 관리책임자에게 정보제공 및 중앙 관제센터에 보고하도록 하는 정보제공기기를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 무인 A/V기록 장치를 이용한 시설물 관리시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Method for road weather apparaisal and computing device for executing the same
title_ko: 도로 기상 감정 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 컴퓨팅 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method for road weather appraisal and a computing device for performing the same. The method for road weather appraisal according to a disclosed embodiment, which is a method performed by a computing device including one or more processors and a memory for storing one or more programs executed by the one or more processors, comprises the steps of: collecting basic appraisal materials for road weather appraisal based on accident-related information included in a request for road weather appraisal; checking whether the temperature of a road where an accident has occurred is equal to or lower than a preset threshold temperature for the time point of the accident included in the accident-related information based on the basic appraisal materials; checking whether cumulative precipitation is equal to or smaller than a preset threshold precipitation during a preset reference time in the region of the accident for the time point of the accident based on the basic appraisal materials if the temperature of the road is equal to or lower than the preset threshold temperature; checking whether the wind velocity in the region of the accident is equal to or smaller than a preset first threshold wind velocity for the time point of the accident based on the basic appraisal materials if the cumulative precipitation is equal to or smaller than the preset threshold precipitation; and generating the result of road weather appraisal for the generation of black ice depending on whether the region of the accident satisfies one or more among a preset first weather condition, a preset second weather condition and a preset third weather condition for the time point of the accident if the wind velocity is equal to or smaller than the preset first threshold wind velocity.
abstract_ko: 도로 기상 감정 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 컴퓨팅 장치가 개시된다. 개시되는 일 실시예에 따른 도로 기상 감정 방법은, 하나 이상의 프로세서들, 및 하나 이상의 프로세서들에 의해 실행되는 하나 이상의 프로그램들을 저장하는 메모리를 구비한 컴퓨팅 장치에서 수행되는 방법으로서, 도로 기상 감정 의뢰 요청에 포함된 사고 관련 정보에 기반하여 도로 기상 감정을 위한 감정 기초 자료를 수집하는 단계, 감정 기초 자료에 기반하여 사고 관련 정보에 포함된 사고 발생 시점을 기준으로 사고 발생 장소의 노면 온도가 기 설정된 임계 온도 이하인지 여부를 확인하는 단계, 노면 온도가 기 설정된 임계 온도 이하인 경우, 감정 기초 자료에 기반하여 사고 발생 시점을 기준으로 사고 발생 지역의 기 설정된 기준 시간 동안 누적 강수량이 기 설정된 임계 강수량 이하인지 여부를 확인하는 단계, 누적 강수량이 기 설정된 임계 강수량 이하인 경우, 감정 기초 자료에 기반하여 사고 발생 시점을 기준으로 사고 발생 지역의 풍속이 기 설정된 제1 임계 풍속 이하인지 여부를 확인하는 단계, 및 풍속이 기 설정된 제1 임계 풍속 이하인 경우, 사고 발생 시점을 기준으로 사고 발생 지역이 기 설정된 제1 기상 조건, 제2 기상 조건, 및 제3 기상 조건 중 하나 이상을 만족하는지 여부에 따라 블랙아이스 발생에 대한 도로 기상 감정 결과를 생성하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Black box for submarines
title_ko: 잠수정용 블랙박스
abstract_ko: 잠수정용 블랙박스가 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 잠수정용 블랙박스는, 잠수정의 비상 상황시 분리되어 수면으로 부상하도록 구성된 블랙박스로서, 잠수정의 위치 관련 정보를 수집하고 기록하는 위치기록부; 잠수정의 외측에 결합된 상태에서 비상 상황시 상기 위치기록부의 구속이 해제되도록 작동하는 결속부; 구속 해제된 상기 위치기록부의 수면 부상을 위해, 상기 위치기록부의 외측으로 팽창하여 부력을 발생시키는 부력체; 및 잠수정에 대한 중첩적인 위치 확인을 위해, 잠수정 일측과 상기 위치기록부 간을 유선 또는 무선으로 연결하는 연결부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 사고 잠수정의 위치 및 상태 등이 정확하고 용이하게 확인될 수 있어 추후 수색 작업과 사고 원인 분석에 신뢰할만한 유용한 단서로 활용될 수 있고, 탑승자의 의식 유무와 상관 없이 결속부에 의해 위치기록부가 자동 또는 수동으로 구속 해제된 후 수면으로 신속하게 부상하게 됨으로써, 수색 작업과 사고 원인 분석이 신속하게 이루어질 수 있게 된다.

title_en: System and method for driving condition detection and notification
abstract_en: A system for accident detection or detecting an unsafe driving condition in a vehicle including a device that measures and transmits at least one output signal; at least one remote device configured to receive, record, and/or display the at least one output signal from the device; a computing device configured to receive the at least one output signal from the device and display the at least one output signal in real-time; and a graphical user interface on the computing device that allows an emergency response professional to view and customize options for monitoring the at least one output signal, wherein the device, the at least one remote device, and the computing device are communicatively connected to each other via a communications network.
assignees: Cyber Physical Systems LLC;CYBER PHYSICAL SYSTEMS INC

title_en: GPS tracking and mapping wildfire defense system network for proactively defending homes and neighborhoods against threat of wild fire by spraying environmentally-safe anti-fire chemical liquid on property surfaces to inhibit fire ignition and flame spread in the presence of wild fire
abstract_en: A GPS tracking and mapping wild fire defense system network configured for defending homes and neighborhoods against threat of wild fire by proactively spraying environmentally-safe anti-fire (AF) chemical liquid on property surfaces to inhibit fire ignition and flame spread in the presence of wild fire. The GPS tracking and mapping wild fire defense system network includes: a command center in operable communication with a wireless communication network; and one or more GPS-tracked anti-fire liquid spraying systems, each having an integrated supply tank and a spray pump deployable at properties having building structures, for spraying the properties with environmentally-clean anti-fire chemical liquid using a spray nozzle assembly connected to said spray pump by way of a fluid connection. The system network further includes: a GPS system for transmitting GPS reference signals from a constellation of GPS satellites deployed in orbit around the Earth, to a GPS transceiver installed aboard each GPS-tracking anti-fire liquid spraying system, for GPS processing and GPS-coordinate location; and one or more mobile computing systems, each for use by a registered user including property parcel owners, spray contractors, and other stakeholders on the system network, to request and receive services supported by said system network. Each mobile computing system has a display screen supporting: messaging services; display of maps indicating where wild fires have been identified and mapped, tracked and ranked in terms of risk to the user and GPS-specified property; and scheduling of spray task to be performed, and recording tasks that been completed, and which are in progress, on the GPS tracking and mapping wild fire defense system network.

title_en: A field of commodity
title_ko: 영어 회화를 습득할 수 있는 상품 면
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 시장, 마트, 백화점 등에서 사고 파는 각종 상품의 겉면(24)에 현재 미국인들이 사용하고 있는 미국인의 원어발음 그대로를 한글로 표기 하여 영어회화를 습득하는 것으로 더욱 상세하게는 '열거된 영어장문(18)' 이 상품의 겉면(24)에 직접 프린트되거나 회화지(20)에 프린트되어 상품의 겉면(24)에 부착된 '열거된 영어장문(18)' 을 자주 되풀이 하여 보고 그리고 '한글로 표기된 미국인의 원어발음(16)그대로를' 소리내어 회화 하면서 영어 회화를 재미있게 습득할 수 있도록 하며, 상기 '열거된 영어장문(18)' 을 해석된 우리말(12)→ 영어 회화작문(14)→ 미국인의 원어발음(한글로 표기)(16)의 3단계로 구성되며, 또한 학생, 고객들이 상품을 이용하면서 또는 먹고 마시면서 수첩이나 노트에 기록하여 자주 되풀이 보고 그리고 '한글로 표기된 미국인의 원어발음(16) 그대로를' 소리내어 대화화면서 서로 의논하고 수정해 주면 가족, 교우, 여러사람들이 더욱 친숙해지며 또한, 가정, 학교, 사회에서 영어의 원어발음을 습득할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
       
     시장, 마트 , 백화점, 우리말, 고객, 원어발음, 수첩, 가족.

title_en: Emergency response method and device for application
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency response method and device for application, and belongs to the technical field of emergency response. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring information of a fault record of a target application; detecting whether the target terminal receives indication information sent by a background server; under the condition that the target terminal is detected to receive the indication information and the operation aiming at the target function module is detected, displaying first prompt information on an initial page in a plurality of interactive pages of the target function module; and displaying second prompt information at the fault page under the condition that the target terminal is detected not to receive the indication information. According to the method and the device, the emergency response speed is improved, and the user experience is improved.
assignees: JD DIGITAL TECH HOLDINGS CO LTD

title_en: Method for evaluating applicability of on-orbit multi-satellite networking system based on cyclic neural network
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-orbit multi-satellite networking system applicability evaluation method based on a cyclic neural network, which comprises the following steps of: aiming at system contribution of satellites when tasks are completed in a networking system, an evaluation index is established to evaluate system applicability, and a cyclic neural network model design step is that: performing online optimization on weights through a cyclic neural network model, wherein the system applicability evaluation index system design steps comprise: the system applicability assessment is established based on the characteristics and the workflow of the satellite system, and the index system comprises task coverage, emergency response, orbit mobility, data compatibility and transmission timeliness, so that real-time and accurate assessment results can be realized, the task management efficiency of satellite on-orbit operation can be improved, a model can be continuously updated in satellite operation, the assessment precision can be improved, satellite faults and problems can be rapidly found, and the reliability of satellite operation can be improved.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted emergency comprehensive communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted emergency comprehensive communication system, which relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted emergency communication and aims at the problems that the existing vehicle-mounted emergency communication system is insufficient in communication mode, inconvenient and accurate in information transmission under the condition of interference in the environment, unfavorable for realizing data sharing, certain in limitation and unsatisfactory in use effect, and the scheme is provided, which comprises a decision system, a multimedia server, a wireless communication module, a vehicle-mounted emergency module and a comprehensive communication module; the decision system comprises a command large screen, a head-to-head terminal and a dispatching desk, wherein the output end of the head-to-head terminal and the output end of the dispatching desk are connected with the input end of the multimedia server. The invention has reasonable design, rich communication modes, accurate and efficient information transmission, high timeliness, no limitation and good use effect, and is beneficial to realizing data sharing.
assignees: NO 69246 TROOPS OF PLA;BEIJING ZHONGKE QIANGJUN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Community fire rescue dispatching system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of rescue scheduling and discloses a community fire rescue scheduling system, which comprises miniature rescue vehicles, a road condition acquisition module, a positioning module, a road condition statistics module, a communication module and a scheduling module, wherein the miniature rescue vehicles are pre-configured with community maps and patrol according to preset lines, the road condition acquisition module acquires environment road condition information, the environment road condition information comprises road traffic duration, road width and road occupation types, the positioning module acquires the current position of the corresponding miniature rescue vehicles to define vehicle position information, and the road condition statistics module acquires the environment road condition information and records according to acquisition time. The communication module acquires rescue information and generates a rescue instruction, the rescue information comprises a rescue location and a rescue type, the scheduling module receives the rescue instruction and acquires vehicle position information, the scheduling module generates vehicle scheduling information to the corresponding miniature rescue vehicle according to a pre-configured vehicle scheduling strategy, and the vehicle scheduling information comprises a scheduling path, so that rapid scheduling is facilitated.
assignees: TIANJIN FIRE RES INSTITUTE OF MEM

title_en: Underwater multi-target physiological signal monitoring method and system based on underwater acoustic communication networking
abstract_en: The invention provides an underwater multi-target physiological signal monitoring method and system based on underwater acoustic communication networking, and belongs to the technical field of underwater communication and monitoring. The system comprises a plurality of sensor nodes, a buoy gateway node and a relay node, wherein each node is provided with a unique identifier. Besides the conventional underwater environment data acquisition function, the sensor node is integrated with a heart rate, blood oxygen, body temperature and other physiological signal monitoring module, can acquire physiological state data of an underwater operator in real time and communicate with other nodes through underwater acoustic signals, the buoy gateway node receives data from each sensor node and the relay node and uploads the data to an onshore control center through radio communication to realize remote monitoring and early warning, and the relay node is used for expanding network coverage, optimizing a data transmission path and improving system robustness. The method is based on a mesh topological structure, adopts a time-sharing multiplexing mechanism to realize accurate time sequence synchronization, avoids data collision, and ensures the order and reliability of data transmission through the record of the hop count among nodes and the forwarding control. The system builds a dynamic self-adaptive networking monitoring system which is easy to expand and low in cost, and is widely applicable to application scenes such as underwater operation safety monitoring, group physiological state management, emergency response and the like.
assignees: UNIV GUILIN ELECTRONIC TECH;NANNING GUIDIAN ELECTRONIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle task whole-flow control system and method based on multi-agent large model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle task whole-flow control system and method based on a multi-agent large model, which mainly solve the problem of poor flight control and anomaly detection performance in a complex dynamic environment. The method comprises the steps of 1) carrying out real-time alignment and fusion on multi-source data such as an IMU, energy management and environmental weather, extracting key features, 2) carrying out intelligent semantic analysis on a user instruction by means of a large language model, combining real-time data and historical task information, disassembling an overall task into subtasks such as environment perception, path planning, flight control and anomaly detection, 3) synchronously executing the tasks by each processing unit through a multi-agent cooperative mechanism and feeding back in real time, and 4) carrying out time sequence modeling by adopting a deep learning technology to obtain a high-precision anomaly detection result, and filtering instantaneous fluctuation through a self-adaptive gating mechanism to form closed-loop control. The invention can effectively improve the intelligent level and safety of the task execution of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and realize the autonomous high-efficiency flight and emergency response of the unmanned aerial vehicle.

title_en: Chemical accident emergency response method and system under real-time monitoring
abstract_en: The application provides a chemical accident emergency response method and system under real-time monitoring, which relate to the technical field of emergency response and generate multi-source synchronous data by collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in real time for time alignment, extracting multi-mode characteristics of the multi-source synchronous data for chemical accident identification, retrieving accident scene parameters, carrying out accident response analysis based on an accident identification result, formulating an emergency response scheme and carrying out resource scheduling analysis to construct a resource scheduling network diagram, carrying out accident monitoring early warning signals according to the resource scheduling network diagram in combination with the multi-source synchronous data, generating a real-time decision instruction and pushing the real-time decision instruction and the emergency response scheme to an emergency command center. The method solves the technical problems of low accuracy of identifying the chemical accident and lagged response flow caused by lack of multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and real-time linkage mechanisms in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the identification accuracy of the chemical accident and the emergency response speed.
assignees: EMERGENCY MAN DEPARTMENT BIG DATA CENTER

title_en: Urban hydrologic situation awareness and identification method, system and readable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city-oriented hydrologic situation awareness and identification method, a system and a readable medium, which comprise the steps of constructing a city hydrologic emergency knowledge system, including the construction of a city hydrologic emergency plan library, a city hydrologic event library and a city hydrologic simulation model library, analyzing natural language inquiry input by a user, searching and fusing the city hydrologic emergency plan library and the city hydrologic event library based on the city hydrologic emergency plan library to construct a specific hydrologic event scene knowledge sub-library, carrying out self-adaption matching and simulation on the specific hydrologic event scene knowledge sub-library and the city hydrologic simulation model library, fusing a simulation result and knowledge rules, and generating an early warning rule related to a specific hydrologic event scene. The invention realizes the unification of hydrologic situation dynamic sensing and accurate identification, improves the timeliness of emergency response, and can provide scientific and intelligent support for urban hydrologic disaster management decision. The invention is supported by the state important research and development subject complex space scene situation identification and virtual-real mutual feedback (2022 YFB 3904104).

title_en: System for recording and storing data of water supply facilities
title_ko: 상·하수도처리 시설의 데이터 기록 및 저장을 위한 시스템 및 블랙박스
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for recording and storing the data of a water and sewage treatment facility and black box thereof are provided to prevent the loss of data by recording and storing the facility data of the water and sewage treatment facility in a protection capsule including emergency power. CONSTITUTION: A center management server(110) collects facility data from sensors in which are installed in a water and sewage treatment facility and integrates the facility data. An audio and video acquisition apparatus(120) acquires the audio or video signal of the center control room where includes the center management server. A black box(130) periodically compresses the facility data and the video or audio signal. A data storage apparatus(140) includes emergency power and memory which stores the compressed data. A data analysis apparatus(150) analyzes data in which is stored in the memory of the data storage apparatus.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 상수도처리 시설의 데이터 기록 및 저장을 위한 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상수도처리시설 각각에 설치된 각 센서로부터 설비 데이터를 수집하여 통합하는 중앙 관리 서버, 상기 중앙 관리 서버가 존재하는 중앙 조정실의 오디오 신호 또는 영상 신호를 획득하는 오디오/영상 획득 장치, 상기 중앙 관리 서버로부터의 설비 데이터, 상기 오디오/영상 획득 장치로부터의 영상 신호 또는 오디오 신호를 주기적으로 압축하는 블랙박스 및 상기 블랙박스에서 압축된 데이터를 저장하는 메모리 및 전용예비전원이 포함된 데이터 저장 장치로 구성된다.  
따라서, 본 발명에 따르면, 상수도처리 시설에 대한 설비 데이터가 전용예비전원을 포함한 Fixed Type의 보호된 캡슐에 의해 기록ㆍ저장되므로, 상수도시설에 재해(정전, 화재, 홍수)나 사고가 발생하더라도 데이터 소실을 방지할 수 있고, 운전원(당직근무자)에 의한 데이터 조작 및 훼손에 대한 원인을 규명할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라, 원인규명을 위한 기간과 소요경비를 대폭 경감시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Emergency call recording device for train
title_ko: 전동차용 비상통화 녹음장치
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an emergency call recording device for a train provides a technique which enables an emergency situation control server to command to record emergency call content by transmitting an emergency situation notifying signal to the emergency call recording device installed in the train when a voice signal is analyzed to determine that an emergency situation actually occurs if an emergency situation generated around the train or in a car of the train is transmitted to the emergency situation control server through an emergency contact terminal by the voice signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 전동차용 비상통화 녹음장치는, 전동차의 객차 내 또는 전동차 주변에서 발생된 비상상황을 비상연락 단말을 통해 비상상황 관제서버로 음성 신호를 전송하면, 상기 비상상황 관제서버는 상기 음성 신호를 분석하여 실제 비상상황이 발생하였다고 판단한 경우, 비상상황 알림신호를 상기 전동차 내부에 설치된 비상통화 녹음장치로 전송하여 비상 통화 내용을 녹음하도록 명령하는 기술을 제공함에 기술적 특징이 있다.

title_en: Smart care walker and management system using the same
title_ko: 스마트 케어 보행기 및 관리 시스템
abstract_en: A smart care walker of the present invention comprising a walker body and a plurality of walker wheels for moving the same further comprises: a detachable panel provided to attach and detach a smart device to and from the walker body; a near-field communication tag (NFC tag) mounted on the detachable panel for communicating with the smart device; a walking sensor module measuring a walking amount according to an operation of the walker wheel; and a control circuit configured to provide walking amount measurement information measured by the walking sensor module to the smart device through the communication unit. The smart device comprises an NFC communication module, a GPS sensor, a data communication module, and an application execution environment, and includes a walker application for providing the waling amount measurement information provided by the NFC tag and location-based information measured by the GPS sensor to a remote location through an internet communication network. The smart care walker and a management system thereof can assist rehabilitation treatment of a patient and can support the rehabilitation patient care of medical staffs and caregivers in real time, thereby improving a rehabilitation treatment effect. In addition, it is possible to immediately respond to emergency situations such as safety accidents which may occur during the use of walker, thereby preventing additional accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 스마트 케어 보행기는 보행기 본체와 이를 이동시키기 위한 복수개의 보행기 휠이 구비된 보행기에 있어서, 상기 보행기 본체에 스마트 기기를 탈부착 할 수 있도록 구비되는 탈부착 패널, 상기 탈부착 패널에 장착되어 스마트 기기와 통신하기 위한 NFC 태그(near-field communication tag), 상기 보행기 휠의 동작에 따라 보행량을 측정하는 보행 센서 모듈, 및 상기 보행 센서 모듈에서 측정되는 보행량 측정 정보를 상기 통신부를 통해서 스마트 기기로 제공하는 제어 회로를 포함한다.  상기 스마트 기기는 NFC 통신 모듈, GPS 센서, 데이터 통신 모듈, 및 응용프로그램 실행 환경을 구비하고, 상기 NFC 태그를 통해서 제공되는 상기 보행량 측정 정보와 상기 GPS 센서에 의해 측정되는 위치 기반 정보를 인터넷 통신망을 통해서 원격지로 제공하는 보행기 어플리케이션을 포함한다.  이러한 스마트 케어 보행기 및 이의 관리 시스템은 환자의 재활 치료를 돕고, 의료진이나 보호자의 재활 환자 케어를 실시간으로 지원할 수 있어서 재활 치료 효과를 높일 수 있다.  또한 보행기 이용 과정에서 일어날 수 있는 안전사고 등의 비상 상황 발생시 즉각적으로 대처할 수 있어서 제2차 3차의 추가적인 안전사고 발생을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Educational Robots, Foreign Language Learning Method Using Educational Robots, and Media Recorded with Program Executing Foreign Language Learning Method
title_ko: 교육용 로봇, 교육용 로봇을 이용한 외국어 학습 방법 및 교육용 로봇을 이용한 외국어 학습 방법을 실행시키는 프로그램이 기록된 기록 매체
abstract_en: Disclosed are an educational robot, a foreign language learning method using an educational robot, and a recording medium recording a program executing the foreign language learning method by using the educational robot. The foreign language learning method using an educational robot is implemented by the following steps of: allowing an educational robot to receive a first language voice command of a user; allowing the educational robot to perform an operation according to the first language voice command; receiving a second language voice command with the same content as the first language voice command; performing an operation according to the second language voice command; and allowing the educational robot to determine whether an operation performance result according to the first language voice command and an operation performance result of the second language voice command match. According to the present invention, provided is an educational robot enabling a user to successfully perform foreign language learning together with learning for coding.
abstract_ko: 교육용 로봇, 교육용 로봇을 이용한 외국어 학습 방법 및 교육용 로봇을 이용한 외국어 학습 방법을 실행시키는 프로그램이 기록된 기록 매체가 개시된다. 본 발명은, 교육용 로봇이 사용자의 제1 언어 음성 명령을 입력받고, 교육용 로봇이 제1 언어 음성 명령에 따른 동작을 수행하며, 제1 언어 음성 명령과 동일한 내용의 제2 언어 음성 명령을 입력받고, 제2 언어 음성 명령에 따른 동작을 수행하며, 교육용 로봇이 제1 언어 음성 명령에 따른 동작 수행 결과와 제2 언어 음성 명령의 동작 수행 결과의 일치 여부를 판단하는 과정을 통해 구현된다. 본 발명에 따르면, 사용자가 코딩에 대한 학습과 함께 외국어 학습을 성공적으로 수행할 수 있도록 하는 교육용 로봇이 제공된다.

title_en: Coding robot apparatus including control module linkable to coding simulation board
title_ko: 코딩 시뮬레이션 보드와 연동 가능한 제어 모듈을 포함하는 코딩 로봇 장치
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, a coding robot apparatus performing an IoT function includes: a control module generating and outputting a control signal corresponding to a control command and including control target information and control detail information by using a program coded by a user when the control command is inputted; a robot control board allowing the control module to be attached thereto or detached therefrom, including a plurality of control targets, and outputting the control signal to a control target indicated by the control target information among the plurality of control targets when the control signal is inputted from the control module; a robot frame including a main frame and a plurality of sub frames corresponding to robot parts, respectively; and a robot skin attached to or detached from the robot frame to form a robot shape. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing an IoT service to a user and creating a design effect of the coding robot apparatus.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 IoT 기능을 수행하는 코딩 로봇 장치는 제어 명령이 입력되면 사용자로부터 코딩된 프로그램을 이용하여 상기 제어 명령에 대응되고 제어 대상 정보 및 제어 내용 정보를 포함하는 제어 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 제어 모듈; 상기 제어 모듈이 탈부착되고, 복수의 제어 대상을 포함하며, 상기 제어 모듈로부터 상기 제어 신호가 입력되면 상기 복수의 제어 대상 중에서 상기 제어 대상 정보가 나타내는 제어 대상으로 상기 제어 신호를 출력하는 로봇 제어 보드; 로봇 부위 각각에 대응되는 메인 프레임과 복수의 서브 프레임을 포함하는 로봇 프레임; 및 상기 로봇 프레임에 탈부착되어 로봇 형상을 구성하는 로봇 스킨;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Simulation combat training system capable of tactical command
title_ko: 전술지휘가 가능한 모의 전투훈련 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전술지휘가 가능한 모의 전투훈련 시스템에 관한 것으로, 사용자에 장착되고, 음성 송수신 장치가 마련되는 통신부; 상기 사용자에게 전투훈련 프로그램의 배경화면을 제공하는 스크린부; 상기 사용자가 소총수인 경우 사용되며, 소총 형상으로 마련되고, 상기 사용자에 의해 조작되어 격발됨으로써, 제1 격발정보를 생성하는 제1 총기부; 상기 사용자가 저격수인 경우 사용되며, 저격소총 형상으로 마련되고, 상기 사용자에 의해 조작되어 격발됨으로써, 제2 격발정보를 생성하는 제2 총기부; 상기 사용자가 소총수인 경우 사용되며, 지면과 단차를 가지도록 형성되고,  상기 스크린부가 설치되며, 상기 사용자에게 상기 전투훈련 프로그램의 진행을 위한 공간을 제공하는 제1 스테이지부; 상기 사용자가 저격수인 경우 사용되며, 지면과 단차를 가지도록 형성되고,  상기 사용자에게 상기 전투훈련 프로그램의 진행을 위한 공간을 제공하는 제2 스테이지부; 및 상기 통신부와, 상기 스크린부와, 상기 제1 총기부와, 상기 제2 총기부와, 상기 제1 스테이지부와, 상기 제2 스테이지부에 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 전투훈련 프로그램에 대한 데이터가 저장되며, 상기 스크린부에서 표시되는 상기 배경화면을 변화시키고, 상기 제1 격발정보 및 상기 제2 격발정보에 따라 상기 전투훈련 프로그램을 진행시키는 연산부를 포함하고, 상기 연산부는, 상기 사용자가 지휘관인 경우, 상기 스크린부에 상기 전투훈련 프로그램의 진행 상황을 전체적으로 파악할 수 있는 전술지휘용 화면을 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 가상의 화면을 이용함으로써, 다양한 상황에 대응할 수 있도록 실전적인 모의 전투훈련 프로그램을 진행할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of distribution network failure repairing receipt auditing system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of distribution network failures to repair receipt auditing system, belong to electric power project engineering field, the data acquisition equipment of the system is used to receive and show the fault ticket that emergency command issues, makes a report on fault handling information and upload fault ticket to data acquisition server；Data acquisition server is for obtaining fault ticket and being uploaded to worksheet system server；Worksheet system server to fault ticket for being accepted, being distributed, being audited and being paid a return visit operation.The present invention can carry out the operations such as the audit of distribution network failure repairing work order, and scene rush to repair is recorded and accepts work order information and compare automatically after breakdown repair commanding is by the receipt of breakdown repair, and final analysis result is labeled and gives breakdown repair personnel, judge whether receipt is qualified, effectively shorten the analytical judgment time of staff, reduce unqualified work order quantity, ensure that the quality of failure emergency first-aid repair.

title_en: Sit-up detection system and method based on human body and skeleton key point identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sit-up detection system and a sit-up detection method based on human body and bone key point identification, wherein the sit-up detection system comprises: the image acquisition module acquires a video image of the testee by adopting a high-definition camera; the image identification module is used for extracting human skeleton key points of the testee in the continuous frames; the action detection module is used for detecting the change condition of an included angle formed by a straight line formed by the waist key point and the shoulder key point and a relative horizontal position of the human skeleton key point of the tested person in the continuous frames to judge whether the tested person lies down or sits up or lies down to sit up; the judging and counting module is used for judging and recording the times of the sit-up of the testee in the testing time; and the data display module is used for displaying the times of the sit-up completed by the testee within the test time. The invention has the advantages of high detection speed and low cost, is suitable for single-person or multi-person detection, and can be applied to sports home operation, exercise detection in an emergency response state and other scenes.

title_en: Processing system using a traffic accident insurers linked external communication module equipped with a black box device
title_ko: 보험사 연계용 외장형 통신모듈이 구비된 블랙박스장치를 이용한 교통사고 처리 시스템

title_en: Augmented reality-based educational programming language authoring system using block smart toys
title_ko: 블록형 스마트토이를 활용한 증강현실 기반 교육용 프로그래밍언어 저작 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an augmented reality (AR)-based educational programming language (EPL) authoring system using a block type smart toy, which is capable of realizing EPL authoring through a combination of block modules, a physical interface, for overcoming problems in physical configuration and content expandability, which are limitation of an existing software educational smart toy, and realizing effects of the EPL authoring in AR content. More specifically, the AR-based EPL authoring system comprises: at least one block type smart toy having a rectangular parallelepiped block shape and having an identification part corresponding to a command disposed on each surface; an AR marker sheet including a predetermined pattern; a photographing unit including a first photographing unit photographing the block type smart toy and a second photographing unit photographing the marker sheet; a block processing unit recognizing the identification part from an image of the first photographing unit to complete one execution sentence; an image processing unit recognizing the pattern from an image of the second photographing unit to convert the pattern into an AR image, and reflecting an execution result of the execution sentence of the block processing unit to the AR image; and a display unit displaying at least one among the images of the first and second photographing units and the image processing unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 기존 SW교육형 스마트토이의 한계인 물리적 구성 및 콘텐츠의 확장성 문제를 극복하기 위한 피지컬(Physical) 인터페이스인 블록 모듈의 결합을 통해 교육용 프로그래밍 언어(EPL: Educational Programming Language) 저작을 가능하게 하고 그 효과를 증강현실(AR: Augmented Reality)콘텐츠로 구현할 수 있는 블록형 스마트토이를 활용한 증강현실 기반 교육용 프로그래밍언어 저작 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는, 직육면체의 블록 형태를 가지며, 각 면마다 명령어에 대응되는 식별부가 구비된 적어도 하나의 블록형 스마트토이; 설정된 패턴을 포함하는 증강현실 마커지; 상기 블록형 스마트토이를 촬영하는 제1촬영부와 상기 마커지를 촬영하는 제2촬영부를 포함하는 촬영부; 상기 제1촬영부의 영상으로부터 상기 식별부를 인식하여 하나의 실행문장을 완성하는 블록처리부; 상기 제2촬영부의 영상으로부터 상기 패턴을 인식하여 증강현실영상으로 변환하며, 상기 블록처리부의 실행문장에 따른 실행결과를 상기 증강현실영상에 반영시키는 영상처리부; 및 상기 제1촬영부, 제2촬영부 및 영상처리부에 의한 영상 중 적어도 어느 하나를 나타내는 디스플레이부;를 포함하는 블록형 스마트토이를 활용한 증강현실 기반 교육용 프로그래밍언어 저작 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_ko: 재난 상황 전파 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 상황 전파 시스템에 관한 것으로, 정부 재난관리 서버와 이동통신 단말기에 전용 프로그램이나 재난신고전파용앱을 설치하여, 교통 사고, 산불 등 주변의 재난 상황을 인지할 경우 신속하고 효율적으로 신고 및 전파할 수 있게 하며, 아울러 불필요한 재난 정보를 자동으로 차단할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and method for synchronizing incident response profiles across distinct computing platforms
abstract_en: A synchronized incident response system is distributed across one or more user devices and a host server. Each device has a stored version of an incident response profile for a defined location, the profile having version numbers corresponding to a set of data values for one or more attributes specific to the defined area. Each device is linked to the server and can transmit data records with changes to profile attributes, wherein the server determines whether the user changes are valid updates with respect to what is already stored in server memory. If so, the server synchronizes the profile attributes to generate a current profile and generates incremented version numbers. Each device can provide an incident response request for the defined area to the server, wherein the server generates an incident response report populated with data corresponding to a latest version number for each of one or more predetermined attributes.

title_en: Mobile communication platform
abstract_en: A communication vehicle system or platform that provides for the integration of multiple audio, visual, telecommunications, thermal, radiological, chemical and biological data detection and/or communication devices. The communication vehicle can be configured for providing mobile communications and surveillance in an environment in which the surrounding communications and/or power infrastructure has been damaged or is non-existent. For example, the vehicle can be deployed to the scene of a disaster or emergency. Accordingly, the mobility of the preferred communication vehicle can enhance and extend the reach of any emergency operations center. Other possible applications include law enforcement surveillance; tactical military command and control; weather and storm chasing; homeland security search and rescue; forward deployment monitoring, news agencies and border patrol. It can be operated in a stand-alone mode or act as a versatile forward-deployable remote vehicle while communicating to a rear command center.

title_en: Multifunctional fire fighting helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a multifunctional fire fighting helmet belongs to security against fire technical field. This multifunctional fire fighting helmet includes casing and intelligent control device, the casing includes aerogel layer, the outer shell, and buffer layer and inner liner, aerogel layer wraps up on the surface of outer shell, and the buffer layer is located between outer shell and the inner liner, does intelligent control device include x IMU fine positioning device, the body temperature detector, smoke transducer, the harmful gas sensor, environment temperature transducer, bone conduction headset makes a video recording and speech device, data processing device, communication device and power, X IMU fine positioning device, the body temperature detector, smoke transducer, the harmful gas sensor, environment temperature transducer, bone conduction headset makes a video recording and speech device, and communication device and power all are connected with data processing device. The utility model discloses collect high temperature resistant, accurate positioning, control and warning function characteristics, can effectively realize the control, do benefit to centralized monitoring, receive instruction, command and arrangement.

title_ko: 너울을 이용한 발전 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 실용신안은 너울을 이용하여 발전을 하는 시스템으로 너울이 심한 곳은 연안에 방파제가 설치되어 있으나 태풍이 오면 방파제가 유실되거나 인명사고 등 피해가 심하면서 또 그 장소가 너울이 심하여 너울 발전 장소로는 좋은 장소라는 장점이 있어 1차적으로 너울의 힘을 이용 발전을 일으켜 너울의 힘을 감소시키고 2차로 방파제에서 연안쇄파를 부수어 방파제도 보호하고 발전도 하는 너울 발전 시스템으로 접수번호 1-1-2011-5018525-24, 출원번호 10-2011-0060511, 서류명 특허 출원서 내용에서 보조 실린더가 간만의 차가 심한 장소에서 사용하려면 간만의 차만큼 실린더와 피스톤 로드 길이가 길어져야 하는 불편이 있으며 긴 피스톤 로드는 제작도 힘들지만 좌굴(휨) 현상이 발생할 수 있어 간만의 차가 심한 곳은 유압 장치 실을 물높이에 따라 상하 이동시켜 간만의 차가 없는 조건에서 너울을 이용 발전하는 조건으로 만들어 발전하며, 물높이 조정은 컴퓨터 프로그램에 물때를 입력 물때에 맞추어 유압 실린더에 유압유를 주입하고 빼고 하여 유압 장치실을 보조 주축 고정 빔을 기준으로 상하 이동시키는 방법을 사용하며, 너울에 부력 판이 좌우 앞뒤로 힘을 받아 쏠리는 현상에 대처하기 위하여 보조 주축 주위 4면에 롤러를 설치하여 부력 판이 부력에 의하여 상승 시 부력 판이 자유롭게 움직이기 때문에 반작용에 의하여 어느 한쪽으로 쏠림 현상이 일어나 보조 주축 하나나 둘 셋에 힘이 집중되는 것을 막기 위하여 보조 주축 4면에 롤러를 설치 4개의 기둥이 동시에 힘을 받도록 하였으며 유압 실린더의 압축 유압유를 바로 유압 모터로 보내 발전하지  않고 어큐뮬레이터로 보내 어큐뮬레이터에 일단 저장하여 필요시 일정량의 유압유를 유압 모터에 보내 발전하는 너울 발전 시스템.
