title_en: Public safety site-oriented vehicle-mounted dynamic monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted dynamic monitoring system and a monitoring method for a public safety site. The invention realizes the monitoring and recording of the vehicle driving process by storing the high-definition video data obtained by the image acquisition equipment into the high-speed storage unit through the mSATA interface after decoding and compressing. The invention can also connect the vehicle-mounted terminal to a background data processing center in cooperation with a 4G communication module, and the background data processing center processes the acquired flammable and combustible detection data, vehicle-mounted electronic information, command commands, positioning data, navigation data and video monitoring signals in real time to generate corresponding command data, wherein the command data comprises video monitoring signals, emergency stop signals, one-key window breaking signals or contact vehicle interception signals and the like to the vehicle-mounted terminal, so that the remote monitoring of the vehicle running state is realized.

title_en: Information acquisition method for community fire socialized emergency rescue
abstract_en: The invention provides an information acquisition method for social emergency rescue of community fire, and belongs to the technical field of emergency rescue. According to the method, based on community fire rescue site risk information analysis, a risk information classification index is established, rapid collection, processing and transmission of rescue site risk information, personnel information and rescue equipment information are achieved aiming at community fire social emergency rescue, a smart phone carrying small program and a two-dimensional code are selected as a way for collecting and analyzing accident site risk information, participation of the masses in the community fire emergency rescue process is expanded, comprehensiveness of information collection and timeliness of information processing are improved, meanwhile, emergency response capability of social emergency rescue personnel on an emergency scene is enhanced, and off-site emergency command efficiency is improved. The method provides decision reference for community fire scene information acquisition, risk dynamic evaluation, auxiliary decision and emergency command research.
assignees: UNIV BEIJING SCIENCE & TECH;CHINA NAT INST STANDARDIZATION;BEIJING RES CENTER OF URBAN SYSTEM ENGINEERING

title_en: Multi-device remote transmission control method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of Internet of things, in particular to a multi-device remote transmission control method and a multi-device remote transmission control system, aiming at solving the problems that in the prior art, law enforcement work is carried out according to fixed frequency transmission of law enforcement records, the law enforcement records cannot be obtained timely by a command terminal when criminal behaviors occur, and the efficiency of command scheduling can be reduced, and the technical scheme is that the multi-device remote transmission control method comprises the following steps: collecting law enforcement information and generating a law enforcement record packet; transmitting the law enforcement record packet to a command terminal according to a preset normal frequency; acquiring behavior characteristics of law enforcement personnel, carrying out intensity analysis on the behavior characteristics, and acquiring the behavior characteristic intensity of the law enforcement personnel; when the behavior characteristic strength exceeds a preset response threshold value, the transmission frequency of the law enforcement record packet is adjusted from the normal frequency to the preset response frequency, and the response frequency is higher than the normal frequency.

title_en: Traffic security management police APP system based on automobile data recorder and monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic security management police APP system based on a vehicle event data recorder and a monitoring system, which comprises the following functional designs: 1. the traffic security management police APP system login is divided into two account numbers: 2. after an accident occurs, citizens report an alarm and log in an APP to upload field data, automobile data recorder video data and geographic positions; 3. the jurisdiction dispatching place coordinates police number through the data on the APP; 4. after the police arrive at the scene, performing evidence collection and responsibility judgment through the APP on-vehicle data recorder and road monitoring probe video; 5. after accident handling, the policemen saves the case-related data through the APP and serves as evidence to be reserved. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that: the invention provides a traffic security management police APP system based on a vehicle event recorder and a monitoring system, which can realize the effects of comprehensive collection, rapid evidence obtaining and accurate judgment when traffic accidents occur, save time for processing traffic security events and improve the public belief of disposal.

title_en: Traffic monitoring and emergency processing system and method based on 5G network slice
abstract_en: The invention provides a traffic monitoring and emergency processing system and method based on 5G network slicing, comprising a vehicle unit, a roadside base station, a roadside unmanned aerial vehicle unit and a traffic data center; the method comprises a traffic monitoring method and an accident emergency treatment method; according to the invention, the base station is used for establishing different priority slice networks so as to quickly respond to traffic accidents, and a quick rescue network of emergency interaction departments and traffic accident sites is established (rescue, fire control and the like), so that the 5G network resource priority of the traffic accident emergency response is ensured, and the scientificity and timeliness of the traffic accident emergency treatment are improved. The traffic monitoring and accident emergency treatment are carried out by constructing two mode slices, namely a public network global monitoring network slice and a dynamic emergency sub-slice of a non-public network accident scene, and the traffic monitoring and accident emergency treatment device has the advantages of customizing, deploying quickly, dynamically switching and the like according to requirements while avoiding complex perception of a public network core network and a vehicle networking terminal to a 5G public network.

title_en: Shelter emergency power supply processing method and system suitable for extreme environment
abstract_en: The application provides a shelter emergency power supply processing method and system suitable for an extreme environment. The method comprises the steps of detecting and recording extreme condition parameters of the environment where the shelter is located, generating an environment risk assessment report, dynamically adjusting the load distribution ratio between a main power supply and a standby power supply according to the environment risk assessment report, carrying out thermal management analysis on an internal circuit of a power supply system, generating an optimized power supply distribution scheme, immediately starting an emergency response mechanism when the system detects that an emergency situation occurs in the shelter, generating an electric power distribution adjustment record under the emergency situation, and executing comprehensive power supply system health inspection by using the electric power distribution adjustment record under the emergency situation after the extreme environment condition is relieved, and generating a detailed maintenance report. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the reliability and stability of the power supply system, improves the emergency response capability, ensures the power supply of key equipment, reduces the maintenance cost and improves the energy utilization efficiency.
assignees: CSSC HAISHEN MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster monitoring system and method based on iron tower big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a geological disaster monitoring system and method based on big data of an iron tower, and relates to the technical field of geological disaster monitoring. The system comprises an iron tower monitoring node module, an edge calculation module, a data transmission module, a cloud big data processing and analyzing module, a visualization and early warning issuing module and an emergency response and decision support module. The intelligent monitoring system for the geological disaster is characterized in that the communication tower resources are provided with various sensing devices, low-cost large-scale deployment is realized, monitoring coverage is enlarged, accuracy and reliability of geological disaster monitoring are improved, collected data are locally preprocessed through an edge computing module and are transmitted to a cloud end in real time by utilizing a 4G/5G network, real-time monitoring and quick response of the data are realized, timeliness of the monitored data is greatly improved, an intelligent analysis early warning system is established through a cloud end big data processing and analyzing module, and multi-source data analysis and risk assessment are carried out by integrating machine learning and an artificial intelligent algorithm, so that the early warning accuracy is improved.

title_en: Mine safety early warning emergency management decision and linkage response system based on scene-quick response chain-coping
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mine safety early warning emergency management decision and linkage response system based on a scene-quick response chain-coping, and belongs to the technical field of mine safety early warning emergency management decision and linkage response. The system comprises modules for multi-element information acquisition and input, multi-chain data fusion, disaster situation analysis and evaluation display, knowledge graph-based emergency knowledge center, command scheduling and emergency capability evaluation display, intelligent emergency information receiving and release, emergency exercise and training and the like. The emergency management closed loop based on knowledge, expert group intelligence, emergency flow and intelligent decision rule sets is realized. The invention can effectively improve the scientificity, compliance and timeliness of mine safety emergency management decision and linkage response, and improve the level of mine safety service guarantee and the working efficiency.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST;Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region Mine Safety Service Guarantee Center

title_en: Intelligent grading early warning linkage calling routing method and system for meteorological and water conservancy disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent grading early warning linkage call routing method and system for meteorological and water conservancy disasters. And establishing a cross-department data fusion channel by constructing a meteorological water conservancy double-factor early warning matrix, developing an early warning coupling model, and realizing multi-dimensional early warning fusion. And (3) formulating a water conservancy special response strategy library, including river channel water level hierarchical routing and mountain torrent risk area customization strategies. And developing intelligent water conservancy enhancement modules, such as a flood control engineering topology analysis engine and a water rain condition semantic analyzer. The method has the characteristics and innovative characteristics of constructing a three-element risk rating model, a double-dimensional-based hydraulic emergency response topological network, a hydraulic engineering BIM data and weather early warning space superposition analysis module and the like by an initial dynamic coupling algorithm. The accuracy and the comprehensiveness of disaster early warning can be improved, the timeliness and the effectiveness of emergency response are ensured, and the intelligent level and the disaster response capability of the system are improved.
assignees: DONGSHEN ZHISHUI TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Safety production accident emergency response method and system based on industrial meta universe
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of industrial Internet, in particular to a safety production accident emergency response method and system based on industrial meta universe, which are characterized in that real-time incremental extraction and lightweight coding capacity is deployed at a sensing edge, and continuous space-time prediction based on a neural differential equation and quick decision optimization of meta reinforcement learning are combined at a rear end. The invention can realize the closed loop emergency response of full link, high timeliness and low delay from the perception of decision, and remarkably improves the timeliness and accuracy of the decision. The invention can solve or at least reduce the problems of redundant data transmission, processing delay, situation update lag and insufficient decision timeliness and accuracy in the existing industrial meta-universe emergency response, and provides a safety production accident emergency response method and system based on the industrial meta-universe.
assignees: HENAN XINANLI SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en: To prepare for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.SOLUTION: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and a viewer for mobile assets include a data encoder, an onboard data manager and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360-degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. In a near real-time mode, a full record comprising five minutes of data is stored to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in a real-time mode, video data is streamed to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Thus, remotely located users can view video, audio, and data in various display modes through a web browser or a virtual reality device.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Web site evaluation system of improving the reliability
title_ko: 신뢰도가 향상된 웹사이트 평가 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a system for evaluating a website with improved reliability. The system for evaluating the website with the improved reliability according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: an application programming interface (API) unit which performs communications between a web surfing program of a user and the evaluation system. The evaluation system comprises: a flow processing unit, a user module, a comment module, an URI evaluation module, a user evaluation module, and a database. The flow processing unit receives a command signal and a data signal transmitted to the API unit from the web surfing program, and transmits the command signal and the data signal to the web surfing program through the API unit. The user module manages the member information of the user. The comment module manages a comment inputted from the user. The URI evaluation module manages evaluation for a uniform resource identifier (URI) executed in the web surfing program. The user evaluation module manages the evaluation for other users performed by the user. The database stores data. The present invention is provided to enable the user to minimize a registration action and a log-in action, minimize an intentional feedback operation through limiting the same IP evaluation number, and reflect an account reliability score, thereby performing a self-purification function among users.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전술한 바와 같은 문제점을 감안하여 안출한 것으로, 신뢰도가 향상된 웹사이트 평가 시스템을 제공함을 목적으로 한다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 신뢰도가 향상된 웹사이트 평가 시스템은, 사용자의 웹서핑 프로그램과 평가 시스템 사이에서 통신을 수행하는 API(Application Programming Interface)부를 포함하고, 상기 평가 시스템은, 
상기 웹서핑 프로그램으로부터 상기 API부에 전송되는 명령 신호 및 데이터 신호를 수신하고, 상기 API부를 통해 상기 웹서핑 프로그램에 명령 신호 및 데이터 신호를 전송하는 흐름처리부와, 상기 사용자의 회원정보를 관리하는 사용자 모듈과, 상기 사용자로부터 입력되는 댓글을 관리하는 댓글 모듈과, 상기 웹서핑 프로그램에서 실행되는 URI(Uniform Resource Identifier)에 대한 평가를 관리하는 URI평가모듈과, 상기 사용자가 수행하는 타 사용자에 대한 평가를 관리하는 사용자평가모듈과, 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이를 통해, 사용자가 최소한의 가입과 로그인 행위를 하도록 하고, 동일 IP평가 횟수 제한을 통해 의도적인 피드백 조작을 최소화 할 수 있고, 계정 신뢰점수를 반영시켜 사용자 간에 자체 정화 기능이 수행될 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Fire department garage door device
title_ko: 소방서 차고용 도어 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a door apparatus for a fire station garage, which comprises: a door unit installed on an entrance of the fire station garage and made of a door for returning from an escape from an impact; a UPS unit supplying power for opening the door of the door unit in case of a power outage; and a log recording unit recording the relevant time and the number of times each time the door unit opens the door, connecting the relevant records to the dispatch of a fire truck, and storing the records as a dispatch history of the fire truck in a database. Therefore, the risk of accidents can be reduced.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방서 차고용 도어 장치에 관한 것으로, 소방서 차고의 출입구에 설치되고 충격 이탈 복구형 도어로 이루어지는 도어부; 정전 시 상기 도어부의 도어 개방을 위한 전원을 공급하는 UPS부; 및 상기 도어부가 도어를 개방할 때마다 해당 시간 및 횟수를 기록하고 해당 기록을 소방차의 출동과 연계시켜 상기 소방차의 출동이력으로 데이터베이스에 저장하는 로그기록부를 포함한다.

title_en: A system and method for drivers training
abstract_en: A system for drivers training where the system has one or more in vehicle cameras (2), one or more remote cameras( 10) several signal inputs for speed, consumptions, speed of vehicle etc (3), an on -board computer (1) or the vehicle or the vessel is wirelessly connected to a remote computing function that can process and store recordings or measurements, and where the recordings may bet tagged in time and place, marked from a positioning system, and may have a time- jump to allow pressing the recording button to allow decision to record to be taken after an incident has happened, wherein the computer or computing function is adapted to implement a process control function where accelerators (8) will measure and give feedback on the comfort and fuel efficiency of the driving and/or where sensors will indicate when the teacher uses his "take-over-pedals" ( 9), said process control function being adapted to trigger said tagging and/or recording.
assignees: DRIVING PERFORMANCE SOLUTIONS AS;ROALD ARNE;HALVORSEN RUNE

title_en: Evidence Management System and Method
abstract_en: A method, system, and computer program product for managing evidence. An evidence management system comprises a computer system that stores information about an incident in evidence records for a witness zones. The evidence records are associated with witness zones for storing evidence for the incident. The witness zones are areas from which the evidence is collected. The computer system collects the evidence for the incident from client devices in the witness zones based on the evidence records. The computer system analyzes the evidence collected for the incident in the evidence records based on the witness zones from which the evidence was collected, enabling the computer system to reduce an amount of time to collect the evidence for the incident.

title_en: Systems to infer identities of persons of interest rapidly and alert first responders
abstract_en: Systems, devices, and technical methods of the present disclosure leverage digital visitor logs from confinement facilities to identify people of interest that may be involved in incidents to which first responders are dispatched. When a phone call is received at phone public safety access point, a first query including a name associated with the call is transmitted to a digital visitor log for a confinement facility. A digital response to the first query identifies a visitee who was visited by a visitor by that name while the visitee was in confinement. The visitee's name is then transmitted in a second query to a digital repository containing release records; a digital response indicates the visitee was released before the call was received. An electronic notification that identifies the visitee is transmitted to a device associated with an agent who is responding to the call.

title_en: Road section operation state early warning method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a road section running state early warning method, a road section running state early warning device and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring road section information of each road section in a preset electronic map, and respectively judging whether the road condition data, the traffic dispatching data, the entrance and exit traffic data and the congestion state data meet corresponding preset congestion judgment conditions or not for each road section; if the road condition data, the traffic and dispatching data, the entrance and exit traffic data or the congestion state data of any road section meet the corresponding congestion judgment condition, determining that the road section is congested and giving out early warning on the electronic map and a preset road network diagram, so that the acquisition precision and timeliness of the running state data of the expressway network are effectively improved, the early warning precision of the congested road section is further improved, support is provided for traffic dispersion and emergency command of a road management department, and the technical effect of guaranteeing the safe and smooth travel of the public is provided.

title_en: Fire rescue path optimization method and system based on integration of multiple algorithms
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire rescue path optimization method and system based on integration of multiple algorithms, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring an incident point through the Internet of things; s2, calculating the addresses of fire brigades around the incident point through GIS information according to the incident point; s3, calculating the linear distance between the incident point and the fire brigade, sequencing the fire brigade, and recording the information of the first ten fire brigade based on the short distance; screening a plurality of fire brigade endpoints which meet the conditions according to the fire brigade information and based on a deep learning algorithm; s4, calculating an optimal path from the incident point to each fire brigade terminal point based on each screened fire brigade terminal point and the optimized ant colony algorithm; s5, based on dynamic factors, selecting the minimum route length and the optimal final route from the multiple calculated optimal routes; the dynamic factors comprise traffic road conditions, single and double numbers, charging, new accident points, accident point cancellation and road construction conditions.

title_en: Remote control's many function synthesis command car of track type
abstract_en: The application relates to a remote control track type multifunctional integrated command vehicle which comprises a track system, a vehicle body, a lifting system, a driving motor, a communication command module, a storage battery and a power supply system. The application can feed back real-time video and detection information acquired by the car body to the command center, the command center can remotely control the car body to move along the track system through the communication command module, and the on-site image is recorded, so that the functions of daily supervision, accident emergency command, congestion management, accident early warning, road surface icing detection and the like are realized. The application can effectively reduce the illegal and illegal phenomena of the road, reduce the running safety risk, timely conduct emergency command and early warning on the accident scene after the accident occurs, reduce the congestion phenomenon and traffic jam time, reduce the occurrence probability of secondary accidents and improve the safe running efficiency.

title_en: Radiological dose modeling system for emergency response
title_ko: 방사능 예측 모델링 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a modeling system for radiation dose prediction, which is a system of modeling radiation doses for predicting and managing radiation exposure through a modeling technique. The system of the present invention is composed of the Lagrangian particle dispersion model (LPDM) for calculating the location and concentration of the relevant radiological particles; a meteorological field model for predicting past meteorological field information and future meteorological field information; and a Eulerian diffusion model (EDM) for receiving modeling data of the LPDM and meteorological data of the meteorological field model and performing modeling by having the spot of accident as the center, with a distance of 105 degrees latitude and 50 degrees longitude including a range of the LPDM model. According to the present invention, the system can predict radiation concentrations and doses in the Asian region and display an area in danger, thereby providing a quick response to radiation exposure accidents. abstract_ko: 방사능 예측 모델링 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명은 모델링 기법을 통해 방사능을 예측 및 관리하는 방사능 예측 모델링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해당 방사선 입자의 위치와 농도를 계산하는 라그랑지안 입자 확산 모델(LPDM)과, 과거기상정보와 미래 기상 정보를 예측하는 기상장 모델, 상기 LPDM모델의 모델링 자료와 상기 기상장 모델의 기상 정보를 입력받아 사고 지점을 중심으로 LPDM 모델 영역을 포함하여 위도 105도 경도 50도 거리의 모델링을 수행하는 오일러리안 확산 모델(EDM)로 구성하고, 아시아 지역의 방사능 농도 및 피폭량을 예측하고 위험 영역을 표출함으로써 방사능 누출 사고시 신속한 대응책을 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: CT FOR ATMOSPHERIC AND ENVIRONMENTAL MODELING CAEM

title_en: Block type apparatus for wirelessly inputting coding command and method using thereof
title_ko: 블록형 무선 코딩 명령어 입력 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 형태에 따른 블록형 무선 코딩 명령어 입력 장치는 메인 블록과, 메인 블록에 순차적으로 접속된 적어도 2 이상의 코딩 블록을 포함하는 코딩 블록 조립체와, 메인 블록에 접속된 적어도 2 이상의 코딩 블록에 대응하는 프로그램 코드를 메인 블록으로부터 수신하고, 수신된 프로그램 코드에 따른 동작을 수행하는 디바이스를 포함하며, 적어도 2 이상의 상기 코딩 블록들 중 적어도 하나는, 기 저장된 프로그램 코드에 따라 디바이스의 동작을 제어하기 위한 메모리 블록으로, 메모리 블록은, 통신부, 고유 아이디를 저장한 저장부, 및 적어도 2 이상의 코딩 블록 중 어느 하나 또는 메인 블록에 접속되면 통신부를 통해 메인 블록으로 고유 아이디를 전송하는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Coding training method and apparatus using coding puzzle
title_ko: 코딩퍼즐을 이용한 코딩교육 장치
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다양한 코딩 퍼즐을 재미있게 풀어가면서 동기부여와 집중력, 논리적 사고방식을 향상시킬 수 있고, 복잡한 명령어의 조합을 이용한 기존 코딩교육과 다르게 게임형식으로 접근하여 아이콘화한 명령어(전진, 회전, 반복, 공격, 방어) 블록을 활용한 직관적인 조작으로 문제 해결이 가능하면서 프로그래밍 경험이 없는 어린이부터 학생, 성인까지 컴퓨터 프로그래밍의 기본 기능을 학습할 수 있도록 한 코딩퍼즐을 이용한 코딩교육 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Disaster training device and disaster training system
title_ko: 가상현실을 기반으로 하는 구급대응 도상훈련시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a virtual reality-based emergency response simulation training system. According to the present invention, firefighting training is performed on a virtual reality platform. The virtual reality platform comprises a user unit, a connection unit, a virtual reality unit, and a management unit. According to the present invention, it is possible to enhance disaster response capabilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 ICT를 활용한 가상현실 플랫폼(1)상에서 재난 상황을 재연하고, 플랫폼에 접속한 다수의 소방관과 일반인이 소방훈련과 소방체험을 개별 또는 서로 협동하여 실시하되, 상기 플랫폼(1)은 네트워크 망에 연결되어 신호의 입력과 정보의 송수신 및 출력 가능토록 지원하는 유저부(100)와, 유저부(100)들의 동시 접속을 위한 인터넷망이 구축되고, 선택적으로 외부에 저장 관리되는 정보를 호출 및 출력하는 접속부(200)와, 접속부와 연동되어 재난 상황 연출을 위한 가상공간과 체험 오브젝트 및 유저별 맞춤 아바타를 모델링하고, 아바타의 행동과 유저부로부터 입력된 메세지를 가상공간에 출력시켜 상호 소통을 유도하며, 가상공간에 재난 상황을 이벤트별로 제공 및 관리하는 가상현실부(300)와, 유저부, 접속부, 가상현실부간 송수신되는 신호와 데이터 정보를 인계받아 관리 및 제어하고, 가상공간에 연출된 재난 상황에 대한 유저들의 대처 능력을 분석 및 평가하는 관리부(400)를 포함하는 구급대응 도상훈련시스템에 있어서, 상기 가상현실부(300)는 재난상황을 재연하기 위해 설정 지역의 건축물, 도로, 자연, 환자용 NPC(Non-Player Character), 구급 도구, 재난 훈련 및 체험 오브젝트를 구축함과 아울러 플랫폼 및 프로토타입을 기반으로 구축되며, 실제에 입각하여 전체 구조를 설계하고 제공할 수 있는 모델링 기능이 제공되고, 훈련 컨텐츠 및 UX 설계서 작성 기능이 제공되며, 클라이언트의 목표 환경 결정 기능이 제공되고, 플랫폼 서버 및 DB 설계서 작성 기능이 제공되며, 대처 방법에 따른 시나리오를 설계할 수 있고, 환자 중증도 분류 알고리즘(START, SALT, RTS), 환자케이스 관리를 위한 웹기반 CMS 기능을 제공하여 각각 특정 지역들을 3D 환경으로 재연한 가상공간을 형성할 수 있음과 아울러 재연된 가상공간에는 건물, 도로 또는 주변시설 등의 건축물 뿐만 아니라, 사고차량, 경찰차량, 구급차량, 소방차 외 화재나 균열 등의 이펙트가 표현되어 실제와 같은 장소를 연출할 수 있으며, 가상공간 상에 아바타와 소품, 애니메이션 등의 구성 요소가 기획됨과 아울러 이를 관리할 수 있는 DB가 제공되고, 세부 기능을 통해 환자 생성 패턴 및 환경에 따른 상호 작용이 가능한 모델링부(310)와, 유저 아바타의 행동 인식과 텍스트를 출력하여 가상공간에서 유저간 소통을 가능케 하고, 유저 아바타에게 재난 상황을 극복 및 대처할 수 있도록 상황을 안내하는 소통안내부(320)와, 접속부로부터 접속 여부를 판별 산출한 정보, 가상공간과 유저 아바타 및 재난 관련 오브젝트, 영상, 이미지 정보와 아바타의 이동 동선을 일괄 저장하고, 외부에 저장 관리되는 정보를 호출 및 수집하여 영상, 이미지, 재난 관련 오브젝트 정보로 분류 및 저장하는 데이터센터(330)와, 수신되는 입력신호에 따라 데이터센터에 저장된 정보를 설정 경로로 전송하는 송수신부(340)를 포함하고, 상기 환자용 NPC는 환자의 연령대와 성별을 설정하는 외형 설정부(A1)와, 가상공간상에서 환자의 위치를 설정하는 위치 설정부(A2)와, 환자의 상해 위치와 중증도를 설정하는 중증도 설정부(A3)로 이루어지되, 상기 중증도 설정부(A3)는 환자의 상태를 긴급, 응급, 비응급, 사망예상, 사망 단계로 분류하여 환자 증상에 따른 미션을 부여하고, 분류된 단계별로 설정의 색상을 부여하여 유저가 환자의 중증 상태를 시각적으로 안내받을 수 있게 제공하며, 대처 시간에 따른 환자용 NPC의 증상이 변화할 수 있도록 세부 설정이 가능한 것을 포함하고, 상기 접속부(200)는, 회원정보의 입력 및 외부에 저장 관리되는 정보를 호출 가능토록 하는 인터페이스부(210), 게스트와 회원으로 구분하여 입장을 안내하고, 게스트와 회원들의 입장 여부 관련 데이터를 수집 및 관리하고, 인터페이스부에 입력된 회원정보를 승인하는 회원가입부(220), 승인 회원에 대해 가상현실부의 입장을 허용 및 안내하는 접속안내부(230), 가상현실부에 실시간 소통 가능토록 함과 아울러 유니티툴로 개발한 룸(room) 형식의 클라우드 기반 서버로 가상공간에 유저부(100)의 다중 접속을 허용하는 포톤서버부(240)를 포함하여 이루어지며, 상기 소통안내부(320)는, 유저부(100)의 입력신호를 기반으로 아바타를 형성 및 커스텀마이징 기능이 제공되는 아바타 생성부(321), 가상공간에서 아바타의 행동 및 유저가 입력한 텍스트를 출력하는 소통 출력부(322), 유저부의 입력 신호에 따라 아바타의 시점을 제어하는 카메라 제어부(323), 시점을 따라 아바타의 이동을 가능케 하고, 유저부의 입력 신호에 따라 아바타의 모션을 형성하는 아바타 동작부(324), 가상공간상에 연출할 적어도 하나 이상의 화재나 붕괴, 교통사고, 천재지변이나 인명 피해와 관련된 재난 상황 이벤트를 생성, 편집, 출력되게 하며, 제작된 재난 상황 이벤트를 유포할 수도 있으며, 타 기업에서 제작된 재난 상황 이벤트를 불러와 현 플랫폼에 적용할 수도 있고, 관리자 페이지를 통해 재난 환경 이벤트의 플레이 시간을 유동적으로 설정할 수 있으며, 각각의 재난 상황 대처 능력을 평가하기 위한 난이도에 맞춰 시간 제한 모드나, 각종 미션 훈련을 적용시킬 수 있도록 형성되는 이벤트 관리부(325)를 포함하여 이루어지고, 상기 관리부(400)는, 유저부(100)의 행동 정보를 수집하는 모션수집부(410), 유저의 행동 정보를 바탕으로 재난 대처 능력을 판단하는 산출부(420), 산출된 내용으로 유저 개별 및 대단위의 재난 대처 능력을 단계별로 평가할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 개별 및 대단위가 각각 목적을 달성한 시간 및 대처 능력을 분석할 수 있는 시스템을 제공하며, 기입력된 프로그램에 의해 개별 및 대단위 각각에 대처가 미흡했던 부분을 각각 실시간 분석하여 해결 방안을 피드백 해주는 평가부(430)를 포함하여 이루어진다.

title_en: Decision support system for air missioncommander dynamic mission re-planning
abstract_en: A dynamic human machine interface system includes a mission commander application (MCA) unit including a control processor, the MCA active on one vehicle of a plurality of mission member vehicles, the MCA unit in communication with a data store, the control processor accessing executable instructions that cause the control processor to direct operations of components of the MCA unit, an alternate scenario evaluation unit accessing at least one of mission parameter records and flight member data records in the data store to recalculate mission parameters, a dynamic video interface unit to render the recalculated mission parameters on a mission control dashboard (MCD), the MCD presented to the mission commander on a display unit of the one vehicle, the MCD including a plurality of display pane areas selectable by a user interaction with an interactive interface, and each display area configurable by the user interaction to change content of the display pane.

title_en: Beidou autonomous navigation method based on Beidou short message and 4G communication mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Beidou autonomous navigation method based on a Beidou short message and a 4G communication mode, namely Beidou type airborne equipment acquires information such as the current position, speed, time and the like of an airplane in real time and sends the information in the form of ADS-C messages according to the requirements of a ground system; meanwhile, the ground low-altitude flight operation monitoring system receives the airspace situation information from other systems, codes and processes the situations of other airplanes around the target airplane, and transmits the coded information to the Beidou type airborne equipment in a short message mode through the Beidou command type user machine or the 4G communication equipment; the invention has the advantages that the positioning information sent by the Beidou type onboard equipment can be received; the system can monitor in real time at low altitude; the flight data such as the position, the height, the speed and the like of the navigation aircraft in the flight process can be recorded in real time through the airborne data recording module; the Beidou short message channel can be used for carrying out emergency command communication with the aircraft loaded with the Beidou type onboard equipment; and the seamless coverage of low-altitude navigation can be realized.

title_en: A kind of dustbin supervisory systems and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of dustbin supervisory systems and method, which includes dustbin monitoring device, customer mobile terminal and Cloud Server platform.The present invention is using dustbin monitoring device to the dumping height of dustbin, garbage weight, temperature and humidity, smog, bung, the states such as topple over to be monitored, mould group sends status information to Cloud Server platform by wireless communication, and as the case may be dustbin information is sent to using Cloud Server platform the customer mobile terminal of personnel assigned, personnel assigned carries out refuse collection according to current information, troubleshooting and fire-fighting processing etc., it will need to carry out refuse collection, dustbin inspection, the tasks such as dustbin maintenance are assigned to specific staff by customer mobile terminal and carry out in-situ processing, to reduce the inspection workload and human cost of environmental sanitation staff, improve the timeliness of refuse collection, reduce the harmfulness for the fire incident that burning causes in dustbin.
assignees: CHENGDU JIUZHOU ELECTRONIC INF SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Campus emergency exercise simulation method and system based on augmented reality
abstract_en: The invention provides a campus emergency exercise simulation method and system based on augmented reality, and relates to the technical field of augmented reality, wherein the method comprises the steps of identifying feature codes in environmental features to generate marking codes, determining GPS coordinates of wind control points in a school, and generating an article library and an event library according to articles and risk sources appearing in the wind control points; collecting audio and video data in the drilling process, coding, extracting image frames in the video stream, identifying objects and specific plane characteristics, extracting feature codes, comparing the extracted feature codes with feature codes in an object library, identifying whether objects or places in the object library occur or not, and if yes, marking Marker positions as center points of AR rendering images; identifying and rendering the picture, and superposing the virtual object on a Marker to generate a new image file; by data tracking the items or locations in this frame, the corresponding processing operations are selected and the exercise process is recorded. The utility model provides an efficiency that emergent drilling was commanded is improved.
assignees: SHANDONG KEXIN EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Coal machine equipment training system and training method based on augmented reality
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of augmented reality, and particularly relates to a coal machine equipment training system and a training method based on augmented reality. Comprising the following steps: the cloud server system is used for bearing deployment of the coal machine equipment training system, and the three-dimensional model library stores and manages theoretical knowledge file storage services; the augmented reality system is used for carrying out three-dimensional modeling on the coal machine equipment model to be trained; the three-dimensional scene system is used for constructing a roadway model where the coal machine equipment is located; the visual system is used for motion tracking of the three-dimensional model and recognition of gesture commands; the simulation operation system is used for simulating a tunnel operation environment, recording each step of a student and the operation capability of the training student, and performing assessment scoring until the score is qualified. The invention combines virtual scenes with real operations, has strong man-machine interaction and immersion, and can improve training interests of students.
assignees: TAIYUAN INST CHINA COAL TECH & ENG GROUP;SHANXI TIANDI COAL MINING MACHINERY CO LTD;CHINA COAL RES INST

title_en: Work station method and device supporting multiple platforms of government enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a labor-hour management method and device supporting a plurality of platforms of a government enterprise, wherein the method comprises the following steps: accessing work order service data and work order link data from each third party system through RocketMQ middleware; carrying out standardized analysis on the work order service data according to the work order type, and writing a dispatching system work order service table; carrying out standardized analysis on the work single-ring node data according to the type of the work single, and writing a dispatching system work single-ring node table; inquiring a dispatching system work ring section table, determining work ring section steps to be processed by the dispatching system, determining a next processor according to configured dispatching rules, and finally generating and recording dispatching tasks; judging whether the current link data is abnormal according to the configured abnormal index rule, and if so, sending a short message to a corresponding processor for early warning. The method and the device realize monitoring of each link so as to capture abnormal conditions, position the abnormal conditions in time and efficiently, solve the problem in the process of work order circulation and ensure the rapid processing of related services.
assignees: ZHONGYING YOUCHUANG INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Public benefit donation interactive system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a public-service donation interactive system which comprises a database, a registration and login module, a donation operation module and a dispatch record module, wherein the database is used for storing first member information and first donation targets, the registration and login module is in signal connection with the database and is used for receiving a login request of a first user and comparing the login request with the first member information of the database, if the login request of the first user is allowed to be matched, the donation operation module is in signal connection with the registration and login module and is used for receiving donation information transmitted by the first user, and the dispatch record module is in signal connection with the donation operation module and the database and is used for carrying out an operation on the donation information and the first donation targets, for example, an effective result is obtained, namely, a public benefit record is executed according to the contents of the first donation targets and the donation information, and the donation information is updated in the first member record.

title_en: Multi-mode city security video abnormal behavior real-time detection system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-mode urban security video abnormal behavior real-time detection system and method, which belong to the technical field of artificial intelligence and urban security, and comprise an edge node module, a central coordination server module, a dynamic federal policy module and an alarm linkage module, wherein the edge node module is used for collecting local video streams and sensor data, executing local model training and real-time abnormal detection, the central coordination server module is used for federal model parameter aggregation, global model distribution and dynamic resource coordination, the multi-mode data fusion module is used for realizing cross-mode feature fusion through a space-time alignment and attention mechanism, the dynamic federal policy module is used for calculating load and network state according to edge nodes, self-adaptively adjusting model parameter aggregation frequency, and the alarm linkage module is used for triggering local acousto-optic alarm when abnormal behaviors are detected and encrypting and transmitting event information to a command center. The invention can solve the problems of privacy disclosure, bandwidth pressure and multi-mode data collaboration in the prior art, minimize calculation overhead and adapt to heterogeneous equipment on the premise of ensuring data privacy.
assignees: INSPUR SMART CITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for watermark embedding in a multimedia system-on-chip
title_ko: 멀티미디어 시스템 온 칩 내에 워터마크를 삽입하는 방법및 시스템
abstract_en: A method and a system for embedding a watermark in a multimedia SOC(System-On-Chip) are provided to prevent non-authorized media or a pirated version of media from being used. A cable input(101) communicates multimedia signals including audio, video data and voice. An STB(Set Top Box)(103) includes a logical algorithm, a circuitry and a command language code for receiving multimedia input signals and generating output signals to be displayed on a television(109). A storage unit(107) stores multimedia data that may have been received from the cable input and processed by a watermark SoC(105). The watermark SoC receives multimedia data from the cable input, generates a digital watermark, and inserts it into the data. The digital watermark includes a source of the multimedia data and encrypted data related to recording privileges regarding the STB.
abstract_ko: 멀티미디어 시스템 온 칩 내에서 워터마크를 삽입(embed)하기 위한 방법 및 시스템들이 공개되며, 암호화 및 서명된 워터마크 신호를 시스템 온 칩 내에 집적되어 있는 보안 프로세서를 이용하여 해독하고, 이 해독된 워터마킹 신호를 이용하여 멀티미디어 신호 내에 워터마크를 삽입하는데, 이때 해독된 워터마킹 신호는 삽입 키, 삽입될 메시지 및 삽입 파라미터들을 포함할 수 있다. 암호화 및 서명된 워터마킹 신호는 시스템 온 칩 내의 호스트 CPU를 통해 외부 메모리로부터 수신되거나 또는 보안 서버를 통해 수신될 수 있다. 해독된 워터마킹 신호는 서명, 공개 키 및 국부 생성된 난수를 이용하여 검증될 수 있다. 검증된 워터마킹 신호는 시스템 온 칩 내의 비휘발성 메모리 내에 저장될 수도 있고, 시스템 온 칩 바깥에 있는 비휘발성 메모리 내에 저장되기에 앞서 재암호화 및 재서명될 수 있다. 워터마킹 신호는 외부의 비휘발성 메모리로부터 읽어들여져서 시스템 온 칩 내에서 재해독 및 재검증받을 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for inspecting performance of controlling device
title_ko: 관제장비의 성능점검 가상훈련 방법 및 성능점검 가상훈련 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed are a virtual performance check training method to provide an environment where a user virtually practices the same performance check procedure as that in the real world, and a virtual performance check training system thereof. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the virtual performance check training method comprises the following steps: preparing a performance check manual having check items recorded therein with respect to a control device; displaying a selection screen for selecting at least one check item on a terminal when receiving a training start command input by the terminal; connecting a measurement device for measuring performance of a first check item selected on the selection screen to the control device; outputting a performance measurement value of the first check item measured by the measurement device according to connection to the terminal; and evaluating the first check item on the basis of the performance check manual to giving an evaluation score to the terminal to which the performance measurement value is output.
abstract_ko: 성능점검 가상훈련 방법 및 성능점검 가상훈련 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른 성능점검 가상훈련 방법은, 관제장비에 대하여, 점검항목을 기록한 성능점검 매뉴얼을 마련하는 단계와, 단말에 의해 훈련개시 명령이 입력되면, 적어도 하나의 점검항목을 선택하는 선택화면을 상기 단말에 표시하는 단계와, 상기 선택화면에서 선택되는 제1 점검항목의 성능을 측정하는 측정장비를, 상기 관제장비에 연결하는 단계와, 상기 연결에 따라 상기 측정장비에서 측정되는 상기 제1 점검항목의 성능 측정값을 상기 단말에 출력하는 단계, 및 상기 성능 측정값이 출력되는 상기 단말로, 상기 성능점검 매뉴얼을 기준으로 상기 제1 점검항목을 평가하여, 평가점수를 부여하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Smart iot-based electrical safety helmet and electric shock prevention system
title_ko: 스마트 IoT 기반 전기안전 헬멧 및 감전 방지 시스템
abstract_ko: 일실시예에 따른 스마트 IoT 기반 전기안전 헬멧 및 감전 방지 시스템은 착용자의 머리를 보호하는 헬멧 본체, 전기장의 변화를 감지하는 전계 센서 및 전압 센서, 감전 위험이 감지될 경우 착용자에게 경고 신호를 출력하는 알림 모듈, 실시간으로 감전 위험 데이터를 송수신하고 원격으로 헬멧을 모니터링할 수 있도록 하는 IoT 통신 모듈, 감전 위험 수준을 분석하여 경고 단계를 조정하고 데이터 로그를 저장하는 마이크로컨트롤러 유닛(MCU) 및 데이터 저장부, 감전 사고 발생 시 외부 서버 또는 관리 시스템에 긴급 알림을 전송하는 클라우드 연동 모듈 및 원격 경보 시스템을 포함하는 전기안전 헬멧 시스템이 개시된다.

title_en: Ecg-enabled personal emergency response systems
abstract_en: The invention provides personal emergency response systems (PERS) with expanded life-saving capabilities. One embodiment of the invention provides a wearable PERS pendant that incorporates a cell phone transmitter or transceiver, a GPS location system, an accelerometer-based fall detector that automatically triggers an alert, and an electrocardiogram (ECG) recorder permitting a remote service center or medical personnel to receive and respond to transmitted alerts and electrocardiographic data.

title_en: 4d system for configuring, monitoring and controlling conditions in a structure
abstract_en: A coordinated system for a location includes a plurality of sensors arrayed within the location to monitor and record location conditions, and a plurality of interconnected location subsystems for lighting, HVAC, and emergency response. A controller is coupled to the plurality of sensors and to the plurality of interconnected location subsystems. The controller is configured to collect data from the plurality of interconnected location subsystems, collect data from the plurality of sensors, and generate a building information data packet comprising the collected data and a set of building plans in three dimensions.

title_en: Evacuation roll call system, secure evacuation method, readable storage medium, and electronic device
abstract_en: The invention provides an evacuation roll call system, a secure evacuation method, a readable storage medium and electronic equipment. The evacuation roll-call system records evacuation events through the event storage module and classifies the evacuation events to determine evacuation areas, command officers and evacuation gathering places. And acquiring an evacuation list according to the real-time database, wherein the evacuation list not only comprises employee lists in the evacuation area, but also comprises visitor and contractor lists so as to avoid evacuation or rescue omission. In addition, all commanders or all employees may perform roll call operations to improve roll call efficiency. And after roll call is finished, the commander can develop quick rescue according to the personnel list information of the places which do not reach the safe evacuation collection, so that rescue efficiency is ensured. Therefore, the invention not only can timely acquire the accurate evacuation list and the commander list under the emergency situation and ensure the stability and the high efficiency of evacuation management, but also can realize high-efficiency emergency rescue through the acquired feedback information.

title_en: Forest fire intelligent prediction early warning system integrating machine learning and ecological behavior recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent forest fire prediction and early warning system, which integrates technologies such as satellite remote sensing, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection, ground monitoring and the like, and utilizes a deep learning algorithm to intelligently identify ecological behaviors. The system comprises four core modules, namely multi-source data acquisition, ecological behavior identification, machine learning prediction model and intelligent early warning and emergency response. By comprehensively monitoring forest environment, analyzing ecological data, accurately predicting fire risk, automatically generating early warning information, and tightly linking with an emergency system. The system effectively solves the problems of single traditional early warning means, poor timeliness and insufficient precision, remarkably improves the accuracy and response speed of forest fire early warning, and provides powerful technical support for forest resource protection and ecological environment safety.

title_en: Mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information data processing technology, in particular to a mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original slope real-time monitoring data, carrying out standardization processing to obtain standardized slope real-time monitoring data, constructing a digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data to obtain a preliminary slope digital twin model, and dynamically updating the preliminary slope digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data and slope history multi-source monitoring data to obtain a real-time updated slope digital twin model. According to the invention, by updating the digital twin model in real time and combining multi-physical field coupling analysis and nonlinear stability prediction, the dynamic monitoring, stability evaluation, risk prediction and emergency response of the slope can be ensured to reflect the actual conditions in time, so that the scientificity and timeliness of disaster prevention and control are improved.

title_en: Multi-source data management method and related device based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-source data management method and a related device based on machine learning, which are characterized in that a multi-source data set under an emergency command and rescue scene is obtained, data preprocessing is carried out on the multi-source data set to obtain a standardized data set with a unified data form, a data meta-information set is extracted from the standardized data set, a pre-trained blood-edge relation modeling model is called to carry out association analysis processing on the data meta-information set, a blood-edge relation description set among all data items in the standardized data set is generated, a data blood-edge tracking result is generated based on the blood-edge description set, and the data blood-edge tracking result comprises a history record of a data full life cycle and cross-data-item dependency graph information. The invention can provide a treatment support with traceable data sources, traceable processing process and clear dependency relationship for emergency command rescue, so that rescue decisions can be developed based on reliable data blood-source information, and the support capability of data treatment on rescue decisions is effectively improved.

title_en: Patient emergency response system
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.

title_en: Wheeled armored vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a wheeled armored vehicle, which is characterized in that the periphery of a vehicle body is additionally provided with armour plates, the front windshield glass of a cab as well as a driver door and an assistant driver door are respectively made of armour and anti-explosion compound glass, the bottom part of a vehicle head is additionally provided with a protection plate, the back of the driver in the vehicle is provided with an electric appliance cabinet, the electric appliance cabinet is respectively provided with a hard disk recorder, a radio station and an industrial personal computer, an inverter power and a battery set are arranged under the electric appliance cabinet, a camera is connected with a video cassette recorder, and the vehicle top is also provided with an emergency escape hole. The utility model has the advantages that the wheeled armored vehicle is suitable for road conditions in China, is convenient to command, can be used for battle commanding protection vehicles with different uses of frontier defence, communication, armed polices, public safety and blocking, and provides good services for frontier defence, armed polices and the public safety.

title_en: Earthquake acquisition management system and method through technology of network cloud
abstract_en: The invention relates to an earthquake acquisition management system and method through the technology of network cloud. The system comprises a cloud server, a computer main system, an acquisition and navigation client, a well-drilling management client, a blasting management client, and a supervising management client. Through monitoring and recording the working conditions of all construction clients, managers at all stage achieve the management of the whole construction process. The system achieves the positioning and collection of construction data through GPS positioning in a process of construction, achieves the real-time monitoring of the whole construction process through the technology of network, unifies the dispatching, and achieves accurate and high-efficiency purposes.

title_en: A kind of mobile emergency command data collection system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of mobile emergency command data collection systems, belong to emergency command technical field, including monitoring camera and cradle head control machine, and the monitoring camera is connected by video adapting line with the cradle head control machine；The monitoring camera is mounted on the top of first support, and the bottom end of the first support is equipped with suspension strop, and the first support is movably arranged on the top of the second support；The built-in system of the cradle head control machine includes central processing unit, network transmission module, video transmission module, deposits record module, GPS positioning module, two-way interaction module and power module.By the way that suspension strop is arranged in first support bottom end, second support and first support are flexibly connected, second support is used for ground supports monitoring camera, first support is for hanging installation monitoring camera, monitoring camera is allowed to select first support and second support to merge or separate according to topographic features, so that monitoring camera installation is more flexible.
assignees: ANHUI CANGLANG NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle hydrogen fuel management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fuel management, in particular to an unmanned aerial vehicle hydrogen fuel management system which comprises a hydrogen leakage detection module, a hydrogen supply interruption module, an emergency communication and navigation module and a fuel dynamic management module. According to the invention, the safety of the hydrogen fuel unmanned aerial vehicle is effectively improved by monitoring the key pipelines in real time and identifying the characteristic frequency of hydrogen leakage, emergency response configuration is implemented, namely, hydrogen inflow is immediately closed and the unmanned aerial vehicle is guided to safely fall when the leakage is detected, the timeliness and the accuracy of emergency response are greatly improved, the fuel consumption is dynamically managed, the supply plan is optimized, the operation efficiency and the fuel utilization rate of the unmanned aerial vehicle are effectively prolonged, the comprehensive optimization strategy not only reduces the energy waste, but also enhances the reliability and the economy of task execution, and particularly provides important contribution to the maximization of the utilization of the pushing energy and the minimization of the environmental impact in long-distance flight and high-load operation.
assignees: SHANGHAI YUSHI ENERGY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Electromagnetic spectrum management and control simulation method, system and medium based on presence/absence formation
abstract_en: The invention provides an electromagnetic spectrum management and control simulation method, a system and a medium based on an on-off/on-on formation, relates to the field of electromagnetic spectrum management and control, and fills the gap of the existing electromagnetic spectrum management and control simulation technology aiming at a real battlefield environment; the method comprises the following steps: recording basic simulation information data, generating frequency-using equipment parameters of the red and blue party on/off formation, and obtaining a radiation signal waveform; simulating and propagating the radiation signal waveform to obtain a received signal waveform; visually displaying electromagnetic spectrum characteristics of a received signal waveform and basic simulation information data, and determining a conflict of frequency-using equipment; aiming at the conflict of frequency-consuming equipment inside the formation and between the two sides of the formation, the formation command personnel performs electromagnetic spectrum control operation to obtain control result data; circularly carrying out multi-round electromagnetic spectrum management and control simulation, and storing a plurality of management and control result data; the invention can provide scientific basis for the optimal configuration of the frequency-using equipment and the test and evaluation of interference and anti-interference strategies in the simulated battlefield environment.
assignees: CHENGDU TIANXUN MICROSATELLITES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent dispatching system and method for park service personnel
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of dispatch management, in particular to an intelligent dispatch system and method for park service personnel. The method comprises the steps of obtaining emergency information, analyzing the emergency information, determining event characteristics, calling a personnel information base, determining personnel service information, analyzing the event characteristics and the personnel service information, determining a resource reservation scheme, and determining personnel arrangement of the emergency information according to the event characteristics and the resource reservation scheme. And the shortage of resources is prevented, enough resources are ensured to be available under the emergency condition, the response time is reduced, and the timeliness for coping with the emergency is improved. According to the event characteristics and personnel capability, personnel are accurately matched, the efficiency and success rate of task completion are improved, and unnecessary personnel allocation and resource waste are avoided.

title_en: Emergency plan making method based on industrial park
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency plan making method based on an industrial park, which is characterized in that data acquisition and preprocessing are realized through a distributed sensing network and edge calculation, a park dynamic model is constructed by utilizing multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and a digital twin technology, a risk propagation path is analyzed by combining a graph neural network, and a preliminary emergency suggestion is generated based on a knowledge graph matching historical case. The invention further adopts a resource scheduling optimization and path planning algorithm to formulate a dynamic response scheme, evaluates the effects of different schemes through a situation evolution prediction model, finally generates an optimal emergency treatment scheme and issues a structural instruction. The method realizes the intelligent formulation of the emergency plan of the industrial park, improves the accuracy of risk identification and the timeliness of emergency response, and provides powerful support for park safety management.
assignees: SHAANXI KING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent anti-theft method and system for climbing vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation transportation and discloses an intelligent anti-theft method and system for a climbing vehicle, wherein the intelligent anti-theft method comprises the steps that a controller and a positioning terminal perform bidirectional identity authentication based on pre-recorded unique hardware fingerprint codes and GPS dynamic verification codes; the method comprises the steps of monitoring the 4G signal intensity in real time, automatically switching to a Bluetooth ad hoc network mode when the signal intensity is lower than a threshold value, authorizing a handheld terminal to send an emergency command through a dynamic temporary password, judging the posture of a vehicle through a sensor and a supporting leg state sensor, entering a delayed vehicle locking mode and preferentially executing a descending arm operation if the height of an arm frame is larger than a set value, immediately locking the vehicle if the arm frame is in a ground static state, and realizing temporary unlocking through voiceprint and dynamic password or fingerprint identification module authentication in the vehicle locking state, wherein the unlocking duration is set according to a scene type. The problems of high-altitude car locking risk, signal dependence, inconvenience in unlocking and equipment loopholes in the prior art are solved, and the purposes of high safety, emergency response, theft prevention and disassembly prevention are achieved.
assignees: ZHEJIANG ZHONGKE ZHENGFANG ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Crime prevention security system
title_ko: 범죄 예방 방범 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A crime preventing system is provided to solve emergency situations by actively manage the emergency situations and reducing crime inclination of a criminal. CONSTITUTION: A wireless terminal(10) wirelessly transmits an emergency signal which including a unique code in response to emergency situations. Crime preventing devices(D0-D3) are dispersedly arranged in multiple positions and comprise a lighting part, a speaker, a camera, and a microphone. The crime preventing devices receive the emergency signal of the wireless terminal and transmit the emergency signal in which an identification code is added to a control center(30) through a modem. The control system determines a user of the wireless terminal with a unique code included in the emergency signal when receives the emergency signal and extracts electric field intensity of the emergency signal and the location of the wireless terminal. The control system transmits a control signal to a corresponding security system and operates the lighting part while outputting a warning message through the speaker. The security system records a field image and a field voice transferred by the camera and the microphone and transmits a dispatch request message.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 등록된 무선 단말기에서 비상 신호가 송출되면 무선 단말기의 위치 정보를 추출하여 현장의 위급 상황에 대응한 촬영, 경고 방송, 비상 조명 작동 및 출동 조치를 수행할 수 있는 범죄 예방 방범 시스템을 개시하며, 상기 범죄 예방 방범 시스템은, 휴대 가능하며 위급 상황에 대응하여 고유 코드를 포함한 비상 신호를 무선송신하는 기능을 갖는 무선 단말기; 다수의 위치에 분산 배치되고 조명부, 스피커, 카메라 및 마이크를 구비하며 상기 무선 단말기의 상기 비상 신호를 수신하고 자신의 식별 코드를 부가한 상기 비상 신호를 모뎀을 통하여 관제 센터로 전송하는 방범 장치들; 및 상기 관제 센터에서 운영되며 상기 비상 신호가 수신되면 상기 비상 신호에 포함된 상기 고유 코드로써 상기 무선 단말기의 사용자를 판단하고, 삼각측량법에 의하여 상기 무선 단말기에 인접한 방범 장치들에서 수신되는 상기 비상 신호의 전계 강도와 상기 식별 코드로써 상기 무선 단말기의 위치를 추출하며, 상기 무선 단말기의 위치에 근접한 하나 이상의 상기 방범 장치를 제어하기 위한 관제 신호를 상기 방범 장치로 전송하여서 상기 조명부를 비상 발광시키면서 상기 스피커로 경고 메시지를 출력하고, 상기 방범 장치에서 카메라 및 마이크로 촬영되어서 전송되는 현장 영상 및 현장 음성을 녹화 및 녹음하며, 상기 관제 신호에 대응하여 미리 지정된 대상으로 출동 요청 메시지 전송을 수행하는 관제 시스템; 을 포함함을 특징으로 한다.  
따라서, 본 발명은 방범 장치들이 설치된 단위 관제 구역 내에서 무선 단말기에서 사용자가 적극적으로 비상 신호를 송출할 수 있고 비상 신호 송출에 대응하여 관제 시스템에서 범죄와 같은 위급 상황에 대한 적극적인 대처 및 위치 정보를 포함한 출동 요청 메시지 전송에 따른 범죄 차단 및 예방이 이루어지므로 무선 단말기 사용자의 안전성이 확보되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Processing system using a traffic accident insurers linked external communication module equipped with a black box device
title_ko: 보험사 연계용 외장형 통신모듈이 구비된 블랙박스장치를 이용한 교통사고 처리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a traffic accident processing system, and more specifically, to a traffic accident processing system using a black box apparatus comprising an insurance company related external communication module, which includes: an impact sensor (1) for sensing impact; a black box apparatus (20) including a black box (24) for collecting image information as being connected to the impact sensor (1) and an external communication module (21) for transmitting the image information as being connected to the black box (24) by an independent configuration separated from the black box; and a vehicle management server (30) for receiving and recording the image information and then transmitting the image information to an insurance company server (40). The image information includes accident image information for a setting time before and after an impact sensing signal, when the impact sensing signal of the impact sensor (1) is generated. The present invention like the above is effective in unscheduled vehicle condition checking, driving behavior correction, rapid accident processing, emergency rescue, etc.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 교통사고 처리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 충격 감지용 충격센서(1)와; 상기 충격센서(1)와 연결되며 영상정보를 수집하는 블랙박스(24)와, 상기 블랙박스(24)와 분리된 독립된 구성으로 상기 블랙박스(24)와 연결되어 상기 영상정보를 전송하기 위한 외장형 통신모듈(21)을 포함하는 블랙박스장치(20); 및 상기 영상정보를 수신하여 기록 및 보험사 서버(40)에 전송하는 차량관리 서버(30)를 포함하되, 
상기 영상정보는 상기 충격센서(1)의 충격 감지신호 발생시, 충격 감지신호 전,후의 설정시간의 사고영상정보를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 보험사 연계용 외장형 통신모듈이 구비된 블랙박스장치를 이용한 교통사고 처리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
이와 같은 본 발명은 차량 상태 수시 점검, 운전 습관 교정, 신속한 사고처리, 긴급구조 등에 효과적이다.

title_en: Firefighting convergence information based integrated control system and method
title_ko: 소방활동융합정보 기반 통합관제 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a firefighting activity convergence information-integrated control system and method to reduce time delay in information acquisition. According to the present invention, the firefighting activity convergence information-based integrated control system comprises: a firefighting activity convergence information database system providing a function of building/analyzing/distributing building spatial information, point of interest (POI) information of firefighting facilities and hazardous material facilities, and firefighting activity information; an integrated control system performing overall integrated control functions such as receiving, processing, delivering, identifying, and reporting on fire disasters and the like, checking the status of damage caused by fire disasters and the like, rescue, support activities, and the like, record and statistics management, information analysis, and the like; and a field command system receiving dispatch orders, site disaster situation information, and firefighting activity convergence information of the building where a firefighting disaster has occurred, visualizing the received information, and transmitting the firefighting activity convergence information to an on-site response terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방활동융합정보 기반 통합관제 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건물의 공간정보, 소방시설 및 위험물시설 POI(Point of Interest) 정보, 소방활동정보를 구축/분석/배포 기능을 제공하는 소방활동융합정보 DB 시스템; 소방재난 등의 접수, 처리, 전달, 진행사항 파악 및 보고 등 소방재난 등으로 인한 피해현황, 구조 및 지원활동 등의 파악, 기록 통계 관리 및 정보 분석 등 전반적인 통합관제 기능을 수행하는 통합관제 시스템; 및 통합관제 시스템으로부터 출동명령, 현장의 재난상황 정보, 소방재난이 발생한 건물의 소방활동융합정보를 수신하고, 이 정보를 가시화하며 현장대응 단말에 소방활동융합정보를 전송하는 현장지휘 시스템을 포함한다.

title_en: Control center dispatch service system using life crisis emergency bell
title_ko: 생명위기비상벨을 이용한 관제센터 출동 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control center dispatch service system using a life crisis emergency bell that receives a rescue request signal from a caller terminal for detecting the ringing of the emergency bell, comprising: a database part for storing information on a caller or a recipient corresponding to the caller, information on a rescue request signal of the caller, CCTV information in a predetermined area and emergency dispatcher information; and a server for receiving a rescue request signal from the caller terminal and performing controls so that information including an emergency text, the location of the caller, and the on-site voice recording information of the caller can be transmitted to a predetermined number of recipient terminals corresponding to the caller. According to an embodiment of the present invention, when a woman, an elderly person, a child, and a female single-person household member are in an emergency or fire situation, an emergency bell (200) manually or automatically generates an inaudible frequency signal, and a terminal receives the same to transmit the same to a control center through a mobile communication network, and at the same time, disseminate the same to a plurality of pre-designated people, thereby preventing an emergency situation or rescuing the person.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비상벨의 울림을 감지하는 발신자 단말기로부터 구조요청신호를 수신하는 생명위기비상벨을 이용한 관제센터 출동 서비스 시스템에 관한 것으로, 발신자 또는 발신자에 대응하는 수신자 정보, 발신자의 구조요청신호 정보, 소정 지역의 CCTV 정보, 긴급출동자 정보를 저장하는 데이터베이스부;  상기 발신자 단말기로부터 구조요청신호를 수신하고, 발신자에 대응하는 소정수의 수신자 단말기로 위급문자, 발신자의 위치 및 발신지의 현장음성 녹음정보를 포함한 정보를 송신하도록 제어하는 서버를 포함한다.  본 발명의 실시예에서는, 여성, 노인, 어린이, 여성1인가구 등의 구성원이 위급, 응급, 화재 상황에 처했을 때, 비상벨(200)이 수동 또는 자동으로 비가청주파수 신호를 발생하고, 단말기가 이를 수신하여 이동통신망을 통하여 관제 센터로 송신함과 동시에 미리 지정된 다수의 사람들에게 전파되도록 하여 위급 상황을 예방 또는 구조할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for providing data stream information to emergency response dispatch
abstract_en: A system and method for providing information to emergency response dispatch including providing an application on the mobile communication device capable of receiving an emergency response request input and allowing a user to initiate a stream, and responsive to a first emergency response request input, transmitting an emergency data stream to be accessible to a remote dispatcher or monitoring center and connecting the user to emergency services dispatch, including providing the emergency data stream to emergency services dispatch to enable direct communication between the user and emergency services dispatch. The emergency data stream including a first video stream for video images an audio stream recording of environment audio stream recorded by the microphone of the mobile communication device; a stream of geolocation coordinates.

title_en: Calorie Counter
abstract_en: A calorie counter that uses a voice command function to transition between various functional modes while maintaining the portability and aesthetic value as an accessory. Preprogrammed memory contained within the system pertains to reported nutritional information relating to specific food/beverage items and also dishes served at restaurants. This information may be ordered via voice command by the consumer, who then receives the information on a display screen and/or conventional synthesized voice and speaker function, before opting to record the number of calories or other nutritional item that was ingested. This recorded information is transferred to an electronic log where it can be reviewed at any time.

title_en: Emergency medical system for sudden disaster accidents
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to an emergency medical system for sudden disaster accidents, which is characterized by comprising a staff information base module for recording information of managers, doctors and nurses and scheduling information. The command center comprises an emergency acquisition module, a personnel arrangement module and an emergency article determination module, wherein the emergency acquisition module is used for determining the type of the emergency disaster accident and the number of people involved; the personnel arrangement module is used for arranging emergency accident personnel; the emergency article determining module is used for matching the required emergency articles for the staff of the staff arrangement module. The identity information card is used for registering the data information of the information input submodule; the emergency article distribution device is used for automatically distributing emergency articles for workers. The invention can rapidly arrange the staff participating in emergency work and automatically distribute emergency articles for the staff.

title_en: Airport passenger security check information management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security check information management, in particular to an airport passenger security check information management system. The invention relates to a passenger file construction module, which builds files according to passenger data and generates passenger riding axes, can comprehensively record each riding situation of passengers, provides abundant historical data for airport management, is convenient for analyzing and managing riding behaviors of passengers, constructs data packets of each type of contraband, comprises X-ray image data, millimeter wave data, danger level and processing means, ensures more scientific and reasonable security check processing, when the prohibited articles of the carrying class are detected, security personnel in the nearby airport can be quickly searched and related information is sent, and quick emergency response is realized.

title_en: Membership bank loan gateway system by seek deposit collateral and the loan managing method by using it
title_ko: 대출고객 중 대출기준에 미달하는 대출회원에게 예금담보를 제공하는 회원을 모집하는 예금담보인 구인중계시스템 및 예금담보인 구인중계서비스 관리방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대출기관에서 대출을 희망하는 대출회원이 대출기관의 대출기준에 미달될 경우 대출담보를 제공할 예금담보회원을 모집하여 대출을 실행하고, 대신 대출기관은 대출이자율을 대출회원과 예금담보회원에게 위임하여 예금담보인 구인중계시스템을 통해 대출금리가 확정되도록 하되, 해당 대출금리의 확정방식을 낮은 금리를 제시한 예금담보회원부터 확정되는 금리 역경매 방식과 대출회원이 제시한 금리에 선착순으로 확정되는 방식을 적용하게 하며, 이 시스템을 통해 결정된 대출회원의 이자율에서 대출기관의 관리비용을 공제한 대출이자를 예금담보회원의 담보제공 보상금 또는 예금이자로 지급함으로써 대출이 불가능한 회원은 대출이 가능해지고, 예금을 담보로 제공한 회원은 일반 예금이자보다 높은 이자를 지급받을 수 있도록 지원하는 예금담보인 구인중계시스템에 관한 것으로, 예금담보회원이 담보로 제공한 담보예금에 대하여 대출회원의 대출사고 발생 시 안전성을 보장하기 위하여 예금담보인 구인중계시스템 관리회사는 대출회원으로부터 매입한 동산을 예금담보회원에게 담보로 제공하거나 대출회원이 직접 소유한 동산을 담보로 제공하여, 발생할지 모르는 대출사고 시 예금담보회원이 담보 원금을 보전할 수 있도록 지원하는 역할을 수행한다. 이를 위해 웹상에서 대출을 진행하는 대출회원은 예금담보회원이 정확하게 판단할 수 있도록 경매진행정보, 대출금액, 대출이자율, 대출기간, 대출금 상환방식, 대출회원의 신용정보, 기존 경매진행정보 및 기존 대출과 관련된 상환정보를 공개하고, 예금담보인 구인중계시스템은 예금담보회원을 위해 제공할 동산에 대한 제품명, 제원, 구입가, 구입년도, 현재 중고시세, 감정가를 공개하여, 경매에 참여하는 예금담보회원이 참여와 불참을 정확한 판단을 내릴 수 있도록 서비스를 지원하는 예금담보인 구인중계시스템과 이를 이용한 예금담보인 구인중계서비스 관리방법에 관한 것이다. 즉, 대출기관에서 대출을 희망하는 대출회원 중 대출기준에 미달하는 대출회원에게 예금담보를 제공하는 회원을 모집하고, 담보로 제공한 예금의 지급이자를 낮게 제시한 회원부터 확정시키는 예금담보인 구인중계시스템 관리지원 서버에 접속하여 회원으로 가입하는 회원컴퓨터; 대출기관에서 대출을 희망하는 대출회원이 대출시 필요한 예금담보회원을 구하는 방법으로 대출기관의 대출 금리를 대출회원과 예금담보회원에게 위임하고, 두 회원은 대출금리를 협상하기 위해 낮은 금리 순으로 확정하거나 확정금리에 선착순으로 확정하는 역경매방식으로 진행하며, 예금담보인 구인 중계시스템에서 목표 모집인원에 이를 때까지 예금담보회원을 받고, 경매에 참여한 회원에 대해서는 대출회원의 대출 금리를 예금담보회원 간 낮은 금리 경쟁방식이나 선착순 방식으로 결정하게하며, 경매 마감 후 대출회원이 대출기관에서 대출받을 수 있도록 확정된 경매완료정보를 대출기관에 전달하고, 대출기관은 전달받은 정보를 바탕으로 대출회원에 대한 대출이자율과 예금담보회원에 대한 예금이자율을 확정하는 과정에 있어서, 각각의 데이터베이스로 저장하는 예금담보인 구인중계시스템 관리지원 서버; 회원의 가입 및 탈퇴 정보, 경매참여보증금 회원납부정보를 저장 및 업그레이드해둠으로써, 경매 진행 및 경매 참여시 회원 여부를 확인할 수 있도록 하는 회원정보 데이터베이스; 경매 진행시 회원별 경매신청 등록내용, 희망대출금액, 회원제시 이자율정보, 대출금 상환방식, 회원신용정보, 경매낙찰횟수, 연체 및 상환관련 대출정보를 저장 및 업그레이드해두기 위한 경매신청정보 데이터베이스; 경매 참여시 회원별 경매참여정보, 참여횟수, 낙찰횟수, 낙찰이자율, 회원 본인의 예금계좌 정보를 저장 및 업그레이드 해두기 위한 경매참여정보 데이터베이스; 경매 진행시 예금담보인 구인중계시스템에서 대출회원이 진행하는 경매에 참여하는 예금담보회원의 예금담보금액을 보증하기위하여 예금담보인 구인중계시스템 관리회사가 제공하거나 대출회원이 직접 소유한 담보물을 제공한 담보물의 정보를 저장 및 업그레이드 해두기 위한 담보물 데이터베이스; 경매가 진행되면 진행된 정보를 저장 및 업그레이드 해두기 위한 경매진행정보 데이터베이스; 경매가 완료되면 낙찰 또는 부결에 관한 경매진행 완료정보, 낙찰에 참여한 예금담보회원과 부결된 예금담보회원의 기본인적정보, 낙찰된 회원의 예금계좌정보를 저장 및 업그레이드 해두기 위한 경매완료정보 데이터베이스; 대출기관으로부터 대출 후 대출금이 연체되거나 미상환된 대출회원의 정보를 제공받아 예금담보인 구인중계시스템 관리회사는 예금담보회원에게 제공한 담보물을 매각하고, 매각 수익으로 대출금을 상환한 정보를 저장 및 업그레이드 해두기 위한 담보매각정보 및 미상환금 상환정보 데이터베이스; 대출회원이 소유한 중고자동차를 담보로 제공하고 경매를 진행할 경우 자동차성능·상태점검기록부, 잔존물회수보험 가입계약서 사본, 자기차량손해보험이 포함된 자동차화재종합보험사본, 경매신청회원이 예금담보인 구인중계시스템에 담보로 제공한 차량이 대출계약이 만료되기 전까지 예금담보인 구인중계시스템 관리회사 명의로 제공한 근저당 설정서류 등을 등록한 정보를 저장 및 업그레이드 해두기 위한 중고차 담보물 정보관리 데이터베이스; 위의 회원컴퓨터와 예금담보인 구인중계시스템 관리지원 서버, 각각의 데이터베이스와 함께 대출기관의 관리지원 서버와 대출회원정보관리 데이터베이스, 신용카드를 발급할 경우 신용카드사 관리지원 서버와 신용카드 신청 및 발급정보 데이터베이스를 포함한 것을 특징으로 하는 예금담보인 구인중계시스템.

title_en: Disaster response drainage system equipped with failure prediction and diagnosis functions
title_ko: 고장 예측 및 진단 기능이 구비된 재난대응 배수시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster-response drainage system equipped with fault prediction and diagnosis functions, which comprises: a monitoring unit including a plurality of sensors installed in a pump to measure a state of the pump in real time; a control calculation unit receiving measurement data from the sensor of the monitoring unit to generate a control signal based on the measurement data; and a control unit controlling an operation of the pump based on the control signal generated by the control calculation unit. The control calculation unit includes: a processor; an input module receiving the measurement data measured from the sensor of the monitoring unit and transmitting the measurement data to the processor; a database in which data is recorded; and a diagnosis unit connected to the processor and analyzing the input measurement data to determine whether the measurement data is normal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 펌프에 설치되어 상기 펌프의 상태를 실시간으로 측정하는 다수의 센서를 포함하는 모니터링 유닛; 상기 모니터링 유닛의 센서로부터 측정데이터를 전달받아, 상기 측정데이터를 기반으로 제어신호를 생성하는 제어연산부; 및 상기 제어연산부에서 생성된 제어신호를 기반으로 상기 펌프의 동작을 제어하는 컨트롤 유닛;을 포함하고, 상기 제어연산부는, 프로세서(Processor); 상기 모니터링 유닛의 센서로부터 측정된 측정데이터가 입력되어 상기 측정데이터를 상기 프로세서로 전달하는 입력모듈; 데이터가 기록되는 데이터베이스; 및 상기 프로세서와 연결되어 입력된 측정데이터를 분석하여 정상여부를 판단하는 진단부;를 포함하도록 구성된 고장 예측 및 진단 기능이 구비된 재난대응 배수시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) for mobile assets that includes a data recorder.
