The data recorder includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queueing repository. DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data acquired by DARS through a web browser, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: A kind of intelligence environmental sanitation report control platform
abstract_en: This utility model discloses a kind of intelligence environmental sanitation report control platform, it includes that dispatching patcher and multiple information receive and launch terminal, wherein information receives and launch terminal is portable terminal, it is loaded in respectively on sanitationman and environmental sanitation vehicles, dispatching patcher includes display management device, and display management device connects warning light and voice module；Display management device is provided with GPS map module；Information receives and launch terminal includes message processing module, and message processing module is connected to GPS locating module, track record module, warning system, voice module, photographing module, work attendance module；Dispatching patcher is received with information and is connected by wireless network between launch terminal.The purpose of this utility model is to provide a kind of intelligence environmental sanitation report control platform; sanitationman and the handling situations of vehicle and movement track, timely and clear environmental sanitation task of assigning can be controlled in real time, improve the efficiency of environmental sanitation work; warning system is set, it is ensured that the safety of environmental sanitation operation.
assignees: HUNAN WESTON INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Drilling and piling integrated machine for emergency and disaster relief
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of rescue and relief work, in particular to a rescue and relief drilling and pile driving integrated machine, which mainly aims to provide a rescue and relief drilling and pile driving integrated machine, can effectively complete drilling operation and pile driving operation on the same equipment, ensures the timeliness requirement in the rescue and relief work, and provides a rescue and relief drilling and pile driving integrated machine, which comprises an independently arranged guide support frame, wherein a support base is arranged at the lower part of the guide support frame, and a station conversion sliding base is also arranged between the support base and the guide support frame; a station conversion oil cylinder is further arranged at the rear end of the support base, a drilling device is arranged on the outer side of the guide support frame, and a piling device is arranged on the inner side of the guide support frame; the lower part of the guide support frame is also connected with a self-walking device, and the integrated machine with the novel structural design for emergency rescue, relief work, drilling and piling effectively improves the efficiency of emergency work and the emergency response capability in the process of emergency rescue and relief work.

title_en: Intelligent security auxiliary system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent security auxiliary system which comprises an intelligent video module, an event management module, a response flow management module and a behavior prediction and path planning module, wherein the event management module is used for receiving a response flow; the intelligent security protection auxiliary system has the beneficial effects that the intelligent security protection auxiliary system is designed, so that a method for deeply combining video behavior analysis with scenes such as campus safety management, intelligent guidance of an office hall and the like is provided, behaviors of campus violence, theft, crossing of an enclosing wall, crowding and treading risks, crowding and the like are automatically identified, judgment, suspected problem marking, electronic record storage and relevant response are made at the first time, and omission caused by human eye checking and monitoring is avoided to a great extent to generate serious consequences; meanwhile, a convenient retrieval mode can be provided for investigation and evidence collection after the fact; a more scientific and friendly auxiliary decision can be provided in the emergency command process; moreover, the manpower for viewing the videos is not required to be increased along with the increase of the number of the video paths, and a large amount of manpower resources can be saved.
assignees: WUHAN BRANCH BEIJING TUCHUANG TIMES TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent subway station management system and method based on BIM and GIS
abstract_en: A subway station intelligent management system and method based on BIM and GIS, including station basic information unit, used for storing and inquiring station space position, building, various facility equipment position, geometry, texture, attribute and metadata, and thematic data; the system comprises an Internet of things equipment monitoring unit, a monitoring unit and a monitoring unit, wherein the Internet of things equipment monitoring unit is used for sensing, identifying and recording the running state of the equipment in the station; the daily operation maintenance unit is used for the traffic organization, the passenger service and the operation safety management of the station in a daily state; the emergency response management and control unit is used for managing and serving stations under emergency conditions; the station three-dimensional platform unit is used for realizing station information query and visual display; and the data processing unit is connected with the station three-dimensional platform unit and is used for carrying out statistical analysis processing on the running conditions of all station facility equipment. The invention realizes the intelligent management of the subway station with high intelligent degree, good visual effect and strong interactive function.
assignees: HEFEI SIWILL INTELLIGENT CO LTD;MAANSHAN UNIV

title_en: System and method for matching nursing stations to give orders to caregivers in endowment industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of home care service, and discloses a nursing staff order dispatching system and method for a matched nursing station in the nursing industry, wherein the nursing staff order dispatching system comprises an order information module, a nursing station information module, a nursing staff information module and a system matching module; the order information module is used for ordering and recording the requirement information proposed by the client; the caregiver information module is used for adding, inquiring and deleting different information of different caregivers; the nursing station information module is used for recording nursing station information and different information of different nursing staff recorded by the nursing staff information module; the system matching module matches the corresponding caregiver according to the requirement information recorded by the order information module; the order information module, the caregiver information module and the nursing station information module are used for providing parameter information for the system matching module. According to the invention, through multi-parameter condition constraint, an optimal model of a matching algorithm is constructed, and the optimal model can be matched with a nearest nursing station and a higher-quality caregiver.
assignees: FUSHOUKANG WISDOM SHANGHAI MEDICAL PENSION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Fire control wireless transmission recorder of duty
abstract_en: The application provides a fire-fighting wireless transmission duty recorder, which relates to the technical field of recorders and comprises: the intelligent fire-fighting equipment comprises an instrument body, wherein a video camera is arranged on the front surface of the instrument body, a switch button is arranged on the front surface of the instrument body, a switch pattern is printed on the front surface of the switch button, an emergency button is arranged on the front surface of the instrument body, an SOS pattern is printed on the front surface of the emergency button, a hot camera is arranged on the front surface of the instrument body, the hot camera is started, a shot hot picture is transmitted to a command center, relatively useful information can be provided for the command center, a firefighter can hold the instrument body by hand, the environment in the current thick fog is observed through a hot screen, whether a person to be rescued exists at the position or not can be judged by heat Cheng Bing, the time for searching the person to be rescued is greatly shortened, the survival rate of the firefighter and the person to be rescued is improved, and the problem that the firefighter has no field of view in the thick fog is avoided.
assignees: WUHAN CHAOXIAN TONGRUI TECH CO LTD;XU JUNFENG;ZHAO CHUNSONG;FAN TAO

title_en: Disinfection supply center workflow optimization system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a large data analysis-based disinfection supply center workflow optimization system, which particularly relates to the technical field of medical data processing and is used for solving the problems of resource extrusion and timeliness lag caused by insufficient dynamic demand adaptation in the existing disinfection task scheduling; the method comprises the steps of integrating instrument demand time sequence distribution, infection risk level and equipment space distribution data, combining dynamic assessment instrument multiplexing priority, marking department cooperation nodes, tracking pollution risk of a storage area in real time, dynamically correcting a disinfection resource scheduling path based on multidimensional decision parameters, realizing real-time balanced adaptation of task priority and equipment load, automatically generating an optimization scheme according to the composite weight of pollution diffusion rate, department cooperation frequency and equipment transportation efficiency, synchronously guaranteeing key instrument scheduling timeliness and storage area environment safety in a sudden high-load scene, and remarkably improving emergency response capacity and resource utilization efficiency of a disinfection supply center.
assignees: AFFILIATED HOSPITAL SHANDONG UNIV TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE

title_en: Safety running system of vehicle using vehicle speed data transmission
title_ko: Vsdt 장치를 이용한 차량 안전 운행 시스템
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention relates to a vehicle safe driving system which uses a vehicle speed data transmission (VSDT). A technical challenge to be solved is to prevent a traffic accident which is caused by the speeding or drowsy driving of a driver by including a VSDT device in a vehicle. In the embodiment of the present invention for the forementioned, the disclosed vehicle safe driving system uses the VSDT device which: is included in a vehicle, detects and stores the speed of the vehicle for one hour by including a speeding vehicle detection program, and transmits the detected and stored speed value to the outside through a wireless communication network in case a speed value which exceeds a reference speed value is detected from the detected and stored speed value more than a number which is equal to or more than a reference number; and includes a vehicle driving management server which receives the detected and stored speed value from the VSDT device through a wireless communication network and delivers the speed value to a preset report agency.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 일 실시예는 VSDT 장치를 이용한 차량 안전 운행 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 기술적 과제는 차량 내에 차량 속도 데이터 전송 장치를 구비하여 운전자의 과속 또는 졸음 운전으로 인한 교통사고 발생을 방지할 수 있게 하는데 있다. 
이를 위해 본 발명의 일 실시예는 차량 내에 구비되고, 과속 차량 검출 프로그램을 내장하여 제1 시간동안 상기 차량의 속도를 검출 및 저장하고, 상기 검출 및 저장된 속도값 중 기준 속도값을 초과하는 속도값이 기준 횟수 이상 검출되는 경우, 상기 검출 및 저장된 속도값을 무선 통신망을 통하여 외부로 전송하는 차량 속도 데이터 전송 장치; 및 상기 차량 속도 데이터 전송 장치로부터 상기 검출 및 저장된 속도값을 무선 통신망을 통하여 전송받아 미리 설정된 신고기관으로 전달하는 차량 운행 관리 서버를 포함하는 VSDT 장치를 이용한 차량 안전 운행 시스템을 개시한다.
assignees: GMS CO LTD;LEE HYUN GU;YUN KEUN JIN

title_en: Wireless network-based sensing module of urban railway
title_ko: 도시철도 현장 기능실의 무선 네트워크 기반 센싱 모듈
abstract_en: The present invention is to provide a wireless network-based sensing module of an urban railway field function room comprising a plurality of wireless non-contact sensors for measuring real-time status information of substation facilities, electrical facilities, signal facilities, and communication facilities installed in the urban railway field function room. The present invention may improve maintenance and inspection efficiency by real-time measuring and detecting of the inspection of the facilities installed in the urban railway field function room. In addition, the present invention may prevent safety accidents such as fire in advance because it can confirm and check in real time the conditions such as voltage, temperature, vibration, smoke detection of various facilities installed in the urban railway field function room. In particular, the present invention may improve the efficiency of use because it can record and manage a state of facilities in the urban railway field function room in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도시철도 현장 기능실에 설치한 변전설비, 전기설비, 신호설비, 통신설비의 상태 정보를 실시간으로 측정하는 다수개의 무선 비접촉식 센서;를 포함하는 도시철도 현장 기능실의 무선 네트워크 기반 센싱 모듈을 제공하기 위한 것으로, 본 발명은 도시철도 현장 기능실에 설치한 설비의 점검을 실시간으로 측정 및 감지하여 유지보수 및 점검효율을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과를 갖는다. 또한, 본 발명은 도시철도 현장 기능실에 설치한 각종 설비의 전압, 온도, 진동 상태, 연기감지 등과 같은 상황을 실시간으로 확인 및 점검할 수 있으므로 화재 등과 같은 안전사고를 사전에 방지할 수 있는 효과를 갖는다. 특히 본 발명은 도시철도 현장 기능실의 설비 상태를 실시간으로 기록 및 관리할 수 있으므로 사용효율을 향상시킬 수 있는 효과를 갖는다.

title_en: Intelligent predictive and triage control system based on deep queries
title_ko: 심층 질의 기반 지능형 예측 및 선별 관제 시스템
abstract_en: An intelligent prediction and selection control system based on a deep query comprises: an input module; a deep query engine; a selection management scheduler engine; an image analysis engine; and a control module. The present invention increases the convenience of setting a control condition by setting an in-depth query method and multiple conditions, and facilitates command modification and execution state classification with a selective control scheduler.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 심층 질의 기반 지능형 예측 및 선별 관제 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상세하게는 심층 질의 방식으로 미리 설정한 관제 조건이 충족된 경우, 선별적으로 관제 조건에 대응되는 이벤트를 수행함으로써, 관제의 효율성을 높일 수 있는 심층 질의 기반 지능형 예측 및 선별 관제 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명은 음성이나 텍스트로 구성되는 문장을 입력받는 입력 모듈과; 입력 모듈에 의하여 입력된 문장을 해석하고, 문장이 미래 조건형 명령인 경우 명령어 조건을 생성하며, 생성된 명령어 조건을 충족하는 영상이 기록되어 관제될 수 있도록 명령어 조건을 선별 관제 스케쥴에 등록하는 심층 질의 엔진과; 선별 관제 스케쥴을 관리하는 선별 관리 스케쥴러 엔진과; 영상 장치에서 촬영된 영상을 분석하되,  심층 질의 엔진에서 등록한 명령어 조건을 충족하는 이벤트 발생 여부를 분석하는 영상 분석 엔진과; 영상 분석 결과 선별 관제 스케쥴에 등록된 명령어 조건을 충족하는 영상 이벤트 발생시, 각 조건에 따라 실행되어야 하는 실행 이벤트를 수행하도록 실행 이벤트와 관련되는 디바이스에 실행 명령을 내리는 제어 모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 심층 질의 기반 지능형 예측 및 선별 관제 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Computerized method and system for global health, personal safety and emergency response
abstract_en: A computerized system and method for intuitively detecting a user's need for emergency help, preventive care and medical interventions and also for coordinating care for user's loved ones and pets when user experiences an emergency or has passed away. Detection is done via labs and life signs equipment and sensors, self-initiated request for monitoring or the system's periodically polling user through an alert, a telephone call, a notification, a text message or other appropriate means to find out if they are in danger. Polling and automated monitoring may also be triggered by real-time medical data electronically or wirelessly transmitted to the system. If user fails to respond, the system automatedly calls either user's contacts (by listed priority) to notify them of a potential emergency, or emergency responders directly depending on severity of the emergency and communicates to them critical information as well as a code to access user's medical record(s).

title_en: Information processing method and non-transitory recording medium
abstract_en: An information processing method causes a processor in a terminal to: display, on the display of the terminal, a first screen representing a pre-preparation process included in cooking processes, the first screen displaying information indicating an intermediate foodstuff made through the pre-preparation process; acquire first identification information indicating a food container storing the intermediate foodstuff from an electronic tag apparatus attached to the food container while the first screen is displayed on the display; store, in a memory, information indicating the intermediate foodstuff or pre-preparation process and the first identification information in correspondence with each other; display, on the display, a second screen representing a finish process included in the cooking processes, the intermediate foodstuff being prepared in the finish process; and when the second screen is displayed, transmit a command to the electronic tag apparatus according to the first identification information so that the user discriminates the food container.

title_en: Method for Weighted Voting in a Public Safety Distributed Ledger
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method and apparatus allow for weighted voting in a public safety distributed ledger. A first node operating in a distributed ledger network receives an incident data record of one or more other nodes to maintain a distributed ledger. The first node reviews the incident data record to determine a vote. The vote indicates whether the incident data record should be entered into the distributed ledger. The vote is sent to a second node operating in the distributed ledger network. Votes are received from the one or more other nodes, and weights are determined for each node operating in the distributed ledger network node. A weighted vote result is calculated utilizing the votes and the weights. The distributed ledger is updated with the incident data record when the weighted vote result is greater than or equal to a predetermined threshold.

title_en: Canine emergency alert system
abstract_en: An emergency alert system and method of operation are provided. The system includes an emergency alert pad configured to detect a pad activation by a service animal and communicate a pad alert in response. An emergency alert vest is worn by the service animal and is configured to detect a vest activation by a person in proximity and communicate a vest alert in response. A user mobile device is in communication with the emergency alert pad and vest and is configured to record a pre-recorded message. At Ieast one affiliated mobile device is configured to receive the pre-recorded message during the pad activation and the vest activation. An emergency response center is in communication with the emergency alert pad and the emergency alert vest and is configured to receive at least one of the pad alert and the vest alert and provide emergency services accordingly.

title_en: Method for preserving access to system in case of disaster
abstract_en: A method for preserving access to document data within a system in a separate location, wherein said document data is stored in a system filestore associated with a system database, the system database containing reference data to point to the document data within the system filestore, in case of disaster to the primary system such as, earthquake, the secondary system can be used, the method comprising steps of: creating a replicated server containing the system database and filestore; determining that a insert, update, delete command has been issued within the primary production system database upon its system tables excepting those containing reference information that uniquely identifies the production system database from its replica on the network fabric; transferring and recording the commands above to the database system tables of the replica based on time of earliest recorded data; transferring recorded document data to secondary filestore using incremental filestore backup transfers;

title_en: Integrated waterlogging management system for comprehensive prevention, prediction, and response to waterlogging
title_ko: 침수의 예방과 예측 및 대응을 통합적으로 관리하는 침수 통합관리시스템
abstract_en: The flooding integrated management system comprises: a management server; an image photographig apparatus; and a flooding sensing composite sensor in which the weather information gathering unit, the storage, and data management and flooding depth estimator are included. The present invention predicts and reinforces flooding facilities in advance, guides residents' evacuation routes, and minimizes flooding damage and casualties by responding in real time.
abstract_ko: 관리영역에 위치한 시설물의 침수 가능성을 예측함으로써 침수에 의한 인명피해 등의 안전사고를 방지할 수 있는 침수 통합관리시스템이 개시된다.  이를 위하여 기상용 API가 설치되며, 상기 기상용 API를 통해 기상 서버로부터 관리영역에 대한 강우량 및 강우시간이 포함된 기상정보와 기상예보를 수집하는 기상정보 수집부와, 상기 기상정보 수집부가 수집한 기상정보와 SWMM 프로그램을 저장하는 저장부와, 상기 저장부에 저장된 관리영역의 기상정보와 SWMM 프로그램을 이용해 관리영역 내에서 지하공간을 갖는 시설물의 침수 심도를 산정하며, 강우량 및 강우시간을 변수로 사용해 침수 심도를 예측하는 수문 데이터 그리드 모형을 생성하는 데이터 관리부, 및 상기 기상예보의 강우량 및 강우시간을 상기 수문 데이터 그리드 모형에 적용해 관리영역 내의 시설물별로 침수 심도를 예측하는 침수심 예측부가 포함된 관리서버를 포함하는 침수 통합관리시스템을 제공한다.  본 발명에 의하면, 관리영역에 위치한 시설물 중 침수 가능성이 높은 시설물을 미리 예측할 수 있어 침수를 방지하기 위한 보강을 미리 수행할 수 있으므로, 침수로 인한 피해를 사전에 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: Earthquake warning systems and related methods
abstract_en: Implementations of a method and system of warning of estimated time of arrival and expected intensity in a given area resulting from a seismic movement including a plurality of measurement elements where the method includes arranging the plurality of measurement elements in a specific area; communicating each of the measuring elements with at least one control center; storing in each measuring element a unique identifier; transforming the measurement of the movement to a scalar representing the intensity of the movement; transmitting periodically and in real time the measurement and the unique identifier to the control center for the duration of the movement; recording the individualized measurements from each of the measuring elements; verifying if the received measurement corresponds to an actual earthquake or a mechanical noise; designating a destination point; determining the expected intensity and expected arrival time; and automatically dispatching an earthquake early warning to the destination point.

title_en: Shore-based formation combat command training simulation system display control console device
abstract_en: This novel commander that belongs to, concretely relates to bank base formation combat commander training analog system shows accuse platform device. The main control device comprises an industrial control host, the industrial control host sends video output signals to a video signal distribution device, the video signal distribution device sends contents to be displayed on the main control device to an internal display device through a screen recording device, the video signal distribution device sends the contents to be displayed on the external device to the external display device, the industrial control host receives signals from an auxiliary expansion unit and an input device, and the industrial control host receives signal input from the input device. This neotype effect is: the training reality is strong, saves space, improves the training effect, and has good expansibility.

title_en: Intelligent terminal based health management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent terminal based health management system which comprises a portable multi-parameter measuring device, an intelligent terminal health management application module and a remote service center. The portable multi-parameter measuring device monitors various physiological parameter information and transmits measuring results to an intelligent terminal in the form of sound carrier signals; the intelligent terminal health management application module is arranged on the intelligent terminal and used for storing and recording the measuring results sent by the portable multi-parameter measuring device according to the received sound carrier signals and sending the measuring results to the remote service center according to the requirements of users; and the remote service center is used for receiving the measuring results containing the various physiological parameter information of the users and giving emergency responses when physiological parameters exceed normal ranges, and the measuring results are sent by the intelligent terminal health management application module. The system can real-timely monitor the physiological parameters of the users and is convenient to carry and capable of achieving movable health management and health care assistance.
assignees: DAI WANHUI;FENG WEI;RONG HUI;ZHU LIN;LI CHENG;HE ZHENG

title_en: A kind of emergency communication temporary base station construction method based on unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of emergency communication temporary base station construction method based on unmanned plane, including unmanned plane, base station equipment, intelligent scheduling center.When there is the condition of a disaster in somewhere, unmanned plane carries base station equipment and goes to the condition of a disaster place overhead fixed high from steady flight rapidly, primarily determine the distribution density of disaster area crowd's communication equipment, intelligent scheduling center is according to disaster area crowd's communication equipment distribution density, more unmanned planes are dispatched to the region more than the crowd's communication equipment of disaster area, according to the quantity of the feedback appropriate adjustment unmanned plane of communication quality to optimize communication quality.When unmanned plane electricity is lower than 35%, the replacement work of equivalent amount unmanned plane progress unmanned plane temporary base station is sent rapidly at intelligent scheduling center.Intelligent scheduling central record disaster area crowd's communication equipment distribution density and its variation tendency, the prediction of a period of time is carried out using intelligent algorithm, and forward scheduling unmanned plane goes to prediction place to establish temporary base station, guarantees the good communication of rescue signal in the disaster relief.

title_en: Simulation training system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulation training system. The director control subsystem is arranged at the director part and is used for assisting the director to finish various tasks of drilling preparation and drilling implementation; the command control subsystem is arranged at the end conditioning group of each stage of command post or director department; the simulation model subsystem is deployed at a director department and mainly simulates various combat action processes and results of the red and blue parties, so as to provide continuous, dynamic and real-time simulation battlefield situations for commanders; the comprehensive situation display subsystem is deployed at a director department and used for continuously, dynamically and near-real-time displaying and recording fighting situations of the red and blue parties, and meets the requirement of real-time monitoring of a training process by director personnel in the training process. The invention simulates vivid threat environment, covers various typical targets, simulates common attack combat styles such as maneuvering, formation, anti-radiation attack and the like, has electromagnetic scattering characteristics consistent with the typical combat targets, and can record main firepower platform display control information, position deployment and main platform activity real-time.
assignees: ANHUI JUNTONG ZHIHUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Internet of things fire fighting equipment early warning method and system based on data processing
abstract_en: The invention provides an Internet of things fire fighting equipment early warning method and system based on data processing, and relates to the technical field of digital processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a fire fighting information distribution map; generating a fire fighting equipment adaptation grade; acquiring a fire-fighting facility adaptation specification set; building a fire-fighting facility dispatching management platform; connecting a fire hydrant pressure monitoring terminal, a spraying pipe network pressure detection terminal and a fire fighting water source liquid level detection terminal, and guiding a real-time monitoring data set into a fire fighting facility dispatching management platform; judging whether to activate a facility early warning signal or not through a fire-fighting facility early warning system; and if the facility early warning signal is activated, packaging and sending the facility early warning signal to an emergency processing column of the fire-fighting facility early warning system. The technical problem of poor state early warning timeliness of the fire fighting equipment of the Internet of things is solved, the fire fighting equipment specification of an intelligent matching target area is achieved, state early warning of the fire fighting equipment of the Internet of things is timely carried out, equipment early warning activation judgment is carried out, and the technical effect of supporting timely maintenance of the fire fighting equipment is provided.
assignees: WUXI BUTA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire-extinguishing rescue tactic sleeve board
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-extinguishing rescue tactical board, which comprises three tactical boards, namely a team station fire-extinguishing rescue tactical board, a large team-level fire-extinguishing rescue tactical board and a fire-extinguishing rescue tactical panel, wherein each tactical board comprises a tactical board cover, an identification area and a hand-painted area, the tactical board cover, the identification area and the hand-painted area are sequentially connected, a plurality of identification pieces are adsorbed on the identification area, the identification pieces comprise a grade personnel label, a equipment label, a fire-fighting vehicle label and a combat team label, the identification pieces adsorbed on the identification area can be removed and adsorbed on the hand-painted area so as to draw a more accurate tactical map on site, the three tactical boards hand-painted area comprises an electronic map function, command information recording, transmission and sharing can be carried out in a traditional mode, and in an effective network state, the team, the command information (comprising words, audios and videos) can be cooperatively recorded, transmitted through a network, and the command information of various levels are convenient for the command staff to communicate and communicate with each other.

title_en: Power utilization potential safety hazard supervision method and system based on power utilization data cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety monitoring of electric power systems, in particular to an electric power safety hidden danger monitoring method and system based on an electric power data cloud platform, which are characterized in that multi-dimensional electric power data are collected in real time and preprocessed, the preprocessed data are subjected to multi-source fusion by combining a data fusion algorithm, and hidden danger detection is carried out on the fusion data by utilizing a multi-layer intelligent learning model; introducing a dynamic scoring mechanism, performing multidimensional scoring on the detection result, dividing hidden danger risk levels, triggering a multi-level early warning mechanism based on the risk levels, and implementing automatic emergency response; the intelligent hidden danger detection and dynamic risk assessment improves the monitoring accuracy and efficiency, reduces the manual intervention and improves the timeliness of emergency response.

title_en: Based on VR gas safety emergency training system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of training simulation, and discloses a gas safety emergency training system based on VR (virtual reality). The system comprises a three-dimensional scene construction module, an interactive data acquisition module, an interactive data processing module, an assessment data analysis module and an assessment evaluation module; the training method replaces physical exercise, training can be repeated for an infinite number of times in the same scene, training cost is obviously reduced, a VR technology provides multi-sense stimulation, visual cognition of students on danger is enhanced, safety consciousness and emergency response capability are effectively improved, dangerousness is avoided, key coefficients such as timeliness ‌, ‌ path planning rationality ‌ and the like are automatically calculated by a system through collecting student operation data, the operation precision ‌, ‌ flow compliance ‌ and ‌ of ‌ equipment are processed, scientific quantification and accurate scoring of training effects are achieved, automatic grading evaluation is carried out according to scoring results, a custom review module is triggered on students with insufficient capability, a 'training-assessment-intervention' closed loop is formed, and overall training efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANYANG CHINA RESOURCES GAS CO LTD

title_en: Disaster area emergency communication networking method and system based on airborne base station and optical fiber transmission
abstract_en: The application provides a disaster area emergency communication networking method and system based on an airborne base station and optical fiber transmission, wherein a hybrid communication network is constructed by deploying the airborne base station and a ground optical fiber node; the method comprises the steps of collecting communication demand data and link state parameters, dynamically adjusting coverage area of a base station and optical fiber bandwidth based on a load balancing algorithm, monitoring a transmission link by adopting a link quality evaluation model and generating an optimization strategy, and forwarding user data according to emergency communication priority in a grading manner. According to the application, the quick communication coverage of the disaster area is realized by integrating the flexibility of the airborne base station and the optical fiber transmission stability, the reliability and the timeliness of emergency communication are improved, and the post-disaster rescue command and the public communication demands can be effectively supported.
assignees: GUANGDONG ZHONG KE RUI TAI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Big data security management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a big data security management system, which aims at the problems of source end unreliability, link leakage, centralized storage single point, rough authorization, disposal lag and the like, and provides a security management system for covering a full life cycle. The system comprises acquisition security, transmission encryption, storage security, access control, threat detection, situation awareness, tracing and emergency response modules. The method comprises the steps of generating a session basis through multi-factor authentication, deriving a dynamic key according to time slices and encrypting data slices by slices, adopting distributed storage and uplink metadata to realize non-falsifiability, using attributes as cores to implement fine-grained authorization, utilizing a sequence model linkage knowledge graph to identify abnormality and calculate a risk index, and automatically reconstructing a log chain and executing isolation, alarm or recording when the threshold is exceeded. The system realizes trusted acquisition, confidential transmission, traceable storage, fine authorization and automatic treatment, and remarkably improves safety and compliance.
assignees: QINGYI SHUKE BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multiple robot control device, method for controlling movement paths of multiple robots according to emergency commands, system and program
title_ko: 다수의 로봇 제어 장치, 비상 명령에 따라 다수의 로봇의 이동 경로를 제어하는 방법, 시스템 및 프로그램
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an apparatus for controlling a plurality of unmanned moving objects using flexible moving path information comprises: a memory; at least one processor performing communication with the memory; and a communication module performing communication with the plurality of unmanned moving objects and a user terminal, wherein the processor can be configured to: generate moving path information by determining the shortest moving path to a destination based on destination information of each of the plurality of unmanned moving objects and information on a plurality of stopovers for reaching the destination when receiving a task command from the user terminal; transmit top view image data for a moving space of the plurality of unmanned moving objects, mission information corresponding to the task, and the generated moving path information to each of the plurality of unmanned moving objects at a predetermined cycle; and allow the unmanned moving objects to move to the destination based on the plurality of pieces of moving path information received at a time before the communication disconnection when communication between each of the plurality of unmanned moving objects and the communication module is cut off.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 유동적인 이동경로 정보를 이용한 다수 무인이동체 제어장치는 메모리, 상기 메모리와 통신을 수행하는 적어도 하나의 프로세서 및 다수 무인이동체 및 사용자 단말과 통신을 수행하는 통신모듈을 포함하고, 상기 프로세서는, 상기 사용자 단말로부터 작업 명령을 수신하면, 상기 다수 무인이동체 각각의 목적지 정보 및 상기 목적지에 도달하기 위한 복수의 경유지 정보를 기초로 목적지까지 최단 이동경로를 판단하여 이동경로 정보를 생성하고, 상기 다수 무인이동체의 이동공간에 대한 탑뷰 이미지 데이터, 상기 작업에 대응되는 미션 정보 및 생성된 상기 이동경로 정보를 미리 결정된 주기로 상기 다수 무인이동체 각각에 전송하고, 상기 다수 무인이동체 각각과 상기 통신모듈의 통신이 단절되면, 상기 무인이동체는 통신 단절 이전 시점에 수신한 복수의 상기 이동경로 정보를 기초로 상기 목적지까지 이동하도록 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Dive dome structure for underwater leisure activities, underwater leisure activities application for using same, and server linked to underwater leisure activities application
title_ko: 수중 레저용 다이브 돔 구조체 및 이를 이용하기 위한 수중 레저 앱 및 이와 연동하는 서버
abstract_en: According to the present invention, an underwater leisure activities provider enables underwater leisure activities business place (a diving pool, a resort, and the like) and usable services to be easily promoted to the public by using a corresponding underwater leisure activities application. In addition, the underwater leisure activities provider can cause customers to become interested in hoping for diving training or desiring a diving tour by registering pictures of the diving tour area of the place of business and facility pictures of the place of business through the corresponding underwater leisure activities application. In addition, a direct-experience training program related to underwater leisure activity sports related to a dive dome structure at a safety-ensured place can be used. A customer can check, through the underwater leisure activities application, the location of a dive dome and the number of people who can make a reservation in real time, assign an underwater leisure activity with GPS, register the number of participants, a water entry time, and a water exit time, and deliver the registered information to a maritime safety management and supervisory office such that an emergency rescue can be quickly supported through location transmission in case of an accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 경우, 수중레저사업자는 해당 수중 레저 앱을 이용하여 수중 레저 영업장(다이빙 풀, 리조트 등)의 위치, 이용 가능한 서비스를 대외적으로 용이하게 홍보할 수 있다는 이점, 또한 수중레저사업자는 해당 수중 레저 앱을 통해 영업장의 다이빙 투어지역의 사진, 영업장 시설사진을 등록함으로써, 다이빙 교육을 희망하거나 다이빙 투어를 원하는 고객들의 흥미를 유발시킬 수 있다. 또한, 안전이 확보된 장소에서의 다이브 돔 구조체와 연계된 수중 레저 스포츠와 관련된 체험 교육 프로그램을 이용할 수 있다는 이점이 있다. 고객은 수중 레저 앱을 통해 다이브 돔에 대한 위치확인 및 실시간 예약가능 인원을 확인할 수 있고, 수중레저활동을 GPS로 지정하고 참여인원, 입수와 출수 시간을 등록할 수 있으며, 등록된 정보를 해양안전관리감독 기관에 전달함으로써, 사고발생 시 위치전송을 통해 빠르게 응급구조를 지원받을 수 있다는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for communicating with emergency dispatch services
abstract_en: Emergency reporting is described in which user input is received in an emergency call, the user input being used to classify the call. Based on this classification process, emergency calls are processed to give priority to certain calls. The call given the highest priority may be sent over the voice network while other calls may be sent over the data network. The report includes: the method includes receiving a user input identifying an emergency perspective of a user, and selecting a data call based on the emergency perspective indicating that the user is a spectator. It still includes: recording an audio message from the user and transmitting the audio message to a Public Service Answering Point (PSAP) over a data network.

title_en: Reservoir dam siltation dynamic monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of reservoir dam safety monitoring, and discloses a reservoir dam siltation dynamic monitoring and early warning system. The multidimensional sensing node array of the system is arranged at key positions of a dam body structure and a reservoir area, and sediment thickness distribution data, water flow speed field data and sediment concentration gradient data are synchronously collected. The edge computing nodes receive the raw monitoring data, perform data cleaning and space-time alignment processing, and generate a standardized siltation feature data set. And the cloud analysis platform receives the data set, calculates a siltation evolution trend matrix through a space-time coupling prediction model, and outputs a siltation risk level distribution map of a reservoir area. The dynamic visualization engine analyzes the risk level distribution map, generates a three-dimensional dynamic siltation situation model, and marks the space coordinates of the abnormal siltation area. And the early warning decision center generates a grading early warning instruction set according to the space coordinates of the abnormal region, and triggers a corresponding emergency response strategy.

title_en: Emergency situation detecting system using a buoyancy suit
title_ko: 부력복을 이용한 위급 상황 감지 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency situation detection system using a buoyant suit, capable of promptly and accurately preparing for negligent accidents and casualties by recognizing information about a body of a wearer. The emergency situation detection system includes: the buoyant suit which is made of a buoyant material, is worn on the body, senses the state of each part of the body and outputs the sensed state to the outside through near field communication; a mobile phone which is mounted on the buoyant suit and includes a data collection and transmission unit which receives the sensed information transmitted from the buoyant suit and transmits the information to the outside through a wireless network as a program, inside; and a management server which stores the sensed information of the body wirelessly transmitted through the mobile phone as a database, determines whether the body is in an emergency situation by comparing and analyzing the information of the body which is transmitted with reference information, and transmits a rescue signal to an emergency rescue center if it is determined that the body is in the emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 착용자의 인체에 대한 정보를 인지할 수 있어 안전사고와 인명사고에 대한 대비가 신속하면서 정확하게 이루어지도록 하는 부력복을 이용한 위급 상황 감지 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 위급 상황 감지 시스템은 부력재로 형성되고, 인체에 착용되며, 인체의 각 부위의 상태를 감지하여 근거리무선통신을 통해 외부로 출력하는 부력복과; 상기 부력복에 착용되고, 상기 부력복에서 전송되는 감지된 정보를 입력받아 무선 네트워크를 통해 외부로 전송하는 데이터수집 및 전송부가 프로그램으로 내장되는 핸드폰과; 상기 핸드폰을 통해 무선으로 전송되는 인체의 감지 정보를 데이터베이스화하고, 전송된 인체의 정보를 기준 정보와 비교 분석하여 인체가 위급한 상황인지를 판별하며, 인체의 위급 상황으로 판별된 경우에 응급구호센터에 구호 신호를 발송하는 관리서버를; 포함한다.

title_en: Intelligent LED street lamp for highway illumination
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent LED street lamp for highway illumination, belonging to the field of street lamps; the method comprises the following steps: communication base station, lamp post, lamp beam, antenna box, etc.; the utility model is characterized in that the traditional street lamp is improved, and the intellectualization of the road lighting street lamp is improved; the traditional street lamp often only has a lighting function, and the street lamp is endowed with the function of a communication base station on the basis of the traditional street lamp and is used as a transfer station for the Internet of vehicles and 5G communication; the intelligent LED street lamp can intelligently acquire and store highway monitoring information, feed back the road condition to a traffic command center in time, provide remote communication capability and improve the timeliness of highway emergency information; meanwhile, the intelligent street lamp is simple to operate, low in cost and suitable for large-range layout, the coverage area of a 5G communication network can be effectively improved, the communication capacity is effectively improved, and communication congestion is reduced; network coverage and timely acquisition of emergency information can be realized on remote roads.
assignees: XIAMEN JIAOAN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: TFT LCD Can Moving Fired Image Seeing And Checking System for looking out electric fire by TFT LCD scene
title_ko: 이동이 가능하고 tft lcd 화면으로 화재 영상 화면을체크를 할 수 있는 이동형 전기 화재 감시 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 빌딩 내에 감시하여야 할 곳에 연기감지 ,GPS 내장 ,시리얼 카메라, sd 카드가 내장 되어 있는 센서 가 있는 이동이 가능한 전기 화재감시용 시스템을 설치하여 연기 감지 센서 작동 시 자동으로 시리얼 카메라가 신속하게 화재 지점의 영상을 저장되고 무선 통신 모듈로 화재 영상을 근거리에는 지그비 송수신 모듈로 모니터로 전송 되고 원거리에는 CDMA 모듈을 사용하여 CDMA PHONE, PDA 에 전달하여 주고 현장에서는 TFT LCD 로 화재 시점의 SD 카드에 저장된 영상 장면을 불러와서 볼수 있고 지난 화재 사건의 영상을 이전 내용 확인 S/W 와 다음 내용확인 S/W를 통해 확인 할 수 있는 빌딩 내/외 이동이 가능한 전기 화재감시 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위해 본 고안은 빌딩 내의 감시하여야 할 곳에 복수개의 시리얼 카메라와 ,자동 촬영 유무를 감지하는 연기 감지 센서 와 상기 센서의 작동시 자동 연동으로 카메라의 영상을 저장하고 현재 화재 상태 화면을 콘트롤러 에서 영상기록 매체인 SD 카드에 기록 및 저장함과 동시에 무선 통신으로 영상을 모니터 및 CDMA PHONE, PDA 에 전달하도록 제어하고 화재발생시 모니터,CDMA PHONE, PDA에서 영상 화재 이메징 을 받을수 있고, 화재 진압 이 될 수 있는 제어 릴레이 2,3 장착하여 구현되고 자체 연기 감지기에서도 화재 경보 수단 제어 소자로도 되는 기술적 구성상의 특징 과 TFT LCD 로 영상 저장 화면을 볼 수 있는 시스템 으로 구성되어 있다. 
     DC 전원 입력 으로 콘트롤러 가 동작이 되고 이동이 가능한 전기 화재감시 시스템에 DC 동작 전원이 인가 되지 않으면 전원 인가 여부 체크 검사부에서 체크하고 충전되고 있는 리듐 이온 배터리 에서 전원이 비상 공급되어 콘트롤러, 지그비 송수신 모듈, CDMA 모듈, 센서의 동작 전원을 공급하게 된다. 
     외부 신호 센서로는, 침입 감지 센서, 연기감지 센서가 있고 시리얼 영상 카메라는 화재 사고가 난 지점 의 영상을 저장하고 조명장치로 빛을 밝힘으로 써 콘트롤러 제어에 의해 SD 카드로 영상이 저장되고 ,경보 부저가 동작이 되고, 통신 모듈(지그비 송수신모듈, CDMA모듈)에 의해 CDMA PHONE, PDA 에 전송 및 모니터에 선명한 화질을 보관 전송 토록 한다. 
       
     이동이 가능한 전기 화재 감시 시스템, 시리얼 카메라, 연기 감지 센서, SD 카드 콘트롤러, GPS , 조명장치, 침입 감지 센서, 제어 릴레이 1, 제어릴레이 2, 제어 릴레이 3, TFT LCD, 이전 내용 확인 S/W, 다음 내용 확인 S/W, 영상 저장 버턴

title_en: Intelligent city SOS emergency call system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent city SOS emergency call system, which comprises a call button arranged on a vertical column of a city place name guide system. The call button is connected with an emergency control center. The emergency control center is respectively connected with a 110 public security system, a 120 first aid system, a 119 fire extinguishing system and a GPS vehicle theft prevention system. The surface of the call button is provided with a fingerprint identification system, and the fingerprint identification system is respectively connected with a national fingerprint database of the 110 public security system and the emergency control center. Through lattice layout, full coverage in the city plane space is realized, the system is turned on for 24 hours, the call button is directly connected with the emergency control center once triggered, and the emergency response timeliness can be ensured to the most extent. Through an LED display system and a camera monitoring system, the field condition can be timely and comprehensively known, two-way interaction of remote information can also be realized, and continuous and comprehensive mastering on the information is kept.
assignees: GELINFEIER INTELLIGENT TECH JIANGSU CO LTD

title_en: River sudden water pollution early warning tracing method, system, terminal and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river sudden water pollution early warning tracing method, a system, a terminal and a medium, and the technical scheme is as follows: acquiring online monitoring data and historical monitoring data of conventional water quality indexes; starting an abnormal algorithm for water quality analysis and prediction on the received online monitoring data, and carrying out early warning and forecasting on the abnormal algorithm; starting a decision response according to the detected abnormal instantaneous water quality event, and operating an emergency monitoring scheme after the emergency response; calculating according to a quantitative inversion traceability algorithm of the source item model to obtain pollution source information, and optimizing the pollution source information; feeding back the optimization result to an emergency response to optimize a monitoring scheme; and inputting instructions in a man-machine interaction mode according to the traceability feedback results of the source item model, and repeating the operation until the traceability search range is reduced to a degree that the pollution source can be found through field investigation. The online monitoring real-time response, the qualitative and quantitative inversion emission history estimation and the pollution source position identification of the river water quality are realized, and the accuracy and the timeliness of the water quality abnormity early warning are improved.
assignees: SOUTH CHINA INST ENVIRONMENTAL SCIENCES MEE

title_en: Novel remote online investigation and evidence obtaining method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a novel remote online investigation and evidence collection method, which comprises the following steps: A. preparation before question: before the inquiry, the inquiry notice book, the right obligation notice book, the inquiry record book, the identification contrast, the identification record book, the evidence notice book and the evidence list are uploaded or edited and sealed. The remote online investigation system is not only suitable for public security, inspection yards and court, but also can be linked with a dispatching place and a guard place, thereby really realizing remote inquiry of the victim, the witness and remote inquiry of the criminal suspect, saving the case handling time and improving the case handling efficiency.
assignees: ZHENGYITONG NANJING INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Operation and maintenance emergency process management system and method based on intelligent contract and consensus mechanism
abstract_en: The invention relates to an operation and maintenance emergency process management system and method based on an intelligent contract and a consensus mechanism, wherein the system comprises an emergency management module, an intelligent contract module and a consensus mechanism module; the method comprises the steps of collecting different monitoring data, calling a judging type intelligent contract, carrying out emergency scene judgment on the collected different monitoring data, outputting to obtain a plurality of emergency scene judgment results, carrying out consensus processing on the plurality of emergency scene judgment results to obtain an emergency scene consensus result, calling a disposal type intelligent contract, creating an emergency work order, associating the emergency scene with a corresponding emergency disposal command, disposing related assets, calling a recording type intelligent contract, and recording the disposal result and emergency process information. Compared with the prior art, the invention can effectively solve the problems of decision delay and error in the emergency process caused by individual experience difference.
assignees: CHANGSANJIAO SHULIAN SHANGHAI NETWORK INFRASTRUCTURE CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic goods supplementing method and system for emergency medical supplies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic replenishment method and system for emergency medical supplies, which relate to the technical field of medical supply data management and comprise the steps of obtaining the actual consumption rate of medical supplies at the current moment of a medical institution; the method comprises the steps of obtaining emergency response factors according to the risk level of current emergency, obtaining ageing constraint factors according to the inventory condition of medical materials at the current moment of a medical institution, obtaining geographical optimization factors according to the distribution ageing of each medical material distribution warehouse, and calculating to obtain the safe replenishment quantity according to the actual consumption rate, the emergency response factors, the ageing constraint factors and the geographical optimization factors. According to the invention, through mathematical model innovation and algorithm collaborative optimization, a medical supply chain management system with elastic response capability is constructed, and the dimensions such as emergency timeliness, resource utilization rate and data security are obviously superior to those of the traditional method.
assignees: JOINTOWN MEDICAL INFORMATION TECH WUHAN CO LTD

title_en: Meta group intelligent information processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, in particular to a meta-group intelligent information processing method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an incident place according to event information, determining an alternative place according to a preset decision strategy based on the incident place, obtaining monitoring network data corresponding to the alternative place, carrying out hierarchical integration to obtain key format sentences, processing the key format sentences through a pre-training model to obtain pre-trained key format sentences, screening the pre-trained key format sentences according to the event information and a screening principle to obtain a data set, generating a resource allocation scheme according to the data set based on constraint conditions, carrying out fitness optimization on the resource allocation scheme by utilizing a genetic algorithm to obtain a resource allocation scheme with highest fitness. The invention solves the problem of information island and low information analysis timeliness existing in the prior security system when processing security tasks.

title_en: Intelligent training system and method for nursing operation of operating room
abstract_en: The application provides an intelligent training system and method for nursing operation of an operating room, which are characterized in that nursing operation tracks of a target user in a high-fidelity operation situation simulation environment matched with the type of the target operation are acquired in real time, a deviation map of the nursing operation tracks and standard operation is generated, time-space operation abnormal characteristics are identified in the deviation map, a pressure load index of the target user when an emergency occurs is determined according to the combined characteristics of various physiological signals of the target user on frequency change in combination with heart rate variability, the target user is guided to relieve psychological pressure and record physiological stress dynamic tracks of the target user when the pressure load index exceeds a preset psychological pressure threshold, and emergency response training is carried out on the target user based on the time-space operation abnormal characteristics and the physiological stress dynamic tracks. By adopting the scheme of the application, an adaptive intraoperative nursing emergency response capability training system can be constructed to dynamically intervene and train the intraoperative emergency response capability of nursing staff.
assignees: GUANGZHOU FIRST PEOPLES HOSPITAL GUANGZHOU DIGESTIVE DISEASE CENTER THE FIRST PEOPLES HOSPITAL AFFIL

title_en: Safeguard for moving
title_ko: 이동용 보안 시스템
abstract_en: A security system for movement is provided to inform a pre-registered/set remote manager server of an emergency by operating emergency alarm software attached within a car and transmit a real time video, and a video before an accident and a predicted movement path, thereby enabling a user to deal with an accident. Through a real time monitoring system, situations before an accident are monitored. Before 1~5 minutes from the time when emergency software is operated, a video recorded in a monitoring camera and a current real time video are divided by frames. The divided videos are transmitted in one video data. A receiving remote control server immediately divides the received video to output different videos, monitors the dual videos in real time, and observes before/after situations as viewing the two videos. And the server consults a current situation and persuades a criminal through a speaker phone. By using a GPS(Global Positioning System) function, a location is searched and a progress direction and progress speed are confirmed as well as computing and grasping a predicted movement path. And by using the GPS function, an emergency situation is informed to a near police or security company so as to deal with the emergency situation.
