title_en: Integrated display system for demonstration of naval combat system operation scenario and method thereof
title_ko: 함정전투체계 운용 시나리오 시연을 위한 통합전시체계 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Integrated display system and method for demonstrating scenarios for operating a ship combat system are provided to enhance a display through the organic connection of a ship combat system to model equipment. CONSTITUTION: An integrated display system for demonstrating scenarios for operating a ship combat system comprises buttons(100~150), an integrated display system controller(200), a display unit(300), various combat equipment models(400~800), and a ship model(900). The buttons operate a display system. The integrated display system controller operates with buttons. The display unit displays moving pictures according to the commands of the integrated display system controller and displays the configurations and operating scenarios of the ship combat system.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 함정전투체계 구성 및 운용 시나리오 시연을 위한 통합전시체계 시스템 및 구성 방법에 관한 것으로, 전투체계, 대공전, 대함전, 대잠전 성분 작전별 전투체계 운용 버튼으로 전시체계 구동을 위한 전면부에 설치된 버튼; 버튼과 연결되고, 버튼으로부터 전달되는 입력을 처리해 동영상을 전시하고, 각종 전투체계 장비 모형을 구동하며, 함정 모형, 탐색레이더 모형/추적레이더 모형/전자광학추적장비 모형, 전투정보실 모형, 전투체계장비실 모형 및 이를 제어하기 위한 통합전시 제어 프로그램을 탑재한 통합전시체계 제어기; 통합전시체계 제어기의 명령에 따라 관련 동영상을 전시하고, 함정전투체계 체계구성 및 운용시나리오를 전시하는 전시기; 실제 전투체계 장비를 정밀 모사하고, 통합전시체계 제어기의 명령에 따라 구동하거나 LED 및 광섬유를 설치하여 전투체계의 위치, 동작상태, 신호의 흐름을 표시하는 각종 전투체계 장비 모형; 및 함상 전투체계 장비(탐색레이더, 추적레이더, 전자광학추적장비 및 탑재 장비(대잠헬기전자전장비, 선체고정형음탐기체계, 전자전장비, 어뢰음향대항체계, 함포, 함대함유도무기체계, 대함유도탄방어유도탄, 근접방어무기체계, 경어뢰체계, 및 대유도탄기만체계))를 정밀 모사하는 함정 모형으로 구성되며, 전시되는 함정전투체계 운용 시나리오와 모형장비 동작 간의 유기적인 연결을 통해 전시 효과를 최대화하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Real time transmission system providing the information of accident vehicle to standardize vehicle damage by accident, to predict occupant's injury from vehicle crash, and and transmission method for the same, and computer-readable recording medium for the same
title_ko: 교통사고에 의한 차량파손 상태를 표준화하고 차량파손 상태로부터 탑승자의 부상 상태를 파악하기 위해 사고차량 정보를 실시간 전송하는 전송방법 및 이를 위한 컴퓨터로 판독가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology of generating a damage level of a vehicle into a standardized form in an accident and predicting occupants′ injury through the standardized form and, more specifically, to a technology of realizing a program in a smart terminal such that accident investigators collecting accident data or emergency medical technicians transferring emergency patients at the scene of an accident can easily input information on damage to a vehicle in a standardized form, immediately transmitting the inputted standardized data to an information management server of the 911 fire station, and allowing the information management server to retransmit the standardized data to the police station, insurance companies, hospitals, etc. Therefore, dealing with an accident vehicle and treating occupants may be effectively performed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교통사고시 차량의 파손 정도를 표준화 양식으로 생성하고 이를 통해 탑승자의 부상 상태를 예측하는 기술에 관한 것이다.  특히, 교통사고 현장에서 사고 자료를 수집하는 사고조사관이나 응급환자를 이송하는 구급대원이 차량파손에 대한 정보를 표준양식으로 간단히 입력할 수 있도록 하는 프로그램을 스마트 단말기에 구현하고, 그 입력된 표준화 자료가 즉각적으로 119 소방 상황센터의 정보관리 서버에 전송되고 다시 이를 필요로 하는 경찰, 보험회사, 병원 등에 재전송하도록 구성된다.  본 발명에 따르면 교통사고 차량의 처리 및 탑승자 치료를 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: A aquarium control system for providing coding education
title_ko: 코딩 교육용 수족관 제어 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an aquarium control system for coding education. The aquarium control system for coding education comprises an aquarium which comprises a sensor part for measuring a water temperature, pH, an amount of water, dissolved oxygen (DO), and the like, a heater, a pump, an air supplier, and a filter; a control part which is attached to the aquarium to receive measured values measured by the sensor part and controls the heater, the pump, the air supplier, and the filter; a communication part which is in connection with the control part and performs wired and wireless communication with the outside; a terminal device which receives an aquarium control command from a user and transmits the control command to the communication part; and a program which is installed at the terminal device, displays block commands in a block form for controlling the aquarium, forms the control command by collecting block commands selected by the user, receives a state of the aquarium, and displays the same on the terminal device. According to the present invention, an aquarium can be remotely controlled.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 코딩 교육용 수족관 제어 시스템에 관한 것으로, 수온, pH, 수량, 용존산소량(DO) 등을 측정하는 센서부, 히터, 펌프, 공기공급기, 여과기를 포함하는 수족관, 수족관에 부착되어 센서부에서 측정한 측정값을 수신하고, 히터, 펌프, 공기공급기, 여과기를 제어하는 제어부, 제어부와 연결되며 외부와 무선, 유선 통신을 수행하는 통신부, 사용자로부터 수족관 제어명령을 입력받아 상기 통신부에 상기 제어명령을 전송하는 단말장치, 단말장치에 설치되어 수족관을 제어하기 위한 블록 형태의 블록명령을 표출하고, 사용자가 선택한 블록명령을 수집하여 제어명령을 형성하고, 수족관 상태를 수신하여 단말장치에 표출하는 프로그램을 포함하는 코딩 교육용 수족관 제어 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: system for reliability of operator's manual action and method for reliability of operator's manual action
title_ko: 운전원 수동조치의 신뢰성 확보 시스템 및 운전원 수동조치의 신뢰성 확보 방법
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, a reliability assurance system of manual action by an operator comprises: a database including scenario data recorded for situations in which an accident occurs requiring manual action by an operator in a specific device among a plurality of devices in a power plant in which a plurality of devices are installed; an accident situation realization unit modeling a virtual power plant corresponding to the power plant and a plurality of virtual devices corresponding to the plurality of devices and implementing the situation in which the accident occurs in the virtual power plant based on the scenario data to simulate a process in which the operator takes manual action on a specific virtual device corresponding to the specific device among the plurality of virtual devices; an available time setting unit setting an available time, which is the time required for the operator to complete manual action on the specific virtual device in response to the accident; a diagnosis time measurement unit measuring a diagnosis time, which is the time consumed in a diagnosis step in which the operator recognizes the accident and specifies the specific virtual device among the plurality of virtual devices; a travel time measurement unit measuring a travel time, which is the time consumed in a movement step in which the operator moves from an initial position in the virtual power plant to an operation position in which the specific virtual device is installed; and an operation time measurement unit measuring an operation time, which is the time consumed in an operation step in which the operator operates the specific virtual device at the operation position. Accordingly, it is possible to assure appropriate manual action for accidents which may occur in power plants.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 운전원 수동조치의 신뢰성 확보 시스템은 복수의 기기가 설치된 발전소에서 상기 복수의 기기 중에 특정기기에 운전원의 수동조치가 요구되는 사고가 발생한 상황에 대한 시나리오데이터가 기록된 데이터베이스, 상기 발전소에 대응되는 가상발전소와 상기 복수의 기기에 대응되는 복수의 가상기기를 모델링하고, 상기 시나리오데이터를 기반으로 상기 가상발전소에서 상기 사고가 발생한 상황을 구현하여, 상기 운전원이 상기 복수의 가상기기 중에 상기 특정기기에 대응되는 특정가상기기를 수동조치하는 과정을 시뮬레이션하는 사고 상황 구현부, 구현된 상기 사고에 대응하여 상기 운전원이 상기 특정가상기기에 대한 수동조치를 완료하기까지 요구되는 시간인 가용시간을 설정하는 가용시간설정부; 상기 운전원이 상기 사고를 인지하고 상기 복수의 가상기기 중에 상기 특정가상기기를 특정하는 진단단계에서 소모된 시간인 진단시간을 측정하는 진단시간 측정부, 상기 운전원이 상기 가상발전소 내의 초기 위치에서 상기 특정가상기기가 설치된 조작 위치까지 이동하는 이동단계에서 소모된 시간인 이동시간을 측정하는 이동시간 측정부 및 상기 운전원이 상기 조작 위치에서 상기 특정가상기기를 조작하는 조작단계에서 소모된 시간인 조작시간을 측정하는 조작시간 측정부를 포함한다.

title_en: System, method, and program for managing dual-track business process considering disaster response business optimization and daily business continuity
title_ko: 재난 대응업무 최적화와 일상업무 연속성을 고려한 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 관리시스템, 관리방법 및 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system, a method, and a program for managing a dual-track business process considering infectious disaster response business optimization and daily business continuity and to a system for managing a dual-track business process considering disaster response business optimization and daily business continuity, the system comprising a regulation module that analyzes an institution's status, business impact, and risk in stages to derive dual-track business continuity process data of the institution, wherein the dual-track business continuity process data includes disaster response business process data and daily business process data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 감염재난 대응업무 최적화와 일상업무 연속성을 고려한 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 관리시스템, 관리방법 및 프로그램에 관한 것으로, 기관의 현황분석, 업무영향분석, 위험분석을 단계적으로 실시하여 기관의 듀얼 트랙 업무 연속성 프로세스 데이터를 도출하는 규정모듈;을 포함하고, 상기 듀얼 트랙 업무 연속성 프로세스 데이터는 재난대응업무 프로세스 데이터와, 일상업무 프로세스 데이터를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난 대응업무 최적화와 일상업무 연속성을 고려한 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 관리시스템에 대한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: Critical health information profile and emergency communication system
abstract_en: A microprocessor-based emergency response communication system used to call and communicate with the 9-1-1 operator and also allows emergency responder's immediate access to a user's Critical Health Information Profile stored in the device at the point and location of crisis. The device is used to create individual Critical Health Information Profiles which is Health Level-7 compliant enabling it to seamlessly communicate with major hospital networks worldwide. This functional capability provides a system that can retrieve and transmit user-stored personal and health information by emergency responders at the point of care. The emergency responder can access the customer's Critical Health Information Profile database, review the data for pertinent information and then transmit that data to a designated receiving hospital or medical center. The device provides an electronic means of dialing and communicating directly with the 9-1-1 operator. A wireless remote transmitter unit can be activated from the wireless transmitter or the base unit to dial and connect with the 9-1-1 operator, broadcast a canned message with or without a personal- recorded message, and personally communicate with the 9-1-1 operator through a two-way speakerphone system. The device contains software enabling the user and medical personnel the ability to input, store, retrieve and analyze the user's vital sign data and other pertinent health information.

title_en: Incident Recording Systems and Methods
abstract_en: A primary subsystem captures original information and supplemental information to form a revision. A primary subsystem enables revisions to be made at the location of the incident prior to leaving the location. Systems for collecting and managing information about incidents include primary and secondary subsystems. A category is a descriptor or label that identifies a common aspect among members assigned to the category. Categories may determine how information is stored, communicated, and/or accessed on primary and/or secondary subsystems.

title_en: Personal portable mobile monitoring and home service platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personal portable mobile monitoring and family service platform, which comprises a network platform for supervising and managing the personal portable mobile monitoring and family service platform in the whole country or in each city or each county; a recorded announcement device A, B, C, D for announcing the presence of the monitoring device and having a human body induction switch function and a remote control video monitoring device turn-on function; a monitoring device; a short version monitoring device; the system comprises a receiving device, a single smell balloon and a national rescuer network platform center; the automatic monitoring device can automatically monitor personal conditions at any place and any time, the monitoring device is started by the sensor, the monitoring device starts the foot monitoring device to automatically shoot, and the video is automatically transferred outwards to realize automatic alarm. Personal portable mobile and family service platform, belong to the video monitoring field, although the cell-phone can shoot the video now, but face illegal crime or incident, under most circumstances, oneself can not realize shooting the video, fixed monitoring platform, because the camera is fixed, distribution range is little scheduling problem, personal portable mobile monitoring and family service platform, realized the function that above-mentioned equipment can not be realized, and increased many functions newly, realized to some individual's various abnormal conditions, it is all-round, the control of whole period and provide the service for a family, the abstract attached drawing, explain the safety supervision to some individual.

title_en: Explosion-proof fire-fighting automatic fire extinguisher
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an explosion-proof fire-fighting automatic fire extinguishing device, which relates to the technical field of sealed motors and comprises a box body, wherein an explosion-proof electromagnetic valve is fixedly arranged in the box body, an explosion-proof air valve is matched with the top of the fire-proof air tank, an air tank pressure gauge is arranged between the explosion-proof electromagnetic valve and the fire-proof air tank, the explosion-proof electromagnetic valve is fixedly arranged at the end part of a pipeline, the pipeline extends to the outer side of the box body, a fire-extinguishing nozzle is fixedly arranged at the end part, and when the device works, an explosion-proof audible-visual alarm and the explosion-proof electromagnetic valve are simultaneously operated through a fire-fighting alarm host, so that the explosion-proof electromagnetic valve is opened, gas in the fire-extinguishing air tank is transmitted into the fire-extinguishing nozzle through the pipeline, the fire-fighting alarm host can record work and upload the work to a fire-fighting command center.
assignees: CHANGZHOU HELON EXPLOSION PROOF ELECTRICAL ENG CO LTD

title_en: Internet of things-based individual portable wireless narrowband video system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an Internet of things-based individual portable wireless narrowband video system, which comprises a portable intelligent terminal, an emergency alarming module, a wireless module, a storage server and a console module, wherein the portable intelligent terminal is connected with a portable camera by a line; the portable camera is connected with a voice module by the line; the emergency alarming module is connected with the portable intelligent terminal by the line, and provides an emergency alarming function; the wireless module is connected with the portable intelligent terminal by the line, and is also connected with a global positioning system (GPS) module and a power module by the line respectively; the storage server is connected with the portable intelligent terminal by an operator network; and the console module is connected with the storage server by the line, and has display and storage functions. The Internet of things-based individual portable wireless narrowband video system has the advantages of solving the problems of finishing field video information transmission and recording in the work of guard duty performing, patrolling, investigation, law enforcement, firefighting, rescuing, commanding and the like, along with exquisiteness and the functions of narrowband video transmission, voice calling, personnel positioning and the like.
assignees: BEIJING BOYA YINGJIE TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Video content analysis system and method for transportation system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of video content analysis systems for mobile asset, and it includes track detectings and infrastructure to monitor component.The track detecting and infrastructure monitoring are comprising to analyze video data, audio data, vehicle data, weather data and route/listings data to determine intensified learning component, object detection and the location component and detection of obstacles component of inside related with the assets and/or external condition.The data, inside and/or external condition information, object detection information, object location information and detection of obstacles information are uploaded to remote memory module and provide stream transmission video data in real time to the user of long range positioning by data acquisition and record system.The user of long range positioning can check the data by web browser or virtual reality device with various view modes, this provides very fast emergency response, verifying is repaired and the validity of route planning, and monitoring group member performance and safety again.

title_en: A kind of method and device having man-machine emergency remote sensing monitoring
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of method and devices for having man-machine emergency remote sensing monitoring.Step is: 1) ground sets up 2 or 2 or more the base stations GNSS, and records static GNSS data；2) different degrees of disaster-stricken situation and corresponding data acquisition time are recorded respectively；3) image initial data and IPAS initial data are obtained, disaster area latitude and longitude coordinates are obtained；4) devastated situation and coordinate information are sent to ground using communication apparatus；5) GNSS base station data is copied out, waits aircraft landing；6) aircraft landing, combined data do difference processing, resolve and generate SOL file；7) 1 grade of image with coordinate information is copied out scene and transfers ground disaster relief personnel to by operating personnel on machine.The present invention quickly post-processes remotely-sensed data using someone's eedle on machine, can determine and be notified to disaster-stricken situation and geographical location in time, facilitates decision, carries out rapid command rescue, reduces casualty loss, is suitble to large area operation.

title_en: Flood control emergency risk avoiding method based on LBS
abstract_en: The invention relates to a flood control emergency danger avoiding method based on LBS, which breaks through the existing personnel transferring mode and technical bottleneck based on household registration by introducing internet and mobile phone communication positioning big data and combining water conservancy, spatial terrain, internet crowd big data and the like to carry out comprehensive analysis, realizes accurate danger avoiding transfer to people, greatly improves the accuracy and timeliness of danger avoiding crowd identification, early warning, guidance, tracking and feedback, and practically improves the efficiency and effect of crowd emergency danger avoiding transfer in a flood inundation influence area. The problems that the traditional emergency risk avoiding technology is limited in real-time dynamic crowd information acquisition means, slow in notification response, low in early warning efficiency, difficult in tracking risk avoiding crowd transfer condition, difficult in control of transfer effect and the like are solved; the crowd emergency response action guide technology solves the problem of emergency action under natural disaster conditions such as earthquake, typhoon, tsunami and the like.
assignees: CHANGJIANG INST SURVEY PLANNING DESIGN & RES CO LTD

title_en: Multi-person collaborative virtual training drilling system and method for rescue
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of virtual reality, and discloses a multi-person collaborative virtual training drilling system and a method for rescue, wherein the multi-person collaborative virtual training drilling system for rescue comprises a management end, a server and a drilling end; the management end, the server and the drilling end are respectively connected through a network; the management terminal is used for setting a virtual drilling scene and a drilling task, wherein the drilling task comprises a drilling scheme and a rescue route; the drilling end is used for displaying a virtual drilling scene and acquiring the drilling operation of rescue workers; the drill end is provided with a plurality of drill ends (including a command end and a common drill end); the server is used for running the drilling program, providing data storage, data forwarding, score calculation and statistics for each drilling end, recording data generated by each drilling end in the operation process in real time, and updating the virtual drilling scene according to the drilling operation. The problems of high drilling cost, long preparation period and unsatisfactory drilling effect in the prior art are solved.
assignees: CHONGQING KEHUA SAFETY EQUIPMENT CO LTD;CHINA COAL TECHNOLOGY ENG GROUP CHONGQING RES INST

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting equipment supervision system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent fire-fighting equipment supervision system, which comprises: the internet of things sensing module is used for sensing and monitoring the state, the environmental parameters and the alarm information of the fire-fighting equipment; the hidden danger processing module is used for helping firefighters to better find, record, evaluate and process various hidden dangers of firefighting; the data processing module is used for helping to realize comprehensive management and intelligent application of the data of the fire fighting facility, and the data is collected, stored, analyzed and displayed. The fire-fighting equipment supervision system is based on mature internet of things technology, cloud computing and big data technology, and adopts advanced sensors, monitors and computing equipment to realize functions of data acquisition, analysis, emergency response and the like of the fire-fighting equipment, so that the supervision and maintenance efficiency and accuracy are improved; the fire-fighting equipment supervision system supports supervision and maintenance of different areas, environments and places through strengthening standardized and normalized design and development.
assignees: JILIN HONGYING FIRE FIGHTING INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real estate intelligent registration method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real estate intelligent registration method and system, which relates to the technical field of real estate registration, solves the technical problems that real-time monitoring and effective management of real estate registration business process key indexes are lacking and risks are difficult to effectively prevent, and analyzes risk sources from multiple dimensions based on a large amount of historical data by establishing a comprehensive business index system to monitor key indexes such as business handling time limit, error rate, illegal activity occurrence rate and the like in real time, by adopting advanced modeling methods such as a neural network and the like to construct a risk identification model, potential risks in the real estate registration service can be accurately identified, the risk grade can be accurately estimated by combining comprehensive risk score calculation and risk grade division standards, corresponding emergency plans are formulated for different risk grades, hierarchical management and control of risks are realized, timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response are improved, loss caused by risks is reduced, and safe and stable development of the real estate registration service is ensured.
assignees: NANJING TAIREN ZIXUEPAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mine dynamic risk prediction method and system based on multi-modal parameter fusion analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of mine risk prediction, in particular to a mine dynamic risk prediction method and system based on multi-modal parameter fusion analysis. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-modal mine omnibearing data streams based on multi-modal sensor clusters, carrying out adaptive filtering noise reduction and space-time synchronous space mapping to construct a cross-modal mine data stream model, carrying out mine geological microwave dynamic behavior deep analysis according to the cross-modal mine data stream model, carrying out dynamic geological risk situation evolution to construct a multi-modal geological risk situation map, obtaining a mine historical risk event log, carrying out risk event extraction, carrying out adaptive risk chain deep learning on the multi-modal geological risk situation map, and constructing a mine risk state dynamic evolution model. The method realizes intelligent prediction and dynamic early warning of mine risk, and improves mine intrinsic safety level and emergency response efficiency.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH;JIANGXI PIAOTANG TUNGSTEN IND CO LTD;GANZHOU NONFERROUS METALLURGICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Integrated Measurement System
title_ko: 통합계측 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a management system (100) for monitoring a site of a structure and notifying a state of the structure of people in the outside. The management system (100) comprises: a sensor (110) installed in a certain location of the site of the structure to monitor a state of the site of the structure; and a logger (120) which collects monitoring data, measured by the sensor (110), stores, and manages the monitoring data; and a management server (140) which receives the monitoring data from the logger (120), provides a screen for monitoring the site of the structure which has an automatic measurement operation program installed therein, compares the monitoring data provided by the logger (120) to a reference value for management, and displays a state of the site of the structure on a map image of the site of the structure, provides a user interface input screen to enable a user to directly register a desired site of a structure by setting the sensor (110) and the logger (120), and provides the screen for monitoring the site of the structure which displays a state of the site of the structure in accordance with registered information when the user registers a site of a certain structure through the user interface input screen. According to the present invention, the management system systematically monitors a site of a structure which may cause an unfortunate accident or a disaster, notifies risk of collapse or the like in advance, and thus can more effectively prevent occurrence of an accident or a disaster. In particular, the management system enables the user to directly register a site of construction measurement through the user interface input screen without developing an additional operation program for each site and thus can provide convenience of use.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구조물 현장을 모니터링하면서 구조물의 현장 상태를 외부에 알려주는 관리 시스템(100)에 관한 것으로서, 구조물 현장 상태를 모니터링하기 위하여 구조물 현장의 특정 위치에 설치되는 센서(110)와; 상기 센서(110)에서 측정되는 모니터링 데이터를 수집하여 저장 관리하는 로거(120)와; 상기 로거(120)로부터 모니터링 데이터를 제공받고, 자동계측 운영 프로그램을 탑재하여 관리기준치와 상기 로거(120)에서 제공받은 모니터링 데이터를 비교하여 구조물 현장 지도 이미지상에 구조물 현장 상태를 표시하는 구조물 현장 모니터링 화면을 제공하되, 사용자가 센서(110) 및 로거(120) 설정을 통해 원하는 구조물 현장을 직접 등록할 수 있도록 사용자 인터페이스 입력 화면을 제공하고, 사용자가 사용자 인터페이스 입력 화면을 통해 특정 구조물 현장을 등록하면 등록된 정보에 따라 구조물 현장 상태를 표시하는 구조물 현장 모니터링 화면을 제공하는 관리 서버(140)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 불의의 사고나 재난재해를 유발할 수 있는 구조물 현장을 체계적으로 감시하여 붕괴 등의 위험을 미리 알려서 사고나 재난재해 발생을 보다 효과적으로 예방할 수 있으며, 특히 사용자가 현장별 운영 프로그램을 별도로 개발할 필요없이 사용자 인터페이스 입력 화면을 통해 토목계측 현장을 직접 등록하여 관리할 수 있도록 하여 사용상 편의성을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for large sructures safety diagnosis using drone, device and computer readable medium for performing the method
title_ko: 무인비행장치를 이용한 거대구조물 안전진단 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 장치 및 기록매체
abstract_en: A safety diagnosis method of large structures using an unmanned flying device includes the steps of: photographing a city using an unmanned flying device wherein a bridge or a building exists in the city; indexing information of bridge structures that match the information collected on buildings and the information on large structures extracted from images of cities where the bridge or the building exists; evaluating an abnormal movement and residual deformation of bridges or structures to perform a disaster damage simulation for disasters; and deriving a response scenario and mission procedures in case of the disaster for the bridge or building based on simulation results. Accordingly, by overcoming the limit of damage assessment of disasters of large structures by using an unmanned flying device, it is possible to quickly predict secondary accidents such as collapse due to disasters such as earthquakes by securing mastery and golden time of the disaster situation.
abstract_ko: 무인비행장치를 이용한 거대구조물 안전진단 장치는, 무인비행장치를 이용하여 교량 또는 건축물이 존재하는 도시를 촬영하고, 교량 또는 건축물이 존재하는 도시를 촬영한 이미지로부터 추출한 거대구조물에 대한 정보와 건축물에 대해 수집한 정보를 일치하는 교량구조물의 정보와 인덱싱하고, 교량 또는 건축물의 이상거동과 잔류변형을 평가하여 재난에 대한 피해 시뮬레이션을 실시하고, 시뮬레이션 결과를 기초로 하여 해당 교량 또는 건축물에 대한 재난 발생 시 대응 시나리오 및 임무절차를 도출한다. 이에 따라, 거대구조물의 재난에 대한 피해 평가한계를 무인비행장치를 활용하여 극복함으로써 재난 상황의 장악력 및 골든타임 확보를 통해 지진 등의 재난에 대한에 의한 붕괴 등 2차 사고를 신속하게 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: Disaster response system through drainage channels monitoring
title_ko: 배수로 감시를 통한 재난 대응 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 배수로 감시를 통한 재난 대응 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 지역의 각 배수로에 설치되며, 각 배수로의 수위 및 유속 등을 실시간으로 감시하고, 감시 데이터를 취합하여 재난 발생에 선제하여 도로 통제나 주민 대피 등의 대응을 할 수 있도록 하는 배수로 감시를 통한 재난 대응 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 적어도 하나의 프로그램이 저장되며, 감시대상지역의 지도정보, 현황정보 및 감시대상지역에 설치되는 배수로의 위치, 수위 및 유속을 실시간으로 감시하는 감시부로부터 수신된 배수로정보가 저장되는 메모리와, 상기 감시부와 네트워크를 통해 통신하기 위한 통신모듈과, 상기 적어도 하나의 프로그램을 실행함으로써 상기 배수로정보에 따른 재난대응정보를 제공하는 프로세서를 포함하는 서버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for shortening average emergency response time of tripping accident of distribution network line
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for shortening the average emergency response time of a tripping accident of a distribution network line, which adopts a server system and a computer terminal of an intelligent scheduling operation system based on multiple fusion; the server system is used for providing signal information required by accident automatic recording, analyzing and processing the obtained information and sending a data processing result to the intelligent scheduling operation system computer terminal based on multiple fusion. The invention can effectively solve the problems of overlong average response time of accident handling and excessive statistics difficulty of bad weather tripping.

title_en: Apparatus for simulating coding program
title_ko: 코딩 확인이 가능한 코딩 시뮬레이션 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for simulating a coding program capable of checking coding, comprising: a control module generating and outputting a control signal corresponding to a control command and including control target information and control content information by using a program coded by a user when the control command is input; and a coding simulation board outputting first coding confirmation information and second coding confirmation information when the control signal is input from the control module, wherein the first coding confirmation information indicates that the program has been coded so that the control signal for controlling the control target indicated by the control target information of the input control signal is generated in response to the control command, and the second coding confirmation information indicates that the program has been coded so that the control signal to control in response to the control content indicated by the control content information of the input control signal is generated in response to the control command. The present invention is to allow users to simulate a control target and control content controlled by a program that the users coded.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 코딩 확인이 가능한 코딩 시뮬레이션 장치는 제어 명령이 입력되면 사용자로부터 코딩된 프로그램을 이용하여 상기 제어 명령에 대응되고 제어 대상 정보 및 제어 내용 정보를 포함하는 제어 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 제어 모듈; 및 상기 제어 모듈로부터 상기 제어 신호가 입력되면, 상기 입력된 제어 신호의 제어 대상 정보가 나타내는 제어 대상을 제어하는 상기 제어 신호가 상기 제어 명령에 대응하여 생성되도록 상기 프로그램이 코딩되었음을 나타내는 제1 코딩 확인 정보 및 상기 입력된 제어 신호의 제어 내용 정보가 나타내는 제어 내용에 대응하여 제어하는 상기 제어 신호가 상기 제어 명령에 대응하여 생성되도록 상기 프로그램이 코딩되었음을 나타내는 제2 코딩 확인 정보를 출력하는 코딩 시뮬레이션 보드;를 포함한다.

title_en: Geo-temporal incident navigation with integrated dynamic credibility assessment
abstract_en: Systems and methods for geo-temporal incident navigation. In one method, a graphical user interface (GUI) is generated. The GUI includes a primary window and a secondary window. The primary window includes a peripheral edge, a map, and an incident location indicator overlaid on the map. The secondary window includes an identifier for the incident, a plurality of outcome nodes, corresponding to potential outcomes for the incident, based on a plurality of nodes related to the incident, and a plurality of outcome credibility scores corresponding to the outcome nodes. A graphical control positioned at the peripheral edge of the primary window includes an incident indicator positioned along a timeline. The plurality of outcome nodes is selected and the plurality of credibility scores is computed based on a position of the incident indicator on the timeline. An electronic processor controls a display to present the graphical user interface.

title_en: Armed-police multifunction emergency response command device
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an armed-police multifunction emergency response command device. The command device is mainly formed by a display screen, a command control disk, a formation transformation button, an internal cell and a switch. A right ahead position of the display screen is provided with a front end function area. A strong light dazzle HID lamp, an infrared LED, a super white light LED illuminating lamp and a laser point are arranged on the front end function area so as to realize functions of defending, infrared night vision, night illumination, laser indication and the like. The command control disk is provided with a pin hole camera, a recording microphone, a shout microphone, a loudspeaker and a sound and light alarm button so as to realize functions of evidence acquisition, shout command, sound and light alarm and the like. Through setting a compass below the sound and light alarm button, a function of positioning and determination is realized. The cell arranged in the command control disk adopts a lithium battery. And a charging port is arranged on the command control disk, which is convenient for usage. Simultaneously, long-time usage is convenient.
assignees: YANG YONG;ZHANG CHONG;YU XIAOLIN;SUN YIXIAO;GUO XUAN;XU LEI

title_en: Automatic distress call car incident data recording system based on thing networking
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the technical field of car incident data record, specifically disclose an automatic car incident data record system of calling for help based on thing networking, including car incident data record main part and high in the clouds server, inside control module and the respectively being provided with of car incident data record main part with acceleration sensor, temperature alarm, GPS module, communication module, storage module and the cancellation button of calling for help that control module connects, the high in the clouds server passes through communication module with control module connects. The utility model provides an automatic car incident data logging system that calls for help based on thing networking can take timely and effectual automatic help-calling measure after the occurence of failure, reduces casualties and loss of property that the accident caused, the emergence of prevention secondary chain accident.
assignees: ZHEJIANG XINMAI INTERNET OF THINGS TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake data acquisition platform used for geophysical exploration
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake data acquisition platform for geophysical prospecting, which transmits earthquake data to a data recording system under the action of a record control system. The platform comprises a power supply, a command synchronization module, a power supply and a synchronization control module, a cable interface module, an auxiliary channel module and a CPU system module, wherein the command synchronization module generates a synchronous instruction; the power supply and the synchronization control module read information of towing hawser power supply state; the cable interface module analyzes towing hawser state data and earthquake data in submarine towing hawser data, and transmits the towing hawser data to the record control system; the auxiliary channel module receives auxiliary channel data; and the CPU system module transmits the earthquake data and the auxiliary channel data to the data record system after the earthquake data and the auxiliary channel data are collected. The earthquake data acquisition platform for geophysical prospecting solves the bottleneck of data interchange, improves capability of transmission and processing, can meet the requirement on data acquisition of a high-density long cable, and has excellent stability and reliability.

title_en: Course recording system for teaching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a course recording system for teaching, which comprises a shooting module, a tracing and positioning module, a multimedia classroom module, a recording and broadcasting workstation, a recording and broadcasting system resource management module, and the like. In the teaching process, an automatic tracing host machine flexibly and accurately dispatches acquiring equipment, such as camera, sound console, and the like on site according to various obtained detecting signals, voice exciting signals, central control switching signals, keyboard and mouse actions, and the like, ensures a shooting main body, automatically adjusts, traces and positions a tracing target and realizes full-automatic intelligent recording and broadcast without interference, conscious control and person guard of a classroom.
assignees: Beijing tongbu science and technology co ltd

title_en: Intelligent dispatching system for public emergency disposal
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling system for public emergency disposal, which comprises the following working steps: firstly, event analysis; secondly, situation budgeting; thirdly, establishing a scheme; fourthly, resource allocation is carried out; fifthly, summarizing and analyzing, wherein the event analysis comprises the following steps: after an emergency occurs, a remote public camera is connected in time for checking, on-site investigation is carried out in time, and preliminary risk analysis is carried out on the nature of the emergency according to the information of the crowd report and the information of the oral description of the crowd. In summary analysis work, simulation drilling is carried out on the obtained data, so that corresponding solutions are made for different influences generated by different emergencies, simulation of various different events and recording of the solutions are carried out, then when subsequent similar emergencies occur, applicable solutions can be found out timely and quickly, solution efficiency is improved, and applicability to the emergencies can be increased through accumulation of the solutions.
assignees: FIRST AUXILIARY HOSPITAL OF NANCHANG UNIV

title_en: Intelligent bronchial asthma symptom monitoring method and system based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bronchial asthma symptom intelligent monitoring method and system based on multi-source data, which relate to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprise the steps of acquiring multi-mode asthma data after space-time alignment; the method comprises the steps of carrying out weighted fusion on Western medicine indexes, environment indexes, tongue image indexes and pulse condition indexes by using a preset pathogenesis mapping rule to generate an asthma pathological state vector, inputting the asthma pathological state vector into a burst response channel, analyzing abnormal changes of short-term peak flow velocity, synchronously inputting the slow evolution channel to track long-term changes of tongue images and pulse conditions, generating emergency response integral and syndrome integral, superposing the emergency response integral and the syndrome integral on a time axis, and triggering risk assessment when the emergency response integral and the syndrome integral meet the time condition and the peak flow velocity is reduced to reach an early warning threshold. According to the invention, the asthma pathological state vector is respectively input into the burst response channel and the chronic evolution channel, so that synchronous monitoring and dynamic modeling of acute attack and chronic disease are realized.
assignees: CHINA JAPAN FRIENDSHIP HOSPITAL CHINA JAPAN FRIENDSHIP INST OF CLINICAL MEDICINE

title_en: Chemical leakage early warning and emergency response system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of chemical conveying monitoring, and particularly relates to a chemical leakage early warning and emergency response system. According to the invention, various factors such as gas concentration, storage pressure and transmission temperature can be comprehensively considered, the risk level of the current chemical transmission is judged, and the feedback frequency of the sensor is dynamically adjusted according to the risk level, so that the monitoring efficiency and accuracy are improved, in a risk early warning stage, multi-mode data and a preset safety threshold can be compared in real time, once abnormal data are found, early warning signals are immediately triggered, related data are recorded as risk data, then a corresponding emergency regulation command is generated according to the risk deviation amount of the risk data, the risk data is regulated and controlled to be below the safety threshold, the safety of the chemical transmission is ensured, and the regulation amount of the risk data under the regulation command is monitored in real time through a sliding window mechanism in the risk regulation process, so that secondary accidents are avoided, and the safety in the chemical transmission process is effectively improved.

title_en: Educate system and method using internet
title_ko: 인터넷을 통한 교육 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: An Internet education system and a method thereof are provided to enable a learner to check pronunciation instantly by listening to the pronunciation of currently learning foreign language voice, which is instantly recorded and played. A learning database(110) stores foreign language learning contents, the foreign language voices and the predicted answers corresponding to respective foreign language contents. A voice recognizer(120) recognizes the foreign language voice of the learner received from a learner computer(200) through the Internet. A voice processor(130) converts the recognized foreign language voice of the learner into a text. A controller(140) provides the learner computer with the foreign language voice corresponding to the foreign language contents selected by the learner and a speaking request, and compares the foreign language voice of the learner converted into the text with the predicted answers corresponding to the foreign language voice. If the foreign language voice of the learner is the required answer, the controller provides a foreign language voice file of the learner to the learner computer and outputs a playback command.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 학습자의 외국어 음성을 순간 녹음 및 재생하는 학습 방식을 통해 학습 효과를 향상시킬 수 있는 인터넷을 통한 교육 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일실시 예에 따른 인터넷을 통한 교육 방법은, 학습자 컴퓨터와 인터넷을 통해 다수의 외국어 학습 콘텐츠를 학습자 컴퓨터로 제공하는 교육용 서버로 구현되는 교육 방법에 있어서,  
     교육용 서버가, 
     외국어 학습을 위한 외국어 음성을 따라하기 요청과 함께 제공하고 데이터베이스에 저장된 외국어 음성에 대응하는 예상답변을 액세스하는 제1 단계와; 외국어 음성을 청취한 학습자가 따라하는 외국어 음성이 입력되면 소정의 음성 툴을 이용하여 텍스트로 변환하여 액세스 된 예상답변과 비교하는 제2 단계와; 제2 단계의 비교결과 학습자의 외국어 음성이 요구답변인 경우 학습자의 외국어 음성 파일을 학습자 컴퓨터로 제공하고 재생 명령을 출력하는 제3 단계를 구비한다. 
       
     학습, 교육, 순간녹음, 발음

title_en: security system
title_ko: 보안시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a security system. All payment, identity check and the like can be transferred through an SNS and an e-mail. All payment units can be stopped all the time. Therefore, the system reduces financial accidents and a personal information leakage.
abstract_ko:
1.개인신용정보나 주민번호 조회등을 할 경우 모든경우에 본인에게 sns나 메일이 오게 하는 소프트웨어다.(개인정보조회 기관이나 사이트가 문자에 같이 뜬다) 
2.카드결재시에도 문자가 온다. 
3.e머니나,비트코인,쿠폰을 쓰거나 살때에도 sns나 메일이 오게 할 수 있고, 
모든 결제수단은 일시 분실시 은행이나 국가나 금융기관 확인을 거쳐 정지가 가능하다. (공인인증서나 지문인식 홍체인식 정보보안으로도 대체가능하다.) 
급하게 분실이나 사고를 막기 위해 빠른 대처로 공인인증서나 지문인식,홍체인식이나 그외 금융기관의 사이트를 통해서 휴일에도 24시간 결제수단들을 정지시킬 수있다.  
4.핸드폰의 유심칩을 다른핸드폰에 쓸때에도 ,본인의 정보로 결제되는 모든  
내용은 sns나 메일로 오게된다. 유심칩도 분실시 정지를 3번과 같은 방법으로 할 수 있다. 포인트와 쿠폰,게임아이템,비트코인,선물받은 내용등 본인 핸드폰 번호와 본인실명이 들어간 모든 내용은 사용정지가 가능하고, 사용시 다 sns나 메일로 받을 수 있다. 
5.이메일이나 모든 sns,쇼셜네트워크도 ,로그인할때 각각 설정으로  문자로 어느사이트에 로그인 했는지 내용을 sns나 메일로 받게된다.개인정보를 보호하기위한 최선을 다한다. 
이메일 접속시에 지문인식,홍체인식으로 아이디와 비밀번호를 치지 않고 들어갈수 있거나,주민번호를 치지않고 지문과 홍체인식으로만 접속이 가능한 사이트를 통해서 개인정보를 보호 할 수있다. 이메일이나 각종 사이트에서 아이디 비밀번호와 함께 추가로 지문인식과 홍체인식을 쓸수 있고, 아이디 비밀번호 대신 지문과 홍체를 인식시켜서 들어가는 시간을 절약하는 번거로움을 줄이면서 보안강화를 할 수 있다.

title_en: Critical health information profile and emergency communication system
abstract_en: A microprocessor-based emergency response communication system used to call and communicate with the 9-1-1 operator and also allows emergency responder's immediate access to a user's Critical Health Information Profile stored in the device at the point and location of crisis. The device is used to create individual Critical Health Information Profiles which is Health Level-7 compliant enabling it to seamlessly communicate with major hospital networks worldwide. This functional capability provides a system that can retrieve and transmit user-stored personal and health information by emergency responders at the point of care. The emergency responder can access the customer's Critical Health Information Profile database, review the data for pertinent information and then transmit that data to a designated receiving hospital or medical center. The device provides an electronic means of dialing and communicating directly with the 9-1-1 operator. A wireless remote transmitter unit can be activated from the wireless transmitter or the base unit to dial and connect with the 9-1-1 operator, broadcast a canned message with or without a personal-recorded message, and personally communicate with the 9-1-1 operator through a two-way speakerphone system. The device contains software enabling the user and medical personnel the ability to input, store, retrieve and analyze the user's vital sign data and other pertinent health information.

title_en: Management of medical equipment and responders
abstract_en: A system for managing responders acquiring medical equipment and responding to an emergency medical event includes mobile devices associated with responders; a computer aided dispatch (CAD), and an equipment/responder management system communicatively coupled to the mobile devices and CAD and configured to receive an event location from the CAD, retrieve medical equipment locations from a database, receive responder locations from the mobile devices, send the event and equipment locations to a first mobile device, generate an activity log for the event including first responder status information based on the responder location, the event and medical equipment locations, send the activity log to the first mobile device, send the event location and the medical equipment locations to a second mobile device, update the activity log with second responder status information based on the responder, event and medical equipment locations, and send the activity log to the mobile devices.

title_en: Management of medical equipment and responders
abstract_en: A system for managing responders acquiring medical equipment and responding to an emergency medical event includes mobile devices associated with responders; a computer aided dispatch (CAD), and an equipment/responder management system communicatively coupled to the mobile devices and CAD and configured to receive an event location from the CAD, retrieve medical equipment locations from a database, receive responder locations from the mobile devices, send the event and equipment locations to a first mobile device, generate an activity log for the event including first responder status information based on the responder location, the event and medical equipment locations, send the activity log to the first mobile device, send the event location and the medical equipment locations to a second mobile device, update the activity log with second responder status information based on the responder, event and medical equipment locations, and send the activity log to the mobile devices.

title_en: Golf lesson apparatus and server by using intrinsic location and user authentication
abstract_en: This invention relates to a golf lesson apparatus and server by using intrinsic location and user authentication which is installed at each tee box of golf courses or driving ranges. This invention aims simple and easy correction of user's swing posture, and is comprised of: the Wireless Communication Part which authenticates users with the user's RFID ID card; the Motion Detection Part which records user's swing posture; the Data Storage Part which stores the video of the user's swing posture; the Key Input Interface Part which receives user's command; the Display Part which shows the video of the user's swing posture on real time basis and the video of analysis and lesson on user's swing posture transmitted from the golf lesson server; the Network Interface Part which connects the golf lesson server via wired/wireless networks; and the Control Part which provides the services linked with the Golf Lesson Server.

title_en: Centralized management mode backup disaster recovery system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a centralized management mode backup disaster recovery system, which comprises: a control console ( 104 ) for performing centralized control on a data container ( 105 ), a backup process module ( 103 ), storage medium ( 101 ), and a standby machine ( 102 ) through respective control operations; a production server ( 108 ) responsible for controlling and managing data circulation between the production server and the storage medium in unit of data blocks; a backup process module ( 103 ) for backing up data to storage space allocated for the production server ( 180 ) by the storage medium ( 101 ) through an mirror technique and a synchronous or asynchronous technique or any other backup methods; the storage medium ( 101 ) for storing data and allocating a logic unit ( 200 ) to the production server ( 108 ) for data storage; the standby machine ( 102 ) for storing system data of the production server ( 108 ) and completing automatic running and setting of the standby machine ( 102 ) through the control console ( 104 ); and the data container ( 105 ) for recording operation modes, data information, and command requests of the control console, the production server, the backup process module, the storage medium, and the standby machine through data condition update.

title_en: Big data application method and system for environmental monitoring law enforcement decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data application method for environment supervision and law enforcement decision, which comprises the following steps: data acquisition and integration: cleaning and integrating government affair data resources of internal and external pollution sources, and converging and integrating multi-source data; data mining analysis: analyzing the multi-source data after the convergence and integration is finished; generating an intelligence clue: generating an information clue for environmental monitoring and law enforcement according to the data analysis result, and managing the information according to the weight; generating an information image: according to the generated information clue, labeling the enterprise problem to generate an enterprise information image; closed loop intelligence application: according to the information clue, developing information research and judgment, information order distribution, information processing and result feedback closed-loop application management; evaluating intelligence efficiency: according to the information processing condition, the research and judgment, the dispatch and the transaction of the information are evaluated. By adopting the method, the problems that the environmental protection data can not be effectively applied and the like are solved, and the timeliness and the accuracy of law enforcement can be improved.

title_en: Geological mineral product based three-dimensional modeling accurate positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological information and discloses a geological mineral product three-dimensional modeling accurate positioning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of deploying a laser ranging, microseismic and fiber bragg grating sensing array and synchronously collecting multi-source deformation and stress data; after space-time alignment and filtering, reconstructing a millimeter-level precision three-dimensional point cloud model by adopting an improved ICP algorithm, calculating a safety coefficient cloud image by combining a geomechanical constitutive equation, automatically defining a risk area according to a three-level threshold, and generating closed-loop control instructions such as voice alarm, thermodynamic diagram pushing, grouting coordinates, avoidance paths and the like. The system comprises a sensing deployment unit, a data preprocessing unit, a point cloud reconstruction unit, a mechanical analysis unit, a risk setting unit, an instruction distribution unit and an execution unit. The invention realizes deformation millimeter-level positioning of the goaf, sub-hour level early warning and full-automatic intervention, the early warning accuracy exceeds 95%, the emergency response is shortened to minute level, and the mine safety and exploitation efficiency are improved.

title_en: A kind of firearms management system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of firearms management system, comprise gun, also comprise chip, client, management service platform and workstation, chip is arranged on gun, chip comprises single-chip microcomputer, bluetooth module and power module, power module is connected with bluetooth module with single-chip microcomputer respectively, described single-chip microcomputer is connected with described bluetooth module, described chip is communicated with client by bluetooth module, client comprises mobile phone or intercom, client is provided with in mobile phone or intercom, client is communicated with management service platform by wireless network, management service platform comprises external network server and database server, workstation comprises command centre's workstation, firearm management workstation and department head's workstation.The beneficial effects of the utility model are, a kind of firearms management system is provided, this system effectively, accurately, intelligently can carry out information binding, collection, record, location to the gun of turnover storehouse, and inquires about fast the maintenance information of gun and add up.
assignees: BEIJING RICHES & SAGACIOUS TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring system for subway fire safety
abstract_en: The utility model provides a monitoring system of subway fire safety belongs to fire safety technical field. The subway fire safety monitoring system comprises a pulse generation module, a switch module, a fire monitoring module, a gas monitoring module, a signal feedback module and a control module, wherein the control end of the switch module is connected with the pulse generation module, the first end of the switch module is connected with a power supply end of the fire monitoring module, the third end of the switch module is connected with the power supply end of the gas monitoring module, the first end of the fire monitoring module and the first end of the gas monitoring module are both connected with the first end of the signal feedback module, the second end of the fire monitoring module and the second end of the gas monitoring module are both connected with the control module, the second end of the signal feedback module is connected with the control module, and the pulse generation module is configured to generate pulse control signals. The emergency response system can solve the problem of poor timeliness of emergency response.
assignees: HEBEI CRRC SHUZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Four-dimensional mine digitalization emergency command dispatching system
abstract_en: The invention provides a four-dimensional mine digitalization emergency command dispatching system, which comprises a resource management database, a command and communication platform subsystem and a visual software operating platform, wherein the resource management database comprises emergency plan information, plan practice records, accident cases, emergency organization constitution information, rescue expert information, relief goods information and disaster statistics information. When an emergency occurs, real-time monitoring and management is realized during a rescue process by adopting emergency treatment steps. The four-dimensional mine digitalization emergency command dispatching system provided by the invention has the advantages that the management is standard and the response is rapid.

title_en: Doorplate information inquiry method and system
abstract_en: A doorplate information inquiry method comprises the following steps: acquiring a doorplate tag scanning command through application mounted on a terminal; scanning doorplate tags corresponding to residential buildings according to the doorplate tag scanning command; acquiring index information stored in the doorplate tags, wherein a mapping relationship exists between the index information and electronic records of the residential buildings on storage paths of a server; inquiring the corresponding storage path according to the index information, and acquiring and displaying the electronic records of the corresponding residential building from the server according to the inquired storage path. By adoption of the method, the doorplate information can be conveniently and quickly acquired to greatly facilitate management of the residential buildings. The invention also provides a doorplate information inquiry system.

title_en: Personal emergency response system is sought help the wearing compliance of button
abstract_en: In personal emergency response system (PERS), individual's button (PHB) (10) of seeking help includes call button (12), motion sensor (22) and transmitter or transceiver (24), and the transmitter or transceiver (24) are used to launch wireless paging signals in response to pressing the call button.Electronic processors (28) perform compliance monitoring process (42) at the successive compliance review time, and each compliance monitoring process includes：Motion sensor data is gathered in compliance data collection interval；Determined whether the PHB has moved after the upper compliance review time；And it is based at least partially on whether moved the PHB described to determine to assess compliance.The change of the orientation for determining can include determining that the PHB after the upper review time.It is alternatively possible to cause the motion sensor from low-power mode to switch to the wake-up interrupts event of operator scheme to monitor compliance by detecting and recording.

title_en: A kind of teaching based on interactive voice manually intelligence control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of teaching based on interactive voice manually intelligence control systems,Including recognition unit,Analytical unit,Voice unit,Adjustment unit,Projecting cell,Broadcast unit and storage unit,Recognition unit is used to obtain the voice messaging in classroom,The information that analytical unit record and analysis recognition unit are sent,Voice unit command instruction for identification,And command instruction is sent to adjustment unit and projecting cell,Adjustment unit includes temperature control modules,Luminance adjustment module and gas permeability module,Projecting cell includes projection module and receiving module,Projection module is used to control the sequence and form of indoor article projection,Receiving module is for receiving and recognizing phonetic order,Broadcast unit includes task module,Alarm modules and adjustment module,Task module is for broadcasting order,Alarm modules are used to carry out the casting of emergency management,Adjustment module is for adjusting different voice systems,Storage unit is used to store the information and voice command message of analytical unit.
assignees: SUZHOU RUOYIMEI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for processing fire events and corresponding vehicle
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for processing a fire incident and a corresponding vehicle. The system comprises: a detection unit configured to detect information of a fire event around the detection unit, wherein the detection unit is located on a vehicle; a processing unit configured to send a fire extinguishing request to one or more further vehicles based on the information detected by the detection unit, wherein the one or more further vehicles are equipped with a fire extinguisher; the one or more additional vehicles, some or all of which are adapted to travel to the location of the fire incident to extinguish the fire with their fire extinguishers in response to receiving the request to extinguish the fire. The invention is beneficial to improving the timeliness, flexibility and safety of fire fighting. In addition, since vehicles are commonly equipped with fire extinguishers, the solution of the present invention facilitates handling of fire events at a relatively low cost. The system, method and vehicle of the present invention are particularly useful for handling fire events occurring on roadways.

title_en: Food safety supervision emergency command and dispatch system
abstract_en: The invention provides a food safety supervision emergency command scheduling system, which comprises an operator record supervision module, a group meal supervision module, an online supervision module, an information management module, an administrative law enforcement supervision module and a file management module, wherein the operator record supervision module is used for managing the group meal; the operator record supervision module comprises a raw material operator record supervision unit and a catering operator record supervision unit; the group meal supervision module is used for supervising the audio and video information and the food list information of a catering operator; the online supervision module is used for real-time audio and video, operator map positioning and emergency rescue work, the invention carries out record processing on the operation information of food and raw material operators through the operator record supervision module and stores the operation information in the file management module, thereby facilitating the responsibility tracing of food problems.
assignees: CHONGQING ZHONGYOU ZHONGKE IND CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle data downloading time optimization method based on calculation and communication combination
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle data downloading time optimization method based on calculation and communication combination, and belongs to the technical field of mobile communication. The unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary emergency response model is established, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary emergency response model comprises three stages of collecting disaster area information, carrying out airborne data processing and transmitting data to a communication area; establishing energy constraint of an unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary emergency response network; the calculation frequency, the transmission power and the calculation strategy are synthesized, and the data airborne calculation and the data transmission strategy are jointly optimized, so that the time of the data downloading stage of the unmanned aerial vehicle is minimized, and the improvement of the task execution time efficiency is realized; based on the constraint of the actual energy of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the unmanned aerial vehicle data processing and data transmission energy is reasonably distributed, the maximum utilization of the limited energy of the unmanned aerial vehicle is realized, the task execution efficiency is improved, and the high-quality task completion rate is ensured; the unmanned aerial vehicle is effectively utilized to carry out airborne data processing in the data transmission stage, and is more suitable for the high-timeliness communication requirement of emergency scenes.

title_en: Ground disaster automatic monitoring equipment linkage early warning technology based on intelligent internet of things cradle head
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring and early warning, and discloses a ground disaster automatic monitoring equipment linkage early warning technology based on an intelligent internet of things holder, which comprises that each monitoring point in a monitoring area is provided with a data acquisition device, the data acquisition device is uniformly connected to the intelligent internet of things holder through a plurality of communication protocols, and the intelligent internet of things holder generates an installation distribution diagram of each data acquisition device; triggering early warning by the data acquisition equipment, and synchronously sending out early warning signals to form early warning equipment; according to the installation distribution diagram, the intelligent internet of things cloud deck marks data acquisition equipment in a set range around the early warning equipment as adjacent equipment, the intelligent internet of things cloud deck sets encryption acquisition frequency of each adjacent equipment and sends an instruction to the adjacent equipment, and the adjacent equipment receives the instruction and then carries out encryption acquisition; and issuing a forecast notice and an emergency response instruction through a research result of linkage early warning research, and finally completing monitoring data analysis and recording.
assignees: SHENZHEN GEOLOGICAL ENVIRONMENT RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Emergency event processing and device
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method and a device for processing an emergency event, wherein the method comprises the following steps: event information of an emergency event is obtained, and an emergency search text is generated according to the event information; searching the candidate emergency response rule set according to the emergency search text to obtain a search emergency response rule set matched with the emergency search text and search scores of all search emergency response rules in the search emergency response rule set, wherein the search emergency response rules comprise search emergency response templates and search emergency response conditions, and the search scores are used for indicating the relevance of all corresponding search emergency response rules and the emergency search text; according to the search scores of the search emergency response rules, at least one target emergency response template is determined from the search emergency response templates of the search emergency response rule set, so that the effectiveness and timeliness of emergency response are improved.
assignees: BEIJING GLOBAL SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wisdom security protection inspection management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security inspection and discloses an intelligent security inspection management system which comprises a core processor, wherein an input end and an output end of the core processor are connected with an information storage unit and an identity recognition unit through bidirectional signals, and an input end of the core processor is connected with a security inspection unit through unidirectional signals. This wisdom security protection inspection management system, the regional personnel's that patrol and examine recognition degree that can furthest, avoid crime suspects to cover the face, change clothing and evade inspection equipment, through more accurate action and body type identification information, can effectively improve personnel's discrimination, carry out the behavior record contrast to the video stream video of inspection equipment record through personnel's behavior record module simultaneously, improve personnel's recognition degree, and compare unusual action, thereby carry out the categorised evaluation security risk coefficient of security incident, further improvement inspection resource's distribution utilization ratio.

title_en: Intelligent vehicle fault injection driver testing method and device
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent vehicle fault injection driver testing method and device, comprising the following steps: setting a current test item, monitoring the current vehicle state, judging whether the vehicle reaches an initial condition of fault injection, if so, sending a signal command, injecting a fault corresponding to the current test item into the vehicle, comparing an expected reaction model with actual reaction of a driver, judging whether the driver makes relevant reaction within a set time, if so, recording the reaction time of the driver to the fault and the final stopping time of the vehicle, and comprehensively grading the operation of the driver according to the reaction time of the driver and the final stopping time of the vehicle to obtain fault item grading data; and when all the test items are finished, carrying out final comprehensive rating on the driver according to the fault item rating data of each test item. The intelligent and accurate test system for the driver test vehicle aims to solve the problem of lack of training of driving skills under special and unexpected fault situations and improve the intelligent and accurate test of the driver test vehicle system.

title_en: Intelligent triage training system based on sudden public events
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent triage training system based on sudden public events, in particular relates to the triage training field, and aims to solve the problem that the existing triage training is lack of pertinence. The method comprises the steps of searching a history record of an emergency public event through a tree construction module, constructing a triage strategy time sequence tree, marking response bias factors through a bias recognition module, constructing a bias path library, converting the bias factors into interference options in a simulation training process through an interference generation module, setting interference induction weight and time compression parameters of the interference options through an interference setting module, collecting training object response data through a dead zone recognition module, constructing a bias trend intensity curve, recognizing triage bias dead zones, and finally using the recognized bias dead zones as key targets of a current training period through a bias training module to carry out training. The system can realize intelligent identification and targeted training of diagnosis-dividing cognition weak links, and improves accuracy and timeliness of diagnosis-dividing emergency response.

title_en: Garden environment real-time emergency response method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a garden environment real-time emergency response method and system based on edge calculation, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of generating a risk assessment correction factor according to adjacent communication characteristics among triangular space units; the edge computing node performs fusion processing on the feature data set and the risk assessment correction factors to generate a corrected risk level assessment result, autonomously triggers emergency response actions matched with the risk level according to the corrected risk level assessment result, and synchronously uploads the emergency response action information, the corrected risk level assessment result and the feature data set to the cloud management platform. The invention shortens the time from risk discovery to measures taking and improves the timeliness of emergency treatment.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIANGJIU GARDEN CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Underground pipe channel safe operation and maintenance method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to an underground pipe channel safe operation and maintenance method based on the Internet of things, which comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining pipe network GIS data and historical risk point data, obtaining optimized sensor layout and network topology based on node layout optimization of risk assessment, S2, obtaining various sensor original data based on the laid sensor, preprocessing the sensor original data to obtain a standardized data packet, S3, carrying out multi-mode data fusion according to the standardized data packet, the historical operation and maintenance record and GIS data to obtain fused data, S4, carrying out underground pipe channel abnormality detection based on a multi-mode model according to the fused data, obtaining an abnormality detection result, and S5, combining the official network GIS data and the optimized sensor layout and the network topology according to the abnormality detection result, and accurately locking the risk point. The invention effectively improves the safety management level and emergency response capability of the urban underground pipe network.
assignees: FUJIAN JULIAN ENVIRONMENTAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en:
PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method and a system that provide for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety. 
     SOLUTION: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and viewer for mobile assets processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in a local memory module. The DARS runs, in a near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and, in a real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second.
