title_en: System for providing emergency mobilization service and method thereof
title_ko: 긴급 출동 서비스를 제공하는 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system for providing emergency mobilization service and a method thereof are provided to automatically display the location of a customer terminal on a navigation screen in order to confirm the location of a customer in real time. CONSTITUTION: A reception center server(420) receives a emergency mobilization service request from a customer terminal(100). The emergency mobilization service request includes location information of the customer terminal. The reception center server transmits a mobilization order and location information of the customer terminal to a moving agent terminal(440). The moving agent terminal receives the mobilization order and the location information from the reception center server. The moving agent terminal outputs the location information on a navigation screen.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 긴급 출동 서비스를 제공하는 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따르면, 긴급 출동 서비스 제공 시스템은 고객 차량 내 탑재된 고객 단말과 이동통신망을 통해 접속되어 고객 단말로부터 고객 단말의 위치 정보가 포함된 긴급 출동 서비스 요청을 수신하고, 고객 단말의 위치 정보에 해당하는 지역에 긴급 출동시킬 출동요원의 단말로 출동명령 및 고객 단말의 위치 정보를 전송하는 접수 센터 서버; 및 접수 센터 서버로부터 출동명령 및 고객 단말의 위치 정보를 수신하여 네비게이션-여기서 네비게이션은 지도를 보이거나 지름길을 찾아 주어 자동차 운전을 도와주는 장치나 프로그램을 의미함- 화면에 상기 위치 정보를 출력하는 출동요원 단말을 포함한다. 
     이와 같이, 긴급 출동 서비스를 요청한 고객 단말의 위치를 출동요원의 네비게이션 화면에 자동으로 표출하므로 출동요원이 고객을 찾아가는 서비스를 구현할 수 있고, 위치 정보의 가독성이 뛰어나 출동요원이 고객의 위치를 빠르게 확인할 수 있다. 
     
     긴급 출동 서비스, 네비게이션

title_en: Ship pollutant emissions and compliance information into real-time analysis, recording and monitoring system using land, sea integrated control system
title_ko: 선박 오염물질 배출정보 및 규제 준수 현황 실시간 분석,기록,감시 장치를 이용한 육해상 통합 관제 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a land and sea integrated control system for managing ship pollutant discharge and compliance information in real time. The present invention comprises: a sea control system which includes an interfacing unit, a ship environment data recorder, and a ship pollutant analyzer, and a current display terminal and controls ship pollutant discharge; and a land control system which includes land control system database and controls pollutant discharge. The present invention monitors whether the policy is violated through the land control system, thereby having an effect of reducing the monitoring based pollutant discharge.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 오염물질 배출 관리를 위한 통합 관제 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 오염물질 배출 감시 대상인 서브시스템과 선박 환경 데이터 기록 장치(Environment Data Recorder)를 인터페이싱하는 인터페이싱 유닛, 상기 인터페이싱 유닛을 통해 전달된 상기 서브시스템의 선박 오염물질 배출 데이터를 기록하는 선박 환경 데이터 기록 장치(Environment Data Recorder), 상기 선박 오염물질을 전달받아 분석하는 선박 오염물질 분석 장치, 육상 관제 시스템과 데이터 송수신을 하기 위한 네트워크장치 및 상기 선박 환경 데이터 기록 장치(Environment Data Recorder)로부터 전송된 출력 값을 표시하는 현황표시단말을 포함하는 선박 오염물질 배출관리를 위한 해상 관제 시스템 및 상기 해상 관제 시스템으로부터 전송된 데이터를 통해 국제 협약 규제 규격에 의한 정책 준수 여부를 실시간으로 모니터링 하는 모니터링 장치, 상기 해상 관제 시스템으로부터 전송된 데이터를 전송받아 저장하는 육상 관제 시스템 데이터베이스를 포함하는 오염물질 배출관리를 위한 육상 관제 시스템을 포함한다.  
실시간으로 선박 내에서 정책 위반 현황이 모니터링되고, 육상 관제 시스템을 통하여 정책 위반 여부가 모니터링되는 바, 감시 기반 오염 물질 배출이 감소될 수 있다. 
또한, 선박의 오염 물질 배출 시스템들의 운영, 동작 상태 감시를 통하여 미 준수 현황을 감시할 수 있다. 
또한, 실시간 감시를 통하여 오염 물질 배출 현황을 항시 파악할 수 있고, 정책 규제 준수를 유도할 수 있다. 
또한, 선박의 총 오염 물질 배출의 통합 분석을 통한 오염 물질 배출을 산출할 수 있고, 항로 별 위치 별 해수 유입 및 배수 패턴에 따른 해양 오염 사고 발생 사전 대응, 항로 별 위치 별 운항 패턴에 따른 대기 오염 위반 사전 대응이 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: Real-time accident impact detection platform linked to madymo service
title_ko: 마디모 서비스 연계 실시간 사고 충격감지 플랫폼
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time accident impact detection platform linked with a mathematical dynamic model (MADYMO) service to quickly perform requests for emergency rescue and the like. According to the present invention, the real-time accident impact detection platform comprises: a portable terminal installed inside a vehicle and transmitting accident data for application of an accident determination algorithm to a control server upon a vehicle accident; the control server using the accident data received from the portable terminal to analyze an accident situation and performing emergency treatment upon the accident; and a MADIMO system having at least one MODIMO model used in a MODIMO program performing a three-dimensional simulation. The portable terminal includes: an acceleration sensor module detecting the amount of impact applied to the vehicle; a GPS module calculating the vehicle's speed and location; a recording module recording sound around the vehicle; a pattern information storage unit storing impulse pattern information and sound pattern information; an accident detection module determining whether an accident has occurred by comparing the amount of impact detected by the acceleration sensor module and the sound detected by the recording module with the pattern information stored in the pattern information storage unit; and a control unit transmitting vehicle accident data including acceleration sensor value, impact amount and sound information, vehicle speed, accident occurrence time, and location information to the control server when the accident detection module determines that the accident has occurred.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 마디모 서비스 연계 실시간 사고 충격감지 플랫폼은, 차량 내부에 거치되어 차량 사고 발생 시 사고 판단 알고리즘 적용을 위한 사고 데이터를 관제 서버 측으로 전송하는 휴대용 단말기, 휴대용 단말기로부터 수신한 사고 데이터를 이용하여 사고 상황을 분석하고 사고 발생 시 긴급처리를 수행하는 관제 서버, 및 3차원 시뮬레이션을 수행하는 마디모 프로그램에 사용되는 적어도 하나의 마디모 모델을 가지는 마디모 시스템을 포함한다. 
이때, 상기 휴대용 단말기는, 차량에 가해진 충격량을 검출하는 가속도 센서 모듈, 차량의 속도 및 위치를 계산하는 GPS 모듈, 차량 주변의 사운드를 녹음하는 레코딩 모듈, 충격량의 패턴 정보 및 사운드의 패턴 정보가 저장된 패턴 정보 저장부, 가속도 센서 모듈에서 감지된 충격량 및 레코딩 모듈에서 감지된 사운드를 상기 패턴 정보 저장부에 저장된 패턴 정보와 비교하여 사고 발생 여부를 판단하는 사고 감지 모듈, 및 사고 감지 모듈이 사고 발생으로 판단하면 가속도 센서값, 충격량과 사운드 정보, 차량의 속도, 사고 발생 시간 및 위치 정보를 포함하는 차량의 사고 데이터를 상기 관제 서버로 전송하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Methods, devices and computer programs for preventing entrepreneur-customized major disasters
title_ko: 사업주 맞춤형 중대재해 예방 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터프로그램
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention can provide a business owner-tailored major accident prevention method including a process of setting an accident prevention response system for a business place, and an accident prevention response monitoring process for responding to an accident related to the business place using the accident prevention response system, in a method performed by a computing device.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예는 컴퓨팅 장치에 의해 수행되는 방법에 있어서, 사업장에 대한 사고예방대응 시스템을 세팅하는 과정; 및 상기 사고예방대응 시스템을 이용해 상기 사업장 관련 사고를 대응하기 위한 사고예방대응 모니터링 과정을 포함하는 사업주 맞춤형 중대재해 예방 방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method of checking well-being of a person in a single-person household based on meter reading information and sensing information, computer readable recording medium and computer program stored on the recording medium
title_ko: 검침 정보 및 감지 정보에 기반한 1인 가구 가구원의 안부 확인 시스템 및 방법, 컴퓨터 판독가능 기록 매체 및 기록 매체에 저장된 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for checking the safety of a single-person household member based on meter reading information and detection information. The system comprises: a collection server for collecting electricity meter reading information, water meter reading information, visual information, and auditory information from a primary sensor unit for providing electricity meter reading information and water meter reading information to numerically obtain whether a single-person household uses electricity and water, and a secondary sensor unit for providing visual information and auditory information to audiovisually detect whether a single-person household uses electricity and water; an analysis server for analyzing the presence or absence of a life reaction of a household member of the corresponding single-person household based on the collected electricity meter reading information, water meter reading information, visual information, and auditory information; and a first application configured to notify a manager to take a predetermined action when it is analyzed that there is no life reaction of a household member of the corresponding single-person household. Accordingly, the present invention can more accurately detect a life response, thereby notifying a manager to respond to unexpected disasters or accidents without delay, and taking action.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 검침 정보 및 감지 정보에 기반한 1인 가구 가구원의 안부 확인 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 1인 가구의 전기 및 수도 사용 여부를 수치적으로 획득할 수 있도록 전기 검침 정보 및 수도 검침 정보를 제공하는 1차 센서부, 및 1인 가구의 전기 및 수도 사용 여부를 시청각적으로 감지할 수 있도록 시각적 정보 및 청각적 정보를 제공하는 2차 센서부로부터, 전기 검침 정보, 수도 검침 정보, 시각적 정보 및 청각적 정보를 수집하는 수집 서버; 수집된 전기 검침 정보, 수도 검침 정보, 시각적 정보 및 청각적 정보에 기초하여 해당 1인 가구의 가구원의 생활 반응 존부를 분석하는 분석 서버; 및 해당 1인 가구의 가구원의 생활 반응이 없는 것으로 분석된 경우, 관리자에게 통지하여 소정의 조치를 취할 수 있도록 구성되는 제1 어플리케이션을 포함한다. 이로써, 보다 정확하게 생활 반응을 감지할 수 있어 예기치 못하는 재난이나 사고 발생에 지체없이 대응할 수 있도록 관리자에게 통지하여 조치를 취할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: System for determining the authenticity of resident registration and method performing the same
title_ko: 보안 기능이 구비된 등본 용지를 통해 출력된 주민등록등본 진위 여부 판단 시스템 및 이의 실행 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for determining authenticity of a copy of a resident registration copy outputted through a copy paper having a security function. The system for determining authenticity of a copy of a resident registration copy outputted through a copy paper having a security function comprises: a first user terminal which selects a printing level of a smart code and a service connected to the smart code when printing the copy of the resident registration copy through a printing program, and commands a point cloud pattern to be inserted into a background screen of the copy of the resident registration copy and then printed through a printing device according to a code value generated according to the service connected to the smart code; the printing device which prints the copy of the resident registration copy with the printing level of the smart code according to a request of the first user terminal; and a copy paper distribution brokerage server which generates a code value using the service connected to the smart code and provides the code value to the first user terminal when the first user terminal receives the service connected to the smart code from the first user terminal when the first user terminal receives the copy of the resident registration copy and prints the copy of the resident registration copy through the printing program.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 보안 기능이 구비된 등본 용지를 통해 출력된 주민등록등본 진위 여부 판단 시스템은 인쇄 프로그램을 통해 주민등록등본을 인쇄할 때 스마트 코드의 인쇄 등급 및 스마트 코드와 연결되는 서비스를 선택하며, 상기 스마트 코드와 연결되는 서비스에 따라 생성된 코드 값에 따라 주민등록등본의 배경 화면에 점군 패턴을 삽입된 후 인쇄 장치를 통해 인쇄되도록 명령하는 제1 사용자 단말, 상기 제1 사용자 단말의 요청에 따라 스마트 코드의 인쇄 등급으로 주민등록등본을 인쇄하는 인쇄 장치 및 상기 제1 사용자 단말이 주민등록등본을 발급받아 인쇄 프로그램을 통해 주민등록등본을 인쇄할 때 상기 제1 사용자 단말로부터 스마트 코드와 연결되는 서비스를 수신하면, 스마트 코드와 연결되는 서비스를 이용하여 코드 값을 생성하여 상기 제1 사용자 단말에 제공하는 등본 용지 유통 중개 서버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A device and system for sending emergency alerts on roads using CCTV, sound and VMS
title_ko: Cctv, 음향 및 전광판을 활용한 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a system for transmitting a road unexpected situation alarm, capable of suppressing a secondary accident caused by a following vehicle by detecting an unexpected situation on a road by using a cctv, a sound, and an electric sign installed on the road. According to the present invention, the apparatus for transmitting an emergency signal of an emergency signal of a road comprises: an image acquisition unit; an emergency signal detection unit; and an emergency signal output unit. The cctv image recording from cctv installed at the image acquisition part is on the road is gotten. The outbreak situation sensor senses the outbreak situation whether or not to the outbreak situation sensing model about the cctv image gotten. The alarm signal output unit outputs an alarm signal when an unexpected situation is detected. At this time, the unexpected situation detection model is modeled by machine learning the cctv image, but machine learning is performed by dividing the time, season, and weather at the time of capturing the cctv image into variables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 위에 설치되는 CCTV, 음향 및 전광판을 활용하여 도로 위 돌발상황을 감지하여 후속차량에 의한 2차 사고를 억제할 수 있는 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치는 영상 획득부, 돌발상황 감지부 및 경보 신호 출력부를 포함한다. 영상 획득부는 도로 상에 설치된 CCTV로부터 촬영된 CCTV 영상을 획득한다. 돌발상황 감지부는 획득한 CCTV 영상에 대한 돌발상황 감지 모델로 돌발상황 여부를 감지한다. 그리고 경보 신호 출력부는 돌발상황이 감지되면 경보 신호를 출력한다. 이때 돌발상황 감지 모델은 CCTV 영상을 기계학습 하여 모델링 하되, CCTV 영상을 촬영하는 시점의 시간, 계절 및 기상을 변수로 구분하여 기계학습 한다.

title_en: Wearable device with user movement analysis and fall risk prediction and fall detection capability
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and wearable device for monitoring and analyzing user movements to predict fall risk The method involves retrieving motion data recorded by an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and a pedometer, followed by processing the data once it exceeds a predefined threshold. A first trained machine learning (ML) model predicts the fall risk based on the processed data. A confidence score is determined from the fall prediction, and a second trained ML model analyzes successive data frames to confirm the fall if the score is above a threshold. If a fall is confirmed, a distress signal is transmitted. The wearable device comprises a processor and memory that stores program instructions to perform the method, including motion data retrieval, processing, fall prediction, confidence scoring, and fall confirmation, along with distress signal transmission. This invention enables timely fall detection and emergency response, improving user safety.

title_en: Worker health management system and monitoring method using biosignal-based safety management workwear
title_ko: 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템 및 모니터링 방법
abstract_en: A worker health management system and monitoring method using biosignal-based safety management workwear, according to the present invention, comprises the steps in which: a signal detected by a biosignal sensor (130) provided to biosignal-based safety management workwear (100) is transmitted to a web service (210) of a server (200); the web service (210) sends an algorithm insertion or deletion request to a database (220) of the server (200), or an algorithm storage request to a Hadoop distributed file system (HDFS) (230) of the server (200); the HDFS (230) stores the algorithm when the algorithm storage request is received; the HDFS (230) transmits the algorithm to the web service (210) in order for the execution of the stored algorithm; the web service (210) that received the algorithm retrieves and applies the algorithm, and then retrieves data having the algorithm applied thereto and sends a simple object access protocol (SOAP) message to an output device; and a screen is outputted via the output device. The worker health management system and monitoring method using biosignal-based safety management workwear, according to the present invention, enables the prevention of work accidents on an industrial site by enabling the identification of the biosignal-based health status of a worker wearing safety management workwear for measuring a biosignal, and enables the prevention of safety-related accidents by having a big data-based server analyze the state of a worker, such as the state of stress, movement intensity, motion and behavior patterns, etc., by using a biosignal, such as an electrocardiogram record, acceleration, body temperature, etc., detected by the biosignal sensor provided to the safety management workwear, and a notable effect of promoting accident prevention, production increase and health improvement is achieved by providing a continuous personalized health management service to workers.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템 및 모니터링 방법은 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복(100)에 구비된 생체신호용 센서(130)를 통해 감지된 신호를 서버(200)의 웹 서비스(210)에 전송하는 단계; 상기 웹 서비스(210)가 알고리즘 삽입 또는 삭제를 서버(200)의 데이터베이스(220)에 요청하거나, 또는 알고리즘 저장을 서버의 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)(HDFS, Hadoop Distributed File System)에 요청하는 단계; 상기 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)이 알고리즘 저장 요청시 알고리즘을 저장하는 단계; 상기 하둡 분산 파일 시스템(230)이 저장된 알고리즘을 실행하기 위해 알고리즘을 웹 서비스(210)로 전송하는 단계; 상기 알고리즘을 수신한 웹 서비스(210)가 알고리즘 검색 및 적용한 후, 적용된 데이터를 검색하여 SOAP(Simple Object Access Protocol) 메시지를 출력장치에 보내는 단계; 상기 출력장치를 통해 화면을 출력하는 단계; 로 이루어지는 것으로, 본 발명 생체신호 기반의 안전관리 작업복을 이용한 근로자 건강관리 시스템 및 모니터링 방법은 생체신호를 측정하는 안전관리작업복을 착용한 근로자의 생체신호 기반의 건강 상태를 파악하여 산업현장에서의 업무상사고를 예방하되, 상기 안전관리작업복의 생체신호용 센서를 통해 감지한 심전도, 가속도, 체온 등의 생체신호를 활용하여 빅데이터 기반의 서버에서 스트레스 상태, 운동 강도, 움직임 및 행동 패턴 등의 근로자의 상태를 분석하여 안전사고를 예방하며, 근로자를 대상으로 지속적인 개인 맞춤형 건강관리 서비스를 제공함으로써 재해 예방, 생산성 향상, 건강증진을 도모하는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Device and method, computer-readable recording medium, and computer program for ai-based job safety analysis creation automation
title_ko: Ai 기반 작업위험성평가 작성 자동화 장치 및 방법, 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology for creating a job safety analysis by recommending and generating content to be included in the job safety analysis. According to an aspect of the present invention, a method for AI-based job safety analysis creation automation may comprise: searching for a job context corresponding to a JSA title and JSA job content which are input by a user; generating accident types (hereinafter, recommended accident types) corresponding to the user job context and user job steps; generating a recommended risk factor on the basis of a handled chemical substance input by the user; generating a current countermeasure corresponding to an accident type selected by the user from among the recommended accident types; generating a damage severity and an accident frequency corresponding to the job context and the recommended risk factor; and creating a JSA document on the basis of the user job context, the user job steps, the accident type selected by the user, the recommended risk factor, a recommended current countermeasure, the damage severity, and the accident frequency.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 작업위험성평가에 포함될 내용을 추천 및 생성함으로써, 작업위험성평가를 작성하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, AI 기반 작업위험성평가 작성 자동화 방법은, 사용자로부터 입력된 JSA 제목 및 JSA 작업 내용에 대응하는 작업 컨텍스트을 검색하고, 사용자 작업 컨텍스트 및 사용자 작업 단계에 대응하는 재해 유형(이하, 추천 재해 유형)을 생성하며, 사용자에 의해 입력된 취급화학물질을 기반으로 추천 위험요인을 생성하고, 추천 재해 유형 중 사용자에 의해 선택된 재해 유형에 대응하는 현재조치사항을 생성하고, 작업 컨텍스트 및 추천 위험요인에 대응하는 피해강도 및 사고빈도를 생성하며, 사용자 작업 컨텍스트, 사용자 작업 단계, 사용자에 의해 선택된 재해 유형, 추천 위험요인, 추천 현재조치사항, 피해강도 및 사고빈도를 기반으로 JSA 문서를 작성할 수 있다.

title_en: Mobile Asset Data Recorder and Transmitter
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allows for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with impact detection, rough operating condition detection, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of a mobile asset. Users can use the normal operation of their mobile assets to locate and alert, in real-time, areas where their assets are encountering rough operating environments, to provide for quicker emergency response, and to validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting.

title_en: Integrating data from multiple devices
abstract_en: A recording system for an emergency response unit includes a first data collection device configured to record a first video, audio or data segment with an incident identifier and transmit a message including the incident identifier. A second data collection device may receive the message and, as appropriate, record at least a second video, audio or data segment with the incident identifier, allowing the first segment and the second segment to be associated using the incident identifier. In other embodiments, a first recording device may begin recording video, audio or legal evidence data with an incident identifier, and a control system may receive a message including the incident identifier from the first recording device, identify one or more additional recording devices located within a certain distance of the first recording device, and obtain recordings from the one or more additional recording devices.

title_en: Method and device for identifying vulnerability of urban public transport network, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent transportation, and discloses a method, a device, a computer device and a storage medium for identifying the vulnerability of an urban public transportation network, namely, automatically calculating index values of the urban public transportation network on various static vulnerability indexes and various dynamic vulnerability indexes based on public transportation topology network data of the urban public transportation network and vehicle operation data and passenger flow collection data of all bus lines recorded when an urban public safety incident occurs, then judging whether the urban public transportation network, each bus stop, each inter-bus line and each bus line are the vulnerability of the urban public transportation network according to the comparison result of the index values and a preset index threshold value, forming a quantifiable vulnerability identification scheme capable of matching the development and evolution characteristics of the urban public safety incident, ensuring the accuracy of the final identification result, and further providing scientific decision basis for determining the guarantee point of an urban public transportation emergency plan, is convenient for practical application and popularization.

title_en: Bedrock incidence-downlink wave numerical value separation method based on array observation
abstract_en: The invention provides a bedrock incidence-descending wave numerical value separation method based on an array observation, which comprises the steps of establishing a two-dimensional layered field finite element model according to wave speed structural information of a field where an array is located, inputting an array bedrock observation wave into a bottom grid node, extracting a counter force time interval RF (t) at a bottom middle grid node after submitting operation, dividing the counter force time interval RF (t) by a grid node width L to obtain a node counter force time interval F (t) with unit length, converting the station bedrock observation wave a (t) into an equivalent node force time interval F  1  (t), calculating an equivalent node force time interval F (t) of the bedrock incidence wave, substituting the equivalent node force time interval of the bedrock incidence wave into an equivalent node force calculation formula, and performing inverse solution calculation to obtain a bedrock incidence wave u (t). The invention can separate the incident wave in the observation record of the vertical array bedrock from the downgoing wave reflected by the ground surface, acquire the accurate input data for carrying out earthquake-resistant analysis of the underground structure, and can realize the accurate analysis of the earthquake field reaction.

title_en: Flight data tracker
abstract_en: When flights meet disaster in the mid-air, the cause of the mishap is unknown immediately. Teams are dispatched in difficult conditions to retrieve the flight data recorder (FDR) also known as black box. Until the black box is found, the exact cause of the crash cannot be determined. Sometimes it may take years to find the black box. For example, Air France flight 447 crashed into the Atlantic Ocean on Jun. 1, 2009. The cause of the accident remained unknown mainly because the black box was missing. It was found after almost two years in May 2011. The delay in finding the flight data creates risks for future flights if the crash occurred due to a manufacturing defect in the model of the plane. The ability to reach the data without the burden and need for a physical black box has obvious benefits. This idea has been discussed in the literature but no one has put forth a functional and effective method for the implementation of this concept, for example no one has determined an appropriate software scheme that would enable a universal system that doesn't need a black box or which can function in parallel with black box. In this project, a set of algorithms for reliable transmission of flight data in real-time to distributed ground servers is developed. The attached description presents an overall structure of the proposed scheme. We also describe the methods of communicating between at least one plane server, several data servers and at least one central server controlling various components of data transmission, and the algorithms that enable the communication of data. In addition, the proposed packet header formats, the packet type codes and fault tolerance features are described.
assignees: ZUBAIRI JUNAID AHMED;UNIV NEW YORK STATE RES FOUND

title_en: Apparatus and method for visual-assisted training, collaboration, and monitoring in augmented/virtual reality in industrial automation systems and other systems
abstract_en: A method includes receiving first data defining first user actions associated with a first augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) space. The method also includes translating the first user actions into first commands associated with first visual objects in the first AR/VR space. The method further includes aggregating the first commands into at least one first record and transmitting the at least one first record. The method also includes receiving at least one second record containing second commands associated with second visual objects in a second AR/VR space. The method further includes translating the second commands into second user actions. In addition, the method includes creating or causing a user device to create a replica of the second AR/VR space based on the second user actions.

title_en: Expandable distributed system supporting large-scale microscopic traffic simulation
abstract_en: The invention relates to an expandable distributed system supporting large-scale microscopic traffic simulation, and the system is characterized in that an Agent technology is combined with the high level architecture (HLA) technology, a simulation entity Agent is correspondently generated through a simulation entity generation server according to a traffic flow distribution status model and a traffic entity behavior model, and the simulation entity Agent is included into a corresponding regional management Agent; and each region in the Agent is coordinated. The Agent performs the time synchronic management through a real-time interface (RTI) of the HLA, and evidence can be provided for the evacuation of different traffic disasters, the traffic commanding and establishment and estimation of specification decision through the simulation. Meanwhile, the simulation effect can be displayed in real time through a display module, and the simulation system module is clear and has customizability, expandability and flexibility. By combining the Agent technology with the HLA technology, the distributed simulation system can efficiently and quickly realize the simulation of a microscopic traffic.
assignees: SHANGHAI RIPU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of anti-crowded device
abstract_en: A kind of anti-crowded device belongs to public safety device field, in order to reach to prevent crowded, guarantee safe purpose.The technical program is mainly made up of infrared scanner, micro calculator and siren, and described infrared scanner is arranged on the commanding elevation of public place, and by transmission after signal discrimination to described micro calculator.Described infrared scanner can carry out 360 degree of cruise scannings for 24 hours incessantly, the number of record public place, by transmission after signal discrimination to described micro calculator, signal is analyzed, judges by described micro calculator, if will appear from security risk, then being sent alarm by described siren, meanwhile, by public administration, mechanism takes immediate action according to emergency preplan.This design simple in construction, has good effect, it is possible to effectively solve public place due to the crowded potential safety hazard brought.

title_en: Nine small place wisdom fire-fighting Internet of things system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of nine small place wisdom fire-fighting Internet of things system, including：Sensing unit, acquisition control unit, communication unit, data resolution unit, data storage cell and alarm unit；Sensing unit is for acquiring all kinds of fire-fighting data；Acquisition control unit is used for according to acquisition tasks to the equipment end transmission data acquisition instructions of collecting unit, and receives returned data；Data resolution unit sends alarm command when sampled data exceeds predetermined threshold value for converting sampled data to alarm unit.Technical solution through the invention, multiple functions module is integrated into whole Internet of things system, it each other both can be with independent operating, having has the function of to cooperate with each other, realize fire protection warning based on technology of Internet of things, early warning, record, the wisdom fire-fightings service functions such as information is fed back and information analysis ability is strong can be inquired.

title_en: Port foreign organism intrusion disaster tracking and monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a tracking and monitoring system for the invasion disasters of foreign organisms at ports, which consists of an unmanned aerial vehicle, a buoy body, a data/image processing module, a monitoring platform and a biological species information system; the unmanned aerial vehicle transmits the invasion disaster condition of the foreign organisms in the port to the data/image processing module in a data and image mode; the detectable molecular probe on the buoy body transmits the biological invasion indication indexes such as chlorophyll a concentration, temperature and salinity, turbidity, pH value and the like of the water body and the data of the detection position and the like to the data/image processing module through a GSM network; the data/image processing module processes the obtained data and images and displays the processed data and images on the monitoring platform, and sends information such as capture records, invasion dynamic and images of the organisms outside the red tide to the biological species information system. The tracking and monitoring system can accurately track and feed back the invasion disaster condition of the external organisms in the port in real time, and provides technical support for disaster emergency response.

title_en: Remote control's many function synthesis command car of track type
abstract_en: The application relates to a remote control track type multifunctional integrated command vehicle which comprises a track system, a vehicle body, a lifting system, a driving motor, a communication command module, a storage battery and a power supply system. The application can feed back real-time video and detection information acquired by the car body to the command center, the command center can remotely control the car body to move along the track system through the communication command module, and the on-site image is recorded, so that the functions of daily supervision, accident emergency command, congestion management, accident early warning, road surface icing detection and the like are realized. The application can effectively reduce the illegal and illegal phenomena of the road, reduce the running safety risk, timely conduct emergency command and early warning on the accident scene after the accident occurs, reduce the congestion phenomenon and traffic jam time, reduce the occurrence probability of secondary accidents and improve the safe running efficiency.

title_en: Fire control command dispatch system based on neural network
abstract_en: The application provides a fire control command and dispatch system based on a neural network, which comprises the following components: the visual management module is used for managing the intelligent fire safety sensor and discovering safety events through the neural network; the task management module is used for automatically scanning fire safety hidden dangers existing in the place where the fire safety sensor is installed by artificial intelligence; the mobile emergency management module is used for providing intelligent mobile terminal application and managing data sources related to fire safety; the intelligent plan module is used for analyzing each fire safety early warning event in real time aiming at the discovery visual management module, the task management module and the mobile emergency management module, starting an intelligent processing flow and a selection mechanism of an emergency plan and providing standard plan making, calling and disposal flows; and the comprehensive statistics module is used for providing the integrated terminal application for field processing personnel and a remote command center, and can be used for datamation presentation of all the data and checking of detailed data source evidence obtaining records.
assignees: BEIJING EASTCOM NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: On-line data-based sewage pipe network burst emission analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of environmental protection and discloses a sewage pipe network burst emission analysis method based on online data, which comprises the following steps that firstly, sensors are arranged at a plurality of key nodes of a sewage pipe network, and sewage flow, water quality parameters and pressure data are collected; the method comprises the steps of collecting on-line data, preprocessing the collected on-line data, removing noise and abnormal values, converting data formats, identifying abnormal emission events, classifying the emergency emission events through an event classifying and evaluating module, generating alarms and notifying related personnel, and recording and subsequently analyzing the emergency events. By arranging a plurality of sensors at key nodes of the sewage pipe network, the real-time online monitoring of a plurality of parameters such as sewage flow, water quality, pressure and temperature is realized, the running state of the pipe network can be monitored all the time, the emergency emission event is ensured to be detected at the first time, and the speed and accuracy of emergency response are greatly improved.

title_en: Train automatic control system and method using a rail image
title_ko: 선로 영상을 이용한 열차 운행 종합 제어 시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A train operation composite control system which uses a railroad image and a control method thereof are provided to control train operation by detecting preceding train service information transmitted from a ground apparatus of a train operation control apparatus, thereby improving railroad efficiency and train operation efficiency. CONSTITUTION: An image recording part(110) records a railroad image. A railroad communication part(150) transmits the railroad image and railroad system information to a train system or a situation room system. A railroad database part(170) stores the railroad image and the railroad system information. A railroad image processing part(120) processes the railroad image by being connected to a railroad control part. A railroad location detection part(160) detects the location of a railroad system using a GPS(Global Positioning System) receiver.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 열차 운행을 제어하는 열차 운행 자동 제어 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 특히, 선로를 따라 순차적으로 설치되어 열차 진행 방향 전방의 선로 영상을 촬영하고, 상기 선로 영상을 분석하여 선행 열차 존재 여부, 선행 열차 운행 정보, 장애물 존재 여부 및, 선로 이상 여부 등을 검출한 후, 상기 선로 영상과 선로 영상 분석 결과 등을 열차시스템과 상황실시스템으로 전송하는 다수 개의 선로시스템; 열차 운전실에 설치되며, 상기 선로시스템과 통신을 수행하여, 상기 선로시스템에서 전송하는 선로 영상과 선로 영상 분석 결과 등을 열차 진행 상황에 따라 순차적으로 수신하여 나타내고, 선로를 따라 설치된 열차운행제어장치의 지상장치에서 전송하는 선행 열차 운행 정보를 검출한 후, 선행 열차 존재 여부와 장애물 존재 여부 및 선로 이상 여부에 따라 열차 운행을 자동 제어하는 열차시스템; 및, 원격지에 위치한 종합 상황실에 설치되며, 하나 이상의 선로시스템에서 전송하는 선로 영상과 선로 영상 분석 결과 등을 수신하여 나타내는 상황실시스템;을 포함하여 구성됨을 특징으로 하는 선로 영상을 이용한 열차 운행 종합 제어 시스템 및 그 제어방법이다. 
이러한 본 발명은, 특히, 본 발명 "선로 영상을 이용한 열차 운행 종합 제어 시스템 및 그 제어방법"은, 특히, 선로 영상을 촬영 및 실시간 분석하여 선행 열차의 존재 여부, 위치, 속도, 거리, 도달 시간 및, 선로 이상 여부, 장애물 존재 유무 등을 검출하고, 상기 선로 영상을 분석하여 얻은 선행 열차 운행 정보와는 별도로 열차운행제어장치의 지상장치로부터 전송되는 선행 열차 운행 정보를 검출하여(검출 이중계 구성) 열차 운행을 제어하고, 상기 선로 영상 및 영상 분석 결과를 운전실 및 상황실에 나타냄으로써, 첫째, 선로 영상 분석과 지상신호 검출의 검출 이중계를 구성하여 열차 안전성을 향상시키고, 둘째, 선로 이용 효율 및 열차 운행 효율을 향상시키고, 셋째, 열차 운전자 및 상황실 운영자에게 선로 영상을 제공하여 근거리에서 원거리에 이르는 전방 선로 영상을 육안으로 확인하며 운전할 수 있고, 넷째, 선로 상에 존재하는 장애물 및 선로 이상으로 인한 사고를 방지하며, 다섯째, 용이하게 선로 유지, 보수를 할 수 있게 되는 효과 등이 있다.

title_en: Method for providing passenger help service and passenger help service server thereof
title_ko: 여객 도우미 서비스 제공 방법 및 그를 위한 여객 도우미 서버 및 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology of providing a passenger service. A method for providing a passenger helper service according to one embodiment of the present invention is performed by a passenger helper server capable of being connected to a passenger client and a guardian client and of being linked to a plurality of image acquisition means installed in a public transportation means. The method for providing a passenger helper service comprises the steps of (a) generating passenger information for a passenger using the boarding information of the passenger provided by the passenger client; (b) setting helper service setting information including at least one among emergency response information and guardian notification information that can be applied to the passenger in previously stored helper service data using the passenger information; and (c) acquiring image information for the passenger from the public transportation means that the passenger boards and performing the emergency response notification or the guardian notification according to the corresponding situation based on the acquired image information when the emergency situation or the guardian notification occurs according to the helper service setting information. [Reference numerals] (210) Communication unit; (220) Helper service approval unit; (230) Helper service management unit; (240) Helper service database; (250) Notification unit; (260) Location information generation unit
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 여객 서비스 제공 기술에 관한 것으로, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 여객 도우미 서비스 제공 방법은 탑승자 클라이언트 및 보호자 클라이언트와 연결 가능하고, 대중 교통 수단에 설치된 복수의 영상 취득 수단과 연동 가능한 여객 도우미 서버에서 수행된다. 상기 여객 도우미 서비스 제공 방법은 (a) 탑승자 클라이언트로부터 제공된 탑승자의 탑승 정보를 이용하여 상기 탑승자에 대한 탑승자 여객 정보를 생성하는 단계, (b) 상기 탑승자 여객 정보를 이용하여, 기 저장된 도우미 서비스 데이터 중에서 상기 탑승자에게 적용 가능한 위급 대응 정보 및 보호자 통지 정보 중 적어도 하나를 포함하는 도우미 서비스 설정 정보를 설정하는 단계 및 (c) 상기 탑승자가 탑승한 대중 교통 수단으로부터 상기 탑승자에 대한 영상 정보를 취득하고, 상기 취득한 영상 정보를 기초로 상기 도우미 서비스 설정 정보에 따른 위급 상항 또는 보호자 통지 사항이 발생하면 해당 상황에 따른 위급 대응 통지 또는 보호자 통지를 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Programmable actuator simulation card
title_ko: 프로그래밍가능한 액츄에이터 시뮬레이션 카드
abstract_en: Provided is a programmable actuator simulator card with one or more actuator simulation models. The actuator simulator card comprises: a first interface configured to communicate with a programmable computer; a second interface configured to communicate with an actuator controller; and a simulation module configured to communicate with each of the first interface and the second interface. The simulation module is configured to receive at least one actuator simulation model corresponding to at least one actuator from the first interface, to receive excitation signals and command signals for operating the actuator from the second interface, and to determine feedback signals simulated based on the excitation signals, the command signals, and the actuator simulation model.
abstract_ko: 하나 이상의 액츄에이터 시뮬레이션 모델들을 가지고 프로그래밍가능한 액츄에이터 시뮬레이터 카드가 제공된다. 액츄에이터 시뮬레이터 카드는 프로그래밍가능한 컴퓨터와 통신하도록 구성된 제1 인터페이스, 액츄에이터 컨트롤러와 통신하도록 구성된 제2 인터페이스, 그리고 제1 인터페이스 및 제2 인터페이스 각각과 통신하는 시뮬레이션 모듈을 포함할 수 있다. 시뮬레이션 모듈은 적어도 하나의 액츄에이터에 상응하는 적어도 하나의 액츄에이터 시뮬레이션 모델을 제1 인터페이스로부터 수신하고, 액츄에이터를 작동시키기 위한 여기 신호들 및 명령 신호들을 제2 인터페이스로부터 수신하고, 여기 신호들, 명령 신호들, 및 액츄에이터 시뮬레이션 모델을 기초로 하여 시뮬레이션된 피드백 신호들을 결정하도록 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Coding robot apparatus for generating control signal based on voice command, condition command, wireless signal command
title_ko: 음성 명령, 조건 명령, 또는 무선 신호 명령을 기반으로 제어 신호를 생성하는 코딩 로봇 장치
abstract_en: In accordance with the present invention, a coding robot apparatus performing an IoT function includes: a control module generating and outputting a control signal corresponding to a control command and including control target information and control detail information by using a program coded by a user when the control command is inputted; a robot control board allowing the control module to be attached thereto or detached therefrom, including a plurality of control targets, and outputting the control signal to a control target indicated by the control target information among the plurality of control targets when the control signal is inputted from the control module; a robot frame including a main frame and a plurality of sub-frames corresponding to robot parts, respectively; and a robot skin attached to or detached from the robot frame to form a robot shape. Therefore, the present invention is capable of providing an IoT service to a user and creating a design effect of the coding robot apparatus.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 IoT 기능을 수행하는 코딩 로봇 장치는 제어 명령이 입력되면 사용자로부터 코딩된 프로그램을 이용하여 상기 제어 명령에 대응되고 제어 대상 정보 및 제어 내용 정보를 포함하는 제어 신호를 생성하여 출력하는 제어 모듈; 상기 제어 모듈이 탈부착되고, 복수의 제어 대상을 포함하며, 상기 제어 모듈로부터 상기 제어 신호가 입력되면 상기 복수의 제어 대상 중에서 상기 제어 대상 정보가 나타내는 제어 대상으로 상기 제어 신호를 출력하는 로봇 제어 보드; 로봇 부위 각각에 대응되는 메인 프레임과 복수의 서브 프레임을 포함하는 로봇 프레임; 및 상기 로봇 프레임에 탈부착되어 로봇 형상을 구성하는 로봇 스킨;을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Direction-sensitive radiation detector and radiation detection method
abstract_en: A radiation detection system and method suitable for use by a first responder to detect a radiological source. The system includes a container that encloses a chamber containing a pressurized inert gas. Incident gamma rays pass through walls of the container to interact with inert gas atoms within the chamber. Wavelength-shifting fiber elements are disposed within scintillator bars oriented parallel to and radially spaced from the chamber axis. At least one sensor is interconnected with the fiber elements to receive first signals therefrom in response to the scattered gamma rays. An electrically-charged wire is disposed within the container along the axis thereof. The wire is adapted to attract electrons released from atoms of the inert gas that are ionized from being impacted by an incident gamma ray, and then produce second signals in response to the released electrons. Electronic circuitry collects the first and second signals, and a processor acquires and analyzes the first and second signals to produce an output based thereon.

title_en: A system which manages the use time of child-care institution
title_ko: 보육기관 이용시간 관리시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 보육기관 이용시간 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에서는 <아동(예컨대, 영아, 유아 등)의 신원이 기록된 정보기록코드(예컨대, 바-코드, 큐알-코드 등)를 해당 아동의 보육기관 이용시간 관리에 탄력적으로 채용하는 조치>, <정보기록코드(예컨대, 바-코드, 큐알-코드 등)를 스캔할 수 있는 스캐너 또는 스마트-폰용 스캔 애플리케이션을 아동의 보육기관 이용시간 관리에 탄력적으로 채용하는 조치> 등을 유연하게 취함과 아울러, 보육기관(예컨대, 어린이 집, 유치원 등)에 의해 관리되는 보육기관 정보기기(예컨대, PC, 노트북, 태블릿 PC, 스마트-폰 등)의 프로그램 블록 내에, <스캐너 또는 스캔 애플리케이션에 의한 정보기록코드의 스캔 시점에서, 각 아동의 보육기관 등원시간이 기재된 등원시간정보를 생성하고, 생성된 등원시간정보를 저장/관리할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <스캐너 또는 스캔 애플리케이션에 의한 정보기록코드의 스캔 시점에서, 각 아동의 보육기관 하원시간이 기재된 하원시간정보를 생성하고, 생성된 하원시간정보를 저장/관리할  수 있는 전산모듈>, <상기 등원시간정보의 생성 시점에서, 해당 등원시간정보가 반영된 등원시간 알림메시지를 생성하고, 생성된 등원시간 알림메시지를 보호자 정보기기로 전송/처리할 수 있음과 아울러, 상기 하원시간정보의 생성시점에서, 해당 하원시간정보가 반영된 하원시간 알림메시지를 생성하고, 생성된 하원시간 알림메시지를 보호자 정보기기로 전송/처리할 수 있는 전산모듈> 등을 체계적으로 배치/제공하고, 이를 통해, 보호자 또는 보육기관 측에서, 별도의 복잡한 절차 없이, 단지, 정보기록코드의 스캔과 동시에, 각 아동의 보육기관 이용시간 정보(예컨대, 아동의 보육기관 등/하원시간, 아동의 보육기관 체류시간 등)를 자동으로 생성/저장/유통시킬 수 있도록 유도함으로써, 결국, 보육기관 이용시간 정보의 수 작업 관리에 기인한 각종 문제점을 손쉽게 탈피하여, 예를 들어, 보육기관 이용시간 정보를 좀더 신속하게 파악할 수 있게 되는 이점, 보육기관 이용시간 정보의 기록/관리를 자동으로 편리하게 달성할 수 있게 되는 이점, 보육기관 이용시간 정보의 누락을 사전 차단할 수 있게 되는 이점, 보육기관 이용시간 정보의 정확성을 대폭 향상시킬 수 있게 되는 이점, 보육기관 이용시간 정보의 허위기재/오인기재/오류기재 등을 사전 차단할 수 있게 되는 이점 등을 융통성 있게 향유하면서, 혹시 모를 아동의 사건/사고 발생에도 효과적으로 대처할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Incident analysis system using metaverse in which incident site status information is recorded
title_ko: 사건 현장 상태 정보가 기록된 메타버스를 이용한 사건 분석 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an incident analysis system. The incident analysis system comprises: a three-dimensional image unit that collects a scanned image of an incident site; an identifier terminal and expert terminal that include an application or program providing a virtual space in which incident site status information is recorded; a communication network that is configured to communicate with the three-dimensional image unit, the identifier terminal, and the expert terminal; and a server that is connected to the communication network to receive the scanned image, receives clue location information and clue memory information from the identifier terminal, and then displays the scanned image and the information on the application to receive an expert opinion from the expert terminal and then provide an incident analysis result. The incident analysis system may prevent accidents from risk factors of the site without time and space constraints for incident identification, and improve public confidence in incident analysis by adding the experience of site investigators and the expertise of advisors.
abstract_ko:
사건 현장의 스캔 영상을 수집하는 3D 영상부와; 사건 현장 상태 정보가 기록된 가상공간을 제공하는 앱 또는 프로그램을 포함하는 감식자 단말기 및 전문가 단말기와; 상기 3D 영상부, 감식자 단말기 및 전문가 단말기와 통신되도록 구성되는 통신망; 및 상기 통신망과 연결되어 상기 스캔 영상을 수신하고, 상기 감식자 단말기로부터 단서 위치 정보와 단서 메모 정보를 수신하여, 상기 스캔 영상과 상기 정보들을 상기 앱에 표시한 후 전문가 단말기로부터 전문가 의견을 수신하여 사건 분석 결과를 제공하는 서버;를 포함하는 사건 분석 시스템이 개시된다. 
이러한 사건 분석 시스템은 사건 감식에 있어 시간적, 공간적 제약을 받지 않고, 현장의 위험요소로부터의 사고 예방이 가능하며, 현장 조사관의 경험과 자문위원의 전문지식이 더해져 사건 분석에 대한 공신력이 향상되는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Safety and health management system establishment and implementation system
title_ko: 안전보건관리체계 구축 및 이행 시스템
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a safety and health management consulting system capable of preventing accidents in advance and improving the efficiency of safety management by systematically constructing and operating a prescribed safety and health management system to minimize safety accidents occurring at construction sites such as work characteristics of a wide variety of construction sites, work processes, large-scale manpower input, various risk factors caused by large-scale equipment, etc. The system comprises: a head office terminal for requesting safety and health management consulting by uploading company information of a construction company and head office information including management policies, planning, and management regulation information corresponding to safety and health management of the construction company; an on-site terminal for requesting safety and health management consulting; a consulting platform server for receiving and managing an execution result by providing an execution request command to the head office terminal and the on-site terminal when non-execution according to safety and health management occurs; and a consultant terminal for inputting and providing corresponding response information when safety and health management related query information is input from the head office terminal or the on-site terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전보건관리체계 구축 및 이행 프로그램과 건설업 현장과 본사에 대한 안전보건경영을 위한 컨설팅 플랫폼 시스템에 관한 것으로, 건설 사업을 수행하는 건설 기업의 회사명, 종업원 수, 업종, 시공 능력, 현장 수, 재해 현황을 포함하는 기업 정보와 상기 건설 기업의 안전보건경영에 해당되는 경영방침, 계획수립, 관리 규정 정보를 포함하는 본사 정보를 업로드하여 안전보건경영 컨설팅을 요청하는 본사용 단말기; 상기 건설 기업이 현재 수행 중인 건설 현장에 대하여 공사명, 공사 기간, 공사 금액, 현장 책임자, 안전 담당자, 작업자 수, 작업자 건강지수, 공정률, 공사 종류, 공법, 작업환경 정보, 상기 건설 현장에서 실시되는 안전 교육 이행 정보, 사고 정보를 포함하는 현장 정보를 입력하여 안전보건경영 컨설팅을 요청하는 현장용 단말기; 상기 본사용 단말기로 입력되는 본사 정보를 수신받아 저장하는 본사 정보 처리부;와 상기 현장용 단말기로부터 입력되는 현장 정보를 수신받아 저장하는 현장 정보 처리부;와 상기 본사 정보와 현장 정보에서 수집되는 사고 정보를 저장하고 관리하는 사고이력 관리부;를 포함하여 구성되고, 수신된 상기 현장 정보가 상기 본사 정보에 해당되는 경영방침, 계획수립, 관리 규정에 기초하여 안전보건경영에 따른 미이행 사항이 발생할 경우 해당 사항을 상기 본사용 단말기와 현장용 단말기에 이행 요청 명령을 제공하여 이행 결과를 수신받고 관리하는 컨설팅 플랫폼 서버; 및 상기 컨설팅 플랫폼 서버에 저장된 본사 정보와 현장 정보를 열람하고, 본사 특성과 현장 특성에 따라 필요한 신규 안전보건경영 정보를 입력하여 상기 본사용 단말기와 현장용 단말기로 출력되도록 제공하며, 상기 본사용 단말기나 현장용 단말기로부터 안전보건경영 관련 질의 정보가 입력되면 해당 답변 정보를 입력하여 제공하는 컨설턴트 단말기;를 포함하여 구성되고, 상기 컨설팅 플랫폼 서버에서 상기 본사용 단말기와 현장용 단말기로부터 본사 정보와 현장 정보를 각각 수신받고, 여기서 안전보건경영에 따른 미이행 사항이 발생할 경우 해당 사항을 상기 본사용 단말기와 현장용 단말기에 이행 요청 명령을 제공한다.

title_en: Intelligent radiation safety interlock integrated control forming device and method through edge-type AI control module for PSIS
title_ko: Psis용 엣지형 ai 제어모듈을 통한 지능형 방사선 안전인터락 통합제어형성장치 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 기존의 PSIS 기술의 구성요소 중 PLC 기반 제어로직부 간 연결된 잠금 신호선 단선시 '정상'신호로 오인되어, 오작동 가능성이 발생되어, 가속기 운전 중 작업자 출입 상태를 정확히 감지하지 못해, 작업자에게 방사선이 노출되는 위험이 자주 발생되는 문제점과, 여러 차폐문, 미로문, 출입문이 하나로 연결된 경우에, 중앙 제어기에서 전체 상태를 취합하는데 지연이 발생되고, 수백 ms로 반응속도가 제한되어, 온도, 영상, 인체, 방사선 등 복합 조건 인식이 불가하고, 사고 징후 사전 판단과 사고 대응이 어려운 문제점, 그리고, 도어의 단순 온(ON)/오프(OFF) 상태만 제공하므로, 사고 발생시 원인 추적이 어렵고, 사용자별 접근 기록 파악이 어려운 문제점을 개선하고자, 안전방호용 차폐문 스마트 제어모듈(100), 다채널 실내 센싱노드 모듈(200), PSIS용 엣지형 AI 제어모듈(300), 초전도 선형가속기용 구동멈춤 액츄에이터 제어모듈(400)이 구성됨으로서, 안전방호용 차폐문 스마트 제어모듈를 통해, 작업자 출입 인증데이터, 차폐문 상태 센싱데이터, 차폐문용 방사선센싱데이터를 기반으로 오경보·과제어 현상을 기존보다 70% 이상 감소시킬 수 있고, ACS 인증, 방사선 수치, 차폐문 상태, 비상버튼 여부, DAS 경보 내역을 타임스탬프 기반으로 기록시킬 수 있어, 출입자 안전 및 피폭 추적성을 기존보다 80% 향상시킬 수 있으며, ESS 누름 즉시, 스마트제어부가 자체 자동 판단하여, 문잠금, EDL폐쇄, 알람, PSIS용 엣지형 AI 제어모듈 알림, 로그저장으로, 비상시 현장에서 자율반응제어시킬 수 있어, 이벤트 발생시, 안전성과 인명보호율을 기존보다 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 다채널 실내 센싱노드 모듈이 구성됨으로서, 온도, 인체, 영상, 방사선 센싱을 동시에 수집하여 복합 조건 판단하도록 해줌으로서, 사고 징후 인식 정확도를 기존보다 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 영상과 센서를 통해 실내 작업자 감지율을 기존보다 1.5배~2배 높일 수 있으며, SCL동, 고에너지 실험A동, 고에너지실험B동, 저에너지실험A동, 저에너지실험B동의 방사선관리구역 실내에 위치되어, SCL동, 고에너지 실험A동, 고에너지실험B동, 저에너지실험A동, 저에너지실험B동의 방사선관리구역 별로, 실내온도데이터, 실내인체감지데이터, 실내영상데이터, 실내방사선센싱데이터를 기록하고 저장시킬 수 있어, 사고 발생시 시간순 재구성과 함께, 사고 추적 정밀도를 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있으며, PSIS용 엣지형 AI 제어모듈이 구성됨으로서, AI 연산 프로세서부를 통해, 실내 작업자 감지, 방사선 수치, 출입기록, 영상, 패턴, 복합조건을 분석하여 오판율 대폭 감소시킬 수 있어, 기존보다 위험 판단 정확도를 85% 향상시킬 수 있고, 방사선 누출, 및 실내 작업자 감지, 기기이상에 따른 이벤트 발생시, 판단, EDL 제어, 가속기 멈춤으로, 평균 반응속도를 기존보다 1.5배~3배 빠르게 할 수  있으며, RTC 기반 타임스탬프와, AI 로깅으로 출입 인증, 영상, 방사선, 온도 등 복합 데이터를 자동 연동 저장시켜, 사고 발생 경로 90% 이상 재현시키고, 법적 감사자료 제공 및 안전통계 기반을 확보시킬 수 있고, 온도상승, 미세 방사선 누출, 실내 작업자 감지를 통해 사고발생을 예측하고, 선제적 폐쇄 및 경고를 수행하여, 사고율을 기존보다 80%이하로 감소시킬 수 있으며, 초전도 선형가속기용 구동멈춤 액츄에이터 제어모듈이 구성됨으로서, DO수신포트부를 통해 PSIS용 엣지형 AI 제어모듈과 직접 연동되는 현장 반응 신경망시스템으로, 초전도 선형가속기(SCL:Superconducting LINAC) 구동멈춤의 지연시간을 기존보다 1.5배~2배 단축시킬 수 있고, 초전도 선형가속기 특성 맞춤형 다단계 안전정지 흐름구조를 만들 수 있어, 비상정지 상황에서도 기기 수명 보존 및 무손실 정지시킬 수 있으며, 가속기형 RMH(Reflective Memory Hub)부를 통해, μs급 상태 동기화 및 다노드 대응시킬 수 있어, 다중 시스템 정합성과 사고경로 투명성을 기존보다 80% 향상시킬 수 있는 PSIS용 엣지형 AI 제어모듈을 통한 지능형 방사선 안전인터락 통합제어형성장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Self-operable, non-invasive, non-contact bio-signal monitoring
abstract_en: Unique methods and bio-imaging systems are introduced herein for self-automated self-operable biomedical devices and methods for bio-signal monitoring, such as electrocardiograms (ECG), heart rate, and other vital signs, requiring no trained medical assistance or minimal assistance. In particular, methods and devices disclosed herein may require no dedicated medical resources, generate diagnostic quality results, and provide for motion artifact correction without inducing discomfort or irritation. Moreover, long term recording is realizable. Such methods and devices reduce the backlog of patients at out-patient wards as well as emergency response in remote areas.
assignees: UNIV WASHINGTON STATE;GUPTA KAVITA SHASHANK;PT JNM MEDICAL COLLEGE

title_en: Systems and methods for forming and operating an ecosystem for a conducted electrical weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment (e.g., ecosystem) for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: Display device for history teaching
abstract_en: The utility model provides a display device for history teaching belongs to teaching aid technical field for solve historical era and historical incident show explanation inefficiency, the poor technical problem of effect. The display seat and the turnover cover form a storage box, the display seat and the turnover cover are hinged together through a plurality of hinges, a locking rod is arranged between the display seat and the turnover cover, a storage battery and a microcontroller are arranged in the display seat, an elastic clamp, a charging port, a radio remote controller and a loudspeaker player are also arranged in the display seat, a scroll-shaped guide rail plate and a scroll-shaped chronograph are arranged in the turnover cover, and a mobile camera mechanism is arranged on the scroll-shaped guide rail plate; the utility model discloses place stably, conveniently accomodate and expand, occupation space is little, through the cooperation of vorticity guide rail board, removal camera mechanism and vorticity chronograph, the historical chronology major incident of recording on the shooting show vorticity chronograph that can be stable makes things convenient for the student directly perceived, high-efficient to watch, and the mr easily explains.
assignees: BAIYIN INST OF MINING AND METALLURGY

title_en: A kind of handle a case control system and its method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of handle a case control system and its method based on artificial intelligence are inquested and are obtained hearing result to suspect including the system of putting on record, positioning system, for personnel in charge of the case and form the intelligence hearing console of folder, intelligent folder control system, command centre in conjunction with the system of putting on record for result is inquested.The present invention using integrate the system of putting on record, positioning system, intelligence hearing console, intelligent folder control system, command centre Technical Architecture, by the way that service logic is complete and linking innovation, the complete process process of case is fully considered, from by putting on record, personnel positioning and tracking, controlled to form streamlined system control system to the intelligence hearing of suspect, intelligent folder, it realizes public security organs users at different levels to jointly control program of handling a case by command centre, substantially increases the efficiency and intelligence handled a case；System design is rigorous, and running efficiency of system is high, and intelligence degree is higher, security performance with higher, is suitble to promote and apply.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HENGBAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: City utility tunnel safety monitoring system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention provides a block chain-based urban comprehensive pipe gallery safety monitoring system which comprises a real-time monitoring module, an information management module, an inspection management module, a pipeline monitoring module, a risk early warning module and an emergency command module, wherein the real-time monitoring module is used for monitoring the safety of an urban comprehensive pipe gallery; the real-time monitoring module is used for monitoring external environment data inside the pipe gallery; the information management module is used for managing the space in the corridor, the pipeline information and the equipment information data; the inspection management module is used for managing the inspection personnel, the inspection route and the inspection record of the pipe gallery; the pipeline monitoring module is used for monitoring various pipelines; the risk early warning module is used for early warning potential safety hazards; the emergency command module is used for carrying out a plan on emergency situations. Different module data are respectively stored in corresponding blocks to form a complete block chain based on a block chain technology and are issued on distributed nodes, so that each terminal participates in data recording, and the problem of untimely data utilization caused by information isolated islands can be solved.
assignees: NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY;JIANGSU LONGTENG SPACE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of automotive window kinetic control system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of automotive window kinetic control system, belongs to body of a motor car control technology field, comprising: control module；Acquire motion state signal；Environment acquisition module acquires ambient condition signal；The movement of drive module control automotive window；Control module includes: wireless communication unit；Processor unit handles to obtain vehicle window image and output control instruction；Instruction input unit is supplied to the instruction of user's input control, including touching instruction；Unit, and user's habits information is obtained by deep learning, processor handles to obtain corresponding template control command according to user's habits information；Safe unit handles to obtain the car status information for being associated with vehicle condition and carries out corresponding operating.Beneficial effects of the present invention: having the function of remote wireless control, and control instruction input mode is flexible and varied, user's use habit can be carried out record and analyze make to operate it is more flexible, in emergency situations have emergency flight control scheme keep vehicle safer.

title_en: Record replay method and system for police preplan making process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a recording replay method and a recording replay system for a police preplan making process. A recording replay method for a police preplan making process comprises the following steps of (1) editing a preplan: (2) recording user operation behaviors through a log file: (3) playback of user-operated behavior by timer-driven system: (4) interpreting the operation instruction and displaying graphically: (5) and (5) ending the playback: and reading the end of the log file by the playback driving module, and finishing the predetermined planning and replaying process. The advantages are that: the mode of executing through command interpretation is adopted to record and replay the police preplan planning process, the volume of a record file is reduced by operating the diary file record preplan planning process, the playback visual effect is improved, meanwhile, manual intervention in the playback process is supported, and the requirement of reply analysis in the preplan planning process is strongly supported.

title_en: Digital emergency plan management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital emergency plan management system, relates to the technical field of emergency management, and aims to solve the problems that the existing system only partially carries out electronization and simple digital processing, the relevance among all links is low, and the emergency requirement cannot be met. The technical scheme is characterized by comprising an event information module, an event grade qualitative module, an emergency response recording module, an organization and responsibility module, an emergency material allocation module, a monitoring and early warning module and a plan matching module, wherein the plan is structurally decomposed and developed into relatively independent and mutually related modules, so that a decision maker can make a more scientific decision for key emergency nodes such as emergency rescue actions and emergency recovery, preferably dispose schemes, and can be used for assisting the decision maker to make a more scientific decision, and the problems that links in the conventional emergency plan electronization and digitization processes are independent, are simply consulted on line and cannot be mutually related are solved.
assignees: NANJING HUAITA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Epidemic situation emergency communication system for multi-network converged communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an epidemic situation emergency communication system for multi-network converged communication, which belongs to the technical field of emergency communication systems and comprises a physical layer hardware platform, an application layer software platform and a system communication subsystem; the physical layer hardware platform adopts a basic mode of SOPC + ASIC; the system communication subsystem adopts a hybrid access technology, an ad hoc network routing technology and a data packaging and aggregation technology; the application layer software platform comprises a core data layer, a core service layer and a core application layer. The authenticity and timeliness of information transmission of emergency rescue sites are ensured through audio and video acquisition, event disposal, event reporting, command scheduling, risk early warning, information disclosure and reporting of emergency sites, and convenience of communication and cooperation among departments and mechanisms is ensured; and the system can provide rapid and effective command and scheduling capability, rapidly handle emergent public events and maximally ensure the life safety of people.
assignees: FUZHOU BOXUN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for dynamically and quantitatively evaluating super-standard flood disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically and quantitatively evaluating a super-standard flood disaster, which comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring basic data of a research area; step 2, performing super-standard flood real-time dynamic simulation by using a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model based on GPU heterogeneous parallel acceleration; step 3, constructing the spatial distribution of the socioeconomic class data and establishing association with flood inundation characteristic parameters; step 4, calculating and establishing the relation between flood inundation characteristic parameters and various property flood damage rates; and 5, estimating the loss of the over-standard flood disasters. The method realizes real-time dynamic rapid quantitative assessment of the flood disaster exceeding the standard of the flood disaster, improves timeliness and accuracy of the flood disaster assessment, and provides references for the exceeding the standard flood dispatching decision and real-time coping; and the GPU heterogeneous parallel acceleration method is adopted to reconstruct a two-dimensional hydrodynamic model, so that the consumption of computing resources is greatly reduced, and the computing efficiency of the model is improved.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Beidou-based ground wire hooking state analysis and abnormality early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ground wire hooking state analysis and abnormality early warning method based on Beidou, which comprises the following steps: collecting real-time parameters of a ground wire hanging point based on a Beidou satellite and a sensor network; processing and analyzing the received real-time parameters, and establishing a reference model of the grounding wire based on a deep learning algorithm; setting a threshold value and an early warning rule, and comparing the difference between the real-time data and the reference model; continuously monitoring the state and parameter change of the grounding wire; the method comprises the steps of monitoring that the ground wire hanging state is abnormal or exceeds a set threshold value, triggering an early warning rule, performing interaction through Beidou satellite communication, sending an alarm notification to related personnel, and taking emergency measures; recording the triggered early warning event and emergency response, and generating an analysis report; the safety can be improved, the potential risk is reduced, and the safety of personnel and equipment is protected.
assignees: POWERCHINA GUIZHOU ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Network security digital proxy protection method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of network security, in particular to a network security digital proxy protection method and a system, which comprise the following steps of, based on data flow from a railway network, network activities including equipment states and communication anomalies are monitored and recorded in real time, normal and abnormal network behavior patterns are analyzed by utilizing an LSTM network, behavior characteristics are extracted, and network virtual copies are established. According to the invention, through monitoring the data flow of the railway network in real time and recording the equipment state and communication abnormality, the network security dynamic is effectively captured, the instant response capability to abnormal behaviors is improved, the analysis and extraction of complex network behavior characteristics are performed by utilizing the LSTM network, the analysis of complex data patterns is enhanced, the efficient identification of unknown threats is ensured, the automatic behavior deviation identification configuration and the emergency response instruction set can be used for rapidly and accurately coping with potential threats, the probability of network security accidents is reduced, the efficient risk management is realized, and the security performance of the railway network is greatly improved.
assignees: CHENGDU NUOSAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Space-sky landslide monitoring method and system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-sky landslide monitoring method and a system based on deep learning, which relate to the technical field of landslide monitoring of mines, wherein the system divides a mine area into a plurality of monitoring subareas by establishing a visual man-machine interaction platform and combining a digital geological disaster model, and multi-source data acquisition covers various sensing data of space, space and foundation, and ensures the consistency and reliability of the data through standardization, time synchronization and spatial registration processing; the landslide dynamic monitoring model is built by adopting a convolutional neural network, the multi-scale space-time characteristics of a landslide body are extracted in real time, the accurate identification of landslide physical effect risks is realized, the landslide risks are estimated in a multi-dimensional mode through a threshold judgment mechanism by combining geomechanical strain response indexes, microseism excitation response coefficients and fluctuation disturbance abnormality indexes, the risk states and early warning levels are dynamically output, an early warning strategy is generated, mine safety management and emergency response are assisted, and life safety and environmental stability of mining area personnel are ensured.
assignees: QINGHAI 906 ENGINEERING SURVEY AND DESIGN INST CO LTD;QINGHAI BUREAU OF ENVIRONMENTAL GEOLOGY EXPLOR

title_en: Investigation disturbance identification method based on sky-ground cooperation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a exploration disturbance recognition method based on sky-ground coordination, which comprises the steps of adopting a similar pattern matching result to evaluate exploration activity distribution characteristics and disturbance probability prediction, dynamically planning sky platform paths and residence time to obtain an optimized moving track scheme, recognizing potential faults and weather interruption factors, adjusting the paths through a multi-platform coordination mechanism to obtain a complementary observation coverage sequence, calculating the discrete degree and distribution density of disturbance points, quantifying the looseness index, judging an aggregation mode from the disturbance point discrete degree and distribution density index to obtain clustering analysis output, comparing the disturbance dynamics characteristic description with a preset dangerous situation feature library, judging that precursor signal combinations appear to obtain early warning trigger signals, and adopting the early warning trigger signal to schedule, encrypt and observe and fuse the real-time analysis, determining dangerous situation types and development trends and correspondingly outputting emergency response decisions. The invention obviously improves the precision of disturbance monitoring and the timeliness of early warning, and provides powerful technical support for risk prevention and control in complex environments.

title_en: Method for producing algorithm
title_ko: 알고리즘 생성 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for generating an algorithm. A source code corresponding to the algorithm created by a command block inserted in an operation main body is generated so that a user can confirm the source code of the algorithm created by the user. The algorithm created by the command block embedded in the operation main body writes the source code in a programming language selected by the user among various programming languages, so that the user can receive education of various kinds of programming languages.

title_en: System and method for emergency communications
abstract_en: The provision of emergency response services to a user can be based on transitioning a communications device associated with a user to a listening mode, setting a first timer, recording user actions with the communications device, ascertaining, based on a status of the first timer and the user actions, whether a criteria with respect to at least user interaction is met, and, if the criteria is met, transitioning the communications device to an emergency communications mode, else resetting the timer and repeating the recording and the ascertaining until the criteria is met. The emergency communication mode consists of forwarding user and live location information to a remote server and receiving emergency contact information, selected based on the user and live location information, for establishing a communication with emergency response personnel.

title_en: Patient emergency response system
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.

title_en: Train group generation method, device and system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a train group generation method, a device, a system, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method is applied to a simulation training system and comprises the following steps: acquiring a train dispatching operation plan which is issued to each station in a preset period by a dispatching center in reality; determining the position of each train in a preset range according to the train dispatching operation plan and the current time; and generating a train model in the dispatching range of the simulation dispatching desk in the simulation training system according to the position of each train. Generating a train model based on a train dispatch operation plan may ensure the authenticity of a training scenario (with the train model generated). And the position of each train can be accurately determined, which is beneficial to ensuring the timeliness of training scenes (such as the positions, the number and the like of train models). In addition, the position of the train can be automatically and accurately determined through the mode, so that the accuracy is ensured, the time of practical training personnel can be saved, and the practical training effect is improved.

title_en: Multi-mode simulation operation method and system based on intelligent garbage collection box, automatic dispatch and VRP
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of operation management, in particular to a multi-mode simulation operation method and system based on an intelligent garbage collection box, an automatic dispatch and a VRP. A multi-mode simulation operation method based on an intelligent garbage collection box, an automatic dispatch and a VRP (virtual router) constructs a matrix-shaped virtual map through longitude and latitude and equipment numbers of the collection box, a transfer station and a sorting center. Further setting the related data of the recovery box and the transfer station and setting delivery record information, deducting and calculating the amount of the residual garbage in the recovery box and the transfer station, and judging whether to trigger a clearing order and a transferring order. Based on the delivery behavior, the clearing and transferring work of collectors and/or truck drivers, the surplus of the recovery box, the surplus of the transfer station and the surplus of the vehicle are dynamically updated in real time, relevant data in the deduction process are recorded, and the most suitable optimal receiving and transferring mode, and the number of collectors and truck drivers in the mode can be selected after multiple deductions.

title_en: Geological disaster early warning system with high stability
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, in particular to a geological disaster early warning system with high stability, which comprises an environment monitoring module, a risk assessment module, a dynamic threshold setting module, an early warning signal transmitting module and an emergency response coordination module, wherein the environment monitoring module is used for monitoring the environment of the geological disaster; wherein, the environment monitoring module: collecting multidimensional environment and geological data; risk assessment module: assessing the potential risk of landslide; dynamic threshold setting module: dynamically adjusting a landslide early warning threshold value; the early warning signal transmitting module: sending out an early warning signal; and a coordination module: the method is used for allocating emergency rescue resources and optimizing the deployment of rescue actions. According to the invention, advanced environment monitoring technology, intelligent risk assessment and dynamic threshold adjustment mechanism are integrated, and effective early warning signal emission and emergency response coordination are achieved, so that accuracy, timeliness and response efficiency of geological disaster early warning are remarkably improved, and risks of casualties and property loss are greatly reduced.

title_en: Apparatus and method for intellectual integration auto controlling
title_ko: 지능형 통합 자동제어장치 및 방법
abstract_en: An intellectual integration auto-controlling apparatus and an auto-controlling method are provided to operate a mutual monitoring system and to enhance reliability by using additional monitoring devices. An illumination monitoring control unit(15) includes a photo sensor, a presence sensor, a program switch, a plurality of LCPs(Light Control Panels), and a first I2DCU(Intellectual Integration Data Control Unit). A security monitoring control unit(16) includes a door lock, an input/output M/C(Micro Controller), an alarm light, a siren, a security M/C, a fire sensor, a fire plug pump, a sprinkler, a fire monitoring M/C, and a second I2DCU. A CCTV monitoring control unit(17) monitors corresponding images from a DVR and a VTR in a real-time period. An automatic metering monitoring control unit(18) transfers metering data of a water meter, a heating meter, a gas meter, and an electric power meter to an integrated monitoring control unit(11). A power monitoring unit(19) transmits information of a distributing board and a generator to a block segment integration unit(14). An air condition monitoring unit(20) controls a boiler according to signals of a motor, a damper, and a temperature sensor. The block segment integration unit collects and matches data of the illumination monitoring control unit, the security monitoring control unit, the power monitoring unit, and the air condition monitoring unit. The integrated monitoring control unit analyzes, determines, commands, and monitors the data of the block segment integration unit, an ACU(ARS Communication Unit)(21), a PTC(Pan and Tilt Controller)(22), and a DCU(Data Control Unit)(23). A remote place monitoring control unit monitors and controls an operating state of a system. The integrated monitoring control unit briefs main information at a constant time to a supervisor by using a voice sound method through a speaker, a telephone, a cellular phone.
