title_en: Telephone networking telephone alarm host for fire fighting
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a telephone networking telephone alarm host for fire fighting, which is characterized in that input ports of a single chip microcomputer are connected with a keyboard and an internal and external switch radio frequency coding receiving circuit, and output ports of the single chip microcomputer are connected with an external alarm interface, a signal interface circuit and a sound recording and playing circuit; the output terminals of the signal interface circuit and the sound recording and playing circuit are connected with a telephone circuit, and the output terminal of the telephone circuit is connected with an A/D input terminal of the single chip microcomputer; and the telephone circuit is connected with a telephone line and is provided with a satellite module which can be in information transmission with a satellite, and when the telephone line is burned out, satellite signals can be used for transmitting alarm information. The alarm host can form an integrated organic whole through the satellite module, a satellite system and an emergency commanding center so as to quickly achieve the emergency handling and commanding for incident scenes, and has dual alarm and dual protection compared with other telephone alarm system. The utility model has strong anti-jamming ability, complex wiring and reliable work, and can automatically adapt to different types of switches in different regions.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGHAI JIN AN HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire detecting system
abstract_en: A forest fire detecting system comprises forest area monitoring points including a heavy-duty data cradle head 1, an infrared thermal imaging instrument 2, a visible light camera 3, a micro weather station 4, an embedded video processing device 5 and a communication network bridge 6, and a command control center including a remote monitoring computer 7 and a communication network bridge 8. The two communication network bridges are bidirectionally communicated through a microwave wireless TCP/IP network. A fire detecting work is smoothly carried out according to 1 site data acquisition, 2 image data treatment, 3 fire recognition analysis, 4 recognized result transmission, 5 fire probability assessment and 6 fire automatic early warning. The forest fire detecting system combines video compression with decompression technology, infrared image recognition analysis technology, visible color image recognition analysis technology, embedded technology, wireless communication technology, remote sensing technology, and three-dimensional geography information system technology, automatically recognizes forest fire and analyzes fire extinguishing strategies, has high probability of finding forest fire, low rate of false alarm and no need of personal participation, and has the advantages of high timeliness, high reliability, advanced technical strategies and wide market prospect.
assignees: QINGDAO KEEN RUITONG INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of search and rescue system of the fire fighter based on wireless signal strength positioning
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to fire-fighting special equipment field, a kind of search and rescue system of the fire fighter based on wireless signal strength positioning, the first bluetooth communication module is provided on sign monitoring bracelet, the second bluetooth communication module is provided on gas cylinder air pressure monitoring device, third bluetooth communication, motion state monitoring modular, ambient enviroment harmful gas monitoring modular and elevation carrection wired in parallel are connected to the input terminal of data processing module, wireless communication module, first Wireless alarm module and buzzer are parallel-connected to the output end of data processing module, first bluetooth communication module and the second bluetooth communication module connect third bluetooth communication module, wireless communication module connection communication trunking, communication relay set connection backstage monitoring commander's equipment.First Wireless alarm module connects the second Wireless alarm module.Realize the timeliness positioned when fire fighter's rear real time implementation alarmed in danger, intelligence and rescue to fire fighter in danger.

title_en: Cross-base nuclear power plant alarm linkage method and device
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the key technical field of million-kilowatt-class advanced pressurized water reactor nuclear power plants, and provides a cross-base nuclear power plant alarm linkage method and device. The method includes the steps: monitoring a plurality of bases in real time and judging whether an alarm linkage system of each base normally runs or not; realizing security and protection monitoring by the alarm linkage system of the current base if the alarm linkage system normally runs; judging the alarm grade of emergency alarm signals transmitted by the alarm linkage system of the current base by an emergency command center system if not; starting corresponding authority management according to the alarm grade; calling an execution plan according to the emergency alarm signals. The alarm signals are generated when illegal attacking happens, a command center extracts on-site alarm position information from the integrated alarm signals, an image acquisition device group is called to acquire on-site images, the on-site images are automatically popped up on a monitor, authenticity and severity of unexpected events are timely known, sound and light alarms are given, and the images automatically popped up in an alarm area are recorded.
assignees: DAYA BAY NUCLEAR POWER OPS;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: A kind of scenic spot vehicles managing and control system based on LoRa wireless network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of scenic spot vehicles managing and control system based on LoRa wireless network, including LoRa gateway, the LoRa gateway communicates to connect several Wireless data acquisition units by LoRa, the LoRa gateway connects local area network, the LAN connection server, the server passes through Internet connection mobile phone terminal and PC terminal, the server connection weather forecast module and alarm, the alarm connects medical rescue station, security rescue station and fire-fighting rescue station, the Wireless data acquisition unit is connected with environmental monitor, GPS positioning instrument, video camera and record of examination memory；The various vehicles are steady in centralized management scenic spot of the present invention, are safely operated, and scenic spot personnel property safety ensured, using LoRa communicating remote transmission technology, apart from remote, low in energy consumption, and by salvage system of comprehensively alarming, scenic spot emergency response capability is improved, reduces loss to greatest extent.

title_en: Multi-user collaborative network security emergency response and exercise platform and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a network security emergency response and exercise platform with multi-user cooperation and an operation method thereof, which comprises a server side, a client side and a storage side, wherein a user can log in the server side for operation through the client side, a virtual experiment scene is built by using an exercise scene management module, communication and cooperation are carried out through a shared file system and a real-time communication tool, the user can handle network attack events in real time and reflect operation in real time through remote desktop software, a monitoring and log module records operation and events in real time, a statistics and analysis module generates a report and visual display, and an exercise result evaluation module evaluates and analyzes exercise results. The platform provides various emergency exercise scenes, improves the safety threat coping capability of emergency response personnel, and ensures traceability and version control of cooperative operation through the virtualized platform, the shared file system and the version control system.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA AUTONOMOUS REGION RADIO AND TELEVISION MONITORING AND DEV CENTER

title_en: Water outlet and water cutoff monitoring method, system and equipment for fire truck and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a fire truck water outlet and water stopping monitoring method, a system, equipment and a storage medium, wherein when a fire fighter opens a fire truck water outlet end valve and presses a monitoring button, an indicator lamp flashes and sends water information; receiving water consumption information of a firefighter, recording the valve opening time of a water outlet end of the fire engine, and sending the current water outlet information and the current water outlet time to a command center; when the water consumption of the firefighter is finished, the firefighter closes a valve at the water outlet end of the firefighting truck and presses a monitoring button, and an indicator lamp is closed and sends out water cut-off information; and receiving the water cut-off information of the firefighter, recording the valve time of the water outlet end of the firefighter, and sending the current water cut-off information and the current water cut-off time to a command center. According to the embodiment of the invention, the water outlet and water stopping operation of the fire engine is digitalized, so that the water outlet and water stopping data of the fire engine are visualized, the cost is low, the operation is simple, the labor is simplified and the time is consumed, and the accuracy of the reported data information is high.

title_en: Urban waterlogging early warning and monitoring method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: A city waterlogging early warning monitoring method and system based on big data analysis comprises six steps of data acquisition, data transmission, data storage and management, big data analysis, early warning release and emergency response, wherein the data acquisition is mainly carried out through sensors, real-time monitoring and early warning of city waterlogging are achieved through various sensors, accuracy and timeliness of early warning are improved, loss caused by the waterlogging can be effectively reduced, scientific basis is provided for the real-time monitoring and data analysis of the city waterlogging, multi-channel release of early warning information can be guaranteed, information can be timely transmitted to related departments and citizens, and emergency response speed is improved. Has higher expandability and adaptability, and improves the flood control and drainage capacity of cities.
assignees: HUAIGU ZHENJIANG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital conversion sand table construction method and system based on aerial photography technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital conversion sand table construction method and a system based on an aerial photography technology, which relate to the technical field of three-dimensional sand table construction and comprise the steps of acquiring aerial photography images, and performing dynamic path planning and multi-mode data recording; and generating a three-dimensional digital sand table, and embedding dynamic updating and multi-platform display functions. The method improves the precision of image acquisition, reduces repeated coverage and blind areas, improves the overall efficiency of aerial photographing tasks, reduces splicing errors caused by complex terrain, illumination change and other factors in the traditional method, ensures that the output overall image parameters are more accurate and consistent, improves the detail expressive capacity of the model, lays a solid foundation for the subsequent three-dimensional digital sand table construction, meets the display requirements of multiple platforms, ensures that the sand table model has higher operability and sharing performance in actual scenes such as urban planning, emergency response and the like, and effectively optimizes the user interaction experience.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Cloud platform-based intelligent scheduling method and system for emergency of water tank fire truck
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud platform-based intelligent scheduling method and system for emergency of a water tank fire truck, and relates to the technical field of intelligent scheduling management. The method comprises the steps of acquiring priority data in the dynamic acquisition and classification storage processes of multi-disaster data and vehicle data to be scheduled based on a multi-dimensional real-time database constructed by a cloud platform, synchronously completing preliminary scheduling distribution of the vehicles to be scheduled so as to shorten the initial scheduling response period, generating a candidate scheduling scheme after the preliminary scheduling distribution, simultaneously screening out an optimal scheduling scheme so as to accurately match emergency demands of all target areas, dynamically adjusting a driving route and task distribution based on received scheduling instructions after the optimal scheduling scheme is acquired, and synchronously pushing scheduling information to a command center and all task scheduling sites so as to avoid rescue delay caused by information lag. The full-flow optimization of data processing, scheme screening and collaborative scheduling under the multi-disaster concurrent scene is realized, and the timeliness of the emergency scheduling of the water tank fire truck is further effectively improved.
assignees: LONGYAN CHANGFENG SPECIAL AUTOMOBILE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-sensing fusion property center 24-hour home health monitoring emergency system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a 24-hour home health monitoring emergency system for a multi-sensing fusion property center, and relates to the technical fields of Internet of things, intelligent care and medical health monitoring. The system realizes 24-hour continuous vital sign monitoring, high-precision abnormal detection, rapid emergency response and personalized health service for the elderly and senior pregnant women in communities through the combination mode of intelligent bedding noninductive monitoring at night and intelligent wearing noninductive monitoring at daytime, and the integrated multi-sensor fusion technology is in deep linkage with a property center. The intelligent monitoring system comprises an intelligent monitoring terminal group, a property intelligent monitoring center, a property APP mobile terminal, a property community gateway and other core modules, adopts a dynamic weight fusion algorithm, a precursor trigger mechanism and a blockchain evidence storage technology, achieves early warning trigger within 3 seconds and response rescue information task dispatch within 30 seconds, effectively solves the problems of accuracy, response timeliness and data safety of home health monitoring, has the advantages of low cost, easiness in popularization and high practicability, and accords with the national intelligent care industry development policy.
assignees: HONGSEN ZHIKANG HAINAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Centralized spraying system and method based on AI video monitoring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency rescue, and relates to a centralized spraying system and method based on AI video monitoring. The automatic eye washing device comprises an AI video monitoring module, a water supply guarantee module, an eye washing device, an alarm device and a control module, wherein the control module is respectively connected with the AI video monitoring module, the water supply guarantee module, the eye washing device and the alarm device, and the eye washing device is connected with the water supply guarantee module. The invention realizes full-flow automatic emergency response from accident sensing and automatic judgment to spray start, thereby remarkably improving the timeliness, accuracy and overall safety protection level of emergency treatment.

title_en: Management device, management method, and management program
abstract_en: To make an operator succeeding jobs related to emergency response conduct the emergency response efficiently.SOLUTION: A server 10 accumulates a task ID of information on a task read by a client terminal 20, and a screen shot in logout from the server 10 of the client terminal 20 as a user activity log of the client terminal 20. Then, when the client terminal 20 logs in the server 10 again, the server 10 refers to the user activity log of the client terminal 20, and displays the screen shot in previous logout. Moreover, the server 10 refers to the task ID contained in the user activity log of the client terminal 20, and displays unread tasks of the client terminal 20.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Home security applications for television with digital video cameras
title_ko: 디지털 비디오 카메라가 결합된 ｔｖ를 통한 가정 방범장치
abstract_en: A home security system using a television combined with a digital video camera is provided to combine the digital video camera and a digital recording device to execute lots of image monitoring works automatically controlled through a control unit. A security and monitoring system(100) is composed of an A/V(Audio/Video) device(106), which includes a television display(102) and one or more digital video cameras(110), and a controller module(108) for monitoring events on the basis of an image signal transmitted from each camera and controlling the A/V device according to the monitoring result. The controller module controls the A/V device on the basis of a command of a user and has a logic unit executed in a set-top box. The cameras are installed at the places remote from the television display and connected with the television display through the controller module.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Device, system and method for duplicate call handling at a public-safety answering point device
abstract_en: Duplicate call handling at a public-safety answering point PSAP device is provided. The PSAP device routes a call from a caller to a call-taker, the call associated with an incident; receives, via an input device of the call-taker, information related to the incident to populate a record associated with the call; prior to the record being complete, receives, via the input device, input to handover the call to an information collection application, the input indicative of the call being a duplicate call related to the same incident but from a different caller; determines, via the information collection application, remaining information to be collected based on one or more of a duplicate call policy and the information already received; receives, via the information collection application to verbally communicating with the caller on the call, at least a portion of the remaining information to continue to populate the record; and ends the call when the record is complete.

title_en: Connected healthcare devices with real-time and proactive capture and relay of contextual information
abstract_en: A portable healthcare device is connected to a networked healthcare service to form a connected healthcare system that is configurable to address a particular predicted or emergent healthcare condition or provisioned to address a number of emergent healthcare conditions. A portable sensor detects the predicted or emergent healthcare condition. A two-way communication channel provides instructions to the affected person or those in proximity, takes remote control of the portable healthcare device to deliver a therapeutic intervention, or facilitates a rendezvous with dispatched first responders. A buffered quantity of data that is recorded proactively can be transmitted in order to make a more accurate remote diagnosis. The remote, networked healthcare service can maintain additional information about the device or a person assigned to the device to augment the transmission, including healthcare records, contact information, configuration type of the device including therapeutic capabilities, service billing, facility location of an assigned device, etc.

title_en: Multifunction Mobile Device and Cellular Phone with Touch Screen and Internet Connectivity
abstract_en: A multifunction mobile device, cellular phone, or smart phone may have a touch screen, cellular radio, microphone, speakers, video and still camera, voicemail, and Internet website connectivity. The device may communicate using Bluetooth, Ethernet, USB, WiFi or 802.11x with an access point and cellular, GSM, CDMA, or LTE. The device records spoken audio, processes the audio, transcribes the audio into text, and displays the text on the screen. Spoken audio may be used for emails or documents composition. The device may accept voice commands for actions including calling, dialing, browsing websites, or Internet searching. The device may use local or server-based voice recognition software. Voice patterns may be stored for an individual in a database. Voice may control functions on the device, a server, Internet site, or an intelligent television.

title_en: PDA software robots leveraging past history in seconds with software robots
abstract_en:
The International market is a vital horizon for todays and future strategies since it provides a robust and competitive arena for expanding business. The focus of the forgoing is to deploy a suite of decision search tools which will live on the phone network and the internet. The prime focus is to mainstream an electronic data record and medical diagnostic application [telephone/internet deployment architecture] which will address one of the most threatening problems in America “Mainstreaming of remote Health Care Services Access”. These tools will primarily be used to determine the severity of health condition providing Doctor Collaboration and health services routing. 
     We spend 1.6 trillion dollars in health care cost and have not realized full efficiency primarily based on access, infrastructure, doctor shortage, rising prices and technology issues.      It appears that one of the enabling technologies that are promoting an intelligent look and feel by software system involves leveraging past history in seconds. This sublime but inertial characteristic provides the ability of decades of information to be searched and realized in such fields as medical critical care or emergency response units.

title_en: Method and apparatus for handling citizen callback of public-safety officer
abstract_en: In order to address the above-mentioned need, a method for routing civilian calls to an associated public-safety officer is provided herein. During operation, a call processor receives a civilian call having a source identifier number identifying a source of the call and a target identifier number identifying a target of the call. A current status priority of the associated public-safety officer is determined as a function of the current assignment status, and when the current status priority is less than the incident record priority, the civilian call is routed directly to a mobile device associated with the associated public-safety officer. When the current status priority is greater than the incident record priority, the civilian call is routed directly to one of a public-safety answering point or an automated voice mail system.

title_en: Learning toy, mobile body for learning toy, and panel for learning toy
abstract_en: A learning toy which enables learning of high-level programming in a stepwise manner. A movement path is constituted by a plurality of command panels in which command information which can be read with an optical reading module is recorded being arranged. A mobile robot sequentially reads command information included in the command panels through which the mobile robot passes while moving along the movement path and stores a plurality of pieces of command information in a command information memory. The mobile robot takes out a plurality of pieces of command information from arbitrary positions in the command information memory to execute operation. If a plurality of pieces of command information necessary for operation of the mobile robot are stored in the command information memory, a control unit of the mobile robot automatically extracts and takes out the command information and causes the mobile robot to operate.

title_en: Large-scale short wave communication network ship monitor location and emergent alarm Apparatus for () and method therefor
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of large-scale short wave communication network ship's fix equipment and method that has conventional location navigation function and emergency alarm positioning function simultaneously, utilize the time synchronizing signal of gps signal as ship's fix equipment in the large-scale short wave communication network of forming by the half-duplex short-wave radio set; Under same shortwave frequency, the time is divided into time slot, boat-carrying shortwave end packet, at certain time slot Access Control center in a certain order, one group of terminal in the same time slot is according to OFDMA mode connecting system control center; In the orthogonal sub-carriers that OFDM divides, select the control signaling subchannel of a part of subcarrier as control center and boat-carrying shortwave terminal.The present invention can be when carrying out conventional position monitor to a large amount of boats and ships, can monitor the location in real time to the boats and ships that give the alarm, can carry out the issue of warning informations such as typhoon again by control center and, be specially adapted to the intensive area of short wave communication equipment, large-scale fishing ground the unified command of ship management.
assignees: NANJING HOUHUA COMM APPARATUS CO LTD;NANJING UNIVERSITY OF TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Emergency command communications vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a special equipment vehicle, and discloses an emergency command communications vehicle. The emergency command communications vehicle comprises a vehicle body and a vehicle-mounted system, wherein the vehicle body is sequentially divided into three function blocks which are respectively to be a driving block, an operating block and an equipment block from end to end, function blocks are mutually isolated from one another by a plurality of isolation doors, and the vehicle-mounted system is distributed inside or outside the three function blocks. Due to the allocation of a plurality of communication modes such as the satellite communication, the wireless communication, the wire communication, the computer communication and the like, and a plurality of platforms such as the broadcasting and the sound amplifying, the sound frequency and video frequency acquiring and processing, the image real-time transmitting, the communication dispatching and managing and the like, the emergency command communications vehicle can be networked with a plurality of command centers at any time anywhere, can timely realize the multimedia communication interaction with each command center at all levels by means of voice, data and image, can realize the multifunctional dispatching and commanding such as controlling, switching, decision making, querying, recording and the like, and can meet the requirement of the instantaneity and the effectiveness of the communication command on the rescue site.
assignees: WUXI BINGDA INDUSTRY CREATIVE DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Centralized management type backup disaster recovery system
abstract_en: The invention provides a centralized management type backup disaster recovery system, which comprises: a console (104) which performs centralized control on the data container (105), the backup process module (103), the storage medium (101) and the standby machine (102) through control operations; a production server (108) for controlling and managing data flow between the production server and the storage medium in units of data blocks; a backup process module (103) for backing up data to a storage space allocated to the production server (180) by the storage medium (101) by means of mirroring and synchronous or asynchronous techniques or any other backup method; a storage medium (101) storing data and assigning a logical unit (200) for data storage to the production server (108); the standby machine (102) stores the system data of the production server (108), and completes the automatic operation and setting of the standby machine (102) through the console (104); and the data container (105) records the operation state, the data information and the command request of the console, the production server, the backup process module, the storage medium and the standby machine through data state updating.

title_en: Low-cost landslide early warning recording device based on MEMS accelerometers
abstract_en: The invention discloses a low-cost landslide early warning recording device based on MEMS accelerometers. The low-cost landslide early warning recording device is composed of a microprocessor, the MEMS accelerometers, a file system management chip, a Flash storage chip, a wireless serial port receiving and dispatching module, a GSM communication module, a GPS positioning module, setting buttons, a character type LED notice board, an audible and visual alarm, a lithium-ion battery, a solar cell panel and the like. After a system is started, real-time collecting and recording of acceleration are carried out on MEMS acceleration sensors distributed on all characteristic point locations of a measured mountain slope at a preset sampling rate, data are transmitted back to the system through a wireless communication network, comparative analysis is carried out on the data and a preset acceleration threshold value, whether mountain slope vibration abnormity warning is triggered or not is judged, and warning modes are divided into GSM short message sending warning and LED character notice audible and visual warning. The low-cost landslide early warning recording device based on the MEMS accelerometers is low in cost, high in reliability, flexible in layout and especially suitable for areas where geological disasters such as landslides occur easily.
assignees: CHENGDU MICRO ENVIRON ENVIRONMENTAL MONITORING EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A method of backup management being carried out to sound recordings using small table database
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of method for carrying out backup management to sound recordings using small table database, includes the following steps: that the index information of sound recordings and recording file are individually backed up and saved；In the corresponding file of desktop database that wherein index information of sound recordings can be inserted under specified backup directory by database engine, and backing up recording file can copy under same backup directory or be stored in its subdirectory.The present invention is realized in emergency communication field command dispatching system, or a kind of means and method that backup recording is more effectively managed in the telephone service system of call center field, it is compared with the traditional method, this method can directly be managed backup sound recordings by access backup recording data library, the efficiency of management is greatly improved compared with traditional mode only by file management, also management means is enriched, and makes entire management process more specification and convenient.

title_en: Positioning method for DCS control cabinet flash alarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of nuclear power control, in particular to a positioning method for DCS control cabinet flash alarm. The DCS control cabinet flash alarm positioning method comprises the following steps: grouping and labeling all cabinets; the system is divided into N groups of cabinets, and each group comprises i cabinets; setting a single cabinet input signal in each group as a digital quantity BIxx, and generating a 2-system output numerical value; setting the (i + 1) th bit as group positioning, and recording the output value as a true value as a cache M; xx represents the sequence number in the cabinet group, the numerical quantity BIxx is 0 or 1, wherein 1 represents the alarm of the cabinet, and 0 represents the normal state of the cabinet; calculating and judging each group of output values in a fixed scanning period, and setting alarm positioning judgment logic; and generating an alarm log. The invention can quickly position the cabinet with alarm, improve the emergency response capability of the cabinet fault and ensure the reliable and stable operation of the DCS cabinet.
assignees: CNNC FUJIAN FUQING NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for shortening average emergency response time of distribution network line tripping accident
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for shortening the average emergency response time of a distribution network line trip accident, which adopts a server system and a computer terminal of an intelligent scheduling operation system based on multi-fusion; and the server system is used for providing signal information required by automatic accident recording, analyzing and processing the obtained information, and sending the data processing result to the intelligent scheduling operation system computer terminal based on multi-fusion. The invention can effectively solve the problems of long average response time of accident handling and excessive statistical difficulty of trip in bad weather.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Multi-source remote sensing emergency rescue measure optimization method oriented to natural disasters based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-source remote sensing emergency rescue measure optimization method oriented to natural disasters based on a knowledge graph, which comprises the following steps of: s1, constructing a knowledge graph based on natural disaster information and rescue measure information; s2, carrying out target recognition on natural environment information of the current moment acquired by a plurality of sensor devices at intervals of preset time to obtain a recognition result of the current moment; s3, judging whether the identification result at the current moment is consistent with the identification result at the previous moment; if the information is inconsistent, path planning is carried out in the knowledge graph to inquire rescue measure information, and an inquiry result at the current moment is obtained; if the inquiring result at the current moment is that the rescue measure information is not inquired, the knowledge graph is complemented; and if the query results are consistent, sending the query result at the previous moment to the command end, and returning to the step S2. The invention improves the accuracy and the real-time performance of the rescue decision, saves manpower and material resources, and improves the timeliness of rescue and the accuracy of obtaining rescue measures.

title_en: Electric power emergency communication system
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power emergency communication system, which comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the on-site audio-video and data information of the event burst, recording the on-site audio-video and data information of the event burst as first information, and compressing, encoding and decoding the first information; the first-aid center master station platform is used for storing first information and displaying on-site video data when an event occurs in real time; the access equipment is used for performing two-way audio and video consultation and multiparty interaction between the user and the incident scene, and the user guides the scene personnel to process the incident through the access equipment; a data transmission module, comprising: and the data transmission module is used for testing the state of each network transmission link at regular time and screening the optimal network transmission link for data transmission when the network transmission links are simultaneously on line. The invention overcomes the defect of a single network carrier and provides a more reliable and effective emergency communication technical scheme for electric power emergency guarantee.
assignees: NUJIANG POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Wearable deep emergency rescue human body monitoring and diagnosing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wearable deep emergency rescue human body monitoring and diagnosing method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, real-time acquisition and fusion pretreatment of multidimensional data; S2, individual baseline modeling and dynamic prompt word self-adaptive generation, S3, large-scale language model deep analysis and interactive risk research and judgment, S4, multi-stage early warning, result presentation and intelligent emergency response linkage, and the system comprises a watch end and a server end. The invention can solve the defects of the existing deep operation safety monitoring means in individual state sensing, data fusion analysis, early warning response timeliness and personalized risk assessment, and can carry out deep understanding, accurate assessment, intelligent early warning and efficient response on deep operators.
assignees: SHENDI SCIENCE AND ENG YUNLONG LAKE LABORATORY;UNIV CHINA MINING

title_en: Nonvolatile memory device and programming method thereof
title_ko: 불휘발성 메모리 장치 및 그것의 프로그램 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A non-volatile memory device and a programming method thereof are provided to prevent the disappearance of LSB(Least Significant Bit) data in the program fail state of MSB(Most Significant Bit) data caused by power outage, thereby improving the reliability. CONSTITUTION: A memory system(100) comprises a host(110), a memory controller(120), and a flash memory(130). The memory controller comprises a buffer memory(121). The flash memory comprises a cell array(131) and a page buffer(132). The flash memory comprises a decoder, a data buffer, and a control unit. The memory controller receives data and a write command inputted from the host. The memory controller controls the flash memory in order to write the data in the cell array. According to a read command inputted from the host, the memory controller controls the flash memory in order to read the data stored in the cell array.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 반도체 메모리 장치에 관한 것으로, 좀 더 구체적으로는 불휘발성 메모리 장치 및 그것의 프로그램 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따른 불휘발성 메모리 장치는 복수의 멀티 레벨 셀들을 포함하는 메모리 셀 어레이; 및 상기 메모리 셀 어레이에 저장될 데이터의 특성을 판별하도록 구성되는 제어 유닛을 포함하며, 상기 제어 유닛은 판별 결과에 의거하여 복수의 멀티 비트 프로그램 방법 중 하나를 선택하며, 상위 비트 데이터의 프로그램 페일시 하위 비트 데이터가 유지되는 상기 선택된 멀티 비트 프로그램 방법으로 상기 메모리 셀 어레이에 데이터가 저장된다. 
     본 발명에 따른 불휘발성 메모리 장치는 상위 비트 데이터의 프로그램이 정전 등에 의해 페일되는 경우에도, 하위 비트 데이터가 소실되지 않도록 한다. 본 발명에 따르면 불휘발성 메모리 장치의 신뢰성이 향상된다.

title_en: Flight guide system by use of a big data
title_ko: 빅데이터를 이용한 비행 조정 가이드 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulated flight training system and, more specifically, a flight guide system to provide flight guide information for a pilot to safely fly an aircraft by using big data. The system comprises: a flight pattern recording unit to change and generate variable situation elements which can be varied during flight, and to accumulate and record simulated flight training practice data of each pilot to deal with a situation as big data; a big data storage unit to store at least one information of weather information, satellite information, flight accident information, and ground situation information as big data in DB; and a flight way recommendation unit to recommend a flight way in a current position based on the big data stored during a simulated flight training.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모의 비행 훈련 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 빅 데이터를 이용하여 조종사에게 안전하게 비행할 수 있도록 조종 가이드 정보를 제공하기 위한 비행 조정 가이드 시스템에 관한 것으로, 비행중 가변될 수 있는 가변상황 요소들을 변경 생성해 주면서 그 상황에 대처하는 각 조종사별 모의 비행 훈련 실습 데이터를 빅 데이터로서 누적 기록하기 위한 조종패턴 기록부와, 기상정보, 위성정보, 비행사고정보, 지상상황 정보 중 적어도 하나 이상의 정보를 빅 데이터로 DB에 저장하기 위한 빅 데이터 저장부와, 모의 비행 훈련 중 상기 저장된 빅 데이터에 기반하여 현재 위치에서의 조종방안을 추천하기 위한 조정방안 추천부;를 포함함을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Video production wizard program and system for disaster response education and training
title_ko: 재난 대응 교육 및 훈련용 영상 제작 마법사 프로그램 및 그 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are a wizard program for producing a video for disaster response education and training and a system thereof. A method for a user to use the wizard program for producing a video for disaster response education and training and the system thereof comprises: a step that basic information of the user is inputted; a step that introductory video information is edited; a step that disaster education and training clip videos are selected and aligned; a step that images and voice data in each clip video are edited; and a step that the edited videos are played in advance before being stored.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 대응 교육 및 훈련용 영상 제작 마법사 프로그램 및 그 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명은 사용자가 재난 대응 교육 및 훈련용 영상 제작 마법사 프로그램 및 그 시스템을 이용하는 방법에 있어서, 사용자의 기초 정보를 입력하는 단계; 인트로 소개 영상 정보를 편집하는 단계; 재난 교육 및 훈련 클립 영상을 선택하여 나열하는 단계; 각 클립 영상의 이미지와 음성 데이터를 편집하는 단계; 편집된 영상을 미리 보고 저장하는 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: Gripper system and grip control method of fabric robot
title_ko: 원단 로봇의 그리퍼 시스템 및 그립 제어방법
abstract_en: A gripper system of a fabric robot according to the present invention comprises: a gripper which directly grips a fabric roll and releases the grip; a robot arm to which the gripper is coupled at a distal end, transmits power or a control signal to the gripper so as to grip fabric and release the grip, such that the fabric is moved to a set position and loaded through rotational and linear motions; and a central control device which is equipped with a program for controlling the rotational and linear motions of the robot arm and a program for the gripping and releasing operations of the gripper, and can directly control the robot arm or control the gripper. After remembering the weight and volume of the previously loaded fabric, the next loading can be performed to ensure balanced loading of the fabric, such that the loaded fabric is prevented from collapsing, thereby minimizing casualties by preventing safety accidents in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 원단 로봇의 그리퍼 시스템은 원단 롤을 직접 그립하고 그립 해제하는 그리퍼; 말단부에 상기 그리퍼가 결합되고, 해당 그리퍼에 전원 또는 제어신호를 전달하여 원단을 그립 하게하고, 그립 해제하게 하여 회전운동과 직선운동을 통해 상기 원단을 설정된 위치로 이동시켜 적재시키는 로봇암; 및 상기 로봇암의 회전운동과 직선운동을 제어하기 위한 프로그램과 상기 그리퍼의 그립과 그립해제를 위한 프로그램이 구비되어 직접 상기 로봇암을 제어하거나, 또 그리퍼를 제어할 수 있는 중앙제어 장치;를 포함하여 이전 적재된 원단의 무게와 부피를 기억 한 후, 다음 적재를 수행함으로써 원단의 적재가 균형적으로 이루어 질 수 있도록 하여 적재된 원단이 무너지는 것을 방지함으로써 결과적으로 안전사고가 발생하는 것을 미연에 방지하여 인명피해 발생을 최소화시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.
assignees: FOUR ONE SYSTEM CO LTD;KWON OH DAE

title_en: System for warning abnormal sign
title_ko: 이상징후 경고 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for warning an abnormal sign. The system for warning an abnormal sign may stream a video for N minutes before and after an abnormal sign captured to an on-site manager or monitoring personnel of the system; record the same on a server; when a risk is sensed by a composite sensing device, provide a notification through a smart device application and a desktop client program owned by a safety manager; provide a live video streaming function; record a video captured by a camera adjacent to a point where the abnormal sign and an emergency occur for 10 minutes before and after the abnormal sign is recognized; and analyze an accident cause and establish reoccurrence prevention measures. According to the present invention, the system performs a preliminary measure or remotely controls workers to prevent industrial accidents, and enables early responses to accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 이상징후 경고 시스템에 관한 것이다. 상기 이상징후 경고 시스템은, 이상징후 포착 전후 N분 동안의 영상을 현장관리자 또는 시스템을 모니터링하는 인원에게 스트리밍하며, 이를 서버에 기록하고,  복합 센싱 디바이스에서 위험을 인지한 경우, 안전관리책임자가 소지하고 있는 스마트 디바이스 어플리케이션 및 데스크탑 클라이언트 프로그램을 통해 알림을 제공하고, 실시간 영상 스트리밍 기능을 제공하고, 이상징후 및 비상상황이 발생한 지점 인근의 카메라에서 촬영한 영상을 이상징후 인지 시점 전후 10분 가량을 기록하여, 차후 사고 원인 분석 및 재발방지대책 수립을 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digital video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event, and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted server to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time, the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: Emergency alert notification device, system, and method
abstract_en: A device, system, and method for determining a user's proximity within a predefined radius. A mobile electronic device with location software thereon can record and analyze ambient noise to determine after initiated the user's estimated locations as well as to track the user's movements throughout a predefined radius. The mobile locate software may present information to the user according to the user's position within the radius of the area. The type and nature of the information presented to the user can be changed according to the user's distance from emergency services as well as how quickly the user is approaches the safe zones. The software may provide detailed data about the movement of the user and additional users of the software that are within the determined radius. This information may be correlated with local, state and federal officials in the determination of the initial incident.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.
assignees: TASER INT INC;SMITH PATRICK W;HANCHETT MARK A;KLOC AARON J;CONANT TYLER J

title_en: Scoring server
abstract_en: A scoring server for assessing technical skills in a practical environment. A client application acts as a middle man between a terminal and an operating system to capture and forward all input from and output to students to the scoring server. The scoring server compares recorded student activity against a list of tasks deemed capable of accomplishing course objectives assigned to students. As objectives are met by a student, the students' grade is updated in real-time. Each student passes or fails an exam based on tasks performed and skills employed. The client application exists for two operating system types: WINDOWS® and LINUX®. A LINUX® client employs a pseudoterminal to permit access to terminal input/output and communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr channels. A windows client (WC) comprises a WC command line activity logger and a WC monitor process to intercept all communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr communication channels.

title_en: Method and system for detecting forest fire
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for detecting forest fire. The system is composed of a forest monitoring point which comprises a heavy-duty digital tripod head 1, a thermal infrared imager 2, a visible light camera 3, a micro-meteorological station 4, embedded video processing equipment 5 and a communication bridge 6, and a command and control center which comprises a telemonitoring computer 7 and a communication bridge 8, wherein, the two communication bridges are communicated by a microwave wireless Tcp/IP network. The fire detection work is sequentially performed by the following six major steps: (1) field data acquisition, (2) image data processing, (3) fire recognition and analysis, (4) transmission of recognition results, (5) fire probability assessment and (6) automatic fire early warning. The method and the system combines video compression and decompression technology, thermal infrared image recognition and analysis technology, visible light color image recognition and analysis technology, embedded technology, wireless communication technology, remote sensing (RS) technology and 3D geographic information system technology to automatically recognize forest fire and analyze fire strategies, thus the method and the system are characterized by high detection probability of forest fire, low false alarm rate, no artificial participation, strong timeliness, high reliability, advanced technological means and wide market prospects.
assignees: QINGDAO KEEN RUITONG INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: The program control risk identification of load and disposal system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides the program control risk identification of a kind of load and disposal system and method, the method comprises: Star Service supervisory computer receives the load operation that remote control is injected, load management module judges the rationality of load operation, automatically abandons performing the program control operation of single overtime load; Whether according to the load of timer record program control job run duration, timeout treatment unit judges that this load adds up stream time overtime, if overtime, sends shutdown command to this load; The judgement of satellite energy state is carried out in the collection of satellite energy state judging unit, under the satellite energy is in an emergency situation, sends instruction and closes all load worked; When the program control end of job, load on-off state judging unit utilizes the load telemetry gathered, and carries out the judgement of load on-off state, if load is not by instruction shutdown, repeatedly repeats to send shutdown command.The present invention can evade the program control and overtime work of payload error, has reached the object that satellite task ensures whole energy source of star safety.

title_en: A system for preventing disasters using photographic measurement and the method thereof
title_ko: 사진 측량을 이용한 재난 방재 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재해 방재 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 감시용 카메라에 의해서 일정 시간 간격으로 촬영된 건설 현장의 영상 정보와 현재 촬영된 영상 정보를 비교하여 거푸집 등 건설 구조물의 변형을 감지하고, 감지된 구조물의 변형이 일정 수준 이상이 되면 경보를 발생시켜, 사고가 발생하기 전에 안전하게 대피할 수 있도록 하는 사진 측량을 이용한 재난 방재 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
이러한 사진 측량을 이용한 재난 방재 시스템은 구조물에 부착되는 다수 개의 LED 발광 노드(101)와; 일정한 거리를 두고 구조물에 부착된 상기 LED 발광 노드(101)를 관측하는 다수 개의 감시용 카메라(103a, 103b)와; 상기 감시용 카메라(103a, 103b)와 일대 일로 결합 되어 각각의 상기 감시용 카메라(103a, 103b)에서 일정 주기로 촬영한 영상 정보를 네트워크(205)를 통하여 전송하는 다수 개의 측정 노드(201a, 201b, 201c)와; 상기 측정 노드(201)에서 송신되어온 영상 정보 데이터를 비교 분석하여 경보 발생 상태를 판단하고, 알람 신호를 발생하는 서버 노드(203)를 포함하여 이루어지며,  
본 발명에 의한 사진 측량을 이용한 재난 방재 방법은 감시용 카메라를 통하여 구조물의 변형을 용이하게 인식하기 위하여, 상기 구조물에 LED 발광 노드(101)로 이루어진 표적을 부착하는 표적 부착 단계와; 상기 감시용 카메라(103)를 통하여 획득된 영상 정보로부터 상기 LED 발광 노드(101) 간의 초기 거리를 측정하는 초기 기준값 측정 단계와; 상기 감시용 카메라(103)를 통하여 획득된 영상 정보로부터 상기 LED 발광 노드(101) 간의 거리를 계산하는 카메라에 의한 변위 측정 단계와; 상기 초기 기준값 측정 단계에서 계산하여 저장하고 있는 저장값과 상기 카메라에 의한 변위 측정 단계에서 계산된 변위값을 누적하여 누적된 변위량을 계산하는 변위량 계산 단계와; 상기 변위량 계산 단계에서 계산된 누적 변위량이 기 설정된 기준치 이상을 초과하면 위험치로 판정하는 위험치 판정 단계와; 상기 위험치 판정 단계에서 위험치로 판단되면 알람 신호를 발생하는 알람 신호 발생 단계;를 포함하여 이루어진다. 
이와 같이 이루어진 본 발명에 의한 사진 측량을 이용한 재난 방재 시스템 및 방법은 건설 현장에서의 인명 사고를 사전에 예방할 수 있고, 사고의 징후를 사전에 탐지하여 대형 사고를 방지할 수 있으며, 사고의 원인에 대한 조사 분석과 재난 사고에 대한 기록을 유지할 수 있어 편리하며, 사고의 원인 분석을 용이하게 재발을 방지하는 효과가 있으며, 사고가 재발하지 않도록 사전에 이에 대한 대책을 강구할 수 있게 하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: HANDONG R & AMP C CO LTD;KOREA NEW TECHNOLOGY INDUSTRY CO LTD;SC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Method of information management for safety home-coming and apparatus thereof
title_ko: 안심귀가 정보관리방법 및 그 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method for managing safe home return data and an apparatus thereof are provided to be used as a decisive evidence for an accident treatment based on photograph and record data about a site situation. CONSTITUTION: An apparatus for managing safe home return data comprises a GPS satellite(100), a geographic data providing computer(200), a communication terminal(300), and a receiver communication terminal(400). A communication terminal stores a communication terminal number in which a current location is delivered by a text message when generating an emergency situation. The communication terminal confirms location data about current latitude and longitude through a GPS satellite at a constant time interval after operating a safe home return function. A communication terminal transmits location data confirmed through a GPS satellite to a geographic data providing computer, requests map data, and stores by tracking a movement route based on map data transmitted from a geographic data providing computer. A communication terminal confirms whether an emergency situation is generated or not based on an operation of a user exposed to an emergency situation or an emergency situation automatic recognition function, and transmits data about a current location to a preregistered receiver communication terminal in a text message when an emergency situation happens. A receiver communication terminal receives data about the current location of a communication terminal from a communication terminal in a text message, and a receiver immediately recognizes that the user of a communication terminal is in an emergency situation. [Reference numerals] (100) GPS satellite; (200) Geographic data providing computer; (300) Communication terminal; (400) Receiver communication terminal
abstract_ko:
개시된 내용은 안심귀가 정보관리방법 및 그 장치에 관한 것으로서, 통신 단말기는 사용자의 입력조작에 따라 통신 단말기의 번호 및 긴급상황 발생시 현재 위치를 문자 메시지로 전달받을 수신자 통신 단말기의 번호를 저장하고, 안심귀가 기능의 실행 이후 일정 시간 간격으로 GPS 위성을 통해 현재의 위도, 경도에 대한 위치정보를 확인하고, 해당 위치정보를 지리정보 제공컴퓨터로 전송하여 지도정보를 요청하며, 지리정보 제공컴퓨터로부터 전송되는 지도정보를 토대로 이동경로를 추적, 구성하여 저장하며, 안심귀가 기능의 실행 이후 긴급상황에 노출된 사용자의 조작이나 긴급상황 자동인식기능을 토대로 긴급상황이 발생하면, 기 등록된 수신자 통신 단말기로 현재 위치에 대한 정보를 문자 메시지로 전송한다.  그리고 현재 위치에 대한 정보를 문자 메시지로 전송한 이후, 해당 수신자 통신 단말기와 통화 연결을 수행할 수 있다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 보다 정확하고 신속한 구조요청을 통해 불의의 사고에 대비할 수 있으며, 현장상황에 대한 촬영 및 녹음정보를 토대로 사건 처리에 결정적 증거로 사용할 수 있다.

title_en: Mental healing system for preventing barracks accidents
title_ko: 병영 사고를 방지하는 정신 힐링 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mental healing system for preventing a barracks accident, and more specifically, to a mental healing system for preventing a barracks accident. Negative information during an army life before and after entering the army is programmed to brains of soldiers to cause barracks accidents. The mental healing system systematically manages mind and brains of the soldiers to enable the soldiers to laugh, praise, and have gratitude mind while periodically exposing the soldiers to a positive language such that the soldiers can keep off negative information and receive positive information. Thus, narcotic happy hormones such as endorphin, didorphin, serotonin, and dopamine can be generated, and anger and stress hormones can be suppressed to prevent the soldiers from feeling extreme anger and stress and to strengthen fellowship between colleagues, thus avoiding an accident due to an army life.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 병영 사고를 방지하는 정신 힐링 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더 상세하게는 입대하기 전과 입대 후 병영생활 속에서 입력된 부정적인 정보들이 병사들의 뇌에 프로그래밍 되어 병영사고를 유발시키고 있는데, 시스템적으로 마음과 뇌를 경영하여 부정적인 정보는 차단하고 긍정적인 정보는 받아드리도록 주기적으로 긍정언어에 노출시키면서 웃음과 칭찬, 감사하는 마음 등을 갖도록 하여 엔돌핀, 다이돌핀, 세로토닌, 도파민 등의 마약성 행복 호르몬은 생성시키고, 분노와 스트레스 호르몬 등은 억제시켜 극도의 분노와 스트레스가 쌓이는 것을 방지하고 동료간 유대감을 강화시켜 건강한 병영생활로 사고를 방지할 수 있는 정신힐링시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Remote training method and apparatus for drone flight in mixed reality
title_ko: 혼합현실에서의 드론 비행을 위한 원격 훈련 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed in the present invention are remote training method and apparatus for flying a drone in mixed reality. According to the present invention, provided is a remote training apparatus for flying a drone, which comprises: a processor; and a memory including the processor. The memory creates a virtual flight space using arrangement information of one or more anchors and tags arranged in a physical space for the flight of the drone, and receives and registers a flight training scenario generated in the virtual flight space from a second computer belonging to a remote expert group that communicates remotely with a first computer belonging to the drone pilot group. The flight training scenario includes one or more virtual obstacles and one or more flight instruction commands, wherein at least some of the flight instruction commands are mutually mapped with the one or more virtual obstacles; and stores program instructions executable by the processor so as to receive one or more annotations generated by a remote expert from the second computer and transmit the same to the first computer.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 혼합현실에서의 드론 비행을 위한 원격 훈련 방법 및 장치를 개시한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 프로세서; 및 상기 프로세서를 포함하는 메모리를 포함하되, 상기 메모리는, 상기 드론의 비행을 위한 물리 공간에 배치되는 하나 이상의 앵커 및 태그의 배치 정보를 이용하여 가상 비행 공간을 생성하고, 드론 조종자 그룹에 속하는 제1 컴퓨터와 원격으로 통신하는 원격 전문가 그룹에 속하는 제2 컴퓨터로부터 상기 가상 비행 공간에서 생성한 비행 훈련 시나리오를 수신하여 등록하고, 상기 비행 훈련 시나리오는 하나 이상의 가상 장애물, 하나 이상의 비행 지시 커맨드를 포함하고, 상기 비행 지시 커맨드 중 적어도 일부는 상기 하나 이상의 가상 장애물과 상호 매핑되며, 상기 원격 전문가가 생성한 하나 이상의 어노테이션을 상기 제2 컴퓨터로부터 수신하여 상기 제1 컴퓨터로 전달하도록, 상기 프로세서에 의해 실행 가능한 프로그램 명령어들을 저장하는 드론 비행 원격 훈련 장치가 제공된다.
assignees: UNIV SEJONG IND ACAD COOP FOUD

title_en: Vehicle impact sensor and notification system
abstract_en: The present disclosure involves systems, software, sensors, and applied solutions for detecting incidents associated with a vehicle, where sensors associated with the vehicle identify impacts or proximity alerts to other vehicles and objects and record information related to those detected incidents. The recorded information can be immediately communicated to interested parties of the person or entity (e.g., emergency responders, business contacts) associated with the vehicle, or alternatively, stored for inspection at the vehicle and reviewed at a destination along the vehicle's route. In one example method, operations include detecting an incident associated with a monitored vehicle, where detecting the incident comprises receiving an alert from at least one sensor associated with the vehicle, identifying a location of the vehicle in response to the detection, and storing a record of the detected incident, where the record includes the identified location of the vehicle and a time associated with the detected incident.

title_en: Interactive mobile intelligent terminal
abstract_en: The application discloses interactive mobile intelligent terminal, including casing and damping device and commander, the damping device activity sets up in the casing, damping device bears commander, commander and a plurality of terminal communication connection dispatch with showing a plurality of terminals simultaneously, through the display screen, the camera, the stereo set, the terminal module, a controller, satellite communication module, image sound collection module, data storage module, image processing module, microwave communication module, orientation module and pronunciation module of talkbacking, thereby collect traditional dispatch terminal, the stereo set, the display screen, the battery, control interface in an organic whole, two-way audio and video transmission has, pronunciation are talkbacked, the video recording is stored, command dispatch, communication in an organic whole, make things convenient for the emergency dispatch to command.
assignees: GUANGZHOU RONSTONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency communication command desk
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of books and provides an emergency communication command desk which comprises a bottom plate, a 360-degree cradle head camera and electric appliance control equipment, wherein the upper side of the bottom plate is connected with a supporting rod, the upper side of the supporting rod is connected with a top surface, one end of the upper side of the bottom plate is connected with a working chair, the upper side of the top surface is connected with the 360-degree cradle head camera, one end of the upper side of the top surface is provided with a satellite antenna, the upper side of the bottom plate is connected with a command desk, the upper side of the command desk is connected with a display screen, the upper side of the display screen is provided with a camera, the left side of the command desk is connected with a microphone, and the left side of the display screen is provided with an interphone. The utility model can realize the high integration level of system functions, unified management and operation by arranging the 360-degree pan-tilt camera, the main control computer, the electric appliance control equipment and the like, has flexible maneuvering performance, can collect and acquire field information in time, and improves the accuracy and timeliness of decision making.
assignees: ANHUI HUADI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for communication with emergency dispatch services
abstract_en: Emergency reporting is described in which user input is received in an emergency call that is used to classify the call. Based on the classification process, emergency calls are processed to give priority to certain calls. The calls that are given the highest priority may be transmitted by a voice network and other calls may be transmitted by a data network. The reporting includes receiving user input identifying an emergency perspective of the user and selecting a data call based on the emergency perspective indicating the user is a bystander. It also includes recording an audio message from the user and transmitting the audio message to a public service answering point (PSAP) over a data network.

title_en: Urban public security video monitoring cloud platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban public security video monitoring cloud platform in the technical field of video monitoring. The urban public security video monitoring cloud platform is formed by five levels of video monitoring Internet of Things, video cloud storage, video cloud analysis, video cloud application and video cloud management. The urban public security video monitoring cloud platform utilizes a monitoring control end to operate an equipment database in a video center server to add and delete a camera in the system, provide a window for searching records according to the time, sending a search command to the video center server and obtain related information of history records. The video monitoring cloud management platform in the invention also provides interfaces of third-party applications, such as a mobile phone, provides storage, application and analysis docking development packages, provides a WebService interface for docking in the aspect of integration and docking of an application system and adopts a networking standard protocol to carry out communication docking in the aspect of cascaded docking of the platform.
assignees: HUBEI THREE GORGES CLOUD COMPUTING CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Clustering safety management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses clustering safety management systems, including proximal end to monitor mould group, is installed with application software, and proximal end monitoring mould group logins via application software, monitors, edits and collect information for commanding；And multiple distal ends action communication module groups, it is provided with application software and is laid in multiple monitoring places respectively, each monitoring place can carry out identical or different race, each distal end action communication module group wirelessly carries out communication connection with proximal end monitoring mould group, and each distal end action communication module group records the information in corresponding monitoring place in real time and is wirelessly back to proximal end in real time by application software and monitors mould group.

title_en: Tent hospital emergency command informatization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a tent hospital emergency command informatization system, which comprises: the core layer is used for providing data support and communication support for emergency commands; the access layer is established on the core layer and is used for realizing the communication connection between the core layer and the application layer; the application layer is used for establishing an emergency command network based on the core layer; the application layer comprises a scheduling center and a communication terminal scheduled and directed by the scheduling center. The tent hospital emergency command informatization system can utilize 4G communication to carry out remote video monitoring and video conference service for a front command center and a rear command center. The communication channel between the front command center and the rear emergency can be quickly established under the condition that conventional communication cannot be carried out, and satellite positioning and real-time communication services are provided for the rear command center, the field command center and rescue team members. The system provides rapid command information and on-site rescue information for disaster relief, and fully exerts the application effects of timeliness and accuracy.

title_en: Indoor simulation experiment system for initial reliability test of weaponry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of simulated exercise of weaponry and discloses an indoor simulated experiment system for testing the initial reliability of the weaponry, which comprises a monitoring system, a command system and exercise personnel carrying equipment; the monitoring system comprises a plurality of cameras installed indoors; the command system comprises a display module and a voice command system, wherein the display module can display indoor pictures shot by each camera; the exercise carrying equipment comprises a wireless headset, heart rate monitoring equipment and step recording equipment which are in communication connection with the voice command system. The commander of performing a maneuver can carry out real-time commander to the commander through voice command system, and the commander can hear the command information that the commander conducted through wireless headset to respond to it, make whole exercise controllability strong, data record is comprehensive, can be fine reflect the result of weaponry initial stage experiment, so that carry out analysis and judgement to the reliability of weaponry initial stage.
assignees: SHAANXI DIANKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Garbage classification and supervision method based on AI intelligent recognition system
abstract_en: The invention provides a garbage classification and supervision method based on an AI intelligent recognition system, wherein the AI intelligent recognition system comprises the following steps: the display screen, the code scanning port, the loudspeaker and the camera are electrically connected with the mainboard; the garbage classification and supervision method comprises the following steps: s1, intelligently identifying user information; s2, intelligently identifying a release behavior; s3, intelligently identifying the delivery classification quality; s4, supervising and dispatching a bill; s5, performing intelligent assessment. By the mode, the problem that the existing garbage classification system can only record the operation process and cannot intelligently output the supervision result is solved.
assignees: SUZHOU NAGU ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Medical security intelligent management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical security intelligent management system which comprises an emergency treatment module, an emergency plan module, a fusion communication module, a command scheduling module, a fire-fighting monitoring module, a patrol inspection module, a training exercise module, a daily duty module and a management module, wherein the emergency treatment module is used for integrating alarm information of a fire-fighting subsystem and integrating a fire-fighting alarm system, a help-seeking alarm system, an access control system, a security inspection system and a video monitoring system. The intelligent management system has the beneficial effects that the originally scattered and independent system of the hospital forms a unified linkage whole, the internet of things monitoring of safety equipment facilities is combined to build a firm hospital safety infrastructure guarantee, four groups of people including patients, visitors, workers and outsourcers are managed, the unified planning management is carried out on internal workers through safety authorities, visitors and family members of the patients are identified through intelligent face analysis, the face data of the passers is automatically recorded, and the track of the workers is accurately tracked.

title_en: Data fusion method, device and equipment for emergency equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a data fusion method, device and equipment of emergency equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining data reported by various emergency equipment; the method comprises the steps of classifying data reported by emergency equipment aiming at each type of emergency equipment to obtain multiple types of characteristic data, and fusing the same type of characteristic data of the multiple types of emergency equipment. The method of the embodiment of the application provides more comprehensive and effective data support for remote command dispatching, and effectively improves the timeliness and accuracy of emergency response.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA BEIJING INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Parking and charging integrated management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transportation facility management, in particular to a parking and charging integrated management method and system, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining the position, the direction and the entrance number of a vehicle, extracting a path leading to a berth, collecting traffic data, calculating traffic influence, matching the berth number, generating an influence mapping table, accumulating the traffic influence and waiting time, judging a control load to generate a linkage state table, inputting a control system and synchronizing the state, and generating a feedback record. According to the invention, the path sequence is extracted by combining the position and the direction of the vehicle, the traffic data is collected, the steering times are superposed, the path traffic complexity evaluation is refined, the optimal berth path combination is screened by combining the waiting time of the tail end of the path, the data is used by the collection equipment to calculate the load change, the resource conflict caused by high-frequency calling is avoided, the berth and the vehicle information are bound according to the priority, the dispatching response speed is improved, the input state and the pre-starting signal are synchronized when the instruction is issued, and the data consistency and the dispatching closed loop performance are enhanced.

title_en: Integrated abnormal signal detection system for fuel cell vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated abnormal signal detection system for a fuel cell vehicle, which comprises a sensor module, a detection module, a main control system, an audible and visual alarm system, a vehicle-mounted controller, a power supply input module and a power supply conversion module, wherein the sensor module is used for collecting and outputting pressure, temperature and hydrogen concentration data of the fuel cell system in real time, the detection module is used for receiving the data of the sensor module and comparing the data with a preset threshold value, outputting an abnormal signal to the main control system, the main control system is used for triggering the audible and visual alarm system according to the abnormal signal and sending fault data to the vehicle-mounted controller, the audible and visual alarm system is used for executing buzzer alarm and LED light alarm according to instructions of the main control system, the vehicle-mounted controller is used for controlling a front-end switch valve to adjust pressure or temperature according to the fault data, the power supply input module is used for providing power for all modules of the system, and the power supply conversion module is used for converting power supply input voltage into working voltage required by the detection module and the main control system. The invention effectively solves the problems of insufficient power supply protection, signal distortion and alarm delay of the traditional system, and has the advantages of improving the power supply reliability, guaranteeing the signal integrity and realizing the timeliness of emergency response.
assignees: SHANGHAI SUNWISE NEW ENERGY SYSTEMS CO LTD

title_en: Care : computerized technical advisory system for a radiological emergency
title_ko: 방사능방재대책 기술지원 전산 시스템
abstract_en: A CARE(Computerized Technical Advisory System for a Radiological Emergency) is provided to facilitate an expansion of the advisory system by installing various application programs for the advisory system. A central control center includes an STES(Source Term Estimation System)(400), a FADAS(Following Accident Dose Assessment System)(500), a GIS(Geographic Information System)(600), and an automatic information recognition system(700). A safety information network(100) monitors an operation state of a nuclear power plant and collects accident information every 10 to 20 seconds and transmits the information to the central control center. A REMDAS(Radiological Emergency Meteorological Data Acquisition System)(200) collects weather information around the power plant every 10 minutes and transmits the collected information to the central control center. An IERNet(Integrated Environmental Radiation Network)(300) collects environmental information every 15 minutes and transmits the collected information to the central control center. An ERIX(Emergency Response Information eXchange System) transmits the signals from the central control center to related authorities.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 방사성 물질의 사고 시에 실시간으로 상황판단을 위한 원전안전정보망(SIDS), 방재대응기상정보망(REMDAS), 환경방사선감시망(IERNet)을 설치하여 운영하고 있으며, 이의 정보를 자동으로 해석하고 판단하여 이상 시에 자동정보인지시스템(AINS)이 가동되며, 사고를 범위 및 방사성물질의 외부 방출량을 평가하는 방사선원항평가시스템(STES), 방사성물질 이동경로 및 피해영역과 피해정도를 계산하는 방사선영향평가시스템(FADAS)등의 주요모듈로 구성되어 있다. 
     이렇게 평가된 결과물을 전자지도 및 방재속성정보 데이터베이스, 즉 지리정보시스템(GIS)에 연결하여 방사성물질의 피해지역과 주민보호조치 대책 등을 시각적 표현으로 결과를 도출하도록 구성되어 있다. 
     또한 중앙정부 및 지방자치단체, 그리고 모든 방재대응 유관기관에 처리된 정보를 제공하고 상호 비상대응 활동 등을 교환하는 비상대응정보교환시스템(ERIX)이용하여 범국가적인 차원에서의 대응·대책을 수립하는 방사능방재대책 기술지원 전산 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
       
     방사능방재대책, 방사선원항평가시스템(STES), 방사선영향평가시스템(FADAS), 지리정보시스템(GIS), 자동정보인지시스템(AINS), 안전정보망(SIDS),  자동기상정보망(REMDAS), 환경방사선감시망(IERNet), 비상대응정보교환시스템(ERIX)

title_en: Public report and traffic accident management system based on black box
title_ko: 블랙박스 기반 공공 제보 및 교통사고 대처 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a public traffic accident reporting and management system based on a black box which provides a one-touch reporting system. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the public traffic accident reporting and management system based on the black box comprises: a button disposed in a vehicle and clicked by a driver of the vehicle to transmit a video request signal when a reporting situation occurs during driving; a video processing module inserted into an insertion slot of a storage medium of a black box of the vehicle and including a configuration, into which the storage medium to be inserted into the black box is inserted, to transfer a video signal photographed by the black box to the storage medium, thereby copying raw data of video from the black box, converting the raw data into a transmission format, and transmitting the video signal converted into the transmission format to the outside, which is not the storage medium; and an application stored in a computer-readable recording medium and converting the video signal received from the video processing module into video data to be displayed to transmit the video data to a server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른 블랙박스 기반의 공공 제보 시스템은 차량에 마련되어 상기 차량의 운전자가 주행중 신고 상황 발생시 클릭하면 영상 요청 신호를 전송하는 버튼, 상기 차량의 블랙박스의 저장 매체의 삽입구에 삽입되고 상기 블랙박스에 삽입될 저장 매체가 삽입되는 구성을 구비하여 상기 블랙박스에서 촬영된 영상 신호를 상기 저장 매체로 전달 가능하도록 구성되어, 상기 영상 요청 신호를 수신하면 상기 블랙박스로부터 영상의 로우 데이터(raw data)를 복사하여 송신용 포맷으로 변환하고, 상기 송신용 포맷으로 변환된 영상 신호를 상기 저장 매체가 아닌 외부로 전송하는 영상 처리 모듈 및 상기 영상 처리 모듈로부터 수신된 영상 신호를 시각화가 가능한 영상 데이터로 변환하여 서버로 전송하는, 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 매체에 저장된 애플리케이션을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Wearable device with user movement analysis and fall risk prediction and fall detection capability
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and wearable device for monitoring and analyzing user movements to predict fall risk The method involves retrieving motion data recorded by an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) and a pedometer, followed by processing the data once it exceeds a predefined threshold. A first trained machine learning (ML) model predicts the fall risk based on the processed data. A confidence score is determined from the fall prediction, and a second trained ML model analyzes successive data frames to confirm the fall if the score is above a threshold. If a fall is confirmed, a distress signal is transmitted. The wearable device comprises a processor and memory that stores program instructions to perform the method, including motion data retrieval, processing, fall prediction, confidence scoring, and fall confirmation, along with distress signal transmission.
