This invention enables timely fall detection and emergency response, improving user safety.

title_en: Remote robot coding education system
title_ko: 원격 로봇 코딩 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-contact remote robot coding education system for creating control commands (programs) that enable students receiving non-contact online classes in each household to control robots located at distanced spaces such as classrooms or auditoriums, and remotely controlling the robots by transmitting the control commands through a teacher terminal located in the same space as that of the robots.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각 가정에서 비대면 온라인 수업을 받는 학생들이 교실이나 강당 등의 이격된 공간에 위치한 로봇을 제어하는 제어명령(프로그램)을 작성하고, 제어 명령을 로봇과 동일 공간에 위치한 교사 단말을 통해 전송하여 원격으로 로봇을 콘트롤하는 비대면 원격 로봇 코딩 교육 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digitial video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event, and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted server to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity, status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time, the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: System and method for gesture activated responder lighting and information center
abstract_en: The integrated and programmable, gesture-activated lighting and information system and related method is disclosed. This system and method is configured to communicate wirelessly with an incident control center, and includes a responder information center that acts to receive and record data from a first responder user at an emergency scene, and a responder lighting and information system. The responder lighting and information system includes (i) a wrist lighting assembly with at least one environmental sensor that, through wrist gestures by the user, generates corresponding predetermined gesture patterns; (ii) a belt assembly with lights; and (iii) a programmable smart device configured to communicate with the wrist lighting and belt assemblies of the same user, and also with other users, the incident command center, and the responder information center. Gesture patterns are processed to convey messages, through light sequences on the belt assembly. Sensor data also is processed to generate messages.

title_en: Apparatus and method for visual-assisted training, collaboration, and monitoring in augmented/virtual reality in industrial automation systems and other systems
abstract_en: A method includes receiving first data defining first user actions associated with a first augmented reality/virtual reality (AR/VR) space. The method also includes translating the first user actions into first commands associated with first visual objects in the first AR/VR space. The method further includes aggregating the first commands into at least one first record and transmitting the at least one first record. The method also includes receiving at least one second record containing second commands associated with second visual objects in a second AR/VR space. The method further includes translating the second commands into second user actions. In addition, the method includes creating or causing a user device to create a replica of the second AR/VR space based on the second user actions.

title_en: Integrated Emergency Event Detection And Mapping Using Individualized Device Location Registrations
abstract_en: A software platform includes emergency event processing functionality for detecting and mapping emergency event occurrences. The emergency event processing includes device location registration functionality for allowing operators of the software platform to register locations of their devices. Information associated with the operator-entered location information is stored alongside network device information. When an emergency call is placed by a device registered with the software platform, the software platform identifies network device information for the device placing the emergency call and searches records generated based on the operator-indicated device locations. A location determined thereby is then signaled to a public safety answering point. This automated signaling can improve an emergency response by directing dispatched responders to a specific location verified by the operator of the device, rather than an assumed location specified by an administrator which may not actually be accurate.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.

title_en: Collaborative filtering-based adaptive pushing method for command elements
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of personalized recommendation, in particular to a command element self-adaptive pushing method based on collaborative filtering, which comprises the first step of constructing an anti-terrorism resource pool and storing and recording comprehensive real-time updating data of anti-terrorism actions; secondly, constructing pre-collaborative filtering based on the fighting type-command element and sending a calculation result to a commander; and thirdly, constructing two-stage collaborative filtering based on commander-command elements and sending the calculated structure to the commander. The method filters command element data which are possibly required by the anti-terrorist battle tasks of different types, so that a commander can conveniently search related information according to the loaded battle tasks, the problem that the commander faces a large amount of data and has no need to take the next place is solved, and the anti-terrorist data push efficiency is improved; the method has the advantages that the most needed data are respectively pushed according to the roles of the commanders in the anti-terrorism battle, so that the difference of the commanders in different levels on the data requirements in the same anti-terrorism battle is solved, and the accuracy of pushing the anti-terrorism data is improved.

title_en: Method for large sructures safety diagnosis using drone, device and computer readable medium for performing the method
title_ko: 무인비행장치를 이용한 거대구조물 안전진단 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 장치 및 기록매체
abstract_ko: 무인비행장치를 이용한 거대구조물 안전진단 장치는, 무인비행장치를 이용하여 교량 또는 건축물이 존재하는 도시를 촬영하고, 교량 또는 건축물이 존재하는 도시를 촬영한 이미지로부터 추출한 거대구조물에 대한 정보와 건축물에 대해 수집한 정보를 일치하는 교량구조물의 정보와 인덱싱하고, 교량 또는 건축물의 이상거동과 잔류변형을 평가하여 재난에 대한 피해 시뮬레이션을 실시하고, 시뮬레이션 결과를 기초로 하여 해당 교량 또는 건축물에 대한 재난 발생 시 대응 시나리오 및 임무절차를 도출한다. 이에 따라, 거대구조물의 재난에 대한 피해 평가한계를 무인비행장치를 활용하여 극복함으로써 재난 상황의 장악력 및 골든타임 확보를 통해 지진 등의 재난에 대한에 의한 붕괴 등 2차 사고를 신속하게 예측할 수 있다.

title_en: system for reliability of operator's manual action and method for reliability of operator's manual action
title_ko: 운전원 수동조치의 신뢰성 확보 시스템 및 운전원 수동조치의 신뢰성 확보 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 운전원 수동조치의 신뢰성 확보 시스템은 복수의 기기가 설치된 발전소에서 상기 복수의 기기 중에 특정기기에 운전원의 수동조치가 요구되는 사고가 발생한 상황에 대한 시나리오데이터가 기록된 데이터베이스, 상기 발전소에 대응되는 가상발전소와 상기 복수의 기기에 대응되는 복수의 가상기기를 모델링하고, 상기 시나리오데이터를 기반으로 상기 가상발전소에서 상기 사고가 발생한 상황을 구현하여, 상기 운전원이 상기 복수의 가상기기 중에 상기 특정기기에 대응되는 특정가상기기를 수동조치하는 과정을 시뮬레이션하는 사고 상황 구현부, 구현된 상기 사고에 대응하여 상기 운전원이 상기 특정가상기기에 대한 수동조치를 완료하기까지 요구되는 시간인 가용시간을 설정하는 가용시간설정부; 상기 운전원이 상기 사고를 인지하고 상기 복수의 가상기기 중에 상기 특정가상기기를 특정하는 진단단계에서 소모된 시간인 진단시간을 측정하는 진단시간 측정부, 상기 운전원이 상기 가상발전소 내의 초기 위치에서 상기 특정가상기기가 설치된 조작 위치까지 이동하는 이동단계에서 소모된 시간인 이동시간을 측정하는 이동시간 측정부 및 상기 운전원이 상기 조작 위치에서 상기 특정가상기기를 조작하는 조작단계에서 소모된 시간인 조작시간을 측정하는 조작시간 측정부를 포함한다.

title_en: Device, system and method for duplicate call handling at a public-safety answering point device
abstract_en: A device, system and method for duplicate call handling at a public-safety answering point (PSAP) device is provided. The PSAP device: routes a call from a caller to a call-taker, the call associated with an incident; receives, via an input device of the call-taker, information related to the incident to populate a record associated with the call; prior to the record being complete, receives, via the input device, input to handover the call to an information collection application, the input indicative of the call being a duplicate call; determines, via the information collection application, remaining information to be collected based on one or more of: a duplicate call policy and the information already received; receives, via the information collection application to verbally communicating with the caller on the call, at least a portion of the remaining information to continue to populate the record; and ends the call.

title_en: System and method for telematics accounts on-the-ground safety
abstract_en: Some embodiments are directed to an emergency response system implemented via a back-end application computer server. A vehicle telematics data store may contain electronic records and each electronic record may include, for example, an electronic record identifier and at least one vehicle operation parameter (e.g., a vehicle speed, an accident location, an accident time of day, etc.). The computer server may receive, from an emergency responder (e.g., a police officer, ambulance, firefighter, etc.) via an interactive graphical emergency responder interface display, a vehicle tag (e.g., based on a QR code). The computer server may then retrieve, from the vehicle telematics data store, a vehicle operation parameter associated with the vehicle tag and update the display based on the retrieved a vehicle operation parameter associated with the vehicle tag.

title_en: Based on the fishery assistant system of smart machine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of fishery assistant system based on smart machine, comprise data center, WEB service center, user terminal and management end system; Described WEB service center comprises fishing ground information platform, navigation platform, meteorological acquisition platform, fisheries news platform, government affairs information distribution platform, the long-range annual test platform of boats and ships user, fishery inspection department record violating the regulations obtains platform, fish products dealing platform, boats and ships rental transaction itself platform, ship-related products shopping platform, fishing boat information management and marine emergency command support platform, mobile instant communication tool, moving game and audio-visual platform and online payment platform.Fishery assistant system based on smart machine of the present utility model, existing information resource can be carried out integration to utilize, further responsible institution and user distance, user and user communication convenient, to improve fishery owner production operation efficiency, enrich owner's life information, and effectively reduce the relevant flow process that is responsible for the administration, promote work efficiency.

title_en: Fireman location real-time sensing system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fire prevention emergency field, and provides a fireman location real-time sensing system and an application method thereof. The system generates a SQL fire prevention acceptance inspection information data table for each building according to the information generated by fire prevention acceptance inspection, wherein the data table records coordinates and details of the building and fire fighting devices. An individual terminal provided for a fireman downloads the fire prevention acceptance inspection information data table of an objective building from a fire prevention acceptance inspection information database of a fire command system terminal by a network or other ways, the downloaded data table is converted into fire fighting device plane graphs of each floor, when the fireman enters into the building in fire, the real-time location sensing system senses information of longitude, latitude and floor by means of GPS and RFID or other three-dimensional positioning ways, and a real-time location comparison system compares the location information to form location coordinates and information of fire fighting device, then, the information is provided for the processor for positioning and navigation, and an audio system and a two-dimensional display system both can be used for outputting navigation information.

title_en: Borehole strain gauge in-situ calibration method based on seismic surface wave
abstract_en: The invention discloses a borehole strain gauge in-situ calibration method based on seismic surface waves, which comprises the following steps: step 1, mounting component type borehole strain gauges and three-component seismographs at intervals in the same borehole in a PBO observation table network; step 2, obtaining surface wave records of the three-component seismograph Recording of P-and S-waves from surface waves Calculating the incident seismic surface wave at the borehole R (ii) a Step 3, according to the incident earthquake strain surface wave R And component borehole strain gauge instrument strain I By incident seismic surface waves of strain R Calculating to obtain the incident seismic strain surface wave R Corresponding instrument strain calculationValue of Step 4, calculating the instrument strain actual observation value of the component type borehole strain gauge by using a least square method Calculated from the strain gauge of the instrument The difference of (a) yields a coupling coefficient matrix K. The method utilizes the surface wave record of the three-component seismograph to realize the high-precision in-situ calibration of the component type borehole strain gauge. The bottleneck problem that restricts the development of the drilling strain observation theory and technology is solved.

title_en: Safety management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a safety management system, comprising: the receiving module is used for sending a corresponding first prompt signal to prompt security personnel to carry out patrol when the patrol command is received; the guiding module is used for sending a corresponding second prompt signal to prompt security personnel to carry out safety inspection on the next inspection main point when receiving the card punching signal; the repair reporting module is used for generating a corresponding repair signal according to the input repair information and sending the repair signal to a corresponding preset terminal; and the alarm module is used for generating a corresponding alarm signal and sending the corresponding alarm signal to the corresponding preset terminal when receiving a control instruction initiated by a security worker. The technical scheme of the invention has the beneficial effects that: the system realizes supervision of security personnel, realizes electronic filing and automatic reporting of patrol records, can send alarm information to responsible personnel at the first time when an emergency occurs, realizes close contact among all departments, and has simple flow and easy tracing.

title_en: Method and device for predicting charging waiting time of pure electric bus
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting the charging waiting time of a pure electric bus, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle dispatching record data or a vehicle dispatching plan, inputting a charging waiting time prediction model, and outputting a corresponding charging waiting time; the charging waiting duration prediction model is obtained after training based on a sample set, the sample set comprises vehicle charging waiting data samples, and each vehicle charging waiting data sample comprises vehicle arrival time, at least one charging starting time and charging waiting duration; the calculation of the charging waiting time is to obtain an accurate calculation result of the charging waiting time by processing and analyzing the vehicle operation data and the charging data. The method and the device for predicting the charging waiting time of the pure electric bus, provided by the embodiment of the invention, can be used for accurately predicting the charging waiting time of the pure electric bus after the pure electric bus arrives at a station, realizing the evaluation of the current charging queuing state of the pure electric bus and improving the operation efficiency of the pure electric bus.
assignees: BEIJING PUBLIC TRANSP HOLDING GROUP LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Urban fire intelligent early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent fire early warning, in particular to an intelligent urban fire early warning system which comprises an intelligent urban structure analysis module, a dynamic fire early warning simulation module, a fireproof strategy optimization module and an intelligent environmental impact analysis module. According to the invention, the urban map model is generated by utilizing urban building geographic positions, materials, fire data and building age data, the relevance and characteristics among buildings are deeply analyzed, the fire spreading influence is simulated through a map convolution network, the prediction precision of fire spreading paths and speeds is obviously improved, evacuation difficulty and risk level of the buildings under multiple fire sources are calculated in an assisted manner, a basis is provided for scientifically planning evacuation routes and fireproof isolation areas, emergency response and resource allocation are optimized, meteorological, population dynamics and holiday activity data analysis are integrated, the effect of environmental factors in fire early warning is enhanced, the accuracy and timeliness of early warning are ensured, and the overall efficiency of an urban fireproof system is improved.
assignees: ZIGUANG HUIZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Pre-hospital first aid scheduling method and system for severe wounds
abstract_en: The pre-hospital emergency dispatching method and system for severe wounds comprises the steps that a pre-hospital wiring center receives accident description information and analyzes the number of severe wounds, a pre-hospital discharge dispatching center dispatches emergency vehicles, an emergency vehicle-mounted terminal obtains the accident scene patient, photographs, records and supplies on-site emergency guidance to hospital medical staff, collects basic information, vital signs and injury information of the patient, corrects and perfects the information after correction, analyzes and obtains the severe wound information, the hospital wound emergency center registers the patient automatically, the emergency vehicle-mounted terminal obtains time for reaching the hospital emergency and informs the hospital wound emergency center, the hospital wound emergency center corrects the severe wound information of the patient, inputs to-be-inspected items and expected arrival time of the patient, informs the inspection center, and inputs the severe wound information and inspection results to a model for illness pre-judgment and decision after correction of the patient is completed, determines a final to-be-operated item and informs an operating room center and an anesthesia department center.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based civil air defense emergency command scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil air defense emergency command scheduling method and system based on an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of emergency command control; the method comprises the steps of carrying out data fusion through Kalman filtering to obtain a three-dimensional disaster condition entropy map, identifying a disaster core area based on an entropy threshold, calculating a dynamic weight centroid, realizing self-adaptive task partition through a weighted Voronoi map, fusing millimeter wave radars and binocular vision to construct a three-dimensional grid map, generating a safe navigation path through heuristic sampling and navigation path smoothing under flight constraint, guaranteeing navigation safety by a collision prevention mechanism, dynamically selecting a communication link, matching the similarity of a historical scheduling scheme or generating a scheduling scheme through a GRU model, optimizing an objective function, combining continuous voyage and material matching constraint to output an optimal scheduling instruction, and reevaluating a cycle entropy value to trigger a closed-loop dynamic re-partition until disaster conditions are relieved, breaking through a traditional unidirectional command mode, forming a full-chain closed loop of perception-decision-execution, and remarkably improving rescue timeliness and safety.
assignees: SICHUAN ZHONGCHEN AVIATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for determining illegal use of card in cash card use security system and computer-readable recording medium storing the same
title_ko: 현금 카드 이용 보안 시스템에서의 카드 부정 사용 판정 방법 및 이를 저장한 컴퓨터로 판독가능한 기록 매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for judging illegal use of a card in a cash card usage security system including the steps of: receiving withdrawal information occurred in case of cash withdrawal request by a card from an automatic teller machine (ATM); transmitting a position information transmission request signal as to a mobile terminal of a card holder using personal information included in the withdrawal information; receiving position information from the mobile terminal; and judging whether the card use is illegal or not at first, by comparing the position information of the mobile terminal with the position information of the ATM. [Reference numerals] (AA) Card withdrawal server; (BB) Communication company server; (CC) Mobile terminal; (S11) Cash withdrawal trial; (S13) Transmit withdrawal information; (S15) Withdrawal refusal; (S21) Check illegal withdrawal type; (S22) Request terminal position information; (S23) First check illegal usage; (S24) Withdrawal check request signal; (S25) Second check illegal usage; (S26) Transmit withdrawal refusal command; (S27) Security camera operation command signal; (S28) Transmit report information to police station server; (S31) Request position information; (S33) Transmit terminal position information; (S41) Transmit position information; (S43) Withdrawal approval signal or withdrawal refusal signal
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 카드로 현금 인출 요청시 발생되는 인출 정보를 현금 인출기(ATM)으로부터 수신하는 단계; 상기 인출 정보에 포함되어 있는 개인 정보를 이용하여 상기 카드 소유자의 이동 단말기에 대하여 위치 정보 전송 요청 신호를 전송하는 단계; 상기 이동 단말기로부터 위치 정보를 수신하는 단계; 및 상기 이동 단말기의 위치 정보와 상기 현금 인출기의 위치 정보를 비교하여, 상기 카드 사용이 부정사용인지 여부를 1차로 판단하는 단계를 포함하는, 현금 카드 이용 보안 시스템에서의 카드 부정 사용 판정 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Traffic accident recognition method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
title_ko: 교통 사고 인식 방법, 장치, 기기 및 컴퓨터 기록 매체
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a method and device for identifying a traffic accident, a device and a computer storage medium, and relates to technical fields of intelligent traffic and big data. An implementation method includes the steps: acquiring road features, environmental features and road traffic stream features; inputting the road features, the environmental features and the road traffic stream features into a pre-trained traffic-accident identifying model to obtain an accident-information identifying result of a road which at least includes an accident identifying result. In the present application, the accident road may be automatically identified according to the road features, the environmental features and the road traffic stream features. Compared with a traditional manual reporting way, timeliness is stronger, and a coverage rate is higher.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교통 사고 인식 방법, 장치, 장치 및 컴퓨터 기록 매체를 개시하였는 바, 지능형 교통 및 빅 데이터 기술 분야에 관한 것이다. 구체적으로 실현 방안은, 도로 특징, 환경 특징 및 도로 상의 교통 흐름 특징을 취득하는 것; 및 상기 도로 특징, 환경 특징 및 도로 상의 교통 흐름 특징을 사전에 트레이닝하여 얻은 교통 사고 인식 모델에 입력하여, 사고가 발생하였는지 여부의 인식 결과를 적어도 포함하는 상기 도로 상의 사고 정보 인식 결과를 얻는 것을 포함한다. 본 발명은 도로 특징, 환경 특징 및 도로 상의 교통 흐름 특징에 기반하여, 도로 상에 사고가 발생하였는지 여부를 자동적으로 인식할 수 있다. 기존의 수동으로 신고하는 방식과 비교하면, 시간적 효과성이 더 강하고, 커버율이 더 높다.
assignees: BEIJING BAIDU NETCOM SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency notification transmission system and method using a detailed map of the event area, and a recording medium recording a computer readable program for executing the method
title_ko: 행사지역의 상세지도를 이용한 긴급알림 송출 시스템, 방법 및 상기 방법을 실행시키기 위한 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 프로그램을 기록한 기록 매체
abstract_en: Disclosed are a system and a method for transmitting an emergency notification using a detailed map of an event area, and a recording medium recording a computer-readable program for executing the method. As to the emergency alarm transmission system, the location information collecting part, location information storage unit, congestion best suiteds, the exit output unit. And an exit information providing unit. A location information collection unit collects location information of a participant in an event area, a location information storage unit stores location information of an exit in the event area, a density calculation unit calculates density of the participant in the event area by using the location information of the participant, an optimal exit calculation unit calculates an optimal exit by using the location information of the participant and density information for each participant when an accident area is inputted from a manager terminal, and an exit information providing unit outputs a detailed map of the event area in which the location of the optimal exit for each participant is displayed.
abstract_ko: 행사지역의 상세지도를 이용한 긴급알림 송출 시스템, 방법 및 상기 방법을 실행시키기 위한 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 프로그램을 기록한 기록 매체가 개시된다. 긴급알림 송출 시스템은 위치정보 수집부, 위치정보 저장부, 밀집도 산출부, 최적탈출구 산출부. 및 탈출구정보 제공부를 포함한다. 위치정보 수집부는 행사지역에서의 참여자의 위치정보를 수집하고, 위치정보 저장부는 행사지역에서의 탈출구의 위치정보를 저장하고, 밀집도 산출부는 참여자의 위치정보를 이용하여 행사지역에서의 참여자의 밀집도를 산출하고, 최적탈출구 산출부는 관리자 단말로부터 사고지역이 입력되는 경우 각각의 참여자에 대해 참여자의 위치정보 및 밀집도의 정보를 이용하여 최적의 탈출구를 산출하며, 탈출구정보 제공부는 각각의 참여자에 대해 최적의 탈출구의 위치가 표시된 행사지역의 상세지도를 출력한다.

title_en: Exercise analysis device, exercise analysis method, program, recording medium, and exercise analysis system
abstract_en: A first imaginary plane specifying unit specifies a first axis which lies in a longitudinal direction of a shaft of an exercise tool at an address posture of a user, using an output of an inertial sensor. A second imaginary plane specifying unit specifies a second axis forming a predetermined angle along with the first axis, using a hitting direction as a rotation axis. An exercise analysis unit calculates a trajectory of a swing of the user based on an output of the inertial sensor. An incident direction determination unit determines an incident direction of the trajectory on a region specified based on the first and second axes in a downswing.

title_en: Systems and Methods for Forming and Operating an Ecosystem for a Conducted Electrical Weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment (e.g., ecosystem) for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: System and method for automatic arrestee grouping and action recommendation during a mass incident arrest
abstract_en: A communication system and method provide for automatic arrestee grouping and action recommendation during a mass incident arrest. A portable radio sends a notification to a server indicating a mass incident event with grouping request for grouping arrestees. The server returns an electronic form including a mass arrest ID based on type of mass event. The electronic form facilitates collecting individual arrestee information based on the type of mass event. Current offense type and personal attribute information are collected and further electronically tagged to each arrestee. The server automatically assigns each arrestee to an offense group based on current offense type, and then refines the offense group into sub-groups based on prior arrest records. The server generates arrest processing procedure recommendations customized for each sub-group and transmits the recommendations to the PS radio associated with the grouping request.

title_en: Deduplication of multi-channel emergency response request notifications
abstract_en: An emergency management system (EMS) may be used to provide and deduplicate multi-channel emergency response requests for an emergency responder application. EMS may receive, from an emergency communications center (ECC), a first emergency response request over a first channel and a second emergency response request over a second channel. The first or second channel may at least partially include over-the-air UHF or VHF dispatch transmissions that may be recorded as audio data. EMS may compare addresses, types of emergencies (e.g., fire, medical, etc.), and/or requested services (e.g., fire, medical, etc.) to determine if the first and second emergency response requests are the same. If the requests are the same, EMS deduplicates the requests so that an emergency responder application displays/provides a combined request (reducing distractions of first responders). Providing multi-channel emergency response requests may enable validation and error correction of requests provided to and by an emergency responder application.

title_en: Incident Recording Systems and Methods
abstract_en: A primary subsystem captures original information and supplemental information to form a revision. A primary subsystem enables revisions to be made at the location of the incident prior to leaving the location. Systems for collecting and managing information about incidents include primary and secondary subsystems. A category is a descriptor or label that identifies a common aspect among members assigned to the category. Categories may determine how information is stored, communicated, and/or accessed on primary and/or secondary subsystems.

title_en: System and method for recording medical information
abstract_en: The present invention is directed to a digital pen and paper system for recording medical information. Medical information includes information about patients, their medical conditions, diagnoses, prescriptions and medical history. Medical information also includes information about evacuees and casualties of incidents such as medical emergencies, traffic and other accidents, natural and non-accidental disasters. This information may include personal information, demographic information and location information. The present invention also provides for recording medical information from incoming patients in hospitals and clinics.

title_ko: 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 국제 표준인 OBD-2 표준커넥터를 통하여 실시간으로 수집된 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량의 운행 내용에 대한 기초적인 데이터(주행기록, 주행패턴 정보, 고장정보, 연료소모 및 온실가스 등의 정보)를 각 항목의 성질에 맞게 개별적으로 분석하고, 그 분석된 정보를 에코 드라이브 포털사이트상의 에코 드라이브 평가 시스템을 통해 평가하여 운전자에게 최적의 에코 드라이브 컨설팅 교육을 제공함으로써, 운전자의 자동차 운전습관을 바꾸어 연료절감 및 온실가스감축, 교통사고 감소효과를 유발할 수 있는 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템은, 에코 드라이브 체험 전용 차량이 운행되는 언덕, 비탈길, 커브길, 과속방지턱, 교차로 및 신호등을 포함하여 구성되는 정형화된 주행시설이 구비된 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터와; 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터에 구비되며, 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자가 탑승하는 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량과; 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량에 장착되어 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터의 주행시설을 운행시, 에코 드라이브 모드와 비에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보를 각각 구분하여 저장하고 블루투스 기능을 구비하는 스마트 카 플랫폼(Smart Car Platform: SCP)과; 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량에 설치되고 스마트 카 플랫폼과 연동되어주행상태 정보를 디스플레이하는 에코 네비게이션과; 상기 스마트 카 플랫폼에 장착된 블루투스에 의해 송신된 에코 드라이브 모드와 비에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보를 수신하고 인터넷을 통해 서버로 송신하는 블루투스 송ㆍ수신 컴퓨터와; 상기 인터넷을 통해 블루투스 송ㆍ수신 컴퓨터에 의해 전송된 에코 드라이브 모드와 비에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보와 운전 패턴 정보가 각각 업로드되고, 상기 주행상태 정보와 운전 패턴 정보로 평균속도, 연비, 연료소모량, CO 2 배출량, 주행시간, 주행거리, 퓨얼컷, 에코점유율 및 공회전시간을 포함하는 주행상태 정보와 급가속 및 급감속과 출발 및 정지전후 5초간의 속도변화를 포함하는 운전 패턴 정보를 비교분석 평가하며, 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드 운행시의 연비, 연료소모량, CO 2 배출량, 급가속, 급감속 및 출발과 정지 전후의 속도변화에 대한 개선율과 에코등급을 포함하는 정보를 산정하기 위한 서버와; 상기 서버에서 비교분석 평가된 주행상태 정보와 운전 패턴 정보, 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드 운행시의 개선율 및 에코등급을 포함하는 정보를 저장하기 위한 데이터 베이스 및; 상기 서버로부터 정보를 제공받고, 체험 신청자의 컴퓨터를 통해 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스에 에코 드라이브 체험 교육생으로 등록시키며, 비교분석 평가된 주행상태 정보와 운전 패턴 정보, 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드 운행시의 개선율 및 에코등급을 포함하는 정보를 포함하는 평가진단지를 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자의 컴퓨터에 제공하는 에코 드라이브 포털사이트;를 포함하며, 상기 스마트 카 플랫폼과 에코 네비게이션은, 비에코 드라이브 모드에서는 스마트 카 플랫폼은 작동되나 에코 네비게이션은 작동되지 않으며, 상기 에코 드라이브 모드에서는 스마트 카 플랫폼과 에코 네비게이션이 모두 작동되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 또한, 본 발명에 따른 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 방법은, 유선 또는 무선 통신망을 통해 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자의 컴퓨터와 관리자의 컴퓨터와 연결되어 에코 드라이브 평가 및 인증 프로그램을 제공하는 서버를 이용한 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 방법으로서, 에코 드라이브 포털사이트와 연결된 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자의 컴퓨터를 통해 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스에 에코 드라이브 체험 교육생으로 등록되는 단계와; 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터에 구비된 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량이 언덕, 비탈길, 커브길, 과속방지턱, 교차로 및 신호등을 포함하여 구성되는 정형화된 주행시설이 구비된 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터의 주행시설에서 운행시, 비에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보와 운전 패턴 정보가 검출 및 수집되는 단계와; 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량이 언덕, 비탈길, 커브길, 과속방지턱, 교차로 및 신호등을 포함하여 구성되는 주행시설이 구비된 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터의 정형화된 주행시설에서 운행시, 에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보와 운전 패턴 정보가 검출 및 수집되는 단계와; 상기 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보가 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량에 설치되고 블루투스 기능을 구비한 스마트 카 플랫폼(Smart Car Platform: SCP)에 로드되어 저장되는 단계와; 상기 스마트 카 플랫폼과 연동되어, 상기 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보가 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량의 에코 네비게이션에 디스플레이되는 단계와; 상기 스마트 카 플랫폼에 로드된 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보를 불루투스에 의해 수신받은 송ㆍ수신 컴퓨터로부터 인터넷을 통해 서버에 업로드되는 단계와; 상기 서버에 업로드된 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보와 운전 패턴 정보가 서버에 의해 평균속도, 연비, 연료소모량, CO 2 배출량, 주행시간, 주행거리, 퓨얼컷, 에코점유율 및 공회전시간을 포함하는 주행상태 정보와, 급가속 및 급감속과 출발 및 정지전후 5초간의 속도변화를 포함하는 운전 패턴 정보를 비교분석 평가하며, 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드 운행시의 연비, 연료소모량, CO 2 배출량, 급가속, 급감속 및 출발과 정지 전후의 속도변화에 대한   개선율 및 에코등급을 포함하는 정보를 산정하고 저장되는 단계와; 상기 서버에서 비교분석 평가된 주행상태 정보와 운전 패턴 정보, 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드 운행시의 개선율 및 에코등급을 포함하는 정보가 데이터 베이스에 저장되는 단계; 및 상기 서버의 데이터 요청에 의해 데이터베이스에 저장된 비교분석 평가된 주행상태 정보와 운전 패턴 정보, 비에코 드라이브 모드와 에코 드라이브 모드 운행시의 개선율 및 에코등급을 포함하는 정보를 포함하는 평가진단지가 에코 드라이브 포털사이트를 통해 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자의 컴퓨터에 제공되도록 하는 단계;를 포함하고, 상기 에코 네비게이션에 디스플레이되는 단계에서의 스마트 카 플랫폼과 에코 네비게이션은, 비에코 드라이브 모드에서는 스마트 카 플랫폼이 작동되나 에코 네비게이션은 작동되지 않으며, 상기 에코 드라이브 모드에서는 스마트 카 플랫폼과 에코 네비게이션이 모두 작동되게 하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 따른 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템 및 방법은 모든 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자가 동일하게 표준화된 주행 환경에서 에코 드라이브를 체험하게 함으로써, 에코 드라이브 평가시스템에 의해 평가된 데이터를 계량화시킬 수 있다. 또한, 자동차 운전자의 운전습관을 바꾸어 줌으로써, 운전자가 급출발, 급가속, 급정지, 공회전을 억제시키고 경제속도를 유지하게 하며, 타이어 공기압을 적정수준으로 유지하게 하고, 소모품 관리 등과 같은 자동차 관리를 통하여, 연료절감 및 온실가스 감축에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있다. 나아기, 에코 드라이브 실천에 따라 수반되는 교통사고 감소로 인하여, 교통사고로 인한 사회적ㆍ경제적 비용을 크게 감소시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Autonomous public safety answering point (PSAP)
abstract_en: A method, apparatus, and computer program product for autonomous public safety answering point (PSAP). Responsive to receiving emergency call(s) originating from client device(s) used to report emergency event(s), one or more artificial intelligence (AI) agents are initiated for handling the emergency call(s), the agent(s) being configured to: classify the emergency event(s) into event type(s) associated with response protocol(s) according to data extracted from the emergency call(s); initiate emergency event report interaction(s) via the client device(s) for prompting reply to query(s) relating to the emergency event(s) driven by the response protocol(s); determine event attribute(s) of the emergency event(s) according to data extracted from the reply received to the query(s); populate entry(s) of emergency event record(s) for computer aided dispatch (CAD) of responder units to emergency events; and responsive to a determination to dispatch responder unit(s) to address the emergency event(s), dispatch the responder unit(s) according to the emergency event record(s).
