title_en: Method, device, equipment and storage medium for dispatching police officers
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for dispatching a police officer, and aims to improve the intelligent level of dispatching the police officer. The method for dispatching the police officers comprises the following steps: under the condition of receiving an alarm, the server receives a case place and a case type recorded by an alarm, and determines a distance weight and a professional weight according to an alarm telephone voice corresponding to the alarm; the server determines the professional score of each police officer in the administration area of the case according to the preset professional label of the police officer and the case type, and determines the distance score of the police officer according to the position information of the police officer and the case type; the server determines the police output score of each police officer according to the professional score and the distance score of the police officer, the distance weight and the professional weight; the server determines the police officer from the plurality of officers according to the respective police output scores of the police officers, and sends an alarm output instruction to a law enforcement terminal of the police officer.

title_en: Traffic data fusion method and system based on multi-source high-precision perception
abstract_en: The invention provides a traffic data fusion method and a traffic data fusion system based on multi-source high-precision perception, and relates to the technical field of traffic data fusion, wherein the method comprises the steps of connecting a traffic monitoring platform integrating a panoramic image acquisition device, a directional image acquisition device and a high-precision laser radar; the method comprises the steps of collecting static scene data of a target traffic scene, constructing a static model of the target traffic scene, carrying out traffic simulation to generate simulated traffic feature data, collecting dynamic traffic data to obtain real-time traffic feature data, carrying out traffic feature comparison, locating traffic feature deviation areas, carrying out directional monitoring on the traffic feature deviation areas, and generating traffic emergency response instructions when traffic abnormality is monitored. The invention solves the technical problems that the traffic monitoring in the prior art depends on a single data source, can not provide comprehensive perception of traffic scenes, further can not accurately identify abnormal conditions in a short time, and affects the timeliness and the effectiveness of emergency response.

title_en: Auto Report Guardrail
title_ko: 사고를 자동 신고하는 가드레일
abstract_en: A sensor device is attached to individual supports of a guardrail that is installed in a road. The sensor device transmits sensing information wirelessly, and includes a wind power generator and a solar cell at a top thereof in order to supply electric power required for the transmission. The sensor device transmits an abnormal signal to a repeater when deformation of the guardrail or tilt of the supports of the guardrail is sensed due to a collision between a vehicle and the guardrail. The repeater is positioned in a streetlight or a telephone pole in order to be stably supplied with power and to secure a stable operational environment. The repeater transmits the received signal to an accident management system by using a mobile network such as CDMA. Then, a program installed in the system indicates a position of an accident in a map through flickering and a voice signal. Through the above processes, the guardrail capable of automatically reporting an accident can minimize damage of a minor collision accident by quickly and accurately identifying the position of the accident related with the guardrail and by supporting lifesaving activities.
abstract_ko:
도로에 설치된 가드레일의 지지대마다 센서 장치를 하나씩 부착하여 사용한다. 해당 센서 장치는 무선으로 센싱 정보를 송출하고, 이를 위한 전력을 충당하기 위해 상단에 풍력발전기와 태양전지를 장착한다. 센서 장치는 가드레일에 차량이 충돌하여 가드레일의 변형, 가드레일 지지대의 기울어짐이 감지되면 이상 신호를 중계기에 전송한다. 중계기는 가로등 또는 전봇대에 위치하여 안정적으로 전원을 공급받아 안정적인 운용 환경을 확보한다. 중계기에 전송받은 신호는 CDMA와 같은 이동통신망을 이용하여 사고 관리 시스템으로 전송한다. 이후 시스템에 내재 되어있는  
프로그램에 의해 지도에 해당 사고의 위치를 점멸하고 음성신호를 통하여 표시한다. 이러한 과정을 통하여 가드레일 관련 접촉 사고 발생 지점을 신속 정확하게 파악하여 인명 구조 활동을 지원하여 그 피해를 최소화하는 데 목적이 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for three-dimensional interaction monitoring in an ems environment
abstract_en: A method for tracking interactions in an emergency response environment according to embodiments of the present invention includes receiving color images and depth information from within a field of view of a sensor array; maintaining an emergency encounter record; monitoring one or both of a position of an object and movement of the object in the emergency response environment based on the color images and depth information received by the sensor array; and recording an occurrence of a condition in the emergency encounter record, wherein the condition is based on the one or both of the position of the object and the movement of the object.

title_en: Intelligent express dispatching system and method based on public transport system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent express dispatch system and method based on a bus system, comprising a bus, a bus stop, a bus dispatch system and an express delivery management center; the express delivery management center is used for receiving the delivery tasks of the express, and executing the following actions: generating a distribution scheme according to the distribution task, and pushing the distribution scheme to a bus station; receiving scheduling information of a bus scheduling system, acquiring planned shift time of an operation line, and calculating estimated arrival time of each shift bus to a target station; receiving transfer information of a bus stop, updating the occupation condition of a storage space of a distribution box of the bus, and updating temporary storage information of an express cabinet of the bus stop; and receiving the mail sending and mail taking information of the bus station, and starting or terminating the delivery task. Based on the express delivery of the invention, the express can reach each bus station in the urban area within 1-2 hours after the delivery of the initial station, so that the timeliness is good, and the beneficial supplement of the urban express delivery system is realized.

title_en: Health management system based on IOT technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health management, in particular to a health management system based on an IOT technology. The system comprises a personal response database, an abnormality cause analysis module and a health intervention module. According to the invention, the current health level of the user is determined by combining the personal response database with the past medical record data of the user, the corresponding health response threshold is formulated, the adaptive health response threshold formulation is carried out according to the health level of the user, a reasonable emergency response scheme is formulated for each user, the adaptation effect of the whole system is improved, the response data fed back by the personal response database is obtained through the abnormal reason analysis module, the reasons causing the abnormality of the health monitoring data of the user are predicted by combining the health monitoring data, and the corresponding health intervention mode is formulated for the user by combining the reasons causing the abnormality of the health monitoring data of the user and the past medical record data through the health intervention module.

title_en: Intelligent power management module of ship computer
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power management, in particular to an intelligent power management module of a ship computer. The system comprises a data acquisition processing unit: for collecting power consumption data of the vessel; the central storage unit is used for storing the data of the data acquisition processing unit and the fault event information of the fault detection unit; the fault detection unit is used for immediately responding and recording fault event information when an abnormal condition is detected; the intelligent distribution control unit is used for generating the power requirement of the current subsystem and the priority of the subsystem according to the historical data and the real-time data, and dynamically adjusting the distribution of the power supply to the system; control instruction execution unit: for converting the calculated power distribution scheme into specific control instructions. The intelligent power management module of the ship computer can meet the operation requirements under different conditions, effectively save energy sources, and enhance the emergency response and self-protection capability of the ship under special conditions.

title_en: Aircraft maneuvering simulator in engagement level, simulation method thereof and a computer-readable storage medium for executing the method
title_ko: 교전급 항공기 기동 시뮬레이터, 시뮬레이션 방법 및 그 방법을 실행시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulation method for maneuvering a combat aircraft, comprising: a step (a) of receiving the input of a maneuver command for an aircraft; a step (b) of checking the state information of the aircraft; a step (c) of comparing the maneuver state of the aircraft with EM data expressing maneuver characteristics of the aircraft based on the state information of the aircraft; a step (d) of correcting the maneuver command when the state information of the aircraft is not within a limit range of the EM data; and a step (e) of calculating maneuver variations of the aircraft by corresponding to the maneuver command, and updating the state information of the aircraft according to the calculated maneuver variations. Therefore, the simulation method for maneuvering a combat aircraft can conduct efficient analysis by reflecting unique maneuver performance characteristics of an aircraft and thus, simulating the maneuver of the aircraft in an actual combat situation.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 교전급 항공기 기동 시뮬레이션 방법에 관한 것으로, (a) 항공기에 대해 기동지시를 입력받는 단계; (b) 상기 항공기의 상태정보를 확인하는 단계; (c) 상기 항공기의 상태정보에 기초하여 상기 항공기의 기동상태를 상기 항공기의 기동특성을 나타내는 EM 데이터와 비교하는 단계; (d) 상기 항공기의 기동상태가 상기 EM 데이터의 제한범위를 벗어나는 경우 상기 기동지시를 수정하는 단계; 및 (e) 상기 기동지시에 대응하여 상기 항공기의 기동 변화량을 산출하고, 산출한 상기 기동변화량에 따라 상기 항공기의 상태정보를 갱신하는 단계를 포함한다.  
이에 의해 항공기의 고유한 기동 성능 특성을 반영하여 실제 현실 교전 상황에서의 항공기의 기동을 그대로 시뮬레이션할 수 있어 효율적인 분석이 가능하다.
assignees: REPUBLIC OF KOREA DEFENSE ACQUISITION PROGRAM ADMINISTRATION

title_en: Methods, devices and computer programs for preventing entrepreneur-customized major disasters
title_ko: 사업주 맞춤형 중대재해 예방 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터프로그램
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예는 컴퓨팅 장치에 의해 수행되는 방법에 있어서, 사업장에 대한 사고예방대응 시스템을 세팅하는 과정; 및 상기 사고예방대응 시스템을 이용해 상기 사업장 관련 사고를 대응하기 위한 사고예방대응 모니터링 과정을 포함하는 사업주 맞춤형 중대재해 예방 방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Integrating data from multiple devices
abstract_en: A recording system for an emergency response unit includes a first data collection device configured to record a first video, audio or data segment with an incident identifier and transmit a message including the incident identifier. A second data collection device may receive the message and, as appropriate, record at least a second video, audio or data segment with the incident identifier, allowing the first segment and the second segment to be associated using the incident identifier. In other embodiments, a first recording device may begin recording video, audio or legal evidence data with an incident identifier, and a control system may receive a message including the incident identifier from the first recording device, identify one or more additional recording devices located within a certain distance of the first recording device, and obtain recordings from the one or more additional recording devices.

title_en: Data center command system
abstract_en: The application discloses a command system of a data center, which comprises: display terminal and command unit, command unit includes: the scene monitoring module is used for acquiring scene image information of the data center and transmitting the scene image information to the display terminal for displaying; the equipment monitoring module is used for acquiring the running state and data of the data center equipment and transmitting the running state and data to the display terminal for displaying; the work order monitoring module is used for acquiring the work order tasks of the data center and transmitting the work order tasks to the display terminal for displaying; and the operation module is used for sending a scene switching instruction to the scene monitoring module, sending an equipment switching instruction to the equipment monitoring module and sending a checking and operating instruction to the work order monitoring module. The method and the device solve the problems that in the related technology, the data center is not monitored in place in the operation process, the command operation is lack of timeliness, and the processing result cannot be effectively monitored.
assignees: CAITUO CLOUD COMPUTING SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system DARS and viewer for mobile assets includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores compressed records of the data in the local memory module at least once per second. DARS is designed to operate in near real-time mode, storing a complete record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once every second and up to once every tenth of a second. The remotely located user may: viewing video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides faster emergency responses; verifying the effectiveness of the repair and rerouting; and monitor panelist performance and safety.

title_en: Analysis method based on mass discrete data
abstract_en: An analysis method based on massive discrete data comprises the following steps: step 1: after the police condition is received by the dispatching of the streets of the community, the police condition information of the police condition is recorded and stored in the dispatching place security platform; step 2: reading out the alarm information of the code to be executed; and step 3: detecting the wireless network throughput application condition to obtain the wireless network throughput; and 4, step 4: analyzing the alarm information to be coded to obtain the easy interception index word proportion; and 5: coding the alarm information to be coded according to the wireless network throughput and the proportion of the easy-to-monitor index words by combining other information; step 6: transmitting the coded warning information to a community management platform; the defect that the community management platform in the prior art cannot improve the anti-eavesdropping performance of the alarm information during subsequent transmission by correctly judging the encoding mode and then encoding the alarm information according to the judged encoding mode is effectively overcome.

title_en: Control system based on Morse code
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Morse code-based control system, which is characterized in that: the system comprises a sending end, a receiving end, a sensor and a relay; the receiving end controls the on-off of the relay to acquire information acquired by the sensor; a sending end requests sensor data and sends a control command; the control signal and the return signal adopt Morse code; the control system comprises a streaming recording Morse code decoding program, decoding is real-time, and the operation efficiency in war and disaster scenes is obviously improved; the system comprises a Morse code encoding program, which converts an input ASCII character string into Morse code audio frequency analog signals according to an international Morse code table; the control system comprises an Enigma encryption and decryption program, and is used for encrypting and decrypting data in a digital password input mode; the Enigma encryption and decryption program comprises an analog wiring board, an analog password rotating wheel and an analog reflecting board; the control system computer includes a front-end display program that displays the Morse code encoding and decoding results on a display.

title_en: Forest fire monitoring and early warning system based on deep learning
abstract_en: Forest fire monitoring and early warning system based on deep learning. The invention discloses a forest fire and smoke recognition method in a target place range through a deep learning image recognition technology, which can transmit information to a fireproof command part at the first time after a fire disaster occurs so as to carry out rapid emergency treatment. The system has the early warning prompt function of forest fire occurrence, the whole system is provided with a high-definition camera at the front end of the system on the basis of a Beidou satellite navigation system, and a raspberry group is utilized to collect data of a BMP180 air pressure sensor, a DHT22 temperature and humidity sensor, an RS-FXJT-N01 wind power wind direction sensor, an MH-RD rainwater collecting sensor and the like, so that a user can use real-time pictures and various meteorological data collected by front-end equipment on a management system for forest fire monitoring and early warning. The system realizes integration, intellectualization and light weight of forest fire monitoring and early warning, has the characteristics of wide application area, small influence by the terrain environment, high recognition accuracy and the like, and can greatly improve the reliability and early warning timeliness of forest fire monitoring.

title_en: Intelligent gateway-based power failure alarm system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power failure alarm system and a method based on an intelligent gateway, which realize low-power consumption and short-distance communication through a Zigbee protocol and aim to improve the accuracy and timeliness of power failure monitoring. The system comprises a door and window sensor, an intelligent gateway, a cloud server and a user terminal application, wherein the intelligent gateway receives sensor signals and pushes power failure warning information to the user mobile phone application by utilizing the Internet. The intelligent door and window sensor has the innovation point that by modifying the door and window sensor into an electromagnet structure and combining an intelligent gateway and cloud service, the quick response and real-time alarm of the power failure event of the power system are realized. The system is simple and convenient to operate and high in response speed, effectively improves the monitoring capability and emergency response capability of the power system, is suitable for power failure monitoring and alarming of various power systems, and has wide application prospects.

title_en: Multi-node real-time cooperative scheduling and emergency response system and scheduling method for supply chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of dispatching and emergency response, in particular to a supply chain multi-node real-time collaborative dispatching and emergency response system and a dispatching method, wherein the system comprises a distributed data acquisition module, a control module and a dispatching module, wherein the distributed data acquisition module is used for acquiring inventory data, logistics states and equipment operation parameters of all nodes in real time; the system comprises a digital twin modeling engine, a collaborative decision center, an emergency response trigger, a multi-objective pareto optimization and a multi-objective pareto optimization, wherein the digital twin modeling engine is used for constructing a dynamic virtual mapping model of a supply chain network, the collaborative decision center is used for generating a multi-objective optimization scheduling scheme based on a reinforcement learning algorithm, the emergency response trigger is used for automatically starting a grading emergency plan through abnormal pattern recognition, second-level response is realized through millisecond-level data synchronization and edge calculation, so that decision timeliness is improved, multi-agent game and federal learning are adopted, cross-node collaborative efficiency is improved, and the time-consuming rate of orders and the toughness index of the network are improved on the premise of controllable cost through multi-objective pareto optimization.
assignees: GUANGXI ZHUBO WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency response method for earthquake event
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information processing, in particular to an emergency response method for a seismic event, which comprises the steps of obtaining seismic service data, determining a preferable template generation mode according to a template association degree and a report response coefficient, wherein the preferable template generation mode is to conduct preferable template recombination according to an area matching mean value or generate a preferable template according to an information matching amplitude value, determining a report updating mode according to a seismic influence coefficient and public opinion information quantity, and determining a report supplementing mode according to a comprehensive evaluation value for adjusting a report updating frequency or according to a characteristic correlation coefficient of an effective public opinion area, wherein the report supplementing mode comprises characteristic text supplementation and associated text supplementation. The invention can improve the accuracy and timeliness of the earthquake event response technology report.

title_en: Drone System For Measuring Construction Spot Installation and Insepction
title_ko: 건설현장의 시공 및 검사 측량용 드론시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a drone system. The drone system comprises: a drone photographing or recording progress of construction while flying over a surrounding area of a construction site; a control terminal remotely controlling the drone; a server receiving and analyzing the construction data photographed or recorded from the drone by wireless or wired communication and determining whether to repair defects found during the construction; and a wireless transmitter transmitting maintenance data determined from the server to mobile terminals of workers, who have been put into the construction site. Specifically, the drone system can prevent big tragedy on the construction site such as collapse of a building or a fatal accident in advance while having efficient management of the construction since the server operates a virtual simulation program based on the photographed or recorded data received from the drone to provide instructional data that maintenance measures should be performed in order of priority among defects found in the construction process.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건설현장의 주변 상공을 비행하며 건설 시공의 진행 상태를 촬영 혹은 녹화하는 드론, 상기 드론을 무선으로 원격 조종하는 조종단말기, 상기 드론으로부터 촬영 혹은 녹화된 건설 시공 자료를 무선 혹은 유선으로 전송받아 분석하여 건설 시공에서 발견된 하자에 대한 보수 여부를 파악하여 결정하는 서버, 및 상기 서버로부터 결정된 보수 자료를 건설 현장에 전체 투입된 작업자들의 휴대단말기로 전송하는 무선송신기를 포함하고, 특히 상기 서버는 상기 드론으로부터 수신된 촬영 혹은 녹화 데이터 자료를 토대로 가상의 시뮬레이션 프로그램을 돌려 시공 과정에서 발견되는 하자들 중 우선적으로 보수 조치가 순서대로 수행되어야하는 지침서 자료를 제공할 수 있음으로써 건설 시공의 효율적인 운용과 더불어 건물 붕괴와 인명사고와 같은 건설현장에 대한 대형참사를 미연에 방지할 수 있는 드론시스템을 제공하고자 한다.

title_en: Ecg-enabled personal emergency response systems
abstract_en: The invention provides personal emergency response systems (PERS) with expanded life-saving capabilities. One embodiment of the invention provides a wearable PERS pendant that incorporates a cell phone transmitter or transceiver, a GPS location system, an accelerometer-based fall detector that automatically triggers an alert, and an electrocardiogram (ECG) recorder permitting a remote service center or medical personnel to receive and respond to transmitted alerts and electrocardiographic data.

title_en: Wireless ad-hoc emergency communication network based on network cluster and message ferrying
abstract_en: The invention discloses a wireless ad-hoc emergency communication network based on network cluster and message ferrying. The network comprises an emergency on-site command center (ECC), multiple emergency rescue special communication nodes (ECNs), a great quantity of ordinary communication nodes (OCNs) and a moderate number of ferrying nodes, wherein the ECC can be used as a command coordination node of the whole emergency communication network and a cluster node of the ECNs in the coverage area of the ECC; the ECNs can be used as cluster nodes of the OCNs in the coverage area of the ECNs; the cluster nodes and gateway nodes are interconnected to form wireless backbone networks (WBNs), the OCNs are connected with handy WBNs to which the OCN belong; and relay communication can be realized among the OCNs in different WBNs through the ferrying nodes. The communication network provided by the invention dynamically integrates the network cluster mechanism and the message ferrying mechanism, thus enhancing the reliability and timeliness of information delivery.

title_en: Linkage control system based on field environment data monitoring
abstract_en: The invention relates to a linkage control system based on field environment data monitoring, which comprises: the mask control device is used for switching the mask on the seat from a hidden state to a use state when receiving a first control instruction, and switching the mask on the seat from the use state to the hidden state when receiving a second control instruction; the linkage control equipment is used for simultaneously sending first control instructions to the mask control equipment respectively corresponding to other seats in the same row when receiving the first control instructions; the network video recording device is arranged on the top of a seat of the entertainment device and is used for carrying out video recording operation on the front of the seat. The linkage control system based on the field environment data monitoring is intelligent in control and reliable in operation. Because the same-row linkage mechanism is established, the same-row emergency response can be simultaneously carried out on the abnormal conditions of the entertainment equipment during operation, thereby increasing the intelligent level of safety control.

title_en: Finite space work order optimization method and system based on intelligent well lid
abstract_en: The invention provides a limited space work order optimization method and a limited space work order optimization system based on an intelligent well lid, which relate to the technical field of data processing, and are used for determining an abnormal well lid coordinate set in a target management and control area, carrying out busyness recognition on a single person, outputting busyness index set, identifying a person smaller than preset busyness, positioning a real-time position coordinate set, carrying out limited space area decomposition on the target management and control area by combining an area decomposition algorithm, carrying out regional management on an output area decomposition result, solving the technical problem that the management is wide in the prior art, which causes that the dispatch management in the area cannot be reasonably balanced, so that the operation and maintenance timeliness of the intelligent well lid is limited.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle data processing system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle data processing system based on edge calculation, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle data processing. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle end, an edge computing node and a ground control center, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle end is provided with a multi-mode sensor array, a data synchronization module and a preprocessing module, a pipeline processing engine is used for realizing data slicing parallel processing based on a Kafka+spark framework, a dynamic unloading controller is used for dispatching computing tasks according to the computing power state of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the ground control center is provided with a multi-mode storage system, a metadata management engine and an end-to-end safety channel, the end-to-end data processing delay is reduced to be within 500ms through the edge node localization processing and dynamic task unloading mechanism by combining with the pipeline parallel engine, and millisecond-level synchronization and self-adaptive compression strategies of the multi-mode sensor are used for improving data transmission efficiency, so that the bottleneck of mass data transmission is effectively solved, and the high-timeliness requirements of scenes such as real-time monitoring and emergency response are met.

title_en: Apparatus and method for learning using robot
title_ko: 로봇을 이용한 학습 장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a learning apparatus comprising: a plurality of command cards including learning information; and a robot device scanning a card group formed by arranging a fixed number of command cards selected for learning in a row among the plurality of command cards, specifically, consecutively scanning the command cards included in the card group according to an arrangement order, and outputting learning results. Each of the command cards includes command cords which express the type and function of each card and have a readable form by the robot device. Therefore, the learning apparatus, programming in unplugged type using an OID sensing based robot, can help even a young student to easily understand the principles of coding. In addition, the learning apparatus can help to easily conduct coding education as the robot reads consecutively arranged command cards and conducts coding of the same. Furthermore, the learning apparatus can be utilized in language or computation learning by recording unit information, the basis of the language or computation learning, on the command cards and making the robot read the command cards.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 학습장치는 학습정보를 포함하는 다수의 명령카드들; 및 상기 다수의 명령카드들 중, 학습을 위해 선택된 소정 개의 명령카드들을 일렬로 배열하여 형성한 카드그룹을 스캔하되, 상기 배열된 순서에 따라 상기 카드그룹에 포함된 명령카드들을 순차적으로 스캔하여 학습결과를 출력하는 로봇장치를 포함하되, 상기 명령카드들 각각은 상기 각 카드의 종류 및 기능을 나타내고, 상기 로봇장치에 의해 판독 가능한 형태의 명령어 코드를 포함한다. 따라서, OID 센싱 기반 로봇을 이용한 언플러그드 방식으로 프로그래밍을 수행함으로써, 어린 학생들도 코딩의 원리를 용이하게 이해할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 상기 로봇이 순차적으로 배열된 명령 카드를 판독하여 코딩을 함으로써, 코딩 교육을 용이하게 할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 게다가, 본 발명은 어학 또는 연산학습의 기초가 되는 단위 정보들을 명령 카드에 기록하고, 상기 로봇이 상기 명령 카드를 판독함으로써, 어학 및 연산 학습에 활용할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Evidence management system and method
abstract_en: A method, system, and computer program product for managing evidence. An evidence management system comprises a computer system that stores information about an incident in evidence records for a witness zones. The evidence records are associated with witness zones for storing evidence for the incident. The witness zones are areas from which the evidence is collected. The computer system collects the evidence for the incident from client devices in the witness zones based on the evidence records. The computer system analyzes the evidence collected for the incident in the evidence records based on the witness zones from which the evidence was collected, enabling the computer system to reduce an amount of time to collect the evidence for the incident.

title_en: Scene surveillance radar simulation system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scene surveillance radar simulation system mainly comprising a central machine subsystem, a radar site subsystem, an aircraft commander site subsystem, a server, a database and a simulation ground-to-air communication subsystem, wherein simulation ground-to-air communication submachines of the central machine subsystem, the radar site subsystem and the aircraft commander site subsystem and a multi-channel synchronous equipment recorder are respectively connected with a simulation ground-to-air host machine; the server and the database are arranged on host machine hardware of a central machine; the multi-channel synchronous voice recorder is connected with the server through an asynchronous series interface; and the scene surveillance radar simulation system is also provided with a database module, a central machine module and a server module. The system can simulate the airport scene environment and the flying motion scene, provides a lifelike working environment for tower controls and has the effects of rapidness, high efficiency and low cost of controllers for the scene.

title_en: Emergency fusion command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency fusion command system in the technical field of information dispatching communication, which comprises a general command center, a village and town command center, a village command center, a satellite, a public network environment and an emergency communication command; the emergency fusion command system is reasonable in structural design, a VPDN network is adopted in a master command center, the VPDN network can fuse a communication server, a recording and video server and a touch screen dispatching desk to realize a basic audio/video dispatching function, an external line telephone and a satellite telephone can be accessed to a fusion communication platform by configuring a telephone gateway, and a conference seat system of the command center can be accessed to the fusion communication platform by configuring a seat gateway to be interconnected and communicated with other voice terminals of the system; the unmanned aerial vehicle video access module is configured, the field unmanned aerial vehicle video access is integrated with the communication platform, and the field situation can be rapidly known by the command center through the unmanned aerial vehicle video, so that the emergency can be rapidly responded, and the command and the scheduling can be timely performed.
assignees: ZHEJIANG HAOCHANG COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Step reservoir group water and electricity joint debugging system and water and electricity joint debugging method thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a cascade reservoir group hydropower joint debugging system and a hydropower joint debugging method thereof, comprising a water regime telemetering system, a meteorological data receiving system, a water regime information exchange system and a waterpower dispatching automation system, wherein the water regime telemetering system is connected with the meteorological data receiving system, the meteorological data receiving system is connected with the water regime information exchange system, the waterpower dispatching automation system of the water regime information exchange system is connected, and the waterpower dispatching automation system comprises: the system comprises a data calculation and gate operation system, a computer monitoring system and a hydraulic dispatching automation system, wherein the size of a gate switch is calculated through data, the displacement and the generated energy are recorded through data calculation, the computer monitoring system is connected with a water regime information exchange system and the hydraulic dispatching automation system, and the computer monitoring system is used for monitoring the generated energy and the instruction operation of power station equipment. The implementation of water and electricity combined optimization scheduling is favorable for the rapid implementation of a flood control scheduling scheme and the safe flood control.
assignees: HUBEI QINGJIANG HYDROELECTRIC DEV CO LTD

title_en: Cooperative control method and system for robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative control method and a system for a robot, which relate to the technical field of cooperative control, wherein the method comprises the following steps: and collecting a target monitoring area image by using the unmanned aerial vehicle cluster, identifying a risk target risk image, and positioning a target rescue path. And analyzing the target risk image to obtain a first material list, and scheduling the ground rescue robot to load materials into the first rescue robot. And dispatching the ground inspection robot. And acquiring the returned ground risk image according to the ground inspection robot to obtain a second asset list, dispatching and loading the assets to form a second rescue robot, and carrying out second batch rescue along the target rescue path to complete supplementary support. The technical problems of incomplete and accurate risk monitoring, poor rescue path planning, unreasonable and untimely material scheduling and poor cooperativity of the multi-type robots in the prior art when dealing with risks are solved, and the technical effects of improving the timeliness, accuracy and effectiveness of rescue are achieved.
assignees: JIANGSU SUYIMENG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive traffic network toughness assessment method based on multiple indexes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic emergency assessment and discloses a comprehensive traffic network toughness assessment method based on multiple indexes, which comprises the following steps of selecting a plurality of key indexes for assessing traffic network toughness in advance; the method comprises the following steps of acquiring real-time traffic data based on an evaluation model when an emergency occurs, and analyzing the influence of the emergency on a traffic network after the emergency is over, and evaluating the recovery capacity of the traffic network based on the evaluation model by combining the repair time of facilities, the recovery condition of traffic flow and emergency resource allocation records. The method has the advantages that the robustness of the traffic network in different dimensions can be comprehensively evaluated by adopting the topological structure index, the traffic flow index, the facility reliability index and the emergency response capability index, and the impact resistance, the recovery capability and the emergency management capability of the network can be comprehensively evaluated by adopting the multi-dimensional quantitative analysis, so that the evaluation accuracy is improved.

title_en: Intelligent multimode emergency life ring sensing method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent multimode emergency life-buoy sensing method and system, which relate to the technical field of multimode sensing and are used for solving the problems of increased burst risk identification error rate and reduced individual emergency response capability guarantee level, generating environment crisis probability by collecting current environment sensing data and user state data in a fusion way, collecting user biological characteristic data and environment change data, calculating an emergency index, integrating and analyzing the crisis probability and the emergency index, and outputting a simple or accurate emergency prompt strategy; when the simple prompt is adopted, the user input response time is monitored, whether the emergency mode is entered or not is judged, the user state data retention record is carried out, intelligent identification and dynamic response of the user state in the sudden risk environment are realized, the pre-judging capability of the system to the potential crisis situation and the accuracy of the user emergency response are improved, and the environmental safety guarantee level is enhanced.

title_en: Speech learning system, speech learning method, and storage medium
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a speech learning system, a speech learning method and a storage medium that enable the learner to obtain comprehensive command of a foreign language while obtaining speaking and listening capabilities by learning accurate pronunciation and vocalization by generating by heart a foreign-language sentence based on a national-language sentence (sample question) and on a correctly pronounced and recorded foreign-language sentence (sample correct answer).SOLUTION: Implementation of a speech reproducing program 7 by a computer 2 results in, regarding each sentence in each category, mother-language sentence reproduction by sound reproduction devices 3 and 4, silent reproduction for causing the learner to speak the corresponding foreign-language translation, first foreign-language sentence reproduction whose speaking velocity is slower than the standard velocity, silent reproduction for causing the learner to speak the foreign-language sentence, second foreign-language sentence reproduction whose speaking velocity is the standard velocity, and silent reproduction for causing the learner to speak the foreign-language sentence.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

abstract_en: To provide a learning toy capable of performing various movements and gradually learning advanced programming so as to include both an infant of low age and a child of an age group older than the low age as a target.SOLUTION: A moving path 120 is formed by arranging a plurality of command panels 121 on which command information readable by an optical reading module 240 is recorded. title_en: System for tracing super-proximity accident vehicle, location tracing server and program recording medium
title_ko: 초근접 사고차량 위치추적 시스템과 위치추적 서버 및 이를위한 기록매체
abstract_en: A super-proximity accident-occurrence vehicle location tracking system, a location tracking server, and a recording medium therefore are provided to enable a rescue vehicle to first access an accident-occurrence vehicle through super-proximity location tracking by delivering a homing signal, so as to rescue the accident-occurrence vehicle. At least one information registration terminal(130) is connected to a predetermined network unit. A terminal information DB(125) connectively processes at least one piece of vehicle information, location tracking terminal information, driver wireless terminal information, and insurance company information to store the processed information. An information registration server(100) receives the at least one piece of the information, and connects the received information with the terminal information DB to store the connected information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 초근접 사고차량 위치추적 시스템과 위치추적 서버 및 이를 위한 기록매체에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 위치추적 서버는, 소정의 통신망을 통해 상기 적어도 3개 이상의 기지국으로부터 소정의 차량에 구비된 위치추적 단말로부터 송출되는 소정의 RCM 데이터(또는 ECM 데이터)를 수신하는 정보 수신부와, 상기 RCM 데이터(또는 ECM 데이터)를 통해 상기 차량의 위치를 산출하는 위치 산출부와, 상기 RCM 데이터(또는 ECM 데이터)를 판독하여 상기 차량에 사고가 발생했는지 확인하는 사고발생 확인부와, 소정의 보험사에 구비된 보험사 서버, 또는 경찰서(또는 소방서)에 구비된 긴급구조 서버로부터 상기 사고차량으로 접근하는 위치추적 단말을 구비한 긴급구조 차량 정보를 수신하는 긴급구조 정보 수신부와, 상기 사고차량의 위치정보와 소정의 위치추적 단말을 구비한 긴급구조 차량의 위치정보를 확인하여 상기 긴급구조 차량이 상기 사고차량의 호밍신호 도달범위에 도달하는지 확인하는 위치 확인부와, 상기 긴급구조 차량이 상기 호밍신호 도달범위에 도달시, 상기 기지국으로 상기 사고차량에 구비된 위치추적 단말로 소정의 호밍신호 송출 명령을 전송하는 정보 전송부를 포함한다.
