title_en: Method for rescue using drone and computer readable record-medium on which program for executing method therefor
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 인명 구조 자동화 방법 및 이를 실행하는 프로그램이 기록된 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for automating lifesaving using a drone and a recording medium having a program recorded therein to perform the method. According to an aspect of the present invention, the system for automating lifesaving comprises: a step of receiving a video on an area of interest relevant to marine leisure activities from one or more cameras; a step of detecting one or more objects from the received video; a step of comparing a change volume in a shape and a position of the one or more objects detected to determine whether an accident relevant to marine leisure activities has occurred in the video; a step of, when it is determined that the accident has occurred, transmitting a movement command including a coordinate corresponding to the position of the object detected to the drone; and a step of, when the drone has moved to a position corresponding to the coordinate, controlling the drone to perform a lifesaving activity for the one or more objects.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면(aspect)에 따른 인명 구조 자동화 시스템은 하나 이상의 카메라로부터 수상 레저 활동과 관련된 관심 영역에 대한 영상을 수신하는 단계, 상기 수신된 영상으로부터 하나 이상의 객체를 검출하는 단계, 상기 검출된 하나 이상의 객체의 형태 및 위치의 변화량과 기 설정된 위험 요소 기준을 대비하여, 상기 영상 내에서 수상 레저 활동과 관련된 안전 사고 상황이 발생하였는지 판단하는 단계, 상기 안전 사고 상황이 발생된 것으로 판단되면, 상기 검출된 객체의 위치에 대응하는 좌표를 포함하는 이동 명령을 드론(Drone)에게 전송하는 단계, 및 상기 드론이 상기 좌표에 대응되는 위치로 이동하면, 상기 드론이 상기 하나 이상의 객체에 대한 구조 활동을 수행하도록 제어하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Automated reporting system and method for the occurrence of a vehicle accident using a digital tacho graph
title_ko: 디지털운행기록계를 이용한 차량사고 자동신고방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic vehicle accident reporting apparatus using a digital tachograph (DTG) and a method thereof which can automatically report an accident by using a digital tachograph when a vehicle accident occurs while driving a vehicle to promote safety of a driver and a passenger by quick reporting even in a situation where a witness is absent when an accident occurs at night or on a remote road. The automatic vehicle accident reporting apparatus using a digital tachograph comprises: a digital tachograph to acquire driving data via communication with a vehicle device arranged on a vehicle, analyze the acquired driving data to determine whether an emergency situation is present, and automatically generate reporting data if an emergency situation is determined to execute reporting; and an accident processing server to store reporting data in an information storage database when the reporting data transmitted from the digital tachograph are received, and search for a response organization based on the reporting data to transmit accident information to the response organization.
abstract_ko: 차량 운행 중 차량 사고가 발생하면 디지털운행기록계(DTG)를 이용하여 자동으로 사고를 신고할 수 있도록 함으로써, 심야 또는 외진 도로에서 사고 발생시 목격자가 없는 상황에서도 신속한 신고로 운전자 및 탑승객의 안전을 도모하도록 한 디지털운행기록계를 이용한 차량사고 자동신고장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 차량에 구비된 차량장치와 통신을 통해 운행 데이터를 획득하고, 획득한 운행 데이터를 분석하여 위급상황 유무를 판단하며, 위급 상황으로 판단되면 자동으로 신고 데이터를 생성하여 신고를 실행하는 디지털운행기록계(DTG) 및 디지털운행기록계로부터 전송된 신고 데이터가 접수되면, 이를 정보저장 데이터베이스에 저장하고 신고 데이터를 기초로 대응기관을 탐색하여 해당 대응기관에 사고 정보를 전송하는 사고처리서버를 포함하여, 디지털운행기록계를 이용한 차량사고 자동신고장치를 구현한다.

title_en: System of convergence phonics education with IT and robot and phonics education method therefor and computer-readable recording medium having program therefor
title_ko: It와 로봇이 융복합된 융복합 파닉스 학습 시스템, 이에 적합한 파닉스 학습 방법, 이에 적합한 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터로 읽어들일 수 있는 기록매체
abstract_en: Disclosed are a convergence phonics learning system in which IT and a robot are converged, a phonics learning method suitable therefor, and a program recorded computer-readable recording medium suitable therefor. An objective of the present invention is to provide a convergence phonics learning system which allows infants to learn correlation between an alphabetic character and a phonetic value by converging IT technology and the robot. The convergence phonics learning system includes: the robot which includes an optical identification (OID) sensor for recognizing coding alphabet cards and robot moving command cards, a driving device for movement, and a Bluetooth communication unit for communication with a smartphone; a plurality of the coding alphabet cards on which an OID pattern for classifying letters to be learned is printed; a plurality of the robot moving command cards on which an OID pattern for classifying robot movement types is printed; a board which forms a robot moving plate, and on which an OID pattern for classifying a starting point and an objective point is printed; and the smartphone which includes a display device outputting a video, a speaker outputting an audio signal, and the Bluetooth communication unit for communicating with the robot, and on which a learning application is mounted, wherein the learning application controls movements of the robot by providing a learner with a phonics story which allows the learner to learn correlation and the phonetic value of the letters and inputting a series of robot moving commands inputted from the learner.

title_en: Method and system of learning baduk using baduk record
title_ko: 학습을 위한 기보 검색 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and a system for searching baduk (Go) records for learning baduk, which is able to analyze the patterns of baduk played by the learner, to search similar baduk records, and to allow the learner to learn baduk. The method comprises: a step where the user starts playing baduk by executing online websites and a baduk learning application on a user terminal; a step where, while starting to play baduk, the user switches the user terminal to an operation mode for searching baduk record-types with similar patterns to the pattern images inputted by the user at the current point of time, performs the capture and the photographing, and inputting the pattern image information or the search condition of the current status obtained by recognizing the image pattern information; a step where a search processor responds to the search command, analyzes the pattern image information and the search condition, and searches baduk records of a baduk record database; and a step where the search processor transmits the baduk records which are the same as or similar to the pattern image information or the search condition as a result of search.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 학습을 위한 기보 검색 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로 학습자가 착수하던 바둑의 패턴을 분석하여 이와 유사한 기보를 검색함으로써 학습이 가능한 학습을 위한 기보 검색 방법 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 사용자가 상기 사용자 단말기의 온라인 웹사이트 및 바둑 학습어플리케이션을 실행하여 바둑을 착수하는 단계; 바둑을 착수하던 중 현재 시점에서의 사용자가 입력한 패턴 이미지와 유사한 패턴의 기보 유형을 검색을 위해 상기 사용자 단말기를 동작모드로 전환하여 캡처 및 촬영을 진행하여 이미지 패턴 정보를 인식하여 얻은 현재 상태의 패턴 이미지 정보 또는 검색 조건을 입력하는 단계; 검색 명령에 응답하여 상기 검색프로세서가 상기 패턴 이미지 정보 및 검색조건을 분석하여 기보 데이터베이스의 기보를 검색하는 단계; 상기 검색프로세서에서 검색된 결과로서 패턴 이미지 정보 또는 검색조건과 동일 유사한 기보를 사용자 단말기에 전달하는 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: Wireless emergency bell control system and method, and computer-readable recording medium
title_ko: 무선 비상벨 제어 시스템, 방법 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention relate to a wireless emergency bell and a method for controlling a wireless emergency bell installed in a school and a school zone, the method comprising the steps of: receiving an input signal generated by pressing a provided button by a reporter when an emergency situation occurs; generating an emergency bell signal, repeatedly transmitting the generated emergency bell signal to at least one pager and a receiver during a predetermined configuration time, and outputting a pre-stored alarm sound to the outside through a provided speaker; generating an emergency bell voice signal and transmitting the generated emergency bell voice signal to the at least one pager and the receiver; generating an emergency bell voice transmission completion signal indicating that the emergency bell voice signal has been completely transmitted, and transmitting the generated emergency bell voice transmission completion signal to the at least one pager and the receiver; converting an operation of the wireless emergency bell into a reception mode in which data can be automatically received from at least one pager after a configured time; receiving a pager voice signal from the at least one pager; determining whether the received pager voice signal exists, and outputting the received pager voice signal to the outside through the speaker when the received pager voice signal exists; and determining whether a mode conversion command signal is received from the at least one pager when the received pager voice signal does not exist, and converting the operation of the wireless emergency bell into a transmission mode in which data can be transmitted to the at least one pager and the receiver when there is the received mode conversion command signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예들은 무선 비상벨에 관한 것으로서, 학교 및 스쿨존에 설치되는 무선 비상벨 제어 방법에 있어서, 비상 상황 발생 시 신고자가 구비된 버튼을 눌러 생성되는 입력 신호를 수신하는 단계; 비상벨 신호를 생성하여 적어도 하나의 호출기 및 수신기로 미리 정해진 설정 시간 동안 반복 송신하며 미리 저장된 알람음을 구비된 스피커를 통해 외부로 출력하는 단계; 비상벨 음성 신호를 생성하여 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기 및 상기 수신기로 송신하는 단계; 상기 비상벨 음성 신호가 송신 완료되었음을 나타내는 비상벨 음성 송신 완료 신호를 생성하여 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기 및 상기 수신기로 송신하는 단계; 설정 시간 이후 자동으로 적어도 하나의 호출기로부터 데이터를 수신할 수 있는 수신 모드로 상기 무선 비상벨의 동작을 전환하는 단계; 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기로부터 호출기 음성 신호를 수신하는 단계; 상기 수신된 호출기 음성 신호가 있는지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 수신된 호출기 음성 신호가 있는 경우, 상기 수신된 호출기 음성 신호를 상기 스피커를 통해 외부로 출력하는 단계; 및 상기 수신된 호출기 음성 신호가 없는 경우, 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기로부터 모드 전환 명령 신호가 수신되었는지 판단하고, 상기 수신된 모드 전환 명령 신호가 있는 경우, 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기 및 상기 수신기로 데이터를 송신할 수 있는 송신 모드로 동작을 전환하는 단계; 를 수행하는 적어도 하나의 무선 비상벨을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Recording and communicating body motion
abstract_en: Recording and communicating human body motion may be provided. One or more wearable device may each include a set of sensors for characterizing motion, a set of vibrating elements placed at different locations, and a radio. Data may be received from the wearable devices and stored at a mobile device. Such data may characterize a set of motions performed over a period of recording time by a recording user wearing the registered wearable devices. When a request for playback of the recorded motions is received at the mobile device from a user wearing the registered wearable devices, it may be determined that the requesting user has different dimensions than the recording user. As such, the stored data may be adjusted based on the difference in dimensions. The requesting user may then perform the motions and be evaluated in real-time to identify a deviation between the adjusted and the real-time data. The deviation is further identified as being associated with one of the wearable devices, and a signal is sent to that wearable device commanding one or more vibrating elements to actuate. Sets of motions may also be communicated to a repository, where each set of motions may be catalogued, tagged, filtered, searched, and distributed to various social networks and users.

title_en: System and method for redaction of data that is incidentally recorded
abstract_en: Techniques for redaction of data that is incidentally recorded are provided. A request for information is received from a user. The requested information includes confidential information. The request is received via a first device. The requested information is sent to the first device for output to the user by the first device. A second device within proximity to the first device is determined. The second device causes the output from the first device to be recorded based on the proximity of the second device to the first device. The recording from the second device is marked as redactable. A portion of the recording from the second device that includes the confidential information is redacted when the recording from the second device is output.

title_en: Distributor
title_ko: 안전사고 방지형 지중전선의 단전형 배전함
abstract_en: A power failure type power distribution terminal box of an underground cable is provided to extinguish a fire in a duct through a penetration hole by exposing the penetration hole of a lower post. A rail is formed on an upper plane of a lower post(11). A power distribution unit(20) and a case(30) are installed on an upper plane of an upper post(12). A first spring is arranged between the lower post and the upper post. An anchor bolt is coupled to the upper post and a lower post. A bracket(40) is installed on a duct. A connector(50) is liftably installed on the bracket, and is downwardly compressed by a second spring. The connector is coupled to a lower end of a connection terminal(60). A connection socket which is detachable coupled to the power distribution unit is installed on an upper end of the connection terminal. A solenoid is installed on the upper post, and is coupled to the connector. The solenoid release or fixes a connection between the connection terminal and the connector. A fixed releasing device releases the fixed upper post and lower post. A control unit is coupled to the solenoid and the fixed releasing device. A fire detecting sensor coupled to the control unit is installed inside the duct, and detects a fire. A sound output device is coupled to the control unit, and outputs previously recorded information broadcasting in response to a control signal of the control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 지중전선에 화재가 발생되었을 때, 이에 신속히 대처할 수 있도록 된 안전사고 방지형 지중전선의 단전형 배전함에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따른 안전사고 방지형 지중전선의 단전형 배전함은 관로(1)의 내부에 화제가 발생하였을 경우, 제어부(90)가 화제감지센서(100)의 신호를 수신하여 상기 솔레노이드장치(70)와 고정해제장치(80)를 작동시키므로써, 상기 접속단자(60)와 커넥터(50)의 연결을 해제함과 동시에 상부기대(12)의 고정을 해제하며, 이에따라, 제1 스프링(13)에 의해 상부기대(12)가 일측으로 이동하여 하부기대(11)의 관통공(11a)을 노출시키므로써, 관통공(11a)을 통해 관로(1) 내부의 화제를 제압할 수 있을 뿐 아니라, 음성출력장치(110)를 이용하여 주위의 보행자에게 안내방송을 하므로써, 보행자가 다치는 것을 방지할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Fire prevention management system
title_ko: 소방관리 시스템
abstract_en: A fire management system is provided to enable a sub wireless communication device for fire prevention to have 20-watt output to the maximum while management wireless communication has 4.8 to 10-watt output so that a signal delivered through the sub device can be received in a fire station or a wireless communication network without transformation or distortion. An external antenna(100) receives management wireless signals or fire signals having different frequency bands. A high-power distributor(200) distributes the fire signals or the management wireless signals in each frequency band, and inputs amplified fire signals or management wireless signals received from the outside to re-output the inputted signals. A repeater(300) inputs analog or digital signals distributed through the distributor to make the inputted signals outputted to corresponding receivers(321,331,341,351), and inputs the amplified signals to output the signals to the distributor.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방용 무선통신보조설비가 최대 20와트의 출력을 가지도록 하고, 관리무선통신이 4.8~10와트의 출력을 가지도록 하여 건축물이 대형화, 고층화, 복합화가 이루어지는 경우에도 무선통신보조설비를 통해 송출되는 신호가 변형 또는 왜곡 없이 해당 관할소방서나 통합지휘 무선통신망으로 수신될 수 있도록 하는 소방관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 소방관리 시스템에 있어서, 서로 다른 주파수 대역을 갖는 소방신호 또는 관리무선신호들을 수신하는 외부 안테나; 상기 외부 안테나를 통해 수신되는 소방신호 또는 관리무선신호를 주파수 대역별로 분배하고, 외부에서 수신되는 증폭된 소방신호 또는 관리무선신호를 입력받아 다시 재출력하는 고출력 분배기; 및 상기 고출력 분배기를 통해 분배된 아날로그 신호 또는 디지털 신호를 입력받아 해당 수신기로 출력되도록 하고, 송신기를 통해 상기 수신기에 의해 증폭된 신호를 입력받아 상기 고출력 분배기로 출력하는 중계기를 포함하여 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
       
     소방, 중계, 통합지휘 무선통신망, 테트라, 소방무선, 관리무선, 원격, 모니터링, FM 무선(radio) 신호

title_en: The combat simulation trainig thereof method using AR VR MR
title_ko: Ar vr mr을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법
abstract_ko:
모의훈련시스템에 있어서, 모의훈련에 대한 프로그램이 저장되는 서버와, 서버의 모의훈련 프로그램에 필요한 데이터가 저장되는 데이터베이스와 서버를 통해 모의훈련에 대한 프로그램을 설정할 수 있도록 하는 디스플레이와 서버를 통해 모의훈련 영상 출력 및 훈련이 가능하도록 제어하는 모션컨트롤러를 포함하되,  모션컨트롤러는 모의훈련 영상 출력 및 착용이 가능한 VR과 VR을 통해 출력되는 모의훈련 영상에 따라 훈련이 가능하도록 제어하는 리모콘과 VR과 리모콘을 활용하여 유도탄 및 포탄을 포격할 수 있도록 훈련이 가능한 곡사화기를 더 포함하도록 제공하는 것이다. 
조종술 향상을 위해 AR 및 동작인식 기술을 적용하여 작전테마 콘텐츠를 통한 다양한 훈련방식이 가능한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 효과는 협소한 훈련 공장 및 과다한 훈련준비 시간으로 인한 개별실습시간 부족 문제를 해결하여 군의 전투력 향상에 기여하기 위한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 효과는 교육생의 무기체계를 사용한 훈련에 대한 안전사고 감소 및 훈련 시 발생하는 소음으로 인한 대민피해 발생을 감소하기 위한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 효과는 유도탄의 조준, 사격, 유도 과정을 쉽게 훈련할 수 있고, 사수들에게 훈련시키기 위하여 실제유도탄을 사용하지 않아 비용절감 및 위험상황을 감소하기 위한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Virtual reality based disaster education method, device and computer readable medium for performing the method
title_ko: 가상현실 기반 재난 대피 교육 방법, 이를 수행하기 위한 장치 및 기록매체
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a virtual reality based disaster evacuation education method comprises: executing a disaster response education game performed in a virtual space composed of a plurality of 3D virtual objects in virtual reality; applying a disaster event for a specific disaster situation to a virtual space at an arbitrary point of time; generating mission information for the disaster event; analyzing the type of 3D virtual object acquired by a user in a process of performing a mission and actions performed by a user based on log data generated in the process of performing the mission information; and calculating a corresponding score for performing the mission information based on an analysis result. According to an aspect of the present invention, an active disaster evacuation education service with improved learning efficiency and immersion can be provided by allowing a user to naturally acquire disaster evacuation abilities through events and missions unexpectedly given to the user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 가상현실 기반 재난 대피 교육 방법은, 복수의 3차원 가상객체로 구성된 가상 공간에서 수행되는 재난 대응 훈련 게임을 가상현실 상에서 실행하고, 특정 재난 상황에 대한 재난 이벤트를 임의의 시점에 가상 공간에 적용하고, 재난 이벤트에 대한 미션 정보를 생성하고, 미션 정보를 수행하는 과정에서 발생되는 로그 데이터를 기초로 미션 수행 과정에서 사용자가 획득한 3차원 가상객체의 종류 및 사용자가 수행한 행동을 분석하며, 분석 결과에 기초하여 미션 정보 수행에 대한 대응 점수를 산출할 수 있다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer-readable recording medium for providing a fall accident and accident notification service based on the life pattern in the video
title_ko: 영상 내 생활 패턴에 기반해 낙상 사고의 유무 및 사고 공지 서비스를 제공하는 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터-판독 가능 기록 매체
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to accurately and quickly determine whether a fall accident has occurred for a user through an image, and to notify a guardian in the event of a fall accident to rescue the user as quickly as possible. The method includes: a fall candidate frame identification step in which, when generating life movement information for the user based on first image information and receiving second image information, a reference frame that satisfies the user's preset fall criteria information among a plurality of frames is identified to identify a fall candidate frame; an accident presence/absence judgment step in which, by comparing the user's behavior pattern based on the fall candidate frame with the lifestyle pattern based on the lifestyle movement information, the user's fall accident is determined through a similarity rate of the behavior pattern to the lifestyle pattern; and an accident occurrence notification step in which, when the fall accident is confirmed to have occurred, rescue information is identified in a previously stored database, and provided to the electronic device of the previously registered guardian, and rescue request information is provided to a previously linked rescue agency to notify the occurrence of the fall accident for the user. The present invention provides a method for detecting the presence or absence of a fall accident and providing a notification service for the accident based on the lifestyle pattern in the video, and can accurately determine whether the action performed by the user in the video is an action performed when a fall accident occurs, thereby preventing the occurrence of errors in the occurrence of a fall accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 하나 이상의 프로세서 및 상기 프로세서에서 수행 가능한 명령들을 저장하는 하나 이상의 메모리를 포함하는 컴퓨팅 장치로 구현되는 영상 내 생활 패턴에 기반해 낙상 사고의 유무 및 사고 공지 서비스를 제공하는 방법에 있어서, IP 카메라로부터 사용자가 촬영된 제1 영상 정보가 수신되는 경우, 상기 제1 영상 정보를 기반으로 사용자에 대한 생활 동작 정보를 생성한 상태에서, 상기 IP 카메라로부터 사용자가 촬영된 제2 영상 정보를 수신 시, 상기 제2 영상 정보에 대응되는 제2 영상에 기반한 복수 개의 프레임 중 사용자가 기 설정된 낙상 기준 정보를 충족하는 기준 프레임을 식별하여, 상기 기준 프레임에 기반한 낙상 후보 프레임을 식별하는 낙상 후보 프레임 식별 단계; 상기 낙상 후보 프레임 식별 단계의 기능 수행이 완료되면, 상기 낙상 후보 프레임에 기반한 사용자의 행동 패턴과 상기 생활 동작 정보에 기반한 생활 패턴을 비교하여, 상기 생활 패턴에 대한 상기 행동 패턴의 유사율을 통해 사용자에 대한 낙상 사고의 유무를 판단하는 사고 유무 판단 단계; 및 상기 사고 유무 판단 단계의 기능 수행에 의해 상기 낙상 사고가 발생한 것을 확인한 경우, 낙상 사고가 발생된 사용자를 구조하기 위한 구조 정보를 기 저장된 데이터베이스에서 식별하여, 상기 식별된 구조 정보를 기 등록된 보호자의 전자 장치에 제공함과 동시에 기 연계된 구조 기관에 구조 요청 정보를 제공해 사용자에 대한 낙상 사고의 발생을 공지하는 사고 발생 공지 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이 외에도 본 문서를 통해 파악되는 다양한 실시예들이 가능하다.

title_en: System for validating and appending incident-related data records in an inter-agency distributed electronic ledger
abstract_en: A computer apparatus, such as a validator node, for validating data records in a distributed electronic ledger may be configured to receive a proposed data record submitted by an originating agent of an originating agency to a distributed ledger. In response to the proposed incident-related data record, other agents within the originating agency may, based on validation criteria, submit one or more responsive data records that may provide information for use in determining a validity of the proposed incident-related data record. Validator nodes hosted by external agencies may submit validation responses relative to a validity of the proposed incident-related data record. The system may determine that the proposed data record is valid. Based a consensus algorithm, the system may responsively append the proposed data record or an indication of validity to the distributed ledger or to a different distributed ledger.

title_en: Integrating data from multiple devices
abstract_en: A recording system for an emergency response unit includes a first data collection device configured to record a first video, audio or data segment with an incident identifier and transmit a message including the incident identifier. A second data collection device may receive the message and, as appropriate, record at least a second video, audio or data segment with the incident identifier, allowing the first segment and the second segment to be associated using the incident identifier. In other embodiments, a first recording device may begin recording video, audio or legal evidence data with an incident identifier, and a control system may receive a message including the incident identifier from the first recording device, identify one or more additional recording devices located within a certain distance of the first recording device, and obtain recordings from the one or more additional recording devices.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.

title_en: Complete equipment for nuclear power station meteorological information emergency early-warning
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to early-warning equipment, and particularly relates to complete equipment for nuclear power station meteorological information emergency early-warning. The equipment comprises a wind speed sensor, a collector, an upper computer, a database server, an industrial mobile phone short message device and a power supply, wherein the collector is connected with the wind speed sensor, the upper computer is in serial port connection with the collector, the database server is connected with the upper computer, the industrial mobile phone short message device is connected with the upper computer, and the power supply provides power for the collector, the upper computer and the industrial mobile phone short message device. The complete equipment provided by the utility model successfully solves a difficult problem between the timeliness of emergency operations of a nuclear power station and the work efficiency of the personnel; the power supply of the complete equipment adopts three-level redundancy of alternating current, a diesel engine and a storage battery, thereby ensuring the hardware power supply reliability; and early-warning information is graded from light to heavy and deepened gradually, and division of the early warning grades, compilation of the early-warning information and the early-warning transmission period fully achieve preventability, rationality and humanization under the premise of conforming to laws and regulations, thereby meeting special requirements for emergency response of the nuclear power station, realizing reduction in cost of on-duty labor of the power station, and being obvious in effect and benefit.

title_en: Stock anchor rope monitoring system warp and monitor thereof
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a stock anchor rope monitoring system warp and monitor thereof, it includes pressure sensor, displacement sensor and measuring instrument, pressure sensor and displacement sensor install in an integrated bench to be connected with the measuring instrument of installing at integrated bench, displacement sensor includes roll subassembly, sensing apparatus, and around establishing a haulage rope, the open end connection of haulage rope warp the tip of stock anchor rope to the roll subassembly outward, the roll subassembly is inside still to be equipped with an elastomeric element so that the roll subassembly resets, and the subassembly that rolls is connected with the sensing apparatus, when the stock anchor rope is out of shape, can drives the roll subassembly through the haulage rope and rotate, and the sensing apparatus detects the displacement volume of roll subassembly to transmit to the measuring instrument. The measuring instrument can carry out acousto -optic warning according to the data that record. The utility model discloses simple structure, convenient to use, the feedback in time can effectively improve production efficiency, has reduced the emergence of geological disasters accidents such as mine incident and landslide.
assignees: BEIJING HENGMAOLI SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;SHANDONG KEDA ZHONGTIAN SAFETY AND CONTROL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: track traffic safety detection method
abstract_en: Track traffic safety detection method, is related to track traffic safety and measurement observation and control technology field.Make a reservation for monitoring regional deployment ground radar along track, if coordinate system builds orbit equation mark radar site, radar beam (such as laser beam) parallel sweep track passes through face, detect and be higher by doubtful barrier and then obtain azran, reference rail equation calculation compares, judge track pass through band in the range of alarm；Alternate covering collaboration warning is scanned between radar, lighting shooting live video is opened in alarm, is screened and is excluded normal pass parking and repair and maintenance period.The present invention carries out full line, round-the-clock, round-the-clock, full-automatic, unattended, high-efficiency high-accuracy scanning probe to track; energy accurate discrimination dangerous obstacles; record natural and man-made calamities are found in time; for track traffic traffic safety and safeguarding of assets; credible monitoring and early warning is provided and ensures emergency response; track traffic safety is lifted, enhancing is gone on a journey and cargo transportation security sense by bus, and economic results in society value is high.

title_en: Manned centrifuge medical science monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention provides a manned centrifuge medical monitoring system, which comprises: the system comprises an operation desk and a control cabinet, wherein physiological monitoring, a database and audio and video monitoring equipment are installed in the control cabinet, and the operation desk controls the equipment in the control cabinet through a PLC (programmable logic controller); the operation panel includes: the control display module displays signals monitored in the control cabinet through the control operation module, and enables a subject to communicate with a commander in real time through real-time monitoring, recording and replaying of analysis and monitoring data, so that the training and testing safety is guaranteed, and the work completion quality is improved.
assignees: PLA AIR FORCE CHARACTERISTICS MEDICAL CENTER

title_en: Tunnel construction three-color safety management system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety monitoring management, and particularly relates to a three-color safety management system for tunnel construction, which comprises a background database, a server, a monitoring module and an alarm module; the background database is used for recording and storing construction information in the tunnel; construction conditions in the tunnel are monitored in real time through the monitoring module, emergency records in the tunnel are uploaded to the background database, the background database compares multiple stored emergency cases quickly, the comparison result is sent to multiple supervision high-rise personnel through the server, the supervision high-rise personnel send signals to the alarm module after confirming, the alarm module rapidly responds to and sends out warning signals in the tunnel, workers are reminded to respond, and the alarm module is provided with an alarm switch in each unit of tunnel construction, the alarm module is used for the workers to meet emergency response for use at the first time, the response of the alarm module can be triggered, and the response speed of the emergency of construction in the tunnel is improved.
assignees: CCCC FIRST HIGHWAY ENGINEERING GROUP CO LTD;THE THIRD ENG CO LTD OF HIGHWAY ENG BUREAU OF CCCC

title_en: Method for running user-written program
title_ko: 사용자 작성 프로그램의 실행 방법
abstract_en: According to one embodiment of the present invention, a user-written program running method, which executes a command corresponding to at least one user input object on a closed curve while a second object circulates along the closed curve generated by a first object, comprises: a step of positioning the user input object at a first position on the closed curve and displaying the user input object at the first position with a first display mode based on user input; a step of determining whether a position of the second object circulating along the closed curve and the first position satisfy a predetermined condition; and, when the predetermined condition is satisfied, a step of executing the command corresponding to the user input object.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 제1 개체에 의해 생성된 폐곡선을 따라 제2 개체가 순환하면서 상기 폐곡선 상의 하나 이상의 사용자 입력 개체에 대응되는 명령을 수행하는, 사용자 작성 프로그램의 실행 방법은, 사용자의 입력에 기초하여, 사용자 입력 개체를 상기 폐곡선 상의 제1 위치에 위치시키고, 상기 사용자 입력 개체를 상기 제1 위치에 제1 표시 방식으로 표시하는 단계; 상기 폐곡선을 순환하는 상기 제2 개체의 위치와 상기 제1 위치가 소정의 조건을 만족하는지 여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 상기 소정의 조건이 만족된 경우, 상기 사용자 입력 개체에 대응되는 명령을 실행하는 단계;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for security analyst modeling and management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for managing incoming cybersecurity events. Incoming security events are first classified based on stored event profiles from previous events. Multiple analysts with relevant experience and background are determined based on the analysts' stored profiles. The incoming event is assigned and dispatched as necessary to one of these analysts. Analyst stress levels and mood is assessed, and the assessments are stored in the analyst profiles. Analyst resolution steps and performance against those steps in resolving the events are also stored in the relevant analyst profiles and in an event record database. QA reviews of resolved events are conducted when norm deviant circumstances arise. AI and process mining techniques are used in classifying the incoming events, assigning the incoming events to the relevant analyst, and determining lessons to be learned from previous events. The analyst profiles models specific analyst behaviour and are used for assigning incoming events.

title_en: System-level emergency response device of spacecraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system-level emergency response device of a spacecraft. Through adoption of a micro technology and micro devices and components, platform design and emergency mechanism design of the spacecraft are coordinated from a top layer of a spacecraft system; main emergency response functions are implemented in an emergency response device; and the platform design only considers the conventional redundancy measures, thereby reducing the coupling degree and the complexity of each spacecraft subsystem due to consideration of emergency design. The emergency response device of the spacecraft achieves an independent power supply function, a spacecraft state monitoring function and a data recording function and is not coupled with an energy subsystem, a measurement and control subsystem, a satellite service subsystem, an attitude and orbit control subsystem and the like of the spacecraft platform; when the subsystems meet emergencies in orbit, the emergency response device of the spacecraft can independently achieve a satellite-ground communication function, a low-precision attitude measurement function and the like, can provide spacecraft state monitoring data and historical spacecraft state data for the ground to eliminate failures; and the emergency response device of the spacecraft is small in volume, low in mass loss (lower than 10kg) and independent and controlled in functions.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system distributed scheduling method and system considering typhoon uncertainty
abstract_en: The invention provides a distributed scheduling method and a distributed scheduling system of a comprehensive energy system for accounting typhoon uncertainty, which relate to the technical field of electric-gas comprehensive energy collaborative operation and toughness enhancement and comprise the steps of constructing an offshore wind power operation model, and sampling and generating a typhoon scene and an offshore wind power output scene by utilizing a Monte Carlo simulation method; the three-layer collaborative scheduling model of the scene-based integrated energy system is subjected to solvability conversion based on the mixed sample average approximation, converted into a determined continuous linear model, and the determined continuous linear model is solved by utilizing a high-efficiency distributed collaborative algorithm of a multi-parameter programming theory and a critical domain acceleration search algorithm based on global optimal solution estimation to obtain a global optimal solution. The solving efficiency of the method can meet the timeliness requirement of emergency response in typhoon scenes.

title_en: River domain disaster monitoring pre-alarming method and system based on multisource monitoring data analysis
abstract_en: The invention provides a river domain disaster monitoring pre-alarming method and system based on multisource monitoring data analysis, which are characterized in that multisource monitoring data are obtained, the multisource monitoring data are subjected to data preprocessing, noise interference in real-time position data is eliminated, channel image data and environment parameter data are subjected to time synchronization alignment to generate a standardized monitoring data set, water flow dynamic characteristics, meteorological abnormal characteristics and channel obstacle distribution characteristics of Jiang Heyu are extracted, the method comprises the steps of generating a multidimensional disaster association feature set, inputting the multidimensional disaster association feature set into a preset disaster early warning model for dynamic analysis, generating a disaster early warning signal, determining a disaster type and an influence range, triggering an autonomous detachment mechanism of a drag airship and a quick starting instruction of an unmanned aerial vehicle, broadcasting early warning information to a ship in a channel through the unmanned aerial vehicle, and synchronously transmitting the disaster type and the influence range to a command center. The invention can improve the timeliness of disaster early warning and the space adaptation precision of disposal measures.

title_en: Fire safety management supervision platform system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire safety management and discloses a fire safety management supervision platform system. The system comprises a building information acquisition module, a risk area division module, a historical data indexing module, a dynamic risk analysis module, a fire resource scheduling module and an emergency response decision module, wherein the building information acquisition module acquires building structure data and environment monitoring data of a target building in real time, the risk area division module divides a plurality of independent fire risk areas according to the building structure data and distributes area identifications, the historical data indexing module indexes a historical fire accident data set and a fire facility maintenance record set of each area according to the area identifications, the dynamic risk analysis module fuses the environment monitoring data and the historical fire accident data set to generate a real-time fire risk coefficient sequence, the fire resource scheduling module generates a fire resource allocation scheme based on the real-time fire risk coefficient sequence and the facility maintenance record set, and the emergency response decision module generates a multi-stage fire emergency response strategy according to the resource allocation scheme. The system improves timeliness and pertinence of fire safety management.

title_en: DVR monitoring system for recording and monitoring in emergency
title_ko: 비상 상황에서의 녹화 감시를 위한 dvr 감시 시스템
abstract_en: A DVR monitoring system according to various embodiments includes: a DVR device including a DVR device, a power supply unit supplying power to at least one camera connected to the DVR device, a communication unit, a storage unit, and a control unit; the camera or cameras connected to the DVR device; and a user terminal receiving from the DVR device monitoring information including image data captured and received by the camera and whether power supply from the outside is blocked or not and transmitting a camera control command to the DVR device. The DVR monitoring system according to the various embodiments is capable of continuously monitoring a monitoring zone even in a case where the power supply from the outside is blocked in a forced way. In the case where the power supply from the outside is blocked in a forced way, the forced blocking of the power supply from the outside is recognized as an emergency situation. Then, camera imaging settings are adjusted, the imaging of the monitoring zone is executed in a more concentrated manner, and monitoring and camera control can be efficiently performed by interworking with the user terminal set in advance.
abstract_ko:
다양한 실시 예에 따른 DVR 감시 시스템은, DVR 장치 및 DVR 장치와 연결된 적어도 하나의 카메라에 전원을 공급하는 전원공급부, 통신부, 저장부 및 제어부를 포함하는 DVR 장치; DVR 장치와 연결된 적어도 하나의 카메라; 및 외부로부터의 전원 공급 차단 여부 및 카메라에 의해 촬영되어 수신되는 영상 데이터를 포함하는 감시 정보를 DVR 장치로부터 수신하고, DVR 장치에 카메라 제어 명령을 전송하는 사용자 단말을 포함할 수 있다.  
다양한 실시 예에 따른 DVR 감시 시스템은, 외부로부터 전원 공급이 강제적으로 차단되는 경우에도 지속적으로 감시 구역을 감시할 수 있다. 또한 외부로부터 강제로 전원 공급이 차단되는 경우 이를 비상 상황으로 인식하고, 카메라 촬영 설정을 조정하여 보다 집중적으로 감시구역에 대한 촬영을 실행하고 미리 설정된 사용자 단말과 연동하여 효율적으로 감시 및 카메라 제어를 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Bathroom space ventilation system for emergency evacuation with intake and ventilation
title_ko: 환기와 급기를 위한 긴급 피난 욕실 실내공간 환풍시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency evacuation bathroom interior space ventilation system for ventilation and air supply that enables a fan in a bathroom space, which can be utilized as an evacuation space in the event of an emergency situation such as a fire in an apartment building, to be used for noiseless ventilation during normal times and to supply fresh air from the outside during an emergency situation, thereby providing fresh air to evacuees to facilitate breathing. According to the present invention, the emergency evacuation bathroom interior space ventilation system for ventilation and air supply comprises: an external noise housing which includes an installation body lid part and a noise installation body part and connects the indoor and outdoor areas in a zigzag penetrating state; a noise return blower fan unit which ventilates the internal air to the outside according to a control signal, operates in a state of reducing noise generation, and brings in the external air inside to supply air; and a ventilation control circuit unit which detects flame and smoke, inputs an external command signal, and outputs a corresponding control signal to be driven in a ventilation or air supply state by a built-in program and data and driven at a controlled rotation speed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사무용 건물 또는 아파트 등과 같은 공동주택 건축물에서 화재와 같은 긴급 상황이 발생하는 경우 피난 공간으로 활용할 수 있는 욕실 공간의 환풍기를 평소에는 무소음 환기용으로 사용하고 긴급상황에는 외부의 신선한 공기가 공급되도록 하여 대피자에게 신선한 공기를 공급하여 호흡이 원활하도록 하는 환기와 급기를 위한 긴급 피난 욕실 실내공간 환풍시스템에 관한 것이며, 육면체 통 형상을 하고 실내의 선택된 위치에 고정 설치되며 설치몸체뚜껑부와 소음설치몸체부를 포함하여 이루어지고 실내와 실외를 지그재그 관통 상태로 연결시키는 외형소음하우징; 외형소음하우징의 내부에 고정 설치되고 해당 제어신호에 의하여 내부 공기를 외부로 배출시켜 환기하며 소음 발생을 줄이는 상태로 동작하고 외부 공기를 내부로 유입하여 급기하는 소음환급기송풍팬부; 소음환급기송풍팬부에 연결되고 화염과 연기를 각각 감지하며 외부의 해당 명령신호를 입력하고 내장 운용되는 프로그램과 데이터에 의하여 환기 상태 또는 급기 상태로 구동되되 제어된 회전속도로 구동되도록 해당 제어신호를 출력하는 환풍제어회로부를 포함하는 특징에 의하여 사무용 건물 또는 아파트가 포함되는 공동주택 건축물의 거주공간, 욕실, 화장실, 주방 등이 포함되는 실내 공간에 설치되는 환풍기가 평소에는 소음 발생이 없는 쾌적한 상태로 내부 공기를 외부로 환기시키고 화재 등과 같은 긴급한 경우에 대피공간으로 사용되는 욕실 또는 특정 주거공간에 외부의 신선한 공기를 대량으로 빠르게 해당 실내 공간에 유입시키므로 대피자의 안전과 건강을 보호하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Scoring server
abstract_en: A scoring server for assessing technical skills in a practical environment. A client application acts as a middle man between a terminal and an operating system to capture and forward all input from and output to students to the scoring server. The scoring server compares recorded student activity against a list of tasks deemed capable of accomplishing course objectives assigned to students. As objectives are met by a student, the students' grade is updated in real-time. Each student passes or fails an exam based on tasks performed and skills employed. The client application exists for two operating system types: WINDOWS® and LINUX®. A LINUX® client employs a pseudoterminal to permit access to terminal input/output and communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr channels. A WINDOWS® client (WC) comprises a WC command line activity logger and a WC monitor process to intercept all communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr communication channels.

title_en: Modular Power Distribution System
title_ko: 모듈식 전원 분배 장치
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 모듈식 전원 분배 장치에 관한 것으로서, 특히 더욱 상세하게는 산업용, 가정용 전기 분전반 및 배전반의 전원을 분리시키는 것으로, 분전반, 배전반과 간단하게 연결될 수 있게 볼트 조립식으로 모듈화하여 종래와 같이 복잡한 제조공정을 거치지 않고 간단하게 탈, 부착이 가능하므로 규격화로 인한 생산성을 높일 수 있고, 통상의 사용자들이 배선용 차단기의 탈, 부착정도의 기술만으로도 제조가 가능하여 재활용이 가능하며,  전기 사용량에 따른 전류를 변류기를 통해 검출하여 표시장치에서 디스플레이할 수 있고 출력단자를 통해 사용하는 전류의 흐름을 외부로 공급할 수 있고, 산업용 분전반 및 배전반의 제작시 부스바를 없애고 부스바의 역할을 완전히 밀폐된 모듈화로 간편하게 함으로써, 부스바와 아크릴 커버로 인해 발생하는 감전사고, 지락 과 단락 및 화재시 유독가스로부터 예방할 수 있는 모듈식 전원 분배 장치에 관한 것이다.       
     상기 본 고안은 메인차단기용 단자와 분기차단기용 단자 및 추가용 단자와 연결되는 전원의 분배 선로를 보호하는 케이스와; 상기 케이스의 상부 면에 위치하며, 메인차단기 전원과 선로에 의해 연결되는 복수개의 메인차단기용 단자와; 상기 케이스의 양쪽 측면에 위치하며, 분기차단기 전원과 선로에 의해 연결되는 복수개의 분기차단기용 단자와; 상기 케이스의 하부 면에 위치하며, 상기 케이스의 표면에 함몰되어 외부의 다른 부하단과 연결하거나 또는 분배선로를 추가하여 연결하는 복수개의 추가용 단자; 를 포함함을 특징으로 한다. 
     상기 본 고안은 메인차단기용 단자와 분기차단기용 단자 및 추가용 단자와 연결되는 전원의 분배 선로를 보호하는 케이스와; 상기 케이스의 상부 면에 위치하며, 메인차단기 전원과 선로에 의해 연결되는 복수개의 메인차단기용 단자와; 상기 케이스의 양쪽 측면에 위치하며, 분기차단기 전원과 선로에 의해 연결되는 복수개의 분기차단기용 단자와; 상기 케이스의 하부 면에 위치하며, 상기 케이스의 표면에 함몰되어 외부의 다른 부하단과 연결하거나 또는 분배선로를 추가하여 연결하는 복수개의 추가용 단자와 ;상기 케이스의 표면에 메인차단기용 단자와 분기차단기용 단자가 선로에 의해 연결되어 전원을 공급받아 흐른 전류량을 검출하는 변류기와; 상기 변류기를 통해 검출된 전류 데이터인 아날로그 데이터를 디지털 데이터로 변환시키는 A/D 변환기와; 상기 A/D 변환기에서 변환된 데이터를 표시하여 주는 표시부; 를 포함함을 특징으로 한다.      
     상기 본 고안에 있어서, 상기 메인차단기용 단자와 분기차단기용 단자를 연결하는 선로는 병렬로 연결되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     상기 본 고안에 있어서, 메인차단기용 단자와 분기차단기용 단자 및 추가용 단자와의 연결은 볼트가 체결되어 고정되는 것을 특징으로 한다.      
       
     모듈식 전원 분배 장치, 케이스, 메인차단기, 메인차단기용 단자, 변류기, 분기차단기, 분기차단기용 단자, 추가용 단자, 볼트, 디스플레이부, A/D 변환기.

title_en: Tropical cyclone emergency response level threshold determining method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a tropical cyclone emergency response level threshold determination method, device, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-disaster factor index system for tropical cyclone emergency; acquiring path intensity data of a tropical cyclone of a history record; according to the path intensity data of the tropical cyclone, carrying out frequency intensity analysis on each disaster causing factor index in the multi-disaster causing factor index system to obtain index value probability distribution functions corresponding to each disaster causing factor index; respectively calculating the X quantiles of the index value probability distribution functions corresponding to the disaster causing factor indexes; respectively determining threshold ranges corresponding to X emergency response levels on each disaster causing factor index according to the X quantiles corresponding to each disaster causing factor index; and summarizing threshold ranges corresponding to the X emergency response levels on each disaster causing factor index to obtain the tropical cyclone emergency response level threshold. The method can accurately send out emergency response grade when the tropical cyclone logs in.

title_en: Electric power safety construction method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power safety construction, and provides a power safety construction method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring information of an electric power construction site, acquiring map information of the electric power construction site through image acquisition equipment, determining current construction area range information in the acquired map information, preparing construction criteria according to the construction information, incorporating the acquired information into a server, sorting constructor information into standard, manufacturing electric power construction site safety management software compatible with a mobile phone and a remote server, designing a construction process, detecting whether the construction process is standard, simulating construction progress in a three-dimensional mode, recording the construction process, and finally commanding constructors to perform safety construction operation to realize safety construction operation; the invention is convenient for identifying and protecting constructors, outputting the identities of the constructors when the constructors are detected, reminding the constructors when the identified identities of the constructors are non-constructors, and reducing potential safety hazards in construction.
assignees: ZHONGXIN PUNENG ELECTRIC POWER EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A simulation driving system for grab ship unloader
abstract_en: The invention relates to a simulated driving system for a grab ship unloader, which comprises a server, a grab ship unloader and a control module, wherein a data receiving port is arranged on the server and is used for receiving environmental characteristic data and attitude characteristic data of the grab ship unloader; and a high-precision high-speed sampling sensor is additionally arranged on the operation equipment in the ship; the real-time database is used for carrying out interaction by adopting multiple data nodes through DFS, and the data nodes have local storage equipment; the database adopts a distributed file system and performs multi-column combined partition; the real-time curve module is connected with the real-time database, acquires equipment command, environment state and position posture data in the database, establishes a time sequence curve chart of the grab bucket, charts all records in the manual operation process and displays the records on the upper computer; the deep learning module adopts a mapping model based on Theano neural network. The invention solves the problem that the operation of a simulated driver on complex working conditions is difficult to realize under the full-automatic control of the ship unloader.
assignees: HANGZHOU KUNSHI AUTOMATION SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Simulator, simulation method, computer program, and recording medium
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To properly allocate the entire function of a working machine operation support system among a cockpit, a cabin, and ground headquarters.  <P>SOLUTION: A simulator 1 comprises: an airborne system evaluation section 2 simulating an airborne system on a rotary-wing aircraft and displaying an object search screen on display sections 9 and 10; a ground system evaluation section 3 transmitting search plan information to the airborne system evaluation section 2 and displaying the search plan information on a display section 12; and a scenario launcher section 5 which transmits a scenario including map information to the ground system evaluation section 3 and transmits a scenario including commands arranged in time series to the airborne system evaluation section 2 to control them. On the basis of the display content of the display sections 9, 10, and 12, the simulator 1 evaluates the validity of function allocation of search operations conducted through cooperations between the airborne system and the ground system using a rotary-wing aircraft.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Chatbot server using natural language model without sharing personal information, control method thereof, computer program, and computer-readable recording medium
title_ko: 개인정보를 공유하지 않으며 자연어 처리 모델을 이용 가능한 챗봇 서버 및 그 제어 방법, 컴퓨터 프로그램, 컴퓨터로 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: An object to be solved of the present invention is to provide a chatbot service without providing user personal information to a natural language processing model. In addition, even users who are not familiar with using chatbots can easily receive desired information based on natural language. The chatbot server generates an output message corresponding to a user message inputted by a user and provides the output message to a user terminal. The chatbot server comprises: a message transmission and reception unit; a personal information blocking unit; a command generation unit; a natural language processing model interlocking unit; a function execution unit; and an output message generation unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은　개인정보를 공유하지 않으며 자연어 처리 모델을 이용 가능한 챗봇 서버 및 그 제어 방법, 컴퓨터 프로그램, 컴퓨터로 판독 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 
일 실시예에 따르면, 사용자가 입력한 사용자 메시지에 대응되는 출력 메시지를 생성하여 사용자 단말기로 제공하는 챗봇 서버에 있어서, 상기 사용자 메시지를 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 수신하고, 상기 출력 메시지를 상기 사용자 단말기로 송신하는 메시지 송수신부; 상기 사용자 메시지에 개인정보가 포함되었는지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 개인정보가 포함된 경우에 개인정보 포함 경고 메시지를 상기 메시지 송수신부를 통해 상기 사용자 단말기로 송신하는 개인정보 차단부; 상기 사용자 메시지에 개인정보가 포함되지 않은 경우, 상기 사용자 메시지와 상기 사용자 메시지에 대응되는 기 설정된 복수의 기능 정보를 포함하되 자연어 처리 모델에서 판독 가능한 명령어를 생성하는 명령 생성부; 상기 명령 생성부에서 생성된 상기 명령어를 상기 자연어 처리 모델로 전달하고, 상기 자연어 처리 모델에 의해 선택된 상기 명령어에 대응되는 실행 대상 기능과 상기 사용자 메시지로부터 추출되거나 상기 사용자 메시지에 기반하여 생성된 상기 실행 대상 기능의 실행을 위해 필요한 필수 정보를 수신하는 자연어 처리 모델 연동부; 상기 필수 정보를 활용하여 상기 자연어 처리 모델 연동부를 통해 전달받은 상기 실행 대상 기능을 수행하는 기능 수행부; 및 상기 기능 수행부의 수행 결과를 기초로 상기 출력 메시지를 생성하는 출력 메시지 생성부를 포함하는 챗봇 서버가 제공될 수 있다.

title_en: Generating an incident dossier
abstract_en: Methods, devices, and systems for generating an incident dossier are described herein. One device includes a memory, and a processor configured to execute executable instructions stored in the memory to import data associated with an incident associated with a site, wherein the data is in a number of different forms, receive a number of user inputs associated with the incident, and generate an incident dossier based on the data associated with the incident and the number of user inputs, wherein the incident dossier includes a timeline of the incident, a report of the incident, and a damage assessment of the incident.

title_en: System for validating and appending incident-related data records in a distributed electronic ledger
abstract_en: A computer apparatus, such as a validator node, for validating incident-related data records in a distributed electronic ledger is configured to receive a request from an agent to add a proposed incident-related data record associated with an incident to the distributed electronic ledger. In response to the proposed incident-related data record, the computer apparatus determines, from the distributed electronic ledger, one or more attributes of the agent or incident. The computer apparatus determines whether the proposed incident-related data record satisfies validation criteria based at least partially on the one or more attributes of the agent or incident. Once validated, the computer apparatus may then append the proposed incident-related data record to the distributed electronic ledger. Alternatively, the proposed incident-related data record may be appended regardless of validity, but an indication of validity may be appended if the proposed incident-related data record is validated.

title_en: Record-Based Device Location Signaling for Emergency Calls
abstract_en: A software platform includes emergency event processing functionality for detecting and mapping emergency event occurrences. The emergency event processing includes device location registration functionality for allowing operators of the software platform to register locations of their devices. Information associated with the operator-entered location information is stored alongside network device information. When an emergency call is placed by a device registered with the software platform, the software platform identifies network device information for the device placing the emergency call and searches records generated based on the operator-indicated device locations. A location determined thereby is then signaled to a public safety answering point. This automated signaling can improve an emergency response by directing dispatched responders to a specific location verified by the operator of the device, rather than an assumed location specified by an administrator which may not actually be accurate.

title_en: System for mimicking the behavior of a multi-engine aircraft with a single engine aircraft
abstract_en: A fly-by-wire system that lets a single-engine aircraft mimic multi-engine behavior for real-flight pilot training, especially asymmetric thrust effects that create yaw/roll. A cockpit central thrust control with two independent thrust levers generates an overall power command plus a dissymmetry signal; a calculator applying a dedicated control law converts these into corrected setpoints for the rudder, left/right ailerons, and propeller parameters to reproduce multi-engine handling. Instructors may trigger a simulated engine failure and then reset back to normal single-engine operation. Optional wingtip electric thrusters powered by a battery may increase asymmetric effects while maintaining safety margin, and the system may display/record simulated multi-engine data for debriefing—reducing training cost and CO 2  versus operating real twins

title_en: On-orbit emergency task instruction response time testing method, system and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an on-orbit emergency task instruction response time testing method, system and medium, which comprise the steps of compiling a testing data packet, arranging an on-ground emergency task instruction response testing target packet before an emergency response testing arc section, enabling the on-ground emergency task instruction to be used by an interrupt task when an emergency response test is conducted, monitoring the execution condition of the on-orbit emergency task instruction response testing target packet after the on-orbit emergency task instruction response testing target packet is conducted, recording the moment T0 when a satellite receives the task interrupt instruction in real-time telemetry after the on-orbit emergency task instruction response testing target packet is conducted, confirming the on-orbit emergency task packet after load equipment is turned off, recording satellite load starting moment T1, and taking T1-T0 as on-orbit emergency task instruction response time. The method can ensure that the response time of the microwave remote sensing satellite on-orbit emergency task instruction can be effectively and accurately tested in the on-orbit emergency imaging environment.

title_en: Service multi-level linkage command scheduling management system and method based on network system management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a business multistage linkage command and dispatch management system and method based on a network system management, in particular to the technical field of command and dispatch management, which are used for solving the problem of poor dispatching in the multistage command process; the invention acquires the shared data sources of all departments and carries out data cleaning, the data of different departments are associated, the data are combined into a unified data set after being matched in a multi-mode, the unified data set is analyzed to obtain a scheduling scheme, then, the intelligent scheduling scheme generating process of business multi-level linkage is carried out on a network system management platform, scheduling influence information generated in the analysis process is obtained, the scheduling management stability condition of the generating scheme of the network system management platform is determined, if the scheduling management state of the network system management platform is abnormal, the command scheduling of multi-level linkage is managed in time, thereby improving the timeliness of the multi-level linkage command scheduling, responding faster when the command scheduling has problems, and providing a more accurate scheduling scheme.

title_en: Intelligent flood sensing decision-making method for multi-source rainfall data fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster decision making, and discloses an intelligent flood sensing decision making method for multi-source rainfall data fusion; the method comprises the steps of constructing a space integrated rainfall monitoring network, collecting a multidimensional rainfall data set in real time, carrying out time alignment and space registration on the multidimensional rainfall data set to generate rainfall processing data, carrying out data fusion on the rainfall processing data to form fused rainfall data, obtaining hydrologic environment data, constructing a hydrologic dynamic model, driving the hydrologic dynamic model to operate based on the fused rainfall data to obtain water flow characteristic data, evaluating flood risk grades of different urban areas by combining the water flow characteristic data and the fused rainfall data, and dynamically formulating a differential emergency response scheme by combining a historical disaster database.

title_en: A gasholder simulation and management system with history of its parts
title_ko: 가스저장탱크 시뮬레이션 이력관리시스템
abstract_en: A system for managing record of gas storage tank simulation is provided to prevent big accidents of a sewage treatment plant by making a remote manager visually view an operation of a gas storage tank and directly understand failure symptom of a gas storage tank, and keep the gas storage tank in an active state by timely checking the gas storage tank with a part record management system. A sensor system(1000) includes the gas storage tank(100), a gas leakage sensor(200), a temperature sensor(300), a gas pressure sensor(400), and a pressure level meter(500) attached to the gas storage tank, and a processing unit including a CPU(600), a memory(900), an ADC(Analog Digital Converter)(700), and a communication controller(1100). The processing unit outputs a locking signal to an automatic safety value and stores accident generation data to the memory when abnormality generated in the gas storage tank is detected through the sensors. A record management system includes a simulation system(1700), a processor connecting the part record management system(1800) and the simulation system, and a report processor. The simulation system visually displays the operation and a status of the gas storage tank and includes an alarm processor.
