title_en: Emergency power system with the solar system
title_ko: 태양광발전 시스템을 갖는 비상 전원 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a systematically linked emergency power system and, more specifically, to an emergency power system having a solar system which automatically supplies and cuts off power to or form a load using distributed power as a solar system linked to a system power source. [Reference numerals] (210) Solar cell module;(221/222) Inverter;(300) AC;(510) Overcharging voltage/current detector;(520) Voltage/current detector;(530) Switching control circuit;(610) Common load;(620) Preliminary load;(AA) System power source;(BB) Overcharging voltage detection;(CC) Bus;(DD,EE) S/W, On-Off control;(FF) Voltage/current signal detection when outage happens;(GG) On-Off control;(HH) Common power supply;(II) Voltage detection
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 태양광발전 시스템을 갖는 비상 전원 시스템에 관한 것으로, 계통 전원(100)과 분산 전원인 태양광발전 시스템(200) 사이에 통상부하(610)와 예비부하(620)를 갖는 분전반(300)이 설치되며, 계통 전원(100)의 정전 사고 시, 계통 전원(100)을 단속하는 제1 스위칭 회로(310)로부터 검출된 정전 신호를 사전에 프로그램화된 제어 알고리즘을 갖는 제어회로 시스템(500)의 스위칭 제어회로(530)에서 인버터 제어용 지령 전류를 연산 처리한 후, 태양광발전 시스템(200)에 내장된 복수개의 파워 컨디셔너(220a,220b)으로 피드백(Feedback)시켜, 태양전지모듈(210)의 발전을 단속하는 제2 스위칭 회로(240)와 충ㆍ방전 시스템(260)을 단속하는 제3 스위칭 회로(250) 및 분산 전원을 분전반으로 자동 공급하고 차단시키는 비상용 스위칭 회로(400)를 개폐 제어하도록 하는 태양광발전 시스템을 갖는 비상 전원 시스템을 구현으로써, 계통 전원(100)의 정전 사고 시에, 태양광발전 시스템(200)으로 하여금 부하 계통으로 교류 전력을 자동적으로 공급하도록 하고, 계통 전원의 정전 복구 시에는 분산 전원인 태양광발전 시스템(200)에서 발전된 교류 전력의 공급을 자동적으로 차단시켜 충전모드로 전환하도록 하는 계통연계형 전력변환 시스템(Power Conditioning System,PCS) 모드와, 부하조건 및 2차 전지(배터리)의 상태에 따라 부하 계통의 최대 전력을 감소시키기 위한 부하관리(Demand Side Management,DSM) 모드 기능을 동시에 수행할 수 있는 독특한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Kiosk System for Education
title_ko: 교육용 키오스크 시스템
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention relates to a kiosk system for training. The technical task to be solved is to provide the kiosk system for training that allows the digitally underprivileged who are difficult to use kiosks that are common in daily life to repeatedly experience various types of kiosk programs (e.g., theaters, trains, civil petition machines, etc.) in one kiosk (device) to be helpful in real life thereof. To this end, the present invention comprises: a kiosk program module part in which a plurality of training kiosk programs are stored; a touch screen that displays screens of the training kiosk programs to a user and receives a command by a touch of the user; and a control part that loads, executes and displays a selected training kiosk program on the touch screen when one of a plurality of training kiosk programs is selected by the touch of the user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예는 교육용 키오스크 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 기술적 과제는 일상 생활에 보편화된 키오스크의 사용이 어려운 디지털 소외 계층을 대상으로 여러 종류의 키오스크(예를 들면, 극장, 기차, 민원 발급기 등) 프로그램을 하나의 키오스크(기기)에서 구현 반복 체험 실습을 통해 실생활에 도움이 될 수 있도록 한 교육용 키오스크를 제공하는데 있다. 이를 위해 본 발명은 다수의 교육용 키오스크 프로그램이 저장된 키오스크 프로그램 모듈부; 사용자에게 교육용 키오스크 프로그램의 화면을 표시하고, 사용자의 화면 터치에 의한 명령을 입력받는 터치 스크린; 및 사용자의 화면 터치에 의해 다수의 교육용 키오스크 프로그램 중 하나가 선택되면, 선택된 교육용 키오스크 프로그램을 로딩하고 실행하여 터치 스크린에 표시하는 제어부를 포함하는, 교육용 키오스크 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Centralized management mode backup disaster recovery system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a centralized management mode backup disaster recovery system, which comprises: a control console ( 104 ) for performing centralized control on a data container ( 105 ), a backup process module ( 103 ), storage medium ( 101 ), and a standby machine ( 102 ) through respective control operations; a production server ( 108 ) responsible for controlling and managing data circulation between the production server and the storage medium in unit of data blocks; a backup process module ( 103 ) for backing up data to storage space allocated for the production server ( 180 ) by the storage medium ( 101 ) through an mirror technique and a synchronous or asynchronous technique or any other backup methods; the storage medium ( 101 ) for storing data and allocating a logic unit ( 200 ) to the production server ( 108 ) for data storage; the standby machine ( 102 ) for storing system data of the production server ( 108 ) and completing automatic running and setting of the standby machine ( 102 ) through the control console ( 104 ); and the data container ( 105 ) for recording operation modes, data information, and command requests of the control console, the production server, the backup process module, the storage medium, and the standby machine through data condition update.
assignees: LI TAK HO ALEX;ZHENG CRAVIN;SHUM PING;BIZCONLINE LTD

title_en: Portable emergency command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a portable emergency command system, which is characterized by comprising a host microcomputer, audio and video equipment, terminal equipment and individual positioning audio and video communication equipment, wherein the host microcomputer comprises a VGA (video graphics array), a digital video recorder, a remote audio and video server, a four-picture divider and a PC (personal computer) server; the audio and video equipment comprises a curtain motor control circuit, a master control circuit, an LED (light-emitting diode) driving board, an interface circuit and a speaker; the terminal equipment comprises a host microcomputer power supply, a power interface, a signal transfer board and a switch. The portable urban emergency command system has complete command post functions, can be used for finishing decision-making, commanding and scheduling within first time, is high in portability, reliability and maintainability, easy to store, arrange and operate, economical and practical, and can be quickly built and used on the spot.
assignees: SUZHOU CUIZHI NEW TECH DEV CO

title_en: Digital twin body system of spaceflight launching field
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twin body system of a space launching field, which comprises a data acquisition module, a launching auxiliary module, a launching module and a drop point simulation module, wherein the data acquisition module comprises a scene modeling system, an air temperature and humidity simulation module, an air temperature and humidity change simulation system, a wind speed simulation module and a wind speed change simulation module, the launching auxiliary module comprises a ground command module, a ground operation module, a space launching module and an audio simulation module, and the launching module comprises a rocket loading module, a fuel loading module, an ignition module and an orbit trimming module. The beneficial effects are that: the data acquisition module, the emission auxiliary module, the emission module and the landing point simulation module simulate the occurrence scene of the spacecraft, and the emission of the spacecraft is simulated in a mathematical modeling mode for recording emission data, so that the simulation experiment is carried out on the aerospace emission in a mathematical model mode, the accuracy of the aerospace emission in reality is improved, and the effect of reducing risks is achieved.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE CHAOYI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Automatic dispatching method and device for government affair hotline
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for automatically assigning government affair hotlines, wherein the method obtains a first tendency characteristic by a first grade account and a concerned time of a concerned list of all accounts bound by a user number of a current government affair hotline, wherein the first grade account comprises an official account and a large v account, calculates the relativity of browsing records and searching records of all accounts, correlates the relativity exceeding a threshold value, then summarizes the relativity to obtain a second tendency characteristic, and matches the first tendency characteristic and the second tendency characteristic with a special line hotline characteristic set to realize the automatic assignment of the current government affair hotline. Therefore, the first trend characteristic of the invention implies the trend of attention of the recent user and the problems possibly encountered by the recent user, the second trend characteristic implies the demands of the user, the automatic dispatch of the current government affair hotline is realized in an active pre-judging mode, the citizens do not need to carry out multi-round conversations, the citizen experience is optimized while the conversation time of the current government affair hotline is shortened, and the dispatch efficiency is improved.
assignees: FUJIAN GOVERNMENT NETWORK STATION OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Application method of distributed key updating and recovering mechanism for Internet of things security
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of Internet of things security, in particular to a method for using a distributed key updating and recovering mechanism of Internet of things security, which comprises the following steps: step 1, key generation and initialization: generating a public-private key pair through HSM safety, and recording the public key by using a blockchain technology to ensure the transparency and safety of key distribution; step 2, updating the dynamic key: integrating time triggering and event driven updating strategies, and combining a multi-layer encryption technology to ensure confidentiality and integrity of the updating process; step 3, distributed consensus and verification: the consistency of the whole network key updating operation is ensured by utilizing Raft protocols and the like, and the tamper resistance is enhanced; and 4, key recovery and emergency response, wherein the key safety and management problems in the environment of the Internet of things are effectively solved by comprehensively utilizing modern cryptography, blockchain and distributed system theory, and a solid foundation is laid for constructing a future safe and stable ecological system of the Internet of things.
assignees: UNICOM SHANGHAI IND INTERNET CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise safety production combined control information management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise safety production combined control information management system, which relates to the technical field of production combined control information management and comprises a collection module, a data processing module, a safety management module and a response module, and is optional. The invention has the advantages of realizing dynamic assessment of safety risks, carrying out intelligent early warning according to the change trend and the severity of the risks, improving the accuracy and timeliness of early warning, realizing quantitative analysis of the dispersion degree of the safety risks, providing scientific basis for emergency response, realizing quick response and intelligent scheduling, improving the accident handling efficiency, realizing quantitative assessment of emergency response capability, providing accurate guidance for the formulation and implementation of emergency measures, improving the accuracy and the effectiveness of emergency treatment, and realizing dynamic early warning and accurate positioning of risk sources and improving the accuracy and timeliness of early warning by utilizing the wind speed and flow speed data monitored in real time.

title_en: Mud-rock flow disaster early warning method and emergency response system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a debris flow disaster early warning method and an emergency response system based on big data analysis, which belong to the technical field of geological monitoring, and specifically comprise the steps of collecting and preprocessing watershed topography, weather, geology, vegetation coverage and historical debris flow event record data, and acquiring image data by combining a remote sensing technology; the method comprises the steps of extracting and integrating the data and image characteristics to form a debris flow characteristic data set, constructing a debris flow early warning model by utilizing a limited volume model, a deep learning algorithm and an Internet of things detection technology and combining an integrated learning method, training and verifying through historical data, issuing early warning information and starting a dynamic response mechanism when the model predicts risks, and finally, feeding back and optimizing and adjusting the early warning model according to response effects.

title_en: Air environment pollution degree detection system and method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of air pollution detection, and particularly relates to an air environment pollution degree detection system and method based on big data. The invention realizes detection and early warning of the pollution degree of the air environment by mining and analyzing the multi-source environment data, adopts a dynamic weight distribution strategy when determining the pollution comprehensive index in a monitoring area, thereby effectively improving the calculation precision of the pollution comprehensive index, improving the accuracy and timeliness of air quality monitoring, and in addition, by constructing a space-time correlation matrix and calculating a correlation strength coefficient, the invention can automatically identify the correlation between abnormal types, provides scientific basis for emergency response, and meanwhile, the bimodal early warning mechanism provided by the invention can distinguish instant abnormality from normalized abnormality, avoids the problems of resource waste caused by false report or missing report and untimely emergency response, and ensures the continuity and stability of air quality monitoring.
assignees: WEIHAI XUANJI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: River and lake burst pollutant leakage cross-boundary pollution real-time monitoring and disposing system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a river and lake burst pollutant leakage cross-boundary pollution real-time monitoring and disposing system and a method, wherein a dynamic monitoring system of the system is provided with more than one monitoring point in a burst pollution system and a conventional pollution system, pollution information is obtained through real-time monitoring and is transmitted to an intelligent control system, and the intelligent control system is connected with a water quality purifying system and a hydrodynamic force regulating and controlling system; the burst pollution system, the conventional pollution system and the water quality purifying system are arranged on two sides of the river channel along the river channel, control gates are arranged at the upstream and downstream of the river channel and at the junction between each system and the river channel, and the water quality purifying system comprises ecological purifying ponds arranged at the upstream and downstream of the river channel. The emission condition of new pollutants of each pollution source is monitored in real time through the flow and concentration monitor, meanwhile, the hydrologic condition of a river channel is clarified through the water level and flow velocity monitor, and the monitored data are sent to the intelligent control system through the signal transceiver to realize real-time monitoring, command execution and data feedback, so that the intelligent control system has the advantages of timeliness, science, accuracy, flexibility and the like.

title_en: Park safety environment-friendly emergency integrated management and control platform
abstract_en: The invention provides a park safety and environmental protection emergency integrated management and control platform, which belongs to the technical field of park safety and environmental protection emergency management and comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a park multidimensional data acquisition network, acquiring safety, environmental protection, equipment operation and personnel flow data in real time, S2, carrying out fusion processing on the acquired data by adopting a dynamic weight self-adaptive algorithm, establishing a safety and environmental protection risk assessment model, S3, constructing a park virtual mapping body based on a digital twin technology, S4, analyzing the fused data by utilizing a deep learning algorithm, predicting potential safety and environmental protection risks and generating early warning information, S5, establishing a hierarchical response mechanism, and S6, tracking the whole emergency treatment process to form closed loop management. The method solves the problems of incomplete data acquisition, unsmooth information sharing, insufficient risk assessment accuracy and timeliness, low emergency response efficiency and lack of closed-loop management and self-adaptive learning mechanisms in the existing park safety and environmental protection emergency management.
assignees: GUANGDONG NANLING DOUBLE CARBON RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-equipment linkage emergency command scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of safety dispatching, and discloses a multi-equipment linkage emergency command dispatching method, which comprises the following steps: in the multi-equipment linkage emergency command, the synchronous precision is ensured by dynamically compensating delay data and adaptively adjusting reporting frequency. And monitoring the signal intensity in real time, predicting the chain breakage risk, and intelligently screening the relay equipment with balanced load to construct an emergency network. The accident scene is divided into space units, and the task precision matching is realized by comprehensively analyzing the event density and the equipment adaptability. And generating a scheduling sequence by combining the task interaction strength and the equipment response capability, and carrying out path correction and energy consumption assessment according to the environment safety state. Parameter coordination is realized among the devices through state broadcasting, and the individual states of the super threshold are automatically adjusted to optimize resource allocation. And after the task is completed, generating a multidimensional efficiency record, and realizing intelligent merging of space units and optimization of a plan through similarity analysis of scene feature vectors to form a closed-loop management command system.
assignees: HANGZHOU YINGSIPU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus and method for detecting leakage current
title_ko: 누전 감지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A current leakage detecting device and method are provided to detect the generation of current leakage from a monitoring object in real time by using a thermal camera, thereby preventing damage to human lives and spreading of the current leakage. CONSTITUTION: A current leakage detecting device includes a thermal camera (100), a setting part (200), a current leakage determining part (300), and an alarm part (400). The thermal camera records a thermal image of at least one monitoring object region. The identification information, allowed temperature, and recording cycle for the monitoring object region are set up at the setting part. The current leakage determining part measures the temperature of the recorded thermal image and determines that a current leaks from a monitoring object if the measured temperature exceeds a reference value. The alarm part outputs a result of the current leakage determination with an alarm. [Reference numerals] (100) Thermal camera; (200) Setting part; (300) Current leakage determining part; (400) Alarm part; (500) Transmission part; (600) Power supply part
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 감시 대상의 누전 발생을 검지하여 2차 사고를 방지하는 누전 감지 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  누전 감지 장치는 적어도 하나 이상의 감시 대상 영역에 대한 열상 영상을 촬영하는 열상 카메라, 감시 대상 영역의 식별정보, 허용온도 및 촬영 주기를 설정하는 설정부, 촬영된 열상 영상의 온도를 측정하여, 측정된 온도가 기준값 이상인 경우 감시 대상의 누전을 판단하는 누전 판단부 및 누전 판단 결과를 경보로 출력하는 경보부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.  본 발명에 따르면 열상 카메라를 이용하여 감시 대상의 누전 발생을 실시간으로 검지하여 인명피해 및 누전 확산을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for emergency situation message system using road facility
title_ko: 도로 시설물을 이용한 긴급상황 알림 시스템 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system to notify an emergency situation using a road facility; and a method thereof. The system comprises: a report button; a wireless AP; a road facility to transmit a message to notify an occurrence of an emergency situation with identification information if the report button is pressed; and a central control server to determine a location of the road facility by receiving the message to notify the occurrence of an emergency situation and control the wireless AP to transmit an emergency alarm message to the mobile terminals located in a service area of the wireless AP. As such, the present invention allows a user to request help to another user in proximity to the location before an expert, who is able to take control of the situation of the accident, arrive during a case of an emergency which needs an immediate action, or if an accident situation needs to be recorded or observed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 시설물을 이용한 긴급상황 알림 시스템 및 그 제어방법에 관한 것으로서,  신고버튼, 무선AP 및 상기 신고버튼이 선택된 경우 고유정보와 함께 위급상황 발생 메시지를 송신하는 도로 시설물; 및 상기 위급상황 발생 메시지를 수신하여 상기 도로 시설물의 위치를 판단하고, 상기 무선AP의 서비스 지역 내에 위치한 이동 단말기에 긴급 안내 메시지가 송신되도록 제어하는 중앙관제서버를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 즉각 적인 조치를 취해야 하는 위급한 상황이거나, 사고 상황을 기록, 혹은, 관찰해야 하는 경우, 사고 수습을 위한 전문가가 도착하기 이전에 근접한 위치의 사용자에게 도움을 요청할 수 있다.
assignees: JUNG-BU SECURITY CO LTD;DO DAE WOOK

title_en: System of deploying videophone and early warning
abstract_en: A device and method for surveillance and early warning detection of undesired activity comprising local videophone and a remote videophone for the purposes of surveying a predetermined area with the local videophone and sending images of the captured information to the remote videophone for real time observation. The method also comprises at will surveillance of the predetermined area by calling the local videophone from the remote videophone to turn the local videophone on, conducting surveillance, and transmitting the captured information, in real time, to the remote videophone. The captured information may be recorded on the remote videophone, by a service provider, or by an emergency response team.

title_en: Mobile property data recorder and transmitter
abstract_en: The application relates to a mobile asset data recorder and transmitter. An acceleration-based athletic data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel quantity sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor circuit board. The inertial navigation sensor circuit board includes: a three-axis gyroscope, a three-axis accelerometer, a three-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allow for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with collision detection, detection of rough operating conditions, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of moving objects. Users are able to locate areas of their property that encounter harsh operating environments and alert in real time using the normal operation of their mobile property, provide faster emergency response, and make repairs and new routing effective.

title_en: Earthquake motion information conversion method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for converting earthquake motion information, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring first earthquake motion information to be converted; inputting the first earthquake motion information into a pre-established earthquake motion information conversion model to obtain first emergency treatment information corresponding to the first earthquake motion information; the earthquake motion information conversion model is a mathematical model established by using a Petri network time sequence modeling mode; the first emergency treatment information is output. Therefore, the embodiment of the invention can realize the rapid conversion from earthquake motion information to emergency treatment information, can save earthquake emergency response time, improve earthquake early warning precision and improve the accuracy and timeliness of an earthquake early warning system.

title_en: Fire control receives and processes police joint command system based on cloud
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire control, in particular to a fire control receiving and processing alarm combined command system based on cloud service; the method comprises the steps of receiving an alarm by an alarm receiving person, judging the alarm condition scale according to telephone content, and sending out early warning information through an alarm touching device; the invention discloses a method for managing and managing fire emergency rescue, which comprises the steps of inputting alarm information by an alarm receiving module, generating an action ticket, uploading the action ticket to cloud service, enabling a firefighter to acquire the action ticket through synchronous service, connecting a portable fire terminal through communication service by an alarm processing module, receiving rescue information acquired by the portable fire terminal, uploading the rescue information to an upper command mechanism through synchronous service for remote joint scheduling command, acquiring the alarm information and the rescue information through an analysis module, constructing a five-dimensional analysis model according to a k-means cluster analysis method, realizing the whole rescue process check of action ticket record, further analyzing the reason and the rescue result of the alarm, summarizing the loss and experience of corresponding emergency rescue, and improving the alarm efficiency of the fire emergency rescue under the follow-up similar alarm conditions.

title_en: Crime geography information system based on location
title_ko: 위치 기반의 범죄 지리정보 시스템
abstract_en: A location-based crime geographical information system is provided to acquire a clue on criminal investigation and share the information by constructing and using crime geographical information database. A location based crime geographical information system of location-based comprises followings. A police office server(100) coverts a criminal record, CCTV, public phone, mobile communication base station information to location based information which is markable on a electrical map, and stores the data. A regional police office computer registers information necessary for criminal investigation to the police server which converts data information in which the payphone base transceiver station information is included into location underlying data can express on the digital map and storing in the database part and managed. A mobile phone having GPS signal receiving function receives command information from the police office server, and displays it on a screen.
abstract_ko:

title_en: Cabinet panel/low-voltage distributing board inside voice-warning device for over-heating protection
title_ko: 과열보호 음성경보장치가 내장된 분전반/저압배전반
abstract_ko:
운전 중 온도상태를 감시하여 과열상태가 발생할 경우 온도-시간에 따른 한시 특성에 따라 경보를 발생함은 물론 최종적으로 차단기를 동작시켜 화재사고 등을 방지하기 위한 과열보호 음성경보장치가 내장된 분전반/저압배전반이 개시된다. 
개시된 과열보호 음성경보장치가 내장된 분전반/저압배전반은, 상기 분전반 또는 저압 배전반의 부스 바(Bus Bar) 또는 케이블 접촉부에 설치되어 주변 온도를 검출하는 온도 센서와; 상기 온도 센서에 의해 검출된 온도와 메모리에 미리 내장된 한계온도를 비교하여 1차적으로 경보를 발생시켜 주의를 환기시키고, 경보중에 과열상태가 지속되고 있다고 판단될 경우 2차적으로 온도-시간에 따른 한시 특성에 맞게 미리 설정된 제어 프로그램을 기반으로 트립 과정을 제공하며, 차단기 동작을 위한 트립 잔여 시간의 표시를 제어하는 메인 컨트롤 유닛과; 상기 메인 컨트롤 유닛과 연동하여 차단기 동작을 위한 트립 잔여 시간을 표시해주는 표시장치; 및 상기 메인 컨트롤 유닛과 연동하여 상기 트립 잔여 시간을 음성으로 송출해주는 잔여시간 음성 경보부를 포함한다.

title_en: It is vehicle-to-vehicle directly to receive and dispatch the anti-emergency warning device that knocks into the back of automatic transmission
abstract_en: Vehicle-to-vehicle can directly receive and dispatch provided by the utility model transmits the anti-emergency warning device that knocks into the back automatically, it is characterized in that：In radio in the operating system of automobile, automobile-used, in automotive avigraph, in driving recorder for vehicle, in mobile phone and in the quick transceiver of independent car networking, be provided with auto electronic flash of light triangle brand and can receive decoding and transmitting coding and automatic integrated control module (2), wireless receiving and the wireless transmission for transmitting coding and the wireless integration module (3) transmitted automatically；Its good effect is：Allow on highway each automobile to shift to an earlier date 300 and 600 meters to hear：The urgent warning of " front occurs emergency, asks pre-decelerating ", the safe distance for being equivalent to increase by 300 and 600 meters of pre-decelerating to each rear automobile or stop in advance, the impulse inertia that just can thoroughly mitigate high speed car；Avoid fiercely colliding at a high speed, avoid big traffic congestion of a chain of car crash accident to knock into the back, reduction highway etc. at a high speed from playing positive effect.

title_en: The service of registering based on personal button of seeking help
abstract_en: In personal emergency response system (PERS), subscriber wears the individual with call button (12) and seeks help button (PHB) (10).Speaker-phone console (30) detection by the PHB signals launched and establishes the call with PERS centers (8) when the call button is pressed.The PHB, speaker-phone console or its combination also perform process of registering, and the process of registering includes：Detection (50) is registered the time, and exports (52) to performing the request for action of registering, and detects whether (54) perform the action of registering.If detect the action of registering, then it is recorded (56).If it is not detected by action of registering, then perform remedial action (60,62,64,66,68,70,72).The action of registering can be the designated movement of PHB, and the designated movement is detected by analyzing by the Gesture Recognition Algorithm performed by the PHB of the sensing data of motion sensor (22) generation of PHB.

title_en: Cross-organization workflow operation method and system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based cross-organization workflow operation method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: a plurality of organization modules acquire certificates issued by CA nodes; a plurality of organization modules register the webService service provided by each organization module to a service registry; the first organization module establishes a business process model and sends a deployment command to the workflow engine; the workflow engine analyzes the business process model and stores the analysis content into the data object; the first organization module sends a flow instance execution command to the workflow engine; the workflow engine creates a business process instance and executes the business process instance, and the first organization module records the process of executing the business process instance and the service request process on the blockchain. The invention can reduce the data coupling degree of the cross-organization business system, reduce the cost of data integration and solve the multi-party trust problem of the cross-organization business process.

title_en: Visualization system for grid emergency management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visualized system for grid emergency management, which comprises a control terminal, a control terminal and a control terminal, wherein the control terminal is used for commanding and supervising in emergency; the monitoring system is used for monitoring the real-time condition of each area; the sensing system senses whether fire disaster occurs in each area by using sensing devices installed in each area; the voice broadcasting is used for carrying out voice broadcasting reminding on the fire disaster area so as to carry out direct mobilization of personnel; and the regional distribution map displays a building topographic map of the fire area when the monitored area is in fire. The visual system for meshing emergency management can display the building topographic map of a fire disaster area when a fire disaster occurs, so that people can be better assisted to evacuate and evacuate, videos and pictures in different periods of the fire disaster can be classified, recorded and saved, analysis on the change process of the disaster condition is facilitated, and images for evacuating and evacuating people in the fire disaster process can be recorded.

title_en: Intelligent emergency disposal method for hydrogen leakage explosion accident of hydrogen adding station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of safety emergency treatment of a hydrogenation station, and discloses an intelligent emergency treatment method for hydrogen leakage explosion accidents of the hydrogenation station, which is realized by constructing an intelligent emergency response system and combining an accident domino effect network evolution model; the method comprises the following steps of accident evolution analysis, intelligent auxiliary decision making, emergency resource allocation, real-time monitoring and feedback. The intelligent algorithm based on real-time data analysis, simulated evolution and risk assessment automatically generates an optimal emergency treatment strategy, provides decision support for emergency commanders, ensures quick and accurate decision, can accurately extract the risk factor most prone to secondary accidents, avoids emergency response temporarily in the accident process, improves predictability and timeliness of accident control, and reduces personnel, property loss and influence to the greatest extent.
assignees: SHAANXI COAL NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;SHAANXI COAL INDUSTRY XINNENG HYDROGEN ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multisource fire data fusion and fire analysis prediction system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire monitoring and prediction, in particular to a multi-source fire data fusion and fire analysis prediction system which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a data fusion module, a fire analysis module and an early warning module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for acquiring fire data of various sources, the data preprocessing module is used for preprocessing the fire data, the data fusion module is used for carrying out fusion processing on the multi-source data output by the data preprocessing module, the fire analysis module is used for identifying the current situation and the fire source position of a fire and predicting the fire spreading direction, and the early warning module is used for timely sending out early warning signals. According to the invention, the occurrence, the spread and the risk level of the fire disaster can be accurately monitored in real time by the multisource fire disaster data fusion and intelligent analysis prediction technology, so that the timeliness and the accuracy of the fire disaster emergency response are effectively improved.
assignees: SHANDONG LONGCHENG FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-node infrared warning internet of things system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of fire safety and emergency rescue, and particularly discloses a multi-node infrared warning Internet of things system. According to the scheme, holographic fusion sensing is carried out on monitoring data of multiple nodes, space-time alignment and weighted fusion are carried out, abnormal events scattered in space are aggregated into cluster events representing fire spread, false alarm caused by local interference is greatly reduced, a fire scene range is accurately positioned, and an optimal path of a dynamic risk grid graph and fire rescue is constructed through multi-factor risk quantification, so that decisions and real-time situations are tightly bound, overall cost is minimized while assessment precision is guaranteed, and dynamic combination of command decisions and risk sensing is realized.

title_en: Campus public health safety early warning and emergency response system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application relates to an artificial intelligence-based campus public health safety early warning and emergency response system. The system comprises a data acquisition processing module, a risk level analysis module, an alarm risk prediction module, a resource allocation optimization module and a resource allocation optimization module, wherein the data acquisition processing module acquires multi-department data and preprocesses the multi-department data to output a preliminary data set, the risk level analysis module determines a quantized potential risk level through a support vector machine and a decision tree algorithm based on the data set, the alarm risk prediction module pushes an alarm after comparing a threshold value, matches an optimal response sequence and combines real-time feedback to generate a potential risk evolution path, and the resource allocation optimization module generates and optimizes a resource allocation strategy according to the potential risk evolution path and generates a cooperative response execution log after reaching standards. The system breaks the data barriers through the cooperation of multiple modules, improves the risk identification precision and early warning timeliness, realizes the dynamic optimal configuration of resources, promotes the management to change from passive treatment to active prevention and control, and improves the standardization and intellectualization level.

title_en: System and apparatus for controlling doorlock key using mobile communication terminal
title_ko: 이동통신 단말기를 이용한 도어락 제어 시스템 및 장치
abstract_en: A system and an apparatus for controlling a door lock key using a mobile communication terminal are provided to store a security state of a door lock controller by embedding a smart card in the door lock controller. A door lock controller(100) includes a sensor, a smart card, and a cellular phone module. When an object is detected for a predetermined time interval, the door lock controller pictures the object and transmits the image to a mobile terminal. When a door control signal is received from the mobile terminal, the door lock controller releases the door lock. When an abnormal signal is detected from a security sensor in the smart card, the door lock controller transmits a door emergency signal to a security server. The mobile terminal(200) stores a door control application program. When the door emergency signal is received, the security server(400) determines a current position of the door lock controller and delivers an emergency call to a security team.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이동통신 단말기를 이용한 도어락 제어 시스템 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 이동통신 단말기를 이용한 도어락 제어 시스템은, 센서, 스마트 카드, 휴대폰 모듈이 내장되어 있으며, 상기 센서에서 소정시간 이상 피사체가 감지되면, 카메라부에서 상기 감지된 피사체를 촬영하여, 상기 스마트 카드에 등록되어 있는 이동통신 단말기로 상기 촬영된 영상 또는 이미지를 전송하고, 상기 이동통신 단말기로부터 도어 제어 신호가 수신되면, 상기 신호에 따라 도어락을 해제하는 도어락 제어 장치; 도어 제어 응용 프로그램을 내장하고 있으며, 상기 도어락 제어 장치로부터 전송된 방문자 영상 또는 이미지를 디스플레이하고, 사용자에 의해 도어락 제어 신호가 입력되면, 상기 입력된 신호를 상기 도어락 제어 장치로 전송하거나, 사용자에 의해 도어 비상 신호가 입력되면, 보안 서버로 상기 비상 신호를 전송하는 이동통신 단말기; 상기 이동통신 단말기 또는 도어락 제어 장치로부터 도어 비상 신호가 수신되면, 도어락 제어 장치의 현재 위치를 판단하여, 보안대에 긴급 출동 명령을 전달하는 보안 서버;를 포함함에 기술적 특징이 있다. 
       
     도어락, 보안 서버, 원거리, 이동통신 단말기, 휴대폰 모듈

title_en: Board game for study and board game method using it
title_ko: 일차식의 계산방법 학습용 보드게임 기구 및 이를 이용한 보드게임 방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a board game device for calculation method learning of a linear expression. The board game device for a calculation method learning of a linear expression includes: a game board formed in a square shape and having multiple boxes as multiple protrusion grids are alternately formed on a board surface in a vertical direction and in a horizontal direction; a tile unit comprising an unknown quantity tile in which ′x′ and ′-x′ are individually printed on the board surface and a number tile in which ′1′ and ′-1′ are individually printed on the board surface; multiple question cards on which two linear expressions are printed; and an answer board formed in the square shape in the half size of the game board and having the multiple boxes as multiple lines protrude in the horizontal direction and the vertical direction from the board surface. So, the board game device enables a middle school student user to learn the calculation method of addition, subtraction, and the linear expression of a whole number by selecting one method among three calculations calculated by two linear expressions recorded on the card, in other words, among the addition or the subtraction of deducting two kinds of the answers in accordance with order and by placing and arranging the tile on the board by using the answer deducted by the selection of the three calculations. Also, the board game device can improve multifunctional brain training and mathematical problem solving ability by enabling the middle school student user to learn various studies of strategic thinking and space formation ability.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 정방 형상으로 형성되며 판면에 가로 방향과 세로 방향을 따라 복수의 돌출격자가 교차 형성되어 복수의 칸이 형성된 게임판과; 판면에 'x', '-x'이 각각 인쇄된 미지수 타일과, 판면에 '1','-1'이 각각 인쇄된 숫자 타일로 이루어지는 타일부와; 두 개의 일차식이 인쇄된 복수의 문제카드와; 상기 게임판의 1/4의 크기로 정방 형상으로 형성되며 판면에 가로 방향과 세로 방향을 따라 복수의 선이 돌출되어 복수의 칸이 형성된 정답판을 포함한 것을 특징으로 하는 일차식의 계산방법 학습용 보드게임 기구를 제시함으로써, 중학생 사용자에게 카드에 기재된 두 개의 일차식으로 할 수 있는 세가지 셈, 즉, 덧셈이나 순서에 따라 두 가지 답이 나올 수 있는 밸셈 중 하나의 방법을 선택하여 나온 정답으로 보드판 위에 타일을 놓아 배열해 갈 수 있도록 하여 정수의 덧셈, 뺄셈, 일차식의 계산방법을 익히며 전략적 사고와 공간구성능력 등의 다양한 학습을 할 수 있도록 하여 다기능의 두뇌훈련 및 수학적 문제해결력을 향상킬 수 있다.

title_en: smart helmet for firefighters
title_ko: 소방관용 스마트 헬멧
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소방관용 스마트 헬멧에 관한 것으로, 공기 질 감지센서에 의하여 공기중의 유해가스를 감지하여 위험을 방지  함으로써 소방관의 안전을 확보하기에는 아쉬운 문제점을 해소하도록 한 것이다. 
즉, 본 발명은, 스마트 안전 헬멧 
에 있어서 공기중의 유해가스를 감지하여 위험을 방지 측면또는 전면에 위치하고 이상 시 외부 led에 이상표시한 공기 질 감지센서, 온도가 급격히 상승, 임계온도를 넘을경우 경고음으로 착용자에게 위험을 경보 외부에 위치 작고 얇은 디스크 경량화 한 실시간 온도 감지센서, 사용자가 강한 충격을 받을 경우 자동으로 경고, 신호를 발송 헬멧의 내부 상단한 충격감지 및 경고기능, 위험한 작업 환경에서 작업자의 위치를 지속적으로 모니터링하여 사고 발생 시 신속하게 구조 요청이 가능하도록 하고, 특정 지역(예: 위험 구역)에 진입하거나 이탈할 경우 경고를 발송하여 작업자가 안전한 경로를 유지하도록 돕고, 사용자가 사고를 당할 경우, GPS 시스템을 통해 정확한 위치 정보를 전송하여 구조대나 관리자에게 빠르게 위치를 알릴 수 있게  GPS 모듈이 헬멧의 내부 상단이나 후면에 장착되어, 신호 수신에 방해가 없도록 위치한 GPS 위치 추적 시스템, 현장 작업 상태를 원격으로 모니터링하거나, 사고 발생 시 기록된 비디오를 즉시 전송하여 구조 및 대응 작업에 활용할 수 있게 측면 또는 전면에 구성한 헬멧 내장 카메라 및 통신 시스템을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 공기 질 감지센서에 의하여 공기중의 유해가스를 감지하여 위험을 방지 하여, 소방관의 안전을 확보하기에는 아쉬운 문제점을 해소하도록 함으로써, 기존의 소방관의 안전을 확보하기에는 아쉬운 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: A device and system for sending emergency alerts on roads using CCTV, sound and VMS
title_ko: Cctv, 음향 및 전광판을 활용한 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a system for transmitting a road unexpected situation alarm, capable of suppressing a secondary accident caused by a following vehicle by detecting an unexpected situation on a road by using a cctv, a sound, and an electric sign installed on the road. According to the present invention, the apparatus for transmitting an emergency signal of an emergency signal of a road comprises: an image acquisition unit; an emergency signal detection unit; and an emergency signal output unit. The cctv image recording from cctv installed at the image acquisition part is on the road is gotten. The outbreak situation sensor senses the outbreak situation whether or not to the outbreak situation sensing model about the cctv image gotten. The alarm signal output unit outputs an alarm signal when an unexpected situation is detected. At this time, the unexpected situation detection model is modeled by machine learning the cctv image, but machine learning is performed by dividing the time, season, and weather at the time of capturing the cctv image into variables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 위에 설치되는 CCTV, 음향 및 전광판을 활용하여 도로 위 돌발상황을 감지하여 후속차량에 의한 2차 사고를 억제할 수 있는 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치는 영상 획득부, 돌발상황 감지부 및 경보 신호 출력부를 포함한다. 영상 획득부는 도로 상에 설치된 CCTV로부터 촬영된 CCTV 영상을 획득한다. 돌발상황 감지부는 획득한 CCTV 영상에 대한 돌발상황 감지 모델로 돌발상황 여부를 감지한다. 그리고 경보 신호 출력부는 돌발상황이 감지되면 경보 신호를 출력한다. 이때 돌발상황 감지 모델은 CCTV 영상을 기계학습 하여 모델링 하되, CCTV 영상을 촬영하는 시점의 시간, 계절 및 기상을 변수로 구분하여 기계학습 한다.

title_en: Mirroring file data
abstract_en: High availability and disaster recovery can be achieved within a database management system by detecting which parts of a file have changed and sending the changed parts to secondary servers, without sending the entire file that has experienced the changes. A log cracker reads data from a transaction log that stores records from a database and a separately maintained file system. The log cracker sends mirror commands with some of the transaction log data to the file system to initiate mirroring of the data from the file system to secondary servers. The log data is then subsequently sent to the secondary servers as well, to enable identification of changed data without having to transfer the entire file that has been changed.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.

title_en: Real-Time Data Acquisition and Recording System
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) for mobile assets that includes a data recorder. The data recorder includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queuing repository. DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data acquired by DARS through a web browser, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Systems and methods for generating graphical user interfaces relating to determined parametric events
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing a graphic user interface. The systems and methods may (1) receive an indication of a parametric event involving a vehicle; (2) provide a series of component graphic user interfaces, wherein the component graphic user interfaces may be configured to (i) initiate a claim filing, (ii) communicate with an insurer entity, (iii) communicate with an emergency response entity, (iv) communicate with a towing service entity, (v) communicate with a taxi or ride-share service entity, (vi) communicating with a vehicle repair service entity, (vii) communicating with a vehicle salvage entity, and/or (viii) communicating with a vehicle rental service entity; (3) detect one or more user interactions that may include one or more selections of the one or more actions; (4) perform the one or more actions; and/or (5) record a transaction indicating that the one or more actions has been performed to the blockchain.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Extracting shared state information from message traffic
abstract_en: An approach to having a shared state from one system to another is to represent data in one system according to service traffic of the other system For example, by intercepting service traffic associated with a first entity, identifying a data object representing at least a portion of the state of the first entity in the service traffic, and updating a corresponding portion of a shared state data structure in accordance with a value of the data object, the shared state can be maintained outside of the first entity This process can be extended to maintaining shared state of more than one entity The service traffic might be e-mail service traffic, database service traffic, or the like Synchronization commands can be used to initiate at least a portion of the service traffic The shared state can be used for backups, record-keeping, service migration, disaster recovery, fail-over and/or fault tolerance improvements

title_en: Client use method for high-speed mobile vehicle scheduling based on 5G technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a client-side using method of high-speed mobile vehicle dispatching based on a 5G technology, which comprises the following steps of 1) inputting travel information of a specified train number at a client-side of a system dispatching center by a system dispatcher, determining a first time point, recording the first time point on a table, keeping a fixed call of each station with a train number contact person and checking, 2) simulating a route map of the specified train number at the client-side of the dispatching center, determining two station nodes with larger distances and marking red by using software, and 3) communicating with the train contact person and determining final departure time when a train is first. According to the invention, unnecessary occurrence of people flow control is avoided, and meanwhile, through the complete emergency plan, staff can take their own role, get on the train is accelerated in a mode of maintaining order, the defect of train delay is avoided as soon as possible, and therefore, the train running is more punctual and efficient while the dispatching effect is improved.

title_en: Internet of things fire protection facility early warning method and system based on data processing
abstract_en: The invention provides an Internet of things fire-fighting facility early warning method and system based on data processing, which relate to the technical field of digital processing, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing a fire information distribution map; generating a fire-fighting facility adaptation level; acquiring a fire-fighting facility adaptation specification set; building a fire-fighting facility dispatching management platform; connecting a hydrant pressure monitoring terminal, a spraying pipe network pressure detecting terminal and a fire-fighting water source liquid level detecting terminal, and guiding the real-time monitoring data set into a fire-fighting facility dispatching management platform; judging whether to activate a facility early warning signal through a fire-fighting facility early warning system; and if the facility early warning signal is activated, packaging and sending the facility early warning signal to an emergency treatment column of the fire-fighting facility early warning system. The technical problem of the state early warning timeliness of thing networking fire control facilities is poor is solved, the fire control facility specification of intelligent matching target area has been reached, the state early warning of thing networking fire control facilities in time carries out the activation judgement of facility early warning, provides the technical effect of support for timely fire control facility maintenance.

title_en: Public health management system for processing trace source of cash microorganism data of financial system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, and provides a public health management system for processing trace sources of cash microorganism data of a financial system. The system comprises: recording the date and the geographic position of each banknote when the banknote flows back; acquiring a long-time circulation characteristic descriptor and a short-time circulation characteristic descriptor of each paper money; obtaining a geographical circulation range index, a reflux stability index and an activity rating index of each banknote; obtaining a microorganism characteristic descriptor of each paper currency; obtaining a public health event, obtaining a plurality of circulation modes by using clustering, obtaining general microorganism feature descriptors of each circulation mode, obtaining an adjusted public health event, obtaining a token Q corresponding to each record, obtaining an LOF value according to each cash situation feature, reducing the illusion phenomenon of LLM training based on the proportion of Dropout obtaining the token Q, and inputting the token Q and a plurality of guide sentences into the LLM to obtain an emergency response scheme.

title_en: Data center system for centralized management and displaying underground monitoring and control data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data center system for centralized management and display of underground monitoring and monitoring data, and relates to the technical field of centralized management and display of underground monitoring and monitoring. The data center system for centrally managing and displaying underground monitoring and monitoring data comprises a parameter acquisition and analysis module, an early warning parameter analysis module, a three-dimensional image acquisition and analysis module, an intelligent ventilation module, an early warning module and a data cloud platform, wherein monitoring and analysis are carried out on the aspect of environment and natural disasters caused by mining factors of mines, so that timeliness of timely processing potential safety hazards of the mines is improved, safety monitoring and analysis results of the mines are more comprehensive and rich, data of a monitoring and monitoring system are centrally managed in the data center and are used as important data supports of a digital mine management system, and more convenient and efficient measures are provided for emergency command, safety production management and production scheduling.

title_en: Tunnel emergency remote control system
title_ko: 터널 비상 영상 원격 감시제어시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A tunnel emergency monitoring remote control system is provided to monitor accidents or emergency situations occurred inside a tunnel on a real time basis, thereby effectively handling the emergency situations by automatically transmitting monitoring images. CONSTITUTION: A sound measurement device(200) installed inside a tunnel detects sound created from a target place. An image recording device(300) records images of surrounding places and vehicles within a fixed section of the tunnel by receiving a recording signal transmitted through an image remote controller(400). The image remote controller detects an abnormal state by receiving a sound signal measured through sound measurement device or a detection signal transmitted from an emergency situation detection device. The image remote controller transmits a message to a user according to a detection result or acquires the image by transmitting a recording signal to the image recording device. The emergency situation informing device(500) informs an emergency situation to the user by receiving an emergency signal from the image remote controller. A traffic information collection device(700) transmits emergency situation information to a mobile terminal or a navigation terminal by acquiring the emergency signal and location information transmitted from the image remote controller.
assignees: HUSE CO LTD;DAE YOUNG CO LTD

title_en: A Danger point sign device for Underwater Worker
title_ko: 수압과 전도도를 이용한 잠수작업자의 사고위치표시장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an accident position indication apparatus of an underwater worker using water pressure and conductivity, which automatically detects (measures) the water pressure and the conductivity changed in accordance with an underwater depth to automatically detect an emergency situation when a detected (measured) value is greater than each set value of the water pressure and the conductivity, so as to automatically inflate a buoy and inform danger of the outside, and an accident position indication method thereof. According to the present invention, the water pressure and the conductivity of the water, at which the underwater worker is placed, are measured to check the position of the underwater worker, who frequently goes up and down in water, such that the position of the underwater worker is checked. In particular, since a water pressure measurement method and a conductivity measurement method have merits and demerits, respectively, both methods are properly combined and supplemented to realize high reliability. Moreover, according to the present invention, both of the water pressure and conductivity measurement methods are simultaneously applied and implemented (performed) as one module, and the buoy floating on a water surface to indicate an accident and allowing a victim to lean thereon is integrally formed (made), such that an additional device is not required and a separate device is not installed on a body of the underwater worker when the underwater worker wears the accident position indication apparatus for an underwater worker using a water pressure switch and conductivity of the present invention, and thus the accident position indication apparatus is able to be simply used. Moreover, the accident position indication apparatus is operated when two options, which a conductivity measurement value satisfies a programmed set value and the pressure switch satisfies the pressure equal to or greater than a predetermined pressure, are simultaneously satisfied, such that malfunction is hardly generated in use, thereby being usefully used by fishermen working in a severe environment. According to the present invention, the accident position indication apparatus comprises the water pressure switch, a conductivity measurer, and a microcomputer unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 수중의 깊이에 따라 달라지게 되는 수압 및 전도도를 자동으로 감지(측정)하여 감지값(측정값)이 수압 및 전도도의 각 설정갑보다 클 경우에 위급상황이 자동으로 감지되어 부이를 자동으로 팽창시키고 위험사실을 외부에 알리도록 된 수압과 전도도를 이용한 잠수작업자의 사고위치표시방법 및 사고위치표시장치이다. 본 발명은, 수시로 수중과 수면을 왕복하는 수중작업자의 위치를 파악하기 위하여 수중작업자가 위치하고 있는 수압과 전도도를 측정하여 수중작업자가 수중 또는 수면에 위치한 것을 파악하고, 특히 수압측정방법 및 전도도 측정 두 가지의 측정방법은 각각의 장단점이 있으므로 이를 적절히 조합 및 보완하여 줌으로써 매우 높은 신뢰도를 가질 수 있다. 또 본 발명은, 수압측정방법 및 전도도 측정 방식 두 가지를 동시에 적용하고, 두 가지 방식을 하나의 모듈로 구현(실시)하며, 사고 시에는  수면으로 부상하여 사고를 표시하고 사고자가 의탁하게 되는 부이도 일체형으로 형성(제작)하여 줌으로써, 수중작업자가 본 발명에 따른 수압스위치 및 전도도를 이용한 잠수작업자용 사고위치표시장치를 착용 할 때에는 별도의 추가적인 장치가 불필요하고 신체에 별도의 장치를 추가 설치하지 않아도 되는 매우 간편하게 사용할 수 있다는 것이다. 또한 본 발명은, 전도도측정값이 프로그램된 설정치를 만족하고 압력스위치가 일정이상의 압력을 만족하여야 한다는 두 가지 조건이 동시에 충족하여야 작동(동작)하므로 사용 시 오동작이 거의 없어 열악한 환경에서 조업하는 어선원들은 매우 유용하게 사용할 수 있다.

title_en: Control system using mobile app for safety and security in construction field of nuclear power plant with improved security function
title_ko: 보안성이 강화된 모바일 앱을 이용한 원자력발전소 설비 공사 현장 안전 및 보안 관리용 시스템
abstract_en: A system for managing safety and security at a nuclear power plant facility construction site using a mobile app according to the present invention includes a smartphone, a central control unit, a location analysis server unit, an access gate, and an administrator terminal device.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 모바일 앱을 이용한 원자력발전소 설비 공사 현장 안전 및 보안 관리용 시스템은 공사 현장 근로자가 휴대하며 터치스크린부와 각종 센서부재를 포함하여 구성되는 스마트폰과, 이동통신망을 통해 상기 스마트폰과 통신되도록 구성되는 중앙제어부와, 상기 스마트폰의 위치를 분석하기 위한 위치분석서버부와, 상기 스마트폰의 공사 현장 출입을 단속하기 위한 출입게이트와, 상기 중앙제어부를 통해 상기 스마트폰 관리용 데이터를 입력하기 위한 관리자단말장치를 포함하며, 상기 중앙제어부에는 관리용 프로그램이 저장되는 모바일 앱을 이용한 원자력발전소 설비 공사 현장 안전 및 보안 관리용 시스템으로서, 상기 관리자단말장치로부터 상기 중앙제어부를 통해 상기 스마트폰으로, 작업일의 온도와 습도와 강수량과 미세먼지 농도와 풍속 및 작업중단 시간을 포함하는 안전상황항목과, 작업장에 위치하는 근 로자들이 알아야할 내용을 포함하는 포함하는 공지사항항목과, 근로자가 이수해야할 교육과정과 안전교육계획과 상기 교육과정에 필요한 교육자료를 포함하는 안전교육항목과, 안전에 관련된 사항을 근로자들이 신고할 수 있도록 제공되는 자율안전신고항목과, 당일 시공작업 내용을 관리자에게 보고할 수 있도록 제공되는 당일작업상황보고항목과, 작업을 중지해야할 사항에 관한 정보를 포함하는 작업중지사항항목과, 공사 관련자들 간의 채팅을 위한 채팅항목과, 공사 관련 작업자들의 건의사항을 제안할 수 있도록 제공되는 건의사항항목을 전송하고,  상기 관리자단말장치로부터 상기 스마트폰으로 전송되는 항목들에는 보안등급이 부여되며, 상기 근로자에 대해서는 보안등급이 부여된 항목에 접근하여 정보를 열람할 수 있는 정보열람등급이 부여되며, 상기 항목들 중 지정된 보안등급의 항목에 대해서는 정보를 열람할 수 있는 시간이 설정되도록 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의해, 원자력 발전소의 설비 공사 현장 상황에서 요구되는 보안 사항과 안전관련 사항을 효율적으로 관리하고 근로자들에게 전달할 수 있으며, 설비 공사 현장 상황 및 교육자료 등에 대한 보안을 효과적으로 유지하고, 이의 외부 반출을 방지할 수 있다. 
또한, 안전에 관한 사항을 근로자들이 원활히 공유하고, 직관적이면서도 신속히 확인할 수 있어, 스마트폰 조작이 번거로운 공사 현장 상황에서도 효과적으로 알릴 수 있고, 안전에 관한 사항을 근로자들이 확인하였는지 여부를 신뢰성 있게 확인할 수 있다. 
그리고, 공사 현장에서 발생되는 각종 문제에 대한 해결 방안 제안을 장려할 수 있고, 해결 방안에 대한 객관적인 평가가 이루어질 수 있으며, 공사 현장에서 사고가 발생되는 경우, 이에 대한 즉각적인 조치가 취해질 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for assignment of equipment to an officer
abstract_en: A system for tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment to security agency personnel (e.g., officers, administration, command, armorer). An armorer is assigned the task of tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment. Equipment may be assigned to a particular individual officer. The equipment provided to and used by officers may capture (e.g. gather, produce) information (e.g. audiovisual information, data logs, recordings). Equipment may provide information to the armorer via near field communication (NFC) circuits. The information captured may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system. The information captured by equipment assigned to a particular individual may be associated with that individual. An armorer may use information supplied by equipment, evidence management system, officers, or other sources to assist in the assignment process.

title_en: Comprehensive alarm and rescue system for personnel falling into water in offshore wind farm
abstract_en: The utility model provides an offshore wind farm personnel drowning comprehensive alarm rescue system, which comprises a marine central monitoring system, a life jacket with a position indicating mark, a shipborne DSC wireless radio station device, a broadcast control system, a lifeboat and a land central monitoring system; the alarm of the life jacket is wirelessly connected with a shipborne DSC radio station device or an AIS device of a lifeboat, the shipborne DSC radio station device is connected with a broadcast control system by adopting an audio cable, the broadcast control system is connected with a marine central monitoring system by adopting a control cable, and the marine central monitoring system is connected with a control module box of the lifeboat by adopting a control cable; the offshore central monitoring system is connected with the onshore central monitoring system through optical fibers and communicates through an optical transceiver SDH. The utility model has the advantages that: the real-time sharing of the position information of the person falling into the water and the lifeboat and the optimization and navigation of the rescue path improve the timeliness of emergency response of the person falling into the water and the high efficiency of rescue.

title_en: Deformation monitoring auxiliary device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of deformation monitoring auxiliary devices, in particular to a deformation monitoring auxiliary device, which comprises: the surface of the deformation monitor is provided with an alarm mechanism; the alarm mechanism comprises an alarm connected to the top of the deformation monitor through an electric wire, the bottom of the deformation monitor is fixedly connected with a bearing plate, the inner wall of the bearing plate is clamped with a connecting frame, and the bottom of the connecting frame is fixedly connected with a fixing pile; utilize fixed pile, wire rope, observation stake, first trigger piece and second trigger piece in the device, realized observing that the stake takes place the displacement and drive wire rope and remove on the side slope, make first trigger piece and second trigger piece offset and touch, and then realized the alarm sound of siren, be convenient for in time monitor the deformation of warning play side slope, guarantee that the staff can in time make emergency response, improved the timeliness that uses deformation monitoring auxiliary device.
assignees: HUANGSHAN LINGCHUANG SURVEYING AND MAPPING CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for dispatching police strength
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and system for dispatching police strength.The method includes the following steps that the position information and the state information of the police strength are obtained through a positioning device, and the obtained position information and the obtained state information are dynamically shown to an electronic map at a police strength dispatching terminal; the warning condition or the position information of a destination is obtained; command information is recorded at the police strength dispatching terminal; selected police strength information and selected command information on the electronic map are sent to a backstage server terminal according to data flow with the specified format; the backstage server terminal sends the command information to a routing node of a specified mechanism of a message distribution intermediate device according to the selected police strength information; the warning condition or the position information of the destination and the command information are pushed to mobile receiving terminals of selected police strength.By means of the method and system, the aims of accurate information transfer of accurately dispatching police and rapidly dispatching police are achieved, police strength resources are saved, alarm dispatching efficiency is improved, the quality of performing a task is increased, and unnecessary police strength resource wasting is saved.
assignees: CIIC ANDA (BEIJING) TECH DEV CO LTD

title_en: Programming device, recording medium, and programming method
abstract_en: The invention provides a programming device, a recording medium, and a programming method, which enable a user to easily understand the relationship between a programming operation and the movement of a three-dimensional object of a controlled part corresponding to a program generated by the operation. The programming device has: a programming board (120) that accepts at least one first user operation for specifying a planar shape by specifying two or more portions among a plurality of portions arranged at mutually different positions in the planar direction; a height receiving unit configured to receive at least one second user operation for indicating a height, which is a position in the intersecting direction of the planes, or an amount of displacement of the height, in association with any one of the two or more portions; and a control unit that generates a command list for moving the target device (200) in accordance with the three-dimensional shape instructed by the programming board (120) and the height receiving unit.

title_en: A kind of method and electronic equipment for editing code in teaching programming video
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the methods and electronic equipment of code in a kind of editor's teaching programming video.Teaching programming course includes teaching audio and video tab file, and videomark file includes a series of play command, and play command is marked according to the time stores the operational order for needing the code information and response that show；Feature operation area receives play instruction and plays teaching audio, while showing that editing area shows the code with teaching audio sync in code；Pause instruction is received, pause teaching audio, which plays while saving code, shows the code that editing area has shown that, and code is made to show that editing area enters programming state；Show that editing area input coding content and/or the code for showing that editing area has saved to code are edited in code；Operation code shows code generating routine operation result in editing area after the completion of programming.Present invention real-time synchronization in teaching process shows programming code, and student can edit and run to the code in course at any time, save student's time, improve the quality of teaching.

title_en: City public affairs based on artificial intelligence technology defend emergency management and rescue aid decision-making system
abstract_en: City public affairs based on artificial intelligence technology defend emergency management and rescue aid decision-making system, and unmanned plane includes locating module, camera and face recognition module, and locating module acquires current location geographical location information, camera floor real-time pictures；Backstage command centre include: receiving module receive current location geographical location information and corresponding live real-time pictures；Disaster determination module determines the specific Disasters Type in scene to live real-time pictures image recognition；Rescue demand module analyzes rescue requirement, drug demand and device requirement according to Wound characteristic；Wounded's locating module enters the disaster local range search that traffic above-ground can not approach according to live real-time pictures manipulation unmanned plane；Face recognition module finds the stranded wounded, positions current location geographical location information when having the stranded wounded；Receiving module receives the image and geographical location information for the stranded wounded that transmission comes；Case history has access to module and is recorded according to the medical history that stranded wounded's image querying is stranded the wounded and reach field rescue personnel.

title_en: Emergency generator car configuration method and computer network system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of emergency repair of electrical equipment, and discloses an emergency power generation car configuration method, which comprises the following steps: 1. collecting records of multi-source data cases aiming at historical disaster sites, and selecting and determining a power failure emergency repair correlation factor; 2. determining the optimal emergency power generation vehicle configuration strategy for each case; 3. training a power generation vehicle configuration strategy selection model network based on a multilayer back propagation neural network by using sample data; 4. acquiring real-time data of a disaster site; 5. and inputting the multidimensional information data acquired in real time at the power disaster site into the model to obtain the optimal configuration of the emergency power generation car in real time. The invention also provides a computer network system which comprises an emergency power-generating car configuration module and a processing circuit, wherein the emergency power-generating car configuration module is stored with the power failure emergency repair correlation factor, and the processing circuit can call the emergency power-generating car configuration module to execute the emergency power-generating car configuration method. The method and the system can achieve the real-time acquisition of the optimal power generation vehicle configuration strategy, guide the field emergency command decision and improve the emergency repair efficiency.

title_en: Information technology education training system
abstract_en: The invention provides an information technology education training system, and relates to the field of education services. This information technology education training system, including education terminal, user side, communication terminal, interactive end, cloud storage, take signal connection through communication terminal between education terminal and the user side, education terminal includes processing unit, display screen, camera, microphone all take electric connection with processing unit, processing unit is including switching module, the module of keeping in, sending module, processing unit's inside still is provided with dispatch module, preparation module, electric connection between dispatch module and the module of keeping in. The training system can record the content in advance, a teacher can record and analyze questions of a trained person in the remote training process, and the remote training in a separated form can reduce the working intensity of the teacher and is more beneficial to the resolution of the teacher to the questions.

title_en: Method for extracting effective data in batches based on monitoring data of earthquake station
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for extracting effective data in batches based on monitoring data of a seismic station, when seismic waves propagate to a seismic detector, the method causes the sensing element in the detector to vibrate and converts mechanical vibration signals into electric signals, the electric signals are converted into EVT digital signals through the signal conversion module, and EVT files are sent to the earthquake testing analysis software through the communication module. And (3) performing preliminary combing on the seismic data in the seismic analysis software to obtain parameters such as the position of the middle earthquake, the moment of earthquake initiation, the earthquake level and the like. Converting EVT files into SAC files by using vibration measurement analysis software, starting Jupyter Notebook at an operation terminal, opening a Notebook file, calling a python library function in a Notebook window to execute a command, extracting the earthquake time and the vibration amplitude recorded by the SAC files, calculating the speed and the acceleration under the corresponding time based on the time and the vibration amplitude, and writing the obtained data into an Excel file.

title_en: Intelligent traffic Internet of things fault monitoring and control system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent traffic Internet of things fault monitoring and controlling system, which belongs to the technical field of fault detection, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition module is configured to acquire running state data of traffic Internet of things terminal equipment in real time through a heterogeneous communication interface, the terminal equipment at least comprises traffic signal lamps, a vehicle-mounted sensor and road monitoring equipment, the equipment attribute, the data timeliness and the environmental state parameters are effectively fused through a multidimensional dynamic priority scheduling module, the transmission priority weight is dynamically generated, and the network load self-adaptive polling and competition time slot proportion dynamic adjustment is realized by combining a hybrid access control module, so that the fault positioning precision, the resource utilization efficiency and the emergency response instantaneity of the system under a high-density equipment scene are improved.

title_en: Garbage discharge device of garbage collection system and garbage discharge method using it
title_ko: 쓰레기 자동집하시스템의 쓰레기 투입장치 및 쓰레기투입방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A garbage discharge device of a garbage collection system and a garbage discharge method using the same are provided to manage garbage easily, and to prevent garbage from mixing input with good usability. CONSTITUTION: A garbage discharge device of a garbage collection system includes a garbage storage area, an input device, and a collecting pipeline. The input device includes a recognition device and a plurality of waste inlets. The input device is embedded on the ground to guide the garbage to the garbage storage area. The input device includes a garbage bag recognition module(10), a user identifying module(20), an interface(40), a display(45), and a control part(50).
abstract_ko: 종량제 쓰레기 봉투와 일반쓰레기 봉투를 모두 사용 가능하며 쓰레기의 혼용 투입을 방지하는 한편 봉투 선별을 정확히 함으로써 쓰레기 수거 관리를 용이하게 하는 쓰레기 자동집하시스템의 쓰레기 투입장치 및 쓰레기 투입방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 쓰레기 자동집하시스템의 쓰레기 투입장치 및 투입방법은 쓰레기 봉투를 인식하여 복수개 마련되는 쓰레기 투입구 중 해당하는 어느 하나를 개방하여 쓰레기를 분리 수거하기 때문에 봉투 선별을 정확하여 쓰레기 혼입 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있다. 또한 바코드가 인식 안 되는 종량제 쓰레기 봉투 또는 일반 쓰레기 봉투도 키패드, RFID나 복수의 바코드 카드, 모바일 등으로 쓰레기 봉투 정보를 획득하고, 획득된 정보가 기록된 식별코드를 쓰레기 봉투에 붙여 버리도록 함으로써 추후 잘못 폐기된 쓰레기 봉투를 확인할 수 있도록 하였으며, 나아가 식별코드 발급 내역을 저장함으로써 쓰레기 처리 비용을 후불 정산할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.
assignees: HYOLIM IND CO LTD;KOREA LAND COPORATION

title_en: Apparatus for searching scene of marine accident area using unmanned aerial vehicle, method thereof and computer recordable medium storing program to perform the method
title_ko: 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장을 수색하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for searching a marine accident area by using an unmanned aerial vehicle, a method therefor, and a computer readable recording medium storing a program to perform the method. Accordingly, the present invention provides a control apparatus for searching a marine accident area, a method therefor, and a computer readable recording medium storing a program to perform the method. The control apparatus comprises: a communication unit provided to communicate with an unmanned aerial vehicle; and a control unit dividing a predetermined area into a plurality of cells having a square column shape, a size of which is predetermined according to a communication range of the unmanned aerial vehicle, deriving at least one cell belonging to the shortest path when a cell, designated as a search area among a plurality of cells, and a cell, in which the control apparatus is located, are connected by a cell unit, designating the derived cell as a cell to constitute a network, and assigning the unmanned aerial vehicle to each derived cell.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 이러한 본 발명은 무인항공기와 통신하기 위한 통신부와, 소정 지역을 상기 무인항공기의 통신 범위에 따라 규격이 결정되는 정각기둥 형상의 복수의 셀로 구분하며, 복수의 셀 중 탐색 지역으로 지정된 셀과 상기 관제장치가 위치한 셀을 셀 단위로 연결했을 때, 최단 경로에 속하는 적어도 하나의 셀을 도출하고, 상기 도출된 셀을 네트워크를 구성할 셀로 설정하며, 상기 도출된 셀 각각에 대해 무인항공기를 배정하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 관제장치와, 이에 따른 방법과, 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: Electric Powered Vehicle Emergency Charging Service System
title_ko: 전기 동력 차량 긴급 충전 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an electric powered vehicle emergency charging service system.
