Provided is the electric powered vehicle emergency charging service system, which includes: an electric powered vehicle equipped with a vehicle information terminal (OBD) which records and displays measured remaining battery information; a server which receives an emergency rescue signal from a vehicle information terminal when the remaining battery of the electric powered vehicle is measured below a set reference value; and an emergency rescue vehicle which matches and dispatches according to the emergency rescue signal transmitted to the server. According to the present invention, the emergency charging between the electric powered vehicle and the emergency rescue vehicle is facilitated by utilizing the remaining battery information measured through the vehicle information terminal (OBD) in the electric power vehicle.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기 동력 차량 긴급 충전 서비스 시스템에 관한 것으로, 측정된 잔여 배터리 정보를 기록하며 표기하는 차량 정보단말기(OBD)가 장착된 전기 동력 차량; 상기 전기 동력 차량의 잔여 배터리가 설정 기준치 이하로 측정될 시에 상기 차량 정보단말기로부터 긴급 구난 신호를 전송 받는 서버 및 상기 서버로 전달된 긴급 구난 신호에 따라 매칭되어 출동하는 긴급 구난 차량을 포함하는 전기 동력 차량 긴급 충전 서비스 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for coordinated dispatch in rail transit emergency conditions
abstract_en: The present invention is suitable for the field of traffic dispatch, and provides a method and system for coordinated dispatch in rail transit emergency conditions. The method comprises: monitoring the operation state and location of a train in real time; simulating the operation location of the train in a tunnel; inferring the actual location of the train in the tunnel, analyzing the actual operation condition of the train, and carrying out recording when the train state is abnormal; and sending a dispatch policy to a rail station near the train by means of an information interface, and increasing the frequency of real-time monitoring of the rail station. In the absence of accurate train information, the location and operation state of the train can be obtained by means of simulation and a sound sensor, so as to provide more accurate dispatch basis and guarantee safe operation of the train. The method can solve the technical problems in the prior art of poor signals in tunnels and inability to obtain train information, and improve the emergency dispatch effect and accuracy.

title_en: Mobile asset data recorder and transmitter
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allows for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with impact detection, rough operating condition detection, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of a mobile asset. Users can use the normal operation of their mobile assets to locate and alert, in real-time, areas where their assets are encountering rough operating environments, to provide for quicker emergency response, and to validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting.

title_en: Managing a patient injured in an emergency incident
abstract_en: A method and system employed by emergency responders to an emergency incident in the management of individuals injured in emergency incidents. An injured patient is tagged with a triage tag that has a bar code and an RFID inlay that identify the patient. At least one of the bar code and RFID inlay are scanned by a portable optical/electronic unit. As the patient is moved through various zones in which the condition of the patient is evaluated and, if necessary, the condition of the patient is treated, patient evaluation data is recorded in the in the portable optical/electronic unit and a command computer in association with patient identification data.
assignees: VASQUEZ REUBEN C;JAMES HARRY B;VASQUEZ MICHAEL A

title_en: Wireless village broadcasting systems for safety and accident prevention
title_ko: 안전사고 방지를 위한 무선 마을방송 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a wireless village broadcasting system for accident prevention comprises: a listening unit including a sensing unit, an away setting unit, a communication unit, a recording unit, a conversion unit, an output unit, and a control unit; and a village broadcasting unit including the recording unit and an automatic broadcasting unit. Therefore, in case of an emergency or housebreaking situation while a resident is away, the wireless village broadcasting system automatically transmits the situation to a village broadcasting unit to broadcast the situation to a village in order to take a rapid measure about an accident or prevent theft.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 안전사고 및 불법침입 방지를 위한 무선 마을방송 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 마을방송정보를 무선 아날로그 신호 또는 무선 디지털 신호로 송출하는 마을방송부와 각각의 가정에 설치되고 상기 마을방송부로부터 상기 마을방송정보를 수신하여 청취하는 청취부를 포함하는 안전사고 방지를 위한 무선 마을방송 시스템에 있어서, 상기 가정 내에서 주거인의 움직임을 감지하여 정보를 생성하는 감지부와, 집안 출입시 외출정보 또는 외출해제정보를 생성하는 외출설정부와, 상기 마을방송부로부터 상기 신호를 수신하는 통신부와, 상기 감지부와 상기 외출설정부로부터 생성된 정보 및 상기 통신부로부터 수신한 정보를 저장하는 기록부와, 상기 통신부로부터 수신하는 신호를 음성정보 또는 문자정보로 변환하는 변환부와, 상기 변환부로부터 변환된 정보를 문자 또는 음성으로 출력하는 출력부와, 상기 감지부와 상기 외출설정부로부터 생성된 정보를 바탕으로 외출시 상기 가정 내에서 외부인의 움직임이 감지되거나 외출이 아닌 경우 주거인이 설정시간 동안 움직임이 없으면 이를 판별하여 긴급발생정보를 생성하고 생성된 정보를 상기 통신부를 통해서 상기 마을방송부로 전송하는 제어부를 구비하는 청취부 및 상기 청취부로부터 수신한 정보를 저장하는 기록부와, 상기 청취부로부터 긴급발생정보를 수신하여 긴급발생정보가 발생한 가정과 그 주변의 가정으로 기 설정된 재난정보를 자동으로 전송하여 방송하는 자동방송유닛을 구비하는 마을방송부를 포함하는 안전사고 방지를 위한 무선 마을방송 시스템에 의해 달성된다. 이에 따라, 주거인이 쓰러지거나 의식이 없을 때의 긴급상황이나 외출시 주거 침입이 있을 경우 이를 자동으로 마을방송부로 전송하여 마을방송을 함으로써 안전사고에 따른 신속한 조치 또는 도난을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: integrated image monitoring system based on IoT camera
title_ko: 사물 인터넷(IoT) 카메라 기반의 통합 영상 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated image monitoring system based on an IoT camera. The integrated image monitoring system of the present invention comprises a number of IoT camera units capable of detecting event occurrence by analyzing an image photographed by the camera while supporting communication and an integrated management server connected to a communication network in order to perform communication with the IoT camera units. The IoT camera unit comprises: a memory part where information as to surrounding IoT camera units is recorded in a surrounding IoT camera list file; and a terminal control part which detects event occurrence from the image photographed by the camera, and transmits an integrated monitoring request message requesting tracking of an object corresponding to event occurrence information from the surrounding IoT camera units registered in the memory part through a communication part if the detected event occurrence information corresponds to an integrated monitoring condition. The integrated image monitoring system based on the IoT camera provides the advantage of easy monitoring extendibility while mitigating calculation load of the integrated management server since each IoT camera unit detects an event related with an accident and can trace a tracking target object while networking with each other.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사물 인터넷 카메라 기반의 통합 영상 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 통신을 지원하며 카메라에 의해 촬상된 영상을 분석하여 이벤트 발생을 검출할 수 있도록 된 다수의 사물 인터넷 카메라 유니트들과, 사물 인터넷 카메라 유니트들과 통신을 수행할 수 있게 통신망에 접속된 통합관리서버를 구비하고, 사물 인터넷 카메라 유니트는 주변 사물 인터넷 카메라 리스트 파일에 주변 사물 인터넷 카메라 유니트들에 대한 정보가 기록된 기억부와, 카메라에 의해 촬상된 영상으로부터 설정된 이벤트가 발생했는지를 검출하고, 검출된 이벤트 발생정보가 통합감시조건에 해당하면 상기 기억부에 등록된 주변 사물 인터넷 카메라 유니트들에게 이벤트 발생정보에 해당하는 객체의 추적을 요청하는 통합감시 요청메시지를 통신부를 통해 전송처리하는 단말 제어부를 구비한다. 이러한 사물 인터넷 카메라 기반의 통합 영상 감시 시스템에 의하면, 사물 인터넷 카메라 유니트 각각이 사고와 관련된 이벤트를 검출하고, 상호 네트워킹하면서 추적대상 객체를 추적할 수 있어 통합관리서버의 연산부담을 완화시키면서 감시 확장성이 용이한 장점을 제공한다.

title_en: Smart Livestock Vehicle Prevention System for Livestock Disease Prevention
title_ko: 가축질병예방을 위한 스마트축산차량방역시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart livestock disease prevention vehicle system for livestock disease prevention, comprising: a complex livestock disease prevention station; a livestock farm; an integrated disease prevention control center; and an automobile livestock farm disease prevention system automatically sterilizing the livestock farm by a remote control command of the integrated disease prevention center, and detecting an inventory state of sterilizing chemical to display an alarm and request the sterilizing chemical to the complex livestock disease prevention station. Accordingly, livestock diseases are terminated in an early stage, and secondary infection and spreading are prevented in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가축질병예방을 위한 스마트축산차량방역시스템 에 관한 것으로, 가축질병예방을 위한 축산농가 방역시스템에 있어서, 축산농가 및 통합방역관제센터와 실시간 양방향 통신이 가능하며, 축산농가 방문차량에 대한 방역실시와 차량번호 및 운전자 정보를 기록하고 저장하는 축산종합방역소와; 상기 축산종합방역소와 통합방역관제센터의 정보를 수신 받아 축산농가 출입차량을 통제하고, 축산농가 방문 차량번호를 상기 축산종합방역소 및 통합방역관제센터로 전송하며, 상기 통합방역관제센터의 명령에 의해 자동으로 소독을 실시하는 축산농가와; 상기 축산종합방역소와 축산농가로부터 전송된 데이터를 데이터베이스화하고, 소독방역차량에 대한 모니터링과 긴급알람 및 분석모니터링하며, 축산농가 질병발생시 해당 축산농가를 비롯한 지역별 및 구역별로 동시 자동 방역실시를 원격제어 하는 통합방역관제센터와; 상기 통합방역관제센터의 원격제어 명령에 의해 자동으로 축산농가를 소독하고, 소독약품 저장 상태를 검출하여 알람표시 및 상기 축산종합방역소로 소독약품을 지원요청 기능을 수행하는 축산농가자동방역시스템을 포함하며; 가축을 도살하고 사료를 공급하며, 상기 축산종합방역소와 축산농가로부터 전송된 방역차량 및 운전자 소독관련 데이터를 수신 받아 도축장과 사료공장을 왕래하는 차량과 운전자를 통제하는 도축장 및 사료공장이 더 포함되는 것을 특징으로 하는 가축질병예방을 위한 스마트축산차량방역시스템을 구현함으로써, 가축질병을 조기에 종식시키고 2차 전염 확산을 사전에 예방하도록 한 것에 독특한 특징이 있다.

title_en: Device, system and method for screening of personally identifiable information
abstract_en: A device, system and method for screening of personally identifiable information is provided. An incident type of a particular incident is determined. Responsive to determining that potential evidence associated with the particular incident includes personally identifiable information, the potential evidence being of a particular evidence type including one or more of media and metadata generated by a user or a device associated with the user, a personally identifiable information processing mode is selected to process the potential evidence as a function of the incident type of the particular incident and an evidence type of the potential evidence. When selected mode is a storing mode, a record of the potential evidence is generated that included the personally identifiable information to be stored in an electronic storage device.

title_en: System and method for electronically obtaining and displaying contextual information for unknown or unfamiliar callers during incoming call transmissions
abstract_en: An incoming call from a source device having a source identifier is received at a receiving device and an indication of and request to accept the incoming call is provided at an output interface of the receiving device. A determination is made of whether this is a first time that the source device has called this receiving device or if the local address book is devoid of the source identifier or any associated contextual information associated with a user of the source device having the source identifier. If so, one or more databases of public safety incident information, call information, registration information, dispatch records, mobile application information, and location information is accessed and contextual information identified from the databases associating the source device with the receiving device. The contextual information is then provided at the receiving device while providing the indication of and request to accept the incoming call.

title_en: Shift hub dock for incident recording systems and methods
abstract_en: An incident recorder records original and supplemental incident information using a simplified user interface. A lead incident recorder may request any of several support tasks be accepted by other subsystems configured to Follow. Tactical support tasks may be requested. Communication support tasks may be requested. Collection support tasks may be requested. Collection support tasks may include directives for operation of an incident recorder.

title_en: Emergency command system based on 3G wireless network
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an emergency command system based on a 3G wireless network, which is especially suitable for handling with emergencies, is convenient to carry, can be quickly moved, deployed and put into use, and can be quickly removed after use. The emergency command system based on the 3G wireless network comprises master control equipment and a processing server which are arranged in a command center, wherein the processing server processes data received by the master control equipment. A video monitoring system also comprises a host machine carried by a single soldier and a camera connected with the host machine, wherein the host machine is used for carrying out digitization processing on video images shot by the camera and transmitting the processed video images to the master control equipment through the 3G network. When emergency occurs, the single soldier arriving at the spot can flexibly shoot the actual condition of the spot at the first time and transmit the actual condition of the spot to the monitoring command center through the host machine, and by combining with the 3G network, the transmitting speed is ensured, and the timeliness and effectiveness of the processing procedure can be further ensured.
assignees: ZHEJIANG NANLIAN TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Vibration feature sensor
abstract_en: This invention relates to a vibration feature sensor. With space navigation and satellite time service function, it comprises an acceleration vibration pickup, a waveform recorder, a real-time process chip, a protective shell, an A/D circuit board to convert the acceleration signal acquired by the vibration pickup into digital signal and input into the process chip, and a GPS antenna and signal process unit to take space position and time service according to the satellite signal from the antenna and process the signal for earthquake decision by the preset threshold as well as outputting command signal. This invention has high precision and reliability.

title_en: Law-enforcing management system based on combination of Internet and public security network
abstract_en: The invention provides a law-enforcing management system based on combination of Internet and public security network, and is suitable for the technical field of network management platforms. The system comprises at least one law enforcement recorder, at least one Internet police data assistant server and at least one public-security-network special server, wherein the law enforcement recorder uploads law enforcement data to the Internet police data assistant server in real time, the public-security-network special server calls the law enforcement data from the Internet police data assistant server, and a manager accesses the law enforcement data via a management application interface of the public-security-network special server and manage commands and scheduling of police affairs. According to the system, the law enforcement recorder uploads the data to the Internet server in real time, the manager or a visitor can access the law enforcement data via the server of the public security network, commands and scheduling are carried out in a unified manner, the efficiency of a police affair process flow is improved, and commands and scheduling are flexible and prevented from mistakes.
assignees: SHENZHEN BAIANDA SECURITY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Tent hospital emergency command information system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of tent hospital emergency command information systems, comprising: core layer, for providing data supporting, communication support for emergency command；Access layer builds on core layer and connect for realizing core layer with application layer communication；Application layer, for establishing emergency command network based on core layer；Wherein, application layer includes control centre and the communication terminal by control centre's dispatch control.It is that front command centre and commanding in the rear center carry out monitoring remote video, video conference service that tent hospital emergency command information system of the present invention can be communicated using 4G.Can in the case that can not general communication, command centre and the urgent communication channel in rear in front of fast construction provide satellite positioning, real-time communication service between commanding in the rear center, operation center, rescue team member.Rapid command information and field rescue information are provided for the disaster relief, gives full play to timeliness and accuracy application effect.

title_en: Automatic issuing method and automatic issuing system for heat supply network scheduling
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban intelligent heat supply, and particularly relates to a heat supply network dispatching automatic command issuing method and an automatic command issuing system, wherein the heat supply network dispatching automatic command issuing method comprises the following steps: constructing a historical fault database of the heat supply network; acquiring fault alarm data information of a heat supply network; performing fault pre-diagnosis according to the heat supply network fault alarm data information and a heat supply network historical database, and calling a corresponding processing scheme; acquiring a fault position of a heat supply network; sending the fault pre-diagnosis result, the heat supply network fault position and the processing scheme to corresponding managers so as to maintain the heat supply network fault; and after maintenance is finished, the fault of the heat supply network is fed back, so that the dispatching command sending time during fault alarm is greatly reduced, the efficiency of a dispatching mechanism is improved, and technical support is provided for the timeliness and the accuracy of dispatching commands.

title_en: Multi-process serial-parallel real-time tracking emergency management information system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency management information system for multi-process serial-parallel real-time tracking, which summarizes various resource information of each department through a resource management module, digitizes various special emergency plans aiming at specific emergencies through a digital plan management module, and realizes the real-time intercommunication of messages between a mobile terminal and a computer client program through a communication module of the system. When an emergency occurs, the command scheduling module of the emergency management information system based on the multi-process serial-parallel real-time tracking of the event can track and record the multi-process serial-parallel real-time disposal process of the emergency, the disposal process of a plurality of units can be monitored in parallel and in real time while the disposal of the whole event is monitored in serial, and the summary evaluation module can trace and reply the data record generated by the multi-process serial-parallel real-time tracking of the event.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring fire extinguisher
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of fire fighting, and particularly relates to an intelligent monitoring fire fighting device which comprises a thermal sensing camera, wherein a heat absorbing plate is sleeved on the back of the thermal sensing camera, the inner wall of the heat absorbing plate is fixedly connected with the outer surface of the thermal sensing camera, the upper surface of the thermal sensing camera is rotatably connected with an external sleeve through a wire pipe, and the top end of the external sleeve is fixedly connected with a hanging scaffold. At this section of time that the temperature rose, the sensible heat motor begins to rotate, one side that the sensible heat camera was shot is the conflagration point of origin promptly, the device can remind the person of monitoring through rotating the visual angle before the fire, some temperature is unusual, there is the possibility of firing, make relevant personnel cool down to the high temperature point, prevent the emergence of fire incident, secondly, after the conflagration takes place, the fire fighter can be according to the device's shooting video recording very first time locking source of firing, the valuable investigation time of fireman has effectively been reduced, the staff's of fire worker work efficiency has been improved.

title_en: Oil gas pipeline station integrity management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pipeline management systems, in particular to an oil and gas pipeline station integrity management system which comprises an acoustic wave monitoring module, a data analysis module, a multidimensional sensing diagnosis module, an environment assessment module, an abnormal behavior identification module, an automatic response protocol module, a maintenance plan optimization module and a risk management and reporting module. According to the invention, the state of the pipeline, including leakage and structural integrity, is accurately monitored in real time through the integrated acoustic wave monitoring and multidimensional sensing module, so that the accuracy and timeliness are improved. The data analysis and environment assessment module utilizes big data and machine learning to deeply analyze pipeline operation data, thereby providing deeper insight. The abnormal behavior recognition and automatic response protocol module efficiently manages risks and emergency responses, and ensures risk recognition and automatic response. Maintenance plan optimization, risk management scientific decision, resource allocation and cost benefit optimization, and system operation efficiency is improved.
assignees: XINJIANG DUYI HUANQIU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent auxiliary training system and method based on nuclear facility simulator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear facility operator training, and particularly relates to an intelligent auxiliary training system and method based on a nuclear facility simulator. Inquiring from a coach station database and a hardware interface point database of the nuclear facility simulator to generate a fault table, a fault group table and a platform screen hardware point table of the intelligent auxiliary training system database; realizing examination question editing, new construction and editing of training scenes, saving the examination questions and the training scenes to a question library and a scene library, and forming a scene file for each scene; loading a scene file generated by a scene editor, displaying scene content, transmitting a control command to a core facility simulator according to a time sequence, changing input model parameters so that each simulation model of the core facility simulator influences calculation, analyzing and executing evaluation logic codes, evaluating operation, and realizing multi-disc on the stored and recorded training data; and automatically collecting management scene execution data, and analyzing and counting. The cognitive depth of teaching staff on the training effect is enhanced, and the refinement and scientificalness level of training is improved.
assignees: RES INST NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION;CHINA NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION TECHNOLOGY CORP LTD

title_en: Signal worker operation training system and training method based on multi-module fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to a signal worker operation training system and method based on multi-module fusion. The training system comprises a simulation module, an interface module, a hardware module and an operation and maintenance module, wherein the simulation module is connected with the interface module through a real-time message bus, the interface module is connected with the hardware module and the operation and maintenance module through the real-time message bus, the simulation module sends an automatic control command and alarm information to the interface module, the interface module sends the automatic control command to the operation and maintenance system and sends the alarm information to the operation and maintenance module, the hardware module executes faults, the operation and maintenance module alarms, a signaler judges the faults of the hardware module, the fault judging result is returned to the simulation module, and the simulation module judges and records the correctness of the fault judging result. Compared with the prior art, the invention has the advantages of optimizing hardware cost, improving training efficiency, improving the working level of signal professional maintenance personnel, saving the learning cost of the professional maintenance personnel to a great extent, and the like.

title_en: Digital human intelligent body system for urban inland inundation management
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital human intelligent agent system for managing urban waterlogging, which belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence and comprises a data acquisition layer, a knowledge processing layer, an intelligent agent cooperation layer, a service function layer and an interactive display layer, wherein the data acquisition layer is configured to acquire multisource urban waterlogging prevention element data, the knowledge processing layer is configured to construct a knowledge graph of the urban waterlogging prevention element data and expand and update the knowledge graph, the intelligent agent cooperation layer is configured to coordinate task division and information sharing among various intelligent agents required by the system based on a multi-intelligent agent cooperation protocol, and the service function layer is configured to realize monitoring, prediction, assessment, emergency decision, information display and man-machine interaction of waterlogging based on various service subsystems. The invention realizes full-link intellectualization from data acquisition, information fusion, prediction simulation, evaluation optimization and emergency command to interactive question and answer, and remarkably improves timeliness, accuracy, usability and expandability of urban waterlogging management.
assignees: CLP CLOUD COMPUTING TECH CO LTD;UNIV CHINA GEOSCIENCES WUHAN

title_en: Fire fighting command system, fire fighting command method, and fire fighting command program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To effectively use information related to past cases, for improving activity accuracy of a fire fighting command activity when there is 119 emergency call.SOLUTION: A fire fighting command system comprises: a past case/case number storage device 208 for storing information related to activity results of cases of 119 emergency call, as information of past cases by case recording means 206; and a disaster point position/case number storage device 109 for storing disaster point positions of the past cases. When there is a dispatch command to a present case, the disaster point position/case number storage device 109 is searched by neighborhood past case search means 106, for extracting the disaster point positions of the past cases whose disaster points exist in a range being neighborhood of the disaster point of the present case, and mark symbols indicating the disaster point positions of the past cases are displayed on a map displayed by map display means 102, by screen display. When the mark symbol is selected by a mouth or the like, the past case/case number storage device 208 is searched for displaying information of the activity results related to the past cases, by screen display.

title_en: Ubiquitous guard system and service using helmet-type instrument
title_ko: 헬멧 형 유비쿼터스 안전관리 시스템 및 서비스
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A helmet type ubiquitous safety management system and a service thereof are provided to offer a ubiquitous safety management service by measuring a safety state of a target person and transferring a measurement result through USN(Ubiquitous Sensor Network). CONSTITUTION: Target persons(100) for safety management wear helmet type safety management equipments(200). A training and operation radius(600) is an activity radius of the target persons wearing the safety management equipments. A first monitor uses an armband type monitoring terminal(500). A second monitor(450) performs central safety management in a remote place.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 헬멧 형태의 유비쿼터스 안전관리 시스템을 이용해 대상인(예를 들어 군인, 소방수, 경찰, 공사장 인부 및 헬멧 착용 운동 선수)의 안전 상태를 측정하고 그 결과 또는(그리고) 그에 대한 해석(예를 들어 사고 발생 유무)을 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크(USN)를 이용하여 감시자의 감시 장비 혹은 중앙 감시시스템 서버에 전달하여, 유비쿼터스 안전관리 서비스를 제공하기 위해 시스템과 그 서비스에 관한 것이다. 
      발명에 해당하는 시스템은 가속도, 심박수, 뇌파, 위치 정보, 온도, 습도 계측이 가능한 센서들의 조합과 지능형 알고리즘을 내장한 계측 장비이며, 그 형태는 대상인이 착용하는 헬멧의 전두부 안쪽에 장착되어 대상인의 이마 부위에서 피부와 접촉되는 형태이다.   
      안전감시 프로그램을 이용한 이벤트 분석(사고 발생 시 경고 신호 발생, 평상시 주기적인 측정)결과를 유비쿼터스 센서 네트워크 기술을 이용하여 전송하며, 사용 환경(훈련시, 일상시, 작전시)에 따라 감시자 및 관리자 등에게 휴대폰을 이용한 문자 메시지나 혹은 전용 단말기를 통한 정보 메세지를 송출하여, 대상인의 상태에 따른 빠른 조치가 가능하도록 하여 그 결과 사망 가능성을 줄이거나 소생률을 향상시킨다. 
       
       헬멧 형태, 안전 관리, 유비쿼터스 센서네트워크(USN), 군인, 소방수, 경찰, 운동선수

title_en: A smart coding block sets of wireless communication-based capable of software coding education
title_ko: 소프트웨어 코딩 교육이 가능한 무선 통신 기반 스마트 코딩 블록 세트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a wireless communication-based smart coding block set capable of software coding education, which contains: an input type smart coding block; a controlled smart coding block; and an output type smart coding block. It is possible to make the functions of the smart coding block sequentially operate such as a method implemented in a computer by merely touching and assembling the smart coding blocks.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 소프트웨어 코딩 교육이 가능한 무선 통신 기반 스마트 코딩 블록에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 소프트웨어 코딩 교육이 가능한 무선 통신 기반 스마트 코딩 블록 세트로서, 소프트웨어 코딩 교육을 위한 입력 기능 모듈을 내부에 구비하고, 상기 내부에 구비되는 입력 기능 모듈에 대응하는 설정된 동작 지령 또는 센서 정보를 출력하는 입력형 스마트 코딩 블록; 소프트웨어 코딩 교육을 위한 제어 기능 모듈을 내부에 구비하고, 상기 내부에 구비되는 제어 기능 모듈에 대응하는 연산 또는 블록 동작 결정의 제어 처리를 수행하는 제어형 스마트 코딩 블록; 및 소프트웨어 코딩 교육을 위한 출력 기능 모듈을 내부에 구비하고, 상기 내부에 구비되는 출력 기능 모듈에 대응하는 동작 기능이 구현되도록 출력하는 출력형 스마트 코딩 블록을 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 소프트웨어 코딩 교육이 가능한 무선 통신 기반 스마트 코딩 블록 세트에 따르면, 다양한 동작 기능이 구현된 출력형 스마트 코딩 블록들과, 동작을 지령하거나 센서 정보를 전달하는 입력형 스마트 코딩 블록들 및 입력형 스마트 코딩 블록에 따른 출력형 스마트 코딩 블록의 동작을 결정하는 제어형 스마트 코딩 블록을 구성함으로써, 스마트 코딩 블록들을 만지고 조립하는 것만으로 컴퓨터에서 구현되는 방식과 같이 스마트 코딩 블록의 기능들이 순차적으로 동작이 가능하도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 입력형 스마트 코딩 블록들과 제어형 스마트 코딩 블록들 및 출력형 스마트 코딩 블록들을 이용한 레고 블록 체결 방식으로 간단하게 조립하여 다양한 형태의 프로그램이 완성될 수 있도록 함으로써, 유아 또는 초보자들도 쉽게 컴퓨터적 사고방식으로 코딩 교육이 가능하고, 그에 따른 유아의 창의적 사고력이 향상될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 각각의 스마트 코딩 블록들이 아웃-인-플레이 무선통신 프로토콜로 구현됨으로써, 무선통신 기능을 이용하여 각각의 스마트 코딩 블록의 특성과 데이터를 상호 전달하고, 스마트 코딩 블록 간의 상호 연결의 구성과 해제가 용이하며, 사용자가 원하는 블록 동작 방식을 결정하여 스마트 코딩 블록들을 순차적으로 꼽는 것만으로 특정 프로그램이 완성되어 자동으로 동작될 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for detecting anomaly in underground utility tunnel based on ConvLSTM-VAE Model
title_ko: ConvLSTM-VAE 모델을 이용한 지하 공동구 이상현상 발생 탐지방법
abstract_en: An object of the present invention is to provide a model capable of accurately distinguishing a normal state and a disaster occurrence state even if there is noise or information loss in collected data for monitoring whether a disaster occurs in an underground common duct, and accurately estimating an initial time of the disaster occurrence. The present invention relates to a method for detecting whether an abnormal phenomenon occurs in an underground utility tunnel using a ConvLSTM-VAE model in an information system including a deep learning program, the method comprising: an encoding step of extracting an approximate probability distribution having spatiotemporal characteristics of time series data; a reparhiameterization step of generating a dden variable onto which an important feature space for the time series data is projected by linearly combining the mean (μ) and the variance (σ) of the approximate probability distribution; a decoding step of outputting new output data onto which the important feature space is projected; an anomaly score calculation step; and a judgment step of comparing the anomaly score with a threshold and determining that an abnormal phenomenon has occurred in the underground utility tunnel if the anomaly score exceeds the threshold.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 ConvLSTM-VAE 모델을 이용한 지하 공동구 이상 현상 발생 탐지방법에 관한 것이다. 지하 공동구에서 화재 등의 재난이 발생하면 시민의 생활과 산업에 막대한 피해와 혼란을 초래한다. 이에 따라 최근에는 IoT 센서를 이용하여 지하 공동구의 재난발생을 감시하는 재난관리 시스템에 관한 많은 연구개발이 진행되고 있다. 그러나, IoT 센서는 통신 환경이나 센서 상태 등에 따라 저품질 데이터가 수집되는 문제가 있는데, 저품질 데이터들로 재난을 판단하는 경우, 재난 대응의 의사결정에 지연 또는 오류를 초래한다. 그러나, 본 발명에서는 수집되는 데이터들에서 시계열 데이터의 시·공간적 특성을 이용하도록 함으로써, 재난이 발생할 수 있는 이상 현상을 신속하고 정확하게 탐지할 수 있는 모델을 제공한다. 이를 위하여 본 발명은 딥러닝 프로그램을 포함하는 정보시스템이 ConvLSTM(convolutional LSTM) Variational AutoEncoder 모델을 이용하여 지하 공동구 내에서 이상 현상 발생 여부를 탐지하게 된다.

title_en: Post-earthquake unmanned aerial vehicle and machine collaborative scheduling method based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-earthquake unmanned vehicle-machine collaborative scheduling method based on edge calculation, which belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster rescue scheduling and comprises the steps of initializing unmanned vehicles and unmanned vehicle clusters, acquiring rescue material state data and wounded data, constructing a comprehensive objective function, and solving the comprehensive objective function based on the rescue material state data and the wounded data to obtain material and wounded scheduling. And acquiring required real-time data based on the edge node, feeding back the real-time data to the control center through the edge server, re-planning a path, calculating and unloading, and dynamically distributing materials and wounded dispatching. And the intelligent scheduling coordinated with the unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to improve the material transfer timeliness and the survival rate of wounded after earthquake.

title_en: A dispatcher training simulation system
title_ko: 급전원 훈련시뮬레이션시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A training simulation system for quickly and accurately evaluating AGC in a training simulation process is provided to evaluate the capability of dispatcher by performing a simulation training under a same condition of an actual power system state. CONSTITUTION: A DTS(Dispatcher Training Simulation) operator(510) acquires data required for simulation. The DTS operator relays the interval of a simulation unit(530) and the dispatcher and controls the simulation situation. The simulation unit practices the dispatcher training simulation. A simulation manager(550) manages the simulation by control signal. A DTS database(570) stores data created in the simulation process.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 전력계통을 운영하는 급전원의 훈련을 위한 훈련시뮬레이션시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 실제 전력계통상태와 동일한 조건하에서 실제 전력계통에서의 변화와 유사하게 모의훈련을 할 수 있어 급전원의 능력을 정확하게 평가할 수 있고 훈련시킬 수 있으며, 전력계통의 설비들에 직접 연결되는 자료취득서버 이외에 자료연계서버를 통해 각 지역급전소의 스카다(SCADA)에서 이미 취득한 자료에 대해서는 이를 연계활용하여 자료의 중복취득에 대한 비효율성을 제거할 수 있고, 기타 외부시스템 일 예로, 한국전력거래소의 기상서버(WIS) 등과도 각종 자료를 송수신할 수 있어 전력계통에 관련된 다양하고 정확한 자료를 취득,관리,활용할 수 있고, 훈련시뮬레이션에 사용될 다양한 시나리오와 이벤트를 훈련교관의 설정조건에 연계하여 용이하게 생성할 수 있고, 훈련에 참여하는 급전원 및 훈련교관이 별도의 프로그램 설치 없이도 웹을 통하여 언제 어디서든 자유롭게 접속,사용이 가능하도록 하여 사용자 편의를 증대시킬 수 있고, 훈련시뮬레이션과정에서의 자동발전제어(AGC)에 대한 이행수준을 정확하고 신속하게 평가할 수 있어 향후 운영자료로 활용될 수 있도록 하는 급전원 훈련시뮬레이션시스템에 관한 것이다.  
       
     EMS, 급전원훈련, 시뮬레이션

title_en: A emergency bell-cctv integration system with enhanced event server
title_ko: 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-cctv 통합 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency bell-CCTV integration system with enhanced stability by having an event server. The system comprises: an event monitoring device having an emergency bell device for generating a preset emergency bell signal as the emergency bell device is installed in a safety blind spot in a parking lot in a building to be operated by executing a user operation in an emergency situation, and a camera installed in the safety blind spot in the parking lot in the building to monitor and photograph a surrounding region and automatically connected to receive the emergency bell signal generated by the emergency bell device; a network video recorder (NVR) connected to the event monitoring device through a single network by using the network as a medium and provided to receive and display a monitoring image photographed by the camera of the event monitoring device and to process an emergency bell event for warning the emergency situation in response to the emergency bell signal generated by the emergency bell device of the event monitoring device and for performing an emergency call; and a central management system (CMS) installed in each security office to receive an emergency bell event signal including position information and image information according to emergency bell event generation from the NVR so as to quickly respond to the emergency situation as a guard moves to a region of the emergency bell device where the emergency call is generated.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템으로서, 건물내주차장의 안전 사각지대에 설치되며, 위급상황 시에 사용자 조작 실행에 따라 구동되어 미리 설정된 비상벨 신호를 발생시키는 비상벨 장치와, 건물내주차장의 안전 사각지대에 설치되어 주변 지역을 감시 촬영하고, 상기 비상벨 장치에서 발생시키는 비상벨 신호를 수신하도록 자동 연결되는 카메라를 구비하는 이벤트 감시 장치; 상기 이벤트 감시 장치와 네트워크를 매개로 단일 망으로 연결 접속되며, 상기 이벤트 감시 장치의 카메라를 통해 촬영되는 감시 영상을 수신하여 디스플레이하고, 상기 이벤트 감시 장치의 비상벨 장치에서 발생시킨 비상벨 신호에 대응하여 비상상황 경고 및 비상 호출을 위한 비상벨 이벤트를 처리하기 위해 관제실에 구비되는 NVR(Network Video Recorder); 및 비상호출이 발생한 비상벨 장치의 해당 지역으로 경비원이 출동하여 위급상황에 신속한 대처가 가능하도록 상기 NVR로부터 비상벨 이벤트 발생에 따른 위치 정보와 영상 정보가 포함된 비상벨 이벤트 신호를 수신하기 위해 경비실에 각각 설치되는 CMS(Central Management System)를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 이벤트 서버가 구비되어 안정성을 높인 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템에 따르면, 양방향 통화 기능이 구비된 비상벨 장치를 카메라부의 오디오 보드에 연결하여 비상벨 신호를 수신하도록 하고, 단일 망으로 형성되는 네트워크를 매개로 NVR이 접속 연결되며, NVR에 연결되는 경비실에 구비되는 복수의 CMS를 포함하되, NVR에 이벤트 서버를 더 구성하여 N개의 이벤트 소스가 M개의 클라이언트에 동시 이벤트 전송이 가능하도록 구성함으로써, 비상벨 이벤트 발생이 손실 없이 안정적으로 전달되고, 그에 따른 비상벨-CCTV의 통합 운용 관리가 안전하게 관리 유지될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 이벤트 서버에서 N개의 이벤트 소스가 M개의 클라이언트에 동시 이벤트 전송이 가능하도록 N:1:M으로 이벤트 송신 클라이언트와 이벤트 전송 처리부 및 이벤트 수신 클라이언트를 구성하되, 이벤트 전송 처리부의 입/출력단에 버퍼 큐를 구성하여 이벤트 손실 발생을 최소화하고, 셀프 와치 독 기능을 이벤트 전송 처리부에 구성함으로써, 프로그램 버그 시 자동으로 재시작 하도록 하여 동작의 연속성이 안정적으로 보장될 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, 범죄예방을 위한 안전 사각지대로 지목되는 건물내주차장에 설치되는 비상벨 장치와 카메라들의 배관/배선을 카메라 선로를 이용하여 시공 공정을 단순화하여 공정 원가를 절감하고, 또한 위급상황 시에 긴급호출을 통한 도움 요청과 함께 양방향 통화를 제공함으로써, 빈번하게 발생하는 안전 사각지대의 위험요소에 대한 신속하고 정확한 상황대처로 사고를 미연에 방지하며, 그에 따른 사용자의 불안감 해소와 안전한 생활공간 및 범죄를 사전에 예방할 수 있도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for incident recording
abstract_en: An incident recorder records original and supplemental incident information using a simplified user interface. A lead incident recorder may request any of several support tasks be accepted by other subsystems configured to Follow. Tactical support tasks may be requested. Communication support tasks may be requested. Collection support tasks may be requested. Collection support tasks may include directives for operation of an incident recorder.

title_en: Systems and methods for generating graphical user interfaces relating to determined parametric events
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed for providing a graphic user interface. The systems and methods may (1) receive an indication of a parametric event involving a vehicle; (2) provide a series of component graphic user interfaces, wherein the component graphic user interfaces may be configured to (i) initiate a claim filing, (ii) communicate with an insurer entity, (iii) communicate with an emergency response entity, (iv) communicate with a towing service entity, (v) communicate with a taxi or ride-share service entity, (vi) communicating with a vehicle repair service entity, (vii) communicating with a vehicle salvage entity, and/or (viii) communicating with a vehicle rental service entity; (3) detect one or more user interactions that may include one or more selections of the one or more actions; (4) perform the one or more actions; and/or (5) record a transaction indicating that the one or more actions has been performed to the blockchain.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Fire rescue scene order record appearance
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a fire rescue site command recorder which comprises a shell, a main board and a power supply, wherein the main board is positioned in the shell, the power supply is used for providing power for all parts of equipment, a plurality of frequency band displays matched with the main board are arranged at the top end of the shell, a frequency modulation button matched with the frequency band displays is arranged on one side of the frequency band displays, an antenna matched with the main board is arranged on one side of the frequency band displays, which is far away from the frequency modulation button, a display matched with the main board is arranged at the top end of the shell, and a group calling button and an emergency evacuation command issuing button which are matched with the main board are respectively arranged on two sides of the display and positioned at the edge of the shell. Convenient to use, easy operation, the start can be recorded, and different phonates person can be distinguished to the sound in-process of changing into characters, makes things convenient for afterwards arrangement data and retrieval, solves the fire rescue in-process, and various information through the intercom transmission can't be recorded, can't accurately trace back afterwards and the problem of accurate duplication.

title_en: Infrared lock-in thermal wave non-destructive detection method based on image sequence processing
abstract_en: The invention discloses an infrared lock-in heat wave non-destructive detection method based on image sequence processing, which is a new method for realizing infrared lock-in heat wave non-destructive detection by using computer software to process the sequence of infrared images. The method comprises the following implementation steps: using a focal plane infrared heat imager to collect the image sequence of heat wave signals, using a halogen light source modulated by sine law to excite, carrying out digital lock-in processing on heat wave signals and analysis of feature images. When the method is used for non-destructive detection, the focal plane infrared heat imager 5 is fixed on a tripod 16 and connected with a data acquisition card of a computer 11, and infrared lock-in processing software 12 based on the image sequence is used for finishing initialization and image display of the infrared heat imager. The halogen light source 6 is fixed on a special support 7 to ensure that incident light is irradiated in an area to be detected of a sample piece 2 as far as possible, a function generator 14 is connected with a light source power amplifier 13 through a signal wire 15, and light intensity of the halogen light source 6 is controlled to change by the sine law. The incident light of the halogen light source 6 is irradiated to the surface of the sample piece 2 to generate excited heat waves 4. The infrared lock-in processing software 12 based on the image sequence records reflected heat waves 3 or transmitted heat waves 1 generated on the surface of the sample piece 2, a lock-in processing module is used for extracting feature information of the heat wave signals and forming the feature images, an image processing and analyzing module processes and analyzes the heat wave feature images, and inner defect features of the sample piece 2 are extracted, so as to realize fast and accurate non-destructive detection of inner defects and damages of the sample piece 2.

title_en: Intelligent-equipment-based assistant system of fishery
abstract_en: Disclosed in the invention is an intelligent-equipment-based assistant system of the fishery. The assistant system comprises a data center, a WEB service center, a user terminal, and a management terminal system. The WEB service center consists of a fishery information platform, a navigation platform, a meteorological information obtaining platform, a governmental information publishing platform, a fishery news platform, a remote annual inspection platform of a ship user, an illegal record obtaining platform of a fishing law enforcement department, a fish product trading platform, a ship lease transaction platform, a ship product shopping platform, a fishing boat information management and offshore emergency command support platform, a mobile instant communication tool, a mobile game and video platform, and an online payment platform. According to the intelligent-equipment-based assistant system and a realization method thereof, existing information resources can be integrated and utilized, so that the distance between the competent unit and the user is shortened and communication between users becomes convenient. The production and work efficiency of the fishing owner is improved; the life information of the fishing owner is diversified; and administrative work flows of relevant competent units can be effectively reduced and the work efficiency is improved.

title_en: It is automatic to mend account processing method and processing device
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of automatic benefit account processing method and processing devices.This method includes：On-line transaction request is received, and on-line transaction request is forwarded to local host to carry out corresponding business function processing；The transaction communications area of the local host is bypassed, obtains on-line transaction comunication area data, and generated according to on-line transaction comunication area data and mend account data；It is generated according to the benefit account data and mends account file；When the local host can not carry out business function processing, the local host is replaced to carry out business function processing by same castellan's machine, by the benefit account file distributing to same castellan's machine；On same castellan's machine, reconciliation processing is carried out according to the benefit account file and host transaction daily record, obtains same castellan's machine reconciliation result；Automatic account of mending is carried out according to same castellan's machine reconciliation result to the loss host transaction data for mending account file to handle.The present invention unifies and simplifies calamity for switching flow, can improve emergency response speed.
assignees: INDUSTRIAL & COMMERCIAL BANK OF CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information data processing technology, in particular to a mountain engineering slope real-time monitoring and early warning method and system based on digital twinning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining original slope real-time monitoring data, carrying out standardization processing to obtain standardized slope real-time monitoring data, constructing a digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data to obtain a preliminary slope digital twin model, and dynamically updating the preliminary slope digital twin model by utilizing the standardized slope real-time monitoring data and slope history multi-source monitoring data to obtain a real-time updated slope digital twin model. According to the invention, by updating the digital twin model in real time and combining multi-physical field coupling analysis and nonlinear stability prediction, the dynamic monitoring, stability evaluation, risk prediction and emergency response of the slope can be ensured to reflect the actual conditions in time, so that the scientificity and timeliness of disaster prevention and control are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN EXPRESSWAY CONSTRUCTION AND DEV GROUP CO LTD;SHUDAO INVEST GROUP CO LTD;CHONGQING TONGNAN DISTR TRAFFIC AFFAIRS CENTER

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle emergency control management method and system based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle emergency control management method and system based on digital twinning, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle control. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle data acquisition module, a virtual scene construction module, an emergency route analysis module, an execution scheme planning module and an operation visualization module, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle data acquisition module acquires image data in an emergency area and parameter records of unmanned aerial vehicles, the virtual scene construction module builds a virtual scene by utilizing a digital twin technology, maps and divides a three-dimensional grid in real time, the emergency route analysis module plans a feasible route for each unmanned aerial vehicle in the virtual scene and screens out an important route, the execution scheme planning module analyzes each scheme according to the important route planning scheme so as to set a communication scheme, and the operation visualization module monitors each unmanned aerial vehicle to fly according to the communication scheme and displays the virtual scene in real time through a visual page of a command center. According to the invention, through digital twin-driven multisource perception fusion, dynamic grid adaptation and nonlinear anti-interference path planning, the environment modeling precision and the communication link reliability of the unmanned aerial vehicle group in a disaster environment are improved.
assignees: TAIZHOU CHENGFA DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Construction intelligent management control platform and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a construction intelligent management control platform and a construction intelligent management control method, wherein the construction intelligent management control platform comprises an emergency response simulation module, an AI decision support module, a cost optimization maintenance module, an environment adaptation protection module, a data transmission module, a risk assessment module and an alarm processing module, wherein the emergency response simulation module is used for simulating a plurality of emergency scenes of a construction site, performing exercise through a virtual reality technology, supporting multi-user collaborative participation, and recording exercise data to optimize an actual response strategy, the AI decision support module is used for analyzing real-time data based on a machine learning algorithm to generate intelligent decision suggestions, including risk priority ordering and automatic response path recommendation.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY 23 BUREAU GROUP NO 3 ENG CO LTD

title_en: system
abstract_en: An object of a system according to an embodiment is to improve safety during driving.SOLUTION: A system according to an embodiment includes a driving situation analysis unit, a conversation unit, a feedback unit, a state monitoring unit, and an emergency handling unit. The driving situation analysis unit analyzes the driving situation in real time. The conversation unit performs a conversation with the driver based on the driving situation analyzed by the driving situation analysis unit. The feedback unit records the advice or warning provided by the conversation unit and provides feedback after the end of driving. The state monitoring unit monitors the state of the driver and issues a warning when an abnormality is detected. The emergency response unit performs an appropriate response at the time of emergency.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Improved patient emergency response system
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digital video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event, and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted server to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time, the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: Computer implemented system and associated methods for management of workplace incident reporting
abstract_en: The computer implemented systems, devices, and methods are for documenting and tracking workplace injuries/incidents, generating safety analytics, providing fraud prevention features, and delivering wellness/training resources, for example. The Workplace Incident Reporting Platform (WIRP) is for industry project managers, associates, insurers, and medical providers. The WIRP is an innovative, user-friendly, secure digital platform that increases efficiency on the job site and brings enterprise leaders, designated employee representatives, associates, and their medical providers together as a team. The WIRP does this by providing a resourceful digital approach to document accurate, and comprehensive, First Report of Injury (FRI). The WIRP's streamline and digitized document record control benefits both the associates and enterprise with smart safety analytics, and updated status reports.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.

title_en: Self-response disposal method for safety product and related equipment
abstract_en: The self-response handling method and the related equipment for the security product can obtain the barrier reporting information sent by the user side, wherein the barrier reporting information comprises the IP address of the user side and system access information; determining a security product for sealing the IP address by using the IP sealing record; calling an interface of a security product to obtain blocking information corresponding to the barrier information through the IP address and the system access information, wherein the blocking information comprises a blocking policy applied by the blocking IP address; obtaining history sealing record information associated with the sealing strategy in a strategy judgment history database; and determining whether to unseal the IP address by using the history sealing record information. The method and the system can integrate various safety products, realize linkage analysis of data through history sealing and forbidden record information of sealing and forbidden strategies, realize emergency response to user fault reporting among various safety products, and are favorable for improving use experience of users.

title_en: Equipment emergency processing method and device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a device emergency treatment method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium; the equipment emergency treatment method comprises the following steps: responding to a first operation aiming at a tool page, and acquiring equipment information; according to the equipment information, determining target equipment in each second network equipment, updating a tool page, and displaying emergency measures corresponding to the target equipment on the updated tool page; the emergency measures are used for representing the association relation between the emergency scene where the target equipment is located and the emergency command; responding to a second operation aiming at the updated tool page, and outputting a corresponding emergency command; the emergency command is used to instruct the first network device to connect to the target device to perform a corresponding emergency operation on the target device. The emergency accuracy and timeliness can be improved.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating burst risk of barrier lake
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of risk assessment, and provides a method and a system for evaluating the burst risk of a barrier lake. The scheme not only enhances the dependence and processing capacity of the monitoring system on the traditional data, but also can rely on more informal data, such as social media information, to acquire necessary information when the conventional monitoring is limited. In addition, the scheme can amplify tiny signals through a data processing means with resolution, help a decision maker to carry out fine judgment, ensure that a disaster response strategy is as fine and accurate as possible, and effectively improve timeliness and appropriateness of disaster management and emergency response.

title_en: System and method for monitering flight software of guidance and control apparatus
title_ko: 유도조종장치 탑재소프트웨어의 점검 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for monitoring the loaded software of a guidance and control apparatus capable of executing and controlling a flight performance simulation program of a monitoring apparatus using the synchronous signal of a guidance and control apparatus with guaranteed real time. The system includes the guidance and control apparatus for transmitting a message including a guided missile control command and a synchronization signal; and a monitoring device which executes a flight performance simulation program according to the synchronization signal included in the message, and transmit a second message including the number of program runs and the flight simulation data to the guidance and control apparatus.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실시간성이 보장되는 유도조종장치의 동기신호를 이용하여 점검장비의 비행성능시뮬레이션 프로그램을 실행 제어할 수 있는 유도조종장치 탑재소프트웨어의 점검 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 유도탄 제어명령과 동기신호가 포함된 메시지를 전송하는 유도조종장치; 및 상기 메시지에 포함된 동기신호에 따라 비행성능시뮬레이션 프로그램을 실행하여, 프로그램 실행횟수와 비행모의데이터가 포함된 제2메시지를 유도조종장치로 전송하는 점검장치;를 포함한다.

title_en: System and method for beach risk assessment based on multiple linear regression and computer program for the same
title_ko: 다중 선형 회귀를 이용한 해수욕장 위험도 평가 시스템 및 방법과, 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_ko: 해수욕장 위험도 평가 시스템은, 공공데이터 서버로부터 대상 해수욕장의 파도 높이, 수심, 수온, 기온, 기압, 유속, 유향, 조위, 풍속, 풍향, 해파리 출현율, 염분, 해수욕장 면적, 안전요원 수 및 안전표지판 수 중 하나 이상을 포함하는 기본데이터를 수신하도록 구성된 데이터 수집부; 상기 기본데이터에 기초하여, 파고, 너울성 파랑, 조류, 조석, 이안류, 해파리 쏘임, 안전요원 비율 및 안전표지판 비율 중 하나 이상을 포함하는 가공데이터를 생성하도록 구성된 데이터 가공부; 대상자의 연령, 성별, 음주 여부, 수영 능력 및 병력 중 하나 이상을 포함하는 인적데이터를 입력받도록 구성된 데이터 입력부; 상기 기본데이터, 상기 가공데이터 및 상기 인적데이터 중 하나 이상에 미리 설정된 범주를 적용하여 지수로 변환하도록 구성된 지수화부; 및 상기 기본데이터, 상기 가공데이터 및 상기 인적데이터로부터 사고별 위험 요소를 추출하고, 상기 사고별 위험 요소에 상응하는 지수에 미리 설정된 가중치를 적용한 값과 상기 대상 해수욕장의 해수욕장 가중치를 이용하여 상기 대상 해수욕장의 위험도를 산출하도록 구성된 평가부를 포함한다.

title_en: Gripper system and grip control method of fabric robot
title_ko: 원단 로봇의 그리퍼 시스템 및 그립 제어방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 원단 로봇의 그리퍼 시스템은 원단 롤을 직접 그립하고 그립 해제하는 그리퍼; 말단부에 상기 그리퍼가 결합되고, 해당 그리퍼에 전원 또는 제어신호를 전달하여 원단을 그립 하게하고, 그립 해제하게 하여 회전운동과 직선운동을 통해 상기 원단을 설정된 위치로 이동시켜 적재시키는 로봇암; 및 상기 로봇암의 회전운동과 직선운동을 제어하기 위한 프로그램과 상기 그리퍼의 그립과 그립해제를 위한 프로그램이 구비되어 직접 상기 로봇암을 제어하거나, 또 그리퍼를 제어할 수 있는 중앙제어 장치;를 포함하여 이전 적재된 원단의 무게와 부피를 기억 한 후, 다음 적재를 수행함으로써 원단의 적재가 균형적으로 이루어 질 수 있도록 하여 적재된 원단이 무너지는 것을 방지함으로써 결과적으로 안전사고가 발생하는 것을 미연에 방지하여 인명피해 발생을 최소화시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method, Apparatus and Computer Program for Supporting Metropolitan Demand Responsive Transport Services
title_ko: 대도시권 수요응답형 광역 모빌리티 서비스의 운영을 지원하기 위한 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: A method, a device, and a computer program for supporting the operation of a demand-responsive metropolitan wide-area mobility service are disclosed. According to one aspect of the present disclosure, a device for supporting the operation of a demand-responsive metropolitan wide-area mobility service is provided. The device comprises: a decision-making support module which provides, based on information collected from one or more platform carriers operating a demand-responsive metropolitan wide-area mobility service, indicators to evaluate each platform carrier; a digital infrastructure management module which provides, based on information collected from the platform carriers and information collected from local governments in one or more regions where the demand-responsive metropolitan wide-area mobility service is operated, information on infrastructure for using mobility; and a cooperative emergency response module which provides, in response to detection of an emergency response situation, an emergency response strategy to at least one platform carrier selected from among the platform carriers. According to the present invention, user satisfaction can be improved by securing a quantitative evaluation system for the minimum service to ensure the publicness of transportation services.
abstract_ko:
대도시권 수요응답형 광역 모빌리티 서비스의 운영을 지원하기 위한 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램를 개시한다. 
본 개시의 일 측면에 의하면, 대도시권 수요응답형 광역 모빌리티 서비스의 운영을 지원하는 장치로서, 대도시권 수요응답형 광역 모빌리티 서비스를 운영하는 하나 이상의 플랫폼 운송사들로부터 수집된 정보에 기초하여, 각 플랫폼 운송사를 평가할 수 있는 지표를 제공하는 의사결정 지원모듈; 상기 플랫폼 운송사들로부터 수집된 정보 및 상기 대도시권 수요응답형 광역 모빌리티 서비스가 운영되는 하나 이상의 지역의 지자체로부터 수집된 정보에 기초하여, 모빌리티를 이용하기 위한 인프라에 대한 정보를 제공하는 디지털 인프라 관리모듈; 및 비상 대응 상황의 감지에 응답하여, 상기 플랫폼 운송사들 중에서 선별된 적어도 하나의 플랫폼 운송사에게 비상대응 전략을 제공하는 협력형 비상 대응모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는, 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Earthquake emergency commanding system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an earthquake emergency commanding system, wherein a display broadcasting module, a sound acquisition module, a sound amplification module and a high-definition video acquisition module are arranged in an earthquake commanding hall; a centralized control module controls video conference terminals to conduct, so the earthquake commanding hall can have remote video conference with an earthquake region, and the disaster and geography environment of the earthquake region can be known in real time; the centralized control module controls a signal exchange module to switch and transfer the signals respectively coming from an image processor, a mobile terminal signal transmission module and the video conference terminals, and the signals are displayed and broadcasted on the display broadcasting module; the information coming from the image processor and the mobile terminal signal transmission module can be learned by work personnel in the earthquake region through the video conference terminals, so the disaster and geography environment in the earthquake region can be known in real time, coping strategy can be timely and accurately adjusted, thereby improving rescuing efficiency; the whole decision making process can be also recorded, thereby reserving precious video data for similar emergent event treatment in the future.
assignees: CHONGQING SHUNLI SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) chemical detection system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) chemical detection system. The UAV chemical detection system includes a UAV platform, a first gyroscope, a surveillance camera, an airborne fire-fighting  detection integrated pod, a wireless data transmitter, a wireless data receiver, a remote control operation handle and a ground computer; the first gyroscope, the surveillance camera, the wireless data transmitter and the wireless data receiver are mounted on the UAV platform; the surveillance camera and the airborne fire-fighting detection integrated pod are connected with the wireless data transmitter; the wireless data transmitter and the wireless data receiver are connected; the wireless data receiver and the remote control operation handle are connected to the ground computer; and the remote control operation handle is connected wirelessly with the UAV platform and the airborne fire-fighting detection integrated pod. The UAV chemical detection system is used for the whole investigation, monitoring, detecting, recording, and analysis of the leakage and diffusion of the dangerous chemical gas, and is used by the fire-fighting command staff for the remote analysis and to command the rescue.
assignees: XI AN SIFANG ELECTROMECHANIC CO LTD;CHINESE PEOPLES ARMED POLICE FORCE ACADEMY

title_en: Command center removes alert situation pusher
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a command center mobile warning situation pushing device, which comprises a pushing platform, a distribution box and a supporting platform, wherein the pushing platform comprises a touch display screen, a memory groove, a control button, a camera, a projector, a wiring port, a central processing unit, a 3D camera, a Bluetooth receiver and a fixed plate, a plurality of signal receivers with the same specification are fixedly arranged on the upper surface of the fixed plate, the signal receivers are electrically connected with the Bluetooth receiver inside the pushing platform to improve the pushing speed of the signal receivers, the signal receivers have good timeliness, meanwhile, the camera is arranged on the outer surface of the pushing platform and is electrically connected with the 3D camera, the live broadcasting function can be realized, the central processing unit is electrically connected with the control button through a second-level wire, a current blocker is arranged on the outer surface of the second-level wire, each control button corresponds to different control functions, and the current blocker can delay the reaction made by the button, the aim of delayed pushing or timing pushing is achieved.
assignees: SHENZHEN BITNET INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bilateral cooperative work system and method based on real-time video
abstract_en: A bilateral cooperative work system and method based on real-time video, the system includes Web service module, GIS service module, stream media service module, central storage service module, recorder, collecting device, storage device, etc., realize bilateral cooperative business function based on real-time video between recorder and command console, and save the video recorded on site of recorder end as cooperative work evidence in the cooperative work process, and facilitate the follow-up backtracking to collect evidence, it can meet the business demand that many people need to participate in real time effectively, especially can solve the problem that it is difficult to equip sufficient police force to enforce law on site in some business. The system and the method are suitable for running in public networks and private networks, have strong applicability, save labor cost, are suitable for security industries such as public security, traffic police and the like, are also suitable for other industries with similar requirements, and can be widely applied to systems with similar application scenes in governments, public security, institutions, companies and the like.
assignees: SHENZHEN FAIWING SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Industry wisdom garden emergency management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency management system for an industrial intelligent park, which belongs to the technical field of emergency management of the intelligent park, and can be used for carrying out exercises for staff in the industrial intelligent park at random by arranging an emergency training unit on a staff management and emergency culture module, designating related exercises according to different posts of the staff and recording related conditions in the exercises so as to be convenient for analyzing exercise results. Be provided with emergency command dispatch module, when the emergent event takes place for industry wisdom garden, can dispatch emergency personnel promptly and have emergent material to go to emergent event place, for the personnel that need evacuate provide reasonable evacuation circuit, simultaneously, for all staff in the industry wisdom garden provide the emergent material distribution condition near its place of place. Through being provided with indoor environment monitoring, can clearly know indoor environmental parameter, be convenient for adjust indoor environment, provide an ideal operational environment for the staff.
assignees: ANHUI XIAOMA CREATIVE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Crust activity real-time monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring and early warning system for earth crust activity, which belongs to the technical field of earth crust activity monitoring, and can automatically analyze abnormal modes in earthquake fluctuation data and predict occurrence probability of earthquake events by integrating artificial intelligent algorithms, compared with the prior art, the invention obviously improves data processing efficiency and early warning accuracy, an early warning module automatically adjusts early warning level according to the prediction result, and rapidly transmits early warning information through multiple channels, ensures that the information is timely delivered to a power-assisted area, in addition, the decision support submodule provided by the system evaluates the earthquake risk by using the geographic information system, the emergency response submodule can be linked with an external service interface, the emergency response capability is further enhanced, the design of the user interface is convenient for a user to configure early warning parameters and view data, the timeliness and the effectiveness of earthquake response can be greatly improved by the application of the monitoring and early warning system, and an advanced disaster prevention and reduction tool is provided for an earthquake high-rise area.

title_en: Intelligent bridge safety early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of structural health monitoring, in particular to an intelligent bridge safety early warning system which comprises a time factor analysis module, a state analysis module, a risk assessment module and a warning generation module, wherein the time factor analysis module carries out trend decomposition on time series data of a spandrel girder based on long-term monitoring data. According to the invention, through combining trend decomposition with analysis of key time factors, the sensitivity of the structure to slight changes is improved, potential structural instability is allowed to be expected earlier, a hidden Markov model is applied to bridge monitoring data, potential structural problems in the future are effectively predicted, the establishment of a maintenance plan and the implementation of preventive measures are optimized, a more systematic risk management method is provided by a risk rating system through comparing histories with current data, the real-time response capability of early warning is enhanced, the efficiency and timeliness of emergency response are obviously improved, and potential risks caused by untimely response are effectively reduced.
assignees: BINZHOU MUNICIPAL PUBLIC DEV SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Expressway traffic emergency command and dispatch system based on VR
abstract_en: The invention discloses a highway traffic emergency command and dispatch system based on VR, which comprises a VR subsystem, a user side computing subsystem, a virtual rendering subsystem, a data visualization dispatch subsystem, a data storage subsystem, a cooperative communication subsystem, a system management control subsystem and a sensing subsystem. The invention can break through the limit of physical space, reduce the cost of entity construction and maintenance, construct flexible and expandable virtual central control room environment under lower hardware dependence, efficiently manage and control expressway traffic monitoring matters, conveniently and rapidly process emergencies and ensure traffic safety, remarkably improve the flexibility and timeliness of monitoring and commanding, greatly improve the efficiency and safety of high-speed operation and traffic management, and provide new technical paths and solutions for expressway operation management. In particular, in a highway maintenance management scene, the invention can display route maintenance information through a VR immersive virtual central control room, early warn abnormal conditions and assist management personnel in making decisions or emergency scheduling.
assignees: JIANGXI TRANSP INVESTMENT GROUP CO LTD;JIANGXI HIGHWAY DEV CO LTD;JIANGXI KINGROAD TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-function circuit breaker and control method with load unbalance rate alarm
title_ko: 부하불평형 경보가 가능한 다기능 차단기 및 그 제어 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A multifunctional circuit breaker and a control method thereof are provided to prevent an outage accident and the damage to a power supply transformer by correcting the load unbalance state. CONSTITUTION: A method for controlling a multifunctional circuit breaker includes an initializing step(S10), a data converting step(S20), a calculating step(S30), a comparing step(S40), and an alarming step(S50). In the initializing step, the initialization is performed using an initial set value inside a memory. In the data converting step, the values of a converter and an image converter is converted from analog to digital. In the calculation step, the load unbalance rate is calculated based on the data of the data conversion step. In the comparing step, the unbalance set value in the memory and the calculated load unbalance rate are compared. In the alarming step, the alarm is generated if the calculated load unbalance rate is above the set unbalance value. If the calculated load unbalance rate is less than the set unbalance value, the step returns from the comparing step to the data converting step. If the key corresponding to the reset of the input device after the alarming step is pushed, the step returns to the data converting step. The multifunctional circuit breaker includes the converter, the A/D converter, a microprocessor, a memory, and a display unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 부하불평형 경보가 가능한 다기능차단기 및 그 제어 방법에 관한 것으로,  3 상의 평균전압 및 평균전류에 대한 각상의 전압, 전류의 편차로 부하에 의한 불평형을 알리며, 역률 및 전력량 등을 확인할 수 있는 다기능 차단기 및 그 제어 방법을 개시한다. 
     본 발명은 전력선에 영상변류기(ZCT)와 차단을 위한 트립장치가 구비된 공지의 차단기에 있어서, 변류기(CT)를 각 전력선에 설치하며, 이와 A/D변환기를 연결하고, A/D변환기의 출력을 마이크로프로세서의 입출력포트에 연결하며, 마이크로프로세서의 입출력포트에 입력장치와, 프로그램 및 설정값을 저장하기 위한 메모리와, 작동상태를 표시하기 위한 표시부로 구성된 부하불평형 경보가 가능한 다기능 차단기와,  
     메모리에 저장된 초기 설정값을 가져다가 초기화하는 초기화 단계와, 전력에 연결된 각 변류기와 영상변류기의 값을 A/D변환하는 데이터 변환 단계와, 데이터 변환 단계에서 획득한 데이터에 의하여 부하불평형률을 산출하는 산출 단계와, 메모리에 저장된 불평형 설정값과 산출된 부하불평형률을 비교하는 비교 단계와, 비교 결과 산출된 부하불평형률이 설정된 불평형 값 이상인 경우 경보를 발생하는 경보 발생 단계를 실시하고, 비교 결과 산출된 부하불평형률이 설정된 불평형 값 미만인 경우 다시 전술한 데이터 변환 단계를 실시하며, 전술한 경보 발생 단계를 실시한 경우 입력장치의 리셋에 해당하는 키가 눌려 진 경우 경보 발생을 중지하고,  전술한 데이터 변환 단계로 돌아가 이상을 반복실시 하도록 하는 단계를 마이크로프로세서에 의하여 실행되도록 하는 부하불평형 경보가 가능한 다기능 차단기의 제어 방법을 제안하여  이에 따라 역률 저하로 인한 에너지 손실을 방지하고, 고가의 설비인 전력 공급 변압기의 손상을 방지하여 시설 보수비용을 크게 절감하며, 정전 사고의 발생을 방지하여 안정적인 전력 공급이 가능하도록 하는 유용한 효과를 얻을 수 있다.

title_en: Learning apparatus
title_ko: 학습장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A learning device is provided to easily select learning data. CONSTITUTION: A central processing device unit(15) reads learning data stored in a memory(13) by a reading command from an input device unit and displays the read learning data on a display unit(12). The central processing device unit inputs a level control command to the displayed learning data and stores the learning data displayed by a storage command together with adjusted understandability level information. The central processing device unit generates a learning data list based on an understandability level of learning data and displays it on the display unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 학습장치에 관한 것으로서, 학습장치에 있어서, 본체와; 상기 본체에 설치된 표시부와; 학습자료의 저장공간을 제공하고, 학습자료를 상기 표시부에 표시하기 위한 불러오기명령과 상기 표시부에 표시된 학습자료에 대한 이해도등급을 조정하기 위한 등급조정명령과 상기 표시부에 표시된 학습자료를 저장하기 위한 저장명령과 학습자료의 명칭을 포함하는 학습자료목록을 상기 표시부에 표시하기 위한 목록표시명령과 상기 표시부에 표시된 학습자료목록에 포함된 하나의 학습자료를 상기 표시부에 표시하기 위한 자료표시명령을 포함하는 학습응용프로그램이 저장되어 있는 메모리와; 상기 불러오기명령, 상기 저장명령, 상기 등급조정명령 및 상기 목록표시명령의 실행을 조작하기 위한 입력장치부와; 상기 입력장치부로부터 상기 메모리에 저장된 학습자료에 대하여 상기 불러오기명령의 실행조작이 입력될 때 불러오기대상이 된 학습자료를 상기 메모리로부터 독출하여 상기 표시부에 표시하고, 상기 입력장치부로부터 상기 표시부에 표시된 학습자료에 대하여 상기 등급조정명령의 실행조작이 입력되고 상기 입력장치부로부터 상기 표시부에 표시된 학습자료에 대하여 상기 저장명령의 실행조작이 입력될 때 상기 표시부에 표시된 학습자료를 조정된 이해도등급 정보와 함께 상기 메모리에 저장하며, 상기 입력장치부로부터 상기 목록표시명령의 실행조작이 입력될 때 상기 메모리에 저장된 학습자료를 이해도등급을 기준으로 학습자료목록을 생성하여 상기 표시부에 표시하며, 상기 입력장치부로부터 상기 자료표시명령의 실행조작이 입력될 때 표시대상으로  지정된 학습자료를 상기 메모리로부터 독출하여 상기 표시부에 표시하는 중앙처리장치부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 이에 의해, 학습하고자 하는 학습자료를 용이하게 선택할 수 있다.
