abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and government service, and discloses a government work order dispatching system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an agent dispatching module, a control module and a control module, wherein the agent dispatching module is used for respectively configuring deep reinforcement learning dispatching agents for a plurality of government service areas and outputting execution work order allocation and priority ordering; the system comprises a fairness monitoring module, a bias analysis module, an agent optimizing module, a collaborative scheduling and auditing module, a collaborative scheduling system and a scheduling process recording module, wherein the fairness monitoring module is used for defining and monitoring fairness indexes, the bias analysis module is used for analyzing attention patterns in scheduling decisions, identifying potential bias characteristics related to changes of the fairness indexes and quantifying the influence of the potential bias characteristics on the fairness of the scheduling, the agent optimizing module is used for optimizing the scheduling agents, the collaborative scheduling and auditing module is used for constructing a collaborative scheduling system and recording scheduling processes to form auditable logs, and the original opaque deep reinforcement learning decision process is made understandable by integrating the interpretable artificial intelligent module, so that the transparency of the scheduling decisions is improved.

title_en: A management system of alarm contained gas and vibration sensor
title_ko: 가스 및 지진센서를 구비한 경보 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an alarm management system providing a gas and seismic sensor, including an alarm device, a camera, a control server, a user terminal, and an administrator terminal. Thereby, through the alarm device equipped with a sensor unit, including gas, fire and earthquake sensors, the gas, fire and vibration are programmed for real-time detection and automatically sensed through a control unit. Based on the sensed information, real-time data can be transmitted through wired/wireless communication in accordance with gas, fire, or earthquake to prevent gas accidents and transmit warnings for earthquakes, thereby enabling rapid response and ensuring reliability in emergency disasters.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 가스 및 지진센서를 구비한 경보 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은 가스누출, 화재 및 진동 여부를 실시간 감지를 위해 프로그램화하여 센서부의 구동을 통해 소정 규모 이상의 지진을 감지하여 신호를 출력하거나 건물붕괴에 따라 진동을 감지하여 가스의 자동 잠금기능을 통해 유입되는 가스를 차단하거나, 내장된 가스센서가 누출된 가스를 감지하여 자동 잠금기능을 수행하는 경보장치; 상기 경보장치 일측에 설치되어 연기 발생에 따른 상태 정보를 촬상하거나, 진동에 따른 떨림을 촬상하여 해당 촬상된 상태정보를 경보장치로 송출하거나, 경보장치의 설정된 통신부를 통해 사용자 단말 또는 관리자 단말로 해당 상태 정보가 전송되도록 하는 카메라; 화재, 가스누출, 재난 알림에 따른 데이터베이스 정보를 수집, 저장하고, 통신망을 통해 외부 공공기관장치 및 다수개의 경보장치와 연동되어 지진, 해일, 지역화재, 가스누출의 응급 상황시 해당 정보를 수신하여 저장된 데이터베이스의 기준에 따라 경보장치로 전송하여 응급상황 대처로 가스차단 정보를 송출하여 잠금기능이 수행되도록 하거나, 사용자 단말로 원격에서 경보장치의 제어를 위한 구동 어플(APP)을 제공하여 사용자에 의해 해당 경보장치가 제어되도록 해당 정보를 송출하는 관제서버; 경보장치의 원격제어를 위해 관제서버를 통하여 구동 어플(APP)을 전송받아 실행하고, 관제서버에서 제공되는 재난 알림 및 지진, 해일, 가스 누출, 해당 지역화재의 응급상황 정보를 수신하여 원격에서 해당 경보장치의 구동에 따른 가스 차단정보를 송출하여 경보장치의 운영이 되도록 하는 사용자 단말; 및 상기 관제서버에서 제공되는 화재, 가스누출, 지진, 해일, 지역화재의 응급상황에 따른 해당 정보를 기초로 관제서버에 저장된 데이터베이스를 기준으로 경보장치로 응급상황 대처에 따른 해당 정보를 송출하여 잠금기능이 수행하거나, 관제서버의 구동에 필요한 제반적인 동작을 모니터링하는 상기 관리자 단말;을 포함하여 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 의해, 가스, 화재센스 및 지진센서를 포함한 센서부가 구비된 경보장치를 통해 가스, 화재 및 진동 여부를 실시간 감지를 위해 프로그램화하여 제어부를 통해 자동으로 센싱하고, 센싱된 정보를 기초로 가스, 화재 또는 지진 여부에 따라 유무선 통신을 통해 실시간 데이터들을 전송하여 가스 사고 예방, 지진에 따른 경고를 송출하여 신속한 대응이 이루어지고 긴급재난에 대하여 신뢰성을 확보할 수 있는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Fire Double Check System Using Drone and Method of The Same
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 화재 더블체크 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
[기술분야/해결과제] 
본 발명은 드론을 이용한 화재 더블체크 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 수많은 센서 또는 화재감지기 중에서 하나라도 고장이 발생되거나 오작동으로 화재 경보가 발생되면 CCTV가 설치되지 않은 장소에는 화재 발생 유무를 즉시 확인할 수 없기 때문에 소방차와 소방인력이 오인 출동하는 문제점을 해결하기 위한 것이다. 
[해결수단] 
본 발명의 드론을 이용한 화재 더블체크 방법은, (a) 산업시설의 공장 내부 도면과 화재감지기의 위치 정보 및 드론의 이동 경로를 시스템서버에 등록하여 저장하는 단계; (b) 상기 화재감지기가 작동하여 화재 감지 신호를 송신하고, IoT 중계기에서 화재 감지 신호를 로라(LoRa) 또는 와이파이(Wi-Fi) 통신을 통해 상기 시스템서버로 전송하는 단계; (c) 상기 시스템서버에서 화재 감지 신호가 수신되면 상기 시스템서버에서 드론으로 이동 경로 및 목표 지점의 좌표를 전송하여 상기 화재 감지 신호가 송신된 구역으로 상기 드론을 자율 비행으로 출동시키는 단계; (d) 상기 드론이 목표 지점에 도달하면 프로그램에 의해 자동으로 공중에서 회전하면서 주변 영상을 촬영하고 촬영한 영상을 실시간으로 송신하는 단계; (e) 상기 드론의 영상을 상기 시스템서버와 스마트폰의 어플리케이션을 통해 실시간으로 출력하여 화재 발생 지점의 영상을 제공하는 단계; 및 (f) 상기 스마트폰의 어플리케이션 영상을 영상공유서버에 스마트뷰 어플로 연결하여 공유하고, 상기 영상공유서버에서 상기 영상을 팀뷰 어플을 통해 하나 이상의 기기로 전송하여 공유하는 단계;를 포함하고 있다. 
[기대효과] 
본 발명에 따르면, 화재감지기에서 화재가 감지되면 드론이 화재감지구역으로 자율 비행하여 영상을 전송함으로써 화재 여부와 화재 상황을 바로 확인할 수 있기 때문에 소방차 및 소방인력이 오인 출동할 우려가 없다.

title_en: Information processing method and non-transitory recording medium
abstract_en: An information processing method causes a processor in a terminal to: display, on the display of the terminal, a first screen representing a pre-preparation process included in cooking processes, the first screen displaying information indicating an intermediate foodstuff made through the pre-preparation process; acquire first identification information indicating a food container storing the intermediate foodstuff from an electronic tag apparatus attached to the food container while the first screen is displayed on the display; store, in a memory, information indicating the intermediate foodstuff or pre-preparation process and the first identification information in correspondence with each other; display, on the display, a second screen representing a finish process included in the cooking processes, the intermediate foodstuff being prepared in the finish process; and when the second screen is displayed, transmit a command to the electronic tag apparatus according to the first identification information so that the user discriminates the food container.

title_en: Optimized navigation method for gas system of iron and steel enterprise
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimized navigation method for a coal gas system of a steel enterprise, which comprises the following steps: modeling a gas system in a network manner; generating a gas dynamic navigation path; identifying a navigation mode and starting a corresponding optimized navigation function; the real-time optimized navigation utilizes real-time optimized scheduling analysis to provide monitoring, control, early warning and decision analysis functions; the historical state optimized navigation utilizes historical inversion to check an expert facing an energy system, utilizes a historical inversion function to evaluate an occurred event, and records good experience and a processing method to an expert knowledge base; the future state optimization navigation checks the prediction result by combining a networked model according to the production and consumption prediction of different energy sources, redistributes the planned performance source supply which cannot meet the constraint conditions and the expert rules, and finds out more reasonable energy supply modes and paths. The method can greatly improve the emergency response speed of the gas system and the accuracy of scheduling regulation.
assignees: NARI RELAYS ELECTRIC CO LTD;NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH

title_en: Disaster site air-space-ground integrated scheduling and consultation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster site air-ground integrated fusion scheduling and consultation system, which comprises a front commanding module, a rear commanding module and a rear scheduling and consultation server, wherein the front commanding module is connected with the rear commanding module; the front commanding module, the rear dispatching consultation server and the rear commanding module are sequentially in communication connection; the front command module comprises a fusion scheduling consultation terminal, information acquisition equipment, individual soldier equipment and a radio station; the rear commanding module comprises a head commanding terminal, a camera, a large display screen, a microphone and a sound box; the rear scheduling consultation server comprises a core command scheduling server, a recording and video server and a GIS server. By the invention, the command and dispatching of the front command post to the site can be realized under the condition of no dependence on the disaster site; the multi-party cooperative command of a rear command center to a plurality of front command posts can be realized; the rear command center can directly carry out flattening command on the individual soldier.

title_en: Emergency communication command system based on satellite broadband platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of emergency communication command systems, and discloses an emergency communication command system based on a satellite broadband platform, which comprises a communication module, integrates various communication modes such as a Tiantong network, a mobile communication network radio communication and the like, and increases the communication record. The command dispatching module comprises three modules, namely a forestation emergency team, a front line command part and an overall command center. The three modules form a command and dispatch system of three-level hierarchical authorities, and can meet different emergency situations and task demands. The invention can be used as a standby communication system when the Internet communication is paralyzed or the signals are unstable. The communication cost can be reduced by using the Internet, the high-power radio transceiver station and the mobile radio transceiver station as communication means of the command center and the front line command part, and the equipment cost of satellite communication can be reduced by adopting the mobile small-sized satellite signal transceiver as communication connection between the satellite and the individual mobile terminal. The standby antenna of the satellite signal receiving and transmitting terminal can be arranged on the unmanned aerial vehicle to send out cloud layers, so that the influence of severe weather on signals is reduced.

title_en: Emergency inversion system based on historical case library
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency inversion system based on a history case library, which comprises a history case library and a functional module, wherein the history case library is used for storing a plurality of history cases, the history cases are cases of the whole emergency management process based on early warning response or emergency response which are already generated, the whole process records from the start of monitoring early warning or the start of the early warning or the emergency response to the occurrence of power grid faults and disaster damage and the input of various emergency resources are realized, the functional module comprises an event interceptor module, an event recording module, an event processing module, a data synchronization module, a data slicing module and a case display module, and the emergency inversion system provides support of key scenes for the history inversion of emergency command and the complex analysis of history data.
assignees: NANJING NARI INFORMATION COMM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-watershed water environment pollution emergency protection system and method based on three-dimensional GIS
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-dimensional GIS-based multi-river basin water environment pollution emergency protection system and method, and belongs to the technical field of water environment pollution emergency protection. The method comprises the steps of constructing a drainage basin database by using a three-dimensional GIS technology, obtaining turbidity data and average pollution concentration data of the drainage basin, unifying data acquisition periods, recording the turbidity data as period turbidity data and the average pollution concentration data as average pollution concentration period data respectively, calculating the change degree and the diffusion degree, designing a pollution index, calculating the comprehensive pollution index, a difference value and a correlation degree, presetting a threshold value, analyzing and outputting emergency protection early warning, rapidly identifying potential pollution events by calculating the change degree and the diffusion degree of different monitoring areas, providing scientific basis for timely emergency, improving multi-basin emergency response capability by a comprehensive pollution index calculation and early warning mechanism, helping related departments to rapidly react, avoiding pollution event diffusion, and effectively protecting water resources and ecological environment.
assignees: JIANGSU GOLDWIND SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD;UNIV HOHAI

title_en: Kiosk for electronic labor contract
title_ko: 전자 근로 계약을 위한 무인 정보 단말 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an unmanned information terminal device for an electronic employment contract. More specifically, the unmanned information terminal device capable of simplifying the conclusion of an employment contract between an employer and a worker comprises: a display panel providing an interface screen for executing an electronic employment contract between an employer and a worker; an identification card scanner which is an identification means of a worker for executing the electronic employment contract extracting first identification data of the worker by allowing a worker identification card to be scanned; and a control means loading an electronic employment contract form corresponding to the first identification data from a database to output and provide the electronic employment contract form to the display panel and recording an input command from the worker and transmitting the input command to a security cloud-based server so that the electronic employment contract between the employer and the worker is concluded.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전자 근로 계약을 위한 무인 정보 단말 장치에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로는 사업주와 근로자 간의 전자 근로 계약 체결을 수행하기 위한 인터페이스 화면을 제공하는 디스플레이 패널; 전자 근로 계약 체결을 수행하기 위한 근로자의 신분 인증 수단으로서, 근로자 신분증이 스캔되도록 하여 근로자의 제1 신분 데이터를 추출하는 신분증 스캐너; 및 제1 신분 데이터 대응되는 전자 근로 계약서 양식을 데이터베이스로부터 로드하여 디스플레이 패널을 통해 출력 제공하고, 근로자로부터 입력되는 입력 명령을 기록하여 보안 클라우드 기반의 서버로 전송함으로써 사업주 및 근로자 간의 전자 근로 계약이 체결되도록 하는 제어 수단;을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Training simulator and method for Inspection Device using argmented reality technology
title_ko: 방사선이용시설 및 방사선 취급 장비에 대한 3차원 볼륨 렌더링 시뮬레이션 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a technology for developing advanced radiation safety education and practice contents centered on radiation exposure situations and realizing preventive safety education for radiation accidents therethrough. By making it possible to implement a program that uses 3D volume rendering simulation technology for radiation utilization facilities and radiation handling equipment, the advanced radiation safety education and practice contents centered on the radiation exposure situations can be developed and the preventive safety education on the radiation accidents can be realized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사선 피폭 상황 중심의 고도화된 방사선 안전 교육 및 실습 콘텐츠를 개발하고 이를 통한 방사선 사고에 대한 예방적 안전 교육을 실현하는 기술에 대한 것으로, 방사선이용시설 및 방사선 취급 장비에 대한 3차원 볼륨 렌더링 시뮬레이션 기술적용하는 프로그램을 구현할 수 있도록 하여, 방사선 피폭 상황 중심의 고도화된 방사선 안전 교육 및 실습 콘텐츠를 개발하고 이를 통한 방사선 사고에 대한 예방적 안전 교육을 실현할 수 있다.

title_en: Coding blocks system for logic education
title_ko: 논리 교육용 코딩 블록 시스템
abstract_en: A coding block system (100) for logic education comprises: an input block (111) which generates and inputs a predetermined state and data; a command block (112) which executes operations such as logic, arithmetic, and comparison determination, and connection functions such as branch and combination, on the input of the input block (111); and an output block (113) which displays an execution result of the command block (112) as a predetermined output. According to the present invention, logic education may be easily received by intuitively checking a program execution result with a coding block combination.
abstract_ko: 이 발명은 C언어나 파이썬 등과 같은 언어를 사용하지 않고 PLC에서 사용 중인 그래픽 언어인 래더 개념을 장난감과 유사한 블록 형태로 적용하는데 조합되는 블록들에 따라 결과가 다르게 나타날 수 있게 프로그램되고 그 실행 결과로서 출력이 정해지는 하드웨어적 시각에서 놀이를 통한 논리개념의 교육을 할 수 있게, 소정의 상태, 데이터를 발생 입력하는 입력 블록(111)과, 상기 입력 블록(111)의 입력에 대해 논리, 산술, 비교 판단과 같은 연산, 그리고 분기, 결합과 같은 연결 기능을 포함하여 실행하는 명령 블록(112), 및 상기 명령 블록(112)의 실행 결과를 소정의 출력으로 나타내는 출력 블록(113)으로 이루어지고, 상기 각각의 블록에는 해당하는 특정 기능으로 구분할 수 있는 ID 정보가 부여되는 코딩 블록(110)과; 상기 코딩 블록(110)이, 복수의 행과 열로 구성되고, 각각으로 분리되는 행열 요소마다 연결되어 전원을 공급하고 전기적인 신호를 주고받을 수 있게 설치되는 커넥터(130)를 통해, 각각의 행열 요소마다 장착 연결 또는 각각의 행열 요소로부터 분리 이탈되게 하는 베이스 보드(120);로 이루어지고, 상기 베이스 보드(120)에, 그래픽 언어인 래더 형태로 상기 코딩 블록(110)의 블록들이 조합 장착되어 상호 연결되면서 정해지는 ID 정보들의 조합으로 특정 논리를 형성하게 프로그램되고, 상기 프로그램의 실행에 따른 결과를 동작 및 상태로 확인하면서 논리 교육을 할 수 있게 한 것을 특징으로 하는 논리 교육용 코딩 블록 시스템(100)을 제공한다.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based safety management platform service method and device
title_ko: 인공지능 기반 안전관리 플랫폼 서비스 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: An artificial intelligence-based safety management platform service device, in a system for providing an artificial intelligence-based safety management platform service for preventing serious disasters at each site by connecting worker terminals and manager terminals distributed at each site to a platform service server, comprises: a risk assessment unit; a checklist unit; a tbm diary unit; a safety education unit; and an accident report unit. The present invention provides a safety management system based on risk assessment. The task risk factor is analyzed and the safety measures is created automatically to checklist and educational material. It also improves worker understanding through tbm education and quizzes. The serious disaster prevention and management efficiency are risen.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예는 하인리히 법칙이나 버드 법칙에 근거한 정확한 안전 상황판을 제공하여 작업자가 중대재해 위험요인을 쉽게 파악하여 사고 감소 대책을 용이하게 실행할 수 있도록 하는 인공지능 기반 안전관리 플랫폼 서비스 방법 및 장치를 개시한다. 개시된 안전관리 플랫폼 서비스 장치는, 각 현장별로 각 작업에 대한 유해요인과 위험요인을 찾아내고, 유해요인과 위험요인에 대한 감소대책을 수립하여 데이터베이스에 저장하는 위험성 평가부와, 상기 위험성 평가부의 감소대책을 회사별, 공종별, 공정별, 작업별로 분류하여 안전 조치 항목으로 체크 리스트를 생성하여 데이터베이스에 저장하는 체크 리스트부와, 감소대책과 체크 리스트를 바탕으로 각 작업에 대한 위험요인 및 안전 대책에 대한 교육을 실시할 수 있게 하고, 공정, 작업, 안전 관리자, 작업 책임자 이름과 작업자들의 이름이 자동 기재되며, 서명란에 작업 책임자와 작업자들이 건강 상태, 위험성 평가 내용에 따른 안전조치에 대해 교육을 받았는지에 대한 사인을 처리하여 TBM 일지를 생성하는 TBM 일지부와, 각 현장에 대한 위험성 평가부의 감소대책과 체크리스트의 체크리스트를 기반으로 조치갯수와 미조치 갯수를 통계처리한 후 하인리히 법칙이나 버드 법칙에 따른 사고 보고 게시판을 생성하여 사용자 로그인시 중대재해 예고 게시판을 통해 표시하는 사고 보고부를 포함한다.

title_en: A device and system for sending emergency alerts on roads using CCTV, sound and VMS
title_ko: Cctv, 음향 및 전광판을 활용한 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a system for transmitting a road unexpected situation alarm, capable of suppressing a secondary accident caused by a following vehicle by detecting an unexpected situation on a road by using a cctv, a sound, and an electric sign installed on the road. According to the present invention, the apparatus for transmitting an emergency signal of an emergency signal of a road comprises: an image acquisition unit; an emergency signal detection unit; and an emergency signal output unit. The cctv image recording from cctv installed at the image acquisition part is on the road is gotten. The outbreak situation sensor senses the outbreak situation whether or not to the outbreak situation sensing model about the cctv image gotten. The alarm signal output unit outputs an alarm signal when an unexpected situation is detected. At this time, the unexpected situation detection model is modeled by machine learning the cctv image, but machine learning is performed by dividing the time, season, and weather at the time of capturing the cctv image into variables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 위에 설치되는 CCTV, 음향 및 전광판을 활용하여 도로 위 돌발상황을 감지하여 후속차량에 의한 2차 사고를 억제할 수 있는 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치는 영상 획득부, 돌발상황 감지부 및 경보 신호 출력부를 포함한다. 영상 획득부는 도로 상에 설치된 CCTV로부터 촬영된 CCTV 영상을 획득한다. 돌발상황 감지부는 획득한 CCTV 영상에 대한 돌발상황 감지 모델로 돌발상황 여부를 감지한다. 그리고 경보 신호 출력부는 돌발상황이 감지되면 경보 신호를 출력한다. 이때 돌발상황 감지 모델은 CCTV 영상을 기계학습 하여 모델링 하되, CCTV 영상을 촬영하는 시점의 시간, 계절 및 기상을 변수로 구분하여 기계학습 한다.

title_en: Rehabilitation system using artificially intelligent horseback-riding apparatus for hippotherapy and method for operating same
title_ko: 히포테라피용 인공지능말을 이용한 재활시스템 및 그의 운용방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to rehabilitative horseback riding and, more specifically, to a rehabilitation system using an artificially intelligent horseback-riding apparatus for hippotherapy and a method for operating same. The present invention provides a rehabilitation system using an artificially intelligent horseback-riding apparatus for hippotherapy, the system comprising: an artificially intelligent horseback-riding apparatus which is ridable; a smartphone which can communicate with a cloud server and has installed an application for controlling the operation state of the artificially intelligent horseback-riding apparatus and operating the horseback-riding apparatus; a diagnostic device which is for diagnosing the state of a patient by means of a brain wave signal of the patient; an operating unit which is for operating the artificially intelligent horseback-riding apparatus; and a cloud server which is for storing, in the smartphone, treatment program and data, necessary for a patient treatment, and for transmitting same, wherein the smartphone has installed therein a plurality of application programs for commanding the artificially intelligent horseback-riding apparatus on the basis of the state and symptoms of the patient, is equipped with an application for detecting a measurement value of various sensors which are equipped in the smartphone and comprise a compass sensor and a gyro sensor, is connected to the diagnostic device, for diagnosing the state of the patient, comprising an electroencephalograph, and exchanges operation data, transmitted from the cloud server, with an interface board, for controlling the operating unit for the operation of the artificially intelligent horseback-riding apparatus, by means of the application programs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재활승마에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 히포테라피(Hippotherapy)용 인공지능말을 이용한 재활 시스템 및 그의 운용 방법에 관한 것이다. 이와 같은 본 발명은 승마가 가능한 인공지능말 기구; 클라우드서버와 통신이 가능하고, 상기 인공지능말 기구의 동작 상태 및 말을 구동하기 위한 어플리케이션을 탑재하고 있는 스마트폰; 환자의 뇌파신호를 통해 환자의 상태를 진단하는 진단장치; 상기 인공지능말 기구의 구동을 위한 구동부(actuator); 및 상기 스마트폰에 환자치료에 필요한 치료프로그램 및 데이터의 저장 및 전송을 담당하는 클라우드서버를 포함하되, 상기 스마트 폰에는 환자의 상태 및 증상에 따라 인공지능말 기구에 명령을 내리는 다수개의 어플리케이션 프로그램이 설치되고, 상기 스마트 폰에 내장된 콤파스 센서, 자이로 센서를 포함하는 각종센서 들의 측정값을 감지하는 어플리케이션이 내장되며, 환자의 상태를 진단하는 뇌파계를 포함하는 상기 진단장치가 연결되고, 상기 클라우드서버로부터 전송된 구동데이터를 상기 어플리케이션 프로그램으로 상기 인공지능말 기구의 구동을 위한 상기 구동부(actuator)를 제어하는 인터페이스보드와 통신하는 것을 특징으로 하는 히포테라피를 위한 인공지능말을 이용한 재활시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Emergency response system and method for health care teacher and health care manager that guide emergency patient classification, treatment and hospital transfer
title_ko: 응급환자 분류, 처치 및 병원 이송을 안내하는 보건교사 및 보건관리자용 응급상황 대응 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: An emergency response system for a health care teacher and a health care manager that guide emergency patient classification, treatment and hospital transfer, according to the present invention, comprises: a patient information input unit in which basic information and health information of students or faculty members are input or updated; information scanning and conversion unit for converting identification, medical records and allergy information of students or faculty members into digital data; a voice recognition and natural language processing unit for recording the symptoms, the conditions and the past medical history of a patient; a data verification and automatic completion unit for requesting correction or supplementation from a user when information is omitted or abnormal data is input; a data security and integrity verification unit for recording, on a blockchain, all data access and correction history; and a control unit for analyzing input symptom data of the patient, classifying relevant symptoms on the basis of an analysis result, and recommending information that should be additionally input.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 응급환자 분류, 처치 및 병원 이송을 안내하는 보건교사 및 보건관리자용 응급상황 대응 시스템은, 학생이나 교직원의 기본 정보와 건강 정보가 입력되거나 업데이트되는 환자 정보 입력부; 학생이나 교직원의 신분증, 의료 기록, 알레르기 정보를 디지털 데이터로 변환하는 정보 스캔 및 변환부; 환자의 증상, 상태, 과거 의료 이력을 기록하는 음성 인식 및 자연어 처리부; 정보가 누락되었거나 비정상적인 데이터가 입력된 경우, 사용자에게 수정 또는 보완을 요청하는 데이터 검증 및 자동 완성부; 모든 데이터 접근 및 수정 이력을 블록체인에 기록하는 데이터 보안 및 무결성 검증부; 입력된 환자의 증상 데이터를 분석하고, 분석 결과를 바탕으로 관련 증상들을 분류하고, 추가로 입력해야 할 정보를 추천하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: Server Based Disaster Recovery by Making Use of Dual Write Responses
abstract_en: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system for asynchronous replication. The mechanism creates a record in a write log in a host computing device for a write command and marking the record as uncommitted. The mechanism maintains a copy of data to be written by the write command at the host computing device. The mechanism issues the write command from the host computing device to a primary storage controller at the primary storage site. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been written to the primary storage site, the mechanism marks the record as unreplicated. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been replicated to a secondary storage site, the mechanism erases the record in the write log and deleting the copy of data.

title_en: Geo-temporal incident navigation with integrated dynamic credibility assessment
abstract_en: Systems and methods for geo-temporal incident navigation. In one method, a graphical user interface (GUI) is generated. The GUI includes a primary window and a secondary window. The primary window includes a peripheral edge, a map, and an incident location indicator overlaid on the map. The secondary window includes an identifier for the incident, a plurality of outcome nodes, corresponding to potential outcomes for the incident, based on a plurality of nodes related to the incident, and a plurality of outcome credibility scores corresponding to the outcome nodes. A graphical control positioned at the peripheral edge of the primary window includes an incident indicator positioned along a timeline. The plurality of outcome nodes is selected and the plurality of credibility scores is computed based on a position of the incident indicator on the timeline. An electronic processor controls a display to present the graphical user interface.

title_en: System and Method for Warning of the Estimated Arrival Time and Expected Intensity in a Particular Area, Caused by a Seismic Movement
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system of warning of estimated time of arrival and expected intensity in a given area resulting from a seismic movement, which comprises a plurality of measurement elements or monitoring stations configuring a network of measurement elements, said method comprising the steps of: arranging the plurality of measurement elements in a specific area; communicating each of the measuring elements with at least one common point or control center; storing in each measuring element an identifier that will uniquely identify the same within the network of monitoring stations; transforming by means of the measuring element the measurement of the movement to a scalar or set of scalars representing the intensity of the movement; transmitting periodically and in real time the measurement and the unique identifier thereof to the control center for the duration of the movement; recording through the control center the individualized measurements from each of the monitoring stations; verifying through the control center if the received measurement corresponds to an actual earthquake or a mechanical noise; designating a destination point; determining the expected intensity and expected arrival time; automatically dispatching an earthquake early warning to the destination point.

title_en: Systems and methods for three-dimensional interaction monitoring in an ems environment
abstract_en: A method for tracking interactions in an emergency response environment according to embodiments of the present invention includes receiving color images and depth information from within a field of view of a sensor array; maintaining an emergency encounter record; monitoring one or both of a position of an object and movement of the object in the emergency response environment based on the color images and depth information received by the sensor array; and recording an occurrence of a condition in the emergency encounter record, wherein the condition is based on the one or both of the position of the object and the movement of the object.

title_en: Video content analysis system and method for transportation system
abstract_en: A video content analysis system for mobile assets includes a track detection and infrastructure monitoring component. The track detection and infrastructure monitoring components include a reinforcement learning component, an object detection and location component, and an obstacle detection component to analyze video data, audio data, vehicle data, weather data, and route/checklist data to determine internal and/or external conditions related to the asset. A data acquisition and recording system uploads the data, internal and/or external condition information, object detection information, object position information, and obstacle detection information to a remote memory module and provides streaming video data to a remotely located user in real-time. Remotely located users can view the data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides faster emergency responses, verifies the validity of repairs and re-routing, and monitors panelist performance and safety.

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system DARS and viewer for mobile assets includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores compressed records of the data in the local memory module at least once per second. DARS is designed to operate in near real-time mode, storing a complete record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once every second and up to once every tenth of a second. The remotely located user may: viewing video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides faster emergency responses; verifying the effectiveness of the repair and rerouting; and monitor panelist performance and safety.

title_en: Ocean emergency scheduling method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine communication, in particular to a marine emergency dispatching method, a marine emergency dispatching system, a computer device and a storage medium, which comprise the following steps: based on marine environmental monitoring data, signal strength and delay data are extracted from the communication node's history record, generating an environmental and performance basis data set. According to the invention, through integrating the analysis of the environment and performance basic data set and the real-time communication network state, the response speed and efficiency of the marine emergency communication are improved, the delay, the packet loss rate and the bandwidth requirement of each node in the communication network are quantitatively evaluated, the weight analysis of marine environment factors is combined, the optimal communication path can be determined, the resource allocation is optimized, the emergency response time is reduced, the future communication state change can be predicted through the time sequence analysis of the communication quality, the key risk point is identified, and the communication strategy can be adjusted in advance according to the prediction information, so that the potential communication faults are avoided.

title_en: Algorithm model operation monitoring method and system for power industry
abstract_en: The invention provides an algorithm model operation monitoring method and system for the power industry, and relates to the field of model monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting physical quantity data of power equipment through a dynamic causal chain construction module, generating a causal chain after noise suppression and preprocessing, binding with algorithm model parameters, recording mutation events and associated parameter update logs, utilizing a four-dimensional space-time lock synchronization module to attach geographic coordinates and time stamps to ensure data space-time consistency, constructing an optimization strategy by a multi-target game strategy engine module based on historical misinformation events and resource consumption records and combining SLA time constraint of a real-time detection task, triggering emergency response by a DEED-Trigger anti-intuitionism triggering module according to deviation between real-time data and the optimization strategy, injecting compound fault test causal chain robustness by a digital twin technology through a verification platform, and dynamically adjusting causal chain structure and strategy.

title_en: High-speed rescue material scheduling method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to a high-speed rescue material scheduling method and system based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of emergency management, wherein the method comprises the steps of dispatching an unmanned aerial vehicle provided with a multi-mode sensing unit to fly against a target area for dynamic inspection, receiving an aid seeking signal sent by the target area through an Internet of things terminal and an inspection signal returned by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and generating an estimated value of the number of trapped people; and generating a dynamic material scheduling scheme based on the estimated value of the trapped people, the real-time disaster prediction information and a preset material demand model, and sending the dynamic material scheduling scheme to a rescue execution unit through an Internet of things scheduling platform. Therefore, the response speed and timeliness of material scheduling are improved.

title_en: Lightweight extraction method and system for disaster risk area on satellite
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightweight extraction method and system for an on-board disaster risk zone, and belongs to the technical field of intersection of satellite remote sensing data processing and emergency disaster response. The method comprises the steps of satellite remote sensing image receiving and on-board preprocessing, disaster risk area on-board extraction and geospatial data conversion, data light weight, namely, carrying out boundary simplification on data in a converted format by using a boundary simplification function, carrying out centroid extraction by using a centroid calculation function to generate simplified vector data, and carrying out data downloading based on Beidou short messages, and ground data receiving and visual display. The invention can realize 'on-board completion of core processing, light-weight data adaptation Beidou and minute-level downloading to the ground', and breaks through the timeliness bottleneck of disaster emergency response.

title_en: Method and incident management system, and computer-readable recording medium
title_ko: 침해 사고 정보를 관리하기 위한 방법과 침해 사고 관리 시스템, 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 매체
abstract_ko:
본 실시예는 외부의 침해 공유 채널로부터 수집되거나 생성된 침해 악용 자원, 침해 연관 정보 및 침해 정보를 수집 또는 조회시 이들의 유기적인 연관 관계를 고려하여 적어도 하나의 인덱스(ID)를 부여하여 관리할 수 있는 메카니즘이 제공된다. 
이에, 본 실시예는 침해사고 정보 관리를 통해, 그에 따른 침해 연관 성을 파악하고, 이를 분류 및 체계적으로 관리함으로써, 차후에 발생하는 침해 사고에 대해 지능적인 분석의 방향성을 제시할 수 있다.

title_en: System for operating public transportation
title_ko: 교통약자 수요응답형 대중교통 운영 시스템
abstract_en: The public transportation operation system includes a vehicle terminal, a driver terminal, a passenger terminal, a vehicle operation manager terminal, a local government manager terminal, and a public transportation integrated operation server. The terminal for the vehicles offers on board information and getting off guideline. It manages dispatch and operation and the driver terminal is created the penalty information. It is created the digital code and the passenger terminal processes the billing information. It best suiteds, the vehicle operation administrator terminal is proceed allocation. The integration operation server outputs the operation prediction result by using the artificial neural network based on operation and getting on and off car data. The present invention analyzes public transportation operation and getting on and off data by integrating a vehicle and a manager terminal. In addition, customized transportation services are provided by generating operation prediction results through artificial neural networks. Furthermore, the effect improving the operation efficiency and enhances the user satisfaction is provided.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 대중교통 운영 시스템에 관한 것으로, 대중교통 차량의 시동이 온되면 상기 대중교통 차량에 탑승할 탑승자의 정보 및 좌석 정보를 제공하면서 상기 대중교통 차량의 운행 경로에 따른 예상 하차 시간과 하차 안내 정보를 제공하는 차량용 단말; 상기 대중교통 차량의 배차정보, 운행경로, 차량점검 및 운행기록을 관리하고, 상기 탑승자가 미승차시 페널티 정보를 생성하고, 운전자에 대한 잔여 휴식시간 정보를 제공하는 운전자 단말; 상기 페널티 정보가 반영된 요금지불 정보를 생성하고, 상기 대중교통 차량의 도착 전 탑승준비 알림 정보와 도착 후 탑승하차 알림 정보를 제공하며, 상기 대중교통 차량의 탑승 전 탑승 지역과 연령별 구분된 탑승인원 정보를 설정하는 탑승자 단말; 상기 대중교통 차량의 운행 기록 데이터, 차량상태 데이터, 노선 및 정류장 데이터를 축적하고, 상기 탑승자 단말로부터 탑승 요청시 상기 탑승자 단말의 위치를 기초로 최적 경로의 운행이 가능한 대중교통 차량을 배차하는 차량운행 관리자 단말; 상기 탑승자의 회원정보와 승하차 기록 데이터를 축적하고, 상기 요금지불 정보를 기초로 수입정산 및 보조금 내역을 관리하여 외부 정산 서버와 교신하는 지자체 관리자 단말; 및 상기 대중교통 차량의 운행 기록과 상기 탑승자의 승하차 기록을 기초로 상기 대중교통 차량의 운영 예측 결과를 제공하는 대중교통 통합 운영 서버;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Multifunctional traffic management and emergency incident command and handling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multifunctional traffic management and emergency incident command and handling system and method, is to provide a plurality of intelligent management schemes suitable for dispersing and directing the traffic jams under various environments, and meanwhile, provides an efficient and integrated signal system and product for commanding and handling emergency social and natural disasters as well as an organization and management scheme for preventing or reducing personal injury and casualty. The multifunctional traffic management and emergency incident command and handling system comprises a video signal module, an audio signal module, a manual setting keyboard module, a labor broadcast module, a timing and clock module, a recording and photographing module, a law-breaking trigger module, an illumination module, a microcontroller module and a power supply and power supply module. The multifunctional traffic management and emergency incident command and handling system and method are widely applied to urban and rural road traffic control and management, and especially applied to the fields of dispersing and directing of the city traffic jams and command and handling and management of emergency events and disaster accidents.

title_en: Information switching system for earthquake field operating personnel
abstract_en: The invention provides an information switching system for earthquake field operating personnel. The information switching system comprises a dispatching platform and a mobile terminal, wherein the dispatching platform comprises an identity information acquiring module and a recording module; the mobile terminal comprises a receiving module, a sending module and a positional information overlaying module. Through the embodiment of the invention, identity information and positional information corresponding to the identity information are obtained through the dispatching platform, the received identity information and the received positional information corresponding to the identity information are overlaid on a topographical image map through the positional information overlaying module, the mobile terminal is used for sending the own identity information to the dispatching platform to realize information sharing of all terminals, and thus the rescue efficiency is improved; the operating personnel can select appropriate teammate identity information according to geographic position change, so that the time of the operating personnel is reduced.
assignees: JIANGSU GUOYAO INFORMATION SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: The emergency command communication system of IP based network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the emergency command communication systems of IP based network, comprising: core communication service device, conferencing resource server, digital recording server, SMS module, service interface server, the network switch, audio docking gateway, conference terminal, wireless colony gateway, digital relay gateway, PSTN/PBX, dispatching desk, internal private network, second level platform；Core communication service device, conferencing resource server, digital recording server, SMS module, service interface server and the network switch connect, and the network switch is also connect with audio docking gateway, wireless colony gateway, digital relay gateway, dispatching desk, internal private network respectively；The wireless colony gateway is connected with communication apparatus；Internal private network connects second level platform.The development of the business such as speech, data, video when present invention has ensured routine work contact, emergency event emergency disposal between platforms at different levels, it is ensured that it is unobstructed that safety is got in touch between state highway road network center and city-level, country highway road network center.
assignees: SICHUAN YONGCHAO NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of earthquake data acquisition stratified management system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of earthquake data acquisition stratified management system.Central record control central record control unit is connect with multiple Transmission and Management Units in system, and central record control unit is used to send signal to Transmission and Management Unit, and receives the signal of Transmission and Management Unit transmission；Each Transmission and Management Unit is connect with multiple gathered data transmission units, and each Transmission and Management Unit is used to send signal to the gathered data transmission unit being attached thereto, and receives the signal of gathered data transmission unit transmission；Each gathered data transmission unit is connect with multiple transmission of seismic data units, and each gathered data transmission unit is used to send signal to the transmission of seismic data unit being attached thereto, and receives the signal of transmission of seismic data unit transmission.The transmission of seismic data unit that system using the present invention makes central record control unit pass through Transmission and Management Unit to each distributed capture point sends control command simultaneously, improves the synchronism of earthquake data acquisition.
assignees: Guangzhou Marine Geological Survey;FIRST INST OCEANOGRAPHY SOA;NAT DEEP SEA CT;XIAN HONGLUYANG ELECTROMECHANICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: A kind of satellite communication method and satellite communication system applied to emergency command
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of satellite communication methods applied to emergency command, based on telecommunication satellite, Adaptive Modulation and Coding AMC is respectively adopted, coding transmission is carried out to the first information for being transferred to satellite communication terminal from main website, coding transmission is carried out to the second information for being transferred to main website from satellite communication terminal using low-density checksum LDPC code, satellite communication system forward link and the asymmetric feature of reverse link are adapted to, to improve the efficiency of transmission of satellite communication system, and then it ensure that the timeliness of emergency command message transmission.Invention additionally discloses a kind of satellite communication systems applied to emergency command, have above-mentioned beneficial effect.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH INFORMATION INDUSTRY CO LTD

title_en: Controllable earthquake focus generating device and controllable earthquake focus generating method for realizing accurate timing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a controllable earthquake focus generating device and a controllable earthquake focus generating method for realizing accurate timing, wherein the device comprises the following components: compressed air generating equipment, pneumatic focus equipment, a control unit and a handheld controller; the hand-held controller sends out a vibration command, the control unit receives and analyzes the vibration command, the compressed air generating device is started, and aerodynamic force is provided for the pneumatic seismic source device through the air pipeline; when the command is a manual command, the pneumatic seismic source equipment vibrates once, and the current UTC time is recorded; when the command is an automatic command, obtaining starting vibration time, vibration gap time and vibration times, vibrating the pneumatic vibration source equipment once when the current UTC time is consistent with the starting vibration time, continuing to wait for the next vibration gap time until all vibration times are completed, ending the automatic vibration, storing a vibration time file and uploading the vibration time file to a handheld controller; the method has the advantages of saving manpower, accurately measuring time and being beneficial to improving the accuracy of analysis of acquired data in the later stage of the seismograph.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC GEOPHYSICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Electric quantity and non-electric quantity internet of things monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric quantity and non-electric quantity internet of things monitoring device, which comprises: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time operation data of each interface in the power distribution equipment, recording the real-time operation data to obtain full-power data, and receiving operation data of sensing equipment provided with a Bluetooth sub-module based on a Bluetooth technology; the processor and the communication module are used for carrying out safety evaluation on the acquired full-power data and the operation data of the sensing equipment, displaying an evaluation result on a local liquid crystal screen, and transmitting the data and the evaluation result to the background based on a broadband power carrier technology; and the execution module is used for positioning hidden danger points based on the background and carrying out emergency response on the power distribution equipment based on preset emergency measures when the evaluation result judges that the hidden danger of electricity consumption exists. The invention simplifies the data transmission mode, and is convenient for workers to check the electricity consumption and line safety condition through the preset liquid crystal display screen.

title_en: Escape and rescue integrated emergency evacuation system and operation method
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of fire protection, and provides an escape and rescue integrated emergency evacuation system and an operation method, wherein the system comprises a terminal module, a fire alarm module, an emergency evacuation module and a cloud platform module; the terminal module is used for receiving and displaying the navigation route and the user position information; providing a rescue personnel mode or an escape personnel mode, wherein the rescue personnel mode comprises a map marking function; the fire alarm module is used for collecting alarm information of a fire detector in a building and sending the alarm information to the emergency evacuation module; the emergency evacuation module is used for acquiring the position information of the user, generating a navigation route and sending the navigation route to the user; the message information is mutually transmitted with the terminal module; uploading the information content and record of the coming and going information to the cloud platform module; the cloud platform module is used for storing the uploaded information and opening information sharing; the invention can effectively reduce the information difference among the personnel in the fire scene, solves the problems of untimely and out-of-place information grasping of the rescue scene by the fire command center, and improves the success rate of rescue.
assignees: SHENZHEN HIGH NEW INVEST SANJIANG ELECTRONICS CO LTD

title_en: Emergency rescue method and system based on mixed ant colony optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency rescue method and system based on mixed ant colony optimization, relating to the technical field of emergency rescue, the method initializes ant colony algorithm parameters including ant number, pheromone matrix, heuristic factors and volatilizing factors by collecting key data such as wounded position, survival probability change, rescue vehicle, hospital position and the like. Then, a survival probability function is set based on the real data of the survival probability of the wounded, and pheromone matrix record path information is constructed. In the iterative process of the algorithm, a rescue target is selected with a certain probability according to the pheromone concentration and heuristic information, the total survival probability of wounded on the path is calculated, and the pheromone matrix is updated according to the total survival probability. And finally outputting the rescue path with the highest total survival probability as an optimal rescue sequence through continuous iterative optimization. The method remarkably improves emergency response efficiency, can rapidly respond to emergencies in a complex rescue environment, and has strong global optimizing capability, excellent adaptability and robustness.

title_en: Extreme weathering self-adaptive flight control system for complex terrain of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extreme weathering self-adaptive flight control system of a complex terrain of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle self-adaptive flight control. The extreme weathering self-adaptive flight control system of the unmanned aerial vehicle complex terrain comprises a flight data acquisition and preprocessing module, a weathering prediction and risk assessment module, an optimal path and task sequence adjustment module, a real-time flight control and path optimization module and a safety emergency response and recording module, wherein the flight data acquisition and preprocessing module acquires air traffic data, the weathering prediction and risk assessment module constructs a neural network model to predict weather, the optimal path and task sequence adjustment module carries out path and task safety assessment, the real-time flight control and path optimization module converts path and task sequence into an airplane instruction, and the safety emergency response and recording module executes an emergency strategy and records. The problem that in the prior art, unmanned aerial vehicle is difficult to adjust flying in real time due to continuous change of weather conditions is solved.
assignees: HANGZHOU FENGCHAO YUNSHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distributed power supply intelligent grid-connected evaluation scheduling method and system based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The intelligent grid-connected evaluation scheduling method and system for the distributed power supply based on multi-source data fusion are used for preprocessing collected original operation data to generate a fusion data set, analyzing the influence of the distributed power supply grid connection on the operation state of a power grid based on the fusion data set to obtain the risk level of the distributed power supply grid-connected operation, constructing a multi-stage scheduling model, wherein the multi-stage scheduling model comprises an initialization stage, a dynamic adjustment stage and an emergency response stage, selecting a current corresponding scheduling stage according to the current operation state of the power grid, an evaluation index and a short-term predicted value of the operation state of the power grid to generate a corresponding scheduling strategy, scheduling the power grid according to the scheduling strategy, collecting the operation response data of the power grid to form feedback information, and obtaining the operation state of the current power grid based on the feedback information. According to the invention, not only can the grid-connected evaluation and scheduling be performed by fusing the data set, the evaluation accuracy is effectively improved, but also the response timeliness is effectively improved by performing the grid-connected evaluation and scheduling through the short-term predicted value.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INST OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Teaching, evaluating and authenticating service system and method of eco drive
title_ko: 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: Eco-drive education, evaluation, and authentication service systems and a method thereof are provided to enable all eco-drive experience applicants to experience eco-drive in an eco-drive experience center, thereby quantizing data evaluated by the eco-drive evaluation system. CONSTITUTION: An eco-drive experience vehicle(11) is equipped in an eco-drive experience center(10). An SCP(Smart Car Platform) automatically stores eco/non-eco drive mode information corresponding to an operation of the vehicle. An echo-navigation device displays the information of the SCP. A Bluetooth transmitting/receiving computer(12) receives the information from the eco-navigation. A server(14) uploads the information. An eco-drive portal site(16) receives the information from the server. [Reference numerals] (13) Internet
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 국제 표준인 OBD-2 표준커넥터를 통하여 실시간으로 수집된 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량의 운행 내용에 대한 기초적인 데이터(주행기록, 주행패턴 정보, 고장정보, 연료소모 및 온실가스 등의 정보)를 각 항목의 성질에 맞게 개별적으로 분석하고, 그 분석된 정보를 에코 드라이브 포털사이트(www.ecodriving.kr) 상의 에코 드라이브 평가 시스템을 통해 평가하여 운전자에게 최적의 에코 드라이브 컨설팅 교육을 제공함으로써, 운전자의 자동차 운전습관을 바꾸어 연료절감 및 온실가스감축, 교통사고 감소효과를 유발할 수 있는 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템은 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터와; 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터에 구비되며, 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자가 탑승할 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량과; 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량에 장착되어, 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량이 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터를 운행할 시, 에코 드라이브 모드 정보와 비에코 드라이브 모드 정보를 각각 구분하여 자동 저장하는 스마트 카 플랫폼(Smart Car Platform: SCP)과; 상기 SCP와 연동되어 상기 SCP의 상기 에코 드라이브 모드 정보와 비에코 드라이브 모드 정보를 디스플레이하며, 블루투스 기능을 구비한 에코 네비게이션과; 상기 에코 네비게이션에 장착된 블루투스에 의해 송신된 상기 에코 드라이브 모드 정보와 비에코 드라이브 모드 정보를 수신하기 위한 블루투스 송ㆍ수신 컴퓨터와; 인터넷을 통해 상기 블루투스 송ㆍ수신 컴퓨터에 의해 전송된 상기 에코 드라이브 모드 정보와 비에코 드라이브 모드 정보를 업로드하기 위한 서버와; 상기 서버의 정보를 저장하기 위한 데이터 베이스; 및 상기 서버로부터 정보를 제공받는 에코 드라이브 포털사이트를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따른 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 방법은 유선 또는 무선 통신망을 통해 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자의 컴퓨터와 관리자의 컴퓨터와 연결되어 에코 드라이브 평가 및 인증 프로그램을 제공하는 서버를 이용한 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 방법으로서, 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자의 컴퓨터를 통해 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스에 에코 드라이브 체험 교육생으로 등록하는 단계와; 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용센터에 구비된 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량이 비에코 드라이브 모드로 주행되는 단계와; 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량이 에코 드라이브 모드로 주행되는 단계와; 비에코/에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보가 검출 및 수집되는 단계와; 상기 비에코/에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보가 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량의 스마트 카 플랫폼(Smart Car Platform: SCP)에 로드되는 단계와; 상기 SPC와 연동되어, 상기 비에코/에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보가 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 전용차량의 에코 네비게이션에 디스플레이되는 단계와; 상기 로드된 비에코/에코 드라이브 모드의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보가 상기 서버에 업로드되는 단계와; 상기 서버에 의해 상기 비에코/에코 드라이브 모드 상황에서의 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보가 수신, 저장 및 비교분석 평가되는 단계와;  상기 비교분석 평가된 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보가 데이터 베이스에 저장되는 단계; 및 상기 서버의 요청에 의해 상기 비교분석 평가된 주행상태 정보 및 운전 패턴 정보가 상기 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자의 컴퓨터에 제공되는 단계를 포함하는 것을 특징으로  한다. 
본 발명에 따른 에코 드라이브 교육, 평가 및 인증 서비스 시스템 및 방법은 모든 에코 드라이브 체험 신청자가 동일하게 표준화된 주행 환경에서 에코 드라이브를 체험하게 함으로써, 에코 드라이브 평가시스템에 의해 평가된 데이터를 계량화시킬 수 있다. 또한, 자동차 운전자의 운전습관을 바꾸어 줌으로써, 운전자가 급출발, 급가속, 급정지, 공회전을 억제시키고 경제속도를 유지하게 하며, 타이어 공기압을 적정수준으로 유지하게 하고, 소모품 관리 등과 같은 자동차 관리를 통하여, 연료절감 및 온실가스 감축에 큰 영향을 미칠 수 있다. 나아기, 에코 드라이브 실천에 따라 수반되는 교통사고 감소로 인하여, 교통사고로 인한 사회적ㆍ경제적 비용을 크게 감소시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Terminal, method and computer-readable recording medium for informing emergency situation
title_ko: 위급상황 알림단말장치, 방법 및 컴퓨터로 판독 가능한 기록 매체
abstract_en: The present invention provides an emergency situation notification terminal device comprising: a setting unit to set an operation of an emergency situation notification service, execution conditions, or execution content; an input unit to refer to the conditions set in the setting unit, to determine an input as an emergency situation notification command when the condition is satisfied, and to receive the same; an execution unit to execute the emergency situation notification command with a phone number which is predetermined in the setting unit when the emergency situation notification command is inputted through the input unit; a communication unit to transmit the emergency situation notification command to an emergency situation notification server; and a control unit to control the setting unit, the execution unit, and the communication unit. The emergency situation notification terminal device, a method, and a computer-readable recording medium according to the present invention transmit position information of a terminal device and/or an emergency situation notification message to a pre-designated terminal device if a user who uses the terminal device does not operate the terminal device during a pre-designated time or the capacity of a terminal device battery is reduced below a pre-designated level or power of the terminal device is arbitrarily turned off.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 위급상황 알림서비스의 작동 여부, 실행 조건 또는 실행 내용을 설정하는 설정부; 상기 설정부에서 설정된 조건을 참조하여 조건 만족시 위급상황 알림명령으로 판단하여 이를 입력받는 입력부; 상기 입력부를 통한 위급상황 알림명령 입력시 상기 설정부에서 기 설정된 전화번호로 위급상황 알림명령을 수행하는 수행부; 위급상황알림서버로 상기 위급상황 알림명령을 전송하는 통신부; 및 상기 설정부, 입력부, 수행부 및 통신부의 각 동작을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 위급상황 알림단말장치를 제공한다. 
본 발명에 따른 위급상황 알림단말장치, 방법 및 컴퓨터로 판독 가능한 기록 매체는 단말장치 사용자가 기 지정된 시간 동안 상기 단말장치를 작동시키지 않거나 상기 단말장치 배터리의 용량이 기 지정된 수준 이하로 감소하는 경우 또는 단말장치의 전원을 임의로 끄는 경우 기 지정된 다른 단말장치로 상기 단말장치의 위치정보 및/또는 위급상황 알림메시지를 전송하게 된다.

title_en: Incident category selection optimization
abstract_en: This disclosure describes techniques that enable a categorization controller to detect activation of a portable recording device that is configured to capture a real-time multimedia stream of the current event. The categorization controller may further identify a set of categories that are likely associated with the real-time multimedia stream, determine an ordered ranking of the set of categories, and generate a ranked category dataset for delivery to the portable recording device. In doing so, the portable recording device may present the ordered ranking of the set of categories at a user interface.
assignees: GETAC TECHNOLOGY CORP;WHP WORKFLOW SOLUTIONS INC

title_en: Mobile Application for Real-Time Legal Guidance, Interaction Documentation, and Emergency Response during Law Enforcement Encounters
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a mobile application system designed to provide real-time legal guidance, secure documentation, and emergency response during encounters with law enforcement. The system incorporates artificial intelligence-based speech-to-text transcription, contextual legal analysis, and actionable advice tailored to user interactions and applicable laws. A recording module captures audio in real-time, while a context analysis module generates situationally appropriate “Do's” and “Don'ts” linked to relevant legal frameworks. The application features an emergency response module for immediate communication with predefined contacts, location sharing, and alert generation. Encrypted storage ensures secure handling of recordings and interaction logs for legal admissibility. Additionally, the application provides jurisdiction-specific legal insights, scenario-based guidance, and curated updates on user rights, empowering individuals to navigate interactions with confidence while fostering transparency and accountability.

title_en: Electromagnetic spectrum management and control simulation method, system and medium based on presence/absence formation
abstract_en: The invention provides an electromagnetic spectrum management and control simulation method, a system and a medium based on an on-off/on-on formation, relates to the field of electromagnetic spectrum management and control, and fills the gap of the existing electromagnetic spectrum management and control simulation technology aiming at a real battlefield environment; the method comprises the following steps: recording basic simulation information data, generating frequency-using equipment parameters of the red and blue party on/off formation, and obtaining a radiation signal waveform; simulating and propagating the radiation signal waveform to obtain a received signal waveform; visually displaying electromagnetic spectrum characteristics of a received signal waveform and basic simulation information data, and determining a conflict of frequency-using equipment; aiming at the conflict of frequency-consuming equipment inside the formation and between the two sides of the formation, the formation command personnel performs electromagnetic spectrum control operation to obtain control result data; circularly carrying out multi-round electromagnetic spectrum management and control simulation, and storing a plurality of management and control result data; the invention can provide scientific basis for the optimal configuration of the frequency-using equipment and the test and evaluation of interference and anti-interference strategies in the simulated battlefield environment.

title_en: System for validating and appending incident-related data records in a distributed electronic ledger
Channel searching cancel method of digital multimedia broadcasting receiver
title_ko: 디지털 멀티미디어 방송수신장치의 채널탐색 취소방법
abstract_en: A channel search cancellation method in a DMB(Digital Multimedia Broadcasting) receiving apparatus is provided to cancel channel search while searching a channel and inform a user that the channel search is cancelled to reduce the power consumption of the DMB receiving apparatus and improve usability. A DMB receiving unit(110) searches the first channel including a DMB signal corresponding to a certain broadcasting program, and receives the DMB signal. A key input unit(160) receives a channel search cancellation command for canceling search for the first channel. If the channel search cancellation command is received, a UI(User Interface) generating unit(150) generates a message for informing that the channel search is being cancelled. An AV processing unit(130) processes the message outputted from the UI generating unit(150) to be displayed on a screen. A control unit(180) controls the DMB receiving unit(110) to cancel the search for the first channel according to the channel search cancellation command, and controls the UI generating unit(150) and the AV processing unit(130) to generate the message and display the generated message on the screen.
abstract_ko:
디지털 멀티미디어 방송수신장치의 채널탐색 취소방법이 개시된다. 본 디지털 멀티미디어 방송수신장치는 소정 방송프로그램에 대응되는 디지털 멀티미디어 방송(Digital Multimedia Broadcasting:DMB)신호가 포함된 제1채널을 탐색하여, 디지털 멀티미디어 방송신호를 수신하는 DMB수신부, 제1채널에 대한 탐색을 취소하라는 채널탐색 취소명령을 입력받는 키입력부, 채널탐색 취소명령이 입력되면, 채널탐색 취소중임을 알리는 메시지를 생성하는 UI(User Interface)생성부, UI생성부에서 출력된 메시지를 화면에 표시하도록 신호처리하는 비디오처리부, 그리고, 채널탐색 취소명령에 따라, 제1채널에 대한 탐색을 취소하도록 DMB수신부를 제어함과 동시에, 채널탐색이 취소되고 있음을 알리는 메시지를 생성하여 화면에 표시하도록 UI생성부 및 비디오처리부를 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이에 따라 채널탐색 중, 필요에 따라 채널탐색을 취소하고, 채널탐색 중임을 사용자에게 알릴 수 있게 된다. 
       
     채널탐색, 탐색취소, DMB(Digital Multimedia Broadcasting)

title_en: Carbon Dioxide Fire Extinguishing Facility Control And Monitoring System
title_ko: 이산화탄소 소화설비 제어 및 통합 모니터링 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a system for controlling and integrally monitoring carbon dioxide fire extinguishing equipment. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the system for controlling and integrally monitoring carbon dioxide fire extinguishing equipment comprises: an operation control room having an integrated monitoring system that controls the operation of fire extinguishing equipment control systems via an Ethernet TCP/IP, and a web server that wirelessly communicates with a mobile device; the mobile device wirelessly communicating with the web server of the operation control room, outputting information obtained through the integrated monitoring system, and transmitting an input control signal to the integrated monitoring system via the web server; and the fire extinguishing equipment control systems connected to the Ethernet at multiple locations to operate under the control of the operation control room, controlling the operation of carbon dioxide fire extinguishing equipment, detecting the status of the carbon dioxide fire extinguishing equipment in real time, transmitting the same to the operation control room, outputting status information of the carbon dioxide fire extinguishing equipment through a touch screen mounted on the front part of one side thereof, and using a PLC program for controlling the operation of the carbon dioxide fire extinguishing equipment through a control signal input by a touch. Therefore, the system comprises components which can prevent the equipment from malfunctioning due to the generation of an abnormal signal, can prevent an accident in which a fire is recognized due to equipment malfunction, carbon dioxide is sprayed, and power generation equipment is stopped, can modify the malfunction at any time by a relay sequence during equipment operation, and can easily check equipment and panel statuses through monitoring of a touch on the front part.
abstract_ko:
이산화탄소 소화설비 제어 및 통합 모니터링 시스템이 개시된다.  본 발명의 실시예에 따른 이산화탄소 소화설비 제어 및 통합 모니터링 시스템은, 이더넷(Ethernet) TCP/IP를 통해 소화설비 제어시스템의 운용을 제어하는 통합 모니터링 시스템과 모바일 디바이스와 무선통신을 수행하는 웹서버를 구비하는 운전제어실; 상기 운전제어실의 웹서버와 무선통신을 수행하고, 통합 모니터링 시스템을 통해 획득한 정보를 출력하며, 입력된 제어신호를 웹서버를 통해 통합 모니터링 시스템에 전달하는 모바일 디바이스; 및 상기 운전제어실의 제어에 의해 작동하도록 이더넷에 다수 개소 연결되고, 이산화탄소 소화설비의 작동을 제어하며, 이산화탄소 소화설비의 상태를 실시간으로 검출하여 운전제어실에 전송하며, 일측 전면부에 장착된 터치 스크린을 통해 이산화탄소 소화설비의 상태 정보를 출력하고, 터치 입력된 제어신호를 통해 이산화탄소 소화설비의 작동을 제어하는 PLC 프로그램을 적용한 소화설비 제어시스템;을 포함하는 것을 구성의 요지로 한다. 
본 발명에 따르면, 이상 신호 발생으로 인해 설비가 오동작하는 것을 방지할 수 있고, 설비 오동작으로 인해 화재로 인식하여 이산화탄소를 분사하고 발전설비가 정지되는 사고를 방지할 수 있으며, 설비 운영중 릴레이 시퀀스로 인하여 언제든 수정 가능하고, 전면부 터치 모니터링으로 설비 및 판넬 상태를 손쉽게 확인할 수 있는 구성을 포함하는 이산화탄소 소화설비 제어 및 통합 모니터링 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Scoring server
abstract_en: A scoring server for assessing technical skills in a practical environment. A client application acts as a middle man between a terminal and an operating system to capture and forward all input from and output to students to the scoring server. The scoring server compares recorded student activity against a list of tasks deemed capable of accomplishing course objectives assigned to students. As objectives are met by a student, the students' grade is updated in real-time. Each student passes or fails an exam based on tasks performed and skills employed. The client application exists for two operating system types: WINDOWS® and LINUX®. A LINUX® client employs a pseudoterminal to permit access to terminal input/output and communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr channels. A windows client (WC) comprises a WC command line activity logger and a WC monitor process to intercept all communication through stdin, stdout, and stderr communication channels.

title_en: Driving simulation test method for test bench of power system of electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a driving simulation test method in the field of a power system of an electric automobile. In the method, a speed curve part, a power calculating and matching part, a data processing part, a dynamometer, a vehicle road impedance realization part, an accelerator output part, a brake output part, a shift operation part and the power system are combined, and the corresponding functional modules are integrated; by setting target speed-time parameters, technical parameters of different vehicles and the like and calculating and matching the power of the whole vehicle, different commands such as rotating speed, torque, accelerator, brake, clutch, shift and the like at different speeds are obtained, and components on a test bench of the power system of the electric automobile perform corresponding actions so as to complete driving simulation tests under different predetermined road conditions and different vehicle models; and analysis can be performed according to the acquired and recorded related data after the tests are finished so as to obtain the related performance analysis report of the power system and complete the driver driving simulation test on the test bench of the power system of the electric automobile.
assignees: HUNAN CSR TIMES ELECTRIC AUTOMOBILE CO LTD

title_en: Data replication system and method for guaranteeing data consistency of application layer
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data copying system and method for ensuring the consistency of application layer data, the system includes: the control management module is used for sending a control command to the production end and acquiring state information and is responsible for unifying task scheduling and state collection work of the production end and the disaster recovery end; the production end captures and records write operation of protection data by using the filter driving module after data synchronization, forms a filter driving log by the captured data and stores the filter driving log in a filter driving log cache, adjusts an application program of the production end to a silent state when receiving a consistency check point acquisition control command sent by the control management module, informs the filter driving module to generate a consistency check point, generates a check point log entry and inserts the check point log entry into the cache, and sends the cached log entry to the disaster recovery end; and the disaster recovery end receives and stores the data synchronized by the production end and the log entries sent by the production end, and informs corresponding storage equipment to carry out snapshot operation when the log entries of the checkpoint type are checked.

title_en: Accident handling method, device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides an accident handling method, an accident handling device, a storage medium and a program product, which are used for creating an accident handling task and an initial user group chat group by receiving an accident creation instruction of a network application service; acquiring accident data, determining related personnel causing the accident and/or affected by the accident according to the accident data, and sending notification messages so as to enable the related personnel to join in a user group chat group; and displaying and/or recording the user group chat information and/or the accident related information in the accident handling process through the user group chat group. The accident handling task and the initial user group chat group are created in a standardized manner for any accident source, related personnel causing the accident and/or affected by the accident are accurately determined to be notified, the user group chat group is conveniently added, user group chat information and/or accident related information in the accident handling process is displayed and/or recorded in the user group chat group, the standardization and the intellectualization of the accident emergency response flow are realized, the accident handling efficiency and the integrity of information recording are improved, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Coal mine reporting method and coal mine communication system based on intelligent voice technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a coal mine reporting method and a coal mine communication system based on intelligent voice technology, which relate to the technical field of voice processing, the method intelligently reforms the traditional coal mine communication system, and by introducing an automatic technology and an intelligent algorithm, the conventional report of the coal mine is abandoned from the scheme that underground operators manually call a dispatcher in the prior art, the conventional report of the coal mine and the conventional report of a non-coal mine in emergency are realized in an automatic mode, the fixed regular report of the coal mine is automatically answered and recorded, the waiting time of a user is reduced, the work load of a dispatcher is lightened, the working efficiency and the processing capacity of the emergency report are improved, the load of a telephone system is reduced in a busy period, the efficiency of the coal mine report is improved, the timeliness of information transmission is improved, the situation that the emergency situation cannot be timely transmitted to the dispatcher is avoided, the safety of the coal mine operation is improved, and the continuity and the efficiency of the coal mine production are ensured.
assignees: WANBEI COAL ELECTRICITY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic lease matching method for electric power construction equipment based on demand prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic lease matching method for electric power construction equipment based on demand prediction, and relates to the technical field of electric power construction. According to the power construction equipment dynamic lease matching method based on demand prediction, the fault range is determined based on the power system topological structure, the fault degree is determined according to the fault equipment set and the power fault data set, the lease scheme is preferentially matched with the fault range with the maximum fault degree, faults with more serious influence can be ensured to be preferentially processed, the pertinence and timeliness of fault emergency response are improved, meanwhile, the substitution degree of substitution equipment is obtained through the comparison of the required construction equipment set and the leasable equipment set and the equipment missing, and whether a substitution scheme or a replacement provider is accepted or not is judged by combining the substitution coefficient, the problem of equipment mismatch can be effectively solved, the dynamic landing of the lease scheme is guaranteed, the fault restoration due to equipment problems is avoided, the leased matching efficiency and reliability of the power construction equipment are finally improved, and powerful support is provided for rapid power fault restoration.

title_en: Device, method and computer program for controlling space vector pulse width modulation using 3-phase 4-leg inverter under sinlge line-to-ground faults in islanded microgrids
title_ko: 독립형 마이크로그리드에서 1선 지락사고 발생시 3상 4레그 인버터를 이용한 공간벡터 전압변조 제어 디바이스, 방법 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a control technique which can perform, even when a line-to-ground fault occurs in phase 1, coordinate transformation to separate the line-to-ground fault of phase 1 without unnecessary power outage by utilizing remaining normal phases, and apply transformed space vector pulse width modulation (SVPWM) to the transformed coordinates. The technical objective of the present invention is to provide a technique for controlling SVPWM, which applies zero voltage to the line-to-ground fault of phase 1 to allow an inverter to operate normally with only the remaining sound phases in order to prevent unnecessary loss generated as even the other sound phases are blocked when a single line-to-ground fault occurs. According to a device, method, and computer program for controlling SVPWM by using a 3-phase 4-leg inverter when a single line-to-ground fault occurs in an islanded microgrid, because available voltage switching vectors are limited as phase 1, in which a line-to-ground fault has occurred, and phase n are restricted to have the same switching state, a novel coordinate transformation can be performed to compensate for distortions generated therefrom, and because a novel SVPWM method which can be appropriately applied to the transformed coordinates can be provided, the problem of inducing loss of power and reduction in the lifespan of devices by unnecessarily cutting off even the sound phases can be solved even when a single line-to-ground fault occurs.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 1상에 지락사고가 발생하더라도 나머지 정상 상들을 활용하여 불필요한 정전 없이 지락사고 1상을 분리할 수 있도록 좌표변환을 수행하고 변환된 좌표에 맞게 변형된 공간벡터 전압변조(SVPWM)를 적용하는 제어 기법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 의해 해결하고자 하는 기술적 과제는, 1선 지락사고가 발생한 경우에 다른 건전 상들까지 차단되어 불필요한 손실이 발생하는 것을 방지하기 위해, 지락사고 1상에 영전압을 인가하며 나머지 건전 상들만으로 정상적인 인버터 동작이 가능하도록 하는 공간벡터 전압변조(SVPWM) 제어 기법을 제공하는 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 독립형 마이크로그리드에서 1선 지락사고 발생시 3상 4레그 인버터를 이용한 공간벡터 전압변조 제어 디바이스, 방법 및 컴퓨터 프로그램에 의하면, 지락사고가 발생한 1상과 n상이 동일한 스위칭 상태를 갖도록 제한됨에 따라 사용 가능한 전압 스위칭 벡터들이 제한되어, 그로 인해 발생하는 왜곡을 보상하기 위해 신규한 좌표변환이 수행될 수 있고, 변환된 좌표에 적합하게 적용될 수 있는 신규한 공간벡터 전압변조(SVPWM) 방식이 제공될 수 있으므로, 1선 지락사고가 발생하는 경우에도 불필요하게 건전 상들까지 차단하여 정전 손실과 기기 수명 단축이 유발되는 문제가 해소될 수 있다.

title_en: Nuclear power plant disaster prevention methods and systems for performing them
title_ko: 원자력 발전소 방재 방법 및 이를 수행하는 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster prevention method for a nuclear power plant and a system for performing the same, wherein the disaster prevention method for a nuclear power plant collects local real-time radioactivity numerical information on the inside, site, or periphery of a nuclear power plant by using a drone equipped with a radioactivity measuring device capable of measuring radioactivity, calculates a radioactivity diffusion map and an evacuation route by integrating weather information on the site through a wind direction anemometer operating together, and guides the evacuation route through a communication network. The disaster prevention method for a nuclear power plant can drive an optimal drone and drone station in the event of a nuclear power plant disaster and can operate the system correctly by preparing various programs for each situation and checking and commanding appropriate information. The disaster prevention method for a nuclear power plant can verify a nuclear power plant disaster evacuation system by optimizing the evacuation route through simulation, and furthermore, can generate and utilize big data.
