abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사능을 측정할 수 있는 방사능 측정 장치를 장착한 드론을 활용하여 원자력 발전소 내부 또는 부지나, 주변부에 대한 국지적 실시간 방사능 수치 정보를 수집하고, 함께 작동하는 풍향풍속계를 통해 현장의 기상 정보를 통합하여 방사능 확산 지도와 대피로를 산출하여, 통신망을 통해 대피로를 안내하기 위한 원자력 발전소 방재 방법 및 이를 수행하는 시스템에 대한 것으로, 원전 재난시 최적의 드론 및 드론 스테이션을 구동할 수 있으며, 다양한 상황별 프로그램을 구상하여 적합한 정보를 확인 및 명령함으로써 시스템을 올바르게 작동하고자 하고, 시뮬레이션을 통해 대피로를 최적화하여 원전재난 대피 시스템을 검증하고, 나아가 빅데이터 생성 및 활용을 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: AI-based Fire Department Organization Auto-formation System and Method
title_ko: Ai 기반 소방 조직 자동편성 시스템 및 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 AI 기반 소방 조직 자동편성 시스템에 관한 것으로, 119 신고 접수시 상황정보를 BERT 기반 자연어처리로 분석하고, 대원정보 데이터베이스의 전문성 및 가용성 정보를 기반으로 딥러닝 AI 편성엔진이 제약조건 최적화를 통해 최적의 출동조직을 10초 이내에 자동 편성한다. 편성 결과는 WebSocket 기반 실시간 동기화를 통해 모든 관련 단말기에 0.1초 이내 전송되며, 음성인식을 통한 즉석 편성 수정과 온라인 학습을 통한 지속적 성능 향상 기능을 제공한다. 이를 통해 기존 3-5분 소요되는 수동 편성을 10초로 단축하고, 24시간 무인 운영과 전국 표준화된 대응 품질을 보장한다.

title_en: Health rating evaluation system and method for predicting occurrence probability of health accident
title_ko: 건강사고의 발생확률을 예측하는 건강등급 평가 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a health rating evaluation system capable of proposing an objective measurement indicator for a health level of an individual, as the paradigm for health changes from disease treatment-centered to disease prevention and health improvement-centered. In this regard, provided is the health rating evaluation system comprising: a user terminal for transmitting approval information agreeing with the use of personal medial information of a user, health rating request information requesting a health rating assessment of the user, and personal authentication information; an organization server including a medical information database in which the personal medical information is stored; and an operation server connected to the user terminal and the organization server via a communication network, when the approval information, the health rating request information, and the personal authentication information are received via the communication network, collecting the personal medical information matching the personal authentication information by providing the personal authentication information to the organization server, and calculating a health rating by analyzing a relative degree of risk that a health accident of the user may occur within a pre-assigned period, via a health rating program in which the personal medical information is applied to a health evaluation model. According to the present invention, the risk of occurrence of a health accident in the near future can be predicted by analyzing medical information of an individual, and thus it is possible to cause lifestyle improvement and enhance social health improvement awareness.
abstract_ko: 질병치료 중심에서 질병예방 및 건강증진 중심으로 건강에 대한 패러다임이 변화됨에 따라 개인의 건강수준에 대한 객관적인 측정지표를 제시할 수 있는 건강등급 평가 시스템이 개시된다. 이를 위하여 사용자의 개인의료정보 이용을 동의하는 승인정보와 사용자의 건강등급 산정을 요청하는 건강등급 신청정보 및 개인인증정보를 전송하는 사용자 단말기와, 개인의료정보가 저장된 의료정보 데이터베이스가 구비된 기관서버, 및 상기 사용자 단말기 및 기관서버에 통신 네트워크를 통해 연결되며, 상기 통신 네트워크를 통해 승인정보와 건강등급 신청정보 및 개인인증정보가 수신되면, 상기 개인인증정보를 상기 기관서버로 제공하여 개인인증정보에 매칭된 개인의료정보를 수집하며, 상기 개인의료정보를 건강 평가모형에 기반한 건강등급 프로그램을 통해 미리 지정된 기간 내에 사용자의 건강사고가 발생할 상대적 위험도를 분석하여 건강등급을 산출하는 운영서버를 포함하는 건강등급 평가 시스템을 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 개인의 의료정보를 분석하여 가까운 미래의 건강사고 발생위험을 예측할 수 있어 생활습관 개선에 대한 유인 및 사회적 건강증진 의식 제고가 가능하다.

title_en: Wireless Real-Time Tongue Tracking for Speech Impairment Diagnosis, Speech Therapy with Audiovisual Biofeedback, and Silent Speech Interfaces
abstract_en: A real-time wireless system for recording natural tongue movements in the 3D oral space. By attaching a small magnetic tracer to the tongue, either temporarily or semi-permanently, and placing an array of magnetic sensors around the mouth, the tracer can be localized with sub-millimeter precision. The system can also combine the tracer localization with acoustic, video, and flow data via additional sensors to form a comprehensive audiovisual biofeedback mechanism for diagnosing speech impairments and improving speech therapy. Additionally, the system can record tongue trajectories and create an indexed library of such traces. The indexed library can be used as a tongue tracking silent speech interface. The library can synthesize words, phrases, or execute commands tied to the individual patterns of magnetic field variations or tongue trajectories.

title_en: Intelligent terminal emergency command system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses an intelligent terminal emergency command system, which is based on the B2C architecture mode, establishes an adapter on its server side, encapsulates service layer interface of the business system with EJB, provides APP application supporting the front end and realizes the service layer interface of available business functions to realize the emergency reporting, video uploading, daily zero report and emergency disposal through mobile phones and other intelligent terminals, improving the timeliness of event reporting and the efficiency of emergency disposal, and minimizing disaster losses. The main functions of the system include emergency reporting, daily zero report, notice and announcement management, early warning information reception, emergency disposal task management, historical event query, emergency resource query, instant messaging, GIS resource query and plotting, video uploading and other functions.

title_en: Emergency communications center intelligent workflow system and methods
abstract_en: A method implements: monitoring, by a cloud server and corresponding cloud application that are operatively coupled to an emergency communication center (ECC), data inputs to the ECC related to incoming emergency calls. The data inputs include voice data. The method further implements: obtaining additional data related to the data inputs, from sources external to the ECC; generating an incident record for each incoming emergency call by correlating the data inputs with the additional data and determining an incident type for each generated incident record; determining units for dispatch to a location of each incident corresponding to an incident record; and providing the determined incident records to an instance of the cloud application, and within a map view user interface, where the instance is executed using a browser on a computer located at the ECC.

title_en: Ship emergency navigation position indication search and rescue and environment monitoring anti-pollution intelligent platform
abstract_en: The application discloses a ship emergency navigation position indication search and rescue and environment monitoring pollution prevention integrated intelligent platform which comprises a floating body capable of floating on the water surface, wherein VDR-EPIRB equipment is arranged on the floating body and used for sending a distress signal to a ground station, reporting an emergency radio position indication mark and real-time position information of a sunken ship, recording navigation information, navigation equipment information, state information, cab recording and very high frequency wireless communication information of the ship, AIS equipment is used for sending out ship name, position and dynamic information, marking accurate positions of the ship for search and rescue command, guiding navigation of the passing ship, marking accurate positions of the sunken ship and real-time dynamic information and providing navigation warning, and a power supply is used for supplying power to various electric equipment.

title_en: Emergency scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency and energy scheduling, and discloses an emergency scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium based on unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring each unmanned aerial vehicle path from a starting point coordinate to an end point coordinate; generating a model according to the risk of each grid in each unmanned aerial vehicle path, the flight distance of each voyage in each unmanned aerial vehicle path and preset cost, generating the cost of each unmanned aerial vehicle path, selecting the unmanned aerial vehicle path with the minimum cost as a preferable unmanned aerial vehicle path, acquiring an unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling scheme corresponding to the preferable unmanned aerial vehicle path, generating the total loss cost corresponding to the unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling scheme according to the user loss cost, the load recovery cost and the energy storage battery deployment cost, and selecting the unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling scheme as an emergency scheduling scheme of a power failure area when the total loss cost is smaller than the preset loss cost. The application is beneficial to improving the timeliness of emergency response.

title_en: Emergency command system and method based on BIM digital base
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency command and discloses an emergency command system and method based on a BIM digital base, wherein a unified data model is established through an expansion IFC standard, BIM building information, GIS geographic space data, monitoring data and an emergency plan document are subjected to semantic mapping and entity alignment, an emergency knowledge graph taking the BIM building information as a node is generated, physical simulation and LSTM prediction algorithm are coupled, the monitoring data are injected into the BIM model to deduce a disaster process, a risk thermodynamic diagram and an evacuation forbidden zone are output, space-time accessibility of emergency resources is calculated through a reinforcement learning model according to the deduction result, an optimization scheme comprising unmanned plane paths, personnel evacuation routes and equipment scheduling instructions is generated, the instructions are synchronized to an augmented reality individual soldier terminal and a mobile command shelter through edge calculation nodes, resource deployment states are marked in the BIM model in real time, multi-terminal operation is synchronized, timeliness and accuracy of disaster situation perception are remarkably improved, and disaster loss is effectively reduced.

title_en: Sea water immersion test unit with pressure
title_ko: 자체압력보상기능을 갖는 해수침수 시험장치
abstract_en: An apparatus for testing immersion of sea water with a pressure self-compensating function is provided to obtain the convenience and efficiency of a sea water immersion test by constantly maintaining the pressure in a test chamber. An apparatus for testing immersion of sea water includes a chamber assembly(110), a chamber support body(120), a chamber cover(130), a pressure generating pneumatic cylinder(140), a cover opening/closing pneumatic cylinder(150), a pneumatic unit(160), and a control box(170). A positioning hole and a pin hole are formed in the chamber assembly. The chamber support body is located at a lower portion of the chamber assembly to support the chamber assembly. The chamber cover includes a pin hole(131), an interior pipe passage(132), a compensation water chamber(134), a check valve(135), and a pressure switch(136). The cover opening/closing pneumatic cylinder is adapted to open and close the chamber cover and is connected to the upper end of the pressure generating pneumatic cylinder. The pneumatic unit controls the operations of the pressure generating pneumatic cylinder and a cover opening/closing pneumatic cylinder. The control box receives a signal of the pressure switch to transmit a control signal to the pneumatic unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 비행자료 기록장치(FDR : Flight Data Recoder) 개발에 필수로 요구되는 해수침수 시험장치에 관한 것으로, 특히 자체압력을 보상하는 장치를 갖는 해수침수 시험장치에 관한 것이다. 비행자료 기록장치는 항공기 운항 중에 사고가 나서 바다 속에 떨어져도 관련기록을 유지하여야 하므로 유럽연합규격 ED55/56에서 해수침수시험을 요구하고 있다. 본 발명은 상기 규격의 해수침수시험 요구조건을 만족하도록 압력스위치를 이용한 자체보상장치가 시험장치 헤드부에 일체형으로 장착되며, 과압력조절을 위해 수두배관을 이용한 압력스위치를 사용한 것을 특징으로 한다. 
     본 발명의 구성은, 내부로 안착홀이 형성되며, 상단 외주연에 덮개고정핀이 삽입되는 핀홀이 형성되는 챔버조립체; 상기 챔버조립체의 하부에 위치하여 상기 챔버조립체를 지지하는 챔버지지체; 상기 챔버조립체의 안착홀에 안착되며, 상기 핀홀과 대응되게 상단 외주연에 핀공이 형성되고, 상부면에서 하부면으로 연통되게 내부관로가 형성되며, 중심부에 피스톤유동홈이 형성되며, 상기 내부관로의 입구에 보충수챔버가 구비되고, 상기 보충수챔버와 내부관로 사이에는 상기 보충수챔버 내의 보충수가 상기 내부관로로 공급되거나 차단되도록 제어하는 역지밸브가 구비되며, 상단에는 상기 챔버지지체의 내부 압력을 체크하는 압력스위치가 구비되는 챔버덮개; 상기 챔버덮개의 피스톤유동홈에 삽입되어 피스톤 운동을 하게 되는 압력 발생피스톤을 갖는 압력발생공압실린더; 상기 챔버덮개를 개폐하기 위한 것으로, 상기 압력발생공압실린더의 상단에 연결되는 덮개개폐공압실린더; 상기 압력발생공압실린더 및 덮개개폐공압실린더의 작동을 제어하는 공압유닛; 및 상기 압력스위치의 신호를 받아 상기 공압유닛으로 제어신호를 전송하는 컨트롤박스;로 구성되는 것을 특징으로 하는 자체압력보상기능을 갖는 해수침수시험장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and viewer for mobile assets that includes a data encoder, onboard data manager, and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting steel cylinder safety monitoring system

title_ko: 자동차 내비게이션의 위치 추적 시스템과 스마트폰의 위치 찾기 기능으로 자동차 추돌을 위성의 거리 측정기능으로 방지하는 급제동, 급 감속 장치를 명령, 지시하는 애플리케이션과 스마트폰 기능기술.
abstract_ko:
본 고안품은 자동차가 서로 차량끼리 중앙선 침범 등으로 정면추돌 시와 사람과의 추돌(인사사고) 때문에 수많은 희생자가 생기고 심지어 고속도로 순찰 경찰관이 사고 처리 중에 고속도로 상에서 안개등의 기상악화 등의 관계와 운전자의 전방주시의무와 과속 때문에 등 운전자의 모든 운전의무사항을 불충실한 행위들 때문에 생기는 사고 등을 예방하고 특히, 어둠이 내린 시골 국도와 좁은 간선 도로변 등에서도 운전자의 시야확보 등이 잘 되지 않고 보행자들의 부주의 때문 소중한 생명을 잃는 사례가 많았습니다. 
     자동차 사고는 때와 장소를 가리지 않고 일어나고 있는데 우리나라는 전 세계에서 교통사고 1위이고 그런 사고를 사전에 막을 수 있는 모바일 기술력도 전 세계에서 1위인 IT강국의 자부심을 가진 나라이고 국민입니다. 물론 수치심도 가지고 있는 나라이고 국민입니다 
     지금 전 세계는 "사물인터넷 시대" 를 열렸고 우리나라에서도 "사물인터넷" 이란 용어가 대통령의 연설 중에서 나와 많은 국민들이 그 필용 성과 편리함을 잘 알게 되었고 더 많은 IT개발자들이 대 기업 등에 밀리고 눌려 주춤했던 어깨를 펴고 이젠 굉장한 아이디어들로 "사물인터넷" 세상을 열고 쏟아져 나오고 있습니다. 
     한번 생각을 해 보십시오. 자동차가 사람과의 추돌을 피하고 혹시 추돌이 예상되면 신호음 등으로 사전에 모바일 알림이가 그 역할을 해준다면 얼마나 안전 할 수가 있을까요. 
     칠흑 같은 어두운 밤길에서도 차량 운전자에게 전방1km 앞에 사람으로 예상되는 형상이 움직이고 있으니 감속이 꼭 필요하고 전방주시요함. 이라고 어두운 밤길에서 내비게이션에서 예쁜 음성으로 알려주면 얼마나 편리하고 안전한 운전과 운행을 할 수가 있겠습니까?! 
     그렇습니다. 이젠 본 고안품으로 그 어려웠던 "인사사고" 와 "차량추돌사고" 를 해결 할 수 있게 되었고 많은 국민의 고귀한 생명도 지킬 수가 있다는 것입니다. 또한 본 고안품의 전 인류가 다 혜택을 받고 누릴 수 있도록 할 것입니다. 
     외국의 발명특허의 사례를 보면 최첨단 군사용품 등을 이용한 열 감지기능과 레이드 등까지 응용, 이용한 전방 장애물을 사전에 감지하는 차량기능 장치는 개발되고 있으나 그 고안품은 차량에 설치해야할 장치기기가 너무 대형이고 차량운행에도 불편함이 많고 가격도 비싼 것이 단점으로 작용하고 있는데 본 고안품은 현재 사용 중인 차량의 내비게이션을 이용하고 물론 현재 사용하는 위성과의 주파수도 같은 것을 사용하고 위치추적 장치 시스템도 현재에 사용 중인 것을 그냥 사용하고 단, 본 고안품의 핵심기술기능을 "애플리케이션" 에 프로그래밍 하여 스마트폰의 기능을 함께 이용하여 이 모든 기능을 더 간단하게 수행하면서 보다 정확한 한 것이 특징이고 혁명이라고 할 수가 있다. 는 것이다. 물론 그 기능은 간단하나 그 기능만큼은 그 어떤 군사용품보다 성능이 우수하고 그 오차의 범위도 최소화 했다. 라는 것이다. 큰 특징이고 자랑이다. 
     그 기능을 요약하여 설명해보면 현재 스마트폰으로 사용자의 위치 추적을 위성을 이용한 이동통신사의 서비스를 자세하게 계산해보면 휴대폰의 신호 주파수만으로 약 2-3m의 오차범위 내에서 정확하게 사용자의 현 위치가 확인이 된다. 물론 이동통신사 마다의 작은 오차는 있으나 통상적으로 모두가 비슷한 범위 내에서 위치를 확인감지를 할 수가 있다. 
     그러나 본 고안품에선 차량용 내비게이션이 전방을 카메라로 촬영하여 추돌의 가능성이 있는 목표물(사람)과 주변 환경들(추돌요인이 될 것으로 예상되는 것.)을 실시간 촬영한 영상물로 위성으로 전송되어 현 위치와 거리까지 산출 되어 다시 차량의 내비게이션으로 운전자에게 음성메시지 및 3차원 영상 디스플레이로도 알려주고 있는 기능과 현 서비스 기능을 이용하고 스마트폰의 가족과 친구 위치 찾기를 위치 추적서비스를 조금 더 완벽하게 응용하고 이용하여 보다 정확한 위치와 거리를 계산하여 오차의 범위를 최소화하여 본 고안품의 기능을 완성케 한다는 것이며, 이를 더 정확하게 추돌방지 기능을 완성케 하기위하여 본 고안품의 심장부이고, 기능부라고 할 수 있는 스마트 폰의 "전용 애플리케이션" 을 이용하여 더 정확한 위치를 그 어떤 악천후 속에서도 정확하게 수행 할 수 있도록 "수행 도우미 매니저" 화 한 것이 특징이고, 특히 본 고안품에서는 차량의 제동창치를 명령하는 기능 장치를 제어하는 기능 및 명령장치가 프로그래밍 되어 있어 차량과 예비 추돌가능성이 있는 목표물이 발생 시엔 그 목표물과의 거리등을 정확하게 계산하여 차량의 내비게이션으로 운전자에게 1차적 경고를 음성과 영상 디스플레이로 문자와 3차원영상 메시지로 하고, 2차적으로 차량제동장치기능부에 명령하여 감속 기능 장치를 작동케 명령하여 안전 거리상내에선 속도를 감속케 하고, 그런 다음에도 추돌의 위험성이 개선되지 않고 차량이 추돌의 위험거리까지 목표물에 접근하면 최후의 보루로, 3차적인 조치로 차량을 급제동케 하는 기능이며 급제동은 운전자의 의사와 운전 행동적 행위와 상관 관계없이 본 고안품의 명령 장치에서 차량의 전기기능 제어 장치부에 강제 급제동을 명령하여 차량의 동력 전달 장치의 동력을 중단함은 물론이고 급제동장치를 동작케 하여 본 고안품의 추돌을 사전에 방지하는 기능을 모바일 기술력으로 완성케 한 장치다. 
     본 고안품은 우리나라의 이동통신사가 사용하고 있는 위성과 주파수를 사용하면서 내비게이션의 위성주파수 역시도 동일한 사이클을 사용하면서 완성하고, 사용법위를 벗어난 타국의 주파수 영역 대에서 본 고안품을 사용 시에는 그 나라에서 사용하는 내비게이션 주파수와 휴대전화 주파수로 변경하면 국내에서처럼 정상적인기능으로 작동이 가능하므로 본 고안품은 "글로벌" 한 고안품이고 전 세계에서 사용이 가능한 고안품이다. 
     또한 본 고안품은 어린이보호구역등 스쿨존과 위험지역, 사고 다발지역, 지방단체등과 도로교통법상의 감속이 필요하다고 인정하여 지정된 곳을 차량이 진입 할 시에도 자동적으로 본 고안품의 기능은 내비게이션의 안내 경고 음성 메시지가 나오고 자동으로 감속이 되나, 만약에 특수한 목적인 차량(소방차, 구급용 차량)이 운행 시엔 본 고안품을 내려 받아 업데이트 된 스마트폰 애플리케이션의 기능을 중지(off)시키면 강제 제동 및 감속장치가 작동되지 않고, 다시 필요시엔 (on)아이콘을 작동케 하면 또 
     본 고안품의 기능은 내비게이션이 장치된 차량과 본 고안품을 스마트폰의 애플리케이션을 내려 받은 모바일 기능성 스마트폰은 그 명령 프로그램은 모두가 철저하게 그 임무를 수행을 한다. 
     본 고안품이 참으로 이번 "영종도 영종대교 초대형의 교통사고 눈, 비 바람등과 안개 때문이라고 핑계치 말고, 이재부터라도 조속하게 본 고안품을 개발하여 그 안전성과 기능을 시행해 보십시다. 
     
     1. application(애플리케이션). 2. 앱 스토어(샵). 3. 사물인터넷시대 4. 시물레이션. 5. 블루투스. 6. 내비게이션. 7. 프로그래밍. 8. 자동차 자동 제어장치. 9. 급 제동장치 급 감속 장치(서행). 10. 강제 제동정차 (급제동). 11. 스쿨존(학교앞). 12. WIFI. 13. 증폭장치. 14. 모바일.

title_en: A kind of Intelligent psychological experiment device for teaching
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of Intelligent psychological experiment device for teaching, detect a lie device by arranging hypnosis device, magnetic white board, shooting projection arrangement and electronics, realization can the most incidentally play hypnosis music in swing ball swing process, makes patient more be rapidly introduced into psycheism；Exchanged with patient by magnetic white board, and observe patient write feedback；Projecting on magnetic white board by shooting projection arrangement, playing some visual experiments stimulates screen, and the state of real time record patient；It is additionally provided with electronics to detect a lie device, to provide significantly more efficient psychological test experiment for the activity of Psychological Teaching.This equipment safety is reliable, economical and practical, and feature richness is easy to use, is suitable for being widely popularized.

title_en: A kind of wisdom driving training system, method and it is applied to wisdom driving training system positioning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wisdom driving training system, method and it is applied to wisdom driving training system positioning system.User terminal and user and background server carry out instruction and the interaction of information, positioning signal is received and dispatched between locating base station and positioning label, and it records transmitting and/or receives the temporal information of positioning signal, background server receives the temporal information, resolve the location information of positioning label, and the location information of Driving Test vehicle is obtained using the location information of positioning label, the also instruction of reception user terminal transmission, and information corresponding with described instruction is returned to user terminal.By can accurately and timely know travel condition of vehicle in the self-built high-accuracy position system in Driving Test place, the authenticity of mock examination and the accuracy of result are improved.System include the live display of traveling, running history see again, coach directed, violation early warning, resource-sharing, the functions such as payment, sufficiently meet the study needs of student, greatly improve user experience and learning effect.

title_en: Head-mounted virtual reality equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses head-mounted virtual reality equipment, and relates to the technical field of virtual reality equipment. The intelligent control device comprises a shell and a soft cushion, wherein the soft cushion is arranged on the rear side of the shell, key control equipment is arranged on the upper surface of the shell, a state indicator lamp is arranged on the front edge of the upper surface of the shell, a front wide-angle camera is fixedly mounted at the front end of the shell, and lateral cameras are arranged at the left end and the right end of the shell; through setting up the ground in laser range finder surveys equipment and the environment of locating, obstacles such as wall distance, survey the position of virtual reality equipment, simultaneously compare time-recorder data acquisition speed data according to the distance variation, judge whether the user can bump or fall down, when unusual state appears, through looking around and getting external environment image and simulating the people's eye field of vision for the equipment, cover virtual image, make the user can obtain environmental information at once, and make emergency response, improve the security of virtual reality equipment.

title_en: Industrial and mining enterprise emergency management mobile intelligent platform and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, and discloses an industrial and mining enterprise emergency management mobile intelligent platform and equipment, which comprise an event sensing system, a filing system, an emergency response system, a rescue storage system and a daily operation system; the event awareness system comprises a confirmation subsystem and a sensing subsystem; the confirmation subsystem is used for confirming and verifying whether the emergency event really occurs or not; the sensing subsystem is used for acquiring basic site information for confirming the emergency event in real time; the recording system comprises an early warning subsystem, and the early warning subsystem is used for comprehensively acquiring and processing monitoring equipment information and early warning equipment information of industrial and mining enterprises and forming emergency recording; the emergency response system comprises a planning subsystem and an execution subsystem; the planning subsystem is used for automatically generating an emergency treatment scheme; and the execution subsystem is used for commanding the industrial and mining enterprises to process emergency events. The invention can provide a timely, reliable and efficient intelligent emergency management scheme, and achieves a better emergency management effect.

title_en: Double-flashing copper smelting factory emergency scheduling method based on video linkage and fusion communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-flashing copper smelting factory emergency scheduling method based on video linkage and fusion communication, which comprises the following steps: the system comprises a video linkage system and a fusion communication system, wherein the video linkage system monitors production signals and alarm signals in real time during normal production, and performs linkage capture and linkage video recording on important signals and intelligent linkage with real-time monitoring pictures; when an emergency event occurs, a communication network is established for personnel in a specific position range through a converged communication system, and point-to-point, point-to-many and many-to-many communication linkage is carried out; according to the invention, the emergency dispatching command of the double-flash copper smelting intelligent factory is made by matching the emergency management of the whole factory and the corresponding plan through video linkage and fusion communication, the double-flash copper smelting intelligent factory has the advantages of quick response, more efficient communication and reduced occurrence rate of production accidents in the aspect of emergency dispatching command.

title_en: Emergency treatment system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power systems, and discloses an emergency processing system and an emergency processing method. The invention realizes the whole flow coverage from monitoring, early warning and analysis to emergency response through a highly integrated technical means, improves the efficiency and accuracy of emergency management, effectively improves the speed and effect of emergency rescue through measures such as real-time data acquisition and analysis, accurate positioning, resource integration and intelligent scheduling, and simultaneously, further enhances the emergency response capability and decision level of enterprises in the future response to abnormal conditions through the post-hoc data recording and analysis and the establishment of an emergency treatment case library.
assignees: CHINA NAT AVIATION FUEL CO LTD

title_en: Construction site emergency management method, device, equipment and medium based on micro-service architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, and discloses a construction site emergency management method based on a micro-service architecture, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical event data and constructing a dynamic digital plan library; the method comprises the steps of applying a dynamic digital plan library to corresponding modules based on a modularized system framework, constructing a structural event matching rule, determining required emergency equipment and computing resources according to the structural event matching rule when an emergency exists, generating an elastic resource management instruction, acquiring data cockpit resources, integrating by using the modularized system framework based on the data cockpit resources, generating a full-dimensional state visual view of a construction site, acquiring double-blind drilling data and an emergency response record, searching problems in an AI model and plan logic, and performing emergency management. The invention also provides a construction site emergency management device, equipment and storage medium based on the micro-service architecture. The invention can improve the risk response speed.
assignees: SHENZHEN SPECIAL ZONE CONSTRUCTION ENG GROUP CO LTD;SHENZHEN SPECIAL ZONE CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;SHENZHEN HUJIANG TECH INVESTMENT DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Action e-book apparatus and operation method thereof
title_ko: 액션 이북 장치 및 그 운용방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An action e-book device and an operation method thereof are provided to insert a second action game into an e-book, thereby enabling children to have interest in a sound education game. CONSTITUTION: A memory unit(12) stores e-book content, an e-book viewer program, and a second action game. An input unit(11) includes an execution button for receiving a command for executing the e-book content and a stop button for terminating execution of the e-book content. If the execution button is pressed, a control unit(16) displays the e-book content through the e-book viewer program. If an input is generated or a fixed amount of time passes, the control unit executes a second action game matched with the e-book content. A display unit(13) displays the e-book content and the second action game by control of the control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사용자(학습자, 유아 등)의 흥미를 최대로 유발시켜 학습효과를 향상시키도록 한 액션 이북 장치 및 그 운용방법에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 액션 이북 장치는 하나 이상의 이북 컨텐츠, 이북 뷰어 프로그램 및 상기 이북 컨텐츠 내용에 부합되는 하나 이상의 2차 액션 게임을 저장하는 메모리부; 상기 하나 이상의 이북 컨텐츠 중에서 상기 사용자가 선택한 특정 이북 컨텐츠의 실행 명령을 상기 사용자로부터 입력받기 위한 실행 버튼, 상기 이북 컨텐츠의 실행을 종료하기 위한 종료 버튼을 포함하는 입력부; 상기 실행 버튼이 입력되면 상기 이북 뷰어 프로그램을 통해 상기 이북 컨텐츠가 디스플레이되도록 제어하고, 사용자의 직접적인 입력 발생시 또는 이북 컨텐츠 진행의 소정시간이 경과되면 그 이북 컨텐츠에 부합되는 2차 액션 게임이 실행되도록 제어하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 이북 컨텐츠 및 2차 액션 게임을 디스플레이하는 디스플레이부;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
또한, 본 발명의 액션 이북 장치 운용방법은 (a) 실행 버튼이 입력되면, 이북 뷰어 프로그램 실행 및 상기 이북 장치의 사용자가 선택한 특정 이북 컨텐츠를 디스플레이하는 단계; (b) 상기 특정 이북 컨텐츠 실행으로부터 소정 시간이 경과되거나 사용자의 직접적인 입력이 발생되면 상기 이북 컨텐츠 내용에 부합되는 2차 액션 게임이 실행되는 단계; 및 (c) 상기 2차 액션 게임이 종료되면 상기 특정 이북 컨텐츠의 계속적인 실행이 이루어지는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이상에서와 같이, 종래의 이북(E-Book)의 정적인 부분은 사용자의 흥미를 오래 유발하지 못하고 또한 사용자의 집중력을 유지 못한 반면에 본 발명의 2차 이상의 액션을 포함하는 2차 액션 게임이 이북에 삽입됨에 따라 아이들의 사행성 게임에서 벗어나 건적한 교육용 게임으로 접함으로 게임의 흥미도 가지며 책도 읽을 수 있다는 효과와 사용자의 집중력 및 인지력을 향상시킬 수 있다는 효과가 있다. 
또한, 본 발명은 이북장치에 부모님의 목소리를 녹음한 데이터를 저장한 후, 그 녹음된 데이터가 유아들에게 들려줌으로써 유아 성장에 큰 정신적인 안정감을 줄 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명은 컨텐츠 또는 2차 액션 게임을 원격지의 컨텐츠 서버로부터 다운로딩 가능하도록 하여, 어디에서나 쉽게 접할 수 있다.

title_en: An image recording system for a vehicle for performing accident style detection and settlement and the control method thereof
title_ko: 사고 유형 감지 및 사고 처리를 수행하는 차량용 영상기록 장치와 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an image recording system and method for a vehicle which can detect a type of accident if the car has a traffic accident, and automatically perform an accident settlement in accordance to the type of the accident. The image recording system additionally stores at least one of the information about a vehicle state, the information about a road state, and the information about a body state of a driver, as well as the photographed image; thereby analyzing more correctly the cause of the accident. Also, the image recording system notifies at least one opponent, who is most suitable for the accident settlement, of the type of accident in accordance to the type of the accident, thereby performing an urgent accident settlement. The image recording system automatically performs a controllable vehicular function in accordance with the type of the accident to notify the accident occurring situation to the surroundings, thereby preventing a secondary accident. In addition, the information stored in the image recording device is automatically backed up to prepare for disappearance due to a vehicle fire, breakdown or loss.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량 사고가 발생할 경우 그 사고의 유형을 감지하고 그 사고 유형에 따라 가능한 사고 처리를 자동으로 수행하는 것으로, 촬영 영상뿐만 아니라 차량 상태에 대한 정보, 노면 상태를 알 수 있는 정보, 또는 운전자의 신체 상태에 대한 정보들 중 적어도 하나 이상을 추가로 저장하여 사고 원인을 좀 더 정확하게 분석할 수 있도록 하며, 또한 사고 유형에 따라 그 사고를 가장 적절하게 처리할 수 있는 적어도 하나 이상의 상대에게 사고 유형을 통보하여 긴급한 사고 처리가 이루어질 수 있도록 하며, 또한 사고 유형에 따라 제어 가능한 차량 기능을 자동으로 처리하여 사고 발생 상황을 주변에 공지함으로써 2차적인 사고를 예방할 수 있도록 하며, 또한 영상기록 장치에 저장된 정보들을 자동으로 백업하여 차량의 화재나 파손 또는 도난에 의해 소실되거나 분실되는 것에 대비할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있는 사고 유형 감지 및 사고 처리를 수행하는 차량용 영상기록 장치와 그 제어방법에 관한 것이다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION AT NAMSEOUL UNIV

title_ko: 첨단 횡단보도 통제시스템을 활용한 국가안전망 연동시스템 및 기술 (횡단보도내에서의 사고예방, 구조요청, 사고처리, 외국인정보안내 등을 위한 첨단 횡단보도 통제시스템을 하나의 최소단위로 코드화하여 모든 상황이 행정단위별로, 112별로, 119별로 집중화되고 통제되는 국가통제시스템 및 기술)
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for creating beam barricade clearly visible even during daytime through visible light filtering, infrared ray filtering, or laser beam filtering. The national safety network linking system according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: a beam barricade system; a sensor system, a signal violation image recording linkage apparatus; and a central processing unit (CPU).

title_en: Secure and anonymous messaging system and method
abstract_en: Systems, methods, apparatuses, and computer program products for reporting incident(s) of illegal, unethical, harmful or other inappropriate conduct are provided. One method includes creating, by a server, a record to identify a user of an application for reporting at least one incident of illegal, unethical, harmful or other inappropriate conduct. The creating of the record further comprises assigning at least one of: a unique code used to anonymously identify a user that is submitting a report of the at least one incident, and/or a unique messenger ID for use by the user to anonymously send and receive real-time messages via a secure, anonymous, and two-way communication session.

title_en: Systems and methods for crowdsourced incident data distribution
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed herein for crowdsourced incident data distribution. In one embodiment of the disclosed technique for crowdsourced incident data distribution, systems and methods receive a report of an incident from one or more devices connected to the incident platform. Upon report of incident, the platform identifies a number of active devices within a determined radius of the incident. The identified devices then send a specific time-period of recording to the platform for processing. The platform receives the recordings and identifies the most relevant recordings by comparing the recordings to a pre-selected number of quality training sets. Upon one or more of the recordings meeting comparison thresholds, the recordings are formatted and sent to the selected party.

title_en: Power management system of production facility for vehicle
title_ko: 차량용 생산설비의 전력관리 시스템
abstract_ko: 차량용 부품을 생산하는 생산설비의 에너지 관리를 수행하는 전력관리 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른, 차량용 생산설비의 전력관리 시스템은, 차량용 부품을 생산하는데 이용되는 생산설비마다 개별적으로 설치되어, 각각의 생산설비의 전력량을 측정하는 복수의 적산전력계가 구비되는 전력 측정부; 및 전력 측정부로부터 각각의 생산설비의 전력량에 대한 데이터를 수신하여, 각각의 생산설비의 전력량을 기록하고, 각각의 생산설비의 이상 여부를 검출하는 제어부;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 차량용 부품을 생산하는 생산설비의 전력량을 실시간으로 수집하고, 이를 가공하여, 생산설비의 이상 여부를 실시간 검출할 수 있어, 에너지 관리의 효율을 향상시키고, 생산설비의 고장 또는 누전, 과전류, 아크 전류 등을 원인으로 하는 화재 등의 사고를 예방할 수 있다. 또한, 가공된 데이터를 이용하여, 가동 스케줄을 작성하거나 또는 조정하여, 에너지 관리의 효율을 향상시키고, 정확한 전력 수요 예측을 통해, 동일 스펙의 생산 설비 제작시, 적용 가능한 최적 용량을 산출하여, 제작 비용을 절감시킬 수 있다.

title_en: Method for Fire Emergency Response of Nuclear Power Plant and Recording Medium Storing Program to Execute the Method
title_ko: 원전 화재비상대응방법 및 이를 실행하기 위한 프로그램을 저장한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a nuclear power plant fire emergency response method and a recording medium storing a program for executing the same. The method comprises the following steps of: (a) identifying fire prevention zones of a nuclear power plant; (b) selecting one of the fire prevention zones installed in the nuclear power plant; (c) tentatively determining a fire suppression route and an evacuation route through a drawing of the selected fire prevention zone; (d) inspecting the tentatively determined fire suppression route and evacuation route; and (e) determining the fire suppression and evacuation routes of the selected fire prevention zone.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 원전 화재비상대응방법 및 이를 실행하기 위한 프로그램을 저장한 기록매체에 관한 것으로, (a) 원전의 방화구역을 확인하는 단계; (b) 원전에 구비된 방화구역 중의 하나를 선정하는 단계; (c) 상기 선정된 방화구역의 도면을 통하여 화재 진압 경로 및 피난 경로를 가결정하는 단계; (d) 가결정된 상기 화재 진압 경로 및 피난 경로를 검수하는 단계; 및 (e) 상기 선정된 방화구역의 화재 진압 및 피난 경로를 결정하는 단계;를 포함하고 있다.
assignees: STANDARD TESTING & ENG INC CO LTD

title_en: AI video auxiliary monitoring system for coal mine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a coal mine AI video auxiliary monitoring system, which comprises an upper monitoring platform, wherein the upper monitoring platform is respectively connected with a plurality of mine-level monitoring platforms; the ore grade supervision platform is divided into a ground part and a downhole part; the ground part comprises a core switch, and the core switch is respectively connected with a display, an AI platform server, an AI analysis server and a monitoring computer; the intelligent disaster risk control system has the advantages that an AI artificial intelligent recognition technology and a big data technology are used as main bodies, disaster risks of mines are prevented and controlled, intelligent safety management of coal mine sites is achieved, various hidden dangers of the coal mines are analyzed, judged, alarming, snapshot, video recording and log recording are carried out on the hidden danger risks at the first time, linkage control commands are sent out when necessary according to set hidden danger processing rules, equipment stopping and other operations are achieved, a service closed loop is formed, supervision staff are assisted, supervision efficiency is improved, and occurrence of underground accidents of the coal mines is reduced.
assignees: XUZHOU ZHONGTU INTELLIGENT CONTROL COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel urbanized community management system
abstract_en: A novel urbanized community management system comprising the following steps: a, when a community event is discovered by a social worker or the community event is known and confirmed by the social work via a receiving terminal, the receiving terminal is used for on-site recording and evidence obtaining; b, recorded content recorded and obtained evidence are uploaded to a management terminal via a reporting terminal of a community terminal; c, the reported community event is dispatched to an undertaking unit via the management terminal based on liability, processing procedures and processing time concerning such an event stipulated by a community event management and service manual; the undertaking unit is urged to supervise the event; d, after the event is handled by the undertaking unit, a processing result is sent to the management terminal; e, the social worker reporting the event is invited by the management terminal to verify actual conditions on site; after verification by the social worker, the community event is settled via the management terminal. Community management is enabled to convenient, effective, standard and rapid.

title_en: A kind of public security safety index statistical method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of public security safety index statistical method, including following processing steps：S1) extracts the related data of public security security incident；S2) counts to public security security incident, obtains public security safety index.It is able to record the information such as the geographical position that public security security-related event occurs；The related information of public security security incident can be automatically extracted, and public security security incident is counted；According to administrative area under one's jurisdiction and public security department's management area under one's jurisdiction, the type according to public security security incident, public security security incident is counted；According to the belonging relation between area under one's jurisdiction, area under one's jurisdictions at different levels are counted respectively；It can support, be traced up and down according to the belonging relation in area under one's jurisdiction and check statistic analysis result；Statistic analysis result can be sent to area under one's jurisdiction director, remind related director's timely processing.

title_en: City first-aid network, first-aid method and cloud center server
abstract_en: The application provides a city emergency network, an emergency method and a cloud center server. The city emergency network comprises: the cloud center server receives the emergency request, determines personal emergency information corresponding to the user intelligent terminal, creates an emergency task based on the personal emergency information and records an emergency process; the emergency command client is communicated with the cloud center server and commands the completion of emergency command work based on the personal emergency information and the emergency task provided by the cloud center server; the user intelligent terminal is communicated with the cloud center server and used for sending an emergency request to the cloud center server.
assignees: ZESHIBAIYI MEDICAL TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: A kind of power station operating risk method for safety monitoring
abstract_en: The invention belongs to power plant safety technical fields, and specifically disclose a kind of power station operating risk method for safety monitoring: safety supervision Platform Server loads industry security risk data automatically, are classified to security risk, give step safety supervision list of schedules；Operation group initiating task；The server real-time synchronization time judges risk class, sends monitor command information to supervision group；Supervision group receives server and selected events in operation, and record security supervises result；Operation group is rectified and improved by server push result and measure, and corrective action gives supervision group acknowledge by server feedback；Supervision group judges corrective action, if negative entangles rear measure, is then repeated up to supervision group and approves measure after correction；Server determines that safety supervision terminates, while automatically updating industry security risk data, and operation group closes operation.Method of the invention can real-time oversight power station field work safe risk, be effectively reduced security risk, reduce equipment malfunction risk, improve working efficiency, it is horizontal to promote power station operation safety.

title_en: Multistage process management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-stage process management system which comprises a problem dispatching, receiving and processing, submitting and approving, handling and approving module, a problem filing module, a set of complete problem handling and approving processes, and a video, audio, law enforcement business and satellite positioning supervision subsystem for problem handling, gathering, circulation and handling. For the found major problems, the system can be butted with a police service supervision and management information system, and transferred to case information to be reserved for records, so that the safety of resources is fully protected, and higher levels can conveniently check subordinate and supervise the working requirements of each service unit.
assignees: CHINA CHANGFENG SCIENCE TECHNOLOGY IND GROUP CORP

title_en: Military combat communication link selector rule method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a military combat communication link selector rule method, which comprises the following steps of: calculating the probability of successfully receiving information by the instruction center in the direct link; step 2: calculating the probability of successfully receiving information by the relay unmanned aerial vehicle and the command center in the relay link; and step 3: calculating average information ages of the direct link and the relay link respectively AoI; and 4, step 4: and estimating and comparing the instant message ages of the direct link and the relay link at the current moment, and further selecting the link with the smaller instant age for communication. The invention provides a technical scheme for reasonably selecting a communication link in military operations, designs a corresponding information transmission timeliness performance measurement method, quantitatively describes link timeliness performance, realizes full and flexible utilization of network facilities, ensures timeliness of end-to-end information transmission, and timely and effectively completes information transmission.

title_en: Intelligent management method for hazardous wastes
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent dangerous waste management method. The method belongs to the technical field of hazardous waste management, and can be used for implementing intelligent monitoring and standardized management of hazardous waste. The method comprises the following steps: s1: intelligent weighing system: collecting and recording dangerous waste weighing data through an intelligent weighing terminal, and generating an electronic tag; s2: a warehouse management system: the handheld terminal is used for butting the electronic tag to generate an electronic coupon which is used for recording the generation place, the processing place and the logistics management of hazardous wastes and recording real-time data of the hazardous wastes in/out of a warehouse; s3: the video monitoring system comprises: video monitoring is implemented on the generation, collection, storage and treatment of hazardous wastes, and the operation of each link is standardized and recorded; s4: a data management system: carrying out decision analysis and statistical analysis on the regional hazardous wastes, and evaluating the generation, storage and treatment of the hazardous wastes in the region and the corresponding industrial layout; s5: the remote command system: setting an emergency command center, carrying out monitoring video identification through artificial intelligence, and carrying out early warning, alarming and/or informing relevant units on abnormal conditions; s6: and establishing a dangerous and useless management platform, wherein the management platform, the electronic tag and the electronic coupon implement data butt joint and data management, and the management platform stores, counts, classifies, manages and backs up the data recorded in the S1-S5.

title_en: Automatic safety protection system and method for wafer defect detection equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wafer defect detection, in particular to an automatic safety protection system and method for wafer defect detection equipment, which mainly comprise a hardware automatic protection system and a software monitoring and recording system, the hardware automatic protection system comprises a safety door state monitoring module, a safety door bypass module, an emergency response module, a vacuum state monitoring module, a compressed air state monitoring module, an automatic protection processing module, a motion control module and a light source control module. The system completely depends on hardware to realize an automatic safety protection function. The automatic protection process has no intervention of upper computer software or embedded software, and ensures real-time, rapid and reliable safety protection response. After the automatic protection is triggered, an operator confirms that the safety risk is relieved and the automatic protection system keeps the triggering state unchanged before the manual intervention operation is performed. Meanwhile, special application requirements of equipment maintenance personnel in equipment debugging and maintenance processes through professional training are met through control of the bypass switch.
assignees: CETC FENGHUA INF EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Parking lot emergency early warning method and system based on multipoint edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parking lot emergency early warning method and system based on multipoint edge calculation, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting multi-mode environment data and video streams in different areas of a parking lot, obtaining collected data, then carrying out time synchronization and dynamic threshold filtering on the collected data, obtaining preprocessed data, and then carrying out space-time feature alignment and noise filtering on the preprocessed data, and obtaining a three-dimensional environment situation map; the invention realizes the functions of monitoring, analyzing, early warning and responding to fire, gas leakage and equipment fault emergency in the parking lot in real time, can obviously improve the safety of the parking lot and optimize the emergency response strategy through distributed data processing and collaborative analysis, can reduce the false alarm rate of the emergency through multi-mode data fusion and dynamic threshold collaborative analysis, shortens the average response time, obviously improves the early warning precision and timeliness, and is suitable for being widely popularized and used.
assignees: NANJING CHENGTOU INTELLIGENT PARKING CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake commander simulation training system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for simulating and training earthquake commanders, wherein the system comprises a simulation module, an evaluation module and a training module, wherein the simulation module is used for responding to a first simulation request of a user, simulating a plurality of scene elements of an earthquake through three-dimensional simulation, the scene elements comprise scene types, environments, characters and equipment, responding to a second simulation request of the user, randomly generating, editing or assembling the plurality of scene elements to construct one or more training subjects, the training module is used for responding to the first simulation request or the second simulation request of the user, loading the scene elements corresponding to the training subjects, recording interaction information and scene information of the user in the training process through interaction of the user and the scene elements, and the evaluation module is used for collecting the interaction information and the scene information of each training subject and evaluating and playing back the training process of the user. The invention utilizes virtual reality, three-dimensional simulation and real-time rendering technology to improve the authenticity, interactivity and reproducibility of earthquake rescue.

title_en: Entity chain store management system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an entity chain store management system based on the Internet of things, which comprises an Internet of things sensing module, an intelligent analysis and decision support module, a dynamic resource scheduling module, a customer service optimizing module, a safety monitoring and emergency response module and an innovation marketing module, wherein the Internet of things sensing module is used for comprehensively sensing temperature and humidity and illumination in the chain store, positions and inventory of commodities, browsing tracks of customers and data of purchase records. According to the physical chain store management system based on the Internet of things, the dynamic resource scheduling module captures the small changes of the stock quantity, personnel states and equipment parameters of each chain store in real time through high-frequency data acquisition once every 5 minutes, the limitation of data lag in traditional static scheduling is broken, the local resource states of a single store are converted into a global visible digital resource network based on a virtual mapping model constructed by 1000 resource nodes, and scheduling decisions can cover resource pools of all chain stores.

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en: SOLUTION: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and viewer for mobile assets that includes a data encoder, onboard data manager, and a local memory module. DARS processes video data from a 360 degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS runs in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second.EFFECT: Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method for providing paraphrasing service, system, server and computer-readable recording medium with program therefor
title_ko: 패러프레이징 서비스를 제공하는 방법과 그를 위한 시스템,서버 및 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체
abstract_en: A method for providing a paraphrasing service, a system and a server therefor, and a computer-readable recording medium are provided to receive and store specific condition information, convert specific word/sentence data into paraphrasing data according to the specific condition information, and transmit the paraphrasing data to a user terminal, thereby providing the paraphrasing service capable of learning the language. If specific condition information is received from a user terminal, a paraphrasing server confirms whether specific word/sentence data is received from the user terminal(S440). The paraphrasing server analyzes the received specific word/sentence data to confirm whether the specific word/sentence data is Korean data(S450). According to the specific condition information, the paraphrasing server performs the paraphrasing of the specific word/sentence data to generate Korean paraphrasing data(S460). The paraphrasing server transmits the generated Korean paraphrasing data to the user terminal(S462). If a received specific word or sentence is not Korean, the paraphrasing server confirms whether the received specific word/sentence is foreign language data(S470). The paraphrasing server confirms whether the termination of a service was requested(S480).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 패러프레이징 서비스를 제공하는 방법과 그를 위한 시스템, 서버 및 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 유무선 통신망을 이용하여 언어 학습 서비스를 제공하는 시스템에 있어서, 상기 언어 학습 서비스와 관련된 컨텐츠를 수신하여 출력하는 사용자 단말기; 및 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 특정 조건 정보를 수신하고 특정 단어/문장 데이터를 수신한 후 상기 특정 단어/문장 데이터를 상기 특정 조건 정보에 따라 패러프레이징(Paraphrasing)하여 패러프레이징 데이터를 생성하며, 상기 패러프레이징 데이터를 상기 사용자 단말기로 전송하는 패러프레이징 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 패러프레이징 서비스를 제공하는 시스템을 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 의하면, 특정 단어/문장에 대한 패러프레이징 서비스를 제공받음으로써, 어휘구사력, 표현력 및 사고력이 증대되는 효과가 있다. 
       
     패러프레이징, 패러프레이즈, 언어, 학습, 번역, 교육

title_en: Method for generating learning contents of multi language learning and terminal device using the same
title_ko: 다중언어 학습을 위한 학습 컨텐츠 생성방법 및 이를 적용한 단말 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A learning content production method and a terminal device applying the same for multi-language learning for freely selecting learning contents are provided to increase the efficiently of multi-language learning by learning language through the comment of the language. CONSTITUTION: A storage unit(140) includes a multi-language learning program(220) and a multi-lingual DB(210). A user input unit(150) inputs a user command. A monitor(110) offers a process result about the user command inputted through the user input. The CPU executes the multi-lingual learning program stored in the storage. The CPU performs the inputted user command.
abstract_ko:
다중언어 학습을 위한 학습 컨텐츠 생성방법 및 이를 적용한 단말 장치가 제공된다.  본 학습 컨텐츠 생성방법은, 복수의 언어들 중 어느 하나를 모국 언어로 설정하는 단계, 복수의 언어들 중 다른 하나를 학습 언어로 설정하는 단계 및 모국 언어로 학습 언어를 학습하기 위한 학습 컨텐츠를 생성하는 단계를 포함한다.  이에 의해, 학습자가 모국 언어와 학습 언어를 자유로이 선택할 수 있게 되어, 모국 언어와 학습 언어 마다 별개의 학습 프로그램을 개발하여야 하는 불편 및 구매하여야 하는 불편 모두를 배제시킬 수 있게 된다. 
     
     학습 컨텐츠, 다중 언어, 학습 포인트, 배경 애니메이션

title_en: Apparatus for supporting decision to fire accident in ship based on deep learning, method thereof and computer-readable recording medium
title_ko: 딥 러닝을 기반으로 하는 선박 화재 사고 의사 결정 지원 장치, 그 방법 및 컴퓨터 판독가능 기록매체
abstract_ko: 선박에서 구획별로 배치되어 있는 적어도 하나의 화재 감지 센서로부터 획득된 위험 요소 데이터, 과거 화재 사고 데이터 및 선박의 환경 관련 데이터를 수신하는 데이터 수집부, 수신된 데이터를 전처리하는 전처리부, 전처리된 데이터를 저장하는 저장부, 화재 위험 요소 분석 데이터를 생성하고, 구획별 화재 발생 확률 및 피해 규모 예측을 위한 AI 모델을 학습하여, 구획별 화재 발생 확률 데이터 및 피해 규모 예측 데이터를 생성하는 AI 모델 학습부를 포함하는 딥 러닝을 기반으로 하는 선박 화재 사고 의사 결정 지원 장치, 그 방법 및 컴퓨터 판독가능 기록매체가 개시되어 있다.

title_en: Emergency response system with dynamic ali database alphanumeric character hacking
abstract_en: An improved emergency response method and system including a content-specified text field, an ALI database record for a communication device that is updated to include information about a person experiencing an emergency and the emergency. A PSAP receiving an emergency services call from the communication device receives the caller name field on a terminal display and is thus informed about the emergency via a alphanumeric character communication rather than orally. A particular emergency may be assigned a code that is put in the caller name field. A PSAP operator receiving the emergency services call may then enter the code into an emergency services web interface to retrieve information about the emergency. The code can be transmitted to first responders and downstream medical professionals to enhance their ability to deliver emergency services.

title_en: Alarm receiving and processing digitization management system for fire fighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses an alarm receiving and processing digitization management system for fire fighting, comprising a central processing module, a digital speech recording playback module and a relay unit, wherein the output end of the central processing module is respectively connected with the input ends of the relay unit and the digital speed recording playback module; the input end of the central processing module is respectively connected with a mode selection switch, a bugle command button and a volume control button; the relay unit is composed of a fire bell controller, a lighting controller and a garage door controller, and the output end of the fire bell controller, the lighting controller and the garage door controller are respectively connected with a fire bell, a lamp and a garage door; the output end of the digital speech recording playback module is connected with a power amplifier and a voice box in sequence; and the central processing module communicates with an upper computer via an extended interface. The invention utilizes the mature and an open TCP/IP protocol to integrate all fire fighting functions at present with good working reliability, rapid response speed, simple operation and relatively low cost.

title_en: The police of flattening Command Information System makes transmission system and method
abstract_en: Transmission system and method are made the invention discloses a kind of police of flattening Command Information System, police makes newly-built module for realizing the newly-built of various alert orders；Police makes group management module often send the unit of alert order for realizing each organization management, by multiple unit creations in a group；Alert order checks and accepts module for realizing management of each mechanism to received alert order；Police makes sending module for realizing the management to having sent alert order, checks and signs for and feedback progress, checks feedback information, downloads feedback annex；Promptness rate statistical module is signed for and feeds back to sign for, feed back police and make timely situation statistics for realizing constituent parts；Police makes log pattern make system log message record for realizing police.The transmission of present invention order is had good grounds, and can effectively realize signing for and feed back in time for alert order, it is ensured that the reliability of alert order and ageing, and the statistics of promptness rate and feedback promptness rate is signed in alert order, for user management examination provides data basis.

title_en: Multifunctional remote operation training equipment for power dispatching
abstract_en: The invention discloses multifunctional remote operation training equipment for power dispatching, which comprises an operation screen cabinet, wherein a power supply network consisting of a plurality of plug-in blocks is installed on the front screen wall of the operation screen cabinet, a signal acquisition module and a signal output module which are electrically connected with the corresponding plug-in blocks are installed on the rear screen wall of the operation screen cabinet, the multifunctional remote operation training equipment also comprises a server which is electrically connected with the output end of the signal acquisition module and the input end of the signal output module, the communication end of the server is connected with a data bus, and a five-prevention workstation, a monitoring workstation and an evaluation workstation are correspondingly and electrically connected on the data bus. The functions of training, checking, evaluating and the like of the electric power skill are realized, the normative and the logical of each step of operation can be recorded and researched, and the five-prevention operation skill is improved.

title_en: Channel security early-warning system and channel early-warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a channel security early-warning system comprising a channel security early-warning instrument, a multimedia early-warning terminal and a background monitoring host, wherein the channel security early-warning instrument is intelligent equipment, is used for acquiring videos and audios of a channel and human body infrared information, can automatically send intervention voices to the field and send warning signals to the background monitoring host if the channel security early-warning instrument performs calculation, analysis, study and judgment to find that the videos, audios and human body infrared information reach early-warning threshold values, and can also send data (such as images and sound) of real-time situations of the field to the background monitoring host. According to the channel security early-warning system disclosed by the invention, monitoring areas are subjected to three-factor information monitoring by virtue of infrared probes, cameras and microphones, people can be guided to pass or evacuate orderly by virtue of intervention, and thus the problems of disorder and stampede caused under the condition that people are not commanded in the prior art can be solved. The invention also provides a channel early-warning method, and according to the method, three signal acquisition modes are adopted, and calculation and analysis are performed in field equipment so as to ensure that the early-warning reliability and timeliness can be improved to a great extent.
assignees: YUNNAN ZHITU XUETAI TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Public bicycle post house one-key shutdown method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public transportation, in particular to a public bicycle post one-key parking method, which comprises the following steps: determining a station set E of the station to be closed according to the station closing plan; acquiring historical use records of public bicycles, and calculating the station borrowing and returning balance degree of the station to be closed; determining a station closing sequence according to the balance degree of the borrowing and returning vehicles of the stations to be closed, and closing the stations with balanced borrowing and returning vehicles preferentially; when the station is closed, the station controller is controlled by a station closing instruction sent by the scheduling platform, the Bluetooth intelligent lock on the public bicycle is controlled by the Bluetooth ground pile in the closed station to be incapable of locking, the Bluetooth intelligent lock sends a voice prompt that the station is closed, and if the public bicycle is parked in the closed station, the rest public bicycles in the station are manually transported by the scheduling personnel. The substantial effects of the invention are as follows: the dispatching center issues the station closing instruction, one-key closing of the station can be achieved, the station with the closed station is prevented from parking public bicycles again, and secondary clearing is avoided.
assignees: HANGZHOU JINTONG TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Automatic emergency call method and device for vehicle and vehicle
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a vehicle automatic emergency call method, device and vehicle, and relates to the technical field of intelligent vehicles. The method comprises the steps of responding to triggering of automatic emergency call of the vehicle, determining the position information of the vehicle, matching corresponding automatic emergency call service processing rules based on the position information of the vehicle, and conducting automatic emergency call processing based on the automatic emergency call service processing rules. The method and the device can meet the requirements of the emergency response center at the position when the automatic emergency call processing is carried out by matching the corresponding automatic emergency call service processing rules based on the position of the vehicle, improve the reliability and universality of the automatic emergency call of the vehicle, and maximally ensure the timeliness of rescue.

title_en: Communication network optimization method and device for rail transit
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of rail traffic communication, and discloses a communication network optimization method and device for rail traffic. According to the communication network optimization method and device for the rail transit, the quality of a communication link is regulated and controlled according to the real-time state of train operation, the stability of data transmission can be guaranteed, the reliability of a communication network in the train operation process is improved, the accurate transmission of key data such as train operation control is guaranteed, the flow is regulated and controlled according to the load distribution of the network nodes of the rail region, the network congestion in a hot spot region can be effectively relieved, the network load is balanced, the utilization efficiency of network resources is improved, the network operation is smoother, the normal development of various businesses is guaranteed, the priority of access is regulated and controlled according to different business demands, the emergency information can be transmitted preferentially, the timeliness and the efficiency of emergency treatment are improved, and the safety and emergency response capability of a rail transit system are enhanced.

title_en: Intelligent oil depot safety risk early warning method and system based on data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent early warning method and system for safety risk of oil reservoir based on data fusion, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting physical parameter sequences of equipment sensors in an oil reservoir area, dynamic environment index sets of an environment monitoring device and abnormal event records of a historical accident database, inputting a pre-trained feature fusion model, extracting joint feature vectors through cross-modal association analysis, calculating risk diffusion weights of target monitoring nodes and adjacent areas according to the obtained feature fusion model, and generating a real-time risk propagation intensity value through dynamic time window sliding weighting, calling a pre-configured risk assessment model, carrying out nonlinear mapping on the real-time risk propagation intensity value and a safety threshold value, outputting the comprehensive risk probability of a target monitoring node, and finally triggering corresponding safety control instructions according to an interval where the comprehensive risk probability is located, wherein the safety control instructions comprise equipment start-stop, environment adjustment and emergency response strategies, so that intelligent early warning of the safety risk of the oil depot is realized.
assignees: SICHUAN XIAOAN INTELLIGENT ENG CO LTD

title_en: Environment emergency monitoring information management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment emergency monitoring information management system which comprises a data acquisition, processing, report generation, quick query, information release and artificial intelligent consultation module, wherein environment data are acquired in real time through a sensor and an artificial input unit, and the data are analyzed and processed by utilizing a multithreading and big data technology. The report generating module automatically generates various emergency reports, supports template management and custom editing, and ensures timeliness and accuracy of the reports. The rapid query module combines the artificial intelligence and the decision tree model to provide contaminant feature identification and emergency response suggestions. The information release module ensures data security through encryption transmission and can rapidly release monitoring reports and early warning information through the APP. The system also has the functions of data backup and asynchronous loading, and ensures the data integrity and user operation experience. Through integrating a plurality of advanced technologies, the environment monitoring data can be accurately processed, the intellectualization and response speed of emergency management are improved, and the environment safety is ensured.

title_en: Water situation AR video fusion management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water condition AR video fusion management system, which relates to the technical field of fusion management and comprises a hydrological data acquisition module, a video acquisition module, a geographic information acquisition module, a dynamic calibration module, an AR fusion module and an intelligent decision module, wherein a water level value H, a flow velocity value V and a rainfall value R are fused with a single risk index through hydrological early warning values F, F=0.5H+0.3V+0.2R to drive AR warning, the dynamic calibration module integrates heterogeneous data sources (hydrological sensors/videos/GIS), beidou RTK positioning data (X  RTK ,Y RTK ) and GIS elevation models Z (X, Y) are fused into three-dimensional space points, the intelligent decision module carries out hierarchical early warning based on the hydrological early warning values F and the submerged depth D (X, Y), and simultaneously supports large-screen synchronous display of AR fusion scenes of a mobile terminal, an AR and a command center, collaborative annotation data are encrypted and stored through a 5G private network, and emergency command timeliness is improved.
assignees: INFORMATION CENTER YELLOW RIVER WATER CONSERVANCY COMMISSION;HENAN HUANGHE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A salvage location record system
title_ko: 멀티 호핑 기술로 이행되는 해상 구조를 위한 위치 확인 및 기록 정보 시스템
abstract_en: A salvage location record system of using multi-hop wireless transmission information mode without using global satellite positioning system utilizes at least two stations to transfer, receive and temporarily store ship navigation information in the form of data package, and repeats these steps to form a network topology which records move track of the ship. When a ship disaster occurs, disaster location is determined by using the newest resource data package, thus rescue could be immediately carried out and the efficiency is advantageous over that of traditional locating mode.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지구상 위치 확인 시스템(GPS)이 아닌  멀티 호핑 기술로 실시되는 해상 구조를 위한 위치 확인 및 기록 시스템으로, 적어도 두 개의 스테이션들이 데이터 패킷의 형태로 서로에게 항해 정보를 전달한다.  데이터 패킷들은 스테이션들에 수신되어 임시로 저장된다.  전송, 수신 및 저장하는 단계들은 선박에 장착된 스테이션의 자취를 기록하는 네트워크 토폴로지(network topology)를 형성하도록 반복된다.  선박이 해상에서 조난을 당했을 때, 선박에 의해 전송된 가장 최근의 데이터 패킷은 선박 사고의 위치에 가장 가까운 위치를 제공한다.  따라서, 구조가 즉각적으로 이루어질 수 있고, 선박의 위치를 추정하는 전통적인 방법들에 비해 구조 동작의 효율이 향상된다.

title_en: Cording robot and control method of the robot
title_ko: 코딩 로봇 및 그 조종 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a robot-type toy for controlling a motion by inputting the motion in a program form in advance. The present invention provides a coding robot comprising: a robot body having a human shape and performing a motion corresponding to the motion of a human; and a coding smartphone for controlling the motion of the robot body. In addition, the method for controlling a coding robot comprises: (a) a template providing step of providing each motion of a coding robot corresponding to a human motion in the form of an icon; (b) a coding step of receiving a selection of a user by the template providing unit and combining the same as a continuous motion command; and (c) a simulation providing step of simulating the command combined in the coding step and implementing the same on a display screen of the coding smartphone in advance.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 동작을 프로그램 형태로 미리 입력하여 움직임을 제어하는 로봇형 완구로서, 인간 형태를 가지며 인간의 동작에 대응하는 움직임을 수행하는 로봇 본체; 및 상기 로봇 본체의 동작을 제어하는 코딩 스마트폰을 포함하는 코딩 로봇을 제공한다. 
또한, (a) 인간의 동작에 대응하는 코딩 로봇의 각 움직임을 아이콘 형태로 제공하는 템플릿 제공 단계; (b) 상기 템플릿 제공부에서 사용자의 선택을 받아 연속적인 동작 명령으로 조합하는 코딩 단계; 및 (c) 상기 코딩 단계에서 조합된 명령을 시뮬레이션하여 상기 코딩 스마트폰의 디스플레이 화면에 미리 구현하는 시뮬레이션 제공 단계를 포함하는 코딩 로봇 조종 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Fire event probabilistic stability evaluation uncertainty analysis system and analysis method
title_ko: 화재사건 확률론적 안정성평가 불확실성 분석시스템 및 분석방법
abstract_en: The present invention provides a fire event probabilistic stability evaluation uncertainty analysis system and method. The system comprises: an ignition source investigation module for investigating ignition sources within a fire area to be analyzed; a database generation module for generating a PSA model input database for the identified ignition sources; a fault tree providing module for constructing basic event information related to fire event-specific consideration factors based on the database; a quantification processing module for providing quantification information of the fault tree; a cutset generation module for generating minimal cutsets, which are combinations of minimum components causing failure of accident mitigation systems, based on the quantification data; and a distribution setting module for applying a log-normal distribution based on the generated minimal cutsets.
abstract_ko: 화재사건 확률론적 안정성평가 불확실성 분석시스템 및 분석방법을 제공한다. 화재사건 확률론적 안정성평가 불확실성 분석시스템으로서, 분석 대상인 화재구역 내의 점화원을 조사하는 점화원 조사모듈; 상기 화재구역 내 상기 점화원에 대한 PSA 모델 입력 데이터베이스를 생성하는 데이터베이스 생성모듈; 상기 데이터베이스를 기반으로 화재사건 특유 고려인자에 대한 불확실성 분석을 위한 기본사건정보를 구성하는 고장수목을 제공하는 고장수목 제공모듈; 상기 고장수목 제공부의 상기 고장수목을 정량화한 정량화정보를 제공하는 정량화 처리모듈; 상기 정량화정보를 기반으로 사고 완화계통의 이용 불능을 유발하는 최소기기 조합의 미니멀 컷셋을 생성하는 컷셋 생성모듈; 상기 미니멀 컷셋을 기반으로 로그정규분포를 설정하는 분포 설정모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Controller for virtual reality-based sensory integration training, and system for sensory integration training using the same
title_ko: 가상현실 기반의 감각 통합 훈련용 vr 컨트롤러 및 이를 이용한 감각 통합 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a VR controller for virtual reality-based sensory integration training, comprising: a case configured to be seated on a palm of a user; a control unit installed inside the case, the control unit including a motion sensing module configured to sense a movement direction and speed of the case, an input module configured to input a control command in response to a user's pressing operation, a program control module configured to process data regarding the movement direction and speed sensed by the motion sensing module and the control command input to the input module, a communication module configured to transmit and receive data to and from a VR control apparatus that provides virtual reality images to a VR headset through wireless or wired communication, and a power supply module configured to supply power; and an input operation unit installed on an upper portion of the case to move vertically in response to the user's pressing operation, the input operation unit being configured to transmit a physical pressing force applied by the user to the input module to input the control command. According to the present invention, predetermined training content related to the prevention of dementia is provided through the VR control apparatus and the VR headset, allowing the user to perform sensory integration training by moving the VR controller and simultaneously pressing a pressing plate of the VR controller to execute the training content.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 고령의 사용자나 장애자 등도 쉽게 가상현실 컨텐츠를 실행할 수 있도록 함으로써 치매 예방이나 재활 치료 훈련 등의 감각 통합 훈련을 효과적으로 실행할 수 있으며, 사용 편의성이 향상된 가상현실 기반의 감각 통합 훈련용 VR 컨트롤러 및 이를 이용한 감각 통합 훈련 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 가상현실 기반의 감각 통합 훈련용 VR 컨트롤러는, 사용자의 손바닥 위에 안착되는 케이스; 상기 케이스의 움직임 방향 및 속도를 감지하는 동작센싱모듈, 사용자의 누름 조작에 의해 제어 명령을 입력하는 입력모듈, 상기 동작센싱모듈에 의해 감지된 케이스의 움직임 방향 및 속도 정보와 상기 입력모듈에 입력된 제어 명령 정보를 판독하는 프로그램제어모듈, VR 헤드셋에 가상현실 영상을 제공하는 VR 제어장치와 무선 통신 또는 유선 통신을 통해 데이터를 송수신하는 통신모듈, 전원 공급을 위한 전원공급모듈을 포함하며, 상기 케이스의 내부에 설치되는 제어부; 및, 상기 케이스의 상부에 사용자의 누름 조작에 의해 상하로 이동하도록 설치되어 사용자의 누름 조작력을 상기 입력모듈로 전달하여 제어 명령을 입력하는 입력작동부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for assignment of equipment to an officer audio information
abstract_en: A system for tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment to security agency personnel (e.g., officers, administration, command, armorer). An armorer is assigned the task of tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment. Equipment may be assigned to a particular individual officer. The equipment provided to and used by officers may capture (e.g. gather, produce) information (e.g. audiovisual information, data logs, recordings). Equipment may provide information to the armorer via near field communication (NFC) circuits. The information captured may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system. The information captured by equipment assigned to a particular individual may be associated with that individual. An armorer may use information supplied by equipment, evidence management system, officers, or other sources to assist in the assignment process.

title_en: Decision support system for air missioncommander dynamic mission re-planning
abstract_en: A dynamic human machine interface system includes a mission commander application (MCA) unit including a control processor, the MCA active on one vehicle of a plurality of mission member vehicles, the MCA unit in communication with a data store, the control processor accessing executable instructions that cause the control processor to direct operations of components of the MCA unit, an alternate scenario evaluation unit accessing at least one of mission parameter records and flight member data records in the data store to recalculate mission parameters, a dynamic video interface unit to render the recalculated mission parameters on a mission control dashboard (MCD), the MCD presented to the mission commander on a display unit of the one vehicle, the MCD including a plurality of display pane areas selectable by a user interaction with an interactive interface, and each display area configurable by the user interaction to change content of the display pane.

title_en: Implantable medical device with patient input mechanism
abstract_en: An implantable loop recorder (ILR) is subcutaneously implantable to record cardiac data. The ILR includes a patient activation mechanism whereby the patient can input commands to the ILR without using an external device. The patient activation mechanism may be a subcutaneous switch disposed on an outer portion of the ILR or a motion sensor that senses tapping of the device as an input. The patient input will direct the device to store data, telemeter data, or send a message summoning an emergency response. The ILR has distance telemetry capabilities so that a telemetered message is wirelessly transmitted to an external device which then relays the message to a remote location.

title_en: Realize the methods, devices and systems of time synchronization
