abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of methods for realizing time synchronization, including receiving the standard synchronisation time that synchronous clock source is sent by local area network；The system time of terminal is obtained at set intervals, and detects the system time and whether the standard synchronisation time is consistent；If it is detected that the system time and the standard synchronisation Time Inconsistency, the system time of the terminal is changed according to the standard synchronisation time.In addition, additionally providing a kind of device and system for realizing time synchronization.The time of communication equipments various in communication network or computer equipment is subjected to unification by standard time clock time service service, time deviation is limited in sufficiently small range, with this guarantee the time unification of system with it is synchronous, and guarantee that public safety emergency command system operates normally.

title_en: Emergency response method for earthquake event
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of information processing, in particular to an emergency response method for a seismic event, which comprises the steps of obtaining seismic service data, determining a preferable template generation mode according to a template association degree and a report response coefficient, wherein the preferable template generation mode is to conduct preferable template recombination according to an area matching mean value or generate a preferable template according to an information matching amplitude value, determining a report updating mode according to a seismic influence coefficient and public opinion information quantity, and determining a report supplementing mode according to a comprehensive evaluation value for adjusting a report updating frequency or according to a characteristic correlation coefficient of an effective public opinion area, wherein the report supplementing mode comprises characteristic text supplementation and associated text supplementation. The invention can improve the accuracy and timeliness of the earthquake event response technology report.

title_en: Disaster investigation system based on special vehicle and disaster investigation method using the same
title_ko: 특수차량기반 재난조사시스템 및 이를 활용한 재난조사 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are special vehicle-based disaster investigation system which performs regular monitoring for disaster prevention and risk management in normal times and uses an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) to investigate and analyze the cause of the disaster and simulate the cause of the accident when a disaster occurs, and a disaster investigation method using the same. According to the present invention, a disaster investigation special vehicle equipped with a UAV comprises: a UAV acquiring disaster images by photographing a disaster site while flying according to a predetermined flight path and remote navigation control at a disaster site; a UAV landing platform for landing or accommodating the UAV; a PC installed with a program for data processing and analysis including data matching, merging, contour generation, volume and area calculation, and distance and angle calculation for the disaster site; and an analysis server executing three-dimensional (3D) numerical analysis for processing and analyzing observational data of the disaster site or including software (SW) for numerical analysis of flood landslide and sediment runoff, and disaster evacuation simulation analysis to control data acquisition, processing, and display.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 평상 시에 재해 예방 및 위험 관리를 위한 정기적인 모니터링을 수행하고, 재난 사고 시에는 무인 비행체를 이용하여 재난 사고의 원인 조사와 분석, 그리고 사고 원인의 시뮬레이션을 실행하는, 특수차량기반 재난조사시스템 및 이를 활용한 재난조사 방법이 개시된다. 
개시된 무인 비행체 탑재형 재난 조사 특수 차량은, 재난 현장에서 사전 지정된 비행 경로 및 원격 항법 조정에 따라 비행하면서 사고 현장의 모습을 촬영하여 재난 영상을 획득하는 무인 비행체; 상기 무인 비행체를 안착하거나 수용하기 위한 비행체 안착대; 상기 재난 현장에 대한 데이터 정합, 병합, 등고선 생성, 체적 및 면적 계산, 거리 및 각도 계산을 포함한 데이터 처리 및 분석을 위한 프로그램이 설치된 PC; 및 상기 재난 현장의 관측자료 처리분석을 위한 3차원 수치 해석을 실행하거나, 홍수산사태 토사유출 수치해석, 재난대피 모의(simulation) 분석에 관한 소프트웨어(SW)가 탑재되어, 데이터의 취득, 처리, 표출을 제어하는 분석용 서버를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: School emergency artificial intelligence notification system and method
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of notifying persons of emergencies using artificial intelligence, wherein the first step includes providing at least one database storing multiple accounts thereon that are operably configured to be selectively hierarchically diminutively associated with another account thereon. The method also includes providing an artificial intelligence hardware component operably configured to generate and receive a recording data file that includes at least one of a sound, an audio, an image, generating the recording by the artificial intelligence hardware component, transmitting, through the artificial intelligence hardware component, the recording data file to a recording database for analyzing, analyzing the recording data file to determine the presence of an emergency event or a non-emergency event, and communicating an emergency response notification, upon determining the presence of the emergency event, to the first school user account and the plurality of teacher user accounts.

title_en: Incident category selection optimization
abstract_en: This disclosure describes techniques that enable a categorization controller to detect activation of a portable recording device that is configured to capture a real-time multimedia stream of the current event. The categorization controller may further identify a set of categories that are likely associated with the real-time multimedia stream, determine an ordered ranking of the set of categories, and generate a ranked category dataset for delivery to the portable recording device. In doing so, the portable recording device may present the ordered ranking of the set of categories at a user interface.
assignees: GETAC TECHNOLOGY CORP;WHP WORKFLOW SOLUTIONS INC

title_en: Record-based device location signaling for emergency calls
abstract_en: A software platform includes emergency event processing functionality for detecting and mapping emergency event occurrences. The emergency event processing includes device location registration functionality for allowing operators of the software platform to register locations of their devices. Information associated with the operator-entered location information is stored alongside network device information. When an emergency call is placed by a device registered with the software platform, the software platform identifies network device information for the device placing the emergency call and searches records generated based on the operator-indicated device locations. A location determined thereby is then signaled to a public safety answering point. This automated signaling can improve an emergency response by directing dispatched responders to a specific location verified by the operator of the device, rather than an assumed location specified by an administrator which may not actually be accurate.

title_en: Wireless mining rescue video communication system
abstract_en: A wireless mining rescue video communication system comprises an integrated video transmitter and a wireless video receiver. Onsite video is recorded and sent to the wireless video receiver through the integrated wireless video transmitter of underground equipment, and wireless video is sent to a ground emergency rescue center through the Ethernet and a wireless Mesh network of a mine and sent to the ground emergency rescue center again through a network of a temporary rescue base of the mine. The wireless mining rescue video communication system is used for emergency rescue, and after an accident happens, multimedia information such as disaster area video images and sounds are transmitted to the temporary rescue base in a wireless mode and then uploaded to the ground emergency rescue command center in a wired or wireless mode for decision making and commanding.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY AUTOMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Displaying and training apparatus and method for overall dynamic process of alternating current-direct current grid characteristic
abstract_en: The invention, which relates to the technical field of the power system, discloses a displaying and training apparatus and method for an overall dynamic process of an alternating current-direct current grid characteristic. With the apparatus and method, a problem of a poor training effect of the existing training system in the prior art can be solved. The displaying and training apparatus comprises a format converter and a display device. The format converter is used for obtaining an electromagnetic transient waveform recording file for describing an electromagnetic transient state of equipment in a power grid from an RTDS work station and carrying out format conversion processing on the electromagnetic transient waveform recording file to obtain analog data of all equipment calculation models in the RTDS work station, wherein the analog data include an operation sate simulation result of a corresponding equipment model. The display device connected with the format converter is used for obtaining the analog data and displaying the analog data. According to the invention, the provided displaying and training apparatus and method can be used for training of dispatchers in a power system.
assignees: CSG POWER GRID TECHNOLOGY RES CT

title_en: A method of realizing Aircraft Simulator data readback
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of methods for realizing Aircraft Simulator data readback, belong to Aircraft Simulator technical field.It is characterized by: this method comprises: communication configuration, data storage and data readback；The communication is configured that the system that flying quality circulates in Aircraft Simulator includes flight simulation computer, instructor console, virtual views and analog capsule cabin, it is same network segment by the network configuration of computers all in system, data communication uses ether net mode；The data storage are as follows: the flying quality of storage is divided into two types, and Class1 data are stored with 10 millisecond periods, including aircraft position and posture information, and 2 data of type are stored with 100 millisecond periods, including pilot guidance and subsystem status data；Flight simulation computer receiving data store instruction calls data memory module start recording；The data readback are as follows: flight simulation computer receiving data play-back command calls data read module, reads file in a binary format.

title_en: Urban rail transit dispatcher emergency treatment scheme recommendation method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a recommendation method of an emergency treatment scheme of an urban rail transit dispatcher, which comprises the following steps: step S1: constructing an emergency treatment case knowledge graph and a scheduling procedure knowledge graph through unstructured records in a scheduling log; step S2: identifying interactive voice through voice recognition technology, and when emergency treatment is triggered, identifying entity information in the interactive voice, generating a search statement, and searching in an emergency treatment case knowledge graph and a scheduling procedure knowledge graph; step S3: sorting according to the search content; step S4: and fusing the content of the extracted emergency treatment case knowledge graph and the content of the scheduling procedure knowledge graph. By the emergency treatment scheme recommendation method, an efficient information retrieval tool can be provided for a dispatcher, and the provided scheme recommendation can provide a reference auxiliary decision for the dispatcher, so that the working pressure of the dispatcher is effectively reduced.

title_en: Abnormal data monitoring and early warning system is revealed to gas based on sensor
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of monitoring of abnormal gas leakage data, and particularly discloses a sensor-based abnormal gas leakage data monitoring and early warning system, which comprises the steps of predicting the distribution range of gas in space by identifying the group diffusion and feather diffusion corresponding diffusion forms of leaked gas, so as to analyze the promotion coefficient of the diffusion form of the leaked gas on reaction behavior according to the diffusion form in a targeted manner; the method comprises the steps of determining a gas leakage related area, identifying object composition and personnel composition in the gas leakage related area, analyzing a corresponding reaction influence coefficient of diffusion behavior, and determining whether leakage factors of the adjacent area originate from faults of leakage points or are caused by gas spreading in air by identifying a corresponding comprehensive abnormal threat coefficient of the adjacent area of the gas leakage point position, so as to further determine early warning grades of the gas leakage point position and the adjacent area of the gas leakage point position, and ensure timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response.

title_en: Method and apparatus for auto recording of digital television receiver
title_ko: 디지털 티브이 수신기의 자동 녹화 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: An automatic recording method and an automatic recording apparatus of a digital television receiver are provided to output a disaster broadcast when an emergency alarm or an interrupt occurs and to perform an automatic record function. A broadcasting signal receiving member(100) receives digital broadcasting. A storing member(180) stores present received broadcasting. A control member(170) stores the present received broadcasting in the storing member when an emergency alarm or an interrupt occurs, commands the conversion and return of the disaster broadcasting and reproduces the broadcasting stored in the storing member. A broadcasting output member(140) selectively reproduces the stored broadcasting according to the control of the control member. The present received broadcasting is stored in a time shift function. The interrupt information generates by interruption of the video or audio signal received by the present watching broadcasting.
abstract_ko:
개시된 본 발명은 긴급경보(EAS) 또는 인터럽트 발생시 자동 녹화 기능을 수행하는 디지털 TV 수신기의 자동 녹화 방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은, 디지털 방송을 수신하고; 긴급경보 또는 인터럽트 발생시 현재 수신되는 방송을 저장시킴과 동시에 해당 재난방송으로 전환하고; 상기 긴급경보 해제시 해당 재난방송을 종료하고 상기 단계에서 정지된 시점으로부터 저장된 방송을 재생한다. 상기 현재 수신되는 방송을 저장시키는 기능은, 타임 시프트(Time Shift) 기능에 의하여 저장되고, 상기 긴급경보는, 현재 시청중인 방송으로 수신되는 비디오 또는 오디오 신호의 인터럽트에 의하여 발생하거나, 현재 시청중인 방송으로 수신되는 PSIP(Program and System Information Protocol) 데이터에 의하여 발생한다. 따라서, 긴급경보 또는 인터럽트 발생시 해당 재난방송을 출력함과 아울러, 자동으로 현재 시청중인 방송의 녹화 기능을 수행하고, 재난방송 종료후 녹화된 방송으로부터 현재 시청하던 방송을 이어서 재생하여 본 방송을 끊김 없이 시청할 수 있다. 
       
     긴급경보, 인터럽트, EAS, 녹화, 타임 시프트, TS, TV, PVR, 재난방송

title_en: System for learning languages program using smart toy
title_ko: 스마트완구를 이용한 언어 프로그램 학습 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for learning a language program using a smart toy, which enables a user to easily learn all languages including a programming language while having the user to have interests, wherein the system comprises: a management server (102) generating word blocks and sending generated word blocks to a smart terminal (104); the smart terminal (104) assembling a word block desired by the user among the word blocks received from the management server (102) to create a first command signal in one language and sending the first command signal to the smart toy (106); and the smart toy (106) moving in response to the first command signal received from the smart terminal (104).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 흥미를 가지면서 프로그램밍 언어를 포함한 모든 언어를 쉽게 학습할 수 있도록 하는 스마트완구를 이용한 언어 프로그램 학습 시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명은 낱말블럭들을 생성하고 생성된 낱말블럭들을 스마트단말기(104)로 보내는 관리서버(102)와; 관리서버(102)로부터 수신된 낱말블럭들 중에서 사용자가 원하는 낱말블럭을 조립하여 하나의 언어로 제1명령신호를 만든 후, 제1명령신호를 스마트완구(106)로 보내는 스마트단말기(104)와; 스마트단말기(104)로부터 수신된 제1명령신호에 따라 움직이는 스마트완구(106)를 포함한다.

title_en: VoIP BROADCASTING SYSTEM USING PSTN NETWORK OR MOBILE NETWORK
title_ko: PSTN 망 또는 이동통신 망을 이용한 VoIP 동보 시스템
abstract_en: In accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, it may have an effect of instantly performing a broadcasting service in a zone to be managed such as mountains, the sea or a building through a client terminal using a PSTN network or a mobile communication network when an emergency situation such as a disaster situation or a dangerous situation is witnessed. To achieve the purpose, in accordance with one embodiment of the present invention, a VoIP broadcasting system using a PSTN network or a mobile communication network comprises: a client terminal requesting a broadcasting service by using a PSTN network or a mobile communication network; an SIP-based speaker distributed and placed in a zone to be managed in which an emergency situation can occur, and outputting a broadcasting service based on a broadcasting service request of the client terminal; an IP-PBX registering an extension number to be called by the client terminal, registering the SIP-based speaker, and executing a command code for the broadcasting service when the client terminal requests an extension number call; a VoIP gateway processing an analog signal of the client terminal into a digital signal to connect the signal to the IP-PBX; and a broadcasting server storing broadcasting protocols corresponding to emergency situations, and executing the broadcasting protocols based on the command code executed when the client terminal requests the extension number to be called.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 의하면, 재난 상황 또는 위험 상황 등의 비상 상황을 목격한 경우 PSTN 망 또는 이동통신 망을 이용하는 클라이언트 단말을 통해 즉각적으로 산, 바다, 빌딩 등 관리 구역 내에 동보방송을 실행할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 이를 위해 특히 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 상기와 같은 본 발명의 목적은, PSTN 망 또는 이동통신 망을 이용하여 동보 방송을 요청하는 클라이언트 단말; 응급 상황 발생 가능한 관리 구역 내에 분산 배치되고, 클라이언트 단말의 동보 방송 요청에 기반하여 동보 방송을 출력하는 SIP 기반 스피커; 클라이언트 단말의 콜 대상인 내선 번호를 등록하고, SIP 기반 스피커를 등록하며, 클라이언트 단말의 내선 번호 콜 요청 시 동보 방송을 위한 명령 코드를 실행하는 IP-PBX; 클라이언트 단말의 아날로그 신호를 디지털 신호로 처리하여 IP-PBX에 연결하는 VoIP 게이트웨이; 및 응급 상황에 대응하는 방송 프로토콜이 저장되고, 클라이언트 단말의 내선 번호 콜 요청 시 실행된 명령 코드에 기반하여 방송 프로토콜을 실행하는 방송 서버를 포함하는 PSTN 망 또는 이동통신 망을 이용한 VoIP 동보 시스템을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: System and method for emergency communications
abstract_en: The provision of emergency response services to a user can be based on transitioning a communications device associated with a user to a listening mode, setting a first timer, recording user actions with the communications device, ascertaining, based on a status of the first timer and the user actions, whether a criteria with respect to at least user interaction is met, and, if the criteria is met, transitioning the communications device to an emergency communications mode, else resetting the timer and repeating the recording and the ascertaining until the criteria is met. The emergency communication mode consists of forwarding user and live location information to a remote server and receiving emergency contact information, selected based on the user and live location information, for establishing a communication with emergency response personnel.

title_en: Extracting shared state information from message traffic
abstract_en: An approach to having a shared state from one system to another is to represent data in one system according to service traffic of the other system. For example, by intercepting service traffic associated with a first entity, identifying a data object representing at least a portion of the state of the first entity in the service traffic, and updating a corresponding portion of a shared state data structure in accordance with a value of the data object, the shared state can be maintained outside of the first entity. This process can be extended to maintaining shared state of more than one entity. The service traffic might be e-mail service traffic, database service traffic, or the like. Synchronization commands can be used to initiate at least a portion of the service traffic. The shared state can be used for backups, record-keeping, service migration, disaster recovery, fail-over and/or fault tolerance improvements. In some instances, an application fingerprint can be applied to the service traffic to identify a context of the first data object, with such objects being caching based on context.

title_en: Information monitoring system based on first-aid scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information monitoring system based on emergency dispatch, which relates to the technical field of information monitoring and is used for solving the problems that the state of illness, detailed places and the like of patients are not recorded in detail in the information monitoring of the existing emergency dispatch center, and the number of emergency ambulances in jurisdictions is limited, so that the vehicle dispatch has a shortage problem, and the system comprises a data acquisition module, an information monitoring module, a database and a dispatch execution module; the invention monitors and processes the emergency request information of the hospital emergency dispatch center through the information monitoring module so as to process the emergency request in time and record the condition information of the patient in detail, processes the emergency request information and dispatches the corresponding rescue vehicle to request for processing, and performs auxiliary rescue through intelligently distributing the externally injected vehicles when the rescue vehicle is insufficient, so as to solve the problem of limited number of ambulances in jurisdictions.

title_en: Black box with high performance of heat insulation and light weight
title_ko: 단열성 및 경량성이 향상된 블랙박스
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A black box with an improved thermal insulation and lightness is provided to minimize damage according to the inner pressure increase. CONSTITUTION: A black box with an improved thermal insulation and lightness comprises a housing(110), an insulation material(130), a memory board(140), a storage space(150) and an opening/closing cover(120). The insulation material is prepared in the inside part of the housing. The memory board is prepared in the inner side of the insulation material. The storage space is formed within the insulation material in order to have the space to the longitudinal direction of the housing. A phase change material is charged on the storage space. The opening/closing cover is located on the front side of the housing in order to open and close the housing.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 블랙박스는 하우징; 상기 하우징의 전면에 위치하여 상기 하우징을 개폐할 수 있도록 하는 개폐커버; 상기 하우징의 내측부에 마련된 단열재; 상기 단열재의 내측면에 마련된 메모리보드; 및 상기 하우징의 길이 방향으로 공간을 가지도록 단열재 내에 형성되고, 상변화 물질이 충전된 다수의 수납공간;을 포함하고 바람직하게는  상변화 물질의 분해 등에 의해 발생하는 가스를 블랙박스 외부로 배출할 수 있는 가스 배출 통로로서, 필터, 가스 저장부, 가스 배출관, 및 밸브를 더 포함한다. 
본 발명에 따른 블랙박스는 단열재 및 단열재 내에 일한 분포로 형성되고, 상변화 물질이 충전된 다수의 수납공간을 포함하고 있어서, 화재 등의 사고에 의하여 발생한 외부의 열이 메모리보드에 전달되는 것을 최소화하고, 그 결과 비행 기록, 사고 기록 등이 저장된 메모리보드의 손상을 방지할 수 있으며, 아울러, 적은 양의 단열재 및 상변화 물질을 사용하는 것으로도 충분한 단열성을 가지기 때문에 향상된 경량성을 가진다. 또한, 본 발명에 따른 블랙박스는 상변화 물질의 분해 등에 의해 발생하는 가스를 블랙박스 외부로 배출할 수 있는 가스 배출 통로를 구비하고 있어서, 가스에 의한 내부 압력의 증가시에도 블랙박스 내부 구조의 손상을 방지하고, 그 결과 블랙박스의 내구성을 향상시킬 수 있다.

title_ko: 진동감지와 누설전류의 실시간 원격 계측 및 외부 침입퇴치 기능과 데이터 저장기능을 구비한 배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to vibration sensing, real time remote measurement of a leakage current, and a distribution panel having an external invasion eradication function and a data storage function. To this end, the present invention includes: a relay circuit unit selectively inputting and outputting a current; a leakage current sensing unit; an input unit setting an operation reference value; a control unit determining a condition of a grounding cable; an alarm unit generating an alarm signal; a FND display unit displaying a measured leakage current value; a graphic display unit displaying a data value in a graphical representation; a power interruption unit interrupting power; a data storage unit storing data by a certain time unit; a wire communications unit including a RS232, a RS485, and a USB for performing communications; a wireless communications unit including wifi; a remote terminal; an integration server analyzing a leakage current and a vibration frequency; a prime power unit supplying DC power supply into an expansion sensor unit; and a lithium battery supplying power supply in case of emergency.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 진동감지와 누설전류의 실시간 원격 계측 및 외부 침입퇴치 기능과 데이터 저장기능을 구비한 배전반에 관한 것이다. 보다 상세하게는, 배전반에 누설전류 감지부, 지진을 포함한 외력으로 인한 진동을 감지하기 위한 진동감지 센서, 온/습도 센서를 포함한 다양한 센서와 센서의 신호를 무선으로 전송할 수 있는 무선 통신부를 장착하여 배전반의 접지선을 통해 누설되는 전류량과 배전반의 내부 상태를 원격에서 실시간으로 계측하고, 제어할 수 있도록 하여 누설 전류로 인한 제품손상 및 전력 손실을 방지하고, 배전반의 관리소홀로 인한 안전사고를 미연에 방지하며, 배전반 내에 구비된 다양한 센서로부터 데이터를 수집 및 축적하여 배전반의 고장 분석, 진단, 고장 처리 등을 포함하여 배전반을 효율적 관리할 수 있는 진동감지와 누설전류의 실시간 원격 계측 및 외부 침입퇴치 기능과 데이터 저장기능을 구비한 배전반에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위해 본 발명은 돌입전류로 인한 회로의 오작동을 방지하는 포토커플러를 포함하고, 각 접지선에서 측정되는 전류를 선택적으로 입출력하는 릴레이회로부; 접지선에서 측정되는 임의의 전류에 대해 상대적으로 작게 비례하는 소전류로 변성하는 변류기, 변류기를 통해 입력된 교류전압을 직류전압으로 변환하여 증폭하는 AC-DC 변환회로, 릴레이회로부의 입출력 신호에 따라 변환증폭된 직류전압 값의 입출력을 제어하는 데이터 셀렉터, 및 데이터 셀렉터로부터 입력된 직류전압 값을 2중 적분하여 디지털신호로 변환하는 A/D 변환회로를 포함하며 다수의 접지선 상에 결선되어 측정되는 전류를 소정의 디지털신호를 변환하는 누설전류감지부; 경보신호의 사용 유무를 입력하는 풀-업 저항과 풀-업 저항에 의해 온/오프되는 발광다이오드로 구성되어 경보신호의 사용 유무를 제어하고 표시하는 경보신호 제어회로를 포함하고, 접지선을 통해 측정되는 전류의 디지털신호와 비교되는 동작기준치를 설정하는 입력부; 제어 프로그램이 내장되어 연산을 수행하고, 회로 소자를 제어하는 MCU, 일정 클록(clock)을 발생시켜 제어 프로그램을 운영하는 크리스탈회로, 풀-업 저항을 이용하여 제어 프로그램을 리셋하는 리셋회로, 및  MCU에 공급되는 전원을 안정화시키는 전원안정회로를 포함하고, 접지선에서 측정된 디지털신호와 동작기준치를 비교하여 접지선의 상태를 판단하는 제어부; 제어부의 판단에 따른 접지선의 상태에 대한 경보신호를 발생시키는 알람부; 표시제어칩,  7-세그먼트 및 밝기제어회로를 포함하고, 제어부의 판단에 따른 접지선의 상황 및 접지선에서 측정된 누설전류 값을 표시하는 FND 표시부; 지진을 포함한 건물의 흔들림에 의한 진동을 감지하기 위한 3축 가속도센서, 자이로 센서, 지자기 센서를 포함한 진동감지센서, 내부의 온도와 습도를 측정하기 위한 온/습도 센서, 내부 화재발생을 감지하기 위한 불꽃형태의 자외선을 감지하기 위한 불꽃감지센서를 포함하는 확장 센서부; 누설 전류감지부 및 확장 센서부로부터 수신된 데이터 값을 그래프를 포함한 도식화된 화면을 보여주는 그래픽 디스플레이부; 확장 센서부의 진동감지센서에 의한 진동과 누설전류 감지부에 의한 누설전류를 비교하여 소정규모 이상의 누설전류가 발생하거나 불꽃감지센서에 의해 불꽃이 감지되는 경우 제어부의 제어 신호에 의해 전력을 차단하는 전력 차단부; 제어부와 연결되고, 확장 센서부로부터 전송된 데이터 및 누설전류 감지부에서 전송된 데이터의 이력관리를 위해 소정 시간 단위로 데이터를 저장하는 데이터 저장부; 과전압방지회로와, 신호변환회로, 절연회로, 및 전원안정회로를 포함하고, 데이터 저장부에 저장된 데이터를 백업하거나 외부로 인출하기 위해 외부 메모리장치와 연결되거나 PC를 포함한 외부 통신기기와 유선으로 접속하여 통신을 수행하기 위한 RS232, RS485 및 USB를 포함한 유선 통신부; 제어부와 연결되고, 확장 센서부에서 전송된 데이터와 제어부의 제어신호를 무선으로 송수신하기 위한  와이파이를 포함한 무선 통신부; 무선 통신부의 데이터 신호를 전송받아 원격에서 데이터를 계측하기 위한 프로그램이 구비된 사용자의 스마트 기기를 포함한 원격단말기; 무선 통신부로부터 누설전류 감지부 및 확장 센서부의 데이터를 전송받아 누설전류 분석과 진동빈도 분석을 위한 통합서버; 누설전류 감지부에서 수신된 DC전원을 확장 센서부에 사용하는 DC전원에 맞도록 변환하여 확장 센서부 내부에 DC전원을 공급하는 주전원부; 및 주전원부의 DC전원을 감지하여 완전충전상태를 유지하며, 주전원부의 DC 전원이 인가되지 않을 경우 데이터 저장부에 저장된 데이터의 보존과 통신기능을 포함한 비상시 기본적인 기능 모드를 유지하도록 비상시 전원을 공급하기 위한 리튬배터리를 포함한 보조 전원부를 포함하는 진동감지와 누설전류의 실시간 원격 계측 및 외부 침입퇴치 기능과 데이터 저장기능을 구비한 배전반을 제공한다.

title_en: Charging and keeping cabinet for battery
title_ko: 배터리 충전 및 보관이 가능한 캐비닛
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a cabinet capable of charging and storing a battery. More specifically, the cabinet comprises: a storage box in which a plurality of storage parts separated up, down, left, and right are integrally configured so as to store a battery therein; a door which is provided to be opened and closed on a front surface of the plurality of storage parts; a charging terminal part which is provided inside the plurality of storage parts and includes a charging terminal and a balance cable connection terminal to be connected to the battery stored in the store unit so as to allow charging; a power supply and a control unit which are provided on one side of the storage box so as to manage a charging state of the battery of the entire storage part through a central management control unit including an embedded charging/discharging control program for automatically controlling power supply according to the full charge of the battery of each storage part while supplying power to the charging terminal part provided on the plurality of storage parts; and a temperature sensor which is provided inside the plurality of storage parts to sense the temperature inside the storage part and transmit a signal to the central management control unit. The power supply and the control unit are provided with: a monitor for displaying, on a screen, the charging state of the battery charged or stored in each storage part; an input unit for confirming the charging state of the battery charged or stored in each storage part or inputting a charging command; and an air conditioner for providing cool/warm air to each storage part under control of the central management control part according to the internal temperature of each storage part sensed by the temperature sensor. In an inner wall of each storage part, a nonflammable interior material is further provided to prevent fire spread in case of fire.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배터리 충전 및 보관이 가능한 캐비닛에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 내부에 배터리를 수납하록 상하, 좌우로 분리된 복수개의 수납부가 일체로 구성되는 수납함체와, 상기 복수개의 수납부 전면에 개폐가능하게 구비되는 도어와, 상기 복수개의 수납부 내측에 구비되어 수납되는 배터리와 연결되어 충전이 이루어지도록 충전단자 및 밸런스케이블 연결단자가 구비되는 충전단자부와, 상기 복수개의 수납부에 구비된 충전단자부에 전원을 공급하면서 각 수납부의 배터리 완충여부에 따라 전원공급을 자동제어하는 충방전제어프로그램이 내장된 중앙관리제어부를 통해 전체 수납부의 배터리 충전상태를 관리하도록 수납함체의 일측에 파워서플라이 및 제어부;가 구비되되, 상기 복수개 수납부의 내측에는 수납부 내부의 온도를 감지하여 상기 중앙관리제어부로 신호를 보내는 온도감지센서가 구비되고, 상기 파워서플라이 및 제어부에는 각 수납부에서 충전되거나 보관중인 배터리의 충전상태를 화면에 표시해주는 모니터와, 각 수납부에서 충전 또는 보관되고 있는 배터리의 충전상태를 확인하거나 충전명령을 입력할 수 있는 입력부와, 상기 온도감지센서에서 감지된 각 수납부의 내부 온도에 따라 중앙관리제어부의 제어로 각 수납부로 냉/온풍을 제공하는 에어컨디셔너가 구비되고, 상기 각 수납부의 내벽에는 화재시 화재확산을 방지할 수 있는 불연성내장재가 더 설치된 구성으로 이루어진다.

title_en: Flow measurement technique that combines Drone and Surface Velocity using doppler radar
title_ko: 드론과 전자파표면유속계를 융합한 유량측정 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a flow measurement method combining a drone and an electromagnetic wave surface flow velocity meter. More specifically, an electromagnetic wave is emitted in the upstream direction of a river by using a drone with an electromagnetic wave surface flow velocity meter mounted on a gimbal attached to the drone to measure the flow of the river in a flood season. Then the Doppler effect of the electromagnetic wave reflected from the water surface is used to measure the surface flow velocity and then flow velocity data and flight data are integrated and processed by a control computer for an electromagnetic wave surface flow velocity meter and are stored in a flow velocity data storage part and a flight record storage part capable of storing data even if communication is temporarily interrupted. Then the flight data and the flow velocity data are simultaneously displayed by an integrated ground control system (GCS) located on the ground. The flow is calculated by using a middle cross-sectional area method or a ground surface flow velocity method to eliminate conventional measurement on a bridge and a bank by manpower to efficiently carry out measurement without accidents.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론과 전자파표면유속계를 융합한 유량측정 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히 설명하면 홍수기에 하천의 유량을 측정하도록 드론에 부착된 짐벌에 전자파표면유속계를 장착한 드론을 이용하여 하천의 상류방향으로 전자파를 발사한 후 수표면에서 반사되는 전자파의 도플러 효과를 이용하여 표면유속을 측정한 다음 전자파표면유속계용 제어 컴퓨터에서 유속 데이터와 비행 데이터를 통합 처리하고, 유속 데이터 저장부 및 통신이 일시적으로 두절되더라도 데이터 기록을 저장하는 비행기록 저장부에 저장한 다음 지상에 위치한 통합 GCS(지상 관제센터)에서 비행 데이터 및 유속 데이터를 동시에 표시하고, 중간단면적법 또는 지표유속법을 이용하여 유량을 산정함으로 인해 종래와 같이 교량, 제방에서 인력에 의해 측정을 하지않아 안전사고 없이 효율적으로 측정할 수 있는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Incident recording systems and methods
abstract_en: A primary subsystem captures original information and supplemental information to form a revision. A primary subsystem enables revisions to be made at the location of the incident prior to leaving the location. Systems for collecting and managing information about incidents include primary and secondary subsystems. A category is a descriptor or label that identifies a common aspect among members assigned to the category. Categories may determine how information is stored, communicated, and/or accessed on primary and/or secondary subsystems.

title_en: Intelligent safety helmet
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an intelligent safety helmet, which belongs to the technical field of safety helmets. The camera is arranged, on-site video or photo data can be collected in real time and then transmitted to the acquired management center, so that the background management center can know emergency information on the expressway in real time, the expressway can be patrolled and positioned through the helmet, video recording is carried out in emergency event processing, evidence is reserved, and in emergency smooth work, road patrols can carry out monitoring video talkback with monitoring center commanders through the management platform at congestion points or accident occurrence points, decision making judgment is carried out according to on-site traffic flow conditions, and the rapid strain capacity is improved.
assignees: LTD RESPONSIBILITY COMPANY ON GUANGXI CENRUO EXPRESSWAY

title_en: Public health emergency command information system
abstract_en: Disclosed is a public health emergency command information system, which presets an emergency message database of related reference information needed when handling various emergent events, after a service desk accepts and records an incoming emergent event, a GIS module locates the scene of the emergent event and provides the topographical map around the scene, and then picks up related reference information from the emergency message database for implementing the corresponding deployment according to the emergent event, and after the emergent event is accepted, the GIS module finally generates the corresponding process report according to the handling process of the emergent event, so as to realize the high efficiency processing to the emergent event, improve the emergency capability of all functional departments and maximally reduce the influence of the emergent event to the public.

title_en: Method and system for communicating based on car networking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and system for communicating based on car networking, and belongs to the field of communication. The method comprises the following steps that a vehicle generates signing messages according to a fake identity label and the communication information produced by the vehicle, and sends the fake identity label, the communication information, a time stamp of the communication information and the signing messages to an emergency vehicle AMB; the AMB effectively verifies the timeliness of the communication information and the fake identity label of the vehicle, wherein if the AMB verifies that the communication information and the fake identity label of the vehicle is valid, the fake identity label, the communication information and the signing messages are sent to a dependable disaster relief commanding mechanism DRA; the DRA verifies the signing messages of vehicles in batches according to the fake identity labels and the communication information sent by the vehicles, wherein if the signing messages of the vehicles are valid, the communication information sent by the vehicles is used. According to the method and system for communicating based on the car networking, the vehicles can still be communicated after a roadside infrastructure is destroyed.

title_en: A kind of shared bicycle fault identification and application system based on information fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of shared bicycle fault identifications and application system based on information fusion, include mainly information collecting platform, differentiate centring system and application platform.Information collecting platform includes GIS cloud service systems, bicycle information service system, Database Systems, for the repair message of the bicycle space time information of real-time collecting, user's use information, feedback information and historical record to be realized integrated treatment in Database Systems.Differentiate the information that centring system is transmitted by receiving information collecting platform, realizes intelligent recognition corpse bicycle and failure bicycle.Application platform realization failure bicycle and the differentiation of normal bicycle are shown, and notify all types of user in time to realize that user looks for vehicle is convenient, enterprise maintenance is timely to be managed effectively with government department.The present invention can effectively integrate the real-time trip for recycling bicycle and historical failure data, realize multi-faceted comprehensively disabled vehicle automatic identification and timely dispatch, that improves user looks for vehicle success rate, the resource utilization of bicycle and service quality.

title_en: Emergency command dispatching system and dispatching method based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency command, in particular to an emergency command scheduling system and a scheduling method based on the Internet of things. According to the invention, through rapid collection and analysis of real-time data, the response speed and efficiency to sudden events are remarkably improved, a data-driven decision process is realized, each decision is ensured to be based on the latest and most accurate information, the calculation of resource requirements and a dynamic scheduling mechanism allow rescue resources to be more reasonably distributed, the resources can be ensured to be delivered to the most needed place, the optimization of communication flow improves the information synchronization efficiency between a command center and a site, the accuracy and timeliness of instruction transmission are enhanced, the life and property safety can be furthest protected under emergency conditions, and the recovery time is shortened.
assignees: GUANGZHOU YISHI ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Anti-icing coating emergency wire-releasing method for overhead cable and anti-icing coating robot
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of electric robots. The invention provides an emergency wire-stripping method for anti-icing coating of an overhead cable and an anti-icing coating robot, wherein a lower coating component cannot be separated from the overhead cable or cannot be moved to a set wire-stripping position although being separated from the overhead cable, and is judged to be in an emergency wire-stripping state. The invention solves the problem that the anti-icing coating device lacks emergency off-line structural support, improves the pertinence and timeliness of emergency response, and avoids the risk that the device is detained in cables due to delay of off-line operation caused by incapability of judging an emergency state.
assignees: LAIWU POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: child car isolation prevention IOT
title_ko: 어린이 차량 고립 방지 iot
abstract_en: Recently, damage to daycare center vehicles caused by intense heat has been reported in the media. Accordingly, systems (sleeping child checking system or the like) capable of preventing accidents have been released in large quantities. However, most protection measures use sensors which check temperature or amounts of carbon dioxide. However, temperature or carbon dioxide is difficult to measure and sensors are sensitive to go off frequently. Easy measurement measures for clearly determining a situation are sought. In addition, subjects showing future practicality using applications and coding are set around the subject of IoT. The present invention is differentiated from other utility models by using Bluetooth, GPS, and application programming. An approach to the problem completely different from previously registered utility models and patents was used to seek a creative measure to derive a conclusion. The present invention achieves the above objective to prevent children vehicle accidents caused by intense heat. The results of the present invention will be basically applied to daycare center and kindergarten vehicles. Furthermore, the present invention will be further developed around CDS sensors by attaching IoT to ordinary buses. The business will be expanded to personal cars and autonomous cars as well as buses.
abstract_ko: 요즘 폭염으로 인하여 생긴 어린이집 차량의 피해가 언론에서 많이 보고되었다. 이에 따라 안전사고를 방지할 수 있는 시스템 (슬리핑 차일드 체크 시스템 등)이 대량 출시되어 있다. 하지만 대부분의 보호 방안들은 온도 혹은 이산화탄소의 양을 체크하는 센서를 이용한 것이다. 그렇지만 이는 실질적으로 측정이 어렵고, 센서들이 예민하여 수시로 울릴 수 있다. 측정하기 쉽고, 명확히 상황을 판단할 수 있는 방안들을 모색해보았다. 또한 IoT라는 주제를 중심으로 애플리케이션과 코딩을 이용하여 미래실용성이 보이는 주제를 설정하였다. 블루투스와 GPS와 애플리케이션 프로그래밍을 이용하여 다른 실용신안과 차별을 두었다. 기존에 등록된 실용신안과 특허에서 전혀 다른 방식으로 문제점에 접근하여 창의적인 방안을 모색하여 결론으로 도출하였다.    본 프로젝트를 통하여 폭염으로 인한 어린이 차량 사고를 방지하기 위한 위의 목적을 달성할 수 있었고, 본 프로젝트의 결과는 향후 어린이집, 유치원 차량은 기본적으로 적용하고, 앞으로 더 나아가서 일반적인 버스에 IoT를 부착하는 형식으로 cds센서 중심으로 더 나아갈 계획이다. 꼭 버스뿐만이 아니라 개인의 승용차와 자율주행자동차까지도 확장해서 사업을 확장시킬 계획이다.

title_en: The AR VR MR Combat simulation trainig system using military operation theme contents
title_ko: 작전테마 콘텐츠를 이용한 ar vr mr 교전 모의 훈련 시스템
abstract_en: A simulation training system comprises: a server for storing a program for simulation training; a database for storing data required for a simulation training program of the server; a display for setting the program for simulation training through the server; and a motion controller for controlling output of a simulation training image and training to be available through the server, wherein the motion controller further includes a remote controller for controlling training to be available according to a VR which is capable of outputting a simulation training image and is wearable, and a simulation training image output through the VR, and a curved trajectory firearm which is capable of training to fire a guided missile and shell by using the VR and the remote controller. According to the present invention, various training methods through military operation theme content are possible by applying AR and a motion recognition technique in order to improve navigation, and it is possible to contribute to improvement of fighting strength of an army by solving an individual practical training time shortage problem due to a narrow training site and excessive training preparation time. Also, according to the present invention, it is possible to reduce accidents caused by training using a weapon system of a trainee and generation of harm to the public due to noise generated during training, and also aiming, firing and inducing processes can be easily trained. In addition, an actual guided missile is not used to train gunners, thereby reducing costs and dangerous situation.
abstract_ko:
모의훈련시스템에 있어서, 모의훈련에 대한 프로그램이 저장되는 서버와, 서버의 모의훈련 프로그램에 필요한 데이터가 저장되는 데이터베이스와 서버를 통해 모의훈련에 대한 프로그램을 설정할 수 있도록 하는 디스플레이와 서버를 통해 모의훈련 영상 출력 및 훈련이 가능하도록 제어하는 모션컨트롤러를 포함하되,  모션컨트롤러는 모의훈련 영상 출력 및 착용이 가능한 VR과 VR을 통해 출력되는 모의훈련 영상에 따라 훈련이 가능하도록 제어하는 리모콘과 VR과 리모콘을 활용하여 유도탄 및 포탄을 포격할 수 있도록 훈련이 가능한 곡사화기를 더 포함하도록 제공하는 것이다. 
조종술 향상을 위해 AR 및 동작인식 기술을 적용하여 작전테마 콘텐츠를 통한 다양한 훈련방식이 가능한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 효과는 협소한 훈련 공장 및 과다한 훈련준비 시간으로 인한 개별실습시간 부족 문제를 해결하여 군의 전투력 향상에 기여하기 위한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 효과는 교육생의 무기체계를 사용한 훈련에 대한 안전사고 감소 및 훈련 시 발생하는 소음으로 인한 대민피해 발생을 감소하기 위한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 효과는 유도탄의 조준, 사격, 유도 과정을 쉽게 훈련할 수 있고, 사수들에게 훈련시키기 위하여 실제유도탄을 사용하지 않아 비용절감 및 위험상황을 감소하기 위한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for safely managing and monitoring railroad station and the periphery zone
title_ko: 철도 및 주변 역사에 대한 통합 안전관리 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated safety management method for a railroad and a nearby station. According to the present invention, a sign of abnormality is detected in advance on a railroad or a nearby track, a station attendant or an engineer as an administrator or a relevant agency such as police and fire stations is quickly informed of the danger situation by means of an artificial intelligence cognitive system, and thus railroad safety management can be efficiently performed. The method includes: a step of installing a sensing unit in a railway station facility, the sensing unit being one of an image sensor (video recording device), a fire sensor, a smoke sensor, a gas sensor, and a noise sensor; a step of receiving information detected by the sensing unit; a step of comparing and analyzing the received information with big data stored in a data warehouse; and a step of notifying an administrator, a fire station, or a police station when a sign of abnormality is detected as a result of the comparison and analysis. The big data stored and learned in the data warehouse is used so that the administrator is notified of an accident probability before the sign of abnormality. As a result, accidents can be forestalled. By the railway station safety management and monitoring method of the present invention, accidents at stations can be forestalled and administrators′ monitoring burden can be reduced based on algorithm-based and automatic situation detection.

title_en: Mobile asset data recorder and transmitter
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allows for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with impact detection, rough operating condition detection, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of a mobile asset. Users can use the normal operation of their mobile assets to locate and alert, in real-time, areas where their assets are encountering rough operating environments, to provide for quicker emergency response, and to validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting.

title_en: A prediction method of user's dangerous situation based on location and terminal-information
title_ko: 위치 및 단말 정보 기반 사용자 위험 상황 예측 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for predicting a user′s dangerous situation based on location and terminal information comprising: a step (a) of mounting a battery check function, an impact recognition function, and a use state collection function on a portable terminal through an application, and setting a level of sharing collected information; a step (b) of calculating a degree of danger by measuring acceleration and terminal information in real time by the portable terminal; a step (c) of outputting recognition data by recognizing one among whether of intentional separation of a battery, whether of an impact by a safety accident, and whether of disuse caused by a natural disaster by the portable terminal; a step (d) of determining whether of a user′s danger possible state by calculating a degree of danger according to preset coverage by applying location information of the portable terminal and the measured acceleration and terminal information from a server; and a step (d) of outputting a danger possible state message by the server if it is determined that the user is in possible danger. The present invention has effects of certainly ensuring personal protection of a user by predicting and preventing the current and future dangerous situations of users in various industries and various levels of society, being easily signed up by an organization such as businesses, schools, etc., being used by easily downloading a program by anyone, and quickly sharing information, which is set and disclosed by a user, with a guardian or the like.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 위치 및 단말 정보 기반 사용자 위험 상황 예측 방법을 공개한다. 이 방법은 (a) 휴대용 단말기에 어플리케이션 앱을 통하여 배터리 체크 기능, 충격 인식 기능 및 사용 현황 수집 기능이 탑재되고, 수집되는 정보의 공유 수준이 설정되는 단계; (b) 상기 휴대용 단말기가 가속도 및 단말 정보를 실시간으로 측정하여 위험도를 계산하는 단계; (c) 상기 휴대용 단말기가 배터리의 고의적 분리 여부, 안전 사고에 의한 충격 여부, 자연재해 사고에 의한 미사용 여부 중 어느 하나 이상을 인지하여 인지 데이터를 출력하는 단계; (d) 서버가 상기 측정된 가속도 및 단말 정보와 상기 휴대용 단말기의 위치정보를 인가받아 기 설정된 커버리지에 따른 위험도를 계산하여 사용자의 위험 가능 상태 여부를 판단하는 단계; 및 (e) 상기 사용자의 위험 가능 상태로 판단된 경우, 상기 서버가 위험 가능 상태 메시지를 출력하는 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 의할 경우, 사회의 다양한 업종 및 다양한 계층의 사용자들의 현재의 위험 상황 및 미래의 위험 상황을 예측하여 미리 예방함으로써 사용자의 신변 보호를 확실하게 보장하게 된다. 또한, 기업, 학교 등의 단체가입이 용이하며, 누구나 쉽게 프로그램을 다운 받아 이용할 수 있고, 사용자가 설정하고 공개한 정보를 보호자 등이 빠르게 공유할 수 있다.

title_en: The listed emulation training evaluation method of power distribution network based on operation information battle array
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of listed emulation training evaluation method of power distribution network based on operation information battle array, including establishes listed simulation operations result battle array in real time RLSI , the step object information for the simulation operations that are listed in real time with this gust of recording dispatching person；Establish listed simulation operations time battle array in real time RLST , the step temporal information for the simulation operations that are listed in real time with this gust of recording dispatching person；Establish the listed simulation operations result battle array of standard SLSI , the step object information for the simulation operations that are listed with this gust of recording dispatching person's standard；Establish the listed simulation operations time battle array of standard SLST , the step temporal information for the simulation operations that are listed with this gust of recording dispatching person's standard；Establish listed simulation operations information evaluation battle array RLIE , the evaluation result for the simulation operations information that is listed with this gust of recording dispatching person, calculate RLIE ；Calculate the evaluation result of the single listed simulation operations of dispatcher SLER .Calculate the listed simulation operations overall merit result of dispatcher RLER .With practical training evaluative meaning.
assignees: FUJIAN AUTOMATION ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: One kind being based on public security big data safety emergency management and Dispatching Decision-making System
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of based on public security big data safety emergency management and Dispatching Decision-making System, including vehicle flowrate monitoring modular, flow of the people monitoring modular, public security information data module, accident information data module, tracking monitor module, system wake-up module, system management module, system decision-making module, personal scheduling module, respective feedback module and data cloud storage module；The much information acquisition method that the present invention is compared using heat source, higher-frequency radar, infrared ray and picture, the vehicle at that time that emergency event occurs and party's information are transferred to system, system is by quickly comparing and judging to carry out safety emergency management to it, and entire treatment process and information record are given a clue and foundation as a complete information chain for transferring for later period, the townie safe emergency capability of raising and capability of fast response.
assignees: HEFEI HAINUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-element dynamic cooperative disposal system for urban disasters
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-element dynamic cooperative disposal system for urban disasters, which comprises: the dynamic cooperative subsystem generates a multi-park/cross-department emergency disposal scheme by utilizing a derivative/secondary emergency coupling method; the comprehensive command subsystem is used for carrying out cooperative command and conflict resolution on each functional department, summarizing disaster information, carrying out analysis and reasoning, and issuing and distributing a plurality of tasks; the emergency material management and dispatching subsystem optimizes the multiple emergency material allocation and carries out multi-target dispatching management on the emergency materials; the emergency management decision knowledge base is constructed by utilizing a cross-domain knowledge map, a knowledge conflict and redundancy detection mechanism and a crowd-sourcing reasoning decision method. According to the invention, through the urban disaster multi-element dynamic cooperative disposal system, the urban disaster treatment emergency treatment efficiency and the timeliness of material scheduling are obviously improved.

title_en: Intelligent monitoring and management system for power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent power grid monitoring and management system which comprises a power grid regulation and control cloud platform, a touch screen, an intelligent monitoring module, control equipment, a communication module and a terminal platform. This application mainly realizes the three aspects and changes, promotes basic level staff to subtract burden and the promotion is imitated to the operation quality: firstly, complicated daily work such as log recording on duty, abnormal notification, report statistics and the like is completed, machine intelligent substitution is completed, based on an intelligent office flow awakening technology, a defect and abnormal management flow is automatically started, and full-flow intelligent management and control of monitoring services are realized; secondly, intelligently generating an accident message after the power grid fault trips, and automatically notifying and reporting relevant units and individuals, so that the accident information, the power grid mode and the emergency response state are shared in real time; and thirdly, collecting real-time operation data of the power grid, learning the data and identifying the operation mode by adopting a big data analysis tool, intelligently adjusting the distribution of active power and reactive power of the power grid, ensuring the lowest loss of the regional power grid, and realizing the safe and economic operation target of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;LONGYAN POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Villages and small towns building protection cooling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a village and town building protection cooling system, which sends out an overheating alarm through a field alarm, determines the specific position of overheating through an on-duty person, and further informs the on-duty person of confirming whether the overheating information of a building material is misinformed or not to relevant on-site personnel, and informs a fire control room to plan as follows if a fire disaster is confirmed to be about to occur: dialing 119 alarm to inform relevant responsible person to organize dispatchable personnel for saving, and the alarm bell is turned on automatically to guide personnel evacuation. And then monitoring the running condition of the fire-fighting equipment, adjusting the working state of the equipment in real time according to the development condition of the fire, receiving a feedback signal, recovering the normal work of each system after the fire is treated, and recording the overheating time, the position, the cause and the like of the building material. And if the false alarm is confirmed, recovering the normal working state and recording false alarm information. The invention forms a complete closed loop in the actual operation process, and any link has corresponding solving measures when a problem occurs.
assignees: CHINESE BUILDING SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE LIMITED COMPANY;BUILDING RESEARCH FIRE PREVENTION SCIENCE AND TECH LIMITED COMPANY

title_en: Emergency command management system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to emergency command management, in particular to an emergency command management system based on the Internet of things, which comprises a server and a distributed image acquisition module connected with the server, wherein the server constructs a flame detection model for detecting whether a flame target exists in an image acquired by the image acquisition module through a flame detection model construction module, the server records a detection target obtained by the flame detection model through a detection target recording module, and performs primary authenticity judgment on the recorded detection target by using a first detection target judgment module; the technical scheme provided by the invention can effectively overcome the defects that the fire disaster identification can not be rapidly and accurately carried out and the optimal escape path can not be provided for the escape crowd.

title_en: Modularized operation site safety monitoring management system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a modularized operation site safety monitoring management system, which is characterized in that a modularized design is adopted on the basis of the original utility model 2024204530612, and corresponding task module components are configured according to different task requirements, wherein the modularized operation site safety monitoring management system comprises an operation site safety monitoring operation platform, a WLAN local area network data storage communication module, a dangerous state monitoring and positioning audible and visual alarm module, an operation personnel communication alarm module, an unmanned aerial vehicle detection module, an operation site access control and electronic fence warning module and other facilities. The system is matched with an operation area and other area setting systems, receives real-time data and field videos sent by an operation field, automatically alarms when exceeding a set threshold value, monitors field conditions and operation processes, improves the safety, accuracy and timeliness of field monitoring, overcomes the defect of purely relying on manpower monitoring and supervision, and is efficient and reliable. The system can also be applied to on-site patrol, command and monitoring of key areas, large-scale mass activities, disaster relief and the like.
assignees: WEIFANG CHENGHENG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ocean emergency scheduling method, system, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine communication, in particular to a marine emergency dispatching method, a marine emergency dispatching system, a computer device and a storage medium, which comprise the following steps: based on marine environmental monitoring data, signal strength and delay data are extracted from the communication node's history record, generating an environmental and performance basis data set. According to the invention, through integrating the analysis of the environment and performance basic data set and the real-time communication network state, the response speed and efficiency of the marine emergency communication are improved, the delay, the packet loss rate and the bandwidth requirement of each node in the communication network are quantitatively evaluated, the weight analysis of marine environment factors is combined, the optimal communication path can be determined, the resource allocation is optimized, the emergency response time is reduced, the future communication state change can be predicted through the time sequence analysis of the communication quality, the key risk point is identified, and the communication strategy can be adjusted in advance according to the prediction information, so that the potential communication faults are avoided.
assignees: NAT MARINE DATA AND INFORMATION SERVICE

title_en: Water source monitoring system based on intelligent matching and inspection management
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water source monitoring systems, in particular to a water source monitoring system based on intelligent matching and inspection management, which comprises a user side module, a cloud platform module, an intelligent matching module, a data analysis module, a water source use report and early warning information, wherein the cloud platform module is in wireless connection with the user side module, performs intelligent matching and dispatching assignment based on user data and water source information, the intelligent matching module is in data connection with the cloud platform module, encodes the water source position based on a topology coherent group theory, quantizes the water source state by using Bes sel functions, builds an intelligent matching scoring model by using the Litstrepan and Litstrepan theory, performs optimal matching selection by using a Toeplitz matrix, and the inspection management module generates and distributes inspection tasks, records and analyzes inspection results, updates the water source state information in real time, and the data analysis module is in data connection with the cloud platform module and the inspection management module, generates the water source use report and early warning information, and can rapidly and accurately perform water source matching.

title_en: Wisdom building platform fire alarm monitoring system
abstract_en: The application discloses a fire alarm monitoring system of an intelligent building platform, and belongs to the technical field of building fire safety. The system comprises a composite sensing network module, a central intelligent processing unit, a high-efficiency communication module, a communication monitoring module, a multi-element early warning module and a remote monitoring and management terminal, wherein the composite sensing network module is used for detecting smoke concentration, temperature, electrical parameters and combustible gas concentration and achieving the effect of timely finding fire, the central intelligent processing unit is used for analyzing and processing data of various sensors to judge fire occurrence probability and danger level, the high-efficiency communication module is used for achieving data and command interaction with other subsystems of a building platform, the communication monitoring module is used for monitoring communication states and guaranteeing stability and timeliness of data transmission, the multi-element early warning module is used for starting a multi-element early warning mechanism when fire risks rise, and the remote monitoring and management terminal is used for real-time checking of fire monitoring dynamic and equipment operation states by property departments and fire departments. The system can realize accurate, rapid and collaborative fire alarm monitoring and prevention and control.
assignees: YUNTU DATA TECH ZHENGZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Integrated bank slope monitoring method based on multi-parameter cooperative sensing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of river bank slope monitoring, in particular to an integrated bank slope monitoring method based on multi-parameter cooperative sensing, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing a multi-parameter cooperative sensing network, namely collecting bank slope displacement, pore water pressure, inclination angle, vibration frequency and environmental temperature and humidity data to form an original monitoring data set; the method comprises the steps of S2, data space-time alignment and abnormal value cleaning, S3, dynamic risk assessment model analysis, S4, multi-stage early warning and linkage control, wherein the multi-stage data space-time alignment and abnormal value cleaning comprises the steps of generating a fusion data matrix comprising space-time correlation characteristics by adopting a multi-mode data fusion algorithm, the S3 is used for combining a geomechanical parameter library and a historical catastrophe case library to output a risk level map, the S4 is used for triggering a multi-stage early warning mechanism and generating a linkage control instruction comprising treatment suggestions, and powerful support can be provided for accurately developing bank slope collapse monitoring, real-time risk assessment and high-effect emergency response of a large river bank slope disaster, and prediction accuracy, response speed and management efficiency of the large river bank slope disaster are remarkably improved.
assignees: CHANGJIANG RIVER SCIENT RES INST CHANGJIANG WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION

title_en: Electric bike operation method, computer program and system based upon unequipped battery
title_ko: 배터리 미장착 기반의 전기 자전거 작동 방법, 컴퓨터 프로그램 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for operating an electric bicycle based on an unequipped battery, a computer program for the same, and a system for the same. The system for the same includes a servo device, at least one electric connection sensing device installed in an electric bicycle, and at least one mobile electric power calculating device that a user can carry. The method for operating an electric bicycle includes: a step (a) of sensing formation of electric connection to the mobile electric power calculating device by the electric connection sensing device of the electric bicycle; a step (b) of uploading registration data on the electric connection sensing device and the mobile electric power calculating device to the servo device and authorizing the registration data; a step (c) of informing the mobile electric power calculating device to provide power for an application of the electric bicycle when the authentication passes; a step (d) of sensing at least one operation parameter of the electric bicycle by the electric connection sensing device; a step (e) of uploading the operation parameter to the servo device and the mobile electric power calculating device; and a step (f) of completing an operation task by using the operation parameter. The present invention includes a computer program product, and the computer program product includes a program code command. When the program code command is executed by the servo device, the method stated above can be executed. The purpose of the present invention is to reduce energy waste by preventing an idle state of a battery for a long period.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배터리 미장착 기반의 전기 자전거 작동 방법, 컴퓨터 프로그램 및 시스템에 관한 것으로, 상기 시스템은 서보 장치, 전기 자전거에 설치되는 적어도 하나의 전기적 연결 감지 장치 및 사용자가 휴대할 수 있는 적어도 하나의 모바일 전력 계산 장치를 포함하고, 이의 응용 단계는, (a). 전기 자전거의 전기적 연결 감지 장치가 모바일 전력 계산 장치와의 전기적 연결 형성을 감지하는 단계; (b). 상기 모바일 전력 계산 장치와 상기 전기적 연결 감지 장치의 등록 데이터를 서보 장치에 업로드하여 인증하는 단계; (c). 인증이 통과되면 상기 전기 자전거의 애플리케이션에 전원을 제공하도록 상기 모바일 전력 계산 장치에 알리는 단계; (d). 상기 전기적 연결 감지 장치에 의해 상기 전기 자전거의 적어도 하나의 작동 파라미터를 감지하는 단계; (e). 상기 작동 파라미터를 상기 서보 장치 및 모바일 전력 계산 장치에 업로드하는 단계; 및 (f). 상기 작동 파라미터를 이용하여 작동 태스크를 완료하는 단계;를 포함한다. 본 발명은 컴퓨터 프로그램 제품을 포함하고, 이는 프로그램 코드 명령을 포함하며, 상기 프로그램 코드 명령이 서보 장치에 의해 실행될 경우, 전술한 방법을 수행할 수 있다.

title_en: Attachable display pad module for rescuers, control method and recording medium for performing the same
title_ko: 구조대원을 위한 어태처블 디스플레이 패드 모듈, 제어 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an attachable display pad module for rescue workers. The attachable display pad module for rescue workers comprises: a communication unit for communicating with a server, a wearing device, and an ID tag; a stretchable display provided to be deformable in shape, and outputting dispatch information related to fire received from the server and rescue information for a rescue target person; a detachable unit provided in a part of the stretchable display; and a control unit for dividing an area of the stretchable display based on a field of view of the rescue workers when at least one of information received from the wearing device and the id tag satisfies a pre-prepared event condition, and controlling notification information for the rescue workers and warning information for others to be output to different areas among the divided areas. Accordingly, a rescue worker rescuing a rescue target person at a fire site can smoothly and quickly perform lifesaving and protect lives of the rescue worker.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구조대원을 위한 어태처블 디스플레이 패드 모듈에 관한 것으로, 서버, 착용 장치 및 아이디-태그(ID Tag)와 통신하는 통신부; 형상 변형이 가능하도록 마련되고, 상기 서버로부터 수신되는 화재와 관련된 출동 정보 및 상기 구조대상자에 대한 구조 정보가 출력되는 스트레처블 디스플레이(Stretchable display); 스트레처블 디스플레이의 일부에 구비되는 탈부착부; 및 상기 착용 장치 및 아이디-태그로부터 수신되는 정보 중 적어도 하나가 사전에 마련되는 이벤트 조건을 만족하면, 상기 구조대원의 시야를 기준으로 상기 스트레처블 디스플레이의 영역을 분할하고, 상기 구조대원을 위한 알림 정보 및 타인을 위한 경고 정보가 분할된 영역 중 서로 다른 영역에 출력되도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이에 의해 화재 현장에서 구조대상자를 구조하는 구조대원이 인명구조를 원활하고 신속하게 수행할 수 있도록 하는 것은 물론, 구조대원의 인명을 보호할 수 있다.

title_en: A device and system for sending emergency alerts on roads using CCTV, sound and VMS
title_ko: Cctv, 음향 및 전광판을 활용한 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a system for transmitting a road unexpected situation alarm, capable of suppressing a secondary accident caused by a following vehicle by detecting an unexpected situation on a road by using a cctv, a sound, and an electric sign installed on the road. According to the present invention, the apparatus for transmitting an emergency signal of an emergency signal of a road comprises: an image acquisition unit; an emergency signal detection unit; and an emergency signal output unit. The cctv image recording from cctv installed at the image acquisition part is on the road is gotten. The outbreak situation sensor senses the outbreak situation whether or not to the outbreak situation sensing model about the cctv image gotten. The alarm signal output unit outputs an alarm signal when an unexpected situation is detected. At this time, the unexpected situation detection model is modeled by machine learning the cctv image, but machine learning is performed by dividing the time, season, and weather at the time of capturing the cctv image into variables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 위에 설치되는 CCTV, 음향 및 전광판을 활용하여 도로 위 돌발상황을 감지하여 후속차량에 의한 2차 사고를 억제할 수 있는 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치는 영상 획득부, 돌발상황 감지부 및 경보 신호 출력부를 포함한다. 영상 획득부는 도로 상에 설치된 CCTV로부터 촬영된 CCTV 영상을 획득한다. 돌발상황 감지부는 획득한 CCTV 영상에 대한 돌발상황 감지 모델로 돌발상황 여부를 감지한다. 그리고 경보 신호 출력부는 돌발상황이 감지되면 경보 신호를 출력한다. 이때 돌발상황 감지 모델은 CCTV 영상을 기계학습 하여 모델링 하되, CCTV 영상을 촬영하는 시점의 시간, 계절 및 기상을 변수로 구분하여 기계학습 한다.

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digital video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event, and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted server to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time, the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: Rotary phased array radar wind disturbance compensation search task scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for dispatching a search task of wind disturbance compensation of a rotary phased array radar, which comprises the steps of detecting and recording the on-site wind disturbance level by comparing the difference between a wave position code and a wave control code of the same time stamp, counting the correlation between the wind disturbance level and the number of the leaked wave positions for a period of time, determining the size of a search task dispatching window to be compensated according to the result, reserving the search task wind disturbance compensation dispatching window matched with the current wind disturbance level in a task dispatching period, calculating the azimuth wave control code to be compensated according to the antenna error data of the previous dispatching period, inserting a scanning wave beam to be compensated in the search task wind disturbance compensation dispatching window of the current dispatching period, and improving the problem of the reduction of the detection capability of the rotary phased array radar caused by wind disturbance.

title_en: Parking lot emergency early warning method and system based on multipoint edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a parking lot emergency early warning method and system based on multipoint edge calculation, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting multi-mode environment data and video streams in different areas of a parking lot, obtaining collected data, then carrying out time synchronization and dynamic threshold filtering on the collected data, obtaining preprocessed data, and then carrying out space-time feature alignment and noise filtering on the preprocessed data, and obtaining a three-dimensional environment situation map; the invention realizes the functions of monitoring, analyzing, early warning and responding to fire, gas leakage and equipment fault emergency in the parking lot in real time, can obviously improve the safety of the parking lot and optimize the emergency response strategy through distributed data processing and collaborative analysis, can reduce the false alarm rate of the emergency through multi-mode data fusion and dynamic threshold collaborative analysis, shortens the average response time, obviously improves the early warning precision and timeliness, and is suitable for being widely popularized and used.

title_en: Remote robot coding education system
title_ko: 원격 로봇 코딩 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-facing remote robot coding education system that allows students taking non-facing online classes at each home to write a control command (program) for controlling a robot located in a space apart from a classroom or auditorium, transmit the control command through a teacher terminal located in the same space as the robot, and remotely control the robot.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각 가정에서 비대면 온라인 수업을 받는 학생들이 교실이나 강당 등의 이격된 공간에 위치한 로봇을 제어하는 제어명령(프로그램)을 작성하고, 제어명령을 로봇과 동일 공간에 위치한 교사 단말을 통해 전송하여 원격으로 로봇을 콘트롤하는 비대면 원격 로봇 코딩 교육 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System for managing industrial site safety based on artificial intelligence image analysis
title_ko: 인공지능 영상분석 기반의 산업현장 안전 관리 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인공지능 영상분석 기반의 산업현장 안전 관리 시스템에 관한 것으로, 해결하고자 하는 과제는 산업현장을 촬영한 영상 내 객체와 이벤트에 대한 정보가 레이블링 된 학습 데이터를 기반으로 미리 학습된 딥러닝 모델을 이용하여 작업 현장을 촬영한 영상(예: 동영상, 이미지)를 분석함으로써, 작업자들이 안전기준을 준수하는지 여부에 따라 화재와 같은 사고 발생 여부를 판별하는데 있다. 
일례로, 산업현장에 설치되어 산업현장을 촬영한 영상데이터를 실시간 송출하는 네트워크 카메라부; 상기 네트워크 카메라부로부터 상기 영상데이터를 수신하고, 딥러닝 모델을 이용하여 수신된 상기 영상데이터로부터 미리 정의된 객체 탐지 및 이벤트 검출을 수행하고, 탐지 및 검출 결과와 해당 영상데이터를 포함하는 데이터 패킷을 실시간 송출하는 엣지 컴퓨팅 장치부; 및 상기 엣지 컴퓨팅 실행부로부터 수신된 데이터 패킷에 대한 영상과 객체 탐지 및 이벤트 검출 결과를 모니터링하고 기록하는 통합 관제 서버부를 포함하는 인공지능 영상분석 기반의 산업현장 안전 관리 시스템을 개시한다.

title_en: Earthquake monitoring system for nuclear power plant emergency command center
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake monitoring system for a nuclear power plant emergency command center, which comprises an acceleration sensor, a displacement sensor, an acceleration recorder, a displacement recorder, a center processing unit, an alarm unit and a data display unit. The acceleration sensor and the displacement sensor are arranged at related measuring points of the emergency command center and are used for monitoring structural response of the measuring points under the action of an earthquake; the acceleration recorder and the displacement recorder are respectively connected with the acceleration sensor and the displacement sensor and are used for receiving monitoring signals of the corresponding sensors and recording results; the center processing unit is respectively connected with the acceleration recorder and the displacement recorder; the alarm unit and the data display unit are respectively connected with the data processing unit. The earthquake monitoring system for the nuclear power plant emergency command center, which is disclosed by the invention, can monitor the structural response of the emergency command center under the action of the earthquake so as to take effects of perfecting earthquake monitoring alarm of an integral nuclear power plant and evaluating a seismic isolation effect of the emergency command center.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER ENG CO LTD;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER

title_en: Collaborative filtering-based adaptive pushing method for command elements
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of personalized recommendation, in particular to a command element self-adaptive pushing method based on collaborative filtering, which comprises the first step of constructing an anti-terrorism resource pool and storing and recording comprehensive real-time updating data of anti-terrorism actions; secondly, constructing pre-collaborative filtering based on the fighting type-command element and sending a calculation result to a commander; and thirdly, constructing two-stage collaborative filtering based on commander-command elements and sending the calculated structure to the commander. The method filters command element data which are possibly required by the anti-terrorist battle tasks of different types, so that a commander can conveniently search related information according to the loaded battle tasks, the problem that the commander faces a large amount of data and has no need to take the next place is solved, and the anti-terrorist data push efficiency is improved; the method has the advantages that the most needed data are respectively pushed according to the roles of the commanders in the anti-terrorism battle, so that the difference of the commanders in different levels on the data requirements in the same anti-terrorism battle is solved, and the accuracy of pushing the anti-terrorism data is improved.

title_en: Distribution network failure training evaluation method based on Fault Isolation Information Matrix
