title_en: A kind of intelligent transportation automobile emergency warning device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of intelligent transportation automobile emergency warning devices, when intelligent transportation automobile crashes or emergency car door can not open, recording apparatus of the invention can record a video to interior situation, and video information can be transmitted to Intelligent transportation management command centre, and the light-emitting alarm and alarm bell alert by wireless transport module；In alarm, the recording apparatus can the elevating movement under the driving of the flexible driving assembly, and the recording apparatus and light-emitting alarm can be rotated around the flexible axis of flexible driving assembly.By the setting of the first anticollision device, collision-prevention device, the second anticollision device, collision-prevention device and elastic sack body, when emergency occurs for automobile, alarm ontology can be protected, further ensure the service life of alarm ontology, and structure is simple, just with popularization.

title_en: Individual soldier companion calling method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of individual soldier companion calling methods, comprising the following steps: receives the track data that multiple terminals issue, and records the relative position between the track data and the multiple terminal of display；Receive the distress call that the first terminal in the multiple terminal issues；Other terminals into the multiple terminal send the track data of rescue signal and the first terminal, and the track data of the track data of itself and first terminal is compared to the position of confirmation first terminal by other described terminals.The present invention also provides a kind of individual soldier companion call device, electronic equipment and storage mediums.The present invention can provide commander when rescuer rescues companion in danger, avoid rescuer from blindly suing and labouring, result in greater loss instead.
assignees: SHENZHEN RONGSHENG INTELLIGENT EQUIPMENT CO LTD;GUANGDONG GLOBEEZ FIRE FIGHTING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency payment starting method and device, computing equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of communication, and discloses an emergency payment starting method, an emergency payment starting device, computing equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting the amount of the user payment worksheet in the payment interface worksheet table; when the user payment work order quantity reaches a threshold value, extracting user payment work orders in batches, and controlling emergency starting of users related to the extracted user payment work orders; continuously detecting the user payment work order quantity in the payment interface work order table, and suspending a payment emergency process when the user payment work order quantity is lower than the threshold value; and inquiring the balance after payment and cancellation for the user who is started in emergency, and performing compensation shutdown on the user when the balance is less than 0. Through the mode, the embodiment of the invention can automatically start and stop according to the accumulated volume of the payment worksheet, can greatly improve the timeliness of emergency response, and can expand the applicability of payment channels.
assignees: CHINA MOBILE GROUP ANHUI CO;CHINA MOBILE COMMUNICATIONS GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic GIS geographic information monitoring system for emergency command
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic monitoring GIS geographic information system for emergency command, the main functions of a reception (police) management module include: the system has the functions of timely receiving a case (police), primarily analyzing and judging the case (police), rapidly responding to the case (police) modes such as manual, telephone, road network detection and analysis and the like, storing and recording the case (police) information, and mainly comprises the following functions: the system has the functions of managing emergency plans, managing an administrative organization, managing emergency vehicles, managing emergency materials, managing personnel teams, managing typical cases and the like, and the platform can carry out emergency dispatch on fire and police by utilizing a GPS positioning technology in the aspect of positioning, improves the response efficiency of emergency handling departments on emergency events such as fire, crime scene, traffic accidents, traffic jams and the like, tracks, dispatches and manages the vehicles by utilizing the GPS technology, and reasonably distributes the vehicles.
assignees: SHENZHEN TIANYU WORLD TECH CO LTD

title_en: Expressway bridge deck emergency event handling system and evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and an evaluation method for handling expressway bridge deck emergency events, and relates to the field of highway emergency rescue. The problems of low efficiency, short accurate estimated time, short evaluation system, untimely information transmission and non-traceable operation process of the manual scheduling in the prior art are solved. The system comprises: an event detection system; an intelligent control platform of the internet of things; an emergency command system. The method comprises the steps of detecting an emergency event, issuing a task and delineating a proper electronic fence; calculating estimated in-place time Ta2, and grading in-place efficiency; the estimated treatment time Tb2 is calculated, and the treatment efficiency is scored. The invention has the advantages of improving treatment efficiency, accurately evaluating rescue capability, improving scientificity of treatment decisions, enhancing command and coordination capability, and effectively recording history and backtracking functions.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SUPCON INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Distribution line fault feature association method based on information fusion
abstract_en: The application provides a distribution line fault feature association method based on information fusion, which comprises the steps of obtaining wave recording data of a distribution line; extracting mutation information in the wave recording data by a wavelet technology; performing reduction on the mutation quantity information; and inputting the protocol information into a fuzzy Petri network for fault diagnosis. The method has the advantages of high reliability and good fault tolerance, contains time sequence information, provides accurate protection and breaker information for the optimized fault diagnosis model of the main station when the power grid has complex faults, is greatly beneficial to improving the overall diagnosis precision, occupies few bandwidth and other resources, accurately judges the fault position and the fault property, judges the action behavior of line protection, provides a manual fault analysis report for emergency dispatching, and assists a dispatcher to rapidly complete fault processing and avoid occurrence of line cascading faults.
assignees: PUER POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: High-adaptability damage assessment method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a high-adaptability damage assessment method, and relates to the field of computer vision and disaster emergency response. Firstly, inputting a damaged area data set into a segmentation network and a damage classification network for training to obtain a segmentation network model and a damage classification model, manufacturing a data set T of the area before and after new damage, and inputting the data set T into a two-stage refined damage evaluation neural network to obtain a building segmentation result and a damage classification result. The method has strong adaptability to the new event area, so that the damage classification can be refined quickly and efficiently, the calculation capability and the quick decision capability of the deep neural network are utilized to replace the on-site manual evaluation, the time and energy consumption is greatly reduced, and the damage degree of the building in the disaster area in a large range is judged efficiently under the condition of ensuring the accuracy and timeliness.

title_en: Public health emergency command method, system, terminal and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of public health informatization, in particular to a public health emergency command method, a system, a terminal and a storage medium, which comprise the steps of inputting various public health emergency information and grading the public health emergency according to severity; the method comprises the steps of carrying out research, judgment and analysis on public health emergency information, matching an emergency plan, displaying the occurrence place of the public health emergency, the number of rescue materials and the rescue route of a rescue team on a GIS map in real time, recording the site information of the public health emergency in a video, voice, picture and text mode by rescue staff in the rescue team, updating the accurate positioning of the occurrence place of the public health emergency in the GIS map, and marking the information of casualties, personnel trapping and rescue equipment on the GIS map according to the site information of the public health emergency. The invention centralizes information and has strong sharing property.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR SMART MEDICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Highway construction safety risk management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk analysis, in particular to a highway construction safety risk management system which comprises a data acquisition and time synchronization module, a worker position information acquisition module, a real-time data stream generation module and a classification and standardization module, wherein the data acquisition and time synchronization module acquires worker position information, sequences the data according to time stamps to generate the real-time data stream, and classifies and standardizes the real-time data stream to generate a classified data stream. In the invention, the identification of the risk event is quicker and more accurate through the classification and analysis of the real-time data flow, the prediction and the intervention before the accident occur are allowed, and the potential property loss and the personnel injury are reduced. The priority of the event and the risk level determined by the site situation are combined, so that the scientificity of reasonable resource allocation and priority ordering is ensured, and the emergency response is more targeted and effective. The comparison of the risk level and the safety standard enhances the strictness of risk control, optimizes the operation and cost efficiency, and improves the adaptability and the foresight.
assignees: ZHEJIANG SHUZHI JIAOYUAN TECH CO LTD;MUNICIPAL ENG COMPANY OF CHINA RAILWAY TUNNEL GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Algorithm model operation monitoring method and system for power industry
abstract_en: The invention provides an algorithm model operation monitoring method and system for the power industry, and relates to the field of model monitoring. The method comprises the steps of collecting physical quantity data of power equipment through a dynamic causal chain construction module, generating a causal chain after noise suppression and preprocessing, binding with algorithm model parameters, recording mutation events and associated parameter update logs, utilizing a four-dimensional space-time lock synchronization module to attach geographic coordinates and time stamps to ensure data space-time consistency, constructing an optimization strategy by a multi-target game strategy engine module based on historical misinformation events and resource consumption records and combining SLA time constraint of a real-time detection task, triggering emergency response by a DEED-Trigger anti-intuitionism triggering module according to deviation between real-time data and the optimization strategy, injecting compound fault test causal chain robustness by a digital twin technology through a verification platform, and dynamically adjusting causal chain structure and strategy.
assignees: CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus, system, and methods for computer aided dispatch incident record creation and updating within emergency service networks
abstract_en: A disclosed method of operating a cloud-based emergency data management system implements: receiving supplemental emergency data from a mobile device that placed an emergency call to an emergency communication center (ECC); obtaining ECC emergency data related to the emergency call by a connectivity device located at the ECC and operatively coupled to a functional entity of the ECC; determining a class of service for the emergency call based on the ECC emergency data; formatting the supplemental emergency data using the class of service; and sending the supplemental emergency data, formatted using the class of service, to an ECC computer-aided-dispatch (CAD) system to update a CAD incident record corresponding to the emergency call.

title_en: Method of electronic voting, decoder for implementing this method, and network comprising a voting server for implementing the method
abstract_en:
Method of electronic voting in a questionnaire, comprising:
         a step of broadcasting an offer of electronic voting service to a plurality of communications terminals;   a step of sending, from a voter's communication terminal, a request to a remote server, this request containing information for authenticating a voter;   a step of authenticating the voter by comparing the authentication information received with recorded information associated with the voter;   when the voter has been authenticated, a step of dispatching to the communication terminal of the voter ticket to participate in the vote;   a step of dispatching the vote to the server, the former containing a response to the questionnaire and the ticket to participate in the vote,
 
this method is characterized in that it comprises two steps of anonymization, a first step ensuring anonymization to the ticket to participate sent to the voter by the server, and a second step ensuring anonymization of the communication terminal sending the response to the vote to the server, the participation ticket containing at least one piece of data associated with the voter's profile.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
Military combat communication link selection mechanism measurement method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a military combat communication link selection mechanism measurement method, which comprises the following steps: calculating the probability of successful information reception by the volatilization center in the direct link; step 2: calculating the probability of successful information receiving of the relay unmanned aerial vehicle and the command center in the relay link; step 3: calculating average information ages AoI of the direct link and the relay link respectively; step 4: and estimating and comparing the instant message ages of the direct link and the relay link at the current moment, and further selecting a link with smaller instant message age for communication. The invention provides a technical scheme for reasonably selecting a communication link in military operations, designs a corresponding information transmission timeliness measuring method, quantitatively characterizes the timeliness of the link, realizes the full and flexible utilization of network facilities, ensures the timeliness of end-to-end information transmission, and timely and effectively completes the information transmission.

title_en: Simulation methods for evacuation in a Massive Disaster
title_ko: 대규모 재난대피 시뮬레이션 제공방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a large-scale disaster evacuation simulation. The method for providing a large-scale disaster evacuation simulation, according to the present invention, comprises the processes of: creating a basic scenario; simulating disaster spread results for the basic scenario; simulating a transportation network for the basic scenario; carry out a simulation in which the disaster spread results and the transportation network simulation are combined; and searching for aid stations within a danger range and connecting the transportation network to the aid stations. Therefore, a systematic evacuation plan can be established based on quantitative analysis results.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난유형별 피해특성을 반영하고 대규모 재난대피 상황을 모사하여 시각적 검토와 연산을 통한 정량적 분석을 수행할 수 있도록 하는 시뮬레이션 제공방법에 관한 것으로, 
대피 계획 수립 및 점검을 지원할 수 있는 시스템을 개발하여 방사능재난, 화학사고, 풍수해, 지진 등 다양한 재난유형의 피해예측 정보를 기반으로 대규모의 도시 단위 복합재난상황 대응이 가능한 체계를 마련할 수 있도록 하는 대규모 재난대피 시뮬레이션 제공방법에 관한 것이다. 
즉, 행정구역에 대한 지도, 도로, 환승시설, 구호소, 인구 등의 재난관련 정적정보와, 기상상태, 교통상황 등의 재난관련 동적정보가 시뮬레이션 모델 통합 데이터베이스로 유입되면, 데이터베이스 수집연계시스템에 의해 아카이빙된 DB/Metadata는 File 및 Meta 데이터로 매쉬업(Mash-up)되어 저장되고, 이와 같이 수집등록 체계에 따라 메타데이터 추출 및 정규화된 데이터들은 컴퓨터로 보내져서 재난대피 시나리오에 의한 시뮬레이션 프로그램이 실행됨에 따라 매크로 기반의 시뮬레이션 분석이 이루어지고, 시뮬레이션 분석의 결과물은 타 시나리오와의 대비를 위해 평가결과 데이터베이스에 저장되는 한편, 모니터를 통해 GIS 표출되어 디스플레이되도록 구성된 대규모 재난대피 시뮬레이션 제공방법에 있어서, 
컴퓨터에 내장된 시뮬레이션 프로그램에서는, 상기 시뮬레이션 모델 통합 데이터베이스 모델로 부터 유입된 재난정보들에 의해 재난유형이 설정되어 기본 시나리오가 만들어지는 과정과, 
기본 시나리오에 대한 재난 확산결과가 시뮬레이션되는 과정과, 
기본 시나리오에 대한 교통 네트워크를 시뮬레이션되는 과정과, 
상기  재난 확산결과와 교통 네트워크 시뮬레이션이 결합된 상태로 시뮬레이션되는 과정과, 
위험범위 내의 구호소를 검색하고 위험범위 내 인구에 대해 교통 네트워크를 상기 구호소로 연결하는 과정으로 진행되고, 
상기 모니터에서는 시뮬레이션 분석의 결과물이 GIS 표출되어 디스플레이되는데, 상기 재난 확산결과에 대해서는 거시적 모델(Macroscopic Model)로 표시되고 교통 네트워크에 대해서는 미시적 모델(Microscopic Model)로 표시되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Server based disaster recovery by making use of dual write responses
abstract_en: A mechanism is provided in a data processing system for asynchronous replication. The mechanism creates a record in a write log in a host computing device for a write command and marking the record as uncommitted. The mechanism maintains a copy of data to be written by the write command at the host computing device. The mechanism issues the write command from the host computing device to a primary storage controller at the primary storage site. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been written to the primary storage site, the mechanism marks the record as unreplicated. Responsive to receiving an acknowledgement from the primary storage controller that the data have been replicated to a secondary storage site, the mechanism erases the record in the write log and deleting the copy of data.

title_en: Cargo vessel operator emergency response system, with operator directives, incident data recording and reporting, and automated relevant party notification
abstract_en: A method, computer program product, mobile communication device, and a shipment tracking system provide automated incident recording, reporting, and response protocols, including operator directives. The method includes receiving an input identifying an occurrence of an incident associated with a shipment entity, the shipment entity being one or more of a vessel, an operator, and a cargo being transported via the vessel. The method includes, in response to the input, presenting on a user interface (UI) of an operator mobile communication device (MCD) one or more selectable incident reporting options to activate incident response, data recording, and reporting (IRDRR) protocols. The method further includes generating and presenting an incident response UI that instructs the operator of specific sequence of steps to take in response to the incident and to complete an incident information gathering process. The method further includes automatically transmitting/uploading a notification of the incident to an incident management server.

title_en: “car - screen” for prevention of secondary traffic accident
title_ko: 2차 교통사고예방 “카 - 스크린”
abstract_ko:
(1) 해결하려는 과제 
매년 자동차 교통사고는 급증하고 있으며 이에 따라 2차 교통사고도 비례증가하여 인적, 물적피해가 가중되는 현실임. 
이에 2차 교통사고 예방을 위하여 다양한 안전삼각대, 불꽃장치 등이 개발되어 사용되고 있지만 아직도 효과적인 사용에는 미치지 못함에 따라 본 고안품인 " 카 - 스크린 " 으로 2차 교통사고를 효과적으로 예방하고자 함 
(2) 과제의 해결 수단 
1차 교통사고 발생시 사고차량의 후면 유리창에 " 카 - 스크린 " 고안품을 부착, 사고차량 후면에서 달려오는 차량들이 사고발생 사실을 즉시 인지토록 하여 안전운전을 유도후 2차 교통사고를 예방함 
*** 1차 교통사고 발생시 " 카 - 스크린 " 사용방법 *** 
1. 1차 교통사고 발생 즉시 사고차량 내부에 보관중인 " 카 - 스크린" 을 꺼내어 즉시 사고차량 후면 유리창으로 가져간다. 
2. " 카 - 스크린 " 상단에 부착된 흡착판 2개를 사고차량 후면 유리창 상단에 부착한다. 
3. 운전자 및 동승자는 갓길 대피후 112, 119 에 사고발생 신고한다. 
4. 후면에서 달려오는 차량들은 사고차량에 부착된 " 카 - 스크린 " 을 인지하고 방어운전 및 안전운전으로 사고차량 주변을 안전하게 통과한다. 
(3) 효 과 
1. 기존의 사고예방 삼각대는 규격이 30 Cm 이내의 소형제품으로서 후방 차량이 전방 사고발생을 인지하기엔 불충분하여 설치효과가 미흡하지만 본 고안품 " 카 - 스크린 " 은 가로 1 m , 세로 1.5 m 의 대형제품으로 사고차량에 부착시 후방 50 ~ 100 m 거리에서도 충분히 사고발생 인지가 가능하여 2차 교통사고 예방 및 인명, 재산상 손실 최소화함 
2. 기존의 타 제품은 차량의 특정부분에만 부착하여 사용하지만 본 고안품 " 카 - 스크린 " 은 흡착판을 도입하여 차량의 유리부분, 금속부분 전체에 부착가능하며 또한 차량의 전, 후, 좌, 우 모든 부분 부착가능 
3. " 카 - 스크린 " 고안품은 전체가 형광옐로그린색으로 주간, 야간 효과 극대화 
4. 초등학생도 5초 이내 설치 가능할 정도로 간단하면서 효과는 극대화함 
*** 본 고안품 제출자는 부산송도우체국장 공무원으로서 2차 교통사고예방을 위하여 실용신안을 신청하였으며 나아가 교통사고 발생시 국민안전을 최우선적으로 실현하기 위하여 고안품을 준비하였음 
" 카 - 스크린 " 하나가 한 가족을 구한다는 일념으로 실용신안 신청

title_en: Comprehensive law enforcement coordination command management process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive law enforcement coordination command management process, which comprises the following steps: step S1: personnel management is carried out, personnel information registration is carried out by filling in related forms, related information can be screened and modified for personnel, monthly attendance checking and card punching of registered personnel are checked, rest and typesetting time of the configured personnel is edited, rest time tables and shift schedule of each personnel in each month are recorded, and post work and post time of the configured personnel are carried out; when the system is used, the comprehensive command center receives cases to carry out addition, deletion, modification and check, assigns the cases to be assigned to the squad after checking details, allocates teammates to carry out checking processing according to actual conditions by the squad, and feeds back processed pictures to submit processing information; then the case flow is returned to the comprehensive command center for handling, printing and exporting; the comprehensive law enforcement coordination command management forms a closed loop through the operation mode of mutual circulation among departments, so that the management capacity and level of the comprehensive law enforcement departments are improved.
assignees: SUZHOU SAFESOFT INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Novel intelligent cloud platform and method for digital village
abstract_en: The application provides a novel intelligent cloud platform and method for a digital village, and relates to the field of village platforms. A novel intelligent cloud platform for a digital village comprises a village region management module, an accident recording module and an accident defending module; the rural area management module is used for managing the regional rights, the regional positions and the regional purposes of a plurality of rural areas; the accident event recording module is used for recording accident occurrence events, event occurrence persons, event occurrence places, event processing persons and event processing results of the plurality of rural areas; the accident recording module is connected with the rural area management module to acquire the area ownership, the area position and the area use of at least one rural area according to the occurrence place of the accident; the incident defense module is configured to analyze the solution based on event processing results of at least one incident. The method can uniformly manage the rural areas and improve the satisfaction degree of people on the rural areas.
assignees: HEBEI BRANCH OF CHINA TELECOM DIGITAL INTELLIGENCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Object information fusion method based on signaling XDR-MR-MDT data association
abstract_en: The invention discloses an object information fusion method based on signaling XDR-MR-MDT data association, which comprises the steps of respectively carrying out formatting analysis and structuring treatment on XDR signaling data and MR or MDT measurement data, converting the XDR signaling data and the MR or MDT measurement data into associable data records, then selecting a network access identifier as an association key, combining with a proximity relation of sampling time, matching the MR or MDT data with the XDR data, and realizing fusion labeling of high-precision position information and user identity information, wherein the association key is an MME triplet in a 4G network and an AMF quadruple in a 5G network, so that data fusion requirements under different wireless systems can be supported. The invention further utilizes the distributed computing framework to execute the object information fusion step, is suitable for carrier-level mass signaling and measurement data processing scenes, and can provide a data basis for accurate marketing, regional passenger flow analysis, emergency response management and business experience analysis.
assignees: SHANGHAI FIRE RESEARCH INST OF MEM

title_en: Broadcast data converter
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a broadcast data converter which, when a broadcasting with a flag to start the Emergency Warning System of TMCC information of a terrestrial digital broadcasting is received, quickly swiches a data broadcasting in consideration of a data switch timing for displaying appropriate information on a screen on the reception terminal side.  <P>SOLUTION: The broadcast data converter comprises: an emergency information detector for recognizing a flag for an emergency information broadcasting in a TMCC signal of the digital broadcasting sent from a head office station in a repeater station; a switch data creator for creating switch contents and for issuing a switch command when emergency information is multiplexed in a TS; and a time synchronizer for synchronizing the TS created by a switch processing with the TS before the switch. The switched data broadcasting can be received without interruption of image and voice as contents of a prefecture area broadcasting on the reception terminal side.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Safty system for unity arms management
title_ko: 병기 관리 통합 안전시스템
abstract_en: A system for integrally managing security of arms is provided to integrally manage the military and private arms by attaching an RFID tag to the arms, and monitoring movement of the arms with a monitoring vehicle and a portable terminal equipped with an RFID reader. An encrypted authentication code recorded in the RFID tag(101) is registered, changed, and deleted in an arms managing/monitoring system, and is recorded to an arms tag with being converted into an encoded algorithm when an approval code is converted. The approval code has the code discriminated according to use purpose of the arms(100) and is registered as the encoded code. The RFID reader(102) for detecting the RFID tag attached to the arms is connected to a cigar jack of the vehicle and transmits data to an arms managing/monitoring database system(103) of a central system through the mobile network by using the mobile terminal embedded in the vehicle. The mobile terminal detects the unapproved arms while being carried by a user.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사제 병기류 및 경찰시설, 군부대의 병기에 의무적으로 RFID용 Tag를 장착하여 인증되지 않은 병기류 판별 및 병기의 위치, 각 시설의 이탈에 대한 방지, 이탈된 병기의 추적을 통해 사제병기 관리 미흡으로 인한 사고, 기존 군부대에서 밀반출된 병기류에 의한 안전사고를 미연에 예방하기 위한 시스템 구축에 목적이 있다. 
      병기 사용에 대한 사용자식별 및 인증코드가 발부된 병기에 대한 판별과  병기가 각 관련 시설에서 이탈되는 경우 각 시설에 설치된 RFID Reader기를 통하여 총기 이탈에 대한 인식 경보음과 함께 통제실 센터의 모니터링 시스템을 통해 병기의 사용자와 병기의 종류, RFID Reader에 의한 병기류의 위치, 최종 시간을 통제실의 모니터링 시스템에서 확인 및 관리되며 또한 병기의 사용 Limited Time을 병기의 Tag에 등록하여 Limited Time이 지난 병기를 사용하게 될 경우 통제실 센터의 모니터링 시스템에 인식 경보와 해당 정보를 조회 할 수 있도록 한다.  
     소지가능한 사제 병기 및 특수 집단(경찰, 군부대)병기에 RFID Tag를 장착하고 RFID Tag에 암호화된 인증 번호 및 병기사용 Limited Time을 등록하며 특정지역에 설치된 RFID Reader기는 해당영역에 감지된 RFID Tag 정보를 유무선 통신망을 통하여 병기관리 DB에 자료를 송신하게 되며 병기관리 DB에서는 RFID Reader기를 통해  수신된 DATA를 병기코드와 매칭되는 제품명, 사용자정보, Limited Time, RFID Read Time, Location, 승인구분 DATA를 파싱하여 승인구분 및 RFID Read Time순으로 정렬하여 적재하게 된다.  
     Limited Time이 지난 사제 병기류 및 미 승인된 코드의 병기류를 사용할 경우 감시 차량에 장착된 RFID Reader기 및 병기류 감시용 휴대용 RFID Reader 단말기에서 감지가 되면 무선 네크워크를 통해 관할 경찰서 및 군부대에 감지된 RFID Tag 정보를 보내게된다.   
     병기관리 모니터 시스템에서는 수신된 DATA를 토대로 경찰청 상황실 및 인근지역의 군부대 상황실로 현 사항을 통보하여 미 승인된 병기로 인한 사고를 미연에 예방할 수 있도록 시스템이 구현된다.  
     군시설의 경우 미 승인된 병기류가 유출될 경우 각 시설에 설치된 RFID Reader기의 감지를 통해 병기류 관리 DB에 실시간으로 해당 병기류에 대한 정보를 송신하게 된다.  
     이후 병기관리 모니터 시스템에서는 실시간으로 병기관리 DB에 적재된 승인구분을 검색하여 미승인 코드의 경우 상황실에 경보를 울림과 동시에 미승인 병기류에 대한 정보를 모니터링 할 수 있게 하여 미 승인된 병기류로 인한 사고를 미연에 방지 할 수 있는 시스템을 구현한다. 
     모니터링 시스템에서는 병기관리 DB와 연동하여 미 승인된 코드에 대한 조회 및 사용자정보를 통해 상황실에 현 사항을 통보할 수 있으며  모든 병기류에 대한 현 상태 정보 조회 및 감시가 가능하다.  
     인증된 병기를 사용함으로서 병기의 현황 파악과 병기를 소지한 근무자의 근무시간 및 근무지 이탈, 인증되지 않은 불법 병기유입에 관한 안전사고를 미연에 방지 하는 시스템으로 응용이 가능하다. 
     병기관리 DB에 적재된 DATA를 근거로 불법 밀렵 지역의 감시와 미 승인된 병기로 인한 사고를 미연에 방지하는 시스템으로 응용이 가능하다 
       
     1. 인증코드 , 2. Tag, 3. RFID Reader, 4. Limited Time, 5. RFID Reader Time, 6. 병기류관리 DB 시스템, 7. 모니터링 시스템

title_en: Control system using mobile app for safety and security in construction field of nuclear power plant
title_ko: 모바일 앱을 이용한 원자력발전소 설비 공사 현장 안전 및 보안 관리용 시스템
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a system for safety and security management of a facility construction site of a nuclear power plant using a mobile application configured to efficiently manage and deliver security matters and safety-related matters required in a facility construction site situation of a nuclear power plant. The system for safety and security management of a facility construction site of a nuclear power plant using a mobile application comprises: a smartphone carried by a construction site worker and including a touch screen unit and various sensor members; a central control unit configured to communicate with the smartphone through a mobile communication network; and a manager terminal device for inputting data for managing the smartphone through the central control unit. According to the present invention, workers can smoothly share safety matters and intuitively and quickly check the safety matters, thereby effectively informing a worker even in a construction site where a smartphone operation is cumbersome.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 따른 모바일 앱을 이용한 원자력발전소 설비 공사 현장 안전 및 보안 관리용 시스템은 공사 현장 근로자가 휴대하며 터치스크린부와 각종 센서부재를 포함하여 구성되는 스마트폰과, 이동통신망을 통해 상기 스마트폰과 통신되도록 구성되는 중앙제어부와, 상기 중앙제어부를 통해 상기 스마트폰 관리용 데이터를 입력하기 위한 관리자단말장치를 포함하며, 상기 중앙제어부에는 관리용 프로그램이 저장되는 모바일 앱을 이용한 원자력발전소 설비 공사 현장 안전 및 보안 관리용 시스템으로서, 상기 관리자단말장치로부터 상기 중앙제어부를 통해 상기 스마트폰으로, 작업일의 온도와 습도와 강수량과 미세먼지 농도와 풍속 및 작업중단 시간을 포함하는 안전상황항목과, 작업장에 위치하는 근 로자들이 알아야할 내용을 포함하는 포함하는 공지사항항목과, 근로자가 이수해야할 교육과정과 안전교육계획과 상기 교육과정에 필요한 교육자료를 포함하는 안전교육항목과, 안전에 관련된 사항을 근로자들이 신고할 수 있도록 제공되는 자율안전신고항목과, 당일 시공작업 내용을 관리자에게 보고할 수 있도록 제공되는 당일작업상황보고항목과, 작업을 중지해야할 사항에 관한 정보를 포함하는 작업중지사항항목과, 공사 관련자들 간의 채팅을 위한 채팅항목과, 공사 관련 작업자들의 건의사항을 제안할 수 있도록 제공되는 건의사항항목을 전송하고,  상기 관리자단말장치로부터 상기 스마트폰으로 전송되는 항목들에는 보안등급이 부여되며, 상기 근로자에 대해서는 보안등급이 부여된 항목에 접근하여 정보를 열람할 수 있는 정보열람등급이 부여되며, 상기 항목들 중 지정된 보안등급의 항목에 대해서는 정보를 열람할 수 있는 시간이 설정되도록 구성되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에 의해, 원자력 발전소의 설비 공사 현장 상황에서 요구되는 보안 사항과 안전관련 사항을 효율적으로 관리하고 근로자들에게 전달할 수 있으며, 설비 공사 현장 상황 및 교육자료 등에 대한 보안을 효과적으로 유지하고, 이의 외부 반출을 방지할 수 있다. 
또한, 안전에 관한 사항을 근로자들이 원활히 공유하고, 직관적이면서도 신속히 확인할 수 있어, 스마트폰 조작이 번거로운 공사 현장 상황에서도 효과적으로 알릴 수 있고, 안전에 관한 사항을 근로자들이 확인하였는지 여부를 신뢰성 있게 확인할 수 있다. 
그리고, 공사 현장에서 발생되는 각종 문제에 대한 해결 방안 제안을 장려할 수 있고, 해결 방안에 대한 객관적인 평가가 이루어질 수 있으며, 공사 현장에서 사고가 발생되는 경우, 이에 대한 즉각적인 조치가 취해질 수 있다.

title_en: Real-time car accident management system and method
title_ko: 실시간 자동차 사고 관리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for managing a vehicle accident in real time, which detect accident information such as a cause and location of a vehicle accident in real time to transmit the accident information to a control system, and efficiently operate a counseling system for requesting a rescue agency or the control system to dispatch, comprises: a vehicle terminal installed in a vehicle to detect an abnormal signal of a customer and the vehicle and generate vehicle accident information; a control system configured to acquire the vehicle accident information from the vehicle terminal through a network and manage the vehicle accident information; and a consultation system configured to acquire the vehicle accident information from the vehicle terminal or the control system to provide a one-stop consultation system for the vehicle accident to a driver through customer information management and consultation history management. Accordingly, by providing the one-stop consultation system through the customer information management and the consultation history management, an accident record for post-processing can be systematically stored and managed.
abstract_ko: 자동차 사고에 의한 인명 피해가 최소화될 수 있도록 실시간으로 자동차 사고의 발생 원인, 발생 위치와 같은 사고 정보를 감지하여 관제 시스템에 전송하고, 구조 기관 또는 관제 시스템에 출동 요청을 할 수 있는 상담 체계를 효율적으로 운영하는 실시간 자동차 사고 관리 시스템 및 방법으로, 차량에 장착되어 고객 및 차량의 이상 신호를 감지하고, 차량 사고 정보를 생성하는 차량 단말기, 네트워크 통신망을 통해 상기 차량 단말기로부터 차량 사고 정보를 입수하여 관리하는 관제 시스템, 및 상기 차량 단말기 또는 관제 시스템으로부터 차량 사고 정보를 입수하여 고객 정보 관리와 상담 이력 관리를 통해 운전자에게 차량 사고의 원 스톱(one-stop) 상담 체계를 제공하기 위해 마련된 상담 시스템을 포함하는 것에 의해, 고객 정보 관리와 상담 이력 관리를 통해 원 스톱(one-stop) 상담 체계를 마련함으로써 사후처리를 위한 사고 기록을 체계적으로 저장 및 관리할 수 있다는 효과가 얻어진다.

title_en: Emergency Dispatch System for Multi-Family Housing: Location Verification of Emergency Reports and Entry/Exit Record Management
title_ko: 공동주택 긴급출동 시스템의 신고 위치 확인 및 출입 기록 관리 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 공동주택 등에서 긴급출동(112·119 등)을 요청할 때 신고자의 모바일 기기가 연결된 Wi-Fi 공유기 및 세대 내 IoT 단말기의 연결정보를 안전하게 수집·전송하여 신고자가 실제 세대 내에 있음을 증명하는 방법 및, 출동 대원이 공동 현관을 개문할 때 공동 현관에 부착된 패시브 NFC 태그를 모바일 기기로 태그하여 출입 기록 (태그ID·인식시각·GPS 등)를 자동으로 생성·전송하고 중앙서버에서 로그를 암호화·블록체인 해시로 기록하여 무결성을 보장하는 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 추가로, 공동 현관문에 블루투스 모듈 탑재 모바일 연동 출입 장치와 리모컨을 활용하여 개문 시 실시간 출입 기록 전송을 가능하게 한다. 나아가, 출동 대원 모바일 기기(100b)의 NFC 기능(앱)을 통해 공동 현관 출입 장치의 NFC 연동으로 개문 시 상기 모바일 기기(100b)에 설치된 앱을 통해 기기 내 저장 및 서버 전송을 가능하게 합니다. 본 발명은 허위 신고를 예방하고 출입기록의 투명성을 확보함으로써 긴급출동의 정확성과 신속성을 향상시킵니다. 나아가, 본 발명은 ISO 3166 글로벌 위치 표준 및 다국어 앱 인터페이스를 지원하여 국제적인 호환성을 확보하며, 신고 실패 시 재확인 안내, 최적 출동 경로 안내, 비정상 접근 패턴 경고, 자동 출동 리포트 생성 등의 기능을 포함하여 시스템의 전반적인 효율성 및 신뢰성을 향상시킵니다.

title_en: Medical Alert Device
abstract_en: A medical alert device for measuring vitals and communicating with emergency response personnel includes a band that is configured to couple around a wrist of a user. An electronics module, a vitals module and a button are coupled to the band. The electronics module is configured to wirelessly communicate and to store a medical record of the user. The button and the vitals module are operationally coupled to the electronics module. The button is configured to be depressed to send a panic signal to the electronics module. The vitals module configured to assess at least one vital sign of the user. The vitals module is positioned to relay the at least one vital sign to the electronics module. The electronics module is configured to selectively wirelessly communicate the panic signal, the least one vital sign and the medical record to the emergency response personnel.

title_en: Fireman location real-time sensing system and application method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the fire prevention emergency field, and provides a fireman location real-time sensing system and an application method thereof. The system generates a SQL fire prevention acceptance inspection information data table for each building according to the information generated by fire prevention acceptance inspection, wherein the data table records coordinates and details of the building and fire fighting devices. An individual terminal provided for a fireman downloads the fire prevention acceptance inspection information data table of an objective building from a fire prevention acceptance inspection information database of a fire command system terminal by a network or other ways, the downloaded data table is converted into fire fighting device plane graphs of each floor, when the fireman enters into the building in fire, the real-time location sensing system senses information of longitude, latitude and floor by means of GPS and RFID or other three-dimensional positioning ways, and a real-time location comparison system compares the location information to form location coordinates and information of fire fighting device, then, the information is provided for the processor for positioning and navigation, and an audio system and a two-dimensional display system both can be used for outputting navigation information.

title_en: Emergency response method and device for application
abstract_en: The application provides an emergency response method and device for application, and belongs to the technical field of emergency response. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring information of fault records of a target application; detecting whether the target terminal receives the indication information sent by the background server or not; under the condition that the target terminal receives the indication information and detects the operation aiming at the target functional module, displaying first prompt information on an initial page in a plurality of interaction pages of the target functional module; and under the condition that the target terminal does not receive the indication information, displaying second prompt information at the fault page. The emergency response speed is improved, and the user experience is improved.

title_en: Early warning method for forest fire based on laser radar and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire early warning method and system based on a laser radar and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The early warning method is used for acquiring laser radar scanning images by controlling the laser radar to periodically and fully cyclically scan and monitor the forest. And determining a smoke plume area in the laser radar scanning image as a suspected fire disaster area. And meanwhile, narrowing the scanning area of the laser radar according to the azimuth information of the suspected fire area, executing local scanning, planning a patrol path, dispatching the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along the patrol path, and collecting overlook patrol images in real time. And judging whether the fire sign features exist in the image by utilizing an image recognition technology, and if so, marking the corresponding suspected fire area as a fire area. And then acquiring smoke plume information of a fire disaster area in the laser radar scanning image, and evaluating the fire scene situation of the fire disaster area. And finally, sending alarm information and fire scene information to the decision end. The method improves the visibility, timeliness and reliability of early warning.

title_en: Ship emergency navigation position-indicating search and rescue and environment monitoring anti-pollution integrated intelligent platform
abstract_en: The application discloses boats and ships emergency navigation shows a search and rescue and anti-pollution integration wisdom platform of environmental monitoring, it is including floating in the body of the surface of water, be provided with on the body: the VDR-EPIRB equipment is used for sending distress signals to a ground station, reporting the real-time position information of an emergency radio position indicator and a sunken ship, and recording navigation information, navigation equipment information, state information, a driving platform recording and very high frequency wireless communication information of the ship; the AIS equipment is used for sending out the name, position and dynamic information of the ship, marking the accurate position of the ship for search and rescue commands, marking the accurate position and real-time dynamic information of a sunken ship for navigation aid of the passing ship and providing navigation warning; and the power supply is used for supplying power to each electric device.

title_en: Improved patient emergency response system
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.

title_en: Fire fighting command training simulation method and system based on browser 3D visualization
abstract_en: The invention relates to a fire fighting command training simulation method and system based on browser 3D visualization. The method comprises data exchange of a control terminal and data exchange of a client terminal, wherein the data exchange of the control terminal particularly comprises the steps as follows: the control terminal acquires and loads fire fighting training tasks; the control terminal sends training initiating orders and begins the fire fighting training tasks; and the control terminal records and stores training logs generated during training at the same time. The data exchange of the client terminal particularly comprises the steps as follows: the client terminal receives readiness orders sent by the control terminal and then acquires and loads the fire fighting training tasks; the client terminal chooses roles according to configuration files in the fire fighting training tasks to carry out the fire fighting training tasks; and the client terminal records and stores training logs generated during training at the same time. The system comprises the control terminal, the client terminal and a task storage server which are mutually connected. Compared with the prior art, the fire fighting command training simulation method and system have the advantages of greatly reducing training cost, being capable of simulating live-action fire fighting very vividly, and having small training risks and the like.
assignees: SHANGHAI SUN3D NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Construction system of power failure pool
abstract_en: The present application illustrates a blackout pool construction system, the system comprising: the intelligent analysis platform firstly acquires upstream and downstream equipment information through the corresponding relation between the fault information after record processing and the equipment set, secondly records the corresponding relation between the equipment information and the user set, selects the summoning user in the user set, traverses an automatic metering database, calls the fault user and the meter data of the summoning user, substitutes the fault user and the meter data of the summoning user into a fault type, judges whether the fault exists or not, and stores power failure information into a shutdown battery if the fault exists. Through the construction of stopping the battery, the problems that a large number of manual communication links exist in the process of emergency repair and dispatching of the power failure, so that the failure information cannot be judged quickly and accurately and the dispatching cannot be carried out reasonably are solved.
assignees: INFORMATION COMMUNICATION BRANCH HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD;YUNNAN YUNDIAN TONGFANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Wearable heads-up display ("HUD") for pharmacy workflow management system
abstract_en: Disclosed herein is a wearable heads-up display ("HUD") for a pharmacy workflow management system. An example HUD includes smart glasses communicatively coupled to a client device. The smart glasses include at least one camera and/or bar code scanner to record information needed to verify the drug dosage during the preparation of the drug formulation. The smart glasses include at least one microphone for recording voice commands. In addition, the smart glasses include at least one embedded display screen showing order steps of a preparation protocol for guiding a pharmacy technician to prepare a drug dose. Applications on the client device and/or smart glasses are configured to recognize and use voice commands to provide navigation for the embedded display. The voice command may also be used to provide data entry for drug dose preparation verification. Gestures may be detected by a camera and converted by an application into navigation or data entry commands.

title_en: New energy power generation equipment accurate monitoring and operation data analysis method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data monitoring of power generation equipment, in particular to a new energy power generation equipment accurate monitoring and operation data analysis method. The method comprises the steps of data acquisition and storage, sensor arrangement at key nodes for acquiring data, operation state evaluation, extraction of key indexes such as equipment efficiency, energy consumption and environmental adaptability, quantification of scoring standards, construction of an evaluation function, determination of weight and calculation of normalized weight value and comprehensive evaluation value by means of combination of a hierarchical analysis method and an entropy weight method, anomaly detection and early warning, definition of early warning level based on the comprehensive evaluation value, mean shift detection, early warning operation and emergency response, establishment of a feedback mechanism and establishment of emergency measures under different early warning levels. The invention improves the monitoring accuracy of the running state of the equipment, the scientificity of data evaluation, timeliness and effectiveness of exception handling, and ensures the stable running and efficient power generation of the new energy power generation equipment.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH OF GUANGDONG ENERGY GROUP GUIZHOU CO LTD

title_en: Coal mine water damage control system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal mine water damage prevention and control system and method based on artificial intelligence, comprising a data acquisition module, a data transmission module, a data preprocessing module, a geological modeling module, a water damage prediction module, a risk assessment module, an artificial intelligence decision module, an equipment control module, an emergency response module and a data management updating module. The invention strives for sufficient time for prevention and treatment work, effectively reduces the possibility of accident occurrence, realizes early warning, obviously improves the timeliness and accuracy of disaster prevention and treatment, strives for sufficient time for prevention and treatment work, effectively reduces the possibility of accident occurrence, effectively ensures that personnel safety evacuation and rescue work are smoothly carried out, furthest reduces disaster loss, improves the efficiency and success rate of prevention and treatment work, reduces economic loss and casualties caused by water damage, continuously improves prevention and treatment effect and system performance, and meets long-term safety production requirements.
assignees: HUATING COAL GROUP CO LTD;UNIV HENAN POLYTECHNIC

title_en: Apparatus and operating method of emergency phone with restrict call
title_ko: 통신제한 비상전화기 및 운용방법
abstract_en: A communication-restrictive emergency phone and a method for operating the same are provided to prevent an unauthorized person from communicating with the third person without permission and to enable a permitted engineer to change an emergency phone number or the arrangement of key buttons in a remote place. A communication-restrictive emergency phone includes a communication circuit part(100), a control part(110), a hook switch part(120), an audio part(130), a key button part(140), a memory part(150), a DTMF receiving part(170), and a DTMF generating part(160). The communication circuit part transmits and receives emergency communication signals. The control part accesses the communication circuit part, controls emergency communication, detects illegal communication, generates a warning signal, and records an inputted emergency phone number. The hook switch part accesses the control part, and provides communication start/stop indication signals. The audio part confirms the input of a command signal according to the control of the control part, and outputs a tone signal to warn of illegally occupied communication. The key button part accesses the control part, and inputs command signals to operate the emergency phone and a command signal to appoint a specific person selected for emergency communication. The memory part records and outputs an emergency phone number according to the control of the control part. The DTMF receiving part receives and detects emergency phone number information which is remotely inputted from the other side who calls the emergency phone. The DTMF generating part outputs the phone number of an appointed person's emergency contact point according to the control of the control part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 통신제한 비상전화기 및 운용방법에 관한 것으로 특히, 비상통신신호를 송신과 수신하는 통신회로부; 통신회로부에 접속하고 비상통신을 제어하며, 무단통신을 검출하여 경고신호를 발생하고 입력되는 비상통신 전화번호를 기록하도록 제어하고 감시하는 제어부; 제어부에 접속하고 통신의 시작과 종료 표시 신호를 제공하는 후크스위치부; 제어부의 제어에 의하여 명령신호의 입력 확인과 무단점유 통신을 경고하는 오디오 신호를 출력하는 오디오부; 제어부에 접속하고 비상전화기를 운용하기 위한 명령신호와 비상통신으로 선택된 상대방을 지정하는 명령신호를 입력하는 키버튼부; 및 제어부의 제어에 의하여 비상전화번호를 기록하고 출력하는 메모리부; 가 포함되는 구성을 특징으로 하여, 비상전화기를 허용되지 않은 타인이 무단으로 국선에 접속하여 제 3 자와 통신하지 못하도록 하고, 허용된 기술자가 현장 또는 원격으로 접속하여 기록된 비상전화번호를 변경 및 키버튼 배열을 변경하므로 감시 감독이 용이한 효과가 있다.  
       
     비상전화기, DTMF, 키버튼, 램, 롬, 버퍼, 코드정보, 루틴

title_en: Adaptive management system and method using black box for vehicle
title_ko: 차량용 블랙박스와 연동된 사고 처리 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: An accident processing system associated with a black box for a car and a method thereof are provided to wirelessly transceive accident related information including video data with an accident management server, thereby automatically processing a car related accident. A black box(100) for a car wirelessly transmits accident related information. The accident related information comprises video data recorded during a predetermined time before or after an accident. An accident management server(200) receives the accident related information and transmits accident occurrence information to an accident processing organization. An accident processing terminal(300) is equipped in the accident processing organization receiving the accident occurrence information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량과 관련된 사고 처리 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로서, 특히 차량용 블랙박스를 이용하여 교통사고 대행업체가 교통사고 발생시부터 사고 처리까지 관공서 기타 업체들과 연관하여 자동으로 처리할 수 있는 차량용 블랙박스와 연동된 사고 처리 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 사고 전후의 소정 시간 동안 기록된 영상 데이터를 포함하는 사고 관련 정보를 무선으로 전송하는 차량용 블랙박스, 사고처리 대행업체에 설치되며, 상기 차량용 블랙박스로부터 전송된 사고 관련 정보를 수신하고 사고처리 기관에 사고 발생 정보를 전송하는 사고관리 서버, 상기 사고관리 서버로부터 사고 발생 정보를 수신하는 사고처리 기관에 구비된 사고처리 단말기를 포함하여 구성되어, 교통사고 발생시, 차량 도난시, 차량 파손시 차량용 블랙박스에서 자동으로 사고 전후의 영상을 사고 대행 업체의 서버로 전송하고, 사고 대행 업체는 사고 발생 위치와 관련된 사고 발생 정보를 경찰서, 119, 보험회사, 견인업체 등에 연락하므로 운전자의 안전과 빠른 사고 처리가 가능하며, 사고 발생에 관한 증거가 자동으로 수집, 전송, 저장되므로 신속한 분쟁해결이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire damage evaluating system and method for simulating individual evacuation behavior and casualty and recording medium thereof
title_ko: 건설 구조물 화재에서 개인별 대피 행동 및 사상자를 시뮬레이션하는 화재 위험 평가 시스템, 화재 위험 평가 방법 및 그 기록 매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and a method for evaluating the danger of the fire which simulates personal actions for taking a shelter/losses in the fire of a building construction are provided to quantitively evaluate the dangerousness of the fire by applying the fire characteristics to a shelter space and evaluating the influence which influences to a human body while taking a shelter. CONSTITUTION: An application method applies a fire interpretation result of a fire simulation to a simulation space. A setting method sets a risk level data corresponding to the external environment variable of fire and smoke to a simulation pace per time and location. A unit for taking a shelter(107) starts to take a shelter according to the pattern of taking a shelter in the shortest path of an individual evacuee by receiving the command of starting to take a shelter. If a dangerous level of a threshold value excesses to the process in which the dangerous level is applied to a evacuee corresponding to the incompletion of taking a shelter, unit for distinguishing the losses(108) distinguishes the evacuee to the losses. A storing unit stores a simulation result of an individual and total evacuee.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 건설 구조물 화재에서 시간 및 위치별 화연에 영향을 받는 개인의 생태적 특성을 고려하여 개인별 대피 행동 및 사상자를 시뮬레이션하는 시스템, 방법 및 기록 매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 화재 위험 평가 시스템은, 화재 시뮬레이션을 수행하여 시간 및 위치별 화재 진행 정보의 화재 해석 결과를 당해 시뮬레이션 대상 공간에 적용하는 수단; 화재 해석 결과에 의하여 대피자의 사망을 유발하는 화연의 위험도 데이터를 시간 및 위치별 공간에 설정하는 수단; 대피 시작되면, 개별 대피자의 최단 경로상에서, 대피 행동 패턴 및 위험도 데이터를 적용하여 대피 진행하는 수단; 대피 미완료에 해당하는 개별 대피자에게 위험도를 적용하는 과정에서 임계치 위험도를 초과한 경우, 사망자로 판별하는 수단; 개별 대피자 및 전체 대피자의 시뮬레이션 결과를 생성하여 저장하는 수단; 및 화연의 진행 경로, 대피자의 대피 경로, 상기 시뮬레이션 결과가 표시되는 3차원 영상을 재생하고 저장하는 수단을 포함하는 컴퓨터 단말을 구비하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Smart toy for play and education
title_ko: 놀이와 교육을 접목한 어린이용 스마트 토이
abstract_en: The present invention provides a smart toy for a child in which play and education are engrafted. The smart toy for a child can perform storytelling or a game for various age groups including an infant. According to the present invention, the smart toy for a child in which play and education are engrafted includes a command input panel (100), an auxiliary command input member (200), and a controller (300). The command input panel (100) includes: a start block (110) reporting a start of a program; an end block (120) reporting the end of the program; and at least a command block (130) connected between the start block (110) and the end block (120) and performing a command between the start and end of the program. The auxiliary command input member (200) is connected to the command block (130) and inputs an auxiliary command to the command block (130). The controller (300) is communicated with the command input panel (100). The controller (300) receives a total command of the command input panel (100) and the auxiliary command input member (200) and controls the movement of at least one among a character on a screen, a drone, and a robot, which are a subject to be operated.
abstract_ko: 개시된 본 발명에 따른 놀이와 교육을 접목한 어린이용 스마트 토이는, 프로그램의 시작을 알리는 시작 블록(110), 상기 프로그램의 종료를 알리는 종료 블록(120) 및 상기 시작 블록(110)과 상기 종료 블록(120) 사이에 연결되어 상기 프로그램의 시작과 종료 사이에 명령을 수행하도록 적어도 하나의 명령 블록(130)을 포함하는 명령 입력판(100); 상기 명령 블록(130)에 결합되어 상기 명령 블록(130)에 해당 보조 명령을 입력하는 보조 명령 입력부재(200); 및 상기 명령 입력판(100)과 통신하며, 상기 명령 입력판(100) 및 상기 보조 명령 입력부재(200)의 종합 명령을 전송받아 작동 대상인 화면상 캐릭터, 드론 및 로봇 중 적어도 하나의 움직임을 제어하는 컨트롤러(300)를 포함한다.

title_en: Comprehensive security inspection management system
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive security inspection management system and a method, wherein the system comprises: the inspection requirement acquisition subsystem is used for acquiring the inspection requirement input by the inspector into the comprehensive management platform; the checking key point list generating subsystem is used for generating a checking key point list according to checking requirements; the comprehensive safety inspection subsystem is used for dispatching inspection personnel to conduct comprehensive safety inspection on the target inspection enterprises according to the inspection gist list; the checking result generating subsystem is used for acquiring the editing record of the checking key point list by the checking personnel and generating a checking result according to the editing record; and the comprehensive management subsystem is used for carrying out comprehensive safety inspection management according to different inspection results. According to the comprehensive security inspection management system and method, the inspection key point list is generated according to the inspection requirements, the inspection results generated by editing records of the inspection key point list are comprehensively managed according to the inspection personnel, the generation of inspection contents is more flexible, and the management efficiency is further improved.

title_en: Petroleum storage device with emergency function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a petroleum storage device with an emergency function, in particular to the technical field of petroleum storage, which comprises the following components: the emergency connection wire seats are respectively arranged at opposite ends of the two petroleum pipe valves, detachable petroleum pipe is respectively arranged on the two emergency connection wire seats, and a controller is arranged on the storage tank; the connecting assembly is used for protecting one of the emergency connection wire seat cages and comprises a connection seat fixedly sleeved on the emergency connection wire seat, a plurality of connection shells arranged at one end of the connection seat and a plurality of baffle plates which can be overturned and arranged at one side of the plurality of connection shells; according to the invention, through the arrangement of the connecting assembly, the connecting shell can be unfolded on the emergency connecting wire seat, so that the situation that the surface connection part of the threaded sealing component is possibly oxidized and rusted to be unfavorable for taking down under the condition of long-time unused can be prevented, and the timeliness of the emergency response of the storage device is improved.

title_en: Emergency response coordination system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of coordination response, in particular to an emergency response coordination system based on the Internet of things, the system comprises an abnormal event identification module, an event influence analysis module, a resource dynamic matching module, an emergency scheme making module, a scene simulation previewing module, a priority adjustment module, a real-time monitoring module and an intelligent scheduling command module. According to the invention, discrete event simulation is adopted in the resource dynamic matching module, emergency resources can be dynamically collected and distributed according to the regional influence rating in the event influence analysis record, the accuracy of resource allocation is remarkably improved, the resource utilization rate is optimized, key resources and personnel can be rapidly scheduled to the most needed place, the scene simulation previewing module adopts an individual as the model, the practicability and the reliability of an emergency scheme are improved by simulating different response strategies, the emergency response speed and accuracy are ensured, and casualties and property loss are effectively reduced.

title_en: Personal alarm device
abstract_en: The personal alarm device communicates with emergency personnel, such as an emergency dispatcher at 911, and emergency contacts. The user depresses an emergency button that initiates communication with the emergency personnel and the emergency contacts. A covering, such as an outer rim or bezel, covers the emergency button, to limit access to the emergency button. The user rotates the covering to align an opening in the covering with the emergency button. Pressing the emergency button transmits communications to emergency personnel and the emergency contacts. These communications include a phone call, a recorded message, a text message, or other message. The alarm device also provides a light and speaker to assist the user. The speaker plays the audio of the phone call and plays an alarm to alert others in the vicinity of the user.

title_en: Remote data mirroring system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of remote data mirroring system.A kind of data guard method is provided, has comprised the data that to store of coming from one or more data sources (24).Send these data to store in main storage means (28) and the auxilary unit (32).When successfully storing the indication of data in waiting for auxilary unit, record associated with the data can be temporarily stored in combating a natural disaster in the difficult storage unit (48) of contiguous main storage means.When the incident of at least some data takes place in damaging main storage means, adopt to be stored in the record of combating a natural disaster in the difficult storage unit and the partial data at least that is stored in the auxilary unit comes data reconstruction.

title_en: Method and system for constructing and managing digital pipe network
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for constructing and managing a digital pipe network, wherein the method comprises the following steps: step 1: acquiring a pipeline distribution diagram of a drainage pipeline of a city, and dynamically acquiring drainage data of the drainage pipeline; step 2: constructing a digital pipe network corresponding to a drainage pipeline according to a pipeline distribution diagram and drainage data based on a GIS technology; and step 3: based on the digital pipe network, the method carries out abnormity detection and corresponding abnormity processing command on the drainage pipeline, and simultaneously outputs and displays the digital pipe network. According to the method and the system for constructing and managing the digital pipe network, inspection personnel do not need to be arranged to inspect and check the pipeline condition of the drainage pipeline, so that the labor cost is greatly reduced; the timeliness of discovering the pipeline abnormity is improved, the missing of the optimal solution time of the pipeline abnormity is avoided, and the solution efficiency of the pipeline abnormity is improved; and the output display digital pipe network is used for the visual check of the working personnel.

title_en: Water conservancy and hydropower engineering construction safety supervision system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for monitoring construction safety of water conservancy and hydropower engineering. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a hub monitoring subsystem comprising a plurality of first sensors in a dam hub area; constructing a landslide body monitoring subsystem comprising a plurality of second sensors in a landslide body area; constructing an early warning rule for single construction risk based on the subset of the first sensor and the second sensor; the pre-warning rules are updated based on periodic and/or incident manual checks. According to the invention, when the deformation of the hub and the landslide body, the groundwater level of the landslide body and other data reflecting engineering risks are monitored through the monitoring subsystem, personnel inspection information which is difficult to obtain through the monitoring data is obtained through manual inspection, an early warning rule is constructed and updated, and the accuracy, timeliness and instantaneity of early warning are improved.
assignees: SICHUAN WATER CONSERVANCY ENG CONSTRUCTION QUALITY AND SAFETY CENTER STATION

title_en: BIM+MR comprehensive pipe rack emergency management method and system based on network collaboration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a BIM+MR underground comprehensive pipe gallery emergency management method and system based on a network collaborative architecture, comprising the steps of splitting and compressing a pipe gallery BIM model; MR gesture interaction, PUN network architecture construction, multi-terminal management synchronization and recording, space anchor point positioning and site in-situ remote management. The method utilizes the mixed reality technology to realize the BIM semantic segmentation model of the gesture interaction comprehensive pipe gallery, and realizes the collaborative management of the multi-terminal low-delay network through the distributed synchronous framework of the PUN. When an emergency situation occurs in the underground comprehensive pipe rack, the system supports low-delay collaborative management of remote experts and on-site personnel, forms a virtual-real linkage three-dimensional emergency command system, and improves collaborative treatment efficiency and decision scientificity for emergency management of the underground comprehensive pipe rack.

title_en: Graded early warning method for stability of toppling deformation body under multiple working conditions
abstract_en: The invention provides a grading early warning method for stability of a toppling deformation body under multiple working conditions, which comprises the steps of collecting real-time monitoring time sequence data and preprocessing, determining an analysis period according to the preprocessing data, extracting target monitoring data to calculate a stability grading label, generating a reinforced support strategy aiming at a high-risk label, generating a maintenance monitoring strategy aiming at the stability label, detecting abnormal deformation based on a current or updated strategy and combining an instability prediction model, and triggering personnel evacuation or disaster early warning through an emergency response decision tree if control abnormality exists. The invention can improve the accuracy and timeliness of the stability control of the dumping deformation body, reduce the risk of geotechnical engineering instability and optimize the distribution of supporting resources.

title_en: Search support device, search support method and search support system
abstract_en: To support early detection of a suspect or a criminal person of incident or accident, by narrowing the escape route of an escape car efficiently, upon occurrence of incident or accident around a crossover point where many cars and people go and come.SOLUTION: A search support device records the video captured by a camera while mapping to camera information and crossover point information, together with road map information including multiple crossover points, extracts camera information of a crossover point adjacent to a first place, according to the information about the first place where an event occurred and the feature information of a vehicle participant to occurrence of the event, searches a vehicle satisfying the feature information of the vehicle by using the video captured by the camera identified the camera information, analyses the feature information of the vehicle, updates the feature information of the vehicle by adding the analyzed feature information of the vehicle to the inputted feature information of the vehicle, while furthermore, updates the information about the first place to the search point information of the searched vehicle, as the detection place information of the vehicle, before being saved in an accumulation area.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 18

title_en: System and method for after managing exhaust gas decreasing devices and program recording medium
title_ko: 매연저감장치 사후관리 방법 및 시스템과 이를 위한프로그램 기록매체
abstract_en: A system and a method for managing an exhaust reduction device after sales, and a program recording medium for the same are provided to collect the exhaust reduction device by checking detach of the exhaust reduction device, and tracing a location of the removed or stolen exhaust reduction device with an LBS(Location-Based Service) terminal installed at a vehicle. An LBS terminal is installed in the vehicle, and transmits accident information or removal information to a central management server when a cause for collecting the exhaust reduction device occurs. The central management server transmits the collection cause information and vehicle information to a collection institution server(445) and an exhaust reduction device management institution server(450). The exhaust reduction device collection institution server transmits a collection result to the exhaust reduction device management institution server when the exhaust reduction device is collected. The exhaust reduction device management institution server checks the information received from the central management server with the collection result, and stores collection details to a storage medium when the exhaust reduction device is normally collected.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 매연저감장치 사후관리 방법 및 시스템과 이를 위한 프로그램 기록매체에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에 따른 매연저감장치 사후관리 방법은, 매연저감장치 장착 차량에 구비된 단말장치에서 상기 매연저감장치를 회수해야 하는 원인 발생시, 상기 매연저감장치 회수 원인 정보-사고발생 정보 또는 장치 탈거 정보 등-를 기지국을 통해 중앙관제서버로 전송하는 제1단계와, 상기 중앙관제서버에서 상기 매연저감장치 회수 원인 정보(또는 상기 매연저감장치 회수 원인 정보에 대응하는 정보)와 상기 차량 정보를 매연저감장치 회수 기관 서버(또는 단말)와 매연저감장치 관리 기관 서버로 전송하는 제2단계와, 상기 매연저감장치 회수 기관을 통해 상기 차량의 매연저감장치가 회수되면, 상기 매연저감장치 회수 기관 서버(또는 단말)에서 상기 차량의 매연저감장치 회수 결과를 상기 매연저감장치 관리 기관 서버로 전송하는 제3단계와, 상기 매연저감장치 관리 기관 서버에서 상기 중앙관제서버에서 기 전송한 정보와 상기 매연저감장치 회수 기관 서버(또는 단말)에서 전송한 회수 결과를 비교하여, 상기 차량의 매연저감장치 회수 내역을 확인하는 제4단계 및 상기 확인결과, 상기 차량의 매연저감장치 회수가 정상적으로 이루어진 경우, 상기 매연저감장치 관리 기관 서버에서 상기 차량의 매연저감장치 회수 내역을 소정의 저장매체에 저장, 관리하는 제5단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Police work supporting system and police work supporting terminal
title_ko: 경찰 업무 지원 시스템 및 경찰 업무 지원 단말기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: As a system and a terminal for supporting polices work is provided to conveniently support the police work, thereby improving police work efficiency. CONSTITUTION: A communication module(90) is connected to a center server according to a command of an input unit(20). The first communication module receives data from integrated database. A control unit controls input and output of data through operation of police business support program. A database module(60) stores a business performance result. An output unit(30) displays business performance process and a result. A design module(40) comprises a displayed screen.
abstract_ko:

title_en: System providing educational programming language content using augmented reality
title_ko: 증강현실을 이용한 에듀케이션 프로그래밍 랭귀지(epl) 콘텐츠를 제공하는 시스템
abstract_en: A coding education method using augmented reality is disclosed, which is performed by a computing device including a camera, the method comprising: a first step of acquiring coding education content; a second step of selecting one or more points included in the coding education content; a third step of acquiring an image captured from the camera; a fourth step of recognizing the captured image and matching one or more objects included in the captured image with the one or more points; a fifth step of displaying the captured image and the one or more matched points; a sixth step of displaying a virtual robot on the captured image; a seventh step of displaying one or more command blocks each including one or more commands for controlling the movement of the virtual robot; an eighth step of arranging the one or more command blocks on the one or more points based on a user input for the one or more displayed command blocks; a ninth step of controlling the virtual robot according to the order in which the one or more command blocks are arranged, wherein the virtual robot moves along the one or more points and performs commands corresponding to the command blocks arranged at each point; and a tenth step of displaying the movement of the virtual robot according to the control result. Accordingly, it is possible to provide coding education using a virtual robot without an actual robot by using augmented reality.
abstract_ko: 카메라를 포함하는 컴퓨팅 장치에 의하여 수행되는 방법으로서, 코딩교육 콘텐츠를 획득하는 제1단계, 상기 코딩교육 콘텐츠에 포함된 하나 이상의 포인트를 선택하는 제2단계, 상기 카메라로부터 촬영된 영상을 획득하는 제3단계, 상기 촬영된 영상을 인식하고, 상기 촬영된 영상에 포함된 하나 이상의 객체와 상기 하나 이상의 포인트를 매칭하는 제4단계, 상기 촬영된 영상 및 상기 매칭된 하나 이상의 포인트를 표시하는 제5단계, 상기 촬영된 영상에 가상의 로봇을 표시하는 제6단계, 상기 가상의 로봇의 움직임을 제어하기 위한 하나 이상의 명령어를 각각 포함하는 하나 이상의 명령어 블록을 표시하는 제7단계, 상기 표시된 하나 이상의 명령어 블록에 대한 사용자 입력에 기초하여 상기 하나 이상의 명령어 블록을 상기 하나 이상의 포인트에 배치하는 제8단계, 상기 하나 이상의 명령어 블록이 배치된 순서에 따라 상기 가상의 로봇을 제어하되, 상기 가상의 로봇은 상기 하나 이상의 포인트를 따라 이동하고, 각각의 포인트에 배치된 명령어 블록에 대응하는 명령을 수행하는, 제9단계 및 상기 제어 결과에 따른 상기 가상의 로봇의 움직임을 표시하는 제10단계를 포함하는, 증강현실을 이용한 코딩교육 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Mobile asset data recorder and transmitter
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allows for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with impact detection, rough operating condition detection, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of a mobile asset. Users can use the normal operation of their mobile assets to locate and alert, in real-time, areas where their assets are encountering rough operating environments, to provide for quicker emergency response, and to validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting.

title_en: System for mimicking the behavior of a multi-engine aircraft with a single engine aircraft
abstract_en: A fly-by-wire system that lets a single-engine aircraft mimic multi-engine behavior for real-flight pilot training, especially asymmetric thrust effects that create yaw/roll. A cockpit central thrust control with two independent thrust levers generates an overall power command plus a dissymmetry signal; a calculator applying a dedicated control law converts these into corrected setpoints for the rudder, left/right ailerons, and propeller parameters to reproduce multi-engine handling. Instructors may trigger a simulated engine failure and then reset back to normal single-engine operation. Optional wingtip electric thrusters powered by a battery may increase asymmetric effects while maintaining safety margin, and the system may display/record simulated multi-engine data for debriefing-reducing training cost and CO 2  versus operating real twins

title_en: Device for establishing communications interoperability at an incident site including means for recording crisis incidents
abstract_en: What is provided is recording capability for each of the modules utilized by the first responders and other personnel within the area of the incident, with the stored information at each of the first responders' modules being read out through the ad hoc network, where it can be uploaded to storage. The stored information can be displayed at an incident commander work station in real time to give the incident commander a realistic view of the timeline and the severity of the incident, as well as the response. The use of the ad hoc network permits offloading stored information from each of the first responders' modules so as to free up storage within the modules. By providing storage at every node of the ad hoc network, one has access to a timeline of the actions at the incident as well as redundancy, which enhances the memories and observational skills of the first responders. Incident reporting is made complete due to the fact of all recordings being: made available at one node on the temporary ad hoc network from which information reports and analysis can proceed, as well as subsequent training.
assignees: BAE SYS INF & ELECT SYS INTEG

title_en: Data processing method, data processing device, and computer program
abstract_en: To achieve high reliability in managing a certificate related to suppression of greenhouse gas.A data processing method includes, by a computer 1 connected to a recorder terminal 30 and a distributed database 50 through a network NW, executing: certification data receiving processing S101 of receiving certification data related to a reduction amount of greenhouse gas from the recorder terminal; deposit receiving processing S103 of receiving a deposit from the recorder terminal, the deposit being transmitted in association with the certification data; communication processing S104 of transmitting a storage request of the certification data and deposit processing necessary for the storage request to the distributed database; recording processing S106 of receiving information of a purchaser of the certification data and recording the information of the purchaser in association with the certification data; amortization processing S205 of storing, in the distributed database, amortization information indicating amortization of the certification data in association with the certification data when receiving an amortization command of the certification data; and deposit reimbursement processing S207 of reimbursing the deposit associated with the certification data to the recorder terminal when the amortization information is stored.

title_en: Method and system for wirelessly transmitting flow state of geographic and geomorphic flow field and realizing remote monitoring
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for wirelessly transmitting a flow state of a geographic and geomorphic flow field and realizing remote monitoring. The underwater geography, geomorphology, flow velocity flow field and other related information are monitored in real time and are transmitted to a remote monitoring center for storage and network sharing through wireless public network transmission, and the problems that the conventional transmission form and process cannot meet the measurement conditions and the real-time transmission requirements of the underwater geography and geomorphology and synchronization of measuring data and monitoring pictures in the field and the consultation center cannot be realized are solved.
