The characteristics such as high maneuverability and wide coverage of the wireless public network are fully exerted, field monitoring information is timely, accurately and rapidly provided for disaster prevention and reduction decision, the timeliness ofhydrological maneuvering emergence monitoring is improved, and the remote information transmission is convenient for remote command of hydrological emergence; and moreover, the resource sharing of the monitored hydrological information can be realized.
assignees: FOSHAN HYDROLOGY BRANCH OF GUANGDONG HYDROLOGY BUREAU

title_en: Automatic signal coincidence monitoring and alarming system
abstract_en: A Data Acquisition and Recording System (DARS) for mobile assets includes a data logger and an automated signal monitoring and alert system. The data logger includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queuing store. The DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores compressed records of the data in a local memory module at least once per second. DARS is designed to operate in near real-time mode, storing a complete record of data comprising five minutes to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once every second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users may: viewing the video, audio, and data acquired by the DARS through a web browser, which provides a faster emergency response; verifying the effectiveness of repair and rerouting and monitoring team member performance and safety; and receiving signal coincidence and signal violation in real time.

title_en: A method and apparatus for the generator disturbance phasor recorder including the measurement of generator load angle
title_ko: 발전기 부하각 측정을 포함하는 발전기 외란 페이져 기록 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a generator disturbance phasor recorder and method for a phasor measurement unit (PMU), capable of preventing a large power outage accident and increasing the reliability of a power system to allow the recorder to record to control and disturbance of system protection and accurate power system monitoring by improving the accuracy of a voltage and current phase and magnitude and allowing to measure a load angle inside a generator even when system frequency is out of 60 Hz.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 계통주파수가 60 Hz에서 벗어나는 경우에도 전압/전류 위상과 크기의 정확도를 향상시키며 발전기 내부 부하각도 측정할 수 있도록 함으로써, 계통보호, 정확한 계통감시 제어 및 외란 기록 등을 할 수 있도록 하여 대형 정전사고 방지와 전력계통 신뢰도를 증가시킬 수 있는, 위상측정장치(PMU)를 위한 발전기 외란 페이져 기록 방법 및 장치에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Method for providing emergency alert using speech recognition, Computer program for the same, and Recording medium storing computer program for the same
title_ko: 음성인식을 이용한 비상경보 방법, 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램, 그 기록매체
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a method to provide an emergency alert, computer program using the same, and a recording medium thereof to generate the emergency alert when a predetermined emergency situation is determined by determining whether a user voice inputted by a voice input means includes a predetermined word or whether a corresponding word is recognized in accordance with a predetermined rule. The present invention relates to a method to provide an emergency alert using voice recognition, a computer program therefor, and recording medium thereof. According to an aspect of the present invention, a method, executed in a system to provide an emergency alert to receive a user voice through a voice input means, to provide an emergency alert comprises the steps of: 1) converting a user voice inputted by a voice input means into a voice signal; 2) determining whether the voice signal includes a predetermined command; 3) recognizing a corresponding command as a first input command when the predetermined command is included in the voice signal; 4) executing an emergency alert operation predetermined for the first input command; 5) recognizing a corresponding command as a second input command when the predetermined command is included in a user voice inputted within a predetermined time from an input time of the first input command and when the command is determined as a command associated with the first input command in a result associated with more executing the 1) step to 2) step; and 6) executing the predetermined emergency alert operation for a combination of the first input command and the second input command.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 음성인식을 이용한 비상경보 방법, 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램, 그 기록매체에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명의 일측면에 따르면, 음성입력수단을 통해 사용자의 음성을 입력받는 비상경보 시스템에서 실행되는 비상경보 방법으로서, 1) 음성입력수단을 통해 입력된 사용자의 음성을 음성신호로 변환하는 단계; 2) 상기 음성신호에 미리 설정된 명령어가 포함되어 있는지를 판단하는 단계; 3) 미리 설정된 명령어가 포함된 경우, 해당 명령어를 제1 입력 명령어로 인식하는 단계; 4) 상기 제1 입력 명령어에 대해 미리 설정된 비상경보 동작을 실행하는 단계; 5) 상기 1) 내지 2) 단계를 더욱 실행한 결과, 상기 제1 입력 명령어의 입력 시점으로부터 미리 설정된 시간 이내에 입력된 사용자의 음성에 미리 설정된 명령어가 포함되고 상기 명령어가 상기 제1 입력 명령어와 연관관계가 설정된 연관 명령어인 것으로 판단된 경우, 해당 명령어를 제2 입력 명령어로 인식하는 단계; 및 6) 상기 제1 입력 명령어 및 제2 입력 명령어의 조합에 대해 미리 설정된 비상경보 동작을 실행하는 단계;를 포함하여 구성된 음성인식을 이용한 비상경보 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: Radiological Emergency Response Support System
title_ko: 방사선비상 대응 지원 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a radiation emergency response support system. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the radiation emergency response support system for managing and operating a radiation emergency situation includes: an input unit for receiving at least one of a plurality of different procedural information and radiation emergency-related information; a storage unit for storing a tree diagram created based on the procedural information entered into the input unit and storing the procedural information and tree diagram in a database; a processing unit for subdividing and listing the tasks of disaster prevention personnel created in the tree diagram into individual tasks; a communication unit for transmitting and receiving the tasks of the disaster prevention personnel and the radiation emergency-related information to and from an emergency situation room and the disaster prevention personnel, respectively; and an output unit for externally displaying at least one of the task information of the disaster prevention personnel and information necessary for determining a radiation emergency situation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예는, 방사선비상 상황을 관리 및 운영하기 위한 방사선비상 대응 지원 시스템에 있어서, 서로 다른 다수의 절차정보 및 방사선비상 관련 정보 중 적어도 하나를 입력 받는 입력부와, 상기 입력부에 입력된 절차정보를 기반으로 작성된 수목도를 저장하고, 상기 절차정보 및 수목도를 각각 데이터베이스 화하여 저장하는 저장부와, 상기 수목도에 작성된 방재인원의 임무를 개인 임무 단위로 세분화 및 목록화 하는 처리부와, 상기 방재인원의 임무 및 상기 방사선비상 관련 정보를 비상상황실 및 상기 방재인원과 각각 송신 및 수신하는 통신부와, 상기 방재인원의 임무 정보 및 방사선비상 상황 판단에 필요한 정보 중 적어도 하나를 외부로 표시하는 출력부를 포함하는, 방사선비상 대응 지원 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Mobile communication platform
abstract_en: A communication vehicle system or platform that provides for the integration of multiple audio, visual, telecommunications, thermal, radiological, chemical and biological data detection and/or communication devices. The communication vehicle can be configured for providing mobile communications and surveillance in an environment in which the surrounding communications and/or power infrastructure has been damaged or is non-existent. For example, the vehicle can be deployed to the scene of a disaster or emergency. Accordingly, the mobility of the preferred communication vehicle can enhance and extend the reach of any emergency operations center. Other possible applications include law enforcement surveillance; tactical military command and control; weather and storm chasing; homeland security search and rescue; forward deployment monitoring, news agencies and border patrol. It can be operated in a stand-alone mode or act as a versatile forward-deployable remote vehicle while communicating to a rear command center.
assignees: SPIVEY KERVIN R;SPIVEY JEVON L;JENESIA1 INC

title_en: Critical health information profile and emergency communication system
abstract_en: A microprocessor-based emergency response communication system used to call and communicate with the 9-1-1 operator and also allows emergency responder's immediate access to a user's Critical Health Information Profile stored in the device at the point and location of crisis. The device is used to create individual Critical Health Information Profiles which is Health Level-7 compliant enabling it to seamlessly communicate with major hospital networks worldwide. This functional capability provides a system that can retrieve and transmit user-stored personal and health information by emergency responders at the point of care. The emergency responder can access the customer's Critical Health Information Profile database, review the data for pertinent information and then transmit that data to a designated receiving hospital or medical center. The device provides an electronic means of dialing and communicating directly with the 9-1-1 operator. A wireless remote transmitter unit can be activated from the wireless transmitter or the base unit to dial and connect with the 9-1-1 operator, broadcast a canned message with or without a personal-recorded message, and personally communicate with the 9-1-1 operator through a two-way speakerphone system. The device contains software enabling the user and medical personnel the ability to input, store, retrieve and analyze the user's vital sign data and other pertinent health information.

title_en: Firefighter distress device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a fire control instrument field specifically is a fireman's ware of calling for help, shell and hou gai including the cooperation setting, battery, circuit board, GPS orientation module, wireless communication module, recording module and storage module are installed respectively to shell and hou gai constitution holistic inboard, install respectively in the middle of the outside upper portion of shell and call for help switch and switch, call for help switch and switch's periphery still is equipped with a plurality of flash lights, and a bee calling organ is still installed respectively to the outside lower part both sides of shell, still be equipped with microphone and microUSB interface on the shell respectively. The utility model discloses the function is abundant, can provide the omnidirectional protection for the fire fighter, and has the recording function, and the later stage commander of being convenient for is worth promoting through the successful experience of the rescue scheme in the scene recording admission accident.
assignees: JIANGXI DINGFENG EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Water pollution three-dimensional dynamic evolution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water pollution three-dimensional dynamic evolution method. The invention mainly solves the problem of the way for generating KML by three-dimensional analog simulation and provides a KML and GoogleEarth-based three-dimensional analog evolution method. A system reads a result calculated by a simulation model and related spatial data by using server script language, dynamically generates a KML file in real time, loads the file to a browser GoogleEarth plugin and displays the file or provides a file downloading service for a user to perform local simulation. When the scheme is applied to simulating a water pollution diffusion process in the middle and lower reaches of the Yellow River, the evolution process of pollutants is clear along with time, a platform operation interface is simple and visual, high three-dimensional real experience feeling and timeliness can be achieved, implementation difficulty is small and the requirement on network transmission rate is low. The method provides support for emergency response and emergency decision work to the greatest degree.

title_en: Criminal investigation application system and method based on WIFI big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a criminal investigation application system and method based on WIFI big data, which are used for solving the problems of single investigation working method, large workload of artificial feature extraction and application of artificial subjective factors to criminal investigation, and comprise a collection layer, a storage layer, an analysis layer and an application layer; the acquisition layer is used for acquiring and recording original user data and sending the original user data to the storage layer; the storage layer is used for collecting original user data in real time and accessing the original user data to the analysis layer through the unified data bus; the analysis layer is used for acquiring original user data and analyzing the original user data in real time, the invention utilizes the probe equipment to acquire the MAC address of the mobile terminal in a radiation range, and carries out modeling analysis by combining the acquired data with the specific application requirements of public security criminal investigation, thereby integrating the investigation thinking, habits, methods and requirements of a commander, a researcher and a detector in the actual investigation activity into a system and carrying out a brand-new investigation hand for searching and tracking criminal suspects by signals.
assignees: ANHUI SUN CREATE ELECTRONIC CO LTD

title_en: Rapid assessment method for death after earthquake in China
abstract_en: The invention provides a rapid evaluation method for death after earthquake in China, which relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster evaluation and comprises the steps of obtaining historical earthquake data in China; establishing a historical human development index aiming at China, and normalizing the recorded death population number of each earthquake according to the historical human development index to obtain a normalization formula; dividing China into a plurality of regions according to development differences; determining a mortality function for each area according to a normalization formula, population exposure data and intensity distribution data of each earthquake; after the earthquake occurs, estimating the death population number according to the death rate function, population exposure data and intensity distribution data of the region to which the earthquake belongs; and calculating the probability that the dead people fall in each emergency response level interval in the earthquake by adopting a normal cumulative distribution function. The method can quickly evaluate the number of dead people in the earthquake and the emergency response grade after the earthquake occurs, and provides scientific guidance suggestion for the quick emergency response of the government.

title_en: Intelligent gas supervision-based pipe gallery emergency material management and control method and Internet of things system
abstract_en: The invention provides a piping lane emergency material management and control method based on intelligent gas supervision and an Internet of things system, comprising the following steps: acquiring at least one of operation and maintenance data, geographical information and operation record data of a pipe gallery; acquiring pipe gallery monitoring data and gas monitoring data in a pipe gallery through a gas equipment object platform; acquiring population data and other pipeline data through a government gas supervision and management platform; evaluating risk responsiveness of different storage locations; determining the adjustment information of the storage position; and adjusting parameters of the environment adjusting device based on the adjustment information in response to the determination of the storage position by the government gas supervision and management platform. By evaluating the risk degree and determining the adjustment information, the distribution of materials is ensured to be uniform and reasonable, and the subsequent rapid and reasonable emergency dispatching is facilitated; and the parameters of the environment adjusting device are adjusted based on the adjustment information, so that the storage environment of the adjusted materials can be improved, and the safe storage of the materials is facilitated.
assignees: CHENGDU QINCHUAN IOT TECH CO LTD

title_en: User health condition monitoring method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of health monitoring, and particularly discloses a method and a device for monitoring the health condition of a user, wherein the method and the device integrate physiological and psychological health monitoring, and realize comprehensive health assessment, physiological abnormality immediate warning and recording by collecting physiological data such as heart rate and blood pressure and psychological feedback, namely an emotion state, ensure the health and safety of the user, monitor the activity of the user in real time by using a model trained by actual falling data, accurately detect falling and position, and improve emergency response capability; in psychological aspects, key emotion features are extracted, an emotion recognition model is built, negative emotion is automatically recognized and monitored, and when the threshold value is exceeded, warning is achieved, comprehensive monitoring of psychological health management is promoted, comprehensive health protection is improved, instantaneity and accuracy are high, fall detection and positioning are rapid and effective, safety guarantee is enhanced, emotion recognition is accurate, early intervention is assisted, and psychological health is promoted. The whole scheme is intelligent and automatic, and the personal health management level is remarkably improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN YITIAN BOCHUANG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Road traffic safety monitoring system based on unmanned aerial vehicle cruising perception
abstract_en: The application provides a road traffic safety monitoring system based on unmanned aerial vehicle cruise perception, which relates to the technical field of traffic safety monitoring, and comprises a flow acquisition module, a traffic monitoring module and a traffic monitoring module, wherein the flow acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time traffic flow data of each road section; the system comprises an anomaly labeling module, a path adjustment monitoring module, an event identification module and an early warning module, wherein the anomaly labeling module is used for generating an anomaly region labeling chart, the path adjustment monitoring module is used for adjusting a flight cruising path of an unmanned aerial vehicle to obtain a multi-source safety monitoring data set, the event identification module is used for generating an event occurrence identification result, and the early warning module is used for carrying out road traffic safety early warning. The technical problems of poor flexibility and timeliness of an emergency response mechanism due to insufficient comprehensive understanding of accident sites and traffic flow in the prior art are solved, real-time identification and early warning of traffic safety events are realized, and the technical effects of improving the capability of traffic management and emergency response are achieved.

title_en: Intelligent emergency command system and method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent emergency command system and method based on artificial intelligence, the method comprises the steps of obtaining emergency data flow containing a first event feature set, determining a first risk analysis cluster according to a risk assessment module corresponding to the feature, associating at least one initial response strategy set with each module, executing emergency decision on each module in the cluster, screening target response strategies meeting the timeliness index standard from response strategies corresponding to the modules, dynamically decomposing each target strategy to generate a dynamic response sub-strategy set, and finally generating an emergency response instruction for the module based on the dynamic response sub-strategy set. Wherein the dynamic decomposition calculates policy decomposition granularity by the environmental interference factor, and remaps the emergency treatment data to generate a sub-policy set. The invention can improve the timeliness and the accuracy of emergency decision and optimize the resource allocation efficiency.
assignees: XIAN XUYANG COMMUNICATION EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Radiology department equipment radiation early warning and emergency response system based on multi-sensor fusion
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of medical radiation protection, and discloses a radiation early warning and emergency response system of radiology equipment based on multi-sensor fusion. According to the application, radiation dose, environmental parameters and target state data are acquired based on the multi-type sensor array, and the global, real-time and credible radiation state monitoring is realized by generating the three-dimensional radiation field dynamic distribution information and combining a self-checking mechanism with the radiation source operation parameters to dynamically correct deviation. Meanwhile, according to preset safety standards, scene characteristic data and historical modes, dose change trend is predicted through an intelligent algorithm, a grading response threshold is dynamically generated, and a threshold strategy is adaptively adjusted, so that safety protection and clinical efficiency are balanced. In addition, based on the intelligent decision output grading abnormal signals, the radiation source and the environment control equipment are automatically linked to perform response when the radiation dose exceeds the limit, and timeliness and safety of risk treatment are improved.
assignees: WOMEN AND CHILDRENS MEDICAL CENTER OF GUANGZHOU MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Natural gas fireproof explosion suppression valve device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of valves and discloses a natural gas fireproof explosion suppression valve device which comprises a transmission pipeline, wherein a resettable explosion suppression cavity component and an emergency cut-off valve are sequentially communicated in the medium flow direction, a heat-sensitive sensor and a pressure sensor are both assembled at one air inlet end of the transmission pipeline, the heat-sensitive sensor and the pressure sensor are both connected with a controller in a signal manner, the controller is used for controlling on-off of the emergency cut-off valve, when a monitoring signal of the heat-sensitive sensor exceeds a preset threshold value, a valve core of the emergency cut-off valve is closed, and a fire blocking core is movably attached to a valve core sealing surface of the emergency cut-off valve. The invention can realize synchronous linkage protection, namely, when the overtemperature is abnormal, the emergency cut-off valve and the fire-retardant core synchronously act, thereby avoiding the hysteresis of single cut-off protection and improving the timeliness of emergency response. And (3) double sealing and blocking, namely, attaching the fire-retardant core to the closed valve core sealing surface to form a double medium blocking of a valve core of the stop valve and the fire-retardant core, and enhancing the reliability of the fireproof sealing.
assignees: JILIN TIANCHENG NATURAL GAS CO LTD

title_en: Training system for treating disaster using virtual reality and role playing game
title_ko: 가상현실과 rpg을 활용한 재난상황 대처 교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a training system for preparing against disaster using virtual reality and RPG, more particularly relates to an effective system for setting various disasters in virtual reality, realizing a training program system for preparing against accident and using the training program system. A variable platform apparatus for a training simulator based on the virtual reality of the present invention comprises: a contents operation unit for managing various training contents corresponding to real working environment and determining a scenario for training contents to be operated by the training simulator based on the virtual reality; an image output unit for providing training contents selected by a user with a stereoscopic image by using an augmented reality technique; a user working tool unit for supporting one or more feedbacks from a visual sense, auditory sense, touch sense and smell sense so that the user can feel the same as in the real working environment according to the scenario of the training contents determined by the contents operation unit, based on a working tool similar to a working tool used in the real world; and a tracking unit for tracking in real time the user and working environment condition and generating input information of the training simulator based on the virtual reality according to the tracking result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상현실과 RPG을 활용한 재난상황 대처 교육 시스템에 관한 것으로, 각종 재난상황을 가상현실로 설정하고 이에 대하여 안전사고에 대처할 수 있는 교육프로그램 시스템을 구현하고 이를 활용하는 보다 효과적인 시스템에 관한 것이다. 이를 위한 본 발명은 가상현실 기반 훈련 시뮬레이터를 위한 가변형 플랫폼 장치에 관한 것으로서, 실제의 작업환경에 상응하는 다양한 훈련 컨텐츠를 관리하며, 상기 가상현실 기반 훈련 시뮬레이터에서 운영될 훈련 컨텐츠의 시나리오를 결정하는 컨텐츠 운영부; 상기 사용자에 의해 선택된 훈련 컨텐츠를 증강현실 기법을 이용하여 입체영상으로 제시하는 영상 출력부; 실제 작업에서 사용되는 작업 도구와 유사한 작업 도구를 기반으로, 상기 컨텐츠 운영부에서 결정된 훈련 컨텐츠의 시나리오에 따라 사용자가 실제의 작업환경에서 느끼는 감각을 느낄 수 있도록 시각, 청각, 촉각, 및 후각중 하나 이상의 감각 피드백을 지원하는 사용자 작업도구부; 및 사용자 및 작업 환경 상태를 실시간으로 추적하여 상기 가상현실 기반 훈련 시뮬레이터의 입력 정보를 생성하는 트래킹부를 구비하는, 가상현실 기반 훈련 시뮬레이터를 위한 가변형 플랫폼 시스템이다.

title_en: Self-operable, non-invasive, non-contact bio-signal monitoring
abstract_en: Unique methods and bio-imaging systems are introduced herein for self-automated self-operable biomedical devices and methods for bio-signal monitoring, such as electrocardiograms (ECG), heart rate, and other vital signs, requiring no trained medical assistance or minimal assistance. In particular, methods and devices disclosed herein may require no dedicated medical resources, generate diagnostic quality results, and provide for motion artifact correction without inducing discomfort or irritation. Moreover, long term recording is realizable. Such methods and devices reduce the backlog of patients at out-patient wards as well as emergency response in remote areas.

title_en: Portable recording device multimedia classification system
abstract_en: This disclosure describes an apparatus and system for classifying audio and video data captured by a portable recording device. The portable recording device may comprise of a camera system enclosure that captures audio and video data that reflects a user's point-of-view perception of their surroundings. The video and/or audio data may be transmitted in real-time, or near real-time, to a Central Multimedia Management (CMM) System at a Network Operations Center, or one or more mobiles computing devices, via one or more networks. Alternatively, or additionally, the video and/or audio data may be stored within memory of the portable recording device. This disclosure further describes a CMM system that may act as a central repository of multimedia data from one or more portable recording device(s). The CMM system may further generate and assign incident report forms for each individual instance of real-time data that is recorded by a portable recording device.

title_en: Method for weighted voting in a public safety distributed ledger
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method and apparatus allow for weighted voting in a public safety distributed ledger. A first node operating in a distributed ledger network receives an incident data record of one or more other nodes to maintain a distributed ledger. The first node reviews the incident data record to determine a vote. The vote indicates whether the incident data record should be entered into the distributed ledger. The vote is sent to a second node operating in the distributed ledger network. Votes are received from the one or more other nodes, and weights are determined for each node operating in the distributed ledger network node. A weighted vote result is calculated utilizing the votes and the weights. The distributed ledger is updated with the incident data record when the weighted vote result is greater than or equal to a predetermined threshold.

title_en: Emergency treatment method of emergency treatment system for unmanned emergency ambulance
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency system and an emergency method for an unmanned emergency ambulance, wherein the emergency system calls medical record information of a patient according to emergency information of the patient provided by a patient side, makes a diagnosis, judges whether to send a following medical worker to follow according to a diagnosis result and emergency measures, dispatches the unmanned emergency ambulance meeting requirements to receive the patient before, plans a driving route of the unmanned emergency ambulance, shortens the time for the vehicle to reach the position of the patient, can implement emergency rescue on the patient after receiving the patient, monitors the condition of the patient at any time, and sends a monitoring result to a pre-selected rescue hospital, so that the hospital can prepare for receiving the patient, reduce the waiting time of the patient and improve the emergency efficiency of the patient.

title_en: Providing method, apparatus and computer-readable medium of
title_ko: 미세먼지 센싱을 통한 공기 질 개선 데이터 생성 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터-판독가능 기록매체
abstract_en: To provide a technology capable of allowing an administrative office to integrally and conveniently manage indoor air quality data of a plurality of indoor spaces within an area, according to one embodiment of the present invention, a method for generating air quality improvement data through fine dust detection executed by a computing device including one or more processors and one or more memories storing commands executed by the processors comprises: a data load step of loading an installation place of the sensor and a detailed installation position in the installation place from the identification information of the sensor included in the air quality data, when receiving air quality data including identification information and concentration value data of pollutants from a plurality of sensors detecting the concentration of pollutants including fine dust; a data storing step of using the installation place and the installation position loaded by the data loading step to accumulate and store the air quality data for each installation position in a predetermined cloud server; and a data providing step of processing the air quality data for accumulated each installation position in accordance with the data storing step based on the installation position to provide the air quality data for each installation place to the external terminal, when an air quality data providing request input for a predetermined installation place is received from an external terminal and authentication for the external terminal is validly completed.
abstract_ko: 행정 기관 등에서 지역 내의 다수의 실내의 공기 질 데이터를 통합적으로 편리하게 관리할 수 있는 기술을 제공하기 위해, 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 미세먼지 센싱을 통한 공기 질 개선 데이터 생성 방법은, 하나 이상의 프로세서 및 프로세서에서 수행 가능한 명령들을 저장하는 하나 이상의 메모리를 포함하는 컴퓨팅 장치로 구현되는 미세먼지 센싱을 통한 공기 질 개선 데이터 생성 방법에 있어서, 미세먼지를 포함하는 오염물질의 농도를 감지하는 복수의 센서들로부터 오염물질의 식별 정보 및 농도값 데이터를 포함하는 공기 질 데이터를 수신 시, 공기 질 데이터에 포함된 센서의 식별 정보로부터 센서의 설치 장소 및 설치 장소 내 세부 설치 위치를 로드하는 데이터 로드 단계;데이터 로드 단계에 의하여 로드된 설치 장소 및 설치 위치를 이용하여, 설치 위치별 공기 질 데이터를 기 마련된 클라우드 서버에 누적 저장하는 데이터 저장 단계;및 외부 단말로부터 특정 설치 장소에 대한 공기 질 데이터의 제공 요청 입력을 수신 시, 외부 단말에 대한 인증이 유효하게 완료된 경우, 데이터 저장 단계의 수행에 따라서 누적된 설치 위치 별 공기 질 데이터를 설치 장소를 기준으로 가공하여, 설치 장소 별 공기 질 데이터를 외부 단말에 제공하는 데이터 제공 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A method for extracting disaster cause automatically
title_ko: 재난원인 정보 자동 추출 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for automatically extracting disaster cause information which enables integrated management of various types of disaster-related information by a keyword dictionary and a disaster cause classification system (MEPS). The method includes: a big data formation process of storing and accumulating data converted into a consistent format by classifying the information by disaster type when various types of past disaster safety information are introduced; and a response information providing process of accumulating information in the big data when the new disaster safety information is introduced, but providing a response method by searching for similar disaster safety information in the past by machine learning.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 다양한 형식의 재난 관련 정보들을 키워드 사전 및 재난원인 분류체계(MEPS)에 의해 통합적으로 관리할 수 있도록 하는 재난원인 정보 자동 추출 방법에 관한 것으로, 
뉴스, 학술정보 DB, 보고서, 각종 SNS 등에 의한 재난 관련 정보들이 컴퓨터에 유입되면, 상기 컴퓨터에 내장된 재난원인 정보 자동 추출 및 축적 프로그램이 실행되어 재난원인 정보가 자동 추출되어 사건 정보 DB에 저장되고, 모니터에서는 결과 화면이 디스플레이되는 재난원인 정보의 자동 추출방법에 있어서, 
다양한 형식의 과거 재난안전 정보들이 유입되면 재난종류별 분류하여 일관된 형식으로 변환되어진 데이터들을 저장 및 축적하는 빅데이터 형성과정과; 
신규 재난안전 정보가 유입되면 상기 빅데이터들에 축적하되, 기계학습에 의해 과거의 유사 재난안전을 검색하여 대응방법을 제공하는 대응정보 제공과정으로 구성되는데, 
상기 빅데이터 형성과정에서는 재난관련 어휘를 추출하기 위한 키워드 사전을 사용하여 재난원인 문장이 추출되고, 별도로 유입된 뉴스 등 참고자료에서는 재난 대응방법과 관련된 메타데이터와 통계결과값이 추출되며, 상기 추출된 재난원인 문장과, 메타데이터와 통계결과값은 결합되어 원인정보 집합을 구축하고, 상기 원인정보 집합의 사건정보 DB 데이터는 재난원인 분류체계(MEPS)에 매핑되어 일관된 형식의 재난원인 분석시트로 변환되어 사건정보 DB에 저장 및 빅 데이터로 축적되며, 
상기 대응정보 제공과정에서도 재난관련 어휘를 추출하기 위한 키워드 사전을 사용하여 재난원인 문장이 추출되고, 상기 재난원인 문장에 의한 사건정보 DB 데이터는 재난원인 분류체계(MEPS)에 매핑되어 일관된 형식의 재난원인 분석시트로 변환되어 사건정보 DB에 저장 및 빅 데이터로 축적되며, 기계학습(Machine learning)에 의해 상기 축적된 빅데이터로 부터 과거 유사 재난정보가 검색되어지되, 과거 유사 재난정보는 재난 대응방법과 관련된 메타데이터 및 통계결과값을 포함하는 원인정보 집합들이 재난원인 분류체계(MEPS)에 매핑되어 재난원인 분석시트로서 제공되므로, 신규 재난안전 정보와 유사한 과거 재난안전 정보를 그 대응방법 및 피해수치 등에 대한 통계값과 함께 바로 확인할 수 있도록 제공되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Implementation of a rescue drone
abstract_en: A system and method for optimizing a rescue operation of an individual. The method comprises maintaining, by an individual engaged in an activity, an unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) associated with and in proximity to the individual. For storage at the UAV, the individual records at a recording device a message. A sensor device is configured to detect a situation requiring a need to rescue the individual at a current location, and generates a trigger signal in response to a detection. In response to the receipt of the trigger signal, a current GPS location of the individual is recorded and a launching of the UAV to traverse a flight-path to a destination location. At or before arriving at the destination location, the UAV contemporaneously provides the stored recorded message and current GPS location of the individual to an emergency response authority to inform of the individual's situation and location.

title_en: Management of medical equipment and responders
abstract_en: A system for managing responders acquiring medical equipment and responding to an emergency medical event includes mobile devices associated with responders; a computer aided dispatch (CAD), and an equipment/responder management system communicatively coupled to the mobile devices and CAD and configured to receive an event location from the CAD, retrieve medical equipment locations from a database, receive responder locations from the mobile devices, send the event and equipment locations to a first mobile device, generate an activity log for the event including first responder status information based on the responder location, the event and medical equipment locations, send the activity log to the first mobile device, send the event location and the medical equipment locations to a second mobile device, update the activity log with second responder status information based on the responder, event and medical equipment locations, and send the activity log to the mobile devices.

title_en: Roadbed slope deformation early warning system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a roadbed slope deformation early warning system which comprises a rainfall monitoring module and a rainfall monitoring module, wherein the rainfall monitoring module is used for collecting rainfall information in a slope range to be monitored and transmitting the rainfall information to a cloud platform database; the slope body data acquisition module is used for acquiring slope body information of a side slope to be monitored and transmitting the slope body information to the cloud platform database; the video monitoring system is used for acquiring environmental video information of the slope to be monitored and transmitting the environmental video information to the cloud platform database; the cloud platform database is used for analyzing, early warning and summarizing rainfall information, slope information and environment video information of a slope to be monitored to obtain a slope early warning result and slope monitoring summarized data, and transmitting the slope early warning result and the slope monitoring summarized data to the emergency command center; the utility model effectively improves the authenticity, accuracy and timeliness of the slope deformation monitoring data, realizes the automation and intellectualization of slope deformation monitoring and data analysis, and greatly improves the monitoring work efficiency.
assignees: XIAN RAILWAY ENG CO LTD;MEDIUM IRON SEVEN BUREAU GROUP LTD COMPANY

title_en: Intelligent wireless communication system for coal mine
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent communication system used underground for a coal mine. Base stations are mutually linked in a wireless manner, the base stations and terminals are also linked in the wireless manner, and the dynamic time synchronization technology capable of carrying out automatic compensation and the delayable command code and tree network intelligent routing technology are used, thereby realizing the flexible wireless communication system of dynamic deployment of the base stations with low cost, and facilitating the daily safety management and the scheduling of the coal mines and other complex environments; furthermore, the base stations have batteries, so that the intelligent communication system can also be used for accident rescue and accident scene well surface emergency communication.

title_en: Power supply dispatching emergency command module
abstract_en: Power supply dispatching emergency command module is related to the emergency first-aid repair technology of the railway system.The mould includes the unit for showing abort situation, repairing path, maintenance agency, and material depot management, material storage management, emergency preplan management, duty management, emergency first-aid repair GIS displaying, technical data inquiry, facility information query unit, it further include for showing that information unit, and live picture and text information receiving unit are set out in operation truck position, personnel.It is applied to emergency command by the emergency first-aid repair command system of core of above-mentioned module, fault location, maintenance agency, repairing equipment, repairing material, emergency preplan, technical data (drawing data, one grade of a bar) and detection can be fast implemented and repair record queries etc., meet the growth requirement of railway power system.
assignees: BEIJING TOGEST AUTOM SYS EQUIP CO LTD

title_en: Automatic tracing system and method for electric power emergency rescue operation task
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic tracing system and method for an electric power emergency rescue operation task, and relates to the technical field of electric power emergency rescue, wherein the system comprises a server, a command terminal and an automatic tracing system for the electric power emergency rescue operation task, the electric power emergency rescue operation task is constructed according to the online rate of intelligent safety caps, portable command terminals and emergency communication terminals in an area, the motion track characteristics of operators, information of the operators and information of an electric power emergency repair area, the server identifies an operation flow through the information reported by the command terminal, and then a related operation flow is added in emergency repair coordinates in an electric power repair area model until the electric power emergency operation task is finished, so that when the operators need to trace a certain subtask in the electric power emergency rescue operation task, the historical electric power emergency rescue operation task backed up in a historical task reservation module can be inquired through an inquiry module, and automatic tracing and recording can be carried out on the electric power emergency rescue operation task.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD QUJING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU

title_en: Hydropower station downstream water level sudden rise early warning method and system based on 5G technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a hydropower station downstream water level sudden rise early warning method based on a 5G technology, which relates to the technical field of hydropower station early warning, and comprises the steps of acquiring an operation load, judging whether early warning prediction is needed, acquiring data information and preprocessing; predicting to obtain a prediction result; and determining a processing scheme according to the early warning grade, issuing early warning information and carrying out flood discharge operation. The method can more accurately predict the change trend and sudden rise risk of the downstream water level of the hydropower station, improve the accuracy and timeliness of early warning, reduce the sudden rise risk and reduce the loss; by means of the high-speed and low-delay characteristics of the 5G technology, water level data are monitored in real time, and the sensing capability of sudden rise risk is improved; automatically generating early warning information, triggering corresponding countermeasures according to different early warning levels, and enhancing management and emergency response of the sudden rise risk; the method helps hydropower station management personnel and related departments to take appropriate measures, ensures the safety of downstream personnel, facilities and environments, and reduces accidents.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA RIVER YUNCHUAN HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Road bridge geological disaster monitoring and early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological monitoring, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring and early warning geological disasters of a road bridge, which comprise the following steps: positioning sensors are deployed on the supporting points of the road bridge, displacement and inclination data of the supporting points are collected, and a displacement data record is generated by recording time stamps of all the data points. According to the invention, the data in the working time period are screened, the abnormal value caused by the environmental variable is deleted, the accuracy and reliability of the data are improved, the abnormal point identification and risk assessment can be performed based on clear and consistent data, the system can accurately identify aperiodic fluctuation and abnormal displacement through comprehensive data processing and analysis, the potential geological threat can be found timely, early warning is provided before the risk develops to a more serious stage, the risk grade is intuitively displayed on a geographic diagram through visualization processing, the intuitiveness and easy understanding of risk transmission are enhanced, and clear operation guidance is provided for emergency response teams.

title_en: Comprehensive command console for simulation training
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of comprehensive command control, and discloses a comprehensive command control console for simulation training, which comprises a hardware part and a software part, wherein the hardware part comprises a control console body, a command control console computer and a hardware control panel, and the software part comprises a comprehensive control system, instructor platform software, video monitoring software and a flight analysis and comment system. The comprehensive command console simulates special conditions and weather conditions in the flight simulator training through instructor platform software, so that a pilot can deal with severe weather or other emergency situations in the real flight process, and the occurrence of flight accidents is reduced. The flight analysis and comment system is used for recording simulation data of flight simulation training and playing back the simulation data, so that a commander and a pilot can analyze unqualified places in the training after the simulation training is finished, and can adjust training items in time, and the next simulation training is more targeted.
assignees: XIAN AEROSPACE PROPULSION INSTITUTE;XIAN AEROSPACE YUANZHENG FLUID CONTROL CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling method and device for sanitation vehicles in target city
abstract_en: The invention provides a dispatching method and a dispatching device for sanitation vehicles in a target city, which relate to the technical field of sanitation vehicle dispatching and comprise the following steps: and determining the dust accumulation amount and the dust accumulation area of each detection point on the road section through dust accumulation detection equipment, determining the dust accumulation grade of the road section, and determining the sanitation vehicle scheduling strategy according to the dust accumulation grade of the target road section, the road grade, the road section length and the position information of all idle sanitation vehicles if the dust accumulation grade of the target road section is higher than the preset grade so as to clean the target road section. The method can ensure the rationality and timeliness of the sanitation vehicle dispatching, and alleviate the technical problems of unreasonable dispatching strategy and low efficiency of the existing sanitation vehicle dispatching method.

title_en: Intelligent safety monitoring system and method for coal storage silo based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coal storage silo intelligent safety monitoring system and method based on multi-source data fusion, which relate to the technical field of industrial safety monitoring and comprise the steps of collecting operation data through a multi-sensor fusion module, transmitting the multi-source data to a central control room of an application layer in real time, carrying out fusion analysis, identifying space-time association relation, constructing a comprehensive feature vector, constructing a dynamic risk assessment model and assessing the current risk level; the method comprises the steps of carrying out deep analysis on infrared thermal imaging data, extracting temperature distribution characteristics by using a convolutional neural network, identifying potential spontaneous combustion risks by combining a historical fault mode, predicting spontaneous combustion probability, automatically starting corresponding emergency response measures according to the early warning level when the risk level reaches an early warning threshold value or the spontaneous combustion probability exceeds a preset value, and displaying monitoring data, a risk assessment result and an emergency response state in a 3D visual mode to generate a safe operation report. The invention improves the reliability, timeliness and systematicness of the safety monitoring of the coal storage silo.
assignees: CHINA COAL TECH & ENGINEERING GROUP NANJING DESIGN & RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Customized content editing and distribution services according to customer requirements
title_ko: 고객의 요구사항에 따른 고객 맞춤형 컨텐츠 편집과 공급을 위한 서비스와 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A customized content editing and supplying service and method thereof that edits content according to consumer requirements are provided to store a huge amount of online/offline content and to arrange the online/offline content. CONSTITUTION: Content desired by a consumer is determined(a1). An edition layout is determined(a2). The content include online/offline content that the consumer wants. An editor acquires the copyright holder of the content(b1). The editor collects and edits the desired content(b3). The content is published in a desired form.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 수요자가 요구한 컨텐츠의 서비스에 관한 것으로, 책자 등 서지류 출판과 e-book등 전자편집물형태에 관한 것이다. 인터넷과 개인 PC 및 개인 휴대용전자기기의 등장으로 종이매체가 사라질 것으로 생각했으나, 여전히 정보획득시 집중력과 그 휴대성에서 종이의 그것을 아직 따르지 못해 여전히 종이매체는 유용하게 사용되고 있다. 또한 지식을 보관하는데 있어 전자적으로 기록된 기록물들이 하드웨어 에러, 소프트웨어 에러, 시간 경과 등으로 인해 소실될 가능성이 높으나 종이매체는 화재 등 일부 사고들을 제외한다면 월등한 저장 및 보관능력을 가지고 있다.하지만 이러한 매체들에 맞춘 컨텐츠 공급능력이 부족하다. 종이매체는 출판사와 언론사에서 콘텐츠를 만들고 있으며 E-book 또한 이들에 의해 만들어 질 것으로 생각된다. 하지만 여전히 일방적인 공급으로 수요자의 지적욕구를 만족시키기 어려울 것이다. 따라서 본 발명이 해결하고자 하는 과제는 수요자가 가치있다 판단하고 요구한 컨텐츠에 대한 편집과 그 공급에 대한 것이다. 상기의 과제는 본 발명에 따라 (a) 수요자가 컨텐츠를 요구하는 단계 및 (b) 수요자의 요구에 따라 컨텐츠를 수집, 편집하여 수요자가 원하는 형태로 공급하는 단계 로 이루어져 있다. (a) 단계에서, (a1) 수요자가 원하는 컨텐츠를 정하고, (a2) 편집 레이아웃을 정하는 단계이다. (a) 단계는 인터넷이나 우편, 혹은 사무실 접촉등 직/간접적인 접촉을 통해 이루어질 수 있다. 여기에서 컨텐츠는 수요자가 접할 수 있는 온-오프라인의 모든 컨텐츠를 포함하며 저작권 문제를 해결할 수 있는 컨텐츠이다.(b) 단계에서  (b1) 편집자가 수요자가 원하는 컨텐츠의 저작권자와 컨텐츠의 사용 권한을 획득한 후 (b2) 편집자가 수요자가 원하는 컨텐츠를 수집하여 편집하고 (b3) 서지류 출판 혹은 전자출판을 통해 수요자가 원하는 형태로 공급을 한다. 전술한 바와 같이 본 발명에 따르면, 방대한 량의 온오프라인상의 컨텐츠를 개인이 소장가능하고 정리된 출판(전자출판포함)형태로 보유할 수 있다. 향후 E-book등 전자출판물등을 볼 수 있는 휴대용전자기기가 보급될 경우 이러한 효과는 더욱 크게 확대될 것이다. 
       
     컨텐츠, 편집, 출판

title_en: Emergency operations incident command kit and method of use
abstract_en: The present invention is directed toward a system for preparing and dealing with emergency or crisis situations. In particular, the present invention comprises a comprehensive kit that provides leaders with the equipment, instructions, records and communication templates needed to guide an organization through a crisis or disaster. The kit is comprised of various electronic and communication equipment housed in protective custom foam packing as well as office supplies and a full set of intellectual management tools combining essential elements of the National Incident Management System and the Incident Command System to enable interoperability with arriving first responders and other local, state, or federal resources. The kit is stored and contained within a durable, mobile, water-resistant, impact-resistant, protective enclosure.

title_en: Towards the polygonal look personnel of maritime affairs emergency command in ring test system
abstract_en: The invention provides a kind of polygonal look personnel towards maritime affairs emergency command in ring test system, it is formed by connecting by gigabit Ethernet by three-dimensional rendering server, accident scene server, program management server, behaviour's ship terminal and control desk, and several subject forms a common participant of collaborative group in ring test.By the system set up, the behavior of collaborative group personnel in each accident task phase is tested, and the emergency disposal behavior of subject is carried out recording and sets up human behavior database, the behavior of behavior evaluation method to single subject utilizing subject to organize is evaluated, the result of evaluation and database similar cases are compared, determine the skill level of subject, for identical subject selects new for ring test case.The present invention can ensure, in the stability of ring test and continuity, to avoid being undertaken testing this group personnel by repetition case simultaneously.

title_en: Visual monitoring method and system for power transmission line iron tower erection construction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a visual monitoring method and a system for the erection construction of a power transmission line iron tower, wherein the method comprises the following steps: recording face information data registered by constructors; deploying a UAV (Unmanned Aerial Vehicle) system to a construction operation site of the iron tower assemblage; designing and writing a UAV flight route planning algorithm for avoiding collision with a bending point of an iron tower; the method comprises the steps that image acquisition equipment carried by the UAV acquires face information and an operation video of an operation site in real time; judging whether the imposition condition of constructors exists or not; and the UAV system transmits a real-time operation video of the construction site to the power grid emergency command center. According to the embodiment of the invention, the UAV automatic shooting process waypoint operation is carried out by setting the UAV fixed navigation process waypoint, the construction operation condition of the iron tower assembly of the overhead transmission line is efficiently monitored, whether the phenomenon of impersonation displacement exists or not is identified, and the personal risk of field maintainers is effectively controlled.

title_en: Armored car driving training system based on man-machine interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses an armored car driving training system based on man-machine interaction, which relates to the technical field of armored car training, wherein in the training process, collaborative operation data among commanders, drivers and blasters are monitored in real time, meanwhile, motion state data and shooting performance data of the blasters are monitored and recorded, and each key step in the training process is further ensured to be recorded and analyzed through real-time acquisition of the data; the collaborative operation analysis module constructs a coordination coefficient Xtxs according to the collaborative state set, and analyzes the response conditions of the driver and the blaster under the command of the commander in a quantized expression form; the shooting analysis module analyzes the shooting precision under different motion states, comprehensively obtains a shooting hit coefficient Smxs, can accurately evaluate the shooting level by analyzing the shooting performance of a gun, provides targeted improvement suggestions, and improves the overall shooting hit rate.

title_en: Flood prevention material scheduling method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a flood control material scheduling method, a flood control material scheduling device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-source flood control information set, generating a city flood control range, carrying out flood control and flood control risk identification on the city flood control range to obtain a city flood control risk position information set, carrying out water accumulation depth prediction on the city flood control risk position information set to obtain a water accumulation depth information set, controlling a flood warning device to push flood warning information, determining a flood control material information set and a city road condition information set, carrying out material scheduling on the flood control material information set to obtain flood control material scheduling information, generating a flood control material transportation path set, and controlling material transportation equipment to carry out material scheduling. According to the embodiment, the accuracy of waterlogging risk identification, the accuracy of early warning information pushing and the rationality and timeliness of flood control material scheduling can be improved, the waste of flood control resources is reduced, and the urban emergency response capability is improved.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for air conditioning system based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for an air conditioning system based on the Internet of things technology. And then, performing simulation analysis through a cloud digital twin model to generate performance prediction and fault point evaluation, and evaluating the fault probability by using a Bayesian network algorithm to generate personalized operation and maintenance suggestions. And then, optimizing operation parameters by adopting a genetic algorithm, and smoothly adjusting settings by adopting an adaptive control theory. When an abnormality is detected, the severity of the fault is judged by utilizing a multi-level threshold and fuzzy logic, an early warning mechanism is triggered immediately, and an emergency response scheme is pushed. And finally, recording maintenance process and user feedback, updating the digital twin model, forming a closed-loop operation and maintenance system, and ensuring high-efficiency stable operation and service quality improvement.

title_en: Coast protection dyke settlement monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a coast protection dyke settlement monitoring method, and belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering safety monitoring. The method comprises the steps of setting a longitudinal monitoring section on a slope surface on the back sea side of a dam, arranging a three-line fiber grating sensor array, periodically collecting vertical displacement and horizontal inclination angle data through a synchronous triggering unit, establishing a vertical displacement-horizontal inclination angle joint analysis model through a multi-source data fusion module, eliminating tide level interference through a Kalman filtering algorithm to generate a settlement distribution curve, triggering three-level to one-level early warning signals based on a grading early warning rule, and transmitting the three-level to terminal equipment. The method solves the problems that the traditional monitoring method cannot effectively separate tidal interference, has poor real-time performance and insufficient multi-dimensional data collaborative analysis, realizes high-precision settlement monitoring, complex environment anti-interference and quick emergency response through multi-line sensor deployment, dynamic filtering optimization and hierarchical early warning mechanisms, and remarkably improves the reliability and timeliness of dam safety monitoring.

title_en: Visual communication system based on weak current engineering and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent industry, and discloses a visual communication system based on weak current engineering and an operation method thereof, the system comprises a multi-mode signal acquisition module, an intelligent data processing module, a dual-channel communication transmission module, an interactive visualization module and an autonomous control system module. The method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting video, audio and environmental parameters through a distributed sensor array, eliminating multi-source signal deviation by adopting a space-time alignment algorithm, realizing feature fusion and quality assessment based on a deep neural network, dynamically selecting a wired and wireless mixed transmission mode, constructing an AR enhanced visual man-machine interface, and implementing a fault self-diagnosis and fault tolerance recovery mechanism. The invention reduces the error rate of the communication system, ensures the continuity and reliability of the communication process, and improves the man-machine interaction efficiency and the emergency response speed.

title_en: Detecting Apparatus and Method for Signs of Form Collapse
title_ko: 거푸집 붕괴징후 검출장치 및 그 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유로폼, 알폼, 목재폼 등과 같은 거푸집의 조립부위에 설치되어 콘크리트 타설 중 또는 양생 중에 발생할 수 있는 거푸집의 붕괴징후를 미리 예측하여 경고할 수 있도록 한 거푸집 붕괴징후 검출장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 거푸집(20)(22)의 조립부위에 설치되는 클램프(30)와, 클램프(30)에 설치되어 거푸집(20)(22) 간의 변위를 검출하기 위한 센서(40)와, 센서(40)로부터 출력되는 아날로그 출력값을 디지털신호로 변환하기 위한 A/D컨버터(50)와, A/D컨버터(50)로부터 출력되는 디지털신호와 기준치를 주기적으로 비교하여 거푸집붕괴 징후를 판독한 후 경보신호를 출력하는 마이크로콘트롤러(60)와, 마이크로콘트롤러(60)로부터 출력되는 경보신호에 의해 구동되는 경고부(70)로 구성된 것이다. 
따라서 본 발명은 거푸집에 붕괴징후가 있는 경우 육안으로 확인이 어려운 거푸집에 가해지는 변화를 센서를 이용해서 검출하여 경고할 수 있도록 구성되어 있기 때문에 거푸집 붕괴로 인한 인명사고와 물적낭비를 사전에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Divedome structure for water leisure, water leisure application for using the same and server linkageing application
title_ko: 수중 레저용 다이브 돔 구조체 및 이를 이용하기 위한 수중 레저 앱 및 이와 연동하는 서버
abstract_en: In case of the present invention, a marine leisure business can easily and externally promote a location of a marine leisure shop (diving pool, resort, etc.) and available services by use of a marine leisure application. Also, the marine leisure business may increase their customers′ interest in diving training or diving tour by submitting photos of a diving tour area and the shop on the marine leisure application. Further, it is beneficial to use an experience training program associated with the marine leisure sports which is connected to the dive dome structure at the location where the safety is ensured. Customers are able to check the location of the dive dome and reserve for a desired event in real time through the marine leisure application. Reservation on the application also allows the customers to select the marine leisure using GPS, the number of participants, the time of entering and leaving water. This registered information can be delivered to a marine safety supervisor which allows for fast emergency rescue service in case of accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 경우, 수중레저사업자는 해당 수중 레저 앱을 이용하여 수중 레저 영업장(다이빙 풀, 리조트 등)의 위치, 이용 가능한 서비스를 대외적으로 용이하게 홍보할 수 있다는 이점, 또한 수중레저사업자는 해당 수중 레저 앱을 통해 영업장의 다이빙 투어지역의 사진, 영업장 시설사진을 등록함으로써, 다이빙 교육을 희망하거나 다이빙 투어를 원하는 고객들의 흥미를 유발시킬 수 있다. 또한, 안전이 확보된 장소에서의 다이브 돔 구조체와 연계된 수중 레저 스포츠와 관련된 체험 교육 프로그램을 이용할 수 있다는 이점이 있다. 고객은 수중 레저 앱을 통해 다이브 돔에 대한 위치확인 및 실시간 예약가능 인원을 확인할 수 있고, 수중레저활동을 GPS로 지정하고 참여인원, 입수와 출수 시간을 등록할 수 있으며, 등록된 정보를 해양안전관리감독 기관에 전달함으로써, 사고발생 시 위치전송을 통해 빠르게 응급구조를 지원받을 수 있다는 이점이 있다.

title_en: P-wave band complete-polarization synthetic aperture radar surveying and mapping application system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a P-wave band complete-polarization synthetic aperture radar surveying and mapping application system which comprises a power supply extension set, a monitoring extension set, a recorder, a receiver, a transmitter, a feeder assembly, a left antenna array surface and a right antenna array surface; the left antenna array surface and the right antenna array surface respectively comprise a horizontal polarization unit and a vertical polarization unit; the horizontal polarization units and the vertical polarization units of the two antenna array surfaces are respectively connected with a horizontal polarization switch and a vertical polarization switch; and a receiving channel of the receiver comprises a horizontal polarization receiving channel and a vertical polarization receiving channel. The system is combined with a data processing method, thus effectively inhibiting radio frequency interference, and realizing high-quality complete-polarization synthetic aperture radar imaging. The system is successfully applied to major projects of emergency response of earthquake in Yushu, Qinghai, and surveying and mapping of the West of State Bureau of Surveying and Mapping, meets the strategic demand of the national major project surveying and mapping of the West, so as to practically improve the fast response capability of aerial remote sensing emergency monitoring, and has huge economic benefits and social benefits.
assignees: CN ELECT TECH NO 38 RES INST

title_en: System-level emergency response device of spacecraft
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system-level emergency response device of a spacecraft. Through adoption of a micro technology and micro devices and components, platform design and emergency mechanism design of the spacecraft are coordinated from a top layer of a spacecraft system; main emergency response functions are implemented in an emergency response device; and the platform design only considers the conventional redundancy measures, thereby reducing the coupling degree and the complexity of each spacecraft subsystem due to consideration of emergency design. The emergency response device of the spacecraft achieves an independent power supply function, a spacecraft state monitoring function and a data recording function and is not coupled with an energy subsystem, a measurement and control subsystem, a satellite service subsystem, an attitude and orbit control subsystem and the like of the spacecraft platform; when the subsystems meet emergencies in orbit, the emergency response device of the spacecraft can independently achieve a satellite-ground communication function, a low-precision attitude measurement function and the like, can provide spacecraft state monitoring data and historical spacecraft state data for the ground to eliminate failures; and the emergency response device of the spacecraft is small in volume, low in mass loss (lower than 10kg) and independent and controlled in functions.

title_en: Authentication method, recording medium, server and vehicle deploying system
abstract_en: This disclosure relates to authentication method, recording medium, server and vehicle deploying system.In authentication method in vehicle deploying system, the User ID of the user for identification is received from the terminal installation of user and identifies the subject vehicle ID of the subject vehicle of user's attempted authentication, judge whether the subject vehicle ID is consistent with the reservation vehicle ID of the reservation vehicle of user's reservation vehicle deploying for identification, at the subject vehicle ID and the reservation vehicle ID unanimous circumstances, the unlocking command for unlocking the door of the subject vehicle is sent to the subject vehicle, and, the terminal installation prompt is set to indicate that the user takes the message of the subject vehicle, in the case where the subject vehicle ID and the reservation vehicle ID are inconsistent, the terminal installation prompt is set to indicate that the subject vehicle is not the message of this case that the reservation vehicle of the user.

title_en: A kind of visual command management platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of visual commands to manage platform, including cloud platform, cloud platform and monitor terminal and multiple terminal calleds；Cloud platform includes following module: management system: for being managed to the equipment on management platform and using the personnel of platform；Intercommunication platform: it is used for intercommunication management；Locating platform: for realizing equipment positioning, motion profile tracking, fence and night watching attendance checking function；Platform of Image Recognition: recognition of face and Car license recognition are used for；Broadcast platform: for sending broadcast and being recorded to broadcast；Urgent call platform: for managing urgent call；Data platform: for storing video, audio and image data.Management platform disclosed by the invention effectively strengthens public security police's Law enforcement capability, shortens the reaction time that public security police faces emergency situations.
assignees: SHENZHEN NEWINGS ZHILIAN TECH INDUSTRIAL CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent integrated version management method, device, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an intelligent integrated version management method, an intelligent integrated version management device, an intelligent integrated version management medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: in response to receiving a user's issuance command for the item, determining a latest version of the item; after determining the latest version of the project, pulling the code of the latest version of the project from the Git server and releasing the latest version of the project to the Web server; after the latest version of the project is released, locally recording version information and state information corresponding to the latest version of the project; in response to receiving a user's rollback command for an item, a rollback version of the item is determined based on locally recorded version information and state information, and a rollback operation is performed according to the rollback version of the item. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention realizes high efficiency, simplification and intensification of version management and improves the reliability of version management.

title_en: Oil depot emergency rescue command system
abstract_en: The utility model provides an oil depot emergency rescue command system includes: the system comprises an audio and video service providing module, a field monitoring providing module, an accident information providing module and a visual interface; the audio and video service providing module is used for providing an audio communication function and a video communication function; the field monitoring providing module is used for acquiring a real-time monitoring picture corresponding to an accident field; the accident information providing module is used for acquiring accident information corresponding to the current accident; the visual interface is used for responding to the interactive operation of the user, respectively calling the corresponding functional interfaces of the audio and video service providing module, the field monitoring providing module and the accident information providing module, and integrating and displaying the data information sent by the audio and video service providing module, the field monitoring providing module and the accident information providing module. The emergency treatment efficiency of the oil depot emergency can be improved, and the timeliness is high.
assignees: CHINA NAT AVIATION FUEL CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent lock capable of preventing technical unlocking and technical unlocking preventing method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent lock capable of preventing technical unlocking and a technical unlocking preventing method, comprising the following steps: the information acquisition module is used for acquiring request parameters of a user based on a triggering request of the user to the intelligent lock, and calling corresponding detection records and authentication sequences based on type sources of the request parameters; the information verification module is used for carrying out standard detection on the request parameters based on the detection record and the identification sequence, and carrying out unlocking linkage control on a linkage device in the intelligent lock after the detection is passed; and the emergency response module is used for starting the active anti-prying monitoring after the detection fails and carrying out anti-prying alarm according to the safety state change amount of the intelligent lock based on the opening result. The accuracy of preventing technical unlocking monitoring is improved, meanwhile, the reliability and timeliness of anti-prying early warning are also improved, and the safety coefficient is improved.

title_en: Meteorological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source remote sensing data
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of disaster monitoring and early warning, and provides a meteorological disaster monitoring and early warning method based on multi-source remote sensing data, which comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source remote sensing image data of a target monitoring area; the method comprises the steps of carrying out image registration and fusion processing on multi-source remote sensing image data to obtain registered multi-mode remote sensing images, identifying and extracting potential weather disaster target areas from the registered multi-mode remote sensing images based on a preset disaster target extraction model, carrying out hierarchical locking identification, extracting disaster characteristic parameters of the potential weather disaster target areas, carrying out comprehensive evaluation based on a preset disaster evaluation model, generating disaster risk level evaluation results, generating weather disaster early warning information according to the disaster risk level evaluation results, and carrying out early warning, thereby effectively improving weather disaster monitoring accuracy and greatly enhancing emergency response timeliness.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Method and apparatus for contolling replay of (an) image display device
title_ko: 영상표시기기의 재생 제어장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A method and an apparatus for controlling reproduction of an image display device are provided to enable a user to set conditions for simultaneously reproducing and recording, thereby automatically deleting recording programs after reproducing the programs. An apparatus for controlling reproduction of an image display device comprises the followings: a key input unit for inputting a user request command; a memory for storing a reproduction condition related to associated recording programs and recording conditions; a control unit for reproducing and deleting recording programs stored according to reproduction conditions stored in the memory; and a display unit for displaying images and menu images for selecting reproduction condition selection and a recording condition desired by a user through the key input unit according to a control signal of the control unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 저장기능을 갖는 영상표시기기에서 사용자가 예약녹화나 즉시 녹화를 할 경우 녹화물에 대하여 라이프 타임(Life Time)을 설정할 수 있도록 한 영상표시기기의 저장영상 제어장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     즉, 본 발명은 사용자가 녹화를 설정함에 있어서, 해당 녹화물의 재생조건을 동시에 설정하도록 한 것으로 녹화물의 재생횟수 및 보존기간 등을 설정함으로써 사용자가 설정한 재생조건에 따라 재생 및 녹화물 삭제가 자동으로 이루어질 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
     따라서 본 발명에 따른 영상표시기기의 저장영상 제어장치 및 방법은 사용자가 녹화설정과 동시에 재생을 위한 재생조건을 설정함으로써 장기간 보존이 필요없는 프로그램에 대해 녹화재생 후 자동 삭제가 가능하며, 녹화물의 저장을 선택적으로 제어함으로써 저장매체를 보다 효율적으로 활용할 수 있을 뿐만아니라, 사용자가 한 번의 설정만으로 별도의 수작업 없이도 삭제가 가능함으로써 사용자에게 보다 편리함을 제공할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
       
     녹화/재생

title_en: VOC Monitering System by Using Big data and Method thereof
title_ko: 빅 데이터를 이용한 voc 모니터링 시스템 및 이를 이용한 voc 모니터링 방법
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to maximize a client service by automatically collecting requests requested through calls or messages by hundreds of thousands, millions of clients and complaints of the clients in real time, by storing and analyzing the requests and the complaints, and by responding to the requests and the complaints. The present invention relates to a voice of customer (VOC) monitoring system using big data. The system comprises: a salesman smart terminal to register a related client telephone number by installing a VOC application, to automatically record a voice on the phone with a client, and to store a text by automatically converting the voice into the text, and to transmit a voice record file and a voce conversion text to a VOC server when the phone with the client is terminated; a VOC server to store the voice record file and the voice conversion text received from the salesman smart terminal, to classify and arrange a service request and dissatisfaction expression of the client by using a text mining technique such as automatically opened keyword search, to confirm a call statement and message contents of the corresponding client according to a priority after determining an emergency response priority, and to transmit a response manual to a service smart terminal held by a service managing employee; and a service smart terminal to process the response manual of the corresponding client by receiving the response manual of the corresponding client from the VOC server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명 빅데이터를 이용한 VOC 모니터링 시스템은 VOC 어플을 설치하여 관련 고객 전화번호를 등록하며 고객과의 전화 시에 음성을 자동으로 녹화하며 음성을 텍스트로 자동 변환하여 저장하고 고객과의 통화 종료 시에 음성 녹음 파일 및 음성 변환 텍스트를 VOC(Voice of Customer) 서버로 전송하는 영업사원 스마트 단말기와, 상기 영업사원 스마트 단말기로부터 수신되는 음성 녹음 파일 및 음성 변환 텍스트를 저장하고 자동으로 열어서 키워드 검색과 같은 텍스트 마이닝 기법을 이용하여 먼저 고객이 서비스를 요청한 것인지 불만을 표출한 것인지를 구분하여 정리하고 긴급 대응 우선 순위를 결정한 후 우선 순위에 따라 해당 고객의 통화 내역 및 메시지 내용을 확인하며 대응 메뉴얼을 서비스 담당 직원이 소지한 서비스 스마트 단말기로 전송하는 VOC 서버와, 상기 VOC 서버로부터 해당 고객의 대응 메뉴얼을 수신하여 처리하도록 하는 서비스 스마트 단말기로 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다.

title_en: Fusion dual IR camera and image fusion algorithm using LWIR and SWIR
title_ko: Lwir 및 swir를 이용한 융합 듀얼 ir 카메라 및 영상융합 알고리즘
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a dual infrared (IR) camera consisting of long wavelength infrared (LWIR) and short wavelength infrared (SWIR). In order to improve the existing problems that it is difficult to identify life saving or safety accidents in a harsh environment, a fusion dual IR camera using LWIR and SWIR comprises: an LWIR and SWIR modules provided with a camera link interface; and an image data processing process board for performing predetermined image processing on image data transferred from the modules and displaying the image data on an LCD. The image data processing process board comprises: an AD converter; a field programmable gate array (FPGA); and a dual memory consisting of two memory banks.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 LWIR 및 SWIR로 이루어진 듀얼 IR카메라에 관한 것으로서, 특히 여러 개의 IR 센서 데이터 선택 기능 기술과, 개별 IR 센서 데이터의 특성을 활용하여 식별 성능 기술과, SWIR의 영상과 LWIR의 영상에 대한 각 장점을 보정 및 합성하는 기술이 구현된 LWIR 및 SWIR 센서를 이용한 융합 듀얼 IR 카메라 및 영상융합 알고리즘에 관한 것이다.  
종래의 LWIR 카메라와 SWIR 카메라는 열화상만 보여주거나 안개 투과 등만이 확인되기 때문에 열악한 환경의 인명 구조나 안전사고에 대한 확인이 어려운 문제점을 개선하기 위해, 본 발명은 카메라 링크 인터페이스가 구비된 LWIR 모듈 및 SWIR 모듈과 상기 LWIR 모듈 및 SWIR 모듈에서 전달된 영상 데이터에 소정의 이미지처리를 수행하여 LCD에 디스플레이하는 영상 데이터 처리 프로세스 보드(PROCESS BOARD)로 이루어지고, 상기 영상 데이터 처리 프로세스 보드는 아날로그신호를 디지털신호로 변환하는 AD컨버터와; 상기 변환된 디지털신호의 영상 데이터를 입력된 CLK에 동기화하여 각각의 R,G,B 영상 데이터를 만들고, sync신호를 이용하여 프레임별로 데이터를 만들어 메모리에 read  및 write 하여 듀얼 IR Data 처리하는 FPGA와; 상기 FPGA에서 손상되지 않은 영상데이터를 실시간으로 전송하기 위해 2개의 메모리 뱅크로 구성된 듀얼 메모리를 포함하여 구성된 것을 특징으로 하는 LWIR 및 SWIR를 이용한 융합 듀얼 IR 카메라를 제안한다. 
또한, 카메라의 CCD/CMOS로 영상을 취득할 때, 제한된 DR(dynamic range) 문제 및 잡음과 번짐 같은 왜곡 현상 발생 문제 등을 최소화하기 위해 영상을 여러 장 취득하여 영상융합(image fusion)하되, 융합하는 대상을 기준으로 하여 국소연산자로 영상 평면과 변환 평면에서 수행하는 것으로서 변환 평면에서의 처리는 계수들을 처리하고, 영상 평면에서는 전역적인 영상처리하는 픽셀 레벨 (pixel level)과, 영상을 영역별로 나누고 영역마다의 특징들을 이용해 영역들을 융합하는 특징 레벨(feature level)과, 영상의 디스크립션 (description)을 결합하는 기호 레벨 (symbol level)중 어느 하나를 선택하고, HDRI(high dynamic range imaging)에서 래디언스 맵을 생성하고, 잡음을 고려해 톤 매핑을 수행한 후 영상을 다단계로 분해하여 저조도에서 발생하는 알갱이 형태의 잡음을 분해 및 제거하는 라디언스 맵을 사용하는 기술, 중첩이나 컬러 코딩으로부터 영상 합성이 가능한 주간 CCD 영상 합성 기술, LWIR과 SWIR의 영상을 합하고 보상을 위해 추가적인 디지털 영상처리 기술이 적용되는 야간 적외선 영상 융합기술을 복합하여 적용하는 것을 특징으로 하는 LWIR 과 SWIR를 이용한 융합 듀얼 IR 카메라의 영상융합 알고리즘을 제안한다.  
따라서, 본 발명에 의한 LWIR 과 SWIR를 이용한 융합 듀얼 IR 카메라는 LWIR과 SWIR의 장점을 결합하여 피 식별 대상에 대한 LWIR의 인체의 열 온도와 SWIR의 선명한 영상을 결합하여 우수한 식별 능력을 제공하므로, 첨단 군사 제품을 비롯한 국방 및 민간 부분의 선명한 영상정보획득이 가능한 효과가 있다. 또한, 본 발명은 완전한 어둠 속에서도  선명한 이미지를 제공하고 비접촉 방식으로 영상 및 온도를 측정할 수 있으므로 광범위한 용도에 적용이 되므로  건물의 열효율, 생산현장의 이상 유무 감지 등에 적용시 탁월한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Remote robot coding education system
title_ko: 원격 로봇 코딩 교육 시스템
