abstract_en: The present invention relates to a non-face-to-face remote robot coding education system, wherein students receiving non-face-to-face online classes at home write a control command (program) to control a robot located in a separated space such as a classroom or auditorium, and transmit the control command through a teacher terminal located in the same space as a place where the robot is present, to remotely control the robot.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 각 가정에서 비대면 온라인 수업을 받는 학생들이 교실이나 강당 등의 이격된 공간에 위치한 로봇을 제어하는 제어명령(프로그램)을 작성하고, 제어명령을 로봇과 동일 공간에 위치한 교사 단말을 통해 전송하여 원격으로 로봇을 콘트롤하는 비대면 원격 로봇 코딩 교육 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Service unit switching method, system and apparatus
abstract_en: Provided by the embodiment of the present application are a service unit switching method, a system and an apparatus. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target service unit; triggering the target service unit to issue first routing information according to configuration information of a first service unit with regard to a first load balancing task, so as to replace the first service unit for providing flow distribution service to the first load balancing task. When a disaster recovery and a capacity dispatch are required for the whole service network, the method provided by the embodiment of the present application is applied to effectively improve the real-timeliness of flow switching, avoiding the problem of poor real-time flow switching caused by the influence of DNS cache in the prior art.

title_en: Social treatment work order dispatching method, medium and equipment based on emergency degree assessment
abstract_en: The invention provides a social treatment work order dispatching method, medium and equipment based on emergency degree assessment, and belongs to the technical field of social treatment information. The method comprises the steps of collecting text data and image data in a social management work order, calling a text encoder and an image encoder, converting the text data and the image data into text feature vectors and image feature vectors respectively, detecting consistency of the text feature vectors and the image feature vectors of the same work order, calculating emotion intensity based on the text feature vectors, combining dangerous degree and time codes of corresponding work order events, splicing the generated vectors into a trained neural network model, generating a work order emergency index, dividing the emergency degree of the work order by comparing the work order emergency index with a preset threshold, and dispatching the work order according to the emergency degree of the work order. The invention obviously improves the disposal timeliness of the social treatment worksheet by introducing the cross characteristic, residual connection and Swish-activated multi-layer perceptron network.

title_en: Portable black-box device and system for detecting and transmitting emergency situations, and controlling method for the same
title_ko: 이벤트 발생을 자동으로 감지 및 전송하는 개인 휴대용 블랙박스 장치와 시스템 및 그의 작동 제어 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a portable mobile black box device for an individual. The mobile black box device according to an embodiment of the present invention includes: an event detection module detecting an event signal; a camera module collecting the image data of an event area; a storage module storing the image data; a GPS module collecting the location information of the event area; a communication module which transmits the event information to a predetermined user terminal at least partially; a power supply module supplying power to the black box device; and a control module which uses the event signal detected by the event detection module and controls the operation of the camera module, storage module, the GPS module, and the communication module according to the event occurrence status.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 인 휴대용 블랙박스 장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 이벤트 신호를 감지하는 이벤트 감지 모듈; 상기 이벤트 발생 지역의 영상 데이터를 수집하는 카메라 모듈; 상기 영상 데이터를 저장하는 저장 모듈; 상기 이벤트 발생 지역의 위치 정보를 수집하는 GPS 모듈; 상기 영상 데이터 및 상기 위치 정보를 포함하는 군에서 선택된 적어도 하나 이상의 이벤트 발생 정보를 미리 지정된 사용자 단말기에 전송하는 통신 모듈; 상기 개인 휴대용 블랙박스 장치에 작동 전원을 공급하는 전원 공급 모듈; 및 상기 이벤트 감지 모듈로부터 감지된 이벤트 신호를 이용하여 이벤트 발생을 판단하고, 이벤트 발생 여부에 따라 상기 카메라 모듈, 저장 모듈, GPS 모듈 및 통신 모듈의 작동을 제어하는 제어 모듈을 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 이벤트 발생을 자동으로 감지 및 전송하는 개인 휴대용 블랙박스 장치에 따르면, 이벤트 감지 모듈 및 카메라 모듈을 포함함으로써 자동으로 이벤트 발생을 판단하며 이벤트 발생 상황을 실시간으로 녹화하여 상황 파악 및 사후 증거 자료로의 활용이 가능하도록 하고, GPS 모듈 및 미리 지정된 사용자 단말기에 이벤트 발생 정보를 전송하는 통신 모듈을 포함함으로써 이벤트 발생 위치 정보 및 녹화 영상을 외부 기기에 전송할 수 있어 장기간의 메모리 저장이 가능해지고, 신속한 외부 도움 요청이 가능할 뿐만 아니라, 자체 내장 전원 공급 모듈을 포함함으로써 개인이 휴대하고 다니면서 위급 상황에 용이하게 대응할 수 있도록 한다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 이벤트 감지 모듈을 제1 센서부 및 제2 센서부로 구성하여, 1차로 사용자의 목소리 크기를 감지(제1 센서부)하고 2차로 기울기 등의 변화를 감지(제2 센서부)하는 2차적 인지 구조를 채택함으로써, 블랙박스가 작동되어야 하는 이벤트 발생 판단의 정확도를 향상시킬 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명에 따르면, 제어 모듈이 이벤트 발생으로 판단하면, 사고 폴더를 생성하여 미리 정해진 시간(10초)동안의 녹화와, 대기 및 이벤트 발생 재판단을 반복하는 구성을 채택함으로써 효율적인 영상 데이터 녹화가 가능하도록 하고, 지속적 이벤트 발생으로 판단되는 경우에는 미리 지정된 사용자 단말기 또는 미리 지정된 연락처에 이벤트 발생 정보를 전송하는 구성을 채택함으로써 신속 정확하게 타인에게 이벤트 발생 상황을 전달할 수 있다. 
한편, 본 발명에 따르면, 이벤트 감지 모듈을 통해 자동으로 이벤트 신호를 감지함과 동시에, 긴급 버튼을 더 포함하여 사용자의 입력으로 이벤트 신호를 발생시키는 구성을 채택함으로써, 사용자가 위협을 가해 소리를 지를 수 없는 등의 이벤트 감지 모듈의 센서가 작동되지 않는 상황에서도 사용자가 수동으로 이벤트 내역을 기록하고 전송할 수 있다.

title_en: Routing method for fire fighting rescue network and communication device
abstract_en: The invention provides a routing method for the fire fighting rescue network and a communication device. The routing method comprises steps that, to-be-transmitted fire fighting data is acquired through a wireless sensing element; a next base station type node and a node type which can receive the fire fighting data are determined, the node type is a fire fighting command vehicle, the node is taken as a target node, and a final routing path from the wireless sensing element to the target node is determined; if the node type is a relay base station, a routing path from the wireless sensing element to the node is recorded, a relay routing path from the node to the fire fighting command vehicle is acquired, and the fire fighting vehicle is taken as the target node to determine the final routing path; through the data transmission method based on a balancing network load, data transmission is carried out according to the final routing path. The communication device comprises the wireless sensing element and wireless coverage and relay equipment which are in mutual wireless communication. Through the method, the optimum routing capable of accomplishing data transmission can be searched among various nodes, and the method further has advantages of rapid transmission speed, high efficiency and high accuracy.
assignees: HARBIN HUAXIA KUANGAN TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Chemicals production device actual time safety method for early warning
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of chemicals production device actual time safety method for early warning, the problem of subsystems fail messages such as existing chemicals process units technological parameter, equipment, interlocking, pressure relief device, torch, fire-fighting are scattered, major accident danger million can not in time be recognized, found and be handled mainly is solved.The present invention is by using a kind of chemicals production device actual time safety method for early warning, pass through data mining technology, concentrate mapping techniques, Early-warning Model, early warning classification rule, warning information treatment principle etc., cell arrangement systematic failure information is monitored in real time, grading forewarning system, and responsible person concerned is sent in time, realize that failure is found in time, problem is handled in time, cut-out in time feeds or stopped in emergency before major accident danger million, and event handler procedure is recorded, statistical analysis simultaneously preferably solves above mentioned problem as knowledge base for the technical scheme that similar incidents next time provide reference, available in chemicals production device actual time safety early warning.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP QINGDAO SAFETY ENG INST

title_en: Big data application method and system for environmental monitoring law enforcement decision
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data application method for environment supervision and law enforcement decision, which comprises the following steps: data acquisition and integration: cleaning and integrating government affair data resources of internal and external pollution sources, and converging and integrating multi-source data; data mining analysis: analyzing the multi-source data after the convergence and integration is finished; generating an intelligence clue: generating an information clue for environmental monitoring and law enforcement according to the data analysis result, and managing the information according to the weight; generating an information image: according to the generated information clue, labeling the enterprise problem to generate an enterprise information image; closed loop intelligence application: according to the information clue, developing information research and judgment, information order distribution, information processing and result feedback closed-loop application management; evaluating intelligence efficiency: according to the information processing condition, the research and judgment, the dispatch and the transaction of the information are evaluated. By adopting the method, the problems that the environmental protection data can not be effectively applied and the like are solved, and the timeliness and the accuracy of law enforcement can be improved.
assignees: FOSHAN NANHAI DISTRICT ENVIRONMENT TECH CENTER

title_en: Network security event response method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method, a device and equipment for responding to a network security event, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a network security event; when the type of the detected network security event is a network attack event, matching attack source information of the network attack event with an attack record, and determining attack times corresponding to the attack source information; if the attack times meet the triggering condition, performing linkage disposal on the network attack event; and if the attack times do not meet the triggering condition, matching the feature information of the network attack event with the feature library, and determining emergency response information corresponding to the feature information so as to respond to the network attack event according to the emergency response information. According to the technical scheme disclosed by the invention, the automatic linkage handling of the network attack can be realized, and the response efficiency of the network attack event is improved.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSEC NETWORK SECURITY TECH CO LTD;BEIJING TOPSEC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;Beijing topsec software co ltd

title_en: Flood water level monitoring method and system for power equipment facilities
abstract_en: The invention discloses a flood water level monitoring method and a system for power equipment facilities, wherein the method starts a flood water level monitoring flow for the power equipment facilities after receiving flood disaster emergency response notice and strong rainfall defense alarm; according to the individual area of the electrical equipment facility, the total area of the electrical equipment facility and the water level sensing monitoring information of the electrical equipment facility body, which are affected by flood disasters, a neural network for measuring the damage range of the electrical equipment facility area due to the disasters is constructed, and the submerged surface height monitoring result of the area where the electrical equipment facility is located is output. The method and the system creatively realize the function of monitoring the flood disaster-causing and disaster-suffering power equipment facility area in all weather and in real time based on hydrologic release data and water level monitoring data, overcome the difficulty of measuring and calculating the height of the submerged surface of the area where the power equipment facility is located, and have excellent timeliness and accuracy in monitoring results of the submerged height, the submerged degree and the moment of the disaster-suffering power equipment facility area.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Nonvolatile memory data destruction method and device based on multistage processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for destroying nonvolatile memory data based on multistage processing. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining user data to be stored, judging and recording whether the user data is secret related information, storing the secret related information in a non-encryption user data storage and storage unit, encrypting the user data by using an encrypted ciphertext key generated by an encryptor to form ciphertext data, storing the ciphertext data and the ciphertext key in the storage unit, detecting a control signal for destroying the data, firstly rewriting configuration information for the non-encryption information, deleting the user data, erasing the ciphertext key of the encryption information, judging whether the data to be destroyed needs emergency response, if not, erasing the ciphertext data, and if yes, carrying out chip burning treatment on the storage unit by using a high-voltage output unit. The invention is beneficial to improving the data security, improving the response speed of destroying the data and reducing the use cost.

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent warehousing equipment collaborative decision-making system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent warehousing equipment collaborative decision-making system and method based on digital twinning, and relates to the technical field of intelligent warehousing management. The intelligent warehousing equipment collaborative decision-making system based on digital twinning comprises a digital twinning synchronization module, a data processing module, an equipment collaborative strategy optimization module and a decision execution module. According to the invention, the synchronization condition among real-time data in the constructed storage digital twin model is monitored in real time to acquire the real-time data synchronization effectiveness score, meanwhile, the real-time synchronization data is processed to acquire the data processing evaluation index, then, whether to adjust the cooperation strategy parameters is judged based on the acquired cooperation strategy effect evaluation value, finally, a cooperation decision is generated and whether to trigger an emergency response mechanism is judged, so that the improvement of the reliability of cooperation performance evaluation in the intelligent storage equipment construction and cooperation decision process is realized, and the problem of low reliability of cooperation performance evaluation in the intelligent storage equipment construction and cooperation decision process in the prior art is solved.
assignees: UNIV LONGYAN;LONGYAN TOBACCO IND CO LTD;FUJIAN FENGXING ELECTROMECHANICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Landslide risk prediction method and related device based on multi-source information fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides a landslide risk prediction method and a related device based on multi-source information fusion. The method comprises the steps of collecting original data of k monitoring points in a landslide to be predicted in a collection time period to obtain an original data set containing k monitoring points, respectively carrying out standardization processing on the k original data in the original data set to obtain a standardized data set, carrying out space-time diagram construction by adopting the standardized data set and position information of the k monitoring points to obtain a target space-time diagram network, carrying out space feature extraction on the target space-time diagram network to obtain space features of n collection moments in the collection time period, carrying out time feature extraction on the space features of n collection moments in the collection time period to obtain space-time feature vectors, and carrying out prediction decoding processing on the space-time feature vectors to obtain landslide displacement prediction results. The method improves the accuracy and timeliness of landslide prediction and enhances the emergency response and decision support capability of related departments.
assignees: CHINA MERCHANTS CHONGQING COMMUNICATIONS TECH RESEARCH & DESIGN INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power station intelligent emergency response and decision support system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency response and decision support system and method for a nuclear power station. The system comprises a distributed data processing terminal, an emergency data acquisition terminal, an intelligent decision support terminal, an adaptive emergency measure management terminal, a man-machine interaction terminal and a real-time running state display terminal, wherein the distributed data processing terminal is used for carrying out distributed preprocessing on emergency data to obtain processed emergency data and transmitting the processed emergency data to the emergency data acquisition terminal, the emergency data acquisition terminal is used for collecting the processed emergency data respectively transmitted by the distributed data processing terminals, the intelligent decision support terminal is used for determining decision support information based on analysis processing results of the processed emergency data, the adaptive emergency measure management terminal is used for screening corresponding emergency measures from a preset emergency measure library according to the decision support information and executing the emergency measures, and the man-machine interaction terminal is used for displaying the decision support information, the emergency measure information and the real-time running state of each device in the nuclear power station. According to the technical scheme, the accuracy and timeliness of emergency measure implementation can be improved, so that the emergency treatment quality of the system in operation and maintenance of the nuclear power station is improved.
assignees: STATE POWER INVEST NUCLEAR ENERGY CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING

title_en: Real-time monitoring system for deformation of coal mining and use method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a real-time monitoring system for coal mining deformation, which comprises a physical layer, a transmission layer, a processing layer and an application layer, wherein the using method of the system comprises the steps of laying a main optical fiber and a branch optical fiber, connecting a data processing unit with an optical fiber sensing head, collecting strain data, denoising, normalizing and constructing a sequence on the data, predicting the strain time sequence data of the optical fiber, carrying out discriminant analysis and hierarchical early warning on predicted value and actual value residual errors, triggering a three-dimensional visualization platform to update abnormal labels, inquiring historical deformation records, and practicing an emergency response plan. The system has the characteristics of strong continuous monitoring capability, strong real-time performance, high deployment flexibility and good visualization effect, and the safety and the production efficiency of the coal mine are obviously improved.
assignees: CHINA COAL XIAN DESIGN ENGINEERING CO LTD

title_en: Method of emergency calling with tracking position of mobile terminal in mobile communication network
title_ko: 이동통신망의 단말기 위치추적을 이용한 비상호출 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An emergency calling method using the terminal position tracking of a mobile communication network is provided to offer surrounding environmental data in which a sound and an image are included and location information. CONSTITUTION: A portable terminal joined/registered in a mobile communication network by a service center requests the subscription/registration for an emergency call service(S10). The intrinsic phone number and machine serial number of the portable terminal and personal identity data of a subscriber is confirmed and inputted(S20). A service selected among plural emergency call services is registered(S30). The portable terminal which registers a service requests the emergency call service(S40). After providing the service by a corresponding service routine, a bill is provided(S50).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이동통신망의 단말기 위치추적을 이용한 비상호출 방법에 관한 것으로, 특히, 서비스 센터에 의하여 휴대단말기가 안심 호출 서비스를 요청하면 휴대단말기의 등록된 가입자 정보를 검색하고 통신하여 현장정보를 수집하는 과정; 서비스 센터는 긴급지원이 필요한 상황이면 공공기관에 지원요청하고 지정된 가족에게 비상호출 상태를 메시지로 통보하는 과정; 서비스 센터에 의하여 지정된 용역업체에 현장정보를 실시간 제공하는 과정; 용역업체로부터 현장에 출동하고 안전 조치한 결과의 데이터를 제공받는 과정; 서비스 센터에 의하여 용역업체에 보상 처리하고 지정된 가족에게 안전조치 결과의 데이터를 메시지로 통보하며, 휴대단말기에 과금 처리하는 과정; 을 포함하고, 상기 휴대단말기에 의하여 요청된 안심 호출 서비스를 취소하는 경우에 소정의 비밀번호를 서비스 센터에 입력하고, 현장정보는 휴대단말기의 현재 위치, 소리, 영상 데이터와 지정된 장소의 출입 확인 데이터가 포함되는 것 중에서 선택된 어느 하나 이상이고, 휴대단말기는 소정 시간 동안 현장정보를 기록 저장하고, 서비스 센터는 휴대단말기와 통신하여 현장정보를 실시간 수집하는 것을 특징으로 하여, 위급한 상황에서 현장의 상황을 정확하게 확인하여 안전조치를 신속하게 제공받고, 홈단말기에 의하여 집안의 화재, 외부인의 무단 침입을 자동 감지하고 안전조치를 취하며, 대중교통 수단인 택시에 탑승하는 경우 차량데이터를 인식에 의하여 목적지에 안전하게 도착함을 확인하도록 하고, 레저, 여행, 운전 중에 사고가 발생하는 경우는 자동 추적되는 현재 위치정보에 의하여 구 조되며, 자녀 및 노약자의 등하교, 야외활동을 안전하게 보호받는 효과가 있다.  
       
     비상, 호출, 휴대단말기, 안전, 긴급, 지원, 구조, 이동통신, 서비스, 안심

title_en: Platform-based Korean language education system and education method
title_ko: 플랫폼 기반의 국어교육 시스템 및 교육 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a platform-based education system and an education method. According to an aspect of the present invention, in a system including a plurality of blocks and a terminal communicating with the plurality of blocks, the plurality of blocks may include: a first block including a sensor unit for receiving a first command of a user; a second block including a communication unit for receiving a second command from the terminal; a third block including an output unit for outputting first information based on at least one of the first command and the second command; and a fourth block including a control unit for controlling operations of the first to third blocks. The terminal may include: a display unit on which a tool for programming block coding for the second command is displayed; and a terminal communication unit for transmitting the determined second command to the plurality of blocks through block coding of the tool.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 플랫폼 기반의 교육 시스템 및 교육 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 양상인 복수의 블록 및 상기 
복수의 블록과 통신하는 단말을 포함하는 시스템에 있어서, 상기 복수의 블록은, 사용자의 제 1 명령을 입력 받 
기 위한 센서부를 포함하는 제 1 블록; 상기 단말로부터 제 2 명령을 전달 받기 위한 통신부를 포함하는 제 2 블 
록; 상기 제 1 명령 및 상기 제 2 명령 중 적어도 하나를 기초로 제 1 정보를 출력하는 출력부를 포함하는 제 3 
블록; 및 상기 제 1 블록 내지 제 3 블록의 동작을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하는 제 4 블록;을 포함하고, 상기 단 
말은, 상기 제 2 명령을 위한 블록 코딩을 프로그래밍하는 도구(tool)가 표시되는 디스플레이부; 및 상기 도구의 
블록 코딩을 통해, 결정된 상기 제 2 명령을 상기 복수의 블록으로 전송하는 단말 통신부;를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and Methods for Forming and Operating an Ecosystem for a Conducted Electrical Weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment (e.g., ecosystem) for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: Cargo vessel operator emergency response system, with operator directives, incident data recording and reporting, and automated relevant party notification
abstract_en: A method, computer program product, mobile communication device, and a shipment tracking system provide automated incident recording, reporting, and response protocols, including operator directives. The method includes receiving an input identifying an occurrence of an incident associated with a shipment entity, the shipment entity being one or more of a vessel, an operator, and a cargo being transported via the vessel. The method includes, in response to the input, presenting on a user interface (UI) of an operator mobile communication device (MCD) one or more selectable incident reporting options to activate incident response, data recording, and reporting (IRDRR) protocols. The method further includes generating and presenting an incident response UI that instructs the operator of specific sequence of steps to take in response to the incident and to complete an incident information gathering process. The method further includes automatically transmitting/uploading a notification of the incident to an incident management server.

title_en: Control method of fire-fighting liquid supply system and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method of a fire-fighting liquid supply system and a storage medium thereof, belonging to the technical field of fire protection. The control method comprises the following steps that a controller reads a firefighter command from a command input module at preset time intervals delta t, performs control operation once and records the control operation, t=0 is the starting time of the fire-fighting liquid supply system, and the control operation is performed according to a specified rule at the time t=i delta t according to the command at the time, the valve opening, the rotating speed of the adjustable motor and the control operation record after starting. The invention can realize flexible, rapid, efficient and reliable adjustment of the spray flow and the spray speed while saving the operation energy consumption and prolonging the operation life.

title_en: Apparatus and method of car diagnosis service using telematics
title_ko: 텔레매틱스를 이용한 차량 진단 서비스 장치 및 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 텔레매틱스에 관한 것으로, 특히 차량의 다양한 상태 정보를 텔레매틱스 단말기에 수신 저장하고 기록된 차량상태 정보를 차량의 기준 데이터와 비교 판단하여 이상이 발생시에는 텔레매틱스 단말기의 화면으로 제공하고, 필요시에는 긴급정비 혹은 긴급출동 서비스를 요청 처리하는 텔레매틱스를 이용한 차량 진단 서비스 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명의 장치는 차량관리 데이터베이스를 설치하고 차량 정보를 CAN 통신부에서 수신하여 상기 차량 관리 데이터 베이스에 기록하여 기준데이터와 비교 판단하여 차량의 이상 여부를 판단하고 차량 진단 메시지를 생성하여 필요시 서비스를 요청하는 텔레매틱스 단말기와, 텔레매틱스 단말기와 이동통신으로 연결되어 상기 차량 진단 메시지를 수신하고 상기 차량에서 요청한 서비스를 연결하고 출동차량의 단말기로 상기 차량의 위치정보를 제공하는 차량관리 서비스센터와, 차량관리 서비스센터에서 상기 차량 진단 메시지를 수신하여 상기 차량의 고장 원인을 파악하고 운전자가 요청한 정비 예약, 긴급 견인, 출동서비스를 제공하도록 제어하는 차량 서비스부를 포함함을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Intergration Environment Monitoring System that The Center Control is possible
title_ko: 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기업, 정부기관, 건물 내의 자료를 저장 보관하는 서버 실과 같은 주요시설의 환경정보를 실시간 감시하여 획득한 정보를 통해 화재와 도난뿐만 아니라, 자료 소실 및 손실을 가질 수 있는 상황을 사전 감지하여 대응할 수 있도록 도와주는 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템이다. 
본 발명의 목적은  건물 내의 환경을 종합적으로 감시 및 제어하여 바람직한 건물 환경을 제공할 수 있도록 한 환경감시(온도, 습도),보안감시(출입자 유무 확인),화재감시(연기센서), 영상감시(CCTV),전원감시(Main 전원,보조전원(UPS)) 및 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템을 제공하는 데 그 목적이 있다. 
상기한 목적을 달성하기 위하여 본 발명에 따른 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템은, 
전체적인 제어를 위한 제어부(MCU)와, 건물 내의 환경감시, 보안감시, 화재감시, 영상감시, 전원감시 등의 환경을 감시하는 복수의 감지센서부(3)(5)(7)(9)(11)와, 상기 센 서부로부터 감지된 환경 정보가 입력되는 신호 입력부(4), Ext. Interrupt(6), 영상신호 입력부(8),ADC(10),GPIO(12)와, 
상기 부에 연결되어 환경 정보를 처리하는 신호처리부와, 처리된 환경 데이터를 클라이언트에 전송하는 인터페이스와, 전송된 환경정보 결과를 출력하는 클라이언트로 구성한다. 
상기 전송된 결과를 클라이언트의 환경 감시 프로그램으로 설정된 기준 정보 데이터를 초과 또는 이상 시 경보음을 울리게 한다. 
또한, 이러한 정보를 종합해서 상황을 유추할 수 있으며, 기준 정보 데이터의 설정 값과 경보음을 변경할 수 있도록 인터페이스 되어 있다. 추가로 상기 수집된 환경 정보와 통신연결 유무를 LAN 통신으로 중앙통제 감시 시스템에 전송하고 기 전송된 정보의 상황을 분석하여 해당 예하 클라이언트에 상황대처 지시를 하달할 수 있도록 설계한다. 
본 발명에 의한 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템은, 
상기와 같은 구성에 의하여 건물 내의 환경을 종합적으로 감시 및 제어하여 바람직한 건물 환경을 제공할 수 있다. 
구체적으로는, 환경 감시 및 제어 시스템에 의해 화재와 도난뿐만 아니라,그에 따른 상황을 사전 감지하여 대응할 수 있도록 도와주는 시스템이며, 건물 내의 환경감시, 보안감시, 화재감시, 영상감시, 전원감시 및 제어 시스템을 통합된 단일장치로 작동함으로써 추가적인 장치가 필요로 하지 않다. 
따라서 건물 내의 환경의 신뢰도를 높이고, 종합적이고 정확한 데이터의 입수를 가능하게 하여 불필요한 인력의 투입 및 사고를 방지함과 동시에 가장 적합한 제어 명령을 수행할 수 있다. 
또한, 중앙 통제 감시 시스템과 원격으로 통신하여 중앙기관 및 부서에서 본 발명의 클라이언트를 통제 또는 감시할 수도 있다.

title_en: System and method for coordinated health monitoring, emergency response, and medical record delivery
abstract_en: A computer-based system for providing coordinated health monitoring, emergency response, and medical record delivery. The system can include computing devices configured to process emergency-related indicators and data. The system can also include monitoring devices linked to the computing devices. The monitoring devices can monitor a particular area for the emergency-related indicators and data, where the monitoring devices detect among speech, sounds, images and other detectable emergency-related indicators. The monitoring devices can also transmit the emergency-related indicators and data to the computing devices. Furthermore, the system can include a module linked to the monitoring devices and configured to execute on the computing devices. The module can analyze the transmitted emergency-related indicators and data to determine whether there is an emergency, communicate with a monitoring service to validate that an emergency exists, and provide access to patient records to authorized personnel, based upon whether an emergency exists.
assignees: QUANTUM GROUP INC;HEATH CHESTER;GUILLAMA NOEL;MARTINEZ PEDRO

title_en: Service reporting system and method oriented to emergency command
abstract_en: The invention discloses a service reporting system and method oriented to emergency command. A service reporting server is connected with a population information comparison server so that popularization information base comparison can be achieved. The service reporting server is connected with a positioning system access server so that police officer GPS data recording can be achieved. The service reporting server is connected with a system integrating three alarming centers. The service reporting server obtains organization information and police officer information from the system integrating the three alarming centers. The system integrating the three alarming centers regularly obtains alarm condition information from the service reporting server. The service reporting server is connected with a third generation client-side, pushes the alarm condition information to the third generation client-side and inquires about historical alarm condition data from the third generation client-side. According to the service reporting system and method, limited multi-functional police service platforms and police force are reasonably distributed to the front line, and therefore the problems that police officers do not go out timely, the police officers do not choose reasonable routes to go out and police force is not enough are solved. The function of service reporting basic data collection, the function of schedule management the function of reporting information query, the function of service information statistics and other functions are achieved.
assignees: Sichuan tianyi network service co ltd

title_en: A kind of photovoltaic plant place monitoring system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of photovoltaic plant place monitoring system, automatically tracks recorded video when intrusion behavior, equipment state exception or fire behavior occurs in the on-site of photovoltaic plant by its place monitoring unit, generates and export video information and alarm signal；And video information and alarm signal are stored and transmitted by its data processing unit；The video information and alarm signal that data processing unit transmission is finally received by control and command center, parse to obtain video and be shown according to video information, carry out warning note according to alarm signal；To realize the real time monitoring to photovoltaic plant security protection security against fire, it effectively prevent personnel's invasion, theft and the generation of fire secret.The present invention combines in safety protection function and fire-fighting function in set of system, simplifies the installment work of system, saves installation duration.
assignees: CHINA RESOURCES NEW ENERGY DATONG YANGGAO WIND ENERGY CO LTD

title_en: Resident health record information system based on regional information integration platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resident health record information system based on a regional information integration platform, which comprises an equipment display screen, wherein the equipment display screen is fixedly connected with resident internet of things equipment, the resident internet of things equipment is fixedly connected with a resident health record system user login end, the resident health record system user login end is fixedly connected with a cloud data processing platform, the cloud data processing platform is fixedly connected with an internet cloud database, and the internet cloud database is fixedly connected with a cloud database data processing center. The product is applied to a resident health record information system based on a regional information integration platform, takes a management system as a portal entrance, and creates a complete online information integration platform by relying on the existing data such as a cloud database, a monitoring system, an operation comprehensive management and control system, an emergency command system and the like, so that one-picture management of a user side, a cloud side and a terminal is realized, and a reasonable data display center platform is carried out on the whole resident health record information system.
assignees: FUZHOU ZHONGKANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional ant colony optimization method and system for energy-saving scheduling in garbage classification recycling process
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional ant colony optimization method and a multidimensional ant colony optimization system for energy-saving scheduling in a garbage classification recovery process, wherein the scheduling method comprises the steps of determining an energy-saving scheduling model in the garbage classification recovery process; and optimizing a target consisting of the total driving time of the vehicle and the carbon emission in the dispatching model by adopting a multi-dimensional ant colony optimization method. According to the invention, the energy-saving scheduling model of the garbage classification recovery process is determined, so that the process expression of scheduling the multi-cabin vehicles is clear and definite; the multi-dimensional pheromone matrix is provided, and the block position and the block relation information of high-quality individuals can be recorded at the same time, so that the global search is effectively guided; disturbance operation is designed to avoid the algorithm from being trapped in local optimization so as to avoid the limitation of the search depth of the algorithm; in the algorithm local search stage, a plurality of neighborhood operations combined with a variable neighborhood descent strategy are constructed, so that the local search capability of the algorithm is enhanced, and the quality of high-quality individuals is further improved.

title_en: Environment-friendly data management system based on enterprise logistics information
abstract_en: The invention relates to an environment-friendly data management system based on enterprise logistics information, which is characterized in that a pound sheet template, an original ledger, a record unit table, a general solid waste ledger and a income analysis table are respectively built in an EXCEL file, the pound sheet template is filled according to actual vehicle entering and exiting conditions, output printing of the pound sheet is carried out through confirming pound sheet information, meanwhile, the filled data in the pound sheet is commanded to automatically enter the original ledger by utilizing VB script language, net weight data of the same receiving unit are extracted from the original ledger by utilizing SUMIF function of the EXCEL and are summed, whether the receiving solid waste amount is critical or exceeds standard is judged, factory records of the specified type of solid waste are extracted from the original ledger by utilizing the FILTER function of the EXCEL and are filled into the general solid waste ledger.
assignees: HEBEI DATANG INT TANGSHAN BEIJIAO THERMAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster warning analysis, and particularly relates to a trend analysis system and method based on multidimensional disaster warning data. According to the invention, the accuracy and timeliness of disaster prediction are obviously improved through optimizing the matching rules and the threshold values in real time, the deep fusion and the efficient utilization of multi-source data are realized, scientific basis and technical support are provided for disaster early warning and emergency response, meanwhile, the system has self-adaptive learning capability, a model can be continuously optimized in continuously updated data, the dynamic accuracy of a prediction result is ensured, and the disaster prevention and reduction capability is effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING LIAOWANG SHENZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital monitoring and channel visualization linkage method for power transmission line
abstract_en: The invention relates to a digital monitoring and channel visualization linkage method for a power transmission line, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent operation and maintenance of power systems and comprises the following steps of constructing a three-dimensional channel model fusing GIS and point cloud data, deploying a plurality of monitoring terminals such as images, weather, mechanical states and the like, binding real-time data to model space coordinates through a space-time alignment engine, automatically positioning fault points in a three-dimensional view and parallel-fetching peripheral images when risks such as temperature abnormality and external force damage are identified, synchronously generating a lightweight alarm report containing three-dimensional scene screenshot and pushing the lightweight alarm report to a mobile terminal. The invention realizes closed-loop management of data driving, space positioning and visual response, and greatly improves the operation and maintenance efficiency and emergency response capability of the transmission line.
assignees: QINGDAO HUANGDAO POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: Geological mineral product based three-dimensional modeling accurate positioning method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological information and discloses a geological mineral product three-dimensional modeling accurate positioning method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of deploying a laser ranging, microseismic and fiber bragg grating sensing array and synchronously collecting multi-source deformation and stress data; after space-time alignment and filtering, reconstructing a millimeter-level precision three-dimensional point cloud model by adopting an improved ICP algorithm, calculating a safety coefficient cloud image by combining a geomechanical constitutive equation, automatically defining a risk area according to a three-level threshold, and generating closed-loop control instructions such as voice alarm, thermodynamic diagram pushing, grouting coordinates, avoidance paths and the like. The system comprises a sensing deployment unit, a data preprocessing unit, a point cloud reconstruction unit, a mechanical analysis unit, a risk setting unit, an instruction distribution unit and an execution unit. The invention realizes deformation millimeter-level positioning of the goaf, sub-hour level early warning and full-automatic intervention, the early warning accuracy exceeds 95%, the emergency response is shortened to minute level, and the mine safety and exploitation efficiency are improved.

title_en: Simulation apparatus and method for training first aid treatment using augmented reality and virtual reality
title_ko: 증강현실과 가상현실을 이용한 훈련용 응급처치 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a simulation method for first aid training using augmented reality and virtual reality. A VR device (10) to be worn on a head of a trainee (E) is provided. A smart phone (20) is mounted at a front of the VR device (10) to be connected, wherein the smart phone (20) has a program for first aid training installed in a database (21), and the relevant menu is displayed on a screen so that the program is executed through an input unit (23). When performing the first aid training by the trainee (E), a background screen photographed by a camera unit (24) of the smart phone (20) is displayed through the VR device (10). When a CPR mannequin (30) is recognized through the camera sensor, the CPR mannequin (30) is implemented as an augmented reality (AR) of a 3D solid person by the processing of the control unit (27) and then through the VR device (10). An effect sound similar to an emergency situation (incident scene) is outputted through a sound output unit (25).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 증강현실과 가상현실을 이용한 응급처치 훈련용 시뮬레이션 방법에 있어서,  
훈련대상자(E)의 머리에 착용되어지는 VR기기(10)를 구비하고 VR기기(10) 전방에는 스마트폰(20)을 연결되게 장착하되 스마트폰(20)에는 응급처치 훈련을 위한 프로그램이 데이터베이스(21)에 설치되어 있고 화면에 관련 메뉴가 표시되어 입력부(23)를 통하여 실행되게 할 수 있으며,  
훈련대상자(E)에 의하여 응급처치 훈련 실행시 상기 스마트폰(20)의 카메라부(24)에서 촬영되는 배경화면이 VR기기(10)를 통하여 나타나도록 하되 카메라센서를 통하여 CPR 마네킹(30)을 인식하면 제어부(27)의 처리에 의하여 CPR 마네킹(30)이 3D입체로 된 사람을 형상의 증강현실(AR)로 구현되어 VR기기(10)를 통하여 보여지도록 하고 응급상황(사고현장)과 유사한 효과음을 음향출력부(25)로 출력하도록 구성하며,  
스마트폰(20)의 제어부(27)는 실제의 배경에 캐릭터(강사) 또는 텍스트 중 어느 하나 이상의 증강현실로 구현되는 가이드용 컨텐츠가 디스플레이부(22)로 나타나도록 하여 훈련대상자(E)는 응급처치의 전반적인 순서와 방법에 대하여 가이드용 컨텐츠가 나타나는 디스플레이부(22) 영상을 보여주는 VR기기(10)를 보면서 학습할 수 있도록 하며,  
 가이드용 컨텐츠의 안내를 바탕으로 CPR 마네킹(30)에 응급처치 학습을 할 수 있도록 하되, 훈련대상자(E)가 CPR 마네킹(30)에 행하는 압박의 강도, 압박의 횟수, 압박의 깊이, 압박의 시간 및 인공호흡의 횟수와 시간 등에 의한 실시간 결과를 포함하여 학습을 마친 후의 성공과 실패 여부가 스마트폰(20)의 통신부(26)와의 통신으로 제어부(27)에 전달되어 VR기기(10)로 텍스트 또는 표식 중 어느 하나의 방법으로 확인할 수 있게 하는 절차학습단계(A단계)와,  
상기 스마트폰(20)에 내장된 프로그램을 바탕으로 VR기기(10)에 실제 사고 현장과 유사한 환경을 가상현실로 구현하여 보여지도록 하여 훈련대상자(E)로 하여금 실제상황을 느낄 수 있게 하되, 가상공간 내에는 환자아바타(50)가 정해진 위치에 나타나도록 하며,  
훈련대상자(E)가 환자아바타(50)의 흉부위치에  CPR Cube(40) 또는 흉부압박장치를 위치시켜 CPR Cube(40)에 행하는 압박의 강도, 압박의 횟수, 압박의 깊이, 압박의 시간 등에 의한 실시간 데이터가 스마트폰(20)의 통신부(26)와의 통신으로 제어부(27)에 전달되어 가상공간 안에서 훈련의 결과가 표시(피드백)되게 하여 VR기기(10)로 확인할 수 있도록 하는 실전훈련단계(B단계)로 이루어지도록 구성한다.
assignees: IND EDUCATION COOPERATION ORGANIZATION DAEGU HEALTH COLLEGE

title_en: Apparatus, method, computer-readable storage medium and computer program for automating the creation of jsa documents based on artificial intelligence
title_ko: Ai 기반 작업위험성평가 작성 자동화 장치 및 방법, 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 작업위험성평가에 포함될 내용을 추천 및 생성함으로써, 작업위험성평가를 작성하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 본 발명의 일 측면에 따르면, AI 기반 작업위험성평가 작성 자동화 방법은, 사용자로부터 입력된 JSA 제목 및 JSA 작업 내용에 대응하는 작업 컨텍스트을 검색하고, 사용자 작업 컨텍스트 및 사용자 작업 단계에 대응하는 재해 유형(이하, 추천 재해 유형)을 생성하며, 사용자에 의해 입력된 취급화학물질을 기반으로 추천 위험요인을 생성하고, 추천 재해 유형 중 사용자에 의해 선택된 재해 유형에 대응하는 현재조치사항을 생성하고, 작업 컨텍스트 및 추천 위험요인에 대응하는 피해강도 및 사고빈도를 생성하며, 사용자 작업 컨텍스트, 사용자 작업 단계, 사용자에 의해 선택된 재해 유형, 추천 위험요인, 추천 현재조치사항, 피해강도 및 사고빈도를 기반으로 JSA 문서를 작성할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for forming and operating an ecosystem for a conducted electrical weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment (e.g., ecosystem) for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: Interoperability apparatus and methods for a cloud-based emergency data management system
abstract_en: A method implements; obtaining emergency call data from one or more functional elements of an emergency communication center (ECC) by an interoperability apparatus; sending the emergency data from the interoperability apparatus to a cloud-based emergency data management system; converting a portion of the emergency data into a data object at the cloud-based emergency data management system; providing the data object to an instance of a cloud-based application provided by the cloud-based emergency data management system, where the instance is executed using a browser on a computer located at the ECC, and the data object updates a map view within a graphical user interface provided by the instance; and providing update data from the cloud-based emergency data management system to a computer-aided-dispatch system using the interoperability apparatus. The emergency data includes: ANI/ALI (Automatic Number Identification/Automatic Location Identification) data, call detail record (CDR) data, AVL (Automatic Vehicle Location) data, and voice data.

title_en: Management of medical equipment and responders
abstract_en: A system for managing responders acquiring medical equipment and responding to an emergency medical event includes mobile devices associated with responders; a computer aided dispatch (CAD), and an equipment/responder management system communicatively coupled to the mobile devices and CAD and configured to receive an event location from the CAD, retrieve medical equipment locations from a database, receive responder locations from the mobile devices, send the event and equipment locations to a first mobile device, generate an activity log for the event including first responder status information based on the responder location, the event and medical equipment locations, send the activity log to the first mobile device, send the event location and the medical equipment locations to a second mobile device, update the activity log with second responder status information based on the responder, event and medical equipment locations, and send the activity log to the mobile devices.

title_en: Smart city environment supervision system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart city environment supervision system, which particularly relates to the technical field of environment supervision, wherein a conversion delay response module, an information loss response module, a noise interference response module and an accuracy loss response module are used for respectively acquiring a calculated data conversion delay coefficient, a data conversion loss coefficient, a data noise interference coefficient and a data accuracy loss coefficient, finding out the problems of conversion delay, information loss, noise interference and accuracy loss in data format conversion in time, constructing a data conversion hidden danger assessment model, generating a data conversion hidden danger assessment index, assessing the hidden danger of format conversion in the data format conversion process, ensuring that the system can always maintain the accuracy and timeliness of data in the environment crisis emergency response process, avoiding decision errors and response delays caused by inaccurate or delayed data, automatically sending early warning and making corresponding decisions based on hidden danger assessment results, and indicating whether the system needs to adjust a data processing flow or carry out emergency repair.

title_en: Iot chemical waste solution separation system and its method by scanning chemical label
title_ko: 화학물질 라벨 스캔을 통한 IoT 화학 폐용액 분리 시스템과 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화학물질 라벨 스캔을 통한 IoT 화학 폐용액 분리 시스템과 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 디스플레이를 통해 버리고자 하는 폐용액을 검색 또는 스캔하면 해당 용액과 혼합되어선 안되는 용액들의 종류를 표기해주고, 현재 여러개의 폐용액 수거함에 들어있는 용액들을 파악하여 버리고자 하는 폐용액을 알맞은 폐용액 수거함에 배출할 수 있도록 하여 실험간에 각종 사고들을 예방할 수 있다. 본 발명에 의한 IoT 화학 폐용액 분리 방법은, IoT 화학 폐용액 분리 방법에 있어서, (a) 폐용액 분리 단말기(110)에 폐액검색엔진(120)을 설치 및 구동하고, 상기 폐액검색엔진(120)의 프로그램 화면에서, 버리고자 하는 폐용액을 입력 후 검색 버튼을 누르면 통신부(112)를 통해 DB 서버(140)로 검색 정보를 전달하는 단계; (b) 상기 DB 서버(140)에서, 상기 폐용액 분리 단말기(110)로부터 수신받은 폐용액을 저장된 정보를 바탕으로 검색하여 상기 폐용액과 섞이면 안되는 물질과 현재 각각의 폐용액 수거함(130)에 수거된 용액 정보를 송신하여 상기 폐액검색엔진(120)의 프로그램 화면에 표시해주는 단계; (c) 상기 폐용액 분리 단말기(110)의 폐액검색엔진(120)에서, 입력받은 폐용액을 상기 DB 서버(140)로 전송하여 알고리즘(190)을 통해 해당 폐용액 수거함(130)의 DB에 취합하는 단계; (d) 상기 폐용액 분리 단말기(110)에서, 상기 DB 서버(140)로부터 수신받은 취합된 데이터를 바탕으로, 상기 폐용액을 수거하는 폐용액 수거함(130)과 그렇지 않은 다른 폐용액 수거함(130)을 구분하여 표시램프(131)로 표시하고, 각각의 폐용액 수거함(130)을 잠금장치(132)로 잠금 및 해제하는 단계; 및 (e) 웹 서버(150)에서, 상기 DB 서버(140)로부터 상기 폐용액 수거함(130)의 현황을 수신받아 웹 페이지(151)에 실시간으로 표시하며, 사용자 단말기(160) 또는 수거업체 단말기(180)에게 접근을 허용하는 단계;를 포함한다.

title_en: BIM construction site management system
title_ko: Ｂｉｍ 건설 현장 관리 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사용자의 단말기가 통신망을 통해서 접속하도록 하는 접속부; 상기 사용자의 단말기에 미리 작성된 위험성 평가 목록을 표시하고, 상기 사용자의 단말기에 의해, 표시된 위험성 평가 목록 중에서 작성하고자 하는 위험성 평가 목록을 선택하도록 하며, 선택한 위험성 평가 목록에 대해서, 위험성 평가 대상 부서나 팀 또는 직책 명을 입력하고, 미리 정해진 위험성 평가의 평가방법 중에서 어느 하나를 선택하며, 작업절차별 지침 목록을 표시하도록 하며, 작성할 단계의 단계, 작업명 및 작업설명을 입력하고, 작성할 단계의 직무를 선택하면 해당 직무의 위험요인이 표시되도록 하며, 위험요인에 대한 대책을 선택하도록 제공하고, 선택된 대책에 대한 위험도를 선택하도록 하는 위험성관리부; 상기 사용자의 단말기에 중대재해 사고 발생에 대응한 안전보건확보의무 목록을 제시하고, 상기 사용자의 단말기에 의해 상기 안전보건확보의무의 이행 여부를 표시 및 모니터링하도록 하며, 상기 사용자의 단말기에 착공 전단계, 승인단계 및 공사 수행단계 별 안전 관련 문서의 목록을 제공하고, 상기 안전 관련 문서의 작성 및 관리를 수행하는 중대재해사고대응부; 및 상기 위험성관리부 및 상기 중대재해사고대응부의 동작에 필요한 프로그램 및 정보와 동작 결과를 정보로서 저장하는 데이터베이스부;를 포함하도록 한 BIM 건설 현장 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Call management system for incoming video calls at a command center
abstract_en: A process and system for managing incoming video emergency calls (VECs) at a command center relative to an incident includes receiving first and second VECs from respective first and second recording and transmitting devices reflecting a first incident. Identifying the second VEC as a preferred one of the first and second VECs based on one or both of a quality and a field-of-view between the first and second VECs, and responsively causing the identified second VEC to be forwarded to a first live call taker and the first VEC to a VEC monitoring bot configured to continue to monitor video content of the first VEC and refrain from forwarding the first VEC to the first live call taker. The first VEC may be forwarded to the first live call taker at a lower relative resolution.

title_en: The firefighting commanding device of rapid deployment fire-fighting operation
abstract_en: The utility model provides a kind of firefighting commanding device of rapid deployment fire-fighting operation, including frame, the frame is equipped with fire-fighting tactics chart board, if the fire-fighting tactics chart board include Ganlei be removably set on its specified region graph card, attack operation inverse timing device and erasable record sheet in fireman, commander's plate for drawing fire-fighting operational deployment figure is additionally provided on the frame, when commanding fire-fighting to fight, the graph card can be removed from fire-fighting tactics chart board and is placed on commander's plate.The utility model embodiment, firefighting commanding device can realize fire-fighting tactics chart board and command the use of plate integrated with storage, ensure intuitive simplicity, security monitoring will be attacked in fireman is included in commander's plate simultaneously, it grasps base conductor person precisely in personnel in operational commanding and attacks situation and combat duty, it can get in touch in time, it is ensured that safety.

title_en: Indoor positioning system and method based on three communication vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses an indoor positioning system and a method based on three communication vehicles, belonging to the technical field of the system and the method using electronic information products and network technology to accurately position in building. The system comprises an emission device, a wireless transmission network and a positioning terminal, wherein the emission device comprises three communication vehicles which are arranged in a certain degree corresponding to the building; the emission device establishes mobile communication connection with the positioning terminal via the wireless transmission network; the positioning method comprises: calculating coordinates as known reference points of a coordinate system corresponding to the positions of the built coordinate system of the three communication vehicles of the emission device, the emission device searching the moving positioning terminal, establishing connection and storing records. The positioning system is independent and can normally work at disaster scenes at the condition of not concerning power supply of the building so that the system is especially suitable for indoors positioning of rescuing people and processing emergent incidents for policemen, armed policemen and firemen.

title_en: Information monitoring system based on first-aid scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information monitoring system based on emergency dispatch, which relates to the technical field of information monitoring and is used for solving the problems that the state of illness, detailed places and the like of patients are not recorded in detail in the information monitoring of the existing emergency dispatch center, and the number of emergency ambulances in jurisdictions is limited, so that the vehicle dispatch has a shortage problem, and the system comprises a data acquisition module, an information monitoring module, a database and a dispatch execution module; the invention monitors and processes the emergency request information of the hospital emergency dispatch center through the information monitoring module so as to process the emergency request in time and record the condition information of the patient in detail; the emergency request information is processed, corresponding rescue vehicles are scheduled to request for processing, and when the rescue vehicles are insufficient, auxiliary rescue is performed by intelligently distributing the externally injected vehicles, so that the problem that the number of ambulances in the jurisdiction is limited is solved.
assignees: HUAIAN FIRST PEOPLES HOSPITAL HUAIAN FIRST RED CROSS HOSPITAL

title_en: Substation management system and method based on intelligent scheduling management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transformer substation management system and method based on intelligent scheduling management, belongs to the technical field of transformer substation management, and aims to solve the problems that existing transformer substation management lacks intelligent scheduling management and lacks automatic safety management, and the transformer substation management system comprises a scheduling and scheduling module, a personnel management module, an equipment management module, a data analysis and decision support module, an early warning and emergency response module, an intelligent scheduling adjustment module, a system notification and communication module, a man-machine interaction and interface module, a history record and report module and a system safety and authority management module.
assignees: SOUTHERN POWER GRID DIGITAL GRID TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Emergency command system and method based on BIM digital base
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency command and discloses an emergency command system and method based on a BIM digital base, wherein a unified data model is established through an expansion IFC standard, BIM building information, GIS geographic space data, monitoring data and an emergency plan document are subjected to semantic mapping and entity alignment, an emergency knowledge graph taking the BIM building information as a node is generated, physical simulation and LSTM prediction algorithm are coupled, the monitoring data are injected into the BIM model to deduce a disaster process, a risk thermodynamic diagram and an evacuation forbidden zone are output, space-time accessibility of emergency resources is calculated through a reinforcement learning model according to the deduction result, an optimization scheme comprising unmanned plane paths, personnel evacuation routes and equipment scheduling instructions is generated, the instructions are synchronized to an augmented reality individual soldier terminal and a mobile command shelter through edge calculation nodes, resource deployment states are marked in the BIM model in real time, multi-terminal operation is synchronized, timeliness and accuracy of disaster situation perception are remarkably improved, and disaster loss is effectively reduced.
assignees: JIANGSU I FRONT SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-dimensional studying decision system based on safety emergency multi-mode data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-dimensional studying decision system based on safety emergency multi-mode data, which belongs to the technical field of public safety emergency decision, and comprises a multi-mode data access layer, a space-time alignment engine, a dynamic decision map generation module and a multi-target optimization decision device, wherein the multi-mode data access layer is used for receiving satellite remote sensing data, a ground sensor network, a social media text stream and a city infrastructure BIM (building information model), the space-time alignment engine is used for carrying out three-dimensional space coding by adopting a Geohash-transform structure, the dynamic decision map generation module is used for constructing a disaster evolution knowledge map with weight time sequence update, and the multi-target optimization decision device is used for outputting a Pareto optimal strategy set. The invention solves the long-standing difficult problems of data island and static response in the field of emergency decision, and provides a new generation of infrastructure-level solution for smart city safety; the system remarkably improves the emergency response precision and efficiency, and is suitable for intelligent decision of urban waterlogging, earthquake and other scenes.

title_en: Urban treatment event processing method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The application provides an artificial intelligence-based urban governance event processing method and system, the method comprises the steps of collecting urban governance multi-mode perception data, constructing a multi-mode feature vector matrix for the multi-mode perception data, conducting time alignment and space alignment processing on the multi-mode feature vector matrix to obtain regularized matrix data, dividing the vector of the regularized matrix data into different clusters according to a clustering algorithm, analyzing each cluster by adopting artificial intelligence, extracting feature data of vectors in the cluster, calculating early warning values of suspicious events in the cluster, obtaining events and event emergency data of which the suspicious event early warning values exceed a threshold value, calculating event emergency values according to the event emergency data, and starting collaborative processing flows of all departments for all events in sequence according to the sequence of the event emergency values from large to small. When the intelligent city management system and the intelligent city management method are used for realizing cooperative work among departments, data resource sharing is realized, the cooperative work among the departments is easy, and the accuracy and the efficiency of emergency response are improved.

title_en: Therapeutic intervention support program, and therapeutic intervention support device
abstract_en: To provide a therapeutic intervention support program and therapeutic intervention support device that can put a therapeutic intervention on record by means of a simple method even in an emergency situation in the therapeutic intervention to persons with a disease such as epilepsy, or can appropriately deal with the emergency situation therein.SOLUTION: A program of a mobile terminal is configured to: in response to a first command of an operator of the mobile terminal, record first current time; in response to the first command of the operator or a second command thereof, start recording a video taken by the mobile terminal; receive input information from the operator in the midst of the video recording; in response to a third command of the operator, end the video recording; in response to the third command of the operator or a fourth command thereof, record the second current time, or elapse time from first current time to second current time; and control recording in a memory in association with the first current time, the second current time or the elapse time, the recorded video and the input information.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 5

title_en: Demand controller with built-in arc, heat and gas sensor for danger-monitering in electric panel
title_ko: 수배전반 내부 위험감시용 아크, 열, 가스 감지센서를내장한 최대수요전력 관리장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 복합기능형 수배전반에 설치되어 전력 수용가의 최대수요전력을 제어하는 최대수요전력 관리장치에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세히는 최대수요전력 관리장치 내부에 아크, 열, 가스 감지센서를 구비하여 최대수요전력 관리기능에 부가하여 수배전반 내에 설치, 운전 중인 기기들의 고장 및 화재 예방기능을 효과적으로 수행하는데 그 목적이 있다. 
     상기 목적 달성을 위해서 본 발명은, 최대수요전력 관리장치 내부에; 수배전반 내부에 설치, 운전 중인 기기들의 경년 열화 및 사고로 인한 아크발생시 감지해내는 아크 감지센서; 변압기 부품의 경년 열화로 인한 급격한 권선온도 상승시 감지해내는 열 감지센서; 수배전반 내부화재시 발생하는 일산화탄소(CO) 및 이산화탄소(CO2)를 감지해 내는 가스 감지센서; 입력받은 미세신호를 사용가능한 신호로 증폭시키는 증폭부; 증폭된 아날로그 신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하는 A/D 변환부; 수배전반 내부의 위험판단을 수행하는 CPU 프로세서; 사고발생시 현장근무자에게 위험을 경고하는 경보 릴레이; 사고발생시 원방근무자에게 위험을 경고하는 위험신호 전송; 을 구비하는 것을 포함한다. 
       
     복합기능형 수배전반, 최대수요전력 관리장치, 아크 감지센서, 열 감지센서,  가스 감지센서, 증폭부, A/D 변환부, CPU 프로세서

title_en: The maritime rescue system using rfid facilities
title_ko: Ｒｆｉｄ시스템을 이용한 해양 인명구조 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A maritime rescue system using an RFID system is provided to use location movement data of a survivor which is finally recorded, thereby easily finding the survivor even though a rescuing activity starts late after a maritime accident. CONSTITUTION: Beacons(110) transmit wireless signals. A plurality of RFID tags(120) stores intrinsic ship passenger information. The RFID tags measure current location information based on the received wireless signals. The RFID tags periodically transmit the current location information with the intrinsic ship passenger information. A CIR(Crew Information Recorder)(130) receives the intrinsic ship passenger information and the current location information. The CIR(Crew Information Recorder) records the intrinsic ship passenger information and the current location information with navigation information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 RFID시스템을 이용한 해양 인명구조 시스템에 관한 것으로,  본 발명에 의하면, 일정 간격으로 배치되어서 무선신호를 송출하는 다수의 비콘(Beacon)(110); 선박에 승선한 선승자마다 각각 구비되고 선승자 고유정보가 기억되어 있으며 상기 비콘(110)으로부터 수신된 무선신호를 기초로 현재 위치정보를 계측하여 상기 선승자 고유정보와 함께 현재 위치정보를 주기적으로 송출하는 다수의 RFID 태그(Radio Frequency IDentification Tag)(120); 및 상기 RFID 태그(120)가 송출하는 상기 선승자 고유정보와 현재 위치정보를 수신하고 수신한 상기 선승자 고유정보와 현재 위치정보를 항해기간 동안의 항해정보와 함께 기록하는 항해자료 기록장치(Crew Information Recorder, CIR)(130)로 구성된다.  상기와 같은 구성에 의하면, 선박 사고 후 시간이 경과하여도 조난자의 위치를 추적하여 구조할 수 있는 이점이 있다. 
       
     해양, 선박, 조난, 위치추적, 비콘, RFID, 위난, CIR

title_en: Method for character and function for store management system simulation model of avionics integration laboratory system, and system of the same and media that can record program for method the same
title_ko: 항공전자 통합시험 시스템의 무장관리컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 모델에 대한 특성과 기능 구현 방법 및 그 시스템과 그 방법에 의한 프로그램을 저장한 기록매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method and system for realizing a characteristic and a function about a SMS simulation model of an aviation electronic integration test system and a recording medium storing a program by the method are provided to facilitate data input/output by interfacing a database with a data link between a system integration lab environment and equipment. CONSTITUTION: A SMS(Store Management System) simulation model of an aviation integration test system receives a command and armed data related to the command from a IMDC(Integrated Mission Design Center). Armed data mounted in an aircraft is inputted into a SMS(100) and analyzed. The flight state and armed mode state of the aircraft is determined and a change request of a pilot is checked through the IMDC. If a change request exists, corresponding data is changed into an input value and an armed list data is determined by setting a content which type and state of a current arm is determined or changed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 항공전자 통합시험 시스템에서 현재 제약적으로 지원되는 무장관리컴퓨터(Store Management System: SMS)의 내부 모드(Mode)인, AA(Air-to-Air), AG(Air-to-Ground), EJ(Emergency Jettison), SJ(Selective Jettison), Gun, BIT(Built In Test) 모든 기능을 모델링(Modeling) 할 수 있고, System Integration Lab 환경과 장비간의 데이터(Data) 연동을 위해 구축된 DB와 인터페이싱(Interfacing) 하여 데이터 입력(Input)/출력(Output)을 용이하게 할 수 있으며, SMS의 입력(Input)/출력(Output) 데이터를 GUI 윈도우(Window)를 통해 모니터링(Monitoring) 할 수 있는 무장관리컴퓨터 시뮬레이션 모델에 대한 특성과 기능 구현 방법 및 그 시스템과 그 방법에 의한 프로그램을 저장한 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 
       
      무장관리컴퓨터(SMS), 시뮬레이션, 모델, SIL(System Integration Lab), 임무컴퓨터(IMDC),

title_en: Position recording apparatus
title_ko: 지피에스와 가속도센서를 이용한 위치기록장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A position recording apparatus which uses a global positioning system and an acceleration sensor is provided to rescue a vehicle involved in an accident without excessive costs or separate space by automatically recording accident information of the vehicle. CONSTITUTION: A location measurement device(21) measures location information of a vehicle involved in an accident. A time measurement device(32) measures driving time of the vehicle. The time measurement device detects a time point when the accident is occurred. A storage device(24) stores information with respect to the vehicle and passengers of the vehicle. The storage device stores location information in which emergency aid is enabled. A detection device(22) detects a moment of a vehicle collision. An output device(25) outputs a sensor signal to a recording medium by amplifying the sensor signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 GPS와 가속도센서를 이용한 위치기록장치에 관한 것으로, 주요 구성은 GPS기능을 갖는 센서를 이용하여 차량의 사고를 자동 기록하는 장치에 있어서, 위성위치측정시스템(GPS) 등을 사용하여 사고시 차량의 위치정보를 측정하는 위치측정수단과, 차량의 운행중 시간을 측정하여 사고시의 시간을 제공하는 시간측정수단과, 차량과 차량탑승자에 대한 정보 또는 긴급구호가 가능한 곳에 대한 위치를 저장하는 저장수단, 일정값 이상의 가속도에 의하여 차량의 충돌순간을 감지하는 차량사고 감지수단과, 센서신호을 증폭하여 상기 기록매체로 출력하기 위한 출력수단, 차량사고 감지수단의 차량충돌 감지시 상기 저장수단에 저장된 정보를 상기 출력수단으로 출력하며 상기 위치측정수단의 차량의 위치정보와 상기 시간측정수단의 사고시 시간을 디지털정보로서 상기 출력수단으로 출력하도록 제어하는 제어수단을 포함한다.

title_en: Unicon Optimization Method and System for Improvement of Accumulated Cloud Parametric Code
title_ko: 적운 모수화 코드 향상을 위한 유니콘 최적화 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: A method and a system for optimizing a unicorn for improving cumulus parameterization codes are suggested. The SCAM system proposed in the present invention includes: a local PC client that acts as an interface so that a user can access his or her user account at a gate using a remote access program; a gate that connects the local PC client and a cluster server through a user account and a SCAM account; and a cluster server that includes a plurality of nodes, receives a command from the gate and transmits the command to a batch system of the server to operate a SCAM model, and returns the operation result and transmits the result to the user account at the gate.
abstract_ko: 적운 모수화 코드 향상을 위한 유니콘 최적화 방법 및 시스템이 제시된다. 본 발명에서 제안하는 SCAM 시스템은 원격 접속 프로그램을 이용하여 사용자가 게이트에 있는 자신의 사용자 계정에 접속하도록 인터페이스 역할을 수행하는 로컬 PC 클라이언트(Local PC Client), 사용자 계정 및 SCAM 계정을 통해 로컬 PC 클라이언트와 클러스터 서버를 연결하는 게이트(Gate) 및 복수의 노드를 포함하고, 게이트로부터 명령어를 입력 받아 서버의 배치 시스템(batch system)에 해당 명령어를 전달하여, SCAM 모델을 구동하고, 상기 구동 결과를 반환하여 게이트의 USER 계정에 전달하는 클러스터 서버(Cluster Server)를 포함한다.

title_en: Emergency relief method and system using smart ring
title_ko: 스마트 링을 이용한 응급 구호 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 스마트 링을 이용한 응급 구호 방법 및 시스템이 개시된다. 개시되는 일 실시예에 따른 응급 구호 방법은, 하나 이상의 프로세서들, 및 하나 이상의 프로세서들에 의해 실행되는 하나 이상의 프로그램들을 저장하는 메모리를 구비한 컴퓨팅 장치에서 수행되는 방법으로서, 사용자의 손가락에 착용된 제1 스마트 링으로부터 사용자 생체 관련 정보를 수신하는 단계, 사용자 생체 관련 정보에 포함된 사용자의 생체 신호를 추출하고, 사용자의 생체 신호를 분석하여 응급 출동 이벤트가 발생하는지 여부를 확인하는 단계, 및 응급 출동 이벤트가 발생하는 경우, 응급 출동 신호를 외부로 송신하는 단계를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: "incident reporting"
abstract_en: This disclosure relates to mobile communication devices with an app installed thereon for managing incidents. The app generates a first user interface with two user control elements. Upon detecting user interaction with the first user control element, the app creates a second user interface. The second user interface comprises first user input elements allowing a user to enter incident report input data. The app creates and stores a new incident report record comprising the incident report input data as one of multiple incident report records. Upon detecting user interaction with the second user element, the app creates a third user interface. The third user interface comprises a selection element for selecting multiple incident report records and second user input elements for entering incident investigation input data. The app then creates a new incident investigation record associated with the selected incident report record.

title_en: System and method for warning of the estimated arrival time and expected intensity in a particular area, caused by a seismic movement
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for warning of the estimated arrival time and expected intensity in a particular area, caused by a seismic movement, using a plurality of measuring elements, which comprises the steps of: arranging a plurality of measuring elements; connecting each of the measuring elements; storing in each measuring element; transforming by means of the measuring element; recording by means of a control centre; verifying by means of the control centre; designating a destination point; determining the intensity; and automatically dispatching an early earthquake alert to the destination point.

title_en: Incident category selection optimization
abstract_en: This disclosure describes techniques that enable a categorization controller to detect activation of a portable recording device that is configured to capture a real-time multimedia stream of the current event. The categorization controller may further identify a set of categories that are likely associated with the real-time multimedia stream, determine an ordered ranking of the set of categories, and generate a ranked category dataset for delivery to the portable recording device. In doing so, the portable recording device may present the ordered ranking of the set of categories at a user interface.
assignees: GETAC TECHNOLOGY CORP;WHP WORKFLOW SOLUTIONS INC

title_en: Circuit, base station, method, and recording medium
abstract_en: [Problem] To provide a framework by which the safety of an autonomous mobile device in an emergency situation can be further improved. [Solution] A circuit provided with: a notification unit for notifying a base station of operable time information regarding an operable time; and an action control unit for controlling an action of the mobile device on the basis of an action command notified from the base station as determined on the basis of the reported operable time information, and for controlling an action to be taken in an emergency situation by reference to a map in which degrees of risk at respective locations are defined.

title_en: Canine emergency alert system
abstract_en: An emergency alert system and method of operation are provided. The system includes an emergency alert pad configured to detect a pad activation by a service animal and communicate a pad alert in response. An emergency alert vest is worn by the service animal and is configured to detect a vest activation by a person in proximity and communicate a vest alert in response. A user mobile device is in communication with the emergency alert pad and vest and is configured to record a pre-recorded message. At least one affiliated mobile device is configured to receive the pre-recorded message during the pad activation and the vest activation. An emergency response center is in communication with the emergency alert pad and the emergency alert vest and is configured to receive at least one of the pad alert and the vest alert and provide emergency services accordingly.

title_en: System and method of aggregating and disseminating in-case-of-emergency medical and personal information
abstract_en: A system for aggregating and disseminating in-case-of-emergency (ICE) medical information to medical units. The system includes an ICE medical record server that stores medical records of respective subscribers, and automatically receive updates from health service entities visited by subscribers. When contacted by emergency dispatchers or first responders, the server sends subscribers medical information to first responders, emergency management agencies directly, via a dispatcher, or via a computer aided dispatch (CAD) system. The medical information may be arranged, emphasized, and/or filtered in a manner relevant to the on-going emergency. A communication device may wirelessly receive the medical information and pre-populate a pre-hospital care form with the information, which may be further orally annotated by the first responder. The completed PCR may then be sent to a PCR server for subsequent access by medical units that subsequently treat the subscriber. The medical server may further assist a public health agency to disseminate emergency information to selected subscribers, responders, and public health alerting systems. An ICE personal server for storing important personal documents is also disclosed. A PCR server is also disclosed that can disseminate aggregate PCR information in near real-time to an emergency management agency (EMA) system for developing incident response plans during a wide area emergency.
assignees: D AMBROSIA ROBERT MATTHEW;ZANKA FRANK;SICARD EDWARD A

title_en: Cargo vessel operator emergency response system, with operator directives, incident data recording and reporting
abstract_en: A method, computer program product, mobile communication device, and a shipment tracking system provide automated incident recording, reporting, and response protocols, including operator directives. The method includes receiving an input identifying an occurrence of an incident associated with a shipment entity, the shipment entity being one or more of a vessel, an operator, and a cargo being transported via the vessel. The method includes, in response to the input, presenting on a user interface (UI) of an operator mobile communication device (MCD) one or more selectable incident reporting options to activate incident response, data recording, and reporting (IRDRR) protocols. The method further includes generating and presenting an incident response UI that instructs the operator of specific sequence of steps to take in response to the incident and to complete an incident information gathering process. The method further includes automatically transmitting/uploading a notification of the incident to an incident management server.

title_en: Public safety data management platform of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle public security data management platform. The method comprises the steps of extracting foreground high-frequency components from an area monitoring image acquired by an unmanned aerial vehicle based on a deep learning image processing technology, extracting multi-level features and enhancing feature gradient masks from the extracted area foreground high-frequency object image to obtain shallow salient feature representation and deep salient feature representation of the area foreground high-frequency object, intelligently identifying whether the high-frequency object is a human object based on main component matching fusion features of the shallow salient feature representation and the deep salient feature representation, and generating corresponding personnel activity prompt signals. Therefore, the method can realize rapid and accurate identification of the human body target in the unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring image, thereby improving the efficiency of public safety management and the timeliness of emergency response.

title_en: Safety evaluation method, system, equipment and program for chemical storage place
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety evaluation method, a system, equipment and a program for a chemical storage place, and relates to the technical field of dangerous chemical management, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment on multi-source data; the multi-source data comprises stored chemical data, environment data, equipment state data, management data and historical data, spatial characteristics of the multi-source data after time-space alignment are extracted to generate a spatial risk weight map, a risk evaluation model is pre-trained, and weights in the spatial risk weight map are mapped to the risk evaluation model to obtain risk grades. Through the processing scheme of the present disclosure, the potential risk of the storage place can be found in time, the emergency response is early-warned and started in advance, the possibility of accident occurrence is effectively reduced, and the safety of the chemical storage place is improved.

title_en: Flight guide system by use of a big data
title_ko: 빅데이터를 이용한 비행 조정 가이드 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 모의 비행 훈련 시스템에 관한 것으로, 특히 빅 데이터를 이용하여 조종사에게 안전하게 비행할 수 있도록 조종 가이드 정보를 제공하기 위한 비행 조정 가이드 시스템에 관한 것으로, 비행중 가변될 수 있는 가변상황 요소들을 변경 생성해 주면서 그 상황에 대처하는 각 조종사별 모의 비행 훈련 실습 데이터를 빅 데이터로서 누적 기록하기 위한 조종패턴 기록부와, 기상정보, 위성정보, 비행사고정보, 지상상황 정보 중 적어도 하나 이상의 정보를 빅 데이터로 DB에 저장하기 위한 빅 데이터 저장부와, 모의 비행 훈련 중 상기 저장된 빅 데이터에 기반하여 현재 위치에서의 조종방안을 추천하기 위한 조정방안 추천부;를 포함함을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Determining priority discrepancies between audio data and records data
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides systems and methods for determining priority discrepancies between audio data and records data. In one example, the system includes an electronic computing device.
