The electronic computing device compares audio data associated with a public safety incident to records data associated with the public safety incident, determines discrepancies between the audio data and the records data, and determines an organization and a type associated with the public safety incident. The electronic computing device also determines, based on the organization and the type, priority discrepancies included in the discrepancies and generates a geographical map that includes the priority discrepancies and that is configured for display on a display device.

title_en: Mountain torrent disaster early warning device
abstract_en: A mountain torrent disaster early warning device. The utility model discloses a water level monitoring system adopts the fluviograph to monitor the river course water level; the rainfall monitoring system monitors the rainfall by adopting a tipping bucket type rain gauge; the method comprises the following steps that a remote terminal unit RTU of a data control module presets a normal water level of a river channel through historical data, prepares to transfer the water level and immediately transfers the water level, and controls an alarm module to send out corresponding alarm information through received river channel water level height monitored by a water level gauge and rainfall data monitored by a tipping bucket type rain gauge; the data transmission system transmits video image data through a 4G wireless network; the alarm module has the functions of sound, light and electricity alarm; the power supply module adopts a solar power supply mode. The early warning system has the advantages that the system integrates real-time rain water level image acquisition, sound-light alarm and data transmission, transmits acquired data images to the early warning platform, and performs early warning according to the model calculation of rainfall and water level; the early warning links are reduced, the timeliness and the reliability are high, and a basis is provided for the command and decision of an emergency department.
assignees: Wenzhou Flood and Drought Disaster Prevention Center;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES;ISTRONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Environment health management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an environment health management method. The environment health management method comprises the steps that an environment health event is submitted, verified, dispatched, audited and the like; based on an environment health management system participated in by community residents and social organizations, the community residents are widely encouraged to participate in law enforcement, the management system is established through an informatization means, and the process management on the environment health is recorded and can be traced, inquired, tracked and the like. The effect of improving the environment health management efficiency is achieved.
assignees: BEIJING YUNHAI HUANYU INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of fire-fighting robot that fire extinguishing strategy is formulated based on object
abstract_en: A kind of fire-fighting robot that fire extinguishing strategy is formulated based on object, including car body, water tank, fire water monitor, water cannon control device, running gear, drive device, processor and flame sensor for detecting burning things which may cause a fire disaster, the processor is connected with the drive device, flame sensor and water cannon control device, for being instructed when detecting burning things which may cause a fire disaster to drive device output driving, and to water cannon control device output open command while output driving is instructed；Drive device is connected with running gear, for driving running gear to be walked to fire location according to driving instruction；Water cannon control device is used to control fire water monitor water spray according to open command, it is arranged on the life-detection instrument being connected on car body with processor, metal detector and the route logging modle being connected with drive device, life-detection instrument is used to detect live body in the scene of a fire, metal detector is used to detect non-ferrous metal in the scene of a fire, and route logging modle is used to record the track route outside the scene of a fire to current location.
assignees: SUZHOU SHANGXINBAO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of test method and system of urban track traffic dispatcher vocational skills
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical fields of technical capability evaluation, disclose a kind of test method of urban track traffic dispatcher vocational skills, including Step 1: visual display and/or the sense of hearing appearance of different test events are presented using testing tool, tested dispatcher makes a response to the visual display and/or the sense of hearing by pad keyboard；Step 2: handling the reaction, handling result is compared with the ability grade criteria for classifying, obtains the ability grade belonging to tested dispatcher, and show.Also disclose a kind of test system of urban track traffic dispatcher vocational skills.The whole process of the present invention is easy to operate, without manual record, simultaneously, by being compared with the ability grade criteria for classifying, obtain the ability grade of tested dispatcher so that test result has more reference significance, and strong guiding opinion is provided to appraiser, but also tested personnel becomes apparent from the horizontal capability of oneself, it is more advantageous to the raising for promoting own service level.

title_en: Forest protection rescue system based on Beidou satellite communication
abstract_en: A forest protection rescue system based on Beidou satellite communication belongs to the field of emergency rescue, and is characterized in that: the system comprises an environment monitoring module, a Beidou satellite communication module, a physical sign detection module and a rescue command center; the physical sign information of the rescue workers is accurately monitored by combining the sensor and algorithm technology, so that the safety and the rescue efficiency of the rescue workers are improved, the physical sign information of the rescue workers can be timely and accurately acquired, and real-time monitoring and rescue guidance are provided; the forest protection rescue capability is improved, the forest disaster situation is monitored in real time, and disaster early warning and quick response are provided; through real-time monitoring and quick response, the forest protection efficiency is improved, and the loss caused by fire and other forest threats is reduced; by recording and analyzing disaster data and recording and analyzing rescue tracks, references and guidance are provided for subsequent rescue work, rescue efficiency and safety are improved, and rescue efficiency and accuracy are improved when personnel rescue is carried out in a complex field environment.
assignees: XIAN ZHENGLI ELECTROMECHANICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster early warning information release method and system based on cooperation of multi-mode products and intelligent agents
abstract_en: The application provides a disaster early warning information release method and system based on cooperation of a multi-mode product and an intelligent agent, which are used for improving comprehensiveness, accuracy and timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response of disaster early warning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a multi-source monitoring data set comprising satellite cloud image data units and ground observation data units, acquiring and generating the multi-source monitoring data set in real time by monitoring nodes distributed at different spatial positions, carrying out joint feature analysis processing on the multi-source monitoring data set through a multi-agent cooperative processing network to generate disaster risk trend features, calling a reinforcement learning algorithm to carry out early warning strategy optimization processing on the disaster risk trend features to generate an optimized early warning strategy comprising early warning content types and throwing opportunities, executing early warning content throwing operation according to the optimized early warning strategy, and connecting an emergency response system in parallel to complete emergency response cooperative operation.
assignees: HUAFENG METEOROLOGICAL MEDIA GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for generating remote centralized control plan of step hydropower
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of hydropower system control, in particular to a method and a system for generating a remote centralized control plan of a step hydropower station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-source heterogeneous dynamic data of a target step hydropower station; the method comprises the steps of carrying out statistics reconstruction on multi-source heterogeneous dynamic data to generate dynamic characteristic tensors, carrying out risk identification on a target cascade hydropower station according to the dynamic characteristic tensors to obtain a risk index sequence of the target cascade hydropower station, carrying out dynamic weighted superposition on a preset plan template set based on the risk index sequence to generate a self-adaptive plan set, carrying out dynamic matching in the self-adaptive plan set based on the real-time running state of a cascade hydropower remote centralized control system, and determining an optimal plan so as to control the cascade hydropower remote centralized control system based on the optimal plan. According to the invention, through dynamic data fusion and risk quantitative analysis, real-time self-adaptive matching of the step hydropower station risk early warning and the emergency plan is realized, and the emergency response accuracy and timeliness are obviously improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU WUJIANG HYDROPOWER DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Learning appliance for improving thinking ability
title_ko: 사고능력 향상을 위한 교습지
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a home-study material for improving thinking ability, which comprises: a question providing part in which subject contents are sorted into specific topics, and the questions included in the topic are written; a question writing part allowing a user to write down questions to ask on the questions or the corresponding topic provided in the question providing part; a given answer analysis writing part analyzing examples for the given answer; an information writing part for writing basic information on the questions and the corresponding topic given on the question providing part; a solving steps recording part allowing the user to write down solving steps for the questions; and a discussed outcome writing part allowing the user to write down information derived after discussion on the questions or the corresponding topic; and a given answer analysis writing part analyzing the contents of the examples for the given answer. According to the present invention, the home-study material can effectively deliver the subject contents by the home-study.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 사고능력 향상을 위한 교습지에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 공교육보다는 사교육에 적합한 교습방법으로서 교과내용을 그대로 전달하는 것이 아니라 사고능력의 향상에 초점이 맞춰 교과내용을 스스로 이해하고 이를 토대로 문항의 해결 능력을 극대화할 뿐만 아니라 창의적인 사고력을 향상시킬 수 있도록 설계된 사고능력 향상을 위한 교습지에 대한 것이다. 
본 발명의 사고능력 향상을 위한 교습지는 초?중?고등학교의 교과내용의 교습에 활용하는 교습지에 있어서, 상기 교과내용을 특정 주제로 분류하고, 해당 주제에 포함되는 문항이 기재되어 있는 문항 제시부와, 상기 문항 제시부에 제시된 문항 또는 해당 주제에 대해 피교습자의 의문사항을 기재하는 질문 기재부와, 주어진 답의 보기항목을 분석하는 주어진 답 분석기재부와, 상기 문항 제시부에 기재된 문항 및 해당 주제에 대한 기초사항을 기재하는 정보 기재부와, 피교습자가 상기 문항을 풀이하는 과정을 적은 풀이과정 기록부와, 상기 문항 또는 해당 주제에 대해 토론 후 토론에서 도출된 사항을 기재하는 토론결과 기재부와, 주어진 답의 보기항목을 내용 분석하는 주어진 답 분석 기재부를 포함한다. 
본 발명의 사고능력 향상을 위한 교습지에 따르면 교습을 통해 교과내용을 효과적으로 전달할 수 있고, 피교습자의 사고능력을 향상시켜 학습능력을 극대화 할 수 있으며, 교과내용의 전달뿐만 아니라 사고능력을 향상시켜 근본적인 문제해결능력을 향상시킬 뿐만 아니라, 본 발명의 교습지로 학습한 선행 학습자를 포함하는 소그룹 형태의 토론을 거침으로써 교습지를 통한 사고능력의 향상을 극대화할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Nutritional monitoring device
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to solve problems in the technical field by providing a device for the nutritional monitoring of foods ingested by a user. The device comprises: an image sensor configured to capture at least one image of food ingestion by the user; a position sensor configured to obtain an item of position data regarding the food monitoring device; a real-time clock configured to generate a real-time base; and a processing unit connected to the image sensor, to the position sensor and to the real-time clock. The image sensor captures at least one image of the foods ingested by the user, on the basis of a command from the processing unit, and the processing unit generates a report recording the food ingestion, based on the image captured by the image sensor.

title_en: Method for the secure logging of correspondence and notification thereof
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed that create a secure electronically recorded log utilizable in the field of emergency response material spill remediation. The system can receive information regarding a spill incident, wherein the information includes an approximate location of the spill incident or a description of a material spilt, populate the secure electronically recorded log with a geolocation code associated with the spill incident, wherein the geolocation code is ascertained as a function of the approximate location of the spill incident, and communicate a notification to a Project Manager assigned to oversee remediation of the spill incident or a representative of a client that supplied the information regarding the spill incident.
assignees: RICHTER CLAYTON VAUGHN;WALDEN NATHAN;STEVENS AMANDA;EMERGENCY RESPONSE AND TRAINING SOLUTIONS INC

title_en: Incident alert and information gathering method and system
abstract_en: An apparatus, a system and a method of collecting vehicle data for use in incident investigations, including: a vehicle data recorder for recording vehicle parameters such as geographic location, speed, azimuth of motion, acceleration, brake pedal pressure and similar parameters: a means for detecting incidents such as an accident, and sending an incident message to a incident monitoring station, which then transmits a broadcast message. Other vehicles within communication range of the incident monitoring station each respond to the broadcast message with a report message including a unique identifier. When an incident occurs, a portion of the data stored prior to, and at the time of, the incident is saved for future retrieval. The incident message may be reported to a central site or other authority so that emergency response can be provided.

title_en: Method and computer readable recording medium storing a program for constructing and managing virtual sensor and driving unit integration network for disaster response
title_ko: 재난 대응을 위한 가상 센서 및 구동체 통합 네트워크 구축 및 운영 방법 및 그 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 독출 가능한 기록매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 대응을 위한 가상 센서 및 구동체 통합 네트워크 구축 및 운영 방법 및 그 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 독출 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것으로서, 가상 센서 및 구동체 통합 네트워크 구축 및 운영 프로그램은, 센서 노드 생성 모듈(module), 구동체 노드 생성 모듈, 센서 및 구동체 노드 연결 모듈, 및 지도기반 화면 구성 모듈을 포함한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 건물내에 상호 분리되어 설치된 실물 센서 노드 및 실물 구동체 노드에 각각 대응하는 가상의 센서 노드 및 가상의 구동체 노드와, 실물 센서 노드 및 실물 구동체 노드를 가상적으로 상호 연결한 가상 센서 및 구동체 통합 네트워크가 용이하게 형성될 수 있고, 이렇게 함으로써 가상 센서 및 구동체 통합 네트워크를 이용하여 실질적으로 실물 센서 네트워크와 실물 구동체 네트워크가 상호 연결된 것과 같은 효과가 얻어질 수 있고, 재난 발생 시 실물 센서 노드의 재난 감지에 따라 가상의 통합 네트워크 정보에 기초하여 재난에 대응할 실물 구동체 노드를 선택적으로 동작시킴으로써, 재난을 감지한 센서의 위치에 근접한 구동체가 자동으로 동작될 수 있으므로, 신속한 대피 유도와 신속한 재난 대응이 가능하다.
assignees: CHEJU NAT UNIV IND ACAD COOP

title_en: A method of constructing a work-based map library to respond to disasters
title_ko: 재난대응 업무기반 맵 라이브러리 구축방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 상황관리 매핑콘텐츠 정보를 하나의 시스템에서 조회가 가능하도록 제공하기 위한 재난상황 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 풍수해를 포함한 자연재난 관련정보들과, 상기 정보들에 의해 풍수해를 예측하기 위한 프로그램(GIS 기반 통합상황 관리시스템)이 내장된 운영컴퓨터와, 상기 프로그램에 의한 결과물을 화면에 표시하기 위한 모니터로 구성되어진 시스템에서, 상기 프로그램에 의해 다음과 같은 과정으로 수행되는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난대응 업무기반 맵 라이브러리 구축방법. 1) 상기 자연재난 관련정보들이 운영컴퓨터의 프로그램에 입력되면 상기 프로그램에 의해  재난유형에 따라 분류되는 과정, 2) 상기 1)과정에서 재난유형별 분류된 정보들이 상기 프로그램에 의해 위험요인 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 피해이력 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 취약자 거주지역에 대한 정보 중에서 2개 이상으로 분류되는데, 상기 위험요인 보유지역 및 피해이력 보유지역에 대한 정보는 사전 점검 및 예찰을 위해 시간에 따라 누적된 정보이고, 상기 취약자 거주지역에 대한 정보는 사전 대피를 위한 정보로서 분류되는 과정, 3) 상기 2)과정에서 위험요인 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 피해이력 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 취약자 거주지역에 대한 정보로 분류된 정보들이  각각 상기 프로그램에 의해 위치정보와 함께 지도정보 기반의 맵포트(재난대비 업무활용지도)로 구축되는 과정, 4) 상기 3)과정에서 위험요인 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 피해이력 보유지역에 대한 정보와, 취약자 거주지역에 대한 정보로 나뉘어 구축된 맵포트(재난대비 업무활용지도)들이 합쳐져서 맵 라이브러리(지도 정보 묶음집)로 구축되는 과정.

title_en: Mine emergency rescue command system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a mine emergency rescue command system, which comprises an intercom broadcast basic system, a video monitoring subsystem and a sensor data acquisition subsystem. The intercom broadcast basic system comprises a slope transport communication subsystem, a communication subsystem of a lifting system and a tunneling working face communication subsystem, the video monitoring subsystem comprises a slope transport monitoring subsystem and a wireless video monitoring system, the slope transport communication subsystem, the communication subsystem of the lifting system and the tunneling working face communication system respectively comprises an explosion-proof communication terminal, and the slope transport monitoring subsystem comprises a mine explosion-proof hard disk recorder, a mine explosion-proof monitor, a mine image separator and a mine explosion-proof camera. The mine emergency rescue command system adopts a full digital transmission mode and provides a comprehensive platform integrating voice intercom, video transmission and data acquisition.

title_en: Marine radar oil spill image recorder
abstract_en: The invention relates to a radar spill image recorder pertaining to the art of marine environmental monitoring technology. The radar spill image recorder is a novel radar spill image collection, analysis and processing equipment connected with a computer. The recorder consists of a voltage regulating device, an A/D converter, a frame storage, a D/A converter, a logic control module and a communication interface. The beneficial effect of the invention lies in that the radar spill image recorder conducts pre-processing of radar spill returning wave signal, radar image numerical processing, identification and classification and corresponding calculation so as to obtain spill location, scope, spill drift direction, speed and other relevant parameters; and also provides PPI explicit, B explicit and A explicit three ways of image display so as to offer technical support for spill monitoring and spill incident emergency response.

title_en: Ship internal communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship internal communication system. The invention adopts the technologies of voice digital processing, time-division program control exchange, loop bus transmission, microprocessor control and the like, more than two loop stations are connected in a ring shape through coaxial cables to form loop configuration, and each user terminal is connected to the corresponding loop station in a star-shaped mode to form the ship internal comprehensive communication system with the characteristics of signal digital transmission bus, management programming, interface standardization and the like. The system completes the functions of loud speaker command, service telephone, literature and art broadcasting, system setting and testing in the ship. The loudspeaker command function comprises a multi-stage command function, a traffic command function, a bridge command function, a real-time recording function and an emergency command function; the service telephone function comprises an automatic telephone function, a conference telephone function and a shore line function. The system adopts a mode of combining an emergency command communication network and a normal command communication network for command communication, and ensures the reliability and survivability of command communication in the ship.
assignees: 7TH 9TH RES INSTITUTE OF CHINESE SHIP HEAVY INDUSTRY GROUP COMPANY

title_en: Flood prevention material scheduling method and device, electronic equipment and computer readable medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure discloses a flood control material scheduling method, a flood control material scheduling device, electronic equipment and a computer readable medium. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a multi-source flood prevention information set; generating a city flood prevention range; carrying out flood control and waterlogging risk identification on the urban flood control range to obtain an urban flood control risk position information set; carrying out ponding depth prediction on the urban flood prevention risk position information set to obtain a ponding depth information set; controlling waterlogging early warning equipment to push waterlogging early warning information, and determining a flood prevention material information set and an urban road condition information set; carrying out material scheduling treatment on the flood control material information set to obtain flood control material scheduling information; generating a flood prevention material transportation path set; and controlling the material transportation equipment to perform material scheduling. According to the embodiment, the accuracy of waterlogging risk identification, the accuracy of early warning information pushing and the rationality and timeliness of flood control material scheduling can be improved, the waste of flood control resources is reduced, and the urban emergency response capability is improved.
assignees: ZHONGGUANCUN SCIENCE CITY URBAN BRAIN CO LTD

title_en: Multi-disaster big data early warning system and method for upstream main flow bank dam group section of yellow river
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-disaster big data early warning system and method for a yellow river upstream main flow reservoir dam group section, wherein a geological disaster monitoring module acquires earth surface displacement and deformation data, low-altitude remote sensing data and high-resolution remote sensing image data in real time, a data processing and storage module cleans the multi-dimensional monitoring data based on an ETL technology, performs space-time alignment and semantic mapping to form a standardized data set, and stores the standardized data set in a distributed database, a multi-disaster early warning calculation module triggers a specific disaster model according to space-time characteristics of input data to perform single-disaster risk calculation and cross-disaster risk superposition probability analysis, an early warning publishing module can convert calculation results into early warning information and send the early warning information to an early warning department in real time, and a live-action display module can convert disaster risk early warning results into visual three-dimensional scenes. The method can effectively improve the early warning timeliness of the sudden disaster chain and realize the full-flow intelligent management from data acquisition to emergency response and the accurate prediction of the disaster chain.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULIC RES

title_en: Fire-fighting and emergency intelligent management method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of communication and remote monitoring control of the Internet of things, in particular to a fire-fighting and intelligent-emergency management method and system based on the Internet of things. The method comprises the steps of obtaining registration information, installation positions and user attributes, carrying out standardized coding and file assembly, configuring communication parameters, establishing a data acquisition channel, monitoring data in real time, carrying out threshold comparison and fault identification, intelligently matching linkage objects according to event feature judgment types and grades, generating instructions, and finally forming an optimized closed loop through multichannel push notification, recording treatment processes and carrying out statistical analysis. The invention realizes the whole process automatic management from terminal access, event perception, intelligent research and judgment to linkage treatment and system optimization, effectively improves the accuracy and efficiency of emergency response, and enhances the reliability and self-optimization capability of the system.
assignees: NANCHENG YUNQU BEIJING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle black box apparatus using smart phone with camera
title_ko: 카메라가 장착된 스마트폰을 이용한 차량용 블랙박스 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A vehicle black box apparatus using a smart phone with a camera is provided to reduce an installation costs for a black box and wire distribution costs by using a smart phone carried in a driver. CONSTITUTION: In a vehicle black box apparatus using a smart phone with a camera, a camera(2-1, 2-2) takes a picture of a front side and a back side. A microphone records a sound in a vehicle. An acceleration sensor(4) detects acceleration. A GPS receives position and time from a GPS satellite. A processor(10) receives an image, a sound, acceleration, direction, position, and time and calculates a traveling speed. A flash memory stores traveling information periodically.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 카메라가 장착된 스마트폰을 이용하여 차량용 블랙박스 장치를 구성하는 것에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는, 스마트폰에서 적절한 응용 프로그램을 실행함으로써 스마트폰을 자동차 블랙박스로 사용할 수 있게 해주는 스마트폰 기반의 자동차 주행 기록 장치(블랙박스)에 관한 것이다.  
	본 발명은, 차량 블랙박스용 스마트폰에 있어서, 
	전후방의 영상을 촬영하는 카메라(2-1, 2-2); 차량 내의 소리를 녹음하기 위한 마이크(3); 가속도를 감지하는 가속도센서(4); 방향을 감지하는 나침반(5); GPS위성으로부터 위치와 시간을 수신하는 GPS장치(6); 상기 영상과 소리와 가속도, 방향, 위치 및 시간 정보를 수신하고, 위치와 시간 정보로부터 주행속도를 계산하여 운행정보를 형성하여 필요시 재생하도록 처리하는 처리장치(10); 상기 운행정보를 주기적으로 저장하는 플래시 메모리(12); 와이파이망 또는 이동통신망을 통해 원격 서버(14)로 운행정보를 전송하는 원격 통신 모듈; 차량 내의 정보 단말기(15)에 운행 정보를 전송하는 근거리 통신 모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
	이상과 같은 본 발명을 이용하면 대부분의 운전자가 소지하고 있는 스마트폰을 이용하여 차량용 블랙박스를 구성하는 것이 가능하게 되어 전용 불랙박스를 설치시의 비용이나 전원 배선 비용이 절감된다. 
	또한, 스마트폰 단말기 업그레이드하면서 발생하는 미사용 스마트폰을 이용해도 본 발명의 대부분의 기능이 수행되므로, 미사용 스마트폰을 폐기할 필요가 없이 재활용가능하게 된다. 
	본 발명의 스마트폰을 이용한 차량 블랙박스에서는 운행정보가 WIFI 및 이동통신망 접속을 통해 원격서버(14)에 전송되므로 사고시 스마트폰이 화재 등의 이유로 파손되더라도 원격서버(14)에 저장된 운행정보를 재생하여 사고 원인을 확인할 수 있어서 편리하다. 
	그리고, 본 발명의 스마트폰을 이용한 차량 블랙박스에서는 스마트폰에 내장된 GPS장치를 통해 시간과 위치 정보를 수신하여 저장하고, 이 시간과 위치 정보를 통해 주행속도를 계산하여 저장하므로, 추후 사고 원인 규명을 위해 관련 운행 영상과 음성을 재생시에 위치와 시간과 주행속도까지 알 수 있어서 사고 원인 규명이 용이하게 된다. 
	또한, 본 발명의 스마트폰을 이용한 차량 블랙박스에서는 사고 순간 전후의 운행 정보를 자세히 저장하는 것이 가능하여 사고 원인 규명이 편리하게 된다. 
	특히, 스마트폰이나 차량 내의 정보 단말기의 맵 정보를 통해 과속구간을 맵에 표시가능하여 사용원인 규명이 신속하고 편리하게 수행되게 된다.

title_en: System for controlling Robot for Education using Light Fidelity and Robot for Education used in the same
title_ko: 라이파이 기술을 이용한 교육용 로봇시스템 및 그에 사용되는 교육용 로봇
abstract_en: The present invention relates to: an educational robot system using light fidelity (Li-Fi) technology that minimizes interference of other transmission methods and can transmit images and programs of commands to a robot in real time in broadband and the robot can transmit a mission to a commander; and an educational robot used therein. The present invention can solve problems occur while delivering images and programs in broadband in real time.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 다른 전송방식의 간섭을 최소화 하고 영상 및 프로그램을 광대역에서 실시간으로 명령을 로봇에게 그리고 로봇은 명령자에 미션을 전달할 수 있는 라이파이 기술을 이용한 교육용 로봇시스템 및 그에 사용되는 교육용 로봇에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System for validating and appending incident-related data records in a distributed electronic ledger
abstract_en: A computer apparatus, such as a validator node, for validating incident-related data records in a distributed electronic ledger is configured to receive a request from an agent to add a proposed incident-related data record associated with an incident to the distributed electronic ledger. In response to the proposed incident-related data record, the computer apparatus determines, from the distributed electronic ledger, one or more attributes of the agent or incident. The computer apparatus determines whether the proposed incident-related data record satisfies validation criteria based at least partially on the one or more attributes of the agent or incident. Once validated, the computer apparatus may then append the proposed incident-related data record to the distributed electronic ledger. Alternatively, the proposed incident-related data record may be appended regardless of validity, but an indication of validity may be appended if the proposed incident-related data record is validated.

title_en: Learning toy, mobile body for learning toy, panel for learning toy, and portable information processing terminal for learning toy
abstract_en: A learning toy is provided which enables various kinds of operation and which allows not only younger infants but also older children to learn high-level programming in a stepwise manner. A movement path  120  is configured by a plurality of command panels  121  in which command information which can be read by an optical reading module  240  is recorded being arranged. A mobile robot  110  sequentially reads the command information recorded in the command panels  121  through which the mobile robot  110  passes while moving on the movement path  120 , operates on the basis of this command information and transmits the read command information to a tablet computer  130 . The tablet computer  130  which receives this command information displays an image or generates sound on the basis of this command information. Further, it is also possible to operate the mobile robot  110  from the tablet computer  130.

title_en: System and method for driving condition detection and notification
abstract_en: A system for accident detection or detecting an unsafe driving condition in a vehicle including a device that measures and transmits at least one output signal; at least one remote device configured to receive, record, and/or display the at least one output signal from the device; a computing device configured to receive the at least one output signal from the device and display the at least one output signal in real-time; and a graphical user interface on the computing device that allows an emergency response professional to view and customize options for monitoring the at least one output signal, wherein the device, the at least one remote device, and the computing device are communicatively connected to each other via a communications network.

title_en: Positioning method for DCS control cabinet flash alarm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of nuclear power control, in particular to a positioning method for a DCS control cabinet flash alarm. The positioning method for the DCS control cabinet flashing alarm comprises the following steps: grouping and labeling all cabinets; dividing the machine cabinet into N groups of i machine cabinets; setting single cabinet input signals in each group as digital quantity BIxx, and generating 2-system output values; setting the (i+1) th bit as group positioning, and recording an output value as a true value as a cache M; xx represents a sequence number in a cabinet group, and the digital quantity BIxx is 0 or 1, wherein 1 represents cabinet alarm, and 0 represents cabinet normal; calculating and judging each group of output values in a fixed scanning period, and setting alarm positioning judgment logic; and generating an alarm log. The invention can rapidly position the cabinet with alarm, improve the emergency response capability of the cabinet fault and ensure the reliability and stability of the operation of the DCS cabinet.

title_en: Intelligent lock capable of preventing technical unlocking and technical unlocking preventing method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent lock capable of preventing technical unlocking and a technical unlocking preventing method, comprising the following steps: the information acquisition module is used for acquiring request parameters of a user based on a triggering request of the user to the intelligent lock, and calling corresponding detection records and authentication sequences based on type sources of the request parameters; the information verification module is used for carrying out standard detection on the request parameters based on the detection record and the identification sequence, and carrying out unlocking linkage control on a linkage device in the intelligent lock after the detection is passed; and the emergency response module is used for starting the active anti-prying monitoring after the detection fails and carrying out anti-prying alarm according to the safety state change amount of the intelligent lock based on the opening result. The accuracy of preventing technical unlocking monitoring is improved, meanwhile, the reliability and timeliness of anti-prying early warning are also improved, and the safety coefficient is improved.

title_en: Chemical accident emergency response method and system under real-time monitoring
abstract_en: The application provides a chemical accident emergency response method and system under real-time monitoring, which relate to the technical field of emergency response and generate multi-source synchronous data by collecting multi-source heterogeneous data in real time for time alignment, extracting multi-mode characteristics of the multi-source synchronous data for chemical accident identification, retrieving accident scene parameters, carrying out accident response analysis based on an accident identification result, formulating an emergency response scheme and carrying out resource scheduling analysis to construct a resource scheduling network diagram, carrying out accident monitoring early warning signals according to the resource scheduling network diagram in combination with the multi-source synchronous data, generating a real-time decision instruction and pushing the real-time decision instruction and the emergency response scheme to an emergency command center. The method solves the technical problems of low accuracy of identifying the chemical accident and lagged response flow caused by lack of multi-source heterogeneous data fusion and real-time linkage mechanisms in the prior art, and achieves the technical effects of improving the identification accuracy of the chemical accident and the emergency response speed.

title_en: Switch board fire watch control unit
title_ko: 배전반 화재감시제어기
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A distribution panel fire detection controller is provided to display an alarm to enable an operator to visually recognize a sign of fire in advance, thereby preventing fire. CONSTITUTION: A distribution side power line temperature detection part detects a power distribution line temperature of a switch. The distribution side power line temperature detection part converts the temperature into a resistance value corresponding to a measured temperature. A first control part (40) checks a sign of fire and provides a first alarm display and fire-extinguisher actuation signal. A second control part (50) checks a sign of fire and provides a second alarm display and fire-extinguisher actuation signal. A first and a second alarm display activation part (60,70) turn on/off an alarm display part of each step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배전반의 수전전력선 및 용도별 전력선의 온도를 실시간 감시하여 배전반의 화재징후여부를 미리 시각적으로 인지할 수 있도록 하므로서 전력선의 이상발열에 의한 배전반의 화재를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 한 배전반 화재감시제어기에 관한 것으로, 이는 배전반 온도 검출부(10)와, 수전측 전력선온도검출부(20)와, 배전측 전력선 온도검출부(30)와, 제1 및 제2 제어부(40)(50)와, 제1 및 제2 경보표시구동부(60)(70)와, 제1 및 제2 기록부(100)(110)와, 소화장치구동부(120)를 구비하여 배전반의 수전전력선 및 용도별 전력선의 온도를 실시간 감시하여 배전반의 화재징후여부를 미리 시각적으로 인지할 수 있도록 경보표시해 주므로서 전력선의 이상발열에 의한 배전반의 화재를 미연에 방지 조치할 수 있는 효과와, 간단한 센서회로구성만으로도 배전반의 수전전력선 및 용도별 전력선의 이상발열을 단계별로 표시하여 관리자가 이를 보고 어느 전력선에 문제가 있는지를 쉽게 인지하여 사전 화재발생을 억제할 수 있는 장점과, 전력선과 개폐기의 교체시기를 손쉽게 알 수 있고, 또 계통도별 또는 용도별 전력선의 부하상태관리 및 교체시기 등의 효율적인 관리를 수행할 수 있는 장점과, 또한 배전반에 설치되는 소화장치와 연계동작이 가능하여 이로 인한 화재사고를 막을 수 있고, 실시간 검출되는 전력선별 이상발열데이타를 기록표시하여 향후 관리자가 배전반의 계통도별 또는 용도별 전력선의 부하상태관리 및 교체시기 등의 효율적인 관리를 수행할 수 있는 효과 및 배전반의 화재감기제어기를 저자로 제작이 가능하여 배전반의 제작비용을 대폭 격감시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of Emergency Command Vehicle
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of Emergency Command Vehicle, including car body, includes driver's compartment and compartment district in described car body, described compartment district is divided into again front portion, middle part and rear portion three district, and described front portion is operating space, and middle part is rest area, rear portion is generating cabin, is provided with partition wall between described middle part and rear portion；Described operating space includes rack, it is provided with operating board on described rack, ups power, server, electrical apparatus control system, power amplifier, printer, video/audio matrix switch, video encoder and 3G router it is placed with in described rack, being provided with display on described operating board, described ups power provides the energy for other electrical equipment.The invention has the beneficial effects as follows: this Emergency Command Vehicle achieves incident scene information collection, emergency vehicles real-time positioning, daily tour record, emergency communication, the several functions such as emergency event floor manager.

title_en: Virtual assistant system for emergency dispatcher and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual assistant system of an emergency dispatcher and an operation method thereof, which can enhance the task execution capacity of the dispatcher and reduce human errors. The functions of the dispatcher virtual assistant include updating the status of emergency events in real time, suggesting or reminding the dispatcher to take appropriate action at the appropriate time, answering the dispatcher's query for task related information, and producing event reports on the dispatcher's request. The dispatcher virtual assistant comprises a dispatcher language model based on machine learning and deep learning algorithms, and is used for analyzing and extracting the current state of an event from an event call record in real time and processing and responding to the inquiry or the request of a dispatcher. The dispatcher virtual assistant may be customized for different types of emergency events, local cells of the event. The dispatcher virtual assistant may be used in conjunction with existing computer-assisted dispatch systems.

title_en: Intelligent dispatching guiding system for nursing homes
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of optimal scheduling and configuration, and discloses an intelligent scheduling guide system for a nursing home, which comprises a monitoring unit, an optimizing unit, an analyzing unit and a scheduling guide unit, wherein the monitoring unit is used for counting the number of old people, recording the states of the old people, tracking the favorites of the old people, monitoring whether medical staff is in an idle state or not, determining the favorites of the old people through collecting the demand analysis selected in the daily life of the old people, and determining the consumption level of the old people according to the service level analysis selected in the daily life of the old people; the quantity, state, hobbies and consumption level of the old are used as input, the evaluation and economic benefit of the nursing home are the highest as an objective function, and the optimal evaluation and economic benefit are obtained by using an optimization field Ma Suanfa, so that an optimal scheduling guiding strategy is determined to perform capacity configuration. According to the invention, through introducing the hobby variable, guiding the grade variable, selecting the demand variable and optimizing the wild horse algorithm, the economic benefit of the nursing home is maximum, the evaluation rate is optimal, and the comprehensive cost is reduced.

title_en: Intelligent regulation and control system for power station energy storage power supply load
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of load distribution control, in particular to an intelligent regulation and control system for a power station energy storage power supply load. According to the invention, the real-time dynamic distribution of the load is realized by accurately evaluating the residual electric energy of the energy storage unit, the setting of the priority of the load is optimized by utilizing the electric power parameter monitored in real time, the accuracy of power supply and demand matching is improved, the dynamic scheduling path optimization is adopted, the interference control mechanism is combined, the stability and reliability during loop switching are ensured, the instability and energy waste of a load loop are avoided, the accuracy of a regulating result is further improved through accurate feedback verification, the load regulating state is recorded in real time, the emergency response capability and the reliability of long-term operation of a power station are enhanced, the intelligent management of the load of the power station is optimized, and the operation stability and safety are improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN WEIPENG SHIJI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus of educating programming, method for educating programming, recording medium storing computer program for executing the same, and computer program storing recording medium for executing the same
title_ko: 프로그래밍 교육 장치, 프로그래밍 교육 방법, 이 방법을 구현하기 위해 컴퓨터 프로그램이 저장된 기록매체 및 이 방법을 구현하기 위해 기록매체에 저장된 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: Presented are an apparatus and a method for educating programming, which can perform programming education interestingly and efficiently. The apparatus comprises: a combination unit for generating a program pattern by combining a pattern of a cube selected by a user and a program command; a program pattern connecting unit for connecting the program pattern selected by the user to each other to generate a program pattern combination; an image generation unit for imaging the program pattern combination; and a storage unit for storing the image generated by the image generation unit.
abstract_ko: 프로그래밍 교육을 재미있고 효율적으로 행할 수 있도록 하는 프로그래밍 교육 장치 및 방법을 제시한다. 제시된 장치는 사용자가 선택한 큐브의 패턴과 프로그램 명령어를 조합하여 프로그램 패턴을 생성하는 조합부, 사용자가 선택한 프로그램 패턴을 서로 연결하여 프로그램 패턴 조합을 생성하는 프로그램 패턴 연결부, 프로그램 패턴 조합을 이미지화하는 이미지 생성부, 및 이미지 생성부에서 생성된 이미지를 저장하는 저장부를 포함한다.

title_en: A system for managing access user identifications with respect to facilities accessed by multi users
title_ko: 다수 사용자가 출입할 수 있는 시설의 각 출입자 식별 정보를 관리하는 시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a computer readable storage medium, recording one or more computer readable commands. If a system, which manages access person identification information with respect to a facility accessed by multiple users, allows a management server to read and execute the commands, wherein the system comprises a facility manager device, when an arbitrary user enters the facility, receiving predetermined identification information prepared in advance with respect to the user from a user terminal of the user and storing the received information, and the management server receiving the access person information from the facility manager device and managing the received information, the one or more computer readable commands allow the management server to: request the facility manager device for providing the access person identification information obtained at a set date or during a set period through a communication network; receive the access person identification information, obtained at the set date or during the period, from the facility manager device, which responds to the request, through the communication network, wherein the access person identification information includes each identification information received from each user terminal of each user, having entered the facility at the date or during the period, and stored, and each identification information is stored at the facility manager device in an encrypted state and transmitted to the management server in the encrypted state as it is; and perform operation such that each identification information received in the encrypted state from the facility manager device is decrypted by using a decryption key prepared in advance, wherein the decryption key is managed in secret by a person who has preset authority. The present invention can effectively contribute to prevention and blocking of the spread of infectious diseases.
abstract_ko: 하나 이상의 컴퓨터 판독가능 명령어가 기록된 컴퓨터 판독가능 저장매체로서, 상기 하나 이상의 컴퓨터 판독가능 명령어는, 다수 사용자가 출입하는 시설의 출입자 식별 정보를 관리하는 시스템- 상기 시스템은, 임의의 사용자가 상기 시설에 입장할 때 상기 사용자의 사용자 단말로부터 상기 사용자에 관하여 미리 준비된 소정의 식별 정보를 수신 및 저장하는 시설 관리자 장치와, 상기 시설 관리자 장치로부터 상기 출입자 식별 정보를 수신 및 관리하는 관리 서버를 포함함 -의 상기 관리 서버에 의해 판독 및 실행될 경우, 상기 관리 서버로 하여금, 통신망을 통하여, 상기 시설 관리자 장치로, 소정 일자 또는 기간에 획득된 상기 출입자 식별 정보의 제공을 요청하고, 상기 통신망을 통하여, 상기 요청에 응답한 상기 시설 관리자 장치로부터 상기 소정 일자 또는 기간에 획득된 상기 출입자 식별 정보를 수신- 상기 출입자 식별 정보는, 상기 소정 일자 또는 기간에 상기 시설에 입장한 각 사용자의 각 사용자 단말로부터 수신 및 저장한 상기 각 식별 정보를 포함하고, 상기 각 식별 정보는, 암호화된 상태로 상기 시설 관리자 장치에 저장되어 있다가, 상기 암호화된 상태 그대로 상기 관리 서버로 전송됨 -하며, 상기 시설 관리자 장치로부터 상기 암호화된 상태로 수신된 상기 각 식별 정보를, 미리 준비된 복호화키- 상기 복호화키는 미리 정해진 권한을 갖는 자에 의해 비밀리에 관리됨 -를 이용하여 복호화하도록 동작하게 하는, 컴퓨터 판독가능 저장매체가 제공된다.

title_en: Helicopter multi-simulator synchronization-based test method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a helicopter multi-simulator synchronism based test method, and belongs to the technical field of computer distributed simulation application. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, a pilot station sends a synchronism test command to a simulator 1 control system; step two, simulation management software in the simulator 1 receives the operation command and sends the operation command to a flight simulation system for settlement, the obtained helicopter position and attitude information is sent to a vision system for rendering, and rendered data is synchronously sent to vision software of the simulator 2 for rendering; step three, the data rendered by the simulator 1 and the simulator 2 are respectively sent to the synchronism testing system in a UDP (user Datagram protocol) form, and the receiving time t is recorded 1 Stage t 2 (ii) a Step four, the synchronism testing system draws a comparison graph according to the sine wave and the time obtained twice to obtain a synchronous time error T; and step five, repeating the steps to obtain a synchronism test statistical table, and judging whether the synchronous time error T meets the requirement.

title_en: Evaluation method and system for payment data security
abstract_en: The invention discloses a payment data security assessment method and system, which comprise the steps of data acquisition, risk identification, security assessment, report generation and the like, wherein a distributed acquisition node is combined with a quantum random number generator, a deep learning model, a self-encoder, a knowledge graph and other innovative modules are adopted, anti-sample detection and risk dynamic simulation are added, report encryption, visualization and automatic update are carried out, and a real-time monitoring, simulated attack and emergency response module is also provided, so that comprehensiveness, accuracy and timeliness of payment data security assessment are ensured.

title_en: System and the Method of Railroad Facility Management on IoT(Internet of Things)-based
title_ko: 사물 인터넷을 기반으로 하는 철도시설물 관리시스템 및 관리방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a railroad facility management system based on the Internet of things and a management method thereof. According to the present invention, the railroad facility management system includes: a central management server part including an algorithm and software to analyze, store and control information inputted from a sensor and information obtained through the Internet of things; a gateway part comprising a wireless interface connecting the central management server part to the sensor; a sensor detection wireless network communicating with the central management server part bidirectionally and providing a wireless network environment to a railroad facility; a wireless communication part delivering a control transceiving signal and a detection state of the sensor to the sensor detection wireless network; an object detection sensor part transmitting the number of detected objects to the central management server part while recording and storing the movement of approaching objects by detecting the movement; a smart sensor part transmitting information about whether security, fire occurrence and air quality are normal to the central management server part and adjusting the lighting and illuminance of the railroad facility; and a smart control part analyzing and controlling a command transmitted from the smartphone or the central management server part. Therefore, the railroad facility management system is capable of reducing expenses for the management of stations and increasing the safety of trains.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 사물 인터넷을 기반으로 하는 철도시설물 관리시스템 및 관리방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 사물인터넷을 통해 얻어진 정보와 센서로부터 입력되는 정보를 분석, 저장 및 제어할 수 있는 소프트웨어 및 알고리즘을 탑재한 중앙관리서버부와 상기 중앙관리서버부와 상기 센서를 연결시키는 무선 인터페이스로 이루어진 게이트웨어부와 상기 중앙관리서버부와 양방향 통신하며, 철도시설물에 무선네트워크 환경을 제공하는 센서감지무선네트워크와 상기 센서의 감지상태와 제어 송수신신호를 상기 센서감지무선네트워크에 전달하는 무선통신부와 접근하는 물체의 이동을 감지하여 기록, 저장하면서 상기 감지된 물체의 개체수를 상기 중앙관리서버부로 전송하는 물체감지센서부와 보안, 화재발생, 공기질의 이상 유무를 상기 중앙관리서버부로 전송하고, 철도시설물의 조명 및 조도의 조정을 하는 스마트센서부와 스마트폰 또는 상기 중앙관리서버부에서 전송되는 명령을 분석, 제어하는 스마트제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.
assignees: 2ISYS INTERMATIONAL IND SYSTEMS CO LTD;KIM CHEOL HWAN;KIM GYU WON

title_en: Method and apparatus for simulating response plans against nbc hazards and recording medium thereof
title_ko: 화생방 재난 대응 시뮬레이션 방법, 장치 및 기록 매체
abstract_ko: 실시예는 화생방 재난 대응 시뮬레이션 방법, 장치 및 기록 매체에 관한 것으로서, 실시예에 따른 화생방 재난 대응 시뮬레이션 방법은, 화생방 재난을 포함한 시나리오가 입력되는 단계, 상기 입력된 시나리오를 기초로 하여 시뮬레이션을 실행하는 단계, 상기 시뮬레이션의 실행 중에 상기 화생방 재난이 발생한 경우, 상기 화생방 재난에 의한, 오염 영역 및 오염 농도 분포를 지배방정식을 이용하여 산출하는 단계, 상기 산출된, 오염 영역 및 오염 농도 분포를 이용하여, 개체가 오염되었는지 판정하는 단계, 그리고 상기 개체가 오염된 것으로 판정된 경우, 상기 오염된 개체가 무력화되었는지 판단하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Device and method for automatically notifying FMS traffic accidents
title_ko: Fms 교통사고 자동통보 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, only driving data and black box image data related to a traffic accident are stored and analyzed from an FMS management vehicle, and the occurrence of the traffic accident is automatically determined and notified to a manager. Accordingly, the manager may receive not only the driving data related to the traffic accident but also the black box image data to quickly and accurately identify a traffic accident. The manager may take follow-up measures (for example, FMS cargo truck transportation, rapid removal and control in case of hazardous material traffic accident, snow removal work, input of an alternative vehicle for a public institution management vehicle such as a garbage collection vehicle, and the like) based on the received driving data and black box image data. Therefore, various follow-up measures are possible compared to e-call, and data can be freely accessed separately from an event data recorder (EDR). Accordingly, the stored data can be used as self-traffic accident investigation and statistical data for each institution. In addition, it is possible to record and verify the status of vehicles involved in traffic accidents for all types of vehicles, without being limited to passenger vehicles and passenger or cargo vehicles weighing 3.85 tons or less, according to Article 56-2 of motor vehicle regulations.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따르면, FMS 관리 차량으로부터 교통사고와 관련된 주행 데이터와 블랙박스 영상 데이터만을 저장 및 분석하고 교통사고 발생을 자동으로 판별하여 관리자에게 통보한다. 이로 인해, 교통사고와 관련된 주행 데이터뿐만 아니라 블랙박스 영상 데이터를 관리자가 제공받아 신속 정확한 교통사고 상확 파악이 가능하고, 관리자가 이를 바탕으로 후속조치(예를 들어, FMS 적재물 대차운송, 위험물 교통사고 시 신속 제거 및 통제, 제설작업, 쓰레기 수거차량 등과 같은 공공기관 관리차량 대체차량 투입 등)를 취할 수 있다. 따라서, 이콜(E-Call)보다 다양한 후속조치가 가능하며, 또한 이벤트 데이터 레코더(Event Data Recorder: EDR)와 별개로 데이터에 대한 자유로운 접근이 가능하여 저장된 데이터를 기관별 자체 교통사고 조사 및 통계 자료로 활용할 수 있다. 또한, 자동차 규칙 제56조의 2에 의한 승용자동차 및 3.85톤 이하 승합, 화물자동차로 제한받지 않고, 모든 차량의 교통사고 차량 상태 기록 및 확인을 할 수 있다.

title_en: Consent management system over a communications network
abstract_en: A system for managing consent over a communications network includes a web server application having a consent scoring module for calculating a dynamic consent score based on received data, a consent monitoring module, a communications link between the web server application and an emergency dispatch center via the communications network, an emergency response mechanism for initiating a call to the emergency dispatch center, and, a cryptographic storage module configured to generate and store tamper-resistant records of consent-related data, including pre-interaction checklist responses, real-time verbal commands, and post-interaction feedback, using cryptographic hashing to ensure data integrity and confidentiality.

title_en: System and method for driving condition detection and notification
abstract_en: A system for accident detection or detecting an unsafe driving condition in a vehicle including a device that measures and transmits at least one output signal; at least one remote device configured to receive, record, and/or display the at least one output signal from the device; a computing device configured to receive the at least one output signal from the device and display the at least one output signal in real-time; and a graphical user interface on the computing device that allows an emergency response professional to view and customize options for monitoring the at least one output signal, wherein the device, the at least one remote device, and the computing device are communicatively connected to each other via a communications network.

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) for mobile assets that includes a data recorder. The data recorder includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queuing repository. DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data acquired by DARS through a web browser, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Image processing and compression coding as well as remote monitoring experimental installation
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an image processing and compression coding as well as remote monitoring experimental installation which includes a synchronous monitoring communication and control device, an Ethernet switch, an experimental data analysis and real time control proxy server, a general packet radio communication device, a central control host and a holder control system. The method is as follows: the synchronous monitoring communication and control device automatically and synchronously monitors the whole process of student video communication processing experiment and records the experiment code and experimental data of students in real time; a movable terminal or the central control host obtains the experiment code, data and image documents from the communication and control device through the proxy server in real time and realizes real time video communication; the proxy server receives and resolves a command sent by the central control host, sends a control command to the appointed synchronous monitoring communication and control device as well as locks and unlocks an experiment box necessarily; and the holder control system receives a holder control command forwarded by the experiment box to control the motion of the holder and a lens.

title_en: Automatic generation method for digital emergency plan
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic generation method for a digital emergency plan. The automatic generation method comprises the following steps of: digitally splitting a historical text plan; setting a preview search matching condition; and digitally matching and generating the plan. A textual plan is converted into a digital plan through structurally processing a historical text plan system; a comparison passage is set between a new emergency and a structured digital plan through setting the preview search matching condition for the structured digital plan so that a plan with the highest similarity with the new emergency can be found in a structured digital plan base, and all related elements are automatically extracted to form a current digital plan. According to the automatic generation method, the time of making a plan for a new emergency by an emergency commander is greatly shortened, and the timeliness of an emergency treatment process is increased.
assignees: GUANGZHOU METRO CORP;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd

title_en: Fire-proof video infrared monitoring system for large-area remote sensing forest
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-proof video infrared monitoring system for a large-area remote sensing forest, comprising an infrared thermal imaging device used for collecting an image of a forest through infrared thermal imaging, a video server used for compressing the image collected by the infrared thermal imaging device and sending the processed image to a monitoring center through a network, and the monitoring center used for receiving image data sent by the video server, analyzing the image data and judging whether there is a disaster in the forest. The fire in the forest can be monitored in real time in the monitoring center, and the purpose of finding a fire in time and preventing fire is achieved. When there is a fire, the infrared thermal imaging device can transmit a field image back to the monitoring center in real time to provide powerful guarantee for remote commanding and dispatching of the monitoring center; and meanwhile, the whole process of fire occurrence, development and extinguishing is recorded in an authentic way to provide first-hand information for disaster prevention and governance.

title_en: Emergency rescue drilling system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue drilling system and method, wherein the method comprises a disaster site information acquisition module for acquiring information of a disaster event site; the scene construction module constructs a corresponding disaster event scene model according to the received information of the disaster event scene; the interaction device acquires scene setting information of the disaster event scene model; the emergency processing deduction module generates a disaster development trend result according to the disaster event scene model and the scene setting information; the emergency resource scheduling module generates an emergency resource allocation scheme according to the disaster development trend result; the interaction device acquires deployment information of emergency rescue force according to a disaster development trend result and generates an emergency rescue scheme; the emergency rescue command module generates an emergency rescue command log according to the received emergency resource allocation scheme and the emergency rescue scheme, can effectively improve the authenticity and the degree of contact of the simulated disaster emergency event, and improves the timeliness and the accuracy of emergency rescue.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle-based fire-fighting auxiliary dispatching management method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a fire control auxiliary dispatching management method and a fire control auxiliary dispatching management system based on an unmanned plane, which relate to the technical field of dispatching management and are used for carrying out fire position positioning and region demarcation, configuring an initial cruising path, acquiring an initial scout image, feeding back to a fire control command center to determine a deployment decision scheme, carrying out correction on the real-time scout image and the initial scout image to determine that the disaster condition is updated, adjusting the deployment decision scheme, outputting an iterative deployment decision scheme, and carrying out fire control dispatching management based on the iterative deployment scheme and adjustment deviation information. The invention solves the technical problems of the prior art that the disaster situation is not controlled in real time, and the information of the command center and the rescue workers is not transmitted in time, so that the fire control dispatching management effect is poor, and realizes the real-time adjustment of the deployment decision scheme by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and the scheme is transmitted to the rescue workers in time, thereby achieving the technical effect of improving the timeliness and the accuracy of the fire control dispatching management.

title_en: Method, device and equipment for on-site law enforcement access evidence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for on-site law enforcement access certificate, which comprise the following steps: when an alarm command is received, matching corresponding alarm personnel according to an alarm place broadcast in the alarm command, and starting to execute an alarm task after the alarm information of the alarm personnel is associated with a case; based on the police-out site, acquiring identity information of the inquired person by the police-out personnel and uploading the identity information to a platform for identity verification; after the identity verification is received, acquiring query audios and videos in real time and automatically creating query records in the query process to generate a case query record file; and calculating the case query record file by using a preset hash algorithm, and uploading the case query record file to a system in real time in a file hash value mode for archiving. The method can realize the fixation of full-flow non-inductive law enforcement and electronic inquiry evidence, effectively realize the working closed loop of the case handling law enforcement flow, further optimize the law enforcement flow and improve the law enforcement efficiency.
assignees: ZHONGJIAN MEIYA XIAMEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Geological disaster early warning system with high stability
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of geological disaster early warning, in particular to a geological disaster early warning system with high stability, which comprises an environment monitoring module, a risk assessment module, a dynamic threshold setting module, an early warning signal transmitting module and an emergency response coordination module, wherein the environment monitoring module is used for monitoring the environment of the geological disaster; wherein, the environment monitoring module: collecting multidimensional environment and geological data; risk assessment module: assessing the potential risk of landslide; dynamic threshold setting module: dynamically adjusting a landslide early warning threshold value; the early warning signal transmitting module: sending out an early warning signal; and a coordination module: the method is used for allocating emergency rescue resources and optimizing the deployment of rescue actions. According to the invention, advanced environment monitoring technology, intelligent risk assessment and dynamic threshold adjustment mechanism are integrated, and effective early warning signal emission and emergency response coordination are achieved, so that accuracy, timeliness and response efficiency of geological disaster early warning are remarkably improved, and risks of casualties and property loss are greatly reduced.
assignees: LUNAN GEOLOGICAL ENGINEERING INVESTIG INSTITUTE OF SHANDONG PROVINCE SECOND GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF SH

title_en: Regional intelligent early warning monitoring system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent early warning and monitoring system and method for an area, wherein the early warning and monitoring system comprises a data acquisition unit, a data analysis and processing unit, a rear end control unit and an alarm unit, the data acquisition unit is connected with the rear end control unit through the data analysis and processing unit, the alarm unit is connected with the rear end control unit, the invention has simple working principle and high intelligent degree, and by providing a monitoring probe and a high-power acousto-optic alarm, the computer and video recorder  、  AI algorithm server are combined to achieve the purposes of early warning and theft prevention, early warning and fire fighting fires, quick help seeking by personnel in the field, keeping the environment clean and tidy and managing the appearance of the vehicle, the practicality is stronger, and is simpler and more convenient, reduces the cost of labor, reduces the personnel on duty manual work, and quick early warning is reported to the police, reduces the emergence of stealing the incident, prevents fire control conflagration, and all-weather no dead angle control early warning etc..
assignees: GUANGDONG NANYUE URBAN MAN SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Emergency event visualization collaboration method and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency event visualization collaboration method and terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical monitoring data set of an emergency event in a target area, preprocessing the historical monitoring data set, and generating a standardized event feature set; training a time sequence prediction model according to dynamic environment parameters to obtain an event evolution prediction model, constructing a geographic region matching model based on static geographic parameters, and generating a visual layer template associated with a target region. And collecting the current environmental data flow of the target area in real time, classifying by an event evolution prediction model to obtain an event classification result, and calling a corresponding visual layer template from a geographic area matching model according to the event classification result. And fusing a diffusion path, an intensity level and a called visual layer template in the event classification result, generating a dynamic visual instruction set, and rendering and outputting an emergency event evolution situation map through an interactive interface. The invention can improve the timeliness and the decision reliability of emergency response.

title_en: Intelligent care monitoring method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses an intelligent care monitoring method, an intelligent care monitoring device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of intelligent care monitoring, wherein the method comprises the steps of utilizing physiological monitoring equipment to collect physiological indexes in real time, monitoring environmental data through an environmental sensor and capturing behavior data through a behavior capturing terminal; analyzing environmental data by using a time sequence clustering algorithm to obtain an environmental abnormal value, analyzing physiological indexes and behavior data based on a Bi-LSTM model and an attribute model to obtain a behavior sequence, calculating a physiological deviation value, analyzing the behavior data by using an MFCC (multi-frequency component carrier) feature extraction and a transducer model to obtain an emotion fluctuation value, generating a comprehensive risk score, carrying out risk classification, carrying out data recording and monitoring at low risk, carrying out family early warning at medium risk, and triggering an emergency response mechanism to carry out multi-equipment linkage at high risk. The invention solves the problems of high false alarm rate, lag response, lack of psychological monitoring and personalized service and weak privacy and safety mechanism in the prior art.

title_en: The combat simulation trainig thereof method using AR VR MR
title_ko: Ar vr mr을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법
abstract_en: A simulation training system comprises: a server for storing a program for simulation training; a database for storing data required for a simulation training program of the server; a display for setting the program for simulation training through the server; and a motion controller for controlling output of a simulation training image and training to be available through the server, wherein the motion controller further includes a remote controller for controlling training to be available according to a VR which is capable of outputting a simulation training image and is wearable, and a simulation training image output through the VR, and a curved trajectory firearm which is capable of training to fire a guided missile and shell by using the VR and the remote controller. According to the present invention, various training methods through military operation theme content are possible by applying AR and a motion recognition technique in order to improve navigation, and it is possible to contribute to improvement of fighting strength of an army by solving an individual practical training time shortage problem due to a narrow training site and excessive training preparation time. Also, according to the present invention, it is possible to reduce accidents caused by training using a weapon system of a trainee and generation of harm to the public due to noise generated during training, and also aiming, firing and inducing processes can be easily trained. In addition, an actual guided missile is not used to train gunners, thereby reducing costs and dangerous situation.
abstract_ko:
모의훈련시스템에 있어서, 모의훈련에 대한 프로그램이 저장되는 서버와, 서버의 모의훈련 프로그램에 필요한 데이터가 저장되는 데이터베이스와 서버를 통해 모의훈련에 대한 프로그램을 설정할 수 있도록 하는 디스플레이와 서버를 통해 모의훈련 영상 출력 및 훈련이 가능하도록 제어하는 모션컨트롤러를 포함하되,  모션컨트롤러는 모의훈련 영상 출력 및 착용이 가능한 VR과 VR을 통해 출력되는 모의훈련 영상에 따라 훈련이 가능하도록 제어하는 리모콘과 VR과 리모콘을 활용하여 유도탄 및 포탄을 포격할 수 있도록 훈련이 가능한 곡사화기를 더 포함하도록 제공하는 것이다. 
조종술 향상을 위해 AR 및 동작인식 기술을 적용하여 작전테마 콘텐츠를 통한 다양한 훈련방식이 가능한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 효과는 협소한 훈련 공장 및 과다한 훈련준비 시간으로 인한 개별실습시간 부족 문제를 해결하여 군의 전투력 향상에 기여하기 위한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 효과는 교육생의 무기체계를 사용한 훈련에 대한 안전사고 감소 및 훈련 시 발생하는 소음으로 인한 대민피해 발생을 감소하기 위한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 효과는 유도탄의 조준, 사격, 유도 과정을 쉽게 훈련할 수 있고, 사수들에게 훈련시키기 위하여 실제유도탄을 사용하지 않아 비용절감 및 위험상황을 감소하기 위한 AR VR MR을 이용한 교전 모의 훈련 방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Systems and methods for forming and operating an ecosystem for a conducted electrical weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment (e.g., ecosystem) for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: Incident management for battery energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an incident management system and method for monitoring a battery energy storage system and providing technical information related to an abnormal event in the battery energy storage system to a plurality of different users in different locations and with different requirements. The incident management system comprises one or more processing units configured to receive data from a plurality of sensors, the data encoding measured properties of the battery energy storage system, and process the received data to identify an abnormal event in the battery energy storage system, obtain information about the abnormal event, and determine a current stage of the abnormal event on a pre-defined incident progress timeline, the pre-defined incident progress timeline comprising a plurality of stages. An operator user interface for use by an operator of the battery energy storage system is configured to output information about the abnormal event. A first responder user interface for use by a first responder is configured to output a subset of the information about the abnormal event and output the current stage of the abnormal event on the incident progress timeline.

title_en: Fire alarm text response system
abstract_en: A computer software and hardware system for fire stations is described which provides communications utilizing SMS (Short Message Service) cellular phone text messaging automatically notifying firemen or other personnel of an emergency page when their dispatch pages them via radio dispatch or by other means. Responses from this SMS text message are replied to via SMS text messaging with a code letter and their response is displayed on a screen at their station so other responding firemen know if, who, and where other firemen are responding. Users can also opt to automatically receive on their cell phones an MMS (Multimedia Message Service) message containing a multimedia sound recording of the actual emergency dispatch voice page.

title_en: Video command/session system without MCU and method
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a video command/session system without a micro-programmed control unit (MCU) and a method applied in the fields of production scheduling, emergency command and the like of industries of electric power, petrifaction, army and the like. The system is based on a soft switch architecture and comprises a plurality of Internet contact center (ICC) video command terminals, a device vector table (DVT) desktop video communication terminal, a model view controller (MVC) mobile video acquisition and communication terminal, a forward voice channel (FVC) fixed video acquisition and communication terminal and a video disk recorder (VDR) video server. The session initiation protocol (SIP) adopted among the components of the system is used as a call control protocol. In a video command or video session, the audio is mixed by an intelligent sound mixing module of the ICC, and the mixed audio is transmitted to the related terminals; and the video is pushed to a plurality of DVTs by the ICC to watch, and the DVTs and the low level ICC can also actively apply for calling the video of a certain channel. The video is automatically distributed by a receiving end so as to realize a video command/session without the MCU or a multicast mode.
assignees: SHENZHEN BANGYAN INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;CHONGQING ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Traffic accident evidence obtaining method based on blockchain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a traffic accident evidence obtaining method based on a blockchain. According to the invention, the vehicles are mutually authenticated and jointly sign the accident report after the traffic accident, and the signed accident report is transmitted to the blockchain by the roadside unit after the vehicles are authenticated with the roadside unit based on the blockchain technology, so that the record and the non-falsifiability of the accident report are realized, and the efficient mutual authentication between the vehicles and the roadside unit is realized. By introducing an elliptic curve to carry out encryption operation on key parameters in the authentication process, the security of the whole authentication process is improved, meanwhile, a batch verification method of signatures is designed, and the operation pressure on wireless equipment is reduced. During authentication and incident report uploading to the blockchain, the vehicle uses dynamic anonymity policies to protect privacy. Can effectively resist various known attacks and realize privacy protection.

title_en: System of crime prevention for children and operating method thereof
title_ko: 어린이 방범 시스템 및 그 운용방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system of crime prevention for children and an operating method thereof are provided to dispatch a safety person after a warning signal is generated if a dangerous situation of children is checked. CONSTITUTION: An unmanned security unit(100) photographs a child protection zone in real time. A server unit(120) records information including crime information, a location, time information, output time and an auditory guide massage in an assigned area. A safety car(150) performs corresponding safety measures by moving to the child protection zone by wireless control of an integrated monitoring center. An administration communication network(160) transceives the crime information through a designated route.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 어린이가 긴급한 경우 보호를 요청하여 범죄로부터 보호받도록 하는 어린이 방범 시스템 및 그 운용방법에 관한 것으로 특히, 인텔리전트와 더미 모드 중에서 어느 하나의 모드로 어린이 보호구역을 실시간 촬영하며 보호 요청 어린이와 사각지대를 촬영하여 방범정보로 확보하며, 시각적 및 청각적 메시지를 출력하는 무인방범 수단과, 무인방범 수단을 제어하여 수집되는 방범정보를 분석하고, 시각적 및 청각적 메시지를 입력하며 방범정보를 서버수단의 할당된 영역에 기록하는 통합관제 센터 및 무인방범 수단의 방법정보를 할당된 영역에 기록하고 출력하는 서버수단을 포함하고, 무인방범 수단, 통합관제 센터, 서버수단에 유선과 무선 중에서 선택된 어느 하나 이상의 방식으로 접속하고 지정된 경로로 정보와 신호를 송수신하는 공중통신망으로 연결된 구성으로 이루어지는 특징에 의하여, 안전요원 및 안전차량을 파견하므로 어린이를 범죄로부터 보호하고 재발을 예방하며, 범죄 추적의 증거 자료로 활용하고, 홍보되면서 범죄로부터 안전한 보호구역을 제공하는 효과가 있다.  
       
      어린이, 범죄, 유저인터페이스, 원클릭, 보호구역, 더미, 인텔리전트

title_en: Method and system to associate the IoT devices with an incident and manage access
abstract_en: A method for registering an Internet of Things (IoT) device to an incident IoT ledger system is provided. A computer aided dispatch (CAD) device sends a first ledger request including an incident record to a distributed incident ledger operated by validation nodes. The CAD device receives a first ledger response indicating that the incident record was accepted and added into the incident ledger after being validated by the nodes. The CAD device then sends a second ledger request to an IoT distributed ledger operated by second validation nodes. The request includes a query to the IoT distributed ledger to find registered IoT devices for affiliating with the incident. The CAD device receives a second ledger response including information identifying registered IoT devices from the IoT distributed ledger. The CAD device then sends an affiliation invitation to an IoT device determined from the registered IoT devices identified in the second ledger response.
