     화재감지장치와 연결되어 화재감지에 따른 정보를 수신받는 화재경보 수신기와;  화재경보 수신기와 연결되어 미리 프로그램된 내용에 따라 유무선 통신을 이용하여 소방서에 화재경보 신호를 출력하는 게이트 웨이로 이루어지고;  상기 게이트 웨이는,  화재경보기의 경보신호를 받아 자동으로 119를 호출하여 소방서 근무자의 응답이 없으면 재발신하고, 정상응답이면 화재발생 위치를 음성으로 자동 송출하는 프로그램 코드와,  화재로 인하여 전화선이 두절된 상태이면 TRS 망을 통해 화재발생 위치를 음성으로 자동 송출하는 프로그램 코드를 갖는 것이 특징이며; 
     아파트나 상가 등에서 화재가 발생하였을 때 유무선 통신을 이용하여 소방서에 자동 신고함과 더불어 현재 위치를 음성으로 출력토록 함으로서 정확한 위치정보에 따라 빠른 출동이 가능하여 초동진압이 원활하게 이루어지는 효과가 있다. 
       
     화재, 전화선, TRS망, P형수신기, R형수신기, 119펄스신호,

title_en: Ship pollutant emissions and compliance information into real-time analysis, recording and monitoring system using land, sea integrated control system
title_ko: 선박 오염물질 배출정보 및 규제 준수 현황 실시간 분석,기록,감시 장치를 이용한 육해상 통합 관제 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 선박 오염물질 배출 관리를 위한 통합 관제 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 오염물질 배출 감시 대상인 서브시스템과 선박 환경 데이터 기록 장치(Environment Data Recorder)를 인터페이싱하는 인터페이싱 유닛, 상기 인터페이싱 유닛을 통해 전달된 상기 서브시스템의 선박 오염물질 배출 데이터를 기록하는 선박 환경 데이터 기록 장치(Environment Data Recorder), 상기 선박 오염물질을 전달받아 분석하는 선박 오염물질 분석 장치, 육상 관제 시스템과 데이터 송수신을 하기 위한 네트워크장치 및 상기 선박 환경 데이터 기록 장치(Environment Data Recorder)로부터 전송된 출력 값을 표시하는 현황표시단말을 포함하는 선박 오염물질 배출관리를 위한 해상 관제 시스템 및 상기 해상 관제 시스템으로부터 전송된 데이터를 통해 국제 협약 규제 규격에 의한 정책 준수 여부를 실시간으로 모니터링 하는 모니터링 장치, 상기 해상 관제 시스템으로부터 전송된 데이터를 전송받아 저장하는 육상 관제 시스템 데이터베이스를 포함하는 오염물질 배출관리를 위한 육상 관제 시스템을 포함한다.  
실시간으로 선박 내에서 정책 위반 현황이 모니터링되고, 육상 관제 시스템을 통하여 정책 위반 여부가 모니터링되는 바, 감시 기반 오염 물질 배출이 감소될 수 있다. 
또한, 선박의 오염 물질 배출 시스템들의 운영, 동작 상태 감시를 통하여 미 준수 현황을 감시할 수 있다. 
또한, 실시간 감시를 통하여 오염 물질 배출 현황을 항시 파악할 수 있고, 정책 규제 준수를 유도할 수 있다. 
또한, 선박의 총 오염 물질 배출의 통합 분석을 통한 오염 물질 배출을 산출할 수 있고, 항로 별 위치 별 해수 유입 및 배수 패턴에 따른 해양 오염 사고 발생 사전 대응, 항로 별 위치 별 운항 패턴에 따른 대기 오염 위반 사전 대응이 가능할 수 있다.

title_en: Information processing system for calculationg safety index of vehicle and operation method thereof
title_ko: 차량의 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 정보 처리 시스템 및 그것의 동작 방법
abstract_ko: 차량들 각각의 사고 기록 데이터를 기반으로 정적 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 정적 안전 지수 산출부, 차량들 각각의 차량 정보 데이터를 기반으로, 차량들 각각의 속도 지수, 가속도 지수, 감속도 지수 및 운행 시간을 산출하기 위한 주행 정보 산출부, 사고 기록 데이터를 기반으로 하나 이상의 가중치들을 산출하고, 하나 이상의 가중치들 및 속도 지수, 가속도 지수, 및 감속도 지수를 기반으로 동적 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 동적 안전 지수 산출부, 운행 시간을 기반으로 차량들 각각의 사고율에 따른 작업부하 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 작업부하 안전 지수 산출부, 및 정적 안전 지수, 동적 안전 지수, 및 작업부하 안전 지수를 기반으로, 종합 안전 지수를 산출하기 위한 종합 안전 지수 산출부를 포함하되, 하나 이상의 가중치들은 속도 지수, 가속도 지수 및 감속도 지수의 일부 또는 전부와 대응하여 산술된다.

title_en: Turtlebot marble game device based on AI learning and marble game method using the same
title_ko: Ai 학습 기반의 터틀봇 구슬 치기 게임 장치를 이용한 구슬 치기 게임 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marble game method using a turtlebot marble game device based on AI learning, which supports a principle of AI-based machine learning and coding to be comprehended. The marble game method of the present invention comprises: a first step of providing a game plate and a game method image for first and second user groups; a second step of separately constructing first and second turtlebot command models; a third step of moving a first turtlebot; a fourth step of moving a second turtlebot; and a fifth step of finishing a game.
abstract_ko: AI 학습 기반의 터틀봇 구슬 치기 게임 장치를 이용한 구슬 치기 게임 방법이 제공된다. 상기 방법은 상기 게임판과 상기 게임 방법 영상을 제1 사용자 그룹과 제2 사용자 그룹에게 제공하는 제1 단계로서, 상기 제1 사용자 그룹과 상기 제2 사용자 그룹은 적어도 한명의 사용자를 포함하고, 상기 게임판의 복수의 구슬은 상기 제1 사용자 그룹에 대응하는 제1 구슬 및 상기 제2 사용자 그룹에 대응하는 제2 구슬을 포함하고, 상기 복수의 터틀봇은 상기 제1 사용자 그룹에 대응하는 제1 터틀봇 및 상기 제2 사용자 그룹에 대응하는 제2 터틀봇을 포함하는, 제1 단계; 상기 학습 모델 구축 프로그램을 상기 제1 사용자 그룹과 상기 제2 사용자 그룹에 제공하여 제1 터틀봇 명령 모델과 제2 터틀봇 명령 모델을 각각 구축하는 제2 단계로서, 상기 제1 터틀봇 명령 모델은 상기 카메라에서 생성된 명령 이미지에 기초하여 상기 제1 터틀봇의 방향 및 속도 중 적어도 하나를 설정하도록 학습되고, 상기 제2 터틀봇 명령 모델은 상기 카메라에서 생성된 명령 이미지에 기초하여 상기 제2 터틀봇의 방향 및 속도 중 적어도 하나를 설정하도록 학습되는, 제2 단계; 상기 제1 사용자 그룹이 상기 구축된 제1 터틀봇 명령 모델을 통해 상기 제1 터틀봇의 방향 및 속도 중 적어도 하나를 설정하고, 상기 기준 라인 내부의 복수의 구슬과 부딪히도록 상기 제1 터틀봇을 이동시키는 제3 단계; 상기 제2 사용자 그룹이 상기 구축된 제2 터틀봇 명령 모델을 통해 상기 제2 터틀봇의 방향 및 속도 중 적어도 하나를 설정하고, 상기 기준 라인 내부의 복수의 구슬과 부딪히도록 상기 제2 터틀봇을 이동시키는 제4 단계; 및 상기 제3 단계 및 상기 제4 단계를 반복 수행하여 상기 기준 라인 내부의 제1 구슬 또는 제2 구슬이 상기 기준 라인 외부로 모두 이탈된 경우, 게임을 종료하는 제5 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: A methods for radiological safety assessment for abnormal scenarios in a radioactive waste disposal facility complex
title_ko: 방사성폐기물 복합처분시설의 비정상 사건에 대한 방사선적 안전성 평가방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a radiation safety evaluation method for abnormal events in a complex disposal facility for radioactive waste. A radiation safety evaluation method includes: a radionuclide concentration determination step (S100); a radionuclide leakage amount calculation step (S300); a determination of physical/groundwater change value by earthquake intensity step (S300); a step of calculating an expected exposure dose (S400); and a radiation safety evaluation and result analysis step (S500). Therefore, it is possible to quickly predict radiation effects to determine and operate an appropriate emergency class for a radiation emergency response.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방사성폐기물 복합처분시설의 비정상 사건에 대한 방사선적 안전성 평가방법에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 우리나라의 경주 방사성폐기물 처분장 한 부지 내에서 전 세계 최초로 서로 다른 두 처분시설이 운영될 방사성폐기물 복합처분시설에 있어서, 지진 및 폭우와 같은 자연 재해로 인해 방사성폐기물 복합처분시설의 처분시설 설계기준을 초과하는 비정상 사건이 발생하였을 경우 방사선적 영향을 신속하게 예측하여 방사선비상대응을 위한 비상 등급을 결정하는 부지경계에서의 핵종 농도 또는 예상피폭선량을 산정하는 핵심 개념 시나리오를 확립할 수 있도록 하는 것이며, 그 구성은 표층처분시설에 유입된 표층수의 방사성핵종 농도와 불포화대에 유입되는 표층수 양, 포화대에 유입되는 표층수 양과 동굴처분시설을 통과하는 지하수 흐름에  최초 유입되는 시간을 고려한 표층처분시설의 방사성핵종의 동굴처분시설 통과 포화대의 유입량을 결정하는 방사성핵종 농도 결정단계와; 상기 방사성핵종 농도 결정단계에서 결정된 표층처분시설의 방사성핵종의 동굴처분시설 통과 포화대로의 유입량에 의거하여 방사성핵종이 지하 매질을 통과하여 처분시설 부지경계에 농축되는 처분시설경계에서의 방사성핵종 농도를 산출하는 방사성핵종 누출량 산출단계와; 지진의 크기에 따른 처분시설 및 지하매질의 입력자료에 대한 변화값을 결정하고, 지진의 크기에 따른 지하수 변화값을 결정하는 지진강도별 물리적/지하수 변화값 결정단계와; 상기 방사성핵종 농도 산출단계를 통해 산출된 방사성핵종 농도값에 의거하여 방사성핵종에 의한 예상 피폭선량을 산출하는 예상 피폭선량 산출단계와; 상기 지진강도별 물리적/지하수 변화값 결정단계에서 결정된 지진의 크기에 따른 처분시설 및 지하매질의 물리/화학적 변화값 및 지하수 변화값, 상기 방사성핵종 농도 산출단계에서 산출된 처분시설경계에서의 방사성핵종 농도값 및 예상 피폭선량 산출단계에서 산출된 방사성핵종에 의한 예상 피폭선량값을 기설정된 기준값과 각각 비교하여 복합처분시설의 비정상 사건에 대한 방사선적 안전성을 평가하는 방사선적 안전성 평가 및 결과 분석단계로 구성되며; 상기 방사선적 안전성 평가 및 결과 분석단계는 표층처분시설과 동굴처분시설로 구성된 복합처분시설을 대상으로 한 폭우, 지진 등으로 인해 발생된 사건, 방사선원항, 초기 방사성핵종 재고량, 처분시설의 공학적방벽과 지하매질과 같은 천연방벽을 거쳐 생태계로 거치는 방사성핵종의 이동으로 이루어지는 비정상 사건에 따라 처분시스템 변화, 지하수 유로/유속변화 및 핵종 유출량 변화로 구분하여 특성을 평가하고, 그 평가결과에 따라 최종적으로 복합 유출을 통한 방사성핵종의 지하매질 운반 및 생태계 전달로 인해 발생될 수 있는 모델을 설정하고, 설정된 모델에 대한 방사선적 안전성을 분석하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: the method to advance the analysis of the causes of disasters
title_ko: 재난사고 원인분석의 고도화 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an advancement method of disaster accident cause analysis, which allows the cause of a disaster to be quickly and accurately determined, comprising the processes of: searching for a sentence containing a keyword, and processing the same into a set of disaster cause information; storing data in a cause information metadata and statistical result value DB; analyzing the set of disaster cause information; and implementing a cause information analysis system.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은, 재난원인 키워드 사전을 활용하여 재난원인 문장을 추출하고, 이를 컴퓨터 내에서 재난 원인정보를 분석 및 세분화하며, 분석영역별 정량적 가중치를 부여하고 이를 바탕으로 원인정보를 가시화함으로써 재난원인을 신속 정확히 판단할 수 있도록 하는 재난사고 원인분석의 고도화 방법에 관한 것으로, 
뉴스, 학술정보 DB, 보고서, 각종 SNS 등에 의한 신규 재난정보들이 컴퓨터에 유입되면, 상기 컴퓨터에 내장된 재난원인 키워드 자동 추출/축적/분석 프로그램이 실행되어 재난원인 키워드가 자동 추출되어 원인정보 메타데이터 및 통계결과값 DB에 저장되고, 상기 원인정보 메타데이터 및 통계결과값은 재난원인 정보 추출, 키워드 세분화, 재난 유형 정의 및 타 재난유형과의 연관성이 분석되어, 분석결과 화면은 모니터에 디스플레이되도록 구성된 재난사고 원인분석의 고도화 방법에 있어서, 
상기 신규 재난정보들이 컴퓨터에 제공되면 자연어 처리 또는 데이터 마이닝 방법에 의해 키워드 포함된 문장을 검색하여 재난원인 정보 집합으로 가공하는 과정과, 
재난원인 정보 집합으로 가공되어 정보 구조화된 자료들을 원인정보 메타데이터 및 통계결과값 DB에 저장하는 과정과, 
원인정보 메타데이터 및 통계결과값 DB에 저장된 재난원인 정보 집합을 분석하되, 자연어 처리 절차에 의한 재난원인 정보를 추출한 후, 재난원인 정보를 키워드에 의해 세분화하고 재난유형을 정의한 다음, 타 재난유형과의 연관성을 판단하는 과정과, 
키워드 빈도에 의한 정량적 가중치를 부여하여 시각화 도출하는 방식으로 표준화된 원인정보 분석 체계를 구현하는 과정으로 구성된 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer program of AI-based user-tailored disaster threat prediction and safety management
title_ko: Ai 기반 사용자 맞춤형 재난 위험예측 및 안전관리 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터프로그램
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention can provide an AI-based user-customized disaster risk prediction and safety management method performed by a computing device, wherein the method comprises the process of: obtaining pre-input information about a plurality of assets being managed by a user; selecting a plurality of first disaster response modules that each match the plurality of assets based on the pre-input information from among a plurality of preset disaster response modules and configuring a user-customized disaster response system by calculating priorities for the selected plurality of first disaster response modules; acquiring disaster monitoring information to determine whether a disaster has occurred in real time; determining the occurrence of a real-time disaster based on the disaster monitoring information; determining relevance and urgency of the real-time disaster to the plurality of first disaster response modules based on the real-time disaster occurrence; performing a plurality of second disaster response modules among the plurality of first disaster response modules belonging to the disaster response system according to the relevance and the urgency; and receiving disaster response results based on the plurality of second disaster response modules. The present invention has the effect of providing customized response measures to facilities or sites actually managed by users.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예는. 컴퓨팅 장치에 의해 수행되는 방법에 있어서, 사용자가 관리 중인 복수의 자산에 대한 사전입력 정보를 획득하는 과정; 미리 설정된 복수의 재난대응모듈 중에서 상기 사전입력 정보에 기초해 상기 복수의 자산에 각각 매칭되는 복수의 제1 재난대응모듈을 선정하고, 선정된 상기 복수의 제1 재난대응모듈에 대한 우선순위를 산출하여 사용자 맞춤형 재난 대응 시스템을 구성하는 과정; 실시간으로 재난의 발생 여부를 판단하기 위한 재난 모니터링 정보를 획득하는 과정; 상기 재난 모니터링 정보에 기초해 실시간 발생 재난을 판단하는 과정; 상기 실시간 발생 재난에 기초해 상기 복수의 제1 재난대응모듈에 대한 연관성 및 상기 복수의 제1 재난대응모듈에 대한 상기 실시간 발생 재난의 긴급성을 판단하는 과정; 상기 연관성 및 상기 긴급성에 따라 상기 재난 대응 시스템에 속하는 복수의 제1 재난대응모듈 중 복수의 제2 재난대응모듈을 수행하는 과정; 및 상기 복수의 제2 재난대응모듈에 기초한 재난 대응결과를 수신하는 과정을 포함하는, AI 기반 사용자 맞춤형 재난 위험예측 및 안전관리 방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Mobile asset data recorder and transmitter
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allows for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with impact detection, rough operating condition detection, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of a mobile asset. Users can use the normal operation of their mobile assets to locate and alert, in real-time, areas where their assets are encountering rough operating environments, to provide for quicker emergency response, and to validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting.
assignees: JORDAN LAWRENCE B;MATTA LISA A;WI TRONIX LLC

title_en: There is the intelligent feedwater piping of blocking self-inspection and locating function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of intelligent feedwater piping with blocking self-inspection and locating function, it is characterized in that being saved by intelligent feedwater piping forming with line clogging detection architecture, wherein novel pipeline joint is made up of pipeline matrix, pressure transmitter and teledata unit R TU.Described pressure transmitter is installed on pipe ends and can correspondingly with pipeline be sealed and matched, and described RTU is connected with pressure transmitter and is fixed on pipeline with Type of Welding.The utility model is a kind of can change and the real-time novel pipeline transferred out with the form of digital signal by testing pipes pressure at two ends ripple in real time, solve a hardware difficult problem for the real-time Detection & Controling of groundwater supply line clogging, Timeliness coverage that water supply line blocks can be guaranteed, rush to repair in time, prevent trouble before it happens, evade or reduce the generation of casualties and property loss security incident.

title_en: Smart phone application Method and system of notifying location information of a car
title_ko: 스마트폰 어플리케이션을 통하여 셔틀버스 위치정보 차량위치를 제공기술
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 셔틀버스 운행 중 예기치 못한 사고나 폭설, 폭우 등 자연재해로 인한 도로사정이 원활하지 않아 탑승자와 부모들이 무작정 기다려야 하는 문제점을 해결하기 위해 통학 서틀버스 차량의 운전자의 스마트폰 차량위치를 송신하는 프로그램의 실행을 통하여 수신을 받는자의 스마트폰과 PC로 실시간 확인을 제공하는 통학 셔틀버스 차량 위치 추적 서비스 이다.   
또한 미리 차량운전자용 GPS위치 송신기능의 프로그램을 실행시킴으로 써 임의로 정해진 노선의 위치를 지도에 표시하고 차량의 GPS신호 위치정보를 송신하는 단계와 
 관리모듈을 통해 사전에 등록된 탑승자 부모의 스마트폰 및 PC의 고유 회원번호를 통해 실시간 차량의 위치 추적정보를 셔틀차량 이용자의 스마트폰과 가정용 PC에 수신자용 프로그램을 통해 임의로 정한 위치에 차량이 지날 경우 도착예정시간을 음성으로 알려주는 서비스 단계로 이루어 진다. 
셔틀버스 운행 중 예기치 못한 사고나 폭설, 폭우 등 자연재해로 인한 도로사정이 원활하지 않아 탑승자와 부모들이 무작정 기다려야 하는 문제점을 해결하기 위해 통학 서틀버스 차량의 운전자의 스마트폰 차량위치를 송신하는 프로그램의 실행을 통하여 수신을 받는 사용자의 스마트폰과 PC로 실시간 확인을 제공하는 통학 셔틀버스 차량 위치 추적 서비스 이다.  
  
본 시스템은 크게 관리 모듈과 위치 추적 모듈로 나뉜다. 관리 모듈은 지능형기기, 사용자, 유아보육시설의 정보를 등록, 수정, 삭제, 조회하는 기능을 한다. 또한 GPS좌표와 탑승자별 정보를 실시간으로 추적하는 위치추적 모듈을 효율적으로 관리하여 실시간 차량의 위치는 물론 등교와 하교시 탑승자와 부모에게 안전한 통학 서비스를 제공하게 된다.

title_en: Temperature and 2 channel slope monitoring system for Bus duct
title_ko: 버스닥트의 온도와 2채널 기울기 측정 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 버스닥트의 온도와 기울기를 측정하는 시스템에 관한 것으로서 버스닥트 유니트(unit)가 접속되는 접속부의 발열온도를 감지하는 온도센서와 상기 접속부와 연결되어 있는 2개의 버스닥트의 기울기를 측정하는 2개의 기울기센서; 상기 온도 센서와 2개의 기울기센서를 포함하는 감지기: 상기 감지기에 전원을 공급하는 전원선로 및 데이터를 송수신하는 통신선로가 연결되고 동작수행의 프로그램이 입력된 운영 컴퓨터를 포함하는 제어부의; 결합으로 구성된 것이다. 
  본 고안에 의하면, 고온 알람온도 와 2가지 알람 기울기 값을 설정하고  동작 프로그램에 따라, 감지기 마다 측정된 접속부 온도 값과 2개의 버스닥트 기울기 값이 사전에 설정된 고온 알람 온도 값과 2가지 허용 기울기값과 같거나 큰 경우에는 운영 컴퓨터에서 해당 접속부의 위치와 측정치를 출력하여 화재 사고를 사전에 예방을 할 수 있다

title_en: A kind of emergency medical system for burst fire-disaster accident
abstract_en: The present invention relates to field of computer technology, especially a kind of emergency medical system for burst fire-disaster accident, which is characterized in that including worker information library module, be used for the record of manager, the record of doctor and nurse's information and information of arranging an order according to class and grade.Command centre comprising emergency event obtains module, personnel placement module and emergency article determining module, and the emergency event obtains the number that module is used to determine type belonging to burst fire-disaster accident and be related to；The personnel placement module is for the arrangement to burst fire-disaster accident staff；The emergency article determining module is used to match corresponding required emergency article for the staff of personnel placement module.Identity information card is used for the deposit of the data input submodule data information；The emergency article distributor is used to distribute emergency article automatically for staff.The present invention can rapidly arrange to participate in the staff of emergency, and can distribute emergency article automatically for staff.

title_en: Health management system based on IOT technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of health management, in particular to a health management system based on an IOT technology. The system comprises a personal response database, an abnormality cause analysis module and a health intervention module. According to the invention, the current health level of the user is determined by combining the personal response database with the past medical record data of the user, the corresponding health response threshold is formulated, the adaptive health response threshold formulation is carried out according to the health level of the user, a reasonable emergency response scheme is formulated for each user, the adaptation effect of the whole system is improved, the response data fed back by the personal response database is obtained through the abnormal reason analysis module, the reasons causing the abnormality of the health monitoring data of the user are predicted by combining the health monitoring data, and the corresponding health intervention mode is formulated for the user by combining the reasons causing the abnormality of the health monitoring data of the user and the past medical record data through the health intervention module.

title_en: Risk prediction method based on identification of human actions in video key frame flood
abstract_en: The application discloses a risk prediction method based on identification of human actions in video key frame flood, which comprises the following steps of extracting key frames of flood monitoring video; and constructing a key frame image rapid motion recognition model, and quantifying the risk level based on disaster condition feature recognition. The method combines single-wide flow information and multi-class behavior characteristics, remarkably improves the accuracy and reliability of risk prediction, ensures the timeliness and effectiveness of emergency response, adopts an optimized deep learning model and an efficient data processing flow, ensures the timeliness and high performance when processing large-scale video data, and greatly improves the monitoring efficiency and resource utilization rate in disaster management.

title_en: AI campus intelligent prevention system based on intelligent perception and automatic response early warning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of campus security prevention and control, and discloses an AI campus security system based on intelligent perception and automatic response early warning, which comprises a data acquisition and perception module, a data processing module and a data processing module, wherein the data acquisition and perception module is used for acquiring multidimensional data in a campus in real time through acquisition equipment; the system comprises an event sensing and behavior recognition module, a multi-mode data fusion module, an AI analysis and event research module, an event early warning and notification module, an emergency response and treatment module, a resource scheduling and management module, an event recording and data archiving module and a disaster emergency response and auxiliary system connection module, wherein the event sensing and behavior recognition module is used for carrying out fusion analysis on data from different sensing devices, the resource scheduling and management module is used for reasonably distributing and efficiently using resources, the event recording and data archiving module is used for carrying out detailed recording and archiving on each processed event. By constructing a video, audio and environment data three-in-one multi-source perception system, comprehensive real-time monitoring of abnormal behaviors, sounds and environment changes in a campus is realized, and the effects of improving event recognition accuracy and perception coverage are obtained.
assignees: WUXI WUXIAN ZHIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cross-warehouse facility allocation method, device, medium and program product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-warehouse equipment allocation method, equipment, a medium and a program product, which relate to the technical field of operation and maintenance of a data center and comprise the steps of constructing an equipment compatibility quantization model according to multi-dimensional characteristics and corresponding dimensional weights of equipment, defining a transportation cost function by using transportation decision influence factors including task urgency, receiving and responding to an allocation task, carrying out multi-objective layered solution on equipment compatibility, transportation economy and task timeliness according to the equipment compatibility quantization model and combining the transportation cost function, and adjusting the dimensional weights and/or the transportation cost function based on related data of a transportation process to generate an optimal allocation scheme meeting preset constraints. Therefore, the multi-objective layered solving strategy is utilized, the generation time of an allocation scheme is greatly shortened, meanwhile, the defects of compatibility misjudgment, transportation cost fluctuation, emergency response delay and the like in the traditional allocation decision are effectively overcome, and the equipment allocation whole process is accurately, intelligently and adaptively optimized.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU YUNHAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear accident radiation field feedback correction model based on self-adaptive depth assimilation network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nuclear accident radiation field feedback correction model based on a self-adaptive depth assimilation network, which comprises a data receiving module, an initial radiation field prediction module, an ADAN module, an intelligent optimization and feedback correction module and a real-time updating and visualization display module, wherein the data receiving module, the initial radiation field prediction module, the intelligent optimization and feedback correction module and the real-time updating and visualization display module are all connected with the ADAN module. The model utilizes a self-adaptive depth assimilation network to fuse and feedback and correct the real-time gamma radiation monitoring data and the data of the nuclear accident radiation field prediction model, thereby realizing high-precision dynamic prediction of radiation field distribution. The method comprises the steps of carrying out a depth assimilation process, wherein an adaptive parameter optimization and prediction result feedback correction mechanism is introduced in the depth assimilation process, so that a model can dynamically adjust assimilation network parameters according to real-time monitoring data, and carrying out iterative correction on the prediction result of an initial physical model chain, thereby forming a closed loop updating mechanism of radiation field prediction, assimilation correction and feedback optimization. The method is suitable for the fields of nuclear emergency management, nuclear accident result evaluation, radiation diffusion simulation and the like, and has the remarkable effect of improving the accuracy and timeliness of emergency response.

title_en: Safety and emergency signal display system for vehicle
title_ko: 자동차용 안전 및 비상 신호 표시 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is a safety and emergency signal displaying system for a vehicle. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the safety and emergency signal displaying system for a vehicle comprises: an intention display controlling device wirelessly transmitting an emergency situation occurrence message and location information while displaying a text message in accordance with an intention of a driver and the emergency situation occurrence message to the outside as text; a control terminal transmitting the emergency situation occurrence message and the location information to mobile communication terminals of other predetermined vehicle drivers with the driver and an emergency dispatch agency; and an application program operation server supporting application programs with the control terminal and the mobile communication terminals. The vehicle driver may be supported to display his/her intentions to other vehicles in the vicinity or in the rear with predetermined images, texts, and the like.
abstract_ko: 자동차용 안전 및 비상 신호 표시 시스템에 대해 개시한다. 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 자동차용 안전 및 비상 신호 표시 시스템은 운전자 의사에 따른 문자 메시지 및 긴급 상황 발생 메시지를 외부에 문자로 표시함과 아울러 긴급 상황 발생 메시지와 위치 정보를 무선으로 송출하는 의사 표시 제어장치, 긴급 상황 발생 메시지와 위치 정보를 운전자를 비롯해 미리 설정된 다른 자동차 운전자들의 이동통신 단말기와 긴급 출동 기관으로 전송하는 관제 단말기, 및 관제 단말기와 이동통신 단말기들로 응용 프로그램을 지원하는 응용 프로그램 운용서버를 포함하는바, 차량 운전자가 주변이나 후방의 다른 차량들에 자신의 의사를 미리 설정된 이미지와 문자 등으로 표시할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Displaying system for drone hologram synchronized with controller signal
title_ko: 조종기 신호를 연동한 드론 홀로그램 디스플레이 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a drone hologram display system linked with a controller signal, which enables a plurality of display devices to be interlocked to display a drone hologram. Provided is the drone hologram display system linked with the controller signal, which includes: a simulation control unit which creates virtual drones in augmented reality and performs virtual operation in a set space; one or more controller connected to the simulation control unit through a relay unit to input a control command for an operation of the virtual drone; and a holo lens for visualizing the operation of the simulation control unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 복수의 디스플레이장치가 연동되어 드론 홀로그램을 표시할 수 있도록 하는 조종기 신호를 연동한 드론 홀로그램 디스플레이 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 증강현실상의 가상화드론을 생성하고 설정된 공간에 가상의 운행동작을 수행하는 시뮬레이션제어부와, 상기 가상화드론에 대한 운행동작의 제어명령을 입력하도록 상기 시뮬레이션제어부와 중계부를 통하여 연결되는 하나 이상의 조종기부와, 상기 시뮬레이션제어부의 운행동작을 시각화하는 홀로렌즈를 포함하는 조종기 신호를 연동한 드론 홀로그램 디스플레이 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Emergency Response System
abstract_en: A server application that includes a receiving module for receiving a plurality of user information from a first mobile computing device, including a user name, user contact information, a plan having an end time and plan location, an emergency contact name, emergency contact information and a list of estimated emergency services required by the user in case of an emergency. The application includes an initiation module for reading the user information, creating a user record, and storing it in an attached database. A transmitting module detects the end time of the plan, then generates and sends a first message to the user. If the user does not respond, a transmitting module generates and sends a second message to the emergency contact. If the emergency contact does not respond, a transmitting module sends a third message to an emergency response organization requesting estimated emergency response services.

title_en: Instructor avatars for augmented reality experiences
abstract_en: An application enables users of electronic eyewear devices to bring a workout session anywhere and have aspects of the workout session (e.g., number of repetitions) recorded automatically. It also allows users to have always-on visibility of their workout instructor so that they can, for example, continue to maintain a visual guide for their form/pose. Virtual avatars perform demonstrations about activities such as yoga in an augmented reality environment using the display of an electronic eyewear device. The demonstration elements can be controlled using voice commands.
assignees: Canberk Ilteris;FEKETE IVAN;KANG SHIN HWUN;KUCHER DMYTRO;KUZIN IHOR;MANLAPAZ VERNON JAMES CARLOS;SYDORAN ARTUR

title_en: Public bicycle post one-key stop method
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of public transportation, in particular to a public bicycle post one-key stop method, which comprises the following steps: determining a site set E of a station to be closed according to a station closing plan; acquiring a history use record of a public bicycle, and calculating the balance degree of a station borrowing and returning vehicle to be closed; determining a closing sequence according to the vehicle borrowing and returning balance degree of the stations to be closed, and closing the stations balanced by the vehicle borrowing and returning preferentially; when the station is closed, the station controller is controlled by a station closing instruction sent by the dispatching platform, the Bluetooth ground stake in the closed station controls the Bluetooth intelligent lock on the public bicycle to be unable to be locked, the Bluetooth intelligent lock sends out a voice prompt that the station is closed, and if the public bicycle is parked in the closed station, the rest public bicycle in the station is manually cleared by a dispatching personnel. The utility model has the following substantial effects: the dispatching center issues the station closing instruction, so that one-key closing of the station can be realized, the station which is closed is prevented from parking the public bicycle again, and secondary clearing is avoided.

title_en: Self-adaptive multi-channel wireless anti-interference communication method and system based on competition
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wireless communication applied to the fire-fighting industry, in particular to a competition-based self-adaptive multi-channel wireless anti-interference communication method and system. The scheme includes the steps of starting monitoring of radio network background noise to obtain network background noise, judging whether the network background noise is larger than a network environment judgment margin, if so, sending a first command, if not, sending a second command, judging whether delay requirements are met, judging whether the channel replacement requirements are met, sending communication data on a current channel, after receiving the fifth command, sending communication data on a new channel, and after receiving a sixth command, updating the network channel. According to the scheme, the problem of communication instantaneity and anti-interference performance of the fire early warning and alarming network is solved by setting the multi-channel preemptive communication with the pre-sending interception function, and the problem of poor communication timeliness and poor anti-interference performance due to the fact that the fixed channels are distributed and the communication time slice network can be effectively avoided.

title_en: IT operation and maintenance management method and IT operation and maintenance management device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to an IT operation and maintenance management method and an IT operation and maintenance management device, which comprise the steps of extracting, classifying, sorting and calculating and analyzing historical data to provide a direction for subsequent deep analysis; the running state and potential risk of the data center are reflected through data processing analysis and characteristic value extraction, so that the subsequent modeling analysis is facilitated; by constructing a risk prediction model, risk early warning and emergency response measures are convenient to implement; by dividing the monitoring period and monitoring the operation data of the data center in real time, the timeliness and the integrity of the data are ensured; through risk score prediction and threshold setting, operation and maintenance efficiency is improved, and therefore faults are reduced. The method and the device are used for solving the technical problems of insufficient comprehensive monitoring and intelligent management in IT operation and maintenance management in the existing scheme.

title_en: System and method for programming education
title_ko: 프로그래밍 교육 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a programming educational system and a method thereof. The programming educational system according to an embodiment of the present invention comprises: a user terminal which receives one of a plurality of program input methods selected by a user, receives one or more commands from the user according to the selected method, generates a program, and transmits the generated program to a training terminal; and a training terminal having a plurality of control target elements, controlling each of the plurality of control target elements according to the program, and having one or more buttons on an outer surface for executing or stopping the program.
abstract_ko: 프로그래밍 교육 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 프로그래밍 교육 시스템은, 사용자로부터 복수의 프로그램 입력 방법 중 어느 하나의 방법을 선택 받고, 선택된 방법에 따라 사용자로부터 하나 이상의 명령을 입력 받아 프로그램을 생성하며, 생성된 프로그램을 실습 단말로 송신하는 사용자 단말, 및 복수의 제어 대상 소자를 구비하고, 프로그램에 따라 복수의 제어 대상 소자 각각을 제어하되, 외면에 프로그램을 실행 또는 정지하기 위한 하나 이상의 버튼을 구비하는 실습 단말을 포함한다.

title_en: Remote driving-assisted surveillance control system that enables automatic data backup redundancy and physical security
title_ko: 자동 데이터 백업 이중화 장치와 최적제어 알고리즘을 적용한 완벽한 보안 확보가 가능한 원격운전 및 경보 통제를 지원하는 감시제어 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote operation support monitoring and control system capable of securing automatic data backup duplexing and physical security and, more specifically, to a remote operation support monitoring and control system capable of securing automatic data backup duplexing and physical security, which stores data collected by communicating with a black box terminal unit (BTU), which is a data backup duplexing device, through serial (RS232C) unidirectional communication in order to prevent physical intrusion of data collected from a measuring device at a water treatment site from a PLC, converts the stored data into big data, supports automatic operation of a water treatment facility (sewage, wastewater, rainwater, drainage, and water supply) by an optimal control operation algorithm, remotely connects the data to a web again to monitor and control the data with the web and app, and supports to remotely perform a rebooting command of power through a digital processing unit in case of momentary power outage and PLC program evaporation.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자동 데이터 백업 이중화 및 물리적 보안 확보가 가능한 원격운전  지원 감시제어 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 수처리 현장에서 계측기기로부터 수집된 자료를 PLC로부터 물리적으로 침입을 방지하기 위하여 시리얼(RS232C) 단방향 통신으로 데이터 백업 이중화 장치인 BTU(Black Box Terminal unit)에 통신하여 수집된 자료를 저장하고 저장된 데이터는 빅 데이터화하고 그 데이터는 최적제어 운영 알고리즘에 의하여 수처리시설 (하수, 폐수, 빗물, 우수, 배수, 상수)의 자동운전을 지원하며, 다시 웹으로 원격 연결하여 웹 및 앱(app)으로 감시,제어가 가능하도록 하고 순간 정전 및 PLC 프로그램 휘발 시 원격으로 디지털 처리부를 통하여 전원의 리부팅 명령을 수행 하도록 지원하는 자동 데이터 백업 이중화 및 물리적 보안 확보가 가능한 원격운전  지원 감시제어 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: ORION SYSTEMS CORP;KOREA ENV CORP;JUNG JONG HO

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and viewer for mobile assets that includes a data encoder, onboard data manager, and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Shooting speed measuring system used for training
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a shooting speed measuring system used for training. Wireless speaker microphone signals of a commander are transmitted in two paths simultaneously, wherein, one path of signal is transmitted to a computer, and the path of signal is transmitted to a trainee; a wireless signal emitter is connected in a gun of the trainee, and a signal switch is arranged on a holster; and a guard signal switch, a bolt signal switch and a trigger signal switch are arranged on the gun; the signal sent by each switch is emitted through the wireless signal emitter, and then received by a wireless signal receiver which is connected with the computer; and the computer is respectively connected with a projector and a camera, the projector projects a scene signal onto a projection screen, the camera transmits a shooting light spot image on the projection screen to the computer, and the computer outputs computed results through a display screen. The utility model can record the time when actions happen including drawing the gun, chambering, opening the bolt, pulling the trigger and completing the shooting after the command of the commander is given out, so that the shooting speed can be accurately measured, and the training level is improved.

title_en: Method for establishing flood-preventing emergency intelligent command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for establishing a flood-preventing emergency intelligent command system. The method comprises the following steps: performing a digital abstraction on a formulated plan, structuring a plan library including all related information of the flood-preventing emergency plan; arranging corresponding emergency plan starting conditions, approvers, reminders and corresponding execution procedures; immediately and automatically giving an alarm and starting the corresponding emergency plan automatically when the emergency plan starting conditions can be satisfied by various point testing information according to the generated digital plan; arranging and processing every emergency plan to a series of mutually linked procedures with the automatic executing condition by adopting a working flow technology; when one emergency plan is started, performing approval and task executing procedures according to the preset procedures. The flood-preventing emergency intelligent command system established by the invention is convenient in inquiry, rapid in reaction, high in working efficiency, intuitive in the command process, and is beneficial for exercising and improving the emergency plan, and keeping complete records of the flood-preventing emergency command process.
assignees: STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;NANJING NARI GROUP CORP

title_en: Road accident emergency command, rescue and investigation vehicle
abstract_en: A road accident emergency command, rescue and investigation vehicle comprises a cab, an operating chamber and an equipment chamber. A lighting device and a snapshot device are arranged on a roof platform. The operating chamber is internally provided with a control wall. A lamp holder at the lower end of a lamp pole is connected with equipment fixing plates. The snapshot device is fixed on an arm of a roof lifting cranked-arm lamp and is composed of a metal halide lamp, a camera, a high-definition electronic snapshot camera, a speed measuring radar unit and a flashlight. A base of the roof lifting cranked-arm lamp is connected with the equipment fixing plates. The equipment fixing plates are all fixed on the roof platform through bolts. A guardrail is arranged on the periphery of the roof platform and is provided with a strobe light and a needle camera. The lighting device is connected with a touch screen arranged on the control wall. The needle camera and the snapshot device are connected with a vehicular television, a control panel, the touch screen and a public security network computer. Charging units are arranged at the tail of a vehicle body and in the equipment chamber. The road accident emergency command, rescue and investigation vehicle allows dead-angle-free rotational recording and allows real-time transmission, command and the like under remote control of a remote controller.

title_en: Forest fire prevention hand-held terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a forest fire prevention hand-held terminal. The forest fire prevention hand-held terminal comprises a camera, a processor with a video encoding and decoding circuit integrated therein, a touch screen, a wireless communication module, a GPS module and a GPS antenna, wherein the GPS antenna is connected with the GPS module; the positioning signal end of the GPS module is connected with the positioning signal end of the processor; the video output end of the camera is connected with the video signal input end of the processor; the video signal output end of the processor is connected with the video signal input end of the touch screen; the serial port input end of the touch screen is connected with the serial port output end of the processor; and the communication signal end of the processor is connected with the wireless communication module. By using the forest fire prevention hand-held terminal, finally problems found in inspection tours can be recorded in details without installing points, and in terms of forest fire fighting, a monitoring center can know forest fire information, schedule and command forest fire fighting work in a timely manner through inspection tour personnel equipped with the fire prevention hand-held terminals.
assignees: CHENGDU JINGLIN ELECTRONIC TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring and early warning instrument for traffic natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of monitoring and early warning of traffic natural disasters and research and development of equipment, and in particular relates to a monitoring and early warning instrument for traffic natural disasters. The monitoring and early warning instrument comprises a mounting housing; a functional keyboard for inputting control commands, a display screen for displaying image-text and data, a battery area for providing power for equipment, a working switch for starting the equipment and a display lamp for displaying early warning signals are arranged on the mounting housing; a field acquisition module for acquiring the monitoring data and image-text records of the field conditions of traffic natural disasters in real time regularly, an expert system module for storing data and image-text data provided by experts, and a monitoring data fitting analysis module for performing fitting analysis on the monitoring data and the image-text records acquired by the field acquisition module and the data and the image-text data provided by the expert system module, and giving analytical data are arranged in the mounting housing.

title_en: A kind of typhoon track method for quick predicting based on GIS
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of typhoon track method for quick predicting based on GIS, belongs to technical field of preventing and reducing natural disasters.This method carries out typhoon Similar Track identification first, for identifying the history typhoon data for having Similar Track with current typhoon；History Similar Track is then based on to carry out typhoon Future Path prediction, following 24 hours and 48 hours possible path is predicted to typhoon；Above-mentioned prediction process finally is realized in GIS platform, and then can realize that the Future Path fast and automatically changed is predicted according to current typhoon track.To examine the reasonability of the present invention, 100 a plurality of history typhoon samples were chosen in record from 10 years to be predicted, 24h and 48h position predictions are close to China Meteorological platform precision of prediction, but supercomputer is not needed to support, can be to provide result in a few minutes, the windproof responding agencies in place can be used as before formal weather forecast is assigned by meteorological department, a kind of early stage method for quick predicting as windproof commanding and decision-making.

title_en: A kind of method and device for urban managing information acquiring and processing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of method and device for urban managing information acquiring and processing, the fixed acquisition equipment of urban information collector, the image of all acquisitions uploads to far end I SP processing module and carries out ISP processing, improving image quality；To the image dynamic adjustment upload frequencies that acquisition module obtains, the repeatability for uploading image is reduced, in conjunction with the numerical value that sends back to of numerical value and far end I SP module of mobile phone light sensor, acquisition module time for exposure dynamic is adjusted, real-time is improved；The picture material sent to ISP module is analyzed and is handled, and records the violations of rules and regulations occurred in city management, location of incident coordinate is returned to acquisition module, display is marked in cell phone application module, collector is made to understand and solve the problems, such as in time.The present invention integrally reduces the workload of city management collector, economizes on resources and the time, and by optimization aim object image quality, reduces the repeatability for reporting image, realize the promotion of working efficiency.

title_en: Mine movable day eye system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of mine movable day eye system, including intelligent mine lamp, downhole wireless base station, interchanger and dispatch control end, the end PC and mobile terminal soft ware platforms；Wherein intelligent mine lamp includes charging module, battery, monitoring information plate, photographing module, wireless network module, lighting module and memory module, the monitoring information plate, for monitoring the working condition of each module and carrying out information processing again；The photographing module, find a view video recording and the superposition such as number, time information on video and photo for underground.The mine lamp of underground all personnel can be become dynamic video collection point by the system, form the full mine of the day eye network coverage, mine dispatch control end, the end PC or mobile terminal can check the environment current intelligence of any someone in underground by underground wireless network in fact, which will bring a completely new management mode to mine safety production management, major system operation management, each work post job management, the prevention of natural calamity etc..
assignees: HUAINAN LONGKE INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Railway emergency communication method and system based on communication conference
abstract_en: The invention relates to a railway emergency communication method and a system based on a communication conference, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, a user initiates help seeking through terminal equipment in the railway system, and the terminal equipment collects user audio and video information in real time and broadcasts the information through a signaling server; s2, the response center receives the help seeking information, pushes the help seeking information in the page help seeking queue, the staff sends the connection information to the signaling server after selecting to connect the help seeking conversation, and the double terminals establish P2P point-to-point connection through respective networks; s3, the response center can record the content information of the help after answering or finishing answering, select a plan and directionally dispatch the message to the staff; and S4, when the staff of the response center finishes the task distribution, the emergency help is defined as ending. The invention has high safety and good usability, and can be widely applied to railway systems.

title_en: Accident handling countermeasure generation method, system, and medium for multiple stages of nuclear accident
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of nuclear accident disposal, and discloses a multi-stage accident disposal strategy generation method, a multi-stage accident disposal strategy generation system and a multi-stage accident disposal strategy generation medium for nuclear accidents, wherein handling task information (receiving and reporting information and a front-end system analysis result) of the nuclear accidents is obtained; judging an event state, a task mode and an accident state based on the acquired disposal task information; determining a treatment plan recommendation based on the event, the accident status, and the accident type; analyzing the results of the accident type and state research and judgment, the accident disposal scheme generation, the accident disposal scheme deduction optimization, the possible accident disposal risk and export condition analysis comprehensively to generate an accident disposal countermeasure suggestion; and performing analysis and duplication of accident disposal countermeasures. The invention can provide professional technical support for scientific decision-making of the nuclear accident emergency command mechanism and effective action of the accident rescue scene, improve the scientific effectiveness and timeliness of the nuclear accident emergency command decision-making, reduce accident loss as much as possible and reduce accident influence.

title_en: Method for assisting in generating WAF rule and reducing false alarm rate
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for assisting in generating WAF rules and reducing false alarm rate, which comprises the following steps: s1, inputting an original text of a request packet, preprocessing a file, and decomposing the file into a plurality of parts by using a script to obtain a plurality of data sets; s2, performing feature mapping on an input request packet by using a BERT pre-trained convolution network through Bi-Gru; s3, combining a certain request with the recorded normal request and malicious request based on the Attention Layer, analyzing the characteristic matrix of the request and the malicious request, carrying out characteristic reinforcement, reinforcing the difference between the characteristics, extracting malicious code parts, and filtering out the normal code parts. The method for generating the WAF rule and reducing the false alarm rate based on the assistance of Bi-Gru Attention and BERT can realize rapid generation of the rule when the WAF rule is deployed in the cloud and the local, shortens the configuration period, greatly accelerates the emergency response speed and reduces the emergency response cost.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating burst risk of barrier lake
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the field of risk assessment, and provides a method and a system for evaluating the burst risk of a barrier lake. The scheme not only enhances the dependence and processing capacity of the monitoring system on the traditional data, but also can rely on more informal data, such as social media information, to acquire necessary information when the conventional monitoring is limited. In addition, the scheme can amplify tiny signals through a data processing means with resolution, help a decision maker to carry out fine judgment, ensure that a disaster response strategy is as fine and accurate as possible, and effectively improve timeliness and appropriateness of disaster management and emergency response.
assignees: CHINA ANNENG GROUP SECOND ENG BUREAU CO LTD;CHINA ANNENG CONSTRUCTION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent security method and device for industrial park, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of Internet of things, and provides an intelligent security method, an intelligent security device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for an industrial park. The method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment and feature fusion on sensor data to obtain environment perception data, carrying out face feature recognition and hierarchical authorization processing on the environment perception data to obtain regional personnel data, carrying out disaster prediction coupling on the regional personnel data and the environment perception data to obtain risk evolution data, carrying out evacuation path planning on the risk evolution data and the regional personnel data to obtain evacuation navigation data, and carrying out emergency response processing on the evacuation navigation data and real-time position coordinates of personnel to obtain a device control instruction set. The application realizes refinement, real-time and automation in all links of environment perception, identity management, risk prediction, evacuation navigation and emergency response, and improves the safety protection capability of an industrial park.
assignees: ANKE PREFERRED SHENZHEN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual reality inspection emergency method and system for safety operation of pressure vessel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual reality inspection emergency method and a virtual reality inspection emergency system for safe operation of a pressure container, which particularly relate to the technical field of the pressure container, and are characterized in that fatigue data in a plurality of time periods are collected and integrated into a VR system, fatigue data of equipment materials are loaded by creating a fault test environment, failure response of the equipment in a fatigue state is simulated, abnormal fluctuation of the equipment data and emergency response of operators are recorded in real time, accuracy of VR simulation is evaluated and divided into high-accuracy and low-accuracy simulation grades, for low-accuracy simulation, abnormal degree is further analyzed, failure time and failure condition of the equipment are dynamically adjusted, so that the simulation precision and the emergency response capability of operators are improved, the problem that the existing VR simulation system cannot fully consider the extreme failure mode of the equipment is effectively solved, and the operators can make more accurate and timely decisions when facing actual sudden events.

title_en: Urban area tunnel network dynamic cooperative scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic collaborative scheduling method and a dynamic collaborative scheduling system for a tunnel network in an urban area, which belong to the technical field of intelligent management of tunnel networks. The method adopts a space-time diagram multidimensional prediction method to carry out multidimensional prediction evaluation, performs unified modeling and short-time prediction on traffic operation, air environment, equipment state and emergency channel conditions in the tunnel network, can identify potential congestion points, pollution hot spots and high risk areas in advance, improves risk identification efficiency and accuracy, adopts a multi-objective optimization tunnel network intelligent scheduling method to carry out dynamic collaborative scheduling, realizes comprehensive balance of traffic smoothness, air quality and energy consumption, and improves the performability and emergency response timeliness of a scheduling strategy through layered optimization and emergency priority strategies on the premise of meeting safety constraint.
assignees: SUZHOU SHENYITONG SMART OPERATION MAN CO LTD

title_en: Full supply chain carbon management method and system for coupling carbon capture and sequestration of coal-fired power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of chain carbon management, and discloses a full supply chain carbon management method and system for coupling carbon capture and sequestration of a coal-fired power plant, which are used for providing reliable technical support for green transformation of the coal-fired power plant. The method comprises the steps of generating a global dynamic geological carbon potential field distribution map based on real-time working conditions and pre-evaluation geological attribute data of a sealing library, generating geological priority dispatching instructions for each batch of carbon dioxide according to the distribution map, creating and binding globally unique carbon asset digital identifications for the carbon dioxide when a conveying pipe network is injected, calculating geological sealing value data based on geological attribute and logistics information of a target sealing library after the target sealing library is injected, registering all data to a trusted carbon asset account book, and forming a permanent carbon removal asset record. According to the invention, safe and optimal scheduling is realized through the geological carbon potential field, and high-quality and high-price carbon asset is realized by using geological value-added factors.
assignees: HUADIAN XINJIANG ZHUNDONG WUCAIWAN POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Method for providing foreign language direct reading-direct translation training service using speech recognition engine
title_ko: 음성인식엔진을 이용한 2단계의 외국어 문장 직독직해 학습 서비스 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a direct comprehension study service of a foreign language sentence. The method for providing the direct comprehension study service of the foreign language sentence with two steps using the voice recognition engine according to the present invention includes the steps of: transmitting one phrase to a user terminal as characters; displaying the transmitted characters on the user terminal for preset time; recording and receiving the voice of a user by analyzing the transmitted phrase with a mother tongue using the voice recognition engine; processing the remaining phrases with the above steps; and transmitting a score to the user terminal by scoring the voice of the user. [Reference numerals] (AA) Start; (BB) End; (S100) Step of transmitting one phrase to a user terminal as characters in a sentence composed of target learning languages and meaning unit phrases; (S200) Step in which the characters transmitted in the S100 are opened on the user terminal for a predetermined time; (S300) Step in which the opening of the characters transmitted in the S100 is ended and the voice phonated by analyzing the characters transmitted in the S100 as the meaning of a mother tongue is recorded and received from the user terminal; (S400) Step of performing a same process of S100 to S300 to the rest of phrases among the characters of S100; (S500) Step of scoring the voice of the user received in the S300 to S400 to the user terminal
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 외국어 문장 직독직해 학습 서비스 제공 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 음성인식엔진을 이용한 2단계의 외국어 문장 직독직해 학습 서비스 제공 방법에 따르면, 서비스 제공 서버가 의미단위의 구절들로 이루어진 문장을 구절별로 나누어 사용자 단말기에 미리 정해진 시간 동안 문자로 제공하고, 사용자로 하여금 문자로 제공된 구절을 그대로 발성한 후에 이를 모국어 뜻으로 해석하여 발성하도록 구현하되, 문자의 제공 시간, 사용자 발성시간 등은 문장 또는 구절의 철자 수나 녹음된 사운드의 길이에 기인하여 적절한 시간을 정교하게 설정함으로써, 사용자로 하여금 문장을 빠르게 읽으면서 동시에 의미를 파악하여 기억하도록 하고, 문자가 사라진 후 다음 문장이 나타날 때까지 정교하게 설정된 짧은 시간 동안 모국어로 빠르게 해석하도록 하여, 의미단위의 구절의 문장 패턴을 내면화하면서, 순간적으로 그 의미를 하나의 단위로 파악할 수 있도록 하며, 아울러 파악한 의미에 대한 기억의 강화 효과도 얻을 수 있도록 한다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 의미단위의 구절들로 이루어진 문장을 사용자 단말기에 전송하고 사용자가 스스로 의미단위의 구절로 분류하여 어순대로 해석하여 발성한 사용자 음성을 음성인식엔진을 이용하여 전송받되, 음성인식엔진은 문장 길이에 따라 미리 정해진 시간 동안에만 작동하도록 설정함으로써, 학습 집중도 및 의미해석의 처리 속도를 높일 수 있고, 구절별로 전송되는 사용자 음성에 대응하는 구절의 문자 색을 나머지 구절과 다른 색으로 변경시킴으로써, 사용자의 흥미를 유발시키며, 여러 의미 절로 이루어진 외국어 문장의 패턴을 더욱 명료하게 파악하고 분류할 수 있도록 한다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명에 따르면, 1단계로 의미단위의 구절별로 나누어 사용자 단말기에 문자로 전송하여 훈련시키는 구절별 문자 제공 직독직해 학습이 완료된 이후에, 2단계로 사용자가 스스로 의미단위의 구절로 분류하여 해석하도록 하는 문장별 문자 제공 직독직해 학습을 수행하도록 함으로써, 문법 지식에 의존하지 않고 문장을 이루는 부분 의미단위로서의 문장 패턴을 직관적으로 파악할 수 있게 하고, 파악한 패턴에 의해 스스로 의미단위의 구절을 분류하면서 정해진 시간 안에 긴 문장을 외국어 사고체계에 따른 어순 그대로 빠르게 해석할 수 있도록 한다.

title_en: Apparatus for presenting scene of marine accident area using unmanned aerial vehicle, method thereof and computer recordable medium storing program to perform the method
title_ko: 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장의 영상을 제공하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus for presenting an image of a scene of a marine accident area by using an unmanned aerial vehicle, a method therefor, and a computer readable recording medium storing a program to perform the method. Accordingly, the present invention provides a control apparatus for searching a marine accident area, a method thereof, and a computer readable recording medium storing a program to perform the method. The control apparatus comprises: a communication unit provided to communicate with an unmanned aerial vehicle; and a control unit dividing a predetermined area into a plurality of cells having a square column shape, a size of which is predetermined according to a communication range of the unmanned aerial vehicle, deriving at least one cell belonging to the shortest path when a cell, designated as a search area among a plurality of cells, and a cell, in which the control apparatus is located, are connected by a cell unit, designating the derived cell as a cell to constitute a network, and assigning the unmanned aerial vehicle to each derived cell.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장의 영상을 제공하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 이러한 본 발명은 무인항공기와 통신하기 위한 통신부와, 소정 지역을 상기 무인항공기의 통신 범위에 따라 규격이 결정되는 정각기둥 형상의 복수의 셀로 구분하며, 복수의 셀 중 탐색 지역으로 지정된 셀과 상기 관제장치가 위치한 셀을 셀 단위로 연결했을 때, 최단 경로에 속하는 적어도 하나의 셀을 도출하고, 상기 도출된 셀을 네트워크를 구성할 셀로 설정하며, 상기 도출된 셀 각각에 대해 무인항공기를 배정하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 관제장치와, 이에 따른 방법과, 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: Apparatus For Integrated Residence Management Using Environmental Information
title_ko: 환경정보를 이용한 거주지 종합 관리를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated residence management program using environmental information. More specifically, the present invention relates to the integrated residence management program using environmental information which collects environment information and prepares for a disaster or prevents an accident based on the collected environment information. According to an embodiment of the present invention, a computer program for integrally managing a residence using environmental information includes: a smart plug; an integrated home appliance capable of communicating with the smart plug; and a user terminal. The computer program comprises: a function including a carbon monoxide sensor, a carbon dioxide sensor, a temperature sensor, a humidity sensor, a fire sensor, a human body sensor, and a fine dust sensor to measure the environment information of the residence; a function performing authentication with the integrated home appliance and the user terminal and permitting access to only the authenticated integrated home appliance and user terminal; a function controlling power of the integrated home appliance to supply or cut off the power of the integrated home appliance; a function transmitting the environment information, disaster situation information, and integrated home appliance state information inside the residence to a user; and a function controlling operation of a set lamp, a speaker, and the integrated home appliance installed in the residence. The function controlling the operation of the set lamp, the speaker, and the integrated home appliance installed in the residence comprises: a function interconnected with a lamp installed in the residence to control turn-on/off of the lamp in accordance with a transmitted control value; a function outputting siren and speech sounds capable of informing the user of a disaster situation; and a function controlling an operation state of the integrated home appliance in accordance with a control value transmitted from the smart plug.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 환경정보를 이용한 거주지 종합 관리를 위한 프로그램에 관한 것이다. 더욱 자세하게, 본 발명은 환경정보를 수집하고 이를 기반으로 재난에 대비하거나 사고를 방지할 수 있는 환경정보를 이용한 거주지 종합 관리 프로그램에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 스마트 플러그 및 상기 스마트 플러그와 통신이 가능한 종합 가전기기 및 사용자 단말기를 포함하는 환경정보를 이용한 거주지 종합 관리를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램은, 일산화탄소 센서, 이산화탄소 센서, 온도 센서, 습도 센서, 화재 센서, 인체감지 센서 및 미세먼지 센서를 포함하여 거주지의 환경정보를 측정하는 기능; 종합 가전기기 및 사용자 단말기와 인증을 수행하고, 인증된 가전기기 및 단말기만의 접속을 허용하는 기능; 스마트 플러그 및 사용자 단말기 간의 데이터 송수신을 매개하는 기능; 종합 가전기기의 전원을 제어하여 종합 가전기기의 전원을 공급 및 차단하는 기능; 거주지 내의 환경정보와 재난상황 정보 및 가전상태 정보를 사용자에게 전송하는 기능; 거주지 내에 설치된 설정등, 스피커, 가전기기의 동작을 제어하는 기능을 포함하되, 상기 거주지 내에 설치된 설정등, 스피커, 가전기기의 동작을 제어하는 기능은, 거주지 내에 설치된 전등과 연동되어 전송된 제어값에 따라 전등의 ON/OFF를 제어하는 기능; 재난상황을 알릴 수 있는 사이렌 소리, 음성 소리를 출력하는 기능; 스마트 플러그로부터 전송된 제어값에 따라 가전의 동작 상태가 제어되는 기능을 포함하는 환경정보를 이용한 거주지 종합 관리를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램을 제공한다.

title_en: Learning toy, mobile body for learning toy, panel for learning toy, and portable information processing terminal for learning toy
abstract_en: A learning toy is provided which enables various kinds of operation and which allows not only younger infants but also older children to learn high-level programming in a stepwise manner. A movement path 12C is configured by a plurality of command panels 121 in which command information which can be read by an optical reading module 240 is recorded being arranged. A mobile robot 110 sequentially reads the command information recorded in the command panels 121 through which the mobile robot 110 passes while moving on the movement path 120, operates on the basis of this command information and transmits the read command information to a tablet computer 130. The tablet computer 130 which receives this command information displays an image or generates sound on the basis of this command information. Further, it is also possible to operate the mobile robot 110 from the tablet computer 130.

title_en: System and Method for Preparing and Implementing Emergency Response Plans
abstract_en: A system and computer implemented method for implementing an emergency response plan in real time includes the steps of electronically providing an emergency plan flow chart including action items that a user must progress through and complete in real time during an emergency incident, and electronically time stamping the completed action items of the emergency plan flow chart as the user progresses through the emergency plan flow chart during the emergency incident. The user can add notes to the time-stamped competed action items and can save an incident record for the emergency incident record as either an actual emergency incident or a drill.

title_en: Personal emergency response system help button wear compliance
abstract_en: In a Personal Emergency Response System (PERS), a Personal Help Button (PHB) (10) includes a call button (12), a motion sensor (22), and a transmitter or transceiver (24), the transmitter or transceiver (24) for transmitting a wireless call signal in response to pressing the call button. The electronic processor (28) performs compliance monitoring processes (42) at successive compliance check times, each compliance monitoring process including: collecting motion sensor data over a compliance data collection time interval; determining whether the PHB has moved since the last compliance check time; and evaluating compliance based at least in part on the determination of whether the PHB has moved. The determining may include determining a change in orientation of the PHB since the last check time. Alternatively, compliance may be monitored by detecting and recording a wake-up interrupt event that causes the motion sensor to switch from a low-power mode to an operational mode.

title_en: Vehicle impact sensor and notification system
abstract_en: The present disclosure involves systems, software, sensors, and applied solutions for detecting incidents associated with a vehicle, where sensors associated with the vehicle identify impacts or proximity alerts to other vehicles and objects and record information related to those detected incidents. The recorded information can be immediately communicated to interested parties of the person or entity (e.g., emergency responders, business contacts) associated with the vehicle, or alternatively, stored for inspection at the vehicle and reviewed at a destination along the vehicle's route. In one example method, operations include detecting an incident associated with a monitored vehicle, where detecting the incident comprises receiving an alert from at least one sensor associated with the vehicle, identifying a location of the vehicle in response to the detection, and storing a record of the detected incident, where the record includes the identified location of the vehicle and a time associated with the detected incident.

title_en: Systems and methods for assignment of equipment to an officer
abstract_en: A system for tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment to security agency personnel (e.g., officers, administration, command, armorer). An armorer is assigned the task of tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment. Equipment may be assigned to a particular individual officer. The equipment provided to and used by officers may capture (e.g. gather, produce) information (e.g. audiovisual information, data logs, recordings). Equipment may provide information to the armorer via near field communication (NFC) circuits. The information captured may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system. The information captured by equipment assigned to a particular individual may be associated with that individual. An armorer may use information supplied by equipment, evidence management system, officers, or other sources to assist in the assignment process.

title_en: System for validating and appending incident-related data records in a distributed electronic ledger
abstract_en: A computer apparatus, such as a validator node, for validating incident-related data records in a distributed electronic ledger is configured to receive a request from an agent to add a proposed incident-related data record associated with an incident to the distributed electronic ledger. In response to the proposed incident-related data record, the computer apparatus determines, from the distributed electronic ledger, one or more attributes of the agent or incident. The computer apparatus determines whether the proposed incident-related data record satisfies validation criteria based at least partially on the one or more attributes of the agent or incident. Once validated, the computer apparatus may then append the proposed incident-related data record to the distributed electronic ledger. Alternatively, the proposed incident-related data record may be appended regardless of validity, but an indication of validity may be appended if the proposed incident-related data record is validated.

title_en: Dangerous goods vehicle monitoring system based on Beidou satellite navigation positioning
abstract_en: Provided is a dangerous goods vehicle monitoring system based on Beidou satellite navigation positioning. The system comprises a vehicle terminal system and a dangerous goods vehicle monitoring scheduling system. Data communication between the vehicle terminal system and the dangerous goods vehicle monitoring scheduling system is realized via a GSM/GPRS network communication module in a wireless manner. A dangerous goods transportation vehicle is monitored and tracked through Beidou satellite navigation positioning, and the driving route and the area of the vehicle are managed through the Beidou satellite navigation positioning. Therefore, a management center can monitor in a real-time manner, schedule and manage in a centralized manner when the dangerous goods vehicle is in a moving state, can know the position of the vehicle on an electronic map in a clear and real-time manner, and the instantaneous speed of the vehicle can be displayed. Meanwhile, the system allows information about overspeed record of a driver, the violation route of the driver or the like to be stored in a central database, is convenient for commanding and guiding a highly toxic chemical road transportation vehicle, enables traffic violation behaviors to be corrected and penalized, helps to effectively and rapidly handle highly toxic chemical accidents on a road and at other places, and enables the loss caused by the accidents to be minimized.

title_en: Natural disaster emergency simulation drill command system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a natural disasters emergency simulation rehearsal command system, including the inner panel, the downside left end surface mounting of inner panel has the slide rail, and the inside of slide rail is provided with the slider, and the slide rail passes through slider and cardboard interconnect, the lower extreme at the slider is fixed to the cardboard, and the inboard of cardboard and the left side outside interconnect of camera, the lower extreme right side of inner panel is provided with the montant, and the internally mounted of montant has the bull stick, the left end top of movable block is connected with the flat board, and dull and stereotyped upside surface is provided with the layer board, and the inboard of layer board and the right-hand member outside interconnect of camera, the spout has been seted up to the upper end inboard of inner panel, and the inner panel passes through the lower extreme interconnect of spout and baffle, the upper end top inboard of baffle is connected with the stretch cord, and the middle part of stretch-through of stretch cord has the fixed block. This emergent simulation rehearsal command system of natural disasters makes the device can record the result of playing, makes things convenient for operating personnel's observation to the device is easy to assemble dismantlement.

title_en: Network electric power accident emergency processing analogue system
abstract_en: A kind of network electric power accident emergency processing analogue system, it mainly is made up of manoeuvre command centre, server, scheduling operation cyber-net, each computer of composition analogue system is connected as a system by network, each the terminal participating in manoeuvre can become manoeuvre command centre or scheduling operation computer according to the authority of user, manoeuvre command centre can arbitrarily arrange modification power failure, modification arranges the load of transformer station and circuit, arranges each transformer station and transmission line malfunction pattern；Scheduling operation computer is able to receive that the fault that manoeuvre command centre sends arranges instruction, can record the treatment measures of fault treating procedure dispatcher and operating personnel；The fault simulation of server record manoeuvre command centre arranges data and the fault treating procedure of each scheduling operation computer, in order to assay electric power accident manoeuvre.

title_en: A kind of loophole automation means of defence and system based on warning information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of, and the loophole based on warning information automates means of defence and system, calling analysis and real-time calling using Web application normal behaviour are intercepted as the breach solved the problems, such as, using loophole notice of warning as starting point: being called by normal behaviour and analyze the coverage for determining loophole, avoid the operating for influencing other business；It is intercepted by real-time calling to there may be the function calls of attack to carry out parameter testing, abnormal behaviour is determined by reference record；By crawling the loophole notice of warning of security website, critical defect information is therefrom extracted, loophole, which is accurately positioned, to be influenced file and function and carry out loophole response and automatic protection automatically.The present invention can implement emergency response measure to the loophole of Web application automatically according to loophole warning information, be lost with lower performance prevents loophole from attacking in time, solve the problems, such as manually to carry out that loophole response speed is slow, exists and fails to report wrong report, and unknown attack is coped with, has certain availability.

title_en: Medical intervention scheduling method and system based on 5G pre-hospital emergency vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of pre-hospital emergency, in particular to a medical intervention dispatching method and a medical intervention dispatching system based on 5G pre-hospital emergency vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of receiving an emergency task of an emergency dispatching center, running the pre-hospital emergency vehicles and starting vehicle-mounted medical equipment; the method comprises the steps of collecting vehicle operation data, medical equipment data and environment situation data in real time, inputting a preset time sequence prediction model to obtain vital sign trend, calculating risk scores according to the vital sign trend, triggering early warning and calling a medical knowledge graph and an expert rule base to generate corresponding intervention measure suggestions when the risk scores exceed a first threshold, receiving feedback of the intervention measure suggestions, collecting new medical record data in the emergency process, carrying out standardization processing on the new medical record data, and fusing the new medical record data to existing medical record data in a hospital through an increment synchronization mode. Based on the method, the potential abnormality can be identified in advance, the intervention scheme can be actively generated, and timely diagnosis and treatment of the patient can be ensured.

title_en: Cabinet panel/low-voltage distributing board inside voice-warning device for over-heating protection
title_ko: 과열보호 음성경보장치가 내장된 분전반/저압배전반
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A cabinet panel/low-voltage distributing board having a voice-warning device for over-heating protection is provided to help a user rapidly manage a situation before the operation of a circuit breaker by generating an alarm according to temperature-time not immediately operating the circuit breaker. CONSTITUTION: A cabinet panel/low-voltage distributing board having a voice-warning device for over-heating protection includes a control power unit(120), a main control unit(130), a display unit, a control panel(150), an alarm driving unit(170), and a remote terminal. The main control unit provides an alarm based on a control program which is set according to a temperature-time. The main control unit compares temperature data with a predetermined data to determine the generation of an alarm. The main control unit transmits the overheat state of the cabinet panel to a remote terminal when overheat occurs from the cabinet panel. A user recognize the overheat of the cabinet panel through the remote terminal and controls an operation switch.
abstract_ko:
운전 중 온도상태를 감시하여 과열상태가 발생할 경우 온도-시간에 따른 한시 특성에 따라 경보를 발생함은 물론 최종적으로 차단기를 동작시켜 화재사고 등을 방지하기 위한 과열보호 음성경보장치가 내장된 분전반/저압배전반이 개시된다. 
개시된 과열보호 음성경보장치가 내장된 분전반/저압배전반은, 상기 분전반 또는 저압 배전반의 부스 바(Bus Bar) 또는 케이블 접촉부에 설치되어 주변 온도를 검출하는 온도 센서와; 상기 온도 센서에 의해 검출된 온도와 메모리에 미리 내장된 한계온도를 비교하여 1차적으로 경보를 발생시켜 주의를 환기시키고, 경보중에 과열상태가 지속되고 있다고 판단될 경우 2차적으로 온도-시간에 따른 한시 특성에 맞게 미리 설정된 제어 프로그램을 기반으로 트립 과정을 제공하며, 차단기 동작을 위한 트립 잔여 시간의 표시를 제어하는 메인 컨트롤 유닛과; 상기 메인 컨트롤 유닛과 연동하여 차단기 동작을 위한 트립 잔여 시간을 표시해주는 표시장치; 및 상기 메인 컨트롤 유닛과 연동하여 상기 트립 잔여 시간을 음성으로 송출해주는 잔여시간 음성 경보부를 포함한다.

title_en: Chemical hazard assessment apparatus and method assessing hazard of chemical
title_ko: 화학물질에 대한 유해성을 평가하는 화학물질 유해성 평가장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for evaluating the harmfulness of chemicals to evaluate the harmfulness of chemicals. According to the present invention, an apparatus for evaluating harmfulness of chemical substances comprises: a memory in which a risk evaluation program is stored; and a processor executing the program stored in the memory. The processor calculates a harmfulness grade of chemical substances and an exposure grade of the chemical substances based on chemical substance information according to the execution of the program, and evaluates a risk grade for a leakage accident of the chemical substances based on the calculated harmfulness grade of the chemical substances and the calculated exposure grade of the chemical substances.
abstract_ko: 화학물질에 대한 유해성을 평가하는 화학물질 유해성 평가장치 및 그 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 화학물질 유해성 평가장치는 위험성 평가 프로그램이 저장된 메모리; 및 메모리에 저장된 프로그램을 실행하는 프로세서를 포함하고, 프로세서는 프로그램의 실행에 따라, 화학물질 정보에 기초하여, 화학물질의 유해성 등급 및 화학물질의 노출 등급을 산출하고, 산출된 화학물질의 유해성 등급 및 산출된 화학물질의 노출 등급에 기초하여, 화학물질의 유출 사고에 대한 위험성 등급을 평가한다.
