title_en: Method and apparatus for communication with emergency dispatch services
abstract_en: Emergency reporting is described in which user input is received in an emergency call that is used to classify the call. Based on the classification process, emergency calls are processed to give priority to certain calls. The calls that are given the highest priority may be transmitted by a voice network and other calls may be transmitted by a data network. The reporting includes receiving user input identifying an emergency perspective of the user and selecting a data call based on the emergency perspective indicating the user is a bystander. It also includes recording an audio message from the user and transmitting the audio message to a public service answering point (PSAP) over a data network.

title_en: Ecg-enabled personal emergency response systems
abstract_en: The invention provides personal emergency response systems (PERS) with expanded life-saving capabilities. One embodiment of the invention provides a wearable PERS pendant that incorporates a cell phone transmitter or transceiver, a GPS location system, an accelerometer-based fall detector that automatically triggers an alert, and an electrocardiogram (ECG) recorder permitting a remote service center or medical personnel to receive and respond to transmitted alerts and electrocardiographic data.

title_en: Systems and methods for a recorder user interface
abstract_en: An incident recorder records original and supplemental incident information using a simplified user interface.

title_en: Emergency payment starting method and device, computing equipment and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention relates to the technical field of communication, and discloses an emergency payment starting method, an emergency payment starting device, computing equipment and a computer storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: detecting the user payment work order quantity in a payment interface work order form; when the user payment work order quantity reaches a threshold value, extracting user payment work orders in batches, and controlling emergency starting of users related to the extracted user payment work orders; continuously detecting the user payment work order amount in the payment interface work order list, and suspending the payment emergency flow when the user payment work order amount is lower than the threshold value; aiming at the emergency starting user, inquiring the balance after paying and billing, and stopping the user when the balance is smaller than 0. By means of the method, the device and the system for automatically starting and stopping the emergency response can be started and stopped automatically according to the backlog quantity of the toll ticket, the timeliness of the emergency response can be greatly improved, and the applicability of a toll channel is improved.

title_en: Network security emergency response method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The application discloses a network security emergency response method and a system thereof based on a knowledge graph, wherein a strategy base is constructed through a crawler technology and the knowledge graph, and comprises a security information base and a knowledge graph base; when a network security event is monitored to occur, matching a corresponding response strategy in a security information base based on event information of the network security event, obtaining a corresponding knowledge graph in a knowledge graph base based on the event information, and obtaining an entity and an association relation related to the event information based on the knowledge graph; generating a safety emergency plan based on the response strategy, the entity related to the event information and the incidence relation, wherein the safety emergency plan at least comprises the response strategy and safety emergency personnel; the safety emergency plan is sent to safety emergency personnel, and the safety emergency personnel are reminded of responding quickly, so that the technical problems that in the prior art, when an emergency network safety event occurs, the linkage of multi-party heterogeneous resources only depends on manual operation, and the timeliness and comprehensiveness of emergency response are reduced are solved.

title_en: Power breaking apparatus with fire protection
title_ko: 화재예방기능을 가지는 전원차단기
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 입력전원으로부터 필요전원을 공급받고 부하전원 라인으로부터 스파크파형 및 누전파형을 검출하고, 이를 이용하여 초기에 누전 또는 전기스파크를 감지 분석하여 전기스파크로 인한 발화 또는 위험이 극도에 달하기 전에 경고 또는 전원을 완전히 차단함으로써, 화재 및 감전사고로부터 재산과 인명피해를 줄일 수 있도록 한 화재예방기능을 가지는 전원차단기 및 전원차단방법으로, 전원차단기 본체(10)에 설치되어 부하전원공급을 개폐하는 스위치(20); 및 상기 입력전원(도시하지 않음)으로부터 전원을 공급받아 스파크파형과 누전파형을 검출하고, 이 검출된 파형을 증폭 출력하는  검출회로(C1)와, 상기 검출회로 로부터 입력된 신호를 변별하여 안정된 디지털신호로 변환하여 출력하기 위한 변환회로(C2)와, 상기 변환회로에 입력된 신호를 선별하여 판별회로(C5)로 출력 및 모니터링 할 수 있는 마이콤(MC)을 구성한 중앙처리부(C3)와, 상기 중앙처리부에 입력된 신호를 사전에 입력된 예측프로그램과 비교 분석하는 비교회로(C4)와, 그 결과에 따라 단계별 경보발생 및 해제할 수 있으며 각각의 경보원인제거 시 초기화기능을 할 수 있도록 한 판별회로(C5)와, 상기 판별회로에서 경보원인 미제거시 스피커(11)를 통해 경고음 발생하고, 동시에 LED램프(12)를 점멸하도록 구성된다.

title_en: Control system for entire facilities by using local area data collector and record device
title_ko: 지역별 데이터 수집ㆍ기록 장치를 이용한 시설물 통합 관리시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A control system for entire facilities by using a local area data collector and a record device are provided to secure the stability and security of managing facilities at local areas. CONSTITUTION: A wired and wireless communication network(200) transmits data between a data collection unit(100) and the sever(400) of a central/local control center through two-way communication. A communication converter(300) converts a transport protocol which is transmitted from the wired and wireless communication network into a standard protocol.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지역별 데이터 수집ㆍ기록 장치를 이용한 시설물 통합 관리시스템에 관한 것이다.  이를 위해 본 발명은, 저수지, 담수호, 펌프장, 상ㆍ하수도 처리장, 하천 보, 사방댐, 다목적댐 등의 지역별 물 관리 시설물을 통합 관리하는 시스템에 있어서, 상기 시스템은, 시설물과 상기 시설물 관리장내의 각종 설비 및 장치들에 대해 팬-틸트(Pan-Tilt), 주밍(Zooming), 고속회전 기능을 갖고, 기준영상과 현재영상을 비교하여 움직임이 검출되거나 센서로부터 이상 음성이 감지되면 동영상을 촬영하는 CCTV/Web-Camera와, 상기 CCTV/Web-Camera와 연동되며, 침입자나 사고발생시 사전에 설정된 프로그램 혹은 원격명령에 따라 침입자와 사고발생 부위를 추적하여 다양한 각도로 카메라를 구동시켜 이미지 사진으로 촬영하는 스틸 카메라와, 상기 각종 설비 및 장비에 부착된 상기 센서로부터 감지된 기계 진동음과 같은 이상 음성을 수집하는 PC기반의 데이터수집(DAQ)Unit와, 상기 동영상과 이미지 사진 및 음성 데이터 신호를 디지털 신호로 변환하고 합성하여 압축 파일로 저장하는 하드디스크와, 상기 시설물 관리장내의 사고 신고나 사고분석 영상 및 자막데이터를 수신하고 저장하는 송ㆍ수신기 및 상기 시설물 관리장내의 침입자 경고와 위험 상황 및 수리방법을 안내하는 스피커와, 상기 수단들을 제어하며 중앙/지역 관제센터 서버와 연동하여 영상/음성 데이터를 수집하는 제어부를 구비하는 하나 이상의 지역별 데이터 수집ㆍ기록 장치를 포함하며; 상기 하나 이상의 지역별 데이터 수집ㆍ기록 장치와 중앙/지역 관제센터 이전의 통신변환기 간의 데이터를 양방향으로 전송하는 유ㆍ무선 통신망과; 상기 유ㆍ무선 통신망으로부터 전송된 상이한 전송 프로토콜을 갖는 지역별 데이터 수집ㆍ기록 장치의 동영상/이미지/음성 데이터 정보를 통합 모니터링이 가능하도록 표준화 프로토콜로 변환하는 통신변환기와; 상기 유ㆍ무선 통신망 및 상기 통신변환기와 연동하며, 상기 통신변환기로 입력된 디지털 신호를 아날로그 신호로 변환하여 다양하고 편리한 사용자 지원 모니터링을 제공하는 통합코덱 기능을 갖는 중앙/지역 관제센터 서버와; 상기 서버로부터 전송된 실시간 동영상과 이미지 사진을 1화면 내지 64화면으로 멀티 분할시키는 제1 감시용 모니터와, 시설물 관리장내의 침입자나 사고발생시 전자지도 상에 자동적으로 아이콘이 점멸되는 제2 감시용 모니터를 구비하는 감시용 모니터와; 상기 감시용 모니터를 통해 지역별 물 관리 시설물의 관리 실태를 분석하되, 상기 제1 감시용 모니터 상의 이미지 사진은 사고발생 전에 준비된 실제 사진과 3D설계도면의 관측지점으로 매핑(Mapping)하여 사고발생 부위를 정밀 분석하도록 하는 분석시스템과; 상기 분석시스템으로부터 분석된 자료를 데이터베이스화하여 중앙/지역 관제센터 상황실로 전송하여 전국 물 관리 정책입안 자료로 활용하고, 지역별 현장 근무자와 관리책임자 및 관계기관에 정보 제공되는 정보제공기기가 포함되는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: A kind of earthquake pre-warning emergency action method and information centre
abstract_en: The embodiment of the present invention provides a kind of earthquake pre-warning emergency action method and information centre.The earthquake information sent the method includes receiving the monitoring information sent by monitoring device and/or seismic network；According to preset information processing method, warning information is obtained, the warning information includes: the warning level of at least one early warning range and each early warning range；If it is determined that earthquake occurs, then earthquake pre-warning is opened, and the warning level of the early warning range is recorded as current level；All controlling terminals emergency action information corresponding with the warning level being sent in the early warning range, the earthquake information that the embodiment of the present invention is sent by the monitoring information and seismic network that receive by monitoring device, obtain early warning range and corresponding warning level, and the controlling terminal into the early warning range sends emergency action information corresponding with the warning level, to save the Emergency Response to Earthquake time, the safety of the protection effect and train operation of urban transportation is promoted.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LTD COMMUNICATION SIGNAL INSTITUTE;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;BEIJING HUATIE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Medical first-aid dispatching system device based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses a medical emergency dispatching system device based on the Internet of things, which comprises a hospital emergency control center, wherein a central server is connected with a 5G receiving module, the 5G receiving module is wirelessly connected with a 5G transmission module and receives data information acquired by an emergency ambulance positioning module and a vital sign acquisition module in real time, the central server classifies the emergency grade according to the data information acquired by the 5G receiving module and arranges emergency dispatching, and a medical equipment dispatching module is connected with the central server. According to the emergency ambulance, the positioning module is installed on the emergency ambulance, the vehicle position information can be acquired in real time, the vital sign acquisition module is further arranged in the emergency ambulance, the patient physiological sign information is acquired, the expert online conference system can arrange medical experts to acquire the patient physiological sign information and the called patient medical record information, when the required medical equipment is configured in place, the medical staff opens the positioning module, and the medical equipment scheduling module can detect the configured-in-place information.

title_en: Emergency command dispatching system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency command scheduling system, relates to the technical field of emergency management, and aims to solve the problems that rescue operation development is affected due to untimely information transmission in a rescue process caused by electronic plans, simple retrieval of emergency resources and rescue operation development through traditional communication. The key points of the technical scheme are as follows: the knowledge base management module is used for storing and analyzing emergency knowledge base research on emergency events; the public opinion management module is used for summarizing opinions held by people in emergency events; the preprocessing module is used for carrying out statistical management on daily emergency resources and recording daily business of related units; the emergency starting module is used for matching emergency plans and emergency resources after an emergency occurs and starting emergency measures; and the map management module is used for providing electronic map display and map query operation functions for commanding rescue. The invention achieves the effect of comprehensively improving the informatization management level of emergency management.
assignees: NANJING HUAITA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for identifying causal relationship of dam emergency event based on feature fusion
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for identifying causal relationship of dam emergency events based on feature fusion, which are used for carrying out event marking on dam safety operation log data and dam emergency response record information; embedding event trigger word information by adopting BERT, and outputting event context characteristics; learning event causal relations in a event map by using a graph representation method of an countermeasure generation formula, and expanding causal semantic features of the event; constructing grammar dependence paths among events, and learning grammar dependence relationships expressing causal relationships; and splicing and fusing the characteristic information of the context, the semantics and the grammar. The application fuses the triple characteristic information of the context, the semantic and the grammar, can help to quickly and accurately identify the causal relationship existing between events when abnormal events such as leakage, cracks and the like occur in the dam, and improves the judgment and decision making capability of staff on the events, thereby better making emergency plans and predicting possible problems.
assignees: UNIV HOHAI;HUANENG LANCANG RIVER HYDROPOWER CO LTD

title_en: Coal gangue storage yard environment risk real-time monitoring method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a coal gangue storage yard environment risk real-time monitoring method and system based on edge calculation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining environment risk original data collected by a multi-source sensor, preprocessing the data through edge computing nodes, constructing a multi-mode identification model to obtain pollution and geological disaster risk results, generating hierarchical early warning information and a dynamic risk map, inputting an intelligent decision system to generate an emergency response plan, updating model parameters based on execution data, and optimizing a risk monitoring system. According to the application, by introducing an edge computing technology, the localization processing of data is realized, the data transmission quantity is reduced, the response time is shortened, and meanwhile, the unified monitoring, prevention and control of pollution risks and geological disaster risks are realized by integrating the multi-mode identification model, so that the timeliness, the accuracy and the response efficiency of the real-time monitoring of the environmental risks of the coal gangue storage yard are improved.
assignees: GUIZHOU MINE SAFETY SCIENT RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive hub emergency command scheduling coordination method based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based comprehensive hub emergency command and dispatch cooperative method, which relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic and emergency management and comprises the following steps of constructing a digital twinning model of a hub area and defining a coordinate system; the method comprises the steps of collecting data in real time through a multisource sensor, carrying out time stamp alignment and filtering fusion on the data to generate fused position information, identifying abnormal objects, carrying out risk assessment, calculating risk scores, triggering emergency vehicle dispatching to select a nearest idle vehicle issuing instruction when the risk scores calculated by the risk assessment are over a preset threshold, operating a dynamic path planning algorithm after triggering the emergency vehicle dispatching, calculating an optimal path based on a cost function and a real-time risk value, issuing the path to a vehicle for execution after the optimal path is calculated, monitoring the position and the abnormal state of the vehicle in real time, updating a digital twin model, and updating the digital twin model and recording event data after the task of the vehicle execution is completed.

title_en: Emergency path control system and method based on data interaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses ‌ emergency path control system and method based on data interaction, which relate to the field of traffic control, and the invention accurately identifies event types and severity levels through mapping models by collecting images of areas to be monitored in real time, dynamically divides evacuation node layers and ensures timeliness and accuracy of event response; the emergency vehicle detection method comprises the steps of detecting emergency vehicles, automatically opening a traffic green channel in combination with event types to form a continuous green wave band, ensuring that the emergency vehicles pass through an event occurrence place in time, improving emergency response speed and safety, detecting idle parking spaces and vehicle coordinates behind the emergency vehicles through a network diagram to be monitored, planning a detour path, guiding the vehicles to complete evacuation in an external standby parking lot in advance, avoiding traffic paralysis of an event scene, and ensuring high efficiency and resource utilization rate of an evacuation process and avoiding delay and resource waste caused by congestion by dynamically adjusting initial evacuation speed iterative optimization to be below a threshold value.

title_en: The safety systems and operating methods for energized line
title_ko: 충전전로용 안전시스템 및 운영방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety system for preventing various accidents occurring on a super high-voltage charging circuit. The safety system comprises: a first detection unit including a detection sensor which measures the distance of an object approaching the charging circuit, and a motion sensor which identifies a motion of the object; a second detection unit including a camera which records the surroundings of the charging circuit and emits light, and a detection module which measures the ambient temperature and humidity; a warning unit including a speaker which propagates sound to the object approaching the charging circuit, and a warning light which emits light; and a control device integrally including a control unit which is circuit-connected to the first and second detection units and the warning unit, and a display which sets a detection area. According to the present invention, at the time of operations on a live wire for checking, repairing, and cleaning a super high-voltage charging circuit or a support insulator, warning is given for a maximum access distance. An electric shock accident caused by carelessness is prevented, and the public and animals are controlled to enter and exit while lives and properties are protected.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 특별고압 충전전로 상에 발생하는 각종 사고를 방지하는 안전시스템에 있어서: 상기 충전전로에 접근하는 물체의 거리를 측정하는 감지센서와, 물체의 움직임을 식별하는 모션센서를 구비하는 제1감지부; 상기 충전전로 주변을 촬영하고 빛을 조사하는 카메라와, 주변의 온도와 습도를 측정하는 감지모듈을 구비하는 제2감지부; 상기 충전전로에 접근하는 물체를 대상으로 소리를 전파하는 스피커와, 빛을 발산하는 경광등을 구비하는 경고부; 상기 제1·2감지부 및 경고부와 회로적으로 연결되는 콘트롤유닛과, 감지 영역을 설정하는 디스플레이를 일체로 구비하는 제어부;를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이에 따라 본 발명은, 특별고압 충전전로 또는 지지 애자를 점검, 수리, 청소를 하는 활선 작업 시에 접근한계거리를 경보해줌으로서 부주의로 인한 감전 사고를 방지하는 것은 물론, 기타 외부인이나 동물들의 출입을 통제하여 인명과 재산을 보호하는 효과가 있다.
assignees: INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION OF DONGYANG UNIVERSITY;CHOI DONG SOO

title_en: moving-images taking system for real time accident
title_ko: 실시간 사건 사고 동영상 촬영 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for filming accidents and incidents in real time, comprising: a wearable glasses including a camera that is capable of recording a video in real time and Bluetooth communications and can be connected via near-field communications; a terminal that is connected to the wearable glasses including the camera via Bluetooth communications to remotely control the video; auxiliary database servers that are capable of storing the real-time video received from the terminal; and a national police agency database server that stores videos from each of the auxiliary database servers. The system for filming accidents and incidents in real time according to the present invention can immediately report the condition of a scene where there is a policeman wearing the wearable glasses including the camera by including the above-mentioned features. Thus, the system enables the policeman to cope with a dangerous situation together with other policemen when an incident occurs. In addition, the system makes a database with conditions of accident and incident fields, stores and keeps the same in the database, to enable policemen to learn beforehand methods of preventing and coping with similar crimes, thereby contributing to prevention and minimization of damage. It is possible to systematically accumulate information on accidents and incidents and to contribute to enhancement of police force by using the database. Furthermore, it is possible to restore trust in the police regarding the excessive use of force, to prevent a fraudulent act such as giving false witness, and to make it easy to analyze a case objectively and accurately.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실시간 사건 사고 동영상 촬영 시스템에 관한 것으로, 실시간 동영상 촬영이 가능하고 블루투스 통신이 가능하여 근거리 통신으로 연동될 수 있는 카메라가 부착된 웨어러블 글래스; 카메라가 부착된 웨어러블 글래스와 블루투스 통신으로 연결되어 원격 제어에 의해 영상 제어가 가능한 단말기; 단말기로부터 넘겨받은 실시간 영상을 저장할 수 있는 보조 데이터베이스 서버; 및 각 보조 서버로부터 수신받은 동영상을 저장하는 경찰청 데이터베이스 서버;를 포함하는 것으로, 본 발명에 따른 실시간 사건 사고 동영상 촬영 시스템은 상술한 바와 같은 특유의 구성을 구비하는 것에 의해서, 카메라가 부착된 웨어러블 글래스를 착용한 경찰의 현장 상황을 즉시 보고할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 이로인해 문제상황이 발생되면 타 경찰과 유기적 공조를 통하여 위험상황에 대한 공동대처가 가능하다. 
또한, 본 발명에 의해, 사건, 사고의 현장 상황을 데이터베이스화 하여 저장 및 보관함으로서 유사 사례의 범죄발생 예방 및 대처의 방법에 대하여 사전에 학습함으로서 피해의 예방 및 최소화에 기여할 수 있다. 이러한 데이터베이스를 이용하여 체계적인 사건, 사고 정보를 정립할 수 있으며, 경찰력의 향상에 크게 기여할 수 있다. 

뿐만 아니라, 본 발명에 따르면, 과잉진압에 대한 경찰의 신뢰회복이 가능하고 피의자의 거짓 증언과 같은 부정행위를 방지하며, 객관적이고 정확한 사건 분석이 용이한 장점이 있다.

title_en: A device for sending emergency alerts on roads based on electrical signal control using CCTV, sound and VMS
title_ko: Cctv, 음향 및 전광판을 활용한 전기 신호 제어 기반 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a system for transmitting a road unexpected situation alarm, capable of suppressing a secondary accident caused by a following vehicle by detecting an unexpected situation on a road by using a cctv, a sound, and an electric sign installed on the road. According to the present invention, the apparatus for transmitting an emergency signal of an emergency signal of a road comprises: an image acquisition unit; an emergency signal detection unit; and an emergency signal output unit. The cctv image recording from cctv installed at the image acquisition part is on the road is gotten. The outbreak situation sensor senses the outbreak situation whether or not to the outbreak situation sensing model about the cctv image gotten. The alarm signal output unit outputs an alarm signal when an unexpected situation is detected. At this time, the unexpected situation detection model is modeled by machine learning the cctv image, but machine learning is performed by dividing the time, season, and weather at the time of capturing the cctv image into variables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 위에 설치되는 CCTV, 음향 및 전광판을 활용하여 도로 위 돌발상황을 감지하여 후속차량에 의한 2차 사고를 억제할 수 있는 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치는 영상 획득부, 돌발상황 감지부 및 경보 신호 출력부를 포함한다. 영상 획득부는 도로 상에 설치된 CCTV로부터 촬영된 CCTV 영상을 획득한다. 돌발상황 감지부는 획득한 CCTV 영상에 대한 돌발상황 감지 모델로 돌발상황 여부를 감지한다. 그리고 경보 신호 출력부는 돌발상황이 감지되면 경보 신호를 출력한다. 이때 돌발상황 감지 모델은 CCTV 영상을 기계학습 하여 모델링 하되, CCTV 영상을 촬영하는 시점의 시간, 계절 및 기상을 변수로 구분하여 기계학습 한다.

title_en: Block programming system using card reader and block programming method using same
title_ko: 카드 리더기를 이용한 블록 프로그래밍 시스템 및 이를 이용한 블록 프로그래밍 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a block programming system using a card reader and a block programming method using same, wherein the block programming system comprises a card unit, the card reader and an operating system. The card unit comprises an operation card including operation contents, and a calculation card including a parameter. The card reader recognizes the card unit and transmits a corresponding command, and comprises a button unit for receiving a user input about whether the corresponding command is executed. The operating system receives contents of the recognized card unit and forms operation logic, and determines whether to execute the formed operation logic on the basis of the input of the button unit.
abstract_ko: 카드 리더기를 이용한 블록 프로그래밍 시스템 및 이를 이용한 블록 프로그래밍 방법에서, 상기 블록 프로그래밍 시스템은 카드부, 카드 리더기 및 운영 시스템을 포함한다. 상기 카드부는 동작 내용을 포함하는 동작 카드, 및 매개 변수를 포함하는 연산 카드를 포함한다. 상기 카드 리더기는 상기 카드부를 인식하여 해당 명령을 전송하고, 해당 명령의 수행 여부에 대한 사용자의 입력을 제공받는 버튼부를 포함한다. 상기 운영 시스템은 상기 인식된 카드부의 내용을 전송받아 동작 로직을 형성하고, 상기 버튼부의 입력을 바탕으로 상기 형성된 동작 로직의 수행 여부를 판단한다.

title_en: Device, system and method for screening of personally identifiable information
abstract_en: A device, system and method for screening of personally identifiable information is provided. An incident type of a particular incident is determined. Responsive to determining that potential evidence associated with the particular incident includes personally identifiable information, the potential evidence being of a particular evidence type including one or more of media and metadata generated by a user or a device associated with the user, a personally identifiable information processing mode is selected to process the potential evidence as a function of the incident type of the particular incident and an evidence type of the potential evidence. When selected mode is a storing mode, a record of the potential evidence is generated that included the personally identifiable information to be stored in an electronic storage device.

title_en: Mountain landslide space-space cooperative sensing early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mountain landslide space-space cooperative sensing early warning method, which belongs to the technical field of early warning and comprises the following steps of setting targets, acquiring images for identifying a plurality of targets at fixed time through a satellite remote sensing technology, connecting each target with a plurality of adjacent targets according to a distance from small to large to form a monitoring early warning network, and triggering early warning, namely measuring the length of each line segment and/or the angle of each line segment included angle in the monitoring early warning network through an image identification technology, comparing measured values of each time with initial values, and triggering a first early warning command when the length change rate of the line segment exceeding A percent is greater than B percent and/or the angle change rate of the included angle exceeding C percent is greater than D percent. The satellite remote sensing technology provides large-scale and high-precision monitoring data, unmanned aerial vehicle inspection provides real-time on-site information, foundation monitoring focuses on key factors such as rainfall, and the three work cooperatively, so that the accuracy and timeliness of early warning are improved.

title_en: Ship final assembly construction safety quality real-time monitoring method based on AI image recognition
abstract_en: The invention provides a ship assembly construction safety quality real-time monitoring method and a storage medium based on AI image recognition, wherein the method comprises the following steps: A time-space aligned multi-modal dataset is created by collecting and preprocessing multi-source heterogeneous data such as high definition visible light images, ultrasound scanning signals, infrared temperature data, and three-dimensional point cloud data. Based on the data set, a multi-modal deep learning model is constructed, texture, time sequence and temperature characteristics are automatically extracted, and the characteristics are fused through an attention mechanism. The model can identify quality hidden trouble in the ship construction process, monitor safety problems, predict collision risk and output a real-time monitoring report. The invention utilizes the comprehensive analysis of the multi-source data, enhances the accuracy and timeliness of monitoring, provides powerful support for management decision, and improves resource allocation and emergency response.

title_en: Virtual reality 4d an image firing system make use of a hologram
title_ko: 홀로그램을 이용한 가상현실 4ｄ 영상사격 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a four-dimensional virtual reality shooting system using a hologram which can provide a realistic shooting environment and experience by projecting a three-dimensional virtual reality image in a shooting space using a hologram and adding sound effects and vibrations when a bullet is fired. The system according to the present invention comprises: a main control device for controlling each configuration according to virtual reality hologram image shooting programs installed into a system; a hologram display device for receiving an image output signal from the main control device and projecting an virtual reality image in a space; shooting devices for performing shooting training and playing a game by outputting a laser when the shooting device is fired at a target in the virtual reality image; an auxiliary control device for interfacing the main control device and multiple shooting devices; an audio device for amplifying an audio signal transmitted by the main control device and outputting the amplified signal; and an reaction device which is attached to a shooter's body and generates trembling and low frequency vibrations according to signals from the main control device. Therefore, the system according to the present invention provides image shooting training or games using a hologram image so that users can feel like they are dispatched to an actual battlefield, and the system meets participant's needs by realizing an actual shooting sound using sound effects such as a firing sound occurring during shooting. [Reference numerals] (100) Main control device; (210) Beam projector; (220) Front surface mirror of reflective screen; (230) Reflective film; (240) Hologram image; (310) Firearms for shooting N; (320) Motion detection module; (330) Control module; (340) Flat infrared reflector; (350) Infrared detector; (400) Auxiliary control device; (500) Audio device; (600) Reaction device; (AA) Network; (BB,EE) Wired, wireless interfaces; (CC) USB, HDMI interfaces; (DD) Four-dimensional image shooting software; (FF) Interfaces such as RGB, DVI, HDMI, etc.; (GG) Audio output
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 홀로그램을 이용하여 격발공간 상에 가상현실 입체영상을 표현하고 격발시의 효과음 및 떨림까지 가미하여 현장감과 체감효과를 극대화할 수 있는 홀로그램을 이용한 가상현실 4Ｄ 영상사격 시스템에 관한 것이다.  본 발명의 시스템은 탑재된 가상현실 홀로그램 영상사격 프로그램에 따라 각 구성을 통제하는 메인통제장치, 메인통제장치에서 보내오는 영상출력신호를 받아서 가상현실 영상을 공간에 표현하는 홀로그램표시장치, 공간에 표현되는 가상현실 영상을 타겟으로 하여 격발시 레이저 출력하여 사격 훈련이나 게임을 하기 위한 사격장치, 메인통제장치와 다수의 사격장치 사이에서 인터페이스를 수행하기 위한 서브통제장치, 메인통제장치에서 보내오는 오디오신호를 증폭하여 외부 출력하는 오디오장치, 및 사격 참가자의 몸에 부착되며 메인통제장치에서 보내오는 신호를 통해 떨림 및 저주파 진동을 발생시키는 반응장치로 구성된다.  따라서, 본 발명은 홀로그램 영상을 이용하여 영상 사격 훈련이나 게임을 진행하게 되므로 실제 전투 현장에 투입된 것과 같은 입장감을 최대로 느낄 수 있게 되며, 사격시 발생하는 격발음 등 사격 효과음을 출력하게 되므로 실제 사격하는 느낌을 제대로 구현할 수 있게 되어 참가자들의 욕구를 충족시키는 효과를 제공한다.

title_en: Integrated Measurement System
title_ko: 통합계측 관리 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 구조물 현장을 모니터링하면서 구조물의 현장 상태를 외부에 알려주는 관리 시스템(100)에 관한 것으로서, 구조물 현장 상태를 모니터링하기 위하여 구조물 현장의 특정 위치에 설치되는 센서(110)와; 상기 센서(110)에서 측정되는 모니터링 데이터를 수집하여 저장 관리하는 로거(120)와; 상기 로거(120)로부터 모니터링 데이터를 제공받고, 자동계측 운영 프로그램을 탑재하여 관리기준치와 상기 로거(120)에서 제공받은 모니터링 데이터를 비교하여 구조물 현장 지도 이미지상에 구조물 현장 상태를 표시하는 구조물 현장 모니터링 화면을 제공하되, 사용자가 현장에 설치되는 센서(110) 및 로거(120), Mux 설정 및 현장 이미지를 포함한 신규 현장 정보를 등록하여 원하는 신규 현장용 프로그램을 직접 제작할 수 있도록 프로그램 제작용 사용자 인터페이스 입력 화면을 제공하고, 사용자가 프로그램 제작용 사용자 인터페이스 입력 화면을 통해 특정 신규 현장을 등록하면 등록된 정보에 따라 신규 현장 상태를 표시하는 통합 계측 모니터링 화면을 제공하는 관리 서버(140)를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 본 발명에 따르면, 불의의 사고나 재난재해를 유발할 수 있는 구조물 현장을 체계적으로 감시하여 붕괴 등의 위험을 미리 알려서 사고나 재난재해 발생을 보다 효과적으로 예방할 수 있으며, 특히 사용자가 현장별 운영 프로그램을 별도로 개발할 필요없이 사용자 인터페이스 입력 화면을 통해 토목계측 현장을 직접 등록하여 관리할 수 있도록 하여 사용상 편의성을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and system for providing convergence security control service based on Internet of Things
title_ko: IoT 기반 융합보안 관제 서비스 제공 방법 및 시스템
abstract_ko: 정보 보안 영역, 물리 보안 영역, 산업보안 영역 및 IoT 보안 영역을 통합관제할 수 있는 IoT 기반의 융합보안 관제 서비스를 제공하는 방법 및 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른, IoT 기반 융합보안 관제 서비스 제공 방법은, 수집부가, 네트워크로 연결된 물리 보안 디바이스, 정보 보안 서버 및 IoT 플랫폼을 통해 로그 정보 및 로우 이벤트(Raw Event) 정보를 수집하는 수집 단계; 분석부가, 수집된 정보들을 기반으로 분석 가능한 형태인 기본 이벤트(Base Event) 정보를 생성하는 정규화 단계; 및 분석부가, 정규화된 기본 이벤트 정보를 분석하여, 분석 이벤트(Analyzed Event) 정보를 생성하는 분석 단계;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 물리 보안 영역에서의 발생되는 이벤트와 정보 보안 영역에서의 발생되는 이벤트 간의 상관관계를 분석하여, 다각적 위험에 대한 예측이 가능하고, 정확한 사고 징후를 탐지하며, 영역 간의 보안 공백이 발생하는 것을 방지하고, 알람의 오탐 발생률을 낮출 수 있다.

title_en: Camera device for vehicle safety
title_ko: 차량안전용 카메라장치
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량안전용 카메라장치에 관한 것으로, 카메라장치는 차량에 장치된 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어시스템에 직·간접적으로 연결돼 차량에 구비함으로써, 차량제어장치(VCU)를 포함한 전력제어장치(EPCU) 및 전자제어장치(ECU)에 연결해서 카메라장치의 영상알고리즘으로 첨단운전자지원시스템(ADAS)을 포함한 자율주행시스템이 가능하고, 차량 실내의 디스플레이장치 및 카메라장치의 안테나모듈을 통해서 실시간으로 유·무선의 영상전송 및 저장이 가능하다. 그리고 운행 중 교통사고로 인한 긴급구조 및 사고 전·후의 현장상황을 녹화해서 영상자료로 사용할 수 있으며, 주·정차 중 차량에 장치된 센서에 물리·화학적 변화가 감지되면 카메라장치를 작동해서 차량파손 현장의 영상녹화가 가능한 차량안전용 카메라장치에 관한 것이다. 
이를 위하여 본 발명은 차량안전용 카메라장치에 있어서, 상기 카메라장치는 카메라모듈과 회로기판을 내장해서 유선으로 차량의 하드웨어 및 소프트웨어시스템에 직·간접적으로 연결돼 전원과 데이터의 입·출력을 위한 케이스와 상기 케이스를 차량에 고정해서 구동하기 위한 본체를 구비한다. 그리고 상기 안테나모듈을 통해 무선네트워크로 연결된 서버에 실시간으로 상기 카메라모듈의 데이터를 전송 및 저장함으로써, 사용자 본인의 모바일앱 또는 PC웹드라이버를 통해 저장된 영상 확인이 가능하고, 내장된 응용프로그램의 무선업데이트 및 장치의 무선제어도 실시간으로 가능한 특징이 있다.

title_en: Mobile asset data recorder and transmitter
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allows for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with impact detection, rough operating condition detection, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of a mobile asset. Users can use the normal operation of their mobile assets to locate and alert, in real-time, areas where their assets are encountering rough operating environments, to provide for quicker emergency response, and to validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting.
assignees: JORDAN JR LAWRENCE B;MATTA LISA A;WI TRONIX LLC

title_en: Portable mine intrinsic safety seismograph
abstract_en: The invention is a portable multifunctional earthquake recorder used in the mine which can resist the burst, water, corrosion and be carried. The device is made up of the hardware and the software. The hardware includes the self-make controlling circuit board, the dot matrix figure LCD, the silvery conducting film, the rechargeable battery, the safety shell with the IP54 safety grade and the connector; the software includes the monitoring module, the recording module, the communicating module and the data processing module; the self-make controlling circuit board is used the double CPU which goes on the data switch by the double ports memorizer. The main function is to collect and command the digital cymoscope, human-machine alternation, store the data and treat the data at time. So the device can be used in the earthquake exploration and the surface wave exploration of the mine.

title_en: Chemical hazard prediction precaution and control system
abstract_en: The invention has the design principle that prediction wind field and turbulence provide basic meteorological information for a prediction precaution system by a meteorology numerical value forecasting system; the prediction precaution system predicts chemical hazard by respectively aiming at a protected target or an accident source; according to the hazard prediction result and a hazard index system, the spatial and temporal distribution of the chemical hazard precaution information is determined; the prediction precaution system is integrated with GIS by a data conversion engine to build a prediction precaution optimal control application system based on the GIS platform; and the optimal control scheme can be determined according to the precaution information to effectively control chemical hazard. The system is suitable for the requirements on the complex environment of battlefields and emergency response fields, and can satisfy the requirements on timeliness, accuracy and intuitionism of chemical hazard prediction precaution and control.

title_en: A kind of special learning system of Tourist Education
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of special learning system of Tourist Education, including human-machine operation module, tourism route planning module, three-dimensional simulation Teaching Module, video acquisition module, audio collection module, data processing module, action command identification module, central processing unit, simulation interactive module.The present invention can obtain cartographic information from true environment, and it is able to real-time update, the foundation of three-dimensional simulation scene can be carried out by three-dimensional simulation Teaching Module according to tourism route, thus after carrying out classroom instruction, students in class, real training is practised, it is possible to provide feeling of immersion true to nature for learner；With tourism personage engage in the dialogue during student can participate in whole simulation process simultaneously or action exchanges, substantially increase students ' interest of study；The process of the most whole teaching and after class real training all uses video data to carry out record, it is simple to Faculty and Students are checked.

title_en: Vehicle-mounted video trace processing method based on sight attention
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted video trace processing method based on sight attention, which comprises the following steps that (1) a vehicle-mounted cinema takes a central control screen as a display and plays videos for passengers; (2) monitoring a driving state of the autonomous vehicle, a head pose of the occupant, and a line of sight direction; (3) classifying the attention of the passengers according to the state in the step (2), and defining the attention as a primary label and a secondary label; (4) the secondary label only establishes a mark point, and the primary label simultaneously records the duration of the current label; (5) continuing monitoring until the current label is eliminated; (6) if the eliminated current label corresponds to the first-level label, the mark point on the progress bar flickers, and the missed progress within the duration of the current label is displayed on the progress bar; and if the eliminated current label corresponds to the secondary label, only keeping the mark point on the progress bar. The method and the device can avoid the condition that the passengers miss videos or live broadcasts due to attention transfer or emergency response caused by an emergency of the environment, and improve the experience degree of the passengers.

title_en: Nuclear facility emergency event action suggestion report generation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear power simulation, and particularly discloses a system and a method for generating a nuclear facility emergency event action suggestion report. The system comprises a search module, a material management module, a template analysis module and a report generation module, wherein the search module is used for searching nuclear emergency event data and sending the data to the material management module for event material extraction to form a final material; the final material is sent to a report generation module; the template analysis module is used for selecting a template and sending the template to the report generation module, and the report generation module binds the materials with the template to generate a report. By binding the search materials with the templates, a nuclear facility emergency event action suggestion report can be formed rapidly, the nuclear emergency command decision requirement is met, and the timeliness of report generation is improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER OPERATION TECHNOLOGY CORP LTD

title_en: Visual angle ophthalmic surgery simulation device for patient
abstract_en: The invention provides a patient visual angle ophthalmic surgery simulation device, which comprises a simulation bed and simulation glasses, wherein the simulation bed is provided with a controller and a voice module; the simulated glasses are provided with a display module coupled with the controller, and the display module is used for displaying an operation picture for human eyes to watch; the simulation glasses are provided with detection modules coupled with the controller, and the detection modules are used for collecting the states of human eyes; the simulated glasses are provided with a dropping component which is coupled with the controller and is used for dropping liquid for eyes; the main control module is used for judging whether the state of the eyes of the patient accords with the operation command. In summary, the above technical scheme has the following beneficial effects: a doctor can judge whether the patient has the ability to cooperate with the operation according to the data recorded by the main control module, and the patient can experience the operation process, so that the fear of the operation is reduced, and the doctor can cooperate better with the operation to perform the following operation.

title_en: Multi-source heterogeneous data analysis-based security risk dynamic assessment system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a security risk dynamic assessment system and a security risk dynamic assessment method based on multi-source heterogeneous data analysis, which belong to the technical field of security risk management and control and specifically comprise the following steps: through active data acquisition and preprocessing, a dynamic knowledge graph is built by fusing multi-source heterogeneous data; predicting evolution paths and results under different risk scenes by utilizing a multidimensional evaluation index and a mixed risk evaluation model and combining a scene simulation technology; calculating a security risk value in real time by adopting a streaming data processing technology, setting a threshold value to automatically trigger a multi-level early warning mechanism, and making emergency response measures in time; the accuracy and timeliness of the chemical industry park safety risk assessment are improved.

title_en: Control method of fire-fighting liquid supply system and storage medium thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides a control method of a fire-fighting liquid supply system and a storage medium thereof, belonging to the technical field of fire protection. The control method comprises the following steps that a controller reads a firefighter command from a command input module at preset time intervals delta t, performs control operation once and records the control operation, t=0 is the starting time of the fire-fighting liquid supply system, and the control operation is performed according to a specified rule at the time t=i delta t according to the command at the time, the valve opening, the rotating speed of the adjustable motor and the control operation record after starting. The invention can realize flexible, rapid, efficient and reliable adjustment of the spray flow and the spray speed while saving the operation energy consumption and prolonging the operation life.

title_en: Power grid emergency document question-answering method and system based on double-flow search and conflict arbitration
abstract_en: The application relates to a power Grid emergency document question-answering method and system based on double-flow retrieval and conflict arbitration, belonging to the technical field of artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting power Grid emergency documents and real-time field data, extracting key visual elements through an improved YOLO-Grid target detection model to form visual streams, respectively carrying out vector coding on the visual streams and text streams, and adding space-time metadata to construct a multi-granularity heterogeneous index library; after receiving user inquiry, the method and the device perform text and visual double-flow retrieval in parallel to obtain text fragments, visual image fragments and confidence degrees thereof, respectively guide a large model to perform independent reasoning to generate a text conclusion and a visual conclusion, and perform timeliness comparison and confidence degree weighted arbitration based on space-time metadata when the conclusions conflict, so as to generate a final emergency response answer. The method effectively solves the problems of visual information loss, large fine granularity semantic alignment deviation and multi-mode evidence conflict in the emergency question and answer of the power grid, and improves the accuracy and safety of decision making.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;EMERGENCY CENTER OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Remote control system for cropping house using wireless communication networks
title_ko: 무선통신망을 이용한 작물재배용 하우스 원격관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system to remotely manage a house for cultivation, capable of remotely controlling a house for cultivation. According to the present invention, the system is able to be applied to the cultivation of various crops as the system automatically controls an internal temperature of a house in accordance with an optimal temperature range for a crop to be cultivated. When an abnormal situation such as overheating, overload, or fire occurs, the system automatically senses the situation and then cuts off the supply of power, operates a fire extinguishing facility, and informs a user of the situation to take instant action, and thus, the system is capable of preventing damage to crops and facilities while at the same time remotely and easily managing and controlling a plurality of houses for cultivation through a wireless communication network by installing an exclusive application program in a personal terminal of the user such as a smartphone. As such, the present invention is capable of easily cultivating a variety of crops with minimum manpower as well as enabling efficient and easy cultivation and monitoring even for a large-scale crop cultivation district.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 작물재배를 위한 작물재배용 하우스를 원격으로 제어할 수 있도록 하기 위한 작물재배용 하우스 원격관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 따르면, 재배하고자 하는 작물에 따른 최적의 온도범위에 맞추어 자동으로 하우스 내부의 온도를 조절하는 것에 의해 다양한 작물의 재배에 용이하게 적용 가능하며, 과열 및 과부하나 화재 등과 같은 이상 상황 발생시 자동으로 감지하여 전원공급을 차단하고 소화장치를 작동시키며 사용자에게 알리는 것에 의해 즉각적인 대처가 가능하여 예상치 못한 사고로부터 작물 및 시설의 피해를 방지할 수 있는 동시에, 사용자의 스마트폰과 같은 개인 휴대용 단말기에 전용의 어플리케이션 프로그램을 설치하여 무선통신망을 통해 복수의 작물재배용 하우스를 원격으로 용이하게 관리하고 제어할 수 있도록 구성됨으로써, 최소한의 인력만으로 다양한 작물의 재배가 용이할 뿐만 아니라, 대규모의 작물 재배단지에서도 효율적이고 용이하게 작물의 재배 및 모니터링이 가능하도록 구성되는 무선통신망을 이용한 작물재배용 하우스 원격관리시스템이 제공된다.
assignees: SUNGJINTECH CO LTD;CHUNGBUK HEALTH SCIENCE UNIV

title_en: Block type apparatus for wirelessly inputting coding command and method using thereof
title_ko: 블록형 무선 코딩 명령어 입력 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A block type wireless coding command input device according to one embodiment of the present invention comprises a coding block assembly which comprises a main block and at least two coding blocks successively connected to the main block; and a device which receives a program code corresponding to the at least two coding blocks connected to the main block from the main block and performing an action according to the received program code. At least one among the at least two coding blocks may be a memory block for controlling the action of the device according to a pre-stored program code. According to the present invention, various kinds of programming can be possible with a small number of blocks.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 형태에 따른 블록형 무선 코딩 명령어 입력 장치는 메인 블록과, 메인 블록에 순차적으로 접속된 적어도 2 이상의 코딩 블록을 포함하는 코딩 블록 조립체; 및 메인 블록에 접속된 적어도 2 이상의 코딩 블록에 대응하는 프로그램 코드를 메인 블록으로부터 수신하고 수신된 프로그램 코드에 따른 동작을 수행하는 디바이스;를 포함하며, 적어도 2 이상의 코딩 블록들 중 적어도 하나는, 기 저장된 프로그램 코드에 따라 디바이스의 동작을 제어하기 위한 메모리 블록일 수 있다.

title_en: System for Generating Real Asset NFT of Carbon Credit based on Blockchain
title_ko: 블록체인을 기반으로 하는 탄소배출권의 실물기반 nft 발행 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for generating a real asset non-fungible token (NFT) of carbon credits based on a blockchain, which may enable efficient management and trading of carbon credits by matching the carbon credits as real assets with the NFT. The system for generating a real asset NFT of carbon credits based on a blockchain comprises: at least one computer processor; and at least one memory device in which a computer-readable command is stored and which enables the at least one computer processor to perform a method when the at least one computer processor is executed. The system for generating a real asset NFT of carbon credits based on a blockchain is configured to: generate a digital token that includes a unique token identifier according to class definition; register the digital token related to an asset to a memory device of an asset registry as a unique record; allow a communication interface to associate with the digital token according to the class definition; include an asset ownership transfer function, an asset valuation issuance function, an asset attribute determination function, and asset-specific processing logic; match a carbon credit as a real asset with an NFT through the fusion of the real asset carbon credit and the NFT; set a first user as an owner of the real asset; change a second user into the owner of the real asset when the second user buys the real asset from the first user.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실물 자산인 탄소배출권을 대체불가능한 토큰(Non-Fungible Token; NFT)과 매칭시켜 탄소배출권의 효율적인 관리 및 거래가 가능하도록 한 블록체인을 기반으로 하는 탄소배출권의 실물기반 NFT 발행 시스템에 관한 것으로,적어도 하나의 컴퓨터 프로세서; 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 명령어가 저장된 적어도 하나의 메모리 장치로서 상기 적어도 하나의 컴퓨터 프로세서가 실행되면 상기 적어도 하나의 컴퓨터 프로세서가 방법을 수행하도록 하는 적어도 하나의 메모리 장치를 포함하고, 클래스 정의에 따라 디지털 토큰을 생성하되, 상기 토큰은 고유 토큰 식별자를 포함하고, 자산과 관련된 상기 디지털 토큰을 자산 레지스트리의 메모리 장치에 고유 레코드로 등록하고, 통신 인터페이스를 상기 클래스 정의에 따라 상기 디지털 토큰과 연관시키고, 자산 소유권 이전 기능, 자산 평가 발행 기능, 자산 속성 결정 기능 및 자산 특정 처리 논리를 포함하고, 실물자산 탄소배출권과 NFT 융합을 하여, 실물 자산인 탄소배출권을 대체불가능한 토큰(Non-Fungible Token; NFT)과 매칭시키고, 제1 사용자를 상기 실물 자산의 소유자로 설정하고, 상기 제1 사용자로부터 제2 사용자가 상기 실물 자산을 구매하는 경우, 상기 제2 사용자를 상기 실물 자산의 소유자로 변경하는 것이다.

title_en: Vehicle accident detection and automatic accident sharing method using black box, and device and program for performing same
title_ko: 블랙박스를 이용한 차량 사고 감지 및 자동 사고 공유 방법, 이를 수행하는 장치 및 프로그램
abstract_en: A vehicle accident detection and automatic accident sharing device using a black box, according to the present invention, comprises: an event reception unit that receives a vehicle accident event detected from a black box which detects a vehicle accident of at least one of a host vehicle and surrounding vehicles; an accident information generation unit that, on the basis of the received vehicle accident event, generates accident occurrence information including information on the place where the accident has occurred; and a communication unit that transmits the generated accident occurrence information to an emergency rescue center and surrounding vehicles within a predetermined distance from the host vehicle, wherein the black box is loaded with an accident detection deep learning model adapted to situations on a road where the host vehicle is driving.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 블랙박스를 이용한 차량 사고 감지 및 자동 사고 공유 장치는 자차 및 주변 차량 중 적어도 하나의 차량 사고를 감지하는 블랙박스로부터 감지된 차량 사고 이벤트를 수신하는 이벤트 수신부, 수신된 상기 차량 사고 이벤트에 기초하여 사고 발생 장소에 대한 정보를 포함하는 사고 발생 정보를 생성하는 사고 정보 생성부 및 생성된 상기 사고 발생 정보를 긴급 구조 센터 및 상기 자차로부터 일정 거리내 있는 주위 차량들에게 전송하는 통신부를 포함하고, 상기 블랙박스는 주행 중인 도로의 상황에 맞는 사고 감지 딥러닝 모델이 탑재된다.

title_en: Ship internal communication system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a communication system inside a ship. The invention adopts the technologies of voice digital processing, time division program control exchange, loop bus transmission, microprocessor control and the like, more than two loop stations are connected in a ring mode through coaxial cables to form loop configuration, and all user terminals are connected on the corresponding loop stations in a star mode to form a ship internal comprehensive communication system with the characteristics of signal digital transmission bus, management program, interface standardization and the like. The system completes the speaker command, service telephone, literature broadcast and system setting and test functions in the ship. The loudspeaker command function comprises a multi-stage command function, a command function, a bridge command function, a real-time sound recording function and an emergency command function; service telephone functions include an automatic telephone function, a conference telephone function, and a landline function. The system adopts a mode of combining an emergency command communication network and a normal command communication network for command communication, and ensures the reliability and survivability of the command communication in the ship.

title_en: Emergency medical support service system
title_ko: 응급의료지원 서비스 시스템
abstract_en: According to an embodiment of the present invention, an emergency medical support service system comprises: a plurality of drones having a photographing device for generating a moving image by photographing the moving ground and a projection device for projecting a hologram in the direction of the ground; an autonomous emergency vehicle on which paramedics board and moving by autonomous driving; and a control server for generating a dispatch path to an event occurrence position when an event occurs to dispatch the autonomous emergency vehicle, dividing the generated dispatch path to generate a dispatch control area for each of the plurality of drones, and dispatching each of the plurality of drones to the plurality of generated dispatch control areas.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 응급의료지원 서비스 시스템은 이동하는 지면을 촬영하여 이동영상을 생성하는 촬영장치와, 지면방향으로 홀로그램을 영사하는 영사장치를 구비하는 복수개의 드론; 구급대원이 탑승하고 있고, 자율주행하여 이동하는 자율주행 구급차량; 및 이벤트 발생 시 이벤트 발생 위치까지의 출동 경로를 생성하여 상기 자율주행 구급차량을 출동시키고, 상기 생성된 출동 경로를 분할하여 복수개의 드론 각각의 출동 관제영역을 생성하고, 상기 생성된 복수개의 출동 관제영역으로 복수개의 드론 각각을 출동시키는 관제서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Land and resources law enforcement monitoring intelligent terminal system that has news propelling movement and short message prompting
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a land and resources law enforcement monitoring intelligent terminal system that has news propelling movement and short message prompting, including wireless communication module, wireless communication module is connected with the smart mobile phone, and the smart mobile phone is connected with relaying communication module and GPS orientation module, relaying communication module is connected with map storage module, inspection daily record storage module, inspection daily record and reports the module, is used for incident follow -up storage module, the incident follow -up of the incident of saving to report module, clue storage module, notice bulletin storage module, news warning module and short message prompting module, the inspection daily record reports the module to be connected with inspection daily record storage module, and the incident follow -up reports the module to be connected with incident follow -up storage module. The utility model discloses put staff's at different levels responsibility in order, improved law -enforcing work personnel's work efficiency to prevent that the law -enforcing work personnel from delaying receive information or leaking the processing material particular, develoies for the day -to -day work of territory removal law enforcement and provide service.

title_en: Intelligent security management system and implementation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent security management system and an implementation method thereof, and aims to solve the problems that security management in the prior art is poor in real-time performance, security teams are scattered, and emergency situations cannot be timely and accurately mobilized. The invention mainly comprises a personnel management module, a scheduling management module, an attendance management module, a data agent module, an icon management module, a GIS map management module, a voice talkback module, a camera management module and an alarm management module. Compared with the prior art, the system and the method have the advantages that multiple functions of visual talkback, emergency treatment, video calling, GIS calling and the like are added, the security team can be uniformly managed in real time, the management timeliness and the emergency response speed in the emergency are effectively improved, the security is greatly enhanced, and the legal rights and interests of customers are better guaranteed against being infringed.
assignees: SHANGHAI TONGYI ELECTRONIC ENG CO LTD

title_en: Recording method and system for city management event
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of digital city management and provides a method and a system for recording city management events. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a video stream in a preset place; analyzing the video stream in real time and capturing a city management event scene; recording relevant information according to the scene of the city management event; automatically dispatching the recorded events to a field worker terminal; receiving event rechecking information uploaded by a field worker terminal; and judging the effectiveness of the event according to whether the rechecking information belongs to the scene of the urban management event, so that the backlog of the urban management event can be avoided, and the urban management event can be accurately recorded.
assignees: TAIHUA WISDOM INDUSTRY GROUP SHARE LTD COMPANY;SHANDONG TAIHUA SMART CITY SERVICE LTD COMPANY

title_en: Natural resource multi-sense integrated monitoring method and platform
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of natural resource inspection, and particularly relates to a natural resource multi-sense integrated monitoring method and a platform. According to the invention, through time synchronization, coordinate unification and historical track fusion correction, the influence of time, coordinate abnormality and sporadic positioning deviation on out-of-range judgment can be effectively removed, so that false alarm and false dispatch are reduced, the self-learning responsibility range is automatically expanded and contracted according to space density and inspection frequency, inspection resources can be concentrated in high-demand or high-risk areas, unnecessary repeated inspection on low-risk areas is avoided, labor and running cost are reduced, time-space matching and continuity inspection of events and tracks can be reduced, inspection behavior paths and trends before and after the occurrence of the events can be restored, a manager is assisted in judging event properties and responsibility attribution, the pertinence and efficiency of treatment are improved, and the classified early warning of the state of natural resources is realized through the fusion evaluation of three risk indexes of space, out-of-range and events.
assignees: BEIJING LIAOWANG SHENZHOU TECH CO LTD

title_en: Video playback program, device, and method
title_ko: 동화상 재생 프로그램, 장치, 및 방법
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to share the synchronous reproduction state of a plurality of videos. With regard to a plurality of videos, the designation of a timing is received in video playback. Depending on a playback command, the videos can be synchronized and played based on a designated timing for each of the videos.
abstract_ko:
[과제] 복수 동화상의 동기 재생 상태를 공유할 수 있게 하는 것을 목적으로 한다.  
[해결수단] 복수의 동화상 각각에 관해서, 동화상 재생 중에 있어서의 어느 한 타이밍의 지정을 접수하고, 재생 지시에 따라서, 상기 복수의 동화상 각각에 관해서 지정된 타이밍을 기점으로 하여, 상기 복수의 동화상을 동기시켜 재생한다.

title_en: Implantable medical device with patient input mechanism
abstract_en: An implantable loop recorder (ILR) is subcutaneously implantable to record cardiac data. The ILR includes a patient activation mechanism whereby the patient can input commands to the ILR without using an external device. The patient activation mechanism may be a subcutaneous switch disposed on an outer portion of the ILR or a motion sensor that senses tapping of the device as an input. The patient input will direct the device to store data, telemeter data, or send a message summoning an emergency response. The ILR has distance telemetry capabilities so that a telemetered message is wirelessly transmitted to an external device which then relays the message to a remote location.

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digital video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event, and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted server to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time, the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: Real-Time Data Acquisition and Recording System Viewer
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and viewer for mobile assets that includes a data encoder, onboard data manager, and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Emergency response system with dynamic ali database alphanumeric character hacking
abstract_en: An improved emergency response method and system are shown and described. A content-specified text field—such as a caller name field—an ALI database record for a communication device is updated to include information about a person experiencing an emergency and the emergency. A PSAP receiving an emergency services call from the communication device receives the caller name field on a terminal display and is thus informed about the emergency via a alphanumeric character communication rather than orally. A particular emergency may be assigned a code that is put in the caller name field. A PSAP operator receiving the emergency services call may then enter the code into an emergency services web interface to retrieve information about the emergency including service provider credentials, the person's medical condition, the person's medical records, real time physiologic data, treatment facility names, treatment facility types, a location of the emergency, a level of care, a videoconference web link, on-site personnel names, disaster information, and hazard information. The code can be transmitted to first responders and downstream medical professionals to enhance their ability to deliver emergency services. The system and method provide a means for legacy PSAPs to receive the benefits of Next Generation 911 systems without the infrastructure changes that would otherwise be required.

title_en: Method and system for optimizing and dispatching large-scale drainage and waterlogging prevention engineering group of plain river network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban drainage and waterlogging prevention, in particular to a method and a system for optimizing and dispatching a large-scale drainage and waterlogging prevention engineering group of a plain river network. The method comprises the steps of determining typical composite waterlogging events of a plain river network, establishing a hydrodynamic model, analyzing the typical composite waterlogging events to identify key nodes of waterlogging, determining linkage relation between scheduling behaviors of a waterlogging facility and hydrologic response of the key nodes, establishing a multi-objective optimization scheduling model through waterlogging risk minimization and running cost optimization, gradually decomposing a global scheduling target into local scheduling targets, establishing mapping relation between the local scheduling targets and scheduling decisions of the waterlogging facility, obtaining real solution of the multi-objective optimization scheduling model aiming at potential individuals predicted in different candidate scheduling scheme populations, constructing an expected improvement matrix, and selecting an optimal solution to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. According to the invention, the scheduling timeliness requirement is effectively met by combining the machine learning prediction capability and the optimization algorithm, and the optimal scheduling of the large-scale drainage and waterlogging prevention engineering group in the plain river network urban area is realized.

title_en: Method, system and program for control road in front of fire station
title_ko: 소방서 앞 도로 제어 방법, 시스템 및 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for controlling the road in front of a fire station, which has an effect of reducing the time required to dispatch fire engines by turning on directional warning lights and floor warning lights installed on the road in front of the fire station and blocking the vehicle traffic after searching for a path from the fire station to a fire site and determining a direction departing from the fire station.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방서 앞 도로 제어 방법에 관한 것으로, 소방서로부터 화재 현장까지의 경로를 탐색하고 소방차가 소방서로부터 출발하는 방향을 판단한 후 그에 따라서 방향경광등과 소방서 앞 도로에 설치된 바닥경광등을 턴온하여 차량 통행을 차단함으로써 소방차의 출동 소요시간을 감소시키는 효과를 발휘한다.

title_en: Security and public safety application for a mobile device
abstract_en: In a plurality of described embodiments, various modules of an application for a client device may operate to enhance personal security for an individual user, as well as public safety in general. A Blue-Phone-in-Pocket (bPip) module operates comparable to, but more effectively than, the traditional college campus blue light phone. When the user of the module toggles a button on the GUI of his/her smartphone, the App may instantly record and transmit key information to a command center, which operates to provide assistance to the student, at their current location, without requiring the student to relocate to one of the tradition blue light phone fixtures. A tracking module permits the student or other user to be tracked by his/her device until safely reaching a travel destination. The person may trigger an alarm if endangered during the trip, which may prompt a respond from local law enforcement, and other assigned individuals.

title_en: Train group generation method, train group generation device, train group generation system, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application provides a train group generation method, a train group generation device, a train group generation system, a storage medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method is applied to a simulation training system and comprises the following steps: acquiring a train dispatching operation plan which is issued by a dispatching center to each station within a preset time period in reality; determining the position of each train within a preset range according to the train dispatching operation plan and the current time; and generating a train model in the dispatching range of the simulated dispatching desk in the simulated training system according to the position of each train. The train model generated based on the train dispatching operation plan can ensure the reality of the training scene (the generated train model). And the position of each train can be accurately determined, which is beneficial to ensuring the timeliness of practical training scenes (such as the position, the number and the like of train models). In addition, the position of the train can be automatically and accurately determined in the mode, so that the accuracy is guaranteed, the time of practical training personnel can be saved, and the practical training effect is improved.

title_en: Emergency calling method for concealed driver in vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-vehicle concealed driver emergency call method, which relates to the technical field of vehicle-mounted safety and comprises the steps of installing a pressure sensor group, generating a trigger signal when a combined trigger mode of a hand pressure value and a pedal pressure value is detected, analyzing daily driving behavior data of a driver, comparing the trigger signal with a pre-stored normal driving behavior mode, acquiring in-vehicle passenger information and vehicle driving data when the trigger signal deviates from the normal driving behavior mode and meets a preset emergency trigger threshold, packaging the passenger information and the vehicle driving data into an emergency information packet, transmitting the emergency information packet to a background rescue system, and transmitting an emergency call instruction with in-vehicle conditions after determining whether dangerous personnel exist. The invention can improve the agility and safety of emergency response, enhance the whole emergency response and decision capability, and improve the response timeliness and the safety prevention and control level of an emergency call system in a vehicle.

title_en: Railway material allocation and path planning method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for railway material allocation and path planning, which relate to the technical field of material allocation and comprise the steps of acquiring transportation network data and supply warehouse data; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a target planning model, optimizing and adjusting basic parameters based on a constraint function preset in the target planning model, and planning transportation paths and resource allocation in an emergency scene based on the target parameters. According to the method, the optimization model is constructed through the emergency demand data and the basic parameters, the material demand and the aging demand in an emergency scene can be effectively quantized, so that timeliness of emergency response and sufficiency of material supply are ensured, the basic parameters are optimized through the constraint function in the target planning model, the configuration of transportation resources and warehouse resources can be dynamically adjusted, the transportation path and the resource allocation are optimized, various demands in the emergency response process are met, meanwhile, the resource utilization efficiency is maximized, the emergency response cost is reduced, and the efficiency and the flexibility of emergency management are improved.
assignees: CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD;RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ELECTRONIC COMPUTING TECH CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITE;Beijing jingwei information technology co ltd

title_en: Disaster correspondence verification system
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster correspondence verification system capable of easily leaving records during a disaster and easily verifying and analyzing correspondence during the disaster.SOLUTION: A disaster correspondence verification system includes: photographing devices 3, 5 for photographing results of artificial actions in a prescribed area in relation to a disaster to output the results as first video data, and photographing disaster related spots to output the disaster related spots as second video data; a storage device 25 for storing those video data together with photographing time information; a control device 21; and a display device 22. The control device 21 simultaneously reproduces a plurality of pieces of the video data by dividing the display part of the display device 22, and displays images constituting each of the plurality of pieces of video data by arranging them in parallel in a time series order at each photographing time according to a command of an operator, and in the images, images having the same photographing time are displayed side by side in the same row or in the same column among the plurality of respective pieces of video data, and a plurality of pieces of video data can be simultaneously reproduced from a desired time according to selection of the operator.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Information integrated control system and information processing program, social infra management system, management method, local device, server device, and program
title_ko: 정보 통합 제어 시스템과 정보 처리 프로그램, 사회 인프라 운용 시스템, 운용 방법, 로컬 장치, 서버 장치 및 프로그램
abstract_ko:
사회 인프라(12A, 12B, …), 행정용 서버(13)로부터 전력 수요 예측 정보, 교통 지체 정보, 사고 발생 정보, 기상 정보 등을 수집하고, 주민용 서버(14)로부터 가옥내 각종 센서(전기 계량기, 가스 계량기, 보안 센서) 등의 주민 정보를 수집하여 데이터베이스(115)에 KVS 형식으로 저장하고, 정기적으로 갱신한다. 
 산출부(114)에서는, 데이터베이스(115)에 저장된 정보로부터, 미리 부여된 지표 또는 행정측으로부터 새롭게 부여된 지표에 기초하여 KPI를 산출하고, 산출된 KPI에 기초하여 각 사회 인프라에 관한 운전 계획의 책정을 행한다. 
최종적으로, 이 운전 계획에 따라 사회 인프라(12A, 12B, …) 및 주민용 서버(14)에 운전 내용을 지시한다.

title_en: Car terminal device, wierless security management system using that car terminal device and Method thereof
title_ko: 차량 단말 장치, 이를 이용한 무선 보안 관제 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed is a wireless security control method of a wireless security control system. Image information of surroundings and state of the vehicle are received from a vehicle terminal device is stored in a database. A server determines whether an emergency situation signal is received or not, and transmits a message to an external public office system or person in charge of danger when the emergency situation signal is received; determines whether there is a following vehicle or not by analyzing the image information, and transmits information of the following vehicle to the vehicle terminal device when there is the following vehicle; and determines whether the vehicle state information is an alarm condition for vehicle management or not by analyzing the vehicle state information, and transmits alarm information to the vehicle terminal device having need for vehicle management when the information is the alarm condition. In an embodiment of the present invention, the server can receive real time image information of hundreds of moving vehicles of corresponding companies in real time, and monitor remotely record, and play driving images, vehicle speed, current positions (GPS), vehicle information (ECU), and vehicle driving routes.
abstract_ko: 무선 보안 관제 시스템의 무선 보안 관제 방법이 개시된다.   차량 단말 장치로부터 상기 차량 주변의 영상 정보 및 상기 차량상태정보를 수신하여 상기 데이터베이스부에 저장한다.  그리고 서버가 위험을 알리는 위급 상황신호가 수신되었는지 판단하고, 위험을 알리는 위급 상황신호가 수신된 경우, 외부의 관공서 시스템 또는 담당자에게 위험을 알리는 메시지를 송신한다.  그리고 상기 서버가 상기 영상정보를 분석하여 미행차량이 있는지 판단하고, 미행차량이 있는 경우 상기 차량 단말장치에 미행 차량의 정보를 송신한다.  또한, 상기 서버가 차량의 상태정보를 분석하여 차량 관리를 해야할 알람조건인지 판단하고, 알람조건인 경우, 해당 차량 단말 장치에 차량 관리를 해야함을 알리는 알람정보를 송신한다.  이러한 본 발명의 실시예에서는 전국에 있는 해당회사 소유의 수백대의 이동차량의 실시간 영상 및 정보를 서버에서 리얼타임으로 동시에 수신하고, 주행영상과 차량속도, 현재위치(GPS), 차량정보(ECU), 차량주행경로를 실시간 모니터링 및 원격 녹화재생이 가능하다. 또한, 도난이나 교통 사고 등의 긴급 상황시 신속한 대체가 가능하고, 또한, 미행 차량이 있는 등 위험이 예상되는 경우에도 신속한 대처가 가능하다.

title_en: Flooded manhole theft anti apparatus and method
title_ko: 맨홀 침수 도난 방지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method to prevent flooding and theft of a manhole. According to the present invention, the apparatus comprises: a water level sensor to measure a water level with a plurality of sensors; a flooding unit to inform a central server of flooding risk when the measured water level exceeds a predetermined water level; a location unit adding a location of a manhole to the measured water level to systematize flooding management; a control unit recording location and water level information to manage a flooding history, and detecting presence of the manhole to inform the central server of a theft fact when the manhole is stolen; and the central server performing detection in a smart sensor when the theft fact is received, and providing flooding and theft information through a gateway. Accordingly, manhole flooding or theft is able to be coped with, and an accident is able to be coped with by promptly dispatching a site manager to an accident position. A water level and temperature sensor, which includes four nodes with a width of 50 cm connecting a plurality of connection lines, of the smart sensor correctly measures a water level even in a situation likely to be occur, thereby providing an advantage of detecting the flooding and enabling the site manager to manage the situation when the manhole is stolen.
abstract_ko: 맨홀 침수 도난 방지 장치및 방법 가 개시된다. 다수의 센서로 수위 측정하는 수위 센서; 측정된 수위가 일정 수위를 초과하면 침수 위험을 알리는 침수부; 측정된 수위에 맨홀 위치를 더하여 침수 관리를 체계화하는 위치부; 위치 정보와 수위 정보를 기록하여 침수 이력을 관리하고, 맨홀 유무를 감지하여 맨홀 도난시 중앙 서버로 도난 사실을 알리는 제어부; 및 도난 사실을 수신하면 스마트 센서에서 감지하고, 게이트웨이를 통해 침수 및 도난 정보를 제공하는 중앙 서버를 구성한다. 따라서 맨홀 침수 또는 맨홀 도난에 대처하고 사고 위치로 현장 관리자가 즉시 출동하여 사고에 대처할 수 있고, 스마트 센서의 수위 온도 센서는 다수의 연결하는 선을 50cm폭의 4개의 마디를 가지고 있는 수위온도센서를 통해 발생할 수 있는 상황에서도 수위를 정확히 측정해서 침수 위험을 판단하는 장점이 있고, 맨홀 도난이 발생할 때 현장관리자가 맨홀을 상황을 조치를 취한다.
assignees: MOKWON UNIV CORPORATION OF INDUSTRIAL EDUCATIONAL PROGRAMS;ASIN IT

title_en: Earthquake portfoilio management
title_ko: 지진 포트폴리오 관리
abstract_ko: 다수의 엘리베이터 시스템을 위한 포트폴리오 관리 방법. 사고가 발생할 때 실행 가능한 방법은 사고에 의해 영향을 받은 엘리베이터 시스템들의 에지 IoT 디바이스들로부터 엘리베이터 시스템 정보를 수신하는 단계, 사고에 의해 영향을 받은 엘리베이터 시스템들을 분류하는 방법을 결정하기 위해 엘리베이터 시스템 정보를 분석하는 단계, 분석하는 단계의 결과들에 따라 출력물을 생성하는 단계, 운영자들에게 제1 상태 정보를 실시간으로 제공하기 위해 애플리케이션 프로그램 인터페이스들(API들)을 사용하여 애플리케이션 계층에 출력물을 푸싱하는 단계, 및 운영자들에게 제2 상태 정보를 실시간으로 제공하기 위해 통신 통지 프로토콜들을 통해 출력물을 운영자들에게 발송하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Video content analysis system and method for transportation system
abstract_en: A video content analysis system for mobile assets that includes track detection and infrastructure monitoring component.
