The track detection and infrastructure monitoring includes a reinforcement learning component, an object detection and location component, and an obstruction detection component to analyze video data, audio data, vehicle data, weather data, and route/manifest data to determine internal and/or external conditions relating to an the asset. A data acquisition and recording system uploads the data, internal and/or external condition information, object detection information, object location information, and obstruction detection information to a remote memory module and provides streaming video data in real-time to a remotely located user. Remotely located users can view the data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validates the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitors crew performance and safety.

title_en: System and method for telematics accounts on-the-ground safety
abstract_en: Some embodiments are directed to an emergency response system implemented via a back-end application computer server. A vehicle telematics data store may contain electronic records and each electronic record may include, for example, an electronic record identifier and at least one vehicle operation parameter (e.g., a vehicle speed, an accident location, an accident time of day, etc.). The computer server may receive, from an emergency responder (e.g., a police officer, ambulance, firefighter, etc.) via an interactive graphical emergency responder interface display, a vehicle tag (e.g., based on a QR code). The computer server may then retrieve, from the vehicle telematics data store, a vehicle operation parameter associated with the vehicle tag and update the display based on the retrieved a vehicle operation parameter associated with the vehicle tag.

title_en: Intelligent integrated version management method, device, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an intelligent integrated version management method, an intelligent integrated version management device, a medium and electronic equipment, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the latest version of the item in response to receiving an issuing command of the user to the item; after the latest version of the item is determined, pulling the code of the latest version of the item from the Git server, and issuing the latest version of the item to the Web server; after the latest version of the item is released, version information and state information corresponding to the latest version of the item are locally recorded; in response to receiving a user's rollback command for the item, a rollback version of the item is determined based on the locally recorded version information and the state information, and a rollback operation is performed according to the rollback version of the item. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention realizes the high efficiency, the simplification and the intensification of the version management, and improves the reliability of the version management.

title_en: Web attack stage analysis method and system based on Web log
abstract_en: The invention discloses a Web attack stage analysis method and system based on Web logs. The method comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring and analyzing an access log file of a website to be detected to obtain source log data of the website to be detected; 2) Carrying out attack detection on the source log data to obtain attack events to which the website to be detected is subjected; 3) Constructing an attack event diagram according to the attack event received by the website to be detected, and recording and storing the detailed information of the detected attack event in the form of the diagram; 4) Based on the attack event graph, acquiring an association relation between the attack events; 5) And aggregating all attack events belonging to the same multi-step Web attack process according to the association relation, restoring the attack scenes of the multi-step Web attack, determining the attack stage of each attack scene and evaluating the damage degree of the attack. The invention can share the analysis work in the emergency response, so that the invention only focuses on the attack event with deeper and important attack stage.

title_en: System and method for analyzing cost of processing waste generated during decommissioning a nuclear power plant
title_ko: 원자력 발전소의 해체 폐기물을 처리하는 비용을 분석하는 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Provided are a system for analyzing costs of nuclear dismantlement waste and a method thereof. The system comprises: a dismantlement waste information storage storing information needed to estimate the total costs for processing dismantlement waste generating when dismantling a nuclear power plant; and a dismantlement waste processing cost analysis server configured to estimate the total cost by using information stored in the dismantlement waste information storage. The dismantlement waste processing cost analysis server calculates the number of accidents during a unit period based on an average value of a plurality of random numbers generated to form triangular distribution, calculates a probability of occurrence of an accident which may occur in a process of processing the dismantled waste by using a probability mass function of Poisson distribution applying the number of accidents during the unit period, and calculates the total costs by taking into account the recovery costs according to the probability of occurrence of the accident.
abstract_ko:
원전 해체 폐기물의 비용 분석 시스템 및 방법이 제공된다.  상기 비용 분석 시스템은 원자력 발전소를 해체할 때 발생하는 해체 폐기물을 처리하는데 소요되는 전체 비용을 예측하는데 필요한 정보들을 저장하는 해체 폐기물 정보 저장소, 및 상기 해체 폐기물 정보 저장소에 저장된 정보들을 이용하여 상기 전체 비용을 예측하도록 구성되는 해체 폐기물 처리 비용 분석 서버를 포함한다.  상기 해체 폐기물 처리 비용 분석 서버는, 삼각 분포를 이루도록 발생되는 복수의 난수들의 평균값을 기초로 단위 기간 동안의 사고 발생 건수(λ)를 계산하고, 상기 단위 기간 동안의 사고 발생 건수(λ)를 적용한 프아송 분포(Poisson Distribution)의 확률질량함수(Probability Mass Function)를 이용하여, 상기 해체 폐기물을 처리하는 과정에서 발생할 수 있는 사고의 발생 확률을 계산하고, 상기 사고의 발생 확률에 따른 복구 비용을 고려하여 상기 전체 비용을 산출한다. 
     
         
     
     컴퓨터가 읽을 수 있는 기록 매체의 예로는 ROM, RAM, CD-ROM, 자기 테이프, 플로피디스크, 광 데이터 저장 장치 등이 있다.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer-readable medium of providing customized cleaning service according to monitoring harmful substances of indoor environment
title_ko: 실내 환경의 유해물질 모니터링에 따른 맞춤화된 청소 서비스 제공 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터-판독 가능 기록 매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing a customized cleaning service based on monitoring of hazardous substances in an indoor environment. Specifically, the method comprises: a provisional estimate submission request step of collecting basic information including at least one of industry, usage status, and precautions of a space to be cleaned from a user terminal, searching for a cleaning service provider matching the collected basic information, providing the basic information to one or more searched cleaning service providers, and requesting provisional estimate submission for the space to be cleaned; a service contract conclusion guide step of, when a provisional estimate is submitted from one or more cleaning service providers, evaluating the appropriateness of the received provisional estimate using an artificial intelligence algorithm, providing cleaning service providers that have submitted the provisional estimate that satisfies pre-established evaluation criteria to the user terminal, and guiding the service contract conclusion with one cleaning service provider selected from the user terminal; and an indoor environment monitoring report generation step of, when a service contract is concluded and one cleaning service provider dispatches a service worker to the space to be cleaned, acquiring indoor environment information of the space to be cleaned using one or more sensor modules mounted on a wearable device of the service worker, updating indoor environment information acquired from the space to be cleaned at preset intervals, and generating an indoor environment monitoring report according to the degree of indoor environment improvement. Accordingly, an improvement in the quality of a cleaning service provided can be expected.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 실내 환경의 유해물질 모니터링에 따른 맞춤화된 청소 서비스 제공 방법에 관련된 것으로서, 구체적으로는 유저 단말로부터 청소 대상 공간의 업종, 사용 상태 및, 유의점 중 적어도 어느 하나를 포함하는 기초 정보를 수집하여, 수집된 기초 정보에 매칭되는 청소 서비스 제공 업체를 검색하되, 검색된 하나 이상의 청소 서비스 제공 업체에 기초 정보를 제공하여 청소 대상 공간에 대한 가견적 제출을 요청하는 가견적 제출 요청 단계; 하나 이상의 청소 서비스 제공 업체로부터 가견적이 제출될 시, 인공지능 알고리즘을 이용하여 수신된 가견적의 적정성을 평가하고, 기 설정된 평가 기준을 만족하는 가견적을 제출한 청소 서비스 제공 업체를 유저 단말에 제공하여 유저 단말에서 선택된 일 청소 서비스 제공 업체와의 용역 계약 체결을 안내하는 용역 계약 체결 안내 단계; 및, 용역 계약이 체결되어, 일 청소 서비스 제공 업체로부터 청소 대상 공간으로 용역자를 파견할 시, 용역자의 웨어러블 기기에 탑재된 하나 이상의 센서 모듈을 이용하여 청소 대상 공간의 실내 환경 정보를 취득하되, 기 설정된 주기마다 청소 대상 공간에서 취득되는 실내 환경 정보를 갱신하여 실내 환경 개선 정도에 따른 실내 환경 모니터링 리포트를 생성하는 실내 환경 모니터링 리포트 생성 단계;를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method for detecting vehicle accident using blackbox and sharing accident information automatically, apparatus computer program for performing the method
title_ko: 블랙박스를 이용한 차량 사고 감지 및 자동 사고 공유 방법, 이를 수행하는 장치 및 프로그램
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 블랙박스를 이용한 차량 사고 감지 및 자동 사고 공유 장치는 자차 및 주변 차량 중 적어도 하나의 차량 사고를 감지하는 블랙박스로부터 감지된 차량 사고 이벤트를 수신하는 이벤트 수신부, 수신된 상기 차량 사고 이벤트에 기초하여 사고 발생 장소에 대한 정보를 포함하는 사고 발생 정보를 생성하는 사고 정보 생성부 및 생성된 상기 사고 발생 정보를 긴급 구조 센터 및 상기 자차로부터 일정 거리내 있는 주위 차량들에게 전송하는 통신부를 포함하고, 상기 블랙박스는 주행 중인 도로의 상황에 맞는 사고 감지 딥러닝 모델이 탑재된다.

title_en: Mobile emergency command system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of mobile emergency command systems, including object wearing device, hand-held device and the master control device being arranged on mobile emergency command car, photographic device is installed on object wearing device, transmitting device is set on hand-held device, dual processor is used in master control device, one is used as primary processor, one central processing unit for being mainly responsible for video acquisition function is from processor, the video recording function of script consumption CPU and memory source maximum are operated on individual second central processing unit, first central processing unit is mainly responsible for the operation of other functions and the working condition of second processor is controlled by data exchange, total system work is more smooth, situations such as being not in interim card, effectively promote user experience.
assignees: CHONGQING BIAN BIHENG SCI&TECH CO LTD

title_en: Implementation method for solving emergency circumstances in tax service hall
abstract_en: The invention provides an implementation method for solving emergency circumstances in a tax service hall. The implementation method comprises the specific implementation steps that a queuing and calling system, fast ball monitoring equipment, an early-warning system and a management system are arranged, wherein the queuing and calling system comprises a queuing machine, a queuing and fetching client side, and a calling client side; the fast ball monitoring equipment comprises a fast ball camera; the early-warning system is a short message sending platform and is used for sending an early-warning message to a mobile phone of a manager; the management system has the functions of setting, initiating and maintaining parameters, and the like. Compared with the prior art, by adopting the implementation method for solving emergency circumstances in the tax service hall, working staff can fast give an alarm when an emergency circumstance happens so as to make emergency response, and clearly record the emergency situation, thus an excellent using effect can be achieved.

title_en: Conversation recording system
abstract_en: The invention provides a conversation recording system which comprises a mobile terminal and a cloud server connected with the mobile terminal. The mobile terminal is used for obtaining command information of a conversation, collecting video data of a conversation scene, and sending the command information and the video data to the cloud server, the command information comprises identification information of conversation personnel in the conversation, the cloud server inquires and obtains pre-stored information corresponding to the identification information according to the received identification information, and sends the pre-stored information obtained by inquiry to the mobile terminal, and the cloud server is further used for storing the received video data. The conversation recording system can improve the user experience.
assignees: SHANDONG CHINA MAGNETIC VIDEO CO LTD

title_en: Large-area power failure data rapid intercommunication method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly communicating large-area power failure data. The method comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring a power failure event: after a large-area power failure, the distribution network dispatching records all power failure lines in a large-area trip event list and transmits the power failure lines to a large-area power failure monitoring platform in real time; (2) customer data acquisition: through a data backflow technology, a large-area power failure monitoring platform obtains the number of clients corresponding to a power failure line, and the number of clients affected by power failure is counted quickly in real time; (3) and (3) automatically generating a report: the system automatically generates a report form by combining the acquired customer data and the events in the large-area trip event list. The method of the invention can quickly and accurately obtain the power failure line list, automatically count the affected customers, collect and display the statistical information, greatly accelerate the power failure information statistics and reporting speed, facilitate the real-time checking of emergency command center personnel, and provide judgment basis for emergency rescue, disaster relief classification and correct event handling of decision-making layer.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;DONGGUAN POWER BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Network security emergency response method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The application discloses a network security emergency response method and a system thereof based on a knowledge graph, wherein a strategy base is constructed through a crawler technology and the knowledge graph, and comprises a security information base and a knowledge graph base; when a network security event is monitored to occur, matching a corresponding response strategy in a security information base based on event information of the network security event, obtaining a corresponding knowledge graph in a knowledge graph base based on the event information, and obtaining an entity and an association relation related to the event information based on the knowledge graph; generating a safety emergency plan based on the response strategy, the entity related to the event information and the incidence relation, wherein the safety emergency plan at least comprises the response strategy and safety emergency personnel; the safety emergency plan is sent to safety emergency personnel, and the safety emergency personnel are reminded of responding quickly, so that the technical problems that in the prior art, when an emergency network safety event occurs, the linkage of multi-party heterogeneous resources only depends on manual operation, and the timeliness and comprehensiveness of emergency response are reduced are solved.
assignees: SHENZHEN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Semi-automatic FA-based power distribution network dispatcher fault handling simulation training evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a semi-automatic FA-based power distribution network dispatcher fault handling simulation training evaluation method, which comprises the steps of firstly describing information of switching-on and switching-off equipment of a transformer substation and the like with a fault feeder; secondly, recording the state of a feeder automation system; establishing a dispatcher operating equipment state information array to record equipment states of the dispatcher in the fault handling process; then, the state information array of the FA operation equipment and the state of the switching-off and switching-on equipment in the state information array of the dispatcher operation equipment are combined by establishing a man-machine combined operation equipment state information array; and recording the running state of the equipment which is required to be opened and closed in the correct fault treatment process again. Differences between the standard operation device state information array and the man-machine combination operation device state information array are described. And finally, evaluating simulation training results based on the combined operation of the semi-automatic FA and the dispatcher by establishing comprehensive fault handling simulation training evaluation indexes.
assignees: QUANZHOU ELECTRIC POWER TECH INSTITUTE OF FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;FUJIAN ELECTRIC VOCATIONAL AND TECHNICAL COLLEGE;STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Safety transformation monitoring system and method for building construction
abstract_en: The invention provides a safety transformation monitoring system for building construction and a method thereof, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a sensor network module, a data transmission module, a data processing and analyzing module, a real-time monitoring and early warning module, a historical data inquiring and analyzing module, an emergency response module and a system integrating and expanding module, wherein the sensor network module is wirelessly connected with the data transmission module, the data transmission module is wirelessly connected with the data processing and analyzing module, the data processing and analyzing module is wirelessly connected with the real-time monitoring and early warning module, the historical data inquiring and analyzing module is wirelessly connected with the output end of the real-time monitoring and early warning module, and the historical data inquiring and analyzing module is wirelessly connected with the emergency response module. The invention provides a safety reconstruction monitoring system for building construction and a method thereof, wherein a real-time registration unit, a real-time classification unit and a real-time registration unit are used for registering a person for recording when the constructor is used, and classifying the person for different construction projects after registering the information of the person.
assignees: YANCHENG POLYTECHNIC COLLEGE;YANCHENG HONGZHIXIN STEEL STRUCTURE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Broadcasting receiver and method for recording traffic accident information
title_ko: 교통 사고 정보를 기록하기 위한 방송 수신 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A broadcasting receiver and a method thereof are provided to reduce a quarrel on a reason of a traffic accident by recording peripheral images at an emergency situation. A broadcasting receiver includes a digital broadcasting processor(310), a running information interface(320), a vehicle information recording unit(340), and a controller(330). Threshold digital broadcasting processor receives and decodes the digital broadcasting. The running information interface receives running information on outer and inner states of a vehicle from sensors and delivers the running information to the controller. The vehicle information recording unit obtains image and audio information on the vehicle and records the information. The controller analyzes the running information and estimates an emergency situation. When the emergency situation occurs, the controller stops the operation of the digital broadcasting processor and controls the vehicle information recording unit to store the image and audio information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 교통 사고와 같은 위급 상황에서 자동으로 차량에 대한 교통 사고 정보를 기록하기 위한 방송 수신 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명은 디지털 방송을 수신하고, 수신된 디지털 방송을 복조 및 복호하여 처리하는 디지털 방송 처리부; 차량의 외부 또는 내부에 설치된 센서로부터 차량의 외부 또는 내부 상태와 관련된 주행 정보를 수신하여 제어부에 전달하는 주행 정보 인터페이스부; 차량의 외부 또는 내부에 대한 영상 및 오디오 정보를 획득하여 기록하는 차량 정보 기록부; 및 수신된 주행 정보를 해석하여 위급 상황이 발생할지 여부를 예측하여 결정하고, 위급 상황이 발생할 것으로 예측되는 경우, 디지털 방송 처리부의 동작을 중단시키고, 차량 정보 기록부가 영상 및 오디오 정보를 획득하여 기록하도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다.  따라서, 본 발명에 따르면, 교통 사고 정보를 기록할 수 있는 방송 수신 장치를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Image displaying device having security function and strengthening method of security using the same
title_ko: 보안 기능을 갖는 영상 표시 기기 및 그를 이용한 보안 유지 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An image display device with a security function and a security maintenance method thereof are provided to easily acquire evidence in an emergency situation such as a theft or burglar case. CONSTITUTION: A network interface unit(114) receives an emergency situation information. A user input interface unit inputs at least one or more key signals requesting a certain command from a remote control unit(190). A control unit(130) controls the automatic recording of the emergency situation information in response to the information. A storage unit(160) stores the emergency situation information according to the control of the control unit.
abstract_ko:
본원 발명은 위급 상황 발생시 증거 자료의 확보를 용이하게 함으로써 보안성을 높일 수 있는 영상 표시 기기 및 그를 이용한 보안 유지 방법이다.  
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 영상 표시 기기 및 그를 이용한 보안 유지 방법은 도난 또는 강도 사건과 같은 위급 상황 발생시 증거 자료를 용이하게 확보함으로써, 영상 표시 기기가 위치하는 소정 공간 내의 보안성을 높일 수 있다.

title_en: Smart phone for containing abuse urgent call button
title_ko: 긴급호출 버튼을 구비한 스마트폰
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart phone having an emergency call button. The smart phone includes a touch sensing unit (111) provided on a rear surface of the smart phone to sense a touch signal by an operation of a user; and a reduced pressure sensing unit (112) provided to a lower portion of the touch sensing unit (111) to sense a reduced pressure signal by an operation of the user; an emergency button (110) concavely formed on the rear surface of the smart phone such that the emergency button does not protrude from the rear surface of the smart phone; and an emergency call transmitting unit (120) for transmitting record information generated by recording in real time a voice generated in an accident place to a server (30) of a wireless communication provider at the same time while emergency relief requesting information is transmitted to a guardian terminal (10) and an agency server (20) when the touch signal and the reduced pressure signal are received through the emergency button (110). According to the present invention, when an emergency situation occurs, a user of the smart phone touches not plural buttons but the emergency button provided to the rear surface of the smart phone so that the smart phone transmits emergency information to the preset guardian terminal and the agency server in response to a reduced pressure. Thus, the user can touch the emergency button to allow the pressure to be reduced without being embarrassed. Since the emergency button is formed in a concave shape to be introduced into an inside of the rear surface of the smart phone, a friction and interference of the smart phone in use can be minimized. As soon as the user reduces the pressure of a camera provided to the rear surface in a button shape, the information is transmitted to the preset guardian terminal and agency server, so that an emergency situation can be transmitted without constructing an additional button.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 긴급호출 버튼을 구비한 스마트폰에 관한 것으로서, 스마트폰의 배면에 구비되어 사용자의 조작에 의한 터치신호를 감지하는 터치감지부(111)와, 터치감지부(111) 하부에 구비되어 사용자의 조작에 의한 감압신호를 감지하는 감압감지부(112)로 구성되며, 스마트폰의 배면에 돌출되지 않도록 음각으로 형성된 긴급버튼(110); 및 긴급버튼(110)으로부터 터치신호 및 감압신호를 인가받은 경우, 기 설정된 긴급구조 요청정보를 보호자 단말기(10) 및 기관서버(20)로 전송함과 동시에 사고현장의 목소리를 실시간으로 녹취하여 생성한 녹취정보를 이동통신사서버(30)로 전송하는 긴급호출 전송부(120);를 포함한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 스마트폰 사용자가 비상상황 발생시, 복수개의 버튼 감압이 아니라 스마트폰 배면에 구비된 단일 긴급버튼의 터치 및 감압에 의해 비상정보를 기 설정된 보호자 단말기 및 기관서버로 전송함으로써, 긴급 상황시 사용자가 당황하지 않고 긴급버튼의 터치 및 감압을 도모하고, 스마트폰 배면에 긴급버튼을 케이스 내측으로 인입되도록 음각형태로 형성함으로써, 스마트폰의 생활사용에 따른 마찰과 간섭을 최소화하며, 사용자가 스마트폰 배면에 구비된 버튼형태의 카메라를 감압함과 동시에 기 설정된 보호자 단말기 및 기관서버로 전송함으로써, 별도의 버튼을 구성하지 않고 긴급 상황을 전송하도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and method for security analyst modeling and management
abstract_en: Systems and methods for managing incoming cybersecurity events. Incoming security events are first classified based on stored event profiles from previous events. Multiple analysts with relevant experience and background are determined based on the analysts' stored profiles. The incoming event is assigned and dispatched as necessary to one of these analysts. Analyst stress levels and mood is assessed, and the assessments are stored in the analyst profiles. Analyst resolution steps and performance against those steps in resolving the events are also stored in the relevant analyst profiles and in an event record database. QA reviews of resolved events are conducted when norm deviant circumstances arise. AI and process mining techniques are used in classifying the incoming events, assigning the incoming events to the relevant analyst, and determining lessons to be learned from previous events. The analyst profiles models specific analyst behaviour and are used for assigning incoming events.

title_en: Emergency responder data communication system, apparatuses and methods
abstract_en: A disclosed method implements: receiving, by a cloud server, unstructured computer-aided-dispatch (CAD) incident data from a CAD system corresponding to a CAD incident record for an emergency call received at an emergency communication center (ECC); performing entity extraction on the unstructured CAD incident data to generate output data; and sending the output data from the cloud-based server, to an emergency responder mobile device terminal to provide information related to the CAD incident record for the emergency call.

title_en: Method and device for processing emergency dispatching command data for urban rail transit
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method and a device for processing emergency dispatching command data for an urban rail transit. The method comprises the steps of before an accident fault happens, reducing probability of a major accident fault through a reliable pre-warning technology; after the accident fault happens, directly guiding and dispatching an administrator to publish an emergency disposal and rescue dispatching command to a travelling watchman terminal and a driver terminal; and publishing accident fault information to a passenger, wherein the device comprises a driver terminal, a travelling dispatcher terminal, a passenger terminal, a server terminal and a secondary server. In comparison with the prior art, the method and the device have the advantages of capability of effectively improving timeliness of emergency dispatching of the urban rail transit under emergency, ensuring operation safety of accident duration, and improving emergency service quality of the rail transit to the passenger.

title_en: Sign-in service based on personal help-seeking button
abstract_en: In a Personal Emergency Response System (PERS), a subscriber wears a Personal Help Button (PHB) (10) having a call button (12). A speakerphone console (30) detects the signal transmitted by the PHB when the call button is pressed and establishes a telephone call with a PERS center (8). The PHB, speakerphone console, or combination thereof also performs a check-in process that includes: a check-in time is detected (50) and a request to perform a check-in action is output (52) and it is detected (54) whether the check-in action is performed. If the check-in action is detected, it is recorded (56). If a check-in action is not detected, a remedial action (60, 62, 64, 66, 68, 70, 72) is performed. The check-in action may be a designated motion of the PHB that is detected by a gesture recognition algorithm executed by the PHB that analyzes sensor data generated by a PHB's motion sensor (22).

title_en: Flood control optimization scheduling efficient solving method for complex reservoir group in river basin
abstract_en: The invention provides a river basin complex reservoir group flood control optimization scheduling high-efficiency solving method which comprises the steps of processing reservoir storage flow abnormal fluctuation based on a VMD-ENHANCED CNN model to obtain a denoising storage flow process, constructing a reservoir group flood control scheduling model, selecting a delivery flow as a coordination variable based on an equivalent projection theory decomposition system to establish a subsystem equivalent model, adopting a Ray distributed computing framework to process the subsystem equivalent model in parallel, executing an EP-DOA-CUDA algorithm solution to obtain a system global optimal coordination variable, and optimizing a lower subsystem based on a IVYA optimization algorithm by taking the global optimal coordination variable as a boundary condition to obtain a reservoir group optimal scheduling scheme. The method solves the problems of abnormal fluctuation of the warehouse-in flow, high complexity of the model, low calculation efficiency and the like, and improves the precision and timeliness of flood control dispatching.

title_en: Multisource data fusion supervision system for geological disaster management engineering
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of geological disaster engineering supervision, and particularly discloses a multi-source data fusion supervision system for geological disaster management engineering, which is characterized in that the real-time acquisition, multi-protocol analysis, high-precision time synchronization, advanced denoising, missing value interpolation, outlier filtering and preliminary feature extraction of data are realized at a data source end, so that the data quality and the real-time performance are remarkably improved, and the processing load of a central platform is reduced; the real-time state mapping of the physical world and the virtual space and the recognition and correction scheme matching of the abnormal result of the disaster management project realize the matching of the multistage early warning linkage and the automatic emergency plan, provide visual and comprehensive visual display and decision support, greatly improve the supervision efficiency, early warning accuracy and emergency response speed, provide reliable technical guarantee for the safe and stable operation of the geological disaster management project, and effectively reduce the disaster risk and economic loss.

title_en: Apparatus for searching scene of marine accident area using unmanned aerial vehicle, method thereof and computer recordable medium storing program to perform the method
title_ko: 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장을 수색하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 무인항공기를 이용하여 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것으로, 이러한 본 발명은 무인항공기와 통신하기 위한 통신부와, 소정 지역을 상기 무인항공기의 통신 범위에 따라 규격이 결정되는 정각기둥 형상의 복수의 셀로 구분하며, 복수의 셀 중 탐색 지역으로 지정된 셀과 상기 관제장치가 위치한 셀을 셀 단위로 연결했을 때, 최단 경로에 속하는 적어도 하나의 셀을 도출하고, 상기 도출된 셀을 네트워크를 구성할 셀로 설정하며, 상기 도출된 셀 각각에 대해 무인항공기를 배정하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 해난 사고 현장을 탐색하기 위한 관제장치와, 이에 따른 방법과, 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: Method for Predicting Vehicle Collision Using Data Collected from Video Games
title_ko: 비디오 게임을 활용한 차량 사고 예측 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 비디오 게임을 활용한 차량 사고 예측 방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 차량 사고 예측 시스템의 차량 사고 예측 방법은, 비디오 프로그램의 실행 상태를 변경하여 게임 플레이어 차량과의 충돌 이미지들 및 비충돌 이미지들을 포함하는 가상의 사고 데이터를 수집하는 단계, 및 상기 가상의 사고 데이터를 학습 알고리즘에 적용하여 훈련된 학습 데이터를 기반으로 차량의 충돌 사고 여부에 대한 판단을 수행하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: A Fire Truck Moving Game Apparatus and A GAme Method Using that
title_ko: 소방차 출동게임장치 및 이를 이용한 게임방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire engine dispatch game apparatus and a game method using the same. According to the composition, the fire engine dispatch game apparatus includes: a game board part formed into a plate shape and including black lines formed on a path like a go board; a fire engine part moving from a starting point on the game board part to a fire scene point along the lines; a guide vehicle part performing a mission while moving along the lines; an action input part inputting a sequence of operations of the fire engine part and the guide vehicle part; a display part displaying a program for the operation input of the action input part, and displaying a game play instruction; a server storing the program and the game play instruction; and a control part controlling the operation of the fire engine part, the guide vehicle part, the display part, the server and an obstacle part. Therefore, the present invention is capable of enabling a user to learn principles of coding with enjoyment.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 소방차 출동게임장치 및 이를 이용한 게임방법에 관한 것으로, 그 구성은, 판상으로 형성되어 경로 상에 검은색의 실선이 바둑판과 같이 형성되는 게임판부와, 상기 게임판부 상의 출발점에서 화재지점까지 실선을 따라 이동하는 소방차부와, 상기 실선을 따라 이동하면서 미션을 수행하는 가이드차량부와, 상기 소방차부와, 상기 가이드차량부의 동작의 순서를 입력하는 행동입력부와 ,상기 행동입력부의 동작입력의 프로그램이 나타내고, 게임방법을 나타내는 디스플레이부와, 상기 프로그램 및 게임방법을 저장하는 서버와, 상기 소방차부, 가이드차량부, 디스플레이부, 서버 및 장애물부의 동작을 제어하는 제어부를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다.

title_en: Charger gateway providing two-way charger gateway providing two-way communications for one of more of the following product categories: security devices, life safety devices, home automation devices, personal emergency response (PERs) devices and tele-health devices
abstract_en: A charger base station includes at least one of a security system, home automation system, life safety system, a PER system and a tele-health system, the charger base station including a housing having a charger port for charging an electronic device with the housing having a compartment for a microprocessor, a memory, a firmware, a transceiver, a cellular communicator, Wi-Fi, and hardware, and software producing a security system supporting IP video, at least one peripheral device taken from the group of 319 MHz, 345 MHz, 433 MHz, 868 MHz and 900 MHz wireless peripherals, a home automation system serving as controller of z-wave or zigbee devices, life safety devices, a PERs device and tele-health device capable of measuring, recording and wirelessly transmitting physiological data of a connected tele-health product, life safety device and a PERs via at least one of a backend device, a central station device and local and remote user devices.

title_en: Systems and methods for forming and operating an ecosystem for a conducted electrical weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: A kind of remote monitoring intelligent security stamp
abstract_en: This utility model relates to a kind of remote monitoring intelligent security stamp.Existing various corporate seal, in the case of there is no wireless counting, can only be by artificial meter record by the number of times of print seal, it is impossible to seal is carried out effective monitoring, it is understood that there may be steal the risk of lid.This utility model includes seal body, described seal is the most internal to be arranged without thread count, described includes mainboard, main control module, independent current source module without thread count, also include wireless communication module, seal counting module, data processing module, described main control module respectively with independent current source module, wireless communication module, seal counting module, data processing module connect, and seal counting module is recorded impress number of times, time of impressing, place of impressing of seal and is uploaded to high in the clouds or server end by wireless communication module by described data processing module in real time.This utility model low cost, can remote real-time monitoring, the information such as the time of continuous data, yield, place all pass through wireless receiving and dispatching, thus strengthen further the automatization of employee's enumeration data is adjusted, manages, analyzes, monitored, and finally raise labour efficiency, cost is relatively low.
assignees: JIANGSHAN ZHIGU SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of liftable intelligentized control method platform
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of liftable intelligentized control method platform, including main table top, substage face, spoke platform lifting plate, spoke platform bottom plate, main elevating mechanism, spoke platform elevating mechanism, load-bearing supporting leg, display twin shaft holder, control unit and shield line hose, described control unit includes single-chip microcontroller, control panel and fingerprint identification unit；Key on the control panel operates the rotation of the main elevating mechanism, the lifting of spoke platform elevating mechanism and the display twin shaft holder to control single chip computer；Described control unit has memory function, and record has the conventional location of different operation personnel, identifies operator by the fingerprint identification unit, the default location of the angular adjustment of Jiang Zhutai, the height of spoke platform and display to corresponding operating personnel.The utility model is applicable in the working environments such as enterprise's scheduling, emergency command and Industry Control, facilitates that operator can will control table top in stance sitting posture and display all be adjusted to being suitble to oneself position.
assignees: JIALI HENGXING BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent electric ladder frame for fire engine
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an electronic ladder frame of intelligence for fire engine can solve the current inconvenient technical problem of elevator frame operation for fire engine. The fire fighting ladder comprises a ladder frame body and a rotary support frame, wherein the ladder frame body is fixed on the rotary support frame, and the rotary support frame is fixed on the top of a fire fighting truck; the ladder rack body is provided with a sliding seat which slides on the ladder rack surface; the electric cylinder assembly is fixed at the bottom of the ladder frame body; the electric cylinder assembly comprises an electric cylinder body and an electric cylinder controller; the intelligent controller is in communication connection with the electric cylinder controller, outputs control signals to control the electric cylinder body to move and drives the ladder frame body to incline or decline. The utility model discloses an add 4G communication mode and in time upload the running state of on-the-spot ladder frame, the fault conditions to distant place control command center, for long-range fire control commander provides technical support, simultaneously through the data record analysis, maintain for the equipment uses the maintenance and provide the data support.
assignees: ANHUI HENGXIN ZHENGAN INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: System and method for holding business in NGN
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system and a method used for service keeping in a next-generation network. The system comprises a soft switch, a spare soft switch and a media gateway which are mutually connected; wherein, after the main soft switch runs out of order or a link path between the main soft switch and the media gateway is broken off, the circuit information in executing service is recorded and protected as the keeping-needed circuit information by the media gateway, and the re-registration is carried out on the spare soft switch by the media gateway; after the media gateway is successfully registered onto the spare soft switch, the recorded keeping-needed circuit information is reported to the spare soft switch by the media gateway, and a return command is sent to other circuits beyond a keeping-needed circuit by the spare soft switch. The system and the method realize the speech path keeping of a gateway-side media when in disaster toleration, thus realizing the smooth switching of the calling service in the dual-homing disaster tolerating process and improving the satisfaction degree of clients.

title_en: The system and method for a kind of CSCF entity disaster-tolerance and load balancing
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the system and method for a kind of CSCF entity disaster-tolerance and load balancing, described system comprises P-CSCF entity, I-CSCF entity, S-CSCF entity and DNS Server; Described method is: each CSCF entity regularly reports DNSServer with the load equivalent of self respectively, and DNS Server adjusts corresponding C SCF tabulation according to the load equivalent that receives; When having the SIP register command to need striking out on the CSCF entity of source, send DNS inquiry signaling to DNS Server; Described DNS Server can return the SRV record of the target CS CF entity of load equivalent minimum in the corresponding CSCF tabulation; Source CSCF entity routes to the corresponding target CS CF entity of described SRV record with described SIP register command.The present invention has alleviated the load of IMS network.

title_en: Ward intelligent calling method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent ward calling method and system based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of ward calling. The method comprises the following steps: receiving a call instruction sent by a user; acquiring an electronic medical record based on a calling instruction, wherein the calling instruction corresponds to the electronic medical record, and the electronic medical record comprises identification information and medical information of a patient; based on the electronic medical record, matching is carried out by combining with a history treatment database, and a disease matching result is obtained; assigning priority to the call instruction according to the illness state matching result, and determining a call queue; and dispatching the medical staff to respond to the call instruction according to the call queue. The technical problems that the emergency degree of the call is difficult to distinguish, so that a great amount of time is consumed by medical staff when a great amount of non-emergency calls are processed, and the emergency situation can not be responded in time are solved, and the technical effect of preferentially processing the emergency calls is achieved.
assignees: The Sixth Medical Center of Chinese PLA General Hospital

title_en: Safety evaluation method, system, equipment and program for chemical storage place
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety evaluation method, a system, equipment and a program for a chemical storage place, and relates to the technical field of dangerous chemical management, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out space-time alignment on multi-source data; the multi-source data comprises stored chemical data, environment data, equipment state data, management data and historical data, spatial characteristics of the multi-source data after time-space alignment are extracted to generate a spatial risk weight map, a risk evaluation model is pre-trained, and weights in the spatial risk weight map are mapped to the risk evaluation model to obtain risk grades. Through the processing scheme of the present disclosure, the potential risk of the storage place can be found in time, the emergency response is early-warned and started in advance, the possibility of accident occurrence is effectively reduced, and the safety of the chemical storage place is improved.
assignees: ZHONGANGUANGYUAN INSPECTION AND EVALUATION TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle road twin engine construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle road twin engine construction method, which is based on acquisition and manufacture of point cloud contour data and image texture data, configuration of rendering, configuration of a coloring device, configuration of basic illumination and the like, scene construction is carried out, accurate road details and building details are depicted, accurate simulation of a real road is realized, and twin construction, twin behavior driving and twin life management are carried out by carrying out unified processing on external data such as vehicle report data, vehicle track smooth data, signal lamp data and traffic event data, so that real-time synchronization of virtual road conditions and real world is ensured, and dynamic and accurate decision basis can be provided for traffic scheduling, emergency command and other applications. The invention also provides a vehicle road twin engine system.
assignees: SHANGHAI LINGANG XINBIAN DISTRICT DIGITAL INFRASTRUCTURE INVEST DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Avionics and Part Task Trainer and Controlling Method for the Same
title_ko: 항전계통요목 훈련장비 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an avionics training device and a controlling method thereof, wherein the device comprises a data input module for inputting command data for avionics training by using the input and output devices of a personal computer; an avionics training control module mounted on the personal computer, calculating and analyzing command data for avionics training inputted through the data input module in real time to generate and transmit a simulation control signal for avionics training, and updating the status of a simulated virtual airplane; and a screen simulation module for indicating an avionics training screen by implementing UI which is approximately identical to an aircraft cockpit on a display according to the simulation control signal of the avionics training control module. The present invention maximizes learning efficiency since the trainee can perform avionics training conveniently and individually after conveniently loading avionics training programs without additional installation of complex equipment under Windows of a personal computer because portable avionics training equipment is made up of several modules after separating an avionics simulation function and an avionics procedural training function from a whole avionics simulation system.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 개인용 컴퓨터의 입,출력장치부를 이용하여 항전계통요목 훈련을 위한 명령데이터들을 입력시키는 데이터 입력모듈과; 상기 개인용 컴퓨터에 탑재되고 데이터 입력모듈을 통해 입력된 항전계통요목 훈련을 위한 명령데이터들을 실시간으로 계산 및 해석하여 항전계통요목 훈련을 위한 시현제어신호를 생성하여 전송하고 시현되는 가상의 항공기의 상태를 업데이트시키는 항전계통훈련 제어모듈과; 상기 항전계통훈련 제어모듈의 시현제어신호에 따라 디스플레이상에 항공기 조종석과 거의 동일한 환경의 UI 구현하여 항전계통요목 훈련화면을 표시하는 화면시현모듈을 포함하는 항전계통요목 훈련장비 및 그 제어방법을 제공한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명은 전체 항공기 시뮬레이션시스템에서 항전시현절차 및 일부항공기절차 수행훈련 기능만을 분리한후 몇 개의 모듈로 조합하여 이동편의성이 가능한 항전계통요목 훈련장비를 구성하므로써, 개인용 컴퓨터의 윈도우 환경하에서 별도의 복잡한 장비의 추가 설치없이 항전계통요목 훈련장비에 따른 프로그램만을 간편히 로딩한후 항전계통요목 훈련을 용이하게 수행할 수 있기때문에 조종훈련생이 개인의 편의에 따라 개별적으로 숙달학습을 수행할 수가 있으므로 그에 따라 학습효용성을 극대화시키는 효과가 있다.

title_en: System and method for conducting infrared monitoring on low-altitude flight targets in sensitive area
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and method for conducting infrared monitoring on low-altitude flight targets in a sensitive area. The system comprises a central station and a far-end station which are connected through an external network. The central station comprises an integrated data display terminal and an integrated monitoring terminal, wherein the integrated data display terminal and the integrated monitoring terminal are connected through an internal network. The far-end station comprises an infrared optoelectronic device, a hard disk video recorder, a data fusion terminal and a display control terminal, wherein the infrared optoelectronic device, the data fusion terminal and the display control terminal are connected through the internal network; the infrared optoelectronic device is also connected with the hard disk video recorder. The system and method have the advantages that remote command control can be achieved, and video data of the flight targets within the range of a whole flight service station can be observed in real time; the method is low in transmission delay and high in real-time performance; the clear and visualized video data of the flight targets can be provided; the far-end station and the central station are directly connected for data communication through the passthrough technology, and the video data are low in delay; visualized information of false targets and the search and rescue process in the sensitive area can be provided.

title_en: System for learning hangeul using text-to-speech and method therefor
title_ko: Ｔｔｓ를 이용한 한글 학습 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A system and a method for learning Hangeul using a TTS(Text-To-Speech) are provided to sequentially generate characters by sequentially storing an initial sound, a medial sound, and a final sound in an electronic tag. A character card(100) has an electronic tag which records card information for learning Hangeul, and an input unit(210) receives a terminal control signal from a user. The input unit(210) receives the card information from the character card(100), and receives a terminal update signal from an external device(300). A tag reading unit(220) reads the electronic tag to sequentially recognize character cards by reading position division information in case that a plurality of character cards are recognized by using the card information. A TTS synthesizing unit(230) synthesizes a syllable into a sound after extracting character data and language data by using the terminal control signal and the card information. A data storage unit(240) and a power supply unit(250) store the card information, the terminal control signal, and the terminal update signal. A command unit(260) outputs a command which the user recognizes a current situation based on the terminal control signal and the card information. An output unit(280) and a control unit(290) output the sound synthesized data and the command through a voice.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 TTS를 이용한 한글 학습 시스템에 있어서, 한글 학습을 위한 카드정보가 기록된 전자태그를 포함하는 글자카드; 및 사용자로부터 단말기 제어신호를 수신받고, 글자카드로부터 카드정보를 수신받으며, 외부장치로부터 단말기의 업데이트 신호를 수신받는 입력부와, 카드정보를 이용하여 글자카드가 다수 인식되는 경우에 위치분할정보를 판독하여 순차적으로 인식 가능하도록 전자태그를 판독하는 태그 판독부와, 카드정보와 단말기 제어신호를 이용하여 문자데이터와 언어데이터를 추출한 후, 음소를 음성으로 합성하는 TTS 합성부와, 카드정보, 단말기 제어신호, 그리고 단말기의 업데이트 신호를 저장하는 데이터 저장부와 전원부와, 사용자가 음소를 조합하여 글자를 안테나에 입력하는 경우에, 단말기 제어신호 및 카드정보를 이용하여 사용자가 현재 상황을 인지할 수 있는 명령어를 출력하는 명령부와, 음성합성 데이터 및 명령어를 음성으로 출력하는 출력부 및 제어부로 구성된 단말기; 를 포함한다. 
     본 발명에 따르면, 학습자 스스로가 자음 및 모음의 조합을 통해서 생성되는 다양한 글자를 음성으로 출력할 수 있는데 그 효과가 있다. 
       
     문자음성변환장치, TTS 합성부, 태그 판독부, 전자태그, 비접촉, 음성합성
assignees: H I TECH CO LTD;KWON KYUNG AHN

title_en: Protection circuit for regulator temperature of heating coil
title_ko: 전기매트 또는 전기온수매트 온도조절기의 온도제어 불능시 발열선의 과열을 방지하는 2중 과열방지 회로
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A double overheat preventing circuit is provided to prevent a fire or burning of a user by preventing the overheating of a heating wire when a power control device is short-circuited and/or an error occurs in a temperature setting control circuit. CONSTITUTION: A first heating circuit(100) and a second heating circuit(200) apply a trigger signal to a temperature setting control circuit by a setting temperature voltage and a comparison temperature voltage. An overheat detecting wire(300) transfers the short of a power control device to a temperature setting control circuit. A first overheat block circuit(400) blocks the power of the temperature controller or heating of the heating wire. A second overheat block circuit(500) blocks the heating of the heating wire using a voltage comparator when an error occurs in the overheat block circuit.

title_en: Vibration feature sensor
abstract_en: This invention relates to a vibration feature sensor. With space navigation and satellite time service function, it comprises an acceleration vibration pickup, a waveform recorder, a real-time process chip, a protective shell, an A/D circuit board to convert the acceleration signal acquired by the vibration pickup into digital signal and input into the process chip, and a GPS antenna and signal process unit to take space position and time service according to the satellite signal from the antenna and process the signal for earthquake decision by the preset threshold as well as outputting command signal. This invention has high precision and reliability.
assignees: ZHAO MING LI JIE YU ATAO

title_en: Mining rescue wireless video communication system
abstract_en: Provided is a mining rescue wireless video communication system. The mining rescue wireless video communication system is composed of an integration video transmitter and a wireless video receiver. The integration wireless video transmitter of equipment under the shaft is used for recording video on a site and sending the video to the wireless video receiver, and the wireless video is sent to a ground emergency rescue center through the Ethernet and the mine wireless mesh network, and then sent to the ground emergency rescue center again through a network in a mine temporary rescue base. The mining rescue wireless video communication system is used for emergency rescue. After accidents occur, the mining rescue wireless video communication system transmits multimedia information such as video images and sound in disaster areas in a wireless mode to the temporary rescue base, and then uploads the multimedia information to the ground emergency rescue center in a wired mode or in a wireless mode for decision and command.
assignees: BEIJING TOPSKY AUTOMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Double-power-supply centralized control device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of controllers, and relates to a double-power-supply centralized control device. A central controller is electrically connected with double-power-supply controllers 1-64 through industrial 485 buses. According to each double-power-supply controller, a central processing unit is electrically connected with a perpetual calendar clock circuit, a liquid crystal display, a conversion switching circuit, a voltage frequency and phase sequence detection circuit of a common power supply, a voltage frequency and phase sequence detection circuit of a standby power supply, a power supply circuit, an emergency tripping circuit, a position detection circuit, and an RS485 communication circuit; the central processing unit receives detection signals and controls switching between the command and standby power supplies, tripping, oil engine start-stop, and unloading output; and the RS485 communication circuit can complete remote setting of internal record or control parameters of the central processing unit and carry out emergency tripping and switching between manual and automatic control modes quickly. The double-power-supply centralized control device of the invention has the advantages of accurate detection, flexible control, reliable electricity utilization and real-time recording, and is used in airports, high-speed rails, chemical industry, metallurgy, shopping malls, hospitals, post and telecommunications, fire fighting and other important places in need of electricity.
assignees: TIANTAI XINRUAN ELECTRICAL APPLIANCE CO LTD

title_en: It is vehicle-to-vehicle directly to receive and dispatch the anti-emergency warning device that knocks into the back of automatic transmission
abstract_en: Vehicle-to-vehicle can directly receive and dispatch provided by the invention transmits the anti-emergency warning device that knocks into the back automatically, it is characterized in that：In radio in the operating system of automobile, automobile-used, in automotive avigraph, in driving recorder for vehicle, in mobile phone and in the quick transceiver of independent car networking, be provided in auto electronic flash of light triangle brand and can receive decoding and transmitting coding and automatic integrated control module (2), wireless receiving and the wireless transmission for transmitting coding and the wireless integration module (3) transmitted automatically；Its good effect is：It allows on highway each automobile that can shift to an earlier date 300 and 600 meters to hear：The urgent warning of " front occurs emergency, asks pre-decelerating ", the impulse inertia for being equivalent to the safe distance that can increase by 300 and 600 meters of pre-decelerating to each rear automobile or stop in advance, capable of thoroughly mitigating high speed car；It avoids high speed from fiercely colliding, avoid big traffic congestion of a chain of car crash accident to knock into the back, reduction highway etc. at a high speed that from can playing positive effect.

title_en: A kind of security against fire index statistical method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of security against fire index statistical method, including following processing steps：S1) extracts the relevant data of security against fire event；S2) counts fire-fighting security incident, obtains security against fire index.It is able to record the information such as the geographical location that security against fire dependent event occurs；The relevant information of security against fire event can be automatically extracted, and fire-fighting security incident is counted；Geographical location when managing area under one's jurisdiction according to administrative area under one's jurisdiction and public security department, occur according to security against fire event, counts fire-fighting security incident；Counted respectively according to the reason for causing during security against fire accident；Severity of consequence caused by according to fire-fighting accident occurs counts respectively；It can support, be traced up and down according to the belonging relation in area under one's jurisdiction and check statistic analysis result；Statistic analysis result can be sent to area under one's jurisdiction director.

title_en: Intelligent control application for safety and management of water-on-railway dirt-absorbing operation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of railway operation, in order to solve the technical problems of the control safety and the fine management of the existing personnel and equipment, the invention discloses an intelligent control application for the safety and the management of the water and dirt sucking operation on a railway, which comprises the following steps that S1, a water and dirt sucking unit is connected to an intelligent control platform; s2, analyzing and positioning identification of video data; s3, identifying abnormal behaviors and equipment conditions; s4, standardized operation data acquisition and analysis; step S5, the time and place of entering and exiting the field and the maintenance record of the equipment; s6, carrying out data statistical analysis on the sewage suction machine; s7, safety early warning and linkage are carried out, and a safety early warning system is constructed and used for instant notification, automatic shutdown and emergency response; and S8, early warning and safety linkage of the safety distance of the water column approaching the contact net. By real-time monitoring, human errors are reduced, overall efficiency and accuracy are improved, emergency capability is improved, and potential risks are reduced by means of instant notification, automatic shutdown and emergency response mechanisms.
assignees: HUAXIN ZHIYUN TECH GUANGDONG CO LTD

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency evacuation intelligent command system and method based on three-dimensional modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency evacuation intelligent command system and a method based on three-dimensional modeling, which relate to the technical field of fire-fighting emergency evacuation, wherein the system comprises: the emergency evacuation system comprises a management and control building site scanning modeling module, a management and control building site fire sensing module, an emergency evacuation route pre-planning module, an emergency evacuation route dynamic correction module, an emergency intelligent command module and a data cloud, wherein after a fire is sensed, the emergency evacuation route of a site evacuation object can be planned in time, and the emergency evacuation route of the site evacuation object can be obtained through correction processing, so that the limitation of the lack of dynamic correction and adjustment of the current emergency evacuation route is effectively overcome, the planned evacuation route can be adapted to specific situations of the site in time after a fire disaster occurs, the capability and efficiency of coping with emergency situations in the command evacuation process are improved, the timeliness of emergency evacuation is guaranteed, and the reliable command evacuation guarantee is provided for evacuees.
assignees: NANJING JIURUN SECURITY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent construction site equipment control method and system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent construction site equipment control method and system based on the Internet of things, and relates to the technical field of digital construction sites. When an abnormal situation state is detected, the system automatically generates a processing task, ensures the reliability of data transmission and the timeliness of emergency response through differential redundancy and dynamic priority redundancy strategies based on task demands, and improves the task processing efficiency by controlling the movement of the sensing node and changing the state of the node. The method effectively improves the intelligent level of the construction site management, enhances the dynamic response capability to complex situations, and is suitable for the efficient management of modern complex construction sites.
assignees: URUMQI HERUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Security protection integrated management system disappears
abstract_en: The invention provides a security protection integrated management system, which belongs to the technical field of fire protection and comprises a plurality of fire protection sensing devices, a server and a monitoring terminal, wherein the fire protection sensing devices are respectively arranged at different fire protection sites and are used for collecting video image data of the different fire protection sites, the server is in communication connection with the fire protection sensing devices and is used for carrying out time synchronization processing on the video image data collected by the fire protection sensing devices, fusing the synchronized video image data to obtain a fused image, extracting an interested region in the fused image, identifying a risk level of fire disaster corresponding to the interested region, and sending out an early warning command when the risk level exceeds a first preset level, and the monitoring terminal is in communication connection with the server and is used for sending out an alarm based on the early warning command. The fire alarm system can solve the technical problems of easiness in false alarm and low fire identification precision of the existing fire alarm system.
assignees: HUBEI FENGHUO PINGAN INTELLIGENT FIRE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive forest and grassland fire monitoring and emergency command method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of forest grassland fire emergency command and discloses a forest grassland fire comprehensive monitoring and emergency command method and system. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multisource monitoring data of satellites, unmanned aerial vehicles and ground sensors, constructing a fire scene multidimensional feature vector through collaborative training and feature fusion, inputting the feature vector into a physical simulation model to generate fire scene spreading speed and temperature gradient data, analyzing terrain obstacle coefficients based on the spreading speed data and generating helicopter no-fly zone coordinates and passing attenuation factors, solving and outputting rescue unit deployment instructions through a scheduling matrix, and utilizing an augmented reality terminal to project holographic images to realize dynamic closed-loop feedback. The invention solves the problem of cracking of traditional fire prediction and resource scheduling through deep fusion of physical mechanism and reinforcement learning, realizes intelligent decision of accurate prediction of fire and emergency response, and remarkably improves the accuracy and timeliness of fire prevention and control.
assignees: BEIJING JINLIN WEIYE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intergration environment monitoring system that the center control is possible
title_ko: 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An integrated environment monitoring system is provided to offer desirable building surroundings by comprehensively controlling environment within a building and to prevent the input of unnecessary manpower. CONSTITUTION: A MCU(Main Control unit)(20) generally control a system. A plurality of sensor units senses temperature and humidity within building, existence and nonexistence of an access, smoke, power state, and environment of a CCTV. A signal input unit(4), an image signal input unit(8), an ADC(Analog to Digital Converter), and GPIO(General Purpose Input/ Output) receives environmental information sensed in the sensor unit. A signal processing unit(30) processes the environmental information. An interface(13) transmits the processed environmental information to a client(14). The client outputs a transmitted environmental information result.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 기업, 정부기관, 건물 내의 자료를 저장 보관하는 서버 실과 같은 주요시설의 환경정보를 실시간 감시하여 획득한 정보를 통해 화재와 도난뿐만 아니라, 자료 소실 및 손실을 가질 수 있는 상황을 사전 감지하여 대응할 수 있도록 도와주는 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템이다. 
본 발명의 목적은  건물 내의 환경을 종합적으로 감시 및 제어하여 바람직한 건물 환경을 제공할 수 있도록 한 환경감시(온도, 습도),보안감시(출입자 유무 확인),화재감시(연기센서), 영상감시(CCTV),전원감시(Main 전원,보조전원(UPS)) 및 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템을 제공하는 데 그 목적이 있다. 
상기한 목적을 달성하기 위하여 본 발명에 따른 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템은, 
전체적인 제어를 위한 제어부(MCU)와, 건물 내의 환경감시, 보안감시, 화재감시, 영상감시, 전원감시 등의 환경을 감시하는 복수의 감지센서부(3)(5)(7)(9)(11)와, 상기 센 서부로부터 감지된 환경 정보가 입력되는 신호 입력부(4), Ext. Interrupt(6), 영상신호 입력부(8),ADC(10),GPIO(12)와, 
상기 부에 연결되어 환경 정보를 처리하는 신호처리부와, 처리된 환경 데이터를 클라이언트에 전송하는 인터페이스와, 전송된 환경정보 결과를 출력하는 클라이언트로 구성한다. 
상기 전송된 결과를 클라이언트의 환경 감시 프로그램으로 설정된 기준 정보 데이터를 초과 또는 이상 시 경보음을 울리게 한다. 
또한, 이러한 정보를 종합해서 상황을 유추할 수 있으며, 기준 정보 데이터의 설정 값과 경보음을 변경할 수 있도록 인터페이스 되어 있다. 추가로 상기 수집된 환경 정보와 통신연결 유무를 LAN 통신으로 중앙통제 감시 시스템에 전송하고 기 전송된 정보의 상황을 분석하여 해당 예하 클라이언트에 상황대처 지시를 하달할 수 있도록 설계한다. 
본 발명에 의한 중앙 통제가 가능한 통합 환경 감시 시스템은, 
상기와 같은 구성에 의하여 건물 내의 환경을 종합적으로 감시 및 제어하여 바람직한 건물 환경을 제공할 수 있다. 
구체적으로는, 환경 감시 및 제어 시스템에 의해 화재와 도난뿐만 아니라,그에 따른 상황을 사전 감지하여 대응할 수 있도록 도와주는 시스템이며, 건물 내의 환경감시, 보안감시, 화재감시, 영상감시, 전원감시 및 제어 시스템을 통합된 단일장치로 작동함으로써 추가적인 장치가 필요로 하지 않다. 
따라서 건물 내의 환경의 신뢰도를 높이고, 종합적이고 정확한 데이터의 입수를 가능하게 하여 불필요한 인력의 투입 및 사고를 방지함과 동시에 가장 적합한 제어 명령을 수행할 수 있다. 
또한, 중앙 통제 감시 시스템과 원격으로 통신하여 중앙기관 및 부서에서 본 발명의 클라이언트를 통제 또는 감시할 수도 있다.

title_en: The system which manages a tax invoice
title_ko: 세금계산서 관리시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A tax bill management system is provided for purchase companies to easily avoid damage caused by delay of unnecessary business flow caused by multiple accessing each computer module. CONSTITUTION: A TI(Tax Invoice) management control module(101) controls an acquisition process of issuing a tax bill issued by a selling company, and a management process of tax related data of a purchase company. After a TI acquisition module(104) acquires TI, the module stores the acquired TI into TRD storage database. A TI issuance authenticity confirmation module(105) reads the record breakdown of TI stored in the TRD storage database. [Reference numerals] (10) Online network; (101) TI management control module; (102) Interface module; (103) Management information storage module; (104) TI acquisition module; (105) TI issuance authenticity confirmation module; (106) TI issuance authenticity recording module; (107) National tax service data acquisition module; (108) National tax service legacy server lon-in support module; (109) National tax service data storage module; (110) IKD/TRD dialogue processing module; (111) IKD/TRD dialogue result processing module; (20) Purchasing company legacy server; (21) IKD storage D/B; (22) TRD storage D/B; (30) National tax service legacy server; (40) Mail server; (50) Information communicator of a purchasing company coordinator
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 세금계산서(TI: Tax Invoice) 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에서는 <매입업체 담당자 정보통신기 또는 메일 서버와 통신을 취하여, TI(Tax Invoice)를 취득한 후, 취득된 TI를 매입업체 기간계 서버에 의해 관리되는 TRD(The Tax Relation Data of the purchase company) 저장 D/B 내에 저장할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <매입업체 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, TRD 저장 D/B 내에 저장되어 있던 TI의 기록내역을 판독한 후, 국세청 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, TI와 동일 기록내역을 가지는 TI가 국세청 기간계 서버에 저장되어 있는지(즉, TI의 발행 진위여부)를 확인할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <TRD 저장 D/B 내에 저장되어 있던 TI의 발행 진위여부가 확인 완료되면, 매입업체 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, TRD 저장 D/B 내에 TI의 발행 진위여부를 기록할 수 있는 전산모듈> 등을 체계적으로 배치 제공하고, 이를 통해, 매입업체 측에서 별다른 어려움 없이 매출업체 측의 TI 발행사실 국세청 신고여부, TI 임의 취소내역, TI 국세청 수정신고내역 등을 실시간 확인할 수 있도록 함은 물론 악의의 소속직원에 의한 TI의 위/변조 사실도 실시간으로 파악할 수 있도록 함으로써, 필요절차의 진행지체 문제점, 무자료 지출사고의 유발 문제점, TI의 위/변조에 따른 각종 손실발생 문제점 등을 손쉽게 회피할 수 있도록 가이드 할 수 있다.  
또한, 본 발명에서는 <국세청 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, 매입업체에 상응하는 각종 국세청데이터를 일괄 취득할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <매입업체 기간계 서버와 통신을 취하여, 취득 완료된 국세청데이터를 TRD 저장 D/B 내에 일괄 저장할 수 있는 전산모듈>, <TI 또는 국세청데이터가 TRD 저장 D/B 내에 저장 완료된 상황에서, 매입업체 기간계 서버에 의해 관리되는 매입업체 측 내부관리데이터(IKD: The Internal-Keeping Date which is managed by the purchase company)와 TRD 저장 D/B 내에 저장되어 있던 TI/국세청데이터의 일치여부를 대사하고, 해당 대사에 상응하는 IKD/TRD 대사결과 데이터를 생성한 후, 생성 완료된 IKD/TRD 대사결과 데이터를 매입업체 담당자 정보통신기, 매입업체 담당자 측 메일 서버 등으로 전송할 수 있는 전산모듈> 등을 체계적으로 배치 제공하고, 이를 통해, 매입업체 측에서 장시간의 불필요한 수작업 절차(예컨대, 국세청데이터를 각 건별로 일일이 수집하는 수작업 절차, 수집 완료된 각 건별 국세청데이터를 하나의 데이터로 일일이 병합하는 수작업 절차, 병합 완료된 국세청 데이터를 매입업체 측 내부데이터와 일일이 비교하여, 누락 정보, 이중발행정보 등을 상세히 확인하는 수작업 절차 등) 없이도, 일련의 부가세 합계 표 작성절차를 단시간 내에 효과적으로 완수할 수 있도록 함으로써, 해당 부가세 합계 표 작성절차에 상응하는 각종 인적/물적 손실을 손쉽게 회피할 수 있도록 가이드 할 수 있다. 
나아가, 본 발명에서는 데이터 취득용 전산모듈들이 자신에게 필요한 일련의 데이터 취득을 위해 국세청 기간계 서버 측으로 통신을 시도할 때, 매입업체에 상응하는 복수의 공인인증정보를 해당 전산모듈 측으로 일괄 제공할 수 있는 로그인 지원용 전산모듈을 추가 배치 제공하고, 이를 통해, 국세청 기간계 서버에 통신 시도 중인 각 전산모듈들이 별다른 어려움 없이 매입업체에 상응하는 모든 사업자번호 명의로 국세청 기간계 서버에 일괄 로그인 할 수 있도록 함으로써, 매입업체 측에서 각 전산모듈들의 국세청 전산망 복수 접속에 의해 발생할 수 있는 불필요한 업무 흐름 지연 피해를 손쉽게 회피할 수 있도록 가이드 할 수 있다.

title_en: Detecting apparatus and method for signs of form collapse
title_ko: 거푸집 붕괴징후 검출장치 및 그 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A mold collapse sign detecting device and a method are provided to prevent accidents due to the collapse of a mold by detecting the change applied to the mold with a sensor. CONSTITUTION: A mold collapse sign detecting device comprises a clamp(30), a sensor(40), an A/D converter, a microcontroller, and a warning unit. The state in which the clamp is interlocked to a mold frame is detected by the sensor. Detected data is outputted from the sensor in a predetermined time after detecting the interlocking of the clamp and is memorized as a standard value. Change value applied to the mold frame is calculated by periodically comparing the detected data and the standard value. When the change value exceeds critical value, a warning signal is outputted.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유로폼, 알폼, 목재폼 등과 같은 거푸집의 조립부위에 설치되어 콘크리트 타설 중 또는 양생 중에 발생할 수 있는 거푸집의 붕괴징후를 미리 예측하여 경고할 수 있도록 한 거푸집 붕괴징후 검출장치 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로, 거푸집(20)(22)의 조립부위에 설치되는 클램프(30)와, 클램프(30)에 설치되어 거푸집(20)(22) 간의 변위를 검출하기 위한 센서(40)와, 센서(40)로부터 출력되는 아날로그 출력값을 디지털신호로 변환하기 위한 A/D컨버터(50)와, A/D컨버터(50)로부터 출력되는 디지털신호와 기준치를 주기적으로 비교하여 거푸집붕괴 징후를 판독한 후 경보신호를 출력하는 마이크로콘트롤러(60)와, 마이크로콘트롤러(60)로부터 출력되는 경보신호에 의해 구동되는 경고부(70)로 구성된 것이다. 
따라서 본 발명은 거푸집에 붕괴징후가 있는 경우 육안으로 확인이 어려운 거푸집에 가해지는 변화를 센서를 이용해서 검출하여 경고할 수 있도록 구성되어 있기 때문에 거푸집 붕괴로 인한 인명사고와 물적낭비를 사전에 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.
