title_en: A prefabricated furnace a scaffolding an air furnace combined with 3 different air turbine omitted
title_ko: A prefabricated furnace에 설치한 a scaffolding과 an air furnace combined with 3 different air turbines들을 조합 이용하여 산사태지역,축대, 지진피해 저감과 중수 재활용과 눈, 빙판을 해결한 길 (도로)
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a road capable of preventing an accident by preventing the accident of a material transfer unit by a tower or a scaffolding on structure installation by being directly manufactured and installed in a place in which production and a structure are necessary, by using a furnace, a formed object to be plastic and installed in the furnace, and the scaffolding used to move and install the formed object. The furnace is moved and assembled. Also, the furnace is separated. The formed object prevents deformation while being sintered and helps the movement, the assembly, and the separation of the furnace. In a special area requiring thawing or the road in winter, hot water and hot air are supplied. An air turbine, a compressed air jetting device, an air pumper (compression and suction), an air furnace combined with three different air turbines with increased capacity and improved compression, and a super heater supply the hot water and the hot air. Also, a cooling discharging device is installed without damaging a human body. Many kinds of air suction pipes use the air in multiple places. The air is discharged by a suction pump and a compression pump to perform an air circulation roll in a structure.

title_en: Internet of Thing multifunction integration module system and method for Smart city
title_ko: 스마트 시티를 위한 IoT 다기능 통합 모듈시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an IoT multifunctional integrated module system and method for a smart city, which can perform integrated monitoring facilities and abnormalties including electric leakage, water leakage, flashing of streetlights and security lights, switchboards, CCTVs, etc. The IoT multifunctional integrated module system comprises: a central management server unit that analyzes, stores, and controls information obtained through the Internet of Things (IoT) and information input from sensors; a gateway unit that consists of a wireless interface connecting the central management server unit and the sensors; a sensor-detecting wireless network that communicates with the central management server bidirectionally and provides a wireless network environment to facilities (street lights, security lights, CCTVs, LEDs, bus stops); a wireless communication unit that transmits sensing states of the sensors and transmission/reception signals of the sensors to the sensor-detecting wireless network; an object-detecting sensor unit that detects, records, and stores a movement of an approaching object and transmits the number of detected objects to the central management server unit; a smart sensor unit that transmits whether there are abnormalities in fine dust, air, and air quality to the central management server unit, and controls lighting and illumination for the facilities; a smart control unit that receives and controls commands transmitted from the central management server unit or a smartphone; and a smart street light distribution board that interworks with the smart sensor unit and includes a fine dust notification unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 스마트 시티를 위한 IoT 다기능 통합 모듈시스템 및 방법에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 사물인터넷(IoT)을 통해 얻어진 정보와 센서로부터 입력되는 정보를 분석하여 저장 및 제어하는 중앙관리서버부와 상기 중앙관리서버부와 상기 센서를 연결시키는 무선 인터페이스로 이루어진 게이트웨어부와 상기 중앙관리서버부와 양방향 통신하며, 시설물(가로등, 보안등, CCTV, LED, 버스정류소)에 무선네트워크 환경을 제공하는 센서감지무선네트워크와 상기 센서의 감지상태와 센서의 송수신 신호를 상기 센서감지무선네트워크에 전달하는 무선통신부와 접근하는 물체의 이동을 감지하여 기록, 저장하면서 상기 감지된 물체의 개체수를 상기 중앙관리서버부로 전송하는 물체감지센서부와 미세먼지, 대기와 공기질의 이상 유무를 상기 중앙관리서버부로 전송하고, 상기 시설물의 조명 및 조도의 조절을 하는 스마트센서부와 상기 중앙관리서버부 또는 스마트폰에서 전송되는 명령을 수신하고 제어하는 스마트제어부와 상기 스마트센서부와 연동하며, 미세먼지 알림부가 구비된 스마트 가로등분전반을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for supporting conducting scientific experiments for education using sensor kit and programming tool
title_ko: 센서 키트 및 프로그래밍 툴을 이용한 교육용 과학 실험 수행 지원 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: Disclosed are a method and an apparatus for supporting educational science experiment execution using a sensor kit and a programming tool. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method for supporting educational science experiment execution using a sensor kit and a programming tool comprises the steps of: receiving a program written using at least one program command block for performing a first educational science experiment from a user terminal through a programming tool; receiving a sensor value from a first sensor connected to the user terminal according to the execution of the program command block corresponding to the reception of the first sensor value included in the program; and providing the performance result of the first educational science experiment visualizing the entire execution result of the program including the processing of the sensor value.
abstract_ko: 센서 키트 및 프로그래밍 툴을 이용한 교육용 과학 실험 수행 지원 방법 및 장치가 개시된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 센서 키트 및 프로그래밍 툴을 이용한 교육용 과학 실험 수행 지원 방법은 사용자 단말로부터 프로그래밍 툴을 통해 제1 교육용 과학 실험의 수행을 위한 적어도 하나의 프로그램 명령 블록을 이용하여 작성된 프로그램을 입력 받는 단계, 상기 프로그램에 포함된 제1 센서 값 수신에 대응하는 프로그램 명령 블록의 실행에 따라, 상기 사용자 단말에 연결된 상기 제1 센서로부터 센서 값을 수신하는 단계 및 상기 센서 값의 처리를 포함하는 상기 프로그램의 전체 실행 결과를 시각화한 상기 제1 교육용 과학 실험의 수행 결과를 제공하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Attachable display pad module for fire extinguishers, control method and recording medium for performing the same
title_ko: 진압대원을 위한 어태처블 디스플레이 패드 모듈, 제어 방법 및 이를 수행하기 위한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an attachable display pad module for a suppressor, which comprises: a communication unit communicating with a server and a wearing device; a stretchable display provided to be deformable in shape and outputting dispatch information and action information related to fire suppression received from the server; a detachable unit provided in a part of the stretchable display to be detachable from at least one of a transfer means and clothes of the suppressor; and a control unit dividing an area of the stretchable display when an event condition provided in advance is satisfied, and controlling structure temperature information displaying biometric information for the suppressor and temperature information received from a thermal imaging camera, which is at least one of the wearing device, on a structure map to be output to each of the divided areas. Through this, the extinguisher who extinguishes the fire at the fire site can smoothly extinguish the fire and protect the lives of the extinguisher.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 진압대원을 위한 어태처블 디스플레이 패드 모듈에 관한 것으로, 서버 및 착용 장치와 통신하는 통신부; 형상 변형이 가능하도록 마련되고, 상기 서버로부터 수신되는 화재 진압과 관련된 출동 정보 및 조치 정보가 출력되는 스트레처블 디스플레이(Stretchable display); 이송 수단 및 상기 진압대원의 의복 중 적어도 하나에 탈부착되도록 상기 스트레처블 디스플레이의 일부에 구비되는 탈부착부; 및 사전에 마련되는 이벤트 조건을 만족하면, 상기 스트레처블 디스플레이의 영역을 분할하고, 상기 진압대원을 위한 생체 정보, 그리고 상기 구조물 지도 상에 상기 착용 장치 중 적어도 하나인 열화상 카메라로부터 수신한 온도 정보를 표시한 구조물 온도 정보가 상기 분할한 영역 각각에 출력되도록 제어하는 제어부를 포함한다. 이를 통해 화재 현장에서 화재를 진압하는 진압대원이 화재의 진압을 원활하게 수행할 수 있도록 하는 것은 물론 진압대원의 인명을 보호할 수 있다.

title_en: Real-Time Data Acquisition and Recording System Viewer
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and viewer for mobile assets that includes a data encoder, onboard data manager, and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Providing a gui to enable analysis of time-synchronized data sets pertaining to a road segment
abstract_en: Techniques for collecting, synchronizing, and displaying various types of data relating to a road segment enable, via one or more local or remote processors, servers, transceivers, and/or sensors, (i) enhanced and contextualized analysis of vehicle events by way of synchronizing different data types, relating to a monitored road segment, collected via various different types of data sources; (ii) enhanced and contextualized analysis of filed insurance claims pertaining to a vehicle incident at a road segment; (iii) advantageous machine learning techniques for predicting a level of risk assumed for a given vehicle event or a given road segment; (iv) techniques for accounting for region-specific driver profiles when controlling autonomous vehicles; and/or (v) improved techniques for providing a GUI to display collected data in a meaningful and contextualized manner.
assignees: STATE FARM MUTUAL AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE CO

title_en: Distributed timed task management method and system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a distributed timed task management method and a system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: sending the timing task to an application container engine so that the application container engine sends a registration request for registering the timing task to an application program coordination server and the timing task is registered to a service node of the application program coordination server; acquiring the real-time state of a timing task and real-time information in an application container engine from an application program coordination server; writing the real-time state of the timing task and the real-time information in the application container engine into a database; and formulating a disaster recovery strategy according to all historical records in the database. The method can dynamically modify the task execution time and issue the execution command of the task by monitoring the real-time state of the task and the internal operation condition of the application container engine and combining the historical record of the task, so that the task management is more flexible, the disaster recovery strategy customization is completed, the business risk is effectively reduced, and the closed loop of the task scheduling management is really achieved.

title_en: Method and system for identifying causal relationship of dam emergency event based on feature fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for identifying causal relationship of dam emergency events based on feature fusion, which are used for carrying out event marking on dam safety operation log data and dam emergency response record information; embedding event trigger word information by adopting BERT, and outputting event context characteristics; learning logic event causal relations in the map by using a graph representation method of an countermeasure generation formula, and expanding causal semantic features of the events; constructing grammar dependence paths among events, and learning grammar dependence relationships expressing causal relationships; and splicing and fusing the characteristic information of the context, the semantics and the grammar. The invention fuses the triple characteristic information of the context, the semantic and the grammar, can help to quickly and accurately identify the causal relationship existing between events when abnormal events such as leakage, cracks and the like occur in the dam, and improves the judgment and decision making capability of staff on the events, thereby better making emergency plans and predicting possible problems.

title_en: Agricultural disaster early warning and emergency response method integrating weather big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of agricultural disaster treatment, and discloses an agricultural disaster early warning and emergency response method integrating weather big data. The method comprises the steps of receiving heterogeneous meteorological data flow of a target area, performing space-time alignment and feature fusion through a disaster feature decoupling model, and generating a disaster potential energy field distribution map and a disaster category probability matrix. And constructing a self-adaptive early warning threshold model, and generating a multi-mode emergency response instruction set. Simulating a disaster secondary event cascade effect by using a disaster chain propagation model, optimizing collaborative decision parameters, and outputting a disaster response action sequence to an agricultural emergency command platform through iterative optimization of a distributed reinforcement learning framework. According to the method, meteorological big data are comprehensively utilized, the early warning accuracy of agricultural disasters is improved, high-efficiency emergency response is achieved, resources are reasonably allocated, cross-department coordination is promoted, and the agricultural disaster loss is effectively reduced.

title_en: System and method for global remittance service based on the bitcoin
title_ko: 비트코인을 기반으로 하는 이종국가간 송금시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for a global remittance service based on a bitcoin. The system includes: a remitter terminal (100) transmitting foreign country remittance request information; a country bitcoin exchange server (200) generating and transmitting the foreign country remittance guidance information for a remittee; block chain retention servers (300) recording the bitcoin payment transaction information for different country remittance; a foreign country remittee terminal (400) guiding a remittee to look through the foreign country remittance guidance information for a remittee; a foreign country currency payment terminal (500) generating and transmitting remittance payment request information; and a foreign country bitcoin exchange server (600) allowing a country remittance conversion foreign country remittance amount to be withdrawn.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 타국에 거주하는 수취인의 연락처만으로도 글로벌 송금서비스를 수행할 수 있을 뿐만 아니라 일국의 송금인이 보내는 송금액을 타국의 수취인이 CD나 ATM을 통해 제공받을 수 있게 안내하며, 현금으로 사용가능한 디지털 화폐로, 세계적으로 동일한 가치를 형성하는 비트코인을 기반으로 글로벌 송금서비스를 안내하는 수단을 통해 송금인이 자신이 보내는 송금액수를 타국의 화폐비율로 인지가능하고, 비트코인을 기반으로 하는 글로벌 송금서비스 중 인증수단으로 이용되는 중요 정보가 유출되어도 금융사고 발생을 예방하여 주는 수단이 구비된 비트코인을 기반으로 하는 이종국가간 송금시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 수취인 국가명, 일국의 화폐 단위로 표시된 송금액수 및 수취인 전화번호로 이루어진 타국 송금요청정보를 전송하는 일국 송금인 단말(100)과; 상기 일국 송금인 단말(100)로부터 전송된 타국 송금요청정보에 포함된 수취인 국가명을 참조하여, 일국의 화폐 단위로 표시된 송금액수를 비트코인으로 환율하고, 그 환율된 비트코인의 결제를 요청하는 이종국가 송금용 비트코인 결제 트랜잭션정보를 생성하여 전송하며, 상기 전송된 타국 송금요청정보를 참조하여 일국의 화폐 단위로 표시된 송금액수를 비트코인으로 환율한 송금액 변환 비트코인 금액, 일국 송금인정보, 수취인 전화번호로 이루어진 거래소용 타국 송금안내정보를 생성하여 전송하고, 상기 전송된 타국 송금요청정보에 포함된 수취인 전화번호를 참조하여, 일국의 화폐 단위로 표시된 송금액수가 타국의 화폐단위로 환율변환되어 표시된 일국 송금액 변환 타국 송금액수 및 일국 송금인정보로 이루어진 수취인용 타국 송금안내정보를 생성하여 전송하는 일국 비트코인 거래소서버(200)와; 블록체인이 탑재된 것으로, 상기 일국 비트코인 거래소서버(200)로부터 전송된 이종국가 송금용 비트코인 결제 트랜잭션정보를 검증을 통해 비트코인 결제를 인증하고, 그 인증에 따라 이종국가 송금용 비트코인 결제 트랜잭션정보를 상기 블록체인에 기록하는 블록체인 보유서버(300)들과; 타국에 거주하는 수취인이 보유한 단말로, 상기 일국 비트코인 거래소서버(200)로부터 전송된 수취인용 타국 송금안내정보를 수취인이 열람가능하게 안내하는 타국 수취인 단말(400)과; 수취인 국가인 타국에 위치하여, 타국에서 통용되는 현지화폐의 인출서비스를 제공하는 단말로, 수취인이 입력한 일국 송금액 변환 타국 송금액수 및 수취인 전화번호로 이루어진 송금액 지급요청정보를 생성하여 전송하는 타국 통용화폐 지급단말(500)과; 상기 일국 비트코인 거래소서버(200)로부터 전송되는 거래소용 타국 송금안내정보를 수신하는 곳으로, 상기 타국 통용화폐 지급단말(500)로부터 전송된 송금액 지급요청정보에 포함된 일국 송금액 변환 타국 송금액수 및 수취인 전화번호가 상기 수신된 거래소용 타국 송금안내정보에 포함된 일국 송금액 변환 타국 송금액수 및 수취인 전화번호와 매칭하여 동일하면 상기 타국 통용화폐 지급단말(500)로 일국 송금액 변환 타국 송금액수가 인출되도록 안내하는 타국 비트코인 거래소서버(600);로 이루어진다.

title_en: Extended reality-based education and training system having an actual equipment linkage function and education and training method using the same
title_ko: 실장비 연동기능이 구비된 확장 현실 기반의 교육 훈련시스템 및 그것을  이용한 교육 훈련 방법
abstract_en: Provided in the present invention are: an extended reality-based education and training system, in which an actual equipment linkage function that will allow for extended reality-based firing procedures training capabilities, firing class/trainee-specific training capabilities through multiple access, instructor training oversight capabilities through the training control system, and learning-to-fire capabilities for inexperienced proficiency training is equipped through a training and education system that includes a fire command and control system implemented in a realistic environment; and an education and training method using the same. The present invention comprises: an instructor's kit for setting up training scenarios and controlling exercises; a training server that processes and stores training status data while interfacing with the above instructor equipment; a trainee equipment that is connected to the above training server to execute training according to training procedures or programs provided by the instructor equipment and formed into an environment similar to the actual equipment for the trainee to board and execute the training; and a fire command and control equipment that is connected to the training server through socket communication or wired or wireless communication network and transmits fire command and control commands that are interlocked with real equipment to the training server for execution.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 실제와 유사한 환경으로 구현된 사격 지휘 통제 체계를 포함하는 교육 훈련 시스템을 통해, 확장 현실 기반 사격 절차 훈련 능력과, 다중 접속을 통한 발사 반/훈련생별 교육 훈련 능력과, 훈련 통제 시스템을 통한 교관의 훈련 총괄 능력과, 미숙련자 숙달 교육을 위한 학습 훈련 능력을 보유할 수 있도록 하는 실장비 연동기능이 구비된 확장 현실 기반의 교육 훈련 시스템 및 그것을 이용한 교육 훈련 방법을 제공한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명은 훈련 시나리오 설정 및 훈련 통제를 위한 교관용 장비와; 상기 교관용 장비와 연동하면서 훈련 상태 데이터를 처리 및 저장하는 훈련용 서버와; 상기 훈련용 서버와 연결되어 교관용 장비로부터 제공된 훈련 절차 혹은 프로그램에 따라 훈련을 실행하고 교육생이 탑승하여 훈련을 실행하도록 실제 장비와 유사한 환경으로 형성된 교육생 장비와; 상기 훈련용 서버에 소켓통신 혹은 유무선통신망을 통해 연결되어 실장비와 연동되는 사격지휘통제 명령을 훈련용서버로 전송하여 실행되게 하는 사격 지휘 통제 장비를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Emergency response system
abstract_en: A server application that includes a receiving module for receiving a plurality of user information from a first mobile computing device, including a user name, user contact information, a plan having an end time and plan location, an emergency contact name, emergency contact information and a list of estimated emergency services required by the user in case of an emergency. The application includes an initiation module for reading the user information, creating a user record, and storing it in an attached database. A transmitting module detects the end time of the plan, then generates and sends a first message to the user. If the user does not respond, a transmitting module generates and sends a second message to the emergency contact. If the emergency contact does not respond, a transmitting module sends a third message to an emergency response organization requesting estimated emergency response services.

title_en: Power monitoring system for firefighting device
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a power monitoring system for firefighting device, including power supply circuit, the minimum system of singlechip, voltage acquisition module, 485 communication module, independent function button, LCD display, news chinese percussion instrument warning circuit and voltage current sensor, power supply circuit, voltage acquisition module and independent function button's output signal transmits the minimum system of singlechip to, the output signal of the minimum system of singlechip conveys to LCD display homeway. Com chinese percussion instrument warning circuit, the minimum system of singlechip respectively with 485 communication module and the two -way data communication of voltage current sensor, the utility model discloses not only having the device power malfunction alerting function, can also indicateing specific warning position, carry out records reserve to alarm information, when preventing that the fire incident from appearing, the fire -fighting equipment causes fire spreading to arrive the emergence of the circumstances of unable effective control because of the unable normal work of power failure.

title_en: Highway tunnel operation management and control system
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway tunnel operation management and control system, which comprises an intelligent tunnel operation management and control platform, a comprehensive monitoring system, an emergency cooperative command system, a data analysis and auxiliary decision system, a communication system and a platform management system, wherein the intelligent tunnel operation management and control platform comprises a platform management platform, a platform management system and a platform management system; the intelligent tunnel operation control platform is respectively connected with the comprehensive monitoring system, the emergency cooperative command system and the data analysis and auxiliary decision system through the communication system and is used for operation of management personnel; the comprehensive monitoring system is used for monitoring the running states of all facilities in the tunnel in real time; the emergency cooperative command system is used for linking various facilities in the tunnel to quickly process according to a preset plan when an accident occurs in the tunnel; the data analysis and auxiliary decision system is used for evaluating the running state of the tunnel, supporting a safety management decision, carrying out statistical analysis on operation data and supporting a special decision; the platform management system is used for managing basic information, electromechanical equipment, system logs, alarm records and telephone records in the system.

title_en: Centerless ad hoc network emergency communication command method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a centerless ad hoc network emergency communication command method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of distributing communication frequency, channel resources, power control parameters and routing strategies for all nodes in a network; the method comprises the steps of generating an initial connection relation table among nodes and an initial topological structure of a network according to communication frequency and channel resources, distributing route paths leading to other nodes for each node and recording, collecting real-time communication load data of links on the route paths, calculating link communication congestion degree, updating the node connection relation and the route paths according to the congestion degree, generating an emergency communication task model, determining task priority and distributing tasks to nodes meeting the conditions, synchronously updating the communication frequency, the channel resources and the route paths of the nodes, starting the nodes in an ad hoc network to execute the emergency communication tasks, and improving network performance and task scheduling reliability.
assignees: SHENZHEN CITY HUAXIASHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium based on unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency and energy scheduling, and discloses an emergency scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium based on unmanned aerial vehicles, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring each unmanned aerial vehicle path from a starting point coordinate to an end point coordinate; generating a model according to the risk of each grid in each unmanned aerial vehicle path, the flight distance of each voyage in each unmanned aerial vehicle path and preset cost, generating the cost of each unmanned aerial vehicle path, selecting the unmanned aerial vehicle path with the minimum cost as a preferable unmanned aerial vehicle path, acquiring an unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling scheme corresponding to the preferable unmanned aerial vehicle path, generating the total loss cost corresponding to the unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling scheme according to the user loss cost, the load recovery cost and the energy storage battery deployment cost, and selecting the unmanned aerial vehicle scheduling scheme as an emergency scheduling scheme of a power failure area when the total loss cost is smaller than the preset loss cost. The application is beneficial to improving the timeliness of emergency response.

title_en: SIS system parallel access and compression method for multi-source heterogeneous data
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power plant automation and industrial control, and particularly discloses a SIS system parallel access and compression method of multi-source heterogeneous data, which comprises the steps of discriminating the value of a signal at a data source according to a physical fluctuation threshold, filtering redundant information to reduce network load and improve timeliness of key data; and through the two-channel hardware-level redundancy and seamless automatic switching, reliable toughness transmission guarantee is provided for the data stream. The method also establishes an emergency recovery closed loop independent of the main system, namely, when the main control unit is diagnosed to fail and gives an alarm, an emergency take-over instruction is triggered by authorization to generate a hardware take-over certificate, an operator immediately inserts the hardware take-over certificate into the intelligent storage device in a physical hot plug mode, point-to-point connection is established, a working condition hot film section which is independently cached in advance is rapidly loaded, a failure server and a network are bypassed, and a temporary emergency command station is generated, so that the continuity of core working condition monitoring under extreme faults is ensured.
assignees: GUONENG ZHUMADIAN THERMAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for extracting black box emergency video considering drive-situation and apparatus thereof
title_ko: 주행 상황을 고려한 블랙박스 긴급 동영상 추출 방법 및 장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides a method and an apparatus for extracting a black box emergency video considering a driving situation. The apparatus comprises an emergency section extracting engine which collects and stores a location, a direction, a velocity, a slope of a vehicle main body, acceleration/brake information, and a vehicle failure code through a GPS, a sensor, and an OBD apparatus, combines GPS and motion sensor information and OBD apparatus providing information providing specific information including a driving state and a failure of the vehicle, collects and analyzes the state and the failure code of the vehicle before and after an occurrence of collision, and sets a section to be recorded through an actual emergency video. The emergency section extracting engine can be utilized for notifying an occurrence of emergency situation in an accident detecting engine embedded in the black box, detects the emergency section when recognizing accidents while maintaining the emergency section, and provides the result of the detection to an emergency video generating module.
abstract_ko: 주행 상황을 고려한 블랙박스 긴급 동영상 추출 방법 및 장치를 제공하며, 상기 장치는 GPS, 센서 및 OBD 장치를 통해, 위치, 방향, 속도, 차량 본체의 기울기, 가속/제동 정보, 차량 고장코드를 수집하여 저장하며, GPS, 모션 센서의 정보, 차량의 주행 상태 및 고장 유무를 포함하는 상세 정보를 제공하는 OBD 장치 제공 정보를 결합하여, 충돌 발생 이전 또는 이후에 차량의 상태 및 고장코드의 수집 및 분석을 통하여 실제 긴급 영상을 통해 기록할 구간을 설정하는 긴급구간 추출엔진을 포함하고, 긴급구간 추출엔진은 블랙박스에 내장된 사고감지 엔진에 긴급상황 발생 여부를 알려주는데 활용할 수 있으며, 긴급 구간 유지 중 사고가 인지되면 긴급 구간의 검출 및 검출 결과를 긴급 동영상 생성 모듈에 제공한다.

title_en: Disaster-tolerant testing method, apparatus and server
abstract_en: A disaster-tolerant testing method, apparatus and server are provided. The method involves sending a code stream request command to a manufacturing machine to request to obtain a real calling code stream, in which the code stream including a service calling code stream and a signaling of an intelligent network for starting up the disaster-tolerant testing; after receiving the code stream, establishing an analog call, and generating an analog calling record of the call; obtaining a real calling record of the call from the manufacturing machine and comparing the content of the real calling record and the analog calling record to judge whether they are coincident to verify whether the disaster-tolerant machine is normal. A disaster-tolerant machine used to disaster-tolerant testing and a manufacturing machine which is capable of disaster-tolerant testing are also provided.
assignees: HUAWEI TECH CO LTD;LI XIAOMING;WU XIAOJING

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.

title_en: A kind of multifunctional traffic management, burst accident commander's disposal system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of the more function traffic management and burst accident commander's disposal system and methods, it is desirable to provide a kind of a variety of intelligent management schemes for being suitble to dredge the congestion that directs traffic under a variety of environment；The social and natural disaster for commander's disposition burst provides a kind of efficient integrated signal system and product simultaneously, and avoids or reduces the organization and administration scheme of casualties.Multifunctional traffic management, burst accident commander's disposal system and method for the present invention include vision signal module, audio signal module, setting Keysheet module by hand, artificial broadcast module, timing and clock module, camera module of recording a video, illegal trigger module, lighting module, micro controller module, power supply and power supply module.The present invention is widely used in urban and suburban roads traffic administration, and particular application urban congestion dredging and commanding, and the commander of emergency event and disaster accident disposes management domain.

title_en: Intelligent triage training system based on sudden public events
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent triage training system based on sudden public events, in particular relates to the triage training field, and aims to solve the problem that the existing triage training is lack of pertinence. The method comprises the steps of searching a history record of an emergency public event through a tree construction module, constructing a triage strategy time sequence tree, marking response bias factors through a bias recognition module, constructing a bias path library, converting the bias factors into interference options in a simulation training process through an interference generation module, setting interference induction weight and time compression parameters of the interference options through an interference setting module, collecting training object response data through a dead zone recognition module, constructing a bias trend intensity curve, recognizing triage bias dead zones, and finally using the recognized bias dead zones as key targets of a current training period through a bias training module to carry out training. The system can realize intelligent identification and targeted training of diagnosis-dividing cognition weak links, and improves accuracy and timeliness of diagnosis-dividing emergency response.

title_en: Construction method of intelligent highway control plan of double emergency lanes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of an intelligent control plan of an expressway with double emergency lanes, which is characterized in that the data of a road are acquired in real time through determining a traffic control comprehensive condition index calculation formula of the road to be controlled, traffic control comprehensive condition characteristics are constructed, a control plan cluster is produced, then a target plan and a plan execution effect and an execution condition thereof are obtained through calculation and simulation verification and recorded into a plan library, so that the expressway with double emergency lanes can be quickly searched for directly providing a solution when dealing with accidents of high-flow traffic or inner lanes, the emergency response speed is higher, and a series of plans in the control plan cluster are respectively and transversely compared through two angles of index calculation and simulation, thereby avoiding errors caused by unreasonable values of influence factor parameters, simultaneously obtaining the emergency target plan with high traffic efficiency and low secondary accident risk, and greatly improving the traffic efficiency of vehicles.

title_en: Fire event probabilistic stability evaluation uncertainty analysis system and analysis method
title_ko: 화재사건 확률론적 안정성평가 불확실성 분석시스템 및 분석방법
abstract_ko: 화재사건 확률론적 안정성평가 불확실성 분석시스템 및 분석방법을 제공한다. 화재사건 확률론적 안정성평가 불확실성 분석시스템으로서, 분석 대상인 화재구역 내의 점화원을 조사하는 점화원 조사모듈; 상기 화재구역 내 상기 점화원에 대한 PSA 모델 입력 데이터베이스를 생성하는 데이터베이스 생성모듈; 상기 데이터베이스를 기반으로 화재사건 특유 고려인자에 대한 불확실성 분석을 위한 기본사건정보를 구성하는 고장수목을 제공하는 고장수목 제공모듈; 상기 고장수목 제공부의 상기 고장수목을 정량화한 정량화정보를 제공하는 정량화 처리모듈; 상기 정량화정보를 기반으로 사고 완화계통의 이용 불능을 유발하는 최소기기 조합의 미니멀 컷셋을 생성하는 컷셋 생성모듈; 상기 미니멀 컷셋을 기반으로 로그정규분포를 설정하는 분포 설정모듈을 포함한다.

title_en: Apparatus for Deep Learning-based Event Detection and Driving Method Thereof
title_ko: 딥러닝 기반 이벤트검지장치 및 그 장치의 구동방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a deep learning-based event detection device and a driving method thereof. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the deep learning-based event detection device comprises: a storage unit storing a photographed image of a camera detecting a designated area; and a control unit applying the stored photographed image to a deep learning program to analyze the stored photographed image to detect a fire object of flame or smoke, tracking the detected fire object to analyze movement, and further determining an analysis result of human objects including falling of a person in the designated area when determining whether there is a fire based on the movement analysis result to generate an event or event notification of an accident.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 딥러닝 기반 이벤트검지장치 및 그 장치의 구동방법에 관한 것으로서, 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 딥러닝 기반 이벤트검지장치는, 지정 영역을 감지하는 카메라의 촬영 영상을 저장하는 저장부, 및 저장한 촬영 영상을 딥러닝 프로그램에 적용해 분석하여 불꽃이나 연기의 화재 객체를 검출 및 검출한 화재 객체를 추적하여 움직임을 분석하며, 움직임 분석 결과를 근거로 화재 여부를 판단할 때 지정 영역에서의 사람의 쓰러짐을 포함하는 사람 객체들의 분석 결과를 더 판단하여 사건이나 사고의 이벤트 알림을 발생시키는 제어부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Portable remote video conference command system
abstract_en: Provided is a portable remote video conference command system. The system comprises a user terminal computer, a high definition camera head, an interphone, an MIC, a video recorder, and a stereo, and is characterized in that the system also comprises a 3G wireless communication device and an ad-hoc network device; and the computer transmits information to outside via the wireless communication and/or the ad-hoc network. A power supply device of the system is equipped with a foot-operated generator and a solar cell panel. The system is capable of ensuring that when the ground public network fails, network connection between the field and a superior command center can be quickly established via the ad-hoc network, and high-efficient, timely and reliable transmission of emergency command information is ensured. All the devices are arranged in a chassis, so the system is small in size, light in weight, and easy to transport, arrange and operate, and even one person can finish the establishment of the system.
assignees: BEIJING AEROSPACE FUDAO HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multifunctional rearview mirror
abstract_en: The utility model relates to an automobile rearview mirror, in particular to a multiple-functional rearview mirror which is used to real-timely shoot images around an automobile when the automobile runs or stops. The automobile rearview mirror comprises a mirror body, a mirror face and a bracket. The automobile rearview mirror is characterized in that cameras, which are used to capture video images, are mounted on the mirror body. Through a video image memory and a monitor, the cameras, which are respectively mounted on the front and the rear of the rearview mirror, can record the state of the automobile under any state of the automobile, and scenes on the way. The automobile rearview mirror can real-timely monitor and record the handling of unexpected incidents such as traffic accidents, earthquakes, flood, fire hazards, robbery, murder, fights and tracking, thus giving a great help in the keeping and recording of original precious data, the investigation of accident liability, insurance survey, and the like, the stored related original video information can be accessed after incidents, and thereby, the automobile rearview mirror can increase efficiency, guarantee safety and reduce misjudgement, so the automobile rearview mirror is a practical technique.

title_en: Command system applied to police service fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of police affair management, in particular to a command system applied to police affair fusion, which comprises: command system platform, PGIS end, skynet system, mobile terminal and intelligent glasses. The intelligent glasses are arranged, so that the law enforcement efficiency is improved, video recording and instruction hidden transmission in the law enforcement process are facilitated, the defects of the conventional police command and dispatch system are overcome, the efficiency of the police command and dispatch system is greatly improved, epoch-making convenient conditions are brought to police reconnaissance and disposal, and powerful support can be provided for timely and accurate decisions of public security organs.
assignees: DONGGUAN ZHONGTIAN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of battle simulation training system and method for the formation of attack unmanned plane
abstract_en: The present invention relates to Distributed Combats to emulate field, it is proposed that a kind of battle simulation training system and method for attack unmanned plane formation.It is that unmanned plane and flat pad simulation node, unmanned plane formation command node, floor planning control node, friendly neighbour's equipment simulation node, enemy troops simulation node, tactical communication's simulation node, battle state display node, training management and control node and data record and analyze node by system decomposition from physical node composition；From operation simulation modeling, structure includes the model system of environmental simulation model, Solid simulation model and Military Conceptual Models.Battle simulation training system of the present invention deduces the tactics coorinated training of attack unmanned plane formation, battle plan, equipment improvement optimization has important supporting role.
assignees: BEIJING JINGPIN MIRROR IMAGE TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of concealed information spy equipment
abstract_en: The present invention relates to network information security monitoring technology fields, and disclose a kind of concealed information spy equipment, including detecting monitoring system, event analysis system, safety auditing system, safety management system, emergency response system, the detection monitoring device and event analysis system, safety auditing system, safety management system, emergency response system are based on network-linked；Detect monitoring system real-time detection transmitted data on network, by event analysis system event analysis its data information of acquisition is analyzed and processed.The concealed information spy equipment, pass through detection monitoring system classification monitoring network information data, File Format Data information, registry data information and daily record data information, so that the information data obtained is more complete, and classifies and the data information of acquisition is analyzed, it improves massive dataflow and obtains efficiency, and then monitoring efficiency is improved, so that detection data is accurate, guarantee to be missed without invasion evidence.

title_en: Method for real-time information service center distribution management
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for distributing and managing a real-time information service center, which comprises the following steps: the client sends real-time information of alarm or service to the service center, the service center receives and records the acquired real-time information with the information sending number in real time and queues the information, the real-time information is assigned to a service staff working terminal, the service staff working terminal and the client establish a voice talkback channel, and the service staff working terminal and the server are in butt joint with a third-party platform to complete corresponding service; the invention has wide application range, can establish a special temporary voice conversation channel, realizes the voice communication and information interaction between an information sender and a server in time, provides corresponding service for the information sender in time at the first time, improves the reliability of information sending and the instantaneity and accuracy of real-time information processing, and is suitable for the fields of community service, old-age care service, enterprise command and dispatch, after-sale service of products and emergency rescue.
assignees: SHENZHEN FULIAN CORE MICROTECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Analog traffic director system with V2X function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulated traffic director system with a V2X function, which comprises a road side monitoring subsystem, a simulated traffic director device subsystem, a remote monitoring subsystem and a site control subsystem, wherein the road side monitoring subsystem is used for automatically collecting the mechanical action image information of the simulated traffic director device and executing a computer vision processing algorithm to extract the mechanical action image characteristics of the simulated traffic director device; the simulated traffic director device subsystem is used for receiving and executing action control commands sent by the remote monitoring subsystem and the field control subsystem; the on-site control subsystem is used for sending an action control command to the simulated traffic director device subsystem; the remote monitoring subsystem is used for receiving and recording the motion execution analysis result sent by the road side monitoring subsystem. The intelligent control system has the advantages of high intelligent degree, high control precision, good real-time performance and the like.
assignees: HUNAN XIANGJIANG INTELLIGENT TECH INNOVATION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Marine oil spill emergency monitoring point position layout method based on avoidance analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses an offshore oil spill emergency monitoring point position layout method based on avoidance analysis, which comprises the following steps: step 1, determining an initial point location layout range; step 2, avoiding analysis; step 3, generating a final point location layout range; step 4, determining the number of final layout points; step 5, generating a preliminary point location layout scheme; and 6, determining a final point location layout result. The method provided by the invention realizes intelligent avoidance of point location arrangement, and effectively prevents point locations from being arranged in sensitive or unsuitable monitoring areas; the most representative monitoring range can be locked in extremely short time, key information of oil spill pollution can be rapidly and accurately captured, and urgent requirements of emergency response are fully met; the uniform distribution of the monitoring points is realized, and the timeliness and the accuracy of the distribution of the monitoring points are obviously improved; the system can flexibly cope with the field situation and provide powerful support for emergency response and treatment of oil spill accidents at sea.

title_en: IT operation and maintenance management method and IT operation and maintenance management device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data analysis, in particular to an IT operation and maintenance management method and an IT operation and maintenance management device, which comprise the steps of extracting, classifying, sorting and calculating and analyzing historical data to provide a direction for subsequent deep analysis; the running state and potential risk of the data center are reflected through data processing analysis and characteristic value extraction, so that the subsequent modeling analysis is facilitated; by constructing a risk prediction model, risk early warning and emergency response measures are convenient to implement; by dividing the monitoring period and monitoring the operation data of the data center in real time, the timeliness and the integrity of the data are ensured; through risk score prediction and threshold setting, operation and maintenance efficiency is improved, and therefore faults are reduced. The method and the device are used for solving the technical problems of insufficient comprehensive monitoring and intelligent management in IT operation and maintenance management in the existing scheme.
assignees: HANGZHOU MINGXUN SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Schedule reminding method, system and terminal of emergency scheduling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a schedule reminding method, a schedule reminding system and a schedule reminding terminal of an emergency dispatching system, wherein the method comprises the steps of creating a schedule on a rule setting interface of the emergency dispatching system; creating a timing task service, setting a reminding function, setting multiple reminders according to actual demands of users, creating a plurality of task classes and task schedulers by using a timer, adding the tasks to the task schedulers, starting a thread pool by a timing task scheduling frame, executing all the tasks by the thread pool, sending out reminders according to the set multiple reminders when the tasks are triggered, updating task states and recording task execution results after the task execution is completed. According to the invention, the schedule reminding is used for more effectively arranging and managing time, the working efficiency is improved, and the risk of omission or delay is reduced, so that timely processing of work and tasks is realized, and meanwhile, the emergency task can be successfully completed.
assignees: XIAN ZHENYOU COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation method and system for payment data security
abstract_en: The invention discloses a payment data security assessment method and system, comprising the steps of data acquisition, risk identification, security assessment, report generation and the like, wherein a distributed acquisition node is combined with a quantum random number generator, a deep learning model, a self-encoder, a knowledge graph and other innovative modules are adopted, countersample detection and risk dynamic simulation are added, report encryption, visualization and automatic update are carried out, and a real-time monitoring, simulation attack and emergency response module is provided to ensure the comprehensiveness, accuracy and timeliness of payment data security assessment; the invention has the advantages of multi-module cooperation, comprehensive and real-time data acquisition and safety, higher risk identification accuracy, more scientific safety evaluation, visual and time-efficient report, and an omnibearing protection system, thereby providing a powerful guarantee for payment data safety and improving the confidence of users and payment service providers.

title_en: The learning method of language and words by the semantics approach and the testing method of foreign language proficiency for each step
title_ko: 시맨틱스 접근법에 의한 언어 및 단어 학습법과 단계별 외국어구사능력 평가방법
abstract_en: A learning method of language and words by a semantics approach method and a testing method of foreign language proficiency for each step are provided to create own expression, thereby promoting a learner to get thinking power and an initiative spirit. A configuration method of a semantics approach method database divides an expression structure of a sentence into an expression structure of a state and an expression structure of an operation in a method for learning language in a database(10). The expression structure of the state stores data which is a process divided into an expression structure of a noun and an expression structure of a special noun. The expression structure of the noun stores data of the process divided into an expression structure of a number noun and an expression structure of an amount noun.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 시맨틱스 접근법에 의한 언어학습법 데이타베이스의 구성방법과 이를 이용한 인터넷을 통한 학습 및 상기 방법을 실현하기 위한 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체 또는 동영상이나 음성으로 편집 제작되어 제공되는 기록매체와, 문장의 표현구조나 표현방식에 따라 순차적이고 체계적으로 단어의 뜻과 개념을 학습함으로써 자연스럽게 문장의 표현으로 이어지게 하는 문장구조적인 단어학습법 데이타베이스의 구성방법과 이를 이용한 인터넷을 통한 학습 및 상기 방법을 실현하기 위한 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체 또는 동영상이나 음성으로 편집 제작되어 제공되는 기록매체 및, 외국어구사능력의 수준에 따라 단계를 구분하고 각 단계별로 외국어구사능력을 평가하는 데이타베이스의 구성방법과 이를 이용한 인터넷을 통한 평가 및 상기 방법을 실현하기 위한 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체 또는 동영상이나 음성으로 편집 제작되어 제공되는 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위해 본 발명은 로그인 단계(S100) 이후 학습자가 자신이 학습할 곳을 클릭하여 시작하고, 만약 새 학습자이면 시맨틱스 접근법 및 영어문장의 표현원리 학습절차에 대하여 설명을 확인하는 예비학습 단계(S101); 이후 학습을 시작하되, 상태의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S200)와 동작의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S300);를 구분한 후, 상태의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S200);는 일반명사의  표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S210)와 특별명사의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S220);를 거쳐  be동사구문의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S230); 동작의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S300);는 일반동사의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S310)와 전환동사의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S320)를 거쳐 일반동사구문의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S230); 이후 상태의 표현구조와 동작의 표현구조를 통합하는 문장의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S400)에서 구(句)의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S410);와 절(節)의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S420);를 거쳐 구문(構文)의 표현구조를 학습하는 단계(S430); 이후 학습이 끝나면 복습 여부를 묻는 단계(S102);와 복습을 하지 않을 경우 배운 내용의 범위를 데이타베이스(10)에 저장하고 학습을 종료하는 로그아웃 단계(S103);가 포함됨을 특징으로 하는 시맨틱스 접근법에 의한 언어학습법과 시맨틱스 접근법을 바탕으로 하는 문장구조적인 단어학습법 및 단계별 외국어구사능력 평가방법이 포함됨을 특징으로 한다. 
     상기와 같이 구성된 본 발명은 인터넷을 통하거나 본 시맨틱스 접근법에 의한 언어학습법 프로그램이 저장된 기록매체 또는 동영상이나 음성으로 편집 제작되어 저장된 기록매체를 통하여 사용자로 하여금 언어의 표현원리에 대한 사고력과 창의력을 계발하게 하고, 의사소통의 기능을 중심으로 한 듣기와 말하기 및 읽기와 쓰기의 통합교육과정으로서 문법이나 어법을 학습하게 하며, 학습자가 목표로 하는 객관적인 외국어구사능력의 수준을 단계별로 설정할 수 있도록 하기 위한 것이다. 
       
     문법, 시맨틱스, 언어학습법, 단어학습법, 외국어능력검정방법

title_en: Diagnosis and Warning System of Wheelchair Fault using Smartphone
title_ko: 스마트폰을 이용한 휠체어 고장 진단 및 알림 시스템
abstract_en: If a fault occurs while using the wheelchair, handicapped and elderly people who are physically uncomfortable will be greatly disturbed. Unlike automobiles, there is no emergency service, and there are not many AS centers. Accordingly, if an electric wheelchair stops because a battery suddenly discharges or parts break down, a user cannot take a big and heavy electric wheelchair. Since the AS support is not easy when the cause of the failure and the solution cannot be found, many wheelchair users cannot use the wheelchair for a long time. If a system can warn the failure of the wheelchair in advance and inform the user of the cause of the failure, various countermeasures will be possible. Currently, some wheelchairs use a battery gauge to tell the user the failure and the cause of the failure but the user cannot know what the blinking of the battery gauge means, and what failure the blinking is meant to indicate. In the present invention, a smartphone used by many people can analyze various information, diagnose, determine and predict the failure and the cause thereof, and provide various countermeasures. Even when the wheelchair is not operated or is not turned on due to the failure, the user can confirm the cause of the failure by utilizing a failure and operation information DB recorded before the failure. If necessary, the failure and operation information DB can be sent to the nearest AS center such that the user can identify the exact cause of the failure through an expert, and receive immediate response measures and accurate AS support.
abstract_ko:
휠체어 사용 중 고장이 발생하면 몸이 불편한 장애인 및 노약자는 매우 크게 당황한다. 자동차와는 달린 긴급 출동서비스가 없고, AS 센터가 많지 않아 배터리가 갑자기 방전되거나 부품이 고장이 나서 작동이 정지되면 크고 무거운 전동휠체어를 조치하기가 매우 힘들다. 고장 원인을 알 수 없고 또 해결 방안을 알 수 없을 때, AS 지원조차 쉽지 않아, 장시간 휠체어를 사용하지 못하는 경우도 많다.  
만약 휠체어 고장을 사전에 경고할 수 있고, 또 고장 원인을 알려줄 수 있다면 다양한 대응조치가 가능할 것이다. 현재 일부 휠체어에서 배터리 게이지를 사용하여 고장과 고장의 원인을 알려주고 있으나 배터리 게이지의 깜빡임이 고장을 의미하는지도 잘 모르고, 또 그 깜빡임이 어떤 고장을 의미하는지도 알기 어렵다. 본 발명에서는 많은 사람들이 사용하고 있는 스마트폰을 통하여 각종 정보를 분석하고, 고장 및 원인을 진단, 판단, 예측하며, 그리고 다양한 대응조치를 알려줄 수 있다. 만약 고장이 나서 작동이 되지 않거나, 전원이 들어오지 않는 경우에도 고장 전까지 기록된 고장 및 운전 정보 DB를 활용하면 고장의 원인을 확인할 수 있다. 필요하면 가까운 AS 센터에 고장 및 운전 정보 DB를 전송하여 전문가를 통해 정확한 고장 원인을 파악할 수 있으며, 즉각적인 대응조치를 전송받을 수 있고, 또 정확한 AS 지원이 가능하다.

title_en: Application for traffic rule violation and disaster reporting and its method
abstract_en: A traffic rule violation and disaster reporting application which can be installed on mobile devices or mobile glasses and wherein those informing traffic rule violations can win a reward, emergency help, fire cases can be reported to concerned units and comprising login display (1) where username, password and plate number details are entered to log in the application displayed when application is started, a start button (9) starting video recording when pressed, account number entrance display (2) where details of account to which rewards payment to be paid as a result of reporting are paid, a camera tab (3) turning on the mobile device or mobile glasses camera used to send reporting to be sent and whereon the application is installed and thus providing video recording or enabling concerned units to monitor instant state, emergency tab (4) by which the unit such as ambulance, police, fire brigade unit to be reported of the recorded or installed reporting will be sent, a past tab (6) providing whether or not reports made in past are completed, an emergency button (8) providing live watching in mobile device by security forces by sending warning in terror incidents threatening public security and enabling obtain of coordinates. The invention also comprises the related method.

title_en: Item Locator and Personal Protection Device
abstract_en: The item locator and personal protection device includes a locator chip comprising a panic button configured to trigger an emergency dispatch and a 360 degree speaker to emit a locator/self defense sound. The disclosure also includes a remote control configured to receive the locator chip and a visual recording lens and a microphone. The disclosure further includes an electronics configured to determine a separation distance between the locator chip and the remote control and to determine a time date stamp.

title_en: Intelligent early-warning emergency system for wind power safety and method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early-warning emergency system for wind power safety. The system comprises a data collection device, a dynamic early-warning device and an emergency rescue device, wherein the dynamic early-warning device comprises a major hazard source identifying device, a major hazard source grading device, an accident potential tracking device, an accident potential evaluating and classifying device and an accident early-warning device; and the emergency rescue device comprises a main control device and a site emergency rescue device, wherein the main control device comprises a data receiving module, a data analyzing module, a data storing module and a data control command transmitting module, and the site emergency rescue device comprises a fire-extinguishing gas control device, a fire-extinguishing gas storing device and a spray head. Meanwhile, the invention also discloses an intelligent early-warning emergency method for the wind power safety. The system has higher automatization degree and has stronger timeliness, safety and reliability; moreover, the concept of humanization is embodied; and meanwhile, the rescue time is saved, the life safety of rescue personnel is ensured, and the unnecessary economic loss is reduced.

title_en: Public safety site-oriented vehicle-mounted dynamic monitoring system and monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle-mounted dynamic monitoring system and a monitoring method for a public safety site. The invention realizes the monitoring and recording of the vehicle driving process by storing the high-definition video data obtained by the image acquisition equipment into the high-speed storage unit through the mSATA interface after decoding and compressing. The invention can also connect the vehicle-mounted terminal to a background data processing center in cooperation with a 4G communication module, and the background data processing center processes the acquired flammable and combustible detection data, vehicle-mounted electronic information, command commands, positioning data, navigation data and video monitoring signals in real time to generate corresponding command data, wherein the command data comprises video monitoring signals, emergency stop signals, one-key window breaking signals or contact vehicle interception signals and the like to the vehicle-mounted terminal, so that the remote monitoring of the vehicle running state is realized.

title_en: Network security event response method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a method, a device and equipment for responding to a network security event, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a network security event; when the type of the detected network security event is a network attack event, matching attack source information of the network attack event with an attack record, and determining attack times corresponding to the attack source information; if the attack times meet the triggering condition, performing linkage disposal on the network attack event; and if the attack times do not meet the triggering condition, matching the feature information of the network attack event with the feature library, and determining emergency response information corresponding to the feature information so as to respond to the network attack event according to the emergency response information. According to the technical scheme disclosed by the invention, the automatic linkage disposal of the network attack can be realized, and the response efficiency of the network attack event is improved.

title_en: Coal gangue storage yard environment risk real-time monitoring method and system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing, and discloses a coal gangue storage yard environment risk real-time monitoring method and system based on edge calculation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining environment risk original data collected by a multi-source sensor, preprocessing the data through edge computing nodes, constructing a multi-mode identification model to obtain pollution and geological disaster risk results, generating hierarchical early warning information and a dynamic risk map, inputting an intelligent decision system to generate an emergency response plan, updating model parameters based on execution data, and optimizing a risk monitoring system. According to the application, by introducing an edge computing technology, the localization processing of data is realized, the data transmission quantity is reduced, the response time is shortened, and meanwhile, the unified monitoring, prevention and control of pollution risks and geological disaster risks are realized by integrating the multi-mode identification model, so that the timeliness, the accuracy and the response efficiency of the real-time monitoring of the environmental risks of the coal gangue storage yard are improved.

title_en: Electronic Meter for fire protection and tamper proof protection.
title_ko: 화재 방지 및 도전 방지를 위한 전자식 전력량계
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An automatic meter reading system for fire proof and tamper proof is provided to block or control power supply when a damage state of high temperature heating is generated, thereby preventing electricity meter damage and a fire accident. CONSTITUTION: A second current sensing sensor unit(105) is installed in a neutral terminal and senses conducted power. A micro switch unit(110) is installed at a main cover or a terminal cover. The micro switch unit generates and records an event when a sealing unit is opened or dissolved. A temperature sensing unit(115) senses temperature of a load terminal unit. When the sensed temperature is over predetermined temperature, a load alarm unit(120) generates a reserve alarm through a buzzer(200) or a display panel(210). A magnetic sensing unit(125) senses access of a magnet class interrupting accumulation of electricity meter. When a tamper alarm unit(130) receives a sensing signal from the magnetic sensing unit, the tamper alarm unit generates an alarm through the buzzer or the display panel. A memory(135) stores setting temperature for event recording information and the reserve alarm. [Reference numerals] (110) Micro switch unit; (115) Temperature sensing unit; (120) Load alarm unit; (125) Magnetic sensing unit; (130) Tamper alarm unit; (135) Memory unit; (140) Central control unit; (145) Reverse sensing unit; (150) Load blocking unit; (200) Buzzer; (210) Display panel; (300) Event information extracting unit

title_en: Steam storage device equipped with a device that condensation
title_ko: 결로 저류장치를 구비하는 찜 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A steaming device with an undercurrent condensation device is provided to prevent a flying material or the dew condensation which is generated when cooking the food using the steam from scattering to the outside or flowing in the steaming device. CONSTITUTION: A steaming device with an undercurrent condensation device comprises a main body (100), a water supply tank (150), a waste water tank (24), a pumping unit (160), a guide unit (30), a dew condensation passing hole (31), a water receiver (11), and a dew condensation drain hole (12). A control unit is built in the main body and includes a water tank (140) with a heater (130). The water supply tank supplies the water to the water tank and lowers the dew condensation and the waste water tank lowers a flying material. The pumping unit supplies the water to the water tank equipped inside the main body from the water supply tank. The guide unit is formed in a lateral wall shape at the upper end of the main body and prevents the dew condensation and the flying material from scattering to the outside of the main body. The dew condensation passing hole is formed in the upper surface of the main body and guides the water generated by the dew condensation and the flying material to the water receiver. The water receiver is equipped on the upper end of the main body and temporarily lowers the water flowing in the dew condensation passing hole. The dew condensation drain hole is formed in the bottom surface of the water receiver.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 찜 장치에 관한 것으로써, 더욱 상세하게는 스팀을 이용하여 음식물을 조리 시 발생되는 결로나 비산물이 찜 장치의 외부로 비산되거나 찜 장치의 내부로 유입되는 것을 방지함과 아울러, 결로나 비산물에 의하여 발생된 폐수를 저류할 수 있는 결로 저류장치를 구비한 찜 장치에 관한 것이다. 
본발명의 구성은, 기 설정된 프로그램에 따라 찜 장치의 동작을 제어하는 제어부를 내장함과 아울러, 히터를 포함하는 저수조가 구비된 사각박스형상의 본체와, 상기 본체의 내부에 구비되며, 상기 저수조에 물을 공급하는 급수탱크와, 상기 본체의 내부에 구비되며, 결로와 비산물을 저류하는 폐수탱크와, 상기 본체의 내부 일측에 구비되며, 상기 제어부와 전기적으로 연결되고, 상기 급수탱크로부터 상기 본체 내부에 구비되는 저수조에 물을 공급하는 펌핑부와, 상기 본체의 상측 단부에 측벽 형상으로 형성되며, 결로와 비산물이 상기 본체의 외부로 비산되는 것을 방지하는 가이드부와, 상기 본체의 상단면에 형성되며, 결로와 비산물로 인해 생성된 물을 물받이부로 유입되게 하는 결로 통과구와, 상기 본체 내부의 상단에 구비되며, 상기 결로 통과구로 유입된 물을 임시 저류하는 물받이부와, 상기 물받이부의 바닥면에 형성되며, 적어도 하나 이상 구비되는 결로 배수구와, 일단은 상기 결로 배수구에 연결되고 타단은 상기 폐수탱크와 연결되어 상기 물받이부에 임시 저류된 물을 배출하는 결로 배수관, 상기 결로 배수구의 상단면에 삽입되고, 상기 결로 배수관 상측 단부의 내주면과 연결 고정되어 상기 결로 배수구와 상기 결로 배수관의 틈새로 물이 세는 것을 방지하는 패킹부재와, 상기 결로 배수관의 일측에 구비되고, 상기 폐수탱크로부터 폐수가 역류되는 것을 방지하는 체크밸브와, 원주형의 측벽과 바닥면으로 이루어지되, 상기 본체의 상단에 적어도 하나 이상 구비되는 떡시루 받침부와, 일단은 상기 본체 내부에 구비되는 저수조와 연결되고 타단은 상기 떡시루 받침부의 바닥면에 연결되는 스팀공급관과, 일단은 상기 떡시루 받침부의 바닥면에 결합되고 타단은 상기 결로 배수관의 일측에 연결되어 상기 떡시루 받침부에 생성되는 물을 배출하는 배수관과, 원주형의 측벽과 바닥면으로 이루어지되, 바닥면에는 다수개의 통공이 형성되며, 상기 떡시루 받침부에 걸쳐지는 떡시루와, 상기 본체의 배면부에 결합되며, 일단에는 그립부가 형성되는 고정구와, 상기 본체의 외주면에 대응되는 측벽으로 이루어지며, 상기 본체의 외주면에 겹쳐지되, 상하로 슬라이딩 되는 케이스와, 스팀방출공을 구비하고, 상기 케이스와 결합되며, 상기 본체의 윗면을 덮되, 상기 떡시루 받침부의 개수에 대응되게 형성되는 커버와, 상기 케이스와 상기 커버를 연결하며, 상기 커버를 여닫을 수 있게 하는 힌지 및, 일단은 상기 케이스 상측의 단부와 체결되고, 타단은 상기 힌지와 체결되어, 상기 케이스와 상기 커버를 이격시키는 유격부재를 포함하여 구성된다. 
본발명은 스팀을 이용하여 음식물을 조리 시 찜 장치의 표면과 습공기의 온도차로 인해 발생되는 결로나, 강한 스팀압으로 인해 발생되는 비산물이 찜 장치의 외부로 비산되어 찜장치의 표면이나 판채의 연결부위에 흡착되는 것을 방지하여 찜 장치의 녹슬음을 방지하고, 이로 인해 찜 장치의 수명을 늘일 수 있는 효과가 있고, 결로나 비산물에 의하여 발생된 폐수를 따로 저류할 수 있어 효율적인 청소나 관리를 할 수 있는 효과가 있으며. 결로나 비산물이 찜 장치의 표면이나 판채의 연결부위에 흡착되는 것을 방지하여 효율적인 찜 장치의 청소가 가능해지고 위생관리가 용이해지며, 조리장 주변의 환경을 쾌적하게 할 수 있는 효과가 있고, 결로나 비산물이 찜 장치의 내부로 유입되어 찜 장치의 전기적 결함을 일으키는 것을 방지하여, 전기적 고장의 원인을 차단하고, 전기적 결함으로 인한 화재사고 등을 예방할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: A kind of Novel firefighting command car
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to Process of A Particular Bodywork technical field of structures, particularly relate to a kind of Novel firefighting command car, primarily to providing a kind of novel fire fighting command car, unified rescue command effectively is carried out to fire the condition of a disaster scene, the Novel firefighting command car, including vehicle body, the upper front end of vehicle body is provided with long row police lamp, long row police lamp is fixedly connected by stainless steel drag hook with vehicle body；On vehicle body top, the rear end of long row police lamp is provided with roof mounting platform, the front end of roof mounting platform is provided with camera, the rear end of camera is additionally provided with the sound equipment that amplifies on roof mounting platform, standby cabinet is additionally provided in the rear end of vehicle body, combination cabinet body is provided in boot body, the timeliness and uniformity of fire rescue is effectively guaranteed in the fire fighting command car, effectively raise rescue efficiency of the fire-fighting vehicle in fire rescue, the service life for improving fire-fighting command vehicle improves the economic benefit of enterprise.
assignees: HENAN MA CHE HUNG IND CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent wireless communication system for coal mine
abstract_en: The present invention is a kind of Intellective Communication System that underground coal mine uses.Base station and base station, base station and terminal room are wireless link, using dynamic can automatic compensation Time synchronization technique, and can time delay command coding and tree network Intelligent routing technology, the flexible wireless telecommunication system of base station Dynamical Deployment is realized with relatively low cost, it is easy to the routine safety management and scheduling of the complex environments such as colliery, and base station is in itself from charged pool, it can also be used to accident rescue and the scene of the accident well ground emergency communication.
assignees: ZIGUANG ZHIYUN JIANGSU INTERNET OF THINGS TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of accident presentation method based on automation system for the power network dispatching
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of accident presentation method based on automation system for the power network dispatching.It is triggered by SCADA data, the items such as emergency stop valve trip, protection act is sent to fault reasoning service；Fault reasoning service is based on Petri knowledge bases, by analyzing the multi-source data received, obtain faulty equipment information and scope of power outage, other decision-making assistant informations such as supply path restores, and can complex reasoning data form failure bulletin, active push is to man-machine interface；Monitoring personnel checks bulletin information according to the prompt in man-machine interface, and can improve related content manually；Failure bulletin data can be sent on the person liable's machine for being pre-configured with or specifying automatically after monitoring personnel confirmation, failure is completed and report flow, the timeliness of troubleshooting is improved, to mitigate the work load of monitoring personnel.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO;LONGYAN POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;INTEGRATED ELECTRONIC SYSTEMS LAB CO LTD

title_en: Wisdom urban traffic warning situation management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a smart city traffic warning management system, which comprises a warning receiving module, a disposal module and a general control terminal, wherein the warning receiving module comprises a warning access component, a warning recording component, a positioning component and a feedback response component, when a warning occurs, the warning access component receives warning information and records the warning by the warning recording component, the positioning component acquires the positioning information of a warning place, screens out the nearest unmanned aerial vehicle hangar through a hangar distribution map, sends the warning information and the positioning information to the adjacent unmanned aerial vehicle hangar, sends an emergency disposal unmanned aerial vehicle to the site after the unmanned aerial vehicle hangar acquires the warning information, acquires the site information through audio and video equipment and distributes the disposal information for site command, the smart city traffic warning management system has the advantages that the unmanned aerial vehicle hangars are dispersedly arranged, a hangar distribution map is constructed, and the nearest unmanned aerial vehicle hangar can be screened out after the warning information and the positioning information are acquired, remote rapid treatment is achieved.
assignees: ZHANGJIAGANG IND TECH RES INST JIANGSU UNIV SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY

title_en: Electric power emergency material allocation method based on RFID and optimized genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power emergency material allocation method based on RFID and an optimized genetic algorithm, which comprises the following steps: RFID tags are arranged according to the warehouse construction condition and the emergency material resource classification, and material in-out information is dynamically associated with an emergency material ledger; the existing GIS platform or production information command system of the power grid is combined with the surrounding road conditions of the disaster occurrence area, and a deployment warehouse is obtained based on an optimal route method; three key parameters are used as input quantities, and an emergency material demand function is constructed; and solving the global optimal solution of the demand function by using a program method by adopting an optimized genetic algorithm. The invention can provide technical support for emergency disaster relief and recovery of the power grid, not only improves timeliness and effectiveness of emergency material supply, provides decision basis for storage management of the emergency materials of the power grid, but also can effectively play the efficacy of the emergency materials of electric power, reduce the material acquisition cost and provide guarantee for safe and economic operation of the power grid.

title_en: Post-earthquake unmanned aerial vehicle and machine collaborative scheduling method based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-earthquake unmanned vehicle-machine collaborative scheduling method based on edge calculation, which belongs to the technical field of earthquake disaster rescue scheduling and comprises the steps of initializing unmanned vehicles and unmanned vehicle clusters, acquiring rescue material state data and wounded data, constructing a comprehensive objective function, and solving the comprehensive objective function based on the rescue material state data and the wounded data to obtain material and wounded scheduling. And acquiring required real-time data based on the edge node, feeding back the real-time data to the control center through the edge server, re-planning a path, calculating and unloading, and dynamically distributing materials and wounded dispatching. And the intelligent scheduling coordinated with the unmanned aerial vehicle is utilized to improve the material transfer timeliness and the survival rate of wounded after earthquake.

title_en: Visual communication system based on weak current engineering and operation method thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent industry, and discloses a visual communication system based on weak current engineering and an operation method thereof, the system comprises a multi-mode signal acquisition module, an intelligent data processing module, a dual-channel communication transmission module, an interactive visualization module and an autonomous control system module. The method comprises the steps of synchronously collecting video, audio and environmental parameters through a distributed sensor array, eliminating multi-source signal deviation by adopting a space-time alignment algorithm, realizing feature fusion and quality assessment based on a deep neural network, dynamically selecting a wired and wireless mixed transmission mode, constructing an AR enhanced visual man-machine interface, and implementing a fault self-diagnosis and fault tolerance recovery mechanism. The invention reduces the error rate of the communication system, ensures the continuity and reliability of the communication process, and improves the man-machine interaction efficiency and the emergency response speed.

title_ko: 유,무선 인터넷 또는 유비쿼터스를 이용한 골프 사업 방법및 그 운영시스템과 저장매체
abstract_ko:
전세계 골프장수는 3만1천여개, 골프인구는 약 5천8백만명인 것으로 조사됐다. 또 골프장 최다보유국은 미국이고, 인구 대비 골프장이 많은 나라는 '골프 발상지'인 스코틀랜드인 것으로 나타났다. 한국은 골프장수로 세계 18위였다. 이는 2년마다 세계 골프장 현황 및 '1백대 코스'를 조사, 발표해 오고 있는 미국 골프전문 월간지 골프다이제스트 2005년 5월호에 실린 내용이다. 
     또한, 재단법인 한국 골프장 경영협회에 자료에 따르면, 2006년 1월 1일 현재 전국에 317개 골프장이 영업 중이며, 그중 196개가 회원제로, 121개가 대중으로 운영중이며, 2005년 1년 동안 13,213,890명이 전국 골프장을 이용한 것으로 조사되었다고 한다. 
     이러한 통계 수치는 관련 사업인 골프 연습장, 골프채, 골프웨어 등의 호황으로 이어지고 있으며, 관련 시장의 증가도 꾸준히 지속 되고 있는 실정이다. 
     본 발명은 유,무선 인터넷 기반 또는 유비쿼터스(Ubiquitous ; 물이나 공기처럼 시공을 초월해 '언제 어디에나 존재한다'는 뜻의 라틴어(語)로, 사용자가 컴퓨터나 네트워크를 의식하지 않고 장소에 상관없이 자유롭게 네트워크에 접속할 수 있는 환경을 말한다. 1988년 미국의 사무용 복사기 제조회사인 제록스의 와이저(Mark Weiser)가 '유비쿼터스 컴퓨팅'이라는 용어를 사용하면서 처음으로 등장하였다. 
     당시 와이저는 유비쿼터스 컴퓨팅을 메인프레임과 퍼스널컴퓨터(PC)에 이어 제3의 정보혁명을 이끌 것이라고 주장하였는데, 단독으로 쓰이지는 않고 유비쿼터스 통신, 유비쿼터스 네트워크 등과 같은 형태로 쓰인다. 곧 컴퓨터에 어떠한 기능을 추가하는 것이 아니라 자동차·냉장고·안경·시계·스테레오장비 등과 같이 어떤 기기나 사물에 컴퓨터를 집어넣어 커뮤니케이션이 가능하도록 해 주는 정보기술(IT) 환경 또는 정보기술 패러다임을 뜻한다. 
     유비쿼터스화가 이루어지면 가정·자동차는 물론, 심지어 산 꼭대기에서도 정보기술을 활용할 수 있고, 네트워크에 연결되는 컴퓨터 사용자의 수도 늘어나 정보기술산업의 규모와 범위도 그만큼 커지게 된다. 그러나 유비쿼터스 네트워크가 이루어지기 위해서는 광대역통신과 컨버전스 기술의 일반화, 정보기술 기기의 저가격화 등 정보기술의 고도화가 전제되어야 한다. 이러한 제약들로 인해 2003년 현재 일반화되어 있지는 않지만, 휴대성과 편의성뿐 아니라 시간과 장소에 구애받지 않고도 네트워크에 접속할 수 있는 장점들 때문에 세계적인 개발 경쟁이 일고 있다.) 기반으로, 
     1) 골프장 정보(기상, 홀 위치, 2D 또는 3D 평면도, 2D 또는 3D 도면도, 2D 또는 3D 안내도, 위치, 교통안내, 편의시설, 부킹 안내, 숙박시설, 주변 관광지, 기타 정보 안내 등)와 실내외 골프연습장 정보(2D 또는 3D 평면도, 2D 또는 3D 도면도, 2D 또는 3D 안내도, 위치, 교통안내, 편의시설, 연습장 사용 안내, 숙박시설, 주변 관광지, 기타 정보 안내 등)를 제공하는 방법과 그 운영시스템과 그 저장 매체, 
     2) 골프 관련 상품의 광고, 홍보, 프로모션 방법과 그 운영시스템과 그 저장매체, 
     3) LPGA, PGA의 국내외 경기정보, 선수 프로필 및 상금액, 전적(戰績) 등을 제공하는 방법과 그 운영시스템과 그 저장매체, 
     4) 국내외 개인 또는 아마추어, 프로골프 선수 및 각종 대회의 경기정보, 선수 프로필 및 상금액, 전적(戰績) 등을 제공하는 방법과 그 운영시스템과 그 저장매체 
     5) 국내외 개인 또는 아마추어, 프로골프 선수가 직,간접으로 입력하는 개인 경지정보 관리 및 전적(戰績)관리 방법과 그 운영시스템과 그 저장매체 
     6) 각종 국내 골프대회, 개인 또는 협회, 단체의 아마추어 골프대회의 정보와 선수의 정보를 제공하고 일정한 금액의 포인트, 마일리지, 현금, 사이버머니, 상품, 경품 등으로 배당을 걸어 과반수의 범위 내에서 배당금을 나누어주고, 나머지 과반수의 범위내에서 운영비와 복지사업을 진행하는 골프 로또사업 방법과 그 운영시스템과 그 저장매체, 
      7)위 1) ~ 6)항을 이용하기 위하여 제공하는 유, 무선 단말기(컴퓨터, 핸드폰, PDA, PDA폰, 인터넷 TV, 비디오게임기, 휴대용 게임기, 노트북, 인터넷 접속 소형 단말기, 위성 수신 장치, 위성 TV, POZ, 차량용 수신 단말기, LCD 모니터, LCD TV, 전광판, 텔레매틱스(Telematics ; 텔레커뮤니케이션(telecommunication)과 인포매틱스(informatics)의 합성어로, 자동차 안에서 이메일을 주고받고, 인터넷을  통해 각종 정보도 검색할 수 있는 오토(auto) PC를 이용한다는 점에서 '오토모티브 텔레매틱스'라고도 부른다. 
     운전자가 무선 네트워크를 통해 차량을 원격 진단하고, 무선모뎀을 장착한 오토 PC로 교통 및 생활 정보, 긴급구난 등 각종 정보를 이용할 수 있으며, 사무실과 친구들에게 전화 메시지를 전할 수 있음은 물론, 음성 이메일을 주고받을 수도 있고, 오디오북을 다운받을 수도 있다. 
     미국의 제너럴 모터스(GM)와 모토롤라의 합작회사인 온스타(On-Star)가 이 분야의 선두주자로, 이미 위성항법시스템(GPS:global positioning system) 위성을 이용해 서비스를 제공하고 있으며, 포드-퀄컴, 벤츠-도이치텔레콤 등 자동차 메이커와 이동통신 전문업체 간의 합작이 활발하게 이루어지고 있다. 
     한국도 텔레메틱스 서비스 개발을 위해 자동차 회사와 이동통신업체 간의 협력이 활발해 현대·기아자동차는 LG텔레콤과 무선차량 정보서비스 개발을 위한 전략적 제휴를 체결하였고, 대우자동차는 한국통신프리텔과 손잡고 이동통신과 위치추적기술을 접목한 드림넷 서비스 제휴를 체결하였다. 
     이처럼 텔레메틱스 서비스는 자동차 메이커와 이동통신업체 간의 합작 형태로 이루어지는 것이 일반적이다. 서비스 형태에 따라 뉴스수신, 주식투자, 전자상 거래, 금융거래, 호텔예약, 팩시밀리 송수신, 게임, 차량 사고 및 도난 등 다양한 서비스가 가능하며, 특히 교통사고가 났을 경우 GPS위성을 이용해 자동적으로 사고차량의 위치를 추적, 가장 근접한 119구조대에 전달해 줌으로써 구난 활동에 용이하다는 장점이 있다.) 단말기, Wi-Fi(와이파이 ; 2.4 GHz대를 사용하는 무선 LAN 규격(IEEE 802.11b)에서 정한 제반 규정에 적합한 제품에 주어지는 인증 마크. 와이파이라고도 한다. 이 규격에 의해 제작된 제품 중에서 무선 네트워크 관련 기업이 만든 업계 단체인 WECA(Wireless Ethernet Compatibility Alliance)가 자체 시험을 통해서 상호 접속성 등을 확인한 후 인정을 취득한 제품에 한해 이 마크를 붙일 수 있다.) 단말기, WiBro(와이브로 ; 정보통신부·한국정보통신기술협회(TTA)와 이동통신 업체들이 2006년 상용 서비스를 목표로 개발하고 있는 무선 휴대인터넷 서비스이다. 와이브로는 와이어리스 브로드밴드 인터넷(Wireless Broadband Internet)의 줄임말이다. 우리말로는 무선광대역인터넷, 무선초고속인터넷, 휴대인터넷 등으로 풀이된다. 
     휴대폰처럼 언제 어디서나 이동하면서 초고속인터넷을 이용할 수 있는 서비스로, 휴대폰과 무선랜의 중간 영역에 위치한다. 한국정보통신기술협회를 중심으로 2003년 6월부터 표준화를 추진하는 한편, 국제전기전자기술협회(IEEE)에도 반영하는 등 한국이 국제 표준화를 주도하고 있는 3.5세대 이동통신 서비스이자 국책사업이다. 
     2006년 상반기부터 서울과 수도권에서 상용 서비스할 계획으로 사업을 추진하고 있는데, 상용화될 경우 시속 60㎞ 이내로 이동하면서 초고속인터넷을 이용할 수 있다. 주파수 대역은 2.3㎓, 인터넷 속도(서비스 대역폭)는 1Mbps 정도이고, 예상되는 서비스 이용료는 월 3만 원 안팎이다. 
     퍼스널컴퓨터·노트북컴퓨터·PDA·차량용 수신기 등에 무선랜과 같은 와이브로 단말기를 설치하면 이동하는 자동차 안이나 지하철에서도 휴대폰처럼 자유롭게 인터넷을 이용할 수 있는 서비스이다.)단말기 등 인터넷이 연결 또는 통신이 가능한 각종 단말기)에게 정보를 제공하는 방법과 각 단말기 플랫폼(platform ; 컴퓨터 시스템의 기반이 되는 하드웨어나 소프트웨어. 컴퓨터는 맨 아래층인 집적 회로(IC) 칩 수준의 하드웨어층, 그 다음 층인 펌웨어와 운영 체계(OS)층, 맨 위층인 응용 프로그램층으로 구성되는 계층화된 장치인데, 이 장치의 맨 아래층만을 흔히 플랫폼이라고 한다. 그러나 응용 프로그램의 설계자들은 하드웨어와 소프트웨어를 모두 플랫폼이라고 한다. 그 이유는 하드웨어와 소프트웨어가 응용에 대한 지원을 제공하기 때문이다.)에 맞게 제공되는 정보제공을 위한 클라이언트 프로그램 개발 방법과 그 광고제공 방법  
     8) 위 1) ~ 6)항을 7)항의 단말기에 제공하기 위해 운영되는 운영 시스템 및 그 저장매체 및 그 방법에 관한 것이다.
