title_en: Advertisement business model for use with emergency exit lighting system in the multitude facilities
title_ko: 피난유도선 시스템을 이용한 다중이용시설 내에서의  광고사업 모델 특허
abstract_en: An AD business model using an emergency exit lighting system in the multitude facilities is provided to prevent human and economical damage by making a rescue party and people recognize a direction going to an emergency exit or zone with the emergency exit lighting system using an electro-luminescence lamp. A lighting AD(ADvertisement) facility performs PR(Public Relation)/AD(ADvertisement) of an advertiser in normal times by using the Internet and saves the people using the multitude facilities by operating the emergency exit lighting system in emergency. The electro-luminescence lamp is embedded in a graphic overlay and statically or dynamically emits light by control of an emergency exit lighting controller. The PR/AD of the advertiser is displayed on the overlay printed by screen printing.
abstract_ko:

         조명램프인 무기 전계발광소자(Electro-Luminescence)(도2)는 그래픽 오브레이(도1)에 내장 장착되며, 제어장치인 피난유도선 컨트롤러(도3)로 정적 발광 또는 동적 발광된다. 외부 표출방법은 제작된 투명 플라스틱에 스크린 인쇄방식으로 제작된 그래픽 오브레이(도1)로 구성된다. 조명 사인 광원으로 사용되는 무기 전계발광소자(EL)(도2)는 0.3mm 두께이고 관이나 전구의 형태를 한 기존의 광원과 달리 형태 그대로 균일하게 면 발광하는 얇고 가벼운 필름형태의 광원이다.  
     발광형식들을 제어하는 기능의 전기제어장치인 컨트롤러는(도3)는 교류 전류 AC220V 전원소스를 통해 공급되는 전류를 직류(DC)로 또다시 교류전류(AC) 및 주파수로 바꾸어 일정한 전류를 무기 전계발광소자(도2)에 공급한다. 
         외장 알루미늄 케이스(도4)내부에 고정 장착된 무기 전계발광소자(EL)(도2) 램프는 부드러운 다양한 색상의 빛 칼라 연출을 통해 직접 조명함으로서, 광원의 비발열성으로 인한 사용상의 안전성, 설치의 편이성, 그리고 생활의 필수성, 긴급성을 갖춘 새로운 개념의 초박판형 긴급대피 유도용 피난시스템이다.

title_en: System and method for transmitting a rejection message, apparatus and computer readable medium having computer program recorded therefor
title_ko: 거절메시지 전송 시스템 및 방법, 그리고 이를 위한 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and method for transmitting a rejection message, and an apparatus and a recording medium storing a computer program therefore and, more specifically, to a system and a method for transmitting a rejection message which allow a caller to clearly identify a rejection reason of a receiver by transmitting, to the caller, a rejection message including a message set by a user, a user location and the status of the user based on the user location when a received call is rejected, and to an apparatus and a recording medium storing a computer program therefor. According to the present invention, by providing a caller with a rejection message including current location information indicating a user location and status information on the current status of the user based on accumulated user locations since a rejection point of time as well as a text message set by a user when a received call is rejected, the caller can identify the current location of the user and the current status, such as moving, or staying at a relevant location as well as the current location of the user. As a result, the present invention can be applied to emergency response, lifesaving, and emergency rescue by identifying not only a simple call rejection reason but also a user location and the current status of a user. The user device for transmitting a rejection message comprises: a positioning unit for measuring a receiver location; a rejection message generation unit for generating setting information according to a setting to reject a received call according to user input and text information provided when the received call is rejected; a status information generation unit for generating and accumulating location information according to measurement by the positioning unit, and generating status information by using the accumulated location information; and a rejecting message providing unit for transmitting, to a caller, a rejection message including the text information, the current location information the status information when the received call is rejected according to the setting information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 거절메시지 전송 시스템 및 방법, 그리고 이를 위한 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 기록매체에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세히는 착신 호의 거절시 사용자에 의해 설정된 메시지와 사용자의 위치를 포함하며 사용자의 위치를 기반으로 사용자의 상태를 포함하는 거절메시지를 발신자측에 전송하여 수신자의 거절이유를 발신자가 명확히 판단할 수 있도록 하는 거절메시지 전송 시스템 및 방법, 그리고 이를 위한 장치 및 컴퓨터 프로그램이 기록된 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명은 착신 거절시 사용자가 설정한 문자메시지와 더불어 사용자의 위치를 판단할 수 있는 현재 위치정보 및 착신 거절이 이루어진 시점부터 누적된 사용자의 위치를 기초로 사용자의 현재 상태에 대한 상태정보를 포함하는 거절메시지를 발신측으로 제공하여, 발신자가 사용자의 현재 위치뿐만 아니라 해당 위치에서의 이동이나 체류 등과 같은 현재 상태를 용이하게 판단할 수 있도록 제공할 수 있으며 이를 통해 단순 착신거절 사유 뿐만 아니라 사용자의 위치와 현재 상태를 판단하여 비상상황 대처, 인명구조 및 긴급구난에 이용할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Apparatus and Method for Providing User Customized Disaster Response Service
title_ko: 사용자 맞춤형 재난 대응 서비스 제공 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: A user-customized disaster response service providing device and method are disclosed. A broadcast server according to an embodiment of the present invention includes a memory in which at least one program is recorded and a processor executing the program. The program includes: a receiving module that extracts disaster analysis information from external alarms; a disaster message management module that manages disaster response guidelines for each disaster type according to disaster awareness and mobile evacuation capabilities; a disaster app creation and information management module that creates disaster response auxiliary app components for each disaster type according to a user's disaster awareness ability and mobile evacuation capability included in the disaster message information, and indexes and manages the list of created disaster app components; a disaster service creation module that retrieving information corresponding to the disaster analysis information obtained from the receiving module from the disaster message management module and the disaster app creation and information management module, and creates a disaster app component in which functions are configured according to user characteristics and disaster messages of types and kinds suitable for the user characteristics on the basis of the retrieved information; and a transmitting module that transmits disaster broadcasting signals to user-customized disaster messages and disaster apps created by the disaster service creation module. A disaster message and a disaster app may be filtered and used according to user characteristics of a receiving device.
abstract_ko: 사용자 맞춤형 재난 대응 서비스 제공 장치 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 실시예에 따른 브로드캐스트 서버는, 적어도 하나의 프로그램이 기록된 메모리 및 프로그램을 실행하는 프로세서를 포함하며, 프로그램은, 외부 경보로부터 재난분석정보를 추출하는 수신 모듈, 재난인지능력과 이동대피능력에 따른 재난종류별 재난대응지침을 관리하는 재난메시지 관리 모듈, 재난메시지 정보에 포함된 사용자의 재난인지능력과 이동대피능력에 따른 재난종류별 재난대응보조앱 컴포넌트들을 생성하고, 생성된 재난앱 컴포넌트들의 목록을 인덱싱하여 관리하는 재난앱 생성 및 정보 관리 모듈, 수신 모듈에서 획득된 재난분석 정보에 상응하는 정보를 재난메시지 관리 모듈 및 재난앱 생성 및 정보 관리 모듈로부터 검색하고, 검색된 정보를 기반으로 사용자의 특성에 적합한 형태와 종류의 재난메시지 및 사용자 특성에 따라 기능이 구성되는 재난 앱 콤포넌트를 생성하는 재난서비스 생성 모듈 및 재난서비스 생성 모듈에 의해 생성된 사용자 맞춤형 재난 메시지 및 재난앱을 재난방송신호를 전달하는 송신 모듈을 포함하되, 재난 메시지 및 재난앱은, 수신 장치의 사용자 특성에 따라 필터링되어 사용될 수 있다.

title_en: Portable recording device multimedia classification system
abstract_en: This disclosure describes an apparatus and system for classifying audio and video data captured by a portable recording device. The portable recording device may comprise a camera system enclosure that captures audio and video data that reflects a user's point-of-view perception of their surroundings. The video and/or audio data may be transmitted in real-time, or near real-time, to a Central Multimedia Management (CMM) System at a Network Operations Center, or one or more mobile computing devices, via one or more networks. Alternatively, or additionally, the video and/or audio data may be stored within memory of the portable recording device. This disclosure further describes a CMM system that may act as a central repository of multimedia data from one or more portable recording device(s). The CMM system may further generate and assign incident report forms for each individual instance of real-time data that is recorded by a portable recording device.
assignees: WHP WORKFLOW SOLUTIONS INC;GETAC TECHNOLOGY CORP

title_en: Artificial intelligence based virtual assistant for hospital management
abstract_en: The “Artificial Intelligence-Based Virtual Assistant for Hospital Management” is a transformative system revolutionizing healthcare administration. Employing adaptive machine learning algorithms, the virtual assistant dynamically optimizes appointment scheduling, considering historical data, real-time factors, and patient preferences. Natural language processing ensures seamless communication with patients and facilitates dynamic rescheduling. An intelligent patient record management module securely organizes unstructured data, enhancing access for healthcare professionals. The system automates billing and insurance processing with AI oversight, identifying discrepancies and ensuring regulatory compliance. Real-time resource allocation dynamics optimize bed utilization based on predictive analytics. An emergency response coordination module interprets and prioritizes messages, initiating protocols during critical events. The system offers an adaptable user interface with real-time analytics. This invention marks a significant leap in healthcare technology, fostering efficiency, accuracy, and patient-centricity in hospital management.

title_en: Method for routing and communication device for fire-fighting and rescue network
abstract_en: The present invention provides the method for routing and communication device for fire-fighting and rescue network.Method for routing includes: to acquire fire-fighting data to be transmitted by wireless sensing member；It determines the next base station class node and node type of receivable fire-fighting data: if node type is fire fighting command car, using the node as destination node, determining the final route path from wireless sensing member to destination node；If node type is relay base station, the routed path of record wireless sensing member to the node, and transistroute path of the acquisition from the node to fire fighting command car, using fire fighting command car therein as destination node, to determine final route path；Data transmission method based on balance network load presses final route path transmission data.Communication device include each other can wireless telecommunications wireless sensing member and wireless coverage and trunking.Above-mentioned technology of the invention can find the Optimization route that can complete data transmission between all kinds of nodes, and transmission speed is fast, high-efficient, accuracy is high.

title_en: Group calling merging method and conflict resolution method for cluster switching center
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group call merging method and a conflict resolution method for a cluster switching center. The incorporation method comprises the following steps: after the group call controller establishes the session C1 of the group a according to the group call request initiated by the user terminal, if some other switching center establishes the session C2 of the group a according to the group call request initiated by the user terminal and sends the call request to the group call controller, the group call controller stores the information of the session C2 in the session record information table of the group a, allocates resources to the call request, aggregates the media of the session C1 and the session C2, and replies the merging success information to the switching center sending the call request. The invention can combine the conversations of a plurality of switching centers calling the same group into one conversation, thereby ensuring the smooth communication of emergency command.

title_en: Intelligent networking method for fire-fighting system and fire-fighting controller thereof
abstract_en: The intelligent networking method for the fire fighting system is characterized in that the running states of all fire fighting controllers in a fire fighting network are obtained by acquiring authentication information, detecting conflicts, forming configuration data and forming a sending rule table, so that all the fire fighting controllers can recognize each other and make corresponding records according to recognition results, and all the fire fighting controllers make corresponding control commands according to the records of the fire fighting controllers. The utility model provides a fire control controller, including bottom communication interface, intelligence network deployment device and upper control unit, wherein, the authentication information in the fire control network is acquireed and configuration data is formed to intelligence network deployment device on the one hand, on the other hand receives upper control unit's service command and produces external control command according to sending the rule table, thereby make whole fire control system possess intelligent information processing process, can independently realize the network deployment problem, also make the staff needn't debug the network deployment controller frequently, the maintenance cost of fire control system has also been reduced simultaneously.

title_en: Urban disaster multi-element dynamic collaborative disposal system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city disaster multi-element dynamic cooperative treatment system, which comprises: the dynamic collaboration subsystem is used for generating a multi-park/cross-department emergency treatment scheme by using a derived/secondary emergency coupling method; the comprehensive command subsystem performs collaborative command and conflict resolution on each functional department, gathers disaster information, performs analysis and reasoning, and simultaneously issues and distributes a plurality of tasks; the emergency material management and scheduling subsystem optimizes the allocation of multiple emergency materials and performs multi-objective scheduling management on the emergency materials; the emergency management decision knowledge base is constructed based on an automatic matching model of the material emergency plan, and constructed by using a cross-domain knowledge graph, a knowledge conflict and redundancy detection mechanism and a crowd-sourced reasoning decision making method. According to the urban disaster multi-element dynamic collaborative disposal system, the urban disaster emergency treatment efficiency and the timeliness of material scheduling are obviously improved.

title_en: Intelligent early warning and response method for slope instability risk
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent early warning and response method for slope instability risks, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent early warning based on data analysis, and comprises the steps of firstly collecting multidimensional environmental geological data, introducing an instability type and space-time evolution chain double-label mechanism to form a dynamic data set, then determining key influence factors and weights thereof through slope disturbance sensitivity mapping modeling to realize self-adaptive optimization of input feature selection and model structures, extracting multi-layer space-time features by adopting a deep learning model fused with a multi-scale convolutional neural network and an attention mechanism, dynamically adjusting model parameters to accurately predict slope instability probability and evolution paths, and finally incorporating risk levels, response timeliness and treatment cost into multi-objective optimization by combining an evolution game theory to generate an optimal intelligent response strategy. The invention realizes dynamic perception, sensitive modeling, intelligent prediction and scientific response of the side slope instability risk, and effectively improves prediction precision and emergency response efficiency.

title_en: Emergency mooring communication unmanned plane platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency mobile communication, in particular to an emergency tethered communication unmanned aerial vehicle platform which comprises a flight attitude regulation module, a signal coverage optimization module, a dynamic track extraction module, a communication quality quantification module and a risk state identification module. According to the invention, the flight attitude of the unmanned aerial vehicle is accurately adjusted, the signal coverage and the communication quality are optimized, the reliability and the coverage of emergency communication are improved, the matching of the signal intensity distribution and the flight path can be analyzed in real time, the stability and the coverage effect of the communication equipment are ensured to reach the optimal state in a sudden environment, the potential risk is monitored and identified in real time, the guarantee state is automatically adjusted through the quantitative analysis of the communication quality trend, the efficient and stable communication service is ensured to be continuously provided under the complex condition, the adaptability of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved due to the optimization, the emergency response capability of the emergency communication under different environments is enhanced, and the timeliness and the accuracy of the communication guarantee are ensured.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.

title_en: Programming device and recording medium, and programming method
abstract_en: A programming device including a planar shape indication section which receives at least one first user operation for indicating a planar shape by specifying two or more portions among a plurality of portions arranged at different positions in a planar direction; a height reception section which receives at least one second user operation for indicating a height that is a position in a direction intersecting with the plane or a displacement amount of the height in association with a portion of any of the two or more portions; and a control section which generates a command list for moving a control target section along a three-dimensional shape indicated by the planar shape indication section and the height reception section.

title_en: A kind of ad hoc network fire-fighting emergent wireless image transmission dispatches system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of ad hoc network fire-fighting emergent wireless image transmission to dispatch system, including:Control centre part, control centre part include LCD display, control system and speech control system, and LCD display is used for the data message of display control program processing；Control system is used to handle the transmitting-receiving work of data and dock received data to be handled and shown by LCD display；Speech control system is used for the transmitting-receiving work for handling voice data；Terminal part, terminal part includes bluetooth vital sign wrist-watch, head-mounted voice intercom system and terminal body, the utility model make use of the characteristic of ad hoc network, the characteristic for needing not rely on public network can be very good to apply in the environment of the failure of the public networks such as fire-fighting scene, pass through the disaster relief state at the intact observation of video/record fire-fighting scene, and can be linked up in real time by voice system and front line staff, the vital sign information of personnel can be recorded and returned through ad hoc network to control centre.
assignees: JIANGSU ZHONGLI ELECTRONICS INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent railway visual emergency command communication operation system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to the technical field of intelligent railway operation, in particular to an intelligent railway visual emergency command communication operation system, which aims to solve the problems that in the existing emergency operation process such as railway operation and maintenance, the communication connection errors are very easy to exist among operation departments and personnel, so that the railway emergency operation is poor in connectivity, and the overall safety and efficiency of railway operation are finally influenced. The intelligent AI analysis box, the explosion-proof law enforcement recorder, the high-precision positioning operation recorder, the handheld recorder, the flashlight and other components are connected to the smarteye command and dispatch platform in a centralized and intelligent manner, so that an operator can effectively realize accurate positioning and real-time tracking of the operation personnel after wearing the recorders, and meanwhile, the high-efficiency analysis of an operation area is realized under unified management of the smarteye command and dispatch platform after illumination of the flashlight and image acquisition and signal transmission to the AI analysis box, operation safety is ensured, and railway emergency command and communication efficiency is greatly improved.
assignees: JIUQUAN TRAFFIC ENERGY DEV CO LTD;HUALONG TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Develop brain operate an abacus
title_ko: 두뇌계발 셈 주판
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 계산기구인 주판을 간편하게 작동하여 수와 셈을 깨우치고 연산능력을 배우는데 보다 효과적인 기존 주판을 거꾸로 놓고 계산하는 방법의 적용으로 주산교육의 폭을 넓히고 주판의 활용 암산기능을 높이는 주산지도 방법의 개선에 관한 것이다. 또한, 종래의 일반 주판에 주판알 낱개를 세로로 2등분 하여 2가지 색상을 달리 색깔을 칠한 알을 구비하여 구성한 주판의 개량이다. 
이것은 주판알의 색깔을 2가지 다른 색으로 채색하여 주판 면의 숫자가 지면 상의 표시와 같게 보여 단계별 수리 계산과정이 시각적으로 표현되어 지각발달을 시켜 창의성을 길어 주며, 그 편리성과 다양성, 그리고 간편성으로 아동들에게 교수ㆍ학습교구로써 교육의 효용도를 높이고, 어른들은 건강 놀이도구로써 일상생활에 손쉽게 활용할 수 있는 주판을 제공하며. 유아들이 주판을 지능개발용구로 활용할 때에 주판을 엎어 놓고 미끄럼을 타지 못하도록 안전한 주판을 개조하였다. 
이에 의하여, 다양한 주판알 움직이기의 여러 가지 놀이로 제2의 뇌인 손과 손가락(손가락 끝은 밖으로 나온 뇌/ 뇌를 움직이는 손가락/손가락은 대뇌의 파견 기관/손은 바깥쪽에 존재하는 또 다른 뇌)을 자극하는 운동과 간단한 계산과정의 주판 활용을 통해 두뇌 사고를 촉진시켜 뇌 혈액 순환을 원활하게 하여 인지 능력 개발로 기억력이 향상되는 두뇌발달과 노화를 예방하는 주판으로 폭 넓게 운용하는 데 있다.  
즉 어른들에게는 무늬 만들기 놀이 등을 통해 건강예방기구로 이용하고, 아동들에게는 수의 분해와 합성, 수의 크기변화 비교, 수 계산의 전후 과정의 식별, 올림과 내림 셈 등, 수와 연산에 대한 개념과 이해를 촉진하는 교수ㆍ학습 교구로 제공하모, 유아들에게는 다양한 주판 놀이 프로그램 적용으로 집중력, 추리력, 공간 지각력에 참을성을 키워주는 주산을 창의력 개발 및 지능 놀이도구 이용시 사고 미연 예방을 위해  미끄럼 방지 안전 주판을 제작하였다.

title_en: Develop brain use an abacus
title_ko: 두뇌계발 주판
abstract_ko: 본 고안은 계산기구인 주판을 간편하게 작동하여 수와 셈을 깨우치고 연산능력을 배우는데 보다 효과적인 기존 주판을 거꾸로 놓고 계산하는 방법의 적용은 손가락셈과 연관이 되고 검지가 정교하게 조작이 가능하여 주산교육의 폭을 넓히고 주판의 활용 암산기능을 높이는 주산지도 방법의 개선에 관한 것이다. 또한, 종래의 일반 주판에 주판알 낱개를 세로로 2등분 하여 2가지 색상을 달리 색깔을 칠한 알을 구비하여 구성한 주판의 개량이다. 이것은 주판알의 색깔을 2가지 다른 색으로 채색하여 주판 면의 숫자가 지면 상의 표시와 같게 보여 단계별 수리 계산과정이 시각적으로 표현되어 지각발달을 시켜 창의성을 길어 주며, 그 편리성과 다양성, 그리고 간편성으로 아동들에게 교수ㆍ학습교구로써 교육의 효용도를 높이고, 어른들은 건강 놀이도구로써 일상생활에 손쉽게 활용할 수 있는 주판을 제공하며. 유아들이 주판을 지능개발용구로 활용할 때에 주판을 엎어 놓고 미끄럼을 타지 못하도록 안전한 주판을 개조하였다. 이에 의하여, 다양한 주판알 움직이기의 여러 가지 놀이로 제2의 뇌인 손과 손가락(손가락 끝은 밖으로 나온 뇌/ 뇌를 움직이는 손가락/손가락은 대뇌의 파견 기관/손은 바깥쪽에 존재하는 또 다른 뇌)을 자극하는 운동과 간단한 계산과정의 주판 활용을 통해 두뇌 사고를 촉진시켜 뇌 혈액 순환을 원활하게 하여 인지 능력 개발로 기억력이 향상되는 두뇌발달과 노화를 예방하는 주판으로 폭 넓게 운용하는 데 있다.  즉 어른들에게는 무늬 만들기 놀이 등을 통해 건강예방기구로 이용하고, 아동들에게는 수의 분해와 합성, 수의 크기변화 비교, 수 계산의 전후 과정의 식별, 올림과 내림 셈 등, 수와 연산에 대한 개념과 이해를 촉진하는 교수ㆍ학습 교구로 제공하고, 유아들에게는 다양한 주판 놀이 프로그램 적용으로 집중력, 추리력, 공간 지각력에 참을성을 키워주는 주산을 창의력 개발 및 지능 놀이도구 이용시 사고 미연 예방을 위해  미끄럼 방지 안전 주판을 제작하였다.

title_en: Automatic generation method and system for scheduling instruction ticket
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for automatically generating a scheduling instruction ticket, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1, the client side obtains power outage detail table data and opens the data through word processing software; s2, triggering a scheduling instruction ticket automatic generation function interface for a single or a plurality of records in the power outage and transmission detail table data by a user; s3, generating confirmation information by the automatic generation function interface of the dispatching instruction ticket, and acquiring a confirmation instruction or a modification instruction of a user for the confirmation information, wherein the confirmation information comprises switch ledger information and equipment state required to be operated; and S4, the automatic generation functional interface of the scheduling instruction ticket generates a corresponding scheduling instruction ticket according to the confirmation instruction or the modification instruction. The invention can automatically generate the corresponding dispatching instruction ticket through the automatic generation function interface of the dispatching instruction ticket, has higher input efficiency compared with manual typing, and can effectively avoid human factor errors.
assignees: DINGAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Space steel structure vibration response capturing and monitoring system based on earthquake early warning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space structure vibration response capturing and monitoring system based on earthquake early warning, which consists of an earthquake early warning monitor, an earthquake pickup, a computer working base station and a magnetic type wireless vibration acceleration sensor; the earthquake early warning monitor captures earthquake P wave signals and sends earthquake trigger information picked by the earthquake pickup to the working base station, and the base station sends a series of commands of vibration response data acquisition, recording, compression, return and the like to the wireless vibration acceleration sensor. And finally, uploading the site vibration and steel structure response data to a cloud platform by the base station, and carrying out building safety evaluation analysis. According to the characteristics of different propagation speeds of the seismic P wave and the seismic S wave, large span of the large-span building and wide distribution, the ground vibration condition of the position of the large-span space structure can be monitored for a long time and all weather on the function by combining the seismic P wave pickup technology and wireless communication, and the vibration response of the large-span space steel structure after the earthquake can be comprehensively captured.

title_en: Intelligent street patrol abnormal condition early warning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for early warning of abnormal conditions of intelligent street patrol. The method comprises the steps of collecting real-time video streams through a street fixed camera and uploading the real-time video streams to an intelligent street patrol equipment comprehensive management and control platform, utilizing a deep learning model to conduct real-time analysis on the video streams, identifying loitering, trailing and gathering abnormal behaviors and generating structural early warning events, generating optimal instructions through a resource scheduling algorithm based on event positions and real-time states of unmanned aerial vehicles and patrol groups, sending down instructions to drive the unmanned aerial vehicles to abut against and reconnaissance and return videos, guiding the patrol groups to go to treatment at the same time, receiving field feedback and storing the field feedback and the early warning events, scheduling instructions and the returned videos in an associated mode, and forming a treatment closed loop. The invention realizes the transition from passive recording to active early warning, from equipment isolation to cooperative linkage and from experience dispatching to data driving, and improves the early warning accuracy and response efficiency of street patrol.
assignees: FIRST RESEARCH INST OF THE MINISTRY OF PUBLIC SECURITY OF PRC

title_en: Multi-mode data fusion digital intelligent mining pressure monitoring method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of coal mine safety monitoring, and discloses a multi-mode data fusion intelligent mining pressure monitoring method, a multi-mode data fusion intelligent mining pressure monitoring device and electronic equipment. And then, cleaning and feature extraction are completed through a data processing module, the cleaning and feature extraction are input into an intelligent analysis module with a built-in attention mechanism and a long-short-term memory network, the space-time evolution rule of the mine pressure is deeply excavated, and real-time pressure probability is output. The system judges the risk level according to the probability interval and executes graded linkage, namely, low risk maintains normal state monitoring, medium risk prompts to strengthen patrol, high risk directly contacts with sounding and light alarming and automatically interlocks and cuts off equipment power to force people to withdraw. The method effectively overcomes the limitation of single-source monitoring, and remarkably improves the accuracy of roof disaster early warning and the emergency response timeliness through multi-mode deep fusion and automatic interlocking control.
assignees: CCTEG COAL MINING RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Information managing system, information managing method and information managing program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable a grasp of an entire status of an emergency response on the basis of a created message and of a progress status of an executing event.SOLUTION: A registering unit 121 registers, in a memory unit 11, an activity log that is information containing a message relating to an activity to be executed at the time of emergency response and a progress status of such an activity in association with a predetermined step of a workflow that sets, for each step, an execution subject of the activity and a condition in which the activity is executed. Moreover, a calculating unit 122 calculates a progress level of the activity for each step of the workflow on the basis of the progress status contained in the activity log registered by the registering unit 121. Further, a display controlling unit 123 displays information on the workflow on a display unit 31 together with information indicating the progress level calculated by the calculating unit 122.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Internet precaution defense system
title_ko: 인터넷을 이용한 경방시스템
abstract_en: A precaution defense system using Internet is provided to quickly and exactly edit and update information and extinguish a fire by using the information outputted in real time. A command headquarter vehicle where a precaution defense system is mounted is sent after a fire is reported. A user of the vehicle can access an Internet service by using the precaution defense system within a short time until the user arrives in a place where the fire is generated. By being connected to the precaution defense system, the user searches and outputs necessary information. By utilizing the obtained information, the user can more exactly grasp a situation and quickly put out the fire.

title_en: Method for providing data for learning chinese character based on item and computer-readable medium having thereon program performing function embodying the same
title_ko: 아이템 기반 한자 학습 데이터 제공 방법 및 이를실현시키기 위한 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 판독 가능한기록 매체
abstract_en: An item based Chinese character learning data providing method and a computer readable recording medium recording a program using Chinese character extracted based on the learning completion Chinese character are provided to learn the Chinese character as an item by using the item composed of the Chinese character. A Chinese character data to be learned is extracted(S110). Extracted learning subject Chinese character data is determined based on synthetic object the Chinese character list(S130). A user selection command about the Chinese character corresponding to the synthesis of learning subject Chinese character data is received(S150). The state of the item corresponding to learning subject Chinese character data is changed to the enable stat(S170).
