title_en: Solar Power Infrared Sensor Risk Detection Smart Pad
title_ko: 태양광 전력 적외선 센서 위험 감지 스마트 패드
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a smart pad for sensing a risk with an infrared (IR) sensor using solar power, which allows a sensor to sense a risk of falling and makes a notification, thereby preventing a falling accident, which accounts for a high percentage and a death rate out of industrial disasters to contribute to a safe working environment for a worker. Accordingly, a problem that any handrail is not sufficiently tall and a worker don't recognize that he or she is in a dangerous position, thereby leading to a falling accident in many cases can be addressed. The smart pad for work in a construction field according to the present invention comprises: a scaffold formed by attaching a handrail to the smart pad such that a worker can work outside a building; a solar panel manufactured in a form of a pad to be able to be attached and detached to supply power to the product in a construction field whose work period is long; IR sensors disposed at both ends of the solar panel in order to continuously sense whether a worker is in a dangerous position; and a speaker disposed at the outer side of the pad such that the worker can recognize that he or she is in a dangerous position. Therefore, the sensor is used to sense and notify any risk of falling to prevent a falling accident, which accounts for a high percentage and death rate of industrial disasters, thereby contributing to a safe working environment for a worker. In addition, a problem that any handrail is not sufficiently tall and a worker don't recognize that he or she is in a dangerous position, thereby leading to a falling accident in many cases can be addressed.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 태양광 전력 적외선 센서 위험 감지 스마트 패드에 관한 것으로서 산업재해 중 높은 비중과 사망율을 기록하는 추락사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 센서를 통해 감지하고 알림으로써 안전한 근무자의 작업환경에 기여할 수 있도록하도록 함으로써 기존의 난간이 있더라도 그 높이가 높지 않으며 위험한 위치에 있어도 인지를 못하여 추락사고로 이어지는 경우가 허다한 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 건설현장 작업용 발판에 있어서 작업자가 건물 외부에서 작업을 할 수 있게 발판에 난간이 부착된 형태로 형성한 비계 , 작업기간이 긴 건설현장에서 제품에 전력을 공급할 수 있게 발판 형태로 탈부착 가능하도록 제작한 태양광 패널, 작업자가 위험한 위치에 있을 때 지속적으로 이를 감지할 수 있게 태양광 패널 발판 양끝에 형성한 적외선 센서, 작업자가 위험한 위치에 있는 것을 인지할 수 있게 발판 외각에 형성한 스피커로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 산업재해 중 높은 비중과 사망율을 기록하는 추락사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 센서를 통해 감지하고 알림으로써 안전한 근무자의 작업환경에 기여할 수 있도록하도록 함으로써 기존의 난간이 있더라도 그 높이가 높지 않으며 위험한 위치에 있어도 인지를 못하여 추락사고로 이어지는 경우가 허다한 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Automated signal compliance monitoring and alerting system
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) for mobile assets that includes a data recorder and an automated signal monitoring and alerting system. The data recorder includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queueing repository. DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data acquired by DARS through a web browser, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety, and receive signal compliance and signal violations in real-time.

title_en: Defamation Avoiding System and Process to Identify Pattern Crimes
abstract_en: A system and process performed by the system for identifying and tracking perpetrators of any of various types of crimes, including bullying, child pornography, sexual assault and rape, in reports which are anonymously reported to the system. The perpetrators can be of various categories, such as formally convicted, and/or formally charged and not convicted, and/or never been charged or not yet been caught, and therefore are without prior convictions or criminal records and are thereby not on law enforcement's radar. The system and process relies upon the reporting by a victim or a witness of information pertinent to an alleged criminal event. The identity of each reporting victim is never known to the system, unless the victim or witness goes to the police. The system uses a “double blind” method to protect the victim and certain details of the reported incident.

title_en: Management of medical equipment and responders
abstract_en: A system for managing responders acquiring medical equipment and responding to an emergency medical event includes mobile devices associated with responders; a computer aided dispatch (CAD), and an equipment/responder management system communicatively coupled to the mobile devices and CAD and configured to receive an event location from the CAD, retrieve medical equipment locations from a database, receive responder locations from the mobile devices, send the event and equipment locations to a first mobile device, generate an activity log for the event including first responder status information based on the responder location, the event and medical equipment locations, send the activity log to the first mobile device, send the event location and the medical equipment locations to a second mobile device, update the activity log with second responder status information based on the responder, event and medical equipment locations, and send the activity log to the mobile devices.

title_en: Method and device for predicting charging waiting time of pure electric bus
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a device for predicting the charging waiting time of a pure electric bus, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring vehicle dispatching record data or a vehicle dispatching plan, inputting a charging waiting time prediction model, and outputting a corresponding charging waiting time; the charging waiting duration prediction model is obtained after training based on a sample set, the sample set comprises vehicle charging waiting data samples, and each vehicle charging waiting data sample comprises vehicle arrival time, at least one charging starting time and charging waiting duration; the calculation of the charging waiting time is to obtain an accurate calculation result of the charging waiting time by processing and analyzing the vehicle operation data and the charging data. The method and the device for predicting the charging waiting time of the pure electric bus, provided by the embodiment of the invention, can be used for accurately predicting the charging waiting time of the pure electric bus after the pure electric bus arrives at a station, realizing the evaluation of the current charging queuing state of the pure electric bus and improving the operation efficiency of the pure electric bus.

title_en: System, method and computer readable recording medium for controlling of wireless emergency bell
title_ko: 무선 비상벨 제어 시스템, 방법 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention relate to a wireless emergency bell. A method of controlling the wireless emergency bell installed in schools and school zones comprises: a step of receiving an input signal which is generated when a reporter presses a provided button in an emergency situation; a step of generating an emergency bell signal, repeatedly transmitting the emergency bell signal to at least one pager and a receiver for a predetermined set period of time, and outputting a pre-stored alarm sound to the outside through a provided speaker; a step of generating an emergency bell voice signal and transmitting the emergency bell voice signal to the at least one pager and the receiver; a step of generating an emergency bell voice transmission completion signal indicating that the transmission of the emergency bell voice signal is complete and transmitting the emergency bell voice transmission completion signal to the at least one pager and the receiver; a step of converting the operation of the wireless emergency bell into a receiving mode capable of receiving data from the at least one pager automatically after the set time; a step of receiving a pager voice signal from the at least one pager; a step of determining whether there is the received pager voice signal and outputting the received pager voice signal to the outside through the speaker when there is the received pager voice signal; and a step of determining whether a mode conversion command signal is received from the at least one pager when there is no received pager voice signal and converting the operation into a transmitting mode capable of transmitting the data to the at least one pager and the receiver when there is the received mode conversion command signal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예들은 무선 비상벨에 관한 것으로서, 학교 및 스쿨존에 설치되는 무선 비상벨 제어 방법에 있어서, 비상 상황 발생 시 신고자가 구비된 버튼을 눌러 생성되는 입력 신호를 수신하는 단계; 비상벨 신호를 생성하여 적어도 하나의 호출기 및 수신기로 미리 정해진 설정 시간 동안 반복 송신하며 미리 저장된 알람음을 구비된 스피커를 통해 외부로 출력하는 단계; 비상벨 음성 신호를 생성하여 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기 및 상기 수신기로 송신하는 단계; 상기 비상벨 음성 신호가 송신 완료되었음을 나타내는 비상벨 음성 송신 완료 신호를 생성하여 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기 및 상기 수신기로 송신하는 단계; 설정 시간 이후 자동으로 적어도 하나의 호출기로부터 데이터를 수신할 수 있는 수신 모드로 상기 무선 비상벨의 동작을 전환하는 단계; 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기로부터 호출기 음성 신호를 수신하는 단계; 상기 수신된 호출기 음성 신호가 있는지 여부를 판단하고, 상기 수신된 호출기 음성 신호가 있는 경우, 상기 수신된 호출기 음성 신호를 상기 스피커를 통해 외부로 출력하는 단계; 및 상기 수신된 호출기 음성 신호가 없는 경우, 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기로부터 모드 전환 명령 신호가 수신되었는지 판단하고, 상기 수신된 모드 전환 명령 신호가 있는 경우, 상기 적어도 하나의 호출기 및 상기 수신기로 데이터를 송신할 수 있는 송신 모드로 동작을 전환하는 단계; 를 수행하는 적어도 하나의 무선 비상벨을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of new law enforcement police cap
abstract_en: The invention belongs to public safety equipment technology field, more particularly to a kind of new law enforcement police cap, it is characterised in that：Including alert cap portion and portion of the handle, alert cap portion includes photographing module, communication module, face recognition module and the locating module being connected respectively with processor data；Portion of the handle includes the fingerprint identification module and display screen by bluetooth connection；Alert cap portion and portion of the handle are respectively equipped with power supply.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows make full use of the existing equipment of police, by the way of alert cap is combined with handheld terminal bluetooth, interconnect, gathered the fingerprint recognition and display function of positioning, recognition of face and handheld terminal, a tractor serves several purposes；Camera is embedded in immediately ahead of alert cap, and substitution conventional hand video recording, crypticity is good；Alert cap portion is communicated by 4G and communicated in real time with command centre, and wifi or bluetooth are easy to the Video Document that transfer is stored, a variety of communication transfer modes, beneficial to reduction use cost.

title_en: Airport emergency rescue system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airport emergency rescue system and method, which are used for judging the occurrence position of an event when an emergency of an airport oil depot occurs, informing a nearby inspection terminal to go to the scene and improving the emergency rescue efficiency. The technical proposal is as follows: the system carries out regional management monitoring on the airport oil depot, judges the occurrence position of an event in time when the emergency is met, and informs the inspection terminals to start according to the sequence and at the same time interval, so that the inspection terminals can be ensured to exist in each monitoring area; presetting an unlocking voice command, and when emergency unlocking is needed, unlocking by the information acquisition unit through acquiring the corresponding voice command, wherein the voice command is input through a patrol terminal of a user, and the patrol terminal is connected with the access control module through a signal, so that a manager remotely controls the opening and closing of the access control; the pre-input personal information is classified and managed, so that the personnel can check the personal information conveniently, the strange information is recorded and stored, and the condition that non-personnel independently enter an oil depot can be effectively prevented.
assignees: DONGHANG TECH APPLICATION RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT CENTER CO LTD;UNIV CIVIL AVIATION FLIGHT CHINA

title_en: Method for rapidly identifying natural disasters based on remote sensing satellite data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly identifying natural disasters based on remote sensing satellite data, and relates to the technical field of natural disaster monitoring. The method and the system solve the problems that in the prior art, the type and the degree of disasters are difficult to accurately and rapidly identify by means of the traditional data processing and analyzing method, the rapid monitoring of a large-area is realized by utilizing multi-source remote sensing satellite data, monitoring blind areas are effectively eliminated, disasters in remote areas can be timely found, the type and the degree of the disasters can be accurately and rapidly identified, the accuracy and the reliability of disaster identification are greatly improved, multi-source data are fully fused, a time sequence analysis and a machine learning algorithm are combined, disaster information behind the data is deeply mined, the data processing and analysis efficiency is remarkably improved, the timeliness requirement of disaster emergency response is met, a dynamically updated disaster feature library and an identification model are established, and the disaster identification and evaluation capability is continuously optimized.
assignees: BEIJING HUAYUN XINGDITONG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for identifying risk of key infrastructure in flood disaster chain scene
abstract_en: The application discloses a key infrastructure risk identification method and device under a flood disaster chain scene, wherein the key infrastructure risk identification method and device comprises an acquisition module, an extraction module, a construction module, a coupling module and an early warning module, wherein the acquisition module is used for acquiring multi-source data and carrying out space-time alignment and fusion processing, the extraction module is used for extracting space-time evolution characteristics of the flood disaster chain based on the multi-source data, the construction module is used for constructing key infrastructure coefficients according to priori infrastructure information, the coupling module is used for coupling the space-time evolution characteristics and the key infrastructure coefficients, and calculating a regional risk index through dynamic coupling coefficients and space sensitivity factors, and the early warning module is used for generating a risk space distribution map and triggering dynamic early warning. According to the technical scheme, the space-time evolution characteristics of the flood disaster chain are extracted through multi-source data acquisition and space-time fusion, key infrastructure coefficients based on information such as buildings, roads and population are constructed, the risk indexes of the areas are calculated through dynamic coupling, the risk distribution is intuitively reflected, accurate early warning and emergency response are realized, the disaster prevention and reduction level of the city is effectively improved, and the public safety guarantee efficiency is remarkably improved.

title_en: Digital relay telephone traffic real-time acquisition and intelligent distribution system oriented to emergency dispatch
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of digital relay, and discloses a digital relay telephone traffic real-time acquisition and intelligent distribution system oriented to emergency dispatch, which comprises the following steps of executing by five modules, receiving and regulating UDP data by a time domain buffer management module, and the cross-protocol association engine completes space-time matching of telephone traffic and media streams, unsuccessful data trigger reverse traceback service to remedy, the intelligent scheduling controller carries out hierarchical processing according to the emergency degree and dynamically allocates resources, and finally the data are intelligently distributed to the message queue cluster through the elastic load balancing module. According to the invention, by constructing a multi-level heterogeneous data processing framework and a dynamic redundancy transmission, intelligent space-time alignment and elastic resource scheduling mechanism, accurate routing of emergency instructions and zero loss guarantee of key data are realized, meanwhile, the self-adaptive fault tolerance capability of a system to abnormal working conditions such as equipment clock deviation and burst flow is enhanced, and a high-availability technical support is provided for digital upgrade of emergency scheduling.
assignees: ZHUHAI ANKER ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and sheet for studying foreign language, recording medium for program thereof
title_ko: 외국어 학습 방법, 학습 용지 및 외국어 학습 프로그램을 기록한 기록 매체
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A method and a sheet for studying a foreign language are provided to improve foreign language studying efficiency. CONSTITUTION: A foreign language studying form(300) includes a mother language meaning writing form(310) and a foreign language sentence writing form(320). The mother language meaning unit writes the meaning of the sentence as the mother language according to the order of the foreign language according to a semantic phrase. The learner writes the foreign language sentence on the foreign language sentence writing unit based on the meaning of the sentence written on the mother language meaning writing unit.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 외국어 학습 방법, 학습 용지 및 외국어 학습 프로그램을 기록한 기록 매체에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 외국어 학습 방법은 외국어 본문을 듣고, 말하고, 쓰는 단계를 통해 본문을 습득한다. 학습자는 모국어로 기재한 단어의 뜻을 보고 외국어 단어를 기재하거나, 모국어로 기재한 숙어의 뜻을 보고 외국어 문장을 기재하여 학습할 수 있다. 학습자는 외국어 어순에 따라 모국어로 기재된 문장의 뜻을 보고 외국어 문장을 기재하여 학습할 수 있다. 학습자는 본문의 원어민 발음을 듣고 이를 따라하는 학습자의 발음을 녹음하여, 녹음된 원어민 발음과 학습자 발음을 듣고, 말하고, 써서 학습할 수 있다.  
     본 발명에 따르면, 외국어에 대한 두려움을 없애고, 사고를 외국어 어순으로 할 수 있다. 따라서 외국어를 빠른 시간 내에 원어민처럼 할 수 있게 된다.  
     
     외국어 학습, 프로그램, 학습 용지, 외국어 어순

title_en: Remaining time displayed Traffic lights
title_ko: Led를 통한 잔여시간 표시 교통신호등 및 알고리즘
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a traffic light installed on a road. Existing traffic lights provide only simple or approximate information on the lighting-up time of a sign when the sign of the traffic lights changes into another sign to a driver using a blinking sign but do not provide accurate information. Therefore, there were many casualties and property damages caused by traffic accidents due to wrong judgment and prediction of a situation as information on the change of traffic signs depends only on the circumstantial judgment and prediction of a driver. Therefore, the present invention has the lighting time display of a crosswalk traffic light coupled to a driver traffic light, has a red sign (11), a yellow sign (12) and a green sign (13) configured using multiple res LEDs, yellow LEDs and green LEDs, and has an area for displaying a number allocated in the middle of each sign. LED groups placed in the allocated area form separate groups for displaying numbers according to data on remaining time. The separate groups for displaying numbers are controlled by the timing count number of a pre-programmed traffic sign control part (17) and the result value of calculating remaining time to display the remaining time of a corresponding traffic sign as digital numbers in a counting-down manner.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 목적은 도로에 설치되는 교통신호등에 관한 것으로써, 기존 교통신호등의 경우 교통신호등의 신호표시가 언제 다른 표시로 바뀌게 될 것인지에 대하여 운전자에게 점멸 신호등과 같이 신호의 점등시기에 대하여 간략 혹은 대략적인 정보만을 제공, 정확한 정보를 제공하지 못함으로써 교통신호의 흐름에 대한 정보는 전적으로 운전자 개인의 상황판단력 및 예측에 의존하여야만 하였으며 이에 따라 잘못된 상황판단 및 예측으로 발생한 교통사고에 따른 인명피해 및 재산피해가 많았다. 따라서 본 발명은 보행자 신호등의 점등시간 숫자표시를 운전자 교통신호등에 접목하여 다수의 적색LED, 황색LED, 녹색LED를 이용하여 각각의 교통신호 적색 표시등(11), 황색 표시등(12), 녹색 표시등(13)을 구성하고 각각의 표시등 중앙부에는 숫자 표기를 위한 영역을 할당하여 할당영역에 위치하는 일련의 LED그룹들이 잔여시간 데이터에 따른 숫자 표시를 위한 개별 그룹을 형성하도록 구성하고, 이들 숫자 표시를 위한 개별 그룹들은 사전에 프로그래밍 되어진 교통신호제어부(17)의 타이밍 카운트 값 및 잔여시간 연산처리 결과 값에 의해 제어되어 해당 교통신호의 잔여시간 값을 디지털 숫자로 다운카운트 형식으로 표시한다.

title_en: Systems, methods, and apparatuses for implementing an incident response information management solution for first responders
abstract_en: Described herein are methods and systems for implementing an incident response information management solution for First Responders. In one embodiment, such means include a system having at least a processor and a memory therein, in which the system includes means for establishing a first communications link between a first client device and the system over a network, the first client device being associated with a first emergency response person; means for displaying an interface at the first client device from the system; means for identifying an emergency response incident type at the first client device via the interface; means for generating an incident response record at the system responsive to the identifying of the emergency response incident type at the first client device; means for establishing a second communications link between a second client device and the system over the network, the second client device being associated with a second emergency response person; means for displaying the interface at the second client device from the system; means for displaying emergency response information at the interface of the second client device selected based on the emergency response incident type identified at the first client device, in which the emergency response information is communicated from the system to the second client device over the network; and means for receiving incident metrics at the system captured via the interface at the second client device and recording the incident metrics within the incident response record. Other related embodiments are further described.
assignees: MOODY DANIEL E B;MOODY LAWRENCE A H;WELLS CHRISTOPHER W L;STRAWBERRY MEDIA INC

title_en: Automatic rescue operation control program system
title_ko: 다기종 승강기에 호환 적용되는 자동구출운전제어 프로그램 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an automatic rescue operation control program system compatible with various types of elevators. The purpose of the present invention is to provide an automatic rescue operation control program system compatible with various types of elevators, which allows an operation control program module to be selectively selected and applied to various types of elevators of manufacturers without being limited to specific types of elevators of manufacturers or specific elevator operating methods, thereby minimizing damage to small and medium-sized elevator companies due to unreasonable demands or tyranny from specific large companies that have independent program technology, and can significantly increase economic efficiency, constructability, and efficiency of facility operation in accordance with various and general installation and use relations. Therefore, the automatic rescue operation control program system comprises: an operation control program module having an accident signal transmission unit and linking a control panel of an elevator to an automatic operation rescue device and controlling the same; an automatic rescue integrated control server connected to the operation control program module through an online network; and an emergency rescue agency server and a maintenance technician terminal connected to the automatic rescue integrated control server through the online network.

title_en: An apparatus for calculating the risk of an accident at a hydrogen charging station, a method therefor and a computer recordable medium storing program to perform the method
title_ko: 수소충전소 사고의 위험도 산출을 위한 장치, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법을 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: Provided is a device for calculating a risk of an accident at a hydrogen charging station. The device comprises: a feature map generating unit generating a feature map including an accident feature map, a geopographic feature map, and a population distribution feature map based on an input data; and a risk prediction unit that generates a personal risk map indicating an individual risk level due to an accident and a social risk map indicating a social risk level due to an accident by inputting the feature map into a prediction model so that the prediction model performs a plurality of operations to which a weighted value learned between a plurality of layers are applied to the feature map.
abstract_ko: 수소충전소 사고의 위험도 산출을 위한 장치가 제공된다. 상기 장치는 수소충전소의 위치 및 상기 수소충전소의 규모를 포함하는 입력 데이터가 입력되면, 입력 데이터를 기초로 사고특징지도, 지형지물특징지도 및 인구분포특징지도를 포함하는 특징지도를 생성하는 특징지도생성부와, 상기 특징지도를 예측모델에 입력하여 상기 예측모델이 상기 특징지도에 대해 복수의 계층 간 학습된 가중치가 적용되는 복수의 연산을 수행하여 사고로 인한 개인적 위험도를 나타내는 개인위험지도 및 사고로 인한 사회적 위험도를 나타내는 사회위험지도를 생성하도록 하는 위험예측부를 포함한다.

title_en: Portable disease surveillance recorder
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a portable disease surveillance recorder which comprises a shell and a central processing unit (CPU), as well as a display screen, a photosensitive module, a camera module, an infrared light fill-in module, a key module, a 3G communication module, a pickup module, a storage module, a power supply module, a GPS module and a USB module, wherein the CPU is arranged in the shell; the CPU is respectively connected with the display screen, the photosensitive module, the camera module, the infrared light fill-in module, the key module, the 3G communication module, the pickup module, the storage module, the power supply module, the GPS module and the USB module; and the photosensitive module comprises a photoreceptor and an infrared lens, the input end of the photoreceptor is connected with the infrared lens, and the output end of the photoreceptor is connected with the USB. The portable disease surveillance recorder disclosed by the utility model has the functions of photographing, camera shooting, recording pens and the like, and integrates the GPS technology and the 3G technology, thereby greatly improving the accuracy, timeliness and rapid emergency response ability of disease information acquisition operations.
assignees: JINAN MUNICIPAL CT FOR DISEASE CONTROL & PREVENTION

title_en: The ball-shaped camera of wireless radar fix
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of ball-shaped camera of wireless radar fix, comprise video camera, The Cloud Terrace, microcontroller, video camera, The Cloud Terrace are connected power supply respectively with microcontroller, power acquisition is that video camera, The Cloud Terrace and microcontroller are powered with the diode of micro-electric current, triode, also comprises the WiFi wireless network module and command process module that are connected with WLAN (wireless local area network); WiFi wireless network module is connected with microcontroller respectively with command process module, and radar connects WiFi wireless network module by supervisory control system.The utility model coordinates the observation and patrol mission that can substitute and be undertaken by manpower frontier sentry with radar, more can discharge more man power and material to the full extent, the confirmation invasion unknown object of energy fast accurate, real-time recording and candid photograph are carried out to unknown object, as provided accurate location and image record to illegal entry personnel, for follow-up arrest action provide strong evidence, for public safety cause is added bricks and tiles.

title_en: Method and device for recording rescue information
abstract_en: The invention aims to provide a method and a device for recording rescue information. Compared with the prior art, rescue request information is received via a network device, and a piece of first marker information corresponding to the request information is generated. The network device determines at least one second user equipment which replies the rescue request information. The second user equipment sends rescue-beginning information to the network device, gets information relevant to the rescue scene, and provides the information relevant to the rescue scene to the network device. The network device receives and saves the information relevant to the rescue scene, wherein the information relevant to the rescue scene is indexed by means of the first marker information. In this way, when carrying out rescue operation in the rescue scene, rescuers can acquire the information relevant to the rescue scene and send the information to the network device so as to record the information, which may be called as evidence in future. In addition, the network device may be allowed to acquire the information relevant to the rescue scene in real time so that the best rescue command is made.
assignees: SHANGHAI JIUYAOJIU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Fire event processing system and method
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and a method for processing fire fighting events, wherein the system comprises: the video equipment maintenance module is used for recording video equipment information of at least one video equipment in the fire fighting area; the fire fighting equipment management module is used for recording fire fighting equipment information of at least one fire fighting equipment in the fire fighting area and associating the fire fighting equipment with the video equipment recorded by the video equipment maintenance module; wherein the distance between each group of associated video equipment and the fire-fighting equipment is closest; the hot spot configuration module is used for configuring the position information of each group of video equipment and fire-fighting facilities related to the fire-fighting facility management module to obtain facility distribution information; and the fire-fighting alarm monitoring module is used for receiving an alarm signal when the external sensor detects a fire-fighting event and displaying the facility distribution information to a user so that the user can process the fire-fighting event. This scheme can improve the treatment effeciency of fire incident.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR GENESOFT INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake disaster rapid evaluation method based on GNSS and MEMS real-time monitoring data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for quickly evaluating earthquake disasters based on GNSS and MEMS real-time monitoring data, which relates to the technical field of earthquake disaster evaluation and comprises the following steps: a data information acquisition module; a seismic influence field attenuation model building module; an intensity attenuation relation determining module; a pre-evaluation intensity map module; an intensity correction model establishing module; an intensity value adjusting module; by using the integral method, the data with administrative districts as units can be converted into data with kilometer grids as units, data allocation errors caused by administrative district division are avoided, the effectiveness of a disaster situation quick evaluation result is guaranteed, disaster situation information of an earthquake area with serious disaster after earthquake can be timely and accurately reported to a command decision department, earthquake disaster loss can be evaluated, building damage, casualties, economic loss and the like are calculated mainly based on historical basic data and a building earthquake damage matrix, the timeliness of historical data is improved, and the accuracy of the evaluation result is guaranteed.
assignees: CHINESE EARTHQUAKE EMERGENCY SEARCH AND RESCUE CENTER

title_en: Simulation analysis evaluation method for hydrogen fuel cell bus dispatching algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a simulation analysis evaluation method of a hydrogen fuel cell bus dispatching algorithm, which realizes simulation operation analysis of an intelligent algorithm for a hydrogen fuel cell bus based on vehicle operation big data, comprehensively considers the actual operation environment and operation characteristics of the hydrogen fuel cell bus, classifies the categories of vehicle driving, operation timeliness, hydrogenation behaviors and the like, and calculates a standard operation reference index value. A simulation environment and various disturbance simulation events are set up by combining the scheduling events in the operation process, so that the scheduling adjustment capability of the intelligent algorithm facing different actual conditions can be effectively verified. The method overcomes the defects of long time consumption and low efficiency of the conventional bus scheduling strategy verification, has extremely high applicability to different intelligent scheduling algorithms, and is favorable for assisting related operation units to timely perform global scheduling decision of hydrogen fuel buses and hydrogen energy systems.
assignees: BEILI XINYUAN FOSHAN INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle road safety interaction system based on Internet of vehicles
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle road safety interaction system based on the Internet of vehicles, which relates to the technical field of intelligent driving and safety assistance and comprises an emergency response module, wherein the emergency response module is in communication connection with a vehicle road data acquisition module, a vehicle road data encryption module and a vehicle road data analysis module, the vehicle road data acquisition module acquires vehicle driving data and road environment data through a vehicle-mounted sensor, the concentration degree of a driver is observed through a biological recognition technology, the identity of a user and equipment is verified, the vehicle road data encryption module visualizes original data, log records and watermarks are used for tracking and recording user operation in the whole course, a hybrid encryption algorithm is adopted for encrypting sensitive data, the vehicle road data analysis module judges whether to carry out safety prompt on the driver according to visibility and driver state, the user identity is authenticated according to Euclidean distance calculation result, the emergency response module evaluates the potential risk of the vehicle driving, isolates leakage sources and sends early warning notification.
assignees: SHUYANG TENGZHIYI NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Expressway emergency response method and system based on management and control unit
abstract_en: The invention provides a highway emergency response method and system based on a management and control unit, which can systematically analyze and process knowledge vector data of each management and control unit driving event in a plurality of emergency response stages with logic time sequence order by acquiring an event logic knowledge network of a highway emergency event and driving event data in a monitoring stream of the management and control unit. By fusing the initial knowledge vector data and the prior transmission knowledge vector data of each emergency response stage, more accurate and comprehensive transmission knowledge vector data is generated, and then response schemes corresponding to each emergency response stage are determined. The method not only improves the precision and efficiency of emergency response, but also optimizes the allocation and scheduling of emergency resources by determining the priority information of the running event of the candidate management and control unit. Finally, according to the priority information of the driving event of each management and control unit, the disposal event corresponding to the expressway emergency event can be rapidly and accurately determined.
assignees: SHENZHONG CHANNEL MAN CENTER OF GUANGDONG HIGHWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD;RES INST HIGHWAY MINI TRANSP;GUANGDONG PROVINCIAL HIGHWAY CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Emergency mooring communication unmanned plane platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency mobile communication, in particular to an emergency tethered communication unmanned aerial vehicle platform which comprises a flight attitude regulation module, a signal coverage optimization module, a dynamic track extraction module, a communication quality quantification module and a risk state identification module. According to the invention, the flight attitude of the unmanned aerial vehicle is accurately adjusted, the signal coverage and the communication quality are optimized, the reliability and the coverage of emergency communication are improved, the matching of the signal intensity distribution and the flight path can be analyzed in real time, the stability and the coverage effect of the communication equipment are ensured to reach the optimal state in a sudden environment, the potential risk is monitored and identified in real time, the guarantee state is automatically adjusted through the quantitative analysis of the communication quality trend, the efficient and stable communication service is ensured to be continuously provided under the complex condition, the adaptability of the unmanned aerial vehicle is improved due to the optimization, the emergency response capability of the emergency communication under different environments is enhanced, and the timeliness and the accuracy of the communication guarantee are ensured.
assignees: CONTINENTAL UNION CHAOLUN TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Power management system of production facility for vehicle
title_ko: 차량용 생산설비의 전력관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a power management system which performs energy management of a production facility for producing parts for a vehicle. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the power management system of a production facility for a vehicle comprises: a power measurement unit having a plurality of integrating wattmeters individually installed on production facilities used in producing parts for a vehicle to measure the wattage of each production facility; and a control unit which receives data for the wattage of each production facility from the power measurement unit to record the wattage of each production facility and detect whether each production facility is abnormal. Accordingly, the wattage of a production facility for producing parts for a vehicle is collected in real time, and is processed to detect whether the production facility is abnormal in real time to improve energy management efficiency and prevent accidents such as a fire caused by a fault or a short circuit, an overcurrent, and an arc current of the production facility. Also, processed data are used to write or adjust an operation schedule to improve energy management efficiency and calculate an applicable optimal capacity when manufacturing production facilities of the same specification through accurate power demand prediction to reduce manufacturing costs.
abstract_ko: 차량용 부품을 생산하는 생산설비의 에너지 관리를 수행하는 전력관리 시스템이 제공된다. 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른, 차량용 생산설비의 전력관리 시스템은, 차량용 부품을 생산하는데 이용되는 생산설비마다 개별적으로 설치되어, 각각의 생산설비의 전력량을 측정하는 복수의 적산전력계가 구비되는 전력 측정부; 및 전력 측정부로부터 각각의 생산설비의 전력량에 대한 데이터를 수신하여, 각각의 생산설비의 전력량을 기록하고, 각각의 생산설비의 이상 여부를 검출하는 제어부;를 포함한다. 이에 의해, 차량용 부품을 생산하는 생산설비의 전력량을 실시간으로 수집하고, 이를 가공하여, 생산설비의 이상 여부를 실시간 검출할 수 있어, 에너지 관리의 효율을 향상시키고, 생산설비의 고장 또는 누전, 과전류, 아크 전류 등을 원인으로 하는 화재 등의 사고를 예방할 수 있다. 또한, 가공된 데이터를 이용하여, 가동 스케줄을 작성하거나 또는 조정하여, 에너지 관리의 효율을 향상시키고, 정확한 전력 수요 예측을 통해, 동일 스펙의 생산 설비 제작시, 적용 가능한 최적 용량을 산출하여, 제작 비용을 절감시킬 수 있다.

title_en: System for validating and appending incident-related data records in an inter-agency distributed electronic ledger
abstract_en: A computer apparatus, such as a validator node, for validating data records in a distributed electronic ledger may be configured to receive a proposed data record submitted by an originating agent of an originating agency to a distributed ledger. In response to the proposed incident-related data record, other agents within the originating agency may, based on validation criteria, submit one or more responsive data records that may provide information for use in determining a validity of the proposed incident-related data record. Validator nodes hosted by external agencies may submit validation responses relative to a validity of the proposed incident-related data record. The system may determine that the proposed data record is valid. Based a consensus algorithm, the system may responsively append the proposed data record or an indication of validity to the distributed ledger or to a different distributed ledger.

title_en: Wearable heads-up display ("hud") for a pharmacy workflow management system
abstract_en: A wearable heads-up display ("HUD") for a pharmacy workflow management system is disclosed herein. An example HUD includes smart-glasses that are communicatively coupled to a client device. The smart-glasses include at least one camera and/or barcode scanner to record information needed for the verification of a medication dose during medication formulation preparation. The smart-glasses include at least one microphone to record voice commands. Further, the smart-glasses include at least one embedded display screen that shows sequential steps of a preparation protocol for guiding a pharmacy technician to prepare a medication dose. An application on the client device and/or the smart-glasses is configured to recognize and use voice commands to provide navigation for the embedded display screen. The voice commands may also be used to provide data entry for medication dose preparation verification. Gestures may be detected by the camera and translated by the application into navigation or data entry commands.

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a data acquisition and recording system DARS for mobile assets, comprising a data logger. The data logger includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queuing store. The DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores compressed records of the data in a local memory module at least once per second. DARS is designed to operate in near real-time mode, storing a complete record of data comprising five minutes to the remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once every second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users may: viewing video, audio, and data acquired by the DARS through a web browser, which provides a faster emergency response; verifying the effectiveness of repair and rerouting; and monitoring team member performance and safety.

title_en: Programming device, recording medium, and programming method
abstract_en: The invention provides a programming device, a recording medium, and a programming method, which enable a user to easily understand the relationship between a programming operation and the movement of a three-dimensional object of a controlled part corresponding to a program generated by the operation. The programming device has: a programming board (120) that accepts at least one first user operation for specifying a planar shape by specifying two or more portions among a plurality of portions arranged at mutually different positions in the planar direction; a height receiving unit configured to receive at least one second user operation for indicating a height, which is a position in the intersecting direction of the planes, or an amount of displacement of the height, in association with any one of the two or more portions; and a control unit that generates a command list for moving the target device (200) in accordance with the three-dimensional shape instructed by the programming board (120) and the height receiving unit.

title_en: Automatic switching system and switching method for automatic switching pressure plate of equipment based on double-active framework
abstract_en: The invention discloses a spare automatic switching press plate switching system and a switching method based on a dual-active architecture, which comprise dual-active systems, wherein the dual-active systems have the capability of performing real-time calculation, an active system and a standby system are mutually switched seamlessly, a perfect fault detection mechanism is designed, the communication state and the running state of the system are monitored through heartbeat test, the data synchronization of the dual-active systems is the key for ensuring the data consistency among the systems, measures are taken to ensure the timeliness and the safety of the data synchronization, the data error caused by inconsistent service data is avoided, and various autonomous judging and self-rescue functions are integrated, so that the fault switching, recovery and early warning can be automatically completed under abnormal conditions. The stability and the safety of the system are improved, the switching efficiency of the disaster recovery system is improved, and the system can be quickly switched to the standby system under the condition that the master system of the OCS system is unavailable, so that the influence of the dispatching production work of the power grid is reduced to the minimum.

title_en: Dynamic goods supplementing method and system for emergency medical supplies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic replenishment method and system for emergency medical supplies, which relate to the technical field of medical supply data management and comprise the steps of obtaining the actual consumption rate of medical supplies at the current moment of a medical institution; the method comprises the steps of obtaining emergency response factors according to the risk level of current emergency, obtaining ageing constraint factors according to the inventory condition of medical materials at the current moment of a medical institution, obtaining geographical optimization factors according to the distribution ageing of each medical material distribution warehouse, and calculating to obtain the safe replenishment quantity according to the actual consumption rate, the emergency response factors, the ageing constraint factors and the geographical optimization factors. According to the invention, through mathematical model innovation and algorithm collaborative optimization, a medical supply chain management system with elastic response capability is constructed, and the dimensions such as emergency timeliness, resource utilization rate and data security are obviously superior to those of the traditional method.

title_en: smart-functional portable Silicone Gas mask and its manufacturing method
title_ko: 휴대용 스마트 실리콘 방독 마스크와 그 제조 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of protective equipment technology, and in particular to a portable smart silicone gas mask. According to the portable smart silicone gas mask of the present invention, a face-fitting silicone absorbent material harmless to the human body is formed as an absorbent part to seal the face, head, and neck in a mask-like manner, wherein a field of vision is secured through a silicone transparent viewing window, and breathing is performed through a purification part and an exhaust part. When a mask body is unfolded, a warning light operates and automatic pairing with a mobile phone is performed. The portable smart silicone gas mask according to the present invention can be placed in large quantities in public places used by an unspecified number of people, and can be carried in a pocket or vehicle at all times and quickly put on like a general mask in the event of a chemical, biological, or radiological terrorism incident or a fire. Then, it is possible to automatically send a rescue signal to a rescue center and make a call while escaping to a safe area without missing the golden time. As a result, social costs due to disasters are reduced and casualties are minimized.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 방호용품 기술분야에 관한 것으로, 특히 휴대용 스마트 실리콘 방독 마스크에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 휴대용 스마트 실리콘 방독 마스크는 인체에 무해한 얼굴 밀착형 실리콘 흡착재질이 흡착부로 형성되어 얼굴과 머리 그리고 목 부위 까지 복면형으로 밀폐시키고 실리콘 투명 투시창으로 시야를 확보하며 정화부와 배기부를 통하여 호흡하며 마스크 본체를 펼치면 경고등이 작동하며 휴대폰과 자동 페어링되도록 구성된다. 이렇게 만들어진 본 발명에 따른 휴대용 스마트 실리콘 방독 마스크는 불특정 다수가 이용하는 공공장소에 대량 비치할 수가 있게 되고 호주머니나 차량에 상시 휴대하다 화생방 테러 발생이나 화재등 재난상황 발생시 일반 마스크처럼 신속하게 착용하여 골든 타임을 놓치지 않고 안전지대로 탈출을 하면서 구조센터에 자동으로 구조신호를 보내며 통화를 할 수 있도록 고안된 것으로 재난으로 인한 사회적 경비를 절감시킴은 물론 인명 피해를 최소화 시키는데 목적이 있다.

title_en: System of realtime remote diagnostic underground power distribution line
title_ko: 지중 배전선로 실시간 원격 진단시스템
abstract_en: Provided is a real-time remote diagnosis system for an underground distribution line, which comprises: an underground relay wireless communication unit (1000) performing real-time relay wireless communication with the ground through a ground antenna (300) and wirelessly communicating with the inside of an underground power line (200) through an underground antenna (400); an underground driving diagnosis robot (2000) photographing an image of the appearance of the underground distribution line (100) in real time; and a ground central control server (3000) recording and storing information transmitted by the underground driving diagnosis robot (2000), analyzing the information in real time, notifying a designated manager terminal device when it is determined that a failure has occurred, and controlling to dispatch to the site. The present invention has the advantage of preventing the occurrence of a major accident by securing pre- and post-processed images and location information of a site and transmitting the images and location information to a remote location while approaching the location and spraying a cooling extinguishing agent and an insulating agent, thereby blocking or extinguishing the accident at an early stage.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하의 전력선 관로에 설치된 지중 배전선로의 상태를 자율주행 로봇으로 감시와 진단하고 지중 배전선로의 특정 부위에서 허용 온도보다 높은 온도 또는 허용레벨 이상의 누설전류가 검출되면 해당 위치의 지중 배전선로에 절연피막을 도포하는 동시에 해당 부위의 이미지를 촬영하고 검출된 위치정보와 함께 서버에 통보하며 연기와 화재가 검출되면 해당 위치에 소화액을 분사하여 초기에 진압하므로 대형사고를 방지하는 지중 배전선로 실시간 원격 진단시스템에 관한 것이며, 지하에 매설되고 지중배전선로가 설치된 지중전력선관로의 내부 벽면 일부분에 균일한 간격으로 고정 설치되며 지표면으로 관통 설치된 지상안테나를 통하여 지상과 실시간 중계무선통신하고 지중안테나를 통하여 지중전력선관로의 내부와 무선통신하는 지중중계무선통신부; 지중전력선관로의 내부에 배치되고 자율주행 방식과 제어신호에 의하여 이동하며 상기 지중중계무선통신부)와 무선 접속하고 지중배전선로의 외관의 이미지를 실시간 촬영하며 촬영된 이미지를 분석하여 온도를 검출하고 지중배전선로로부터 검출되는 전류크기를 측정하여 전류가 누설되는지 판단하며 해당 제어신호에 의하여 냉각소화액 또는 절연체도포액을 분사하고 촬영된 이미지 정보와 분석된 온도 정보와 측정된 누설전류 정보를 상기 지중중계무선통신부에 실시간 전송하는 지중주행진단로봇; 지중중계무선통신부와 무선 접속하고 지중주행진단로봇이 전송한 정보를 기록 저장하고 실시간 분석하여 장애가 발생된 것으로 판단되면 지정된 관리자 단말장치에 통보하여 현장으로 출동하도록 제어하는 지상중앙관제서버를 포함하는 특징에 의하여 지하에 매설된 전력선 관로에 설치된 지중 배전선로의 주변을 자율주행 로봇이 주행하여 감시 진단하고 발열이 심한 위치와 화재 또는 연기가 검출되는 위치와 전류가 급격하게 변화하는 위치가 검출되면 현장의 이미지 정보와 위치정보를 확보하여 원격지에 전송하는 동시에 해당 위치에 접근하여 냉각소화액, 절연제를 분사하므로 초기에 진압하여 대형사고를 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Armored vehicle training management system and apparatus thereof
abstract_en: The invention provides an armored vehicle training management system. A method of the system comprises the following steps: (1) when training starts, using a video acquisition device to collect driver operation image information and armored vehicle gun-pointing image information in an armored vehicle, and sending the information to a command center in real time through wireless transmission; (2) reading corresponding user information from a database of the command center, carrying out voice communication with a driver in real time, and correcting a driver operation; (3) carrying out marking according to driver real-time operation information and inputting a remark; (4) when the training is finished, integrating marking, obtaining a final result, and storing image information and a marking record for inquiring. According to the system, a driver error can be corrected at any time, and training quality is improved.

title_en: A kind of comprehensive improvement brain processing method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to big data administrative skill fields, disclose a kind of comprehensive improvement brain processing method, include the following steps：(1) it selected target region and models；(2) face acquisition is carried out to personnel by collecting device and drawn；(3) it draws and calculates the staff and reach scheme；(4) it obtains function and feature and requires skills match degree；(5) all arrival schemes are drawn out；(6) optimal arrival scheme is filtered out；(7) event handling data are recorded.The present invention uses big data analysis technology, draws personage's portrait, and accurate match event process flow calls emergency preplan.Realize front end perception, displaying, middle-end business model, back-end processing, automatic sensing and Intelligent treatment are carried out to being happened at city integrated improvement event, and system supports the trend of energy magnetic field to render, command centre is allowed more intuitively to understand event severity, Urban Event is realized under the premise of no command centre supervises, realizes the purpose of second grade response.
assignees: HANGZHOU FREE COMPUTER SOFTWARE CO LTD

title_en: A kind of Internet of things node ecological bodyguard system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of Internet of things node ecological bodyguard systems, including ecological bodyguard data collection station, ecological bodyguard cloud platform and ecological bodyguard management terminal, the tentacle that environmental sensor that wherein ecological bodyguard data collection station covers the whole network, visual sensor, audio frequency apparatus, alarm linkage device are acquired as whole system data, acquisition information in real time, ecological bodyguard cloud platform for realizing each operation system data exchange, support the big datas services such as real-time, history, and all kinds of service applications of bearing system, database data supporting；Ecological bodyguard management terminal commands large-size screen monitors, microphone and alarm linkage mobile phone to carry out real-time video, speech message, the commander's displaying of electronic map positioning informix by managing main frame, maincenter.The present invention be capable of providing it is a kind of without manually on the spot acquisition, timeliness is good, renewal speed is fast and apply wide coverage Internet of things node ecological bodyguard system.
assignees: NANJING ZHONGYU SMART WATER CONSERVATION RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Multi-mode simulation operation method and system based on intelligent garbage collection box, automatic dispatch and VRP
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of operation management, in particular to a multi-mode simulation operation method and system based on an intelligent garbage collection box, an automatic dispatch and a VRP. A multi-mode simulation operation method based on an intelligent garbage collection box, an automatic dispatch and a VRP (virtual router) constructs a matrix-shaped virtual map through longitude and latitude and equipment numbers of the collection box, a transfer station and a sorting center. Further setting the related data of the recovery box and the transfer station and setting delivery record information; and deducing and calculating the amount of the residual garbage in the recovery box and the transfer station, and judging whether to trigger a clearing order and a transferring order. Based on the delivery behavior, the clearing and transferring work of collectors and/or truck drivers, the surplus of the recovery box, the surplus of the transfer station and the surplus of the vehicle are dynamically updated in real time, relevant data in the deduction process are recorded, and the most suitable optimal receiving and transferring mode, and the number of collectors and truck drivers in the mode can be selected after multiple deductions.
assignees: ZHEJIANG THROUGH WISDOM OF SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD;ZHEJIANG YUNQI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Emergency diagnosis guiding management system and method applied to public health event
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency diagnosis guiding management system applied to public health events, which belongs to the technical field of medical emergency diagnosis guiding and comprises a medical terminal module, a server module and a data transmission module, wherein the medical terminal module is used for recording patient information and maintaining medical information, the server module is used for carrying out data exchange of the patient information and medical information of medical institutions, and the data transmission module is used for transmitting the patient information and medical information data uploaded by the medical terminal module to a server. The invention provides a diagnosis guiding treatment system under public health events, which is used for accurately positioning each corresponding medical center, marking the jurisdiction region, the number of dialysis machines, the number of medical care persons, the number of existing dialysis persons and the number of re-admitted dialysis persons, marking each patient with a treatment scheme, a test result, an address, a contact way and the like, so as to facilitate emergency command and region adjustment in sudden and serious public health events, and realizing near and reasonable diversion of dialysis patients.
assignees: ANHUI KEDA GUOCHUANG SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Laboratory hazardous gas leakage intelligent early warning system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent early warning system for laboratory dangerous gas leakage, which comprises a system initialization and configuration module, a real-time monitoring and data acquisition module, a data analysis and judgment module, an alarm and notification module, a coordinated control and emergency response module, a recording and reporting module, a system recovery and evaluation module and a system recovery and evaluation module, wherein the system initialization and configuration module is used for deploying sensors, configuring the systems and connecting the networks, the real-time monitoring and data acquisition module is used for continuously monitoring sensor data and preprocessing the data, the data analysis and judgment module is used for threshold comparison and trend analysis to acquire alarm information and notification information, the alarm and notification information is used for sending the alarm information and the notification information, the coordinated control and emergency response module is used for automatically closing a dangerous source and starting a ventilation system, the recording and reporting module is used for recording events and generating reports, and the system recovery and evaluation module is used for relieving alarm, system inspection and safety evaluation. The invention can perform more comprehensive and intelligent laboratory dangerous gas leakage early warning.
assignees: SHENZHEN HUITE SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-department collaborative decision-making method and system based on large model and water transport security risk event classification
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of emergency decision, and particularly discloses a multi-department collaborative decision method and a system based on a large model and water transport security risk event classification. And then, inquiring all historical risk event records related to the current ship navigation comprehensive situation in a professional knowledge base in the water transport safety field, and carrying out deep context modeling on the historical risk event records so as to capture a safety risk mode and a coping strategy which possibly exist in the current ship navigation, and further carrying out semantic reasoning on the historical risk event context reference characteristic and the current ship navigation comprehensive situation characteristic by means of a large model so as to generate risk assessment and collaborative decision advice aiming at the current ship. The method not only can adapt to the evolution of real-time navigation situation, but also has the credible support of history handling experience, and provides effective guarantee for timeliness and synergy of cross-department emergency response.

title_en: Portable IoT Sensor Kit for Smart Safety with Wireless Mesh and Artificial Intelligence
title_ko: 무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a configuration of a device and an artificial intelligence program related to a portable intelligent IoT sensor kit for fire prediction using wireless mesh and AI. Since the reliability of sensor data is very important for an IoT smart sensor used in a fire disaster site, it is safe to construct a wireless mesh sensor network with enhanced connectivity between sensor nodes to increase the reliability of sensor data transmission.
abstract_ko:
국가적으로 큰 문제가 되고 있는 공공 및 민간 다중이용시설 (재래시장, 상가/쇼핑몰, 병원/요양원, 위락시설-극장, 실내놀이시설 등)에서의 화재발생과 유독가스 등의 누출시 발생 할 수 있는 대량 인명손실과 천문학적인 사회적 기회비용의 손해가 빈번히 발생하고 있는데, 이러한 화재 및 가스누출사고 발생시 즉각적인 감지하고 징후를 판단하여 화재 확산의 예측이 가능하여 관련자 및 관련기관에 자동적으로 경보하고 전파하여 인명의 조기구조나 재산손실을 미연에 방지하기 위한 골든 타임을 확보 할 수 있도록 도와주는 (1) 경제적으로 보급이 가능하고  (2)구성 및 운용이 쉬우며 (3)휴대 또는 이동 하여 일반 초보자도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있는 화재 및 가스누출 등의 재난 방재와 사회안전 편익에 도움을 주는 “무선메쉬와 AI를 이용한 휴대가능한 지능형 화재예측 IoT센서 키트”에 관한 장치의 구성과  인공지능 프로그램에 관한 것이다 
      화재 재난현장에서 사용되는 사물인터넷(IoT) 스마트 센서는 센서데이터의 신뢰성이 매우 중요하기 때문에 센서데이타의 전송 신뢰도를 향상하기 위하여 센서 노드간에 연결성이 강화된 무선메쉬 센서네트워크를 구성하는 것이 안전하다. 
      아래 대표도 에서 보는 바와 같이, 센서노드는 전원이 인가되는 즉시 인접한 모든 센서노드와 무선메쉬네트워크를 통하여 센서노드 자신의 기기정보와 측정값 등을 모든 센서노드 및 지능형 접속노드에 저전력으로 즉각 전달 가능한 센서네트워크을 구성한다. 
      센서네트워크가 구성되면, 센서노드는 측정한 센서데이터를 종류에 따라서 일정주기 또는 데이터 발생 즉시 다른 센서노드를 통하거나 직접 지능형 접속노드에 전송한다. 
      지능형 접속노드는 센서노드가 전달한 모든 센서데이터를 수신하여 제어부의 데이터베이스에 저장하고 백엔드시스템에 전송한다. 제어부는 데이터베이스에서 센서, 위치 및 노드 정보 데이터를 통하여 화재예측 및 발생 판단을 위한 인공지능 알고리즘을 생성 및 수정한다. 
      지능형 접속노드에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘(216) 및 백엔드시스템에서 생성되는 인공지능 알고리즘은 시간별, 센서별, 종류별 측정 데이터를 기준으로 각 센서의 오차 및 화재 발생 여부를 판단한다. 
     만일 인공지능 알고리즘이 화재 발생 상황이 일어났다고 판단한 경우, 지능형 접속노드(200)는 제어부를 통해 자동경보프로그램에 화재경보를 전달하며 자동경보프로그램은 관리자 등 관련자, 소방서 등 관련부처, 필요한 경우 미리 등록해둔 지자체에 화재 발생 사실과 해당 지능형 접속노드의 실제 위치정보를 전파한다. 
     센서데이타에 의해 화재 감지와 분석, 예측이 가능하기 때문에 센서데이터 오류를 제거하여, 보정하고 정확한 데이터를축적하여, 최적의 예측 알고리즘을 생성하여 활용한다. 
    센서데이타의 유형과 패턴에 따라 보다 정확한 분석을 위해 충분한 데이터를 확보하기 위하여 여 센서노드의 데이터 전송주기와 센서에서 측정되는 센서데이터 수치정보를 증가하여 전송하게하므로서 보다 밀도 있는 시계열 분석이 되도록 하여, 단기간내에 모든 데이터를 수집 분석하여  정확한 시나리오를 예측하고 이에 따른 경보 수준을 판단 한다. 
화재, 가스누출 등의 재난 방재 목적 이외에, 산업현장의 위험작업장, 예를 들면 유해가스 지역의 환경정보 감지 및 알람, 유류저장소, 원전과 같은 방사능 누출 지역, 고로, 사일로 등과 같은 시설파괴시 재해가 예상되는 장소나 기관의 구조물 등에도 간편하게 사용 할 수 있으며, 사회안전을 위한 공공SCO, 예를들면 교량, 도로, SOC구조물 등에서도 사용 할 수 있다.

title_en: Method and apparatus for handling citizen callback of a public-safety officer
abstract_en: In order to address the above-mentioned need, a method for routing civilian calls to an associated public-safety officer is provided herein. During operation, a call processor receives a civilian call having a source identifier number identifying a source of the call and a target identifier number identifying a target of the call. A current status priority of the associated public-safety officer is determined as a function of the current assignment status, and when the current status priority is less than the incident record priority, the civilian call is routed directly to a mobile device associated with the associated public-safety officer. When the current status priority is greater than the incident record priority, the civilian call is routed directly to one of a public-safety answering point or an automated voice mail system.

title_en: A system and method for delivering aggregated animal care services through a computing platform
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system (100) and method (200) for delivering aggregated animal care services. The system (100) comprises a user interface (10) accessible via web or mobile platforms, a login module (20) for user authentication and role-based access, a data collection module (30) to store animal profiles, user data, and service provider details, and a repository (40) for maintaining structured records of pets, incidents, and services. An aggregation module (50) analyses data to generate case updates, alerts, and recommendations. A communication module (60) enables messaging, group interaction, forums, and feedback. A services module (70) provides access to emergency response, adoption, rescue, medical services, donations, volunteer coordination, and lifecycle tracking. The system (100) supports integrated animal welfare management by enabling real-time collaboration and streamlined access to services for all stakeholders through a unified platform, enhancing coordination and continuity in animal care efforts.

title_en: System for coordination with driverless vehicles for public safety
abstract_en: Aspects of the subject disclosure may include, for example, constructing a vehicle record for a driverless vehicle that indicates capabilities of the vehicle for responding in an emergency; receiving an alert regarding an incident; analyzing a database to identify available vehicles for responding to the incident; selecting a vehicle from the available vehicles in accordance with selection criteria including a current vehicle location and capabilities of the vehicle; directing the selected vehicle to the incident location; directing the selected vehicle to perform one or more actions to respond to the incident; receiving data from the selected vehicle regarding performance of the actions; analyzing the data to evaluate the performance; and generating a report of the incident including an indication of the performance. Other embodiments are disclosed.

title_en: Personal alarm and serveillance system
abstract_en: The present invention is a system for observing stationary and mobile subjects and sending alarms and initiating remedial actions at the observation site by using an observation device, having the recording, and communications capabilities typically found in cell phones, to observe the subject and send recordings and relay alarm signals directly to a controller device possessed by the user. The controller device has the recording and communications capabilities typical of cell phones and allows users to review the data from the observation device and take appropriate actions. Such actions include commanding the observation unit to activate on-site devices that can mitigate damage, issuing an alarm to appropriate emergency response units, and augmenting data sent to emergency response units with the subject's location and descriptive information that can help responders arrive at the scene quicker and act more effectively when they arrive.

title_en: Scene recorder in-place supervision method suitable for electric power operation site
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-place supervision method of a scene recorder suitable for an electric power operation site, and relates to the technical field of electric power operation risk management and control. The scene recorder is embedded with a positioning algorithm, the position deviation of the scene recorder and each working surface of a working site is obtained according to the positioning algorithm, the obtained position deviation is sent to a provincial power grid emergency command center through a power wireless private network, and workers of the provincial power grid emergency command center judge whether the position of a safety supervisor carrying the scene recorder is out of supervision or not according to the sent position deviation data. The in-place supervision method can realize supervision of a multi-surface operation field, can conveniently, accurately and effectively judge whether a safety supervision person carrying a scene recorder breaks away from supervision in the operation field, supervises the implementation condition and the control effect of various risk management and control measures in the jurisdiction range, and effectively guarantees personal risks of the electric power operation field.

title_en: Method for rapidly estimating earthquake middle position based on strong vibration acceleration record
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for rapidly estimating the position of a seism based on strong vibration acceleration record, which belongs to the technical field of geophysics and is used for estimating the position of the seism, and comprises the steps of extracting the arrival time of P waves of the seism, constructing a station P wave arrival time observation equation, and (3) primarily selecting quasi-observation and primarily calculating true error estimation, fitting a feature vector by using a random sample consensus algorithm RANSAC, identifying inner points and outer points, checking the inner points as quasi-observation and secondarily calculating the true error estimation, and outputting seismic elements. The method introduces a more efficient and rapid quasi-observation selection scheme so as to optimize the accuracy of the coarse-difference quasi-verification method, realizes real-time and rapid estimation of the position of the middle of the large earthquake based on a strong-earthquake observation means, realizes more accurate and reliable determination of the position of the middle of the earthquake, and can provide technical support for rapid early warning of the earthquake and post-earthquake emergency response.

title_en: Emergency event visualization collaboration method and terminal equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency event visualization collaboration method and terminal equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a historical monitoring data set of an emergency event in a target area, preprocessing the historical monitoring data set, and generating a standardized event feature set; training a time sequence prediction model according to dynamic environment parameters to obtain an event evolution prediction model, constructing a geographic region matching model based on static geographic parameters, and generating a visual layer template associated with a target region. And collecting the current environmental data flow of the target area in real time, classifying by an event evolution prediction model to obtain an event classification result, and calling a corresponding visual layer template from a geographic area matching model according to the event classification result. And fusing a diffusion path, an intensity level and a called visual layer template in the event classification result, generating a dynamic visual instruction set, and rendering and outputting an emergency event evolution situation map through an interactive interface. The invention can improve the timeliness and the decision reliability of emergency response.

title_en: Method for Providing Learning Language Service by Using Paraphrase, System, Server and Computer-Readable Recording Medium with Program Therefor
title_ko: 패러프레이즈를 이용하여 언어 학습 서비스를 제공하는방법과 그를 위한 시스템, 서버 및 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는기록매체
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 패러프레이즈를 이용하여 언어 학습 서비스를 제공하는 방법과 그를 위한 시스템, 서버 및 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 유무선 통신망을 이용하여 언어 학습 서비스를 제공하는 시스템에 있어서, 상기 언어 학습 서비스와 관련된 컨텐츠를 수신하여 출력하는 사용자 단말기; 및 상기 사용자 단말기의 사용자 계정에 대한 사용자 레벨을 추출하고, 상기 사용자 레벨에 따른 제시 문장을 생성하여 상기 사용자 단말기로 전송하며, 상기 사용자 단말기로 상기 제시 문장에 대한 패러프레이징(Paraphrasing) 요청 데이터를 전송한 후 상기 사용자 단말기로부터 패러프레이징 응답 데이터를 수신하는 경우 상기 패러프레이징 응답 데이터에 잘못된 표현 또는 어색한 표현이 있는지의 여부를 확인하고, 확인 결과, 상기 패러프레이징 응답 데이터에 잘못된 표현 또는 어색한 표현이 없는 경우, 상기 패러프레이징 응답 데이터의 수신 횟수를 산출하여 상기 사용자 레벨을 갱신하는 패러프레이징 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 패러프레이즈를 이용하여 언어 학습 서비스를 제공하는 시스템을 제공한다. 
     본 발명에 의하면, 패러프레이징을 이용한 언어 학습 서비스를 제공받음으로써, 영문을 한글로 번역하는 과정에서, 번역에 대한 학습 능력이 증대되는 효과가 있을 뿐만 아니라, 보다 자연스러운 문장을 구현할 수 있는 학습 능력의 개발로 인해 어휘력, 사고력, 심미적인 능력 및 언어 발달 능력이 증대되는 효과가 있다.
