title_en: A emergency bell-cctv integrated system with bidirectional call function in emergency bell with single network
title_ko: 단일 망으로 비상벨에서의 양방향 통화 기능이 구현된 비상벨-cctv 통합 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency bell-CCTV integrated system for performing a bidirectional call function in an emergency bell with a single network. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the emergency bell-CCTV integrated system for performing a bidirectional call function in an emergency bell with a single network comprises: an emergency bell device; a camera unit; a network connecting unit; and a network video recorder (NVR) managing unit. The emergency bell-CCTV integrated system for performing a bidirectional call function in an emergency bell with a single network of the present invention can reduce process costs.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 단일 망으로 비상벨에서의 양방향 통화 기능이 구현된 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 보다 구체적으로는 단일 망으로 비상벨에서의 양방향 통화 기능이 구현된 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템으로서, 건물내주차장의 안전 사각지대에 설치되며, 위급상황 시에 사용자 조작 실행에 따라 구동되어 미리 설정된 비상벨 신호를 발생시켜 송신하며, 양방향 통화기능을 구비하는 비상벨 장치; 건물내주차장의 안전 사각지대에 설치되어 주변 지역을 감시 촬영하고, 상기 비상벨 장치에서 발생시키는 비상벨 신호를 수신하도록 자동 연결되는 카메라부; 상기 비상벨 장치와 연결 접속되는 상기 카메라부와 단일 망으로 연결 접속되는 네트워크 접속부; 및 상기 네트워크 접속부와 연결 접속되며, 상기 비상벨 장치에서 발생시킨 비상벨 신호를 감지하고, 감지된 비상벨 신호에 대응하여 비상상황 경고를 제어함과 동시에 비상호출을 요청한 상기 비상벨 장치와 양방향 통화를 수행하는 관리실 또는 방재실에 구비되는 NVR(Network Video Recorder) 관리부를 포함하는 것을 그 구성상의 특징으로 한다. 
본 발명에서 제안하고 있는 단일 망으로 비상벨에서의 양방향 통화 기능이 구현된 비상벨-CCTV 통합 시스템에 따르면, 양방향 통화 기능이 구비된 비상벨 장치를 카메라부의 오디오 보드에 연결하여 비상벨 신호를 수신하도록 하고, 네트워크 접속부를 통해 카메라부와 NVR 관리부가 단일 망으로 연결되도록 구성함으로써, 위급상황 시에 긴급호출을 통한 도움 요청과 함께 양방향 통화가 가능하고, 빈번하게 발생하는 안전 사각지대의 위험요소에 대한 신속하고 정확한 상황대처로 사고를 미연에 방지하며, 그에 따른 사용자의 불안감 해소와 안전한 생활공간 및 범죄를 사전에 예방할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명에 따르면, 네트워크 접속부의 PoE Hub를 이용한 이더넷으로 단일 망을 구성함으로써, 범죄예방을 위한 안전 사각지대로 지목되는 건물내주차장에 설치되는 비상벨 장치와 카메라들의 배관/배선을 카메라 선로를 이용하여 시공 공정을 단순화하여 공정 원가를 절감할 수 있도록 할 수 있다. 
뿐만 아니라, 본 발명은, CCTV와 비상벨 시스템을 단일 망으로 연결 접속하여 통합 운영할 수 있으므로 관리 운영자 측면에서 보면 편리한 운용과 신속한 대처가 가능하도록 할 수 있다.

title_en: Method for rescue using drone and computer readable record-medium on which program for executing method therefor
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 인명 구조 자동화 방법 및 이를 실행하는 프로그램이 기록된 기록매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 측면(aspect)에 따른 인명 구조 자동화 시스템은 하나 이상의 카메라로부터 수상 레저 활동과 관련된 관심 영역에 대한 영상을 수신하는 단계, 상기 수신된 영상으로부터 하나 이상의 객체를 검출하는 단계, 상기 검출된 하나 이상의 객체의 형태 및 위치의 변화량과 기 설정된 위험 요소 기준을 대비하여, 상기 영상 내에서 수상 레저 활동과 관련된 안전 사고 상황이 발생하였는지 판단하는 단계, 상기 안전 사고 상황이 발생된 것으로 판단되면, 상기 검출된 객체의 위치에 대응하는 좌표를 포함하는 이동 명령을 드론(Drone)에게 전송하는 단계, 및 상기 드론이 상기 좌표에 대응되는 위치로 이동하면, 상기 드론이 상기 하나 이상의 객체에 대한 구조 활동을 수행하도록 제어하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Resource-centric agency disaster dual-track work process-based business interruption crisis warning system and crisis warning method
title_ko: 자원 중심의 기관 재난 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 기반 업무중단 위기경보 시스템과 위기경보방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a resource-centered institutional disaster dual-track work process-based business interruption crisis warning system and method, and a program therefor, and more specifically, to a resource-centered institutional disaster dual-track work process-based business interruption crisis warning system including: a regulation module that performs status analysis, business impact analysis, and risk analysis of the institution in stages to derive risk analysis data for crisis stages by institution, department, or business continuity (BC) unit, and derives dual-track business continuity process data by institution, department, or business continuity unit based on the risk analysis data. The dual-track business continuity process data includes disaster response work process data and daily work process data.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 자원 중심의 기관 재난 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 기반 업무중단 위기경보 시스템, 위기경보방법 및 프로그램에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 기관의 현황분석, 업무영향분석, 위험분석을 단계적으로 실시하여 기관, 부서 또는 업무연속성(BC) 단위별 위기단계에 대한 위험분석데이터를 도출하며, 상기 위험분석데이터를 기반으로 기관, 부서 또는 업무연속성 단위별 듀얼 트랙 업무 연속성 프로세스 데이터를 도출하는 규정모듈;을 포함하고, 상기 듀얼 트랙 업무 연속성 프로세스 데이터는 재난대응업무 프로세스 데이터와, 일상업무 프로세스 데이터를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 자원 중심의 기관 재난 듀얼 트랙 업무 프로세스 기반 업무중단 위기경보 시스템에 관한 것이다.
assignees: UNIV INDUSTRY COOPERATION GROUP KYUNG HEE UNIV

title_en: Systems and methods for assignment of equipment to an officer
abstract_en: A system for tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment to security agency personnel (e.g., officers, administration, command, armorer). An armorer is assigned the task of tracking, assigning, and issuing equipment. Equipment may be assigned to a particular individual officer. The equipment provided to and used by officers may capture (e.g. gather, produce) information (e.g. audiovisual information, data logs, recordings). Equipment may provide information to the armorer via near field communication (NFC) circuits. The information captured may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system. The information captured by equipment assigned to a particular individual may be associated with that individual. An armorer may use information supplied by equipment, evidence management system, officers, or other sources to assist in the assignment process.

title_en: A kind of insulating bar inspection detection Practical training equipment
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a kind of insulating bar inspection detection Practical training equipment, it includes insulating bar, motion detection module, main control module, wireless communication module and background service system.The motion detection module, including body of rod installation fastness check that detection module, lever fastness check detection module and visual examination detection module, pass through the wireless communication module and the main control module wireless telecommunications.The main control module, the data transmission for being acquired the motion detection module by the wireless communication module receive the control command that the background service system is sent to the background service system.The background service system according to the data auto judge of reception and records the insulating bar Inspection process of operating personnel.A kind of insulating bar inspection detects Practical training equipment, has the advantages that design science, simple in structure, highly practical, easy to use, safe intuitive.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU WONDER ELECTRICAL POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent collaborative sensing and decision-making system for emergency response of storage channel
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic scheduling, and particularly discloses a enter into Tibet-channel emergency response intelligent collaborative awareness and decision-making system, which comprises a multi-level heterogeneous module, a data linkage inquiry module, a channel parameter prediction module, a traffic state evaluation module, an emergency fluffing scheduling module and an information playback and display module, wherein the multi-level heterogeneous module is used for receiving information from a user; the invention ensures that workers in different departments and levels can efficiently acquire the required information through the functions of quick inquiry, such as keyword retrieval, advanced retrieval of complex inquiry conditions, one-stop full text retrieval, batch retrieval and the like, can promote the circulation and sharing of the information, ensures that all relevant departments can make decisions based on the latest and comprehensive information, reduces the information island phenomenon, improves the overall emergency rescue efficiency, and can realize the whole process of recording and revising event perception-comprehensive decision-rescue guarantee based on a comprehensive Geographic Information System (GIS).
assignees: HIGHWAY MONITORING & RESPONSE CENTER MINISTRY OF TRANSP OF THE P R C

title_en: Hydraulic engineering full life cycle safety compliance intelligent management system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hydraulic engineering full life cycle safety compliance intelligent management system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module for acquiring multi-mode data; the system comprises an edge preprocessing module, a federal learning and blockchain module, a central multi-mode big model, a regulation knowledge graph module, a self-adaptive digital twin module, a multi-mode consistency anomaly detection engine, a compliance report generation and emergency decision module and an intelligent emergency strategy formulation support, wherein the edge preprocessing module is used for carrying out local processing and reasoning on acquired data, the federal learning and blockchain module is used for carrying out cross-project and cross-regional privacy protection collaborative learning and recording metadata information, the central multi-mode big model is used for understanding and analyzing multi-mode data, the regulation knowledge graph module is used for carrying out structural matching on engineering states and regulation standards, the self-adaptive digital twin module is used for constructing a digital twin body synchronous with physical hydraulic engineering so as to predict results, and the multi-mode consistency anomaly detection engine is used for evaluating consistency and uncertainty of the multi-mode data and the predict results. The invention can improve the safety supervision level, risk identification capability and emergency response efficiency of hydraulic engineering.

title_en: Method for sizing hardware of energy management system
title_ko: 에너지 제어 시스템의 규격산정 최적화방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 에너지관리시스템(Energy Management System, EMS)의 하드웨어 규격 산정방법에 관한 것이다. 
     이를 위하여 본 발명은 EMS의 하드웨어 규격 산정 방법에 있어서, 시스템의 규모와 응용 프로그램에 따라 호스트노드/RTU데이터취득노드/RCC데이터취득노드/히스토리데이터노드 등에 대응하는 각각의 변수값을 입력받고 그 결과값을 계산하여 출력하는 에너지 관리 시스템을 구성하는 하드웨어 규격 산정 방법을 제공하여, 전력계통 운영의 특징이 반영되도록 접근 가능하고, 안정적인 계통상태 뿐만 아니라 고장(또는 사고)발생시에도 요구 성능을 충분히 발휘할 수 있도록 한다. 
       
     에너지 관리 시스템(EMS), 하드 웨어, 규격 산정

title_en: Intelligent predictive and triage control system based on deep queries
title_ko: 심층 질의 기반 지능형 예측 및 선별 관제 시스템
abstract_en: An intelligent prediction and screening control system based on deep query is provided, comprising: an input module that receives sentences composed of voice or text; a deep query engine that interprets the sentences input by the input module; a screening management scheduler engine that manages screening control schedules; a video analysis engine that analyzes whether an event occurs that meets command conditions registered by the deep query engine; and a control module that issues execution commands to devices related to execution events to perform the execution events that should be executed according to each condition, when a video event occurs that meets the command conditions registered in the screening management schedule based on the video analysis results. According to the present invention, by setting control conditions in a deep query manner, the convenience of condition setting can be maximized, and the work burden can be significantly reduced.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 심층 질의 기반 지능형 예측 및 선별 관제 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 상세하게는 심층 질의 방식으로 미리 설정한 관제 조건이 충족된 경우, 선별적으로 관제 조건에 대응되는 이벤트를 수행함으로써, 관제의 효율성을 높일 수 있는 심층 질의 기반 지능형 예측 및 선별 관제 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
본 발명은 음성이나 텍스트로 구성되는 문장을 입력받는 입력 모듈과; 입력 모듈에 의하여 입력된 문장을 해석하고, 문장이 미래 조건형 명령인 경우 명령어 조건을 생성하며, 생성된 명령어 조건을 충족하는 영상이 기록되어 관제될 수 있도록 명령어 조건을 선별 관제 스케쥴에 등록하는 심층 질의 엔진과; 선별 관제 스케쥴을 관리하는 선별 관리 스케쥴러 엔진과; 영상 장치에서 촬영된 영상을 분석하되,  심층 질의 엔진에서 등록한 명령어 조건을 충족하는 이벤트 발생 여부를 분석하는 영상 분석 엔진과; 영상 분석 결과 선별 관제 스케쥴에 등록된 명령어 조건을 충족하는 영상 이벤트 발생시, 각 조건에 따라 실행되어야 하는 실행 이벤트를 수행하도록 실행 이벤트와 관련되는 디바이스에 실행 명령을 내리는 제어 모듈을 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 심층 질의 기반 지능형 예측 및 선별 관제 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Crisis response function AI system for safety on predict accident or disaster with collecting big-data at restricted hazard local area
title_ko: 빅데이터 수집분석으로 제한된 지역 내 재난사고 다발영역 예측과 안전대응 신속처리 인공지능 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a quick and accurate safety response by collecting and analyzing disaster accident big data to predict a multi-area and notify a manager. An artificial intelligence system for predicting a disaster accident multiple area and rapidly processing a safety response in a region limited by big data collection analysis comprises an artificial intelligence integrated processing server(1000); a region operation control center part(2000); an entrance area sensor part(3000); and a field activity area sensor part(4000).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 거주인구 또는 유동인구가 많은 지역 중 각종 재난사고가 자주 발생하거나 발생할 수 있는 영역을 인공지능의 빅데이터 수집과 분석을 통하여 빠르게 예측하고 안전한 대응방법을 정확하게 안내하면서 신속한 후속조치가 빠르게 이루어지도록 하는 빅데이터 수집분석으로 제한된 지역 내 재난사고 다발영역 예측과 안전대응 신속처리 인공지능 시스템에 관한 것이며, 주거단지의 각 지역에서 발생되는 각종 재난사고 관련 데이터를 해당 위치정보와 시간정보에 연계시켜 수집 기록하고 재난정보포털서버로부터 재난사고 관련 빅데이터를 해당 위치정보와 시간정보에 연계시켜 주기적으로 수집 기록하고 분석하여 그 발생을 예측하는 인공지능통합처리서버; 인공지능통합처리서버에 접속하고 특정 지역에서 발생되는 재난사고 관련 데이터를 해당 위치정보와 연계시켜 수집 기록하며 패킷프레임으로 암호화하여 인공지능통합처리서버에 전송하는 지역운용관제센터부; 지역운용관제센터부에 접속하고 주거단지의 출입구 위치에 각각 설치되어 출입자의 인원수와 진행방향을 검출하고 출입구 주변의 영상신호와 소리신호를 확보하며 지역운용관제센터부로부터 인가되는 안내메시지를 소리신호와 영상신호로 각각 출력하며 터치에 의한 메시지를 입력받는 출입구영역센서부; 지역운용관제센터부에 접속하고 주거단지의 주차장, 어린이 놀이터, 계단참복도, 구내도로, 쉼터, 공공시설에 각각 설치되어 해당 주변의 영상신호를 가시광선과 적외선으로 확보하고 소리신호를 확보하며 지역운용관제센터부로부터 인가되는 안내메시지를 소리신호와 영상신호로 각각 출력하며 터치에 의한 신호를 입력받는 현장활동영역센서부를 포함하는 특징에 의하여 비교적 넓은 지역에서 다양하게 많이 발생되는 각종 재난사고의 빅데이터를 빠르게 수집하고 인공지능으로 정확하게 분석하여 재난사고가 발생할 수 있는 특정 다발영역과 발생을 예측하고 현장 및 지정된 관리자에게 통보하여 재난사고 예방과 대피 그리고 후속조치가 신속하고 빠르며 정확하게 이루어지도록 하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Method and system to enforce traffic laws using common citizens
abstract_en: In some embodiments, a common citizen installs a camera in the dashboard of his car. The camera records in continuous mode. When a traffic violation occurs in sight of the citizen, he commands the camera to preserve that occurrence. The camera automatically saves a video file that starts 2 minutes before the command was given and ends 2 minutes after the command was given. This 2 minutes time interval can be adjusted by the user. The recorded video constitutes the proof of a violation occurrence. This information is transmitted to a processing unit, validated and a citation or notice of citation is issued.

title_en: Analog traffic director system with V2X function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a simulated traffic director system with a V2X function, which comprises a road side monitoring subsystem, a simulated traffic director device subsystem, a remote monitoring subsystem and a site control subsystem, wherein the road side monitoring subsystem is used for automatically collecting the mechanical action image information of the simulated traffic director device and executing a computer vision processing algorithm to extract the mechanical action image characteristics of the simulated traffic director device; the simulated traffic director device subsystem is used for receiving and executing action control commands sent by the remote monitoring subsystem and the field control subsystem; the on-site control subsystem is used for sending an action control command to the simulated traffic director device subsystem; the remote monitoring subsystem is used for receiving and recording the motion execution analysis result sent by the road side monitoring subsystem. The intelligent control system has the advantages of high intelligent degree, high control precision, good real-time performance and the like.

title_en: Rail transit junction emergency regulation and control method and system based on real-time simulation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rail transit junction emergency control method and system based on real-time simulation, which relate to the technical field of intelligent transportation and rail transit emergency management and comprise the steps of performing time synchronization processing on real-time passenger flow data and train running state data to generate a junction state data set; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-level simulation model, simulating a passenger flow distribution evolution process by presetting passenger flow evacuation behaviors and train operation constraint conditions, positioning capacity limiting nodes in each evacuation path based on an output result of the multi-level simulation model by adopting a bottleneck recognition algorithm, calculating passenger flow bearing capacity, generating optimal path regulation parameters aiming at shortest evacuation time, converting the optimal path regulation parameters into a train automatic control system instruction and a passenger flow guiding display instruction, and transmitting the train automatic control system instruction and the passenger flow guiding display instruction to each line control unit by a hub centralized dispatching system to regulate train operation frequency and passenger flow evacuation direction. The invention realizes the intellectualization and the coordination of the emergency control of the rail transit junction.

title_en: Sensor for detecting fire-sensing
title_ko: 화재감시 시스템
abstract_en: A fire monitoring system is provided to enable a user to easily prevent fire by applying different colors to normal image data and thermal wavelength image data according to the temperature. A fire preventing system(10) includes a monitoring camera and a fire preventing server, which received thermal images and normal image data from the camera and generates three different alarm sounds according to the temperature. A fire monitoring system(20) includes a panorama camera, a fire monitoring server, a UV(UltraViolet) sensor, and a data collector. The panorama camera photographs an omni-directional color image. Flame and smoke detecting program is loaded in the fire monitoring server. The UV sensor measures the temperature and amount of gas within a region covered by the panorama camera. The data collector receives data from the UV sensor, an IR(InfraRed) sensor, and a gas sensor. A screen output portion(30) includes a digital recorder and a monitor. A self-diagnosing system includes a real time monitoring portion and a central monitoring portion.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재의 위험성이 많은 공장에 설치하여, 화재의 예방 및 화재의 발생시 사후조치를 할 수 있는 화재감시 시스템에 관한 것으로, 열영상과 일반영상을 촬영하여 화재감시 구역에서의 온도의 상승시 3단계의 경보를 발령하여 화재의 발생을 미연에 방지할 수 있는 화재예방 시스템과 파노라마 카메라를 하여 촬영된 영상데이터를 비교분석할 수 있는 프로그램 탑재된 화재감지 시스템을 이용하여 화재의 징후 및 화재의 발생시 현장 출동할 수 있도록 하여 화재발생을 조기에 진압할 수 있으며, 화재예방 시스템과 화재감지 시스템에 설치되는 실시간 감지부를 통해, 두 시스템에 설치된 카메라나 렌즈, 경사각조절, 화재감지센서들의 과부하나 단선여부를 체크할 수 있도록 구성하여, 자가진단을 통한 시스템의 유지보수를 보다 용이하게 할 수 있는 화재감시 시스템을 제공한다. 
     상기에서 기술한 바와 같이 본 발명의 화재 감시 시스템은 화재예방 시스템에 의해 화재가 발생되어 질 수 있는 위험지역에 설치되어 일반영상 데이터와 열파장 카메라로부터 전송받은 열파장 영상화면에 온도에 따른 색상을 적용함으로써, 육안으로 화재의 예방이 가능하며, 또한 화재예방 서버에 탑재된 열분석 프로그램에 의해 화재 위험지역의 지속적인 온도상승에 따른 단계별 점검/경계/화재위험경보 기능이 있어, 조기에 화재를 예방함과 동시에 화재지역 감시에 필요한 인력을 줄일 수 있는 효과가 있으며, 또한 화재감지 시스템에 의해 상기 화재예방 시스템에 의해 감시된 화재위험지역에서 지속적인 온도상승으로 인해 화재가 발생되었을 때에, 이를 360°를 감시할 수 있는 파노라마 카메라의 영상데이터를 화재감지 서버에 탑재된 불꽃 및 열기감지 프로그램에 의한 패턴인식방식을 이용하여, 영상화면의 변화에 따른 실시간 감시를 함과 동시에 후속조치로서, 경보발령에 따른 즉각적으로 화재진압 인원을 보내어 조기에 진압할 수 있으며, 아울러 자가진단 시스템을 이용한 화재예방 시스템과 화재감지 시스템의 구성요소의 오작동을 중앙 상황실에서 실시간으로 확인하여 유지보수가 용이한 장점을 가지고 있다.

title_en: electric power analysis recorder for electric safety check
title_ko: 전기안점점검용 전력분석기록계
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재예방, 전기사고예방, 전기사고분석을 위한 전기안전점검용 전력분석기록계에 관한 것으로서, 분전반의 메인차단기에 설치된 변류기와 영상변류기의 출력단측  전선을 메인장치에 접속하거나 메인장치의 전선통과구멍으로 통과하도록 배선하고, 상기 메인장치와 무선으로 교신할 수 있는 보조 장치를 사용자가 위치한 곳의 벽 콘센트에 꽂으면 일일이 메인장치까지 가지 않고도 어디서나 쉽게 분전반의 전압, 전류, 누설전류, 접촉불량, 역률 등을 표시장치에 의해 용이하게 파악할 수 있도록 한 것이다. 
     본 발명은 사용자가 분전반(1)까지 일부러 가서 상태를 파악하지 않아도 현재 일하고 있는 장소의 벽 콘센트에 간단히 보조 장치(30)만 꽂으면 분전반의 전압 및 전류 등의 측정이 가능한 것인바, 분전반(1)으로부터의 전선이 메인장치(10)의 전선통과구멍(11)을 통과하도록 배선한 상태에서 이러한 메인장치(10)와 무선으로 통할 수 있는 보조 장치(30)를 임의의 장소에 설치하고, 메인장치(10)로부터 무선으로 송출되는 신호를 보조 장치(30)의 RF수신부(35)에서 수신하며, 메인장치(10)의 각종 입력장치(29)를 통하여 입력되는 전압, 전류, 누설전류, 역률, 역상 등의 상태를 보조 장치(30)의 표시부(32)를 통해 용이하게 파악할 수 있음은 물론 알람부저(34) 등을 통해 경고해 줄 수 있는 것이다. 
       
     전력, 기록, 무선, 표시, 엘이디, 통신포트, 조작버튼, 누설

title_en: System for maintaining and managing facilities and establishing social security network using radio frequency tag connector
title_ko: 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 이용한 시설물 유지 관리 및 사회 안전망 구축 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for maintaining various ground facilities and establishing a social safety network through the transmission of location information (GIS information) to a disaster-related agency and families using wireless communications tag connectors. More particularly, the present invention provides a system which: enables a wireless communications tag connector containing location information (GIS information) to be installed at pre-installed and newly-installed facilities; records and stores various types of maintenance information about the facilities in a database through a server using the wireless communications tag connector; enables an administrator to receive the stored information through a terminal and view, edit, input, and store the information about the facilities; and enables a normal user to transmit location information of the facilities stored in the database to a disaster-related agency or to a family in real time using a wireless terminal through the wireless communications tag connector. The present invention enables an administrator to electronically manage various types of information about ground facilities without using a hand-written register, thereby improving accuracy, reliability, and convenience; and if a tragic accident or incident takes place, enables a user to immediately transmit GIS-based current location information to the location information display of a disaster-related agency without calling the disaster-related agency and explaining surrounding information in detail and therefore enables the disaster-related agency to immediately initiate rescue operation, thereby establishing a national, social safety network.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 이용하여 각종 지상 시설물을 유지 관리하는 동시에 위치 정보(GIS 정보)를 재난 관련 기관 및 가족에게 전송하여 사회 안전망을 구축하는 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로는 기 설치된 시설물 및 신규로 설치되는 시설물에 위치 정보(GIS 정보)가 저장된 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 설치해 두어 상기 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 이용하여 시설물의 각종 유지 관리 정보를 서버를 통해 데이터베이스에 수록, 저장하며, 이렇게 저장된 정보를 관리자가 단말기를 통해 전송받아 시설물의 정보를 조회, 수정, 입력, 저장 등을 할 수 있는 동시에, 상기 무선 통신 태그 커넥터를 통해 데이터베이스에 저장된 상기 시설물에 관한 위치 정보를 일반 사용자의 무선 단말기를 통해 재난 관련 기관이나 가족에게 실시간으로 전송할 수 있도록 하는 시스템을 제공하고자 한다.  
본 발명에 의해 지상 시설물의 각종 정보를 수기 대장에 의해 관리하지 않고 전자적으로 관리할 수 있게 되어 정확성, 신뢰성 및 편의성을 증대시킬 수 있고, 불의의 사고나 사건 발생시 재난 관련 기관에 전화하여 일일이 주변 정보를 설명할 필요 없이 즉각적으로 GIS에 기반한 현재의 위치 정보가 재난 관련 기관의 위치 정보 디스플레이에 전송되도록 함으로써 재난 관련 기관의 즉각적 구호 활동을 가능하게 하여 국가적인 사회 안전망을 구축할 수 있다.
assignees: PARK KWANG SEOK;YANG IN CHEOL;KIM GI SEONG;KANG HYOUN HOI;LEE SANG MOON

title_en: Current transformer Secondary commercial circuit and isolation Separate surveillance Protection method Distributing board
title_ko: 변류기 2차 상용회로와 절연분리형 감시보호방식 수배전반
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a monitoring protection type distribution board insulation-separated from a second common circuit of a converter. The monitoring protection type distribution board insulation-separated from the second common circuit of the converter includes: a CT second opening monitoring protection circuit branched from a CT second input terminal (4) and a CT second output I terminal (5); a power blackout monitoring circuit (16) monitoring whether the power of an A/D converter (15) is cut; a standby power charging circuit (17) connected to the power blackout monitoring circuit (16); a storage battery (18) for backup, which is connected to the standby power charging circuit (17) and is installed to perform a function in a blackout; a reset button (19) for resetting a contactor, wherein the reset button (19) is connected to the standby power charging circuit (17); an SMPS power circuit (20) connected to the reset button (19) and the storage battery (18) for the backup; a CPU (21) collecting various operation states as a mixed system of digital and analog; a communication module (22); a monitoring PC (23); a monitoring circuit including a warning lamp (29) reporting a CT second opening voltage accident; the contactor (24); and multiple contact points including a sub contactor contact point (24-1), a sub contactor contact point (25), a CT second opening voltage monitoring relay (R1, R2, R3), and an output contact point (26, 27, 28). The monitoring protection type distribution board can obtain accurate reliability and can prevent breakdown.

title_en: Monitoring device with sound amplifying function
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a monitoring device with sound amplifying function, belonging to the technical field of monitoring devices, comprising a camera, one side of the bottom of the camera is welded with a universal ball and is rotationally connected with one end of the top of the bracket through the universal ball and a universal ball seat, the other side of the bottom of the camera is welded with a universal ball seat and is rotationally connected with the top of the electric telescopic rod through the universal ball seat and a universal ball, the bottom of the electric telescopic rod is arranged at the other end of the top of the bracket, the top of the camera is detachably provided with the loudspeaker and the alarm, the monitoring device with the sound amplifying function of the utility model realizes the rapid sharing of information and the cooperation among various security departments, can acquire calamity site information in real time, information sharing can communicate each other, and direct command improves communication efficiency, strives for the time, and quick rescue, the utility model discloses monitoring device with public address function can be according to the angle of making a video recording of demand automatically regulated camera.

title_en: Mobile supervision and management method and system for city management
abstract_en: The invention provides mobile supervision and management method and system for city management, which relate to the field of city management. The system comprises a server side and a mobile terminal communicated with the server side, wherein the server side comprises a hardware part and a software part and is used for realizing the relevant functional requirements of the technical specifications of the urban municipal comprehensive supervision and management information system (CJJ/T 106) of the Ministry of Construction and achieving the functions of collection, uploading, dispatching, statistics and overall evaluation to city management problems; the mobile terminal comprises a logging-in module, a running module and a statistical query module, wherein the running module comprises an examination unit, a supervision and management unit and a coordination and notification unit, and a user achieves the functions of examination, supervision and management, coordination and notification, statistical analysis and classified query to the city management problems by the program of the mobile terminal. By adopting the invention, leaders at all levels can know the detailed information of a certain record by logging in the program of the mobile terminal, the problems of no symmetry and no timeliness of the information are effectively solved, and the treatment processes of some difficult problems are obviously quickened by supervision and management as well as coordination.

title_en: Sea fishery maritime safety command system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of sea fishery maritime safety command systems, it is based on sea fishery AIS collision system, Beidou Navigation System, ocean radio system, provides account management and the password modification to local user, the update of ship basic data, the update of chart data, export sea chart picture, print screen sea chart, operation video record, system parameter setting, query statistic, carries out the functions such as video monitoring playback function to ship；Sea chart particular requirement is shown, to ship monitor, while to monitoring ship send notice, alarm, short message, moreover it is possible to realize ship track played back, data check；Alarm rescue can be shown with the drafting of customized alarm region, customized alarm region management, meteorology and Typhoon Information.

title_en: A kind of public resource dispatching method, system and electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of public resource dispatching method, system and equipment and media, this method comprises: receiving public resource scheduling request；Obtain the public resource usage record of the promoter of the public resource scheduling request；The operation of preset schedule specification is not met in detection public resource usage record；The resources use right limit of the promoter of public resource scheduling request is updated based on operation；Public resource scheduling request is executed according to resources use right limit after update.The application is that user sets corresponding resources use right limit in advance, after receiving the scheduling request of public resource, it will acquire the public resource usage record of request promoter, and after in detection usage record not meeting the operation of preset schedule specification, the resources use right of actual originator limit is updated.From the foregoing, it will be observed that the user that the application can not meet specification to resource in, which carries out permission, updates operation, the specification to scheduling behavior can be realized, to effectively be managed to scheduling of resource process.

title_en: A kind of city flood risk management system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to flood control and drainage project technical fields, and disclose a kind of city flood risk management system, including intelligent release unit, Intelligent water level video surveillance unit, wisdom gateway, launching tower and urban flood defence Emergency command decision-making system, level switch is installed on the Intelligent water level video surveillance unit, the level switch includes the shell of both ends open, the upper shell opening is equipped with cap, the cap bottom being located in the shell is equipped with antenna, the shell is uniformly and equidistantly fixedly connected with several hooks in a ring on the inner annular sidewall of cap, link is linked on the hook, the link is far from being fixedly connected with horizontally disposed fixed ring on the annular sidewall of cap.The city flood risk management system, can make pressure type long distance water level recorder detection accuracy higher, and the fixation of pressure type long distance water level recorder and disassembly can be made easier.

title_en: Steel frame snow vehicle wind resistance testing and simulation training system utilizing wind tunnel
abstract_en: The invention provides a steel frame snowmobile wind resistance testing and simulation training system utilizing a wind tunnel. The method comprises the following steps: the system comprises a wind tunnel, a force measuring balance, a camera monitoring device, an information real-time display device and an attitude adjusting device; the force measuring balance is fixedly arranged on a bottom plate of the wind tunnel, the posture adjusting device is fixedly arranged on the force measuring balance, and a user leans over and attaches to the steel frame snow vehicle by utilizing the posture adjusting device; the wind generated by the wind tunnel blows towards a user, the posture adjusting device assists in adjusting the posture of the user, the camera monitoring device records real-time motion video of the user, the force measuring balance measures wind resistance data received by the user, and an information picture of the information real-time display device displays wind speed and wind resistance data of the wind tunnel, a motion posture control command for the user and the like in real time. The device provided by the invention helps a trainer and a user to perform posture optimization and intensive training of key technical actions by using the quantified wind resistance, and helps technicians to research and develop high-performance sports equipment.

title_en: In-situ cement-based material tensile test system and method based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of civil engineering material detection, and particularly discloses an in-situ cement-based material tensile test system and method based on image recognition. The non-contact image strain measurement system is arranged on the substrate and is positioned on one side of the replaceable strain sensing clamp and used for collecting images of the cement-based material tensile test piece, correcting the images based on a visual positioning module positioned on the surface of the substrate and calculating a strain test result of the cement-based material tensile test piece by utilizing the corrected images. The invention has lower requirements on the field flatness and higher test efficiency, and can meet the timeliness of emergency response and the effectiveness requirements of disaster prevention and control.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NANTONG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Intelligent navigation system for blind person
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent blind person navigation system, which relates to the technical field of intelligent wearable blind person navigation and comprises a multi-mode sensing unit, A I decision centers, a two-way feedback module and an emergency response system, wherein the intelligent wearable blind person navigation system still keeps 94% obstacle detection rate under 5l ux low illumination through a three-layer sensing framework of a double-light fusion camera, a laser radar and an ultrasonic array, and the effective detection distance is 8 meters. The semantic segmentation algorithm enables the detection rate of suspended obstacles to be increased from 12% to 92%, and the recognition error of the glass door in the underground garage scene is only 2.1cm. The multi-sensor space-time alignment technology reduces the false alarm rate from 25% to 3.2% in a complex scene, and realizes the accurate perception of all-weather and full-height obstacles. The biological characteristics and environmental risk multi-level triggering mechanism automatically alarms and shares positioning within 2.1 seconds when a user falls, and the falling rescue success rate of the underground garage is improved from 62% to 100%. And (3) automatically recording environment video with positioning when no operation is overtime, and constructing a closed-loop safety net for 'prevention-early warning-rescue'.
assignees: XIAYU INTEGRATED CIRCUIT SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic evaluation method for power consumption management priority
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic evaluation method of power consumption management priority, which is characterized in that power grid operation, user behavior and environment data are collected in real time through an Internet of things terminal, data cleaning and space-time alignment are completed at edge computing nodes, power grid side power supply margin/node vulnerability, user side elasticity coefficient/urgency index and environment economy side carbon cost multidimensional indexes are dynamically generated, a deep reinforcement learning model (DQN) is adopted to optimize index weight in real time by taking power grid frequency, user complaint rate and operation cost as rewarding functions, a multi-objective Pareto optimal solution set is solved through an improved gray wolf algorithm, load priority ordering is output, and intelligent contract storage is conducted through a block chain, and finally a rigid group, an elastic group and a tradable group are divided according to load characteristics to execute differential regulation. The method solves the problems of poor dynamic adaptability and low reliability of the traditional evaluation method, realizes quick response, quantification of user elasticity and tamper resistance of regulation and control instructions, and improves the emergency response efficiency of the power grid.

title_ko: 자외선(u,v)경화용 발화성 모든 레진도료들과 일반도료에 혼용할 자연식재료들을 활용한 나노기술의 혼용방염제 제조방법.
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A manufacturing method of a flame resistant is provided to dissolve water-soluble material of various natural materials with any useful material by processing a specific production process. CONSTITUTION: A manufacturing method of a flame resistant comprises: a step of obtaining lacquer tree/pine needle steam by treating a lacquer tree and pine needle by high-pressure vapor; a step of vaporizing a root of an arrowroot, and processing kaolin and rice powder by steam of the root of an arrowroot in order to obtain an adhesive containing the root of an arrowroot; a step of obtaining silver/silicate solution by spraying silver solution and sodium silicate by a high-pressure spray; a step of increasing flame-resistance by mixing the lacquer tree/pine needle steam with the silver/silicate solution through high air pressure; and a step of obtaining the flame resistance by repeating the melting process, and measuring the outcome in a chamber of high temperature and a chamber of low temperature.
abstract_ko:
1.종래기술의 문제점. 
     오늘날 자외선(U,V)도료의 활용은 모든 업계에 놀라운 발전을 가져온 것은, 경이로운 기술의 월등한 발전으로 평가되고 있는 현실이다. 
     현실적으로 인간의 생존을 위협하는 화재사고를 방지할 자외선경화도료와 일반도료 등에 混用(혼용)할 난연도료 즉 방염도료는 아직도 활성화된 기록이 없다, 생각해 보면 브롬(Br)등은 비중이 높고 유독성이 강해 잠깐의 냄새도 치명적인 물질을 용융 화합시켜 자외선으로 경화하기는 기술적이나 경제적 불편이 있고, 일반도료 에도 혼용하여 방염할 혼용방염제는 없고 특히 자연식재료를 응용한 무독성 혼용방염제는 아직은 지구상에는 없다. 본 발명가는 미국우주항공국(NASA)과 항공기화재방지책을 개발할 때 경험으로 확인한다면 항공기내부는 알미늄 은박지에 포장된 유리섬유와 탄소섬유로 내화 단열하여 화재위험을 방지하고 있기에, 승객의 안전을 위해 유리섬유는 폐기하고 값비싼 탄소섬유와 불안나Firex를 활용키 위해 불안나파이렉스 난연제를 미국내 수입화학 물질로 등록했고, 미국 나사에서는 불안나파이렉스를 테스트하여 섭씨12만7천7백도의 화염속을 견디어 낸 테스트발표 자료가 있으니 물론(군사병기 자료로 미국방장관의 승인을 얻어 출고케 되어 있으나, 이미 본 발명가 홈 www.iist.or.kr 에서 공개하고 있기에 무관함을 고지)합니다. 위 기술한 자료같이 자외선 경화도료는 비중이 높은 염류나 독성높은 물질 등과 브롬, 안티몬, 인계,는 중금속 등 반사율이 혼란하여 자외선(U,V)경화도료,또는 일반도료 도 혼용방염제나 혼용불연내화제는 공개된 바가 없었고, 
     본 발명같이 천연의 식재료를 나노기술 응용으로 발명한 일이 없고, 본 기술은 발명가의 40년의 발명(인터넷의 싸이트 무관하게 -김재운박사-란 검색어로 세계적으로 검색이 되는 발명가 임)과정을 전부 바쳐 천연식물,광물들을 응용하여 수용성물질이 톨로엔 벤젠 솔밴트 각종 레진 등 유용성물질과 융합된 PH8-10정도의 알칼리성을 유지하며 물성을 변형시킬 수 있는 방법은 40년간 실험경험의 발명기술이기에 종래기술의 난점을 밝혀 세계초유 제조방법 발명특허를 출원합니다. 
     2.본 발명의 신기술 요약. 
     전기 1항과 같은 문제들을 혁신하여 과학기술로 개발된 신기술를 요약하자면, 발명의 제조방법은 엄선된 천연재료 (1번재료,옻나무. 2번재료,갈근. 3번재료,현미, 4번재료,솔잎. 5번재료,규산소다. 6번재료,실버이온수. 7번재료,카오린)를 응용하여 진액으로 준비도 하고, 고열의 증기로 쪄서 기름도 짜고, 자외선으로 건조시켜 중탕하여 숙성하고. 규산은 보편화된 작업이니 규산은 규산소다(Sodium Silicate)를 2호로 선정하고. 실버는 과학기술원의 김수철박사가 나노기술로 개발한 은용액(Silver Colloid)제조기를 활용하고. 카오린은 300-500메쉬로 한다. 
     재료들은 수용성 물질로서 특수제법의 나노기술을 응용하여 물질을 고압증기로 분해하는 등 분자를 鎔融(용융)하여 물질간의 기체화 融合(융합)시켜 수용성재료들을 皮質(피질)변형으로 수용성물질의 외질과 내질이 상이하게 변형시키는 나노기술활용으로 혼용방염제를 레진종류 조정하여 생산한다(자외선(U,V)경화도료와 일반도료의 혼용방염제) 
     어떤 종류의 유성의자외선(U,V)경화성 도료라도 용융되어 비중과 물성이 동일한 혼용방염제로 자외선 경화도료와 일반도료(밴젠,토루엔,신나,석유,휘발유 등 희석제활용 특유성)에 혼용될 방염제가 세계초유로 발명된 것을 본 발명가도 경이롭게 생각합니다. 
     오늘을 주신 선생님들과 선배님들 그리고 나의 조상님과 신들게 감사드리며 상세한 것은 명세서에 식별하기 쉽게 백분율(百分率)로 기술하여 드리겠습니다.

title_en: Temperature monitoring system of switchgear
title_ko: 배전반 온도 감시 시스템
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 배전반 내의 부스바나 접속부의 온도를 실시간으로 검출하여 화재 등을 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 하는 배전반 온도 감시 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 중앙관제실의 전류, 전압 및 각종 데이터 기록과 저장, 측정 데이터의 실시간 분석 및 관리를 위한 중앙관제시스템; 및 배전반 내에 설치된 각종 계측기를 실시간으로 측정하는 통신유닛;을 포함하는 것을 기술적 요지로 한다. 이에 따른 본 발명에 의하면, 배전반 내의 온도를 실시간으로 검출하여 외부기기(중앙관제센터)에 전송함으로써 원격 모니터링이 가능하며 화재 등의 사고를 사전에 방지하여 안전관리가 용이한 효과가 있다. 또한, 기존의 광케이블을 이용한 온도 검출 방식이 아닌, 이미 설치된 케이블을 이용할 수 있으므로 구축 비용을 크게 절감할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Coding Education System linked with Hardware Device
title_ko: 하드웨어 장치와 연계한 코딩교육 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to coding education device and system for easily understanding the concept of coding by arranging blocks corresponding to unit program commands output on a display part of a coding education device in a row by drag-and-drop, controlling a robot by executing a series of coded commands, and providing a sense of achievement according to coding performance and motivation for coding. One problem to be solved by the proposed invention is to arrange blocks corresponding to unit program commands output on the display part of the coding education device in a row by drag-and-drop so that the concept of coding can be easily understood.
abstract_ko:
코딩 교육 장치의 표시부에 출력된 단위 프로그램 명령어에 대응되는 블록을 드래그 앤 드랍으로 일렬로 배치하여 쉽게 코딩의 개념을 이해할 수 있도록 하고, 코딩된 일련의 명령어를 실행하여 로봇을 제어하고 코딩 수행에 따른 성취감과 코딩에 대한 동기를 부여해주는 코딩 교육 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
제안된 발명이 해결하고자 하는 하나의 과제는 코딩 교육 장치의 표시부에 출력된 단위 프로그램 명령어에 대응 되는 블록을 드래그 앤 드랍으로 일렬로 배치하여 쉽게 코딩의 개념을 이해할 수 있도록 하는 것이다.

title_en: System and method for maritime accident monitoring to prevent maritime passenger's accident and computer program for the same
title_ko: 해상 여객 사고 방지를 위한 해양사고 모니터링 시스템과 방법 및 이를 위한 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a marine accident monitoring system. The marine accident monitoring system comprises: a receiving module configured to receive image information of a space including a ship; an evaluation module configured to store a machine learning-based detection model, and calculate a risk related to one or more areas partitioning the space corresponding to the image information or passengers in the space by applying the image information to the detection model; and an output module configured to generate dashboard content by matching the risk calculated by the evaluation module to the space, and display the dashboard content through a user interface on the marine accident monitoring system or a terminal device communicatively connected to the marine accident monitoring system.
abstract_ko: 해양사고 모니터링 시스템으로서, 선박을 포함하는 공간의 영상 정보를 수신하도록 구성된 수신 모듈; 머신러닝(machine learning) 기반의 탐지 모델을 저장하며, 상기 영상 정보를 상기 탐지 모델에 적용함으로써 상기 영상 정보에 상응하는 상기 공간을 구획하는 하나 이상의 영역 또는 상기 공간 내의 여객에 관련된 위험도를 산출하도록 구성된 평가 모듈; 및 상기 평가 모듈에 의해 산출된 상기 위험도를 상기 공간에 매칭하여 대시보드(dashboard) 콘텐츠를 생성하며, 상기 대시보드 콘텐츠를 상기 해양사고 모니터링 시스템 또는 상기 해양사고 모니터링 시스템과 통신 가능하게 연결된 단말 장치 상의 사용자 인터페이스를 통해 표시하도록 구성된 출력 모듈을 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Hybrid power supply system for disaster prevention
title_ko: 재난재해예방을 위한 하이브리드형 전력공급 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 재난재해예방을 위한 하이브리드형 전력공급 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 강 또는 하천에서 발생하는 각종 재난 및 재해를 예방하기 위해 태양광, 풍력 및 수력발전을 이용한 하이브리드형 전력공급시템을 설치하여 전력이 부족한 지역에서도 강 또는 하천과 같은 수역에서 지속적인 영상촬영과 저장이 가능한 저장장치와 수위센서 및 강우량 센서,투광기 등의 각종 전력이 소모되는 장비를 지속적이고도 안정적으로 전력을 공급하여 사용할 수 있도록 스마트 하이브리드형 전력공급장치로 전력을 공급하여 강 또는 하천에서 발생하는 각종 재난 및 재해를 방지하고, 인명사고 위험시 대피 안내방송과 관할단체의 관할 통제소에 즉각적으로 통보하여 사고를 예방할 수 있는 재난재해예방을 위한 하이브리드형 전력공급 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 풍력을 이용하여 전기 에너지를 획득하는 풍력발전장치(102)와, 태양광을 이용하여 전기 에너지를 획득하는 태양광 발전장치(104)와, 수력을 이용하여 전기 에너지를 획득하는 수력발전장치(106)로부터 전력을 공급받도록 전력공급 풀대(10)를 구비하는 하이브리드 전력공급장치(100)와; 상기 하이브리드 전력공급장치(100)에서 제공되는 전기 에너지를 함체(130)에 구비된 전력콘트롤러(108)를 통해서 전력을 분배하여 공급받는 인체감지 프로그램 서버(114)와; 상기 인체감지 프로그램 서버(114)에 의해 제공되는 전력을 공급받아 동작하는 라우터(116)와, 투광기(118)와, 스피커(120)와, 카메라(122)를 포함하고,  상기 하이브리드 전력공급장치(100)에서 발전된 전기 에너지를 충전하고 필요한 경우 전기를 공급하기 위한 배터리(112)를 포함하며, 상기 풍력발전장치(102)와 태양광 발전장치(104)에서 획득한 전력을 공급받아서 장치들에게 전원을 공급하고, 풍력발전장치(102)와 태양광 발전장치(104)의 전력이 부족한 경우, 상기 수력발전장치(106)에서 발전된 전기를 공급받아서 상기 전력콘트롤러(108)가 전원을 분배 공급하여 지속적이고 안정적인 전원공급이 이루어지도록 설치되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
이와 같은, 본 발명은 전기와 인터넷이 없는 지역 및 강이나 농수로 하천에서도 안정적으로 작동하여 농촌지역과 수역에서의 재난 안전사고 예방에 기여하는 효과가 있고, 설치지역의 상황을 실시간으로 데이터 전송하여 모니터링 할 수 있어거 효율적인 관리가 가능한 효과가 있으며 수면높이 감지 기능을 통해 홍수와 같은 자연재해를 예방하고 수난 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있으며 강우량  및 강설량 계측기를 통해 기상상황을 정확히 파악하고 대응할 수 있는 효과가 있다. 

그리고, 강 또는 하천 주변의 현장정보를 감시하고 획득하여  기상청, 홍수통제소, 수자원공사, 환경부 등의 통합관제소에 실시간으로 정보를 송신하고 공유함으로써 강 또는 하천의 범람, 익사자, 극단적인 선택 등의 재난 및 재해를 방지하는 효과가 있으며, 전력을 원할하게 제공받지 못하거나 전력의 수급이 끊겨서 전원공급이 이루어지지 못하는 경우에도 전력을 충분히 확보하여 지속적인 감시를 할 수 있도록 수력발전과 태양광 발전과 풍력발전을 연결하여 지속적이고 충분한 전원공급을 제공하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Emergency scenario communication and informational system
abstract_en: An emergency scenario communication and informational system comprises an electronic device with a digital display, a communication interface, and a processor. The system is configured with a plurality of preconfigured emergency scenarios and a database containing pre-recorded informational videos and contact data associated with these scenarios. The processor executes computer program code instruction controllers, including an emergency scenario initiation controller to initiate an emergency scenario, a communication controller to initiate electronic emergency communications based on contact data from the database, and a video player controller to display informational video data on the digital display. This system enhances emergency response by providing immediate, situation-specific instructional videos and automated communication capabilities during critical emergency scenarios.

title_en: Method and apparatus for disaster resilience in mobile networks
abstract_en: A first PLMN performs: receiving an initiation command to initiate a disaster support mode; responsively to the receiving of the initiation command, configuring the first PLMN to broadcast with at least one radio cell a pilot signal indicating that disaster support mode has begun in the first public land mobile network; receiving a registration request from a user equipment apparatus for which a second PLMN is a home network; and signaling with the second PLMN and based on the signaling performing all of the following: authenticating the user equipment apparatus; setting up encryption of radio interface between the first PLMN and the user equipment apparatus; and creating billing records for use of the first PLMN by the user equipment apparatus. The first PLMN further performs: receiving a termination command to end disaster support mode; and responsively to the receiving of the termination command, configuring the first PLMN to broadcast with at least one radio cell a pilot signal indicating that disaster support mode has ended in the first public land mobile network. A user equipment apparatus bypasses its black list of forbidden networks in response to detecting the disaster support mode and attempts to register to also other networks than its home network if sufficient service is not available in the home network.

title_en: Optical fiber illuminator, method of fabricating optical fiber illuminator, and optical recording head and optical recording and reading apparatus having the optical fiber illuminator
abstract_en: Provided is an optical fiber illuminator used for recording and reading high density optical information according to a near field recording (NFR) scheme, a method of fabricating the optical fiber illuminator, and an optical recording head and recording apparatus having the optical fiber illuminator. The optical fiber illuminator includes: an optical fiber having a core upon which light is incident and a clad that surrounds the core, one end of the optical fiber having a mirror formed in an inclined manner; and a lens formed on an outer surface of the optical fiber for focusing light reflected by the mirror. The optical fiber illuminator has an improved optical arrangement for optical illumination and detection, it is easy to manufacture, its optical input is easy to control, and it can be readily provided in an array form. When an array type optical recording and reading apparatus having an optical recording head and multiple aperture probes adopts the optical fiber illuminator, the resulting simple arrangement and compact size enables size reduction of the overall apparatus, a signal to noise ratio is high, and high density optical information can be recorded and reproduced at an extremely high rate.
assignees: PARK KANG HO;KIM EUN KYOUNG;LEE SUNG Q

title_en: Method for shortening average emergency response time of distribution network line tripping accident
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for shortening the average emergency response time of a distribution network line trip accident, which adopts a server system and a computer terminal of an intelligent scheduling operation system based on multi-fusion; and the server system is used for providing signal information required by automatic accident recording, analyzing and processing the obtained information, and sending the data processing result to the intelligent scheduling operation system computer terminal based on multi-fusion. The invention can effectively solve the problems of long average response time of accident handling and excessive statistical difficulty of trip in bad weather.

title_en: Space-earth integrated information processing method and system based on aviation medical emergency rescue big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to an aerospace-ground integrated information processing method and system based on aviation medical emergency rescue big data, and belongs to the technical field of aviation medical emergency rescue. The method comprises the following steps of S1 classifying and collecting data related to aviation medical emergency rescue tasks, S2 processing the collected data and connecting the data with external assistance equipment to realize real-time transmission of the data, and S3 storing and managing the data, namely integrating and storing medical records, patient information, rescue resources and aviation transportation data for emergency rescue resources and real-time rescue information, and realizing comprehensive data integrated management. The method can meet the air-ground combined rescue requirement, solves the problem of reliable transmission of multi-source heterogeneous data in the air-ground collaborative rescue process, supports the processing and management of structured and unstructured emergency rescue key data, realizes the air-ground collaborative rescue information interaction problem, and provides refined information support for the smooth development of aviation medical emergency rescue comprehensive command and dispatch.

title_en: Visualization command communication system based on administration soft switch
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a visualization command communication system based on administration soft switch. The system comprises a visualization fixed terminal, a visualization mobile terminal, an early warning system, an early warning device and a soft switch device. The visualization fixed terminal and the visualization mobile terminal carry out communication through the soft switch device. The visualization mobile terminal carries out communication with the early warning device. The early warning device carries out communication with the early warning system. The early warning system carries out communication with the on-site visualization mobile terminal. According to the utility model, the visualization mobile terminal is introduced, so that work can be carried out whenever and wherever possible and the efficiency of mobile work is improved; the deep combination of an information technology, enterprise operation management and other activities is strengthened; information sharing and business collaboration are promoted; in addition, a device relevant principal timely acquires the early warning information through the early warning system; the timeliness of the emergency information is ensured; and an enterprise early warning mechanism is effectively enhanced.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;INFORMATION COMM COMPANY OF SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CORP

title_en: Baton gun management system platform
abstract_en: The present invention discloses baton gun management system platform, baton gun management system platform, including back-end server, front-end control center, terminal device and Command center, the back-end server includes database server, calculation server, storage server and backup server, the front-end control center includes PC, face recognition device, RFID card reader and alarming horn composition, and the terminal device includes intelligent pikestaff device, Digiplex and intelligent pikestaff cradle.This kind invention replaces traditional paper records, greatly shorten neck and go back the rifle time, gun and user's one-to-one relationship are realized, during neck is gone back, the definition of gun, uniqueness, avoid the artificial real-time positioning obscured gun, realize gun, specify each rifle particular location and track and at that time receive people, overall process real-time control realizes management and control and the remote control function of gun insurance, it is to avoid gun cock off or supercargo is because the factors such as individual use gun.
assignees: LIANYUNGANG JIN'AN ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Chemical accident early warning system and method based on emergency response data
abstract_en: The invention relates to a chemical accident early warning system and method based on emergency response data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: the field data acquisition module is used for acquiring field information of the stored chemicals; a database module to: storing the field information, and presetting an accident prediction model which is established based on the emergency response data of the chemical accident and reflects the relation between the field information and the chemical accident occurrence trend; and the prediction module is used for predicting according to the accident prediction model and the field information so as to obtain the corresponding chemical accident occurrence trend. This patent is based on the basic data record of chemical accident emergency response, through the accident prediction model that has typicality to the deep statistical analysis establishment of past chemical accident record data, has realized the prediction early warning to the chemical accident, and the emergence of effectual prevention chemical accident avoids or reduces chemical accident harm and influence to the at utmost, reduces casualties and loss of property as far as possible.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP QINGDAO SAFETY ENG INST

title_en: Cloud medical record construction method, system, equipment and medium for disaster site
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud medical record construction method, a cloud medical record construction system, cloud medical record construction equipment and a cloud medical record construction medium for a disaster site. The cloud medical record construction method is applied to terminal equipment and comprises the following steps: identifying rescue identification of the wounded to acquire an electronic medical record of the wounded from a cloud server; editing the electronic medical record according to the treatment information corresponding to the wounded; and updating the edited electronic medical record to the cloud server. Aiming at the application requirements of complex environments of emergency rescue of wounded persons in disaster sites, the invention provides an informatization support scheme which is suitable for the whole rescue process and can improve the whole rescue effect, so as to ensure the medical quality and safety of the wounded persons in special environments and under the scene of site transfer, realize the rapid acquisition and sharing of the rescue information of the wounded persons in disaster sites, and be conductive to ensuring the medical quality and safety and improving the whole rescue efficiency and command decision capability of the disaster sites.
assignees: WINNING HEALTH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Pumped storage power station equipment supervision system for fault wave recording identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pumped storage power station equipment supervision system for fault wave recording identification, which comprises the following components: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the operation data of the pumped storage power station equipment in real time; the fault recording module is used for automatically triggering and recording fault recording data during faults when the equipment is abnormal; the feature extraction module is used for extracting fault features in the fault record data to obtain a target fault feature set; the analysis module is used for inputting the extracted fault characteristics into a pre-trained deep learning model for analysis and determining the fault type; the early warning module is used for giving an alarm to an operator according to the fault type and starting corresponding emergency response measures according to the fault type; the functions of monitoring the running state of the equipment in real time, automatically recording data during faults, extracting and analyzing fault characteristics, timely giving out alarms and emergency responses and the like can improve the detection and diagnosis capability of the equipment faults and reduce the influence of the faults on the running of the power station equipment.
assignees: QINGHAI WARANG PUMPED STORAGE CO LTD;BEIJING JIANGHE HUIYUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Airport passenger security check information management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security check information management, in particular to an airport passenger security check information management system. The invention relates to a passenger file construction module, which builds files according to passenger data and generates passenger riding axes, can comprehensively record each riding situation of passengers, provides abundant historical data for airport management, is convenient for analyzing and managing riding behaviors of passengers, constructs data packets of each type of contraband, comprises X-ray image data, millimeter wave data, danger level and processing means, ensures more scientific and reasonable security check processing, when the prohibited articles of the carrying class are detected, security personnel in the nearby airport can be quickly searched and related information is sent, and quick emergency response is realized.
assignees: XIAMEN CIVIL AVIATION CARES CO LTD

title_en: Building safety monitoring system integrating natural language interaction and self-iterative optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides a building safety monitoring system integrating natural language interaction and self-iterative optimization, which comprises a natural language interaction module, a right management module, a task sequence scheduling module, an API data input module, a data preprocessing module, a picture video real-time monitoring module, a data analysis and image display module, an energy consumption optimization module, a blockchain data storage module, a GIS and BIM model interaction module, a real-time monitoring and early warning module, an emergency response module and a model iterative optimization module. The invention solves the field gap in the aspects of timeliness and convenience of data acquisition, multi-source data comprehensive processing, real-time response of emergency, energy efficiency management and the like.

title_en: Automatic monitoring and alarming system for traction force of elevator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevators, in particular to an automatic monitoring and alarming system for an elevator traction force, which solves the problems that the automatic monitoring and alarming system for the traction force can be interfered by various types due to the complexity of the operation environment of the elevator, the monitoring precision of the automatic monitoring and alarming system for the traction force can still be limited to a certain extent, and the system can not accurately judge whether the traction force is abnormal or not, so that the reliability of the automatic monitoring and alarming system for the traction force is affected. An automatic monitoring and alarming system for the traction force of an elevator comprises data acquisition, data processing and analysis, anomaly detection, alarm triggering, information transmission and recording, emergency response and fault processing. The invention can monitor the change of the traction force in real time, trigger alarm rapidly under abnormal conditions, effectively prevent elevator accidents caused by insufficient or overlarge traction force, such as falling, roof-rushing and the like, obviously improve the operation safety of the elevator, and discover potential progressive faults in advance through trend analysis and fault mode identification.
assignees: ZHONGSHANG YICHENG MECH AND ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT TIANJIN CO LTD

title_en: Safety monitoring method based on limited space construction worker
abstract_en: The invention discloses a safety monitoring method based on a limited space construction operator, which relates to the technical field of safety monitoring of construction operators, and comprises the steps of obtaining an original monitoring data set of an operation site, and processing the original monitoring data set based on the original monitoring data set through an Internet of things communication technology to obtain a formatted data stream; based on the formatted data flow, carrying out risk quantification assessment and violation identification by utilizing an artificial intelligent analysis model to obtain an analysis result containing a risk grade and a violation type, comparing the analysis result with a preset multi-dimensional safety threshold to obtain a multi-stage early warning instruction, triggering automatic linkage response based on the multi-stage early warning instruction, sending a remote control signal to a working site and generating a monitoring and supervising record. The invention can realize the automatic monitoring, intelligent risk identification and grading early warning linkage of the whole process of the operation in the limited space, and improves the safety supervision efficiency and the emergency response capability.
assignees: PETROCHINA BEIJING PROJECT MAN CO LTD;BEIJING XINGYOU ENGINEERING PROJECT MAN CO LTD;CHINA NAT PETROLEUM CORP

title_en: Emergency notification system and camera device
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency notification system and a camera device, capable of distributing a video before and after accident occurrence to a management center.  <P>SOLUTION: A video around a vehicle is always recorded by an on-vehicle camera, a trigger is started in time of the accident occurrence to store the video of a prescribed time before and after an accident. Notification of the accident occurrence and the video before and after the accident, and vehicle-related information are automatically transmitted to the management center 1. When the management center 1 receives the notification of the accident occurrence, the management center 1 deduces a contact point of a possessor, and performs automatic transmission to the possessor. When the management center 1 receives a reply from a transmission destination within a prescribed time after the transmission, the management center 1 automatically transmits the notification of the accident occurrence and the vehicle-related information to the police 3, a fire station 4, and an insurance company 5. When cannot receive the reply from the transmission destination within the prescribed time after the transmission, safety of a driver cannot be confirmed, and emergency dispatch request is automatically transmitted to the police 3 and the fire station 4 via a communication line because there are cases where it is an emergency situation.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Intelligent video management system
title_ko: 지능형 영상 감시 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An intelligent video management system is provided to increases easily the monitor system by optimizing the operation between the server-client and each application. CONSTITUTION: The management server(210) provides the camera information. The IP camera part(220) generates the event information according to the generated image. The matrix decoding unit(242) decodes the video signal and the event information inputted through a network. The network video recorder part stores the video signal and the event information inputted through a network according to the camera group. The event server(260) informs the alarm situation by analyzing all event information within the administrative area. The workstation(271) controls an operation including the display about the whole camera within the operation group, the image restoration, the various events processing, and etc.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 IP 카메라를 이용하여 영상감시 체계를 계층적으로 구축하여 소,중,대 규모의 영상감시 시스템을 자유롭게 구축하여 이벤트 상황을 표출하는 기술에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명은, 관리 영역 내의 모든 카메라 및 서버 정보들을 데이터베이스 형태로 관리하여 각 서버들이 필요로 하는 카메라 정보 및 운용방식의 정보를 제공하는 관리서버와; 아이피 카메라로 감시지역을 촬영하여 그에 따른 영상신호와 이벤트 정보를 발생하는 아이피 카메라부와; 네트워크를 통해 입력되는 영상신호와 이벤트 정보를 카메라 그룹별로 저장하는 네트워크 비디오 레코더부와; 관리 영역 내의 모든 이벤트 정보를 분석하여 알람 상황을 알리는 이벤트 서버와; 운용그룹내의 전체 카메라에 대한 표출, 영상 재생, 각종 이벤트 처리 등의 동작을 제어하는 운용서버와; 상기 네트워크를 통해 영상신호를 입력받아 각 카메라 그룹에 대한 상시 표출을 수행하고, 경계모드, 경비모드, 경고모드, 알람모드에 대한 각각의 경보 표출 기능을 수행하는 표출서버와; 상기 네트워크를 통해 입력되는 영상신호를 분석하여 침입사고, 도난사고, 교통사고, 화재 사고 등의 지능형 이벤트 정보를 생성하는 객체인식서버에 의해 달성된다. 
     
     영상감시,아이피 카메라

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system viewer
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) and viewer for mobile assets that includes a data encoder, onboard data manager, and at least one local memory module. DARS processes video data from at least one 360 degree camera and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming video data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data in various view modes through a web browser or virtual reality device, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Communication System for Emergency Response Teams
abstract_en: A communication system for emergency first responders provides a unique software application (“app”) used on a handheld tablet (for example, an iPad®) and web-based platform to aid with dispatch, communications, scene management, documentation, records, and billing of 9-1-1 emergency medical calls. A “thin” web-based client is viewable through the Internet, including wirelessly from within emergency vehicles, and communicates with a main system that is designed around a core-layered architecture with at least one system database and a web-based interface. The system facilitates report entry and delivery to hospitals and end-user administration, including the ability to create new fields for the e-PCR, notifications about relevant data conditions, continuous reporting capabilities, and en route updates.

title_en: Real-time data acquisition and recording system
abstract_en: A data acquisition and recording system (DARS) for mobile assets that includes a data recorder. The data recorder includes a data encoder, an onboard data manager, a vehicle event detector, at least one local memory component, and a queueing repository. DARS processes data from at least one input sensor and stores a compressed record of the data at least once per second in the local memory module. DARS is designed to run in near real-time mode, storing a full record comprising five minutes of data to a remote memory module every five minutes, and in real-time mode, streaming data to the remote memory module by uploading a record of data at least once per second and up to once every tenth of a second. Remotely located users can view video, audio, and data acquired by DARS through a web browser, which provides for quicker emergency response, validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting, and monitor crew performance and safety.

title_en: Vehicle impact sensor and notification system
abstract_en: The present disclosure involves systems, software, sensors, and applied solutions for detecting incidents associated with a vehicle, where sensors associated with the vehicle identify impacts or proximity alerts to other vehicles and objects and record information related to those detected incidents. The recorded information can be immediately communicated to interested parties of the person or entity (e.g., emergency responders, business contacts) associated with the vehicle, or alternatively, stored for inspection at the vehicle and reviewed at a destination along the vehicle's route. In one example method, operations include detecting an incident associated with a monitored vehicle, where detecting the incident comprises receiving an alert from at least one sensor associated with the vehicle, identifying a location of the vehicle in response to the detection, and storing a record of the detected incident, where the record includes the identified location of the vehicle and a time associated with the detected incident.

title_en: Emergency response using voice and sensor data capture
abstract_en: Methods, systems, computer-readable media, and apparatuses for emergency response using voice and sensor data capture are presented. One example method includes transmitting, by a user device, an emergency call request to an emergency services provider; prior to the emergency call request being answered: recording, by the user device, audio signals comprising speech signals; and obtaining one or more keywords from recognized words based on the speech signals; and after detecting an emergency call connection: generating a message to the emergency services provider, the message comprising at least one annotation based on the keywords; and transmitting, by the user device, the message to the emergency services provider

title_en: Cargo vessel operator emergency response system, with operator directives, incident data recording and reporting, and automated relevant party notification
abstract_en: A method, computer program product, mobile communication device, and a shipment tracking system provide automated incident recording, reporting, and response protocols, including operator directives. The method includes receiving an input identifying an occurrence of an incident associated with a shipment entity, the shipment entity being one or more of a vessel, an operator, and a cargo being transported via the vessel. The method includes, in response to the input, presenting on a user interface (UI) of an operator mobile communication device (MCD) one or more selectable incident reporting options to activate incident response, data recording, and reporting (IRDRR) protocols. The method further includes generating and presenting an incident response UI that instructs the operator of specific sequence of steps to take in response to the incident and to complete an incident information gathering process. The method further includes automatically transmitting/uploading a notification of the incident to an incident management server.

title_en: Multi-equipment remote transmission control method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of Internet of things, in particular to a multi-equipment remote transmission control method and a system, which aim to solve the problems that in the prior art, in the process of law enforcement work, law enforcement records are transmitted according to fixed frequency, so that command terminals can not obtain the law enforcement records in time when criminal behaviors occur, and the efficiency of command scheduling can be reduced, and the technical scheme is that the multi-equipment remote transmission control method comprises the following steps: collecting law enforcement information and generating a law enforcement record packet; transmitting the law enforcement record packet to a command terminal according to a preset normal frequency; acquiring behavior characteristics of law enforcement personnel, and performing intensity analysis on the behavior characteristics to acquire behavior characteristic intensity of the law enforcement personnel; when the behavior characteristic intensity exceeds a preset response threshold, the transmission frequency of the law enforcement record packet is adjusted from the normal frequency to a preset response frequency, and the response frequency is higher than the normal frequency.

title_en: Emergency rescue command center management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency information management, in particular to an emergency rescue command center management method. Acquiring a history rescue record; acquiring a resource transportation time index according to the transportation time from the resource supply point to the disaster point; acquiring the resource satisfaction degree according to the resource demand of disaster points and the resource supply of the resource supply points in the history rescue record; constructing an initial scheduling model of resource scheduling according to the resource transportation time index and the resource satisfaction degree; an optimization function is constructed to optimize the initial scheduling model, and an optimized scheduling model is obtained; and acquiring an optimal scheduling scheme based on the optimized scheduling model. The invention builds the initial dispatching model according to the resource transportation time index and the resource satisfaction degree, optimizes the resource transportation time index and the resource satisfaction degree through the optimization function, and can solve the problem that the condition constraint of the objective function can generate local optimization, thereby obtaining a more reasonable dispatching scheme.

title_en: Method and apparatus for analysis of damage, computer-readable storage medium and computer program
title_ko: 피해 분석 방법 및 장치, 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체 및 컴퓨터 프로그램
abstract_en: A damage analysis method according to an embodiment of the present invention includes the steps of: calculating a range of damage caused by a high-speed aircraft; predicting a type of damage based on the range of damage; analyzing the amount of damage according to the type of damage. According to an embodiment of the present invention, it is possible to help a commander's judgment by quantifying and objectifying various damage factors in high-speed air vehicle defense, which is mostly made through subjective judgment such as personal knowledge and experience of the commander.
abstract_ko:
실시예의 피해 분석 방법은 고속 비행체로 인해 발생되는 피해 범위를 산출하는 단계와, 상기 피해 범위를 기초로 피해의 종류를 예측하는 단계와, 상기 피해의 종류에 따라 피해량을 분석하는 단계를 포함할 수 있다. 
본 발명의 실시 예에 따르면 대부분 지휘관의 개인 지식, 경험 등 주관적인 판단을 통해 이루어지는 고속 비행체 방어에 있어서 다양한 피해요소들에 대해 수치화하고 객관화함으로써 지휘관의 판단에 도움을 줄 수 있다.

title_en: Driving simulator for accident analysis of autonomous emergency braking
title_ko: 긴급제동장치의 사고 분석을 위한 주행 시뮬레이터
abstract_en: The present invention provides a driving simulator for accident analysis of an emergency brake. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the driving simulator for accident analysis of an emergency brake is to analyze and simulate an accident of a vehicle with a high-tech driver support system. The driving simulator for accident analysis of an emergency brake includes a boarding unit and a control unit. The boarding unit includes: a boarding display unit providing a virtual driving image; a main body unit controlling a virtual driving vehicle as a user gets in the main body unit; and a support unit supporting the main body unit and the boarding display unit. The control unit includes: a control part operating a simulation program for accident analysis of an emergency brake and controlling the boarding unit; and a control display unit providing an administrator interface screen of the simulation program for the accident analysis of the emergency brake. The simulation program for accident analysis of an emergency brake includes an emergency brake driving logic unit. The emergency brake driving logic unit outputs a warning signal on the boarding unit according to a sequence of the emergency brake or applies virtual brake pressure to the virtual driving vehicle. Moreover, the emergency brake driving logic unit calculates collision data including a final stop distance and a collision speed and displays the calculated collision data on the control display unit.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 가상주행영상을 제공하는 탑승디스플레이부, 탑승자가 탑승하여 가상주행차량을 조작하는 본체부, 및 상기 탑승디스플레이부와 상기 본체부를 지지하는 지지부를 구비하는 탑승유닛 및 긴급제동장치의 사고 분석을 위한 시뮬레이션 프로그램을 구동하고 상기 탑승유닛을 제어하는 제어부, 및 상기 긴급제동장치의 사고 분석을 위한 시뮬레이션 프로그램의 운영자 인터페이스 화면을 제공하는 제어디스플레이부를 구비한 제어유닛을 포함하고, 상기 긴급제동장치의 사고 분석을 위한 시뮬레이션 프로그램은 긴급제동장치의 시퀀스에 따라 상기 탑승유닛에 경고신호를 출력하거나, 가상주행차량에 가상의 제동압력을 인가하고, 최종 정지거리 및 충돌속도를 포함하는 충돌데이터를 산출하여 상기 제어디스플레이부에 표시하는 긴급제동장치 구동 로직부를 포함하는, 긴급제동장치의 사고 분석을 위한 주행 시뮬레이터를 제공한다.
assignees: REPUBLIC OF KOREA NAT FORENSIC SERVICE DIRECTOR MINISTRY OF INTERIOR AND SAFETY

title_en: System and method for reporting and tracking incidents with a mobile device
abstract_en: A novel system and method for enhancing people's personal safety and incident reporting is presented, wherein mobile devices are used to report and/or record both “911” type situations and non-emergency situations. Users of the invention can record, transmit, stream, upload and/or send information from a threatening situation to a dispatcher at an emergency management office or facility and to the user's safety group. The dispatcher can assess the situation and, if the situation warrants action, then the information can be forwarded to the appropriate first responders. The system geo-locates the user and allows integration of camera feeds in the user's vicinity. The inventive system and method enables a user to contact a dispatcher and also to alert the user's safety group. Four pieces of software facilitate video, audio, images and/or text medium of communication between the user-in-distress and the dispatcher, first responders and the user's safety group.

title_en: Emergency rescue command center management method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency information management, in particular to an emergency rescue command center management method. Acquiring a history rescue record; acquiring a resource transportation time index according to the transportation time from the resource supply point to the disaster point; acquiring the resource satisfaction degree according to the resource demand of disaster points and the resource supply of the resource supply points in the history rescue record; constructing an initial scheduling model of resource scheduling according to the resource transportation time index and the resource satisfaction degree; an optimization function is constructed to optimize the initial scheduling model, and an optimized scheduling model is obtained; and acquiring an optimal scheduling scheme based on the optimized scheduling model. The invention builds the initial dispatching model according to the resource transportation time index and the resource satisfaction degree, optimizes the resource transportation time index and the resource satisfaction degree through the optimization function, and can solve the problem that the condition constraint of the objective function can generate local optimization, thereby obtaining a more reasonable dispatching scheme.
assignees: FOSHAN ERTUO MACHINERY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Safety emergency management command dispatching system
