abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency resource scheduling optimization method based on reinforcement learning, which belongs to the technical field of emergency resource scheduling and comprises the following specific steps: the whole map is divided into different rescue areas according to a provincial administrative area division principle; collecting related data of disaster conditions; collecting data to be rescued; establishing an emergency dispatching multi-objective optimization model based on disaster conditions; solving the model by adopting an RL-DE algorithm, setting reinforcement learning related concepts, and training the model to obtain an optimal emergency rescue scheduling scheme; the invention can realize rescheduling according to the recorded data when encountering emergency, has no interruption in the middle and good connection, and achieves the effect of preventing accidents.
assignees: SUZHOU SHENGBINUO INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on time sequence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle search course determining method based on a time sequence, and relates to the technical field of information perception and recognition. The unmanned plane heading determining method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining ship navigation data in real time, recording comparison sequences of different moments and positions, predicting possible positions and headings of ships after AIS (automatic identification system) tracks of the ships disappear for a period of time based on a time sequence analysis model, and then calculating unmanned plane heading determining methods when the ship can search areas based on different navigational speeds based on searching meeting points. According to the invention, under the condition that the current ship position information cannot be acquired, the unmanned aerial vehicle is required to be dispatched to search and rescue the ship, the course of the unmanned aerial vehicle for searching and rescue is calculated and determined after a period of interruption based on a time sequence method, and engineering realization and application are easy.
assignees: THE 54TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Urban water supply management data trend analysis method based on space-time analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city water supply management data trend analysis method based on space-time analysis, which relates to the field of data processing and comprises the steps of collecting data in real time through a city water supply network sensor network, establishing a space-time unified coordinate system, constructing a space-time Kriging interpolation model based on a network topology, realizing space-time alignment of multisource data, dividing self-adaptive space-time grids by utilizing a Voronoi diagram and a sliding window mechanism, calculating multidimensional features, constructing a dynamic space-time diagram by taking the grids as nodes, carrying out multi-step prediction by combining a space-time diagram convolution circulation network, fusing Kriging interpolation results, evaluating abnormal probability and confidence intervals through a Bayesian neural network, superposing monitoring, prediction and risk layers in a three-dimensional GIS, generating a dynamic thermodynamic diagram, optimizing an early warning path based on Dijkstra algorithm, and outputting a minimum risk topology path. The intelligent urban water supply management system has the advantages that the intelligent, stability and emergency response efficiency of urban water supply management are remarkably improved through space-time analysis and accurate prediction, and powerful support is provided for smart city construction.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHUHUI INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: AI-based integrated flight simulation platform to open the future of the drone industry
title_ko: 드론 산업의 미래를 여는 ai 기반 통합 비행 시뮬레이션 플랫폼
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 드론 산업의 미래를 여는 AI 기반 통합 비행 시뮬레이션 플랫폼에 관한 것으로, 교육생, 교관 및 적어도 하나의 드론 정보를 관리하고, 기상청 API와 연계하여 교육원의 위치를 기반으로 기상 정보를 안내하며, 상기 기상 정보를 기반으로 지정된 교관, 교육생 및 드론의 비행로그를 모의 계산하여 비행계획을 수립 및 관리하는 드론 비행 교육 관리 서버; 적어도 하나의 교관 또는 관리자의 제어에 의해 상기 드론 비행 교육 관리 서버와, 연계하여 관리 기능을 수행하는 교육장 단말; 및 조종 단말을 통한 원격 제어에 의해 비행이 가능한 적어도 하나의 드론;을 포함함으로써 교육생, 교관, 드론 등의 다양한 관리대상을 통합적으로 관리하고, 인공지능 기반 비행 분석을 제공하여 교육생과 교관의 교육 성과 및 합격율을 높일 수 있으며, 드론의 비행기록, 정비, 사고기록을 기반으로 체계화된 관리 시스템을 통해 드론의 장비 수명을 늘릴 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Security and Public Safety Application for a Mobile Device
abstract_en: In a plurality of described embodiments, various modules of an application for a client device may operate to enhance personal security for an individual user, as well as public safety in general. A Blue-Phone-in-Pocket (bPip) module operates comparable to, but more effectively than, the traditional college campus blue light phone. When the user of the module toggles a button on the GUI of his/her smartphone, the App may instantly record and transmit key information to a command center, which operates to provide assistance to the student, at their current location, without requiring the student to relocate to one of the tradition blue light phone fixtures. A tracking module permits the student or other user to be tracked by his/her device until safely reaching a travel destination. The person may trigger an alarm if endangered during the trip, which may prompt a respond from local law enforcement, and other assigned individuals.

title_en: Vehicle path planning method fusing battlefield situation information
abstract_en: The invention provides a vehicle path planning method fusing battlefield situation information, which comprises the following steps: firstly, performing topology interruption processing on vector road data to construct a basic road network; simplifying the situation information into a map, and setting the battlefield situation attribute of the road in the map after the battlefield situation information is fused in the map; inputting a starting point and a terminal point of a vehicle on a road network, breaking the road at the starting point and the terminal point of the vehicle, and updating the map; presetting path planning preference according to the battlefield tasks, setting the influence of battlefield situation attributes on the weight under different path planning preference, and calculating by using a shortest path algorithm to obtain a shortest path; and finally, searching the original coordinate point list by combining the shortest path and the road number recorded by the edge list to obtain a path planning result of the vehicle on the road. Compared with the prior art, the invention can support military vehicles to safely and efficiently complete battlefield tasks in a battlefield environment; the system can help the commander to make rapid battlefield decisions; the path planning scheme of continuous multiple steps is provided for users.

title_en: Extreme climate self-adaptive flight control system for complex terrain of unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses an extreme climate self-adaptive flight control system of a complex terrain of an unmanned aerial vehicle, and relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle self-adaptive flight control. The extreme climate self-adaptive flight control system of the unmanned aerial vehicle complex terrain comprises a flight data acquisition and preprocessing module, a climate prediction and risk assessment module, an optimal path and task sequence adjustment module, a real-time flight control and path optimization module and a safety emergency response and recording module, wherein the flight data acquisition and preprocessing module acquires air data, the climate prediction and risk assessment module constructs a neural network model to predict climate, the optimal path and task sequence adjustment module carries out path and task safety assessment, the real-time flight control and path optimization module converts the path and task sequence into an airplane instruction, and the safety emergency response and recording module executes an emergency strategy and records. The problem that in the prior art, unmanned aerial vehicle is difficult to adjust flying in real time due to continuous change of weather conditions is solved.

title_en: An image recording system for a vehicle for performing accident style detection and settlement and the control method thereof
title_ko: 사고 유형 감지 및 사고 처리를 수행하는 차량용 영상기록 장치와 그 제어방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 차량 사고가 발생할 경우 그 사고의 유형을 감지하고 그 사고 유형에 따라 가능한 사고 처리를 자동으로 수행하는 것으로, 촬영 영상뿐만 아니라 차량 상태에 대한 정보, 노면 상태를 알 수 있는 정보, 또는 운전자의 신체 상태에 대한 정보들 중 적어도 하나 이상을 추가로 저장하여 사고 원인을 좀 더 정확하게 분석할 수 있도록 하며, 또한 사고 유형에 따라 그 사고를 가장 적절하게 처리할 수 있는 적어도 하나 이상의 상대에게 사고 유형을 통보하여 긴급한 사고 처리가 이루어질 수 있도록 하며, 또한 사고 유형에 따라 제어 가능한 차량 기능을 자동으로 처리하여 사고 발생 상황을 주변에 공지함으로써 2차적인 사고를 예방할 수 있도록 하며, 또한 영상기록 장치에 저장된 정보들을 자동으로 백업하여 차량의 화재나 파손 또는 도난에 의해 소실되거나 분실되는 것에 대비할 수 있도록 하는 효과가 있는 사고 유형 감지 및 사고 처리를 수행하는 차량용 영상기록 장치와 그 제어방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: One-shot hybrid CBRN integrated remote detection device and method consisting of harmful gas detection and radiation detection in one device
title_ko: 하나의 장치에서 유해가스 탐지와 방사선 탐지로 이루어진 원샷 하이브리드형 화생방 통합 원격 탐지 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: In the present invention, in order to resolve the existing problems in which separate radiation detection equipment must be provided and installed, the detection radius of harmful gases generated in the field is low, the detection speed is slow, and harmful gas detection errors frequently occur, provided are a one-shot hybrid chemical, biological and radiological integrated remote detection device and method, wherein the device comprises a pan-tilt module (100), a radiation detection module (200), a harmful gas detection module (300), a wired and wireless communication module (400), a display unit (500), a smart control unit for pan-tilt operation (600), and a power supply module (700).
abstract_ko: 본 발명에서는 기존의 원거리 유해가스탐지장비는 대기상의 유해가스만을 탐지할 뿐, 방사능 탐지기능이 없어, 방사능 누출시, 이에 따른 방사능 누츨감지 기능이 없어, 별도의 방사능 탐지설비를 따로 구비해서 설치해야 하는 문제점과, 지지프레임이 고정타입으로 되어 있어서, 상하좌우의 움직임이 어려워, 탐지 시야(Fov : Field of view)가 좁은 탐지 관심영역(RoI : Region of Interest)을 형성시키기 때문에, 현장에 발생된 유해가스 탐지 반경이 낮고, 탐지속도도 느리며, 유해가스 탐지에러가 자주 발생되는 문제점을 개선하고자, 팬-틸트모듈(100), 방사선 탐지모듈(200), 유해가스 탐지모듈(300), 유무선통신모듈(400), 디스플레이부(500), 팬틸트 구동용 스마트제어부(600), 전원공급모듈(700)로 구성됨으로서,  일정거리 범위 내에서 일정 방향에 존재하는 대기 중의 특정 유해가스 및 특정 방사성 물질을 하나의 장치에서 탐지하고, 그 유해가스 및 방사성물질의 탐지 과정을 통해 얻은 분광데이터를 동일한 표시장치에 매핑시킬 수 있는 원샷 하이브리드형 화생방 통합 원격 탐지 장치 및 방법을 제공함으로서, 별도의 방사능 탐지설비를 따로 구비하지 않아도, 유해가스 탐지와 방사선 탐지를 동시에 수행할 수 있고, 이로 인해, 설치비용을 기존에 비해 40%이하로 낮출 수 있고, 화생방사고에 따른 빠른 피난과 대처방안을 제시해 줄 수 있고, 유해가스 탐지모듈과 방사선 탐지모듈을 필요에 의해 분리할 수 있어, 현장의 상황에 따라 유해가스 탐지 시스템 혹은 방사선 탐지 시스템으로 독립적인 사용이 가능하여, 장비운용율을 기존에 비해 80% 향상시킬 수 있고, 특정공간의 고정된 위치에서만 방사선탐지와 유해가스탐지만을 수행하는 것이 아닌, 팬 틸트장치의 수평이동과 수직이동을 통해 탐지 관심 영역(RoI) 전체에서 방사선탐지와 유해가스탐지를 수행할 수가 있어, 기존에 비해 1.5배~3배 넓은 대공간 원격 방사선탐지와 유해가스탐지를 동시에 수행시킬 수 있고, 80% 향상된 탐지속도와, 엣지형 유해가스 AI플랫폼모듈을 통해 양질의 현장유해가스탐지데이터를 제공할 수 있는 하나의 장치에서 유해가스 탐지와 방사선 탐지로 이루어진 원샷 하이브리드형 화생방 통합 원격 탐지 장치 및 방법을 제공하는데 그 목적이 있다.

title_en: Regional personnel scheduling method, device and equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The method comprises the steps of receiving an emergency area and a user information request sent by an emergency command system through an operator server, wherein the user information request carries an authorization level of an emergency; determining user information of the emergency area according to the user information request; sending user information to the emergency command system according to the authorization level, wherein the user information is used for indicating the emergency command system to determine users needing to be scheduled and scheduling arrangement and feeding back; the scheduling arrangement is sent to the users needing scheduling, so that the processing efficiency of emergencies is improved, the timeliness of emergency processing is improved, the comprehensive personnel information needing scheduling can be collected, the information collecting time is shortened, and the efficiency of regional personnel scheduling is improved.
assignees: CHINESE JOINT NETWORK COMMUNICATION GROUP LTD COMPANY

title_en: All-in-one search and rescue system air-drop command solution based on intelligent handheld equipment
abstract_en: An air-landing command solution of a heaven-earth integrated search and rescue system based on intelligent handheld equipment is characterized in that altitude values at every 0.5 second in real time are obtained through a conversion relation between air pressure and altitude; then, calculating the average parachute landing speed within 0.5 second according to the landing height difference before and after 0.5 second; then according to the time requirement of reporting or recording the instantaneous speed, the current parachute landing instantaneous speed of the parachute landing information = the sum of the average speeds of the past n 0.5 s/0.5 n; according to the method, a signal is sent to the transfer equipment through a Lora technology arranged in a wristwatch worn by a parachutist, and then the transfer equipment transmits information to the command platform, so that the command platform can monitor the parachuting speed, position situation information, abnormal alarm, distress information and other conditions of the parachutist during airborne landing in real time under a public network-free environment, then the command platform transmits an aggregation instruction or a rescue instruction to the transfer equipment through the received information, and finally the transfer equipment transmits the instruction to the wristwatch worn by the parachutist.
assignees: BEIJING TAIJI JIANGTAI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Emergency storage intelligent control system based on image recognition
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency storage intelligent control system based on image recognition, relates to the technical field of intelligent storage, and solves the technical problem that the prior art can not ensure that the taken emergency materials can efficiently cope with emergency events; the invention comprises a central control module, an intelligent terminal and a plurality of data acquisition modules, wherein the intelligent terminal and the data acquisition modules are connected with the central control module; the invention manages from two aspects of emergency material storage and emergency material scheduling; emergency materials are reasonably stored according to the storage information of the emergency materials and the basic information of each material warehouse, the emergency materials are stored in the required material warehouse, and the reasonable distribution of the emergency material storage warehouses is guaranteed; and the material supply area is defined according to the emergency information, the target warehouse is screened according to the material supply score of the material warehouse in the material supply area, the dispatching of emergency materials is completed through the target warehouse, the dispatching of the emergency materials can be completed in a range as small as possible, and the timeliness of the dispatching of the emergency materials can be ensured.

title_en: Satellite autonomous mission planning system based on weather forecast
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of communication data processing, in particular to a satellite autonomous task planning system based on weather forecast, which comprises a meteorological data receiving module, an on-board weather forecast processing module, an autonomous task decision module and an instruction execution verification module. The weather data receiving module obtains global grid weather forecast products through a satellite-to-ground link, and generates standardized format data after analysis. The on-board weather prediction processing module fuses meteorological data and orbit parameters, calculates effective imaging probability according to the observation condition evaluation model, and outputs an executable degree quantization map. And the autonomous task decision module adopts a dynamic rolling optimization strategy to generate a satellite control instruction sequence. The instruction execution verification module executes the instruction and records imaging quality data to generate a feedback log. The system eliminates the ground instruction transmission delay through on-board closed-loop decision, avoids cloud layer interference by utilizing a multi-source meteorological data fusion and real-time feedback mechanism, and improves disaster emergency response efficiency and data acquisition effectiveness.
assignees: XIAMEN XINGZUO SATELLITE APPLICATION RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Third party compensation work management system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a compensation work management system for traffic accidents for restoring the health of national health insurance finance by collating the traffic accident dispatch records of the police and fire departments, etc., with bill medical information submitted next month by sharing the records in an information network including insurers, confirming that it is an insurable accident by an automobile, checking the presence of "10. third" description and thereby utilizing them for the number of cases of compensation work requests to the Federation of National Health Insurance Organizations and the contents of the cases, etc.  <P>SOLUTION: The computer system (1-6) of at least one organization receives medical fee receipts from the computer system (6) of the Federation of National Health Insurance Organizations of all prefectures and confirms the presence of "10. third" description.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System for monitoring confined space in vessel and ocean platform
title_ko: 선박 및 해양 플랫폼 내의 사각지대 관리시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A blind spot management system for a vessel or a marine platform system is provided to prevent a passenger from being isolated in a blind spot in a massive vessel with a complicated structure or a marine platform. CONSTITUTION: A RFID (Radio Frequency Identification System) tag (110) built on a safety helmet (100) of a passenger has the passenger's personal information. Multiple RFID wireless transceivers (120) are installed several blind spots in a vessel or a marine platform and wirelessly read the RFID tag-stored personal information. Receiving the RFID tag information from one of the RFID wireless transceivers, an AP (Access Point) (130) transmits the information to a control center. A management computer (140) of the control center recognizes the passenger entering one of the pre-determined blind spots based on the RFID tag information.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선박 및 해양 플랫폼 내의 사각지대 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 그 목적은 미리 설정된 사각지대에서 승선자가 작업 외 시간에 잔류한 경우 이를 확인하여 즉각적인 안전조치가 이루어질 수 있도록 함으로써, 복잡한 내부 구조를 갖는 선박이나 해양 플랫폼의 사각지대에서 승선자의 고립으로 인해 발생될 수 있는 사고를 미연에 방지할 수 있도록 한 선박 및 해양 플랫폼 내의 사각지대 관리시스템을 제공함에 있다. 이를 위한 본 발명의 선박 및 해양 플랫폼 사각지대 관리시스템은 승선자의 안전모에 설치되며, 해당 승선자의 인적정보를 포함하는 RFID 태크; 선박 또는 해양 플랫폼 내의 미리 설정된 사각지대에 설치되어 설정된 사각지대로 승선자가 들어올 때, 승선자의 안전모에 설치된 상기 RFID 태그와 무선으로 송수신하는 기능을 수행하여 RFID 태그에 기록되어 있는 정보를 읽어 들이는 다수 개의 RFID 무선 송수신기; 상기 RFID 무선 송수신기로부터 RFID 태그에 대한 정보를 유선 또는 무선으로 전달받아 상황실로 전송시켜 주는 AP; 및 상기 상황실에 설치되어 AP를 통해 전달되는 RFID 태그의 정보를 통해 해당 구역에 들어온 승선자의 정보를 파악하되, 작업시간 이외의 시간에 승선자의 진입신호가 감지되면, 현장 안전관리자의 휴대단말기로 해당 정보를 전송하는 관리 컴퓨터로 구성된다.
assignees: HYUN DAI HEAVY IND CO LTD

title_en: System and Method of Controlling Educational Robot
title_ko: 교육용 로봇 제어 시스템 및 제어방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system and a method for controlling an educational robot. The system performing programming by utilizing an RFID instruction tag comprises: one or more RFID instruction tags storing instruction information for driving a robot apparatus; a programming board reading information through an RFID reader having the RFID instruction tag disposed in a predetermined location; the robot apparatus receiving the instruction information of the RFID instruction tag read by the programming board; and a mission board allowing the robot apparatus to perform an operation in accordance with the received instruction information. According to the present invention, most operations performed by a real robot can be realized by using various instructions without use of a separate computer. Moreover, the system and the method of the present invention can be utilized to induce computational thinking.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교육용 로봇 제어 시스템 및 제어방법에 관한 것이다. 개시된 교육용 로봇 제어 시스템 및 제어방법은, RFID 명령어 태그를 활용하여 프로그래밍을 하는 교육용 로봇 제어 시스템에 있어서, 로봇장치의 구동을 위한 명령어 정보를 저장하고 있는 하나 이상의 RFID 명령어 태그, 상기 RFID 명령어 태그를 소정의 위치에 배치하고 RFID 리더를 통하여 정보를 독출하는 프로그래밍 보드, 상기 프로그래밍 보드가 독출한 상기 RFID 명령어 태그의 명령어 정보를 전달받는 상기 로봇장치 및 상기 로봇장치가 상기 전달받은 명령어 정보에 따라 동작을 수행하는 미션보드를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 교육용 로봇 제어시스템 및 제어방법을 제공한다. 본 발명에 의하면, 별도의 컴퓨터를 사용하지 않고도 다양한 명령어를 사용하여 실물 로봇이 수행 가능한 대부분의 동작 구현을 할 수 있고 컴퓨터적 사고의 유도를 할 수 있는 교육용 로봇 제어 시스템 및 제어방법을 제공하는 솔루션으로 활용 가능하다는 이점이 있다.

title_en: Programs that keep your car from moving if you do not use your seat belt
title_ko: 안전벨트를 하지 않으면 차가 움직이지 않게 하는 프로그램
abstract_en: If a car accident occurs while a driver is driving without wearing a seat belt, there may be more serious casualties than when the driver or passenger fastens his/her seat belt. Seat belts must be worn to prevent such injuries and the police are trying to crack down on drivers not wearing seat belts. However, still four out of 10 people are unlikely to fasten seat belts. The present invention aims to keep the driver′s safety even for the safety of the four people. According to the present invention, because there is a conductive material in a ring and a hole of a seat belt, electricity flows through the conductive material when the seat belt is worn, then a program recognizes that the driver is complete with conditions for driving and the car starts. If the seat belt is not worn, the program recognizes that the driver does not satisfy all the conditions to drive because the driver does not wear the seat belt in the car. Accordingly, no matter how the driver tries to start, the car does not move because the engine is not started. According to the present invention, since four out of 10 people are still unlikely to wear the seat belts though the police are trying to crack down on those not wearing seat belts to keep the driver′s safety, the present invention intends to keep even the four people safe.
abstract_ko:
본 발명이 해결하고자하는 과제는 경안전벨트를 착용하지 않고 주행을 하다가 교통사고가 발생하게 되면 안전벨트를 하였을 때 보다 더욱더 심각하게 부상을 입을 수 있으므로 그 부상을 당하는 것을 예방하기 위하여 안전벨트를 착용해야하*찰들이 운전자의 안전벨트를 단속하고 있지만 그래도 10명중에 4명은 안전벨트를 하지 않을 가능성이 있으므로 그 4명의 안전을 위해서라도 본 발명이 운전자의 안전을 지키는 것이 이 발명품이 해결하고자 하는 과제이다. 안전벨트의 고리와 구멍에 전도체 물질이 있어서 안전벨트를 착용하게 되면 전도체물질에 의하여 전기가 흐르고 프로그램으로 자동차가 "운전자는 운전을 할수있는 조건을 다 갖추었다" 로 인식하여 차가 스스로 시동을 건다. 만약 안전벨트를 착용하지 않게 된다면 자동차에 운전자가 안전벨트를 착용하지 않았으므로 "운전자는 운전을 할수있는 조건을 다 만족하지 못하였다"로 인식이 되어 아무리 운전자가 시동거는 것을 시도해도 차가 시동이 걸어지지 않음에 따라 차가 움직이지 않는다. 
따라서, 본 발명에 따른 효과는운전자의 안전벨트를 단속하고 있지만 그래도 10명중에 4명은 안전벨트를 하지 않을 가능성이 있으므로 그 4명의 안전을 위해서라도 본 발명이 운전자의 안전을 지키는 것이 이 발명품이 해결하고자 하는 과제이다.

title_en: Method, apparatus, computer program and computer readable recording medium for performing emergency call processing based on patient status
title_ko: 환자 상태 기반의 응급 호출 처리 방법, 서버, 컴퓨터 프로그램 및 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록 매체
abstract_en: Disclosed is a method for handling an emergency call based on a patient condition. The method includes the steps of: receiving an emergency dispatch request including patient identification information and patient condition information from a terminal device of a patient; obtaining at least one of patient record data corresponding to the received patient identification information; determining the emergency level of the emergency dispatch request of the patient based on the patient condition information and the obtained patient record data; and requesting an emergency call to an emergency response agency as a process corresponding to the determined emergency level.
abstract_ko: 환자 상태 기반의 응급 호출 처리 방법이 개시된다. 본 방법은 환자의 단말 장치로부터 환자 식별 정보 및 환자 상태 정보를 포함하는 응급 출동 요청을 수신하는 단계, 수신된 환자 식별 정보에 대응되는 환자 기록 데이터 중 적어도 하나를 획득하는 단계, 환자 상태 정보 및 획득된 환자 기록 데이터를 기초로 환자의 응급 출동 요청의 응급 레벨을 판단하는 단계 및 판단된 응급 레벨에 대응되는 프로세스로 응급 출동 기관에 응급 호출을 요청하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Patient emergency response system
abstract_en: An improved emergency response system is provided. The system includes a patient or subscriber location database having a schedule of patient or subscriber activities. In one implementation, an emergency services server detects when the patient or subscriber is having a possible medical event as indicated by medical physiologic data transmitted from a wireless communication device proximate the patient. A third party such as a technologist and/or doctor diagnoses the patient and determines whether treatment is required. If treatment is required, a phone located remotely from the patient is used to call an emergency services first responder from a public safety access point in the patient's location. The remotely located phone has an automatic location identification database record that is updated based on the patient's current location as indicate by the patient location database. The address information in the patient location database includes street number, building number, floor and room number information, if applicable, to ensure that first responders are directed to the patient's specific location. Other implementations of the emergency response system are also described, including natural disasters, home security, and travel applications.

title_en: School emergency artificial intelligence notification system and method
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method of notifying persons of emergencies using artificial intelligence, wherein the first step includes providing at least one database storing multiple accounts thereon that are operably configured to be selectively hierarchically diminutively associated with another account thereon. The method also includes providing an artificial intelligence hardware component operably configured to generate and receive a recording data file that includes at least one of a sound, an audio, an image, generating the recording by the artificial intelligence hardware component, transmitting, through the artificial intelligence hardware component, the recording data file to a recording database for analyzing, analyzing the recording data file to determine the presence of an emergency event or a non-emergency event, and communicating an emergency response notification, upon determining the presence of the emergency event, to the first school user account and the plurality of teacher user accounts.

title_en: System and method for situational awareness assist view
abstract_en: Embodiments described herein relate to a threat detection system that shows a user an incident as it develops in real time by leveraging artificial intelligence (AI) to more accurately focus cameras and highlight the areas of concern within those feeds, providing a much more efficient user interface to the operator. These annotated feeds and feed focused triggering events can also be connected to third party systems. This timeline of events and evidence (small annotated clip of detection when available) is archived and can be reviewed at a later date, containing an accurate timeline of the incident as it progressed.

title_en: Gps tracking and mapping wildfire defense system network for proactively defending homes and neighborhoods against threat of wild fire by spraying environmentally-safe anti-fire chemical liquid on property surfaces to inhibit fire ignition and flame spread in the presence of wild fire
abstract_en: A GPS tracking and mapping wild fire defense system network configured for defending homes and neighborhoods against threat of wild fire by proactively spraying environmentally-safe anti-fire (AF) chemical liquid on property surfaces to inhibit fire ignition and flame spread in the presence of wild fire. The GPS tracking and mapping wild fire defense system network includes: a command center in operable communication with a wireless communication network; and one or more GPS-tracked anti-fire liquid spraying systems, each having an integrated supply tank and a spray pump deployable at properties having building structures, for spraying the properties with environmentally-clean anti-fire chemical liquid using a spray nozzle assembly connected to said spray pump by way of a fluid connection. The system network further includes: a GPS system for transmitting GPS reference signals from a constellation of GPS satellites deployed in orbit around the Earth, to a GPS transceiver installed aboard each GPS-tracking anti-fire liquid spraying system, for GPS processing and GPS-coordinate location; and one or more mobile computing systems, each for use by a registered user including property parcel owners, spray contractors, and other stakeholders on the system network, to request and receive services supported by said system network. Each mobile computing system has a display screen supporting: messaging services; display of maps indicating where wild fires have been identified and mapped, tracked and ranked in terms of risk to the user and GPS-specified property; and scheduling of spray task to be performed, and recording tasks that been completed, and which are in progress, on the GPS tracking and mapping wild fire defense system network.

title_en: Vehicle processing apparatus
abstract_en: A vehicle processing apparatus configured to be applied to a vehicle includes one or more processors, and a non-transitory computer readable recording medium containing a program configured to be executed by the one or more processors. The program includes one or more commands. The one or more commands are configured to cause the one or more processors to: acquire current law information as road traffic-related law information; determine whether the current law information includes a revised provision provided by revision made to past law information, the past law information being held in a storage of the vehicle; and cause, when determining that the current law information includes the revised provision, an interface of the vehicle to present a notification that encourages handling in compliance with the revised provision.

title_en: Mobile phone AT command handling methods and equipment when losing covering and standard switching
abstract_en: The present invention, which discloses a kind of mobile phone AT command handling methods and equipment, methods described when losing covering and standard switching, to be included：If being resident after mobile phone power-on under the first standard, current standard and backup standard are recorded as the first standard by protocol stack respectively；Mobile phone due to signal intensity die down or blackout and after losing covering, if there is AT orders to issue, ATI modules are handled by obtaining the backup standard in the NAS modules for the first standard being issued to the AT orders corresponding to backup standard；When mobile phone standard is switched to the second standard from the first standard, after current standard and standby standard are revised as the second standard by top control module, the NAS of the first standard is notified to switch over operation, if now there are AT orders to issue, then the AT orders are transferred to the NAS of the second standard to be cached by ATI modules, and handle cached AT orders after the handover operation terminates, then by the NAS of the second standard.

title_en: Automated, remotely-verified alarm system with intrusion and video surveillance and digital video recording
abstract_en: An automated self-monitored alarm verification solution including at least a premises portion, a server portion, and an end user device portion. Alarm verification includes capturing by an image capture device at least one image in response to a detection event, and transmitting a first data signal including the image to a local signal processing device. The signal processing device transmits a second signal including at least a portion of the image to a remote hosted server according to at least a first set of predetermined parameters. After receiving the second signal, the server transmits a third signal including at least a portion of the image from the hosted server to a user device. Using the user device, a user views the image and indicates a validity status of the alarm based at least in part on the content of the image. Based at least upon either the validation status indicated by the user, or upon a failure to receive a message including a validation status from the user within a predetermined duration of time, the server portion may send an alarm signal to an emergency response service.

title_en: Mobile asset data recorder and transmitter
abstract_en: An acceleration-based mobile asset data recorder and transmitter equipped with a wireless processing unit, an event recorder, a digital video recorder, a fuel level sensor, and an inertial navigation sensor board. The inertial navigation sensor board includes a 3-axis gyroscope, a 3-axis accelerometer, a 3-axis magnetometer, and a microcontroller. The data recorder and transmitter allows for automatic orientation, automatic compass calibration, fuel compensation with pitch and roll, emergency brake application with impact detection, rough operating condition detection, engine running detection, and inertial navigation of a mobile asset. Users can use the normal operation of their mobile assets to locate and alert, in real-time, areas where their assets are encountering rough operating environments, to provide for quicker emergency response, and to validate the effectiveness of repairs and rerouting.
assignees: JORDAN LAWRENCE B;MATTA LISA A;WI TRONIX LLC

title_en: Maritime emergency command-oriented multi-role human-in-the-loop test system
abstract_en: The invention provides a maritime emergency command-oriented multi-role human-in-the-loop test system. The system is formed by connecting a three-dimensional render server, an accident scene server, a plan management server, a boat drill terminal and a console by a gigabit Ethernet, and multiple testees form a cooperation group to jointly participate in a human-in-the-loop test. By the built system, the behaviors of the persons of the cooperation group in various accident task stages are tested, the emergency disposal behaviors of the testees are recorded, a person behavior database is built, a behavior evaluation method of the testee group is used for evaluating the behavior of the testees in one test, evaluation results are compared with similar cases in the database, the proficiency of the testees are determined, and a new in-loop test case is selected for the same testees. By adopting the system, the stability and the continuity of the in-loop test can be ensured, and the condition that repeated cases are used for testing the group of persons is avoided.

title_en: Intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for air conditioning system based on Internet of things technology
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent operation and maintenance method and system for an air conditioning system based on the Internet of things technology. And then, performing simulation analysis through a cloud digital twin model to generate performance prediction and fault point evaluation, and evaluating the fault probability by using a Bayesian network algorithm to generate personalized operation and maintenance suggestions. And then, optimizing operation parameters by adopting a genetic algorithm, and smoothly adjusting settings by adopting an adaptive control theory. When an abnormality is detected, the severity of the fault is judged by utilizing a multi-level threshold and fuzzy logic, an early warning mechanism is triggered immediately, and an emergency response scheme is pushed. And finally, recording maintenance process and user feedback, updating the digital twin model, forming a closed-loop operation and maintenance system, and ensuring high-efficiency stable operation and service quality improvement.
assignees: TIANJIN QINGYUAN ELECTROMECHANICAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle data processing system based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle data processing system based on edge calculation, and belongs to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle data processing. The system comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle end, an edge computing node and a ground control center, wherein the unmanned aerial vehicle end is provided with a multi-mode sensor array, a data synchronization module and a preprocessing module, a pipeline processing engine is used for realizing data slicing parallel processing based on a Kafka+spark framework, a dynamic unloading controller is used for dispatching computing tasks according to the computing power state of the unmanned aerial vehicle, the ground control center is provided with a multi-mode storage system, a metadata management engine and an end-to-end safety channel, the end-to-end data processing delay is reduced to be within 500ms through the edge node localization processing and dynamic task unloading mechanism by combining with the pipeline parallel engine, and millisecond-level synchronization and self-adaptive compression strategies of the multi-mode sensor are used for improving data transmission efficiency, so that the bottleneck of mass data transmission is effectively solved, and the high-timeliness requirements of scenes such as real-time monitoring and emergency response are met.
assignees: XIAN BAOTONG DEFENSE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nuclear power plant emergency response data management system
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of safety management and information of nuclear power plants, and discloses a nuclear power plant emergency response data management system which comprises a data integration module, a data processing and analyzing module, a data visualization module and a system management and configuration module, wherein the data integration module is used for integrating data from a plurality of heterogeneous data sources of the nuclear power plant and carrying out unified access and standardized processing on the data, the data processing and analyzing module is used for carrying out preprocessing and advanced analysis on the data processed by the integration module so as to extract key information required by emergency response, the data visualization module is used for dynamically displaying the analyzed data in a plurality of visualization forms, and the system management and configuration module is used for carrying out user permission management, system log recording and system custom configuration. The application can improve the data utilization rate, the emergency response efficiency, the decision support capability and the system flexibility and expandability.
assignees: CNNC FUJIAN FUQING NUCLEAR POWER CO LTD

title_en: System and method for language training using multi expression sentence image, recording medium and language study book therefor
title_ko: 다중 표현 문장이미지를 이용한 언어 학습 시스템 및방법과, 이를 위한 기록매체와 언어 학습 교재
abstract_en: A language learning system using a multi-expression sentence image, a method thereof, a recording medium therefor and a language teaching material are provided to enable a user to accurately recognize meanings of each learning sentence which makes a contextual sentence. An input control unit(120) receives a control command and data from a user by being connected to at least one of a keyboard, a microphone and a touch screen. An output control unit(130) provides a processing result, corresponding to a language learning process of a language learning system(10) and the control command input of the user, to the user by being connected to one of a display unit and a speaker. A data storage unit(140) stores various application programs required for the operation of the language learning system and data required for the language learning.
abstract_ko:
상황문을 구성하는 학습문의 의미를 상황문의 내용과 연관지어 나타낸 다중 표현 문장이미지를 이용한 언어 학습 시스템 및 방법, 이를 위한 기록 매체와 언어 학습 교재를 제시한다. 
     본 발명에서는 복수의 문장(학습문)으로 구성되는 상황문을 학습하기 위하여, 학습문의 의미를 상황문의 의미와 연관지어 강조 표현한 다중 표현 문장이미지를 생성하고, 상기 다중표현 문장이미지를 기초로 한 어학학습을 제어함으로써, 학습하고자 하는 상황문을 구성하고 있는 학습문의 의미를 보다 정확하게 인식하게 하여 효과적인 어학 학습이 이루어지도록 한다.

title_en: Apparatus for rewind and play digital voice data
title_ko: 디지털 음성 데이터의 되감기 및 재생 장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An apparatus for rewinding and reproducing digital voice data is provided to reproduce a digital language content without degrading reproduction voice even if a section is reproduced unlimitedly and repeatedly. CONSTITUTION: An apparatus for rewinding and reproducing digital voice data comprises a voice date storage(100), a voice data processing unit(200), a voice data analyzing unit(300) and a controller(500). The voice data analyzing unit outputs the rewinding position information of a digital voice data corresponding to the rewinding time when information is requested. The controller comprises a reproduction location storing unit, a data information receiving unit, a repetition section calculation unit and a repetition reproduction command unit. The repetition section calculation unit calculates the repetition section of a digital voice data with reference to the reproduction position of a stored digital voice data and the rewinding position information of a received digital voice data. The repetition reproduction command unit commands the voice data processing unit to repeatively reproduce the digital voice data corresponding to the repetition section until a stop button is pressed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 디지털 음성 데이터의 되감기 및 재생 기술에 관한 것으로, 특히 디지털 음성 데이터를 재생하는 중 이전에 재생했던 구간을 원하는 시간만큼 되감아서 선택된 구간의 디지털 음성 데이터를 반복 재생하는 디지털 음성 데이터의 되감기 및 재생 기술에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면 테이프를 사용하지 않는 디지털 어학 학습기에서 소정의 재생 구간에 대해 반복 구간을 설정해서 무한 반복하거나 소정 횟수만큼 반복 재생함으로써 학습자가 잘 듣지 못한 재생 구간을 반복 청취해서 어학 학습에 도움을 주고, 아날로그 어학 학습기에서 발생할 수 있는 테이프 열화 현상이 발생하지 않으며, 반복 구간에 대해 무한정 반복 재생하더라도 재생음 열화 없이 디지털 어학 컨텐츠를 재생하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Fire extinguisher included fire defense sensor and power management possible wireless communication
title_ko: 무선 통신이 가능한 화재방어용감지수단과 전원관리수단을 내장한 소화기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a fire extinguisher with a power management unit and fire detection unit for wireless communications. The invention is provided by combining a fire detection function and a fire extinguishing function into one so that wireless communications is possible regardless of places and circumstances. By combining a fire detection unit, a wireless communication unit, and a controller into one, a fire detection facility is easily maintained and inspected. The fire detection unit self-detects fire, and transfers detection information. The fire detection unit receives an operation signal from a fire management unit in order to operate the fire extinguisher. If the information has larger values than a critical value, the fire detection unit self-operate the fire extinguisher with the control of the fire management unit so that the fire detection unit flexibly extinguishes fire. [Reference numerals] (110) Power supply unit;(120) Power management unit;(130) Wireless communication unit;(141) Temperature sensing sensor;(142) Fire protection data collecting unit;(143) Critical value determining unit;(144) Unit for checking whether to perform a communication process;(145) Detection control unit for fire protection;(146) Communication monitoring unit;(147) Power reset command unit;(148) Detecting information recording unit;(149) Memory unit;(151) Fire extinguisher operation signal receiving unit;(152) Fire management operation unit;(153) Operation unit to be performed just before fire management;(154) Manual operation unit for a fire extinguisher;(155) Fire alarm generation processing unit;(156) High Brightness LED operation processing unit;(160) Electrically operated solid aerosol fire extinguisher;(AA) Charging;(BB) Discharging
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 무선 통신이 가능한 화재방어용감지수단과 전원관리수단을 내장한 소화기에 관한 것으로서, 종래의 소화기와 감지장치가 별도로 존재하여 상호 유선으로 연결하여 화재 진압을 하는 방식을 화재 감지 및 소화 기능을 하나로 통합하면서 무선 통신이 가능하도록 구성하여 설치 장소 및 환경에 구애받지 않는 무선 통신이 가능한 화재방어용감지수단과 전원관리수단을 내장한 소화기에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명을 통해 종래에 개별적으로 동작하는 소화기에 화재방어용감지수단과 무선통신부와 소화기작동제어수단을 통합하여 구성함으로써, 화재감지 설비의 보수 및 점검의 용이성을 제공하게 된다. 
또한, 화재방어용감지수단이 독자적으로 센싱하여 이상징후 감지 및 화재 상황을 감지했을때 화재이상징후관리수단에 감지 정보를 전송하며, 화재이상징후관리수단으로부터 소화기 동작 신호를 수신하여 소화기를 동작시키거나, 해당 소화기에서 판단된 감지 정보가 임계치 이상의 수치일 경우에 화재이상징후관리수단의 제어 없이 독자적으로 소화기를 작동시킴으로써, 탄력적인 화재 진압을 수행할 수 있게 된다.

title_en: A WATER LEVEL MEASUREMENT SYSTEM USING CCTV-based ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE
title_ko: cctv 기반의 인공지능을 적용한 수위계측 장치
abstract_en: The purpose of the present invention is to provide a water level measurement system that can measure the water level of a verifiable reservoir, waterway, and spillway, perform predictable water management through predictive simulation, and prevent safety accidents in facilities that managers do not frequently visit and take appropriate measures. The water level measurement system to which a CCTV-based artificial intelligence is applied includes a 3D modeling data collection module that models information on reservoir appearance information, waterway and spillway appearance information, reservoir underwater topography, reservoir surrounding environment, structures installed in the reservoir, and data measured from observation equipment as 3D graphics; a digital twin module that creates a twin virtual reservoir with a real-time 3D production platform; and a simulation module for big data collection that stores big data simulation result records; and a big data deep learning learning module that learns big data deep learning with CNN-based algorithm.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 농업용 저수지의 현장에서 실제 수위을 CCTV로 촬영하여 인공지능으로 수위를 계측하고 시설물의 안전사고을 예방하는 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 드론으로 저수지를 촬영하여 3D 실사화로 모델링 작업을 진행하고 리얼타임 3D 제작 프로그램으로 시뮬레이션을 진행하여 시뮬레이션 과정을 레코드형태로 저장하여 저장된 레코드들을 CNN 기반 알고리즘으로 학습한다. 학습이 완료되면 현장에 설치되어 본 발명 제품에 적용하고 본 발명 제품에서 CCTV로 저수지 실제 수위를 촬영하여 생성된 이미지를 CNN 기반 알고리즘에 대입하여 수위를 계측하고 결과를 지정된 서버로 전송하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
관리자가 자주 방문하지 못하는 저수지와 같은 시설물에 본 발명이 설치되어 상, 하, 좌, 우, 360도 주변 상황을 촬영하고 실시간으로 촬영된 영상에서 미리 정의된 사람, 동물, 구조물, 물에 빠진 사람, 산불, 제방붕괴, 여수로 붕괴 등과 같이 대상물을 특정하고, 대상물에 따라 이벤트를 달리하여 대응 조치를 차별화 할 수 있으며, 다른 관리주체에게 이벤트 정보를 전달하기 위해 Trap을 전송할수 있으며, 대상물이 탐지되는 동안 대상물을 따라다니면서 녹화하고 녹화영상을 서버로 전송하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.  
안정적인이고 예측 가능한 물관리을 위해서 예측 시뮬레이션을 진행하여 정상 단계인지, 관심 단계인지, 주의 단계인지, 심가 단계인지, 사전 방류해도 되는지 예측하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명이 설치되는 장소는 인터넷망이 설치되지 않는 지역으로써 Lora, Cat.M1, LTE와 같은 모뎀이 사용되는데 서버로 전송되는 데이터 패킷을 최소화하기 위해서 본 발명의 압축기법을 활용하여 서버로 데이터 패킷을 전송하는 시스템이다.

title_en: Heart attack detection and emergency response system
abstract_en: The present invention mainly relates to a heart attack detection and emergency response system that is developed so as to monitor rhythm and conduction disturbances; bloodshot of the heart (myocardium), such as ischemia (insufficient bloodshot) or lesion (injury) or necrosis; heart muscle (hypertrophy) and blood ions imbalances such as Ca, K, Mg, and to detect heart attack at an early stage; wherein the present invention comprises ECG device that is worn by the patient for recording the values measured by electrodes connected to the skin surface and to create the electrocardiography file of the patient; a GPS system and a control unit that transmits the patient's current condition and location data to the paramedics or control center if ECG device detects an anomaly.

title_en: Big data analysis-based sand-mud interbed reservoir development zone earthquake prediction method
abstract_en: A sand-mud interbed reservoir development zone earthquake prediction method based on big data analysis comprises the following steps: firstly, the method comprises the following steps: constructing a mass sand-mud interbedded geological model based on the sedimentary characteristics of the drilled reservoir to obtain a transition probability matrix; II, secondly, the method comprises the following steps: constructing a 0-degree incident PP wave reflection seismic record of the model in a forward algorithm and a 90-degree phase Rake wavelet simulation model; thirdly, the method comprises the following steps: screening a model trace data set highly matched with the seismic record waveform of the actual stratum through a big data analysis technology, and carrying out normalization processing; matching records in the big data model which are most similar to the actual seismic waveform according to a formula; fourthly, the method comprises the following steps: and obtaining the quantitative prediction and characterization of the earthquake of the dominant development zone of the reservoir. The invention not only realizes the earthquake forward modeling; moreover, the probability density distribution of the sand-ground ratio and the maximum single-layer sand body thickness corresponding to the corresponding geological model is statistically solved, the development degree of the reservoir is indicated, and meanwhile, the uncertainty of the interpretation is quantified.

title_en: Analysis method based on mass discrete data
abstract_en: An analysis method based on massive discrete data comprises the following steps: step 1: after the police condition is received by the dispatching of the streets of the community, the police condition information of the police condition is recorded and stored in the dispatching place security platform; step 2: reading out the alarm information of the code to be executed; and step 3: detecting the wireless network throughput application condition to obtain the wireless network throughput; and 4, step 4: analyzing the alarm information to be coded to obtain the easy interception index word proportion; and 5: coding the alarm information to be coded according to the wireless network throughput and the proportion of the easy-to-monitor index words by combining other information; step 6: transmitting the coded warning information to a community management platform; the defect that the community management platform in the prior art cannot improve the anti-eavesdropping performance of the alarm information during subsequent transmission by correctly judging the encoding mode and then encoding the alarm information according to the judged encoding mode is effectively overcome.

title_en: Method of Real time transmission providing the information of accident vehicle to standardize vehicle damage by accident, to predict occupant's injury from vehicle crash, and computer-readable recording medium for the same
title_ko: 교통사고에 의한 차량파손 상태를 표준화하고 차량파손 상태로부터 탑승자의 부상 상태를 파악하기 위해 사고차량 정보를 실시간 전송하는 전송방법 및 이를 위한 컴퓨터로 판독가능한 기록매체
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 교통사고시 차량의 파손 정도를 표준화 양식으로 생성하고 이를 통해 탑승자의 부상 상태를 예측하는 기술에 관한 것이다.  특히, 교통사고 현장에서 사고 자료를 수집하는 사고조사관이나 응급환자를 이송하는 구급대원이 차량파손에 대한 정보를 표준양식으로 간단히 입력할 수 있도록 하는 프로그램을 스마트 단말기에 구현하고, 그 입력된 표준화 자료가 즉각적으로 119 소방 상황센터의 정보관리 서버에 전송되고 다시 이를 필요로 하는 경찰, 보험회사, 병원 등에 재전송하도록 구성된다.  본 발명에 따르면 교통사고 차량의 처리 및 탑승자 치료를 효과적으로 수행할 수 있는 장점이 있다.

title_en: Vehicle Black Box Having Self Defense Function and Method for Coping with Emergency Situation Thereof
title_ko: 호신 기능을 구비한 차량용 블랙박스 및 이를 이용한 위급 상황 대처 방법
abstract_ko:
호신 기능을 구비한 차량용 블랙박스 및 이를 이용한 위급 상황 대처 방법은 차량용 블랙박스의 내부에 호신용 스프레이 장치를 내장하고, 운전자가 블랙박스를 손에 들고 상대방을 촬영할 수 있으므로 사각지대의 촬영이 가능하고, 위급 상황에서 차량용 블랙박스의 머리 부분을 돌려 스프레이액을 분사하여 운전자 스스로 즉각적인 보호가 가능하여 추가 피해를 예방할 수 있다. 
본 발명은 블랙박스 기술과 호신 기술을 통해 사고 직후의 사각지대의 영상 기록과 사고 직후 발생할 수 있는 폭력으로부터 운전자의 안전을 스스로 보호할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Communication and navigation command vehicle for guiding and suppressing forest fire
abstract_en: The utility model provides a condition and a mode for in-depth communication between a command center and field suppressing staff. A communication and navigation command vehicle for guiding and suppressing forest fire comprises an off-road jeep, the off-road jeep comprises a GPS (global positioning system), a sound and time recording instrument, an alternating-current power supply, a power distribution and control device, an ultrashort wave ground platform and a handheld GPS and interphone. By the aid of rapid mobility and configured communication devices of the off-road jeep, meanings expressed by the command center and field staff can be efficiently understood and transmitted, and the communication and navigation command vehicle can go deep into an operation site, timely grasp situations, communicate information and realize field command, and has huge practical significance for developing forestry production and decreasing casualty loss.

title_en: Distribution Network Equipment set emulation training evaluation method based on track battle array
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of Distribution Network Equipment set emulation training evaluation method based on track battle array, including establishes real-time device set simulation operations track battle array RSST , with the trace information of the real-time set simulation operations of this gust of recording dispatching person, including operating procedure, operating time；Establish standard device set simulation operations result battle array SSST , with the trace information of this gust of recording dispatching person's standard set simulation operations, including operating procedure, operating time；Establish equipment set simulation operations information evaluation battle array RSIE , and with the evaluation result of this gust of recording dispatching person's set simulation operations information, calculate RSIE ；Calculate the evaluation result of dispatcher's individual equipment set simulation operations SSER .According to individual equipment set simulation operations evaluation result SSER Calculate dispatcher's equipment set simulation operations overall merit result RSSR .The evaluation method can preferably reflect the operating process of dispatcher's equipment set emulation training, have preferable practical training evaluative meaning.
assignees: FUJIAN AUTOMATION ELECTRIC POWER TECH CO LTD

title_en: The optimization method and system in the fire-fighting and rescue path based on integrated many algorithms
abstract_en: The optimization method and system in the fire-fighting and rescue path the invention discloses a kind based on integrated many algorithms, wherein method the following steps are included: S1, pass through Internet of Things obtain incident point；S2, according to incident point, pass through GIS information and calculate incident point periphery fire brigade address；S3, incident point is calculated to the linear distance of fire brigade, carry out fire brigade's sequence, based on apart from short, fire brigade's information of record preceding ten；According to fire brigade's information, and it is based on deep learning algorithm, filters out multiple qualified fire brigade's terminals；The ant group algorithm of S4, each fire brigade's terminal and optimization based on screening calculate incident point to the optimal path between each fire brigade's terminal；S5, it is based on dynamic factor, the smallest path length and optimal final path is selected from multiple optimal paths of calculating；The dynamic factor includes traffic, odd or even number, charge, newly-increased incident point, cancels incident point, road construction situation.

title_en: The method of the Intranet application system emergency response disposition of intelligent automation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of methods of the Intranet application system emergency response of intelligent automation disposition, collect log information, operation information and the warning information of application system, the network safety event of application system is detected accordingly, and collect various emergency response disposal methods, the scheme of acquisition is screened by way of machine learning, constructs emergency response policy library.It when detecting network safety event, is disposed using emergency plan corresponding in policy library, and disposition result is recorded and shown, to complete the reinforcement and repair to network safety event.
assignees: INF CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Dispatching telephone simulation system based on urban rail transit industry
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dispatching telephone simulation system based on the urban rail transit industry, which relates to the technical field of urban rail transit and comprises a signal system module, a voice switch, an application server, a client terminal and an IP telephone. The invention solves the problem that the scheduling personnel can not operate the scheduling telephone at any time to improve the proficiency in the actual rail transit operation. The dispatching personnel cooperate with other rail transit related training systems to check and examine the timely response and timely processing capability of the dispatching personnel at any time according to a preset scene. The proficiency of the whole dispatching telephone system is improved, and the accuracy and the safety of urban rail transit operation are improved; the linkage communication function between the signal system and the dispatching telephone system is added, and the signal system can automatically play a pre-recorded voice file to remind dispatching personnel when a fault occurs. Automatic fault response and fault processing can be realized, and the efficiency of fault response and fault processing is improved.

title_en: Pollution event quick response and management system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pollution event quick response and management system based on big data analysis, which belongs to the field of track big data and environmental protection and is used for monitoring, early warning, responding and processing of environmental pollution events, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module, an event simulation prediction module, an emergency response coordination module and an information release module; the system comprises a data acquisition module, a data analysis module, an event simulation prediction module, an emergency response coordination module and an information release module, wherein the data acquisition module receives and processes AIS data, meteorological data, geographic information data and pollutant monitoring data, the data analysis module classifies and predicts by using a machine learning algorithm, the event simulation prediction module simulates, the emergency response coordination module coordinates emergency response activities of all departments, records and tracks the processing process of pollution events, and the information release module releases real-time information to the public through a public information release platform. Compared with the prior art, the invention greatly improves the response speed and the processing efficiency to the environmental pollution event, and simultaneously is beneficial to the government and environmental protection institutions to more accurately formulate environmental policies and management measures.
assignees: UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Multi-scene simulation command training system and training method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of command training, and particularly discloses a multi-scene simulation command training system and a training method, wherein the system comprises a scene generating end, a command decision end, an instruction executing end and a data recording end; the scene generating end is used for creating training scenes according to diversified requirements and standards, recording various complex environments in cities, mountains, seas and air in real time, ensuring that training contents are close to real conditions, improving training effects, collecting more experimental data, recording operation steps and key information of students in real time through the system, automatically recording training processes through a learning recording module of a learning and observation end, providing convenience for subsequent learning and review for the students, evaluating the operation of the students through the system, and providing targeted improvement suggestions in real time, and helping the students to quickly improve command capability.
assignees: GUORUAN XINTONG BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ocean emergency command scheduling method and system based on data processing
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of marine emergency management, in particular to a marine emergency command scheduling method and system based on data processing, and the method comprises the following steps: and collecting data flows of the offshore monitoring station and the meteorological station, integrating the collected wind speed, wave height and ship position information, identifying data points which are inconsistent with the conventional mode, analyzing the data points, and judging whether the data points are abnormal events or not to obtain a marine data set. According to the invention, the data is analyzed through the time sequence, the standard deviation and the mean value are obtained through calculation, so that the abnormal fluctuation is identified more accurately, the detection capability of key events is enhanced through the refined data processing, the timeliness and the accuracy of resource scheduling are further improved through the real-time resource and demand matching analysis, the emergency response is more targeted and effective, the performance is simulated and compared and the response efficiency is analyzed, the optimization of a command scheduling scheme in actual execution is ensured, and the overall efficiency and the accuracy of marine emergency management are remarkably improved.
assignees: NAT MARINE DATA AND INFORMATION SERVICE

title_en: Mine self-rescuer simulation training effect monitoring method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of mine self-rescuers, in particular to a method and a system for monitoring simulation training effect of a mine self-rescuer, comprising the following steps of collecting data of physiological monitoring equipment worn by a trainer, and collecting heart rate value and blood oxygen saturation, recording response time and error rate of operation behaviors of a trainer, extracting equipment operation sequence and environment change information, and establishing a physiological behavior integration data set. According to the invention, physiological data and operation behavior data of the trainee are collected in real time, and a multidimensional physiological behavior integration data set is created by combining environment change information, so that not only are heart rate and blood oxygen changes of the trainee in simulation training reflected, but also response time and error rate are synthesized, a basis is provided for evaluating emergency response capability of the trainee, and the training difficulty adaptability index can dynamically reflect physiological and behavior states of the trainee, so that training content can be adjusted in a targeted manner in real time according to the conditions of the trainee, and training difficulty is optimized.
assignees: YANKUANG ENERGY GROUP CO LTD;SHANDONG COAL SCIENCE RES INSTITUTE CO LTD;UNIV SHANDONG SCIENCE & TECH;WEISHINUO INTELLIGENT TECH QINGDAO CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent early warning and response method for slope instability risk
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent early warning and response method for slope instability risks, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent early warning based on data analysis, and comprises the steps of firstly collecting multidimensional environmental geological data, introducing an instability type and space-time evolution chain double-label mechanism to form a dynamic data set, then determining key influence factors and weights thereof through slope disturbance sensitivity mapping modeling to realize self-adaptive optimization of input feature selection and model structures, extracting multi-layer space-time features by adopting a deep learning model fused with a multi-scale convolutional neural network and an attention mechanism, dynamically adjusting model parameters to accurately predict slope instability probability and evolution paths, and finally incorporating risk levels, response timeliness and treatment cost into multi-objective optimization by combining an evolution game theory to generate an optimal intelligent response strategy. The invention realizes dynamic perception, sensitive modeling, intelligent prediction and scientific response of the side slope instability risk, and effectively improves prediction precision and emergency response efficiency.
assignees: SHANDONG COAL GEOLOGICAL SURVEY AND RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Method and system for optimizing and dispatching large-scale drainage and waterlogging prevention engineering group of plain river network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban drainage and waterlogging prevention, in particular to a method and a system for optimizing and dispatching a large-scale drainage and waterlogging prevention engineering group of a plain river network. The method comprises the steps of determining typical composite waterlogging events of a plain river network, establishing a hydrodynamic model, analyzing the typical composite waterlogging events to identify key nodes of waterlogging, determining linkage relation between scheduling behaviors of a waterlogging facility and hydrologic response of the key nodes, establishing a multi-objective optimization scheduling model through waterlogging risk minimization and running cost optimization, gradually decomposing a global scheduling target into local scheduling targets, establishing mapping relation between the local scheduling targets and scheduling decisions of the waterlogging facility, obtaining real solution of the multi-objective optimization scheduling model aiming at potential individuals predicted in different candidate scheduling scheme populations, constructing an expected improvement matrix, and selecting an optimal solution to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme. According to the invention, the scheduling timeliness requirement is effectively met by combining the machine learning prediction capability and the optimization algorithm, and the optimal scheduling of the large-scale drainage and waterlogging prevention engineering group in the plain river network urban area is realized.

title_en: Integrated maritime safety apparatus
title_ko: 통합 해상 안전장치
abstract_en: An integrated marine safety apparatus is provided to improve safe for a ship by using an integrated interface developed for recording sailing data on a ship in a hard disk and the like while being applied to marine communication systems. An integrated marine safety apparatus provided for safety sailing of a ship and analysis of marine accidents, comprises a control processing unit(CPU) and a multiple communication interface(100). The CPU collects data on sailing from a sailing equipment of the ship and processes the data into sailing information, and thus controls the ship automatically or manually on the basis of the information. In addition, the multiple communication interface transmits the information transmitted from the CPU to other ships or a control system and sailing information on other ships received from the ships or the control system to the CPU.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 통신체계가 다른 선박끼리 항해정보를 교환하거나 관제시스템으로부터 타 선박의 항해정보를 전송받고, 본선의 항해정보를 내장형 또는 외장형 데이터베이스에 기록·저장함으로써 해양사고 예방과 더불어 신속한 구조활동의 개시 및 사고발생시 정확한 원인분석이 가능하게 한 통합 해상 안전장치에 관한 것이다. 
     본 발명에 따른 통합 해상 안전장치는 본선의 항해장비로부터 선박 운항에 따른 데이터를 수집하여 항해정보로 처리하고, 상기 항해정보에 기초하여 본선의 운항 상태를 자동제어 또는 수동제어 하는 중앙처리기와; 중앙처리기에서 전달받은 본선의 항해정보를 타 선박이나 관제시스템에 송신하고, 본선과 통신체계가 다른 타 선박의 항해정보를 상기 타 선박이나 관제시스템으로부터 수신하여 중앙처리기에 전달하는    다중통신인터페이스   ; 를 포함하여 구성될 수 있다. 
     따라서, 해양재난정보의 공동활용을 위한 통합관제시스템 구축 시 본 발명의 통합 해상 안전장치를 이용하게 되면, 정부입장에서는 서로 다른 통신체계를 이용하는 모든 선박에 대한 통합관리가 가능하고, 선박측에서는 육상(관제시스템) 또는 주변 선박과의 교신을 통하여 안전운항에 필요한 항해정보를 송·수신할 수 있으며, 선주/해운사 등의 이해관계자는 선박 운영에 필요한 정보를 제공받을 수 있다. 
       
     선박자동식별, 선박관제, 선박위치정보, 부가정보, 항해자료기록, 해양사고예방, 사고분석, 해상안전, 보안, 통합시스템, 무선통신, 위성통신

title_en: Accident data sending method for emergency management in car accident
title_ko: 차량 사고시 응급 대처를 위한 사고 데이터 전송 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An accident data transfer method for emergency measure in car accident is provided to chase the location of the driver automatically when the driver is unconscious, and to transfer the data about the accident situation as text message to the service of family through the wireless communications and makes the driver get help as soon as possible. CONSTITUTION: The accident data transfer method includes the steps of: initializing by sensing the minimum vibration value of the car according to the driving of the car and vibration value of the car according to stop and parking of the car(S100) collecting the data by measuring information data about at least one among present location of the car, speed, and the present time(S110) analyzing the stop, parking or driving state of the car by comparing the collected information data with the minimum vibration value of the car(S120) recording the information data of the car into the storage media of the car if the vibration value is more than the minimum vibration value range(S140) transmitting the record data to the wireless terminal(S170).
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량 사고시 응급 대처를 위한 사고 데이터 전송 방법에 관한 것으로, 본 발명에 의한 차량 사고시 응급 대처를 위한 사고 데이터 전송 방법은, 주, 정차에 따른 차량의 최소 진동값과 주행에 따른 차량의 최소 진동값을 감지하여 초기화시키는 제1 단계; 상기 차량의 현위치와 속도 및 현시간 중 적어도 하나에 대한 정보 데이터를 측정하여 수집하는 제2 단계; 상기 수집한 정보 데이터와 차량의 최소 진동값을 비교하여 상기 차량의 주, 정차 또는 주행 상태 여부를 분석하는 제3 단계; 상기 최소 진동값 범위 이상의 진동값이 감지되면 상기 차량의 정보 데이터가 차량의 저장매체에 기록되는 제4 단계; 및 상기 차량의 현위치 및 사고 시간 중 적어도 하나에 대한 기록 데이터가 무선 단말기로 전송되는 제5 단계;를 포함한다. 
     본 발명에 따르면, 차량의 사고 발생 후에 운전자가 의식이 없는 상황에서도 자동에 의해 사고자의 위치를 추적하고, 무선 통신을 통해 기관, 가족 등에게 사고 상황에 대한 데이터를 문자 메시지 등으로 전송하여 사고자에게 최대한 빨리 도움을 줄 수 있는 효과가 있다. 그리고 탑승자가 없는 주, 정차된 차량의 사고시 외부 충격에 의해서도 운전자에게 상황을 인지시킬 수 있는 효과가 있다. 
       
      차량 사고, 무의식, 정보 데이터, 무선 단말기, 전송
assignees: UNIV KOREA IND UNIV COOP FOUND

title_en: Information integrated control system and information processing program, social infra management system, management method, local device, server device, and program

사회 인프라(12A, 12B, …), 행정용 서버(13)로부터 전력 수요 예측 정보, 교통 지체 정보, 사고 발생 정보, 기상 정보 등을 수집하고, 주민용 서버(14)로부터 가옥내 각종 센서(전기 계량기, 가스 계량기, 보안 센서) 등의 주민 정보를 수집하여 데이터베이스(115)에 KVS 형식으로 저장하고, 정기적으로 갱신한다.
