title_en: Method of electronic voting, decoder for implementing this method and network comprising a voting server for implementing the method
abstract_en: Method of electronic voting in a questionnaire, comprising: - a step of broadcasting an offer of electronic voting service to a plurality of communications terminals; - a step of dispatching from a communication terminal of a voter, a request to a remote server, this request containing information for authenticating a voter; - a step of authenticating the voter by comparing the authentication information received with recorded information associated with the voter; - when the voter has been authenticated, a step of dispatching to the communication terminal of the voter a ticket to participate in the vote; a step of dispatching the vote to the server, the former containing a response to the questionnaire and the ticket to participate in the vote, this method being characterized in that it comprises two steps of anonymization, a first step ensuring anonymization to the ticket to participate addressed to the voter by the server, a second step ensuring anonymization of the communication terminal addressing the response to the vote to the server, the participation ticket containing at least one item of data associated with the profile of the voter.

title_en: Emergency response using voice and sensor data capture
abstract_en: Methods, systems, computer-readable media, and apparatuses for emergency response using voice and sensor data capture are presented. One example method includes transmitting, by a user device, an emergency call request to an emergency services provider; prior to the emergency call request being answered: recording, by the user device, audio signals comprising speech signals; and obtaining one or more keywords from recognized words based on the speech signals; and after detecting an emergency call connection: generating a message to the emergency services provider, the message comprising at least one annotation based on the keywords; and transmitting, by the user device, the message to the emergency services provider.

title_en: System and method for telematics accounts on-the-ground safety
abstract_en: Some embodiments are directed to an emergency response system implemented via a back-end application computer server. A vehicle telematics data store may contain electronic records and each electronic record may include, for example, an electronic record identifier and at least one vehicle operation parameter (e.g., a vehicle speed, an accident location, an accident time of day, etc.). The computer server may receive, from an emergency responder (e.g., a police officer, ambulance, firefighter, etc.) via an interactive graphical emergency responder interface display, a vehicle tag (e.g., based on a QR code). The computer server may then retrieve, from the vehicle telematics data store, a vehicle operation parameter associated with the vehicle tag and update the display based on the retrieved a vehicle operation parameter associated with the vehicle tag.
assignees: TURNER DAVID J;SAMELA III JOSEPH M

title_en: Total thinking skills studying system
title_ko: 종합 사고력 학습장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a comprehensive thinking ability learning device capable of developing comprehensive thinking ability, creativity, numeracy, cognition, compositional ability, reasoning ability, and others according to purposes. The comprehensive thinking ability learning device according to the present invention comprises a learning material (10); and a learning application terminal (20) connected to the learning material (10) through short-range wireless communication. When power is applied to the learning material (10), a driving signal is transmitted to the learning application terminal (20) to execute a learning application. A problem having the same digital image to that of a problem presented on the learning material (10) is displayed on the learning application terminal (20). When information of an answer selection unit (113) manipulated in the learning material (10) by a user is transmitted to the learning application terminal (20), an answer selection unit of a digital image displayed on the learning application terminal (20) is matched with an answer selection unit (113) of the learning material (10) in real time. When correct answer checking request information is transmitted to the learning application terminal (20), the answer is verified whether the answer is correct or wrong based on a value of a current set answer selection unit in the learning application of the learning application terminal (20) and a result thereof is informed to the user. If the answer is correct, a next problem is guided. If the answer is wrong, not only correct answer is requested to the user again but also hints or correct answer guiding informing sound and screen are provided to support the user to select the correct answer by analyzing a record of a problem solving process.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 유아부터 노인에 이르기까지 적합한 활용성 목적에 맞춰 종합적인 사고력, 창의력, 수리력, 인지력, 구성력, 추리력 등을 계발하고 발달시킬 수 있는 종합 사고력 학습장치에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 종합 사고력 학습장치는 종합 사고력 학습을 위한 학습 교구재(10)와, 상기 학습 교구재(10)와 근거리 무선통신을 통해 연결되는 학습앱 단말기(20)를 포함하고, 학습 교구재(10)에 전원이 인가되면, 구동신호가 학습 교구재(10)에서 근거리 무선통신(WLAN)을 통해 학습앱 단말기(20)로 전송되어, 학습앱 단말기(20)에 학습교구재와 같은 형태로 구성된 학습 앱이 실행되고, 학습 교구재(10)에 제시된 문제와 동일한 디지털 이미지의 문제가 학습앱 단말기(20)에 디스플레이되며, 사용자에 의해 학습교구재(10)에서 조작되는 답안선택 유니트(113)의 정보가 실시간으로 학습앱 단말기(20)로 전송되면, 학습앱 단말기(20)에 디스플레이되고 있는 디지털 이미지의 답안선택 유니트가 학습교구재(10)의 답안선택 유니트(113)와 실시간으로 일치되고, 학습앱 단말기(20)로 정답확인 요구 정보가 전송되면, 학습앱 단말기(20)의 학습앱에서 현재 설정된 답안선택 유니트의 값을 기초로 정답과 오답을 판단하여 정답과 오답을 알리고, 정답인 경우 다음 문제를 안내하고, 오답인 경우, 사용자에게 정답을 다시 요구할 뿐만 아니라 사용자가 정답을 선택할 수 있도록 답안풀이 과정의 기록을 분석해 힌트 또는 정답 유도 안내를 음성 및 화면으로 제공하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Live broadcast system for highway emergency-response and risk-relief site
abstract_en: Provided is a live broadcast system for a highway emergency-response and risk-relief site. The live broadcast system comprises a data acquisition mobile carrier used for acquiring image, voice and data of the site; a command processing center comprising a display screen used for displaying the image, the voice and the data of the site; and a two-way communication network which is in communication connection with the command processing center and the data acquisition mobile carrier. The live broadcast system for the highway emergency-response and risk-relief site can assist in timely performing teletransmission of emergencies sites of the emergency response and risk relief in the highway and the like and timely transmitting a handling decision to the emergency-response and risk-relief site. The live broadcast system enables commanders and decision makers to feel as if they were in the site, which is conductive to scientifically and quickly adopting effective measures and realizing real-time command. Therefore, abilities of quick response and handing important emergencies can be improved; and accuracy and timeliness of decision making can be also improved, thereby, efficiently and rapidly solving a problem.
assignees: BEIJING ROAD & BRIDGE RUITONG MAINTENANCE CT CO LTD

title_en: Rail transit dispatch simulated training system and usage thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rail transit dispatch simulated training system, which comprises a case writing subsystem and a case using subsystem. The case writing subsystem comprises a front-end case writing interface module, a task recording module and a data base storing module, which are in sequential connection. The case using subsystem comprises a case task analyzing module, a task trigger module, a triggered task state storage module and a front-end interface display module. The task trigger module and the triggered task state storage module are both connected with the case task analyzing module and the front-end interface display module, and the case task analyzing module is connected with the data base storing module of the case writing subsystem. The invention further discloses the usage of the rail transit dispatch simulated training system. The case writing subsystem can be used for adding, deleting and modifying cases, the case using subsystem can be used for operating written and added cases, and thereby the case writing subsystem can be used for dispatch learners for operation training.

title_en: Integrated application system of consultation, study and judge platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated application system of a consultation, study and judge platform; the integrated application system comprises a display system, a conference acoustic-amplification system, an integrated control system and other auxiliary systems; the access end of the display system is connected with a computer, a cable television, a satellite communication, a DVD machine and a conference camera and the output end is connected with a projection machine and a liquid crystal television; the image display terminal of the display system is an electric projection screen; the conference acoustic-amplification system comprises a tone-tuning system, a main acoustic-amplification system, a digital system and a peripheral processing system; the integrated control system comprises a central control host computer and other auxiliary systems comprise custom-made study and judge conference tables, furniture, equipment cabinets and comprehensive cablings; the integrated application system can provide an advanced technical support platform for establishing emergency management systems and operation mechanisms, which can be unified in command, managed hierarchically, flexible in reaction, well-aligned in coordination and efficient in operation; in combination of an interactive touch system and an intelligent camera-shooting tracking, complete study and judge records and convenient and rapid cooperation of the study and judge conferences can be obtained.
assignees: NAT DISASTER REDUCTION CT OF CHINA

title_en: Multimedia emergency command dispatching system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multimedia emergency command dispatching system, which comprises a multimedia dispatching desk, a dispatching terminal and a dispatching terminal, wherein the multimedia dispatching desk is used for establishing communication connection with the dispatching terminal and monitoring and dispatching the dispatching terminal by adopting a suitable dispatching mode according to the type of the dispatching terminal; the dispatching terminal is used for being in communication connection with the multimedia dispatching desk and receiving and executing a dispatching instruction of the multimedia dispatching desk; and the video monitoring terminal is in communication connection with the multimedia dispatching desk and feeds back monitoring video data to the multimedia dispatching desk based on the dispatching instruction. The system can utilize 4G communication to carry out remote video monitoring and video conference service for the front command center and the rear command center. The communication channel between the front command center and the rear emergency can be quickly established under the condition that conventional communication cannot be carried out, and satellite positioning and real-time communication services are provided for the rear command center, the field command center and rescue team members. Provides rapid command information and on-site rescue information for disaster relief, and gives full play to the timeliness and the accuracy of the information.

title_en: Scene recorder in-place supervision method suitable for electric power operation site
abstract_en: The invention discloses an in-place supervision method of a scene recorder suitable for an electric power operation site, and relates to the technical field of electric power operation risk management and control. The scene recorder is embedded with a positioning algorithm, the position deviation of the scene recorder and each working surface of a working site is obtained according to the positioning algorithm, the obtained position deviation is sent to a provincial power grid emergency command center through a power wireless private network, and workers of the provincial power grid emergency command center judge whether the position of a safety supervisor carrying the scene recorder is out of supervision or not according to the sent position deviation data. The in-place supervision method can realize supervision of a multi-surface operation field, can conveniently, accurately and effectively judge whether a safety supervision person carrying a scene recorder breaks away from supervision in the operation field, supervises the implementation condition and the control effect of various risk management and control measures in the jurisdiction range, and effectively guarantees personal risks of the electric power operation field.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent fire-fighting emergency rescue command system
abstract_en: One set of fire fighter's intelligent wearable equipment realizes and command center interconnection through AIoT technique, talkbacks through the pronunciation, commands his how to speedily carry out rescue work, ensures his life safety. The method comprises the steps of establishing a special wireless base station on a vehicle to ensure smooth communication of firemen, establishing a server platform and a large-scale database server platform, wherein the large-scale database server platform is a data center of an intelligent fire-fighting emergency rescue command system, all various information data are stored in a disk array in fields and a streaming data form and are established by adopting an ORACLE database management system, and the intelligent fire-fighting emergency rescue command system is established by adopting the following database management system: personnel, vehicles, materials, equipment, district maps, dangerous chemicals, daily training, emergency rescue simulation, emergency rescue scheme generation, emergency rescue personnel positioning and action tracks, voice pair lecture and record and the like.
assignees: BEIJING BEIAN SAFETY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dam break risk prediction and emergency response method and device for tailing pond and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a dam break risk prediction and emergency response method, a device and electronic equipment for a tailing pond, and relates to the technical field of dam break emergency response of the tailing pond, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing an erosion dam overtopping collapse model based on pre-acquired initial collapse influence parameters; calculating the downward discharge flow and the breach broadening after the dam break of the tailing pond based on the erodible dam overtopping break model; determining dam break influence data of a downstream channel through a pre-established planar two-dimensional dam break flood evolution model; and estimating the dam break risk according to the downward discharge flow, the widening of the break opening and the dam break influence data of the downstream channel, and determining the emergency response grading. The method and the device improve the accuracy of the risk estimation of dam break of the tailing pond, further improve the safety early warning effect, and improve the timeliness and the accuracy of emergency response.
assignees: BEIJING GXAK TECH CO LTD;QINGDA SHUIMU BEIJING ENGINEERING TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE;BGRIMM TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Lightweight extraction method and system for disaster risk area on satellite
abstract_en: The invention relates to a lightweight extraction method and system for an on-board disaster risk zone, and belongs to the technical field of intersection of satellite remote sensing data processing and emergency disaster response. The method comprises the steps of satellite remote sensing image receiving and on-board preprocessing, disaster risk area on-board extraction and geospatial data conversion, data light weight, namely, carrying out boundary simplification on data in a converted format by using a boundary simplification function, carrying out centroid extraction by using a centroid calculation function to generate simplified vector data, and carrying out data downloading based on Beidou short messages, and ground data receiving and visual display. The invention can realize 'on-board completion of core processing, light-weight data adaptation Beidou and minute-level downloading to the ground', and breaks through the timeliness bottleneck of disaster emergency response.
assignees: INSPUR GUANGYIN SATELLITE TECH SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Risk management method and risk management program in computer, and risk management system for executing the method
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a risk management technology for previously predicting that an inconvenient phenomenon which has occurred once diffuses to somewhere else or is repeated, and suppressing it.  <P>SOLUTION: An event log described with event contents in each terminal with time is acquired, inconvenient phenomenon occurrence information showing that the inconvenient phenomenon has occurred in a specific terminal is acquired, an inconvenient phenomenon arrival event pattern prescribed from an event pattern group from an initial event causing the inconvenient phenomenon determined based on the inconvenient phenomenon occurrence information to a final event triggering final occurrence of the inconvenient phenomenon is generated, and an notice event pattern obtained by applying pattern matching processing to a notice event pattern taken out from the event log of the other terminal by use of the inconvenient phenomenon arrival event pattern outputs an inconvenient phenomenon countermeasure command according to an inconvenient phenomenon transition degree undergoing a transition to the inconvenient phenomenon arrival event pattern.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Methods and systems for generating time-synchronized audio messages of different content in a talkgroup
abstract_en: Methods and systems for generating time-synchronized audio messages of different content in a talkgroup. One system includes an electronic computing device that includes an electronic processor configured to generate first public safety incident information as a function of context information of a first member of a talkgroup, and second public safety incident information as a function of context information of a second member of the talkgroup. The second public safety incident information is different than the first public safety incident information. The electronic processor is further configured to generate a first audio message including the first public safety incident information sized according to a time window and a second audio message including the second public safety incident information sized according to the time window such that a playback time of the first audio message is approximately the same as a playback time of the second audio message.

title_en: Systems and Methods for a Recorder User Interface
abstract_en: An incident recorder records original and supplemental incident information using a simplified user interface.

title_en: Pumped storage power station equipment supervision system for fault wave recording identification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a pumped storage power station equipment supervision system for fault wave recording identification, which comprises the following components: the data acquisition module is used for acquiring the operation data of the pumped storage power station equipment in real time; the fault recording module is used for automatically triggering and recording fault recording data during faults when the equipment is abnormal; the feature extraction module is used for extracting fault features in the fault record data to obtain a target fault feature set; the analysis module is used for inputting the extracted fault characteristics into a pre-trained deep learning model for analysis and determining the fault type; the early warning module is used for giving an alarm to an operator according to the fault type and starting corresponding emergency response measures according to the fault type; the functions of monitoring the running state of the equipment in real time, automatically recording data during faults, extracting and analyzing fault characteristics, timely giving out alarms and emergency responses and the like can improve the detection and diagnosis capability of the equipment faults and reduce the influence of the faults on the running of the power station equipment.

title_en: Apparatus of emergency bell using speech recognition, method for operating the same and computer recordable medium storing the method
title_ko: 음성 인식을 이용한 비상벨 장치, 이의 작동 방법 및 이 방법이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency bell apparatus using speech recognition, an operating method thereof and a computer-readable recording medium storing the same. The emergency bell apparatus using speech recognition comprises: a speech recognition unit to perform speech recognition for an inputted speech signal to generate an event if the inputted speech signal is a command for operating the emergency bell apparatus as a result of speech recognition; and a control unit to perform an emergency situation process of the emergency bell apparatus according to generation of the event.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 음성 인식을 이용한 비상벨 장치, 이의 작동 방법 및 이 방법이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체에 관한 것이다. 이러한 본 발명은 입력되는 음성 신호에 대한 음성 인식을 수행하여, 음성 인식 결과, 상기 입력된 음성 신호가 상기 비상벨 장치를 작동시키는 명령어이면 이벤트를 발생시키는 음성인식부와, 상기 이벤트의 발생에 따라 상기 비상벨 장치의 비상 상황 프로세스를 수행하는 제어부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 하는 비상벨 장치와, 이를 위한 방법 및 이 방법이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능한 기록매체를 제공한다.

title_en: Submersion sensor with BIT device for aircraft
title_ko: Bit 수단이 설치되는 항공기용 침수감지기
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a submersion sensor with a BIT means installed thereon for an aircraft. The submersion sensor senses submersion when an aircraft crashes into a river, lake and sea, turns off the power to a flight data recorder (FDR), thereby preventing accident records and major flight records of the aircraft stored in the FDR from being deleted. In the submersion sensor, the BIT means comprising a BIT LED (20), a BIT indicator, with a BIT switch (10) is embedded to sense whether the submersion sensor properly operates. The submersion sensor senses submersion when the aircraft, in particular, a helicopter crashes into the river, lake, and sea, turns off the power to the FDR to prevent the accident records and major flight records of the aircraft stored in the FDR from being deleted, and the BIT means is embedded in the submersion sensor, such that an operator can recognize whether the submersion sensor properly operates, thereby enabling the operator to sense a failed or malfunctioning sensor in advance, and subsequently, preventing the risk of accidents in advance, and thus, reliability of the submersion sensor is remarkably enhanced.
abstract_ko:
본발명은 BIT 수단이 설치되는 항공기용 침수감지기에 관한 것으로, 항공기가 강, 호수, 바다에 추락할 경우 침수감지기에 의해 침수를 감지하고, 비행기록장치(FDR)의 전원을 차단하여, FDR에 기 저장된 항공기 사고기록 및 주요 비행기록 삭제방지를 하는 것으로, 상기 침수감지기에는 BIT(Built in Test) 스위치(10)와 BIT indicator인 BIT LED(20)로 구성되는 BIT 수단이 내장되어 침수감지기가 정상적으로 작동되는지를 알 수 있는 것으로, 
항공기, 특히 헬기가 강, 호수, 바다에 추락할 경우 침수감지기에 의해 침수를 감지하고 비행기록장치(FDR)의 전원을 차단하여, FDR에 기 저장된 항공기 사고기록 및 주요 비행기록 삭제를 방지를 하며, 상기 침수감지기에는 BIT 수단이 내장되어 침수감지기가 평소 정상적으로 작동되는지를 알 수 있어서 기기의 고장 내지 오작동을 사전 감지하여 사고위험을 미연에 방지하며 침수감지장치의 신뢰도를 향상시키는 현저한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Grid-based data conversion method for constructing, managing, and utilizing disaster information
title_ko: 재난정보의 구축, 관리, 활용을 위한 격자 기반 데이터 변환방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a grid-based data conversion method for constructing, managing, and utilizing disaster information includes: a metadata information determining process; a lattice transformation process; a standard scoring process; a weight calculation process; and a fusion lattice generating process. Therefore, people can gain intuitive insight by quickly and easily merging a lot of spatial information.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 다수의 공간정보를 쉽고 빠르게 융합함으로써 사람들에게 직관적인 통찰이 가능하도록 제공하기 위한 재난정보의 격자 기반 데이터 변환방법에 관한 것으로,  
점, 선, 면 등의 다양한 벡터 데이터를 쉽고 빠르게 격자로 변환한 후 융합할 수 있는 기반을 제공함으로써, 향후 쏟아지는 다양한 재난대응 정보들을 활용할 수 있도록 벡터의 격자 변환 기술을 개발하였다.  
즉, 자연재난과 관련된 수많은 정보들과, 상기 정보들에 의해 풍수해를 예측하기 위한 프로그램이 내장된 운영컴퓨터와, 풍수해를 시뮬레이션하기 위한 모니터로 구성되어진 시스템에서, 상기 프로그램에 의해 다음과 같은 과정으로 수행되는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
1) 상기 자연재난과 관련된 수많은 정보들이 유입되면 피해시설에 대한 위치정보를 토대로 점,선,면 등의 벡터 유형 별 격자 데이터로 변환하기 위해, 먼저 국가지점번호를 기반으로 격자사양을 정의하는 과정으로서, 격자 기반의 공간정보서비스에서 제공하는 격자사양에 대한 정의, 개념적 모델, 상세사항(원점, 공간적 범위, 좌표참조체계, 구성격자의 크기, 계층구조, 격자셀의 형태/크기/식별자 등) 등의 메타데이터 정보를 결정하는 과정, 
2) 데이터를 공간상에 표현하기 위한 위치정보와 개체 특성을 묘사하기 위한 속성정보로 이루어진 공간데이터들을 격자기반 데이터로 변환하는 과정으로서, 속성정보 측면에서 벡터 데이터를 포인트(point), 폴리라인(polyline), 폴리곤(polygon)의 세 가지 유형별로 격자 변환하기 위해,  포인트(point), 폴리라인(polyline), 폴리곤(polygon)의 대푯값을 결정하되, 먼저 PRIORITY에 의해 결정하고, PRIORITY가 같은 경우에는 METHOD에 따라 결정함으로써, 포인트(point), 폴리라인(polyline), 폴리곤(polygon)을 각각 격자 레스터로 변환하며, 선이나 면 데이터를 격자로 변환하기 위해 중첩되는 격자의 면적에 따라 속성값을 분배하는 면적분배법에 의한 격자변환방법을 함께 사용하는 격자 변환과정과, 
3) 2)과정에서 격자 변환된 데이터를 표준 점수화하는 과정으로서, 원점수(raw score)의 상대적 위치를 확인하기 위해, 어떤 점수와 평균 간의 차이, 즉 편차를 표준편차로 나누어서 변환해줌으로써 Z-Score와 T-Score로 표준화한 값을 할당해주는 표준점수(standard score)화 과정, 
4) 지표 간 상대적 중요도와 각 지표들이 평가 결과에 미치는 영향 정도를 고려하여 3)과정에서 얻은 표준점수에 가중치를 적용해줌으로써 최종 융합 격자를 생성하게되는 가중치 산정과정, 
5) 4)과정에서 얻은 가중치가 적용된 표준점수들을 모두 융합하여 하나의 수치를 도출하는 융합 격자 생성과정.

title_en: Safety inspection manual system
title_ko: 안전점검 매뉴얼 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a safety inspection manual system to provide diagnostic items and management methods for each case. According to the present invention, the safety inspection manual system comprises: a control unit including an interface through which information is input and output, and a control module which controls the information input or output through the interface; and a database connected to the control module of the control unit to store data. The database includes: a first database in which manual data related to serious industrial accidents are recorded; and a second database in which manual data related to conventional accidents are recorded. The first database and the second database include a first metadata group and second metadata including a plurality of keywords, respectively, wherein the data is hierarchical so that at least one diagnostic item and management method are dependent on the keyword.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 정보가 입출력되는 인터페이스와, 상기 인터페이스로 입력된 정보 또는 출력되는 정보를 제어하는 제어모듈을 포함하는 제어부; 및 상기 제어부의 제어모듈과 연결되어 데이터를 저장하는 데이터베이스;를 포함하고, 상기 데이터베이스는, 중대산업사고 관련 매뉴얼 데이터가 기록되는 제1데이터베이스 및 재래형사고 관련 매뉴얼 데이터가 기록되는 제2데이터베이스를 포함하고, 상기 제1데이터베이스 및 제2데이터베이스는 복수의 키워드를 포함하는 제1메타데이터군 및 제2메타데이터를 각각 포함하되, 상기 키워드를 기준으로 적어도 하나의 진단항목과 관리방법이 종속되도록 데이터가 계층화된 안전점검 매뉴얼 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: System of remote wireless diagnostic for underground power distribution line
title_ko: 지중 배전선로 원격 감시 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a remote monitoring system for an underground distribution line, wherein an autonomous driving robot travels around an underground distribution line to monitor and diagnose the underground distribution line, transmits an image and location information of a site to a remote location when a location where heat is severe and a location where fire or smoke is detected are detected, and at the same time, approaches the corresponding location to spray a cooling fire extinguishing agent and an insulating agent material, thereby preventing a large accident by blocking or suppressing the same at an early stage. In the remote monitoring system for an underground distribution line including an underground relay wireless communication unit (100), an underground driving diagnosis robot (200), and an underground central control server (300), the underground driving diagnosis robot (200) comprises a driving robot body (201), a moving wheel (202), a fire extinguishing water tank (203), a pump (204), a two-way valve (206), a driving robot concentration control unit (210), a distribution line image photographing unit (220), an image temperature measurement unit (230), a leakage current detection unit (240), a cooling fire extinguishing liquid injection unit (250), an insulator coating liquid injection unit (260), a first frequency modulation/demodulation unit (270), a driving robot antenna unit (280), a driving motor unit (290), a diagnosis packet encryption/decryption unit (295), and a scattering injection nozzle (2550).
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지하의 배전선 관로에 설치된 지중 배전선로의 상태를 자율주행 로봇으로 감시와 진단하고 지중 배전선로의 특정 부위에서 허용 온도보다 높은 온도 또는 허용 레벨 이상의 누설전류가 검출되면 해당 위치의 지중 배전선로에 절연체피막을 도포하여 누전을 차단하는 동시에 보호하고 해당 부위의 사전 사후 이미지를 촬영하고 검출된 위치정보와 함께 서버에 통보하며 연기 또는 화재가 검출되면 해당 위치에 소화액을 분사하여 초기에 진압하므로 대형사고를 방지하는 지중 배전선로 원격 감시 시스템에 관한 것이며, 지하에 매설되고 지중배전선로가 설치된 지중전력선관로의 내부 벽면 일부분에 균일한 간격으로 반복하여 고정 설치되며 지표면으로 관통 설치된 지상안테나를 통하여 지중전력선관로의 내부에서 생성되어 송신된 배전선로진단제어신호패킷을 중계하여 지상으로 실시간 무선송신하고, 지상으로부터 지상안테나를 통하여 무선수신된 배전선로진단제어신호패킷을 중계하여 지중안테나를 통하고 지중전력선관로의 내부에 실시간으로 무선송신하므로 지상과 지중전력선관로의 내부 사이에 무선중계통신하는 지중중계무선통신부; 지중전력선관로의 내부에 배치되고 자율주행 방식과 배전선로진단제어신호패킷으로 수신된 해당 원격 제어신호에 의하여 주행 또는 이동하며 상기 지중중계무선통신부와 무선 접속하고 상기 지중배전선로의 외관의 이미지를 실시간 촬영하며 촬영된 이미지를 분석하여 온도를 검출하고 지중배전선로로부터 검출되는 전류크기를 측정하여 전류가 누설되는지 판단하며 상기 해당 원격 제어신호에 의하여 냉각소화액 또는 절연체도포액을 각각의 비산분사노즐에 의하여 분사하고 촬영된 이미지 정보와 분석된 온도 정보와 측정된 누설전류 정보를 배전선로진단제어신호패킷으로 변환하여 상기 지중중계무선통신부에 실시간 전송하는 지중주행진단로봇; 지중중계무선통신부와 무선 접속하고 상기 지중주행진단로봇이 배전선로진단제어신호패킷으로 전송한 정보를 기록 저장하고 실시간 분석하여 장애가 발생된 것으로 판단되면 지정된 관리자 단말장치에 통보하여 현장으로 출동하도록 제어하며 관리자가 입력하는 원격 제어신호를 배전선로진단제어신호패킷으로 변환하여 지중주행진단로봇에 전송하는 지상중앙관제서버를 포함하는 특징에 의하여 지하에 매설된 전력선 관로에 설치된 지중 배전선로의 주변을 자율주행 로봇이 주행하여 감시 진단하고 발열이 심한 위치와 화재 또는 연기가 검출되는 위치와 전류가 급격하게 변화하는 위치가 검출되면 현장의 이미지 정보와 위치정보를 확보하여 원격지에 전송하는 동시에 해당 위치에 접근하여 냉각소화액, 절연제를 분사하므로 초기에 진압하여 대형사고를 방지하는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Integrated emergency event detection and mapping using individualized device location registrations
abstract_en: A software platform includes emergency event processing functionality for detecting and mapping emergency event occurrences. The emergency event processing includes device location registration functionality for allowing operators of the software platform to register locations of their devices. Information associated with the operator-entered location information is stored alongside network device information. When an emergency call is placed by a device registered with the software platform, the software platform identifies network device information for the device placing the emergency call and searches records generated based on the operator-indicated device locations. A location determined thereby is then signaled to a public safety answering point. This automated signaling can improve an emergency response by directing dispatched responders to a specific location verified by the operator of the device, rather than an assumed location specified by an administrator which may not actually be accurate.

title_en: Optical fiber illuminator, method of fabricating optical fiber illuminator, and optical recording head and optical recording and reading apparatus having the optical fiber illuminator
abstract_en: Provided is an optical fiber illuminator used for recording and reading high density optical information according to a near field recording (NFR) scheme, a method of fabricating the optical fiber illuminator, and an optical recording head and recording apparatus having the optical fiber illuminator. The optical fiber illuminator includes: an optical fiber having a core upon which light is incident and a clad that surrounds the core, one end of the optical fiber having a mirror formed in an inclined manner; and a lens formed on an outer surface of the optical fiber for focusing light reflected by the mirror. The optical fiber illuminator has an improved optical arrangement for optical illumination and detection, it is easy to manufacture, its optical input is easy to control, and it can be readily provided in an array form. When an array type optical recording and reading apparatus having an optical recording head and multiple aperture probes adopts the optical fiber illuminator, the resulting simple arrangement and compact size enables size reduction of the overall apparatus, a signal to noise ratio is high, and high density optical information can be recorded and reproduced at an extremely high rate.

title_en: Internal work management and control board for reinforcing auxiliary fire rescue
abstract_en: An internal work management and control board for strengthening auxiliary fire rescue, which belongs to the field of fire rescue equipment, wherein the top end of the internal work management and control board is provided with a portable opening, two sides of the portable opening are provided with timer fixing areas, and an identity management and control fixing board is arranged below the top end; the identity control fixing plate is provided with a plurality of identity mark areas; the identity mark area comprises a plurality of identity nameplate areas, a scale mark number area and a pointer area; the identity nameplate area is provided with an identity nameplate control grid for placing a firefighter identity nameplate. The internal work management and control board strengthens the auxiliary command efficiency, can rapidly and accurately register the information such as the name, the time of entering and exiting the fire scene, the air-breathing pressure reading and the like of the internal attack personnel, and effectively master the state of the internal attack personnel. The safety personnel can more intuitively record the residual quantity of the air-breathing gas through the scales of the device, timely and accurately send out evacuation signals, optimize the fire scene management of the internal work personnel, and effectively provide support for emergency rescue.
assignees: CANGZHOU HIGH TECH IND DEVELOPMENT ZONE FIRE RESCUE BRIGADE

title_en: Emergency information service system and method based on satellite-borne unmanned aerial vehicle and high-flux satellite
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency information service system and method based on a satellite-borne unmanned plane and a high-flux satellite, which realize real-time sensing, information support and emergency command from the rear to the front based on the high-flux satellite, and comprise a multi-node sensing platform, the high-flux satellite, a satellite-ground integrated communication network and an emergency communication command center; the multi-node aware platform includes: satellite base nodes, space base nodes and ground nodes. The emergency information service method based on the manned satellite and the high-flux satellite comprises two working modes, namely: the remote automatic real-time sensing mode and the data and instruction bidirectional real-time feedback mode, the high-flux communication satellite link can improve the data transmission rate and timeliness, and the hundred percent success rate of unmanned aerial vehicle tasks is met. The system combines the flexibility of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the advantages of high-speed, real-time and wide-area coverage of the broadband communication satellite, can meet the industry with higher real-time requirements, and particularly aims at emergency information service under the scenes of serious disasters or military requirements.

title_en: Big data-based energy management method and system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy management, and particularly discloses an energy management method and system based on big data. The application divides a plurality of management sub-road sections; determining a plurality of networking street lamps and a plurality of local street lamps, and constructing local communication connection; based on a big data technology, navigation record data are acquired, and vehicle passing data of a plurality of management sub-road sections are periodically predicted; matching an energy gear instruction; and according to the multiple energy gear commands, adjusting the illumination gear. The navigation record data can be acquired based on a big data technology, the vehicle passing data is periodically predicted, the energy gear instruction is generated, the illumination gear adjustment is carried out on a plurality of management sub-road sections, a large number of sensing devices are not needed to be additionally arranged, the energy management cost of street lamp illumination is effectively reduced, good illumination environment can be provided for the farther front of the vehicle due to the adjustment of the plurality of management sub-road sections, and illumination energy management adjustment of different gears can be carried out according to different vehicle passing data.
assignees: TIANNA ENERGY TECH SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Combined simulation training system based on kylin operating system
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a combined simulation training system based on a kylin operating system, which is applied to the kylin operating system, wherein the training system comprises a training official module, a control module, a command module, a central service module and a training module, wherein the training official module is used for receiving real training data, inputting the real training data into a preset training deployment model, determining a training scheme output by the preset training deployment model, the control module is used for receiving the training scheme, determining corresponding operation commands according to the training scheme and a preset analysis rule, the command module is used for receiving the operation commands and displaying the operation commands on a training manual interface, recording and operating data of the operation commands executed by a training user, determining corresponding operation results, and the central service module is used for receiving the training scheme, the operation commands and the operation results and transmitting the training schemes to the corresponding training official module, the control module and the command module according to a preset linkage rule.
assignees: BEIJING ZHONGKE ZHUORUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Site pollution heat monitoring method and system for emergency command and dispatch
abstract_en: The invention provides a site pollution heat monitoring method and a system for emergency command and dispatch, which relate to the technical field of atmospheric environment supervision and comprise the following steps that S1, a pollutant type corresponding to pre-processed site early warning information of a current monitoring site is obtained; the method comprises the steps of S2, obtaining a historical inspection list of pollution source points, carrying out pollution source matching on pollutant types emitted by pollution sources recorded in the historical inspection list and pollutant types corresponding to site early warning information, S3, respectively calculating a distance heat value between a current monitoring site and a first pollution source point, screening the first pollution source point, S4, calculating the pollution heat value of the first pollution source point through a linear weighting method, S5, generating a current total inspection priority table according to the distance heat value and the pollution heat value between the current monitoring site and the first pollution source point, and carrying out quick and accurate dispatching management on the pollutant types and the pollutant types according to the priority sequence in the total inspection priority table.
assignees: SICHUAN CHINA BLUE SKY ENVIRONMENT TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Dam piping intelligent diagnosis method and system based on unmanned aerial vehicle infrared and distributed optical fiber fusion
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of hydraulic engineering safety monitoring, and discloses an intelligent dam piping diagnosis method and system by combining unmanned aerial vehicle infrared rays with distributed optical fibers, wherein a data acquisition module acquires dam surface temperature distribution through an unmanned aerial vehicle infrared thermal imager, and a distributed optical fiber network arranged in a fence mode is combined to monitor a deep temperature field so as to realize full coverage data acquisition of the surface and the interior; the data processing module adopts GPS timing and interpolation algorithm to realize time synchronization of multi-source data, eliminates environmental interference through wavelet noise reduction and dynamic baseline correction, judges seepage risk based on temperature gradient and machine learning model, and the visualization module superimposes thermodynamic diagram and optical fiber temperature data on a dam BIM model to generate a 3D temperature field, marks a seepage channel in real time through an interactive interface and pushes early warning information. The system can replace the traditional manual inspection, and is suitable for long-term safety monitoring and emergency response of hydraulic buildings such as earth-rock dams, embankments and the like.
assignees: HUNAN JIEZHUO TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Smart network control system for land and the sea integration alarm
title_ko: 지능형 육해상 통합 경보용 네트워크 제어시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A network control system for intelligent land/marine integrated alarm is provided to handle dangerous environment. CONSTITUTION: A main control unit(20) controls the whole system and backs data up. The main control unit comprises a main CPU(22), a communication module(27), a display unit(21), an input key(26) and a situation alarm LED(25). A repeater unit(30) is connected to one side of the main control unit. The repeater unit comprises a repeater CPU(32), a communication module(33), a display unit(31), an input key(34), and a situation alarm LED(35). The repeater unit monitors operation environment of the main control unit. An interface unit(40) is connected to the other side of the main control unit. The interface unit delivers a command and a control signal to an external device in the main control unit. [Reference numerals] (20) Main control unit; (30) Repeater unit; (40) Interface unit; (50) Expanding unit; (A1) LAN port; (A2) Serial port; (A3) USB port; (A4) Voyage Data Record(VDR); (B1) Smoke detector; (B2) Fire detector; (B3) Frame detector; (B4) Manual call pointer; (C1) Smoke detector manufactured by an "A" company; (C2) Smoke detector manufactured by a "B" company; (C3) Smoke detector manufactured by a C" company; (C4) Smoke detector manufactured by a "D" company; (D1,D2,D3) Water leakage detector; (E1) Temperature sensor; (E2) Pressure sensor; (F1) Gas detector(O_2); (F2) Gas detector(H_2S); (F3) Gas detector(CO_2); (F4) Harmful gas detector
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 육상 및 해상에 대한 통합 경보용 네트워크 제어시스템에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 선박, 빌딩, 공장, 산업현장 등의 장소에 설치하여 화재 경보 및 화재 진압 장비 등으로 신호를 전송할 수 있고, 다중 검출 및 다중 감시(Multi Detector and Multi Monitoring) 시스템 기능을 활용하여 위험 환경에 대해 지능적으로 대처 할 수 있는 지능형 육해상 통합 경보용 네트워크 제어시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명은 전체 시스템을 통제하고 데이터의 백업 기능을 하며 메인 CPU(22), 통신모듈(27), 디스플레이부(21), 입력키(26), 상황알림 LED(25)로 이루어지는 메인 컨트롤 유닛(20)과, 상기 메인 컨트롤 유닛(20)의 일측에 연결되어 리피터 CPU(32), 통신모듈(33), 디스플레이부(31), 입력키(34), 상황알림 LED(35)로 이루어져 상기 메인 컨트롤 유닛(20)의 운용 환경을 감시하는 기능을 수행하는 리피터 유닛(30)과, 상기 메인 컨트롤 유닛(20)의 다른 일측에 연결되고 인터페이스 컨트롤 유닛(43), 루프 베이스(45), 루프카드(47), 전원공급장치(41), 긴급 보조 전원장치(42), 확장 릴레이(44), 터미널 단자대(46)로 이루어져 상기 메인 컨트롤 유닛(20)에서 명령 및 제어신호를 외부장치로 전달시켜 주는 인터페이스 유닛(40)과, 상기 인터페이스 유닛(40)의 일측에 연결되는 연기검출기, 화재검출기, 가스 검출기, 누수감지기, 압력센서, 온도센서로 이루어진 개별적인 검출기 모듈(70a~70e)이 설치되는 루프 카드모듈(47)과, 상기 메인 컨트롤 유닛(20)의 또 다른 일측에 연결되고 랜 포트, 시리얼 포트, USB 포트, 항해 자료 기록기(VDR)포트로 이루어지는 통신포트(10)로 이루어지는 것에 특징이 있다.

title_en: Method and system of verifying traffic accident
title_ko: 교통 사고 검증 방법 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for verifying a vehicle accident using a server to verify the vehicle accident. The method includes the steps from (a) to (c). The method includes: (a) receiving the location and time information regarding the vehicle accident; (b) searching for one or more vehicles passing through the location of the accident during the time of the accident based on the location and time information received to the server; and (c) playing videos recorded at the time of the accident among the videos in the black-box of the found vehicles.
abstract_ko: 검증되지 못했던 교통 사고를 서버 장치가 검증하는 교통 사고 검증 방법에 있어서, 단계들 (a) 내지 (c)를 포함한다.  단계 (a)에서 서버 장치는 교통 사고의 위치 정보와 시간 정보를 입력받는다.  단계 (b)에서, 서버 장치는, 입력받은 위치 정보와 시간 정보에 따라, 교통 사고의 시간에 교통 사고의 위치를 통과하는 적어도 한 차량을 검색한다.  단계 (c)에서, 서버 장치는, 상기 적어도 한 차량의 블랙 박스에 기록된 동영상 중에서 상기 교통 사고의 시간에 기록된 동영상을 재생한다.

title_en: Fire Alarm System Including a Repeter For self-diagnosis of Fire Detector
title_ko: 화재감지기 및 자가진단이 가능한 중계장치를 구비하는 화재경보 시스템
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a fire alarm system comprises a relay device and a fire detector. The relay device includes: a detector communication unit connected to a two-wire line, and transmitting and receiving data to/from at least one fire detector using a half-duplex power line communication scheme; an input unit for receiving a command of a user; a display unit for displaying a status of the fire detector; and a second control unit for sequentially calling the fire detector connected to the two-wire line when self-diagnosis execution is selected through the input unit, and analyzing a response signal of the fire detector to display the status of the fire detector on the display unit. In addition, the fire detector includes: a fire sensor unit for sensing whether a fire occurs by detecting heat or smoke, or sensing an analog data value of temperature or humidity; a power communication module including bridge diodes (D1-D4), and connected to the two-wire line to rectify a data signal transmitted from the relay device to DC power; a power supply unit connected to the power communication module to receive the rectified DC power, and converting the same into power required for the fire detector to supply the same; a transmitting unit connected to the power communication module, and converting a transmission packet of the fire detector into a transmission signal to transmit the same to the relay device; and a receiving unit for receiving data of the data signal transmitted from the relay device. According to the fire alarm system of the present invention, the relay device can diagnose the status of a terminal, such as a fire detector even before a fire receiver is installed, through a self-diagnosis function, such that the convenience of construction is provided in a construction site.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 화재경보 시스템은 중계장치와 화재감지기를 포함하고, 상기 중계장치는, 2선식 선로에 연결되어 하나 이상의 화재감지기와 반이중통신방식의 전원선통신방식을 이용하여 데이터를 송수신하는 감지기통신부;와, 사용자의 명령을 입력받는 입력부;와, 하나 이상의 화재감지기의 상태를 표시하는 디스플레이부;와, 입력부를 통하여 자가진단 실행이 선택되면 2선식 선로에 연결되는 하나 이상의 화재감지기를 차례로 호출하고 화재감지기의 응답 신호를 분석하여 상기 화재감지기의 상태를 디스플레이부에 표시하는 제2 제어부를 포함한다. 또한 상기 화재감지기는, 열감지 또는 연기감지로 화재 발생 여부를 감지하거나 온도 또는 습도 아날로그 데이터 값을 센싱하는 화재센서부;와, 브릿지 다이오드(D1 ~ D4)로 구성되고 2선식 선로와 연결되어 중계장치로부터 전송되는 데이터 신호를 DC 전원으로 정류하는 전원통신모듈;과 상기 전원통신모듈과 연결되어 정류된 DC 전원을 공급받아 화재감지기에 필요한 전원으로 변환하여 공급하는 전원부;와 상기 전원통신모듈과 연결되고 화재감지기의 송신패킷을 송신신호로 변환하여 중계장치로 송신하는 송신부;와 중계장치로부터 전송되는 데이터 신호의 데이터를 수신하는 수신부;를 포함한다. 본 발명의 화재경보 시스템에 따르면 자가진단 기능을 통하여 화재수신기 설치 전에라도 중계장치가 화재감지기 등 단말의 상태를 진단할 수 있으므로 공사현장에서 시공상의 편익를 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: System for health and safety and management of worker in construction site
title_ko: 건설현장 근로자의 보건 안전 및 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system for health safety and management of workers at a construction site which can efficiently perform health safety and management of workers. In accordance with the present invention, the system for health safety and management of workers at a construction site comprises: a worker position identification and entry management unit tracking positions of workers and objects based on various and extended wireless positions and scanners, and managing the entry of workers based on a gateway having electronic equipment, which senses entry; an accident prevention unit monitoring a work environment using an environment sensor, checking the physical and mental health conditions of the workers based on a healing solution and worker fatigue management, and notifying a situation that heavy equipment approaches workers; a web/application monitoring unit allowing communication between system components and between a work site and an external system based on Wi-Fi Internet; an artificial intelligence-based intelligent safety helmet non-wearing/fire sensing analysis unit analyzing whether a worker does not wear a safety helmet and whether a fire occurs at a work site based on a CCTV image monitoring system; and a data linking unit linking with the web/application monitoring unit, and sharing a variety of information and data recorded and managed at the work site based on a cloud server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 건설현장 근로자의 보건 안전 및 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명에 따른 건설현장 근로자의 보건 안전 및 관리 시스템은, 다양하고 확장된 무선 측위와 스캐너를 기반으로 근로자와 사물의 위치를 추적하고, 출입을 감지하는 전자장비가 구비된 게이트웨이 기반으로 근로자의 출입을 관리하는 근로자 위치 파악 및 출입 관리부와; 환경센서를 이용한 작업환경을 모니터링하고, 근로자 피로도 관리 및 치유 솔루션에 기반하여 근로자의 신체적, 정신적 건강 상태를 체크하며, 중장비의 근로자에의 접근 상황을 알리는 안전 사고 예방부와; 와이파이(WiFi) 인터넷을 기반으로 시스템의 구성요소간 및 현장과 외부 시스템 간의 통신을 가능하게 하는 웹/앱 모니터링부와; CCTV 영상 모니터링 시스템을 기반으로 하여 작업 현장에서의 근로자의 안전모 미착용 여부와, 화재 발생 여부를 분석하는 인공지능 기반 지능형 안전모 미착용/화재감지 분석부; 및 상기 웹/앱 모니터링부와 연동하며, 클라우드 서버를 기반으로 작업 현장에서 기록 및 관리하는 각종 정보와 데이터를 공유하도록 하는 데이터 연동부를 포함한다.

title_en: A device and system for sending emergency alerts on roads using CCTV, sound and VMS
title_ko: Cctv, 음향 및 전광판을 활용한 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an apparatus and a system for transmitting a road unexpected situation alarm, capable of suppressing a secondary accident caused by a following vehicle by detecting an unexpected situation on a road by using a cctv, a sound, and an electric sign installed on the road. According to the present invention, the apparatus for transmitting an emergency signal of an emergency signal of a road comprises: an image acquisition unit; an emergency signal detection unit; and an emergency signal output unit. The cctv image recording from cctv installed at the image acquisition part is on the road is gotten. The outbreak situation sensor senses the outbreak situation whether or not to the outbreak situation sensing model about the cctv image gotten. The alarm signal output unit outputs an alarm signal when an unexpected situation is detected. At this time, the unexpected situation detection model is modeled by machine learning the cctv image, but machine learning is performed by dividing the time, season, and weather at the time of capturing the cctv image into variables.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 도로 위에 설치되는 CCTV, 음향 및 전광판을 활용하여 도로 위 돌발상황을 감지하여 후속차량에 의한 2차 사고를 억제할 수 있는 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치 및 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따른 도로 돌발상황 경보 송출 장치는 영상 획득부, 돌발상황 감지부 및 경보 신호 출력부를 포함한다. 영상 획득부는 도로 상에 설치된 CCTV로부터 촬영된 CCTV 영상을 획득한다. 돌발상황 감지부는 획득한 CCTV 영상에 대한 돌발상황 감지 모델로 돌발상황 여부를 감지한다. 그리고 경보 신호 출력부는 돌발상황이 감지되면 경보 신호를 출력한다. 이때 돌발상황 감지 모델은 CCTV 영상을 기계학습 하여 모델링 하되, CCTV 영상을 촬영하는 시점의 시간, 계절 및 기상을 변수로 구분하여 기계학습 한다.

title_en: Cross-base alarm linkage method and device for nuclear power plant
abstract_en: A cross-base alarm linkage method and device for a nuclear power plant. The method comprises: monitoring alarm linkage systems of a plurality of bases in real time (S101); judging whether the alarm linkage system of each of the bases operates normally (S102); if so, the alarm linkage system of the current base achieving security and protection monitoring (S103); if not, an emergency command centre system judging the alarm level of an emergency alarm signal sent by the alarm linkage system of the current base (S104); according to the alarm level, starting corresponding permission management (S105); according to the emergency alarm signal, invoking and executing a plan (S106); when an illegal attack occurs, generating an alarm signal (S401); the command centre extracting site alarm position information from the integrated alarm signal, then invoking an image collection device group to collect a site image, and automatically popping up the site image on a monitor so as to understand the authenticity and seriousness of an unexpected event in time (S405); giving audible and visual alarms simultaneously (S406); and recording the image of an alarm region which is automatically popped up while the alarms are given (S407).
assignees: DAYABAY NUCLEAR POWER OPERATIONS AND MAN CO LTD;CHINA GENERAL NUCLEAR POWER;CGN POWER CO LTD

title_en: Wearable heads-up display ("hud") for a pharmacy workflow management system
abstract_en: A wearable heads-up display ("HUD") for a pharmacy workflow management system is disclosed herein. An example HUD includes smart-glasses that are communicatively coupled to a client device. The smart-glasses include at least one camera and/or barcode scanner to record information needed for the verification of a medication dose during medication formulation preparation. The smart-glasses include at least one microphone to record voice commands. Further, the smart-glasses include at least one embedded display screen that shows sequential steps of a preparation protocol for guiding a pharmacy technician to prepare a medication dose. An application on the client device and/or the smart-glasses is configured to recognize and use voice commands to provide navigation for the embedded display screen. The voice commands may also be used to provide data entry for medication dose preparation verification. Gestures may be detected by the camera and translated by the application into navigation or data entry commands.

title_en: Rail transit operation control method, device, electronic equipment and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of traffic, and provides a rail transit operation control method, a device, electronic equipment and a system. The method is applied to a cloud platform, and the cloud platform is in communication connection with station-level operation information and a safety guarantee subsystem, a line-level multi-station and multi-professional monitoring control subsystem and a line-level comprehensive operation monitoring and emergency command subsystem, and comprises the following steps: acquiring monitoring information; determining a traffic running state; and sending control instructions to each subsystem to realize the cooperative linkage of each subsystem and adjust the traffic running state. Acquiring feedback information after the traffic running state is regulated; based on the feedback information to adjust the traffic operating conditions. The cloud brain platform is used for uniformly managing the subsystems, so that the cooperative linkage of the subsystems is realized, the traffic running state is regulated, the information element circulation and multi-system linkage of the station, the line and the line network are realized, and the timeliness of the release of operation information and the comprehensive emergency command capability of safety guarantee are improved.

title_en: Dynamic drainage method-based cascade reservoir group dam break emergency scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of reservoir emergency dispatching, and relates to a cascade reservoir group dam-break emergency dispatching method and system based on a dynamic drainage method. The method comprises the following steps: inputting the flood process into a cascade reservoir group emergency scheduling model, taking the water rising and water falling stages of the flood process into consideration, controlling reservoir capacity pre-discharging and reservoir flood discharging based on a dynamic discharging method, and combining to generate a reservoir emergency scheduling scheme set; when the dam is broken, a dam break flood simulation model is called to calculate the dam break flood process and the river course evolves; calculating a benefit objective function of the step reservoir group emergency dispatch; and carrying out optimization and recommendation of the emergency scheduling scheme according to the benefit objective function value. According to the invention, timeliness and feasibility of cascade reservoir dispatching under dangerous conditions of dam-break flood as well as variability and method universality of different drainage areas and different cascade reservoir dispatching processes are considered, so that when a cascade reservoir group encounters a dangerous condition of dam-break flood, emergency dispatching scheme formulation can be rapidly and universally carried out, and the method can be applied to dam-break emergency dispatching of cascade reservoir groups in different drainage areas.

title_en: Construction site emergency management method, device, equipment and medium based on micro-service architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency management, and discloses a construction site emergency management method based on a micro-service architecture, which comprises the steps of obtaining historical event data and constructing a dynamic digital plan library; the method comprises the steps of applying a dynamic digital plan library to corresponding modules based on a modularized system framework, constructing a structural event matching rule, determining required emergency equipment and computing resources according to the structural event matching rule when an emergency exists, generating an elastic resource management instruction, acquiring data cockpit resources, integrating by using the modularized system framework based on the data cockpit resources, generating a full-dimensional state visual view of a construction site, acquiring double-blind drilling data and an emergency response record, searching problems in an AI model and plan logic, and performing emergency management. The invention also provides a construction site emergency management device, equipment and storage medium based on the micro-service architecture. The invention can improve the risk response speed.

title_en: Battle system of naval vessel capable of operating mutiple operating mode simultaneously, method thereof, and computer readable medium recording program for performing the method
title_ko: 다중 운용 모드를 동시 운용할 수 있는 함정 전투 시스템 및 그 방법, 그리고 이를 행하는 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 매체
abstract_ko:
다중 운용 모드를 동시 운용할 수 있는 함정 전투 시스템 및 그 방법, 그리고 이를 행하는 프로그램을 기록한 컴퓨터로 읽을 수 있는 매체가 개시된다.  복수의 단위 장비를 구비하는 함정 전투 시스템에 있어서, 소정의 지휘 통제 장비에 구비되어 상기 복수의 단위 장비의 운용 모드를 각 단위 장비별로 설정 또는 변경하도록 제어하는 통합 운용 통제 장치와, 상기 복수의 단위 장비 중에서 각 단위 장비마다 구비되고, 구비된 단위 장비의 운용 모드를 상기 통합 운용 통제 장치의 제어에 의해 설정 또는 변경하는 단위 운용 통제 장치를 포함하는 다중 운용 모드를 동시 운용할 수 있는 함정 전투 시스템을 구성한다.  상기와 같은 함정 전투 시스템에 따르면, 하나의 함정 전투 시스템에서 각 노드에 배치되는 단위 장비들의 운용 모드를 개별적으로 설정하여 동시에 다중 운용 모드를 운용할 수 있으므로, 운용 모드 변경을 위한 전체 단위 장비들의 재가동이나 그에 따라 소비되는 시간을 줄일 수 있는 유리한 효과를 가진다.  한편, 모든 단위 장비들이 물리적으로 분리되지 않고 논리적으로 구분된 운용 모드에서 동작되므로, 지휘 통제 장비가 센서 연동 장비나 무장 연동 장비에 대한 통합 운용을 유지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Deterioration Diagnosis Device for Switchboard using Overload and Leakage current
title_ko: 과부하와 누설전류를 이용한 배전반 열화 진단장치
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a switchboard deterioration diagnosis device using overload and leakage current. The present invention analyzes the most important electrical properties to accurately monitor and diagnose a deterioration condition which is the main cause of electrical fire in a switchboard in real time and effectively diagnoses deterioration by detecting the temperature, the number of arcs, and carbon monoxide in the main part of the switchboard so as to minimize a malfunction cause which is the shortcomings of an existing product detecting the temperature, arc and carbon monoxide and improve the reliability caused by the deterioration diagnosis of the switchboard by reliably detecting electrical fire and preventing accidents in advance.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 과부하와 누설전류를 이용한 배전반 열화 진단장치에 관한 것으로 특히, 전류 검출부와 전압 검출부를 통해 각각 검출되는 배전반 내 구성품들의 계통 전류와 전압을 입력받아 선간전압과 상전압, 과전류, 전력량, 주파수, 역률, 고조파 함유율에 따른 전력 품질을 연산하고, 누설 전류 검출부를 통해 검출되는 누설전류를 입력받아 각각의 누설전류 양을 연산하는 전력 품질 제어부와; 배전반 내부의 버스-바(Bus-bar)와 차단기 및 전력 케이블의 접속부 온도를 입력받아 각각의 온도 지수를 검출하는 온도센서 제어부와; 배전반 내부에서 발생되는 아크 또는 불꽃을 검출하여 설정한 시간 주기 동안 발생된 아크의 횟수를 연산하는 아크센서 제어부와; 배전반 내부에서 과열이 발생되거나 또는 아크로부터 발생되는 탄화 시점부터 발생되는 일산화탄소를 ppm 단위로 검출하는 일산화탄소센서 제어부와; 상기 전력 품질 제어부와 온도센서 제어부, 아크센서 제어부 및 일산화탄소센서 제어부에서 각각 검출되는 지수들을 수집하여 정해진 진단 프로그램을 통해 배전반 내의 열화 상태를 판단하는 열화 진단 제어부;로 구성한 것을 특징으로 한다. 이와 같이 배전반에서 전기화재의 주원인이 되는 열화 상태를 실시간으로 정확히 감시 및 진단하기 위하여 가장 중요한 전기적 특성을 분석하고, 배전반의 주요 부분에서의 온도와 아크 발생 횟수 및 일산화탄소 등을 검출하여 보다 효과적인 열화 진단을 할 수 있도록 함으로써 온도와 아크 및 일산화탄소를 각각 검출하는 기존 제품의 단점인 오동작 요소를 최소한으로 줄일 수 있고, 전기화재를 보다 안정적인 진단하여 사고를 미리 예방할 수 있어 배전반의 열화 진단에 따른 신뢰도를 대폭 향상시킬 수 있다.
assignees: DAE SHIN HEAVY ELECTRICAL CO LTD

title_en: Simulation-based action evaluation support system, action observation evaluation support method, and program stored in recording medium
title_ko: 시뮬레이션에 기반한 조치 평가 지원 시스템, 조치 평가 지원 방법 및 기록 매체에 저장된 프로그램
abstract_en: An action evaluation support system according to an embodiment of the present invention is to support action evaluation with respect to simulation-based emergency preparedness training conducted by government agencies. The system includes: an evaluation criterion setting unit setting an evaluation criterion including evaluation indices for the action evaluation related to the simulation-based emergency preparedness training, an evaluation criterion for each evaluation index, and an evaluation score; a simulated situation providing unit creating a simulated situation for the simulation-based emergency preparedness training based on a scenario input from a central control group terminal or a pre-programmed scenario and providing a training agency terminal with simulated situation status as status information on the generated simulated situation; an action command processing unit receiving an action command from the training agency terminal with respect to the simulated situation and generating, based on the received action command, an action simulation result as the result of simulating an action corresponding to the simulated situation; and an action evaluation unit performing action evaluation with respect to the emergency preparedness training of the training agency based on the evaluation criterion, the action command, and the action simulation result.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 조치 평가 지원 시스템은, 복수의 정부 기관에 의해 실시되는 시뮬레이션 기반의 비상 대비 훈련에 대한 조치 평가를 지원하기 위한 조치 평가 지원 시스템으로서, 시뮬레이션에 기반한 비상 대비 훈련에 대한 조치 평가의 평가 지표, 각 평가 지표에 대한 평가 기준 및 평가 배점을 포함하는 평가 기준을 설정하는 평가 기준 설정부; 중앙 통제단 단말기로부터의 입력된 시나리오 또는 미리 프로그램된 시나리오에 기초하여 시뮬레이션 기반의 비상 대비 훈련을 위한 모의 상황을 생성하고, 생성된 모의 상황에 관한 현황 정보인 모의 상황 현황을 훈련 실시 기관 단말기에게 제공하는 모의 상황 제공부; 훈련 실시 기관 단말기로부터 상기 모의 상황에 대한 조치 명령을 수신하고, 수신된 조치 명령에 기초하여 상기 모의 상황에 대응하는 조치를 시뮬레이션한 결과인 조치 시뮬레이션 결과를 생성하는 조치 명령 처리부; 및 상기 평가 기준, 상기 조치 명령 및 상기 조치 시뮬레이션 결과에 기초하여 훈련 실시 기관의 비상 대비 훈련에 대한 조치 평가를 수행하는 조치 평가부를 포함할 수 있다.

title_en: Video integrated scheduling system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a video-information integration dispatch system, including dispatch server, recording server, video server, network switch, dispatch table, visual talkback monitoring camera and bimodulus public address phone, dispatch server, recording server and video server are connected to network switch through the net twine respectively, and network switch is connected with dispatch table, visual talkback monitoring camera and bimodulus public address phone respectively again, realizes the video audio transmission of dispatch table and visual talkback monitoring camera and bimodulus public address phone. The utility model discloses collect pronunciation, broadcast, video scheduling in an organic whole, no region restriction, when meetting emergency, a key is reported to the police, and many system's emergency command such as pronunciation, video responds immediately, has realized many ways linkage, resource sharing, scheduling in coordination.

title_en: Apparatus for Gathering waste
title_ko: 안전기능을 가진 쓰레기 투입설비
abstract_ko:
본 고안은 주로 아파트와 같은 집합건물 등에 설치되어 쓰레기봉투를 자동으로 투입하는 쓰레기 투입설비에 관한 것이다. 본 고안의 안전기능을 가진 쓰레기 투입설비에 따르면, 안전판의 움직임을 감지하는 감지신호에 의하여 투입구의 개폐가 제어될 수 있도록 하는 구조이므로, 안전판에 올라간 어린이가 안전판의 회동에 의해 투입관으로 낙하되는 안전사고와, 투입설비 및 투입관에 갇히게 되어 질식되는 인명사고를 미연에 방지하도록 한 것이다. 
     본 고안은, 쓰레기봉투를 투입하는 투입구가 개폐될 수 있도록 도어를 구비하는 본체와, 상기 투입구의 내측에 고정되는 감속모터와 연동하도록 연결되며 투입되는 쓰레기봉투를 올려놓은 상태에서 낙하 될 수 있도록 안전판이 회동가능하게 설치되고, 상기 도어 개폐동작 및 안전판을 회동시키는 감속모터 구동을 제어하는 제어유닛이 포함된 쓰레기 투입설비에 있어서, 상기 안전판의 중앙을 중심으로 하여 시소 동작을 할 수 있도록 안전판의 상부에 플레이트가 구비되고; 시소 동작으로 플레이트가 맞닿게 되는 안전판에는 플레이트의 접근을 감지하면서 제어유닛과 신호연결되는 감지부재가 다수개 고정 되어 있어, 상기 플레이트의 시소 동작에 의하여 감지부재로부터 발생하는 감지신호가 제어유닛에 입력되면 미리 설정된 프로그램에 따라 상기 안전판이 회동하지 않도록 감속모터를 제어하고 투입구가 개방되도록 하는 안전기능을 가진 쓰레기 투입설비가 제공된다.
