title_en: Control system for telephone alarm bell
abstract_en: The invention relates to a phone alarm bell control system for controlling a public security center, a fire fighting center and 110 Center by a telephone, which is characterized in that the system is composed of a CPU, a telephone interface, a voice chip, a dual audio receiver, a cryptography blocking coding switch, a ringing startup time coding switch, a alarm bell controlling relay and a reset control button; the voice chip is connected with the CPU by a data bus, a address bus and chip selection signals; and the telephone interface is connected with telephone lines outside the system and is connected with the CPU by the data bus, the address bus and chip selection signals within the system. The invention changes the original mode of the alarm bell activated by the telephone or by transmitting data information by a computer network and enhances the timeliness and reliability of the alarm bell control. The system can be used together with the alarm receiving and disposing system of a command center, so that in case of a fire accident or an alarm, the alarm receiving and disposing system of the command center can automatically dial the telephone of the phone alarm bell controller by a CTI server and automatically control the alarm bell for alarming.

title_en: Firefighter distress device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of fire fighting tools, in particular to a fireman distress call device which comprises a shell and a rear cover which are arranged in a matched mode, wherein the inner side of the shell and the rear cover which form a whole is respectively provided with a battery, a circuit board, a GPS (global positioning system) positioning module, a wireless communication module, a recording module and a storage module, the middle of the upper part of the outer side of the shell is respectively provided with a distress call switch and a power switch, the peripheries of the distress call switch and the power switch are also provided with a plurality of flash lamps, two sides of the lower part of the outer side of the shell are respectively provided with a buzzer, and the shell is also respectively provided with a. The invention has rich functions, can provide all-round protection for firemen, has the recording function, is convenient for the subsequent commander to take in the successful experience of the rescue scheme in the accident through on-site recording, and is worth popularizing.
assignees: JIANGXI DINGFENG EQUIPMENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-scene simulation drilling and evaluation system for urban rail transit vehicle dispatching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-scene simulation drilling and evaluation system for urban rail transit vehicle dispatching, and relates to the field of urban rail transit training. The system comprises an ATS system foreground, an ATS system background, an assessment system and a background assessment system. The method realizes multi-scene loading and multi-fault injection through the compilation of the scene test paper, and ensures the drilling of the urban rail transit vehicle dispatcher and the evaluation of the flexibility and the complexity of the scene; the communication fusion system integrating the wireless train dispatching system and the dispatching telephone system realizes the identification of dispatching instructions of training and examining students, solves the technical problem of multi-post combined drilling which is difficult to carry out in the existing training system, and simultaneously avoids the problem of high dependency on teachers in the training and examining process; through the process playback system, the whole process of the human-computer interaction interface is uniformly recorded, and the problem that the existing training and examination process cannot be reproduced is solved.
assignees: BEIJING SUBWAY OPERATION CORP;TECH INNOVATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE BRANCH OF BEIJING SUBWAY OPERATION CO LTD

title_en: Forest fire emergency command and monitoring system based on satellite communication
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire emergency command and monitoring system based on satellite communication, which comprises: a satellite communication system for providing communication channel resource guarantee; the forest fire video monitoring system is used for rapidly and accurately locking the position of a fire point; the forest vehicle and pedestrian monitoring system is used for preventing fire and tracing the fire cause after the fire; the fire scene reconnaissance unmanned aerial vehicle system is used for providing fire scene real-time data; the comprehensive command and dispatch system is used for conducting unified command and dispatch on the whole system; and the service application system is used for providing forest fire control command dispatching and monitoring service. The invention overcomes the conditions of wide coverage range and complex and changeable topography of forest and grassland fire, ensures that the site communication rate reaches 100 percent, really improves the comprehensive prevention and control capability of forest, grassland and the like, greatly improves the timeliness and accuracy of positioning the fire source when forest and mountain fire occurs, and greatly reduces the economic loss and the casualties probability.

title_en: Master and slave cluster data replication method and system in distributed database scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for copying main and standby cluster data in a distributed database scene, belongs to the technical field of distributed databases, and aims to solve the technical problem of improving high availability and disaster recovery capacity of services in the distributed database scene. The method is applied among a main library cluster, a standby library cluster and a Merge module, wherein the Merge module is served as a standby library cluster node and comprises the following steps: when the transaction operation is carried out through the main library cluster, recording the transaction ID of the current transaction in the value record of each KV operation under the current transaction operation, recording the times of the current KV operation in the transaction record corresponding to the current transaction, forming a commit command with a successful identification after the current transaction operation is successfully executed, sending the commit command corresponding to the current transaction operation and the KV operation quantity of the current transaction to the Merge module, wherein the Merge module is matched with the standby library cluster, and copying the data corresponding to the transaction operation to the standby library cluster.

title_en: Intelligent network connection data dynamic scheduling method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an intelligent network connection data dynamic scheduling method, system, equipment and storage medium. The intelligent network data dynamic scheduling method comprises the steps of dynamically adjusting the priority of data based on an identified vehicle operation scene and a preset priority adjustment rule, wherein the vehicle operation scene comprises an environment scene, a network scene and a vehicle state, and executing a data transmission strategy according to the adjusted priority. The data transmission mode breaks through fixed classification, takes the vehicle scene characteristics as the core basis of priority adjustment, designs specific transmission rules aiming at different operation scenes instead of the common same rule, can dynamically adjust the priority of data aiming at different operation scenes, effectively ensures the priority transmission of key data in each operation scene, obviously reduces the transmission delay of the key data, improves the timeliness of emergency response, and solves the technical problems that the key data is blocked by low priority data and delayed and the safety risk is increased in the related technology.

title_en: Substation indoor track planning method and system based on multi-view heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a substation indoor track planning method and system based on a multi-view heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle, and aims to solve the problem of accurate track planning of the unmanned aerial vehicle in a substation without GPS and under a complex environment. The method comprises the steps of S1 obtaining image, depth, infrared and IMU data collected by an unmanned aerial vehicle, constructing a database with indexes and version control through denoising, distortion removal, quality assessment and semantic annotation pretreatment, S2 generating unified feature representation through feature alignment and time synchronization on the treated data, establishing a fusion model with a consistent space coordinate system, S3 predicting a panoramic depth map based on the unified feature, combining a vision-inertial odometer and factor map optimization, outputting an indoor dense map and an unmanned aerial vehicle pose, and S4 generating an optimal track through reinforcement learning and map optimization construction planning strategy and performing on-line obstacle avoidance adjustment according to sensing feedback in flight. The invention can obviously improve the automation degree, the operation safety and the system expansibility of the substation in the scenes of indoor inspection, emergency response and the like.
assignees: JIUJIANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Apparatus for automatic report of the scene of fire and method thereof
title_ko: 화재경보 발생위치 자동신고 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A system and a method for automatically reporting a fire generation position are provided to smoothly perform initial extinguishing by performing a sound output function and an automatic report function at a generation state of a fire alarm. CONSTITUTION: A fire alarm receiver(100) is connected to a fire detecting device, and receives information according to fire detection. A gateway(200) is connected to the fire alarm receiver, outputs a fire alarm signal to a fire station by using wire/wireless communication according to preprogrammed contents, and has a program code which automatically transmits a fire generation position with sound and a program code which automatically transmits a fire generation position with sound through TRS network.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 화재가 발생시에 유무선 통신을 이용하여 소방서에 화재를 자동으로 신고토록 하고 동시에 현재 위치를 음성으로 출력토록 함으로써 국민의 생명과 재산을 보호하는데 크게 기여함을 특징으로 하는 화재경보 발생위치 자동신고 시스템 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 
     화재감지장치와 연결되어 화재감지에 따른 정보를 수신받는 화재경보 수신기와;  화재경보 수신기와 연결되어 미리 프로그램된 내용에 따라 유무선 통신을 이용하여 소방서에 화재경보 신호를 출력하는 게이트 웨이로 이루어지고;  상기 게이트 웨이는,  화재경보기의 경보신호를 받아 자동으로 119를 호출하여 소방서 근무자의 응답이 없으면 재발신하고, 정상응답이면 화재발생 위치를 음성으로 자동 송출하는 프로그램 코드와,  화재로 인하여 전화선이 두절된 상태이면 TRS 망을 통해 화재발생 위치를 음성으로 자동 송출하는 프로그램 코드를 갖는 것이 특징이며; 
     아파트나 상가 등에서 화재가 발생하였을 때 유무선 통신을 이용하여 소방서에 자동 신고함과 더불어 현재 위치를 음성으로 출력토록 함으로서 정확한 위치정보에 따라 빠른 출동이 가능하여 초동진압이 원활하게 이루어지는 효과가 있다. 
       
     화재, 전화선, TRS망, P형수신기, R형수신기, 119펄스신호,

title_en: System for learning foreign language using message through web and mobile communication and method of learning foreign language
title_ko: 웹과 모바일 통신의 메시지를 이용한 외국어학습 시스템 및 외국어학습 제공 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A foreign language learning system using messages of mobile communication and an application and a foreign language learning providing method enable a user to learn a foreign language in life without a separate device by using devices normally utilized in a daily life. CONSTITUTION: A smart phone is composed of a display unit(40), a communication unit(10), a storage unit(30) storing data for translation and learning, and a controller(20). The controller is operated according to a predetermined command set by an operating program(50) and directly processes information or makes other devices perform necessary functions. The contents of an electronic dictionary are stored in the form of a database. [Reference numerals] (10) Communication unit; (20) Controller; (200) Network environment; (30) Storage unit; (40) Display unit(including a touch pad); (50) Operational program; (AA) Communication message
abstract_ko: 표현부, 통신부, 어휘나 문장 정보를 저장할 수 있는 저장부, 통신부를 통해 수신되는 제1 국어로 이루어진 통신 메시지를 저장부에 저장된 어휘나 문장 정보와 비교하여 제2 국어의 어휘나 문장을 찾고, 통신 메시지와 제2 국어의 어휘나 문장을 표현부에 동시적으로 나타내거나 순차적으로 나타내도록 하는 콘트롤러 및 운용프로그램을 구비하는 외국어학습 시스템 및 이를 이용하여 외국어학습을 제공하는 방법이 개시된다.

title_en: I-sop system for hazardous materials handling and incident management
title_ko: 위험물 취급 및 사고 관리 용 동적 상호 자기학습형 인공지능 표준 행동 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an interactive standard operating procedures (I-SOP) system for handling hazardous materials and accident management. The I-SOP system of the present invention comprises: an I-SOP database which collects data of overall handling of disaster accidents and experiences of relevant institution workers, and stores a uniform standard operating procedure prescribed by check lists according to a disaster handling step; a disaster responding process which produces an activity diagram with the type of disasters and the lowest level for each response level; an operating procedure producing unit which produces a fused uniform operating procedure; and an I-SOP producing unit which provides process segments for users in the order granted within each category depending on an input situation in a disaster. The system can implement an I-SOP for handling disasters for each hazardous material on a mobile device, according to a handling record of hazardous materials, a response scenario when the materials leak, and a data access and a use system of material information reserved in institutions.
abstract_ko: 위험물 취급 및 사고 관리 용 동적 상호 자기학습형 인공지능 표준 행동 시스템이 개시된다. 본 발명의 인공지능 표준행동 시스템은 재난사고 처리 전반의 자료들과 관련 기관 종사자들의 경험치에 대한 자료를 수집하여 재난처리단계에 따라 체크리스트별로 규정한 단일 표준행동지침을 저장한 I-SOP 데이터베이스와, 재난의 유형과 대응 단계별 최저 레벨을 활동 도표(Activity Diagram)로 생성하는 재난 대응 프로세스와,  융합된 단일 표준행동지침을 생성하는 행동지침생성부, 및 재난시 입력되는 상황에 따라 각 카테고리 내에서 부여된 순서로 사용자에게 제공하는 I-SOP생성부를 포함하여 구성함으로써, 위험물 취급 방법 기록 및 유출시 대응 시나리오 와 기관 보유 물질정보 데이터 접근과 활용 체계에 따라 위험 물질별 재난사고 대응 I-SOP를 모바일기기에서 구현할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Number Talks count card
title_ko: 넘버톡스 셈카드
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a Number Talks calculation card, and more specifically, to a Number Talks calculation card in which a user can easily learn number reading, next number and previous number, numbers which equal to 5, multiples of 10, numbers for which the sum of four numbers is 20, addition, filling practice, numbers which equal to 100, addition of equal numbers, multiplication and the like, using the 6-digit numbers printed on number cards on which random numbers are written. According to the present invention, thinking ability, concentration, creativity, diversity, fluency, and brain development effects are provided to children.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 넘버톡스 셈카드에 관한 것으로서, 상세하게는 임의수가 기록된 숫자 카드에 인자된 6자리 숫자들을 이용하여 수읽기, 다음수 및 이전수, 5가 되는 수, 10의 배수, 네 수 합이 20이 되는 수, 덧셈, 채우기 연습, 100되는 수, 동수 덧셈, 곱셈 등을 쉽게 익힐 수 있도록 하기 위한 넘버톡스 셈카드에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명을 통해, 아이들에게 사고력, 집중력, 창의력, 다양성, 유창성, 두뇌계발 효과를 제공하게 된다.

title_en: Emergency response using voice and sensor data capture
abstract_en: Methods, systems, computer-readable media, and apparatuses for emergency response using voice and sensor data capture are presented. One example method includes transmitting, by a user device, an emergency call request to an emergency services provider; prior to the emergency call request being answered: recording, by the user device, audio signals comprising speech signals; and obtaining one or more keywords from recognized words based on the speech signals; and after detecting an emergency call connection: generating a message to the emergency services provider, the message comprising at least one annotation based on the keywords; and transmitting, by the user device, the message to the emergency services provider.

title_en: Voice self-training method and user terminal device for voice impaired patient
title_ko: 음성 장애 환자를 위한 음성 자가 훈련 방법 및 사용자 단말 장치
abstract_en: A user terminal device for voice self-training comprises: an input device receiving an input of training program selection command by a user; a storage device for storing voice training candidate programs for user voice training; a calculation device for generating first guide content in accordance with a first voice training program selected by the user from among the voice training candidate programs; an output device for outputting the first guide content; and a microphone receiving an input of voice output by the user in accordance with the first guide content being output by the output device.
abstract_ko: 음성 자가 훈련을 위한 사용자 단말 장치는 사용자의 훈련 프로그램 선택 명령을 입력받는 입력장치, 사용자 음성 훈련을 위한 음성 훈련 후보 프로그램들을 저장하는 저장장치, 상기 음성 훈련 후보 프로그램들 중 상기 사용자가 선택한 제1 음성 훈련 프로그램에 따른 제1 가이드 콘텐츠를 생성하는 연산장치, 상기 제1 가이드 콘텐츠를 출력하는 출력장치 및 상기 출력장치에 출력되는 제1 가이드 콘텐츠에 따라 사용자가 출력하는 음성을 입력받는 마이크를 포함한다.
assignees: CATHOLIC UNIV KOREA IND ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION

title_en: Space-to-air integrated communication emergency communication command cluster communication application system and method based on skynet and Beidou satellite
abstract_en: The real-time monitoring system for the power equipment in different environments is established based on the skynet and the Beidou satellite and is provided with a data acquisition module, a data aggregation module, a data analysis module, an alarm module, a voice calling module, a switchboard, a rating database and a switchboard. Each data acquisition module is provided with an identity which can be recognized by the data acquisition module, and is used for acquiring data information in an area in real time, recording scattered power facilities and iron tower line data into a database by using Beidou high-precision base positioning and then sending the data to the data analysis module, after the analysis module analyzes the real-time data, notifying a switchboard or indicating alarm or updating a rating database or indicating a voice calling module to carry out voice calling according to an analysis result, and a worker can maintain the system according to different analysis results and can master the environmental stability condition of each area of the system in real time.

title_en: Site pollution heat monitoring method and system for emergency command and dispatch
abstract_en: The invention provides a site pollution heat monitoring method and a system for emergency command and dispatch, which relate to the technical field of atmospheric environment supervision and comprise the following steps that S1, a pollutant type corresponding to pre-processed site early warning information of a current monitoring site is obtained; the method comprises the steps of S2, obtaining a historical inspection list of pollution source points, carrying out pollution source matching on pollutant types emitted by pollution sources recorded in the historical inspection list and pollutant types corresponding to site early warning information, S3, respectively calculating a distance heat value between a current monitoring site and a first pollution source point, screening the first pollution source point, S4, calculating the pollution heat value of the first pollution source point through a linear weighting method, S5, generating a current total inspection priority table according to the distance heat value and the pollution heat value between the current monitoring site and the first pollution source point, and carrying out quick and accurate dispatching management on the pollutant types and the pollutant types according to the priority sequence in the total inspection priority table.

title_en: Control apparatus and method of emergency phones with restrict call
title_ko: 다수의 통신제한 비상전화기 제어장치 및 그 제어방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A plurality of communication restriction emergency telephone control devices and a control method for preventing the use of a communication line are provided to easily manage the emergency telephone on one communication line. CONSTITUTION: A controller(110) detects an alarming signal by detecting unauthorized communication. The controller records an emergency communications phone number. An audio unit(160) decodes an audio stored in a memory. An interphone unit(130) comprises one or more emergency telephones. The emergency telephone comprises the designated button designating a command signal for applying the emergency telephone.
abstract_ko: 다수의 통신제한 비상전화기 제어장치 및 그 제어방법이 개시된다. 본 발명은 하나의 통신 선로를 이용하여 여러 대의 비상전화기를 손쉽게 관리할 수 있도록 어느 하나의 비상전화기가 동작되면 스피커로 송출하던 오디오를 중지하고 해당 비상전화기에는 통화 준비음을 송출시켜 외부와 통화가능하게 연결하고 다른 비상전화기에는 통화 중 메세지를 송출하도록 제어함으로써, 무인상태로 시설되는 비상전화기를 허용되지 않은 타인이 무단으로 국선에 접속하여 제 3 자와 통신하지 못하도록 하고 미리 지정된 곳으로만 신속하게 통화할 수 있도록 하여 통신 선로의 임의적 사용을 방지할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Safety and emergency signal display system for vehicle
title_ko: 자동차용 안전 및 비상 신호 표시 시스템
abstract_ko: 자동차용 안전 및 비상 신호 표시 시스템에 대해 개시한다. 본 발명의 실시 예에 따른 자동차용 안전 및 비상 신호 표시 시스템은 운전자 의사에 따른 문자 메시지 및 긴급 상황 발생 메시지를 외부에 문자로 표시함과 아울러 긴급 상황 발생 메시지와 위치 정보를 무선으로 송출하는 의사 표시 제어장치, 긴급 상황 발생 메시지와 위치 정보를 운전자를 비롯해 미리 설정된 다른 자동차 운전자들의 이동통신 단말기와 긴급 출동 기관으로 전송하는 관제 단말기, 및 관제 단말기와 이동통신 단말기들로 응용 프로그램을 지원하는 응용 프로그램 운용서버를 포함하는바, 차량 운전자가 주변이나 후방의 다른 차량들에 자신의 의사를 미리 설정된 이미지와 문자 등으로 표시할 수 있도록 지원할 수 있다.

title_en: Early warning method for forest fire based on laser radar and unmanned aerial vehicle
abstract_en: The invention relates to a forest fire early warning method and system based on a laser radar and an unmanned aerial vehicle. The early warning method is used for acquiring laser radar scanning images by controlling the laser radar to periodically and fully cyclically scan and monitor the forest. And determining a smoke plume area in the laser radar scanning image as a suspected fire disaster area. And meanwhile, narrowing the scanning area of the laser radar according to the azimuth information of the suspected fire area, executing local scanning, planning a patrol path, dispatching the unmanned aerial vehicle to fly along the patrol path, and collecting overlook patrol images in real time. And judging whether the fire sign features exist in the image by utilizing an image recognition technology, and if so, marking the corresponding suspected fire area as a fire area. And then acquiring smoke plume information of a fire disaster area in the laser radar scanning image, and evaluating the fire scene situation of the fire disaster area. And finally, sending alarm information and fire scene information to the decision end. The method improves the visibility, timeliness and reliability of early warning.
assignees: PURUI QUANTUM TECH SHANDONG CO LTD

title_en: Digital plan construction method for emergency command decision
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of emergency command decisions, and particularly relates to a digital plan construction method for an emergency command decision, which comprises the steps of 1, establishing a plan database, 2, setting a method for identifying and extracting entities and parameters, setting a method for judging emergency scenes and key parameters according to emergency response conditions after obtaining the entities and the parameters, 3, generating an emergency command flow, 4, constructing a digital plan model, 5, making an emergency command decision to form a plan, 6, implementing an emergency command decision, and 7, evaluating and optimizing the emergency command decision. According to the invention, on one hand, the influence weight of risks corresponding to treatment tasks is calculated through an entropy method, and on the other hand, training is realized through historical record data on a loss classification model, and the influence of time-ordered emergency tasks and related risks is combined in the training process.
assignees: JIANGSU JINGE NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Nursing task dynamic scheduling and path optimization collaborative management method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a nursing task dynamic scheduling and path optimization collaborative management method and system, which particularly relate to the technical field of nursing task scheduling and are used for solving the problems of unnecessary moving distance accumulation and emergency response delay caused by task transfer and path planning disconnection in the existing cross-shift handover process, generating a to-be-handed over set by acquiring unfinished task points, evaluating the complexity of a path movement decision tree of each task point, excavating a cross-shift task chain and calculating timeliness entropy, generating space-time value based on the complexity and the timeliness entropy to select a dynamic handover anchor point, tracking the attenuation rate of the anchor point value in real time and triggering anchor point update, generating an initial path and an emergency re-planning path based on the position of the dynamic anchor point, eliminating a redundant path moving from a fixed starting point to the first task point through the dynamic anchor point decision driven by the space-time value, and realizing the rapid path response of an emergency task by utilizing the anchor point real-time position.

title_en: Method for providing vehicle accident information
title_ko: 자동차 사고 정보 제공 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for providing vehicle accident information if a vehicle accident occurs. More specifically, the present invention transmits accident information to a portable terminal of a user (driver) when detecting that the vehicle accident occurs, and provides the accident information to a separate accident recording server and an emergency rescue institute in accordance with the input value of the user (driver). Thus, the present invention can store the accident information in a server or request an emergency rescue for the accident by the selection of the user.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자동차에 사고가 발생하게 되면 이에 대한 사고 정보를 제공하는 방법에 관한 것이다. 
보다 구체적으로, 본 발명은 자동차에 사고가 발생되었다고 감지되는 경우 이에 대한 사고 정보를 사용자(운전자)의 휴대용 단말기로 전송하고, 이에 대한 사용자(운전자)의 입력 값에 따라 상기 사고 정보를 별도의 사고 기록 서버 및 긴급 구조 기관에 제공하는 일련의 정보 제공 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Earth history database serch system
title_ko: 지구 역사 데이터베이스 검색 시스템
abstract_en: Disclosed is an automatic managing method as an application agent for helping education which can perform interactive education with a command performing method using a capacitive method by showing a timeline in real time by outputting an image to an apparatus for using the internet and a transparent sphere to be used for education in history, science, social studies, geography, and so on in an education field. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the method comprises: a first step of accessing online by a teacher; a second step of realizing an image to be properly focused; a third step of forming an interactive command system; and a fourth step of performing the image and a command to operate a timeline-based education process.
abstract_ko: 교육현장에서 역사과목과 과학 사회 지리등 교육에 이용 가능하도록 하는 인터넷을 이용한 장치와 투명한 구체에 영상을 출력하여 실시간으로 타임라인을 보여주고 정전방식을 이용한 명령수행방식으로 인터 엑티브 교육이 가능한 교육도움의 활용제로서의 자동화 관리 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명에 따른 일 실시예는, 교육자가 온라인접속하는 1단계; 영상을 구현하여 적절한 상이 맺히는 2단계; 인터엑티브 명령체계가 이루어지는 3단계; 영상과 명령을 수행하여 타임라인의기반을 둔교육과정 이 운영되는 4단계;를 포함하여 구성이된다.

title_en: Method and system for testing vocational skills of urban rail transit dispatcher
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of skill assessment, and discloses a method for testing the occupational skills of an urban rail transit dispatcher, which comprises the following steps of firstly, presenting visual display and/or auditory appearance of different test items by using a test tool, and enabling a tested dispatcher to react to the visual display and/or auditory appearance through a handle keyboard; and step two, processing the reaction, comparing the processing result with the capability level division standard to obtain the capability level of the tested dispatcher, and displaying the capability level. The utility model also discloses a test system of urban rail transit dispatcher's professional skill. The whole process of the invention is simple to operate, does not need manual recording, and obtains the capability level of the tested dispatcher by comparing with the capability level division standard, so that the test result has more reference significance, provides powerful guidance suggestions for evaluators, makes the tested dispatcher more clear the self level capability, and is more favorable for promoting the improvement of the self service level.

title_en: GIS platform-based emergency processing method and system for transmission line external damage
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency treatment method and system for transmission line external damage based on a GIS platform, which comprises the following steps: after entering a defense state of a corresponding level due to the external damage warning of the power transmission line, extracting warning element information and sending the warning element information to a release platform; according to the stored processing plans of corresponding grades and department personnel information, the processing plans are disassembled in parts, and the disassembled processing work is distributed to corresponding department personnel meeting conditions in corresponding areas or adjacent areas according to the responsibility authorities of the departments; and receiving processing feedback information of the department personnel on the corresponding processing work, comparing the processing feedback information with the processing plan, and preferably selecting the next processing work and distributing the next processing work to the corresponding department personnel. The emergency command timeliness is high, so that the treatment after the power transmission line is broken outside is rapid and timely; the practicability is strong, and the operation is convenient.

title_en: Ecological dispatching method capable of improving spawning rate of reservoir viscosity-producing egg fishes
abstract_en: An ecological dispatching method capable of improving spawning rate of reservoir spawning and depositing egg fishes is characterized in that slow flow control systems for constructing spawning comfort areas of fishes are constructed on two sides of a reservoir along the coasts of the reservoir, a hydrological monitoring system, an analysis and control system and spawning ecological simulation layers of spawning and depositing egg fishes are mounted on the slow flow control systems, and dispatching adjustment is carried out on spawning ecological environments of fishes by the hydrological monitoring system, the analysis and control system and the slow flow control systems. According to the method, prediction and dynamic adjustment can be carried out according to the weather conditions, the conditions of opening the gate and draining the dam and the like, and the sudden conditions of opening the gate and draining the dam are predicted and dynamically adjusted, and meanwhile, the economic cost caused by real-time monitoring and the timeliness problems of instantaneous regulation and response are avoided, so that the ecological dispatching problem of the reservoir is optimized, and the fish spawning is promoted.

title_en: Curing system for concrete constructidn using a steam heater
title_ko: 증기 보일러를 이용한 콘크리트 건축 구조물의 양생 시스템
abstract_en: A curing system for a concrete structure using a steam heater is provided to increase expression strength in using steam and to prevent cracks by minimizing dried contraction. A curing system for a concrete structure using a steam heater comprises a thermal insulation film(61), a fuel pump(80), a burner(90), a boiler(100), a steam integrator(110), a plurality of solenoid valves(121,122,~12n), and a pipe. The thermal insulation film surrounds the concrete structure. The fuel pump is installed in the concrete structure surrounded by the thermal insulation film to feed fuel stored in a fuel tank(82). Fuel is fed to the burner to be ignited. The boiler is installed in an elevator core so as to heat water stored in a water tank to generate steam. The steam integrator stores steam with high temperature generated by the boiler. The solenoid valve feeds high temperature steam stored in the steam integrator to a plurality of concrete structure partition units(181,182,~18n) by being opened by a control signal output by a controller(10). The controller is installed in the elevator core. The pipe is connected to the solenoid valves to jet high temperature steam in the concrete structure partitioning units.

title_en: Accident data recording device for vehicle
title_ko: 차량용 사고기록 시스템
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 차량 사고 기록 시스템에 관한 것으로서, 사고 당시의 차량 내부 또는 외부의 영상을 촬영하는 카메라, 차량의 충돌 여부를 감지하는 가속도 센서, 차량의 현재 위치를 검출하는 GPS 모듈, 차량의 작동정보를 산출하는 전자제어유닛, 상기 전자제어유닛으로부터 입력된 차량의 작동정보를 연산 및 변환처리하여 출력하는 내부 게이트웨이 모듈, 촬영된 영상 정보, 차량 충돌 감지정보, 사고 당시의 차량의 위치정보, 상기 내부 게이트웨이 모듈을 통해 수신된 차량의 작동정보를 연관시켜 기록하는 사고 기록부 및 상기 사고 기록부에 기록된 차량의 사고 정보를 통신망을 통해 외부로 송출하는 외부 게이트웨이 모듈을 포함하는 것으로서 차량 내부에 설치되는 차량 사고 기록장치, 상기 차량 사고 기록장치로부터 사고 당시의 컷영상, 사고위치 및 차량 작동정보를 수신하고, 이에 기초하여 사고 상황을 분석하고 긴급 상황 발생시 긴급처리를 수행하는 관제 서버 및 상기 차량 사고 기록장치로부터 수신된 차량의 사고 정보에 기초하여 사고 원인을 분석하고 사고 분석 결과를 영상 데이터 형태로 저장하는 사고 분석 서버를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다. 
상기와 같은 본 발명에 따르면, 사고 당시의 운전자 조작 정보 제공, 사고 영상 분석을 통한 신속한 긴급 출동, 촬영 영상에서의 단서 정보 인식 기능 제공, 사고의 정밀한 재구성을 통한 사고 사례의 데이터베이스화 및 이를 통한 사고 원인의 신속 정확한 분석이 가능한 효과가 있다.

title_en: Incident report generation from multimedia data capture
abstract_en: This disclosure describes an apparatus and system for classifying audio and video data captured by a portable recording device. The portable recording device may comprise a camera system enclosure that captures audio and video data that reflects a user's point-of-view perception of their surroundings. The video and/or audio data may be transmitted in real-time, or near real-time, to a Central Multimedia Management (CMM) System at a Network Operations Center, or one or more mobile computing devices, via one or more networks. Alternatively, or additionally, the video and/or audio data may be stored within memory of the portable recording device. This disclosure further describes a CMM system that may act as a central repository of multimedia data from one or more portable recording device(s). The CMM system may further generate and assign incident report forms for each individual instance of real-time data that is recorded by a portable recording device.

title_en: Emergency rescue communication system
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an emergency rescue communication system, draw together rescue command platform terminal and with rescue command platform terminal communication connection's rescue mobile terminal, rescue command platform terminal includes first audio frequency receiving and dispatching unit, well control computer and first communication unit, rescue mobile terminal includes GPS unit, central processing unit, second audio frequency receiving and dispatching unit and second communication unit, first audio frequency receiving and dispatching unit and first communication unit all with the central processing unit electricity is connected, first communication unit and second communication unit communication connection, GPS unit, second audio frequency receiving and dispatching unit and second communication unit all with central processing unit communication connection. title_en: Black Box

title_en: Control method and device of pipeline auxiliary installation robot
abstract_en: The application provides a control method and a control device of a pipeline auxiliary installation robot, wherein the control method of the pipeline auxiliary installation robot comprises the following steps: receiving a variable amplitude control instruction for controlling the activity of the movable arm; recording initial values of the variable-amplitude rotation detector and the pitching rotation detector before variable-amplitude control; controlling the variable amplitude driving piece of the power system to move according to the variable amplitude control command; calculating to obtain a target value of the pitching rotation detector according to the current value of the amplitude-variable rotation detector, the initial value of the amplitude-variable rotation detector and the initial value of the pitching rotation detector; and controlling the pitching driving piece to move according to the target value of the pitching rotation detector. According to the control method and the control device for the pipeline auxiliary installation robot, the operation of adjusting the control process by workers can be simplified in the installation process of the fire fighting pipeline of the underground garage, and the construction efficiency of fire fighting pipeline installation is effectively improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG BRIGHT DREAM ROBOTICS CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent law enforcement method and system based on law enforcement recorder
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent law enforcement method and system based on a law enforcement recorder, and relates to the field of artificial intelligence, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a historical law enforcement log, wherein the historical law enforcement log comprises a plurality of historical law enforcement records with time identifiers; extracting a target historical law enforcement record and analyzing to obtain target historical law enforcement flow information; the expert group evaluates to obtain a target business process set which comprises a plurality of business processes to be optimized; obtaining a business process preprocessing result and constructing an intelligent law enforcement module; obtaining first information to obtain first analysis data of a first responsible person; the intelligent law enforcement module obtains a first law enforcement scheme, wherein the first law enforcement scheme comprises a first dispatch scheme and a first allocation scheme. The problems that the intelligent degree of law enforcement is low, and the efficiency of law enforcement is affected in the prior art due to the fact that a law enforcement recorder is manually operated manually to record and keep the law enforcement process are solved, and meanwhile, incomplete and incomplete law enforcement recording is achieved. The effect of improving the effectiveness and the credibility of intelligent law enforcement is achieved.

title_en: Control system and method for linkage of fire and gas system and video monitoring system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a control system and a control method for linkage of a fire gas system and a video monitoring system, wherein the control system comprises a fire gas central control system and a video monitoring system; the fire central control system comprises a plurality of fire detection units and a plurality of linkage channels, the video monitoring system comprises a control unit, a plurality of cameras and a central display screen, the fire detection units output fire detection signals when detecting fire signals, the linkage channels generate linkage signals according to the fire detection signals and linkage rules, the control unit generates linkage control signals according to the linkage signals, the corresponding cameras rotate to preset machine positions according to the linkage control signals and collect video images of sites, and the central display screen displays the video images and linkage popup display. The invention realizes the linkage of the fire and gas system and the video monitoring system, the video monitoring system can be automatically switched to the relevant area for real-time monitoring and recording, the emergency response efficiency is improved, the invention can cooperate, and the time cost and the operation complexity are reduced.
assignees: SHENZHEN BRANCH CHINA NAT OFFSHORE OIL CORP

title_en: Atmospheric flux estimation method based on multi-scale dynamic association
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of atmospheric flux calculation, in particular to an atmospheric flux estimation method based on multi-scale dynamic association. In the existing multi-scale atmospheric flux calculation technology, multi-scale data integration depends on manual interpolation or step calculation, space-time correlation of different-scale atmospheric processes cannot be effectively captured, obvious scale engagement errors are easy to generate, and the traditional iterative calculation needs repeated parameter verification, so that the aging requirement is difficult to meet in the scenes of atmospheric pollution emergency monitoring, real-time carbon flux evaluation and the like. The invention firstly performs space-time alignment and noise suppression on multisource multiscale observation data, and then adopts an AI model to construct a trans-scale dynamic association mechanism to replace the traditional artificial empirical formula. The method can effectively reduce the scale engagement error, solves the problem that the precision and the speed of the traditional technology are difficult to consider, and is suitable for the scenes such as emergency response of air pollution, dynamic monitoring of regional carbon circulation and the like.

title_en: Reservoir dam siltation dynamic monitoring and early warning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of reservoir dam safety monitoring, and discloses a reservoir dam siltation dynamic monitoring and early warning system. The multidimensional sensing node array of the system is arranged at key positions of a dam body structure and a reservoir area, and sediment thickness distribution data, water flow speed field data and sediment concentration gradient data are synchronously collected. The edge computing nodes receive the raw monitoring data, perform data cleaning and space-time alignment processing, and generate a standardized siltation feature data set. And the cloud analysis platform receives the data set, calculates a siltation evolution trend matrix through a space-time coupling prediction model, and outputs a siltation risk level distribution map of a reservoir area. The dynamic visualization engine analyzes the risk level distribution map, generates a three-dimensional dynamic siltation situation model, and marks the space coordinates of the abnormal siltation area. And the early warning decision center generates a grading early warning instruction set according to the space coordinates of the abnormal region, and triggers a corresponding emergency response strategy.
assignees: HUANENG YIMIN COAL AND ELECTRICITY CO LTD HONGHUAERJI HYDROPOWER BRANCH

title_en: Internet of things integrated machine integrating AIoT with safety prevention and control upgrading and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated machine of the Internet of things integrating AIoT and security control upgrading and an implementation method thereof, and relates to the technical field of the intersection of the Internet of things and the security control, wherein a AIoT perception module collects and preprocesses data in a multi-dimensional mode, an edge calculation and AI analysis module locally researches, judges and identifies targets and gives early warning, a security control execution module responds to instructions to control access control, track video, link fire control, a cloud coordination module gathers data and remote control, an equipment health management module monitors states, predicts service lives and reminds maintenance, an emergency response module classifies events, reports and supports parallel connection, and the modules are interconnected through an industrial bus. According to the invention, the comprehensiveness and timeliness of safety prevention and control are improved, the AI identification precision and the multi-equipment cooperative efficiency are optimized, the time of fault shutdown and emergency treatment is reduced, the energy consumption and operation and maintenance cost are reduced, multiple scenes are adapted, safety, experience and economy are taken into consideration, and high-efficiency support is provided for the safety management of the Internet of things.

title_en: Recording system for fire fighting
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To obtain a recording system for fire fighting which automatically prepares a report on fire fighting when a fire engine is dispatched to a fire site.  <P>SOLUTION: The fire engine 1 is equipped with detection means 13 to 22 to detect the operating conditions of a variety of equipment mounted on the fire engine 1, and a transmission means 24 to transmit data on the operating conditions of equipment detected by the detection means 13 to 22 to a management base 25 via a communication line. The management base 25 is provided with a computer 27 having a report preparation program to sum up fire fighting activities in a prescribed report 28 on the basis of the data on operating conditions of equipment sent from the transmission means 24.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2008,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Accessory available transmitting and receiving of mobile telecommunications terminal and gps satellite and position finding method using the same
title_ko: 이동통신단말기 및 지피에스위성과 송수신이 가능한액세서리 및 이를 이용한 위치확인 방법
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An accessory capable of transceiving with a mobile communication terminal and a GPS satellite and a position finding method using the same are provided to trace a position of a lost child quickly by a protecting person, thereby finding the lost child. CONSTITUTION: An accessory for a protected person(11) and a mobile communication terminal(12) of a protecting person communicate each other in an STM(Synchronous Transfer Mode). When the accessory for a protected person and the mobile communication terminal are apart at a predetermined distance, the mobile communication terminal transmits the first danger alarm sound through alarm or vibration. The protecting person can check surroundings by the alarm sound. A program is provided by buying of a ZG chip. The ZG chip is made by combining a Zigbee chip with a GPS transceiving chip. The support chip and the mobile communication terminal perform one to one communication.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 이동통신단말기 및 GPS위성과 송수신이 가능한 액세서리 및 이를 이용한 위치확인 방법에 관한 것으로서, 유아, 의사결정 능력이 없는 치매인, 정신적 무능력자를 포함하는 장애인에게 미아방지 제품을 제공하고 그 위치 확인이 동행하는 보호자의 이동통신단말기(휴대폰, PDA)를 통해서 이루어지도록 함으로 해서 미아발생 및 유괴, 실종 등의 인명사고를 예방할 수 있는 지지칩이 내장된 액세서리와 이동통신단말기를 이용한 위치확인 시스템을 제공코자 한 것이다. 
     즉, 본 발명은 신체에 착용할 수 있으며 지그비칩과 GPS 송수신칩을 일체형으로 결합한 모듈인 지지칩(10)이 결합 구성되는 피보호자용 액세서리(11)를 구성하고, 상기 지지칩(10)과 통신이 가능한 프로그램이 다운로드 설치된 보호자가 소지하는 이동통신단말기(12)와, 지지칩(10)의 GPS 정보를 송수신하는 GPS용 인공위성(13)과, 수신된 GPS 정보를 분석하여 이동통신단말기(12)에 위치 정보를 보내주는 이동통신사 네트워크(14)에 의해 이루어지며, 상기 피보호자용 액세서리(11)가 보호자가 소지하는 이동통신단말기(12)에서 정해진 거리 이상 떨어지는 경우 이동통신단말기(12)에서 알람 혹은 진동으로 1차 위험 경고음을 송출하여 피보호자의 위치를 확인할 수 있게 하고, 육안으로 확인이 불가한 거리로 피보호자가 이동했을 경우 이동통신단말기(12)로 이동통신사 네트워크(14)에 접속하여 피보호자의 위치를 GPS 통신으로 확인하여 찾을 수 있게 한 것으로서, 미아발생 사고를 미연에 막고, 미아가 발생한 경우 보호자가 신속하게 미아의 위치를 추적하여 미아를 찾을  수 있게 하는 효과가 있을 것이며, 유아 유괴의 경우에도 유아의 위치를 쉽게 파악하여 유아를 쉽게 찾을 수 있고, 미아발생 사고와 유괴 사건을 줄일 수 있을 것으로 기대된다. 
       
     지지칩, 피보호자용 액세서리, 이동통신단말기, GPS용 인공위성, 이동통신사 네트워크

title_en: The processing method of car's signal detection system by sensor
title_ko: 충격량이 계수된 시간의 차량 상태에 따른 고유 신호 검출 처리 방법
abstract_en: A method for detecting a unique signal at a time point measuring a shock amount by a vehicle status is provided to quickly process a spot inspection and an accident by checking violence and damage status of a vehicle in real-time. A control center(20) receives an accident through the wireless network by a report of neighboring vehicles equipped with a microcomputer(10) and a sensor(13). The microcomputer receives a signal measuring a shock amount from the sensor in real-time when the shock amount is higher than a predetermined value. A GPS(Global Positioning System) device(12) transmits current coordinates and shock generation time to the microcomputer receiving the signal from the sensor. A database(21) records and stores the coordinates, the time, and shock generation information received from the control center. A storing unit(14) encodes and stores the signal, the coordinates, and the time by the microcomputer. A communication interface(15) transmits a coded information signal generated from the microcomputer through the wireless network.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 충격량이 계수된 시간의 차량 상태에 따른 고유 신호 검출 처리 방법에 관한 것으로, 차량에 의한 대인사고나 대물사고가 발생시에 해당 차량의 가해 유무 및 피해상황을 실시간으로 확인하여 현장 검증과 사고 처리를 신속하게 수행할 수 있으며, 특히 뺑소니 사고 발생시에 사고 발생 지역의 좌표값을 통하여 사고 추정시간에 해당하는 해당 지역의 충격량 발생 정도를 검출하여 도주차량의 차량번호를 포함하는 상세 사건 이력 정보를 실시간 확인하거나 차량의 블랙박스를 통하여 검증할 수 있어, 미결사건을 해결 및 실시간 교통사고 상황 집계 등의 관리에 효율성을 높일 수 있는 특징이 있다. 
     상기와 같은 특징을 달성하기 위해 본 발명은 차량의 외부에 한 쌍으로 마련되는 센서부(13)와, 상기 센서부(13)에 구성된 센서에 의해 실시간 감지되고 설정된 수치이상의 충격량이 감지되면 상기 센서부(13)에서 충격량이 계수되는 신호가 발생하고 상기 신호를 전송받는 마이컴(10)과, 센서부(13)에 의해 신호를 수신한 마이컴(10)에 현재의 좌표값과 충격발생 시간을 전송하기 위해 마련되는 위성항법장치(GPS)(12)와, 상기 발생된 신호와 좌표값 및 시간을 코드화하여 마이컴에 의해 저장되는 저장부(14)와, 상기 마이컴(10)을 비롯한 부가장치에 전원을 공급하기 위한 전원공급부(11)와, 상기 마이컴(10)에서 생성되는 코드화 정보 신호를 무선통신을 이용하여 송신하기 위해 마련되는 통신 인터페이스 장치부(15)로 이루어지며, 관제센터(20)는 차량으로부터 전송되는 코드화 정보 신호를 수신하기 위하여 마련 되는 통신 인터페이스 장치부(25)와, 상기 관제센터(20)에 수신되는 디지털신호인 코드화 정보 신호를 좌표값과 시간 및 충격발생정보를 기록 및 저장하는 데이터베이스(DB)(21)와, 상기 관제센터(20)를 통하여 분석된 자료를 1차적으로 관할 기관에 전송하기 위한 중계국(교환망)(23)과, 상기 중계국(23)에 의해, 입력된 코드화 정보 신호의 좌표값이 분석되어 좌표가 위치하는 지역 관할로 전송되며 이를 전송 받기 위한 지역 관할센터(24a ~ 24n)와, 상기 지역 관할센터(24a ~ 24n)에 의한 실시간 또는 사후 처리 결과가 경료된 경우, 이를 DB(21)에 저장하기 위하여 사건에 대한 처리과정이 실시간 집계되는 현장처리 관리부(22)로 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 것이다. 
       
     마이컴, 전원공급부, 위성항법장치(GPS), 센서부, 저장부, 통신 인터페이스장치부, 관제 센터, 현장처리 관리부, 중계국(교환망), 지역 관할 센터.

title_en: Method, apparatus and computer program of AI-based user-customized disaster response
title_ko: Ai 기반 사용자 맞춤형 재난 대응 방법, 장치 및 컴퓨터프로그램
abstract_en: An embodiment of the present invention relates to an AI-based user-customized disaster response method performed by a computing device. Provided is an AI-based user-customized disaster response method, which includes the steps of: obtaining pre-input information about a plurality of assets under management from a plurality of users; and configuring a user-customized disaster response system for each of the plurality of users by selecting a plurality of disaster response modules which each match the plurality of assets from among the plurality of disaster response modules preset based on the pre-input information, wherein one disaster response module can provide the AI-based user-customized disaster response method which includes information on the disaster response method for one asset.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 실시예는, 컴퓨팅 장치에 의해 수행되는, AI 기반 사용자 맞춤형 재난 대응 방법에 있어서, 관리 중인 복수의 자산에 대한 사전입력 정보를 복수의 사용자로부터 획득하는 과정; 및 상기 사전입력 정보에 기초해 미리 설정된 복수의 재난대응모듈 중에서 상기 복수의 자산에 각각 매칭되는 복수의 재난대응모듈을 선정하여 상기 복수의 사용자 각각을 위한 사용자 맞춤형 재난 대응 시스템을 구성하는 과정을 포함하며, 하나의 재난대응모듈은 하나의 자산에 대한 재난 대응 방법에 대한 정보를 포함하는, AI 기반 사용자 맞춤형 재난 대응 방법을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Safety management device with NFC module
title_ko: 휴대폰 연계 비상상황 관리 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a mobile phone-linked emergency situation management system mounted on a terminal (smartphone, mobile phone, PDA, etc.). More specifically, it comprises: a communication shielding part having an upper body part in the shape of a rectangular pad attached to the back of the terminal, the center of which is open to provide an opening for electromagnetic waves to pass through, and a lower body part provided as a shielding member that blocks electromagnetic waves, with a hinge device provided in the opening; and an NFC module part having a module member on which an NFC chip member is mounted, with the upper end connected by a hinge. By utilizing the above configuration, the invention relates to a safety management technology that enables the terminal to link with the built-in NFC module part through a simple operation by a user during an emergency situation, thereby transmitting emergency situation and location information and performing the function of recording (video recording, etc.) the scene at the time of the accident.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 단말기(스마트폰, 휴대폰, PDA 등)에 장착되는 휴대폰 연계 비상상황 관리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 더욱 상세하게는,  
단말기 배면에 부착되는 장방형 패드 형상의 상측 몸체부 가운데가 개구되어 전자기파가 통과할 개구부로 제공되고 하측 몸체부가 전자기파를 차단하는 차폐부재로 제공되고 힌지장치가 개구부의 구비되는 통신차폐부; 및 NFC칩부재가 안착된 모듈부재가 구비되고 상단이 힌지연결이 되는 NFC모듈부;를 포함하여 구성된다.  
위와 같은 구성을 활용하여, 비상상황 시에 사용자가 간단한 동작으로 내장된 NFC모듈부와 단말기가 연동되게 하여서 비상상황과 위치정보를 전송하고 사고 당시 현장의 녹음(녹화 등)의 기능을 수행하는 안전관리 기술에에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Reporting system according to social crime characteristics and method therefor
title_ko: 소셜 범죄 구성에 따른 신고 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_en: A reporting method according to social crime characteristics according to the present invention comprises the steps of: recording and reporting details of criminal damage by using a user app when an incident occurs according to social crime formation; receiving details of the incident with respect to the details of the criminal damage by means of a report system server, storing only suspect information among the recorded details of the incident in a suspect DB, and searching a sexual assault/harassment details DB, a power harassment details DB, and a bribery and corruption prevention details DB to determine which type of crime corresponds to the details of the incident for the criminal damage; and, when multiple users (victims) point to an identical suspect in recorded cases, notifying the fact to the terminals of all users having pointed to the corresponding suspect by means of the report system server and a person in charge through a webpage of the system, and notifying the same fact to a server of an external investigation agency.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 소셜 범죄 구성에 따른 신고 방법은, 소셜 범죄 구성에 따른 사건의 발생이 있을 때, 사용자 앱을 이용하여 범죄 피해에 대한 내용을 기록하고 신고하는 단계와; 신고 시스템 서버에 의해 범죄 피해에 대한 사건 내용을 접수하고, 기록된 사건 내용 중 용의자 정보만 용의자 DB에 별도로 저장하고, 범죄 피해에 대한 사건 내용이 어떤 범죄에 해당되는지 성폭행/성추행/성희롱 세부 DB, 우월지위 악용 괴롭힘 세부 DB와, 뇌물 및 부정부패 방지 세부 DB를 검색하여 판별하는 단계와; 기록된 사건 내용에서 복수의 사용자(피해자)가 동일한 용의자를 지목했을 때, 신고 시스템 서버에 의해 그 사실을 해당 용의자를 지목한 모든 사용자 단말기 및 시스템의 웹 페이지를 통해 업무 담당자에게 알리고, 외부의 수사기관 서버로 동일한 내용을 통보하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: A kind of multi-node disaster tolerance method and NGCC node
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of multi-node disaster tolerance method and NGCC nodes, applied in the IP network including multiple NGCC nodes, one of the multiple NGCC node is equipped with main C3F routing logic module, remaining NGCC node is equipped with backup C3F routing logic module, the main C3F routing logic module and backup C3F routing logic module composition C3F Pool, the described method includes: electing one of backup C3F routing logic module is new main C3F routing logic module when backup C3F routing logic module judges that the main C3F routing logic module breaks down；The new main C3F routing logic module is sent to the C3F Pool to broadcast the message, indicate that call center's Media Gateway Control Function CC-MGCF module of all NGCC nodes in the C3F Pool records its address information, so that the call request received is forwarded to the new main C3F routing logic module by CC-MGCF module carries out seat allocation processing.By using aforementioned present invention scheme, the United Dispatching to seat resource is realized.

title_en: Rail transit emergency working condition cooperative scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the field of traffic scheduling, and provides a method and a system for collaborative scheduling of emergency working conditions of rail transit, wherein the method comprises the following steps: monitoring the running state and the position of the train in real time; simulating the running position of the train in the tunnel; the actual position of the train in the tunnel is estimated, the actual running condition of the train is analyzed, and recording is carried out when the abnormal train state is obtained; and sending the scheduling strategy to a track station adjacent to the train through an information interface, and increasing the real-time monitoring frequency of the track station. The position and the running state of the train can be obtained through simulation and the sound sensor under the condition of lacking accurate train information, so that more accurate dispatching basis is provided and the safe running of the train is ensured. The method can solve the technical problems of poor signals, incapability of obtaining train information and the like in the tunnel in the prior art, and improves the effect and accuracy of emergency dispatching.

title_en: Apparatus and method for educating the coding
title_ko: 코딩을 교육하는 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and a method for educating coding. According to one embodiment of the present invention, the device comprises: a display part; a voice input and output part; and a control part which receives a voice command from a user through the voice input and output part, extracts code information by analyzing the voice command, generates a program by coding based on the code information, displays the generated program through the display part, generates a voice guiding message for confirming a condition of the command in at least one code included in the displayed program, and outputs the generated voice guiding message through the voice input and output part. According to the present invention, coding education can be conveniently performed even with a portable terminal.
abstract_ko: 본 발명의 일 실시 예에 따른, 코딩 교육 장치 및 방법은, 표시부; 음성 입출력부; 및 상기 음성 입출력부를 통해 음성 명령어가 사용자로부터 입력되면, 상기 음성 명령어를 분석하여 코드 정보를 추출하며, 상기 코드 정보를 기반으로 코딩하여 프로그램을 생성하고, 상기 표시부를 통해 상기 생성된 프로그램을 표시하며, 상기 표시된 프로그램에 포함된 적어도 하나의 코드 중에서 명령어의 조건을 확인하는 음성 안내 메시지를 생성하고, 상기 음성 입출력부를 통해 상기 생성된 음성 안내 메시지를 출력하는 제어부를 포함한다.

title_en: IoT-based Smart Convergence Pergola Capable of Preventing from Disaster And The Management System Thereof
title_ko: 재난대응이 가능한 IoT 기반의 스마트 융복합 퍼걸러 및 관리시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a disaster response management system through an IoT-based smart convergence pergaller capable of responding to a disaster. In the disaster response management system through an IoT-based smart convergence pergaller capable of responding to a disaster, one or more IoT-based smart convergence pergallers capable of responding to a disaster having an AED device and a fire extinguisher are provided, emergency situations can be responded through an emergency call device, a central control server and the convergence pergaller are connected through a wired or wireless network, state management and monitoring of the convergence pergaller are possible through a web program (monitoring program) in various terminals (PC, mobile devices), and self-testing is possible by changing various setting values and pergalling.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난대응이 가능한 IoT 기반의 스마트 융복합 퍼걸러를 통한 재난대응 관리시스템에 관한 것으로, 재난대응이 가능한 IoT 기반의 스마트 융복합 퍼걸러를 통한 재난대응 관리시스템에 있어서, AED 장치 및 소화기를 구비한 재난대응이 가능한 IoT 기반의 하나 이상의 스마트 융복합 퍼걸러가 구비되어 있고, 비상 호출장치를 통하여 긴급상황 대처가 가능하며, 중앙관제서버 및 상기 융복합 퍼걸러는 유선 또는 무선 네트워크로 연결되며, 다양한 단말(PC, 모바일기기)에서 웹 프로그램(모니터링프로그램)을 통해 융복합 퍼걸러의 상태관리 및 모니터링이 가능하며 각종 설정 값 변경 및 퍼걸러 자체시험이 가능한 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Alarm system that puts out a fire is monitored to 4G communication solar energy forest
abstract_en: Alarm system that puts out a fire is monitored to 4G communication solar energy forest, including solar photovoltaic power module, maintenance free cell, the monitoring alarm module of making a video recording, the fire suppression control device, high -pressure squirt put out a fire module and forest fire prevention command center module are collected to the rainwater, maintenance free cell respectively with solar photovoltaic power module, the monitoring alarm module of making a video recording, the fire suppression control device, high -pressure squirt put out a fire module and the connection of forest fire prevention command center module are collected to the rainwater, the monitoring alarm module of making a video recording is connected with fire suppression control device and forest fire prevention command center module respectively, fire suppression control device and rainwater are collected high -pressure squirt and are put out a fire the module and be connected. The utility model has the advantages of: the utility model discloses can pass through solar photovoltaic power module, utilize solar energy to provide electric power for maintenance free cell with each module, avoid storage battery microcomputer to use up the artifical change in back, save a large amount of manpower and material resources.
assignees: GUIZHOU DABOJIN SOLAR PHOTOELECTRIC CO LTD

title_en: Time synchronization method, device and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a time synchronization method. The method comprises following steps: receiving standard synchronization time sent by a synchronization clock source through a local area network; obtaining the system time of a computer terminal according to a set time interval; detecting whether the system time and the standard synchronization time are consistent; and if detecting that system time and the standard synchronization time are inconsistent, modifying the system time of the computer terminal according to the standard synchronization time. Moreover, the invention also provides a time synchronization and system. Through the timing service of the standard clock, the time of various communication devices and the computer device on the communication network is unified; the time deviation is limited in a small enough range; the time of the system is ensured to be uniform and synchronous; and the normal operation of a public security emergency command system is ensured.

title_en: A kind of emergency response system
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a kind of emergency response system, it include: multiple mobile terminals, wireless communication apparatus and emergency response platform, the wireless communication apparatus is connected with the multiple mobile terminal and emergency response platform respectively, emergency response platform includes apparatus for management of information, second controller, the second controller receives the location information of the emergency people, video recording and/or recording and/or photo, and determine the location information of the corresponding mobile terminal of each phone number in the apparatus for management of information, judge the location information of each mobile terminal whether in the setting range of the location information apart from the emergency people；If sending location information, video recording and/or recording and/or the photo of the emergency people to each mobile terminal in the setting range of the location information apart from the emergency people, whether being rescued so that each user decides in its sole discretion.The present invention, which is realized, issues alarm urgency signal to periphery all groups by emergency response platform, improves opportunity and the effect of emergency processing.

title_en: Information and decision interaction method based on earthquake rescue virtual drilling system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an information and decision interaction method based on an earthquake rescue virtual drilling system, which comprises the following steps: determining the type of the user as a squad, a command group or a teaching group; each type of user performs a partitioning scheme; each type of user conducts drilling after browsing the information table; each type of user records the information circulation condition of the execution stage, and the information and/or feedback information is filled after the information circulation condition of the execution stage is analyzed. The corresponding device, the electronic equipment and the computer readable storage medium are further disclosed, so that the time sequence and the mutual restriction relation of information transfer are scientifically analyzed, and a data foundation is laid for further optimizing the drilling system.
assignees: XINXING JIHUA TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD;XINXING CATHAY INT GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Earthquake early warning system for elevator
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of security equipment, in particular to an elevator earthquake early warning system, which comprises a protection component and an earthquake processing general control module, wherein the protection component is assembled at one corner below an inner top wall of an elevator, the protection component comprises a protection frame, a box body, a connecting piece and a camera, the protection frame is connected with one corner of the top wall of the elevator, the front surface of the protection frame is provided with a mounting groove matched with the box body, and the inner bottom wall of the box body is provided with the connecting piece connected with the protection frame: the protection component is arranged at one corner below the inner top wall of the elevator, does not occupy the space of passengers, can effectively protect elevator equipment from being damaged by earthquake fluctuation, and the earthquake processing master control module comprises an earthquake early warning module, a control center module, an elevator control linkage module, an emergency communication module, a power management module and a data recording analysis module. The modules cooperate together to realize functions of earthquake early warning, emergency response, data recording and the like.

title_en: Fire-fighting emergency response linkage system based on pipe gallery and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting emergency response linkage system based on a pipe gallery and a control method thereof, and belongs to the technical field of pipe gallery fire fighting. The system of the invention comprises: the system comprises an automatic early warning module, a three-dimensional construction module of the internal environment of the pipe gallery, a fire-fighting safety situation analysis module, a fire-fighting linkage control module and a fire-fighting emergency response module; the automatic early warning module is used for determining the early warning condition of an early warning subsystem arranged in the pipe gallery; the three-dimensional construction module for the internal environment of the pipe gallery is used for constructing a real-time three-dimensional model of the internal environment of the pipe gallery. According to the invention, the fire safety situation of each region to be fire-fighting is analyzed through the real-time rendering model of each region to be fire-fighting, the temperature and the concentration of the combustible gas in each region to be fire-fighting, and meanwhile, the real-time involvement coefficient of each region to be fire-fighting is considered, so that the comprehensive analysis of the fire safety situation in the pipe gallery is facilitated, and the timeliness and the accuracy of the comprehensive analysis result are ensured.
assignees: ZHONGAN CONSTRUCTION AND INSTALLATION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Meteorological disaster intelligent early warning system based on real-time data acquisition and analysis
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of meteorological disaster early warning, in particular to a meteorological disaster intelligent early warning system based on real-time data acquisition and analysis, which comprises a meteorological data monitoring and acquisition module, a meteorological disaster prediction module, an intelligent early warning module, a regional monitoring grade analysis module and a regional meteorological monitoring end; according to the invention, through collecting and analyzing various meteorological data in real time, the meteorological abnormality and disaster precursors are found timely, the accuracy and timeliness of early warning are improved, corresponding emergency response measures can be automatically triggered according to early warning information, timely rescue and protection measures are provided for relevant departments and public, the influence and loss of disasters are effectively reduced, the meteorological monitoring grades of corresponding areas are analyzed through the area monitoring grade analysis module, the area meteorological monitoring management is enhanced when the corresponding areas are marked as high-grade areas, the subsequent meteorological disasters of the corresponding areas can be ensured to be rapidly and effectively treated, and the damage to the corresponding areas due to the meteorological disasters is further reduced.
assignees: NORTH CHINA SEA FORECAST DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF MINI OF NATURAL RESOURCES QINGDAO OCEAN CENTER

title_en: Old person falls monitoring and multiport linkage emergency response system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fall monitoring and multi-terminal linkage emergency response system for old people, which relates to the technical field of medical treatment and comprises the steps of performing noninductive acquisition on human body dynamic information in a dim light vision blind area environment, wherein a voice interaction verification judgment module comprises a far-field voice excitation unit, and a priority queue management mechanism is arranged to confirm a behavior perception output fall instruction. The invention realizes closed-loop management of fall monitoring and emergency treatment of the old, has obvious beneficial effects, effectively protects user privacy, obviously reduces false alarm rate and invalid scheduling of nursing resources, improves the accuracy and individual suitability of event discrimination, ensures that high-risk events are not missed, improves the timeliness and accuracy of emergency response, and provides safe, intelligent and humanized technical support for intelligent care and home health monitoring.

title_en: Remote switchboard management system
title_ko: 원격 배전반 관리시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A remote switchboard management system is provided to efficiently manage the switchboard by using a management server offering a management program according to the request of a client PC. CONSTITUTION: A temperature sensing part(40) detects the temperature of a busbar installed on a distribution panel(5) and the battery circuit breaker. A camera part(50) monitors inside and outside of the distribution panel. A PC(60) for interface receives the signal outputted from the temperature sensing part and the camera part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 원격 배전반 관리시스템에 관한 것으로써, 더욱 상세하게는 배전반 인입선로상에 설치되어 상기 인입선로로 공급되는 전원, 전압 등을 계측하는 계측부와; 상기 계측부가 계측한 전원, 전압값 등을 표시하는 디스플레이부와; 상기 계측부가 계측한 전원, 전압값 등이 상기 디스플레이부에 표시될 수 있도록 상기 디스플레이부를 제어하는 인터페이스용 PLC;를 포함하여 이루어지는 배전반에 있어서, 상기 배전반에 설치된 부스바 및 부하개폐기의 온도를 감지하는 온도감지부와; 상기 배전반의 내부 및 외부를 촬영하여 감시하는 카메라부와; 상기 온도감지부 및 상기 카메라부가 출력하는 신호를 수신하고, 상기 인터페이스용 PLC와 이더넷을 통해 연결되는 인터페이스용 PC와; 상기 인터페이스용 PC와 네트워크망을 통해 연결되고, 부하개폐기를 포함한 상기 배전반의 저,고압기기의 개폐를 제어하며, 상기 배전반의 이상트립의 기준을 설정하고, 상기 카메라부의 촬영영상을 요청할 수 있는 관리프로그램을 클라이언트 PC의 요청에 의해 제공하는 관리서버;를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징으로 하는 원격 배전반 관리시스템에 관한 것이다. 
     이와 같이 구성된 본 발명은 인터페이스용 PC와 네트워크망을 통해 연결되고, 부하개폐기를 포함한 상기 배전반의 저,고압기기의 개폐를 제어하며, 배전반의 이상트립의 기준을 설정하고, 상기 카메라부의 촬영영상을 요청할 수 있는 관리프로그램을 클라이언트 PC의 요청에 의해 제공하는 관리서버로 인해 상기 배전반을  보다 효율적으로 관리할 수 있음은 물론 이로 인해 특히 정전사고를 포함한 안전사고율을 현저히 낮출수 있는 효과가 있다.
