title_en: Apparatus and method for predicting a combination of safety facilities based on traffic accident data, and computer-readable recording medium on which a program for performing the method is recorded
title_ko: 교통사고 자료 기반 안전시설물 조합 예측 장치 및 방법과 이를 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능 매체
abstract_en: Disclosed are an apparatus and a method for predicting a combination of safety facilities based on traffic accident data, and a computer-readable medium recording a program performing the same to maximize safety of an intersection by recommending an optimal combination of safety facilities suitable for characteristics and situations of the intersection through data analysis and a machine learning model. An apparatus for predicting a combination of safety facilities based on traffic accident data comprises: a dataset construction unit for constructing an intersection safety analysis dataset by using traffic accident data generated at an intersection, environmental characteristic data of the corresponding intersection, safety facility data installed at the corresponding intersection, real-time traffic information data, real-time disaster information data, and real-time weather information data; an importance analysis unit for analyzing the importance of variables affecting the safety of accident histories including the number of accidents, accident rate, and casualties in the corresponding intersection safety analysis dataset for each intersection to classify the data; a necessary safety facility derivation unit for deriving necessary safety facilities for improving the safety and the effect of safety facilities reflecting the characteristics of each intersection by classifying and learning the classified data through a machine learning model; and a safety facility combination recommendation unit for recommending a combination of necessary safety facilities by analyzing necessary safety facilities for reducing the accident histories at each intersection.
abstract_ko: 데이터 분석과 머신러닝 모델을 통해 교차로의 특성과 상황에 맞는 최적의 안전시설물 조합을 추천함으로써, 교차로의 안전성을 극대화하기 위한 교통사고 자료 기반 안전시설물 조합 예측 장치 및 방법과 이를 수행하는 프로그램이 기록된 컴퓨터 판독 가능 매체가 개시된다. 교통사고 자료 기반 안전시설물 조합 예측 장치는, 교차로에서 발생되는 교통사고 데이터, 해당 교차로의 환경적 특성 데이터, 해당 교차로에 설치되어 있는 안전시설물 데이터, 실시간 교통정보 데이터, 실시간 재난정보 데이터 및 실시간 날씨정보 데이터를 활용하여 교차로 안전분석 데이터셋을 구축하는 데이터셋 구축부; 각 교차로마다 해당 교차로 안전분석 데이터셋에서 사고건수, 사고율 및 인명피해를 포함하는 사고이력들이 안전도에 미치는 변수 중요도를 분석하여 데이터를 구분하는 중요도 분석부; 상기 구분된 데이터에 대해 머신러닝 모델을 통해 분류 및 학습시켜 각 교차로 특성을 반영하는 안전시설물의 효과 및 안전도를 높이기 위한 필요 안전시설물을 도출하는 필요 안전시설물 도출부; 및 각 교차로에서 상기 사고이력들을 감소시키기 위한 필요 안전시설물을 분석하여 필요 안전시설물의 조합을 추천하는 안전시설물 조합 추천부를 포함한다.
assignees: UNIV AJOU IND ACADEMIC COOP FOUND

title_en: An emergency wifi authentication sensor for use with an emergency dispatch network of responders
abstract_en: An emergency controller unit having wireless communication identification sensor comprising a wifi BSSID combined with programmable SSID data, wherein the BSSID in combination with the programmable data is configurable to uniquely identify the sensor, which SSID is broadcast upon activation of the controller, in use. The activation of the sensor by a trigger event causes the BSSIDs in a predetermined distance from the sensor to be recorded, alternately tracked. The sensor uses a software application enables the user to input and store personal identifying information on the user sensor as an aspect of the SSID data broadcast, alternately a user may input said information on a remote server which interacts with the software application and communicates the user information when appropriately accessed.

title_en: Determining inconsistencies in digital evidence
abstract_en: A system for prioritizing and resolving inconsistencies in digital evidence. The system includes a database containing a first type of data and a second type of data related to an incident record and an electronic computing device including an electronic processor. The electronic processor is configured to receive the first and second types of data from the database, determine an inconsistency between the first and second types of data, and determine an incident type from the incident record. The electronic processor is also configured to determine whether a priority of the determined inconsistency meets a threshold case impact level. When the priority of the inconsistency meets the threshold case impact level, the electronic processor is configured to take a first notification action and when the priority of the inconsistency does not meet the threshold case impact level, the electronic processor is configured to take a second notification action.

title_en: Integrating data from multiple devices
abstract_en: A recording system for an emergency response unit includes a first data collection device configured to record a first video, audio or data segment with an incident identifier and transmit a message including the incident identifier. A second data collection device may receive the message and, as appropriate, record at least a second video, audio or data segment with the incident identifier, allowing the first segment and the second segment to be associated using the incident identifier. In other embodiments, a first recording device may begin recording video, audio or legal evidence data with an incident identifier, and a control system may receive a message including the incident identifier from the first recording device, identify one or more additional recording devices located within a certain distance of the first recording device, and obtain recordings from the one or more additional recording devices.

title_en: A methord and the system of drawing of the traffic accident and statistics management of traffic accident point and atfer creating automatic serial number based on gis
title_ko: Gis를 기반으로 교통사고 실황지도를 그리는 방법과 교통사고 고유식별용 연속번호를 자동 생성하여 교통사고의 통계를 관리하는 방법과 시스템
abstract_en: A method for drawing a real traffic accident condition map based on a GIS(Geographic Information System), and the method and a system for managing traffic accident statistics by generating a serial traffic accident number automatically are provided to obtain information used for finding/understanding causes of a traffic accident by using a GIS map, and output traffic accident statistics in real-time without collecting/refining traffic accident records of each insurance company. A web-based program module(50-10) obtains coordinate/address information of a point when a user selects the point in which a traffic accident occurs by connecting to a GIS server. A real traffic accident condition map drawing module(100-10) loads map data of an area centering on the traffic accident point automatically when the traffic accident point is selected in the web-based program module. A traffic accident management program module(50-20) assigns a serial traffic accident number to the traffic accident when traffic accident data are inputted to a database of the GIS server. A traffic accident statistics program module(200-10) calculates traffic accident statistics by processing data stored in an integrated database server(200) based on the serial traffic accident number.

title_en: Apparatus for Failure Coping in Disaster Response Special Purpose Machine's Travel Device
title_ko: 재난 대응용 특수목적기계 주행장치의 고장발생 대처 장치
abstract_en: The present invention provides an apparatus for coping with a failure in a disaster response special purpose machine′s travel device. The apparatus includes: a crawler rotation driving state detection unit for each crawler provided in the disaster response special purpose machine′s travel device; a leg displacement driving state sensing unit for each leg provided in the travel device; a control unit for performing control to cope with the failures including a displacement drive failure of each leg and a rotation failure of each crawler, based on an embedded travel device malfunction coping program; a leg displacement hydraulic control valve for controlling the displacement drive of each leg by controlling hydraulic pressure applied to a hydraulic cylinder for driving the leg displacement from a hydraulic pump under the control of the control unit; and a crawler rotation hydraulic pressure control valve for controlling the rotation drive of each crawler by controlling hydraulic pressure applied to a hydraulic actuator for driving the crawler rotation from the hydraulic pump under the control of the controller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난 대응용 특수목적기계의 주행장치에 구비된 각 크롤러(Crawler)의 회전 구동상태를 감지하여 크롤러 회전 구동상태 감지신호를 출력하는 크롤러 회전 구동상태 감지부; 상기 주행장치에 구비된 각 레그의 변위 구동 상태를 감지하여 레그 변위 구동상태 감지신호를 출력하는 레그 변위 구동상태 감지부; 자체 내장된 주행장치 고장발생 대처 프로그램에 의거하여 상기 각 레그의 변위 구동 장애 및 상기 각 크롤러의 회전 장애를 포함하는 고장 발생에 대처하는 제반 제어를 수행하되, 상기 크롤러 회전 구동상태 감지부를 통해 각 크롤러의 정상 회전 구동 여부를 파악하고, 상기 레그 변위 구동상태 감지부를 통해 각 레그의 정상 변위 구동 여부를 파악하여, 상기 고장 발생에 대처하는 제반 제어를 수행하는 제어부; 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 유압펌프로부터 레그 변위 구동용 유압 실린더에 인가되는 유압을 제어하여서 각 레그의 변위 구동을 제어하는 레그 변위 유압제어밸브; 및 상기 제어부의 제어에 따라 유압펌프로부터 크롤러 회전 구동용 유압 작동기에 인가되는 유압을 제어하여서 각 크롤러의 회전 구동을 제어하는 크롤러 회전 유압제어밸브;를 포함하고, 상기 제어부는, 크롤러 회전 구동상태 감지신호에 의거하여 설정 개수 이내의 크롤러가 정상적으로 회전 구동하지 않는 것으로 판단되는 경우, 회전 구동하지 않는 크롤러에 대응하는 정상적으로 회전 구동되는 다른 크롤러의 회전속도를 제한하여서 상기 주행장치의 이동이 가능하도록 상기 크롤러 회전 유압제어밸브에 의해 각 크롤러의 회전 구동용 유압 작동기에 인가되는 크롤러 회전 구동용 유압을 제어하는 것을 특징으로 하는 재난 대응용 특수목적기계 주행장치의 고장발생 대처 장치를 제공한다.

title_en: Emergency situation response service system and method using sound and motion recognition
title_ko: 소리와 움직임 인식을 이용한 비상 상황 대응 시스템 및 방법
abstract_en: Disclosed are an emergency response system and a method using sound and motion recognition. According to an aspect of the present invention, an emergency response system using sound and motion recognition comprises: a sound source input unit for recording a sound in a management place; a motion detection unit provided in the management place to sense a motion of a person; an emergency determination unit for analyzing the motion of the person by the motion detection unit to determine whether an emergency occurs when a situation is recognized as a possible emergency as a result of analyzing the sound by the sound input unit; and an emergency guide unit for transmitting emergency information to a preset external device when the emergency determination unit determines that the emergency occurs.
abstract_ko: 소리와 움직임 인식을 이용한 비상 상황 대응 시스템 및 방법이 개시된다. 본 발명의 일측면에 따른 소리와 움직임 인식을 이용한 비상 상황 대응 시스템은, 관리장소에서의 소리를 녹취하기 위한 음원입력부; 관리장소 내에 구비되어 사람의 움직임을 센싱하기 위한 움직임감지부; 음원입력부에 의한 소리를 분석한 결과 비상가능상황임이 인식되면, 움직임감지부에 의한 사람의 움직임을 분석하여 비상상황 여부를 결정하는 비상상황판단부; 및 비상상황판단부에 의해 비상상황이라 판단되는 경우, 비상상황 정보를 미리 설정된 외부 장치로 전송하는 비상안내부를 포함한다.

title_en: Systems and methods for processing recorded data for storage using computer-aided dispatch information
abstract_en: Computer-implemented methods and systems for processing recorded data for storage is provided. An auditable device, such as a digital video camera, stores a set of recorded data. The auditable device also stores auditable event entries that represent auditable events detected by the auditable device. One type of auditable event is the receipt of information from a computer-aided dispatch (CAD) system that indicates an event. The auditable device marks at least one subset of the set of recorded data based on the auditable event entries, and uploads the marked at least one subset of the set of recorded data to an evidence management system.

title_en: Communication command car
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a communication command car. The outer part of a car body is respectively connected with a satellite antenna, an antenna ascending and descending rod and a sucker antenna, the inner part of the car body is connected with a satellite communication host, a vehicle station, a single pawn receiver, an active sound box, a storage battery, a control panel, an audio and video codec, a hard disk video recorder, an audio and video amplifier and an inverter power supply, and a camera is connected with an inner car roof. The communication command car disclosed by the utility model has the advantages of strong maneuverability and strong functions, can be used for collecting spot information more quickly in emergent accidents such as natural disasters, and is convenient to use.
assignees: JIANGLING MOTOR GROUP SPECIALTY VEHICAL CO LTD JIANGXI

title_en: A long -range voice communication system for emergency command vehicle
abstract_en: The utility model provides a long -range voice communication system for emergency command vehicle, the system includes: computer, the headset, digital video recorder, network switch, 3G wireless router, satellite modem, optical fiber transceivers, SIM card antenna, exceedingly high line in quiet, wherein computer and headset, digital video recorder, network switch connects, digital video recorder and network switch are connected, network switch and 3G wireless router, satellite modem, the fiber optical transceiver links to each other, SIM card antenna is connected with 3G wireless router, exceedingly high line is connected with satellite modem in quiet, this system synthesis the satellite, 3G, the multiple communication technology means of optic fibre provide reliable emergency communication guarantee, realize interior personnel of car and higher level command center's speech communication.
assignees: HEBEI JUNKE EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Vehicle-mounted high-rise building fire extinguishing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-mounted fire extinguishing system for a high-rise building, relates to the technical field of fire extinguishing of the high-rise building, and particularly relates to a vehicle-mounted fire extinguishing tool capable of being used for the high-rise building. The method is realized by the following technical scheme: a flying appliance is carried on a vehicle-mounted platform, and the flying appliance is powered by a power supply from the ground; the flying appliance is provided with a fire-carrying appliance and an automatic shooting and recording device. Due to the fact that the vehicle-mounted flying device is adopted and the ground provides a power source, the vehicle-mounted flying device can arrive at an incident site very timely, the ground power source provides the flying device carrying the fire extinguishing device, under the control of personnel on the flying device, the vehicle-mounted flying device can fly to a fire catching point accurately to extinguish fire, the possibility of casualties is greatly reduced, the condition of the fire scene can be fed back to rescue personnel timely, and the vehicle-mounted flying device can serve several purposes and can be the development direction of high-rise fire fighting.

title_en: Laterally interconnection and longitudinally through urban track traffic emergency information management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of laterally interconnections and longitudinally through urban track traffic emergency information management method, including urban mass transit network basic information module, information acquisition module and information issuing module, after determining warning information by information acquisition module, the data information of current information source site is transferred from Rail traffic network database and website facility layout information database in Regional Control Center command post, and it is sent to Police Command Center, after emergency center command post determines its influence and degree, it is sent to responsibility object, realizes the lateral interconnection of information；Each line region emergency command room sends relevant information to responsibility object and traveler simultaneously, realizes the longitudinally through of information.The present invention considers the sharing, intercommunity and the timeliness of transmission of urban track traffic emergency information, can be effectively improved existing urban track traffic emergency information management status, the fast throughput to emergency event is improved, to ensure the normal trip of people.

title_en: Multifunction power dispatches remote operation training equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses multifunction power scheduling remote operation training equipment, including operator control panel cabinet, the power supply network being made of several inserted blocks is installed on the preceding screen-wall of operator control panel cabinet, it is equipped on the rear screen-wall of operator control panel cabinet and the signal acquisition module and signal output module of the electrical connection of corresponding inserted block, it further include the server being electrically connected with the input terminal of signal acquisition module output end and signal output module, the communication terminal of server is connected with data/address bus, and correspondence is electrically connected with five anti-work stations, monitor workstation, assessment work station on data/address bus.The functions such as electric power skills training, examination, assessment are realized, is able to record, studies and judges the normalization and logicality of every single stepping, improve five-prevention operation technical ability.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO;STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Mine water disaster early warning and prevention and control system and prevention and control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine water disaster early warning and prevention and control system and a prevention and control method, which relate to the technical field of water disaster early warning and prevention and control systems, and the technical scheme is as follows: the intelligent monitoring system comprises a dispatching center module, wherein the connecting end of the dispatching center module comprises an Internet sharing module and a prevention and control management module, the connecting end of the prevention and control management module is respectively provided with a multi-information fusion processing module and a wireless communication module, the multi-information fusion processing module comprises a prediction model building module, an information management platform module and a water damage grading module, the connecting end of the wireless communication module is provided with a personnel positioning bracelet module, and the personnel positioning bracelet module comprises an audible and visual alarm module and an underground navigation module, and has the advantages that: the measuring efficiency is high, the precision is high, time and labor are saved, the timeliness and the continuity of data are effectively guaranteed, the improvement of mine hydrogeology data is facilitated, the early warning of the water quantity change of the observation station is facilitated, the information can be effectively transmitted due to water damage, and underground workers can be evacuated rapidly.
assignees: BEIJING HONGSHAN INFORMATION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent security dispatching management method for intelligent communities based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent communities and discloses an intelligent security scheduling management method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of obtaining video monitoring data and access control record data of a plurality of communities, cleaning the data, unifying data formats and contents by adopting a data standardization technology to obtain standardized community security data, mining personnel flow modes and vehicle track modes of different communities by adopting a graph algorithm analysis technology on the basis of a community relation network to obtain a cross-community personnel flow mode and a vehicle track mode, identifying potential safety hazards by adopting an anomaly detection algorithm according to analysis results of the cross-community personnel flow mode and the vehicle track mode, and generating early warning information if an anomaly condition is detected. The method and the system realize deep association analysis of the cross-community security data and effectively improve the intelligent level of community security management.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION JIUHE DEV GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Atmospheric environment monitoring emergency early warning method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an atmospheric environment monitoring emergency early warning method, in particular to the technical field of atmospheric environment monitoring and early warning, which comprises S1, constructing a multi-source data fusion three-dimensional monitoring system, S2, a dynamic risk assessment and early warning trigger mechanism based on artificial intelligence, and S3, an emergency response cooperation and feedback optimization mechanism. According to the invention, the comprehensive and accurate monitoring is improved by constructing a multi-source data fusion three-dimensional monitoring system, more scientific and reasonable early warning and decision making are realized by means of an artificial intelligence-based dynamic risk assessment and early warning trigger mechanism, emergency response is optimized by means of an emergency response cooperation and feedback optimization mechanism, the treatment efficiency is improved, the accuracy of atmospheric environment monitoring, the timeliness of early warning and the high efficiency of emergency treatment are comprehensively ensured, the atmospheric pollution hazard is effectively reduced, and public health, urban operation, ecological environment safety and social stability are ensured.
assignees: SICHUAN NANCHONG ECOLOGICAL ENV MONITORING CENTER STATION

title_en: Equipment information verification and update method in emergency scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of equipment information management, in particular to an equipment information verification and update method under an emergency scene, which comprises the steps of obtaining equipment information from a plurality of service systems, identifying difference records through comparing attribute information, generating a list to be verified, determining a reference data source based on a preset priority rule, verifying the list by taking the reference as a reference and combining an automatic judging rule with manual arbitration, determining equipment authority attribute information, screening out equipment to be verified on site and geographic coordinates thereof, generating a set of equipment to be verified, constructing a pipe network topology model of a target area, mapping the equipment to be verified to a model vertex, planning an optimal site verification path through a graph search algorithm, forming final equipment information based on the authority information and a site verification result, and synchronously updating the final equipment information to all relevant service systems. The method realizes the rapid comparison, conflict arbitration, efficient field verification and data synchronization of the information of the multi-source equipment, and improves the emergency response efficiency and the decision accuracy.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU INST OF TECHNOLOGY;ZHENGZHOU DIGWAY IND CO LTD

title_en: Receiver, television receiver, management method, home network system, program, and recording medium
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To achieve a receiver which can quickly transmit generation of an emergency to households with the receiver while contributing to suppression of sudden power consumption rise in a target region after securing safety.SOLUTION: A receiver (1) includes: a receiving section (10) for receiving an emergency warning signal; and a command transmission section (41) for successively transmitting a start command at a time interval to a plurality of display devices in a home network when the receiving section (10) receives the emergency warning signal.

title_en: Cell storage system, cell storage method and program
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a cell storage system, a cell storage method and a program which can reduce such a risk as to lose the same kind of cell altogether even when an accident such as natural disaster occurs.SOLUTION: A cell storage system S manages empty circumstances which exhibit the number of storable containers at every cell storage device 10, updates storage circumstances information of a cell storage device 20 recorded on a data base 400 including the empty circumstances information in accordance with variations of the empty circumstances, (2) gains the number of containers to be stored based on a command of a manager who manages the containers and (3) determines the cell storage device 20 of a storage destination on a gained container to be stored while following predetermined storage conditions when storing a plurality of containers to be stored on each cell storage device based on the number of the gained containers to be stored and the storage circumstances information when gaining the number of the containers.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_ko: 화상 및 소리 처리 장치를 구비한 경보 전달 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: The emergency signal delivery system equipped with image and sound processing unit together records image and sound. The availability of the information can be enhanced a lot. CONSTITUTION: A plurality of CCTV(Closed Circuit Television) cameras and microphone is installed in the pillar of the either side in order to visually sense the crosswalk(10) and crossing atmosphere delivery. In the crossing atmosphere delivery, the main control panel(3) and the assistant control half(4) transferred are installed the emergency signal, image and sound in the promised object. The cable transfers the information which becomes from the CCTV camera and micro to the main control panel and assistant control half.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 횡단 보도, 학교주변 등 안전 취약지역에 CCTV 카메라와 마이크를 설치하여 횡단 보도, 학교주변 등 안전 취약지역에서 발생 되는 비정상적인 경보 상황을 감지하고, 그 경보와 영상 및 소리를 사전에 약속된 대상에 신속하게 전달하는 시스템에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Power distribution network transfer training evaluation method based on load transfer information array
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power distribution network transfer training evaluation method based on a load transfer information matrix, which comprises the following steps: and establishing a load transfer standard range set LTSR and a load transfer actual range set LTPR to record all switch and disconnecting link information contained in a single transfer range after standard operation and actual operation. And establishing a load transfer standard information array LTSI and a load transfer actual information array LTPI to record the number of action equipment for transferring all loads after standard operation and actual operation, the number of loads transferred and removed, the number of power supplies recovered by important users and a load transfer range set related to the transfer and supply. The dispatcher load transfer training evaluation method based on the transfer information array is provided by comparing the load transfer standard information array LTSI with the load transfer actual information array LTPI. The evaluation method can better reflect the operation process of dispatcher load transfer, and has better practical training evaluation significance.

title_en: Simulation method for training first aid treatment using augmented reality and virtual reality
title_ko: 증강현실과 가상현실을 이용한 훈련용 응급처치 시뮬레이션 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 증강현실과 가상현실을 이용한 응급처치 훈련용 시뮬레이션 방법에 있어서,  
훈련대상자(E)의 머리에 착용되어지는 VR기기(10)를 구비하고 VR기기(10) 전방에는 스마트폰(20)을 연결되게 장착하되 스마트폰(20)에는 응급처치 훈련을 위한 프로그램이 데이터베이스(21)에 설치되어 있고 화면에 관련 메뉴가 표시되어 입력부(23)를 통하여 실행되게 할 수 있으며,  
훈련대상자(E)에 의하여 응급처치 훈련 실행시 상기 스마트폰(20)의 카메라부(24)에서 촬영되는 배경화면이 VR기기(10)를 통하여 나타나도록 하되 카메라센서를 통하여 CPR 마네킹(30)을 인식하면 제어부(27)의 처리에 의하여 CPR 마네킹(30)이 3D입체로 된 사람을 형상의 증강현실(AR)로 구현되어 VR기기(10)를 통하여 보여지도록 하고 응급상황(사고현장)과 유사한 효과음을 음향출력부(25)로 출력하도록 구성하며,  
스마트폰(20)의 제어부(27)는 실제의 배경에 캐릭터(강사) 또는 텍스트 중 어느 하나 이상의 증강현실로 구현되는 가이드용 컨텐츠가 디스플레이부(22)로 나타나도록 하여 훈련대상자(E)는 응급처치의 전반적인 순서와 방법에 대하여 가이드용 컨텐츠가 나타나는 디스플레이부(22) 영상을 보여주는 VR기기(10)를 보면서 학습할 수 있도록 하며,  
 가이드용 컨텐츠의 안내를 바탕으로 CPR 마네킹(30)에 응급처치 학습을 할 수 있도록 하되, 훈련대상자(E)가 CPR 마네킹(30)에 행하는 압박의 강도, 압박의 횟수, 압박의 깊이, 압박의 시간 및 인공호흡의 횟수와 시간 등에 의한 실시간 결과를 포함하여 학습을 마친 후의 성공과 실패 여부가 스마트폰(20)의 통신부(26)와의 통신으로 제어부(27)에 전달되어 VR기기(10)로 텍스트 또는 표식 중 어느 하나의 방법으로 확인할 수 있게 하는 절차학습단계(A단계)와,  
상기 스마트폰(20)에 내장된 프로그램을 바탕으로 VR기기(10)에 실제 사고 현장과 유사한 환경을 가상현실로 구현하여 보여지도록 하여 훈련대상자(E)로 하여금 실제상황을 느낄 수 있게 하되, 가상공간 내에는 환자아바타(50)가 정해진 위치에 나타나도록 하며,  
훈련대상자(E)가 환자아바타(50)의 흉부위치에  CPR Cube(40) 또는 흉부압박장치를 위치시켜 CPR Cube(40)에 행하는 압박의 강도, 압박의 횟수, 압박의 깊이, 압박의 시간 등에 의한 실시간 데이터가 스마트폰(20)의 통신부(26)와의 통신으로 제어부(27)에 전달되어 가상공간 안에서 훈련의 결과가 표시(피드백)되게 하여 VR기기(10)로 확인할 수 있도록 하는 실전훈련단계(B단계)로 이루어지도록 구성한다.

title_en: A method for monitoring a drowning accident and a readable media storing a program for performing the method
title_ko: 익수사고 감지방법 및 이를 수행하는 프로그램을 저장하는 기록매체
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method for detecting a drowning accident, and more specifically, the method comprises a time-series of steps including a continuous shooting step (S100) for shooting images in real time by a camera (10) installed at a drowning-predicted location; an image transmission step (S200) for transmitting image data of a person to a server (20) during the continuous shooting step; a drowning judgment step (S300) for determining whether or not a person has drowned by the server (20) after the image transmission step; and an alarm step (S400) for activating a rescue signal by the server (20) after the drowning judgment step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 익수사고 감지방법에 관한 것으로서, 구체적으로 익수예상 위치에 설치된 카메라(10)에 의해 영상을 실시간으로 촬영하는 상시촬영단계(S100); 상기 상시촬영단계 중, 인명의 영상데이터를 서버(20)로 전송하는 영상전송단계(S200); 상기 영상전송단계 후, 서버(20)에 의해 익수여부를 판독하는 익수판단단계(S300); 상기 익수판단단계 후, 서버(20)에 의해 구난신호를 발동하는 알람단계(S400);를 포함하는 시계열적 단계로 이루어진다.

title_en: Method and system for locating a personal emergency response system (PERS) device based on real estate lockbox interaction
abstract_en: Real estate properties can have lockboxes that contain keys for gaining property access. The lockboxes can record information about each real estate agent who showed a property and can wirelessly transmit that information for storage in a database. The information can include the agent's identity, an identifier of the lockbox or property, and an access time, for example. The agent can carry a personal emergency response system (PERS) device so that the agent can send out a wireless emergency alert if the agent feels threatened or otherwise experiences an emergency situation. Upon receipt of such a wireless emergency alert, a remote system can access the database to determine one or more properties that the agent has visited. Thus, the system can track the agent and determine a location of the emergency situation.

title_en: Method for the secure logging of correspondence and notification thereof
abstract_en: Systems and methods are disclosed that create a secure electronically recorded log utilizable in the field of emergency response material spill remediation. The system can receive information regarding a spill incident, wherein the information includes an approximate location of the spill incident or a description of a material spilt, populate the secure electronically recorded log with a geolocation code associated with the spill incident, wherein the geolocation code is ascertained as a function of the approximate location of the spill incident, and communicate a notification to a Project Manager assigned to oversee remediation of the spill incident or a representative of a client that supplied the information regarding the spill incident.
assignees: RICHTER CLAYTON VAUGHN;WALDEN NATHAN;STEVENS AMANDA;EMERGENCY RESPONSE AND TRAINING SOLUTIONS INC

title_en: Systems and methods for forming and operating an ecosystem for a conducted electrical weapon
abstract_en: A system that creates an environment (e.g., ecosystem) for using, transmitting, and storing data from a CEW and other equipment. The information from a CEW includes a log maintained by the CEW. The log may include information related to the operation, maintenance, software, and deployment units used by the CEW. The information may be used alone or in combination with other information received and stored by an evidence management system for managing inventory, generating use-of-force reports, incident reports, and/or providing information related to equipment, such as a CEW, to the supplier of the equipment. Sources of information provided to an evidence management system includes equipment suppliers, CEWs, other cooperating equipment, records management systems of an agency, a dispatch system of an agency, and third parties. A CEW or other equipment may also receive information for storing in the log.

title_en: Commanding and monitoring device suitable for flight simulator
abstract_en: The utility model belongs to the flight simulation technical field and relates to a commanding and monitoring device suitable for a flight simulator. According to the commanding and monitoring device, a four-path hard disk video recorder capable of simultaneously receiving Vadio signals and/or VGA/DVI signals is selected; the output end of the hard disk video recorder is connected with a display terminal through using a VGA/DVI signal line; and either a single projection display unit or a display on an instructor stage can be selected as the display terminal. With the commanding and monitoring device adopted, required information can be obtained visually and conveniently; a variety of related data information of aircrafts in simulated training can be known selectively in real time; and subjective and objective information of trainees can be observed in real time. The commanding and monitoring device can be conveniently applied to development and simulation tactical confrontation networking.

title_en: A kind of monitoring device of driver's health
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a kind of monitoring device of driver's health, including housing, battery is provided with housing, accumulator channel wire is sequentially connected single-chip microcomputer, A/D converter, display screen, relay and brain wave sensor and forms closed-loop path；Relay also connects EGC sensor parallel with one another, recording playback module and GPRS module by wire；Display location is in surface of shell；Single-chip microcomputer, A/D converter and relay are respectively positioned in housing.The utility model by using brain wave sensor and EGC sensor use, not only monitor health of the driver in driving, and traffic safety of the driver in emergency situations can be avoided, reduction that can be limited is because the security incident that the health of driver is produced, it is simple in construction, there is good use value.
